Title: JƐNƐSIS 1
Content:
Jeŋbɔɔ he sane
1 Shishijee mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ. 2Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ olɛŋlɛ, ni efee flóŋŋ, ni duŋ ha nu babaoo ni ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ ha nu lɛ hiɛ.
3 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “La aba.” Kɛkɛ ni la ba. 4Ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ la lɛ hi. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbala la lɛ kɛ duŋ lɛ mli. 5Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ la lɛ shwane, ni duŋ lɛ etsɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ. Je na, ni je tsɛre, ni no ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ.
6Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Atatu aba koni eja nu lɛ mli enyɔ.” 7No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fee atatu lɛ ni eja nu lɛ mli enyɔ koni ana nu yɛ atatu lɛ shishi ni ana nu yɛ atatu lɛ yiteŋ; ni eba mli nakai. 8 Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ he ni atatu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ akɛ ŋwɛi. Je na, ni je tsɛre; no ji gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
9Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Nu ni yɔɔ ŋwɛishishi lɛ abua ehe naa yɛ he kome, koni ana shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ!” Ni eba mli nakai. 10 Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ he ni egbi lɛ akɛ shikpɔŋ, ni nu ni ebua ehe naa lɛ etsɛ lɛ ŋshɔ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi. 11Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ akwɛ̃ bai kɛ tsei kɛ jwɛi; tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, kɛ yeli tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ yɛ ehenɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!” Ni eba mli nakai. 12Shikpɔŋ lɛ kwɛ̃ tsei kɛ bai kɛ jwɛi; tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, kɛ yeli tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, eko fɛɛ eko kɛ ehenɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi. 13Ni je na, ni je tsɛre; ni no fee gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ.
14 Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Kanei aba ŋwɛi atatu lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ teŋ srɔto ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ okadii kɛ bei kɛ gbii kɛ afii, 15ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kanei yɛ ŋwɛi atatuiaŋ ni amɛtso yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ni eba mli nakai. 16 Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ kanei wuji enyɔ lɛ koni ewulu lɛ aye shwane nɔ ni bibioo lɛ aye nyɔɔŋ nɔ, ni ebɔ ŋulamii lɛ hu. 17Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ wo ŋwɛi atatu lɛ mli koni amɛtso yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, 18koni amɛye shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ nɔ, ni amɛgbala la lɛ kɛ duŋ lɛ mli. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi. 19Ni je na ni je tsɛre ni no fee gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ.
20Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Nu lɛ awo loi nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, ni loofɔji afliki yɛ ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli!” 21No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋshɔŋ loi wuji lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni tsiɔ ehe ni nu lɛ ewo nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ lɛ. Asaŋ ebɔ loofɔji fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi. 22Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛfɔa koni nyɛyi afaa ni nyɛyimɔa fai kɛ ŋshɔ mli obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni loofɔji afa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!” 23Ni je na ni je tsɛre, ni efee gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ.
24Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ awo bɔɔnii ni hiɛ kã yɛ amɛhenɔ: shĩa kooloi kɛ kooloi ni wamɔɔ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ!” Ni eba mli nakai. 25Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ kɛ shĩaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.
26 Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa gbɔmɔ adesa yɛ wɔsu nɔ, tamɔ wɔhenɔ, koni eye ŋshɔŋ loi kɛ loofɔji kɛ shĩaŋ kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ!” 27 No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ adesa yɛ esu nɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ nɔ ebɔ lɛ yɛ, ebɔ nuu, ni ebɔ yoo. 28 Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ amɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afa. Nyɛyea ŋshɔŋ loi kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni tsiɔ ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.” 29Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ tsei ni woɔ dumɔwui kɛ tsei ni woɔ yeli yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ehã nyɛ koni nyɛye.” 30“Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ kɔɔyɔŋ loofɔlɔ fɛɛ loofɔlɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ emli lɛ, mikɛ baa fɔ fɛɛ baa fɔ ehã lɛ koni eye!” Ni eba mli nakai. 31Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛ nibii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ, ni naa, ehi naakpa. Ni je na ni je tsɛre; ni no fee gbi ni ji ekpaa.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 2
Content:
1Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni agbe ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ fɛɛ bɔɔ naa ahã. 2 Be ni shɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ egbe enitsumɔ ni etsu lɛ fɛɛ naa; ni ejɔɔ ehe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ. 3 Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ ni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ no nɔ ejɔɔ ehe yɛ, be ni egbe ebɔɔ nitsumɔ ni etsu lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ.
4Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋbɔɔ he saji nɛ.
Eden Trom lɛ
Be ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ je lɛ, 5ŋa nɔ baa ko bɛ ni ŋa nɔ jwɛi ko nako akwɛ̃ ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hãko nu anɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni gbɔmɔ ko bɛ ni huɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 6Shi afua teɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ, ni eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ nu.
7 Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ sũ shɔ̃ gbɔmɔ, ni emu wala mumɔ ewo egugɔ mli, ni gbɔmɔ tsɔ bɔɔnɔ ni hiɛ kã.
8Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ fee trom yɛ Eden yɛ bokãgbɛ, ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ ni eshɔ̃ lɛ to jɛi. 9 Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hã tsei fɛɛ ni kɛ akwɛ ni aaaba mɔ tsine ni amɛhi hã yeli hu kwɛ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ sũ lɛ mli. Ehã wala tso kɛ ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋlee tso hu kwɛ̃ yɛ trom lɛ teŋ.
10Ni faa ko hoɔ yɛ Eden mli ni hãa trom lɛ nu. Egbalaa niji ejwɛ kɛjɛɔ jɛi. 11Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Pishon. Ehoɔ kɛbɔleɔ Hawila shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, he ni shika yɔɔ lɛ. 12Nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shika lɛ hi naakpa; ni bedola ojeŋma kɛ onike tɛ hu yɛ jɛi. 13Faa ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Gihon. Ehoɔ kɛbɔleɔ Kush shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ. 14Faa ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbɛi ji Tigris. Ehoɔ yɛ Asiria bokãgbɛ. Faa ni ji ejwɛ lɛ gbɛi ji Eufrate.
15Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ bato Eden trom lɛ mli koni ehu mli ni ebu he. 16Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ, “Trom lɛ mli tsei lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yibii lɛ ye bɔ ni osumɔɔ; 17 shi ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋlee tso lɛ yibii lɛ kaaye ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni oooye eko lɛ, gbo ooogbo!”
18 Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ehiii akɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ koome hiɔ shi, mafee hefatalɔ ko ni sa lɛ mahã lɛ.” 19No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ sũ shɔ̃ ŋa nɔ kooloi kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ; ni ekɛ amɛ ba gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ koni ekwɛ bɔ ni eeetsɛ amɛ; ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni hiɛ kã lɛ, no nɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ egbɛi. 20Gbɔmɔ lɛ wo shĩaŋ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ gbɛi; shi lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, anako hefatalɔ ko ni sa lɛ ahã lɛ. 21No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hã wɔ ni tsii nyɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ni ewɔ. Be ni ewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie eŋmawu wui lɛ ekome, ni ekɛ loo tsi wui lɛ anajiaŋ. 22 Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ŋmawu wu ni ejie yɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ fee yoo, ni ekɛ lɛ ba gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 23Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ,
“Mihe nɔ nɛ!
Wu ni jɛ miwui amli,
kɛ loo ni jɛ miheloo mli nɛ.
Mɔ nɛ lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ yoo
ejaakɛ nuu mli ajie lɛ kɛjɛ.”
24 No hewɔ lɛ, nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome. 25Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ, nyiɛ yayai, shi amɛhiɛ gbooo he.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 3
Content:
Gbɔmɔ toigbele
1 Onufu ji kooloo ko ni le ŋaa fe kooloi fɛɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ. Ebi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ trom lɛ mli tsei ayibii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ nyɛkaye lɛ?” 2 Ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ onufu lɛ akɛ, “Trom lɛ mli tsei ayibii lɛ wɔyeɔ, 3shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ tso ni yɔɔ trom lɛ teŋ lɛ nɔ yibii lɛ, ‘Nyɛkayea, ni nyɛkataa he tete, kɛjeee nakai lɛ nyɛbaagboi.’ ” 4 Onufu lɛ kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Jeee gboimɔ nyɛaagboi; 5shi moŋ le Nyɔŋmɔ le akɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛaaye eko lɛ, nyɛhiŋmɛi aaagbele, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ lɛ, ni nyɛaale ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ.” 6 No hewɔ lɛ be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ tso lɛ hi hã yeli ni efeɔ hiŋmɛi akɔnɔ ni tso lɛ baa mɔ tsine ni ehãa mɔ leɔ nii lɛ, etse enɔ yibii lɛ eko ni eye ni ehã ewu lɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu eko ni eye. 7Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiŋmɛi gbele ni amɛna akɛ amɛnyiɛ yayai. Amɛkpɛ agbãmi baa amɛkɛfee mama amɛkɛha amɛhe.
8 Amɛnu Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he ni enyiɛ trom lɛ mli be ni gbɛkɛnaashi kɔɔyɔɔ shwie lɛ; ni Adam kɛ eŋa lɛ tee amɛhe yɛ trom lɛ mli tsei lɛ ateŋ koni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akana amɛ. 9Shi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Adam ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyɔɔ?” 10Ni Adam kɛɛ, “Minu ohe yɛ trom lɛ mli, ni mishe gbeyei ejaakɛ minyiɛ yayai ni miyatee mihe.” 11Nyɔŋmɔ bi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ kɛɛ bo akɛ onyiɛ yayai? Te tso lɛ ni miwo bo he kitã akɛ okaye eyibii lɛ eko lɛ, no oye nɛɛ?” 12Ni Adam kɛɛ akɛ, “Yoo lɛ ni okɛfata mihe lɛ, lɛ ehã mi tso lɛ yibii lɛ eko ni miye.” 13 Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee nɛɛ?” Ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ, “Onufu lɛ ni laka mi ni miye.”
Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ
14 No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ onufu lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ ni ofee hewɔ lɛ, alomɔ bo yɛ shĩaŋ kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ ateŋ. Omusu nɔ ooonyiɛ, ni sũ oooye owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ. 15 Mikɛ nyɛɛ aaaŋmɛ bo kɛ yoo lɛ teŋ, kɛ oshwiei kɛ eshwiei ateŋ. Eshwiei aaatswa oyitso nɔ, ni bo hu oshwiei aaakɔ̃ enane tsitsi.”
16Yoo lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã mahã ohe ajara bo, yɛ omusuhiɛmɔ mli. Hejaramɔ mli ooofɔ bii yɛ; owu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ oootao, ni lɛ eeeye onɔ.”
17 Ni Adam lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Akɛni obo oŋa lɛ toi ni oye tso lɛ ni miwo bo he kitã akɛ okaye eyibii lɛ eko lɛ hewɔ lɛ, alomɔ shikpɔŋ sũ yɛ ohewɔ. Hejaramɔ okɛaana enɔ nii oye owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ. 18Ŋmei kɛ aŋɛ̃ŋlɛ̃ eeewo ehã bo, ni ŋa nɔ baa oooye. 19 Ohiɛ latsaa mli oooye nii yɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooku osɛɛ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ sũ mli; ejaakɛ emli ajie bo kɛjɛ; sũ ji bo, ni sũ mli nɔŋŋ oooku osɛɛ kɛaatee.”
20Adam wo eŋa lɛ gbɛi akɛ Hawa ejaakɛ lɛ ji adesai fɛɛ anyɛ. 21Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ kooloo hewolo fee atadei ehã Adam kɛ eŋa lɛ, ni ekɛwo amɛ.
Ashwie Adam kɛ Hawa kɛje Trom lɛ mli
22 Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Naa, gbɔmɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ wɔteŋ mɔ kome, ni ele ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ. Agbɛnɛ, eko lɛ eeekpã enine mli ni etse wala tso lɛ yibii lɛ eko ni eye koni ehiɛ akã kɛya naanɔ.” 23Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shwie lɛ kɛje Eden trom lɛ mli koni eyahu shikpɔŋ, nɔ mli ni ajie lɛ kɛjɛ lɛ. 24 Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shwie Adam, ni ekɛ kerubim kɛ klante ni miifo ehe ni kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ la to Eden trom lɛ hiɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ koni ebu gbɛ ni yaa wala tso lɛ he lɛ he.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 4
Content:
Kain kɛ Habel
1Adam kɛ eŋa Hawa na bɔlɛ. Hawa na musu ni efɔ Kain, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mina binuu yɛ Yehowa yelikɛbuamɔ naa”. 2Kain sɛɛ lɛ efɔ enyɛmi Habel. Habel tsɔ̃ tookwɛlɔ, ni Kain tsɔ̃ okwaafonyo. 3Yɛ mli aahu lɛ Kain kɛ eŋmɔshi nii lɛ eko yashã afɔle ehã Yehowa. 4 Habel hu kɛ etoi lɛ akromɔbii ni ewo fɔ ba ekɛbashã afɔle. Yehowa hiɛ sɔ Habel kɛ efɔle lɛ; 5shi ehiɛ esɔɔɔ Kain kɛ efɔle lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Kain mli wo la naakpa, ni etũ ehiɛ. 6Yehowa bi Kain akɛ, “Mɛɛba omli ewo la, ni mɛɛba otũ ohiɛ nɛkɛ? 7 Aso kɛji ofee ekpakpa lɛ, ohiɛ baŋ nyam? Kɛji ofeee ekpakpa lɛ, esha bu oshinaa lɛ shi, ni bo osɛɛgbɛ etaoɔ lɛ; shi bo lɛ ye enɔ kunim.”
8 Kɛkɛ ni Kain kɛɛ enyɛmi Habel akɛ, “Hã ni wɔya ŋa lɛ nɔ wɔba.” Be ni amɛyɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Kain te shi wo enyɛmi Habel ni egbe lɛ. 9Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi Kain akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ onyɛmi Habel yɔɔ?” Kain to he akɛ, “Mileee; ani minyɛmi lɛ, enɔkwɛlɔ ji mi lo?”
10 Ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee nɛɛ? Onyɛmi lɛ la miibolɔ kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ sũ mli eetsɛ mi. 11Agbɛnɛ alomɔ bo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni gbɛ edaaŋ ekɛmi onyɛmi lɛ la lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ. 12Kɛji ohu shikpɔŋ lɛ ebaŋ nii ehaŋ bo yɛ ehewalɛ naa dɔŋŋ. Kobɔlɔ kɛ shikpalɔ oootsɔ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!” 13Kain kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Mitɔmɔ lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo lɛ da fe bɔ ni manyɛ matere. 14 Naa, oshwie mi ŋmɛnɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni matee mihe yɛ ohiɛ. Mitsɔ̃ kobɔlɔ kɛ shikpalɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana mi lɛ, eeegbe mi.”
15Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Kain akɛ, “Dabida! Kɛji mɔ ko gbe Kain lɛ, aaatɔ Kain he owele shii kpawo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa to okadi yɛ Kain he koni kɛji mɔ ko na lɛ lɛ, ekagbe lɛ. 16Kɛkɛ ni Kain je Yehowa hiɛ etee, ni eyahi shi yɛ Nod shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Eden bokãgbɛ.
Kain Shwiei
17Kain kɛ eŋa lɛ na bɔlɛ, ni ena musu ni efɔ Henok. Kain to maŋ ni ekɛ ebi Henok gbɛi wo maŋ lɛ. 18Henok fɔ Irad; Irad fɔ Mehuyael; Mehuyael fɔ Metushael; ni Metushael fɔ Lamek. 19Lamek ŋɔ yei enyɔ: mɔ kome gbɛi ji Ada ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Zila. 20Ada fɔ Yabal, lɛ ji mɛi ni hiɔ bui amli, ni amɛlɛɔ kooloi lɛ atsɛ. 21Yabal nyɛmi lɛ gbɛi ji Yubal; saŋkutswalɔi kɛ blɛkpãlɔi fɛɛ atsɛ ji lɛ. 22Zila hu fɔ Tubalkain, ni ji ayawa nibii kɛ dade nibii fɛɛ sɔ̃lɔ lɛ; ni Tubalkain nyɛmi yoo gbɛi ji Naama.
23Lamek kɛɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ akɛ,
“Ada kɛ Zila, nyɛboa migbee toi,
Migbe oblanyo ko:
ejaakɛ epila mi.
24 Kɛji aaatɔ Kain he owele shii kpawo lɛ,
asonɔkwa Lamek lɛ, aaatɔ ehe owele shii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo!”
Set kɛ Enosh
25Adam kɛ eŋa Hawa na bɔlɛ ekoŋŋ, ni Hawa fɔ binuu, ni Hawa wo lɛ Set, ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bi kroko eto mibi Habel ni Kain gbe lɛ lɛ najiaŋ.” 26 Set hu fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Enosh. Nakai be lɛ mli gbɔmɛi bɔi Yehowa gbɛi tsɛmɔ kɛ lɛ jamɔ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 5
Content:
Adam Shwiei lɛ
(1 Kronika 1.1-4)
1 Adam shwiei lɛ ahe sane nɛ. Gbi ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ Adam lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ su nɔ ebɔ lɛ yɛ. 2 Ebɔ nuu ni ebɔ yoo ni ejɔɔ amɛ ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ “Gbɔmɔ adesa” gbi nɔ ni ebɔ amɛ lɛ. 3 Adam eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ momo dani efɔ binuu tamɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Set. 4Be ni afɔ Set sɛɛ lɛ, Adam hi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi. 5No hewɔ lɛ, afii abɔ fɛɛ ni Adam ye dani egbo ji afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
6Set eye afii oha kɛ enumɔ ni efɔ Enosh. 7Be ni efɔ Enosh sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpawo, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei. 8Hewɔ lɛ be ni Set gbo lɛ afii ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
9Enosh ye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu ni efɔ Kenan. 10Be ni efɔ Kenan sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei. 11No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Enosh gbo lɛ, afii abɔ fɛɛ ni eye ji afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ.
12Kenan eye afii nyɔŋmai kpawo dani efɔ Mahalalel; 13Mahalalel fɔmɔ sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi. 14Hewɔ lɛ be ni Kenan gbo lɛ afii ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋma.
15Mahalalel eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ dani efɔ Yared; 16ni be ni efɔ Yared sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi. 17No hewɔ lɛ, afii fɛɛ ni Mahalalel ye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ.
18Yared ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ dani efɔ Henok; 19ni be ni efɔ Henok sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi. 20No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yared gbo lɛ, afii abɔ ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ.
21Henok ye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ dani efɔ Metusela, ni be ni efɔ Metusela sɛɛ lɛ, eja Nyɔŋmɔ afii ohai etɛ̃, 22ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi. 23No hewɔ lɛ, afii ni Henok ye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ. 24 Henok mɔ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli waa, no hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee, ni no sɛɛ lɛ anaaa lɛ dɔŋŋ.
25Metusela ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpawo dani efɔ Lamek; 26be ni efɔ Lamek sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enyɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi. 27No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Metusela gbo lɛ, afii ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ nɛɛhu.
28Lamek ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enyɔ dani efɔ binuu. 29Ewo lɛ Noa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ baashɛje wɔmii yɛ wɔninenaa nitsumɔ kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔɔ wɔ yɛ loomɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ lomɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.” 30Be ni Lamek fɔ Noa sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ; ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi. 31No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Lamek gbo lɛ, afii fɛɛ ni eye lɛ fee ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo.
32Be ni Noa eye afii ohai enumɔ lɛ efɔ Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 6
Content:
Gbɔmɔ fee efɔŋ
1 Be ni gbɔmɛi bɔ̃i fɛomɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni afɔfɔɔ biyei ahã amɛ lɛ, 2 Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ yana akɛ gbɔmɛi abiyei lɛ ahe yɛ fɛo, ni amɛŋɔŋɔɔ amɛteŋ yei fɛɛ ni amɛsumɔɔ. 3 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mimumɔ lɛ nyɛŋ ahi gbɔmɔ mli kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ heloo ji gbɔmɔ ni ebaagbo ni afii abɔ ni ebaaye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.” 4Nakai bei lɛ amli kɛ no sɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔbii lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi abiyei lɛ fɔfɔɔ asaabui yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Bii nɛɛ tsɔmɔ gbɔmɛi kãkãlɔi ni agbɛii hehee kɛjɛ blema bei lɛ amli tɔ̃ɔ.
5 Be ni Yehowa na akɛ gbɔmɛi anɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ efa tsɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nibii ni amɛsusuɔ yɛ amɛyiŋ daa nɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, 6edɔ lɛ naakpa akɛ ebɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni Yehowa shwa ehe. 7No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Makpãtã gbɔmɔ ni mibɔ lɛ lɛ hiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ aahu kɛyashi kooloi kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ kɛ loofɔji anɔ ejaakɛ shi edɔ mi akɛ mibɔ amɛ.” 8Shi Yehowa na Noa he miishɛɛ.
Noa
9 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Noa shwiei lɛ. Noa ji jalɔ ni eye emuu yɛ eyinɔbii lɛ ateŋ; ni efeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii. 10Noa fɔ bihii etɛ̃. Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet. 11Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi efite yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi kɛ awuiyeli. 12 Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ efite ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ efite amɛjeŋba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
13 No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Noa akɛ, “Mito miyiŋ akɛ makpãtã heloo fɛɛ hiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ awuiyeli. Naa, mibakpãtã amɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. 14Ŋɔɔ timba ni okɛkpɛ adeka ohã ohe. Feemɔ tsui yɛ mli ni okɛ amã akpa emli kɛ ehewɔ fɛɛ kɛtsimɔ ehe fɔji lɛ. 15Bɔ ni ofee lɛ ohã nɛ. Adeka lɛ kɛlɛ ninetalɔi ohai etɛ̃, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. 16Hɛhɛmɔ adeka lɛ ni oha ekpa nu ninetalɔ kome yɛ ekoji anɔ. Haa adeka lɛ yiteŋ. Feemɔ shinaa yɛ adeka lɛ he. Feemɔ adeka lɛ sɔɔdoi etɛ̃: shishi nɔ, kɛ nɔ ni ji enyɔ kɛ nɔ ni ji etɛ̃. 17Ejaakɛ naa, mahã nu afua aha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni akɛkpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ mli lɛ hiɛ yɛ ŋwɛishishi nɛɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã. 18Shi bo lɛ mi kɛ bo aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ, ni ooobote adeka lɛ mli, bo kɛ obihii lɛ kɛ oŋa kɛ obihii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ. 19Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã yɛ heloo mli lɛ, ŋɔɔ srɔtoi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo, ni okɛya adeka lɛ mli koni ahere amɛyiwala afata ohe. 20Ŋɔɔ loofɔji yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ yɛ amɛhenɔ, srɔtoi fɛɛ lɛ, enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, kɛba oŋɔɔ yɛ adeka lɛ mli koni ahere amɛyiwala. 21Ŋɔɔ niyenii fɛɛ niyenii ni ayeɔ lɛ eko oto yɛ adeka lɛ mli. Obua naa oto ohã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ amɛ.” 22 Noa fee nakai; bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 7
Content:
Nu afua lɛ
(Luka 17.26-27)
1Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Noa akɛ, “Bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbotea adeka lɛ mli ejaakɛ bo ji mɔ ni mina akɛ jalɔ yɛ mihiɛ yɛ yinɔ nɛɛ mli. 2 Ŋɔɔ kooloi ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ kpawokpawo, nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ kooloi ni he tseee lɛ enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo, 3kɛ loofɔji hu kpawokpawo, nuu kɛ yoo, ofata ohe koni akɛhere amɛshwiei fɛɛ ayiwala yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. 4Shi eshwɛ gbii kpawo ni mahã nu aba abanɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni makpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni mibɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” 5 Noa fee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
6Noa eye afii ohai ekpaa be ni nu afua lɛ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 7 Noa kɛ eŋa kɛ ebihii kɛ ebii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ bote adeka lɛ mli yɛ nu afua lɛ hewɔ. 8Kooloi ni he tse kɛ kooloi ni he tseee kɛ loofɔji kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, 9 enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ Noa tee adeka lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ. 10Gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nu afua lɛ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
11Noa wala be mli afi ni ji ohai ekpaa lɛ mli, yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ, ni bu wulu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ hiŋmɛii fɛɛ fɛlɛ, ni agbele ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ; 12 ni nu tue ni enɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
13Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Noa kɛ ebii lɛ, Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet, kɛ Noa ŋa lɛ kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ aŋamɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, bote adeka lɛ mli, 14amɛ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ shĩa kooloi fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ waamɔ nii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Fijiatsɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ filikilɔi fɛɛ bote adeka lɛ mli. 15Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni wala yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ateŋ enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ Noa tee adeka lɛ mli. 16Heloo fɛɛ heloo ni hiɛ kã, nuu kɛ yoo, tee adeka lɛ mli taakɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã lɛ lɛ. Ni Yehowa ŋa Noa yi.
17Nu afua lɛ damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Nu lɛ fa, ni ewo adeka lɛ nɔ, ni adeka lɛ shi shikpɔŋ. 18Nu lɛ he shi, ni efa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni adeka lɛ tɛo nu lɛ hiɛ. 19Nu lɛ he shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu po ni eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gɔji ni kwɔlɔ fɛɛ nɔ. 20Nu lɛ kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni esu gɔji lɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ. 21Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loofɔji kɛ shĩa kooloi kɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi kɛ waamɔ nii kɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ plene. 22 Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni muɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ lɛ gboi. 23Akpãtã nibii fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloi kɛ waamɔ nii kɛ loofɔji anɔ; akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ Noa kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ adeka lɛ mli lɛ pɛ. 24Nu lɛ damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 8
Content:
Nu afua lɛ mii
1Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kai Noa kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi lɛ kɛ shĩa kooloi lɛ fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ adeka lɛ mli lɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko batswa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nu lɛ bɔ̃i kpɔ̃ŋmɔ. 2 Aŋamɔ nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ anaa; ni nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kpa. 3Nu lɛ hiɛ kpɔ̃ŋmɔ fiofio yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni gbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ nu lɛ nɔ gbɔ. 4Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, adeka lɛ yama shi yɛ Ararat gɔji lɛ anɔ. 5Nu lɛ hiɛ kpɔ̃ŋmɔ aahu kɛyashi nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ. Nakai nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ana gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ.
6Gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Noa gbele adeka ni efee lɛ samflɛ lɛ, 7ni etsu kwãakwãalabite ko. Kwãakwãalabite lɛ hiɛ yaa kɛ baa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nu lɛ mii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 8Kɛkɛ ni Noa tsu okpo ko koni ekɛna kɛji nu lɛ emii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lo. 9Shi be ni okpo lɛ tee lɛ enaaa he ko esɔ̃ ejaakɛ nu lɛ ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lolo. Hewɔ lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba Noa ŋɔɔ yɛ adeka lɛ mli. 10Noa mɛ gbii kpawo kroko, ni esaa etsu okpo lɛ ekoŋŋ. 11Okpo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ gbɛkɛnaashi, ni naa, mutso baa fɔ kɔ̃ enaa. Enɛ hã Noa na le akɛ nu lɛ emii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 12Esaa emɛ gbii kpawo kroko hu, ni etsu okpo lɛ ekoŋŋ, shi okpo lɛ ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa eŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.
13Eba mli akɛ Noa wala mli afi ni ji ohai ekpaa kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ, yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nu lɛ mii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni Noa jie nɔ ni ekɛha adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ekwɛ ni ena akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ egbi. 14Nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi kwraa.
15Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Noa wie ni ekɛɛ, 16“Jee adeka lɛ mli, bo kɛ oŋa kɛ obii kɛ obii aŋamɛi ni fata ohe lɛ. 17 Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã, ni ji heloo fɛɛ heloo ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ, loofɔji kɛ kooloi kɛ nii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, okɛ amɛ aje kpo koni amɛfɔ ni amɛyi afa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!” 18 Kɛkɛ ni Noa kɛ ebii lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii lɛ aŋamɛi ni fata ehe lɛ je kpo; 19kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ fɛɛ kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni tsiɔ ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ je kpo yɛ adeka lɛ mli yɛ amɛwekui anaa.
Noa shã afɔle
20 Kɛkɛ ni Noa ma afɔleshãa latɛ ehã Yehowa. Eŋɔ shĩaŋ kooloi ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ mli eko kɛ loofɔji ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ mli eko, ni ekɛshã shãa afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 21 Be ni Yehowa here afɔle lɛ ŋma jurɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Milomɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ hewɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nii ni gbɔmɔ jwɛŋɔ yɛ eyiŋ lɛ efɔŋ ni kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi; ni asaŋ mikpãtãŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã hiɛ dɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni mifee nɛɛ. 22 Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nidumɔ kɛ nikpamɔ, latsaabe kɛ fɛ̃ibe, Agbiɛnaa kɛ Aharabata, shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ sɛɛ efoŋ.”

Title: JƐNƐSIS 9
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Noa kpãŋ
1 Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ Noa kɛ ebii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afa, ni nyɛyia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ. 2Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ ashe nyɛ gbeyei ni nyɛheŋmiŋmi amɔ amɛ, nyɛdɛŋ atu amɛ awo. 3 Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni tsiɔ ehe ni ehiɛ kã lɛ atsɔ̃ nyɛniyenii, ni tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ shwie ŋmɔŋ ehã nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ehã nyɛ. 4 Shi loo ni lá ni ji ewala yɔɔ mli lɛ nyɛkayea. 5 Shi anɔkwa mabi nyɛlá ni ji nyɛwala lɛ shi; mabi shi yɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni kpãtãa lá hiɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni mabi gbɔmɔ lá shi yɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ ejaakɛ enyɛmi ji lɛ. 6 Mɔ ni shwieɔ gbɔmɔ lá shi lɛ, gbɔmɔ nɔŋŋ aaashwie lɛ hu elá shi kɛ̃ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ.
7 “Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afa; nyɛwoa shwiei babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛyi afa yɛ nɔ.”
8Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Noa kɛ ebii ni fata ehe lɛ akɛ, 9 “Naa, mikɛ mikpãŋmɔ miima shi mahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ni aaaba yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ, 10 kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ, ni ji loofɔji kɛ shĩaŋ kooloi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ni fata nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ. 11 Mahã mikpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ ama shi, ni nu afua lɛ ebapleneŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ nu afua ko ebakpãtãŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ.” 12Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ ekpãŋ kɛyaa yinɔi ni baaba lɛ fɛɛ lɛ he okadi. 13Mikɛ mikwaabuɛtɛ miito atatui lɛ amli, ni efee kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ je lɛ teŋ he okadi. 14Kɛji mihã atatui wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ana kwaabuɛtɛ lɛ yɛ atatui lɛ amli lɛ, 15makai kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ kɛ nibii srɔtoi srɔtoi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ, ni nu tsɔŋ afua ni eeekpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã hiɛ dɔŋŋ. 16Kɛji kwaabuɛtɛ lɛ fo yɛ atatui lɛ amli lɛ, mana ni makai minaanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni kã mi kɛ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ.” 17Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Noa akɛ, “Enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ he okadi.”
Noa kɛ ebihii lɛ
18Noa bii lɛ ni jɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ ji Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet. Ham ji Kanaan tsɛ. 19Mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ji Noa bihii lɛ; amɛmli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ jɛ gbɛ shwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
20Noa nitsumɔ ji humɔ; lɛ ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni fee waintrom. 21Enu wain ni etɔ, ni ekã ebuu lɛ mli kɛ ehe yayai. 22 Ham, Kanaan tsɛ lɛ, yana etsɛ yayaiaŋ ni eyakɛɛ enyɛmimɛi enyɔ lɛ yɛ agbo lɛ naa. 23Kɛkɛ ni Shem kɛ Yafet kɔ mama ni amɛkɛfɔ̃ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɔ̃ji anɔ ni amɛnyiɛ sɛɛsɛɛ ni amɛtee amɛkɛyaha amɛtsɛ yayaiaŋ, amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛhiɛ amɛhã sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛnaaa amɛtsɛ yayaiaŋ. 24Shi be ni dãa lɛ tserɛ yɛ Noa hiɛ ni ena ele nɔ ni ebi gbekɛ lɛ efee lɛ lɛ, 25ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Alomɔ Kanaan;
nyɔji amli nyɔŋ eeetsɔ̃
ehã enyɛmimɛi lɛ.”
26 Asaŋ ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, Shem Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
ni Kanaan atsɔ̃ Shem nyɔŋ.”
27 “Nyɔŋmɔ ahã Yafet shwiei ashwere.
Ehi Shem bui lɛ amli
ni Kanaan atsɔ̃ Yafet nyɔŋ.”
28Nu afua lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Noa hi shi afii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. 29Afii ni Noa ye dani egbo lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 10
Content:
Noa bihii lɛ ashwiei
1Noa bihii ni ji Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet ashwiei nɛ; amɛfɔ bihii yɛ nu afua lɛ sɛɛ.
2Yafet bii ji Gomer kɛ Magog kɛ Madai kɛ Yavan kɛ Tubal kɛ Meshek kɛ Tiras. 3Gomer bii ji Ashkenaz kɛ Rifat kɛ Togarma. 4Yavan shwiei ji Elishahbii kɛ Tarshishbii kɛ Kiprobii kɛ Dodanimbii. 5 Mɛnɛɛmɛi amli mɛi jɛ amɛgbɛ amɛshwã ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji kɛ ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ anɔ. Yafet shwiei nɛɛ hi amɛshikpɔji anɔ yɛ amɛwekui amli yɛ amɛmaji amli, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.
6Ham shwiei ji Kushbii kɛ Ijiptbii kɛ Libiabii kɛ Kanaanbii. 7Kush shwiei ji Sebabii kɛ Hawilabii kɛ Sabtabii, kɛ Raamabii kɛ Sabtekabii; Raama shwiei ji Shebabii kɛ Dedanbii. 8Kush fɔ bi ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nimrod, ni ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni tsɔ̃ kãkãlɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 9Eji gbɔbilɔ kpanaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, afɔɔ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Etamɔ Nimrod, gbɔbilɔ kpanaa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.” 10Eje emaŋtsɛyeli shishi yɛ Babilon kɛ Erek kɛ Akad. Maji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyɔɔ. 11 Ejɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛtee Asiria, ni eyato Nineve maŋ lɛ kɛ Rehobot Ir kɛ Kala 12kɛ Resen ni yɔɔ Nineve kɛ Kala maŋ wulu lɛ teŋ lɛ.
13Ijipt shwiei ji Ludiabii kɛ Anambii kɛ Lehabbii kɛ Naftubii 14kɛ Patrusbii kɛ Kaslubii kɛ Kaftorbii, mɛi amli ni Filistibii lɛ jɛ lɛ.
15Kanaan fɔ Sidon, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Het. 16Lɛ nɔŋŋ eshwiei ji Yebusbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Girgashbii 17kɛ Hivbii kɛ Arkbii kɛ Sinbii 18kɛ Arvadbii kɛ Zemarbii kɛ Hamatbii. Fee sɛɛ lɛ Kanaanbii akutsei lɛ gbɛ shwã, 19aahu kɛyashi amɛhusu lɛ shɛ Sidon kɛtsɔ̃ Gerar kɛyashi Gaza, kɛjɛ jɛi kɛtsɔ̃ Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ Adama kɛ Ziboim kɛyashi Lasha. 20Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ham shwiei lɛ. Amɛhi shi yɛ amɛwekuiaŋ kɛ amɛmajiaŋ yɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ anɔ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.
21 Shem ni ji Yafet nyɛmi nukpa lɛ hu yɛ bii. Hebribii fɛɛ lɛ Shem shwiei ni. 22Shem fɔ Elam kɛ Ashur kɛ Arpakshad kɛ Lud kɛ Aram. 23Aram bii ji Uz kɛ Hul kɛ Geter kɛ Meshek. 24Arpakshad fɔ Shela; ni Shela fɔ Eber. 25Eber fɔ bii enyɔ, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Peleg, ejaakɛ ebei lɛ amli agbala shikpɔŋ lɛ mli; ni enyɛmi lɛ gbɛi ji Yoktan. 26Yoktan fɔ Almodad kɛ Shelef kɛ Hazamawet kɛ Yera kɛ 27Hadoram kɛ Uzal kɛ Dikla 28kɛ Obal kɛ Abimael kɛ Sheba kɛ 29Ofir kɛ Hawila kɛ Yobab. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yoktan shwiei ni. 30Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ jɛ Mesha kɛtee Sefar bokã gɔŋ lɛ he. 31Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Shem shwiei lɛ. Amɛhi shi yɛ amɛwekuiaŋ kɛ amɛmajiaŋ yɛ amɛshikpɔji anɔ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.
32 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Noa shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekukpãa naa. Amɛhi amɛmajiaŋ yɛ amɛshikpɔji anɔ. Amɛmli jeŋ maji lɛ jɛ gbɛ shwã jeŋ fɛɛ yɛ nu afua lɛ sɛɛ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 11
Content:
Babilon Mɔɔ lɛ
1Tsutsu lɛ, jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ wieɔ wiemɔ kome. 2Ni eba mli akɛ be ni amɛfã gbɛ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, amɛyana ŋa kplenee ko yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛhi jɛi. 3Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfoa ntayaa ni wɔshãa ni egbĩ keketee!” Ni amɛna ntayaa ni wa yɛ tɛ najiaŋ, ni asaŋ amɛkɛ sũ tswãa tswa gbogbo lɛ. 4Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔtoa maŋ wɔhãa wɔhe, ni emli mɔɔ yiteŋ ayashi ŋwɛi, ni wɔkɛhe gbɛi koni wɔkagbɛ wɔshwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.”
5 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpeleke shi kɛba ni ebakwɛ maŋ kɛ mɔɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesai ema lɛ. 6Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, gbɔmɛi kome ni, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛwieɔ wiemɔ kome, ni nɔ ni amɛaafee wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ, eshishijee kɛkɛ po nɛ, etsɛŋ kwraa ni amɛaafee nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ. 7Nyɛhãa wɔkpelekea shi ni wɔyatsakea amɛwiemɔ lɛ ni wɔfee lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoisrɔtoi, koni mɔ ko akanu enaanyo wiemɔ dɔŋŋ!” 8 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gbɛ amɛ eshwã kɛje jɛi kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛfɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ too. 9No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Babilon, ejaakɛ jɛi Yehowa tsake shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ awiemɔ yɛ, ni jɛi Yehowa jɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shem Shwiei lɛ
(1 Kronika 1.24-27)
10 Shem shwiei nɛ: Shem eye afii oha ni efɔ Arpakshad yɛ nu afua lɛ sɛɛ afii enyɔ. 11Be ni Shem fɔ Arpakshad sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enumɔ eshwie nɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
12Be ni Arpakshad ye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ lɛ, efɔ Shela. 13Be ni Arpakshad fɔ Shela sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
14Shela eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni efɔ Eber. 15Be ni Shela fɔ Eber sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
16Eber eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ejwɛ ni efɔ Peleg. 17Be ni efɔ Peleg sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ eshwie nɔ, efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
18Peleg eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni efɔ Reu. 19Be ni efɔ Reu sɛɛ lɛ eye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
20Reu eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ ni efɔ Serug. 21Be ni Reu fɔ Serug sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ kpawo eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
22Serug eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni efɔ Nahor. 23Be ni Serug fɔ Nahor sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enyɔ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
24Nahor eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu ni efɔ Tera. 25Be ni Nahor fɔ Tera sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
26Tera eye afii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni efɔ Abram kɛ Nahor kɛ Haran.
Tera Shwiei nɛ
27Tera shwiei nɛ. Tera fɔ Abram kɛ Nahor kɛ Haran, ni Haran fɔ Lot. 28Haran gbo yɛ etsɛ Tera hiɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni afɔ lɛ yɛ ni ji Ur yɛ Babilon lɛ. 29 Abram kɛ Nahor ŋɔ yei; Abram ŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Sarai, ni Nahor ŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Milka, ni ji Iska tsɛ Haran biyoo lɛ. 30Shi Sarai fee kene, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebɛ bi.
31 Tera ŋɔ ebi Abram kɛ Haran bi Lot ni ji enabi lɛ kɛ eshaayoo Sarai, ni ji ebi Abram ŋa lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛje Ur yɛ Babilon koni amɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi be ni amɛbashɛ Haran lɛ, amɛhi jɛi. 32Tera ye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, ni egbo yɛ Haran.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 12
Content:
Yehowa tsɛ Abram
1 Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Jee oshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛ ojakumɛi ateŋ kɛ otsɛ we lɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ. 2 Mahã otsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple, ni majɔɔ bo, ni mahã ogbɛi ahehee, ni oootsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ! 3 Majɔɔ mɛi ni jɔɔ bo, ni mɔ ni lomɔɔ bo lɛ, malomɔ lɛ; kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wekui fɛɛ.”
4Kɛkɛ ni Abram yiŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni Lot kɛ lɛ tee. Abram eye afii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ, be ni eyiŋ kɛjɛ Haran lɛ. 5Eŋɔ eŋa Sarai lɛ kɛ enyɛmi nuu bi Lot lɛ, kɛ amɛnibii fɛɛ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛshɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ 6Abram tee ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛyashi eyashɛ Shekem; etseŋ kɛtee tso krɔŋkrɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ More ŋa lɛ mli lɛ he. Nakai be mli lɛ, Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 7 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Abram ni ekɛɛ, “Oshwiei mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã.” No hewɔ lɛ, Abram mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa, mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ. 8 Abram fã yɛ jɛi kɛtee gɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ Betel bokãgbɛ lɛ he, ni eshi ebuu yɛ jɛi; Betel ye anaigbɛ, ni Ai ye bokãgbɛ. Jɛi hu ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ ehã Yehowa, ni eja Yehowa yɛ jɛi. 9Abram tsa egbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya wuoyi gbɛ lolo.
Abram kɛ Sarai yɛ Ijipt
10 Shi hɔmɔ ko ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, Abram yiŋ kɛtee Ijipt koni eyato gbɔ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 11Be ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaashɛ Ijipt lɛ, ekɛɛ eŋa Sarai akɛ, “Mile akɛ yoo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ji bo, ni kɛ ana bo lɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo; 12ni eeeba mli akɛ kɛ Ijiptbii lɛ na bo lɛ, amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Eŋa ni.’ Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaagbe mi, shi bo lɛ amɛaahere oyiwala. 13 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ akɛ minyɛmi yoo ji bo, koni ahi ahã mi yɛ ohewɔ, ni miyi ana wala hu yɛ ohewɔ.” 14Be ni Abram bashɛ Ijipt lɛ, Ijiptbii lɛ na yoo lɛ akɛ ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa. 15Farao lumɛi lɛ hu na lɛ, ni amɛyajie eyi amɛhã Farao, ni abaŋɔ yoo lɛ kɛtee Farao we lɛ. 16Sarai hewɔ lɛ Farao hiɛ Abram jogbaŋŋ. Ni no hewɔ lɛ, Abram na toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tejihii kɛ webii kɛ weyei kɛ tejiyei kɛ yoomai.
17 Shi Abram ŋa Sarai hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã Farao kɛ ewe lɛ na amanehulu ni naa wa. 18No hewɔ lɛ, Farao tsɛ Abram ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee mi nɛɛ? Mɛɛba okɛɛɛ mi akɛ yoo lɛ oŋa ni lɛ? 19Mɛɛba okɛɛ akɛ onyɛmi yoo ji lɛ, ni ohã miŋɔ lɛ mifee miŋa lɛ? Agbɛnɛ naa oŋa, ŋɔɔ lɛ ni oya!” 20Kɛkɛ ni Farao famɔ hii komɛi eto ehe akɛ amɛyajie lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ gbɛ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 13
Content:
Abram kɛ Lot gbala mli
1Abram kɛ eŋa kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ je Ijipt, ni Lot fata ehe; amɛtee wuoyigbɛ. 2 No mli lɛ Abram ena nii babaoo: shĩaŋ kooloi kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika tsuru. 3Etsa egbɛfãa lɛ nɔ fiofio kɛjɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛtee Betel. Eyashɛ he ko yɛ Betel kɛ Ai teŋ, he ni eshi ebuu lɛ yɛ ni ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ tsutsu ko lɛ. 4 Biɛ Abram ja Yehowa yɛ.
5Lot ni kɛ Abram nyiɛ lɛ hu yɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ bui, 6ni no hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ faaa hãaa amɛ bɔ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaahi he kome, ejaakɛ amɛnibii fa. 7Kɛkɛ ni bei ba Abram koolookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ Lot koolookwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
8 Kɛkɛ ni Abram kɛɛ Lot akɛ, “Kaahã bei miiba mi kɛ bo teŋ kɛ mikoolookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ okoolookwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ nyɛmimɛi ji wɔ. 9Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ. Tse ohe yɛ mihe. Kɛji okɔ abɛkugbɛ lɛ, no lɛ makɔ ninejurɔgbɛ; ni kɛji okɔ ninejurɔgbɛ lɛ, no lɛ makɔ abɛkugbɛ.”
10Kɛkɛ ni Lot wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkpe, ni ena akɛ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ frɔ̃frɔ̃ aahu kɛtee Zoar tɔ̃ɔ. Etamɔ Yehowa trom lɛ aloo Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Yehowa kpãtãko Sodom kɛ Gomora hiɛ. 11Kɛkɛ ni Lot kɔ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni efã kɛtee bokãgbɛ. Bɔ ni fee ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛgbala mli nɛ. 12Abram hi Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Lot hi maji ni yɔɔ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ amli. Lot shi ebuu lɛ shii abɔ kɛyashi be ni eyashɛ Sodom. 13 Shi Sodombii lɛ yiwalɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛfeɔ esha amɛshiɔ Yehowa.
Abram fã kɛtee Hebron
14Be ni Lot kɛ Abram egbala mli sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Wo ohiɛ nɔ, ni ojɛ he ni oyɔɔ lɛ okwɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni onaa nɛɛ, 15 bo kɛ oshwiei mikɛbaahã kɛaatee naanɔ. 16 Mahã oshwiei afa tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu, ni kɛji mɔ ko aaanyɛ shikpɔŋ mlu akane lɛ, belɛ aaanyɛ oshwiei lɛ hu akane. 17Tee shi, nyiɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ nɔ, shi bo mikɛbaahã”. 18 Kɛkɛ ni Abram fã ebuu lɛ, ni eba ebahi Mamre tsei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ni yɔɔ Hebron lɛ amasɛi, ni ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 14
Content:
Abram here Lot yiwala
1Maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ Amrafel kɛ Elasar maŋtsɛ Ariok kɛ Elam maŋtsɛ Kedorlaomer kɛ Goiim maŋtsɛ Tidal abei amli lɛ, 2 maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fã ta amɛshi Sodom maŋtsɛ Bera kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛ Birsha kɛ Adma maŋtsɛ Shinab kɛ Zeboim maŋtsɛ Shemeber kɛ Bela ni ji Zoar maŋtsɛ lɛ. 3Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ fee ta kome yɛ Sidim jɔɔ lɛ ni etsɔ̃ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ agbɛnɛ lɛ mli. 4Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ sɔmɔ Kedorlaomer afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, shi afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtse atua. 5Afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Kedorlaomer kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni fata ehe lɛ ba ni amɛbaye Refabii anɔ kunim yɛ Ashterot-Karnaim. Amɛye Zuzbii anɔ yɛ Ham, ni amɛye Embii anɔ yɛ Kiriataim ŋa lɛ nɔ. 6Amɛye Horbii hu anɔ yɛ amɛgɔŋ Edom lɛ nɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi El-Paran ni kã shiaŋa kplanaa lɛ naa lɛ. 7Amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛba En-mishpat, (no ji Kadesh) ni amɛye Amalekbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, kɛ Amorbii ni yɔɔ Hazazon-Tamar lɛ hu anɔ.
8Kɛkɛ ni Sodom maŋtsɛ kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛ kɛ Adma maŋtsɛ kɛ Ziboim maŋtsɛ kɛ Bela, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zoar hu lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fã, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Sidim jɔɔ lɛ mli, 9ni amɛkɛ Elam maŋtsɛ Kedorlaomer kɛ Goiim maŋtsɛ Tidal kɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ Amrafel kɛ Elasar maŋtsɛ Ariok bawu; maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ wu. 10Shi Sidim jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amãtɛ bui sɔŋŋ yɔɔ jɛi. Awo Sodom kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ afoi, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi bui lɛ amli, shi maŋtsɛmɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ jo foi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 11No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ lɛ ŋɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora nii fɛɛ kɛ niyenii fɛɛ, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee. 12 Amɛŋɔ Abram nyɛmibi Lot ni yɔɔ Sodom lɛ hu kɛ enibii kɛtee.
13Shi nuu ko ni jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ ba ni ebagba Abram, Hebrinyo lɛ ni ehe shi yɛ he ni Mamre, Amornyo lɛ, wɔŋ koo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Shi Eshkol kɛ Aner nyɛmi ji Mamre; ni amɛkɛ Abram ekpãŋ. 14Be ni Abram nu akɛ aŋɔ enyɛmibi lɛ nom lɛ, ekɛ etsuji ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ ni le ta he nii, ni afɔ amɛ yɛ ewe lɛ, fã ta, ni etiu maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtee Dan. 15Ekɛ etsuji lɛ gba ta wo amɛhe nyɔɔŋ, ni enine tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni etiu amɛ kɛtee Hoba ni yɔɔ Damasko kooyigbɛ lɛ. 16Eŋɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enyɛmibi Lot lɛ hu kɛ enibii lɛ, kɛ yei lɛ hu kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba.
Melkizedek jɔɔ Abram
17Be ni Abram eye Kedorlaomer kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ kunim ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ tee eyakpee lɛ yɛ Shaveh Jɔɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi Maŋtsɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli. 18Ni Salem maŋtsɛ Melkizedek kɛ aboloo kɛ wain ba. Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ osɔfo ji lɛ. 19Ejɔɔ Abram ni ekɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ ajɔɔ Abram; 20 ni ajie Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni hã oye ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ yi.” Ni Abram hã Melkizedek nii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome.
21Kɛkɛ lɛ Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ migbɔmɛi lɛ ohã mi, shi haa nibii lɛ ŋɔɔ ohã ohe.” 22Shi Abram kɛɛ Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ 23akɛ kɛjɛ kpãa nɔ aahu kɛyashi tokota naa kpãa nɔ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji onɔ lɛ, kɛji mikɔ eko fii! Koni okakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi, mifee Abram niiatsɛ.’ 24Miŋɔɔɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja nɔ ni oblahii lɛ eye kɛkɛ, kɛ hii ni kɛ mi tee lɛ, Aner kɛ Eshkol kɛ Mamre; amɛ lɛ hã ni amɛŋɔ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.”

Title: JƐNƐSIS 15
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abram kpãŋ
(Hebribii 11.8-10)
1 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Abram wie yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, Abram, mabu ohe, ni mabaa oyi.”
2Shi Abram kɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni obaahã mi, mi ni minyiɛ ni mibɛ bi ni mɔ ni baaye migboshinii lɛ ji Eliezer, Damaskonyo nɛɛ?” 3Abram tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa, mi lɛ, ohãko mi shwie ko, ni nyɔŋ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ miwe lɛ baaye minii.” 4Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ yeŋ onii; shi moŋ bi ni aaajɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋ lɛ, lɛ ebaaye onii.” 5 Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abram je kpo ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ŋwɛi koo, ni okane ŋulamii lɛ akɛ ooonyɛ amɛ okane lo.” Ekɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Bɔ ni oshwiei aaatamɔ nɛ.”
6 Abram kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa na ehe tsuijurɔ.
7 Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa mɔ ni jie bo kɛjɛ Ur yɛ Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni maŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ mahã bo akɛ onɔ lɛ.”
8 Shi Abram bi akɛ, “Ao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni mikɛaale akɛ eeetsɔ̃ minɔ?”
9Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ tsinayoo ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ too abotiayoo ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ ojwɛni ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ kosɛɛ okpo kɛ shĩa okpo aba.” 10Abram kɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba. Abram folɔ amɛmli enyɔɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni eto fãfãi lɛ eshwie biɛ kɛ biɛ, eko yɛ eko ŋlɛnɔ; shi loofɔji lɛ efolɔɔɔ amɛmli. 11Kɛkɛ ni loofɔji ni yeɔ loo kpeleke shi basɔmɔ kooloi agbohii lɛ anɔ, shi Abram shwie amɛ.
12 Be ni hulu yaa eyanyɔ shi lɛ, wɔ ni tsii nyɔ Abram nɔ, ni duŋ kpii kɛ gbeyei ni naa wa mɔ lɛ. 13 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Na ole akɛ oshwiei aaatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni jeee amɛnɔ nɔ ni amɛaasɔ̃mɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ aaawa oshwiei lɛ ayi afii ohai ejwɛ. 14 Shi nakai jeŋmaŋ lɛ hu ni amɛaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ, magbala amɛtoi, ni no sɛɛ lɛ, oshwiei lɛ aaashi jɛi kɛ nii babaoo. 15Bo lɛ oooyanina otsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; ni aaafu bo be mli ni ogbɔ gbɔlɛ kpakpa. 16Shi yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ oshwiei lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba biɛ ekoŋŋ; ejaakɛ eshai ni Amorbii feɔ lɛ shɛko he ni kɛ eshɛ ni abaagbala amɛtoi.”
17Ni be ni hulu enyɔ shi ni hiɛ ebu lɛ, naa, kukwɛi kɛ emli la ni miifã lasu kɛ kɔti ni miitso gboŋaa batsɔ̃ loi fãfãafãi lɛ ateŋ kɛho. 18 Ni nakai gbi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abram kpãŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Oshwiei lɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã, kɛjɛ Ijipt faa lɛ naa kɛyashi faa kpeteŋkple ni ji Eufrate Faa lɛ naa. 19 Kenbii kɛ Kenizbii kɛ Kadmonbii 20 kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Refabii 21kɛ Amorbii kɛ Kanaanbii kɛ Girgashbii kɛ Yebusbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ.”

Title: JƐNƐSIS 16
Content:
Hagar kɛ Ishmael
1Agbɛnɛ Sarai, Abram ŋa lɛ fɔɔɔ; shi eyɛ weyoo Ijiptyoo ko ni egbɛi ji Hagar. 2 Ni Sarai kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Naa, Yehowa etsi mifɔmɔ naa. Okɛ minyɔŋyoo lɛ ayawɔ; eko lɛ mana bii kɛaatsɔ̃ enɔ.” Ni Abram bo Sarai toi. 3No hewɔ lɛ, Sarai ŋɔ Ijiptyoo Hagar, eweyoo lɛ, ehã ewu Abram gbãlã, be ni Abram eye afii nyɔŋma yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 4Abram kɛ Hagar na musu; shi be ni Hagar na akɛ ehiɛ musu lɛ, ewula lɛ heguɔ gbo yɛ ehiɛ.
5Kɛkɛ ni Sarai kɛɛ Abram akɛ, “Sane ni eŋɔɔɔ ni akɛyeɔ mi nɛɛ, sɔ̃ lɛ atere bo! Mikɛ miweyoo lɛ hã bo; shi kɛjɛ be ni ena akɛ ena musu lɛ, mihiɛ eshwiei shi yɛ ehiɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ aaakojo mi kɛ bo teŋ sane nɛɛ.”
6Shi Abram kɛɛ Sarai akɛ, “Naa, oweyoo lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; feemɔ lɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Sarai nyɛ Hagar hiɛ, ni Hagar jo foi kɛje eŋɔɔ.
7Yehowa bɔfo lɛ na Hagar yɛ nubu ko he yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ Shur gbɛ lɛ nɔ nubu lɛ he. 8Bɔfo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Hagar! Sarai weyoo, nɛgbɛ ojɛ? Ni nɛgbɛ hu oyaa?” Hagar to he ekɛɛ, “Miijo foi kɛjɛ miwula Sarai ŋɔɔ.”
9Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ kɛya owula lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oba ohe shi ohã lɛ.” 10Asaŋ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Hagar akɛ, “Fa mahã oshwiei afa babaoo bɔ ni anyɛŋ amɛ akane.” 11Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ Hagar akɛ, “Naa, ohiɛ musu ni obaafɔ binuu ni gbɛi ni ooowo lɛ ji Ishmael, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ena bɔ ni onaa nɔ ni oyoyro lɛ, 12shi gbekɛ lɛ aaafee enii tamɔ ŋaŋ teji, ekɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu kɛ lɛ aaana, ni ekɛ ewekumɛi efeŋ nɔ ko.”
13Hagar bi ehe akɛ, “Ani mina Nyɔŋmɔ lɛɛlɛŋ ni fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mihiɛ kã lolo nɛɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ Yehowa mɔ ni kɛ lɛ wie lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ni naa mi.” 14Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, atsɛ nɛkɛ bu nɛɛ akɛ, “Beer-lahai-roi”, eshishi ji, “Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni enaa mi” lɛ nubu. Nubu nɛɛ yɛ Kadesh kɛ Bered teŋ.
15Ni Hagar kɛ Abram fɔ binuu, ni Abram wo ebi ni Hagar fɔ lɛ gbɛi akɛ Ishmael. 16Abram eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpaa be ni Hagar kɛ lɛ fɔ Ishmael lɛ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 17
Content:
Ketiafoo akɛ Kpãŋmɔ lɛ he okadi
1 Be ni Abram eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ, Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, ba ojeŋ yɛ mihiɛ koni shwamɔ ko akahi ohe. 2Mikɛ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ mi kɛ bo teŋ, ni mahã oshwiei afa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.” 3Kɛkɛ ni Abram ŋɔ ehiɛ ebu shi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 4“Mi kɛ bo miikpãŋ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ maji pii atsɛ. 5 Atsɛŋ bo Abram dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ aaatsɛ bo Abraham, ejaakɛ mahã ofee maji pii atsɛ. 6Mahã owo shwiei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ni mahã majimaji ajɛ omli ni maŋtsɛmɛi aaajɛ omli.
7“Mahã mikpãŋmɔ ni kã mi kɛ bo teŋ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ, ni eeetsɔ̃ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ehã oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli; matsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ mahã bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ. 8 Mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni obato gbɔ yɛ nɔ nɛɛ baahã bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ. Kanaan shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ oshwiei anɔ kɛya naanɔ, ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.”
9Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Yɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ lɛ, bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛyinɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli. 10 Bɔ ni nyɛbaato mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaabaye osɛɛ lɛ teŋ nɛ: nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ afo lɛ ketia. 11Afolɔ nyɛ ketia, ni no atsɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ lɛ he okadi. 12Binuu fɛɛ binuu ni eyɔɔ nyɛteŋ ni eye gbii kpaanyɔ lɛ, afo lɛ ketia; binuu fɛɛ binuu yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ owe lɛ jio, akɛ oshika he lɛ yɛ gbɔ ni jɛɛɛ oshwiei lɛ ateŋ jio, afo lɛ ketia. 13Fo afo mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ owe lɛ mli kɛ mɔ ni okɛ oshika he lɛ fɛɛ ketia koni mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ahi nyɛheloo mli akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ. 14Nuu foolɔ ko ni afoko lɛ ketia lɛ akabu lɛ ashi mimɛi lɛ anɔ; eku mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.”
15Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Oŋa Sarai lɛ, kaatsɛ egbɛi akɛ Sarai dɔŋŋ, shi abaatsɛ lɛ Sara. 16Majɔɔ lɛ ni asaŋ mahã okɛ lɛ afɔ binuu. Majɔɔ lɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ maji anyɛ, ni maji anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi aaajɛ emli.”
17 Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni eŋmɔ, ni ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Ani nuu ni eye afii oha lɛ aaanyɛ ekɛ yoo afɔ bi lo? Sara ni eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu lɛ aaanyɛ afɔ bi lo?” 18Abraham kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Ao, mina ni kulɛ Ishmael yi na wala yɛ ohiɛ.”
19 Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Okɛ oŋa Sara lɛ baafɔ binuu, ni obaawo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Isak. Mahã mi kɛ lɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ ama shi ni etsɔ̃ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ehã eshwiei ni aaaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ. 20 Yɛ Ishmael hu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mibo bo toi. Naa, majɔɔ lɛ; mahã eshwere ni ewo shwiei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. Eeefɔ lumɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni mahã efee maŋ kpeteŋkple. 21Shi mikpãŋmɔ lɛ, Isak mɔ ni Sara kɛ bo aaafɔ biɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, lɛ mikɛaakpãŋ.” 22 Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abraham ewie egbe naa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ shi Abraham ni etee ŋwɛi.
23Kɛkɛ ni Abraham ŋɔ ebi Ishmael kɛ hii fɛɛ ni afɔ yɛ ewe lɛ kɛ hii fɛɛ ni ekɛ eshika he, nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ eshĩa mli bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ni efolɔ amɛ fɛɛ ketia yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie lɛ. 24Abraham eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu be ni afo lɛ ketia lɛ, 25ni ebi Ishmael eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ be ni afo lɛ ketia lɛ. 26Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ afo Abraham kɛ ebi Ishmael fɛɛ ketia. 27Abraham we lɛ bii fɛɛ, mɛi ni afɔ yɛ shĩa kɛ mɛi ni akɛ shika he yɛ gbɔi adɛŋ fɛɛ, afolɔ amɛ ketia afata ehe.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 18
Content:
Awo Abraham kɛ Sara binuu he shi
(Hebribii 13.2)
1Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Abraham yɛ Mamre tsei lɛ ahe, be ni eta shi yɛ buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa shwane ketekete lɛ. 2 Abraham yaawo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekwɛ lɛ, naa hii etɛ̃ damɔ emasɛi. Be ni ena amɛ lɛ, esha foi kɛjɛ buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi kɛtee koni eyakpee amɛ. Ekoto amɛ 3ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, kɛji ona mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ, miikpa bo fai, kaaho otsulɔ he ooya. 4Hã ni ayɛ nu fioo kɛba ni nyɛkɛfɔ nyɛnaji ahe, ni nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe yɛ tso lɛ shishi 5koni mayakɔ aboloo atrɔma kome kɛba ni nyɛkɛwo nyɛdaaŋ. No sɛɛ koni nyɛfoŋ kɛya, akɛni nyɛbatsɔ̃ otsulɔ ŋɔɔ nɛɛ.” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.”
6Kɛkɛ ni Abraham yiŋ kɛtee Sara ŋɔɔ oya mli yɛ buu lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Feemɔ mramra, tii mã kiloi etɛ̃ koni okpɔtɔ ni okɛshã aboloo.” 7Kɛkɛ ni Abraham sha foi kɛtee tsinai lɛ ateŋ ni eyamɔ tsinabi ni esako ni hi, ni ekɛhã etsulɔ ko, ni tsulɔ lɛ ye ehe oyai ni ekɛfee niyenii. 8Kɛkɛ ni Abraham wo butru kɛ fufɔ kɛ tsinabi loo ni akɛfee niyenii lɛ ni ekɛbamamɔ gbɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni edamɔ amɛhiɛ esɔ̃mɔ amɛ yɛ tso lɛ shishi ni amɛye nii lɛ.
9Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oŋa Sara yɔɔ?” Ni eto he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Eyɛ buu lɛ mli.” 10 Amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ maku misɛɛ maba oŋɔɔ wɔsɛɛ afi benɛ mli ni be ni maba lɛ oŋa Sara ena binuu.”
Sara damɔ buu lɛ mli gbɛ yɛ shinaa lɛ shi yɛ Abraham sɛɛgbɛ eebo toi. 11Abraham kɛ Sara fɛɛ egbɔlɔ ni amɛye afii pii, ni Sara ekpa tsuiasɛɛ yaa. 12 No hewɔ lɛ, Sara ŋmɔ yɛ eyitsoŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Belɛ migbɔlɛ nɛɛ mli be ni miwu etsɔ̃ nuumo nɛɛ, mɛɛ miishɛɛ wɔɔna yɛ nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ mli.”
13Yehowa bi Abraham akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ ni Sara ŋmɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Aso lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mi ni mitsɔ yoomo nɛɛ mana bi mafɔ lo?’ lɛ. 14 Ani nɔ ko wa hã Yehowa lo? Be ni mito lɛ maba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ afi naakplɔ benɛ, ni Sara aaana binuu!”
15Shi Sara tso ni ekɛɛ, “Miŋmɔko,” ejaakɛ eeeshe gbeyei. Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Dabida, oŋmɔ.”
Abraham kpa fai ehã Sodom
16Kɛkɛ ni hii etɛ̃ lɛ yi mli kɛjɛ jɛi ni amɛtsɔmɔ amɛhiɛ amɛhã Sodom gbɛ, ni Abraham kɛ amɛ tee eyajie amɛ gbɛ. 17Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ nɔ ni mibafee nɛɛ eteŋ Abraham. 18 Abraham baatsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa, ni abaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ, 19 ejaakɛ mile lɛ akɛ eeefã ebii kɛ ewebii ni baa yɛ esɛɛ lɛ koni amɛbo mi toi ni amɛfee nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja koni nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, miwo shi yɛ ehe lɛ aba mli.” 20 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni nibii ni awieɔ ashiɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora lɛ fa, ni amɛhe eshai lɛ efa naakpa hewɔ lɛ, 21 makpeleke shi matee mayakwɛ akɛ nibii fɔ̃ji ni awieɔ ashiɔ amɛ ni minuɔ lɛ eyɛ mli nakai lo? Ni kɛji ebɛ mli nakai lɛ, koni male.”
22 No hewɔ lɛ, hii enyɔ lɛ tsɔ amɛhe ni amɛtee Sodom gbɛ; shi Abraham damɔ shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lolo. 23 Kɛkɛ ni Abraham tsi ebɛŋkɛ Yehowa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ani oookpãtã jalɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ shi kome lo? 24Ekolɛ benɛ jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ aaahi maŋ lɛ mli. Ani kɛji nakai lɛ, oookpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni okɛfaŋ maŋ lɛ yɛ jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ ahewɔ? 25Enɛ akagbale bo fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ oooye nɛkɛ sane, ni ooogbe jalɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ shi kome, ni jalɔ aaana nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ nɔŋŋ lo! Enɛ akagbale bo! Ani shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kojolɔ lɛ, ekojoŋ kojomɔ ni ja lo?”
26 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mana jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ Sodom maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, mikɛbaafa maŋ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jalɔi lɛ ahewɔ.”
27Abraham here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miŋɔ mifɔ̃ minɔ akɛ mikɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaawie, tsɛbelɛ mi lɛ su kɛ lamlu kɛkɛ ji mi. 28Ekolɛ be nɛ, aaashwɛ mɛi enumɔ dani ashɛ jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ. Ani oookpãtã maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ mɛi enumɔ ni shwɛ dani ashɛ lɛ hewɔ?” Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Kɛji mana mɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ, mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ.”
29Abraham kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wie ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ekolɛ aaana jalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ jɛi.” Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mifeŋ nɔ ko yɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ ahewɔ.”
30 Abraham wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ mli akawo la akɛ mawie. Ekolɛ aaana gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.” Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mina mɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi lɛ, mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ.”
31Abraham kɛɛ akɛ, “Miŋɔ mifɔ̃ minɔ akɛ mikɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaawie. Ekolɛ aaana mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ jɛi.”
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ ahewɔ.”
32Abraham kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ mli akawo la kɛji mawie shi kome nɛɛ pɛ kɛkɛ. Ekolɛ aaana mɛi nyɔŋma yɛ jɛi.”
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ ahewɔ.” 33Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abraham wie etã lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋ etee ni Abraham ku esɛɛ kɛba shĩa.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 19
Content:
Sodom he eshai
1 Bɔfoi enyɔ lɛ shɛ Sodom gbɛkɛ mli. Lot ta shi yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Be ni ena bɔfoi lɛ, ete shi ni ekɛ amɛ yakpe. Ekoto shi ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi. 2Ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔmɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai, nyɛgbaa kɛbaa nyɛtsulɔ we lɛ koni nyɛbafɔa nyɛnaji ahe ni nyɛwɔa gbɛkɛ nɛɛ koni nyɛte shi maŋkɛ mra nyɛya!”
Shi amɛkɛɛ, “Dabida, wɔbaawɔ blohu lɛ mli.”
3Shi Lot hiɛ amɛ aahu, ni amɛbagbale eŋɔɔ; ni amɛbote ewe lɛ. Efee niyenii ehã amɛ, ni eshã aboloo, ni amɛye.
4Shi dani gbɔi lɛ yakamɔ shi lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli hii ni ji Sodom hii lɛ, oblahii kɛ hiimeji fɛɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ eshwɛɛɛ mɔ kome nɛkɛ po, babɔle shĩa lɛ kɛkpe. 5 Amɛtsɛ Lot ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ hii ni ba oŋɔɔ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Jiemɔ amɛ ohã wɔ koni wɔkɛ amɛ awɔ!”
6Lot je kpo eba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eŋmɛ shinaa lɛ mli yɛ esɛɛ 7ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miikpa nyɛ fai, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkafea nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ. 8Miyɛ biyei enyɔ ni nako ale nuu; nyɛhãa mikɛ amɛ ajea kpo abahã nyɛ, ni nyɛfea amɛ nɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; shi nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ lɛ nyɛkafea amɛ nɔ ko, ejaakɛ no hewɔ ni amɛba amɛbaba mi abo lɛ.” 9 Shi maŋbii lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Jee jɛi!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛtee nɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ bato wɔ gbɔ akɛ mɔkpɔŋ, ni eetao efee ehe kojolɔ! Agbɛnɛ wɔkɛ bo moŋ baaye sane fɔŋ fe ogbɔi lɛ.” Amɛbɔle Lot ni amɛtsi amɛba koni amɛbajwa shinaa lɛ. 10Shi bɔfoi lɛ kpã amɛnine mli, ni amɛsha Lot kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ shĩa lɛ mli, ni amɛŋa shinaa lɛ. 11 Ni bɔfoi lɛ hã mɛi ni damɔ shinaa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ shwila, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ; amɛtatra shi kɛtao shinaa lɛ naa gbɛ.
Lot shi Sodom
(Mateo 11.23-24; Luka 17.28-32)
12Agbɛnɛ bɔfoi lɛ bi Lot akɛ, “Ani oyɛ mɔ ko yɛ sɛɛ yɛ biɛ tamɔ shaanuu ko kɛ bihii kɛ biyei kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛkɛ ni ji onɔ yɛ maŋ nɛɛŋ lo? Okɛ amɛ aje biɛ. 13 Shi wɔbaakpãtã maŋ nɛɛ hiɛ, ejaakɛ nibii ni awieɔ ashiɔ amɛ lɛ naa wa waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni etsu wɔ koni wɔbakpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ.”
14 Kɛkɛ ni Lot je kpo ni ekɛ eshaahiimɛi lɛ ni baŋɔ ebiyei lɛ wie akɛ, “Nyɛtea shi, nyɛshĩa biɛ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baakpãtã maŋ nɛɛ hiɛ!” Shi Lot shaahiimɛi lɛ ŋɔ Lot wiemɔ lɛ akɛ shwɛmɔ nɔ ko.
15Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ tsirɛ Lot yisɛɛ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, ŋɔɔ oŋa kɛ obiyei enyɔ ni yɔɔ biɛ lɛ koni akakpãtã ohiɛ afata maŋbii lɛ ahe.” 16 Lot shashao shi, shi Yehowa na lɛ mɔbɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, hii lɛ mɔmɔ lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebiyei enyɔ lɛ aniji ashi, ni akɛ amɛ je kpo kɛje maŋ lɛ mli. 17 Be ni amɛkɛ Lot kɛ ebiyei lɛ eje kpo nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ Lot akɛ, “Joo foi ni ohere oyiwala; kaakwɛ osɛɛ, ni kaawa yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli he ko he ko. Joo foi kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ koni akakpãtã ohiɛ.”
18Shi Lot kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, miNuŋtsɔmɛi, ekaba lɛ nakai. 19Naa, otsulɔ ena hiɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni ona mi mɔbɔ kpeteŋkple akɛ ohere miyiwala. Shi moŋ minyɛŋ foi majo kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ; miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ aaabanina mi ni magbo. 20Naa, maŋ nɛɛ bɛŋkɛ bɔ ni aaanyɛ ajo foi kɛaatee jɛi. Edaaa moŋ nɛ, shi miyi aaana wala yɛ jɛi.”
21Ni bɔfo ni kɛ Lot wieɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mikpɛ̃lɛ̃ nɔ ni obi nɛɛ hu nɔ, ni mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ. 22Ohe afee oya ni ojo foi kɛya jɛi, ejaakɛ mifeŋ nɔ ko akɛ ja obote jɛi dã.” Akɛni Lot tsɛ maŋ lɛ maŋ bibioo hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Zoar.
Sodom kɛ Gomora fitemɔ
23Be ni Lot shɛ Zoar lɛ hulu eje. 24 Yehowa hã swɔɔ kɛ la nɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi eshwie Sodom kɛ Gomora nɔ, 25ni ekpãtã nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ kɛ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ maji lɛ amli bii fɛɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii ni ekwɛ̃kwɛ̃ɛ fɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ. 26 Shi Lot ŋa lɛ kwɛ esɛɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsɔ́ ŋoo kpɔ ema shi.
27Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa etee he ni edamɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ lɛ, 28ni etsɔ ehiɛ ehã Sodom kɛ Gomora gbɛ kɛ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekwɛ, ni naa, lasu miifã kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ flɔnɔɔŋ lasu. 29No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni eba lɛ nɛ. Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtã maji ni yɔɔ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kai Abraham ni ejie Lot kɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli be ni ekpãtã maji ni Lot hi mli lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
Moabbii kɛ Amonbii ajɛɛhe
30Lot kɛ ebiyei enyɔ lɛ shi Zoar, ni amɛyahi gɔji lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ Lot miishe Zoar hii lɛ gbeyei. Eyahi tɛkplo ko mli, lɛ kɛ ebiyei enyɔ lɛ. 31Kɛkɛ ni Lot biyoo nukpa lɛ kɛɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔtsɛ egbɔ ni nuu ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aaabaŋɔ wɔ ni ekɛ wɔ afɔ. 32 Ba koni wɔhã wɔtsɛ wain ni enu ni etɔ, koni wɔkɛ lɛ awo shwiei.” 33Ni amɛhã amɛtsɛ wain enu nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli. Onukpa lɛ yiŋ etee ni ekɛ etsɛ yawɔ, ni Lot leee be ni ebi lɛ bakã shi kɛ be ni ete shi.
34Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ biyoo nukpa lɛ kɛɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, nyɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mikɛ mitsɛ yawɔ; hã ni wɔhã lɛ wain enu gbɛkɛ nɛɛ hu koni bo hu oya okɛ lɛ ayawɔ koni wɔkɛ wɔtsɛ afɔ bii.” 35No hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã amɛtsɛ wain enu nakai gbɛkɛ lɛ hu; ni gbekɛ lɛ hu yiŋ etee, ni ekɛ lɛ yawɔ; ni Lot leee be ni ebi lɛ bakã shi kɛ be ni ete shi. 36Bɔ ni fee ni Lot biyei enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛ na musu nɛ. 37 Kromɔbi lɛ fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Moab; lɛ eshwiei ji Moabbii lɛ. 38 Ni gbekɛ lɛ hu fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Ben-Ami; eshwiei lɛ ji Amonbii lɛ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 20
Content:
Abraham kɛ Abimelek
1 Abraham fã yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ kɛtee wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eyahi Kadesh kɛ Shur teŋ, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Gerar. 2 Abraham kɛɛ yɛ eŋa hewɔ akɛ, “Minyɛmi yoo ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek, Gerar maŋtsɛ lɛ, tsu ayaŋɔ Sara abahã lɛ. 3Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ba Abimelek ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ yɛ lamɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, obaagbo yɛ yoo lɛ ni oyaŋɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko ŋa ni.”
4Shi Abimelek nako ata Sara he, no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ani ooobutu maŋ ko ni efeko efɔŋ ko lo? 5Ani jeee Abraham diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Minyɛmi yoo ji lɛ’ lɛ? Ni yoo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛmi nuu ji lɛ’ lɛ? Mihe nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ mi lɛ miye, ni nɔ ni mifee nɛɛ lɛ, mijɛ tsui ni tse mli mikɛfee, ni midɛŋ hu diii.”
6Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abimelek yɛ lamɔ lɛ mli akɛ, “Hɛɛ, mi hu mile akɛ onɔkwale fɛɛ okɛfee enɛ. Asaŋ, mi ni mitsi onaa koni okafee esha oshi mi, no hewɔ ni mihãaa bo hegbɛ akɛ ota ehe lɛ. 7 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛ nuu lɛ ŋa lɛ aku sɛɛ oyahã lɛ ejaakɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ, ni eeesɔle ekpa fai ehã bo, ni oyi aaana wala. Shi kɛji okɛ lɛ hãaa lɛ lɛ, no lɛ na ole akɛ gbo ooogbo, bo kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ji onɔ lɛ.”
8No hewɔ lɛ, Abimelek te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni etsɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ, ni ebɔ amɛ nɔ ni ba lɛ fɛɛ; ni hii lɛ she gbeyei naakpa. 9Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek tsɛ Abraham ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ? Mɛni esha mifee bo hewɔ ni otsi mi kɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ owo esha kpeteŋkple tamɔ nɛkɛ mli nɛɛ? Nɔ ni afeee ofee mi nɛɛ.” 10Asaŋ Abimelek bi Abraham akɛ, “Mɛni osusu hewɔ ofee enɛ?”
11Abraham to he akɛ, “Miyasusu akɛ ekolɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni amɛbaagbe mi yɛ miŋa lɛ hewɔ. 12Ni asaŋ eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ minyɛmi yoo ni, ejaakɛ mitsɛbi ni, shi jeee minyɛbi ni, ni etsɔ miŋa. 13No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mije mitsɛ we lɛ ni miyatsomlo lɛ, mikɛɛ miŋa lɛ akɛ, ‘Enɛ ji ejurɔ ni mitaoɔ ni ofee mi: He fɛɛ he ni wɔɔshɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ yɛ mihe akɛ minyɛmi nuu ni.’ ”
14Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek ŋɔ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ wehii kɛ weyei eyahã Abraham, ni ekɛ eŋa Sara lɛ ku sɛɛ ehã lɛ. 15Abimelek kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Mishikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ; hii he ni osumɔɔ.” 16Ni Sara lɛ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, mihã onyɛmi nuu lɛ shika jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe ni yeɔ odase yɛ mɛi ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ ahiɛ akɛ muji ko bɛ ohe.”
17Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsa Abimelek kɛ eŋa kɛ eweyei lɛ, ni amɛfɔfɔɔ bii, 18ejaakɛ kulɛ Yehowa eŋa yei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Abimelek we lɛ amusu naa yɛ Abraham ŋa Sara sane lɛ hewɔ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 21
Content:
Isak fɔmɔ
(Hebribii 11.11)
1 Yehowa baduro Sara tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ ni Yehowa fee nɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ ehã lɛ. 2 Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ to hã Sara lɛ shɛ, ni Sara na musu ni ekɛ Abraham fɔ binuu yɛ egbɔlɛ mli. 3 Abraham wo ebi ni ekɛ Sara fɔ lɛ gbɛi akɛ Isak. 4 Ni Abraham fo ebi Isak ketia be ni gbekɛ lɛ ena gbii kpaanyɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo lɛ kitã lɛ. 5Abraham eye afii oha be ni efɔ ebi Isak lɛ. 6 Ni Sara kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ewo minaaŋmɔlɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ aaaŋmɔ eko.” 7Asaŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kulɛ namɔ aaagba Abraham akɛ Sara aaahã ebii afufɔ? Shi mikɛ lɛ efɔ bi yɛ egbɔlɛ mli.”
8Gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni atse lɛ fufɔ; ni Abraham ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple gbi nɔ ni atse lɛ fufɔ lɛ.
Awo Hagar kɛ Ishmael gbɛ
9Shi Sara na Ishmael, Hagar Ijiptyoo lɛ binuu lɛ ni ekɛ Abraham fɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ Sara bi Isak miishwɛ. 10 Ni Sara kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Shwiemɔ tsulɔyoo nɛɛ kɛ ebi lɛ ni amɛya koni tsulɔyoo nɛɛ binuu lɛ kɛ mibi Isak akaja gboshinii lɛ. 11Wiemɔ nɛɛ eŋɔɔɔ Abraham naa kwraa yɛ ebi Ishmael hewɔ. 12 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, ‘Kaahã oblanyo lɛ kɛ otsulɔyoo lɛ sane lɛ miidɔ bo. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Sara aaakɛɛ bo lɛ, bo egbee toi ni ofee ejaakɛ Isak gbɛi mli aaatsɛ oshwiei agbɛi yɛ. 13 Tsulɔyoo lɛ binuu lɛ hu, mahã etsɔ̃ maŋ kpele ejaakɛ oshwie ji lɛ.’ ”
14Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa. Ekɔ aboloo ni ewo nu kɛ tɔ ekɛtswa Hagar kɔŋ. Ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ hu hã Hagar, kɛkɛ ni ewo lɛ gbɛ. Hagar yi mli ni eyatsomlo yɛ Beersheba ŋa lɛ nɔ. 15Be ni nu lɛ tã yɛ wolo tɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Hagar ŋmɛɛ gbekɛ lɛ he efɔ̃ koowie ko mli. 16Ni etee eyata sɛɛ flɛŋŋ aaafee tɛfɔ̃ɔ jɛkɛmɔ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Minyɛŋ makwɛ gbekɛ lɛ gbele.” Eho eta shi yɛ gbekɛ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ ni gbekɛ lɛ jwa yaafo.
17Nyɔŋmɔ nu oblanyo lɛ gbee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Hagar, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni gbaa onaa Hagar? Kaashe gbeyei, shi Nyɔŋmɔ enu gbekɛ lɛ gbee yɛ he ni gbekɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. 18Tee shi ni owo gbekɛ lɛ nɔ, hiɛmɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ejaakɛ mahã etsɔ maŋ kpeteŋkple.” 19Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbele Hagar hiŋmɛii, ni ena nubu ko. Eyiŋ etee, ni eyayɛ nu ewo wolo tɔ lɛ mli obɔ̃, ni ehã gbekɛ nuu lɛ eko enu. 20Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbekɛ nuu lɛ yɛ ni eda. Ehi shi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ gãitsɛ̃lɔ ni he esa naakpa. 21 Ehi shi yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni enyɛ yaŋɔ yoo kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ebahã lɛ.
Abraham kɛ Abimelek kpãŋ
22 Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Abimelek kɛ etatsɛ Fikol bakɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo yɛ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ofeɔ lɛ mli. 23 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akã mi kitã yɛ biɛ nɛɛ akɛ oyeŋ mi loo mibii loo mihɔi kutumpɔo; shi bɔ ni miyeɔ bo anɔkwa lɛ, nakai obaafee mi kɛ shikpɔŋ ni obato gbɔ yɛ nɔ nɛɛ.” 24Ni Abraham kɛɛ akɛ, “Makã kitã lɛ.”
25 Shi Abraham kɛ Abimelek wie kɛ dɔlɛ yɛ nubu ko ni Abimelek tsuji lɛ eshɔ̃ ekãa naa yɛ edɛ lɛ he. 26Ni Abimelek kɛɛ akɛ, “Mileee mɔ ni ye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, ni bo hu otsiii tã okɛɛɛ mi lɛ, asaŋ minuko da hu, akɛ ja ŋmɛnɛ.” 27Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ toi kɛ tsinai hã Abimelek ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãŋ. 28Abraham jie toi lɛ amli gwantɛŋ biyei kpawo eto afã. 29Abimelek bi Abraham akɛ, “Nɛkɛ gwantɛŋ biyei kpawo ni ojie oto afã nɛɛ, te eshishiŋ?”
30Ni Abraham kɛɛ, “Gwantɛŋ biyei kpawo nɛɛ, ŋɔɔ yɛ midɛŋ koni okɛye odase ohã mi akɛ mi mije nɛkɛ nubu nɛɛ.” 31 No hewɔ lɛ, Abraham tsɛ jɛi Beersheba, ejaakɛ jɛi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkãmɔ kitã yɛ.
32Amɛkpãŋ yɛ Beersheba. Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛ etatsɛ Fikol te shi, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. 33 Abraham tɛo tso ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ tamariske tso lɛ yɛ Beersheba, ni eja Yehowa, Naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi. 34Abraham to gbɔ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ be kplaŋŋ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 22
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ ka Abraham
1 Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ eba mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ka Abraham ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Abraham!” Ni Abraham kɛɛ, “Naa mi!”
2 Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ obi Isak ni ji obi koome ni odɔɔ ehe lɛ, ni oyiŋ oya Moria Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛ lɛ ayashã afɔle yɛ jɛi, yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ.”
3No hewɔ lɛ, Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ewo eteji nɔ nii, ni eŋɔ eblahii lɛ enyɔ kɛ ebi Isak lɛ efata ehe. Egba lai ni ekɛyaashã shãa afɔle lɛ; ni eyiŋ eeya he ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ. 4Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Abraham wo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ena jɛi yɛ shɔŋŋ. 5Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛɛ eblahii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ teji lɛ ahĩa biɛ; mi kɛ oblanyo lɛ miiya he ni jeɔ lɛ wɔyaja Nyɔŋmɔ ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.”
6Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ afɔleshãa lai lɛ tere ebi Isak, ni eŋɔ la lɛ kɛ kakla lɛ ehiɛ edɛ; ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ amɛyi mli amɛtee. 7Be ni amɛyaa lɛ, Isak kɛ etsɛ Abraham wie, ni ekɛɛ, “Ataa!” Etsɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa mi, mibi!” Ni Isak kɛɛ, “Naa, la kɛ lai nɛ, shi nɛgbɛ too gwantɛŋbi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ yɔɔ?”
8Abraham to he akɛ, “Mibi, Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ aaahã too gwantɛŋ ni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛtee.
9 Be ni amɛshɛ he ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, Abraham ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi. Eto lai lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni efi ebi Isak lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 10Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kpã enine mli ekɔ kakla lɛ koni ekɛgbe ebi lɛ. 11Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Abraham ekɛɛ, “Abraham, Abraham!” Abraham here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa mi!” 12 Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaahã onine miisa oblanyo lɛ he, ni asaŋ kaafee lɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko! Shi mina mile agbɛnɛ akɛ osheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, akɛni okamaaa lɛ obi koome nɛɛ lɛ.”
13Kɛkɛ ni Abraham wo ehiɛ nɔ; eyaakwɛ ehe lɛ, naa ojwɛni ko yɛ esɛɛgbɛ ni eklontoi elalaa koo. Abraham tee eyamɔ ojwɛni lɛ, ni eŋɔ lɛ eshã shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ ebi lɛ najiaŋ. 14No hewɔ lɛ, Abraham wo jɛi gbɛi akɛ “Yehowa aaakwɛ.” No hewɔ akɛɔ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ akɛ, “Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaakwɛ yɛ lɛ.”
15Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Abraham nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, 16 ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ, akɛni ofee enɛ ni okamaaa mi obi lɛ ni ji obi kome too lɛ 17 hewɔ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ majɔɔ bo, ni mahã oshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii kɛ ŋshɔnaa shia. Oshwiei lɛ aaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ kunim. 18 Ni oshwiei lɛ amli aaajɛ ajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ, ejaakɛ obo mi toi.’ ” 19Kɛkɛ ni Abraham ku esɛɛ kɛba eblahii lɛ aŋɔɔ. Amɛte shi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛŋɔ shwie nɔ kɛba Beersheba. Abraham hi shi yɛ Beersheba.
20 Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ abakɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Naa, Milka hu kɛ onyɛmi nuu Nahor efɔ bii.” 21Kromɔbi lɛ ji Uz kɛ enyɛmi Buz kɛ Kemuel ni ji Aram tsɛ lɛ; 22kɛ Kesed kɛ Hazo kɛ Pildash kɛ Yidlaf kɛ Betuel. 23 Betuel fɔ Rebeka. Mɛi kpaanyɔ nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Milka kɛ Abraham nyɛmi Nahor fɔ. 24Nahor hemɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Reuma lɛ hu kɛ Nahor fɔ Teba kɛ Gaham kɛ Tahash kɛ Maaka.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 23
Content:
Sara gbo, ni Abraham he fuuhe
1Afii abɔ ni Sara ye yɛ jeŋ ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo. 2Sara gbo yɛ Kiriat-Arba, ni ji Hebron ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Abraham ye Sara he ŋkɔmɔ ni efo lɛ.
3Kɛkɛ ni Abraham te shi yɛ egbonyo lɛ he, ni ekɛ Hitbii lɛ yawie akɛ, 4 “Mɔkpɔŋ ji mi, ni mibato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Nyɛhãa mi he ko mahe koni mikɛfee fuuhe ni mato miŋa gbonyo ni kã mihiɛ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi.”
5Hitbii lɛ here lɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, 6“Nuŋtsɔ, bo wɔ toi; wɔbuɔ bo akɛ lumɔ kpele yɛ wɔteŋ. Wɔfuuhei lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, fuu ogbonyo lɛ yɛ mli; wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ bo gbɛ akɛ okafu ogbonyo lɛ yɛ fuuhe lɛ.”
7Kɛkɛ ni Abraham te shi, ni ekoto shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni ji Hitbii lɛ, 8ni ekɛ amɛ wie ekɛɛ; “Kɛji nyɛyɛ he tsui akɛ mifu migbonyo ni kã mihiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛkpaa Zohar bi Efron lɛ fai nyɛhãa mi 9koni ekɛ etɛkplo ni ji Makpela tɛkplo lɛ ni yɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee he lɛ ahã mi. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ji tɛkplo lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ ehã mi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni mahe mikɛfee mifuuhe lɛ.”
10Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, ta Hitbii lɛ ateŋ, ni ehere Abraham nɔ bɔ ni Hitbii lɛ fɛɛ nu yɛ amɛtoiŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni boteɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ hiɛ akɛ, 11“Dabida, minuŋtsɔ, bo mi toi! Shikpɔŋ lɛ mikɛmiihã bo, ni tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ hu mikɛmiihã bo, mimaŋbii lɛ ahiɛ mikɛhãa bo yɛ nɛɛ, fuu oŋa lɛ gbonyo lɛ yɛ jɛi.”
12Kɛkɛ ni Abraham ho koto shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛɛ Efron yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ atoiŋ 13akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, bo mi toi. Masumɔ matse shika mikɛhe shikpɔŋ lɛ; hemɔ shika lɛ yɛ midɛŋ koni mafu migbonyo lɛ yɛ jɛi.”
14Efron here Abraham nɔ akɛ, 15“Minuŋtsɔ, bo mi toi. Shikpɔŋ ni naa ji jwiɛtɛi shekel ohai ejwɛ lɛ, mɛni ji no yɛ mi kɛ bo teŋ? No hewɔ lɛ, fuu ogbonyo lɛ.” 16Abraham kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ ehã Efron, ni eŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi ni Efron tsĩ tã yɛ Hitbii lɛ atoiŋ lɛ ehã lɛ, efee jwiɛtɛi shekel ohai ejwɛ yɛ jarayelɔi asɛnii tɛ naa.
17Kɛkɛ ni atu Efron shikpɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Makpela, yɛ Mamre bokãgbɛ lɛ, awo Abraham dɛŋ. Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ kɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ kɛ tsei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ehusui lɛ anɔ lɛ 18tsɔ̃ Abraham nɔ yɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ hu ni tee maŋ koi lɛ shi lɛ ahiɛ.
19Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abraham fu eŋa Sara yɛ nakai tɛkplo lɛ ni yɔɔ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ mli, yɛ Mamre bokãgbɛ (no ji Hebron) yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 20 Hitbii lɛ tu abɔɔ nɛɛ kɛ emli tɛkplo lɛ amɛwo Abraham dɛŋ, ni etsɔ̃ egbonyofuuhe.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 24
Content:
Aŋɔ yoo ahã Isak
1Abraham egbɔ, ni eye afii pii; ni Yehowa ejɔɔ Abraham yɛ nibii fɛɛ amli. 2 Abraham kɛɛ etsulɔ ni ji ewe lɛ mli onukpa ni lɛ ekwɛɔ nii fɛɛ ni Abraham yɔɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ba ni okɛ onine abahɔ mishuɔ shishi 3 koni mahã okã Yehowa, ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitã akɛ oŋɔŋ Kanaanbii ni miyɔɔ amɛteŋ nɛɛ abiyei lɛ eko akɛ ŋa ohaŋ mibi Isak; 4shi moŋ oootee mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ miweku lɛ mli ni oyaŋɔ yoo obahã lɛ.”
5Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, “Ekolɛ, yoo lɛ ebakpɛlɛŋ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Kɛ eba lɛ nakai lɛ, ani mikɛ obi lɛ aku sɛɛ aya shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni ojɛ kɛba lɛ lo?”
6Abraham kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okɛ mibi lɛ akaku sɛɛ kɛmiiya jɛi. 7 Yehowa, ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ mi kɛjɛ mitsɛ we lɛ kɛ miwekumɛi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ mi wie ni ekã mi kitã akɛ, ‘Oshwiei maŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ mahã lɛ,’ lɛ eeetsu ebɔfo kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ ni oyaŋɔ yoo kɛjɛ jɛi obahã mibi lɛ. 8Kɛji yoo lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ eeenyiɛ osɛɛ kɛba lɛ, no lɛ, ohe eje mikitã nɛɛ mli; mibi lɛ kɛkɛ ni okɛ lɛ akaku sɛɛ kɛmiiya jɛi.” 9Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛ enine hɔ enuŋtsɔ Abraham shuɔ shishi ni ekã lɛ kitã yɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ.
10 Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ enuŋtsɔ yoomai lɛ ateŋ nyɔŋma, ni eŋɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ nikeenii kpakpai srɔtoi ehiɛ edɛ̃ŋ, ni eyiŋ kɛtee maŋ he ni Nahor hi yɛ Mesopotamia kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 11Tsulɔ lɛ hã yoomai lɛ bumɔ shi yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ, yɛ nubu ko he, gbɛkɛnaashi be mli ni yei jeɔ kpo baa nuyɛɛ lɛ. 12Esɔle ekɛɛ “Ao, Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ! Miikpa bo fai ni ohã mihe aba nii ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni ojie osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ minuŋtsɔ Abraham. 13Naa, midamɔ nubu nɛɛ he, ni maŋ lɛ mli bii abiyei miije kpo miiba nuyɛɛ. 14Hã aba mli akɛ oblayoo mɔ ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Miikpa bo fai, too ogbɛ lɛ kɛba shi ni manu nu lɛ eko,’ ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuu, ni mahã oyomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu’ lɛ, lɛ efee mɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ojie ohã otsulɔ Isak. Enɛ mikɛaale akɛ ojie osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ minuŋtsɔ.”
15 Enaa naaa anyɔ shi kɛkɛ lɛ naa Rebeka, Betuel biyoo lɛ, ni eje kpo eeba ni egbɛ tswa ekɔŋ. Betuel nɛɛ, Abraham nyɛmi Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka bi ji lɛ. 16Oblayoo nɛɛ ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa; oblayoo foro ni, ni nuu ko etako ehe dã. Ekpeleke shi kɛtee bu lɛ mli ni eyawo egbɛ lɛ obɔ̃, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo kɛba. 17Abraham tsulɔ lɛ sha foi ekɛ lɛ yakpe ni ekɛɛ, “Miikpa bo fai ni ohã manu ogbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ fioo.” 18Oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ, “Nuu, minuŋtsɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni ehe fee oya ni eto gbɛ lɛ ehiɛ edɛ̃ŋ ni ehã lɛ nu enu. 19Be ni tsulɔ lɛ enu egbe naa lɛ, oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ, “Mayɛ eko mahã oyomai lɛ hu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaanu amɛtã.” 20Ehe fee oya ni etsɔ̃ egbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ ewo nunumɔ nɔ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni esha foi etee bu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ eyayɛ nu lɛ ni eyɛ ehã yoomai lɛ fɛɛ. 21Tsulɔ lɛ fee diŋŋ ni ekwɛ oblayoo lɛ too koni ekɛle akɛ Yehowa ehã egbɛfãa lɛ efee omanye lo.
22Be ni yoomai lɛ enu nu lɛ egbe naa lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi ga ni jara wa ekɛwo oblayoo lɛ gugɔŋ, ni eŋɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi nineshi gai agboi enyɔ hu ekɛwo oblayoo lɛ niji. 23Kɛkɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ biyoo ji bo? Kɛɛmɔ mi koo! Ani wɔɔna gbɛ yɛ otsɛ we lɛ koni wɔyato jɛi?”
24Oblayoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka bi Betuel lɛ biyoo ji mi.” 25Asaŋ oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ jwɛi kɛ kooloi aniyenii pii, ni gbɛ hu yɛ bɔ ni aaanyɛ ato jɛi.”
26Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ma eyi shi, ni eja Yehowa ni ekɛɛ, 27“Aaajie Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi akɛ ehãko esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enɔkwayeli lɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ minuŋtsɔ nɔ; ni mi hu Yehowa ebatsɔ̃ɔ mi minuŋtsɔ wekumɛi awe gbɛ!”
28Kɛkɛ ni oblayoo lɛ sha foi kɛtee eyagba mɛi ni yɔɔ enyɛ we lɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ. 29Rebeka yɛ nyɛmi nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Laban; Laban nɛɛ sha foi kɛje kpo ni etee nuu lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ nubu lɛ he. 30Be ni Laban na ga lɛ kɛ nineshi gai lɛ yɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ niji, ni asaŋ enu wiemɔi ni Rebeka kɛɛ nuu lɛ kɛ lɛ wie lɛ, eba nuu lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ he ni edamɔ yɛ yoomai lɛ amasɛi yɛ bu lɛ he lɛ, 31ni Laban kɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Ba shĩa, bo mɔ ni Yehowa ejɔɔ bo! Mɛɛ hewɔ odamɔ ŋmaŋmasha? Shi misaa shĩa lɛ mihã bo, kɛ gbɛ hu mihã yoomai lɛ.”
32No hewɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ ba shĩa lɛ, ni Laban jie yoomai lɛ anɔ nii lɛ. Ehã nuu lɛ jwɛi kɛ niyenii ni akɛhã yoomai lɛ. Asaŋ ehã tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ nu ni amɛkɛfɔ amɛnaji ahe. 33Kɛkɛ ni akɛ niyenii bama tsulɔ lɛ hiɛ koni eye. Shi tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Miyeŋ nii ja mibɔ mimaniɛ ni mihiɛ kɛba lɛ dã.” Ni Laban kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wiemɔ!”
34No hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Abraham tsulɔ ji mi. 35Yehowa ejɔɔ minuŋtsɔ naakpa, ni etsɔ̃ niiatsɛ wulu. Yehowa ehã lɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ webii kɛ weyei kɛ yoomai kɛ tejii. 36Minuŋtsɔ ŋa Sara kɛ minuŋtsɔ fɔ binuu be ni Sara egbɔ sɛɛ, ni minuŋtsɔ Abraham eŋɔ enii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ ehã ebinuu nɛɛ. 37Minuŋtsɔ hã mikã kitã akɛ, ‘Kaaŋɔ Kanaanbii, mɛi ashikpɔŋ nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ abiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko akɛ ŋa ohã mibinuu lɛ; 38shi moŋ yaa mitsɛ we lɛ kɛ wekumɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ koni oyaŋɔ ŋa obahã mibinuu lɛ.’ 39Ni mikɛɛ minuŋtsɔ akɛ, ‘Eko lɛ yoo lɛ ebanyiɛŋ misɛɛ kɛbaŋ.’ 40 Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yehowa, mɔ toi ni miboɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ, aaatsu ebɔfo afata ohe, ni eeehã oye omanye, ni obaaya oyaŋɔ ŋa yɛ mijaku kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ obahã mibinuu lɛ. 41Ja nakai dani ohe aaaje mikitã nɛɛ mli. Kɛji otee mijakubii aŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ yoo lɛ hãaa bo lɛ, no lɛ ohe eje mikitã lɛ mli.’
42“Be ni mibashɛ nubu lɛ he ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, misɔle mikɛɛ, ‘Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛji ooohã migbɛ ni minyiɛ nɛɛ afee omanye lɛ, 43no lɛ naa miidamɔ nubu nɛɛ he, ni hã aba mli akɛ oblayoo ni aaaje kpo aba nuyɛɛ ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ miikpa bo fai ni ohã mi ogbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ fioo manu, 44ni eeekɛɛ mi akɛ, nuu, ni masaa mayɛ eko mahã oyomai lɛ hu lɛ, hã lɛ efee yoo krɛdɛɛ ni Yehowa ejie ehã minuŋtsɔ bi lɛ.’ 45Be ni mikɛɛ miwieɔ migbeɔ naa yɛ miyitsoŋ pɛ lɛ, naa, Rebeka epue ni egbɛ tswa ekɔŋ kɛmiiba. Ekpeleke shi kɛtee bu lɛ mli eyayɛ nu. Mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ ni ohã mi nu lɛ fioo.’
46“Ehe fee oya, ni eto egbɛ lɛ ehiɛ edɛ̃ŋ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nuu ni mahã oyomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu!’ No hewɔ lɛ, minu, ni ehã yoomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu. 47Kɛkɛ ni mibi lɛ akɛ, ‘Namɔ bi ji bo?’ Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka binuu Betuel lɛ bi ji mi’. No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ ga lɛ wo egugɔŋ, ni mikɛ nineshi gai lɛ wo eniji. 48Kɛkɛ ni mima miyi shi, ni mija Yehowa, ni mijie Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ jurɔ koni mikɛbaŋɔ minuŋtsɔ wekunyo biyoo mahã ebinuu lɛ. 49Agbɛnɛ kɛji nyɛkɛ minuŋtsɔ aaaye yɛ mlihilɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli naa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkɛa mi ni kɛjeee nakai hu, nyɛkɛa mi, koni male bɔ ni mafee.”
50Kɛkɛ ni Laban kɛ Betuel here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ŋɔɔ sane nɛɛ jɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, wɔbɛ nɔ ko ni wɔbaakɛɛ. 51Naa, Rebeka lɛ nɛ, ŋɔɔ lɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya ni eyatsɔ onuŋtsɔ binuu lɛ ŋa, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ.” 52Be ni Abraham tsulɔ lɛ nu amɛnaa wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, eho ebu shi ni eja Yehowa. 53Agbɛnɛ tsulɔ lɛ jie jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii kɛ mamai kɛba, ni ekɛhã Rebeka. Asaŋ ehã Rebeka nyɛmi nuu lɛ kɛ enyɛ hu nibii ni jara wa.
54Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ ye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Amɛwɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ. Be ni amɛte shi leebi lɛ, Abraham tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa mi gbɛ koni maya minuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ.”
55Shi Rebeka nyɛmi nuu lɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã oblayoo lɛ kɛ wɔ ahi shi gbii fioo, akɛ gbii nyɔŋma nɛkɛ, koni no sɛɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya.”
56Shi tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkatsia minaa, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã migbɛfãa lɛ eye omanye; nyɛwoa mi gbɛ ni maya minuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ!”
57Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔbaatsɛ oblayoo lɛ koni wɔbi edaaŋ gbee.” 58Amɛtsɛ lɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ nuu nɛɛ aaatee lo?” Ni Rebeka kɛɛ akɛ, “Matee.”
59Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo amɛnyɛmi yoo Rebeka kɛ tsulɔyoo nukpa kɛ Abraham tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe kɛba lɛ gbɛ.
60Amɛjɔɔ Rebeka amɛkɛɛ,
“Wɔnyɛmi yoo, tsɔ mɛi akpei huhaa anyɛ,
ni oshwiei aye amɛhenyɛlɔi amaji anɔ kunim.”
61Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka kɛ eblayei lɛ te shi, ni amɛho amɛtara yoomai lɛ anɔ koni amɛya; kɛkɛ ni Abraham tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ Rebeka, ni amɛŋɔ shwie nɔ.
62 Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Isak ejɛ nubu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ, “Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni enaa nii lɛ nubu” lɛ kpokpai anɔ eba. Nubu nɛɛ yɛ Kanaan wuoyigbɛ. 63Gbɛkɛnaashi mli lɛ, Isak je kpo etee ŋa lɛ nɔ eyaashwie eyiŋ. Be ni ewo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, naa yoomai miiba. 64Rebeka hu wo ehiɛ nɔ, ni be ni ena Isak lɛ, eje yooma lɛ nɔ eyi shi. 65Ebi Abraham tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni nyiɛ ŋa lɛ mli kɛbaa ni ekɛ wɔ abakpe nɛɛ, namɔ ni?” Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ lɛ ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka kɔ ehiɛhaa nɔ lɛ ni ekɛha ehiɛ.
66Tsulɔ lɛ gba Isak nii fɛɛ ni eyatsu lɛ. 67 Kɛkɛ ni Isak kɛ Rebeka ba buu ni enyɛ Sara hi mli lɛ mli. Isak ŋɔ Rebeka ni ebatsɔ eŋa ni esumɔ lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, Rebeka shɛje Isak mii yɛ enyɛ gbele lɛ sɛɛ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 25
Content:
Abraham ŋɔ Ketura akɛ ŋa
(1 Kronika 1.32-33)
1 Abraham ŋɔ yoo kroko. Yoo lɛ gbɛi ji Ketura. 2Abraham kɛ Ketura fɔ Zimran kɛ Yokshan kɛ Medan kɛ Midian kɛ Ishbak kɛ Shua. 3Yokshan fɔ Sheba kɛ Dedan. Dedan bii ji Ashurbii kɛ Letushbii kɛ Leumbii; 4Midian bii ji Efa kɛ Efer kɛ Hanok kɛ Abida kɛ Eldaa. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Ketura shwiei ni.
5Abraham kɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ hã Isak. 6Shi ehemɛi lɛ abii lɛ, Abraham hã amɛ nikeenii be mli ni ehiɛ kã beebe, ni ewo amɛ gbɛ kɛje ebi Isak he kɛtee bokãgbɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Abraham gbele kɛ efuu
7Afii abɔ ni Abraham ye dani egbo ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ. 8 Ni Abraham gbo yɛ gbɔlɛ kpakpa mli, nuumo ni, ni egbɔ kotokoto. 9Isak kɛ Ishmael ni ji ebii lɛ fu lɛ yɛ Makpela tɛkplo lɛ mli. Tɛkplo nɛɛ yɛ Efron, ni ji Zohar Hitnyo lɛ bi lɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Mamre bokãgbɛ lɛ mli. 10 Abraham he nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ Hitbii lɛ adɛŋ. Jɛi afu Abraham kɛ eŋa Sara fɛɛ yɛ. 11 Abraham gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ebinuu Isak. Ehi shi yɛ “Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni naa mi” lɛ nubu lɛ he.
Ishmael Shwiei
(1 Kronika 1.28-31)
12Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Abraham bi Ishmael ni Ijiptyoo Hagar ni ji Sara weyoo lɛ kɛ Abraham fɔ lɛ shwiei. 13Yɛ fɔmɔ naa lɛ, Ishmael bihii lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Nebaiot, lɛ ji kromɔ, kɛ Kedar kɛ Abdeel kɛ Mibsam 14kɛ Mishma kɛ Duma kɛ Masa 15kɛ Hadad kɛ Tema kɛ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Kedema. 16 Ishmael bihii lɛ, amɛ ji akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ablematsɛmɛi, ni akɛ amɛgbɛii wo amɛkrowai kɛ amɛshitoohei lɛ. 17Afii abɔ ni Ishmael ye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo. Egbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ ewekumɛi ateŋ. 18 Ishmael shwiei nɛɛ he shi kɛjɛ Hawila kɛyashi Shur. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Ijipt ŋlɛnɔ kɛyaa Asiria gbɛ. Amɛtse amɛhe kɛje Abraham shwiei krokomɛi lɛ ahe.
Esau kɛ Yakob fɔmɔ
19Abraham bi Isak shwiei nɛ: Abraham fɔ Isak. 20Isak eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni eŋɔ Rebeka ni ji Betuel Aramnyo ni jɛ Mesopotamia lɛ biyoo lɛ. Laban, Aramnyo lɛ nyɛmi yoo ni. 21Isak kpa Yehowa fai ehã eŋa lɛ ejaakɛ efee kene. Yehowa bo efaikpamɔ lɛ toi ni eŋa Rebeka na musu. 22Bii lɛ shimɔshimɔɔ amɛhe yɛ musu lɛ mli. Ni Rebeka kɛɛ, “Mɛɛba sa akɛ nɛkɛ nɔ ko afee mi?” No hewɔ lɛ, etee eyabi Yehowa. 23 Ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
“Jeŋmaji enyɔ yɛ omusuŋ,
ni maŋ kome he aaawa fe ekome,
ni onukpa lɛ aaasɔmɔ gbekɛ lɛ.”
24Be ni Rebeka fɔmɔ be shɛ lɛ, efɔ hãaji. 25Mɔ ni ba klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ etsuɔ fɔɔ kɛ ehe tsɔi sulaŋŋ tamɔ ofo; awo lɛ Esau. 26No sɛɛ lɛ, enyɛmi lɛ hu ba ni enine hiɛ Esau nanetsitsi mli, ni awo lɛ Yakob. Be ni afɔ amɛ lɛ, Isak eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Esau hɔɔ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa
27Gbekɛbii lɛ badara. Esau le gbɔbimɔ jogbaŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, efɔɔ ŋa mli yaa; shi Yakob lɛ gbɔmɔ kpoo ni, ni ehiɔ shĩa. 28Isak sumɔɔ Esau ejaakɛ milɛloo ŋɔɔ enaa shi Rebeka sumɔɔ Yakob.
29Gbi ko lɛ Yakob miihoo nii, ni Esau jɛ ŋa lɛ mli eba ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ. 30Esau kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, hã mi nɛkɛ niyenii tsuru nɛɛ eko maye, shi hɔmɔ miiye mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, awo Esau gbɛi akɛ Edom.
31Shi Yakob kɛɛ Esau akɛ, “Hɔɔmɔ okromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ohã mi dã!”
32Ni Esau kɛɛ akɛ, “Miigbo kɛ hɔmɔ, ni mɛni kromɔbi gbɛnaa nɛɛ baafee ehã mi?”
33 Yakob kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kã mi kitã yɛ nɔ dã!” Hewɔ lɛ Esau kã lɛ kitã ni ehɔ̃ɔ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ehã Yakob. 34Kɛkɛ ni Yakob hã Esau aboloo kɛ abɔbɔi ni ehoo lɛ eko. Esau ye, ni enu nɔ ko eshwie nɔ; kɛkɛ ni ete shi, ni eyiŋ etee. Bɔ ni fee ni Esau ŋmɛɛ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa ni ebuuu lɛ nɛ.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 26
Content:
Isak yahi Gerar
1 Hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; soro klɛŋklɛŋ hɔmɔ ni ba yɛ Abraham yinɔ lɛ. Isak yiŋ etee Filistibii amaŋtsɛ Abimelek ŋɔɔ yɛ Gerar. 2Shi Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Isak ni ekɛɛ: “Kaaya Ijipt; shi hii shi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ; 3 too gbɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ; ni mikɛ bo aaahi shi, ni majɔɔ bo, ejaakɛ bo kɛ oshwiei mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ baahã, 4 ni maye kitã ni mikã otsɛ Abraham lɛ nɔ. Mibahã oshwiei afa tamɔ bɔ ni mikã otsɛ Abraham kitã lɛ. Mibahã oshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii, ni mibaŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔji nɛɛ fɛɛ mahã oshwiei lɛ. Oshwiei lɛ mli aaajɛ ajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jeŋ maji lɛ fɛɛ, 5ejaakɛ Abraham bo migbee toi, ni eye mimlai kɛ mikitãi lɛ anɔ.”
6No hewɔ lɛ, Isak hi shi yɛ Gerar. 7 Ni be ni jɛibii lɛ bi eŋa lɛ he sane lɛ, eto he akɛ, “Minyɛmi yoo ni”. Ejaakɛ eeshe gbeyei ni ekɛɛɛ akɛ: “Miŋa ni.” Ni ekɛɛ hu yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Bɔ ni afee ni jɛibii lɛ akabagbe mi yɛ Rebeka hewɔ; ejaakɛ Rebeka he yɛ fɛo.” 8 Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Isak ehi jɛi be kplaŋŋ lɛ, Filistibii amaŋtsɛ Abimelek bu samflɛ naa, ni ena ni Isak kɛ eŋa Rebeka miishwɛ. 9Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek tsɛ Isak ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eei, asomoaŋ, yoo lɛ oŋa ni! Te fee tɛŋŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛmi yoo ji lɛ lɛ?’ ” Ni Isak kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni afee ni akagbe mi yɛ ehewɔ, no hã mikɛɛ nakai lɛ.” 10Ni Abimelek kɛɛ, “Mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ? Shwɛ fioo ni maŋbii lɛ eko kɛ oŋa lɛ ana bɔlɛ. Eba lɛ nakai kulɛ ohã sɔ̃ etere wɔ.” 11Ni Abimelek wo maŋ lɛ fɛɛ kitã akɛ, “Mɔ ni aaata nuu nɛɛ loo eŋa lɛ he lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!”
12 Ni Isak fee ŋmɔ, ni edu nii yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ena nakai bɔ toi oha yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa jɔɔ lɛ. 13Ni Isak tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu. Ni eshwere aahu kɛyashi etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ agbo kpanaa. 14Ena too kui kɛ tsina kui kɛ webii pii. Ni Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ kɔ̃ enɔ. 15 No hewɔ lɛ, nubui fɛɛ ni Isak tsɛ Abraham tsuji lɛ je yɛ lɛ Abraham lɛ yinɔ lɛ, Filistibii lɛ tsimɔ fɛɛ ni amɛloo su amɛwo amɛmli obɔ̃ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
16Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛɛ Isak akɛ, “Jee wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni oya.
