25Ni amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛba amɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 26Ni amɛbakɛɛ amɛtsɛ akɛ, “Ataa, Yosef yɛ jeŋ lolo, ni lɛ eyeɔ lumɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Yakob yiŋ fee lɛ kɔshikɔshi ejaakɛ eheee amɛ eyeee.”
27Shi be ni amɛgba lɛ wiemɔ ni Yosef kɛ amɛ wie lɛ fɛɛ ni ena shwiilii ni Yosef hã koni akɛbaŋɔ lɛ kɛba lɛ, amɛtsɛ Yakob he tse lɛ, 28 ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Omanye sane! Mibi Yosef yɛ jeŋ lolo! Matee mayana ehiɛ dani magbo!”

Title: JƐNƐSIS 46
Content:
Yakob kɛ eweku fɛɛ fã kɛtee Ijipt
1 No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob fã kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ, ni eba Beersheba. Eshã afɔlei ehã etsɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi. 2Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob wie yɛ ninaa mli nyɔɔŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Yakob, Yakob!” Ni Yakob here nɔ akɛ, “Naa mi.”
3Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, otsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Kaashe Ijipt yaa gbeyei ejaakɛ mahã oshwiei atsɔ̃ jeŋmaŋ kpeteŋkple yɛ jɛi. 4Mi diɛŋtsɛ mi kɛ amɛ aaatee Ijipt, ni mi kɛ oshwiei aaasaa aba ekoŋŋ; ni ooogbo ofɔ̃ Yosef tsitsiŋ.”
5Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛshwie nɔ kɛjɛ Beersheba. Ebihii lɛ ŋɔ lɛ Yakob lɛ, kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ tara shwiilii lɛ ni Farao hã akɛ akɛbaŋɔ lɛ Yakob lɛ amli. 6 Asaŋ amɛŋɔ amɛkooloi kɛ amɛnibii ni amɛna yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛba Ijipt, Yakob kɛ eshwiei lɛ fɛɛ; 7ebihii kɛ ebihii lɛ abihii kɛ ebiyei kɛ ebihii lɛ abiyei, eshwiei fɛɛ ekɛba Ijipt lɛ.
Yakob Shwiei lɛ
8 Yakob shwiei ni ba Ijipt lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Yakob kɛ ebii lɛ: Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ, 9ebihii ji Hanok kɛ Pallu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi. 10Simeon bihii nɛ: Yemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Ohad kɛ Yakin kɛ Zohar kɛ Shaul ni ji Kanaanyoo lɛ bi lɛ. 11Levi bihii nɛ: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari. 12 Yuda bihii nɛ: Er kɛ Onan kɛ Shela kɛ Perez kɛ Zera, shi Er kɛ Onan gboi yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni Perez bihii ji Hezron kɛ Hamul. 13Isakar bihii nɛ: Tola kɛ Pua kɛ Yashub kɛ Shimron. 14Zebulon bihii nɛ: Sered kɛ Elon kɛ Yakleel. 15Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Lea bihii kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo Dina ni ekɛ Yakob fɔ yɛ Mesopotamia lɛ. Yakob bii ni ekɛ Lea fɔ fɛɛ feɔ gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ.
16Gad bihii nɛ: Zefon kɛ Hagi kɛ Shuni kɛ Ezbon kɛ Eri kɛ Arodi kɛ Areli. 17Asher bihii nɛ: Imna kɛ Ishvah kɛ Ishvi kɛ Beria kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo Sera. Beria bihii ji Heber kɛ Malkiel. 18Shwiei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa nɛɛ ji bii ni Yakob kɛ Zilpa, nyɔ́ŋyoo lɛ ni Laban kɛhã ebiyoo Lea lɛ fɔ.
19Yakob ŋa Rahel bihii ji Yosef kɛ Benyamin. 20 Yosef hu fɔ bii yɛ Ijipt. Ekɛ Osɔfo Potifera biyoo Asenat lɛ fɔ Manase kɛ Efraim. 21Benyamin hu bii ji Bela kɛ Beker kɛ Ashbel kɛ Gera kɛ Naaman kɛ Ehi kɛ Rosh kɛ Mupim kɛ Hupim kɛ Ardi. 22Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Rahel kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛyibɔ ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
23Dan bi nɛ: Hushim. 24Naftali bii ji Yazeel kɛ Guni kɛ Yezer kɛ Shillem. 25Shwiei kpawo ni Yakob kɛ Bilha, nyɔ́ŋyoo lɛ ni Laban kɛhã ebi Rahel lɛ wo nɛ.
26Yakob shwiei diɛŋtsɛ ni ekɛba Ijipt lɛ ayibɔ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa, esoro ebihii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ. 27 Yosef bihii ni afɔ yɛ Ijipt lɛ ji bihii enyɔ. Belɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni jɛ Yakob we lɛ ni amɛba Ijipt lɛ ayibɔ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Yakob kɛ ebii yɛ Ijipt
28 Agbɛnɛ Yakob tsu Yuda kɛtsɔ ehiɛ kɛtee Yosef ŋɔɔ koni Yosef atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ kɛya Goshen; ni amɛba Goshen. 29Kɛkɛ ni Yosef saa eshwiili ni eyiŋ etee koni eyakpee etsɛ Yakob yɛ Goshen; ni be ni Yosef na etsɛ lɛ, eloo lɛ atuu ni efo eshwie ekuɛ nɔ aahu. 30 Israel kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ ni mina ohiɛ akɛ oyɛ jeŋ lolo nɛɛ, kɛ migbo tete po miyajɔɔ mihe.”
31Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ akɛ, “Miiya Farao ŋɔɔ mayagba lɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ ni yɔɔ Kanaan lɛ eba miŋɔɔ. 32Gbɔmɛi lɛ tookwɛlɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛlɛɔ kooloi. Amɛkɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ amɛnii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ eba.’ 33Yosef kɛɛ, ‘Kɛ Farao aaabatsɛ nyɛ ni eeebi nyɛ akɛ, Mɛni ji nyɛnitsumɔ? lɛ’ 34 nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Otsuji lɛɔ kooloi kɛjɛ wɔblahiaŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ koni ehã nyɛhi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ Ijiptbii nyaŋeɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji koolookwɛlɔ.’ ”

Title: JƐNƐSIS 47
Content:
1No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef yiŋ etee eyakɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Mitsɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ejɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba. Amrɔ nɛɛ amɛyɛ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” 2Kɛkɛ ni Yosef hala enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enumɔ ni ekɛ amɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ Farao. 3 Farao bi Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji nyɛnitsumɔ?”
Amɛhã Farao hetoo akɛ, “Otsuji lɛ koolookwɛlɔi ji wɔ, wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ.” 4Ni asaŋ amɛkɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Wɔba gbɔtoo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ejaakɛ otsuji kooloi lɛ naaa nii amɛye yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikpa bo fai ni ohã otsuji ahi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” 5Kɛkɛ ni Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Otsɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ eba oŋɔɔ. 6Naa, Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ, hã otsɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ahi shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ; hã amɛhi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni kɛ ole amɛteŋ mɛi ni he esa yɛ koolookwɛmɔ mli lɛ, tuu mitsinai lɛ akwɛmɔ owo amɛdɛŋ.”
7Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛ etsɛ Yakob ba ni ekɛ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ Farao, ni Yakob jɔɔ Farao. 8Agbɛnɛ Farao bi Yakob akɛ “Afii enyiɛ oye?”
9 Ni Yakob hã hetoo akɛ, “Afii abɔ ni miye yɛ jeŋ shihilɛ mli ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Mifii lɛ faaa ko moŋ nɛ, shi hejaramɔ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ amɛmli. Eshɛɛɛ wala afii babaoo ni mitsɛmɛi lɛ ye yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ.” 10Kɛkɛ ni Yakob jɔɔ Farao ni eje Farao hiɛ etee. 11Ni Yosef hã etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ shihilɛhe. Ehã amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ebɛŋkɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Rameses lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Farao efã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ. 12 Yosef hã etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ niyenii yɛ amɛbii ayibɔ naa.
Hɔmɔ be lɛ
13Agbɛnɛ niyenii bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa ewa naakpa, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ Ijipt kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ miihe amɛgboi kɛ hɔmɔ. 14Ni Yosef bua shika ni mɛi ni jɛ Ijipt kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛbahe abele lɛ naa. Ni Yosef kɛ shika nɛɛ ba Farao we lɛ mli. 15Ni be ni shika fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ijipt kɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tã lɛ, Ijiptbii lɛ fɛɛ ba Yosef ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã wɔ nii wɔye! Shi mɛɛ hewɔ ni oookwɛ ni wɔɔgboi yɛ wɔshika ni etã hewɔ.”
16Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ni nyɛshika etã nɛɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛkooloi ahãa mi ni mahã nyɛ niyenii yɛ nyɛkooloi lɛ anaa.” 17No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛkooloi lɛ bahã Yosef ni ehã amɛ niyenii eŋɔ tsake okpɔŋɔi kɛ too kui kɛ tsina kui kɛ tejii. Ni ehã amɛ niyenii ekɛhe amɛkooloi fɛɛ nakai afi lɛ.
18Be ni nakai afi lɛ ho lɛ, amɛba Yosef ŋɔɔ yɛ afi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko atee wɔnuŋtsɔ, no ji akɛ, Wɔshika kɛ wɔkooloo kui lɛ fɛɛ etã; wɔkɛ fɛɛ ebahã wɔnuŋtsɔ; eshwɛko nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja wɔgbɔmɔtsei ni onaa nɛɛ kɛ wɔshikpɔji pɛ. 19Mɛɛ hewɔ oookwɛ ni wɔgboi ni wɔshikpɔji lɛ hu aje wɔdɛŋ lɛ? Ŋɔɔ niyenii ohe wɔ kɛ wɔshikpɔji lɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Farao nyɔji koni wɔshikpɔji lɛ hu atsɔ̃ enɔ. Hã wɔ dumɔwui koni wɔyi ana wala ni wɔkagboi ni wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ batsɔ amaŋfɔ̃.”
20No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef he Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ehã Farao ejaakɛ Ijiptnyo fɛɛ Ijiptnyo hɔ̃ɔ eshikpɔŋ yɛ hɔmɔ waa ni yeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ Farao nɔ̃; 21ni gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ enyɔji yɛ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he. 22Osɔfoi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ kɛkɛ ni eheee ejaakɛ amɛyɛ sisɛ̃ ni ato ni Farao hãa amɛ, ni sisɛ̃ nɛɛ amɛyeɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhɔ̃ɔɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ. 23Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ mihe nyɛ kɛ nyɛshikpɔji lɛ mihã Farao. Agbɛnɛ, naa dumɔwui! Nyɛdua yɛ nyɛŋmɔji lɛ amli. 24Kɛ shɛ nikpamɔbe lɛ, nyɛbaaja nyɛŋmɔshinii lɛ mli enumɔ; Farao baaŋɔ ekome; ni nyɛbaaŋɔ ejwɛ lɛ. No eko nyɛbaadu, ni no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛbaaye, no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛwebii baaye, ni no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛbii bibii lɛ baaye.” 25Maŋbii lɛ here Yosef nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Ohere wɔyiwala! Kɛ ooosumɔ lɛ, hã wɔtsɔmɔ Farao nyɔji.” 26No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef ŋɔ enɛ efee akpɔ efɔ̃ shi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ aja ŋmɔshinii mli enumɔ ni Farao aŋɔ ekome.
Osɔfoi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔɔ Farao nɔ.
Yakob naagbee shamaŋsheo ni ewo
27 Bɔ ni fee ni Israelbii lɛ hi shi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Goshen lɛ nɛ. Israelbii nɛɛ nanaa shikpɔji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfɔfɔɔ ni amɛshwere babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. 28Yakob hi shi yɛ Ijipt afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo. No hewɔ lɛ, afii abɔ ni Yakob ye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpawo. 29 Be ni Yakob gbele be eshɛ etã lɛ, etsɛ ebi Yosef ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ oyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ, okɛ onine abahɔ milagbaateŋ ni owo mi shi akɛ obaaye mi anɔkwa. Kaafu mi yɛ Ijipt. 30 Shi moŋ kɛji migbo lɛ, wo mi kɛje Ijipt ni oyafu mi yɛ mitsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ.” Ni Yosef here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mafee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.” 31Shi Yakob kɛɛ, “Kã mi kitã!” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef kã lɛ kitã. Kɛkɛ ni Israel ma eyi shi yɛ esaatso lɛ yitsogbɛ ni esɔle.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 48
Content:
Yakob jɔɔ Efraim kɛ Manase
1Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ abakɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Naa, otsɛ he miiye.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef ŋɔ ebihii enyɔ ni ji Manase kɛ Efraim efata ehe kɛtee. 2Ayakɛɛ Yakob akɛ, “Obi Yosef miiba oŋɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yakob mia ehiɛ ni ete shi eta saatso lɛ nɔ. 3 Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ Luz yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejɔɔ mi ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 4 ‘Naa, mahã ofɔ pii ni obaashwere, ni mahã oshwiei atsɔmɔ maji pii, ni mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ aaahã oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.’ ”
5 Yakob tsa ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Obihii enyɔ ni ji Efraim kɛ Manase ni ofɔ yɛ Ijipt dani miba oŋɔɔ lɛ, minii ji amɛ. Efraim kɛ Manase etsɔ̃mɔ mibii tamɔ Ruben kɛ Simeon nɔŋŋ; 6ni bii ni ooofɔ yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ afee bo onii; shi yɛ gboshiniiyeli gbɛfaŋ lɛ, aaabu amɛ ashi Efraim kɛ Manase nɔ. 7 Ejaakɛ be ni mijɛ Mesopotamia ni mibaa Kanaan lɛ, Rahel gbo shi mi yɛ gbɛ teŋ, be ni eshwɛ gbɛ kukuoo dani ashɛɔ Efrat lɛ, ni mifu lɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ gbɛ ni yaa Efrat ni ji ŋmɛnɛ Betlehem lɛ he.”
8Be ni Yakob na Yosef bihii lɛ, ebi akɛ, “Namɛi nɛ?”
9 Yosef kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Mibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mi yɛ Ijipt lɛ nɛ.”
Yakob kɛɛ, “Okɛ amɛ aba ni majɔɔ amɛ.” 10Shi gbɔlɛ ehã Yakob hiŋmɛii anɔ eha, ni enaaa nii jogbaŋŋ. Yosef tsi gbekɛbii lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etsɛ. Yakob shwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa ni eloo amɛ atuu, 11 ni ekɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Misusuko kɔkɔɔkɔ akɛ mana ohiɛ; ni naa, Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mina obii hu.” 12Agbɛnɛ Yosef hole gbekɛbii lɛ yɛ Yakob nakutsei anɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
13Yosef mɔmɔ gbekɛbii enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amli, Efraim ye Yakob abɛku nɔ, ni Manase ye Israel ninejurɔ nɔ, ni etsi amɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yakob. 14Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kpã eninejurɔ mli ni ekɛŋmɛ Efraim ni ji gbekɛ lɛ yiteŋ, ni ekɛ ebɛku tsɔ̃ eninejurɔ lɛ nɔ ekɛŋmɛ Manase yiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ Manase ji kromɔ. 15 Kɛkɛ ni Yakob jɔɔ Yosef ni ekɛɛ,
“Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni mitsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak sɔ̃mɔ lɛ,
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ekwɛ minɔ miwala gbii fɛɛ
kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ,
16 bɔfo ni jie mi kɛjɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ mli lɛ,
ajɔɔ gbekɛbii nɛɛ.
Amɛhewɔ lɛ, migbɛi
kɛ mitsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak agbɛi
gboŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Amɛyi afa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
17Be ni Yosef na akɛ etsɛ kɛ eninejurɔ eŋmɛ Efraim yiteŋ lɛ, enaaa he miishɛɛ, ni ewo etsɛ nine nɔ koni ejie kɛjɛ Efraim yiteŋ kɛyaŋmɛ Manase yiteŋ. 18Ni Yosef kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Jeee nakai ni Ataa, ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji kromɔbi; okɛ onine jurɔ aŋmɛ lɛ moŋ eyiteŋ.”
19 Shi etsɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mibi, mile, mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ onukpa lɛ hu aaatsɔ̃ maŋ kpele, ni eeetsɔ agbo; shi kɛ̃lɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kpeteŋkple fe lɛ, ni eshwiei aaatsɔ majimaji babaoo.”
20 No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob jɔɔ gbekɛbii lɛ nakai gbi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ nyɛgbɛi Israelbii kɛaajɔɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ ahã otsɔ̃ tamɔ Efraim kɛ Manase.’ ” Belɛ Yakob ŋɔ onukpa gbɛhe lɛ ehã Efraim.
21Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Naa, mi lɛ, migbele be eshɛ etã, shi nyɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ baahi shi, ni ekɛ nyɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛya nyɛblematsɛmɛi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. 22 Asaŋ, bo pɛ ji mɔ ni miŋɔ Shekem shikpɔŋ lɛ mihã, shi jeee onyɛmimɛi lɛ, nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛ miklante kɛ migãi shɔ̃ yɛ Amorbii lɛ adɛ̃ŋ lɛ.”

Title: JƐNƐSIS 49
Content:
Yakob naagbee wiemɔi
1Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tsɛ ebii lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa koni magba nyɛ wɔsɛɛ saji ni baaba nyɛ nɔ:
2“Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa,
ni nyɛboa mi toi;
nyɛ Yakob bihii,
nyɛboa nyɛtsɛ Yakob toi!
3 “Ruben, bo ji mikromɔbi,
miblahiaŋ be hewalɛ mli bi,
mɔ ni fe fɛɛ yɛ gbɛnaa
kɛ hewalɛ gbɛfaŋ.
4 Otamɔ nu hamahama
ni damɔɔɔ he kome;
ofeŋ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ dɔŋŋ,
ejaakɛ okɛ mihemɔ wɔ,
ni owo misaa he muji
ni obule misaatso.
5“Simeon kɛ Levi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ni;
amɛkɛ amɛklantei lɛ tsuɔ yiwalɛnii.
6 Mihiŋ amɛ jinatoo mli,
ni mitaŋ amɛkpei amli.
Amɛmlifu mli lɛ, amɛgbe gbɔmɔ,
ni amɛkɛ yiŋflɛflɛ fee tsinai akpaketsɛmɛi.
7 Alomɔ amɛmlifu, ejaakɛ enaa wa;
alomɔ amɛmlila, ejaakɛ eyi wa.
Magbala amɛmli mawo Israel
magbɛ amɛ mashwã
Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
8 “Yuda, onyɛmimɛi lɛ aaajie oyi.
Oooye ohenyɛlɔi anɔ;
otsɛbii lɛ aaakoto bo!
9 Yuda lɛ, jata binuu ni;
mibi yagbe milɛloo
ni eku esɛɛ eeba!
Eedɛkɛ shi, eebumɔ shi
tamɔ jata, tamɔ jatayoo;
namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ ajije?
10 Maŋtsɛyeli ejeŋ Yuda dɛŋ,
ni nɔyeli hu ejeŋ eshwiei adɛŋ;
gbii abɔ ni jeŋmaji kɛ amɛ onia baa,
ni amɛbaa amɛhe shi amɛhãa lɛ lɛ.
11 Ekɛ etejibi aaaŋmɔ wain tso,
ekɛ etejiyoo bi aaaŋmɔ wain tso ni wa.
Ekɛ wain aaafɔ etade he,
ekɛ wain tsuru fɔɔ aaafɔ ehebo he.
12Ehiŋmɛii aaatsu fɔɔ fe wain,
ni enyanyɔji aaayɛ futaa,
fe fufɔ.
13 “Zebulon aaahi ŋshɔ naa;
ni ehilɛhe aaatsɔ̃ lɛji adaamɔhe,
ni ekɛ Sidon aaaje husu.
14“Isakar lɛ, teji ni he wa ni,
ni ebuɔ shi yɛ kooloi atsui ateŋ.
15Enaa akɛ hejɔɔmɔhe lɛ hi,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ akɔnɔ.
Ni eŋɔɔ ekoto sɛɛ ehãa ni atere lɛ jatsu.
Ni anyɛɔ enɔ ni etsu nii tamɔ nyɔŋ.
16 “Dan aaatsɔ̃ lumɔ ehã emɛi lɛ
ni amɛaatamɔ Israel akutsei krokomɛi lɛ.
17Ni Dan aaatsɔ̃ onufu ni ble gbɛ toi,
onaŋka ni naa yɔɔ ebɔɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ toi,
ni ekɔ̃ɔ okpɔŋɔ nanetsitsi,
ni enɔtalɔ lɛ kpaa gbeɔ shi.
18 “Yehowa, oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ,
gbɛ miikwɛɔ nɛɛ!
19“Gad lɛ ojotswalɔi asafo aaabatua lɛ,
shi lɛ moŋ eeewo amɛ foi.
20 “Asher shikpɔŋ aaaba nii kpɔtɔɔ
nii ni sa maŋtsɛ.
21“Naftali lɛ ofrote ni foɔ shi kɛkɛ ni;
ni enaa ŋɔɔ.
22 “Yosef lɛ, tso nine ni woɔ yibii ni,
tso nine ni ma nuhiŋmɛi he,
ni eniji kwɔlɔɔ gbogbo.
23Gãitsɛ̃lɔi kɛ hiɛdɔɔ batua lɛ,
ni amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ lɛ gãi kɛ yiwalɛ.
24Shi egãi lɛ yɛ hewalɛ kpɛŋŋ.
Eniji kɛ ekɔ̃ɔji ahe yɛ oya;
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ
ni hã lɛ nakai hewalɛ lɛ.
Tookwɛlɔ lɛ ni ji
Israel tɛsaa lɛ, gbɛi lɛ tsu enɛ.
25Otsɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ
ji mɔ ni aaaye abua bo.
Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ baajɔɔ bo.
Lɛ eeejɔɔ bo kɛ jɔɔmɔi ni jɛ ŋwɛi
kɛ jɔɔmɔi ni jɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi nui lɛ amli.
Eeejɔɔ bo kɛ fufɔ ni kɔ̃ɔ,
eeejɔɔ bo kɛ fɔmɔnii kpakpa.
26 Otsɛ jɔɔmɔi lɛ mli wa fe naanɔ gɔji lɛ,
kɛ naanɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ ajɔɔmɔi lɛ.
Jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ ashwie Yosef yiteŋ,
eshwie lɛ mɔ ni ajie lɛ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ato afã lɛ pampam.
27 “Benyamin lɛ, klaŋ ni yɔɔ
hahaaha ni.
Leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ emɔɔ
emilɛloo ni eyeɔ.”
28Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ; ni wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɛ kɛ amɛ wie be ni ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ jɔɔmɔ ni sa lɛ lɛ, no ekɛjɔɔ lɛ.
Yakob gbele kɛ efuu
29 Yakob wo amɛ kitã ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ miiya mitsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ. Nyɛfũa mi nyɛfataa mitsɛmɛi lɛ ahe yɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, abɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ mli. 30 Tɛkplo nɛɛ yɛ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Mamre bokãgbɛ, yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nɔ ni Abraham diɛŋtsɛ he kɛ abɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, dɛŋ, ni eŋɔ fee efuuhe lɛ. 31 Jɛi afu Abraham kɛ eŋa Sara yɛ; jɛi afu Isak kɛ eŋa Rebeka yɛ; ni jɛi mifu Lea hu yɛ. 32Abɔɔ nɛɛ kɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, ahe yɛ Hitbii lɛ adɛŋ.” 33 Be ni Yakob ewo ebii lɛ kitãi nɛkɛ egbe naa lɛ, ebua enaji anaa eshwie saa lɛ nɔ, ni ebu enaa. Afu lɛ afata emɛi lɛ ahe.

Title: JƐNƐSIS 50
Content:
1 Kɛkɛ ni Yosef ho egbee etsɛ nɔ ni efo ni eshwɔ enaa. 2Yosef fã etsuji tsofawolɔi lɛ akɛ amɛwo etsɛ tsofa, ni amɛwo lɛ. 3Amɛkɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ wo lɛ tsofa lɛ; ejaakɛ gbii abɔ ni ayeɔ kɛwoɔ tsofa lɛ ji no. Ijiptbii lɛ fo Yakob gbii nyɔŋmai kpawo.
4Be ni afo Yakob agbe naa lɛ, Yosef kɛɛ Farao we lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ, kɛ nyɛyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, nyɛwoa Farao toi nɔ akɛ 5 mitsɛ hã mikã lɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Naa, eshɛ migbele be; mibu lɛ ni mitsa mihã mihe yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jɛi oyafu mi yɛ!’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni mayato mitsɛ ni maku misɛɛ maba.”
6Farao to he akɛ, “Yaa ni oyafu otsɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ehã okã lɛ kitã lɛ.”
7No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef yiŋ etee ni eyafu etsɛ. Farao tsuji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ewe onukpai lɛ kɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ onukpai fɛɛ 8kɛ Yosef shĩaŋbii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ fata ehe kɛtee; amɛbii kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛkɛ amɛshi yɛ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 9Asaŋ shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi hu kɛ Yosef tee; asafo yuu diɛŋtsɛ kɛ lɛ tee lɛ.
10Agbɛnɛ be ni amɛshɛ Atad abeleshaahe lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛfee yara wulu yɛ jɛi; ni Yosef fo etsɛ gbii kpawo. 11Be ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni ji Kanaanbii lɛ na ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ yɛ Atad abeleshaahe lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Abel-Mizraim, eshishi ji Ijiptbii Akɔmɔyeli. Eyɛ Yordan sɛɛ.
12 Yakob bii lɛ ye amɛtsɛ kitã ni ewo amɛ lɛ nɔ. 13 Amɛwo lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyafu lɛ yɛ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli tɛkplo lɛ mli. Abɔɔ nɛɛ Abraham diɛŋtsɛ he kɛ tɛkplo lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, dɛŋ yɛ Mamre bokãgbɛ ni ekɛfee efuuhe lɛ. 14Be ni Yosef efu etsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ tee etsɛ fuu lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt ekoŋŋ.
Yosef shɛje enyɛmimɛi lɛ amii
15Agbɛnɛ be ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛtsɛ egbo lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ekolɛ Yosef ebɛ wɔ ewo emli, ni eeetɔ ehe owele yɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ ni wɔfee lɛ lɛ hewɔ.” 16Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã ayakɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Otsɛ wo kitã dani egbo akɛ, 17‘Bɔ ni nyɛkɛ Yosef awie nɛ, Miikpa bo fai ni okɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ afa amɛ ejaakɛ amɛfee bo efɔŋ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wɔmiikpa bo fai ni okɛ otsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji lɛ atɔ̃mɔi lɛ afa amɛ!” Be ni amɛkɛ Yosef wie nɛkɛ lɛ, efo.
18Kɛkɛ ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ tee amɛyabumɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, otsuji ji wɔ!”
19Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei! Minyɛŋ maye Nyɔŋmɔ najiaŋ mafee nɔ ko. 20 Tsɛbelɛ, nyɛ lɛ, nyɛto nyɛyiŋ akɛ nyɛaafee mi efɔŋ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hã etsɔ̃ nɔ kpakpa; bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ no nɔ ahere mɛi babaoo ayiwala, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ. 21No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei! Mibalɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ.” Bɔ ni ehã enyɛmimɛi lɛ atsui ni eshɛje amɛmii nɛ.
Yosef gbele
22Yosef hi shi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ. Ni eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma. 23 Yosef na Efraim nanakansowai; ni Manase bi Makir bii lɛ hu afɔ amɛ ashwie eshuɔ nɔ. 24 Agbɛnɛ Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Migbele be eshɛ; shi saramɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaabasra nyɛ kɛ̃, ni eeekpala nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ ni ekã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kitã yɛ he lɛ nɔ.” 25 Kɛkɛ ni Yosef hã enyɛmimɛi, Yakob bii, lɛ kã lɛ kitã ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ aaakai nyɛ kɛ̃. Kɛ eeebajie nyɛ lɛ, nyɛjiea miwui lɛ kɛjea biɛ kɛya.” 26Be ni Yosef eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma lɛ egbo. Amɛwo lɛ tsofa, ni akɛ lɛ wo adeka mli yɛ Ijipt.

Title: ƐKSODƆS WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbɛi “Eksodɔs” lɛ ni akɛtsɛɔ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ shishi ji “Shimɔ”, ni shimɔ ni Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni aye amɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ, he saji yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli.
1. Bɔ ni fee ni akpɔ̃ Hebribii lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ amɛ lɛ mli kɛ gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ kɛtee kɛyashɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he.
2. Kpãŋmɔ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãŋ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ no nɔ ni amɛna mlai ni amɛkɛkura henilee yɛ maŋ shihilɛ kɛ jamɔ mli saji.
3. He ko ni ama koni maŋ lɛ aja yɛ jɛi lɛ he saji kɛ mlai kɛ akpɔi ni kɔɔ osɔfoi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ he.
Sane ni ta saji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ji gbɛ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ nɔ ekpɔ̃ ewebii lɛ ni yɔɔ nyɔŋyeli mli, kɛ bɔ ni ehã amɛbatsɔ̃ jaku kome ni na hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ amɛwɔsɛɛ shihilɛ mli baahi ahã amɛ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ titri ni he sane yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli ji Mose. Lɛ ji mɔ pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hala akɛ enyiɛ Hebribii lɛ ahiɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛya lɛ. Wolo nɛɛ mli sane ni mɛi le fe ekrokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ji Kitai Nyɔŋma lɛ. Eyɛ Yitso 20 lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Israelbii lɛ aheyeli yɛ Ijipt 1.1—15.21
a. Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔji yɛ Ijipt 1.1-22
b. Mose fɔmɔ kɛ edalɛ 2.1—4.31
d. Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Ijipt Maŋtsɛ 5.1—11.10
e. Hehoo lɛ kɛ Ijiptshimɔ 12.1—15.21
Gbɛfãa kɛjɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa kɛtee Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he 15.22—18.27
Mla lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ lɛ 19.1—24.18
Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ jamɔ he mlai 25.1—40.38

Title: ƐKSODƆS 1
Content:
Awa Israelbii lɛ yi yɛ Ijipt
1 Yakob musuŋ bihii ni fata ehe kɛtee Ijipt lɛ agbɛii nɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ ewe: 2Ruben kɛ Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda, 3Isakar kɛ Zebulon kɛ Benyamin, 4Dan kɛ Naftali kɛ Gad kɛ Asher. 5 Yakob shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ ji nyɔŋmai kpawo. Shi ebi Yosef lɛ, lɛ lɛ eyɛ Ijipt momo. 6 Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yosef kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ nakai yinɔbii lɛ fɛɛ bagboi. 7 Shi amɛshwiei, ni ji Israelbii lɛ, fɔfɔɔ ni amɛshwere babaoo. Amɛyi bafa, ni amɛna hewalɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛyi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ.
8Agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ hee ko ni leee Yosef baye Ijipt nɔ. 9Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ kɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa, Israelbii lɛ ayi efa, ni amɛna hewalɛ hu fe wɔ. 10Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ amɛ ayea ŋaa mli koni amɛyi akafa dɔŋŋ ni ebaba akɛ be ni ta ehe shi lɛ amɛyafata wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ moŋ ahe ni akɛ wɔ miiwu koni amɛjo foi kɛshi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” 11 No hewɔ lɛ, Ijiptbii lɛ totoo nitsumɔ nɔkwɛlɔi yɛ Israelbii lɛ anɔ koni amɛkɛ nitsumɔi keketekeketei awa amɛ yi. Israelbii mamɔ nitoo maji ni ji Pitom kɛ Rameses amɛhã Farao. 12Shi babaoo ni Ijiptbii lɛ waa Israelbii lɛ yi lɛ, babaoo moŋ ni Israelbii lɛ ayi faa ni amɛshwereɔ ji no. Enɛ hã Ijiptbii lɛ atsui su Israelbii lɛ anɔ. 13No hewɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ Israelbii lɛ nyɔji ahiɛmɔ shɛii. 14Amɛhã amɛnaa su, ni amɛfo ntayaa, ni amɛtsu ŋmɔshi nitsumɔi srɔtoi, ni enɛ hã jeŋ shihilɛ je Israelbii lɛ atsine.
15Kɛkɛ ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Shifra kɛ Pua, ni ji Hebriyei yoofɔlɔi lɛ, akɛ, 16“Kɛji nyɛtee Hebri yei lɛ fɔmɔ ni nyɛna yɛ sɛi ni yoofɔyoo lɛ taa nɔ efɔɔ lɛ shishi akɛ bi lɛ nuu ni lɛ, nyɛgbea lɛ; shi kɛji yoo ni lɛ ehi shi.” 17Shi yoofɔlɔi lɛ yashe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni amɛfeee nɔ ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, shi moŋ amɛhere gbekɛbii hii lɛ ayiwala. 18Enɛ hã Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tsɛ yoofɔlɔi lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ? Mɛɛba ni nyɛhãa gbekɛbii hii lɛ ayi naa wala lɛ?”
19Yoofɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Ejaakɛ Hebriyei lɛ tamɔɔɔ Ijipt yei lɛ; amɛ lɛ amɛyɛ kamkam bɔ ni be ni yoofɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ eshɛɔ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ amɛfɔ momo.” 20-21Akɛni yoofɔlɔi lɛ yashe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ to amɛ ejurɔ, ni eduro amɛ bii. Yɛ Israelbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, amɛtee nɔ amɛshwere, ni amɛna hewalɛ naakpa. 22 Kɛkɛ ni Farao wo emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akpɔ akɛ, “Binuu fɛɛ binuu ni Hebri yoo aaafɔ lɛ nyɛshɛa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a Nilo faa lɛ mli, shi biyoo lɛ nyɛhãa eyi ana wala.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 2
Content:
Mose fɔmɔ
1 Be nɛɛ mli lɛ nuu ko ni jɛ Leviwe yaŋɔ Leviwe nɔŋŋ yoo ko. 2Yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu. Ena akɛ abifao lɛ he yɛ fɛo, hewɔ lɛ ekɛ lɛ tee nyɔji etɛ̃. 3Shi be ni eyanyɛɛɛ lɛ ekɛtee dɔŋŋ lɛ, etao adai kɛntɛŋ, ni ekɛ amã tsara he fɛɛ, ni ekɛ abifao lɛ ŋmɛ mli, ni eyashi lɛ ema glãi amli yɛ faa lɛ naa. 4 Belɛ abifao lɛ nyɛmiyoo damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ eekwɛ nɔ ni aaaba enɔ.
5Farao biyoo ba ehejuu yɛ faa lɛ naa, ni eweyei lɛ miishara shi yɛ faa lɛ toi. Kɛkɛ ni ehiŋmɛi gba kɛntɛŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ glãi lɛ ateŋ, ni etsu eweyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni eyawo kɛba. 6Be ni Farao biyoo lɛ gbele naa lɛ, naa abifao kã mli ni eefo. Emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɛɛ, “Hebribii lɛ abihii lɛ eko nɛ.”
7Kɛkɛ ni abifao lɛ nyɛmiyoo lɛ babi Farao biyoo lɛ akɛ, “Ani miyatsɛ Hebriyoo fufɔhãlɔ ko mibahã bo koni ehã lɛ fufɔ ehã bo lo?”
8Farao biyoo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Hɛɛ! Yaa!” Gbekɛyoo lɛ tee ni eyatsɛ abifao lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛba. 9Ni Farao biyoo lɛ kɛɛ yoo ni ayatsɛ kɛba lɛ akɛ, “Hemɔ abifao nɛɛ koni oyakwɛ lɛ ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ.” Ehe abifao lɛ kɛtee ni eyakwɛ lɛ. 10Be ni gbekɛ lɛ bada lɛ, yoo lɛ kɛ lɛ tee eyahã Farao biyoo lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ Farao biyoo bi. Ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ mijie lɛ kɛjɛ nu mli.”
Mose jo foi kɛtee Midian
11 Mose bada. Gbi ko lɛ etee eyasara emaŋbii Hebribii lɛ, ni eyana nii ni ahãa amɛtsuɔ lɛ. Ehiŋmɛiŋ, ni Ijiptnyo ko tswa Mose nyɛmimɛi Hebribii lɛ eko nɔ. 12 Mose kwɛ ehe biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni be ni enaaa mɔ ko lɛ, egbe Ijiptnyo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ tee shia mli. 13Je tsɛre nɔ hu Mose tee eyasara enyɛmimɛi lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ naa Hebribii enyɔ ni miinɔ. Ebi mɔ ni eye sane fɔŋ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ ni oyiɔ onyɛmi Hebrinyo?”
14Mɔ ni eye sane fɔŋ lɛ hã Mose hetoo akɛ, “Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ? Gbe otaoɔ ni ogbe mi tamɔ ogbe Ijiptnyo lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsui fã, ni ekɛɛ, “Ei, ana ale sane nɛɛ!” 15-16 Be ni Farao nu nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ lɛ, etao Mose egbe. Shi Mose jo Farao naa foi kɛtee Midian shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyahi jɛi. Mose ta nubu ko naa, ni Yetro, ni ji Midian osɔfo lɛ, biyei kpawo lɛ ba jɛi koni amɛbasha nu amɛwo tsesei amli amɛhã amɛtsɛ toi lɛ ni amɛnu. 17 Shi tookwɛlɔi komɛi bashwie amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Mose te shi ni efã oblayei lɛ ahe, ni ehã amɛtoi lɛ nu ehã amɛ. 18Be ni oblayei lɛ ba amɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛba mra nɛkɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?”
19Amɛ jie naa akɛ, “Ijiptnyo ko bajie wɔ yɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni esaa esha nu tete ehã toi lɛ amɛnu.” 20Yetro bi ebiyei lɛ akɛ, “Ni nɛgbɛ nuu lɛ yɔɔ? Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛshi lɛ? Nyɛyatsɛa lɛ kɛba koni ebaye nii.” 21Mose kpɛlɛ̃, ni ekɛ Yetro hi shi. Yetro kɛ ebiyoo Zipora hã Mose gbãlã. 22 Zipora fɔ binuu, ni Mose wo lɛ Gershom ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, “Mibato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.”
23 Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ bagbo. Ni Israelbii lɛ dɔmɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛfo amɛtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ. 24 Nyɔŋmɔ nu amɛkɔmɔyeli lɛ, ni ekai kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kpãŋ lɛ. 25Kɛkɛ ni ekwɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛsane bakã etsui nɔ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 3
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Mose
1Mose miikwɛ eshaanuu Yetro, Midian osɔfo lɛ, toi. Gbi ko lɛ ekpala toi lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ anaigbɛ, ni eyaje Horeb, Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ he. 2Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ lalilɛi, yɛ ŋmeitso ko mli. Mose kwɛ ŋmeitso lɛ gãa ejaakɛ eetso nɛ, shi eshãaa. 3 Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ matsi mabɛŋkɛ ni mayakwɛ naakpɛɛ nii nɛɛ, nɔ hewɔ ni ŋmeitso lɛ eshãaa lɛ.”
4Be ni Yehowa na akɛ Mose miibɛŋkɛ ni eyakwɛ lɛ, ejɛ ŋmeitso lɛ teŋ etsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Mose, Mose!” Mose here nɔ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi!”
5Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaatsi oba dɔŋŋ! Jiemɔ otokotai lɛ, shi he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.” 6 Esaa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi ji otsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsĩ ehiɛ, ejaakɛ eeshe gbeyei akɛ eeekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
7 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mina amanehulu mli ni miwebii lɛ yɔɔ yɛ Ijipt lɛ, ni minu ŋkɔmɔ blɔmɔ ni amɛbolɔɔ koni abahere amɛ yɛ amɛkpalalɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ hu. Amɛnidɔɔ nii lɛ kã mitsui nɔ pam. 8Naa, mikpeleke shi miba amɛ jiemɔ yɛ Ijiptbii lɛ adɛŋ, koni makpala amɛ kɛshi Ijipt kɛya shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni da, ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni niyenii pii yɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ, he ni Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii yɔɔ lɛ. 9Israelbii lɛ akɔmɔyeli lɛ jwere mitoiŋ, ni mihiɛ tua bɔ ni Ijiptbii haoɔ amɛ lɛ. 10No hewɔ lɛ, ba ni matsu bo Farao ŋɔɔ koni oyajie mimaŋ Israel kɛje Ijipt.” 11 Shi Mose kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mi, ni matee Farao ŋɔɔ ni mayajie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt?”
12Nyɔŋmɔ to he akɛ, “Mi kɛ bo ni yaa lɛ, ni enɛ ji nɔ ni aaaye he odase akɛ mi mitsu bo lɛ. Kɛji oyajie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt kɛba lɛ, nyɛbaa gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ he nyɛbajaa mi.”
13Ni Mose here nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji mitee Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ miyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ’, ni amɛaabi mi akɛ, ‘Te egbɛi hu?’ lɛ, te mikɛɛ amɛ tɛŋŋ?”
14 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mi ji mɔ ni mi ji. Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji mɔ ni mi ji tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ.’ ” 15 Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Migbɛi kwraa nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni no yinɔi fɛɛ kɛtsɛ mi.’ 16Yaa ni oyabua Israel onukpai lɛ anaa, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, ni ekɛɛ, Mikwɛ, ni mina nyɛ kɛ nɔ ni afeɔ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt lɛ, 17ni miiwo shi akɛ majie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt amanehulu lɛ mli kɛya Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ kpakpa ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.
18 “Israel onukpai lɛ aaabo bo toi, ni okɛ amɛ aya Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa, Hebribii aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikpa bo fai, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ ni wɔya gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ nyiɛmɔ koni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ 19Shi mi lɛ mile akɛ Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni nyɛya, ja anyɛ enɔ. 20No hewɔ lɛ, majie mihewalɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ Ijipt, ni mikɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni mafee yɛ jɛi lɛ aaagbala Ijipt toi, ni no sɛɛ dani eeehã nyɛya.
21 “Ni mahã Ijiptbii ahiɛ asɔ nyɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni be ni nyɛaatee lɛ, nyɛyaŋ lɛ efolo. 22Yoo fɛɛ yoo amala shika nii kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ mamai yɛ Ijiptyoo ni ji ehe gbɔmɔ kɛ eshiaŋyoo dɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛwowoo nyɛbihii kɛ biyei. No nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni nyɛaakpakpaa Ijiptbii lɛ ahe nii kɛaatee.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 4
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ hã Mose naakpɛɛ hewalɛ
1Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, Israelbii lɛ heŋ mi amɛyeŋ, amɛboŋ mi toi hu, ejaakɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ejieko ehe kpo etsɔ̃ko bo.’ ”
2Ni Yehowa bi Mose akɛ, “Mɛni yɔɔ odɛ̃ŋ lɛ?” Ejie naa akɛ, “Tso.”
3 Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Shɛ ofɔ̃ shikpɔŋ!” Mose shɛ tso lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, kɛkɛ ni tso lɛ tsɔ̃ onufu, ni Mose jo onufu lɛ naa foi kɛtee sɛɛ. 4Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpã onine mli ni omɔ elei!” Mose kpã enine mli, ni emɔ onufu lɛ lei lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ tso ekoŋŋ yɛ edɛŋ. 5Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Enɛ amɛkɛaahe amɛye akɛ Yehowa, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔɔ bo.”
6Asaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ okɛ onine ahɔ omiinaa.” Mose kɛ enine lɛ hɔ emiinaa, ni be ni ejie lɛ, naa nine lɛ ni hela ko tamɔ kpiti eshwie he fuu. 7Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ onine ahɔ omiinaa ekoŋŋ.” Esaa ekɛ enine lɛ hɔ jɛi. Be ni ejie lɛ, naa ehewolo lɛ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ. 8Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛji amɛheee bo amɛyeee, ni asaŋ amɛbooo bo toi yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ okadi lɛ naa lɛ, okadi ni ji enyɔ lɛ naa lɛ amɛaabo bo toi. 9 Shi kɛji amɛheee bo amɛyeee yɛ okadii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛbooo bo toi hu lɛ, no lɛ yɛɛ Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ eko ni ofɔse oshwie shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ, ni nu lɛ ni oyɛ yɛ faa lɛ mli lɛ aaatsɔ̃ lá yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ.”
10 Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Ofainɛ miNuŋtsɔ! Minaa tseee kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe, ni kɛjɛ beyinɔ hu ni okɛ mi, otsulɔ, wie nɛɛ fɛɛ, minaa tseko, ni mililɛi tsii.”
11Yehowa bi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ bɔ naabu hã gbɔmɔ? Namɔ bɔ mumui loo toimulɔ, loo mɔ ni naa nii, loo shwilafo? Ani jeee mi, Yehowa nɛɛ nɔŋŋ? 12 No hewɔ lɛ, yaa otsumɔ lɛ, shi mibawa bo kɛ wiemɔ, ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni owie.”
13Shi Mose here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, miNuŋtsɔ, tsu mɔ kroko.”
14Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mli wo Mose la, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani onyɛmi Aaron, Levinyo lɛ, bɛ? Mile akɛ enaa tse. Ni ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ po enyiɛ gbɛ eeba ni ekɛ bo abakpe, ni kɛ ena bo lɛ eeenya ohe kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ. 15Bɔɔ lɛ amaniɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ. Mibawa bo kɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ wiemɔ mli, ni matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee. 16 Aaron aaatsɔ̃ onaawielɔ yɛ okɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, ni eeewie yɛ onajiaŋ, ni bo hu oootsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ohã lɛ. 17Okɔ tso nɛɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, no okɛbaafee naakpɛɛ nii lɛ.”
Mose ku esɛɛ etee Ijipt
18 Mose ku esɛɛ etee eshaanuu Yetro ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, hã maku misɛɛ maya Ijipt mayakwɛ akɛ minyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ wala mli lolo lo.” Yetro to he akɛ, “Yoo, yaa ni oba, gbɛ aŋmɛ ahã bo.”
19 Mose yɛ Midian lolo ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ oya Ijipt, ejaakɛ mɛi ni tao bo agbe lɛ egboi.” 20 Kɛkɛ ni Mose ŋɔ eŋa kɛ ebihii lɛ etara teji nɔ, ni eyiŋ kɛmiiku esɛɛ kɛya Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ tso lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃.
21 Yehowa kɛɛ Mose ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Kɛji oyashɛ Ijipt lɛ kwɛmɔ ni naakpɛɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, ofee yɛ Farao hiɛ; shi mi lɛ mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui, ni ehãŋ maŋ lɛ aya. 22 Okɛɛ Farao akɛ mi Yehowa mikɛɛ, ‘Mikromɔ binuu ji Israel, 23 ni miikɛɛ bo akɛ, hã mibinuu lɛ aya, no lɛ naa, magbe okromɔ binuu lɛ.’ ”
24 Amɛyashɛ shitoohe ko yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni Yehowa bahɛŋ Mose, ni eetao lɛ egbe. 25 Kɛkɛ ni Zipora kɔ tɛ kakla ni naa ba, ni ekɛfo ebinuu lɛ ketia; ekɛ loo ni efo lɛ sa Mose naji ahe, ni ekɛɛ, “Lá ayɛmforowu ji bo”. 26Ketiafoo lɛ hewɔ ni Zipora kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Eji anɔkwale akɛ nuu ni feɔ hii anii ji bo” lɛ.
27Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Yaa ni okɛ Mose ayakpe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.” Aaron tee, ni ekɛ Mose yakpe yɛ Sinai, Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni eshwɔ enaa. 28Kɛkɛ ni Mose jaje wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛtsu lɛ lɛ, kɛ okadii fɛɛ hu ni efã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Aaron. 29Ni Mose kɛ Aaron tee Ijipt, ni amɛyabua Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ fɛɛ anaa. 30Aaron jaje wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose ewie lɛ, ni Mose fee okadii lɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ. 31 Maŋ lɛ he lɛ ye. Ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Yehowa ekwɛ ni ena Israelbii lɛ amanehulu lɛ, amɛmamɔ amɛyitsei ashi ni amɛja.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 5
Content:
Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ Ijipt Maŋtsɛ hiɛ
1Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaye gbi jurɔ amɛhã mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.’ ”
2 Farao bi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji nakai Yehowa lɛ hewɔ ni esa akɛ mabo lɛ toi, ni mahã Israel aya? Mileee Yehowa ko, ni Israel hu mihãaa amɛya.”
3Mose kɛ Aaron to he akɛ, “Hebribii aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikpa bo fai koni ohã wɔya gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni ekabatua wɔ kɛ gbele hela loo ta.”
4Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni bo Mose, kɛ Aaron, nyɛhãaa maŋbii lɛ ajwɛŋ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ? Nyɛyaa nyɛyatsua nyɛnii! 5 Agbɛnɛ moŋ ni maŋ lɛ yi efa momo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni nyɛhãa amɛjɔɔ amɛhe nɛɛ!”
6Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Farao wo Israelbii lɛ akpalalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kitã akɛ, 7“Nyɛkahãa Israelbii lɛ jwɛi tamɔ tsutsu lɛ ni amɛkɛfo ntayaa lɛ dɔŋŋ. Amɛya amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyatao jwɛi amɛhã amɛhe, 8shi ntayaa abɔ ni amɛfoɔ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa amɛfoa nakai nɔŋŋ, nyɛkatsea nɔ. Amɛmiifee anihao hewɔ ni amɛbolɔɔ akɛ, ‘Hã wɔya ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ!’ 9Ahã nitsumɔ lɛ anyɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ koni etɔ amɛ ni amɛkana hiɛ amɛbo lakamɔ wiemɔi atoi.”
10Israelbii lɛ akpalalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyakɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Farao kɛɛ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, ehãaa nyɛ jwɛi dɔŋŋ; 11nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyaa nyɛyataoa jwɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaana eko yɛ; shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ atseŋ nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ nɔ dɛ̃rɛ̃.” 12No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii nitsulɔi lɛ gbɛ shwã Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛyabuabua gbetselii anaa amɛkɛfee jwɛi. 13Kpalalɔi lɛ tsirɛ Israelbii lɛ ayisɛɛ akɛ amɛgbe amɛdaa gbi nitsumɔ lɛ naa tamɔ be mli ni ahãa amɛ jwɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ. 14Ni Farao kpalalɔi lɛ yi Israelbii ni afee amɛ nɔkwɛlɔi akɛto nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛgbeee daa gbi ntayai ni ato ahã nyɛ ni nyɛfo lɛ anaa tamɔ sa lɛ?”
15Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ tee Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyabolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane okɛyeɔ wɔ, otsuji nɛɛ? 16Ahãaa wɔ jwɛi, shi akɛɛ doo wɔfo ntayaa kɛ̃. Aayi wɔ yɛ no hewɔ, tsɛbelɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ jɛ omaŋbii lɛ.”
17Farao here amɛnɔ ekɛɛ, “Hejɔ̃lɔi ni nyɛ ji hewɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Hã wɔya ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa lɛ.’ 18Nyɛyaa nyɛyatsua nii lɛ moŋ. Jwɛi ni ji jwɛi lɛ ahaŋ nyɛ eko, shi ntayai lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ nyɛbaafo nakai nɔŋŋ.” 19Israelbii lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ na akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ be ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkatsea nyɛdaa gbi ntayaa ni sa ni nyɛfo lɛ nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ” lɛ.
20Be ni amɛshi Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyaa lɛ, amɛyanina Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛmiimɛ amɛ. 21 Amɛkɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Yehowa akojo nyɛ ejaakɛ nyɛhã wɔsane eje Farao kɛ etsuji agugɔŋ fũ, ni nyɛwo amɛdɛ̃ŋ klante ni amɛkɛgbe wɔ.”
Mose ye ŋkɔmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa
22Kɛkɛ ni Mose saa eku esɛɛ etee Yehowa hiɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Ao! Yehowa, mɛɛba moŋ ofee wɔ, omaŋ lɛ, efɔŋ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba kwraa otsu mi biɛ mɔ? 23Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni miba mikɛ Farao bawie yɛ ogbɛi mli nɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ moŋ sɔŋŋ efeɔ omaŋ lɛ, ni jiemɔ hu ojieko amɛ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 6
Content:
1 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpaako obaana nɔ ni mibafee Farao. Ja minineshiwalɛ naa dani eeehã Israelbii lɛ aya. Anɔkwa, minineshiwalɛ naa hu dani eeeshwie amɛ kɛje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Mose
2Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, 3 mi mijie mihe kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ. Shi migbɛi Yehowa lɛ, mihãaa akɛ no ale mi. 4 Ni misaa mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋ akɛ mikɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ baahã amɛ, shikpɔŋ ko ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ. 5Agbɛnɛ hu, minu Israelbii ni Ijiptbii lɛ yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ akɔmɔyeli blɔmɔ lɛ he, ni mikai mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ. 6No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ mikɛɛ, ‘Mi ji Yehowa, ni majie nyɛ, ni mawo Ijiptbii lɛ ajatsu lɛ yɛ nyɛkuɛ nɔ, ni mahere nyɛ kɛje nyɔŋ ni amɛyeɔ nyɛ lɛ mli. Mikɛ mihewalɛ aaakpɔ̃ nyɛ, ni no nɔŋŋ mikɛaagbala Ijiptbii lɛ atoi. 7Maŋɔ nyɛ mafee mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt nyɔŋyeli lɛ mli lɛ. 8 Mikɛ nyɛ aaatee shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob lɛ nɔ. Mi ji Yehowa.’ ” 9Mose bɔ Israelbii lɛ amaniɛ, shi amɛbooo Mose toi yɛ amɛwerɛ ni eho amɛhe kɛ amɛnɔ nyɔŋyeli ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ.
10Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 11“Yaa ni okɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ayawie, ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ aje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛya.”
12 Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, Israelbii lɛ tete boko mi toi, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Farao aaabo mi toi hu; ni minaa hu tseee nɛɛ?”
13Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron wie, ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛya Israelbii lɛ kɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, koni amɛyajie Israelbii lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mose kɛ Aaron wekukpãa
14 Yakob, ni batsɔ̃ Israel lɛ, kromɔbi Ruben bihii nɛ: Hanok kɛ Palu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ruben wekui lɛ ayitsei lɛ. 15Simeon bihii nɛ: Yemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Ohad kɛ Yakin kɛ Zohar kɛ Shaul, Kanaanyoo lɛ bi lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Simeon wekui lɛ ayitsei. 16 Levi bihii nɛ: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa. Levi ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo. 17Gershon bihii nɛ: Libni kɛ Shimei. Amɛ hu amɛna wekui. 18Kohat bihii nɛ: Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel. Kohat ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃. 19 Merari bihii nɛ: Maheli kɛ Mushi. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levi wekui lɛ ayitsei yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa.
20Amram ŋɔ enyɛkwɛ̃ Yokebed, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose. Amram ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo. 21 Izhar bihii nɛ: Kora kɛ Nefeg kɛ Zikri. 22 Uziel bihii nɛ: Mishael kɛ Elzafan kɛ Sitri.
23 Aaron ŋɔ Aminadab biyoo Elisheba, ni ji Nahashon nyɛmiyoo lɛ. Ekɛ lɛ fɔ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar. 24Kora bihii nɛ: Asir kɛ Elkana kɛ Abiasaf. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Kora wekui lɛ ayitsei lɛ. 25 Aaron bi Eleazar yaŋɔ Putiel biyoo ni ekɛ lɛ hi shi, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Finehas. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii awei kɛ shĩai lɛ ayitsei lɛ.
26Aaron kɛ Mose nɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyajiea Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ” lɛ, 27amɛ amɛyabi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ koni eŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa fã Mose kɛ Aaron
28Gbi nɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 29ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa. Kɛɛmɔ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mikɛ bo wieɔ lɛ.”
30 Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, minaa tseee. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Farao aaabo mi toi hu.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 7
Content:
1 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, miihã otsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ohã Farao, ni onyɛmi Aaron aaatsɔ̃ ogbalɔ. 2Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifã bo ni owie lɛ, kɛɛmɔ onyɛmi Aaron, ni lɛ ekɛ Farao awie koni eŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛshi eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛya. 3 Shi mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui, ni okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii babaoo ni mafee yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, 4eboŋ nyɛ toi. No baahã mikɛ Ijipt aye kɛ joomɔ, ni magbala etoi, ni majie mimaŋ Israel kɛje Ijipt. 5 Kɛ migbala Ijiptbii lɛ atoi, ni mijie Israelbii lɛ kɛje amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no Ijiptbii kɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa.” 6Mose kɛ Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 7Be ni amɛkɛ Farao yawie nɛɛ lɛ, Mose eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni Aaron hu eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Aaron tso lɛ
8Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, 9 “Kɛji Farao kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛfea naakpɛɛ nɔ ko’ lɛ, no lɛ Mose, kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, ‘Kɔ otso lɛ ni okɛfɔ̃ shi yɛ Farao hiɛ; ni tso lɛ aaatsɔ̃ onufu.’ ” 10No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ Aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ, ni amɛfee bɔ ni Yehowa efã amɛ lɛ. Aaron kɛ etso lɛ fɔ shi yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, ni tso lɛ tsɔ onufu. 11 Kɛkɛ ni Farao hu hã ayatsɛ nilelɔi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi kɛba. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Ijipt ashwãifeelɔi lɛ. Amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛkunyaayeli ŋai lɛ fee nakai nɔŋŋ. 12Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ etso fɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni tsei lɛ tsɔmɔ onufui; shi Aaron tso lɛ mimii amɛtsei lɛ. 13 Shi Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Amanehului ba Ijipt nɔ
Nu tsɔ la
14Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Farao tsui wa, ekpɛlɛɛɛ ni maŋ lɛ yaa. 15Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ leebi. Ebaaje kpo eya faa lɛ naa. Kɔ tso lɛ ni tsɔ onufu lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni oyadamɔ jɛi omɛ lɛ. 16 Okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa, ni ji Hebribii lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsu mi oŋɔɔ koni mibakɛɛ bo akɛ, hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaja mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni naa, okpɛ̃lɛko kɛbashi benɛ. 17 Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, enɛ okɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa lɛ. Naa, mikɛ tso ni mihiɛ yɛ midɛ̃ nɛɛ baatswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ baatsɔ̃ lá. 18Nilo Faa lɛ mli loi baagboi, ni faa lɛ baasha bɔ ni Ijiptbii aaanyaŋe Nilo numɔ!’ ”
19 Ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, ‘Kɔ otso lɛ ni okpã onine mli yɛ Ijipt nu fɛɛ nu, ni ji fai kɛ nujɔi ni aje gbɛ agbala kɛ bukoi kɛ nu ni bua shi fɛɛ, nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔmɔ lá. Nu ni yɔɔ tso kɛ tɛ gogai amli fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ lá.’ ”
20Mose kɛ Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ. Aaron wo etso lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛtswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, kɛkɛ ni faa lɛ mli nu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ lá. 21Loi ni yɔɔ faa lɛ mli lɛ gboi, ni faa lɛ sha bɔ ni Ijiptbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ Nilo mli nu amɛnu. Lá sɔŋŋ ji Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he. 22 Shi Ijipt ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ hu kɛ amɛkunyaayelɔi fee nakai nɔŋŋ. Enɛ hã Farao tee nɔ ekpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ. 23Ni Farao ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ, ni nɔ ni afee lɛ gbaaa enaa kwraa. 24Ni Ijiptbii fɛɛ jejee nubui yɛ faa lɛ hewɔ koni amɛna nu amɛnu ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ Nilo mli nu amɛnu.
25Ni be ni Yehowa ehã Nilo faa lɛ etsɔ̃ lá sɛɛ lɛ, gbii kpawo baho ni faa lɛ yɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 8
Content:
Kɔkɔdenei ba
1 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ koni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ; hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ mi. 2Shi kɛji okpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni amɛya lɛ, mikɛ kɔkɔdenei baahao oshikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ. 3Nilo Faa lɛ baawo kɔkɔdenei nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, ni kɔkɔdenei nɛɛ aaaba owe lɛ kɛ osa nɔ kɛshɛ osɛɛtsuŋ; amɛaaba otsuji ashĩai kɛ omaŋbii lɛ ateŋ kɛ nyɛflɔnɔi kɛ nyɛmã tsesei fɛɛ amli. 4Kɔkɔdenei lɛ aaatumɔ kɛnyiɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ omaŋbii kɛ otsuji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ tete.’ ”
5Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, ‘Kɔ otso lɛ ni okpã onine mli yɛ fai kɛ nujɔi ni agbala kɛ nu ni buabua shi lɛ anɔ, ni ohã kɔkɔdenei atumɔ kɛba Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ ” 6No hewɔ lɛ, Aaron kpã enine mli yɛ Ijipt nu ni buabua shi lɛ anɔ. Kɛkɛ ni kɔkɔdenei lɛ ba, ni amɛbaha Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. 7Shi ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ kɛ amɛkunyaayeli ŋai lɛ fee nakai nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ hu amɛhã kɔkɔdenei ba Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
8 Kɛkɛ ni Farao fã, ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkpaa Yehowa fai koni ejie kɔkɔdenei lɛ yɛ mi kɛ mimaŋbii lɛ anɔ, ni mahã Israelbii lɛ aya koni amɛyashã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa.”
9Mose here Farao nɔ akɛ, “Bo diɛŋtsɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ beyinɔ ni mikpa fai mihã bo kɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋbii lɛ koni ajie kɔkɔdenei lɛ yɛ bo kɛ owe lɛ kɛ omaŋbii ashĩai, ni ashwɛ faa lɛ mli nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.”
10 Farao jie naa akɛ, “Wɔ”. Mose kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aaafee bɔ ni obi lɛ koni okɛna ole akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 11Kɔkɔdenei lɛ baaje bo kɛ owe lɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ kɛ omaŋbii lɛ anɔ aya. Nilo Faa lɛ mli nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ aaashwɛ.” 12Ni Mose kɛ Aaron gbala amɛhe shi, ni Mose tee eyasɔle etsɛ Yehowa yɛ shi ni ewo Farao yɛ kɔkɔdenei lɛ ahe lɛ hewɔ. 13Yehowa fee bɔ ni Mose bi lɛ lɛ, ni kɔkɔdenei lɛ gboi yɛ shĩai kɛ kpoi anɔ kɛ jwɛiaŋ. 14Ni Ijiptbii lɛ buabua kɔkɔdenei gbohii lɛ anaa kuikui, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ sha. 15 Shi be ni Farao na akɛ ena mumɔhe fioo lɛ, ekpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ ba
16Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron koni ekpã enine mli ni ekɛ etso lɛ atswa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mlu lɛ koni mlu lɛ atsɔ̃ tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.” 17Mose kɛ Aaron fee nakai. Aaron kpã enine mli, ni ekɛ etso lɛ tswa shikpɔŋ mlu lɛ, ni mlu lɛ tsɔ̃ tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ, ni eku eshwie gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ nɔ. Shikpɔŋ mlu fɛɛ tsɔ tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ yɛ Ijipt. 18 Kɛkɛ ni Ijipt ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ ka, yɛ amɛkunyaayeli ŋai lɛ anaa koni amɛhã tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ lɛ eko aba, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ. Tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ lɛ ha gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ. 19 Kɛkɛ ni ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu.” Shi Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Ofɔii ba
20 Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Tee shi leebi maŋkpa ni oyafo Farao be mli ni eyaa faa lɛ naa, koni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ, ‘Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaja mi. 21Naa, kɛji oŋmɛɛɛ mimaŋ lɛ gbɛ ni amɛya lɛ, mahã ofɔii abaha bo kɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋbii lɛ. Ijiptbii ashĩai amli kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ hu aaayi tɔ kɛ ofɔii lɛ. 22 Nakai gbi lɛ matɛ̃ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mimaŋ lɛ yɔɔ nɔ lɛ mashi, koni ofɔii lɛ akaya jɛi, bɔ ni afee ni ole akɛ mi ji Yehowa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. 23Ni mikɛ tɛ̃ ni matɛ̃ amɛ mashi nɛɛ aaato bo okadi koni okɛna srɔto ni yɔɔ mi mimaŋ lɛ kɛ bo omaŋ lɛ teŋ. Wɔ ni ji wɔ lɛ mato nɛkɛ okadi nɛɛ.’ ” 24Ni Yehowa fee nakai, ni ofɔii babaoo ba Farao we lɛ kɛ etsuji ashĩai lɛ kɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Ni ofɔii lɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtã.
25Kɛkɛ ni Farao fã ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyashãa afɔle lɛ nyɛhãa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛshãa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.”
26 Shi Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Ebahiŋ nakai feemɔ, ejaakɛ Ijiptbii anihiinii wɔkɛbaashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Kɛji wɔkɛ Ijiptbii anihiinii shã afɔle yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ, ani amɛtswiaŋ wɔ tɛ? 27 Esa ni wɔnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ kɛya ŋa nɔ koni wɔyashã afɔle lɛ wɔhã Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ ni efã wɔ.”
28 Farao to he ekɛɛ, “Mibaŋmɛ nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛya koni nyɛyashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, shi shɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkayaa. Nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mi.”
29Mose jie naa akɛ, “Naa, mibashi maya koni mayasɔle mabi Yehowa koni ofɔii lɛ aje Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii anɔ wɔ. Shi shishiumɔ sane kɛkɛ ni Farao akaye dɔŋŋ, akɛ ehaŋ maŋ lɛ aya ayashã afɔle ahã Yehowa.”
30 Ni Mose gbala ehe shi etee eyasɔle ekpa Yehowa fai. 31Ni Yehowa fee nɔ ni Mose bi lɛ lɛ, ni ejie ofɔii lɛ yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ anɔ. Eshwɛɛɛ ekome folo. 32 Shi Farao kpliŋ etsui ekoŋŋ, ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ aya.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 9
Content:
Kooloi gboi
1 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Hebribii aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya koni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ mi. 2Shi kɛji okpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni amɛya, ni okã he ootsi amɛnaa lolo lɛ, 3no lɛ Yehowa baatswia nyɛkooloi ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ nii, ni ebaahã otswashiogbo ni naa wa abote nyɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ tejii kɛ yoomai kɛ tsinai kɛ toi lɛ ateŋ. 4Shi Yehowa aaahã srɔto aba Israelbii akooloi kɛ Ijiptbii akooloi ateŋ, ni Israelbii akooloi lɛ ateŋ eko eko gboŋ.’ 5Ni Yehowa to be ekɛɛ, ‘Wɔ lɛ Yehowa baafee nii nɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ ”
6Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Yehowa fee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ; Ijiptbii akooloi lɛ fɛɛ gboi, shi Israelbii akooloi lɛ ateŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ gbooo. 7 Ni Farao tsu ayakwɛ, ni ayana akɛ Israelbii akooloi lɛ ateŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ gboko. Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ehãaa maŋ lɛ aya.
Asanei ba
8Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Nyɛkpitía flɔɔnɔɔ mli lamlu nyɛkɔkɔi obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni Mose kɛshwã ŋwɛi yɛ Farao hiɛ. 9 Lamlu nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ mlu, ni eeegbɛ eshwã Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ; eeetsɔ̃ asane ni fuɔ, ni efɛlɛɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ahe yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.” 10 Mose kɛ Aaron kpiti flɔnɔɔ mli lamlu lɛ, ni amɛbadamɔ Farao hiɛ, ni Mose kɛ lamlu lɛ shwã ŋwɛi. Kɛkɛ ni lamlu lɛ tsɔ̃ asane ni fuɔ ni fɛlɛɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ahe. 11Ijipt ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ nyɛɛɛ Mose hiɛ tete amɛshɛ yɛ asanei lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ asane lɛ etsɛ̃rɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ kɛ Ijiptbii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. 12 Shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛ
13Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Tee shi wɔ leebi maŋkpa ni oyadamɔ Farao hiɛ, ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Hebribii aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya koni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ mi, 14 ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ lɛ mahã haomɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ aba bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ kɛ omaŋbii lɛ anɔ koni okɛna ole akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ mi yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ. 15Kulɛ bɛnɛ mijie mihewalɛ kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ, ni mihã gbele hela etswa bo kɛ omaŋbii, ni nyɛhiɛ ekpãtã momo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 16Shi enɛ hewɔ mihã oyɔɔ wala mli lolo koni majie mihewalɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ bo koni akɛtsi mitã yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ. 17Okã he oowo ohe nɔ yɛ mimaŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ohãaa amɛya. 18 Naa, wɔ aaafee benɛ mli lɛ mahã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi ni naa wa naakpa diɛŋtsɛ anɛ bɔ ni anako ehenɔ dã yɛ Ijipt kɛjɛ ni ato maŋ lɛ nɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. 19No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ tsu ni ayaŋɔ okooloi kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ kɛba shĩa okɛbato, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni aaana yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni akɛ lɛ baaa shĩa lɛ, nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ aayi lɛ ni eeegbo.’ ” 20Farao tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni yashe Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, ehã etsuji kɛ ekooloi fɛɛ jo foi kɛba shĩa; 21shi mɔ ni eyabuuu Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ, eshĩ etsuji kɛ ekooloi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
22Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpã onine mli kɛya ŋwɛi koni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi anɛ ashwie gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi kɛ ŋa nɔ bai fɛɛ nɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.” 23 Mose wo etso lɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛ, ni srawa gbala. Yehowa hã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛɛ nɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 24Be ni enɛɔ lɛ belɛ srawa lɛ hu miigbala plamplam kɛnyiɛ mli. Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ nɛ waa naakpa bɔ ni anako ehenɔ dã yɛ Ijipt kɛjɛ be mli ni etsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ. 25Ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ yi nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloo nɔ; ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ kpãtã ŋa nɔ tsei kɛ bai fɛɛ ahiɛ. 26Shi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ ji he ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛɛ eko enɛɛɛ yɛ.
27 Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsu ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ mifee esha. Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, shi mi kɛ mimaŋ lɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ji wɔ. 28Nyɛkpaa Yehowa fai koni ŋwɛi shiimɔ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ akpa; shi efa; ni mahã nyɛya, ni mitsiŋ nyɛnaa dɔŋŋ.”
29Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Amrɔ pɛ ni maje kpo yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, mahole miniji anɔ matsɛ Yehowa, ni ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ asɛɛ aaafo, ni eko eko baŋ dɔŋŋ, koni ona ole akɛ je lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni. 30Shi mile akɛ bo kɛ otsuji lɛ nyɛnako nyɛshe Yehowa ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.”
31Akoko kɛ tso ni ajieɔ kpãa ni akɛloɔ ojarawa mama yɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ kpãtã, ejaakɛ akoko lɛ ewo, ni tso lɛ hu ehere momo. 32Shi ŋmaa kɛ abele hiɛ kpãtãaa ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ amɛkpeɔ sɛɛ kɛ woo.
33Kɛkɛ ni Mose shi Farao, ni eje maŋ lɛ mli hu, ni ehole eniji anɔ etsɛ Yehowa. Kɛkɛ ni ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ asɛɛ fo, ni nu lɛ kpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛmɔ. 34Shi be ni Farao na akɛ nunɛmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo lɛ, esaa efee esha ekoŋŋ, ni lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ saa kpliŋ amɛtsui. 35 Farao bakpliŋ etsui, ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ aya tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto yɛ Mose naa lɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 10
Content:
Baalabii ba
1Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ, shi mihã ekpliŋ etsui, ni etsuji lɛ hu ekpliŋ amɛtsui bɔ ni afee ni mafee naakpɛɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, 2 koni ogba obii kɛ obii abii nibii ni mifee yɛ Ijipt, kɛ naakpɛɛ okadii ni mifee yɛ amɛteŋ, ni okpã owo amɛtoiiaŋ koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa.”
3 Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Hebribii aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mɛɛ beyinɔ po oookpɛ̃lɛ koni oba ohe shi ohã mi? Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya koni amɛyaja mi. 4Shi kɛji okpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni mimaŋ lɛ aya lɛ, no lɛ naa, wɔ kpaakpa wɔ lɛ, mahã baalabii aba okpokpai lɛ anɔ, 5ni amɛaaha shi bɔ sɔŋŋ ni anaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ tete, ni amɛaaye nii fɛɛ ni shwɛ hã nyɛ yɛ ŋa nɔ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ kpãtãaa hiɛ lɛ. Amɛaaye bai fɛɛ ni tsɛ̃rɛɔ yɛ nyɛtsei anɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ lɛ. 6Ni amɛaayimɔ oshĩai kɛ otsuji fɛɛ ashĩai kɛ Ijiptbii fɛɛ ashĩai amli tɔtɔɔtɔ, bɔ ni otsɛmɛi kɛ oniimɛi enako ehenɔ pɛŋ kɛjɛ be ni afɔ amɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.’ ” Ni Mose tsɔ̃ ehe, ni eshi Farao.
7Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni nuu nɛɛ aaahao wɔ kɛyashi? Hã Israelbii lɛ aya ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ani oleko lolo akɛ Ijipt hiɛ miikpãtã?”
8No hewɔ lɛ, ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba Farao hiɛ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Shi moŋ, namɛi kɛ namɛi ji mɛi ni baaya lɛ?”
9 Mose jie naa ekɛɛ, “Wɔbii bibii lɛ ni jio, wɔnukpai lɛ ni jio, wɔbihii jio, wɔbiyei jio, wɔtoi kɛ wɔtsinai jio wɔkɛ fɛɛ baaya ejaakɛ wɔyaaye gbi jurɔ wɔhã Yehowa.”
10Farao kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ miŋmɛ gbɛ ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ tee fĩĩ bɛ Yehowa ejɔɔ nyɛ. Kolɛ jeee yiŋ fɔŋ ko nyɛto nɛɛ? 11Dabida, nyɛhii lɛ kɛkɛ nyɛyaa nyɛyasɔ̃mɔa Yehowa, ejaakɛ no nɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ.” Ni ashwie Mose kɛ Aaron kɛje Farao hiɛ.
12 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpã onine mli yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni baalabii aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛbaye bai fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ eshi lɛ.” 13Mose wo etso lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko batswa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, gbi lɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni be ni je tsɛreɔ lɛ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ kɛ baalabii lɛ eba. 14Baalabii lɛ bashwie Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Amɛha Ijipt kpokpai lɛ anɔ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. Baalabii bako ni tamɔ amɛ nakai dã, ni amɛsɛɛ hu eko baŋ nakai dɔŋŋ. 15Ejaakɛ amɛha shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wo duŋ, ni amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bai fɛɛ kɛ tsei ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ shi lɛ anɔ yibii fɛɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
16 Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsu oya mli, ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mifee esha mishi Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mifee nyɛ hu esha. 17 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ okɛ mihe esha lɛ afa mi, shi kome nɛɛ kɛkɛ, ni nyɛkpa Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai koni ejie nɛkɛ toigbalamɔ ni gbeɔ mɔ nɛɛ kɛkɛ yɛ minɔ.” 18 Mose shi Farao etee, ni eyakpa Yehowa fai. 19Ni Yehowa hã anai kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa naakpa batswa, ni eloo baalabii lɛ blublu kɛtee eyashwie Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli. Baalabii lɛ ateŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ eshwɛɛɛ yɛ Ijipt kpokpai lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. 20 Shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ aya.
Duŋ wo
21Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpã onine mli kɛya ŋwɛi koni duŋ awo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, duŋ kabitii.” 22Mose kpã enine mli kɛtee ŋwɛi, kɛkɛ ni duŋ kpii wo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ gbii etɛ̃. 23Duŋ nɛɛ wo bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko enaaa enaanyo, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko shiii he ni duŋ lɛ banina lɛ yɛ lɛ kɛyashi gbii etɛ̃. Shi jeŋ tse heŋŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ashihilɛhei lɛ.
24 Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsɛ Mose ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa koni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ Yehowa; nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛbii lɛ aya, shi nyɛshĩa nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ.”
25Shi Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Ja ohã wɔna kooloi hu ni akɛshãa gbee afɔle kɛ shãa afɔlei wɔhiɛ wɔdɛ̃ ni wɔkɛyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 26Wɔkooloi aku lɛ hu ja wɔkɛtee, ni ashiŋ kooloo kome tete yɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi eko wɔkɛyaasɔmɔ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ kwraa wɔleee amɛteiaŋ nii ni wɔkɛyaasɔmɔ Yehowa akɛ ja wɔshɛ jɛi dã.” 27 Shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ Israelbii lɛ aya. 28Ni Farao bɔ Mose kɔkɔ ekɛɛ, “Jee mihiɛ ni oya. Okwɛ ohe ni ahi koni okaba mihiɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni ooobapue ekoŋŋ yɛ mihiɛ lɛ gbo ooogbo.”
29Mose here Farao nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, mibaŋ ohiɛ dɔŋŋ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 11
Content:
Krɔmɔbii gboi
1Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Eshwɛ amanehulu wulu kome ni mahã aba Farao kɛ Ijipt nɔ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ eeehã nyɛje biɛ nyɛya. Be ni eeehã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛya kwraa lɛ, shwiemɔ tete ebaashwie nyɛ kɛje biɛ. 2 Agbɛnɛ kpã owo Israelbii lɛ atoiŋ akɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo amala jwiɛtɛi nii kɛ shika nii yɛ enaanyo Ijiptnyo dɛŋ.” 3Yehowa hã Ijiptbii lɛ ahiɛ sɔ Israelbii lɛ. Anɔkwa, Farao tsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ buɔ Mose akɛ gbɔmɔ wulu diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
4 Ni Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ maje kpo makpa Ijipt, 5 ni Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ aaagboi kɛjɛ Farao kromɔbi ni baaye esɛɛ yɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi nyɔŋyoo ni yɔɔ wiɛ sɛɛ lɛ kromɔbi lɛ tete nɔ. Kooloi po akromɔbii fɛɛ baagboi. 6Ni aaawo yara babaoo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni anako ehenɔ dã, ni asaŋ ehenɔ ko hu baŋ dɔŋŋ. 7Shi yɛ Israelbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, gbɔmɔ jio, kooloo jio, gbee tete shiŋ esɛŋ ewoŋ lɛ, koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ Yehowa miitsɔ̃ɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ Ijiptbii kɛ Israelbii ateŋ. 8Nakai be lɛ otsuji fɛɛ aaakpeleke shi aaaba miŋɔɔ, ni amɛaabakoto mi amɛkɛɛ, Jee biɛ ni oya, bo kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ matee.’ ”
9Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Farao ebaboŋ nyɛ toi bɔ ni afee ni minaakpɛɛ nii lɛ afa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
10 Mose kɛ Aaron fee nɛkɛ naakpɛɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Farao nɛ, shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ ashi eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛya.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 12
Content:
Hehoo lɛ
1Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ, 2 “Nɛkɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ afi mli klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ kɛ afi shishijee ahã nyɛ. 3Nyɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ awie akɛ, Nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ amɔmɔ toobi kome kome yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, shĩa fɛɛ shĩa lɛ toobi kome. 4Shi kɛji shĩa lɛ bii faaa hãaa toobi muu lɛ yeli lɛ, no lɛ shĩatsɛ lɛ kɛ ekuuŋnyo, mɔ ni shĩa tsa enɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aye yɛ mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ naa. Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akane mɛi abɔ ni fa hã toobi lɛ yeli. 5 Nyɛŋɔa toobi ni kpa bɛ ehe, nuu ni eye afi, yɛ too gwantɛŋi loo too abotiai lɛ ateŋ. 6Nyɛkɛ toobi nɛɛ ato kɛyashi nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ koni Israelbii fɛɛ agbegbee amɛ gbɛkɛnaashi. 7 Akɛ lá lɛ eko adiki shĩai hei ni abaaye yɛ lɛ agboi lɛ ashinaatsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ yiteŋ nɔ lɛ hu he. 8Aye loo lɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ. Ashã, ni akɛ aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kɛ shwie ni joɔ aye. 9Akaye lɛ eŋmɔŋ, ni akɛ nu akahoo, shi moŋ ashã, eyitso kɛ eshuɔji kɛ emlinii lɛ fɛɛ. 10Nyɛkashwɛa eko nyɛtoa ni je tsɛre nɔ. Shi kɛji eko shwɛ ni je tsɛre nɔ lɛ, nyɛwoa mli la ni nyɛshãa. 11 Ni bɔ ni nyɛye lɛ nɛ. Nyɛfimɔa nyɛmliteiaŋ, ni nyɛwoa nyɛtokotai, ni nyɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtsei ahiɛa nyɛdɛ̃, ni nyɛyea lɛ paopao, shi Yehowa Hehoo ni.
12 “Ejaakɛ matsɔ̃ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli, ni magbe Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, koni mahã Ijipt nyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe guɔ agbo, mi ji Yehowa. 13 Lá lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shĩai amli ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ ahe okadi. Kɛji mina lá lɛ pɛ mateke nyɛ, ni mikpataŋ nyɛhiɛ be ni matswia Ijipt gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi nii lɛ. 14Nɛkɛ gbi nɛɛ atsɔ̃ kaimɔ gbi ahã nyɛ, ni nyɛye lɛ akɛ Yehowa gbi jurɔ, ni etsɔ̃ akpɔ ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei kɛya naanɔ.”
Akpiti Gbijurɔyeli lɛ
15 “Aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã nɛɛ nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo. Shi klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ beebe lɛ, nyɛjiea masha fɛɛ masha yɛ nyɛshĩai amli. Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaye masha aboloo yɛ gbii kpawo nɛɛ eko nɔ lɛ, aaakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ Israel. 16Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja Nyɔŋmɔ, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ hu nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ nakai nɔŋŋ. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbii nɛɛ amli ja nitsumɔ ni kɔɔ nɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye he kɛkɛ. 17Nyɛyea nɛkɛ akpiti gbijurɔ nɛɛ nyɛkɛkaia gbi nɔ ni mijie nyɛ fɛɛ yuu kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ akpɔ ehã nyɛ kɛya naanɔ. 18Nyɛbɔ̃ia aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã nɛɛ yeli kɛyashi nyɔɔŋ lɛ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ gbɛkɛ. 19Akana masha ko yɛ nyɛshiai amli gbii kpawo, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye masha nii lɛ, gbɔ ni jio, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, ehiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ Israelbii ateŋ. 20Nyɛkayea masha nii, nyɛyea akpiti yɛ nyɛshihilɛhei fɛɛ.”
Klɛŋklɛŋ Hehoo lɛ
21Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjiea toi nyɛtoa yɛ nyɛwekui lɛ anaa, ni nyɛgbea kɛyea Hehoo lɛ. 22Nyɛkɛ lá lɛ awoa lalakã mli, ni nyɛkɛ ŋshɔŋ kotsa atsɔ lá nɛɛ mli koni nyɛkɛdiki agbo lɛ shinaatsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ yiteŋ nɔ lɛ hu, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akajea kpo kɛba shinaashi kɛyashi leebi. 23Ejaakɛ Yehowa baaho koni eyatswia Ijiptbii nii. Kɛji ena lá lɛ yɛ shinaatsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ eyiteŋ nɔ lɛ he pɛ, Yehowa baateke nyɛshiai lɛ, ni eŋmɛŋ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ gbɛ ni ebote nyɛshĩai lɛ amli koni ebatswia nyɛ nii. 24Nyɛyea gbɛjianɔtoi nɛɛ anɔ, ni etsɔ̃ akpɔ ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii kɛya naanɔ. 25Ni kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nɛkɛ jamɔ nɛɛ mli. 26 Ni kɛji nyɛbii aaabi nyɛ akɛ, ‘Te nyɛjamɔ nɛɛ shishi hu?’ lɛ, 27nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa Hehoo afɔle ni, ejaakɛ be ni etswia Ijiptbii lɛ nii lɛ, eho Israelbii ashĩai lɛ ahe yɛ Ijipt ni etɛ̃ wɔshĩai lɛ eshĩ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ mamɔ amɛyi shi, ni amɛja Yehowa, 28ni Israelbii lɛ gbɛlɛ mli, ni amɛyafee bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ afee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kromɔbii lɛ agbele
29 Gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ Yehowa tswia Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ nii, kɛjɛ Farao kromɔbi lɛ ni baaye etsɛ sɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛyashi gboklɛfonyo ni kã kpabu mli lɛ kromɔbii kɛ shĩa kooloi akromɔbii fɛɛ nɔ. 30Kɛkɛ ni Farao te shi nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, lɛ kɛ etsuji fɛɛ kɛ Ijiptbii fɛɛ, ni amɛwo yara waa yɛ Ijipt fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eyashwɛɛɛ shĩa ko ni gbonyo bɛ mli. 31Nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Farao tsu ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjea mimaŋbii ateŋ nyɛyaa, nyɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ, nyɛyasɔ̃mɔa Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛbi lɛ. 32 Nyɛkɛ nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ hu ayaa tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ lɛ. Kɛfee lɛ nyɛsɔlea eko nyɛhãa mi koni jɔɔmɔ lɛ eko anina mi hu.”
33 Ni Ijiptbii lɛ tsirɛ Israelbii lɛ ayisɛɛ akɛ amɛhe afee oya ni amɛshi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛbaahã wɔ fɛɛ wɔgboi.” 34Israelbii lɛ hole amɛmai ni nako asha ni yɔɔ tsesei amli lɛ, ni amɛfimɔ tsesei lɛ amɛwowoo amɛmamai amli, kɛkɛ ni amɛhole amɛtswia amɛkɔ̃ji. 35 Nakai be mli lɛ Israelbii lɛ efee bɔ ni Mose ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛmala jwiɛtɛi nii kɛ shika nii kɛ mamai yɛ Ijiptbii lɛ adɛŋ. 36 Yehowa hã Ijiptbii lɛ ahiɛ sɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛhãhãa amɛ nibii ni amɛbibii amɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kpakpla Ijiptbii lɛ ahenii kɛtee.
Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt
37Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ yi mli kɛjɛ Rameses kɛtee Sukot, hii ni nyiɛ amɛnane aaafee akpei ohai ekpaa, soro yei kɛ gbekɛbii. 38Maji srɔtoi anɔ bii babaoo hu fata he kɛtee kɛ agbɛnɛ toi kɛ tsinai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. 39Ni amɛkɛ mã ni amɛkɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ eko shã mã akpiti keeki ejaakɛ eshako akɛ ni Ijiptbii lɛ shwie amɛ bɔ ni amɛwooo mɛɛ koni mã lɛ asha lɛ, ni no hewɔ hu lɛ amɛsako niyenii amɛtoko gbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ.
40 Be abɔ ni Israelbii lɛ ye yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. 41Gbi ni amɛna afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa webii lɛ blublu shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 42Ni akɛni Yehowa shi kpe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛjie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt hewɔ lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ batsɔ̃ kpeshii nyɔɔŋ ehã Israelbii kɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ, ni amɛyeɔ lɛ akɛ Yehowa gbijurɔ.
Hehoo lɛ he akpɔi
43Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Hehoo lɛ he akpɔi nɛ: Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko akaye eko. 44Shi nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ ni akɛ shika he lɛ lɛ, ofo lɛ ketia dani eye eko. 45Mɔ ni ebato nyɛ gbɔ kɛ apaafonyo hu akaye eko. 46 Shĩa fɛɛ shĩa aye enɔ, akɛ loo lɛ eko akaje kpo yɛ shĩa lɛ, asaŋ akajwa loo lɛ mli wui lɛ eko. 47Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aye gbɛjianɔtoi nɛɛ anɔ. 48Shi kɛji gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ miitao akɛ eyeɔ Hehoo lɛ ekɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam lɛ, hã afolɔ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ ketia dani eba ni ebaye eko, ni eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ Israelnyo nɔŋŋ. Shi foolɔ ko foolɔ ko akaye eko. 49 Mla kome akã shi ahã maŋnyo kɛ mɔ ni bato nyɛ gbɔ fɛɛ.” 50Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fee bɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose kɛ Aaron kitã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 51Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yehowa jie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 13
Content:
Kromɔbii anɔjɔɔmɔ
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2 “Kromɔbi nuu fɛɛ kromɔbi nuu, ni ji binuu fɛɛ binuu ni gbeleɔ musu naa, yɛ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi, ejaakɛ minɔ ni.”
Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ
3Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkaia nɛkɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni ji gbi nɔ ni nyɛje Ijipt nyɔŋyeli shishi lɛ, ejaakɛ nineshiwalɛ naa Yehowa jie nyɛ kɛje jɛi. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea masha nii. 4 Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nyɛmiishi Ijipt yɛ Nikpamɔ Nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. 5 Kɛji Yehowa kɛ nyɛ yashɛ Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ kpakpa ni da ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni niyenii pii yɔɔ nɔ, nɔ ni ekã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ ekɛbaahã nyɛ, lɛ nɔ lɛ, jamɔ ni nyɛkɛja lɛ yɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nɛ: 6Aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã lɛ, nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo; shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ Yehowa gbijurɔ ni. 7 Aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã lɛ nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo; akana masha aboloo ko yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ loo masha nɔ ko yɛ nyɛkpokpai anɔ he ko he ko. 8Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛtsia tã, ni nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbii gbijurɔ nɛɛ shishi akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Yehowa fee ehã wɔ be mli ni wɔjeɔ Ijipt lɛ hewɔ ni wɔfeɔ enɛ.’ 9 Nyɛkaia gbijurɔ nɛɛ. Nyɛhãa efea tamɔ okadi ko ni fi nyɛnineshi aloo ni kpɛtɛ nyɛhiɛŋtso nɔ koni Yehowa mla lɛ akã nyɛdaaŋ, ejaakɛ nineshiwalɛ naa Yehowa jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt. 10No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea nɛkɛ akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ ebe lɛ mli.
Kromɔbii kpɔ̃mɔ
11“Kɛji Yehowa kɛ nyɛ yashɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ ekɛaahã nyɛ lɛ, 12binuu fɛɛ binuu ni gbeleɔ musu naa lɛ, nyɛjɔa enɔ nyɛhãa mi, Yehowa. Nyɛshiai amli kooloi akromɔ bihii hu Yehowa nii ni. 13Teji kromɔ binuu fɛɛ kromɔ binuu lɛ nyɛkɛ too akpɔ̃a lɛ. Shi kɛji nyɛkpɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ aku ekuɛŋ. Shi gbɔmɔ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi lɛ nyɛkpɔ̃a lɛ. 14Kɛji nyɛbii bi nyɛ wɔsɛɛ ko akɛ, ‘Ni te gbijurɔ nɛɛ shishi hu lɛ,’ nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Nineshiwalɛ naa Yehowa jie wɔ kɛje Ijipt he ni aye wɔ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ. 15 Ejaakɛ be ni Farao kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kwrakwra akɛ eŋmɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔshi Ijipt lɛ, Yehowa gbe Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ kromɔbi nɔ kɛyashi kooloo tete kromɔbi nɔ. Enɛ hewɔ ni kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni gbeleɔ musu naa, ni ji nuu lɛ, wɔkɛshãa afɔle wɔhãa Yehowa lɛ, shi wɔkromɔ bihii lɛ, amɛ lɛ wɔkpɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ. 16Nyɛhãa enɛ afea tamɔ okadi ko ni fi nyɛnine shi aloo ni kpɛtɛ nyɛhiɛŋtso nɔ ejaakɛ nineshiwalɛ naa Yehowa jie wɔ kɛje Ijipt.’ ”
Atatu kutuu kɛ la kutuu
17Be ni Farao ŋmɛ Israelbii lɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛya lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kpalaaa amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ; tsɛbelɛ jɛi gbɛ lɛ jɛkɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Koni Israelbii lɛ kɛ ta ko akayakpe yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni no hã amɛshwa amɛhe ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt ekoŋŋ.” 18No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Israelbii lɛ lɔgɔ shi kɛtsɔ̃ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ he ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ. Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Ijipt ni amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã ta.
19 Mose loo Yosef gbonyowui lɛ kɛtee tamɔ bɔ ni Yosef ehã Israelbii lɛ ekã kitã amɛto lɛ. Yosef ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ̃ be ko; kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ koni nyɛwo migbonyo wui lɛ kɛje biɛ.”
20Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Sukot, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Etam yɛ ŋa lɛ naa. 21 Shwane mli lɛ Yehowa nyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ tamɔ atatu kutuu koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ hu enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ tamɔ atatu la kutuu koni ehã amɛna nii; ni amɛnyiɛ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ. 22Shwane mli lɛ atatu kutuu lɛ ejeee amɛhiɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ hu la kutuu lɛ ejeee amɛhiɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 14
Content:
Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ foo
1Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛdɔ amɛyi ni amɛyato shi yɛ Pi-Hahirot hiɛ, yɛ Migdol kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ teŋ, yɛ Baal-Zefon masɛi. Nyɛtoa shi yɛ eŋlɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa. 3No aaahã Farao asusu ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Israelbii lɛ eyadu gbɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ, shiaŋa lɛ esa amɛyi’. 4 Mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui koni etiu nyɛ, ni no aaahã Farao kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ ashe mi gbeyei, ni Ijiptbii baana ale akɛ mi ji Yehowa lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ ni akɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
5Be ni ababɔ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ Israelbii lɛ ejo foi amɛtee lɛ, Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ tsake amɛjwɛŋmɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ mɛni po wɔfee nɛɛ, ni wɔhã Israelbii lɛ kpa wɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni amɛtee nɛɛ?” 6No hewɔ lɛ, Farao saa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etayaa shwiilii lɛ, ni eloo esraafoi efata ehe. 7Esaa eŋɔ tayaa shwiilii ohai ekpaa ni aje gbɛ ahala, agbɛnɛ kɛ Ijipt shwiilii fɛɛ kɛ amɛnɔ tatsɛmɛi eshwie esɛɛ. 8Shi Yehowa hã Ijipt maŋtsɛ Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni etiu Israelbii lɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ nine ni tsii lɛ hiɛ amɛ kɛyaa lɛ. 9Ijiptbii lɛ yi Israelbii lɛ asɛɛ kɛ Farao okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ asraafoi fɛɛ. Ni amɛyanina Israelbii lɛ ni amɛto shi yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa, yɛ Pi-hahirot masɛi yɛ Baal-Zefon hiɛ.
10Farao kɛ eta lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ. Be ni Israelbii lɛ yaahole amɛhiŋmɛii anɔ lɛ, naa Farao kɛ Ijiptbii lɛ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba. Gbeyei mɔmɔ Israelbii lɛ naakpa, ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa. 11Ni amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ani gbonyobui ni bɛ Ijipt hewɔ ni okpala wɔ kɛba koni wɔbagboi yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɛɛ? Mɛɛba oye wɔ nɛkɛ sane, ni oloo wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba biɛ nɛɛ? 12Ani jeee wiemɔ ni wɔkɛ bo wie yɛ Ijipt lɛ nɛ akɛ, ‘Fɔ̃ɔmɔ ni ohã wɔsɔ̃mɔ Ijiptbii lɛ kɛkɛ?’ Shi faŋ nɔ moŋ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔ Ijiptbii lɛ fe nɔ ni wɔɔyagboi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.”
13Ni Mose here Israelbii lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei! Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ ni nyɛkwɛa nyɛyiwala ni Yehowa baahere ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ. Ejaakɛ Ijiptbii ni nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ. 14 Yehowa baawu ahã nyɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛfea diŋŋ”.
15Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni obolɔɔ otsɛɔ mi? Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛya amɛhiɛ. 16Shi bo lɛ, wo otso lɛ nɔ ni okpã onine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ koni ogba ŋshɔ lɛ mli enyɔ koni Israelbii lɛ anyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ kɛya. 17Mahã Ijiptbii lɛ akpliŋ amɛtsui koni amɛnyiɛ Israelbii lɛ asɛɛ, ni maye Farao kɛ eta shwiilii kɛ ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim. 18Ni kɛji miye Farao kɛ eta shwiilii kɛ ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, Ijiptbii aaana amɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa.”
19Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ ni nyiɛ Israelbii lɛ ata lɛ hiɛ lɛ gbala ehe shi eyaje amɛsɛɛgbɛ, ni atatu kutuu lɛ je amɛhiɛgbɛ ni eyashi yɛ amɛsɛɛgbɛ, 20yɛ Ijiptbii ata lɛ kɛ Israelbii ata lɛ teŋ. Shwane lɛ atatu lɛ woɔ Ijiptbii lɛ hiɛ duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ ekpɛɔ ehãa Israelbii lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi nyɛɛɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi abɛŋkɛ. 21Mose kpã enine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni naa wa batswa nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni ehã ŋshɔ lɛ gbala kɛtee sɛɛ, yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni emli gba enyɔ, ni eshi shikpɔŋ gbiŋ efɔ̃ shi yɛ eteŋ, 22 ni Israelbii lɛ yi shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ, ni nu lɛ ma shi tamɔ gbogbo yɛ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku. 23 Ijiptbii lɛ tiu Israelbii lɛ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛbote ŋshɔ lɛ mli. Amɛkɛ Farao okpɔŋɔi kɛ etayaa shwiilii kɛ ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ fɛɛ. 24 Ni maŋkɛ mra mli lɛ Yehowa jɛ atatu kutuu kɛ la kutuu lɛ mli ekwɛ Ijiptbii ata lɛ, ni ehao amɛ. 25 Ehã amɛshwiilii lɛ anaji lɛ bɔi fuu, ni ekɛwo Ijiptbii lɛ hejaramɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Ijiptbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔjoa Israelbii lɛ anaa foi ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ wɔ miiwu miihã amɛ.”
26Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpã onine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ koni ŋshɔ lɛ abaha Ijiptbii kɛ amɛtayaa shwiilii kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ anɔ.” 27No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kpã enine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ. Ni jetsɛremɔ mli leebi lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ yiridi kɛjɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ kɛmiiba abatsa ekoŋŋ, ni Ijiptbii lɛ wo foi, shi amɛkɛ ŋshɔ lɛ bakpe, ni Yehowa hã Ijiptbii lɛ ahiɛ kpãtã yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ.
28Ŋshɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ ba, ni ebaha Farao shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi kɛ eta muu lɛ fɛɛ ni tiu Israelbii lɛ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ; eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome tete po. 29Shi Israelbii lɛ nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo hã amɛ yɛ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku.
30Nakai gbi lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa fee ehere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala kɛjɛ Ijiptbii adɛŋ nɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ na Ijiptbii lɛ jwere ŋshɔ lɛ naa ni amɛgboi. 31 Ni Israelbii lɛ na Yehowa hewalɛ wulu ni ejie lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Ijiptbii lɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ she Yehowa gbeyei, ni amɛhe Yehowa kɛ etsulɔ Mose amɛye.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 15
Content:
Mose lala lɛ
1 Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ la nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ kɛjie Yehowa yi, ni amɛkɛɛ,
“Mala majie Yehowa yi,
ejaakɛ eye kunim kpeteŋkple
kɛwo ehiɛ nyam;
okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ lɛ
etsirɛ amɛ ewo ŋshɔŋ.
2 Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala,
ni lɛ etsɔ̃ miyiwalaherelɔ.
Lɛ ji miNyɔŋmɔ, ni majie eyi,
mitsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ ni, ni mawo ehiɛ nyam.
3 Yehowa, lɛ tawulɔ ni.
Ani jeee egbɛi ji Yehowa?
4“Farao shwiilii lɛ kɛ eta lɛ
eloo ewo ŋshɔŋ,
ni etatsɛmɛi kpanakpanaa lɛ,
amii amɛ nu yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli.
5Ŋshɔ lɛ ha amɛnɔ,
ni amɛshiu kɛtee nu shishi tamɔ tɛ.
6Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ hiɛ eba nyam,
Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ tserɛɔ henyɛlɔ mli.
7 Ogbojee lɛ naa sɔŋŋ lɛ,
obutu mɛi ni te shi wo bo lɛ.
Omlila lɛ gri wo amɛ,
ni eshã amɛ tamɔ la shãa gbetseli.
8Omu oshwie ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ,
ni nu lɛ bua ehe naa,
ni ŋshɔkei lɛ ho damɔ shi keikei,
ŋshɔ teŋteŋ nu lɛ shɔ̃ etsɔ̃ kpɔ.
9Henyɛlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Matiu amɛ mayamɔmɔ amɛ.
Maja nomŋɔɔnii lɛ,
mitsui aaanyɔ mimli.
Magbala miklante
ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ.’
10Ohã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ha amɛnɔ;
amɛshiu tamɔ sumui yɛ nu hamahama lɛ mli.
11 “Namɔ tamɔ Bo, Yehowa,
yɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ?
Namɔ tsuɔ nyam nii
ni yɔɔ gbeyei kɛ naakpɛɛ?
12Okpa oninejurɔ mli,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mi amɛ.
13Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ
okpala maŋ ni okpɔ̃ nɛɛ.
Ohewalɛ naa lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ
kɛshɛ oshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
14 Jeŋ maji lɛ nu he,
ni amɛhe kpokpo,
ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ Filistibii lɛ.
15Agbɛnɛ shiofɔ̃ eshi Edom maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ,
Moab kãkãlɔi lɛ ahe kpokpo;
Kanaanbii fɛɛ ehao.
16Gbeyei kɛ ŋmiŋmi eloo amɛ,
onineshi tsiimɔ sɔŋŋ ehã amɛmu shi dɛoo
kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa, omaŋ lɛ aaaho,
kɛyaashi mɛi ni okpɔ̃ lɛ aaaho.
17Okɛ amɛ aaaba ni obato amɛ shi
yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ogɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
18 Yehowa aaaye maŋtsɛ
kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.”
Miriam lala lɛ
19 Be ni Farao okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ eshwiilii lɛ kɛ ekpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi lɛ bote ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa hã ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ ku esɛɛ ebaha amɛnɔ, shi Israelbii lɛ nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ ŋshɔ lɛ mli kɛtee.
20 Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔyoo Miriam, Aaron nyɛmiyoo lɛ, kɔ fao ehiɛ edɛ̃, ni yei lɛ fɛɛ kɔlɔ fabii kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛsha ni amɛjo. 21 Miriam wo lala ekɛɛ,
“Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa
ejaakɛ eye kunim kɛwo ehiɛ nyam;
etsirɛ okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ lɛ ewo ŋshɔŋ.”
Nu ni joɔ lɛ
22Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa kɛtee Shur ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni amɛnaaa nu. 23Be ni amɛyashɛ he ko ni gbɛi ji Mara lɛ amɛyanina nu; shi Mara nu nɛɛ ehiii numɔ ejaakɛ eejoo. No hewɔ awo jɛi Mara lɛ. 24Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni wɔbaanu mɔ?” 25Mose bo etsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ tso ko; ni be ni ekɔ ni eshɛ efɔ nu lɛ mli lɛ, nu lɛ baŋɔɔ. Jɛi Yehowa wo Israelbii lɛ kitã kɛ akpɔ yɛ, ni jɛi hu ekã amɛ yɛ, 26 ni ekɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛaaye Yehowa, ni ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee nɔ kadikadi, ni nyɛaafee nɔ ni ja gbɛ yɛ ehiɛ, ni nyɛaaye ekpɔi kɛ kitãi fɛɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ helai ni mihã ye Ijiptbii lɛ eko eko yeŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛtsalɔ lɛ.”
27Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ ba Elim, he ni nubui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amitsrɔbi tsei nyɔŋmai kpawo yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛbato shi yɛ jɛi yɛ nu lɛ he.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 16
Content:
Mana kɛ Trakɔkɔi lɛ
1Israelbii asafo lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Elim kɛtee Sin ŋa ni kã Elim kɛ Sinai teŋ lɛ nɔ. Amɛyashɛ jɛi Ijipt shimɔ lɛ sɛɛ nyɔji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ. 2 Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. 3 Amɛkɛɛ, “Yehowa hã wɔgboi yɛ Ijipt be ni wɔtara loo kɛ kukwɛii ahe ni wɔyeɔ nii wɔtɔrɔɔ lɛ moŋ kulɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni nyɛjie wɔ kɛba ŋa nɛɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkɛ hɔmɔ abagbe asafo muu nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ.”
4 Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, mibahã aboloo ajɛ ŋwɛi anɛ ashwie shi ahã nyɛ. Daa gbi lɛ maŋbii lɛ aje kpo ayabua naa bɔ pɛ ni aaashɛ amɛyeli gbi kome. Mikɛ enɛ baaka amɛ makwɛ akɛ amɛaaye mimla lɛ nɔ aloo amɛyeŋ nɔ. 5Shi gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, hã ni amɛsaa nɔ ni amɛbuaa naa daa gbi lɛ falɛ toi enyɔ amɛto.”
6Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 7Leebi lɛ nyɛaana Yehowa anunyam lɛ, ejaakɛ enu huhuuhu wiemɔi ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ namɛi ji wɔ ni nyɛwieɔ huhuuhu nyɛshiɔ wɔ?” 8Mose tee nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji gbɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa hã nyɛ loo nyɛye, ni leebi lɛ ehã nyɛ aboloo nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ, ejaakɛ enu huhuuhu wiemɔi ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ lɛ lɛ, wɔ lɛ nɛgbɛ wɔdamɔ? Jeee wɔ nyɛwieɔ huhuuhu nyɛshiɔ lɛ, shi Yehowa mɔŋ ni.”
9Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsia nyɛbaa Yehowa hiɛ; enu nyɛ huhuuhu wiemɔi lɛ.’ ” 10 Be ni Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ wieɔ lɛ, amɛkwɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni naa, Yehowa anunyam lɛ epue yɛ atatu lɛ mli. 11Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 12“Minu Israelbii lɛ ahuhuuhu wiemɔi lɛ. Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ nyɛaaye loo, ni leebi lɛ nyɛaaye aboloo nyɛtɔrɔ, ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ”
13 Gbɛkɛnaashi mli lɛ trakɔkɔi baha Israelbii lɛ ashihilɛhe lɛ. Leebi mli lɛ bɔ nyɔ kɛbɔle Israelbii lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe kpula. 14Be ni bɔ lɛ kpala lɛ, ana nibii tɛtɛrɛbii kokrobii bibiibii komɛi jwere ŋa lɛ nɔ fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni efĩ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 15 Be ni Israelbii lɛ na nibii nɛɛ, amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Kolɛ mɛni nɛ?” Ejaakɛ amɛleee nɔ ni ji. Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aboloo ni Yehowa hã nyɛ koni nyɛye lɛ nɛ. 16Ŋmaa nɛɛ he kitã ni Yehowa ewo nɛ: ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abua bɔ ni eeenyɛ eye naa, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa nii afee tsenesa loo gomer kome falɛ yɛ nyɛyibɔ naa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akɔlɔ ahã mɛi abɔ ni ekɛyɔɔ ebuu mli lɛ.’ ”
17Israelbii lɛ fee nakai. Mɛi komɛi kɔlɔ pii, ni mɛi komɛi kɔlɔ fioo. 18 Shi be ni akɛ tsenesa yaasusu lɛ, mɔ ni kɔlɔ pii lɛ enaaa eko yɛ sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni kɔlɔ fioo hu eshwɛɛɛ lɛ eko dani ashɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ na bɔ ni eeenyɛ eye. 19Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo maŋbii lɛ shi ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko akashwɛ eko ni je miitsɛre nɔ.” 20Shi kɛ̃lɛ mɛi komɛi eyabooo Mose toi ni amɛshwɛ eko. Be ni je tsɛre lɛ ewo gɔgɔmi, ni esha. Enɛ hã Mose mli wo amɛ la. 21No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ daa leebi lɛ Israelbii lɛ yakɔlɔɔ ŋmaa lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, bɔ ni eeenyɛ eye kɛkɛ. Kɛji hulu naa wa lɛ esereɔ.
22Gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɔlɔ daa gbi niyenii lɛ falɛ toi enyɔ, mɔ kome nɔ tsenesai enyɔ, ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ onukpai lɛ babɔ Mose amaniɛ. 23Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Yehowa fã: ‘Wɔ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni, Yehowa hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni. Nyɛshãa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ shãa, ni nyɛhoa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ hoomɔ. Nɔ ni baashwɛ lɛ nyɛkɛtoa ni je atsɛrea nɔ.’ ” 24 Amɛkɛ nii ni shwɛ lɛ to ni je tsɛre nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ lɛ; niyenii lɛ eshaaa lɛ, ewooo gɔgɔmi hu.
25Ni Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyea enɛ ŋmɛnɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa hejɔɔmɔ gbi ji ŋmɛnɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɛnɛ nyɛnaŋ eko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ nyɛkɔlɔ. 26Nyɛbuaa ŋmaa lɛ naa gbii ekpaa ejaakɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni, ni no nɔ lɛ eko baŋ.”
27Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛi komɛi je maŋbii lɛ ateŋ tee ŋmaa kɔlɔmɔ, shi amɛyanaaa eko amɛkɔlɔ. 28Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaakwa mikitãi kɛ mimlai lɛ? 29Nyɛnaaa akɛ ni Yehowa hã nyɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, no hewɔ ni ehãa nyɛ gbii enyɔ niyenii yɛ gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ? Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahi eshĩa, mɔ ko akaje egbɛhe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.” 30No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ jɔɔ amɛhe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.
31Israelbii lɛ wo niyenii nɛɛ gbɛi akɛ mana. Edalɛ tamɔ mlɛ bibii, ni eyɛɔ futafuta, ni eŋɔɔmɔ tamɔ akpãanɔɔ kɛ wo. 32Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Kitã ni Yehowa ewo nɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ niyenii nɛɛ tsenesa kome falɛ atoa nyɛhãa nyɛshwiei koni amɛbana ŋmaa ni mikɛlɛ nyɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ be mli ni mijie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.’ ” 33 Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Wo kpulu ni osusu mana tsenesa kome falɛ owo mli, ni okɛyama Yehowa hiɛ koni akɛto ahã nyɛshwiei yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.” 34Aaron kɛ mana lɛ yama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ koni akɛto. 35Ni Israelbii lɛ ye mana afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛyashi amɛyanina shikpɔŋ ni amɛaanyɛ nɔ amɛhi. Amɛye mana lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛyashɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ husu naa. 36(“Gomer” loo tsenesa kome feɔ “efa” loo yiteremɔ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome.)

Title: ƐKSODƆS 17
Content:
Nu jɛ tɛsaa mli
(Numeri 20.1-13)
1Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Sin ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛtotoo shi yɛ gbɛ teŋ yɛ Yehowa famɔ naa kɛyashi amɛyashɛ Refidim; shi nu bɛ jɛi ni maŋ lɛ baanu. 2 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Hã wɔ nu wɔnu!” Mose here amɛ nɔ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ mi beɔ? Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkaa Yehowa?”
3Shi kumai ye maŋ lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛwie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ obajie wɔ yɛ Ijipt? Koni okɛ kumai abagbe wɔ kɛ wɔbii kɛ wɔkooloi?”
4 No hewɔ lɛ, Mose bo etsɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, “Te mafee maŋ nɛɛ mahã tɛŋŋ? Tɛ amɛheɔ amɛtswia mi nɛɛ!”
5Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Halamɔ Israel onukpai lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi komɛi ofata ohe, ni okɔ otso lɛ ni okɛtswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni okɛ amɛ atsɔ̃ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛya. 6 Naa, mibadamɔ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, ni nu baajɛ mli aba koni maŋ lɛ anu.” Ni Mose fee nakai yɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ.
7 Ni Mose wo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Masa kɛ Meriba yɛ shwamɔ ni Israelbii lɛ shwa Yehowa lɛ kɛ nɔ ni amɛwie amɛkɛka lɛ akɛ, “Ni Yehowa yɛ wɔteŋ kɛ̃ nɛ?” lɛ hewɔ.
Israelbii kɛ Amalekbii wu ta
8Amalekbii lɛ fã ta kɛbanina Israelbii lɛ yɛ Refidim, ni amɛkɛ amɛ wu. 9Ni Mose fã Yoshua ekɛɛ, “Halamɔ hii ni amɛya amɛkɛ Amalekbii lɛ ayawu ahã maŋ lɛ. Mi lɛ mibadamɔ gɔŋkpɔ lɛ yiteŋ wɔ, ni mahiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tso lɛ yɛ midɛ̃.” 10Yoshua fee bɔ ni Mose fã lɛ lɛ, ni amɛtee amɛkɛ Amalekbii lɛ yawu, ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Hur kwɔ gɔŋkpɔ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ. 11Kɛji Mose wo enine nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ Amalekbii lɛ anɔ; shi kɛji Mose kɛ enine ba shi pɛ Amalekbii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ. 12Shi Mose niji bɔ̃i lɛ shɔ̃ɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, awo tɛ akɛto Mose shishi ni eho eta nɔ, ni Aaron kɛ Hur hiɛ eniji lɛ amli, mɔ kome yɛ biɛ, ni mɔ kome hu yɛ biɛ, ni eniji lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ kɛyashi hulushinyɔɔ mli. 13Ni Yoshua kpãtã Amalek kɛ emaŋ lɛ hiɛ.
