14 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋmaa kunimyeli nɛɛ he sane lɛ owo wolo mli ofɔ̃ shi koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔ nɔ; ni okpã owo Yoshua toiŋ akɛ mibagbe Amalek kwrakwra yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.” 15Ni Mose ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ “Yehowa ji miflaŋaa”, 16ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛwoa Yehowa aflaŋaa lɛ nɔ. Yehowa kɛ Amalek baawu kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyaashi yinɔ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 18
Content:
Yetro yasara Mose
1 Yetro, Midian osɔfo lɛ ni ji Mose shaanuu lɛ nu nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee ehã Mose kɛ emaŋ Israel lɛ he, no ji bɔ ni Yehowa jie Israel kɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ. 2Kɛkɛ ni Yetro, Mose shaanuu lɛ, yiŋ etee Mose ŋɔɔ. Eŋɔ Zipora, Mose ŋa lɛ ni Mose hã eku esɛɛ etee Midian lɛ, 3 kɛ Mose bihii enyɔ lɛ efata ehe kɛtee. Bihii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbɛi ji Gershom, ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ, “Miyato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ”, 4ni mɔ kome lɛ hu gbɛi ji Eliezer ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ, “Mitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni wa mi, ni ehe mi kɛje Farao dɛŋ gbele mli.” 5Yetro, Mose shaanuu lɛ, kɛ Mose ŋa lɛ kɛ ebihii enyɔ lɛ ba Mose ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ he ni Israelbii lɛ eyato shi yɛ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ. 6Ni Yetro hã ayakɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mi oshaanuu, mi kɛ oŋa kɛ obihii enyɔ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ.” 7No hewɔ lɛ, Mose je kpo ekɛ eshaanuu lɛ yakpe. Mose koto lɛ ni eshwɔ enaa; amɛflaflaa amɛhe, ni amɛba Mose buu lɛ mli. 8Ni Mose gba eshaanuu lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa fee Farao kɛ Ijiptbii yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ. Egba lɛ haomɔi hu ni ba Israelbii lɛ anɔ yɛ amɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli, kɛ bɔ ni fee ni Yehowa jie amɛ yɛ mli. 9Yetro mii shɛ ehe yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni Yehowa efee yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahewɔ, akɛ ejie amɛ yɛ Ijipt nyɔŋyeli shishi. 10Ni Yetro kɛɛ, “Ajie Yehowa yi, lɛ mɔ ni ejie nyɛ yɛ Farao kɛ Ijiptbii lɛ adɛŋ, ni ejie emaŋ lɛ yɛ Ijiptbii anɔyeli shishi lɛ. 11Kpaako mina mile akɛ Yehowa fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ ejaakɛ eto Ijiptbii lɛ kpa, akɛni amɛwo amɛhe amɛhã Israelbii lɛ, ni Yehowa ba amɛ shi.” 12Ni Yetro, Mose shaanuu lɛ, yashã shãa afɔle kɛ afɔlei krokomɛi ehã Yehowa, ni Aaron kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ba koni amɛ kɛ Mose shaanuu lɛ abaye nii yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kojolɔiwoo
(Deuteronomio 1.9-18)
13Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Mose ho eta shi, ni ekura maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji, ni maŋ lɛ jwere enɔ kɛjɛ leebi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 14Be ni Mose shaanuu lɛ na nibii fɛɛ ni Mose tsuɔ ehãa maŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji nɔ ni otsuɔ ohãa maŋ lɛ nɛɛ? Mɛɛba okome too ota shi, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ jwere onɔ nɛkɛ leebileebi jenamɔ nɛɛ?”
15Mose hã lɛ hetoo ekɛɛ, “Ebaa lɛ nakai ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ baa amɛbabiɔ mi Nyɔŋmɔ daaŋ gbee. 16Kɛji amɛna sane ko lɛ amɛkɛbaa miŋɔɔ, ni mikuraa, ni mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpɔi kɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ.”
17Mose shaanuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni ofeɔ nɛɛ ehiii. 18 Ebaatɔ bo kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hu. Nitsumɔ nɛɛ fa tsɔ̃ hã bo; okome too onyɛŋ otsu. 19Agbɛnɛ bo migbee toi; mawo bo ŋaa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ aye abua bo. Bo lɛ feemɔ maŋbii lɛ anaadamɔlɔ yɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ koni okɛ amɛsaji lɛ ashwie Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; 20ni otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpɔi, nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, ni ohã amɛle bɔ ni sa akɛ amɛba amɛjeŋ amɛhã, kɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ amɛfee. 21Ni asaŋ halamɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ mli hii ni aaanyɛ atsu gbɛnaa ni abaahã amɛ lɛ he nii, mɛi ni amɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei hu, ni amɛ ji anɔkwafoi ni heee nyɔɔŋnii, koni oto amɛ kui anɔkwɛlɔi: mɛi nyɔŋmanyɔŋma kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ kui kɛ mɛi ohaoha kui kɛ akpeakpe kui anɔkwɛlɔi. 22Ohã amɛ amɛkura saji ni baaba maŋbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ be fɛɛ be. Sane wulu fɛɛ sane wulu lɛ, no lɛ akɛba ohiɛ; shi saji bibii fɛɛ lɛ kui anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ aye, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛmɔ mli amɛhã bo koni efo tsɔ́ ehã bo. 23Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fãa bo nɛ. Kɛji ofee nakai lɛ, ooonyɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ naa odamɔ, ni maŋbii nɛɛ fɛɛ hu aaayashɛ amɛshɛɛhe yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.”
24Mose bo eshaanuu lɛ toi, ni efee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ fɛɛ. 25Ehala maŋ lɛ fɛɛ mli hii ni aaanyɛ atsu gbɛnaa ni abaahã amɛ lɛ he nii, ni eto amɛ kui anɔkwɛlɔi: mɛi nyɔŋma nyɔŋma kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ kui kɛ mɛi ohaoha kui kɛ mɛi akpeakpe kui anɔkwɛlɔi. 26Nɔkwɛlɔi nɛɛ kuraa maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji be fɛɛ be. Saji wuji lɛ amɛkɛbaa Mose ŋɔɔ; shi saji bibii fɛɛ lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkuraa.
27Fee sɛɛ lɛ Mose shaanuu Yetro kɛ lɛ ye shɛɛ, ni Yetro ku esɛɛ etee emaŋ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 19
Content:
Israelbii lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he
1Gbi ni Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, enɔ nyɔji etɛ̃ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni amɛyashɛ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ. 2Refidim ji he ni amɛfã kɛjɛ dani amɛyashɛ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛbato shi yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ hiɛ. 3Kɛkɛ ni Mose kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ. Yehowa jɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ etsɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Yakob shwiei, ni ji Israelbii, lɛ akɛ, 4 ‘Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛna nɔ ni mifee Ijiptbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni mihiɛ nyɛ kɛ hewalɛ tamɔ okropɔŋ, ni mikɛ nyɛ bashɛ miŋɔɔ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ. 5 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji nyɛaabo mi toi, ni nyɛaaye mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaatsɔ̃ mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ yɛ maji fɛɛ ateŋ; ejaakɛ je lɛ fɛɛ lɛ minɔ ni. 6 Mibafee nyɛ osɔfoi abladei, mibafee nyɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nɔ ni okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ nɛ.’ ” 7Mose ku esɛɛ eba, ni ebatsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ. 8Ni maŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ shi kome amɛkɛɛ, “Nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ wɔɔfee.” Mose hã Yehowa le hetoo ni maŋ lɛ hã lɛ.
9Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Miiba oŋɔɔ yɛ atatu kpii mli koni kɛ mi kɛ bo miiwie lɛ, maŋ lɛ anu ni amɛhe bo hu amɛye kɛya naanɔ.”
10Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yaa maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni otsuu amɛhe ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ ni ohã amɛfɔ amɛtadei ahe, 11ni amɛsaa amɛhe amɛto gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ Yehowa baakpleke shi kɛba gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiŋmɛiŋ. 12 Foo akrabatsa okɛtsi maŋ lɛ gbɛ, ni obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni nyɛkakwɔa gɔŋ lɛ, aloo ni nyɛtaa ehusu lɛ he.’ Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ gbe aaagbe lɛ. 13 Mɔ ko mɔ ko nine akata nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ he, shi atswia lɛ tɛ aloo atsɛ̃rɛ lɛ gãi. Kooloo ni jio, gbɔmɔ ni jio, akahã eyi na wala. Shi kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni esɛɛ tsɛ aahu lɛ, no dani amɛba gɔŋ lɛ he.”
14Mose kpeleke shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba maŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni etsuu maŋ lɛ he, ni amɛfɔfɔɔ amɛtadei ahe. 15 Ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa hã, wɔ bɛ mli, wɔsɛɛ. Nuu akaya yoo masɛi.”
16 Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ leebi lɛ ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni srawa gbala ni atatu kpii ko baha gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ko gbɛɛ waa naakpa, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ shitoohe lɛ fɛɛ kpokpo. 17Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ maŋ lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ shitoohe lɛ koni amɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ayakpe, ni amɛyadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ shishi. 18Sinai Gɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miije lasu, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekpeleke shi kɛba gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ la mli. Lasu lɛ fãa kɛyaa ŋwɛi tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli lasu, ni gɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hoso waa naakpa. 19 Be ni tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ yaa nɔ gbɛɔ waa lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Mose wie, ni Nyɔŋmɔ here lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔ. 20Be ni Yehowa kpeleke shi kɛba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, etsɛ Mose akɛ eba gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ; ni Mose tee. 21Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpelekemɔ shi ni oyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ kpɔ́kpɔ́ɔkpɔ́ akɛ amɛkatse mli kɛmiiba Yehowa ŋɔɔ amɛbakwɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ, koni amɛteŋ mɛi pii miiplenee. 22Asaŋ hã osɔfoi lɛ ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa atsuu amɛhe koni Yehowa akakpãtã amɛhiɛ.”
23Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Maŋ lɛ nyɛŋ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aba ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ okpã owo wɔtoiŋ akɛ, ‘Nyɛfoa akrabatsa nyɛwoa gɔŋ lɛ he nyɛfea lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.’ ”
24Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpelekemɔ shi oya ni okɛ Aaron akwɔ kɛba, shi kaahã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ miiteke akrabatsa lɛ kɛkwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛba mi, Yehowa, miŋɔɔ koni mikaplene amɛ.” 25Mose kpeleke shi kɛba maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ amɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 20
Content:
Kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ
(Deuteronomio 5.1-21)
1Ni Nyɔŋmɔ wie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ ekɛɛ:
2“Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mi mijie bo yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
3 “Kaana nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi yɛ misɛɛ.
4 “Kaafee amãgã ko loo nɔ ko ni tamɔ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi loo nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo nii ni yɔɔ nu mli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ ohã ohe.
5 “Kaaja amɛ, ni kaasɔ̃mɔ amɛ hu, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ji mi, ni miwoɔ tsɛmɛi kɛ bii anyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ nɔ.
6“Shi mɛi akpei abɔ fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ mi, ni amɛyeɔ mikitãi anɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ amɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee, ni minaa amɛ mɔbɔ.
7 “Kaahiɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli yakayaka, ejaakɛ Yehowa ebuŋ mɔ ni tsɛɔ egbɛi yakayaka lɛ bem.
8 “Ohiɛ ahi hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ ni oye lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ. 9Tsu nii gbii ekpaa ni ofee onii fɛɛ, 10shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni hã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No nɔ lɛ okatsu nɔ ko, bo jio, obinuu jio, obiyoo jio, owenuu jio, oweyoo jio, okooloo jio, ogbɔ ni ebato omaŋ jio. 11 Ejaakɛ gbii ekpaa Yehowa kɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ; ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ejɔɔ ehe. No hewɔ ni Yehowa jɔɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
12 “Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mi, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
13 “Kaagbe gbɔmɔ.
14 “Kaafite gbãlã.
15“Kaaju.
16 “Kaaye amale odase yɛ onaanyo he.
17“Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ onaanyo nɔ ko nɔ, eshĩa jio, eŋa jio, ewenuu jio, eweyoo jio, etsina jio, eteji jio, enɔ kroko jio, ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nɔ.”
Israelbii lɛ she gbeyei
(Deuteronomio 5.22-33)
18Be ni Israelbii lɛ na bɔ ni ŋwɛi shimɔɔ, ni srawa gbalaa, ni tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɔ, ni gɔŋ lɛ fãa lasu lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei, ni amɛkpokpo, ni amɛdamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. 19Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Bo moŋ okɛ wɔ awie, ni wɔɔbo toi, shi kaahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ miiwie ni wɔbagboi.”
20Mose kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ kaa Nyɔŋmɔ ba nyɛ kaa, bɔ ni afee ni lɛ egbeyeishemɔ ahi nyɛmli daa koni nyɛkafee esha.” 21 Shi maŋ lɛ damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ lolo; kɛkɛ ni Mose tsi ebɛŋkɛ duŋ kpii lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ mli lɛ.
Afɔleshãa latɛi ahe mlai
22Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛna akɛ ŋwɛi mijɛ mikɛ nyɛ wie nɛɛ. 23Nyɛkafea mihenɔ jwiɛtɛi loo shika amãgãi; nyɛkafea eko eko nyɛhãa nyɛhe koni nyɛja amɛ nyɛfata mihe. 24Nyɛshɔ̃a su afɔleshãa latɛ nyɛhãa mi, ni no nɔ nyɛshãa afɔlei yɛ, shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei kɛ gwantɛŋi kɛ tsinai lɛ yɛ. He fɛɛ he ni mato mahã nyɛ akɛ aja mi yɛ lɛ, maba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi ni majɔɔ nyɛ. 25 Kɛji nyɛkɛ tɛ miima afɔleshãa latɛ nyɛhã mi lɛ, akɛ tɛ ni ako akama ejaakɛ ŋaa dade naa ni aaasa tɛ lɛ he pɛ ebule lɛ. 26Ni okafee atrakpoi owo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni akana oyayaiaŋ yɛ atrakpoi lɛ kwɔɔ mli.’ ”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 21
Content:
Bɔ ni ahiɛ nyɔji ahã
(Deuteronomio 15.12-18)
1“Agbɛnɛ okɛ mlai nɛɛ ashwie Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ. 2 Kɛji ohe Hebrinyo akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ esɔ̃mɔ afii ekpaa, ni afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe ni eye ehe tswaa. 3Kɛji ekome eba lɛ, ekome nɔŋŋ eya. Shi kɛji ekɛ eŋa ba lɛ, no lɛ eŋa lɛ kɛ lɛ aya. 4Kɛji enuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã lɛ ŋa, ni ekɛ yoo lɛ efɔ bihii loo biyei lɛ, no lɛ yoo lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ etsɔ̃ enuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nuu lɛ kome too aya. 5Shi kɛji nyɔŋ lɛ gba mli kpoo ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Miisumɔ minuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ miŋa kɛ mibii lɛ, ni misumɔɔɔ akɛ mashi amɛ maya mayaye mihe lɛ,’ 6 no lɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ aya Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ehã edamɔ jamɔhe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa loo shinaatso lɛ he, ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ fitii agbu nyɔŋ lɛ toi, ni nyɔŋ lɛ asɔ̃mɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
7 “Kɛji nuu ko hɔ̃ɔ ebiyoo akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ, biyoo nɛɛ akatsɔ̃ gbɛ nɔ ni hii nyɔji tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ amɛhe lɛ nɔ eye ehe. 8Kɛ nyɔŋ yoo nɛɛ esaaa enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ akɛ eeeŋɔ lɛ efee eŋa lɛ, no lɛ ehã abakpɔ̃ lɛ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɛ hegbɛ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ ehãa maŋsɛɛnyo, ejaakɛ no lɛ eku eshiwoo mli. 9Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ yoo lɛ hã ebinuu gbãlã lɛ, nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ yoo nɛɛ ahi shi akɛ ebiyoo. 10Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ yaŋɔ yoo ni ji enyɔ ebafata nyɔŋyoo lɛ he lɛ, no akahã etse nyɔŋyoo lɛ daaŋ ŋmaa kɛ ehebo kɛ egblãshihilɛ mli gbɛnaa nii nɔ. 11Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsuuu nibii etɛ̃ nɛɛ ahe ehãaa nyɔŋ yoo lɛ, no lɛ nyɔŋ yoo lɛ aye ehe tswaa, ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ aheɔ eyi shika ko.”
Awuiyeli he mlai
12 “Mɔ ni aaatswa enyɛmi gbɔmɔ nɔ, ni mɔ lɛ aaagbo lɛ, lɛ hu agbe lɛ. 13 Kɛjeee ka eyawo lɛ, shi osharã naa ni, enine kpa yɛ mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ ejo foi eyaba abo yɛ he ko ni mato mahã nyɛ. 14 Shi kɛji mɔ ko to ŋaa fɔŋ yɛ enyɛmi gbɔmɔ he, ni eje gbɛ eyatua lɛ, ni egbe lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ eyaba abo yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa tete po, ajie lɛ kɛje jɛi ni ayagbe lɛ.
15“Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagba etsɛ loo enyɛ ma lɛ agbe lɛ.
16 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaju gbɔmɔ lɛ, eyahɔɔ lɛ jio, eto lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ ehã ehe jio, agbe lɛ.
17 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaalomɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ agbe lɛ.
18“Kɛji hii miinɔ ni mɔ kome tswa enaanyo lɛ tɛ aloo ema lɛ atswɛrɛ, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔɔɔ mli gbooo, shi efee lɛ hela kɛkã shi lɛ, 19kɛji helatsɛ lɛ na ete shi ekoŋŋ, ni emɔ tso mli enyiɛ kɛje kpo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ eye ehe, shi moŋ ewo be ni helatsɛ lɛ efite lɛ he nyɔmɔ, ni ekwɛ koni atsa helatsɛ lɛ ni ehe atã kwrakwra.
20“Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ tso tswa enyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo, ni nyɔŋ lɛ nyɔ yɛ enine naa lɛ, ja atɔ nyɔŋ lɛ he owele yɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ. 21Shi kɛji je tsɛre nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi kome loo gbii enyɔ lɛ, akatɔ owele yɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ nyɔŋ lɛ ni egbo lɛ, lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ, eshika ni elaaje ni.
22“Kɛji hii miinɔ ni amɛkɛ nɔmɔ lɛ yapila yoohɔlɔ, ni emusu lɛ fite, shi eyeee lɛ awui kroko kɛfataaa he lɛ, agbe nuu mɔ ni pila yoohɔlɔ lɛ shika gbele. Yoo wu lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ nyɔmɔ ni ekɛfɔ̃ɔ nuu lɛ nɔ nɛ, shi moŋ bɔ ni saneyelɔi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nakai nuu lɛ awo. 23 Shi kɛji sane fɔŋ ba yɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ oweletɔɔ lɛ afee atoŋ kɛ atoŋ, no ji akɛ wala atse wala, 24 ni akɛ hiŋmɛi atse hiŋmɛi, ni akɛ nyanyɔŋ atse nyanyɔŋ, akɛ nane atse nane, 25akɛ la fala atse la fala, akɛ pilamɔ atse pilamɔ, ni akɛ kpelebi naa fala atse kpelebi naa fala.
26“Kɛji mɔ ko tswa enyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo hiŋmɛi nɔ, ni hiŋmɛi lɛ fite lɛ, ehã nyɔŋ lɛ aye ehe tswaa yɛ ehiŋmɛi lɛ hewɔ. 27Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã enyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo nyanyɔŋ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ nyɔŋ lɛ he koni eyaye ehe tswaa yɛ enyanyɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.”
Kooloi anuŋtsɔmɛi asɔ̃
28“Kɛji tsina shi nuu loo yoo, ni mɔ lɛ gbo lɛ, atswia tsina lɛ tɛ ni agbe lɛ, ni akaye eloo lɛ, shi tsinatsɛ lɛ aye ehe. 29 Shi kɛji tsina lɛ fɔɔ mɔ shimɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, ni abɔ nɔtsɛ lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ he, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ewooo ekooloo lɛ tsuŋ, ni eyagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, atswia tsina lɛ tɛ, ni tsinatsɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ. 30Shi kɛji aahe tsinatsɛ lɛ kpãtãmɔ nii lɛ, no lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni aheɔ lɛ lɛ, ewo koni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma. 31Kɛji tsina lɛ yashi mɔ ko binuu loo biyoo lɛ akɛ tsinatsɛ lɛ aye yɛ mla kome nɛɛ nɔŋŋ naa. 32Kɛji tsina lɛ yashi nyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo lɛ tsinatsɛ lɛ ahã nyɔŋ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwiɛtɛi shekel nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni no sɛɛ hu lɛ atswia tsina lɛ tɛ.
33“Kɛji mɔ ko shi bu naa eŋmɛ aloo eyatsa bu ni etsiii nɔ, ni tsina loo teji ko yagbee mli lɛ, 34mɔ ni tsa bu lɛ awo koolootsɛ lɛ ekooloo lɛ he nyɔmɔ koni bu tsɛ lɛ aŋɔ kooloo gbonyo lɛ. 35Kɛji mɔ ko tsina pila enaanyo tsina, ni kooloo lɛ gbo lɛ, mɛi enyɔ lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ tsina hiɛkãalɔ lɛ koni amɛja shika lɛ, ni kooloo ni egbo lɛ hu amɛja. 36Shi kɛji ale ato akɛ tsina lɛ fɔɔ mɔshimɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, shi tsinatsɛ lɛ wooo tsina lɛ tsuŋ lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ tsina ato mɔ lɛ tsina lɛ najiaŋ ehã lɛ koni mɔ ni tsina yashi lɛ aŋɔ tsina ni egbo lɛ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 22
Content:
Niianajiaŋtoo he mlai
1 “Kɛji mɔ ko yaju tsina loo too, ni eyagbe aloo eyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ekɛ tsinai enumɔ ato tsina kome najiaŋ, ni ekɛ toi ejwɛ ato too kome najiaŋ. Shi kɛ ebɛ nɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ koni akɛtse nii ni eju lɛ. 2Kɛji ana kooloo ni eyaju lɛ hiɛkãalɔ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, tsina ni jio, teji ni jio, too ni jio, eku ebɔ he toi enyɔ eto najiaŋ.
3“Kɛji ana julɔ nyɔɔŋ ni eejwa mɔ ko shinaa ni ebote mli, ni atswa lɛ nɔ ni egbo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ yeee ela yi sɔ̃. 4Shi kɛji shwane agbe lɛ lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ yeɔ ela yi sɔ̃.
5“Kɛji mɔ ko ŋmɛɛ ekooloo he, ni eyaye ŋmɔ loo waintrom ko mli nii, aloo mɔ ko kwɛɛɛ ekooloo lɛ nɔ, ni ekooloo lɛ yaye mɔ kroko ko ŋmɔshinii lɛ, koolootsɛ lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋmɔshi loo waintrom mli nii ni hi fe fɛɛ ato nii ni afite lɛ najiaŋ.
6“Kɛji mɔ ko wo la, ni etso kɛyamɔ ŋmeii, ni eshã abele kɛ aboŋo, loo abele ni akuko, loo ŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni wo la lɛ ato nii ni hiɛ kpãtã lɛ najiaŋ shishiishi.
7“Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ shika loo nibii hã enaanyo shitoo, ni aju nii lɛ yɛ mɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni amɔ julɔ lɛ, julɔ lɛ kɛ nii ni eju lɛ toi enyɔ ato najiaŋ. 8 Shi kɛji anaaa julɔ lɛ, no lɛ shĩatsɛ lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ebatsɔɔ akɛ enine etako enaanyo lɛ nii lɛ he.
9“Niiaheplemɔ fɛɛ ni aaate shi lɛ, tsina he ejɛ jio, teji he jio, too he jio, atade he jio, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eji ni aaapele he ni mɔ ko aaakɛɛ akɛ enɔ ni lɛ, akɛ sane lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu lɛ fɔ lɛ, ekɛ nɔ lɛ toi enyɔ ato enaanyo lɛ nii lɛ najiaŋ.
10“Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ eteji loo tsina loo too loo kooloo fɛɛ kooloo hã enaanyo shitoo, ni kooloo lɛ gbo, aloo aye lɛ awui, aloo ofɔ̃yelɔi bamɔ lɛ kɛtee, shi anaaa mɔ ko aye he odase lɛ, 11mɔ ni akɛ nɔ lɛ hã shitoo lɛ ayakã Yehowa kitã akɛ enine etako enaanyo lɛ nii lɛ he. Nɔtsɛ lɛ akpɛlɛ̃ nɔ, ni mɔ ni akɛ nii lɛ hã shitoo etoŋ nɔtsɛ lɛ najiaŋ. 12Shi kɛji ju aju nii lɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ eto nɔtsɛ lɛ najiaŋ. 13 Kɛji kooloo kakawua ko ni tserɛ kooloo lɛ, ekɛ kooloo gbonyo lɛ abaye odase koni ekato najiaŋ.
14“Kɛji mɔ ko yama kooloo ko yɛ enaanyo dɛŋ, ni eye kooloo lɛ awui, aloo egbo be mli ni nɔtsɛ lɛ bɛ jɛi lɛ, mɔ ni yama kooloo lɛ ato najiaŋ shishiishi; 15shi kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ, no lɛ akato najiaŋ. Kɛji apaayeli akɛ kooloo lɛ ba lɛ, no lɛ akato najiaŋ ejaakɛ epaayeli nyɔmɔ ni awo hewɔ eba.”
Jeŋba he mlai
16 “Kɛji nuu ko yalaka oblayoo foro ni atsɛko ehe baa, ni ekɛ lɛ wɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ ahã yoo lɛ yinii koni etsɔ̃ eŋa. 17Shi kɛji yoo lɛ tsɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ yoo lɛ kɛ nuu lɛ hãmɔ kwraa lɛ, nuu lɛ ahã bɔ ni ji oblayoo foro yinii kɛ̃.
18 “Akaŋmɛ yoo ŋkunyaayelɔ gbɛ ni ehi jeŋ.
19 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ kooloo aaawɔ lɛ esa akɛ agbe lɛ.
20 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaashi Yehowa sɛɛ ni eeeyashã afɔle ehã nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ akpãtã ehiɛ butubutu.
21 “Akaye gbɔ sane ni ejaaa, ni akawa lɛ yi ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔi yɛ Ijipt dã. 22 Akawa yoo okulafo loo awusa yi. 23Kɛji awa amɛ yi, ni amɛfo amɛtsɛ mi lɛ, ja mibo amɛyaafo toi. 24Mimlifu naa aaawa naakpa, ni magbe nyɛ yɛ ta mli, ni nyɛŋamɛi aaatsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi, ni nyɛbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ awusai.
25 “Kɛji ofa mimaŋbii ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ ohiafo ko shika lɛ, kaaye lɛ wie, ni kaahe hekpa hu. 26 Kɛji eeeba lɛ po akɛ onaanyo kɛ ehebo aaato bo awaba lɛ, okɛ ehebo lɛ aku sɛɛ ohã lɛ dani hulu ayanyɔ shi, 27ejaakɛ no pɛ ji nɔ ni ekɛhaa ehe, ehewolo nɔ mama ni. Mɛni eha kɛwɔ? Kɛji efo etsɛ mi lɛ mabo lɛ toi ejaakɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji mi.
28 “Kaawie oshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kaalomɔ maŋ onukpa.
29 “Kɛji oŋmɔshi nii ba, ni kɛ oŋa owain kɛ omu lɛ, kaashashao shi ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ abahã lɛ. Jɔɔmɔ obihii ateŋ kromɔ lɛ nɔ ohã mi. 30 Nakai nɔŋŋ hu ofee otsinai kɛ toi. Kooloo kromɔ nuu lɛ ehi enyɛ masɛi gbii kpawo, ni gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ ojɔɔ enɔ ohã mi.
31“Nyɛaatsɔ̃ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhã mi. No hewɔ lɛ, loo ni ŋaŋ kooloo etserɛ lɛ lɛ nyɛkayea, ashɛrɛ ashwie ahã gbei.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 23
Content:
Jalɛ saneyeli
1 “Kaawie nɔ ni bɛ mli. Kaafi gbɔmɔ fɔŋ sɛɛ kɛmiiye kutumpɔo odase. 2Kaanyiɛ mɛi ni yi fa sɛɛ kɛyafee efɔŋ, ni kaanyiɛ nɔ ni mɛi pii kɛɔ sɛɛ ni okɛɛ nɔ ko ni aaahã atsɔ sane hiɛ abu shi, 3 asaŋ kaasaa ohiafo sane he ohã lɛ yɛ saneyeli mli.
4 “Kɛji ona ohenyɛlɔ tsina loo teji ni edu gbɛ lɛ kplamɔ lɛ obahã lɛ. 5Kɛ oyanina mɔ ni kɛ bo yeee kɛ eteji ni teji lɛ jatsu tsii fe lɛ lɛ, kwɛmɔ ni okaho amɛhe otee, shi moŋ ye obua nɔtsɛ lɛ koni awo kooloo lɛ nɔ adamɔ shi.
6 “Kaatsɔ̃ ohiafo sane hiɛ obu shi yɛ saneyeli mli. 7Kaafo sane ofɔ̃ mɔ nɔ, ni kaagbe jalɔ kɛ mɔ ni he bɛ sane ko mli ejaakɛ mihaŋ efɔŋfeelɔ aye ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ. 8 Kaahe nyɔɔŋnii ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋnii shwilaa nɔkwɛlɔ, ni efiteɔ mɔ ni sane ja sane.
9 “Nyɛkawaa gbɔ yi, akɛ ni nyɛle bɔ ni gbɔ tsui nuɔ nii ahe ehãa lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔi yɛ Ijipt dã.”
Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ kɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ
10 “Ahu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akpa enɔ nibaanii lɛ kɛyashi afii ekpaa; 11shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ahã shikpɔŋ lɛ ajɔɔ ehe ni ekã shi efolo koni omaŋ lɛ mli ohiafoi lɛ ana enɔ nii amɛkɔlɔ amɛye, ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hu ana aye. Nakai nɔŋŋ ofee owain trom kɛ omutso trom.
12 “Otsu nii gbi ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ okɛjɔɔ ohe, bɔ ni afee ni otsina kɛ oteji ajɔɔ amɛhe, ni nyɔŋ yoo bi kɛ ogbɔ awo amɛtsui.
13“Nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ. Nyɛkatsĩa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi agbɛii ata, akanu yɛ nyɛnaa tete.”
Gbii juji etɛ̃ lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 34.18-26; Deuteronomio 16.1-17)
14“Daa afi lɛ nyɛyea gbii juji etɛ̃ nyɛhãa mi. 15 Nyɛyea Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ. Bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ, nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã. Nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo yɛ be ni ato lɛ, ni ji Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ no nɔ nyɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No be lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ko akaba mi jamɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ edɛŋ afɔle.
16“Nyɛyea Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔ lɛ ni ji ŋmɔshinii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii agbijurɔ lɛ; ni nyɛyea Ŋmaa naabuamɔ kɛtoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ afi lɛ naagbee mli, be ni nyɛbuaa ŋmɔshi nii anaa nyɛtoɔ lɛ. 17Daa afi lɛ nyɛteŋ nuu fɛɛ nuu abaja Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shii etɛ̃ yɛ nɛkɛ gbii juji etɛ̃ nɛɛ anɔ.
18 “Kooloo ni akɛbaashã afɔle ahã mi lɛ, nyɛkɛ masha aboloo akafataa he; ni kooloo ni akɛshã afɔle ahã mi lɛ, nyɛkahãa je miitsɛre emli fɔ lɛ nɔ.
19 “Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshinii ni nyɛbaakpa lɛ nyɛkɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ. Akahoo toobi kɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu.”
Shiwoi kɛ akpɔi
20 “Naa, miwo bɔfo gbɛ ni enyiɛ nyɛhiɛ koni ebaa nyɛyi yɛ gbɛteŋ koni ekɛ nyɛ ayashɛ he ni misaa mito lɛ. 21Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ egbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛyea ewiemɔ nɔ. Nyɛkatsea ehiɛ atua; ekɛ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔtɔmɔ ekeŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ ehiɛ mihewalɛ. 22Shi kɛji nyɛye egbee nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ matsɔ̃ henyɛlɔ mahã nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ nyɛ tswaa baatswa. 23Mibɔfo lɛ aaanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛyanina Amorbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ butubutu. 24 Nyɛkajaa ni nyɛkasɔ̃mɔa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, asaŋ nyɛkakasea gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anifeemɔ nii hu, shi moŋ nyɛbutua amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni nyɛkumɔa amɛshiui lɛ butubutu nyɛshwiea shi. 25 Kɛji nyɛsɔ̃mɔ mi, Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, madro nyɛ niyenii kɛ nu, ni makɔ hela yɛ nyɛteŋ mashɛ mafɔ̃ kwraa. 26Yoo sharakeŋ, ni anaŋ yoo kene yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mahã nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ.
27“Mahã miheŋmiŋmi atsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ amɔmɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ dani nyɛaayanina amɛ, ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ ni nyɛaashɛ lɛ aaajija yɛ nyɛhiɛ. 28 Matsu sosomootii kɛaatsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ. Mashwie Hivbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ. 29Shi moŋ mishwieŋ amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ afi kome nɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ akabatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, koni ŋaŋ kooloi ayi bafa yɛ nɔ wo nyɛ. 30Fiofio mibashwie amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛyi aaafa, ni nyɛaaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ. 31 Mafo husu mahã nyɛ kɛjɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa kɛyashi Filistibii lɛ aŋshɔ lɛ naa, agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, ejaakɛ mahã nyɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anɔ kunim koni nyɛshwie amɛ. 32 Amɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ jio, amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jio, nyɛkɛ amɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko. 33 Nyɛkahãa amɛhia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛmiihã nyɛfee esha nyɛshi mi. Ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ eeetsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã nyɛ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 24
Content:
Asɔo Kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa
1 Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Bo kɛ Aaron kɛ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo akwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ koni nyɛbaja yɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. 2Mose, okome pɛ otsi obɛŋkɛ Yehowa; mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ akatsi amɛbɛŋkɛ, ni maŋbii lɛ hu kɛ bo akakwɔ kɛmiiba.”
3 Mose ba ni ebajaje Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ. Ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ kɛ gbee kome amɛkɛɛ, “Wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa ewie lɛ wɔɔye nɔ.” 4 Mose ŋmala Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shi. Kɛkɛ ni ete shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ehole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ edamɔ shi yɛ Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ anaa. 5 Ni etsu Israelbii lɛ ateŋ oblahii komɛi, ni amɛkɛ tsina hii yashã afɔle kɛ shidaa afɔle amɛhã Yehowa. 6Mose kɛ lá lɛ fã wo lalakãi amli, ni lá lɛ fã ni shwɛ lɛ efɔ̃ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. 7 Agbɛnɛ ekɔ kpãŋmɔ wolo lɛ, ni ekane yɛ maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ wɔɔfee, ni wɔɔbo lɛ toi.”
8 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Mose wo lá lɛ, ni ekɛshwã maŋbii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ yɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ he lɛ nɔ lá nɛ.”
9Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Israel onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee, 10 ni amɛyana Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Amɛna ni enanemaahei lɛ efee tamɔ he ko ni akɛ safiro tɛ eka; safiro tɛ nɛɛ mlitsemɔ lɛ enɔ bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. 11 Nyɔŋmɔ efeee Israel onukpai nɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ko, shi amɛna Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi, ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nɔ ko.
Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ
12Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kwɔɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni obamɛ, ni mikɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii ni maŋmala mlai lɛ kɛ kitãi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ baahã bo, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii.” 13Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ etsulɔ Yoshua te shi, ni Mose kwɔ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 14Shi ekɛɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhia biɛ nyɛmɛa wɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛba. Aaron kɛ Hur kɛ nyɛ yɛ biɛ. Kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ sane ko lɛ akɛyahã amɛ.”
15Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ Mose kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ, ni atatu lɛ baha gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 16 Ni Yehowa anunyam la lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba Sinai gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Atatu lɛ ye gbii ekpaa ni eha gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ Yehowa jɛ atatu lɛ mli etsɛ Mose. 17 Yehowa anunyam lɛ, kɛji Israelbii lɛ miikwɛ lɛ, amɛnaa lɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ tamɔ la grigri ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ. 18 Mose kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ, ni ebote atatu lɛ mli. Eye nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 25
Content:
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nikee nii
(Ɛksodɔs 35.4-9)
1Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2 “Bi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛkɛ nikee nii aba. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ he tsui akɛ ehã lɛ, lɛ edɛŋ nikee nii nyɛhea nyɛhãa mi. 3Ni nikee nii ni amɛkɛba lɛ nɛ: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble, 4kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kɛ abotia he tsɔi, 5kɛ ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru kɛ nuŋgbee he wolo kɛ tso. 6Ekrokomɛi hu ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane, kɛ tsofai ni akɛfutuɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu mli lɛ. Ekomɛi hu ji tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa. 7Abake oniketɛi ni akɛbaamamɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ kɛ ehewulamɔ nii lɛ eko ni atsɛɔ lɛ efod lɛ amli lɛ. 8Ohã Israelbii lɛ afee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ ko amɛhã mi koni mahi amɛteŋ. 9 Bɔ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ su kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ hu asu lɛ, nyɛfea lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 37.1-9)
10“Ohã amɛkpɛ tso adeka. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 11Ashwie adeka lɛ mli kɛ ehe fɛɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni akɛ shika abaŋ adeka lɛ naa fɛɛ kɛkpe kpula. 12Ashwie shika gai ejwɛ ato adeka lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ. Gai enyɔ aye afã kome, ni enyɔ hu aye afã kome lɛ. 13Akɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko agbɔlɔ tsei bloblobii ni ashwie amɛhe shika. 14Akɛ tsei nɛɛ ahɔlɔ gai ni yɔɔ adeka lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ amli koni akɛwo. 15Tsei lɛ ahɔlɔ gai lɛ amli, akajie yɛ mli. 16Okɛ odaseyeli tɛi lɛ ni mikɛbaahã bo lɛ awo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.
17 “Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 18Otswia shika, ni okɛfee kerubim enyɔ omamɔ naanɔ lɛ nɔ koji lɛ anɔ. 19Kerub kome yɛ koŋ kome kɛ ekome hu yɛ koŋ kome lɛ. Sɔomɔ kerubim nɛɛ okpɛtɛ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ. 20Kerubim lɛ agbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛya ŋwɛi ni amɛkɛha naanɔ lɛ nɔ, ni kerub kome akwɛ kerub kome hiɛ, asaŋ amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi amɛkwɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ. 21 Okɛ odaseyeli tɛi lɛ ni mikɛbaahã bo lɛ awo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli koni okɛ naanɔ lɛ abu naa. 22 Gbɛ ni kã kerubim enyɔ lɛ ateŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ mi kɛ bo kpeehe, ni jɛi majɛ mi kɛ bo aaawie nibii fɛɛ ni mifã bo akɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ.
Okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Aboloo lɛ maa nɔ lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 37.10-16)
23“Okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko akpɛ okplɔ̃. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 24Oshwie ehe shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekoji lɛ okɛ shika abaŋ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe. 25Ogbɔ tso blawa ni elɛɛmɔ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ koni okɛkpɛtɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ toi kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni okɛ shika abaŋ tso blawa nɛɛ naa kpula. 26Feemɔ shika gai ejwɛ okɛwo okplɔ̃ lɛ naji ejwɛ lɛ ahe. 27Gai nɛɛ aye tso blawa lɛ shishi tuuŋtu, ni nomɛi amli akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ ahɔlɔ. 28Okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko agbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ, ni oshwie he shika koni akɛwo okplɔ̃ lɛ. 29Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee okplɔ̃ lɛ he plɛtei kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma baawo amɛmli lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ okpolui kɛ kpuji ni akɛbaaye ŋkpai lɛ. 30 Ni okɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa mihiɛ lɛ ama okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ yɛ mihiɛ daa.
Kanetso lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 37.17-24)
31“Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia afee kanetso. Otswia shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛfee eshimaatso lɛ kɛ eshishi nii ni ema nɔ lɛ fɛɛ. Ehe tɔi lɛ kɛ ehe kpɔbii lɛ kɛ ehe fɔfɔi samai lɛ fɛɛ atsa akɛ nɔ muu kome. 32Kanetso lɛ ahiɛ niji ekpaa, niji etɛ̃ aye afã kome nɛɛ, ni niji etɛ̃ hu aye afã kome nɛɛ. 33Afã kome ahiɛ tɔi etɛ̃ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi; tɔ fɛɛ tɔ kɛ ekpɔ kɛ efɔfɔi sama yɛ nine kome he, ni afã kome lɛ hu ahiɛ tɔi etɛ̃ tamɔ ŋmɛi, tɔ fɛɛ tɔ kɛ ekpɔ kɛ efɔfɔi sama yɛ nine kome he. Nakai sɔŋŋ afee niji ekpaa lɛ fɛɛ ni kanetso lɛ egbala lɛ. 34Kanetso lɛ shimaatso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ena tɔi ejwɛ ni tamɔ ŋmɛi kɛ amɛhe kpɔbii kɛ fɔfɔi samai. 35Ni kpɔi amãmɔ kanetso lɛ hu niji ntai enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ lɛ ashishi yɛ shimaatso lɛ he, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ niji ekpaa lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kpɔ yɛ eshishi. 36Amɛhe tɔi lɛ kɛ fɔfɔi samai lɛ kɛ shimaatso lɛ fɛɛ atsa akɛ nɔ muu kome, ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi atswia fɛɛ. 37Ofee kanei kpawo omamɔ kanetso lɛ nɔ, koni kɛji asu lɛ amɛkpɛ kɛya hiɛgbɛ. 38Kanetso lɛ he abɛɛlei lɛ kɛ ehe lagbee nii lɛ akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee. 39Aŋmɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome koni akɛfee kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ. 40 Kwɛmɔ ni ofee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 26
Content:
Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 36.8-38)
1“Okɛ mamai nyɔŋma ni alo kɛ klala yɛŋ futaa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ ni anyɛne afee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Alo kerubim awo mli. 2Mama kome kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai lɛ fɛɛ adaramɔ afee ekome. 3Okpɛ mamai lɛ enumɔ otsara, eko tsa eko naa, kɛfee mama muu kome, ni okpɛ enumɔ krokomɛi lɛ hu otsara, eko tsa eko naa, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛfee mama muu kome. 4Okɛ kpãa bluu aŋmɔlɔ aflãi owo mama muu kome naa, ni ofee mama muu kroko lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. 5Oŋmɔlɔ aflãi nɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome naa kɛ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ hu yɛ mama muu kroko lɛ naa. 6Ofee kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni okɛlala mamai enyɔ lɛ anaabui lɛ otsara Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ mama lɛ koni etsɔ̃ nɔ muu kome.
7“Okɛ abotia he tsɔi afee mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome okɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 8Mama kome kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome nɛɛ fɛɛ adaramɔ afee ekome. 9Otsara mamai enumɔ aŋklo kɛ mamai ekpaa hu aŋklo. Mama ni ji ekpaa ni baaye buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ odɔ mli enyɔ. 10Oŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mamai enumɔ ni otsara lɛ aŋklo lɛ naa, kɛ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ hu yɛ mamai ekpaa ni otsara lɛ aŋklo lɛ naa. 11Ofee akɔɔble kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni okɛlala aflãi lɛ, ni okɛtsara buu mama lɛ koni efee nɔ muu kome. 12Buu mama ni shwɛɔ lɛ, ni ji mama fã lɛ ni dɛŋ nɔ lɛ, odɔ ofɔ̃ nɔ koni ekã nɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ. 13Ni buu mamai lɛ akɛlɛ mli ninetalɔ kome ni dɛŋɔ nɔ yɛ afã kome nɛɛ, kɛ ninetalɔ kome hu ni dɛŋɔ nɔ yɛ afã kroko lɛ, ebɔ nɔ koni ekã Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ koni eha Buu lɛ he.
14“Okɛ ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru aha buu lɛ nɔ, ni okɛ nuŋgbee wolo aha yiteŋ oto nɔ.
15“Okɛ tso afee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi ni baamamɔ shi lɛ. 16Mplaŋ kome kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 17Ojie nyanyɔji enyɔ yɛ mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ he koni onyɛ okɛtsa eko kɛ eko. Bɔ ni omamɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ nɛ: 18mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ aye Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ. 19Okɛ jwiɛtɛi afee nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ owo mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ ashishi koni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ama enyɔ nɔ. 20Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ aye jɛi, 21kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni enyɔ yɛ mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ shishi. 22Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, he ni ye kɛyaa anaigbɛ lɛ, mplaŋi ekpaa aye jɛi. 23Okɛ mplaŋi enyɔɔnyɔ ajie Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ koji enyɔ lɛ. 24Okɛ koŋ kome mplaŋi enyɔ lɛ abɔ he kɛkɛ yɛ amɛshishigbɛ; shi otsa amɛ yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ga lɛ yi. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ofee koji enyɔ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ. 25No hewɔ lɛ, abaana mplaŋi kpaanyɔ yɛ sɛɛgbɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ama enyɔ nɔ.
26“Okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko afee mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ ohã mplaŋi ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kome, 27ni mplaŋi ni yɔɔ ŋmawuiaŋ kome lɛ hu ana mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ; ni sɛɛgbɛ, ni ji anaigbɛ, mplaŋi lɛ ana mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ. 28Ni mlibɛlɛmɔ nii ni baaye mplaŋi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekã shi emuu kɛjɛ koŋ kome kɛyagbe naa yɛ koŋ kome lɛ. 29 Okɛ shika aha mplaŋi lɛ ahe, ni okɛ shika nɔŋŋ afee gai ni akɛ mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ baahɔlɔ mli lɛ; ni mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ hu okɛ shika aha he. 30Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ bɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, oma lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
31 “Okɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne afee muhɔɔ. Akɛ ŋaa alo kerubim awo muhɔɔ nɛɛ mli. 32Okɛ muhɔɔ lɛ atsotsoro kpoji anaa yɛ tso akulashiŋi ni aha amɛhe shika lɛ ahe. Akɛ shika afee kpoji lɛ, ni akulashiŋ lɛ amãmɔ jwiɛtɛi nibii ejwɛ anɔ. 33 Okɛ kpoji lɛ alala muhɔɔ lɛ kɛtsotsoro shi, ni okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ abama muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ koni muhɔɔ lɛ afo He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ teŋ ahã nyɛ. 34 Okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ, ni ji kpãtãmɔ sɛi lɛ, abu naa yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ. 35 Okɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ ama muhɔɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kooyigbɛ, ni kanetso lɛ aye Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli wuoyigbɛ koni ekwɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ hiɛ.
36“Ni buu lɛ naa shinaa lɛ, okɛ mama ni akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne elo, asaŋ ni akɛ abui elo nii awo mli afee. 37Ni okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko afee akulashiŋi enumɔ ohã shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ. Okɛ shika aha tsei nɛɛ ahe, ni owo amɛhe shika kpoji kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 27
Content:
Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 38.1-7)
1“Okɛ tso lɛ eko akpɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi enumɔ, ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ aye egbɔ; ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔi etɛ̃. 2Feemɔ akloŋtoi omamɔ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ anɔ. Akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ afee nɔ muu kome, ni okɛ akɔɔble aha latɛ muu lɛ fɛɛ he. 3Ofee latɛ lɛ he ŋɛsui ni akɛloo elamlu lɛ, asaŋ ofee ehe sofii kɛ ekpolui kɛ fakai kɛ lajee tsɛnsii hu. Okɛ akɔɔble afee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ. 4Ofee akɔɔble ntaŋ, ni okɛ akɔɔble nɔŋŋ afee gai owo ntaŋ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ. 5Okɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ lɛ awo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli ni eyakã latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu. 6Okɛ tso lɛ eko agbɔlɔ tsei bloblobii, ni oha amɛhe akɔɔble. 7Okɛ tsei nɛɛ ahɔlɔ gai lɛ amli yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ koni akɛwo. 8 Okɛ ŋmoŋmolo akpɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni gbɛ ahi emli. Okpɛ latɛ lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ.”
Kpee Buu lɛ he afabaŋ lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 38.9-20)
9“Ofee kpo owo Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he. Ewuoyigbɛ lɛ akɛ klala kpakpa ni ekɛlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi oha afee muhɔɔ ahã jɛi. 10Amãmɔ muhɔɔ lɛ he akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii nyɔŋmai enyɔ koni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji lɛ kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi afee. 11Ni asaŋ kpo lɛ kɛlɛ nɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ hu, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi oha. Akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ nakai nɔŋŋ ahi jɛi kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Shi akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi afee. 12Kpo lɛ lɛɛmɔ nɔ he ni ye anaigbɛ lɛ jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni akulashiŋi nyɔŋma kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋma ni amɛmamɔ nɔ ahi jɛi. 13Kpo lɛ lɛɛmɔ mli he ni ye bokãgbɛ, ni ji ehiɛ lɛ, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ. 14Muhɔɔ ni ekɛlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ aha kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ afã kome kɛ ehe akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. 15Agbo lɛ afã kome lɛ hu jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ ehe akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃. 16Kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naahaa nii lɛ akɛ mama ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ kpãa yɛŋ srãsrã ni anyɛne, asaŋ ni akɛ abui elo nii ewo mli afee. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ehe akulashiŋi ejwɛ kɛ amɛshishi nibii ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. 17Akulashiŋi fɛɛ ni bɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ, akɛ jwiɛtɛi afee amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii kɛ amɛhe kpoji lɛ, ni akɛ akɔɔble afee amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ. 18Kpo lɛ kɛlɛ ahiɛ ninetalɔi oha, elɛɛmɔ ahiɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ ahiɛ ninetalɔi enumɔ. Akɛ klala kpakpa afee emli muhɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ akɔɔble afee akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ. 19Ni nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbaatsu Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nii kɛ ehe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ kpo lɛ hu shiŋmlitsei lɛ akɛ akɔɔble afee fɛɛ.”
Kanetso lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ
(Levitiko 24.1-4)
20 “Fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛbahã bo mutso mu ni mli tse krɔŋŋ ni akɛsu kane lɛ koni ahã kane lɛ ama nɔ be fɛɛ be. 21Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ asu kane lɛ ama muhɔɔ ni etsĩ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkwɛ koni kane nɛɛ atso kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ kɛyashi leebi yɛ mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi hã Israelbii ayinɔbii fɛɛ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 28
Content:
Osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 39.1-7)
1 “Ŋɔɔ onyɛmi Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ, ni ji Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar, kɛjɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ koni amɛsɔmɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi. 2Ni okpɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ nyam kɛ fɛo ohã onyɛmi Aaron. 3Mɛi fɛɛ ni miduro amɛ ŋaa ni baanyɛ nii ni obaahã amɛ lɛ amɛtsu lɛ, okɛ amɛ awie koni okɛ hewulamɔ nibii lɛ kpɛɛ awo amɛdɛŋ. 4Ni hewulamɔ nibii ni abaakpɛ lɛ nɛ: tsitsinɔhaanii kɛ efod kɛ atade yuu kɛ flaka ni alo nii awo mli kɛ fai kɛ mliteŋfĩinii. Amɛkpɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi nɛɛ amɛhã onyɛmi Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ koni amɛkɛsɔ̃mɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi. 5Ahã ŋaalɔi nɛɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa.
6“Amɛkɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa ni alo nii awo mli afee efod lɛ. 7Akpɛ mamai hwĩahwĩabii enyɔ ni baakã kɔŋ nɔ akɛtsa efod lɛ koji enyɔ koni akɛ nomɛi aŋmɔ efod lɛ. 8Akɛ ŋaa kome lɛ nɔŋŋ afee kɔŋ nɔ mamai hwĩahwĩabii nɛɛ, ni akɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa ni alo nii awo mli lɛ nɔŋŋ eko afee.
9“Kɔlɔmɔ oniketɛi enyɔ ni oŋmala Israelbii lɛ agbɛii owo amɛnɔ. 10Gbɛii lɛ amli ekpaa ahi tɛ kome nɔ, ni ekpaa ni eshwɛ lɛ hu ahi tɛ kome lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa. 11Bɔ ni shikaŋaalɔ yeɔ sama ewoɔ wolonaasɔomɔnii nɔ lɛ, nakai okpɛ Yakob bii lɛ agbɛii lɛ owo tɛi enyɔ lɛ anɔ. Ni osere shika okɛbɔle tɛi lɛ koni amɛmamɔ mli. 12Okɛ tɛi enyɔ nɛɛ amãmɔ efod lɛ he mamai hwĩahwĩabii ni baakã kɔŋ nɔ lɛ anɔ koni akɛkai Yakob bii lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni Aaron aaaba Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, Israel akutsei lɛ agbɛii yɛ ekɔji enyɔ lɛ anɔ koni makai amɛ daa. 13Seremɔ shika okɛbɔle tɛi lɛ koni amɛmamɔ mli, 14ni okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa koni okɛlalaa shika ni asere abɔle tɛi lɛ.”
Tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 39.8-21)
15“Okɛ ŋaa afee tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ ohã osɔfonukpa lɛ, ni ekɛtao Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii ele. Nibii ni okɛfee efod lɛ okɛ no nɔŋŋ eko afee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ: kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa. 16Ofee lɛ ni adɔ mli enyɔ afɔ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ aye egbɔ: ekɛlɛ afee klakate kome kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu klakate kome. 17Oto tɛi klɛmpɛi ejwɛ omamɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ nɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ klɛmpɛ lɛ mli tɛi afee ojarawatɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ rubi kɛ topasiɔn kɛ garneto lɛ. 18Klɛmpɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli tɛi lɛ afee smaragdo kɛ safiro kɛ daiamɔnd. 19Klɛmpɛ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli ojarawatɛi lɛ afee tekwais kɛ kalkedɔn kɛ amɛtisto, 20ni klɛmpɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ mli tɛi lɛ afee berilo kɛ onike kɛ yaspi. 21Tɛi lɛ ayibɔ baafee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni amɛkɛ Yakob bihii lɛ agbɛii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ anyiɛ yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa, koni tɛi lɛ adamɔ shi ahã Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ. Akpɛ gbɛii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nii nɔ lɛ, tɛ fɛɛ tɛ kɛ egbɛi yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ anaa. 22Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ he kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa. 23Ofee shika gai enyɔ okɛwo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ yiteŋgbɛ koji enyɔ lɛ. 24Okɛ shika kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ alala gai enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ koji lɛ. 25Kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ anaabui enyɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, okɛlala shika ni asere kɛbɔle tɛi enyɔ lɛ shishi lɛ amli, koni okɛŋmɔlɔ tɛi lɛ omɔmɔ efod lɛ he mamai hwĩahwĩabii lɛ ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ yɛ hiɛgbɛ. 26Ofee shika gai enyɔ owo tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ afã kome ni adɔ awo shishigbɛ koni ekã efod lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ anɔ. 27Ni asaŋ ofee gai enyɔ hu ni okɛmamɔ efod lɛ he osɛŋ mamai hwĩahwĩabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ naa, yɛ amɛshishigbɛ tsamɔhe yɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ ŋwɛi. 28Akɛ kpãa bluu aŋmɔlɔ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ he gai lɛ akpɛtɛ efod lɛ he gai lɛ, koni tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ akã efod lɛ mlifiinii lɛ nɔ, koni ekaje he.
29“No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Aaron miiba He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ Israel akutsei lɛ agbɛii ni aŋmala yɛ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ nɔ lɛ miiba mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ koni makai amɛ daa. 30 Ni okɛ Urim kɛ Turim lɛ awo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni amɛhi Aaron tsui nɔ kɛji eeba mihiɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni Aaron anyɛ ale miyiŋtoo yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe be fɛɛ be.”
Osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii krokomɛi
(Ɛksodɔs 39.22-31)
31“Okɛ kuŋtu bluu sɔŋŋ akpɛ efod lɛ shishi atade yuu lɛ. 32Ajie kuɛ awo atade lɛ he, ni akɛ mama ni alo abaŋ kuɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe koni ekagba. 33Okɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ afee kpɔbii kokrobii kɛbɔle atade lɛ naamuu lɛ, kɛkpe, ni shika ŋmɛji atsotsoro kpɔbii lɛ ateiaŋ kɛkpe nɛkɛ: 34shika ŋmɛlɛ kome kɛ kpɔ kokroo kome kɛbɔle atade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ kɛkpe. 35Atade nɛɛ Aaron awo ni ekɛsɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfo koni kɛ eeba mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ jio, eeje kpo yɛ jɛi jio, anu ŋmɛji lɛ agbɛɛmɔ koni ekagbo.
36 “Otswia shika ŋmiiŋmi fɛtɛfɛtɛ, ni oŋma yɛ nɔ, tamɔ nii ni aŋma yɛ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ, akɛ, ‘Afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa.’ 37Okɛ shika ni atswia fɛtɛfɛtɛ nɛɛ akpɛtɛ mama bluu nɔ, ni okɛfi osɔfonukpa fai lɛ ni eta fai lɛ hiɛ. 38Nii nɛɛ ahi Aaron hiɛnaa tuuŋtu koni tɔ̃mɔi fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ etɔ̃ yɛ nikee lɛ hãmɔ mli lɛ akã Aaron nɔ. 39Ni okɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta alo flaka lɛ, ni okɛ klala fɛɛfɛo akpɛ fai lɛ, ni okɛ abui alo nii owo mlifiinii lɛ mli.
40“Aaron bihii lɛ hu, okpɛ flakai kɛ mlifiinii kɛ faii ohã amɛ. Ofee nibii nɛɛ ni efee nyam kɛ fɛo. 41 Okɛ nibii nɛɛ awula onyɛmi Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ofata ehe, ni ofɔ amɛ mu, ni owo amɛ osɔfo, ni otsuu amɛhe koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi. 42Okpɛ klala tswakoto ohã amɛ koni amɛwo kɛkete amɛyayaiaŋ kɛjɛ hɛ kɛyashi shuɔ. 43Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ awo tswakoto nɛɛ kɛji amɛmiiba Kpee Buu lɛ mli aloo kɛ amɛmiibɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛbasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli koni amɛkaloo musu ni amɛgboi. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi kɛmiiya naanɔ hã Aaron kɛ eshwiei ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 29
Content:
Awo Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ osɔfo
(Levitiko 8.1-36)
1“Nɔ ni ofee okɛtsuu Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ahe koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi nɛ: Mɔ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ toi ojwɛnii enyɔ ni kpa bɛ amɛhe. 2Ŋɔɔ aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kɛ mã akpiti keeki ni awo mli fɔ, kɛ mã akpiti akpãanɔɔ ni akpa hiɛ fɔ. Akɛ ŋmaa ma afee fɛɛ. 3Okɛ nibii nɛɛ awo kɛntɛŋ kome mli, ni amɛhi kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni okɛba; tsina lɛ kɛ toi enyɔ lɛ afata he.
4“Ŋɔɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni okɛ nu aju amɛhe. 5No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ wulamɔ nibii lɛ awula Aaron: flaka lɛ kɛ efod lɛ shishi atade yuu lɛ, kɛ efod lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ; naagbee lɛ okɛ efod lɛ mlifiinii lɛ afi emliteŋ. 6Okɛ fai lɛ abu lɛ, ni okɛ shika ni atswia fɛtɛfɛtɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ata fai lɛ hiɛ. 7Agbɛnɛ owo mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ koni ofɔse oshwie Aaron yiteŋ ni okɛfɔ lɛ mu.
8“Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ oŋɔ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛba ni owo amɛ flakai, 9 ni okɛ mlifiinii lɛ afimɔ amɛmli, ni obumɔ amɛ faii lɛ. Bɔ ni owo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ osɔfo nɛ koni osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ afee amɛnɔ ni kã shi akɛ naanɔ akpɔ.
10“Ohã akɛ tsinanuu lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsina lɛ yiteŋ, 11ni ogbe tsina lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 12Oŋɔ tsina lá lɛ eko koni okɛ owao atsɔ eko okpa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he akloŋtoi lɛ ahe, ni ofɔse lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ oshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. 13 Jiemɔ fɔ fɛɛ ni ha tsina lɛ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ, kɛ mlɛbo lɛ fã ko kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ hu, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, ni oshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 14Shi tsina lɛ loo lɛ kɛ ehe wolo lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ, ayashã fɛɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ ahe esha afɔle ni.
15“Asaŋ oŋɔ toi ojwɛnii lɛ ateŋ ekome, ni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie eyiteŋ, 16ni ogbe too lɛ, ni okɛ elá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe. 17Folɔmɔ too lɛ mli kukuji, ni ofɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ eshuɔji lɛ ahe, ni okɛfata loo kukuji lɛ kɛ yitso lɛ he, 18ni oma too ojwɛni muu lɛ fɛɛ naa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eji afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa; ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ.
19“Omɔ too ojwɛni kome lɛ hu agbɛnɛ, ni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie eyiteŋ, 20ni ogbe too lɛ, ni okɛ too lá lɛ eko asa Aaron ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ ebihii lɛ hu aninejurɔ toii anaa kɛ amɛninejurɔ kɛ nanejurɔ gɔŋtii anaa, ni okɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe. 21Agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lá ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ eko kɛ mɔmufɔɔ mu lɛ hu eko ni okɛshwã Aaron kɛ ehewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; ni okɛshwã Aaron bihii lɛ hu kɛ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, koni okɛfee Aaron kɛ ehewulamɔ nibii lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu kɛ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
22 “Jiemɔ too ojwɛni lɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ elei ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ emlinii ahe fɔ lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he, kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ hu, kɛ too lɛ ninejurɔ shuɔ (ejaakɛ osɔfowoo afɔle too ojwɛni ni), 23ni oŋɔ aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ mã akpiti keeki ni awo mli fɔ kome, yɛ aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kafu ni maa mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ lɛ mli, 24ni okɛwo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛfɔ̃ niyenii nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ afɔle ni amɛkɛhãa mi, Yehowa. 25Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ohe nibii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛ̃ ni oma fɛɛ naa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni oshã ofata shãa afɔle lɛ he akɛ afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa; ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ.
26“Too ojwɛni lɛ ni akɛshã Aaron osɔfowoo afɔle lɛ, jiemɔ etsitsi lɛ koni ofɔ̃ otsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ afɔle ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã mi Yehowa ni. Tsitsi nɛɛ afee ogbɛfaŋ nɔ.
27 “Agbɛnɛ too tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ ni afɔ̃ɔ akɛ afɔle ni afɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ji loo ni ajie yɛ too ojwɛni ni akɛshã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ osɔfowoo afɔle lɛ, feemɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 28Enɛ atsɔ̃ gbɛnaanii ni akã shi daa ni sa akɛ Israelbii lɛ atuu ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. Ejaakɛ eji osɔfo gbɛnaanii ni yɔɔ nii ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbaashã Yehowa toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ mli.
29 “Aaron hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ atsɔ̃ ebihii lɛ anii yɛ egbele sɛɛ, ni no amɛwo kɛji aafɔ amɛ mu koni atuu osɔfoyeli lɛ awo amɛdɛŋ. 30Ni Aaron binuu, mɔ ni baaye enajiaŋ akɛ osɔfonukpa, lɛ, ewo nibii nɛɛ gbii kpawo kɛji eeba Kpee Buu lɛ mli ebasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
31“Oŋɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni lɛ loo lɛ koni ohoo yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 32Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ loo lɛ aye aboloo lɛ ni yɔɔ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 33Amɛye nii ni akɛkpãtãa ni akɛwo amɛ osɔfo, ni asaŋ akɛfee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Mɔ folo ko akaye nii nɛɛ eko ejaakɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni. 34Kɛji osɔfowoo afɔle loo aboloo lɛ eko shwɛ ni je tsɛre nɔ lɛ, no lɛ akɛ la ashã; akaye ejaakɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
35“Bɔ ni mifã bo nɛɛ, feemɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ nakai. Gbii kpawo okɛwo amɛ osɔfo lɛ. 36Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ omɔ tsina kome koni okɛshã afɔle ni okɛkpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ esha ni afee hewɔ, ni okɛ kpãtãmɔ ni obaakpãtã nɛɛ nɔŋŋ akpala afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha, ni ofɔ latɛ lɛ mu koni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 37Okɛ gbii kpawo akpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha hewɔ koni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi, bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaasa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ afee krɔŋkrɔŋ.”
Daa gbi afɔle
(Numeri 28.1-8)
38 “Agbɛnɛ afɔle ni oshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nɛ: Daa gbi lɛ toobii enyɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. 39 Okɛ toobi kome ashã afɔle leebi, ni okɛ ekome hu ashã afɔle gbɛkɛ. 40Klɛŋklɛŋ toobi lɛ okɛ ŋmaa mamu yiteremɔ kilo mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome, ni akɛ fɔ ni ashi mli lita mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome akpɔtɔ afata he, kɛ wain lita mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome ni akɛshã afɔle lɛ. 41Ni toobi kome lɛ hu okɛshã afɔle gbɛkɛ. Okɛ niyenii kɛ dãa, tamɔ leebi nibii lɛ afalɛ nakai nɔŋŋ, afata he ni oshã, ni ahã eje ŋma. Eji afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa, ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ. 42Etsɔ̃ afɔle ni ashãa daa yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ amli, yɛ mi Yehowa, mihiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. Jɛi mikɛ nyɛ aaakpe yɛ, ni mikɛ bo awie yɛ. 43 Ni jɛi mikɛ Israelbii lɛ aaakpe yɛ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ he krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ minunyam lɛ hewɔ. 44Mahã Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ afee krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni asaŋ mafee Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi. 45Ni mahi Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ. 46Ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni mahi amɛteŋ lɛ; mi Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 30
Content:
Tsofakɛŋma latɛ lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 37.25-28)
1“Oma latɛ ni ashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ. Akɛ tso afee. 2Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu afee ninetalɔ kome, ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ aye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔi enyɔ. Ehe akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ afee nɔ muu kome. 3Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi aha he, eyiteŋ kɛ ehe fɛɛ kɛkpe, kɛ ehe akloŋtoi lɛ hu, ni okɛ shika abaŋ latɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe. 4Ofee shika gai enyɔɔnyɔ owo latɛ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ, yɛ shika ni akɛbaŋ naa lɛ shishi, koni akɛ tsei bloblobii ahɔlɔ gaii nɛɛ amli ni akɛwo. 5Okɛ tso lɛ eko agbɔ tsei nɛɛ ni aha he shika. 6 Okɛ latɛ lɛ ama muhɔɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ, ni ji he ni mikɛ bo aaakpe yɛ lɛ, hiɛ. 7 Aaron ashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ. Daa leebi kɛji etee kanei lɛ saamɔ hã suu lɛ, eshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ; 8ni kɛji etee eyasu kanei lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, eshã tsofakɛŋma nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ nɔ. Daa tsofakɛŋmashãa nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ akã shi ahã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ. 9 Akashã tsofakɛŋma ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ loo kooloo loo niyenii afɔle ko kwraa yɛ nɔ, ni akafɔse wain akɛ dãa afɔle ashwie nɔ. 10 Aaron kɛ kooloo ni akɛkpãtãa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ esha ni afee hewɔ lɛ lá lɛ akpa latɛ lɛ akloŋtoi lɛ ahe, ni ekɛkpãtã shi kome daa afi. Efee kpãtãmɔ nii nɛɛ shi kome daa afi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ amli. Eji nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ hã mi, Yehowa.”
Kpee Buu Shihilɛhe lɛ hetooyeli
11Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 12“Kanemɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni kɛ ona amɛyikulɛ lɛ, ohã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo eyi too yɛ ekpɔ̃mɔ̃ hewɔ ehã mi Yehowa, koni gbele hela akaba amɛteŋ kɛbakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ kanemɔ lɛ hewɔ. 13Ni too ni áye lɛ nɛ: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakane lɛ lɛ awo jwiɛtɛi shekel fã yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shekel lɛ tsiimɔ naa akɛ shidaa afɔle ni akɛhãa mi, Yehowa. (Shekel kome feo gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ.) 14Mɛi ni abaakane lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewo mi, Yehowa, mitoo nɛɛ. 15Kɛji aawo, mi Yehowa mitoo nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛkpãtãa nyɛhãa nyɛwala lɛ, niiatsɛ akahã fe jwiɛtɛi shekel fã nɛɛ, ni ohiafo hu akahã nɔ ni shɛɛɛ nakai. 16Hemɔ kpãtãmɔ too nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii adɛŋ ni akɛto koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he nii, koni ehã Yehowa akai Israelbii lɛ daa ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ too lɛ miikpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛhã nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwala.”
Akɔɔble okpolu lɛ
17Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 18 “Asaŋ okɛ akɔɔble afee okpolu. Okɛ akɔɔble nɔŋŋ afee shimaa nɔ koni okpolu lɛ ama nɔ. Okɛma Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni oyɛ nu owo mli 19koni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe. 20Kɛji amɛyaabote Kpee Buu lɛ mli aloo amɛyaabɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, kɛbasɔ̃mɔ mi ni amɛshã afɔle ni akɛ la shãa amɛhã mi Yehowa lɛ, amɛfɔfɔlɔ amɛhe koni amɛkagboi. 21Amɛfɔfɔlɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe koni amɛkagboi; ni enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ahã Aaron kɛ eshwiei yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ amli kɛya naanɔ.”
Mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ
22Asaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 23“Ŋɔɔ tsofakɛŋma kpakpai nɛɛ fɛɛ eko: tso mli mu ni jeɔ ŋma shekel ohai enumɔ, kɛ sinamon ni jeɔ ŋma nakai bɔ fã, ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kooŋkpãa ni jeɔ ŋma ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ, 24kɛ kashia tso lɛ hu kiloi etɛ̃ ni aŋmɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa, kɛ mutso mu lita kome. 25 Futumɔ nibii nɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ojeŋmafeelɔ futuɔ ojeŋma ehãa, ni okɛfee mu, ni ji mu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ. 26Okɛ mu nɛɛ ashwã Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ, 27kɛ nibii nɛɛ hu: okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ, 28kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okpolu lɛ ni yɔɔ nane ni ta shi lɛ. 29Ofee enɛ koni okɛtsuu amɛhe ni ehã amɛfee krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi, bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaasa amɛhe lɛ aaafee krɔŋkrɔŋ. 30 Ofɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ mu, ni ofee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi. 31Ni okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, enɛ baafee mimu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛbaafɔ mɔ mu yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli. 32Akɛkafɔ mɔ folo ko kɛkɛ, ni nyɛkafea eko hu ni afutu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ afutu no lɛ. Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni, ni ahi shi nakai ahã nyɛ. 33Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafutu mu ko tamɔ no, aloo ekɛ mu nɛɛ eko aaasa mɔ folo ko kɛkɛ he lɛ atswa enaneshi tu.’ ”
Tsofakɛŋma lɛ
34Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ tsofakɛŋmai srɔtoi nɛɛ fɛɛ eko: krɔbɔo kɛ onitsa kɛ galbano. Tsofakɛŋmai nɛɛ okɛ mire ŋmiiŋmi afata he; ŋmɛɛ eko fɛɛ eko falɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, 35ni okɛfee tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa. Awo mli ŋoo koni ekafite, ni afutu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ojeŋmafeelɔ futuɔ ojeŋma ehãa. Emli atse, ni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ. 36 Oshimɔ eko ni ebo mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni okɛ eko ama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, he ni mikɛ bo aaakpe yɛ lɛ. Tsofakɛŋma nɛɛ afee nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi ahã nyɛ. 37Tsofakɛŋma ni obaafee nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkakwɛa bɔ ni afutu lɛ ahã lɛ nɔ ni nyɛmiifee eko nyɛmiihã nyɛhe. Abu lɛ akɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ hã mi, Yehowa. 38Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafee eko tamɔ no, ni eeeshã lɛ atswa enaneshi tu.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 31
Content:
Ŋaalɔi ni baama Kpee Buu lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 35.30—36.1)
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Naa, mije gbɛ mitsɛ Bezaleel, ni ji Hur bi Uri binuu lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛŋ lɛ, 3 ni mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ ewo emli obɔ̃, ni miduro lɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee ni akɛnyɛɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ atsuɔ, 4koni ekɛye sama, ni ekɛŋa shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble ŋaa, 5ni ekɛfolɔ tɛi ni akɛtaraa nibii amli, ni ekɛkpɛ tso ni akɛtsuɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi srɔtoi fɛɛ. 6Ni naa, mi nɔŋŋ miŋɔ Ahisamak binuu Oholiab ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛŋ lɛ mifata Bezaleel he. Mɛnɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni ŋaa yɔɔ amɛhiŋmɛiŋ lɛ, miduro amɛ ŋaa koni amɛnyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni miwo bo he kitã nɛɛ amɛtsu: 7Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enaanɔ ni buɔ naa lɛ, kɛ Buu lɛ he nii lɛ, 8kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii lɛ, kɛ kanetso ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ, 9kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ akɔɔble okpolu lɛ. 10Ni asaŋ amɛfee wulamɔ nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ ni ji Aaron, Osɔfo lɛ, hewulamɔ nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nii ni amɛkɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ. 11Amɛfee mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni abaashã yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ. Amɛfee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni mi mifã bo lɛ.”
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ
12Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 13 “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Asaŋ mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nyɛyea, ejaakɛ eji okadi yɛ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kɛmiiya nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mifeɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 14 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ hã nyɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabule gbi nɛɛ lɛ gbe aaagbe lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaatswa enaneshi tu. 15Atsu nii gbii ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi kɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hã mi, Yehowa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ gbe aaagbe lɛ. 16No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ aye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, amɛye yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ. 17 Mi kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ okadi ji no kɛmiiya naanɔ; ejaakɛ gbii ekpaa, mi, Yehowa, mikɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ mijɔɔ mihe, ni miwo mitsui.’ ”
18 Be ni Yehowa kɛ Mose ewie egbe naa yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ tɛi enyɔ ni ji tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii ni lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ewao eŋma nii yɛ nɔ lɛ hã Mose.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 32
Content:
Shika Tsinabi lɛ
(Deuteronomio 9.6-29)
1Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Mose eyatsɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekpelekeee shi lɛ, amɛbua amɛhe naa, ni amɛtee Aaron ŋɔɔ amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni ofee nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ.”
2Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkpɔlɔa shika toiiaŋnii ni yɔɔ nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ atoiiaŋ lɛ nyɛbahãa mi.” 3Maŋ lɛ fɛɛ kpɔlɔ shika toiiaŋnii ni yɔɔ amɛtoiiaŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛbahã Aaron. 4 Aaron he toiiaŋnii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛ̃, ni esere fɛɛ, ni ekɛ ŋaayeli dade tsu he nii, ni eshwie lɛ tsina. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Israel, naa wɔnyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!”
5Be ni Aaron na enɛ lɛ, ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ tsina lɛ hiɛ; kɛkɛ ni eshiɛ, ni ekɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, aye gbijurɔ ahã Yehowa.” 6 Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ te shi maŋkɛ mra, ni amɛshãshãa shãa afɔlei, ni amɛkɛ niyenii afɔlei hu ba, ni maŋ lɛ ho tara shi, ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nii hu, ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛte shi amɛshwɛ.
7Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpelekemɔ shi oya ni oya, shi omaŋbii lɛ ni okɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba lɛ ewo amɛhe muji. 8 Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛje gbɛ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ. Amɛkɛ shika efee tsinabi, ni amɛja lɛ, ni amɛshã afɔlei hu amɛhã lɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ yɛ ehe ji, ‘Israel, naa wɔnyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!’ ” 9Yehowa tee nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mina nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ akɛ maŋ ko ni kuɛŋ ti. 10 No hewɔ lɛ, hã mimli awo la awo amɛ koni maplenee amɛ; shi bo lɛ mahã otsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple.”
11Mose kpa Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, mɛɛba ni omli woɔ la woɔ omaŋ ni okɛ hewalɛ kpele kɛ nineshiwalɛ eyakpɔ̃ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ? 12Mɛɛ hewɔ hu ni ooohã Ijiptbii ana hegbɛ amɛwie akɛ, ‘Moaŋ yiŋ fɔŋ ni eto hewɔ eyajie amɛ kɛtee lɛ, koni eyagbe amɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ ni eplenee amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ Na tsui ohã amɛ, ni efɔŋ ni oto oyiŋ akɛ obaafee amɛ lɛ, okɛfa amɛ. 13 Kaimɔ otsuji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob, mɛi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ okã amɛ kitã, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mahã nyɛshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ ni miwo nyɛ shi yɛ he lɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii kɛya naanɔ.’ ” 14Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ efɔŋ ni kulɛ eto akɛ ebaafee Israelbii lɛ fa amɛ.
15Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɔ ehe, ni eje gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpeleke shi ni tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni aŋma nii yɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛ hiɛ fɛɛ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃. 16 Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ninenaa nitsumɔ ji tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ, ni nii ni aŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ni ŋma.
17Be ni Yoshua nu akɛ aabɔ oshe hoo yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Aabolɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli tamɔ ta mli blɔmɔ.”
18Shi Mose here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nɔ he ni minuɔ lɛ, ejeee mɛi komɛi kunimyeli he oshebɔɔ, ni ejeee yaafo ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nine etsɔ̃ mɛi komɛi anɔ hu, shi moŋ lala ni aahere nɔ ni.”
19Ni amrɔ pɛ ni Mose bɛŋkɛ shitoohe lɛ ni ena tsina lɛ kɛ joo ni maŋ lɛ joɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni emli wo la, ni ekɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ tswia shi. 20Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo tsina lɛ ni maŋbii lɛ efee lɛ, ni ekɛwo la mli ni eshã, ni egbɛlɛ lɛ mlumlu, ni ekɛshwã nu hiɛ, ni ehã Israelbii lɛ nu. 21Ni Mose bi Aaron akɛ, “Mɛni po maŋbii nɛɛ fee bo hewɔ ni ohã amɛfee esha kpele nɛkɛ?”
22Aaron jie enaa ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ mli akawo mi la. Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole akɛ maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ efɔŋ feemɔ.” 23Ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, “Feemɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ ni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ.” 24Ni mito he mihã amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ shika nii lɛ ekpɔlɔ kɛba, ni amɛkpɔlɔ kɛba, ni mikɛwo la mli, ni etsɔ̃ tsina nɛɛ.”
25Be ni Mose na akɛ maŋ lɛ efee yuuyaa (ejaakɛ Aaron ehã amɛfee yuuyaa, ni amɛbɔ amɛhe ahora amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi) lɛ, 26eyadamɔ shitoohe lɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ebo etsɛ ekɛɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ? Mɔ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Mose ŋɔɔ. 27Ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nuu fɛɛ nuu akɔ eklante eŋmɔ, ni nyɛnyiɛa maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, kɛjɛ agbonaa kɛya agbonaa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enyɛmi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enaanyo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe ehe gbɔmɔ.’ ” 28Levibii lɛ fee bɔ ni Mose fã amɛ lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ mli hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔ nakai gbi lɛ. 29 Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe nɔ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛhã Yehowa sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akɛni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ te shi ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi lɛ, Yehowa ejɔɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ.”
30Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfee esha kpeteŋkple. No hewɔ lɛ, makwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛya Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Eko lɛ eeebo mifaikpamɔ toi, ni eeeŋɔ nyɛhe esha lɛ efa nyɛ.” 31Ni Mose ku esɛɛ etee Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ao, maŋ nɛɛ efee esha kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ akɛ amɛfee shika amãgã amɛhã amɛhe. 32 Ofainɛ, okɛ amɛhe esha lɛ afa amɛ; shi kɛji ehiii nakai feemɔ lɛ no lɛ gbee mi moŋ migbɛi yɛ wolo ni oŋma omɛi agbɛii yɛ mli lɛ mli.” 33Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ ni efee esha eshi mi lɛ, lɛ egbɛi magbe yɛ miwolo lɛ mli. 34 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, yaa ni oyakpala maŋ lɛ kɛya he ni mi kɛ bo ewie he eto lɛ. Naa, mibɔfo lɛ aaanyiɛ ohiɛ, shi moŋ kɛji gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ esha ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ.” 35Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã gbele hela bote Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛfee, ni Aaron fee shika tsina lɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 33
Content:
Israelbii fã kɛjɛ Sinai
1 Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yi mli ni oje biɛ, bo kɛ maŋ ni oyajie kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba lɛ, kɛya shikpɔŋ ni mikã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ehe kitã akɛ, ‘Oshwiei mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã’ lɛ nɔ. 2 Mibatsu mibɔfo kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ, ni mashwie Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ. 3 Nyɛmiiya shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni baa nii nɔ, shi mikɛ nyɛ enyiɛŋ kɛyaŋ, ejaakɛ maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, koni moŋ mikayaplene nyɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.”
4Be ni Israelbii lɛ nu nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ amɛye ŋkɔmɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ fɔ̃ɔ jwinewoo. 5Ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, ni kɛji mibaye hiŋmɛitswaa kome kɛkɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ mibaplene nyɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkpɔlɔa jwinei lɛ yɛ nyɛhe koni makwɛ nɔ ni mafee yɛ nyɛhe.’ ” 6 No hewɔ ni Israelbii lɛ jie amɛhe jwinei fɛɛ, ni amɛkpa woo kɛjɛ be ni amɛshi Horeb, ni ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ.
Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ
7 Kɛji Israelbii lɛ to shi lɛ Mose kɛ Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yaa ni eyashiɔ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. Ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Kpee Buu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miitao Yehowa nii ebi lɛ, ejeɔ kpo kɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ. 8Be fɛɛ be ni Mose aaaje kpo kɛmiiya Buu lɛ he lɛ, maŋbii teteɔ shi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ badamɔɔ ebuu shinaa shi, ni amɛhiɛɔ Mose yisɛɛ kwɛmɔ aahu kɛyashiɔ eboteɔ Buu lɛ mli. 9Kɛji Mose bote Buu lɛ mli lɛ, atatu kutuu lɛ kpelekeɔ shi, ni ebadamɔɔ Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wieɔ. 10Kɛ maŋ lɛ na atatu kutuu lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi nakai lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ teɔ shi ni amɛmamɔɔ amɛyi shi, ni amɛjaa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ ebuu shinaa shi. 11 Yehowa kɛ Mose wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ tamɔ mɔ kɛ enaanyo wieɔ. Kɛji Mose ku esɛɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, etsulɔ Yoshua, Nun binuu oblanyo lɛ, lɛ lɛ eshiii Buu lɛ mli.
Yehowa wo shi akɛ ebaahi ewebii ateŋ
12 Ni Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaaŋɔ maŋ nɛɛ kɛya’ shi moŋ ohãko male mɔ ni obaatsu ni ekɛ mi aya. Kɛ̃lɛ bo nɔŋŋ okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mile bo jogbaŋŋ, ni miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ’. 13No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ miikpa bo fai, kɛji ona he miishɛɛ lɛ, hã male oyiŋtoo (yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe) bɔ ni afee ni male bo, koni masa ohiɛ. Kaimɔ hu akɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ omaŋ ni.”
14Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mikɛ nyɛ aaatee ni mahã oye kunim.”
15Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛ bo okɛ wɔ eyaaa lɛ, no lɛ kaaloo wɔ kɛmiijɛ biɛ kɛmiiya, 16 ejaakɛ mɛni aaatsɔ̃ɔ akɛ oyɛ mi kɛ omaŋ nɛɛ he miishɛɛ akɛ ja tee ni okɛ wɔ aaatee lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ana akɛ soro wɔ, ni ji mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ, yɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.”
17Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Nɔ ni okɛɛ nɛɛ hu mafee, ejaakɛ miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ, ni mile bo jogbaŋŋ.”
18Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛ nakai ni lɛ hã mana onunyam lɛ.”
19 Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mibahã minunyam lɛ abaho yɛ ohiɛ, ni mibatsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi, Yehowa lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ. Mibaduro mɔ ni mibaduro, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ ehe mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ. 20Shi moŋ, onyɛŋ mihiɛ ona, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko enaŋ mihiɛ ni eyi aaana wala.”
21 Yehowa tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa, tɛsaa ko yɛ mimasɛi yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, daamɔ jɛi. 22 Shi be mli ni minunyam lɛ hoɔ lɛ maŋɔ bo mawo tɛsaa lɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni mi kɛ minine aaatsi onɔ kɛyashi mibaho dã. 23Kɛkɛ lɛ majie minine lɛ, ni ooona mikotosɛɛ gbɛ, shi mihiɛ lɛ no lɛ anaaa.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 34
Content:
Tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ krokomɛi
(Deuteronomio 10.1-5)
1 Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋnii lɛ koni maŋma klɛŋklɛŋ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii ni ojwara lɛ anɔ wiemɔi lɛ mawo nɔ. 2Wɔ lɛ osaa ohe, ni oba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ okɛ ohe abatsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ jɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ. 3 Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafata ohe kɛmiiba lɛ, akana mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko, ni akana toi loo tsinai miiba abaye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he.” 4Kɛkɛ ni Mose ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋnii lɛ, ni ete shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ekwɔ kɛtee Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ lɛ, ni ehiɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ.
5 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpeleke shi yɛ atatu mli kɛbanina Mose, yɛ he ni edamɔ lɛ, ni Yehowa tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. 6Yehowa batsɔ̃ Mose hiɛ kɛho, ni etsɛ ehe ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ durolɔ lɛ, mɔ ni toɔ etsui shi, ni emli eyi kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwale babaoo lɛ, 7 mɔ ni yɔɔ suɔmɔ hã mɛi akpei abɔ, ni ekɛ tɔ̃mɔ kɛ esha faa, shi ehãaa tɔ̃lɔ ko aye ehe tswaa, ni ewoɔ bii nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anajiaŋ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.”
8Ni Mose he fee oya, ni ekoto shi, ni eja Yehowa, 9ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ona mihe miishɛɛ lɛ, miikpa bo fai akɛ Nuŋtsɔ ahi wɔteŋ kɛya, tsɛbelɛ gbɔmɛi ni kuɛŋ ti ji maŋ nɛɛ. Okɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi kɛ wɔhe esha afa wɔ koni okɛ wɔ afee onɔ.”
Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ ekoŋŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 23.14-19; Deuteronomio 7.1-5; 16.1-17)
10Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, mi kɛ nyɛ baakpãŋ. Mibafee naakpɛɛ nii yɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni ji nii ni eko bako dã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, loo yɛ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ, ni mɛi ateŋ ni oyɔɔ lɛ kɛaana Yehowa nitsumɔ, ejaakɛ mi kɛ bo baatsu nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei. 11Ye mlai ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ anɔ. Naa, mibahã Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ajo nyɛnaa foi. 12 Kwɛmɔ ohe ni ahi koni okɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni nyɛyaa lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋ koni no batsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã nyɛ. 13 Shi moŋ nyɛkumɔa amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ, ni nyɛfitea amɛkrabatsai lɛ, ni nyɛfolɔa amɛ-Ashera lɛ wɔŋ koo lɛ nyɛshwiea.
14 “Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔ kroko ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni egbɛi ji ‘Awuŋã’ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ni. 15Ni nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko, ejaakɛ kɛji amɛmiija amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni amɛshã amɛfɔle lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ ko aaatsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛaayaye amɛfɔleshãa niyenii lɛ eko. 16 Nakai nɔŋŋ eeehã nyɛyaŋɔŋɔɔ amɛbiyei akɛ ŋamɛi nyɛhã nyɛbihii, ni kɛji amɛbiyei lɛ tee amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jamɔ lɛ, nyɛbihii lɛ aaanyiɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ asɛɛ amɛje misɛɛ, ni amɛaayaja ŋamɛi lɛ asɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
17“Kaafee dade amãgã ko ohã ohe.
18“Nyɛyea Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ. Bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ; nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã. Nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo, yɛ be ni ato ni ji Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛshi Ijipt.
19“Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji nuu ni gbeleɔ musu naa lɛ minɔ ni, tsina ni jio, too ni jio. 20 Shi teji kromɔbi lɛ akɛ toobi akpɔ̃ lɛ, shi kɛji asumɔŋ ni akpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ no lɛ aku ekuɛŋ. Okpɔ̃ bihii ateŋ kromɔbii fɛɛ.
“Mɔ ko mɔ ko akapue kɛ edɛ̃ folo yɛ mihiɛ.
21“Atsu nii gbii ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ajɔɔ he, humɔ be mli jio, nikpamɔ be mli jio, ajɔɔ he.
22“Asaŋ nyɛyea Otsii Agbijurɔ lɛ, be mli ni akuɔ ŋmaa kpokploku lɛ, kɛ Ŋmaa naabuamɔkɛtoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ afi lɛ naagbee mli.
23“Daa afi lɛ nyɛteŋ hii lɛ fɛɛ abapue yɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ shii etɛ̃. 24Ejaakɛ mibashwie majimaji yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni malɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli kɛya shɔŋŋ, ni daa afi shii etɛ̃, be mli ni nyɛba Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ ekɔŋ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eeeta he.
25“Akɛ masha aboloo akafata kooloo he akɛshã afɔle ahã mi; ni je hu akatsɛre Hehoo Gbijurɔ afɔle lɛ eko nɔ.
26“Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni nyɛbaakpa lɛ, nyɛkɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ.
“Akahoo toobi kɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu.”
27 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋmaa wiemɔi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa mi kɛ bo kɛ Israel ekpãŋ yɛ.”
28 Mose ye nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ni ji Kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ, eyeee nii lɛ enuuu nu hu.
Mose kpeleke shi kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ
29Be ni Mose jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpeleke shi, ni tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃ lɛ, eleee kwraa akɛ wiemɔi ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ehã ehiɛ miikpɛ. 30 Be ni Aaron kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ na Mose lɛ ehiɛ miikpɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei akɛ amɛaabɛŋkɛ lɛ. 31Shi Mose tsɛ amɛ, ni Aaron kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni Mose kɛ amɛ wie. 32Fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose, ni ewo amɛ kitãi lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 33Be ni Mose kɛ maŋ lɛ wie egbe naa lɛ, ekɛ mama ko ha ehiɛ. 34 Kɛji Mose tee Yehowa hiɛ ekɛ lɛ yaawie lɛ, ekpaa mama nɛɛ yɛ hiɛ kɛyashiɔ ejeɔ kpo, ni ebakɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ. 35Israelbii lɛ naa Mose hiɛ akɛ eekpɛ, ni Mose saa ekɛ mama lɛ haa ehiɛ kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni eeetee ekoŋŋ ekɛ Yehowa ayawie.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 35
Content:
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ he akpɔi
1Mose bua Israelbii lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kitãi ni Yehowa ewo akɛ nyɛye nɔ nɛ; 2Aŋɔ gbii ekpaa akɛtsu nii, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ atsɔ̃ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã nyɛ, Yehowa hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɔŋŋ ni. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ nɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ. 3 Nyɛkashɛrea la yɛ nyɛshihilɛhei lɛ eko eko mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.”
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nikee nii
(Ɛksodɔs 25.1-9)
4 Mose kɛɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Naa nɔ ni Yehowa efã koni afee: 5Nyɛkɛ nikee nii abahãa Yehowa; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ he tsuijurɔ akɛ ehã lɛ, lɛ ekɛ nikee abahã Yehowa: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble, 6kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo, kɛ abotia he tsɔi 7kɛ too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru kɛ nuŋgbee wolo kɛ tso. 8Ekrokomɛi hu ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane kɛ tsofai ni akɛfutuɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu mli lɛ. Ekomɛi hu ji tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ. 9Akɛ oniketɛi aba abake, nɔ ni akɛbaamɔ osɔfonukpa tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ kɛ ehewulamɔnii lɛ eko ni atsɛɔ lɛ efod lɛ mli.
Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ he nibii lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 39.32-43)
10“Ni nyɛteŋ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni le ŋaa nitsumɔ lɛ eba ebawa kɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa efã ni afee lɛ: 11nomɛi ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ebuu lɛ kɛ nɔ ni haa nɔ lɛ, kɛ ekpoji lɛ kɛ ehe mplaŋi lɛ kɛ emliblɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ. 12Ekomɛi hu ji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ ehe tsei bloblobii, kɛ enaanɔ ni bu naa lɛ, kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ ni tsĩɔ ehiɛ lɛ, 13kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ, kɛ ehe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, 14kɛ kanetso lɛ kɛ kanei lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ. 15Ekrokomɛi ji tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei bloblobii lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ, 16kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, kɛ latɛ lɛ he tsei bloblobii lɛ, kɛ ehe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ. 17Ekrokomɛi hu ji kpo lɛ he muhɔi lɛ kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii ni amɛmamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ, 18kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiŋmlitsei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ hu he shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe taŋkpei lɛ. 19Ekrokomɛi hu nɛ: Osɔfoi lɛ ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni nomɛi ji Aaron ni ji Osɔfo lɛ hewulamɔ nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ.”
Maŋbii lɛ kɛ nikee ba
20Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ je Mose hiɛ ni amɛtee. 21 Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sane lɛ eta etsui mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ena he tsuijurɔ lɛ, hiɛ edɛŋ nikee ebahã Yehowa koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ ehe sɔ̃ɔmɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu ahe nii. 22Hii kɛ yei fɛɛ ba ni amɛhiɛ tsitsinaatsɛɛ nii kɛ toiiaŋnii, kɛ waogai kɛ nineshi kpotiai, kɛ shika kɛ jwinei srɔtoi. No ji mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ he tsuijurɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ shika nɔ ko ebahã Yehowa. 23Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ kuŋtu bluu loo kuŋtu afaseo loo kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ loo klala fɛɛfɛo loo abotia he tsɔi loo too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru loo nuŋgbee wolo lɛ ekɛba. 24Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni na jwiɛtɛi loo akɔɔble lɛ ekɛba akɛ Yehowa nikee nii, ni mɔ hu ni yɔɔ tso ni abaanyɛ akɛtsu sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ ekɛba. 25Kɛkɛ ni yei fɛɛ ni le kpãatsɛ̃mɔ kɛ amɛnine tsɛ̃ kpãa, ni amɛkɛ nii ni amɛtsɛ̃ lɛ ba, no ji kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futaa. 26Yei fɛɛ ni he esa kɛ abotia hetsɔi kpãatsɛ̃mɔ lɛ amɛtsɛ̃ eko kɛba. 27Ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ oniketɛi kɛ ojarawatɛi krokomɛi ni akɛbaamɔmɔ efod lɛ kɛ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ amli lɛ ba; 28asaŋ amɛkɛ tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ ba. 29Israelbii lɛ bake Yehowa nii yɛ tsuijurɔ naa. Nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni nu he yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ ehã nɔ ko lɛ, ekɛbake, koni akɛtsu nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ atsɔ̃ Mose nine nɔ atsu lɛ.
Ŋaalɔi ni baama Kpee Buu lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 31.1-11)
30Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Yehowa eje gbɛ ekɔ Bezaleel, ni ji Hur bi Uri binuu lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ. 31Eduro lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ kɛ ŋaa kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee ni akɛnyɛɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ atsuɔ, 32koni ekɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble aŋa ŋai srɔtoi, 33ni efolɔ tɛi ni akɛtaraa nibii amli, asaŋ ni ekpɛ tso mli koni akɛtsu ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi srɔtoi fɛɛ. 34Asaŋ Yehowa kɛwo Bezaleel kɛ Ahisamak binuu Oholiab ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛŋ lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ŋaa nitsumɔi. 35Eduro amɛ nilee koni amɛkɛŋa ŋai srɔtoi fɛɛ, tamɔ samayeli loo niloo kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa mliwoo nɛkɛ, kɛ mamaloo diɛŋtsɛ hu. No ji amɛle nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni ŋaalɔ tsuɔ lɛ tsumɔ.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 36
Content:
1Mose tee nɔ ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Bezaleel kɛ Oholiab kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni Yehowa eduro lɛ ŋaa kɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛbaanyɛ nibii srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛbaama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amɛfee lɛ, baatsu nibii nɛɛ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.”
Maŋbii lɛ bake nibii babaoo
2Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Bezaleel kɛ Oholiab kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni Yehowa eduro lɛ ŋaa, asaŋ ni eyɔɔ he tsui akɛ etsu nii lɛ eko lɛ kɛba, 3ni ekɛ nibii lɛ fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbake Yehowa, yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ hã amɛ. Maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛkɛ tsuijurɔ naa nibii lɛ miiba amɛkɛmiike daa leebi. 4Enɛ hã ŋaalɔi lɛ ni tsuɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nibii srɔtoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shi enitsumɔ ni etsuɔ, 5ni amɛba amɛbakɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Maŋbii lɛ kɛ nibii ni fa fe nitsumɔ ni Yehowa efã ni atsu lɛ miiba.”
6No hewɔ lɛ, Mose fã akɛ ashiɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli fɛɛ akɛ, “Nuu jio, yoo jio, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko akaba dɔŋŋ hã Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɔ̃ɔ kɛbaa, 7ejaakɛ nibii ni ana lɛ fa aahu fe bɔ ni he ehia hã nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ maa
(Ɛksodɔs 26.1-37)
8Mɛi ni tsuɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ŋaa yɔɔ amɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ lɛ ŋɔ mamai nyɔŋma amɛkɛfee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Amɛkɛ klala yɛŋ futaa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ fee buu mamai nɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ ŋaa ni mli wa ye kerubim samai amɛwo mli. 9Mamai lɛ eko fɛɛ eko kɛlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai nɛɛ fɛɛ adaramɔ kome. 10Amɛkpɛ mamai lɛ enumɔ amɛtsara, eko tsa eko naa, kɛfee mama muu kome, ni amɛkpɛ mamai enumɔ krokomɛi lɛ hu amɛtsara, eko tsa eko naa kɛfee mama muu kome nakai nɔŋŋ. 11Amɛkɛ kpãa bluu ŋmɔlɔ aflãi yɛ mama muu kome naa, ni amɛfee nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa. 12Amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome naa, kɛ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa. Biɛ kɛ biɛ aflãi nɛɛ eko kɛ eko yɛ ŋlɛnɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 13Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ shika fee kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni amɛkɛ kpoji lɛ lala mamai muji enyɔ lɛ amɛtsa, ni buu mama lɛ tsɔ̃ nɔ muu kome. 14Ni amɛkɛ abotia he tsɔi fee mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome akɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 15Mamai lɛ ekome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ fɛɛ adaramɔ kome. 16Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsara mamai enumɔ aŋklo kɛ mamai ekpaa hu aŋklo. 17Amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mamai enumɔ ni atsara afee emuu kome lɛ naa, ni amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa. 18Amɛfee akɔɔble kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni akɛlala aflãi lɛ atsara koni buu mama lɛ afee nɔ muu kome. 19Amɛkɛ too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru fee nɔhaanɔ koni akɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ nuŋgbee wolo hu fee nɔhaanɔ kroko koni akɛha nɔ ato nɔ.
20Amɛkɛ tso lɛ eko fee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi ni mamɔ shi lɛ. 21Mplaŋ kome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 22Mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ yɛ nyanyɔji enyɔ koni anyɛ akɛtsa eko kɛ eko. Nɛkɛ amɛfee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ. 23Bɔ ni amɛmamɔ mplaŋi lɛ amɛhã nɛ: Mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ, 24ni amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi fee nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ amɛwo mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ ashishi ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ nɔ enyɔ. 25Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ye jɛi, 26kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ma enyɔ nɔ. 27Ni Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, he ni ye anaigbɛ, lɛ mplaŋi ekpaa ye jɛi. 28Amɛkɛ mplaŋi enyɔɔnyɔ jie Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ. 29Amɛhã koŋ kome mplaŋi enyɔ lɛ bɔ he kɛkɛ yɛ amɛshishigbɛ, shi atsa amɛ yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ga lɛ yi. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee koji enyɔ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ. 30No hewɔ lɛ, ana mplaŋi kpaanyɔ yɛ sɛɛgbɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ma shishi nibii enyɔ anɔ.
31Ni amɛkɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko fee mlibɛlɛmɔnii enumɔ amɛhã mplaŋi ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kome, 32ni mplaŋi ni yɔɔ ŋmawuiaŋ kome lɛ hu na mlibɛlɛmɔnii enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ. 33Amɛhã mlibɛlɛmɔnii ni ye mplaŋi lɛ ateŋ lɛ kã shi emuu kɛjɛ koŋ kome kɛyagbe naa yɛ koŋ kome lɛ. 34Amɛkɛ shika shwie mplaŋi lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛ shika nɔŋŋ fee amɛhe gai ni akɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii baahɔlɔ mli lɛ, ni mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ hu amɛkɛ shika shwie he. 35Amɛkɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne fee muhɔɔ, ni akɛ ŋaa ni mli wa lo kerubim samai amɛwo mli. 36Amɛkɛ tso lɛ eko fee akulashiŋi ejwɛ amɛto muhɔɔ lɛ he; amɛshwie akulashiŋi nɛɛ ahe shika, ni amɛkɛ shika nɔŋŋ fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji lɛ, ni amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi fee nibii ejwɛ amɛwo akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. 37Amɛkɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne, asaŋ ni akɛ abui elo nii ewo mli fee Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naahaa mama lɛ. 38Amɛmamɔ akulashiŋi enumɔ kɛ amɛhe kpoji amɛhã shinaa lɛ naahaa mama lɛ. Amɛkɛ shika shwie akulashiŋi lɛ ayitsei lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ hu ahe, shi akɛ akɔɔble fee nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 37
Content:
Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kpɛɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 25.10-22)
1Bezaleel kɛ tso kpɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni ekwɔlɛ hu ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 2Eshwie adeka lɛ mli kɛ ehe fɛɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekɛ shika baŋ adeka lɛ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe. 3Efee shika gai ejwɛ eto adeka lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ. Gai enyɔ ye afã kome, ni gai enyɔ hu ye afã kome lɛ. 4Ekɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko gbɔlɔ tsei bloblobii, ni eshwie amɛhe shika; 5ekɛ tsei nɛɛ hɔlɔ gai ni yɔɔ adeka lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ amli koni akɛwo. 6Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 7Etswia shika ekɛfee kerubim enyɔ emamɔ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ anɔ. 8Kerub kome yɛ koŋ kome, ni ekome hu yɛ koŋ kome lɛ. Esɔo kerubim nɛɛ ekpɛtɛ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ. 9Kerubim lɛ egbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni amɛkɛha naanɔ lɛ nɔ, ni kerub kome miikwɛ ekome hiɛ, asaŋ amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi kɛmiikwɛ naanɔ lɛ.
Okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Aboloo lɛ maa nɔ lɛ kpɛɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 25.23-30)
10Bezaleel kɛ tso lɛ eko kpɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã. 11Eshwie he shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekɛ shika baŋ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe. 12Asaŋ egbɔ tso blawa ni lɛɛmɔ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ, ni ekɛkpɛtɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ toi kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe. 13Efee shika gai ejwɛ ewo okplɔ̃ lɛ naji ejwɛ lɛ ahe. 14Gai nɛɛ ye tso blawa lɛ shishi tuuŋtu, ni nomɛi amli akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ hɔlɔ. 15Ekɛ tso lɛ eko nɔŋŋ gbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ, ni eshwie tsei lɛ ahe shika. 16Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee okplɔ̃ lɛ he nibii ni ji plɛtei kɛ kpuji ni akɛbaashã wain afɔle lɛ.
Kanetso lɛ feemɔ
(Ɛksodɔs 25.31-40)
17Bezaleel kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia fee kanetso lɛ. Etswia shika ŋmiiŋmi ekɛfee eshimaa tso lɛ kɛ eshishi nii ni emaa nɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ehe tɔi lɛ kɛ ehe kpɔbii kɛ ehe fɔfɔi samai lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ nɔ muu kome.
18Kanetso lɛ yɛ niji ekpaa: niji etɛ̃ ye afã kome nɛɛ, ni etɛ hu ye afã kroko lɛ. 19Afã kome hiɛ tɔi etɛ̃ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi, tɔ fɛɛ tɔ kɛ ekpɔ kɛ efɔfɔi sama yɛ nine kome he.
