Nakai sɔŋŋ afee niji ekpaa lɛ fɛɛ ni kanetso lɛ egbala lɛ. 20Kanetso lɛ shimaatso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ tɔi ejwɛ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi kɛ amɛhe kpɔbii kɛ fɔfɔi samai. 21Ni kpɔi mamɔ kanetso lɛ he, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ niji ekpaa lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kpɔ yɛ eshishi. 22Tɔi lɛ kɛ fɔfɔi samai lɛ kɛ kpɔbii lɛ kɛ niji lɛ kɛ kanetso lɛ shimaatso lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia afee nɔ muu kome. 23Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi nɔŋŋ fee kanetso lɛ he kanei kpawo lɛ kɛ ehe abɛɛlei lɛ kɛ ehe lagbee nii lɛ kɛ kanetso lɛ he aklotɛi bibii lɛ fɛɛ. 24Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome fee kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ kpɛɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 30.1-5)
25Bezaleel kɛ akasia tso kpɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ninetalɔ kome kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔ kome; ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi enyɔ. Ehe akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ nɔ muu kome. 26Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi shwie latɛ lɛ he, eyiteŋ kɛ ehe fɛɛ kɛkpe kpula. 27Efee shika gai enyɔnyɔ ewo latɛ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ, yɛ shika ni akɛbaŋ naa lɛ shishi, koni akɛ tsei ahɔlɔ mli ni akɛwo latɛ lɛ. 28Ekɛ tso gbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ, ni ekɛ shika shwie he.
Mufɔɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma lɛ feemɔ
29 Ekɛ ŋaa ni akɛfeɔ ojeŋma fee mu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 38
Content:
Shãa Afɔle latɛ lɛ kpɛɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 27.1-8)
1Bezaleel kɛ tso kpɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ. Latɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi enumɔ; ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi etɛ̃. 2Efee akloŋtoi emamɔ latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ anɔ. Akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ fee nɔ muu kome, ni ekɛ akɔɔble ha latɛ muu lɛ fɛɛ he. 3Efee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nibii lɛ fɛɛ: kukwɛii lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ fakai lɛ kɛ lajee nii lɛ. Ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɔɔble ekɛfee. 4Efee akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ. 5Efee gai ejwɛ ewo akɔɔble ntaŋ nɛɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ koni akɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ ahɔlɔ mli. 6Ni ekɛ tso lɛ eko gbɔ tsei bloblobii nɛɛ, ni ekɛ akɔɔble ha he, 7ni ekɛ tsei bloblobii nɛɛ hɔlɔ gai lɛ amli yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ koni akɛwo. Ŋmoŋmolo ekɛfee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni gbɛ kã mli.
Akɔɔble okpolu lɛ feemɔ
(Ɛksodɔs 30.18)
8 Bezaleel kɛ akɔɔble fee okpolu kɛ ehe akɔɔble nane ni ta shi koni akɛfɔflɔ he lɛ. Akɔɔble ni akɛfee lɛ yei ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ ashwishwɛi akɛfee.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he kpo lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 27.9-19)
9Bezaleel fee kpo ewo Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he. Ewuoyigbɛ lɛ ekɛ klala kpakpa ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha fee muhɔɔ eha jɛi. 10Emamɔ muhɔɔ nɛɛ he akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee. 11Kpo lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ hu jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha. Emamɔ akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee. 12Kpo lɛ he ni ye anaigbɛ lɛ jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ehe akulashiŋi nyɔŋma kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋma ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmliblɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee. 13Kpo lɛ he ni ye bokãgbɛ, ni ji ehiɛ lɛ, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ. 14Muhɔɔ ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ ha kpo lɛ hiɛgbɛ afã kome, kɛjɛ agbo lɛ he kɛyashi kpo lɛ koŋ. Muhɔɔ nɛɛ he akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. 15Ni kpo lɛ hiɛgbɛ afã kome lɛ hu, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ, kɛ ehe akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃. 16Muhɔɔ ni bɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ klala kpakpa akɛfee. 17Kpo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ akɔɔble akɛfee, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, ni amɛyiteŋhaa nii lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi nɔŋŋ fee nii ni akɛbele amɛteŋ lɛ. 18Kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naahaa mama lɛ akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futaa ni anyɛne lo nii wo mli kɛ abui. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ hu ji ninetalɔi enyɔ tamɔ kpo lɛ nɔ muhɔi lɛ fɛɛ. 19Agbo lɛ hiɛ akulashiŋi ejwɛ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi feefee amɛhe gai lɛ kɛ amɛyitsei ahehaa nii lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ. 20Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ kpo lɛ hu he shiŋmlitsei ni bɔle lɛ kpula lɛ, akɔɔble akɛfee fɛɛ.
Dadei ni akɛma Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ
21 Naa bɔ ni dadei srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛma Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ maa mli lɛ naa yakpa, be ni Mose fã Itamar, ni ji Aaron, osɔfo lɛ binuu lɛ, koni ekwɛ Levibii lɛ anɔ koni amɛbu fɛɛ naa lɛ.
22 Bezaleel, ni ji Hur ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi Uri bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni fee nibii ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ atsu lɛ fɛɛ. 23Mɔ ni fata ehe ji Ahisamak ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi Oholiab, mɔ ni he esa kɛ ŋaayeli kɛ samajiemɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ ele bɔ ni akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta loɔ nii awoɔ mama mli lɛ.
24 Shika ŋmiiŋmi fɛɛ ni akɛtsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ maa mli fɛɛ, ni ji shika ni akɛbake Yehowa lɛ, naa yashiɔ talentai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ shekel ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nsɛnitɛ naa. 25Jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni akane lɛ hã lɛ naa yashiɔ talentai oha kɛ shekel akpe kome ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ ni aŋmɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nsɛnitɛ naa. 26Be ni akane mɛi lɛ, ana mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa. 27Ajie jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli talentai oha ni akɛfee nibii ni Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ nibii ni muhɔɔ lɛ hu akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ. Akɛfee nibii nɛɛ oha, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ talenta kome feɔ akulashiŋ kome. 28Ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi shekel akpe kome ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ ni shwɛ lɛ fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛyitsei ahehaa nii lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ. 29Akɔɔble fɛɛ ni abake lɛ naa yashiɔ talentai nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ shekel akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ. 30Ni no akɛfee nibii ni Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nibii lɛ fɛɛ. 31No nɔŋŋ eko akɛfee nibii ni kpo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ kɛbɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ, kɛ nibii ni kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ hu mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei fɛɛ ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei hu ni bɔle kpo lɛ kɛkpe kpula lɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 39
Content:
Osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii lɛ feemɔ
(Ɛksodɔs 28.1-14)
1Amɛkɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ fee hewulamɔ nibii ni yɔɔ fɛo naakpa koni akɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Amɛfee osɔfonukpa hewulamɔ nibii amɛhã Aaron tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
2Amɛkɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa fee efod lɛ. 3Ni amɛtswia shika fɛtɛfɛtɛ, ni amɛfolɔ lɛ kpãikpãi, ni akɛfee ŋaabii awo kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa lɛ mli. 4Amɛfee mama hwĩahwĩabii ni baakã kɔŋ amɛkɛtsa efod lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ koni akɛŋmɔ efod lɛ. 5Amɛkɛ ŋaa kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ nibii kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ eko fee efod lɛ mlifiinii lɛ; nibii nɛɛ ji kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa ni alo nii awo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. 6Ni amɛfolɔ oniketɛi, ni amɛkɛhɔlɔ shika gai amli ni amɛkpɛ Israel bihii lɛ agbɛii lɛ amɛwo tɛi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ. 7Ni amɛkɛ tɛi lɛ mamɔ efod lɛ he mama hwĩahwĩabii ni kãa kɔ̃ŋ nɔ lɛ anɔ koni akɛkai Yakob bihii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ feemɔ
(Ɛksodɔs 28.15-30)
8Bezaleel kɛ ŋaa ni mli wa naakpa nakai nɔŋŋ fee tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni afee efod lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ekɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa fee. 9Efee tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ koji ejwɛ, ni adɔ mli enyɔ afɔ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ: ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔ kome. 10Kɛkɛ ni amɛto tɛi klɛmpɛi ejwɛ amɛmamɔ nɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ klɛmpɛ lɛ mli tɛi fee ojarawatɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ rubi kɛ topasiɔn kɛ garneto lɛ. 11Klɛmpɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli ojarawatɛi lɛ fee ameldo kɛ safiro kɛ daiamɔnd. 12Klɛmpɛ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli ojarawatɛi fee tekwais kɛ kalkedɔn kɛ amɛtisto, 13ni klɛmpɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ mli ojarawatɛi lɛ fee berilo kɛ onike kɛ yaspi. Akɛ tɛi lɛ mamɔ shika gai amli. 14Tɛi lɛ ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni tɛi nɛɛ agbɛii kɛ Yakob bihii lɛ agbɛii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nyiɛ yɛ Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ naa. Akpɛ gbɛii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ, tɛ fɛɛ tɛ kɛ egbɛi. 15Ni amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa, amɛkɛwo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ naa. 16Ni amɛfee shika gai hu enyɔ amɛwo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ yiteŋgbɛ koji enyɔ lɛ. 17Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ shika kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ lɛ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ lala gai enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ koji lɛ. 18Kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ anaabui enyɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, amɛkɛlala shika ni asere kɛbɔle tɛi enyɔ lɛ ashishi lɛ, ni amɛkɛyaŋmɔ efod lɛ he mama hwĩahwĩabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ yɛ hiɛgbɛ. 19Amɛfee shika gai enyɔ amɛwo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ afã kome, ni adɔ awo shishigbɛ koni ekã efod lɛ nɔ koji enyɔ lɛ nɔ. 20Ni amɛsaa amɛfee shika gai krokomɛi enyɔ ni amɛkɛmamɔ efod lɛ he mama hwĩahwĩabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ anaa yɛ amɛshishigbɛ tsamɔhe, yɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ yiteŋgbɛ. 21Ni amɛkɛ mama bluu fimɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ he gai lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ efod lɛ he gai lɛ, koni tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ akã efod lɛ mlifiinii fɛɛfɛo lɛ nɔ koni akɛje nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii krokomɛi lɛ feemɔ
(Ɛksodɔs 28.31-43)
22Akɛ mama bluu sɔŋŋ kpɛ efod lɛ shishi atade yuu lɛ. 23Ajie kuɛ awo atade lɛ he, ni akɛ mama baŋ kuɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe koni ekagba. 24Amɛkɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo fee kpɔbii kokrobii kɛbɔle atade lɛ naamuu lɛ kɛkpe. 25Ni amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee ŋmɛji, ni amɛkɛ ŋmɛji nɛɛ folɔ kpɔbii kokrobii lɛ ateiaŋ yɛ atade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ naa kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe nɛkɛ: 26shika ŋmɛlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome, shika ŋmɛlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome aahu kɛbɔle atade yuu lɛ ni abaawo kɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ naamuu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm kɛkpe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
27Ni amɛkɛ klala kpakpa fɛɛfɛo lo flakai amɛhã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. 28Amɛkɛ klala kpakpa nɔŋŋ fee osɔfonukpa fai lɛ kɛ osɔfoi bibii afaii pɛmpɛbii lɛ kɛ tswakotoi lɛ hu. 29Ni amɛkɛ klala kpakpa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ fee mlifii nɔ lɛ, ni alo nii awo mli tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. 30 Amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee nii ni taa osɔfonukpa fai lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni amɛŋma wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛwo nɔ tamɔ aŋmaa nii yɛ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ akɛ, “Afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa.” 31Kɛkɛ ni amɛfĩ kɛkpɛtɛ kuŋtu bluu nɔ, ni akɛta osɔfonukpa fai lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Nitsumɔ lɛ naagbee
(Ɛksodɔs 35.10-19)
32Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee agbe Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa ahã. Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. 33Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ Mose, no ji Buu lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ekpoji lɛ kɛ eplaŋi lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni amɛmamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, 34kɛ buu lɛ nɔhaa nii lɛ ni ji too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru lɛ kɛ nuŋgbee wolo ni haa no nɔ lɛ, kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ. 35Asaŋ amɛkɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enaanɔ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ 36kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ hu ba. 37Nibii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe kanei lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ, 38kɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ. 39Ekrokomɛi ji akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa latɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ latɛ lɛ he tsei bloblobii lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ. 40Ekrokomɛi hu ji kpo lɛ muhɔi lɛ kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he taŋkpei lɛ kɛ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni akɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ, 41kɛ osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii fɛɛfɛji ni akɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Nomɛi ji Osɔfo Aaron hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ. 42Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ tsu nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 43Mose kwɛ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni naa, bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ afee lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɔɔ amɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 40
Content:
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shii kɛ enɔjɔɔmɔ
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, shii Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. 3Okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama mli, ni okɛ muhɔɔ lɛ atsĩ hiɛ. 4Okɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ aya Buu lɛ mli, ni oto nibii ni sa akɛ amãmɔ nɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ omamɔ nɔ, ni okɛ kanetso lɛ aya mli, ni okɛ ehe kanei lɛ amãmɔ nɔ. 5Okɛ shika latɛ ni akɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma lɛ ama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, ni okɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ aha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa. 6Agbɛnɛ okɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛgbɛ. 7Okɛ okpolu lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni okɛ nu awo mli. 8No sɛɛ lɛ, owo kpo lɛ oma shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ tswɛm, ni okɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ aha naa.
9“Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ owo mu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ okɛfɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ emli nibii lɛ fɛɛ koni okɛfee lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ. 10Ofɔ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ni okɛfee latɛ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni etsɔ̃ afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ. 11Ofɔ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ hu mu ni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
12“Agbɛnɛ okɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni okɛ nu aju amɛhe. 13No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ awula Aaron, ni ofɔ lɛ mu okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni eye osɔfo ehã mi. 14Okɛ Aaron bihii lɛ hu aba ni okɛ flakai lɛ awo amɛ, 15ni ofɔ amɛ hu mu tamɔ ofɔ amɛtsɛ mu lɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi. Amɛmufɔɔ nɛɛ aaahã osɔfoyeli atsɔ̃ amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei abihii anɔ kɛya naanɔ.”
16Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 17Be ni Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt lɛ enɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ ashi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama shi. 18Mose ji mɔ ni shi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ema shi. Ekala nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ baamamɔ nɔ lɛ, etee mplaŋi lɛ shi emamɔ shi, ni ekɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ bɛlɛ teiaŋ, kɛkɛ ni etee ekulashiŋi lɛ shi emamɔ shi. 19Elɛɛ buu mama lɛ mli ekɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔhaanɔ lɛ ha nɔ to nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 20Ni Mose kɛ tɛi ni aŋmala kitãi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ hɔlɔ Adeka lɛ he, ni ekɛ naanɔ lɛ bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naa. 21Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eshi muhɔɔ lɛ ekɛtsi Adeka lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
22Agbɛnɛ Mose wo okplɔ̃ lɛ ekɛyama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ, 23kɛkɛ ni eto aboloo lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ eshwie nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 24Ewo kanetso lɛ eyama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ. 25Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehe kanei lɛ mamɔ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 26Ekɛ shika tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ, 27ni eshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 28Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ mama lɛ ha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 29Ekɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni eshã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 30Ewo okpolu lɛ ema Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni ekɛ nu wo mli, 31ni no sɛɛ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe. 32Kɛji amɛbaaya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni kɛji amɛbaabɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ amɛfɔfɔlɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. 33Ni Mose tee kpo lɛ shi ema shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ ha naa. Kɛkɛ ni Mose gbe nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa.
Atatu ni shi ema Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ lɛ
(Numeri 9.15-23)
34 Kɛkɛ ni atatu baha Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ yi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃. 35No hewɔ lɛ, Mose nyɛɛɛ ebote Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ejaakɛ atatu lɛ eha Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ hu eyi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli obɔ̃. 36Israelbii lɛ agbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, kɛji atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛfãa kɛyaa amɛhiɛ; 37shi kɛji atatu lɛ wooo ehe nɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛfãaa kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni eeewo ehe nɔ. 38Ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa atatu lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane, ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ atatu lɛ kpɛɔ la ni Israelbii lɛ naa gbɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Mlai srɔtoi ni awo yɛ jamɔ kɛ jamɔ mli gbɛjianɔtoi ahe ahã maŋbii kɛ osɔfoi ni kwɛɔ koni aye mlai lɛ anɔ yɛ blemablema Israelbii lɛ abeiaŋ ji saji ni yɔɔ Levitiko loo Jamɔ He Mlai Awolo lɛ mli.
Sane krɛdɛɛ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehe tse. Atsɔ̃ɔ gbɛi anɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ webii atsɔ̃ aja Nyɔŋmɔ, asaŋ ni amɛhi shi, bɔ ni afee ni amɛnyɛ amɛ kɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, teŋ ahi jogbaŋŋ daa.
Wiemɔ ko ni ale jogbaŋŋ yɛ Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, eyɛ Yitso 19.18. Yesu tsɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ akɛ, “Kitã Wulu ni ji Enyɔ lɛ.” Ni no ji, “Suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.”
Mlijaramɔi
Mlai ni kɔɔ afɔlei kɛ afɔleshaã he 1.1—7.38
Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ osɔfowoo 8.1—10.20
Mlai ni kɔɔ hetsemɔ kɛ he muji he 11.1—15.33
Kpãtãmɔ Gbi lɛ 16.1-34
Mlai ni kɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ yɛ jeŋshihilɛ kɛ jamɔ he 17.1—27.34

Title: LEVITIKO 1
Content:
Afɔle ni ashãa lɛ emuu
1Yehowa jɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli etsɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 2“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko miiba ekɛ kooloo abashã afɔle ehã mi, Yehowa, lɛ ekɛ etsinai lɛ loo etoi lɛ ateŋ eko abashã afɔle lɛ. 3Kɛji tsina ekɛbaa afɔleshãa lɛ, ehiɛ tsinanuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ebahã. Ekɛ kooloo lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni Yehowa ahe efɔle lɛ. 4Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ afɔleshãa kooloo lɛ yiteŋ, ni abaaŋɔ kooloo lɛ akɛshã afɔle ni akɛkpãtã ehe esha lɛ ahã lɛ. 5Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ egbe tsinanuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koji ejwɛ lɛ he lɛ kɛkpe. 6Mɔ lɛ akpɔ kooloo lɛ hewolo lɛ koni esaa loo lɛ. 7Aaron bihii lɛ ato lai amɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛshɛre la lɛ. 8No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛto loo ni asaa lɛ yitso lɛ kɛ emli fɔ lɛ amɛshwie lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 9 Nuu lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe; ni osɔfo lɛ ashã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; shãa afɔle ni, afɔle ni akɛ la shãa kooloo lɛ fɛɛ ni. Afɔle nɛɛ jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
10“Shi kɛji too gwantɛŋ loo abotia mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ, ehiɛ gwantɛŋ nuu loo abotia nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛba. 11Egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ekooyigbɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe. 12Mɔ lɛ asaa loo lɛ; ni osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai be lɛ ato kooloo ni asaa lɛ: yitso lɛ kɛ emli fɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ashwie lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 13Shi mɔ lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe. No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ni tsuɔ nii nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nomɛi hu baashi nɔ, ni eshã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shãa afɔle ni: afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
14“Shi kɛji loofɔlɔ mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpo loo shĩa okpo pɛmpɛoo. 15Osɔfo lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ lɛ abaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; etsɔ̃mɔ ni etse loofɔlɔ lɛ yitso, ni eshã loofɔlɔ lɛ loo lɛ, shi loofɔlɔ lɛ lá lɛ atsere kɛnyiɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. 16Ejie loofɔlɔ lɛ kpɔŋɔshi kɛ emlinii lɛ koni eshɛrɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ebokãgbɛ he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ. 17Emɔ loofɔlɔ lɛ fiji lɛ amli koni egba loofɔlɔ lɛ mli, shi ekakpɔlɔ efiji lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ ashã loofɔlɔ lɛ yɛ lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shãa afɔle ni: afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.”

Title: LEVITIKO 2
Content:
Niyenii afɔlei
1“Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ŋmãa miiba abashã afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ, egbɛlɛ ŋmãa lɛ mã. Ekɛ mu ashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma hu afata he; 2koni ekɛbahã Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ. Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpiti mã lɛ kɛ mu lɛ ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma lɛ fɛɛ koni ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ afɔle muu ni akɛbahã Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ. Eji shãa afɔle, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa. 3Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashãa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni; eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ eko ni.
4“Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee ŋmãa nii ni ashã yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ, nɔ lɛ efee mã akpiti keeki ni akɛ mu wo mli ashã, loo mã akpiti akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mu ekpa hiɛ.
5“Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee nii ni ashãa yɛ looshãa dade nɔ lɛ, no lɛ efee nii ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu fee niyenii. 6Akumɔ afɔle lɛ mli dukuduku, ni afɔse mu ashwie nɔ. Niyenii afɔle ni.
7“Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee niyenii ni ashĩ yɛ ŋɛsu mli hu lɛ, afɔle lɛ afee niyenii ni akɛ mã akpiti kɛ mu fee. 8Akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ nibii nɛɛ fee lɛ aba akɛ Yehowa nikeenii, ni akɛbahã osɔfo lɛ, ni ekɛya afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. 9Osɔfo lɛ ajie niyenii afɔle lɛ mli eko, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ shãa afɔle muu lɛ ni akɛbahã Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ. 10Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni. Eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa mli eko ni.
11“Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ko niyenii afɔle ko ni akɛ mã sha fee akabahãa Yehowa, ni nyɛkashãa nɔ ko ni mã sha loo wo yɔɔ mli akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛhãa Yehowa. 12 Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛŋɔ nibii nɛɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ nii lɛ eko nyɛbahã Yehowa. Shi moŋ akashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ nii ni jeɔ ŋma. 13 Nyɛwoa nyɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ amli ŋoo. Ŋoo ji nii ni yeɔ kpãŋmɔ ni nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ he odase lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, akashi ŋoo sɛɛ yɛ nyɛniyenii afɔle fɛɛ mli. Nyɛkɛ ŋoo afataa nyɛfɔlei fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛbaa he. 14 Kɛji niyenii afɔle ni akɛbaahã Yehowa fee ŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nibaanii lɛ mli eko lɛ, no lɛ afɔle lɛ afee abele kpokploku ni ashĩ mamu. 15Akɛ mu ashwie nɔ, ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma afɔ̃ nɔ. Niyenii afɔle ni. 16Osɔfo lɛ ashã mamu lɛ he ni mu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni fata he lɛ hu fɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni akɛbahã lɛ he odaseyeli nɔ. Eji afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa.”

Title: LEVITIKO 3
Content:
Naanyobɔɔ afɔlei
1“Kɛji mɔ ko miiba ebashã toiŋjɔlɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ etsinai lɛ ateŋ eko, tsina lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe. 2Mɔ lɛ kɛ enine aŋmɛ tsina lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ abashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe. 3Naanyobɔɔ afɔle kooloo lɛ mli nibii ni sa akɛ ashãa ahãa Yehowa ji fɔ fɛɛ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ 4kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe. 5Osɔfoi lɛ kɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni ashã: shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
6“Kɛji mɔ lɛ miiba ebashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa kɛ gwantɛŋi loo abotiai lɛ ateŋ eko lɛ, kooloo lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe. 7Kɛji mɔ lɛ hiɛ gwantɛŋ kɛba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ, 8ni ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe. 9Naanyobɔɔ afɔle kooloo nɛɛ mli nibii ni sa akɛ ashãa ahã Yehowa ji emli fɔ lɛ kɛ elei muu ni ajie kɛjɛ ekotosɛɛ wu lɛ tɔ̃ɔ nɔ, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ, 10kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni yɔɔ amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe. 11Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni aashã akɛhã Yehowa.
12“Kɛji mɔ lɛ kɛ abotia ba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛbahã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 13Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe. 14Kooloo lɛ mli nibii ni ekɛbaahã akɛ afɔle ni ashã ahã Yehowa ji fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ, 15kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni ha amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe. 16Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa kɛŋma akɛhã Yehowa. Fɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni. 17 Israelbii akaye kooloo fɔ loo lá. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni akã shi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaahi.”

Title: LEVITIKO 4
Content:
Eshai ni hiɛ kãaa he ni afee he afɔlei
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ 2ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃ akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni Yehowa ewo lɛ eko nɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ akafee lɛ eko be mli ni mɔ lɛ hiɛ kãaa he lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ:
3Kɛji Osɔfonukpa lɛ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, ni no ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ etɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛ tsina oblanyo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe abashã ehe esha lɛ he afɔle ehã Yehowa. 4Ekɛ tsinanuu lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ekɛ enine afɔ̃ tsinanuu lɛ yiteŋ ni egbe lɛ. 5Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli, 6 ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, koni ekɛ la lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 7 Osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsinanuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi. 8Osɔfonukpa lɛ ajie fɔ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ esha afɔle tsinanuu lɛ mli, ni ji fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ; 9ejie esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni ha amɛhe lɛ, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ ekɛfata sabai lɛ ahe, 10tamɔ ajieɔ nibii nɛɛ yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔleshãa tsinanuu lɛ loo lɛ he lɛ, koni eshã fɛɛ yɛ shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 11 Shi tsinanuu lɛ hewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ fɛɛ: eyitso kɛ enaji lɛ kɛ emlinii lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ, 12 Osɔfonukpa lɛ awo tsinanuu muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo kɛya he ko ni tse yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ he ko, koni eyashã yɛ lai nɔ yɛ jɛi. He ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ, jɛi ashã afɔle nɛɛ yɛ.
13Kɛji Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni tɔ̃ Yehowa kitãi lɛ eko nɔ, ni amɛfee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni amɛhiɛ kãaa he, ni asaŋ amɛkɔɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ ni amɛtɔ̃ lɛ sɛɛ hu, ni no hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ eye sɔ̃ lɛ, 14 kɛji ana ale esha tɔ̃mɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ kɛ tsina oblanyo ashã esha afɔle. Akɛ tsina oblanyo lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ. 15Maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsina lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni agbe tsina lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 16Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli, 17ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 18Ekɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsinanuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi. 19Tsinanuu lɛ fɔ lɛ ejie fɛɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 20Bɔ ni efee esha afɔle tsinanuu lɛ loo lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee tsinanuu nɛɛ hu loo lɛ, koni ekpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ koni akɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa amɛ. 21Ewo tsinanuu lɛ loo lɛ kɛje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni eshã tamɔ bɔ ni eshã lɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ he esha tsina afɔle loo lɛ. Maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle ni.
22Kɛji nɔyelɔ ko tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ejaakɛ efee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eye sɔ̃ lɛ, 23kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ekɛbashã afɔle. 24Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ. Esha afɔle ni. 25Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi la ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. 26Eshã too kpakpo lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei akooloi lɛ amli fɔ lɛ koni kɛtsɔ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛbaafa lɛ.
27 Kɛji maŋbii lɛ kɛkɛ ateŋ mɔ ko tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ejaakɛ efee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eye sɔ̃ lɛ, 28kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ abotia yoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ni ekɛbashã afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ. 29Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle too lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ. 30Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. 31Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ shidaa afɔlei akooloi amli fɔ lɛ, ni eshã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni eje ŋma ewo Yehowa, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ehã lɛ, ni akɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ baafa lɛ.
32Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ gwantɛŋ miiba abashã esha afɔle lɛ, ekɛ gwantɛŋyoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba. 33Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ koni akɛshã esha afɔle yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ. 34Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle kooloo lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. 35Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ naanyobɔɔ afɔle gwantɛŋ lɛ mli fɔ lɛ koni eshã no kɛ niyenii afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa. Ni osɔfo lɛ baakpãtã ahã lɛ, ni akɛ ehe esha lɛ baafa lɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 5
Content:
Saji amli ni esha afɔle he ehia yɛ
1 Kɛji atsɛ mɔ ko odase yɛ sane ko he, ni emua enaa, ni ewieee, tsɛbelɛ ena aloo ele sane lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ efee esha, ni eye sɔ̃.
2Kɛji mɔ ko ta nɔ ko ni he tseee he, ŋa mli kooloo ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, shĩa kooloo ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, kooloo ni wamɔɔ ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, kɛ ehiɛ kãaa he ni eta he tete lɛ, akɛni ebule ehe hewɔ lɛ, eye sɔ̃.
3Aloo kɛji eta nɔ ko ni he tseee yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛkɛ ni he tseee ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ he, ni eleee, shi kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, eye sɔ̃.
4Kɛji mɔ ko eyakwɛɛɛ jogbaŋŋ ni ekã kitã akɛ eeefee efɔŋ loo ekpakpa ko tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi kãa kitã ni amɛjwɛŋŋ he lɛ, kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji lɛ eyeɔ sɔ̃ yɛ mli.
5Kɛji mɔ ko ye sɔ̃ yɛ nii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ 6ni ekɛ esɔ̃ afɔle abahã Yehowa yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ. Ekɛ gwantɛŋ loo too abotia yoo aba, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
7Shi kɛji enyɛɛɛ too ehe lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpobii enyɔ aba ebahã Yehowa akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ; okpo kome akɛ esha afɔle kɛ ekome hu akɛ shãa afɔle. 8Ekɛ afɔlei enyɔ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Ekɛ nɔ ni ji esha afɔle lɛ aba tsutsu. Etsɔ̃mɔ loofɔlɔ lɛ yitso yɛ ekuɛ nɔ, shi ekatse kɛje nɔ. 9Etsɔ esha afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. Lá ni baashwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. Afɔle ni akɛjieɔ esha kɛyaa ji no. 10Loofɔlɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ekɛfee shãa afɔle yɛ gbɛnaa ni ato lɛ naa; koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ koni akɛfa lɛ.
11Shi kɛji enyɛɛɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpobii enyɔ ehã lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mã kilo kome aba akɛ esha afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ. Ekɛ mu akawo mli, ni ekɛ ohɛ hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ esha afɔle ni. 12Ekɛba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Osɔfo lɛ atĩ ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ekɛfee afɔle lɛ mli eko ni akɛkaiɔ Yehowa yɛ afɔle muu lɛ fɛɛ he, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ashãa ŋmãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ nɔ. Esha afɔle ni. 13Osɔfo lɛ afee nɛkɛ koni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ, ni akɛ esha ni efee yɛ enɛɛmɛi eko gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaafa lɛ. Afɔle lɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔle gbɛfaŋ lɛ.
Afɔlei ni akɛtoɔ mlai krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anajiaŋ
14Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 15“Kɛji oniai krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsuɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ mɔ ko hãaa egbɛfaŋnɔ, ni no ehã eye sɔ̃ ni eleee lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ afɔle ni ekɛbaahã Yehowa nɛ: etoi lɛ ateŋ too ojwɛni ni he bɛ kpa ko. Too lɛ jara adamɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shika jara nɔ, ni akɛfee sɔ̃ afɔle. 16Mɔ ni efee esha yɛ onia krɔŋkrɔŋ ko gbɛfaŋ lɛ ato onia ni ehãaa lɛ najiaŋ, ni ekɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome afata he. Ekɛhã osɔfo lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ akpãtã akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle ahã lɛ, koni akɛ esha ni efee lɛ afa lɛ.
17“Kɛji mɔ ko fee esha, ni efee nii ni Yehowa ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, tsɛbelɛ ehiɛ kãaa he moŋ nɛ, shi eye sɔ̃, ni aaagbala etoii. 18Emɔ too ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ ehe yɛ etoi lɛ ateŋ. Abu naa, ni ejara afee sɔ̃ afɔle jara, koni ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee ni eleee lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛbaafa lɛ. 19 Sɔ̃ afɔle ji enɛ; ejaakɛ eye sɔ̃ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.”

Title: LEVITIKO 6
Content:
1Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, 2“Kɛji mɔ ko fee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha yɛ tso ni etso yɛ nɔ ko ni enyɛmi Israelnyo kɛhã lɛ shitoo aloo ekɛto lɛ awaba, aloo eju enyɛmi lɛ nɔ ko, aloo etswa lɛ ojo, 3aloo ena nɔ ko ni elaaje ni ekã amale kitã akɛ enako lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafee nibii nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni gbɔmɛi fɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, efee esha. 4Kɛ mɔ ko fee esha ni eye sɔ̃ lɛ, eto nɔ ni eju lɛ, loo nii ni ekɛ amimyeli shɔ̃ lɛ, loo nɔ ni akɛto lɛ awaba ni etso akɛ akɛ nɔ ko hãko lɛ, loo nii ni laaje ni eshiu nɔ lɛ, 5loo nɔ ko ni ekã he amale kitã lɛ, najiaŋ. 6Esɔ̃ afɔle ni ekɛbaahã osɔfo lɛ ni akɛhã Yehowa lɛ nɛ: etoi lɛ ateŋ too ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ ehe; ejara afee bɔ ni bo oootsɔ̃ɔ. 7 Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ aaafa lɛ.”
Afɔlei ni ashãa amɛ emuu
8Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, 9“Fã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ akɛ shãa afɔle he mla nɛ. Shãa afɔle lɛ ahi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni la ahi shishi kɛyashi leebi. 10 Osɔfo lɛ awo eklala flaka kɛ eklala tswakotoi lɛ koni eloo lamlu lɛ; shi la lɛ ni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ, eshi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi he ko. 11Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ajie etadei lɛ koni ewo ekroko. Ekɛ lamlu lɛ aje kpo kɛya nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛyashwie he ko ni tse. 12La lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ akã he atso daa; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko. Daa leebi lɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ lai ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eto shãa afɔle lɛ gbɛjianɔ eshwie nɔ ni eshã toiŋjɔlɛ afɔlei ahe fɔi lɛ yɛ nɔ. 13La atso daa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko.”
Ŋmãa afɔlei
14Ŋmãa afɔle lɛ he mla nɛ: “Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ. 15Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome aŋɔ mã lɛ kɛ emli mu lɛ kɛ ohɛ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɔkɔ kome ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eji okadi kɛkɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ akɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ fɛɛ ehã Yehowa. Afɔle nɛɛ ŋma lɛ sa Yehowa hiɛ. 16Afɔle lɛ nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aye. Afee lɛ mã akpiti keeki, ni aye yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ, no ji yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ. 17Aboloo akpiti nɛɛ ji osɔfoi lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni mihã amɛ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa mi lɛ mli. Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni, tamɔ esha afɔle kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ. 18Bei fɛɛ, yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ, nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ aye akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ mli. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ.”
19Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, 20 “Gbi nɔ ni afɔɔ Aaron loo eshwie ko mu akɛ osɔfo lɛ, ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome aba abahã Yehowa tamɔ daa ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ. Akɛ fã aba leebi, ni akɛfã hu aba gbɛkɛ. 21Akɛ mu ashi yɛ ŋɛsu mli. Kɛ ebe lɛ, akumɔ mli dukuduku ni akɛba akɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni eŋma sa Yehowa hiɛ. 22Aaron bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu ni baaye esɛɛ akɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ afee enɛ ahã Yehowa akɛ akpɔ ni kã shi kɛmiiya naanɔ. Ashã afɔle muu lɛ fɛɛ. 23Ŋmãa afɔle ni osɔfo lɛ shãa lɛ akaye eko; ashã emuu lɛ fɛɛ.”
Esha afɔlei
24Yehowa fã Mose 25koni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ bɔ ni ashã esha afɔlei lɛ ahã. He ni agbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa shãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ agbe kooloo ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ yɛ ahã Yehowa. Eji afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa. 26Osɔfo ni gbeɔ kooloo lɛ kɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aye loo lɛ. Eye yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ; no ji yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ. 27Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni taa loo lɛ he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko tsɛ̃ŋe shwie atade he lɛ, afɔ atade loo nɔ lɛ ni lá lɛ tsɛ̃ŋe shwie he lɛ he yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ. 28Sũ gbɛ ni ahoo loo lɛ eko yɛ mli lɛ, ajwara; shi kɛ akɔɔble loo dadesɛŋ mli ahoo yɛ lɛ, asha mli ni akɛ nu ajale mli. 29Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye loo lɛ eko; eji nɔ ko ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa. 30Shi esha afɔle fɛɛ esha afɔle ni akɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko aaaba Kpe Buu lɛ mli ni akɛaakpãtã yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ esha ko hewɔ lɛ, akaye; ashã kɛ la.

Title: LEVITIKO 7
Content:
Sɔ̃ afɔlei
1Sɔ̃ afɔle he mla nɛ. Eji afɔle ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ. 2 Kooloo ni akɛbaashã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ agbe lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ. Kooloo lɛ lá lɛ afɔse ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ he. 3Ajie efɔ lɛ fɛɛ, elei ni ewo fɔ lɛ, fɔ ni ha emlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ 4sabai enyɔ ni yɔɔ hɛ mli lɛ, kɛ fɔ ni ha amɛhe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ, koni akɛshã afɔle. 5Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ la shãa. Sɔ̃ afɔle ni. 6Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye eko; eye yɛ he ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni.
7Esha afɔle lɛ etamɔ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ; mla kome nɔŋŋ kã shi hã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ: osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ kɛkpãtãa lɛ, enɔ ji loo lɛ. 8Kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hewolo lɛ, osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ nɔ ni. 9Niyenii afɔle fɛɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli aloo nɔ ni ashãa yɛ nishãa nɔ nɔ, loo nɔ ni ashĩɔ yɛ ŋɛsu mli lɛ, osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ hãa Yehowa lɛ nɔ ni. 10Shi niyenii afɔle fɛɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, awo mli mu jio, afee lɛ egbiŋ jio, Aaron shwiei osɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni; aja lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana tamɔ bɔ ni enyɛmi na lɛ pɛ.
Naanyobɔɔ afɔlei
11Bɔ ni sa akɛ ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei ahã Yehowa nɛ. 12Kɛ afɔle lɛ shidaa afɔle ni lɛ, nibii ni akɛfata he ji keeki ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu shã kɛ akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mã akpiti ni akpa hiɛ mu shã kɛ keeki ni akɛ mã ni mu enumɔ mli shã. 13Kɛshi naanyobɔɔ shidaa afɔlei nɛɛ anɔ lɛ ekɛ keeki ni akɛ mãsha shã hu abashã afɔle. 14Nii ni ekɛba lɛ, ejie fɛɛ mli ekomekome ehã, ni akɛfee nɔwomɔ afɔle ahã Yehowa; Osɔfo lɛ ni tsiɔ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eshwieɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ nɔ ni. 15 Kooloo ni akɛshãa shidaa afɔle lɛ loo lɛ, aye gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; akashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ.
16Kɛji afɔle ni mɔ ko kɛba lɛ shiwoo afɔle ni, loo afɔle ni ekɛba yɛ tsuijurɔ naa ni lɛ, no lɛ ebɛ akɛ aye loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛ loo lɛ eko shwɛ lɛ, aye enɔ jetsɛremɔ. 17Shi kɛji loo ni eshwɛ lɛ eko ye gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, ashã. 18Kɛji gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ko ye loo lɛ eko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hereŋ mɔ ni kɛ afɔle lɛ ba lɛ. Enaŋ he nyɔmɔwoo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Nihii nii ji loo lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye eko lɛ, eloo musu. 19Loo ni nɔ ko ni he tseee aaasa he lɛ, akaye, ashã.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni he tse lɛ aye loo lɛ eko. 20Shi mɔ ni he tseee ni eeeye naanyobɔɔ afɔle loo ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enaneshi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ. 21Asaŋ kɛ mɔ ko aaaye naanyobɔɔ afɔle nɛɛ eko, be mli ni eta nɔ ko ni he tseee he, gbɔmɔ ni he tseee he eta jio, kooloo ni he tseee he eta jio, nɔ kroko ni jio, aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
22Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, 23 “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛkayea fɔ ko fɔ ko; tsina fɔ jio, gwantɛŋ fɔ jio, too abotia fɔ jio, nyɛkayea. 24 Kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele loo kooloo ni kooloo kroko etserɛ emli lɛ, aaanyɛ akɛ efɔ lɛ afee nɔ kroko; shi loo lɛ akaye. Kooloo ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ efɔ lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ. 25Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye kooloo ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ. 26He fɛɛ he ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛkayea lá ko lá ko, loofɔlɔ lá jio, kooloo naji ejwɛ tsɛ jio. 27 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaku mla nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, aaatswa enaneshi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.”
28Yehowa kɛɛ Mose 29koni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle miiba abahã Yehowa lɛ, ajie afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni ji Yehowa nɔ krɛdɛɛ lɛ ahã lɛ. 30 Ehiɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ kɛba akɛ niyenii afɔle. Akɛ kooloo lɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ etsitsi lɛ fɛɛ aba ni ekɛbahã Yehowa akɛ nikeenii titri ko hã Yehowa. 31Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, shi tsitsi lɛ Aaron kɛ ebii osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni. 32Kooloo lɛ sɛɛgbɛ nanejurɔ lɛ akɛhã 33osɔfo ni shãa naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ ehãa Yehowa lɛ. Akɛhã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ titri ko. 34Ejaakɛ kooloo lɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛgbɛ nanejurɔ lɛ mihe yɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ mihã osɔfoi ni ji Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛnaanɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ daa. 35Enɛ ji afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ mli nɔ ni akɛhã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ gbi nɔ ni awoɔ amɛ osɔfo lɛ. 36Nakai gbi lɛ Yehowa fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛkɛhã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ koni efee amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ daa yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli. 37Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ esha afɔlei kɛ sɔ̃ afɔlei lɛ kɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔlei lɛ. 38Enɛ he Yehowa wo Mose kitã yɛ gbi nɔ ni ewo Israelbii lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkɛ amɛfɔlei lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 8
Content:
Awo Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ osɔfoi
(Ɛksodɔs 29.1-37)
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Ŋɔɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ofata ohe, ni oŋɔ atadei lɛ kɛ mɔ mufɔɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsinanuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ kɛ too ojwɛnii enyɔ lɛ kɛ mã akpiti kafu lɛ koni okɛ amɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ naa. 3Ni obua asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ naa.”
4Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ, ni ehã asafo lɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 5Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ mifee lɛ, no mibafee nɛɛ.”
6Mose hã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ ba hiɛ, ni ekɛ nu ju amɛhe. 7Ekɛ flaka lɛ wo Aaron, ni ekɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fĩ emliteŋ. Ekɛ atade yuu lɛ wo Aaron. Ekɛ efod lɛ hu wo lɛ, ni ekɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fĩ efod lɛ ekpɛtɛ lɛ. 8 Ekɛ tsitsinɔnii lɛ to nɔ, ni ekɛ Urim kɛ Tumim lɛ wo tsitsinɔnii lɛ kotoku lɛ mli. 9Ekɛ yitsofii nɔ lɛ fĩ Aaron yitso, ni Mose kɛ shika fɛtɛfɛtɛ ni ji hiɛnaanii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ta yitsofii nɔ lɛ hiɛnaa. Amɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ.
10Agbɛnɛ Mose wo mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ. Efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ mu koni efee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 11Ekɛ mu lɛ eko shwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo ekɛfɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ nibii ni akɛtsuɔ nii yɛ he lɛ kɛ lalakã lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ema nɔ lɛ mu, koni efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa. 12Mose fɔse mufɔɔ mu lɛ eko eshwie Aaron yiteŋ, ni ekɛfɔ lɛ mu koni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 13Agbɛnɛ Mose hã Aaron bii lɛ ba hiɛ. Ewo amɛ flakai; ekɛ amɛmlifĩinii lɛ fimɔ amɛmliteŋ, ni ekɛ amɛfaii lɛ bumɔ amɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
14Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ tsinanuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie esha afɔle tsinanuu lɛ yiteŋ. 15Mose gbe tsinanuu lɛ. Ekɛ ewao tsɔ lá lɛ eko, ni ekɛkpa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe, koni ekɛtsuu he. Mose tsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. Efee enɛ ekɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ehã Yehowa. 16Mose jie fɔ lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 17Shi tsinanuu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ Mose kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ eyashã, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
18Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ, 19ni Mose gbe lɛ. Etsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ kɛbɔle. 20-21Esaa too ojwɛni lɛ, ni ekɛ nu fɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe. Kɛkɛ ni eshã yitso lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ too muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ. Shãa afɔle nɛɛ niyenii afɔle ni; eŋma lɛ sa Yehowa hiɛ.
22 Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni ji enyɔ ni agbeɔ akɛ afɔle kɛji aawo osɔfo lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ, 23ni Mose gbe lɛ. Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa Aaron ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa. 24Mose hã Aaron bihii lɛ hu ba. Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa amɛninejurɔ toi naa kɛ amɛninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ amɛnane gɔnti naa. Kɛkɛ ni efɔse lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe. 25Mose ŋɔ fɔ kɛ lei lɛ ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ fɛɛ ni ha mlinii kɛ mlɛbo lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ kɛ sɛɛ nanejurɔ lɛ. 26Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ aboloo kome yɛ mã akpiti kafu ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ mli, kɛ aboloo kome ni mu yɔɔ mli kɛ akpãanɔɔ kome, ni ekɛshwie fɔ lɛ kɛ shuɔ jurɔ lɛ nɔ. 27Mose kɛ niyenii nɛɛ fɛɛ wo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ; ni efɔ̃ kɛtee kɛba akɛ afɔle ni afɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 28Kɛkɛ ni Mose saa he niyenii lɛ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ eshi shãa afɔlei ni ashãa fɛɛ emuu lɛ anɔ. Eji osɔfowoo afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa Yehowa, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ lɛ. 29Mose kɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni lɛ tsitsi lɛ, ni ekɛshã afɔle ehã Yehowa akɛ nɔkee nɔ titri ko. Mose ŋɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni tsitsi lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
30Mose ŋɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ eko kɛ lá ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ eko, ni ekɛshwã Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Ekɛ enɛ fee Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa.
31Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ loo lɛ ayaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni nyɛyahoa. Nyɛyea loo lɛ kɛ aboloo ni yɔ kafu ni akɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei toɔ mli lɛ mli lɛ yɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ. Nyɛyea tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã akɛ, ‘Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aye lɛ.’ 32Loo kɛ aboloo ni aaashwɛ yɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshãa. 33Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo ni akɛfeɔ nyɛ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ aaaho; ejaakɛ gbii kpawo akɛfeɔ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ. 34Nɔ ni afee ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ afee koni akɛjie nyɛhe esha kɛya. 35Nyɛhia Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii kpawo koni nyɛkɛfee nɔ ni Yehowa efã akɛ afee lɛ. Kɛji nyɛfeee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi. Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa wo mi kitã.” 36No hewɔ lɛ, Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose he kitã lɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 9
Content:
Aaron shã afɔle
1Gbi ni agbe osɔfowoo kusumi lɛ anaa lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Mose tsɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ. 2Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ: “Ŋɔɔ tsinanuu fioo kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too ojwɛni kome hu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ni okɛshã afɔle, ohã Yehowa. Okɛ tsinanuu lɛ ashã esha afɔle ni okɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ashã shãa afɔle. 3Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛŋɔ too ojwɛni amɛkɛshã esha afɔle; amɛkɛ tsinabi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too gwantɛŋbi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle; 4ni amɛkɛ tsinanuu kɛ too ojwɛni kɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni awo mli mu ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle. Amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.”
5Amɛkɛ nii ni Mose fã amɛ akɛ amɛkɛba lɛ ba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ, ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi koni amɛja Yehowa. 6Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa fã akɛ nyɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enunyam ni kpɛ kaŋkaŋ lɛ ajie ehe kpo atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.” 7 Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Tsi obɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni oshã esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle ohã ohe koni okɛfɔ ohe esha kɛ maŋ lɛ he esha. Oshã afɔle nɛɛ koni okɛfɔ maŋ lɛ he eshai, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã lɛ.”
8Aaron tsi kɛtee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni egbe tsinanuu fioo lɛ ekɛshã esha afɔle ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. 9Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ewao tsɔ mli, ni ekɛdiki koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ. Ni lá ni shwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. 10Kɛkɛ ni eshã fɔ lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ mlɛbo lɛ he loo ni tsotsoro shi lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose kitã lɛ. 11Shi kooloo lɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ eshã yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
12Mose gbe kooloo ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ hu. Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe. 13Amɛkɛ shãa afɔle lɛ hu bahã lɛ, loo ni ashãa lɛ kɛ yitso lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 14Kɛkɛ ni efɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe, ni ekɛshwie shãa afɔle ni jwere afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eshã fɛɛ.
15Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ maŋ lɛ afɔlei lɛ ba. Eŋɔ too kpakpo ni akɛbaashã maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle lɛ; egbe lɛ ni ekɛshã afɔle, tamɔ bɔ ni efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha afɔle lɛ. 16Eŋɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hu kɛba, ni ekɛshã afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. 17Ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ ba; ni ekpiti emli eko ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ni ekɛfata shãa afɔle ni ashãa daa leebi lɛ he, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 18 Kɛkɛ ni egbe tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ekɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã maŋ lɛ; ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe. 19Tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ fɔi lɛ kɛ lei ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ, 20Aaron kɛ fɛɛ shwie kooloi lɛ atsitsii lɛ anɔ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 21Ekɛ tsitsii lɛ kɛ sɛɛ ninejurɔ shuɔ naji lɛ hã Yehowa akɛ nikeenii titri ko, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose ewo kitã lɛ.
22 Be ni Aaron eshã esha afɔle kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ maŋ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekpeleke shi. 23Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ Aaron bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli. Be ni amɛje kpo ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛjɔɔ maŋ lɛ. Ni Yehowa anunyam ni kpɛɔ kaŋkaŋ lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ. 24 Trukaa lɛ Yehowa hã la ba ni ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ fɔi lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Be ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ, amɛbolɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.

Title: LEVITIKO 10
Content:
Nadab kɛ Abihu fee esha
1Shi Aaron bihii ni ji Nadab kɛ Abihu lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo elajee ŋɛsu, ni amɛkɛ la wo mli. Amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛshã amɛhã Yehowa; shi la ni amɛkɛshã lɛ bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ jeee no he kitã Yehowa wo lɛ. 2 Yehowa hã la ba ebashã amɛ, ni amɛgboi yɛ ehiɛ. 3 Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Enɛ ji nɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ be ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ mi lɛ esa akɛ abu mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; majie minunyam lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.’ ” Shi Aaron mua enaa.
4 Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Mishael kɛ Elzafan, Aaron tsɛkwɛ Uziel bii lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ: “Nyɛbaa nyɛbaholea nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ agbohii lɛ kɛjea He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.” 5Amɛba ni amɛbahole Aaron bihii lɛ kɛ amɛflakai ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje shitoohe lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ lɛ.
6 Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa nyɛyiteŋ fea tsaŋtsaŋ aloo nyɛgbalaa nyɛtadei kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ. Kɛ nyɛfee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi, ni Yehowa mli baawo maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ la. Nyɛhãa nyɛwekumɛi, Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, afoa shãa ni Yehowa ehã la eshã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ni amɛgboi nɛɛ. 7Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa hu ni nyɛbagboi, ejaakɛ akɛ Yehowa mufɔɔ mu lɛ efɔ nyɛ mu.” Amɛfee bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Mlai ni awo Osɔfoi
8Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, 9 “Bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkanua wain loo dãa ni wa ko be mli ni nyɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ. Kɛ nyɛnu dãa lɛ, nyɛbaagboi. Oshwiei fɛɛ aye akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ. 10Esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni kã nɔ ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni buleɔ mɔ teŋ; ni esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ. 11Nyɛtsɔ̃a Israelbii lɛ akpɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛ amɛ wie he lɛ.”
12 Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni eshwɛ ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar lɛ akɛ, “Niyenii afɔlei ni shwɛɔ yɛ afɔlei ni ashã ahã Yehowa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛshãa mã akpiti aboloo ni nyɛyea yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he ejaakɛ afɔle nɛɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni fe fɛɛ ni. 13Nyɛyea yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛgbɛnaanii ji niyenii afɔlei nɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ shãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ asɛɛ lɛ. Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Yehowa kitã ni ewo mi. 14Shi tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ ni akɛhãa Yehowa akɛ keenɔ lɛ nyɛyea yɛ he ko ni tse, bo kɛ obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ akɛ afɔlei nɛɛ ehã bo kɛ obii lɛ akɛ nyɛgbɛnaanii yɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔlei ni Israelbii lɛ shãa lɛ amli. 15 Akɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛ shuɔ lɛ afata fɔi lɛ ahe kɛba, be mli ni ashãa fɔi lɛ akɛ afɔle ahãa Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ. Tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ, bo kɛ obihii lɛ agbɛnaanii ni akɛhã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ ni. Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ afee.”
16Mose tao too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aahu kɛyashi ena ele akɛ ashã momo. Mose mli wo Eleazar kɛ Itamar Aaron bihii ni eshwɛ lɛ la ni ekɛɛ, 17 “Mɛɛba nyɛyeee esha afɔle lɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ? Nɔ ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ji afɔle lɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ koni nyɛkɛ kpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni nyɛjie maŋ lɛ he esha lɛ kɛya lɛ. 18Akɛni akɛ too ojwɛni lɛ lá lɛ baaa Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛye afɔle lɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ bɔ ni mifã lɛ.”
19Aaron to he ehã Mose akɛ, “Maŋbii lɛ shã amɛhe esha afɔle kɛ amɛshãa afɔle lɛ ŋmɛnɛ; ni kɛ̃lɛ oshara ebasharã mi nɛɛ. Eji miye esha afɔle ŋmɛnɛ kulɛ ehi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ?” 20Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ena akɛ eja.

Title: LEVITIKO 11
Content:
Kooloi ni aaanyɛ aye
1Yehowa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron wie koni amɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ ahã Israelbii lɛ ni amɛye nɔ. 2Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ nii ni nyɛye ji: 3nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ koklotoi ni agbala mli aloo aja mli, ni asaŋ amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii ni amɛtaa. 4-6Shi nyɛkayea yooma kɛ afutuɔkɔ kɛ kpɛŋkplɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee. Amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii, ni amɛtaa moŋ, shi agbalako amɛkoklotoi amli. 7Nyɛkayea kplotoo, ejaakɛ ehe tseee. Eyɛ koklotoi ni agbala mli moŋ, shi egɔiii eniyenii etaaa. 8Nyɛkayea kooloi nɛɛ aloo; nyɛkataa amɛgbohii ahe hu, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
9“Yɛ nu mli loi ateŋ lɛ, nyɛyea nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ fiji kɛ totoi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ kɛ fai amli fɛɛ. 10Shi nii fɛɛ ni bɛ fiji kɛ totoi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli loo fai amli, bɔɔnii bibii ni ebua amɛhe naa tɔo kɛnyiɛ nu mli jio, bɔɔnii ni yɔɔ nu mli ni dara fe nomɛi jio, nyɛhia amɛ. 11Nihiinii ji amɛ; nyɛkayea amɛloo, ni nyɛhia amɛgbohii lɛ tete. 12Nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nu mli ni amɛbɛ fiji loo totoi lɛ, nii ni ahiɔ ni. 13Yɛ loofɔji ateŋ lɛ, nii ni nyɛhia ni nyɛkayea nɛ: okropɔŋ kɛ akpaŋa 14kɛ ŋshɔŋ okropɔŋ kɛ laalɔɔ kɛ osansa henɔi srɔtoi lɛ 15kɛ kwãakwãalabite henɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ, 16kɛ duguma kɛ nyɔɔŋ akroma kɛ faanaa oka, kɛ akroma henɔi srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, 17kɛ patu kɛ ŋshɔŋ patu, kɛ patu bibioo 18kɛ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kɛ kpokukpoku kɛ guŋ 19kɛ klitso kɛ ehenɔi srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ obleku kɛ aputupata.
20“Kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni filikiɔ ni amɛwamɔɔ ni amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ amɛnaji ejwɛjwɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea. 21Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ nii ni yɔɔ shɔji enyɔɔnyɔ ni tsara amɛnane tokota nɔ ni amɛkɛtumɔɔ lɛ, nyɛyea. 22Kooloi nɛɛ ji baalabii kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ, ligɔligɔ kɛ ehenɔi lɛ, kɛ agã kɛ ehenɔi, 23filikilɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ ni wamɔɔ ni amɛyɔɔ naji ejwɛɛjwɛ lɛ nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee. 24 Ni enɛɛmɛi buleɔ nyɛ. Kɛ nyɛye lɛ nyɛkɛbaabule nyɛhe. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa kooloi nɛɛ agbohii ahe lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 25Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɔ kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni egbo he nɔ ko ehiɛ yɛ edɛ̃ lɛ, efɔ etadei lɛ ahe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 26Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ koklotoi ni agbalako mli, ni asaŋ egɔiii nii ni eye momo lɛ, ehe tseee. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata eko he lɛ, mɔ lɛ he tseee. 27Kooloi fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛniji nyiɛɔ yɛ kooloi naji ejwɛɛjwɛtsɛmɛi ateŋ lɛ, amɛhe tseee. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa eko gbonyo he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 28Mɔ ni aaawo kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; shi ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Nyɛbua kooloi nɛɛ akɛ kooloi ni ahe tseee.
29“Kooloi ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ, nii ni he tseee ji obishi kɛ kwakwe kɛ odaaklɔ kɛ ehenɔi, 30kɛ mampam kɛ odiŋmɔlɔ kɛ tsunyɛ kɛ kɔ̃dɔ̃ kɛ obosumaketeo. 31Nyɛbua enɛɛmɛi akɛ nii ni he tseee yɛ kooloi ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ ateŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa eko ni egbo he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 32Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni egbo aaagbee enɔ lɛ, ehe tseee; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ tso loo mama loo kooloo hewolo fee, loo kpekpe loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛkɛ ni akɛtsuɔ nii jio, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ akɛwo nu mli. Shi ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. No sɛɛ dani ehe aaatse. 33Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ sũ fee ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko aaagbee mli lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ he tseee. Ajwa sũnɔ ni nii lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ. 34Niyenii fɛɛ ni ayeɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ nu ni jɛ sũnɔ nɛɛ mli aaashwie nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni anuɔ ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ sũnɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee. 35Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo aaagbee nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee. Kɛ flɔnɔɔ loo latɛ nɔ egbee lɛ, akumɔ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee, ni nyɛbua lɛ akɛ nɔ ni he tseee. 36Shi kɛ nu hiŋmɛi loo dudɔ ni akɛ nu toɔ mli ni lɛ, no lɛ ehe tse; shi kɛ eko he aaasa kooloo gbonyo he lɛ, ehe tseee. 37Kɛji kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo gbee wu ni abaadu nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tse lolo. 38Shi kɛ aafɔ dumɔnii lɛ yɛ nu mli, ni gbonyo lɛ gbee nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tseee.
39“Kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ lɛ eko gbo lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa egbonyo lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 40 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ loo lɛ eko lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Mɔ ni woɔ kooloo lɛ gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
41“Kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ nii ni ahiɔ ni. 42Kooloi fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ amɛmusu nɔ aloo amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ amɛnaji ejwɛ nɔ, aloo amɛyɔɔ naji piipii, kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ amɛbuleɔ mɔ. 43Nyɛkayea koni nyɛkɛ no bule nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛwo nyɛhe muji. 44 Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ; nyɛtoa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nibii ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ lɛ eko eko akabulea nyɛhe. 45Mi ji Yehowa mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
46“Belɛ enɛ ji mla ni kã shi yɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɔ nu mli kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni nyiɛɔ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ he. 47Awo mla lɛ koni akɛna srɔto ni yɔɔ kooloi ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee teŋ, kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ kɛ nii ni ayeee teŋ.”

Title: LEVITIKO 12
Content:
Yei ahetsuumɔ yɛ bifɔmɔ sɛɛ
1Yehowa kɛ Mose wie 2koni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji yoo ko na musu, ni efɔ binuu lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo, tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ eyei aniifeemɔ be mli lɛ. 3 Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, afo gbekɛ lɛ ketia. 4Yoo lɛ aŋɔ gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ ni ekɛtsuu ehe, ni ekɛjie ehe lá muji lɛ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ ekata nɔ ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ he, ni ekaya Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi gbi ni eeegbe ehetsuumɔ lɛ naa.
5“Kɛ yoo ko fɔ biyoo lɛ, ehe tseee otsii enyɔ, tamɔ be ni efee yeianii lɛ. Eŋɔ gbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa sɔŋŋ ni ekɛtsuu ehe, ni ekɛjie ehe lá muji lɛ.
6“Kɛji gbii ni ekɛtsuɔ ehe lɛ, yɛ binuu loo biyoo hewɔ lɛ ho lɛ, ekɛ too gwantɛŋ bi ni eye afi aba abahã ni akɛshã shãa afɔle, kɛ shĩa okpo loo kosɛɛ okpo ni akɛshã esha afɔle. Ekɛba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ. 7Osɔfo lɛ kɛ afɔle lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ekpãtã ehã yoo lɛ, koni ehe atse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ. Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã yoo ni fɔɔ nuu loo yoo lɛ.
8 “Shi kɛji yoo lɛ naaa too gwantɛŋbi yinii lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi enyɔ aba. Akɛ ekome ashã shãa afɔle, koni akɛ ekome hu ashã esha afɔle. Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ, ni ehe aaatse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.”

Title: LEVITIKO 13
Content:
Mlai ni kɔɔ hewolo nɔ helai ahe
1Yehowa kɛ mlai nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron. 2“Kɛji nɔ ko fũu yɛ mɔ ko hewolo nɔ loo fala ko loo gbɛ̃ ko, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ elɛɛ shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ kpiti hela lɛ, akɛ mɔ lɛ aba Osɔfo Aaron loo ebihii osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ŋɔɔ. 3 Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Kɛ ekwɛ ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, belɛ kpiti ni; ni be ni osɔfo lɛ ekwɛ helatsɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee. 4Shi kɛji hewolo nɔ he ni akwɛ lɛ yɛ eyɛŋ ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ hu tsɔ̃ko eyɛŋ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo. 5Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ, ni kɛ hela lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ heloo lɛ hiɛ, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa aŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ. 6Kɛji gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ ekoŋŋ, ni kɛ hela lɛ elaaje, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni he tse; hela lɛ gbɛ̃i ni. Helatsɛ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, koni ehe atse. 7Shi kɛji gbɛ̃i lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ ehewolo lɛ nɔ be ni osɔfo lɛ ekwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ ehe tse lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ehe ayatsɔɔ osɔfo lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ. 8Kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni gbɛ̃i lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
9“Kɛji kpiti shwie mɔ ko he lɛ, akɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. 10Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ. Kɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ ewo yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ, ni ehã jɛi tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni loo ŋmɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ ni efuu lɛ mli lɛ, 11belɛ kpiti momo yɔɔ ehewolo lɛ mli lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni he tseee ni. Osɔfo lɛ akaŋa eyi, ejaakɛ ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ ehe tseee. 12Shi kɛji hela lɛ je kpo yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ, ni nɔ ni osɔfo lɛ naa kɛkɛ ji hela lɛ eshwie helatsɛ lɛ hewolo nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ eyiteŋ kɛyashi enaji ahe lɛ, 13osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ hela lɛ eha ehewolo nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse. Ni kɛ helatsɛ lɛ he fɛɛ eyɛ futaa lɛ, ehe tse. 14Shi gbi nɔ ni aaana fala ŋmɔŋ yɛ helatsɛ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee. 15Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni kɛ ena lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni. 16Shi kɛji fala lɛ tã, ni eesaa etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ ekoŋŋ lɛ, helatsɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. 17Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛ ena akɛ loo ŋmɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, helatsɛ lɛ he tse; ni osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tse.
18“Kɛji asane tsɛ̃ mɔ ko hewolo nɔ ni etã, 19ni fee sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ bawo yɛ he ni asane lɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ yɛ lɛ, aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni tsuɔo ba jɛi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. 20Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ. Kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tseee; kpiti ebote asane lɛ mli. 21Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ mli, ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ni enaa miilaaje lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo. 22Kɛji hela lɛ miilɛɛ shi fe bɔ ni kulɛ eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni. 23Shi kɛji nɔ ko yɛŋ lɛ elɛɛɛ shi, ni eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ fladoku ni; asane lɛ shishi ni. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse.
24“Kɛji la shã mɔ ko, ni la fala lɛ fee nɔ ko yɛŋ aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni etsuru fioo futu mli lɛ, 25osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ. Kɛji tsɔi ni yɔɔ la fala lɛ mli etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, belɛ kpiti ebote la fala lɛ mli. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni. 26Shi kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ lɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ fala lɛ mli ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo. 27Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ. Kɛji fala lɛ elɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ fe bɔ ni kulɛ eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni. 28Shi kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni elɛɛko shi efatako he, shi moŋ enaa miilaaje lɛ, belɛ la fala lɛ kɛkɛ ni ehã jɛi efuu lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ fala doku kɛkɛ ni.
29“Kɛji fala fee nuu loo yoo ko yiteŋ loo etsɛŋ mli lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ. 30Kɛji he ni fala lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ hwiaahwiaa ni ehiɛ wuɔfɔ su lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ fafale ni; efeɔ yiteŋ loo tsɛŋ mli. 31Kɛji be ni osɔfo lɛ kwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ena akɛ he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ bɛ ediŋ lɛ, eŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi ewo tsuŋ gbii kpawo. 32Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji fafale lɛ elɛko, ni tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su ekwɛ̃ko yɛ mli, ni fala lɛ enyɔko hewolo lɛ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, 33ahã mɔ lɛ ashɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ fe he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ pɛ eshi. Osɔfo lɛ aŋa mɔ lɛ yi awo tsuŋ gbii krokomɛi kpawo. 34Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji elɛɛko ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tse. Mɔ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe koni ehe atse. 35Shi kɛji fafale lɛ elɛɛ, yɛ be ni akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tse lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, 36Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji fafale lɛ esaa elɛɛ lɛ, ehe ehiaaa akɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ akɛ eeena tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su lo; nɔ ni kã shi faŋŋ kɛkɛ ji mɔ lɛ he tseee. 37Shi kɛji ekwɛ lɛ esusuɔ akɛ fafale lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni tsɔi diŋ ekwɛ̃ yɛ mli lɛ, belɛ fafale lɛ etã. Helatsɛ lɛ he etse; ni osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tse.
38“Kɛji nii yɛji hãlãhãlã komɛi ba nuu loo yoo ko hewolo nɔ lɛ, 39osɔfo lɛ akwɛ. Kɛji nibii yɛji hãlãhãlã nɛɛ ejeee shi jogbaŋŋ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, belɛ aflimata eshwie mɔ lɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ; mɔ lɛ he tse.
40“Kɛji nuu ko yi kpa yɛ eyisɛɛ lɛ, yikpataatsɛ ji lɛ, shi ehe tse. 41Kɛji ehiɛnaa gbɛ kɛkɛ eyi lɛ kpa yɛ lɛ, hiɛnaa kpataa tsɛ ji lɛ, shi ehe tse. 42Shi kɛji nɔ ko yɛŋ ni tsuɔ oo shwie eyiteŋ loo ehiɛnaa he ni ekpa lɛ, kpiti ji nɔ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ. 43Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ. Kɛji osɔfo lɛ na fafale yɛŋ ni tsuɔ oo yɛ eyisɛɛ loo ehiɛnaa he ni ekpa lɛ, ni etamɔ kpiti yɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ, 44osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ eji mɔ ko ni he tseee yɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ eyiteŋ lɛ hewɔ.
45“Mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti lɛ egbala etadei, ni ehiɛ eyitso efolo. Eha enaabu nɔ, ni ebolɔ akɛ, ‘Mihe tseee, mihe tseee!’ 46Gbii abɔ ni hela lɛ yɔɔ ehe lɛ, ehe tseee kwraa. Ekome too ehi shi, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ ahi shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
47“Kɛji kpiti ekadi kuŋtu loo klala atade ko mli, 48aloo ekadi kuŋtu loo klala kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ mli, loo kooloo wolo loo nɔ ko ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli, 49ni kadimɔ lɛ su eŋɔli loo etsuru yɛ atade loo kooloo wolo loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ, loo nɔ ko ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ kpiti he okadi ni; ni esa akɛ akɛtsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ. 50Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ, ni ekɛ nɔ ni mli ni ekadi lɛ ato gbii kpawo. 51Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ ekwɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ elɛɛ yɛ atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ loo kooloo wolo lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo lɛ fee lɛ mli lɛ, belɛ kpiti ni fiteɔ nii eshwie he lɛ; ni nɔ mli ni ekadi lɛ he tseee. 52Osɔfo lɛ ashã atade ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ, loo kpãi ni akɛlo kuŋtu loo klala atade lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee ni akadi mli lɛ; ejaakɛ eji kpiti ni fiteɔ nii; ni esa akɛ akɛ la ashã.
53“Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ elɛɛko yɛ atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo lɛ, loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, 54no lɛ osɔfo lɛ afã akɛ afɔ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he, ni esaa eŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ. 55Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ kadimɔ lɛ su tsakeko be ni afɔ he sɛɛ, ni elɛko hu efatako he lɛ, belɛ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he tseee. Akɛ la ashã; hiɛgbɛ ekadi jio, sɛɛgbɛ jio, no kɔɔɔ he eko. 56Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ ni ena akɛ nɔ ni ekadi nii lɛ mli lɛ miilaaje be ni afɔ he sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ etse he ni kadimɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ atade lɛ loo kooloo wolo lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ he. 57Shi kɛji aana kadimɔ lɛ lolo yɛ atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ mli, loo nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ekadi nii lɛ mli lɛ miiku esɛɛ ekoŋŋ, akɛ la ashã nɔ ni mli ni ekadi lɛ. 58Atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo lɛ loo kooloo wolo nɔ lɛ ni afɔ he lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ je mli lɛ, afɔ he ekoŋŋ koni ehe atse.
59“Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã kpiti ni eshwie kuŋtu loo odonti mama loo kpãi ni akɛloɔ mama lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee he lɛ. Eji mla hu ni akɛnaa akɛ nɔ ni kpiti eshwie he lɛ he tse aloo ehe tseee.”

Title: LEVITIKO 14
Content:
Mɔ ni eye hewolo nɔ hela hetsuumɔ
1Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã lɛ. 2 Mlai nɛɛ kã shi hã mɔ ni eye kpiti ni ehe etã hetsuumɔ. Gbi nɔ ni aaakɛɛ akɛ ehe etse lɛ, akɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. 3Osɔfo lɛ kɛ lɛ aje kpo kɛya nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni eyakwɛ lɛ. Kɛji kpiti ni shwie helatsɛ lɛ etã yɛ ehe lɛ, 4osɔfo lɛ afã mɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ koni ekɛ loofɔji hiɛkãalɔi enyɔ ni he tse kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo aba. 5Osɔfo lɛ afã ni agbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nu ŋmɔŋ yɔɔ mli nɔ. 6Osɔfo lɛ amɔ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ. Ekɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ afata he ni ekɛ fɛɛ atsɔ loofɔlɔ ni agbe lɛ yɛ kã ni nu yɔɔ mli lɛ lá lɛ mli. 7 Etsɔ la lɛ eshwã kpitiyelɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu ehe. Eŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ. 8 Mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ afɔ etadei lɛ ahe. Eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi fɛɛ, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe koni ehe atse. No sɛɛ lɛ, eba shitoohe lɛ mli, shi ekabote ebuu lɛ mli gbii kpawo. 9Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ esaa eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ekoŋŋ kɛ etsɛŋ kɛ ehiŋmɛi sɛɛ tsɔi kɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ. Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.
10Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋbii enyɔ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ gwantɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu ewo mli kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome aba. 11Osɔfo ni tsuuɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ he lɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu shinaa lɛ naa. 12Emɔ gwantɛŋbii lɛ ateŋ ekome ekɛbahã akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu, koni ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ akɛ keenii titri ko. 13 Egbe gwantɛŋbi lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ jio, esha afɔle lɛ jio, fɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni; eji nɔ ko krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa. 14 Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa. 15Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ awo mu lɛ ni efo eko ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enine abɛku kɔkɔ mli. 16Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ mli lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 17Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni eshwɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa he ni akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ sa lɛ. 18Mu ni eshwɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, efɔse eshwie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yiteŋ koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
19Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ashã esha afɔle lɛ koni ekɛjie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ he muji lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ agbe too ni akɛ baashã shãa afɔle lɛ; 20no sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ashã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, koni ekɛtsuu mɔ lɛ he; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse. 21Shi kɛ eji ohiafo ni enaaa enɛɛmɛi lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ gwantɛŋbi kome aba akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle, keenii titri ko ni akɛkpãtã ahã lɛ ni. Ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome ni awo mli mu hu aba akɛ niyenii afɔle, kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome. 22Asaŋ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba; emli eko fɛɛ eko ni enine aaashɛ nɔ. Akɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni akɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle. 23Ehetsuumɔ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ nibii nɛɛ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 24Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ gwantɛŋbi lɛ ni akɛshãa sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ ni ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ akɛ keenii titri ko. 25Osɔfo lɛ agbe gwantɛŋbi ni akɛshãa sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ. Ekɛ toobi lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa. 26Osɔfo lɛ afo mu lɛ eko awo enine abɛku kɔkɔ mli. 27Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 28Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni yɔɔ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa, kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ akɛsa he ni lá ni akɛshã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. 29Mu ni eshwɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, efɔse eshwie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yiteŋ, koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 30Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okpoi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ, ni enine aaashɛ, kosɛɛ okpoi jio, shĩa okpoi jio, 31osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle efata niyenii afɔle lɛ he. Efee enɛ ni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 32Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti ni enine shɛɛɛ nii ni akɛbaatsuu ehe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kpiti yɛ shĩai amli
33Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron. 34Kɛ nyɛshɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛhã nyɛ ni nyɛye nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mihã kpiti shwie shĩa ko he yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 35 no lɛ nakai shĩa lɛ tsɛ lɛ aya ni eyakɛɛ osɔfo lɛ akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni nɔ ko tamɔ kpiti eshwie eshĩa lɛ he. 36Osɔfo lɛ afã ni ajie shĩa lɛ mli nii kɛje kpo dani osɔfo lɛ abote shĩa lɛ mli ni eyakwɛ nɔ ni eshwie he lɛ. Kɛji afeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ shĩa lɛ mli nii fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ nii ni he tseee. 37 Kɛ osɔfo lɛ yakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni eshwie shĩa lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ, fɔji ŋɔlii kɛ etsuji ni, ni amɛmiikpe kɛmiibote gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ, 38no lɛ eje kpo ni eŋmɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo. 39Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ aba ekoŋŋ. Kɛji ekwɛ, ni ena akɛ fɔji lɛ elɛɛlɛɛ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ, 40no lɛ efã ni ajie tɛi ni hela lɛ eshwie he lɛ koni ashɛrɛ ashwie maŋ lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni tseee. 41No sɛɛ lɛ, aŋmala shĩa lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ fɛɛ he kɛ kpe, ni akɛ su ni aŋmala lɛ ayashwie maŋ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ he ko ni tseee. 42Akɛ tɛi krokomɛi ahɔlɔ tɛi ni afamɔ lɛ anajiaŋ, ni akɛ su hee ama gbogboi lɛ ahe.
43Kɛji hela lɛ ku sɛɛ eshwie gbogboi lɛ ahe ekoŋŋ, ni eje shi faŋŋ yɛ he ni afamɔ tɛi lɛ ni aŋmala gbogboi lɛ ahe ni ama he yɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, 44osɔfo lɛ aya ni eyakwɛ. Kɛji ena akɛ nɔ ni eshwie shĩa lɛ he lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ hela ko ni tamɔ kpiti ni fiteɔ nii yɛ shĩa lɛ; shĩa lɛ he tseee. 45Akumɔ shĩa lɛ ashwie shi, etɛi lɛ kɛ mplaŋi lɛ kɛ shĩa lɛ sũ lɛ fɛɛ, ni aloo kɛje maŋ lɛ mli kɛyashwie he ko ni tseee. 46 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boteɔ shĩa lɛ mli be mli ni ala agbo lɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ; 47ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawɔ shĩa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe; ni mɔ ni aaaye nii yɛ shĩa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe.
48Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ ba shĩa lɛ ni ebakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ ekuko esɛɛ eshwieko shĩa lɛ he kɛjɛ be ni ama shĩa lɛ he ekoŋŋ nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, shĩa lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ etã kwraa. 49Osɔfo lɛ kɛ loofɔji enyɔ kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo ashã esha afɔle kɛjwira shĩa lɛ. 50Egbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu yɔɔ mli lɛ nɔ. 51Ekɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ fɛɛ atsɔ loofɔlɔ ni agbe lɛ lá lɛ kɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu ni yɔɔ kã lɛ mli lɛ mli koni ekɛshwã shĩa lɛ shii kpawo. 52Kɛ efee nɛkɛ lɛ, belɛ ekɛ loofɔlɔ lɛ lá lɛ kɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ kɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ ejwra shĩa lɛ. 53Agbɛnɛ eŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he, yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa, koni efiliki kɛya ŋa lɛ nɔ. Gbɛ nɔ ni osɔfo lɛ atsɔ kɛkpãtã ehã shĩa lɛ nɛ, koni shĩa lɛ he atse. 54Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã hewolo nɔ helai srɔtoi ni tamɔ kpiti henɔ: 55-56fala, fafale, loosule, gbɛ̃, fuumɔ kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli muji ni kaa mama mli kɛ gbogbo he mla. 57Eji mla ni akɛnaa nɔ ni he tseee kɛ nɔ ni he tse; hela ni tamɔ kpiti kɛ ehenɔi ahe mla nɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 15
Content:
Gbɔmɔtso mli nu ni he tseee
1Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron 2 ni amɛkɛhã Israelbii lɛ. Kɛji nu miiho yɛ nuu ko nuutso mli lɛ, nu ni hoɔ lɛ he tseee. 3Nu lɛ kã he eeho jio, nuutso lɛ etsi enaa ni ehã ekpa hoo jio, gbɔmɔ lɛ he tseee. 4Saa fɛɛ saa ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ kãa nɔ lɛ he tseee, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etaa nɔ lɛ he tseee. 5Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa saa lɛ he lɛ afɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
6Mɔ ni taa mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ sɛi nɔ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 7Mɔ ni taa mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ he lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 8Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ tsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie mɔ ni he tse he lɛ, mɔ ni atsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ashwie ehe lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 9Sɛi ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ taa nɔ yɛ shwiili mli loo kooloo nɔ lɛ he tseee. 10Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nɔ ko ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ nɔ ko ni tamɔ nakai lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 11Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu ni efɔko edɛ aaata ehe lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 12 Sũ nii ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ aaata he lɛ, ajwa; ni tso nii fɛɛ tso nii ni eeeta he lɛ, akɛ nu afɔ mli.
13Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ hela lɛ tã lɛ, emɛ gbii kpawo. Efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu aju ehe; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse. 14 Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi enyɔ aya Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ni ekɛyahã osɔfo lɛ. 15Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle, koni ekpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ nu ni hoɔ lɛ hewɔ.
16 Kɛji nuu ko shwie ehe shi lɛ, ekɛ nu aju ehe fɛɛ; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 17Mama fɛɛ mama kɛ kooloo wolo fɛɛ kooloo wolo ni nu nɛɛ eko aaatee mli lɛ akɛ nu afɔ he; ni ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 18Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko wɔ, ni nuu lɛ henu je emli lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ nu aju amɛhe; amɛhe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
19 Kɛji yoo ko fee yeianii ni ehe miiho lá lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa ehe lɛ he tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 20Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ ekã nɔ gbii abɔ ni etee tsuiasɛɛ lɛ he tseee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ hu he tseee. 21Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ lɛ saa he lɛ, afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 22Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 23Kɛji mɔ ko ta nɔ ko ni yɔɔ yoo lɛ saa nɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 24Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo lɛ na bɔlɛ ni lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ eko tee ehe lɛ, no lɛ ehe tseee gbii kpawo, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ekã nɔ lɛ he tseee.
25Kɛji yoo ko he ho lá gbii pii be ni eshɛko etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ, aloo ehe ho lá yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ehe hoɔ la lɛ ehe tseee, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa gbii lɛ amli lɛ pɛ. 26Saa fɛɛ saa ni ekã nɔ gbii abɔ ni ehe hoɔ lá lɛ tamɔ etsuiasɛɛyaa saa lɛ pɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he tseee tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ mli lɛ. 27Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nibii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, ehe tseee. Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. 28Kɛji lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ sɛɛ fo lɛ, ekane gbii kpawo ehã ehe; no sɛɛ lɛ ehe aaatse. 29Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 30Osɔfo lɛ kɛ okpoi lɛ ateŋ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle ni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ni ehe aaatse.
31Yehowa kɛɛ Mose koni ebɔ Israelbii lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ amɛhe ni tseee lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkabule miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ni amɛbagboi.
32Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã mɔ ni he hoɔ nu kɛ mɔ ni nu jeɔ emli ni no hãaa ehe atse. 33Mla nɛɛ kã shi hã mɔ ni kɛ yoo ni miifee yeianii wɔɔ kɛ nuu ko ni kɛ yoo ni he tseee naa bɔlɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 16
Content:
Najiaŋtoo gbi
1 Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Aaron bihii enyɔ ni kɛ la ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ tee Yehowa hiɛ ni amɛgboi lɛ agbele lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, 2 “Okɛ onyɛmi Aaron awie koni ekabote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmiiya muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, be fɛɛ be kɛkɛ, koni ekagbo, ejaakɛ mapue yɛ atatu mli yɛ naanɔ ni bu Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ. 3 Nii ni Aaron kɛbote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛ: tsinanuu oblanyo ni akɛfee esha afɔle kɛ ojwɛni ni akɛfee shãa afɔle.
4 “Aaron kɛ nu aju ehe, ni ewo klala flaka krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ klala tswakotoi lɛ. Ekɛ klala mlifiinii lɛ afi emli, ni ekɛ klala tɔɔbaŋ afi eyitso. Atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛ. 5Israel asafo ku lɛ ahã Aaron too kpakpoi enyɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle, kɛ ojwɛni kome ni akɛbaafee eshãa afɔle. 6 Aaron kɛ tsinanuu ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ abashã esha afɔle kɛjie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai kɛ ewe lɛ he eshai. 7Agbɛnɛ ekɛ too kpakpoi enyɔ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 8Efɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki; oshiki kome hã Yehowa kɛ oshiki kome hã Azazel. 9Aaron kɛ too kpakpo ni Yehowa oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ aba ni ekɛbashã esha afɔle. 10Shi too kpakpo ni Azazel oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ ni kooloo lɛ hiɛ kã. Eŋmɛɛ kooloo lɛ he ehã Azazel yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ koni ewo maŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ kɛya.
11“Aaron kɛ etsinanuu lɛ aba akɛ esha afɔle ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ ewe lɛ, ni egbe. 12Eloo ŋai kɛ la ŋɛsu obɔ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni ashi bɔdɔbɔdɔ ekɔkɔi obɔbɔi enyɔ, ni ekɛbote muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ. 13Ekɛ ohɛ lɛ ashwie la lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ohɛ lɛ he lasu kumɔŋŋ lɛ baaha mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ he, koni Aaron akana ni egbo. 14Ekɛ ewao atsɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko koni ekɛshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛgbɛ; ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko hu ni ekɛshwã Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ shii kpawo.
15 “No sɛɛ lɛ, egbe too kpakpo ni ji maŋ lɛ nɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle lɛ. Ekɛ lá lɛ abote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni etsɔ eko eshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛgbɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛgbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ tsina lá lɛ fee lɛ. 16 Ni akɛjwira He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni tseee kɛ amɛtũatsemɔi kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ. Aaron afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Kpee Buu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ; efee yɛ amɛmuji nii lɛ ahewɔ. 17Be ni Aaron boteɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni eyakpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko akahi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeje kpo. Aaron akpãtã ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ ewe lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ. 18 No sɛɛ lɛ, eje kpo kɛya afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ he, ni etsuu he. Ekɛ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛ too kpakpo lɛ lá lɛ eko asra koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ahe kɛkpe. 19Ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu he efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
20“Kɛ Aaron egbe He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ jwiramɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ aba. 21Ekɛ eniji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ashwie too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ yiteŋ, ni ejaje Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛmla tɔ̃mɔi ni ji amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ eshwie too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ. Etu lɛ ewo nuu ko ni mɛɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ dɛŋ koni eyaŋmɛɛ ehe ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ. 22Too kpakpo lɛ baatere amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛya ŋa nɔ he ko kplanaa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ, ni jɛi nuu lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe yɛ. 23 Agbɛnɛ Aaron abote Kpee Buu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ. Ejie klala atadei ni ewo be ni ebote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ, ni eshi yɛ jɛi. 24Eju ehe kɛ nu yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ekɔlɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ. Eje kpo ni eyashã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshãa afɔle lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ shãa afɔle kooloo lɛ koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ maŋ lɛ hu. 25Eshã fɔ ni yɔɔ esha afɔle lɛ he lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 26Agbɛnɛ mɔ ni kɛ too kpakpo lɛ tee eya ŋmɛɛ ehe ehã Azazel lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe dani eba nsra lɛ mli. 27 Akɛ tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too kpakpo lɛ ni akɛshã esha afɔle lɛ ni akɛ amɛlá lɛ tee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni akɛyakpãtã lɛ, aje nsra lɛ mli ni akɛ la ayashã.
