Ashã amɛloo kɛ amɛhewoji kɛ amɛwamɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 28Mɔ ni yashã lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; no sɛɛ fɛɛ dani eba shitoohe lɛ mli.”
Kpãtãmɔ gbi wulu lɛ
29“Enɛ afee akpɔ ahã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ. Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko, nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli bii jio, gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ jio. 30 Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ abaakpãtã ahã nyɛ koni akɛtsuu nyɛhe ni akɛhã nyɛhe atse yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 31Hejɔɔmɔ gbi wulu ni hã nyɛ. Nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ. Akpɔ ni yɔɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ. 32Kusum ni abaafee kɛkpãtã lɛ, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu ni awo lɛ osɔfo koni eye etsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewo klala atadei ni ji atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni efee. 33Ejwra He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekpãtã ehã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ. 34Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi hã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, koni akɛkpãtã ahã Israelbii lɛ daa afi shi kome yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ.”
Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 17
Content:
Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔ ko ji lá
1Yehowa fã Mose, 2koni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ. 3“Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo ni gbeɔ tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli loo shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, 4 ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni akɛshã afɔle ahã Yehowa yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, eye lá yi sɔ̃. Lá efɔse eshwie shi lɛ, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Yehowa bii anɔ dɔŋŋ. 5Mla nɛɛ oti ji akɛ kooloi ni Israelbii lɛ gbeɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛkɛba ni amɛkɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni amɛgbe amɛkɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa. 6Osɔfo lɛ atsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eshã fɔ lɛ koni eje ŋma ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ. 7 Israelbii lɛ akafee amɛhe mɛi ni yeee Yehowa anɔkwa ni amɛshãa afɔlei amɛhãa wɔji ni amɛnyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni yɔɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ kɛ yinɔi fɛɛ ni baaba yɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
8“Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii lɛ ni shãa shãa afɔle loo 9 afɔle kroko ehãa Yehowa yɛ he kroko ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii lɛ anɔ.
10 Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii akaye loo lɛ mli lá, no lɛ majie mihiɛ maka nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ, ni mi kɛ lɛ baafo takoŋ. 11 Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, elá lɛ mli ewala yɔɔ, ni no hewɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ afɔse lá lɛ fɛɛ ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni akɛjie maŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ. Ejaakɛ lá ni ji wala lɛ akɛjieɔ eshai yɛ gbɔmɔ he. 12No hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛ jio, gbɔ ni ebato amɛ jio, amɛkaye loo ni lá yɔɔ mli lɛ.
13“Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel lɛ, kɛji eyagbɔbi ni egbe kooloo loo loofɔlɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ, efɔse elá lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɛ sũ atsi nɔ, 14 ejaakɛ bɔɔ nii fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, amɛlá lɛ mli amɛwala yɔɔ; ni no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛkaye loo ko loo ko lá lɛ. Bɔɔnɔ fɛɛ bɔɔnɔ lɛ elá mli ewala yɔɔ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lá lɛ abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔ.
15 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele aloo kooloo ni kooloo awuyelɔ ko tserɛ emli lɛ, Israelnyo ji lɛ jio, gbɔ ni ebato Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji lɛ jio, efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛnu aju ehe; ebaahi shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ dani ehe baatse. 16Kɛji efɔɔɔ etadei ahe, ni ejuuu ehe lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ akã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.”

Title: LEVITIKO 18
Content:
Nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ ni ahiɔ
1Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, 2“Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 3 Nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni nyɛhi tsutsu lɛ. Asaŋ nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ nɛɛ lɛ. Amɛkusum lɛ nyɛkafea. 4Nyɛyea mimlai kɛ migbɛjianɔtoi lɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 5 Nyɛyea migbɛjianɔtoi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ; nɔ ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni enaa wala lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa. 6Nuu ko nuu ko akabɛŋkɛ ewekunyo ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ. Mi ji Yehowa. 7Okɛ onyɛ akawɔ ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi; onyɛ ni, kaahã ehiɛ miishwie shi. 8 Okɛ otsɛ ŋa akawɔ; obaashwie otsɛ hiɛ shi. 9 Okɛ onyɛmi yoo ni ji otsɛ loo onyɛ bi akawɔ; alɛ lɛ yɛ nyɛshĩa lɛ mli jio, shĩa kroko mli jio, okɛ lɛ akawɔ. 10Okɛ obinuu biyoo loo obiyoo biyoo akawɔ. Eji nɔ ko ni baashwie bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ shi. 11Okɛ otsɛ ŋa biyoo ni otsɛ fɔ lɛ akawɔ. Onyɛmi yoo ni, ni esaaa akɛ ohãa ehiɛ shwieɔ shi. 12 Okɛ otsɛ nyɛmi yoo akawɔ: otsɛ lá ji lɛ. 13Okɛ onyɛ nyɛmi yoo akawɔ: onyɛ lá ji lɛ. 14Kaabɛŋkɛ otsɛ nyɛmi nuu ŋa ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi: onyɛkwɛ ni. 15 Okɛ onyɛmi nuu ŋa akawɔ: ebaahã onyɛmi nuu lɛ hiɛ ashwie shi. 16 Okɛ onyɛmi nuu ŋa akawɔ ni okɛshwie onyɛmi nuu lɛ hiɛ shi. 17 Okɛ yoo kɛ ebiyoo fɛɛ akawɔ, ni asaŋ okaŋɔ obinuu biyoo loo ebiyoo lɛ biyoo ni okɛ lɛ yawɔ. Yoo lɛ lá ji amɛ, ni jeŋba ni tamɔ nakai bɛ fɛo. 18Kaaŋɔ oŋa nyɛmi yoo ofee oŋa bienyɛ; ni okɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ be mli ni oŋa hiɛ kã lolo.
19 “Kaaya yoo ŋɔɔ ni okɛ lɛ ayawɔ be mli ni etee tsuiasɛɛ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee. 20 Okɛ onaanyo ŋa akawɔ ni okɛwo ohe muji. 21 Kaaŋmɛɛ obii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko he ohã ni akɛ lɛ ja Molek ni akɛ no wo oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji. Mi ji Yehowa. 22 Okɛ nuu akawɔ tamɔ okɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ; aahi. 23 Okɛ kooloo ko kooloo ko akawɔ ni okɛwo ohe muji. Nakai nɔŋŋ esaaa akɛ yoo ko kɛ ehe hãa kooloo ko. 24Nyɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko eko akawoa nyɛhe muji; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ jeŋmaji ni mibashwie mahã nyɛ lɛ kɛwoɔ amɛhe muji lɛ. 25Gbɛ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni shikpɔŋ fee shikpɔŋ ni he tseee nɛ. Mibagbala etoii yɛ enishaianii lɛ hewɔ, ni ebaafɛ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ eshwie. 26-27Mɛi ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ fee nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛkɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ he muji. Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkafea nɛkɛ nihii nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko eko. Maŋnyo jio, gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ jio, nyɛyea Yehowa mlai lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ anɔ, 28koni shikpɔŋ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ hu eshwie tamɔ bɔ ni efɛ̃ jeŋmaŋ ni tsɔ nyɛhiɛ lɛ eshwie lɛ. 29Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ nɛkɛ nihiinii nɛɛ eko lɛ, abuŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mɛi lɛ anɔ.
30“No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea nii ni mifã akɛ nyɛfee lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkafea kusumi ni ahiɔ ni afeɔ dani nyɛba lɛ, koni nyɛkɛkawo nyɛhe muji. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

Title: LEVITIKO 19
Content:
Krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ kɛ jalɛ he mlai
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose, 2 ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi. 3 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashe enyɛ kɛ etsɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛyea mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ; mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
4 “Nyɛkayanyiɛa yakayaka wɔji asɛɛ, ni nyɛkafea dade wɔji hu ni ashwie nyɛhã nyɛhe; mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
5“Kɛji nyɛgbe kooloo nyɛkɛmiishã naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ, nyɛfea lɛ yɛ mlai ni awo yɛ he lɛ naa koni esa mihiɛ ni mahere. 6Aye loo lɛ gbi ni ashã afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ; shi nɔ ni baashwɛ kɛyaashi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ la ashã, ejaakɛ ehe tseee; 7ni kɛ aye gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ loo lɛ eko lɛ, minaŋ afɔle lɛ he tsui. 8Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ, etere musu, ejaakɛ ewo keenɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛmiihã Yehowa he muji, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ mimɛi lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
9 “Kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshinii lɛ, nyɛkakpaa nii ni yɔɔ nyɛŋmɔji lɛ anaanaa lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa. 10Ni nyɛkakpaa wain tsei lɛ ayibii hu fɛɛ kɛmɔɔ shi; ni wain yibii ni aaashwie shi lɛ hu nyɛkakɔlɔa. Nyɛshĩa nyɛhãa ohiafoi kɛ gbɔi lɛ koni amɛbaye lɛ kpɛkpɛo. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
11 “Kaaju; kaashishiu onaanyo gbɔmɔ, kaalaka lɛ. 12 Kaakã kitã yɛ migbɛi mli ni okɛshishiu mɔ ko ni okɛwo oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji. Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
13 “Kaaye onaanyo gbɔmɔ amim, ni kaatswa lɛ ojo. Kaahã je miitsɛre apaafonyo nyɔmɔwoo nɔ. 14 Kaalomɔ toimulɔ, ni okɛ pampi akama shwilafo gbɛ nɔ ni eyatɛ; shi she oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei. Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
15 “Kaatsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ obu shi ni oye ohã ohiafo aloo ohiɛ shwie gbɔmɔ wulu hiɛ. Kojomɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ yɛ jalɛ naa. 16Kaanyiɛ kɛmiiya kɛmiiba ni ooye osheku yɛ omaŋ lɛ mli; ni kaate shi oshi onaanyo gbɔmɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɔgbee sane fɔ̃ enɔ; mi ji Yehowa.
17 “Kaanyɛ onyɛmi gbɔmɔ yɛ otsui mli; shi kã lɛ blɛoo yɛ etɔ̃mɔ he koni okatere sɔ̃ ko bo diɛŋtsɛ hu. 18 Kaatɔ ohe owele, ni kaabɛ omaŋbii lɛ eko owo omli, shi suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.
19 “Nyɛyea mikpɔi lɛ anɔ. Kaahã oshĩa kooloi srɔtoi miifutu amɛmiikwɔ. Oŋmɔ mli hu kaafutu wui srɔtoi odu. Ni kaawo atade ni akɛ klala kɛ kuŋtu futu lo.
20“Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nyɔŋyoo ko wɔ, ni nyɔŋyoo lɛ atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu kroko, shi nuu nɛɛ woko eyi nyɔmɔ koni yoo lɛ aye ehe lɛ, no lɛ abote sane lɛ mli. Agbala yoo lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ toi, shi akagbe amɛ, ejaakɛ ahãko yoo lɛ aye ehe. 21Shi nuu lɛ kɛ ojwɛni aba abahã Yehowa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 22Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ojwɛni ni ji sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ akpãtã ahã nuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛaafa lɛ.
23“Kɛji nyɛyashɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, yeli tso fɛɛ yeli tso ni nyɛaatɛo ni ayeɔ lɛ, nyɛbua eyibii lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni ehe tseee kɛyashi afii etɛ̃; akaye eyibii lɛ. 24Shi afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ afee tso yibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ akɛ afɔle ni aashã ahã mi, Yehowa, kɛda mi shi. 25Shi afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛyea yibii lɛ, koni nibaa nii afa babaoo ahã nyɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
26 “Nyɛkayea loo ni lá yɔɔ mli. Nyɛkaklaa, ni nyɛkayea ŋkunyaa. 27 Nyɛkashɛa nyɛyitsei ahe, ni nyɛkakua nyɛtsɛŋ nɔ. 28Nyɛkabamɔa nyɛhewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛyea gbonyo ko he ŋkɔmɔ; ni nyɛkayea sãmãi yɛ nyɛhewolo nɔ. Mi ji Yehowa.
29 “Okɛ obiyoo akawɔ ni ohã etsɔ̃ yoo ajwamãŋ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bayi tɔ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ. 30 Nyɛyea mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni nyɛshea he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ gbeyei; mi ji Yehowa.
31 “Nyɛkanyiɛa okɔmfoi kɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai anɔ, koni nyɛkawo nyɛhe muji. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
32“Ohiɛ asɔ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ, ni owo amɛ. She Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei. Mi ji Yehowa.
33“Kɛ gbɔ ko bato gbɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkawaa lɛ yi. 34 Nyɛhiɛa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛbaahiɛ nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛsumɔa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyato gbɔ pɛŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
35“Nyɛkayea sane ni ejaaa yɛ nisusumɔ kɛ niŋmɛɛ kɛ nikaa mli. 36 Nyɛhiɛa nsɛnii kpakpai kɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛi kpakpai kɛ nisusumɔ nii kpakpai. Mi ji Yehowa ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 37No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akãa mimlai kɛ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni nyɛyea fɛɛ nɔ. Mi ji Yehowa.”

Title: LEVITIKO 20
Content:
Toigbele he toigbalamɔ
1Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, 2ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ ebii lɛ eko aaahã ni akɛja Molek lɛ, agbe lɛ; shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ. 3Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ebii ateŋ mɔ ko hã Molek, ni ekɛwo He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni ajaa mi yɛŋ lɛ he muji, ni eshwie migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ shi lɛ, mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ. 4Shi kɛji mɛi ateŋ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ku amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ nɔ ni efee lɛ nɔ, ni amɛgbeee lɛ lɛ, 5mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ kɛ eweku fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa, shi amɛjaa Molek lɛ. Mibuŋ amɛ mishiŋ miwebii anɔ.
6“Kɛji mɔ ko yabi nii yɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai aŋɔɔ lɛ, mate shi mawo lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ. 7Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 8Nyɛhiɛ akãa mimlai lɛ ahe ni nyɛyea nɔ; mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
9 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, agbe lɛ. Etsɛ kɛ enyɛ elomɔ lɛ; esɔ̃ atere lɛ.
10 “Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko ŋa ku gbãlã mli lɛ, agbe nuu gbãlãŋkulɔ kɛ yoo gbãlãŋkulɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 11 Nuu ni kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ eshwie etsɛ hiɛ shi. Gbe agbe lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ. 12 Kɛji nuu ko kɛ eshaayoo ni ji ebinuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, agbe lɛ kɛ eshaayoo lɛ fɛɛ; hiɛgbejianii amɛfee lɛ; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ. 13 Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ, amɛfee nɔ ni ahiɔ; agbe amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ. 14 Kɛji nuu ko ŋɔ yoo ko kɛ enyɛ fɛɛ efee eŋãmɛi lɛ, ashã amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ musu ni amɛbɔ lɛ hewɔ. 15Kɛji nuu ko kɛ kooloo ko wɔ lɛ, agbe lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ fɛɛ. 16 Kɛji yoo ko bɛŋkɛ kooloo ko, ni ekãa shi ehãa lɛ, ni ekɛ kooloo lɛ wɔ lɛ, agbe yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ fɛɛ; amɛmusu atere amɛ.
17 “Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛmi yoo ni ji etsɛbi loo enyɛbi wɔ lɛ, amɛfee hiɛgbejianii. Atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ. Nuu lɛ ni kɛ enyɛmi yoo ewɔ lɛ, esɔ̃ atere lɛ. 18 Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko ni etee tsuiasɛɛ wɔ lɛ, atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ.
19 “Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛ nyɛmi yoo loo enyɛ nyɛmi yoo wɔ lɛ, eshwie mɔ ni ekɛ lɛ hiɛ heloo kome hiɛ shi; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ. 20Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛkwɛ̃ ŋa wɔ lɛ, eshwie etsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ hiɛ shi; ekɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ, amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko naŋ bi, ni ebaagbo. 21 Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛmi nuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, amɛbaagboi ni amɛbɛ bi. Nuu lɛ etsu hiɛgbejianii, ni eshwie enyɛmi lɛ hiɛ shi.
22“Nyɛyea mimlai lɛ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa ni nyɛyahi nɔ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ eshwie. 23Nyɛkakasea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akusumi ni amɛfeɔ lɛ. Miishwie nɛkɛ wɔŋjalɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛya. Amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ehã minyaŋe amɛ. 24Shi miwo nyɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii nɛɛ he shi, ni mikɛbaahã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã. 25No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea srɔto yɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee ateŋ. Nyɛkayea kooloi loo loofɔji ni he tseee. Mihã nyɛle akɛ amɛhe tseee; ni kɛ nyɛye lɛ nyɛhe baawo muji. 26Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhãa mi pɛ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mihe tse. Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã koni nyɛfee mi pɛ minɔ.
27“Nyɛteŋ nuu loo yoo ni aaayabi nii yɛ sisa ŋɔɔ lɛ, atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ enɛ lɛ egbele sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.”

Title: LEVITIKO 21
Content:
Osɔfoi lɛ ahe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ
1 Yehowa fã Mose ni ekɛɛ osɔfoi ni ji Aaron bihii lɛ akɛ, “Osɔfo ko akaya wekunyo ko kɛkɛ ni egbo yara nɔ ni ekɛwo ehe muji, 2belɛ ja enyɛ loo etsɛ loo ebinuu loo ebiyoo loo enyɛmi nuu 3loo enyɛmi yoo, ni ji oblayoo foro ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, koni ekɛbule ehe. 4Ekaya mɔ ko ni gbãlã hewɔ efeɔ ewekunyo yara nɔ koni ekɛwo ehe muji.
5 “Osɔfo ko akakpɔ eyi, ni ekaku etsɛŋ nɔ, ni asaŋ ekabãmɔ ehewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ. 6Osɔfo lɛ afee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã mi, ni ekawo migbɛi lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ Yehowa afɔlei ni akɛ la shãa, ni ji eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aboloo lɛ, lɛ ekɛbahãa. No hewɔ lɛ, efee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ. 7Osɔfo ko akaŋɔ yoo ajwamãŋ ko loo yoo ni le nuu, loo yoo ni ewu eshwie lɛ, ejaakɛ miniyenii afɔle lɛ, osɔfo lɛ kɛbahãa mi; Osɔfo lɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni. 8Nyɛbua osɔfo lɛ akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, ji mɔ ni mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. 9Kɛji osɔfo ko biyoo fee ehe ajwamãŋ lɛ, ewo etsɛ he muji; ashã lɛ ni egbo.
10 “Osɔfonukpa lɛ, mɔ ni afɔse mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ ashwie eyiteŋ ni awo lɛ osɔfo, ni ewo osɔfo atadei lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekahiɛ eyitso folo, ni ekagbala etadei hu kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ. 11-12Afɔ lɛ mu ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi; no hewɔ lɛ, ekawo mishihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji; ni ekashi jɛi etee eyabote shĩa ko ni gbonyo ko kɛkɛ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ tete gbonyo kã mli. 13Eŋɔ oblayoo foro. 14Ekaŋɔ yoo okulafo loo mɔ ni ewu eshwie lɛ loo mɔ ni le nuu loo yoo ajwamãŋ; shi moŋ eŋɔ oblayoo foro kɛjɛ etsɛ weku lɛ mli. 15Efee enɛ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ eshwiei ni sa akɛ amɛfee krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ahe baawo muji. Mi ji Yehowa, ni mijɔɔ enɔ mifee lɛ osɔfonukpa.”
16Yehowa fã Mose, 17ni ekɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Oshwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni eje kpa akaba, yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli, ni ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ bahã mi. 18Mɔ ko ni kpa yɔɔ egbɔmɔtso he kɛ afɔle lɛ akaba; mɔ ni eshwila aloo etsɔ̃ɔ, loo eji gbɔmɔ akotia loo gbɔmɔ asaabu, 19loo mɔ ni enane loo enine eje kpa 20loo afutsɛ, loo mɔ ni tɛ kã ehiŋmɛi nɔ, loo mɔ ni he edɔ kpla loo mɔ ni egbɛi mli wui ejwra. 21Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni kpa ko yɔɔ ehe yɛ osɔfo Aaron bihii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ ni ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ bahã mi. 22Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nakai lɛ eeenyɛ eye aboloo ni ji nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ amli lɛ eko moŋ, 23shi muhɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he kɛkɛ ni ekaba, ni ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ kpa yɛ ehe. No hewɔ lɛ, ekawo minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahe muji, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”
24Belɛ enɛ ji nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 22
Content:
Krɔŋkrɔŋ nii ji afɔlei lɛ
1Yehowa fã Mose, 2ni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ: “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni Israelbii lɛ tsuɔ he ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhãa mi lɛ he, koni migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ akagbo. Mi ji Yehowa. 3Kɛji oshwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni he tseee tsi bɛŋkɛ afɔlei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ etsuu he amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhã mi lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ. Mla nɛɛ kã shi hã yinɔi fɛɛ.
4“Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miiye hewolo nɔ hela gbeyeigbeyei aloo ehe miiho nu akaye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ehe aaatse. 5Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni taa nɔ ko ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, loo nuu ni ehe nu jeɔ emli hoɔ, loo nuu ni taa waamɔnii ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, aloo etaa mɔ ko ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, 6loo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nibii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi hulu aaanyɔ shi. Ni kɛ ejuko ehe lɛ ekaye nikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ eko. 7Kɛ hulu enyɔ shi ni ehe tse lɛ, no sɛɛ dani eye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ eko, ejaakɛ nomɛi ji eŋmãa. 8 Ekaye kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele loo kooloi etserɛ lɛ. Kɛji eye lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ mɔ ni he tseee; mi ji Yehowa.
9“Osɔfoi fɛɛ aye mlai ni miwo nɛɛ anɔ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ amɛaatere sɔ̃, ni amɛaagboi yɛ mimlai krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anɔtɔ̃mɔ hewɔ; mi mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
10“Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko akaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbɔ loo apaafonyo ni ebato osɔfo gbɔ. 11Shi nyɔŋ ni osɔfo lɛ he kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshika, aye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; ni nyɔji ni afɔ amɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ we lɛ kɛ lɛ aye eniyenii lɛ eko. 12Kɛ osɔfo ko biyoo yagbã mɔ ko kɛkɛ lɛ, ekaye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli nɔ ni aje gbɛ ajie ato afã lɛ. 13Shi kɛji osɔfo biyoo lɛ tsɔ̃ okulafo aloo ewu shwie lɛ, ni ebɛ bi, ni eku esɛɛ kɛba etsɛ we lɛ, tamɔ eyɔɔ yɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, no lɛ eye etsɛ nii lɛ eko. Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko kɛkɛ akaye eko.
14“Kɛji mɔ ko ni jɛɛɛ osɔfoi aweku mli leee ehe be ni eyaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko lɛ, eto najiaŋ ni ekɛ mlijai enumɔ mli ekome ashi nɔ. 15Osɔfoi lɛ akaŋmɛ mɔ ko kɛkɛ gbɛ ni eye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ eko. 16Kɛji amɛŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ amɛbaawo niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, ni amɛaatere tɔ̃mɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃, ni aaagbala amɛtoi, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”
17Yehowa fã Mose 18koni ekɛ mlai nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ, “Kɛji Israelnyo ko loo mɔ ko ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shãa afɔle miiba abahã Yehowa, shiwoo ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa nii jio, kooloo lɛ afee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe. 19Bɔ ni afee ni esa Yehowa hiɛ ni ehe lɛ; kooloo lɛ afee tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe. 20 Kɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe ba lɛ, esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ, ni eheŋ. 21Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle tamɔ akɛ tsina loo too, loo afɔle ni ewo he shi eto, loo afɔle ni eeshã yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, miiba abahã Yehowa lɛ, esaaa akɛ kpa ko ahi kooloo lɛ he; esa akɛ efee kooloo ni eye emuu koni esa Yehowa hiɛ. 22Nyɛkɛ kooloo ni eshwila aloo ehe ko eku, loo ehenii shɛɛɛ, loo fala ni hoɔ nu yɛ ehe, loo kpla loo ajitɔ eshwie ehe loo nɔ ko ewo yɛ ehewolo nɔ akaba akɛ nyɛkɛbaahã Yehowa koni akɛshã afɔle ahã lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 23Kɛji afɔle ni nyɛkɛba lɛ tsuijurɔ naa nyɛkɛba lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni enine loo enane bɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ashã afɔle lɛ. Shi kɛ afɔle ni nyɛwo he shi nyɛto nyɛshãa lɛ, no lɛ kooloo lɛ esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ ni eheŋ. 24Nyɛkɛ kooloo ni ajwara aloo ashimɔ aloo atserɛ aloo afolɔ egbɛi akashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa. Ni nyɛkafea nakai yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
25“Nyɛkahea kooloi nɛɛ eko yɛ maŋsɛɛnyo dɛŋ ni nyɛkɛbahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle, ejaakɛ adebɔɔ mli kpa ko yɛ maŋsɛɛ kooloi nɛɛ ahe. Eji kpa ni eka amɛhe, ni amɛsaŋ Yehowa hiɛ.
26-27“Kɛji afɔ tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotiabi lɛ, akajie lɛ yɛ enyɛ he kɛyashi gbii kpawo. Kɛjɛ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ, esa hã niyenii afɔle shãa hã Yehowa. 28 Nyɛkagbea tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia kɛ ebi fɛɛ gbi kome. 29Kɛji nyɛmiishã shidaa afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa lɛ, nyɛyea ehe mlai lɛ anɔ, koni afɔle lɛ asa ehiɛ. 30Nyɛyea loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ; nyɛkashwɛa eko ni je tsɛre nɔ.”
31Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛhiɛ ahiãa mikpɔi lɛ anɔ ni nyɛyea nɔ; mi ji Yehowa. 32Nyɛkahãa migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ miigbo. Esa akɛ Israelbii fɛɛ abu mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; mi ji Yehowa, ni mi mifeɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 33Mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni matsɔ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ; mi ji Yehowa.”

Title: LEVITIKO 23
Content:
Jamɔ gbii juji lɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ gbii juji ni, mi, Yehowa, mito akɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.
3 Atsu nii gbii ekpaa; shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni nyɛaahi; akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja 4Yehowa gbii juji ni akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ kɛja lɛ nɛ. Nyɛshiɛa eko fɛɛ eko kɛji ebe ni ato lɛ shɛ lɛ.”
Hehoo kɛ Ma Akpiti Aboloo Gbijurɔ
(Numeri 28.16-25)
5 “Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ ji Yehowa Hehoo gbi lɛ. 6Ni gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ lɛ, no ji mã akpiti gbijurɔ lɛ. Nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã gbii kpawo kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ. 7Gbii kpawo nɛɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ. 8 Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle abahãa Yehowa gbii kpawo. Ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa; shi akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.”
9Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 10“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkpa enɔ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkɛ nikpamɔnii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ abele tso kɛ eyinii lɛ abahãa osɔfo lɛ. 11Osɔfo lɛ baafɔ̃ nikpamɔnii nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛya kɛba akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ko ni nyɛsa Yehowa hiɛ. Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ osɔfo lɛ baafɔ̃ afɔle nɛɛ. 12Gbi nɔ ni nyɛkɛ ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ nii afɔle lɛ baaba lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛŋ gwantɛŋbi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛbahãa Yehowa. 13Ni niyenii afɔle ni afata kooloo lɛ he ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ, kiloi enyɔ, koni ashã ahã Yehowa koni eje ŋma ewo lɛ; ni dãa afɔle ni akɛfata he ji wain lita kome. 14Ni kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔle lɛ aaabahã nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aboloo loo abele ni ashã loo abele fɔ ko akaya nyɛdaaŋ. Akpɔ nɛɛ kã shi hã nyɛshwiei yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
Ŋmãakpamɔ gbijurɔ lɛ
(Numeri 28.26-31)
15“Nyɛkanea otsii kpawo kɛjɛ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ ni ji gbi ni nyɛkɛ ŋmãa ni nyɛku lɛ baahã Yehowa lɛ. 16Gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ ni ji Hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ abele fɔ afɔle lɛ abahãa Yehowa. 17Nyɛkɛ aboloo akwaabɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni akɛŋmãa mamu kiloi enyɔ ni awo mli yiisi shã ajɛa nyɛshĩai amli kɛbaa akɛ nyɛŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nikpamɔnii ni nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa. 18Nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋbii kpawo ni amɛye afifii, ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ afata aboloi lɛ ahe. Akɛ kooloi lɛ kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa lɛ fɛɛ baafee shãa afɔle akɛhã Yehowa. Afɔle ni ashãa ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni. 19Asaŋ nyɛkɛ too kpakpo kome afea esha he faikpamɔ afɔle, koni nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋbii enyɔ ni amɛye afifii lɛ afea shidaa afɔle. 20Osɔfo lɛ baaŋɔ aboloo lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋbii lɛ ehã koni afɔ̃ akɛ fɔ̃ɔ afɔle yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Nibii nɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ Yehowa nii krɔŋkrɔŋ. Aŋɔ hã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ. 21 Ashiɛ koni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛkpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja, ni akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ. Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
22 “Ni kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkakpaa ŋmɔ lɛ naanaanii lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa; nakai nɔŋŋ hu onikpamɔnii lɛ amli kpɛkpɛbii lɛ hu kaakpɛte; shi moŋ ashi ahã ohiafo kɛ gbɔ koni amɛkɛbaye kpɛkpɛo. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Afi hee gbijurɔ
(Numeri 29.1-6)
23Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 24“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ, nyɛyea lɛ kpoo akɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbijurɔ. Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ akɛ kaimɔ nɔ kɛshiɛ gbi lɛ, koni akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja. 25Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ; ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle abahãa Yehowa.”
Kpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ
(Numeri 29.7-11)
26Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 27“Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ ji esha kpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ. Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ; asaŋ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa. 28Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ kpãtãmɔ gbi ni, koni akpãtã yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ ahã nyɛ. 29Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni waaa ehe yi kɛ hɔmɔ nakai gbi lɛ lɛ, akaneŋ lɛ ashiŋ emaŋbii anɔ dɔŋŋ. 30Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ emaŋbii lɛ ateŋ. 31Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ. Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ. 32 Hejɔɔmɔ gbi wulu nɛ hã nyɛ. Nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ kɛjɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi aahu kɛyaashi enɔ jetsɛremɔ gbɛkɛnaashi ekoŋŋ. Nyɛyea Hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ.”
Asesei agbijurɔ lɛ
(Numeri 29.12-40)
33Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 34“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo ni kã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ ji Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ; aye gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo ahã Yehowa. 35Gbi ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ. 36 Gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa nyɛkɛbahãa Yehowa. Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa. Kpee wulu diɛŋtsɛ gbi ni. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.
37“Enɛɛmɛi ji gbii juji ni Yehowa eto lɛ; ni kɛji eko shɛ lɛ nyɛshiɛa koni maŋ lɛ akpe kpei krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛja, asaŋ koni ashã niyenii afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei akɛhã Yehowa, eko fɛɛ eko yɛ egbi nɔ. 38Esoro Yehowa Hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ, dani esoro nyɛdaadaa nikeenii lɛ, ni esoro nyɛshiwoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ hu ni nyɛkɛbahãa Yehowa.
39“Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ, be ni nyɛkpa ŋmɔshinii nyɛgbe naa lɛ, nyɛjea shishi nyɛyea Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ kɛyashia gbii kpawo. Gbi ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɛdɛɛ ni. 40 Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛhiɛa nyɛtsei anɔ aduawai kpakpai fɛɛfɛji kɛ tɛŋ bɛlɛo kɛ tsei flofloi aniji kɛ faa naa ŋɔi kɛbaa koni nyɛbanyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ gbii kpawo. 41Nyɛkɛ gbii kpawo ayea gbijurɔ nɛɛ daa afi nyɛhãa Yehowa yɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ. Eji naanɔ akpɔ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ. 42Nyɛhia asesei amli gbii kpawo. Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo ahi asese mli, 43koni nyɛshwiei kɛna amɛle akɛ be ni miyakpala Israel kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, asesei amli mihã amɛhi. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
44Belɛ bɔ ni Mose tsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ gbii juji ni Yehowa eto ehã amɛ akɛ amɛye lɛ nɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 24
Content:
Kanei lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ
(Ɛksodɔs 27.20-21)
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Fã Israelbii akɛ amɛbahã bo mutso mu krɔŋŋ ni akɛ mutso ni ashimɔ fee koni akɛ mu lɛ asu Kpee Buu lɛ mli kane lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ahã kane lɛ ama nɔ be fɛɛ be. 3Aaron akwɛ koni kane lɛ atso, kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ aahu kɛyashi daa jetsɛremɔ leebi, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ be fɛɛ be yɛ muhɔɔ ni fo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli. Enɛ afee naanɔ akpɔ ahã nyɛshwiei. 4Aaron baakura kanei lɛ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi kanetsei lɛ anɔ, ni ebaakwɛ koni amɛtso yɛ Yehowa hiɛ be fɛɛ be.
Aboloo ni akɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ
5“Okɛ ŋmãa mamu ashã aboloo akwaabɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, aboloo akwaabɔ kome aye ŋmãa mamu kilo kome. 6 Too aboloo lɛ srɛnɛɛ kui enyɔ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ. Aboloo ekpaa aye afã biɛ, ni aboloo ekpaa hu aye biɛ. 7Okɛ krɔbɔo krɔŋŋ afata aboloo ku kome fɛɛ ku kome he, koni no afee kaimɔ nɔ ni akɛbahã akɛ afɔle ni ashã ahã Yehowa. 8Daa Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, Aaron ato aboloo nɛɛ eshwie okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ni kã shi hã Israelbii nɛ. 9 Aboloi lɛ atsɔ̃ Aaron kɛ eshwiei agbɛfaŋnɔ; ni amɛye nii nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle ni abashã akɛhã Yehowa mli nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni.”
Toigbalamɔ ni ja gbɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ
10Be ko lɛ Israelyoo ko binuu ni ekɛ Ijiptnyo ko fɔ lɛ kɛ Israelnyo ko yabe yɛ maŋ, yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. 11Israelyoo nɛɛ gbɛi ji Shelomit, ni etsɛ ji Dibri ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli lɛ. Bei lɛ mli lɛ oblanyo lɛ bɔ musu elomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, amɔ lɛ kɛbahã Mose. 12Atsi oblanyo lɛ naa kɛyashi Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni afee lɛ.
13Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 14“Mɔ mɔ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje shitoohe lɛ mli kɛya esɛɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nu akɛ elomɔ lɛ kɛ amɛniji abashwie eyiteŋ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋtso muu lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo. 15Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baalomɔ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ lɛ, emusu baabua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ; 16mɔ ni baalomɔ Yehowa lɛ, gbe kɛ̃ aaagbe lɛ. Gbɔ ni jio, maŋnyo ni jio, kɛji ena elomɔ Yehowa lɛ, maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.’
17 “Mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu agbe lɛ; 18ni mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ kroko kooloo lɛ, eto kooloo lɛ najiaŋ kɛ kooloo nɔŋŋ; akɛ kooloo ato kooloo najiaŋ.
19“Kɛji mɔ ko pila enaanyo gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu apila lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ bɔ ni epila enaanyo lɛ koni akɛtse. 20 Kɛji eku enaanyo lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli wu lɛ, aku lɛ hu ewu akɛtse; kɛji hiŋmɛi ni lɛ, akɛ ehiŋmɛi atse, ni kɛji nyanyɔŋ ni lɛ, akɛ lɛ hu enyanyɔŋ atse. Bɔ ni epila mɔ lɛ ehã lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nɔŋŋ apila lɛ hu kɛtse. 21Mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ ko kooloo ko lɛ, eto mɔ lɛ kooloo lɛ najiaŋ; shi mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ gbe agbe lɛ. 22Mla koome nɛɛ akã shi ahã nyɛ fɛɛ, gbɔ kɛ maŋnyo fɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
23Be ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ewie egbe naa lɛ, maŋbii lɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje amɛshitoohe lɛ mli kɛtee esɛɛ, ni ayatswia lɛ tɛ yɛ jɛi ni egbo. Belɛ kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.

Title: LEVITIKO 25
Content:
Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ kusum
(Deuteronomio 15.1-11)
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ 2ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa shikpɔŋ lɛ akãa shi efolo afi koni ekɛjɔɔ ehe akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa. 3Nyɛhua shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛdua nyɛŋmɔshi nii afii ekpaa, ni nyɛkpɔlɔa nyɛwaintsei ahe, ni nyɛkpaa amɛyibii afii ekpaa hu; 4shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, aŋmɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he koni ejɔɔ ehe kpoo, akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa. Akadu nii yɛ ŋmɔshi, ni akakpɔlɔ waintsei ahe hu. 5Ŋmɔshinii ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eeekwɛ̃ lɛ, akakpa ato; ni yibii ni waintsei ni akpɔlɔko amɛhe lɛ aaawo lɛ hu, akakpa ato. Nakai afi lɛ eji hejɔɔmɔ afi hã shikpɔŋ lɛ. 6Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ be nɛɛ mli niyenii ni baakwɛ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ebaashɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɔji hii kɛ yei kɛ nyɛpaafoi kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ fɛɛ, 7 kɛ nyɛshĩa kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yeli aahu. Niyenii fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba lɛ aye.”
Nikpɔ̃mɔ afi lɛ
8“Nyɛkanea shikpɔŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ afi nɛɛ toi kpawo, no ji afii kpawo kpawo toi kpawo. Enɛ feɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ nɛɛhu. 9Afi nɛɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ, no ji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi lɛ. Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kɛfo shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi nɛɛ nɔ. 10Nyɛfea afi ni ji afi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Ashiɛ heyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahã enɔ bii fɛɛ. Etsɔ̃ nyamɔ afi ehã nyɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ko ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ, mɔ lɛ loo eshwie ko aku sɛɛ ayaŋɔ nii lɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ aku esɛɛ eya ewekumɛi aŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ. 11Nɛkɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɛɛ atsɔ nyamɔ afi ahã nyɛ. Nyɛkadua nii yɛ enɔ; ni nyɛkakpaa niyenii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahã nyɛ lɛ nyɛtoa; asaŋ nyɛkakpaa nyɛwaintsei ni akpɔlɔɔɔ amɛhe lɛ anɔ yibii lɛ hu. 12Nyamɔ afi ni, ni nyɛyea lɛ akɛ afi krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahã nyɛ lɛ, no nyɛyea.
13“Nɛkɛ nyamɔ afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kulɛ ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ, eya ni eyaŋɔ enii ekoŋŋ. 14No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ohɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ ko ohã onyɛmi Israelnyo, aloo ohe shikpɔŋ ko yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akamɔ enyɛmi lɛ loo eshishiu enyɛmi lɛ. 15Adamɔ afii abɔ ni abaanyɛ ahu shikpɔŋ lɛ ni akpa enɔ nibaanii lɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ ashɛ nɔ awo shikpɔŋ lɛ he jara. 16Kɛji afii lɛ fa lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ awa; ni kɛji afii lɛ faaa lɛ, no lɛ ejara lɛ aba shi, ejaakɛ afii lɛ amli nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo lɛ ji nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ. 17No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akashishiu enyɛmi; shi nyɛshea nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ mli saji
18“Nyɛyea mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ ekpakpa, ni nyɛaahi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe. 19Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba eniyenii, ni nyɛaaye nyɛtɔrɔ; ni nyɛaahi nɔ shweshweeshwe.
20“Eko lɛ nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji wɔduŋ nii, ni wɔkpãŋ ŋmɔshinii wɔtoŋ yɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ mɛni wɔɔye mɔ?’ 21Naa, mibajɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ bɔ ni ebaaba afii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ niyenii shi kome. 22Belɛ afi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ be mli ni nyɛdu nii lɛ, nyɛbaaye blema niyenii ni nyɛkpa nyɛto lɛ kɛyaashi afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛaakpa enɔ nii ni nyɛdu lɛ.
Nikpɔ̃mɔ lɛ
23“Akafo shikpɔŋ yibaa ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ owura kosɛɛ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mi minɔ ni; ni nyɛ lɛ miwe kɛ mishĩa mli gbɔi kɛkɛ ji nyɛ.
24“Nyɛŋmɛa shikpɔŋ kpɔ̃mɔ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu ni nyɛyaaŋɔ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he. 25Kɛji efi onyɛmi Israelnyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eehɔ̃ɔ egboshinii ko lɛ, ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ ebakpɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni enyɛmi lɛ hɔ̃ɔ lɛ. 26Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ bɛ mɔ ko ni aaayakpɔ̃ nii lɛ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ amrɔmrɔ nɔŋŋ, shi fee sɛɛ lɛ ena edɛŋ bɔ ni shɛɔ nii ni ehɔɔ lɛ kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ, 27no lɛ akane afii abɔ ni nii lɛ eye, kɛjɛ be ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ naa, koni mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ awo afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ shɛɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ eku sɛɛ eŋɔ enii lɛ. 28Shi kɛji mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ nyɛɛɛ eyakpɔ̃ nii lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ ahi mɔ ni he nii lɛ dɛŋ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ, ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ mli lɛ nihelɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ nii lɛ he, koni nɔtsɛ lɛ aŋɔ enii lɛ ekoŋŋ.
29“Kɛji mɔ ko hɔ̃ɔ eshĩa ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he mli lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ shĩa lɛ kɛyashi enɔ afi naakplɔ ni ekpɔ̃ɔ shĩa lɛ. 30Shi kɛji akpɔ̃ɔɔ shĩa nɛɛ kɛyashi afi muu ho lɛ, no lɛ shĩa nɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni he shĩa lɛ kɛ eshwiei agboshinii kɛmiiya naanɔ. Kɛji shɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ tete lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ he ehã mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ lɛ. 31Shi tsui ni yɔɔ akrowai ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe amli lɛ, abu amɛ tamɔ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Abaanyɛ akpɔ̃ amɛ be fɛɛ be; ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ amɛhe ahã tsutsu nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ. 32Shi yɛ Levibii amaji ni ahã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ amli shĩai lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Levibii lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛkpɔ̃ɔ eko fɛɛ eko ni ahɔ̃ɔ be fɛɛ be. 33Kɛji Levinyo ko kpɔ̃ɔɔ shĩa ko ni ehɔ̃ɔ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ aŋmɛɛ shĩa ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ Levibii amaŋ lɛ mli lɛ he ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ shĩai ni yɔɔ Levibii amaji lɛ amli lɛ, nomɛi ji Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋnii ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. 34Shi amɛmaji lɛ ahe shikpɔji lɛ akahɔ̃ɔ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni kɛmiiya naanɔ.”
Shika ni akɛfaa ohiafoi
35 “Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni enyɛɛɛ ehe ekwɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, omɔ mli ohã lɛ ni okwɛ lɛ; okɛ lɛ ahi shi akɛ gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo. 36Kaahe lɛ nɔ ko he kpa, ni kaaŋmɛ nyɔmɔ ko ni ewoɔ bo nɔ; shi oshe oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei; ni oŋmɛ onyɛmi Israelnyo lɛ gbɛ koni ehi omasɛi. 37 Kaahe lɛ oshika ni okɛfa lɛ lɛ he kpa; ni oniyenii ni ohãa lɛ lɛ hu kaaŋmɛ ejara nɔ. 38Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã nyɛ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Nyɔji aheyeli
39“Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã bo lɛ, okaye lɛ nyɔŋ, 40shi moŋ etsɔ̃ tamɔ apaafonyo loo gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo. Esɔmɔ bo kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ. 41Kɛji eshɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛ kɛ ebii kɛ hɔi fɛɛ ashi oŋɔɔ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛwekumɛi ateŋ kɛ eseshibii anɔ mli ekoŋŋ. 42Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni mijie amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji amɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ebɛ akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ nyɔŋ. 43Okaye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ; shi oshe oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei. 44Kɛji nyɛmiitao wehii kɛ weyei, nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei lɛ, nyɛyahea amɛ yɛ majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ amli. 45Nyɛbaanyɛ hu ni nyɛhe nyɔji kɛjɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ abii ni afɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛgboshinii; 46 ni nyɛaanyɛ nyɛshi amɛ nyɛhã nyɛbii akɛ amɛgboshinii. Amɛ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛye amɛ nyɔŋ, shi nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israel fɔmɔbii lɛ, amɛ lɛ, akaye amɛteŋ mɔ ko nɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.
47“Kɛji gbɔ ko loo mɔkpɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ tsɔ̃ niiatsɛ; shi onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ emasɛi lɛ ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã gbɔ loo mɔkpɔŋ lɛ loo gbɔ lɛ wekunyo ko lɛ, 48gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hehɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hegbɛ yɛ lolo akɛ akpɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Esa akɛ enyɛmi nuu ko, 49loo etsɛkwɛ̃ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ nyɛmibi loo ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa aya ayakpɔ̃ lɛ, loo kɛji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ena nɔ ko lɛ, ekpɔ̃ ehe. 50Ekɛ mɔ ni he lɛ lɛ abu akɔntaa kɛjɛ afi nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã lɛ lɛ, kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ; ni eyinii lɛ abu yɛ afii lɛ ayikulɛ naa. Be ni eye yɛ mɔ ni ehe lɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, abu lɛ akɛ apaayeli be. 51Kɛji eshwɛ afii pii dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ eyi shika ni ekɛbaakpɔ̃ ehe lɛ ada. 52Kɛji eshwɛ afii fioo ko kɛkɛ dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ po, mɔ ni he lɛ kɛ lɛ abu akɔntaa, koni akwɛ afii abɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, kɛna shika fioo ni sa akɛ ewo kɛkpɔ̃ ehe lɛ. 53Mɔ ni he lɛ lɛ abu lɛ tamɔ apaafonyo ni miitsu afi nii yɛ ekɛ lɛ shihilɛ mli. Enuŋtsɔ lɛ akaye enɔ kɛ yiwalɛ. 54Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ naaa mɔ ko atsɔ̃ gbɛi nɛɛ eko nɔ ni ebakpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe ni eye ehe, lɛ kɛ ebii ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ fɛɛ. 55Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni; amɛ ji mitsuji ni mijie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

Title: LEVITIKO 26
Content:
Toiboo sɛɛ Jɔɔmɔi
(Deuteronomio 7.12-24; 28.1-14)
1Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkafea amãgãi nyɛhãa nyɛhe, ni nyɛkɛ tɛ akamaa shiu ko, ni nyɛkakpɛa nɔ ko mfoniri yɛ tɛ mli hu nyɛkɛma shi yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkoto shi nyɛja lɛ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 2 Nyɛyea gbii juji ni mito lɛ, ni nyɛhiɛ asɔa he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.
3“Kɛji nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbu mikitãi lɛ, ni nyɛye amɛnɔ lɛ, 4mahã nu anɛ ahã nyɛ yɛ be ni sa mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba nii babaoo ahã nyɛ, ni ŋmɔshi tsei hu baawo yibii. 5 Nyɛbaakã he nyɛgbee ŋmãa ni nyɛku aahu kɛyaashi wainyibii tsemɔ be mli, ni nyɛbaahiɛ wainyibii tsemɔ nɛkɛ aahu kɛyashi nidumɔ be mli, ni nyɛaaye nyɛboloo nyɛtɔrɔ. Nyɛaahi nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.
6“Mahã jeŋ ajɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛaakamɔ shi nyɛwɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ nyɛhe gbeyei. Mahã kooloi fɔ̃ji atã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni awuŋ ta yɛ jɛi. 7Nyɛaawo nyɛhenyɛlɔi foi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ klante naa. 8Nyɛteiaŋ gbɔmɛi enumɔ kɛkɛ aaawo henyɛlɔi oha foi, ni nyɛmɛi oha hu aaawo henyɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma foi. Nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ aaanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ klante naa. 9Madro nyɛ, ni mahã nyɛwo shwiei ni nyɛyi afa; ni maye mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. 10Nyɛhiɛ abele kukudabi ni nyɛto lɛ yeli mli ni abele kpokploku baapue, ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛaajie kukudabi lɛ kɛje kpo koni ana toohe ahã kpokploku lɛ. 11Mahi nyɛteŋ yɛ miBuu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni minyaŋeŋ nyɛ. 12Manyiɛ nyɛteŋ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ. 13Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛkahi shi akɛ amɛnyɔji dɔŋŋ lɛ. Mikumɔ tsei ni akɛwo nyɛ apã lɛ, ni mihã nyɛnyiɛ ni apã kãaa nyɛkuɛ.”
Toigbele he toigbalamɔ
(Deuteronomio 28.15-68)
14“Shi kɛji nyɛbooo mi toi, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi nɛɛ anɔ; 15ni kɛji nyɛkwa mikpɔi lɛ, ni nyɛnyaŋe mimlai lɛ, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, 16mi hu nɔ ni mibafee nyɛ nɛ: Mibahã tsuifãa saji abahɛŋ nyɛ trukaa, ni wɔlɔmɔ kɛ atridii ni hãa hiŋmɛi fiteɔ, ni etãa gbɔmɔtso loo baaye nyɛ. Nyɛbaagbo deŋme yaka nyɛdu nii ejaakɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi moŋ baaba abaye. 17Majie mihiɛ maka nyɛ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi baaye nyɛnɔ, ni mɛi ni hetsɛ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aaaye nyɛnɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ, ni nyɛbaawo foi be mli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ nyɛsɛɛ.
18“Ni kɛji enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbooo mi toi lolo lɛ, no lɛ mibagbala nyɛtoi ekoŋŋ shii kpawo yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ, 19ni maku nyɛhe ni nyɛwoɔ kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ lɛ naa, ni mahã ŋwɛi agbi tamɔ dade, ni nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ aaagbi tamɔ akɔɔble, 20ni nyɛaagbo yaka deŋme ejaakɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baŋ niyenii, ni enɔ tsei lɛ hu woŋ yibii.
21“Kɛji nyɛfeee nɔ ni mi mitaoɔ, ni nyɛtee nɔ nyɛbooo mi toi lɛ, mayanɔ magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa. 22Maŋmɛɛ ŋaŋ kooloi ahe mawo nyɛteŋ, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛbii, ni amɛbaakpãtã nyɛshĩa kooloi ahiɛ, ni amɛbaahã nyɛ nɔ agbɔ, bɔ ni nane baaje nyɛgbɛjegbɛi anɔ.
23“Kɛji yɛ nɛkɛ toigbalamɔ nɛɛ hu fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsakeee, shi nyɛtee nɔ nyɛfee nɔ ni mitaooo lɛ, 24no lɛ mi hu mate shi mawo nyɛ, ni magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ. 25Mahã ta abanina nyɛ koni atsɔ̃ no nɔ kɛgbala nyɛtoi, kɛtɔ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mlikuu he owele. Kɛji nyɛbua nyɛhe naa yɛ nyɛmaji wuji amli, yɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ hewɔ hu lɛ, mibahã gbele hela abote nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anine aaashɛ nyɛnɔ. 26Mafo nyɛŋmãa ni nyɛnaa nyɛyeɔ sɛɛ lɛ; ni no baahã yei nyɔŋma ashã aboloo fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shãa lɛ yɛ flɔnɔɔ kome pɛ mli. Aboloo lɛ hu abaaŋmɛ kɛ nsɛni ahã nyɛ nyɛye; ni nyɛaaye nɛ shi nyɛtɔrɔŋ.
27“Ni kɛji yɛ enɛ fɛɛ hu sɛɛ lɛ nyɛbooo mi toi, shi nyɛfee nɔ ni mitaooo lɛ, 28no lɛ mi hu mate shi mawo nyɛ kɛ mlila, ni magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
29“Hɔmɔ naa lɛ nyɛbaagbe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei, nyɛye. 30Mibafite hei ni nyɛjaa yɛ, yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ ohɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ; ni mibashɛrɛ nyɛgbohii lɛ mashwie nyɛmãgãi ni akumɔ ashwie shi lɛ anɔ. 31Mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei lɛ hu; ni mihereŋ nyɛtsofakɛŋma lɛ ŋma dɔŋŋ. 32Makpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ bɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni aaabahi nɔ lɛ tete ahiɛ aaafee amɛ yaa. 33Ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mahã ta abanina nyɛ, ni magbɛ nyɛ mashwã majimaji ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ anɔ. Gbɔmɛi baatã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛmaji lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i. 34Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, belɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miijɔɔ ehe ekɛtse ehejɔɔmɔ be ni nyɛshã nyɛshwie lɛ. Belɛ ja nakai dani shikpɔŋ lɛ baana hegbɛ eye ehejɔɔmɔ be lɛ. 35Gbii abɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, belɛ ehejɔɔmɔ ni nyɛhã ŋmɛɛ lɛ be ni nyɛyɔɔ enɔ lɛ, no eyeɔ lɛ.
36“Ni nyɛteŋ mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ gbeyeilɔi feetɔi, mɛi ni baa ni etse kɛyaagbee shi gbɛɛmɔ kɛkɛ po baawo amɛ foi, ni amɛbaajo foi tamɔ ajoɔ klante naa foi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ. 37Ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, mɔ ko kã mɔ ko nɔ tamɔ mɛi ni miijo klante naa foi gbeɔ shi, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko woko amɛ foi; ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ahiɛ nyɛdamɔ. 38Nyɛaagboi yɛ maŋsɛɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, ni eeefee tamɔ nɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ emimii nyɛ. 39Ni nyɛteŋ mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ, mligbigblimɔ sɔŋŋ baagbegbee nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ hu nyɛaagbigbli nyɛmli tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛyaashi nyɛaagboi tamɔ amɛ.
40“Shi kɛji amɛjaje amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfee amɛshi mi, kɛ bɔ ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ bɔ ni mi mitaoɔ, 41ni no hewɔ hu mi hu mite shi miwo amɛ, ni mihã amɛyaje amɛhenyɛlɔi shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, kɛji amɛtsui ni ekpiliŋ lɛ he jɔ, ni amɛba amɛhe shi, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ ahe nyɔmɔwoo lɛ nɔ lɛ, 42 no lɛ mibakai mi kɛ Yakob teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ mi kɛ Isak teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, kɛ mi kɛ Abraham teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, ni mibakai amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ. 43Shi ja amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ lɛ ana aye ehejɔɔmɔ be lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, ja agbala amɛtoi kɛwo amɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛnyaŋe mikpɔi lɛ. 44Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, be mli ni amɛyɔɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, mikwaŋ amɛ, ni minyaŋeŋ amɛ bɔ ni no baahã makpãtã amɛhiɛ kwraa kɛku mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 45Shi amɛhewɔ lɛ, mibakai mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni mijie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, koni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.”
46Akpɔi kɛ kitãi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni ekã lɛ, Yehowa, kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ji enɛɛmɛi.

Title: LEVITIKO 27
Content:
Nibii ni akɛkeɔ Yehowa ahe mlai
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko je gbɛ, ni ewo shi krɛdɛɛ, ni ejɔɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi anɔ ekɛke Yehowa koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ jamɔhe lɛ, jara ni abaawo yɛ amɛyi kɛkpɔ̃ amɛ nɛ: 3Nuu ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa lɛ, eyi jara afee jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ. 4Kɛji yoo ni lɛ, no lɛ eyi jara lɛ afee jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. 5Yɛ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii enumɔ aahu kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, awo nuu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ yoo hu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma. 6Shi yɛ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔɔŋ kome aahu kɛyashi afii enumɔ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, awo nuu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ, kɛ yoo hu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli etɛ̃. 7Ni mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛyaa lɛ, nuu yi jara ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ, yoo hu yi jara ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma.
8“Kɛji mɔ ni wo shi lɛ ohiafo ni, ni enyɛɛɛ jara ni afo lɛ ewo lɛ, no lɛ ekpala gbɔmɔ ni ejɔɔ enɔ eke Yehowa lɛ kɛya osɔfo lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ awo egbɔmɔ lɛ yi jara. Osɔfo lɛ adamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni wo shi lɛ aaana ahã nɔ kɛwo jara lɛ.
9“Shi kɛji shĩa kooloo ji nɔ ni awo ehe shi ajɔɔ enɔ akɛhã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ, etsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 10Mɔ ni wo shi lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekɛ kooloo kroko toɔ najiaŋ aloo etsakeɔ; ekɛ kooloo kpakpa akato kooloo gbonyo najiaŋ lɛ, ekɛ kooloo gbonyo akatsake ekpakpa. Kɛji ekɛ kooloo tee emomo lɛ tsakemɔ lɛ, no lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo momo lɛ kɛ kooloo hee ni ekɛba tsakemɔ lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ Yehowa nii. 11Shi kɛji kooloo lɛ yafee kooloo ni he tseee, ni no hewɔ lɛ, akɛshãaa afɔle ahãaa Yehowa lɛ eko ni lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. 12Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ kpa ni yɔɔ kooloo lɛ he kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ koni ewo eyi jara. Jara ni osɔfo lɛ baawo lɛ, aŋɔ nɔ nakai. 13Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ ekooloo lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kooloo lɛ jara lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie kooloo lɛ yi jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo eyi nyɔmɔ.
14“Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ eshĩa nɔ eke Yehowa lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nibii ni hi kɛ nibii ni ehiii fɛɛ yɛ shĩa lɛ he koni ewo ejara; ni jara ni osɔfo lɛ baawo lɛ aŋɔ nɔ nakai. 15Ni kɛji mɔ ni jɔɔ eshĩa nɔ eke lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ eshĩa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ shĩa lɛ jara ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo shĩa lɛ he nyɔmɔ, ni shĩa lɛ baatsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ.
16“Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii nɔ ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akwɛ dumɔ wui ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yeɔ falɛ kɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ jara. Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo jara lɛ ji akoko kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ akɛhe jwiɛtɛi shekel nyɔŋma. 17Kɛji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afiyeli lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ adamɔ jara bɔ ni awo lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ. 18Kɛji afiyeli lɛ sɛɛ dani ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi ekoŋŋ yɛ shika mli koni akɛtse jara ni awo lɛ nɔ. 19Kɛji mɔ ni jɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ sumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jara ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo nyɔmɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ. 20Shi kɛji esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, aloo ehɔ̃ɔ ehã mɔ kroko ko lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehiŋ kpɔ̃mɔ dɔŋŋ. 21Ni kɛji eshɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ, ni aŋmɛɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he tete lɛ, ebaahi shi akɛ Yehowa nɔ, nɔ ko ni ajɔɔ nɔ owura kosɛɛ ake Yehowa; ebaatsɔ̃ osɔfo lɛ nɔ.
22“Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni jeee gbo agbo ashi ahã lɛ, shi etse shika ekɛhe, nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ, 23no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ naa kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ ehã mɔ lɛ, ni mɔ lɛ awo shika nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ akɛ shika lɛ ahã Yehowa akɛ enii yinii. 24Ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpale shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã mɔ dɛŋ ni ahe yɛ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii.
25“Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo jara fɛɛ jara afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ jwiɛtɛi tɛ lɛ naa; no ji akɛ gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ afee shekel kome.
26“Shi kooloi fɛɛ akromɔbii ni ji Yehowa nii momo lɛ, mɔ ko akajɔɔ eko nɔ ekɛmiike Yehowa: tsina ni jio, too ni jio, Yehowa nɔ ni momo. 27Shi kɛji kooloi ni ahe tseee lɛ eko kromɔbi ni lɛ, no lɛ akpɔ̃ lɛ yɛ jara tɛ ni afo lɛ naa; ni akɛ eyi jara ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo eyi nyɔmɔ. Shi kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ kpɔ̃ɔɔ ekooloo lɛ, no lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ jara ni awo lɛ kɛkɛ naa.
28 “Shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mɔ ko yɔɔ, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, shikpɔŋ ni agbo ashi ahã lɛ ni jio, ni ejɔɔ nɔ tswaa ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akahɔ̃ɔ, ni akakpɔ̃ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ lɛ eji Yehowa nii kɛmiiya naanɔ. 29Gbɔmɔ adesa tete ni akɛ lɛ eke koni akpãtã ehiɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, akakpɔ̃ lɛ; ana agbe lɛ kɛ̃.
30“Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmãa ni jio, aduawai ni jio, amɛmlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni; nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni. 31Kɛji mɔ ko sumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ egbɛfaŋ nibii lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome agbe yi kɛwo nyɔmɔ. 32Nakai nɔŋŋ ji tsinai kɛ toi: no ji kooloi fɛɛ ni akpalaa amɛ lɛ amɛyikulɛ nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eji Yehowa nɔ. 33 Akakpa mli akwɛ akɛ kooloo lɛ ehi aloo ehiii; ni akatsake hu. Kɛji mɔ ko aaatsake eko kɛ̃ lɛ, no lɛ no kɛ lɛ kooloo hee ni akɛbaatsake emomo lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm baatsɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; akakpɔ̃ kooloo lɛ.”
34Enɛɛmɛi ji kitãi ni Yehowa fã Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ewo Israelbii lɛ.

Title: NUMERI WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Israelbii Agbɛfaa wolo lɛ gbaa saji ni ba amɛshihilɛ mli yɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ mli; kɛjɛ be ni Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he aahu kɛyashi amɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa. Israelbii lɛ anyiɛmɔ nɛɛ mli sane wulu ko ni ba lɛ ji kanemɔ ni Mose kane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he dani amɛfã nyiɛmɔ lɛ. Fee sɛɛ aaafee yinɔ kome sɛɛ lɛ, akane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ ekoŋŋ. No mli lɛ amɛyashɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ. Kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ maŋbii akanemɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi maŋbii akanemɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yahi Kadesh Barnea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ. Shi moŋ amɛnyɛɛɛ jɛigbɛ amɛtsɔ̃ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni awo amɛ ehe shi lɛ nɔ. Amɛye afii babaoo yɛ Kadesh Barnea kpokpai anɔ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã kɛtee Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Israelbii akutsei lɛ ekomɛi wa nɛkɛ Yordan Faa shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kwraa. Shi akutsei krokomɛi lɛ saa amɛhe koni amɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Israelbii Agbɛfaa Wolo lɛ gbaa wɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi ahe sane; gbɔmɛi ni kɛji amɛkɛ haomɔ kpe pɛ kɛkɛ lɛ gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛnijiaŋ eje wui nɔŋŋ. Amɛtse Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose, ni ji gbɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ efã koni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ hiɛ atua. Wolo lɛ gbaa wɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ye eshiwoo nɔ ehã, ni etee nɔ ekura ewebii lɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛ lɛ amɛgbede ni amɛgbo enɔ toi. Egbaa wɔ bɔ ni Mose bo Nyɔŋmɔ toi kɛwula shi, kɛ bɔ ni esɔmɔ ejakumɛiabii lɛ ehã.
Mlijaramɔi
Bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ saa amɛhe dani amɛfã yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he 1.1—9.23
a. Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋbii Akanemɔ lɛ 1.1—4.49
b. Mlai srɔtoi ni awowoi 5.1—8.26
d. Hehoo Gbijurɔyeli ni ji Enyɔ lɛ 9.1-23
Gbɛfãa kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he kɛtee Moab lɛ 10.1—21.35
Saji ni ba yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ 22.1—32.42
Gbɛfãa kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛtee Moab lɛ 33.1-49
Yordan Faa lɛ foo he Akpɔi 33.50—36.13

Title: NUMERI 1
Content:
Israelbii ayikulɛ kanemɔ, klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ̃
1Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 2 “Nyɛkanea Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa. Aŋmala hii fɛɛ agbɛii 3kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa. Bo kɛ Aaron akane mɛi lɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa. 4Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli nuu kome ni ji onukpa yɛ etsɛmɛi awe afata nyɛhe.” 5Hii, akutseiaŋ onukpai, ni ahala akɛfata Mose kɛ Aaron he koni amɛtsu nii lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Ruben akutso lɛ fã Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ; 6ni Simeon akutso lɛ fã Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ; 7 ni Yuda akutso lɛ fã Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ. 8Isakar akutso lɛ fã Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ, 9ni Zebulon akutso lɛ fã Eliab, Helon bi lɛ; 10 ni Efraim akutso lɛ, ni ji Yosef shwiei lɛ, fã Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ; ni Manase akutso, ni ji Yosef nɔŋŋ shwiei hu, fã Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ. 11Benyamin akutso lɛ fã Abidan, Gideoni bi lɛ; 12ni Dan akutso lɛ fã Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ; 13ni Asher akutso lɛ fã Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ; 14Gad akutso lɛ fã Eliasaf, Deuel bi lɛ; 15ni Naftali akutso lɛ fã Ahira, Enan bi lɛ. 16Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji hiɛnaanɔbii, ni asaŋ amɛ ji amɛtsɛmɛi akutsei lɛ amli onukpai, ni ahala amɛ, ni afee amɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ. 17Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔ hii ni atsi amɛgbɛii atã nɛɛ amɛfata amɛhe, 18ni amɛbua Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛŋmala maŋbii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa. Hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ aŋmala amɛgbɛii ni akane amɛyibɔ. 19Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ, nakai efee, ni ekɛkane Israel asafo lɛ yikulɛ yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. 20Akɛjɛ Ruben ni ji Israel kromɔbi lɛ bihii lɛ ashwiei lɛ anɔ, ni aŋmala hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ni asaŋ amɛshɛ tayaa lɛ agbɛii ekomekome yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
21Rubenbii ayikulɛ ni ana ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
22Ni Simeon shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
23mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ ohai etɛ̃.
24Ni Gad shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
25mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
26Yuda shwiei lɛ kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
27mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
28Ni Isakar shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
29mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
30Ni Zebulon shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
31mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
32Efraim shwiei lɛ, ni jɛ Yosef mli lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
33mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
34Ni Manase shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
35mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
36Ni Benyamin shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
37mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
38Dan shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
39mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.
40Ni Asher shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
41mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai enumɔ.
42Ni Naftali shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee
43mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
44Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Israel maŋ onukpai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa ni wa Mose kɛ Aaron kɛkane amɛyikulɛ lɛ. 45No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ni akane amɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei anaa akɛ mɛi ni eshɛ tayaa lɛ, 46 amɛyikulɛ fee mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
47Shi Levibii lɛ akaneee amɛ ashiii akutsei krokomɛi lɛ anɔ, 48ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 49“Kɛji okane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ, okakane Levibii lɛ oshi nɔ. 50Moŋ akɛ miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni fata he lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ awo amɛdɛŋ. Amɛ amɛtere Buu lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛkura Buu lɛ. Ni kɛji ato shi yɛ he ko lɛ, amɛmãmɔ amɛwɔɔhei amɛkɛbɔle Buu lɛ he kpula kɛkpe. 51 Kɛji maŋ lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Levibii lɛ afã Buu lɛ, ni kɛji shɛ be ni abaashi Buu lɛ, Levibii lɛ nɔŋŋ ashi. Mɔ folo fɛɛ mɔ folo ni aaabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ agbe lɛ. 52Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ ashi amɛbuui yɛ amɛsafo kuikui lɛ anaa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ buu ahi esafo shitoohe mli, ni asaŋ yɛ etsɛmɛi awe aflaŋaa shishi. 53Shi Levibii lɛ ashishii amɛbui lɛ kɛbɔle miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; amɛbu he bɔ ni afee ni mɔ folo ko akabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ ni no yatsɛ mimlifu bahã Israelbii lɛ.” 54Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee lɛ.

Title: NUMERI 2
Content:
Bɔ ni akutsei lɛ jwereɔ shi yɛ shitoohe lɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, 2“Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi ebuu yɛ esafo shitoohe, yɛ etsɛmɛi awe aflaŋaa lɛ shishi. Amãmɔ bui fɛɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ kɛbɔle lɛ kpula kɛkpe.
3“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda aflaŋaa lɛ shishi baashi amɛbui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ bokãgbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa; ni amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ. 4Ta ni yɔɔ eshishi lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa. 5Mɛi ni ashitoohe baatsa Yudabii lɛ anɔ ji Isakarbii lɛ, ni amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ; 6ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ lɛ. 7Kɛkɛ lɛ Zebulon akutso lɛ etsa Isakarbii lɛ hu anɔ, kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Eliab, Helon bi lɛ. 8Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ejwɛ. 9No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai ejwɛ. Amɛ esa akɛ amɛnyiɛ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ lɛ.
10“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ruben aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ wuoyigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa. Rubenbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ, 11ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ. 12Mɛi ni ashitoohe baatsa Rubenbii lɛ anɔ ji Simeon akutso lɛ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ; 13ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ ohai etɛ̃. 14Kɛkɛ lɛ Gad akutso lɛ atsa Simeonbii lɛ hu anɔ. Gadbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa lɛ ji Eliasaf, Reuel bi lɛ, 15ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. 16No hewɔ lɛ, Ruben aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Amɛ amɛ ji asafo ni ji enyɔ ni baafã kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ.
17“Kɛkɛ lɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hu baafã kɛnyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ ateŋ. Bɔ ni ato naa abato shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaato naa kɛfã nyiɛmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anyiɛ egbɛhe yɛ aflaŋaa shishi.
18“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Efraim aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ anaigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa. Efraimbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ; 19ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ. 20Manasebii lɛ atsa Efraim akutso lɛ nɔ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ; 21ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ. 22Kɛkɛ lɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ hu atsa Manase akutso lɛ nɔ. Benyaminbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Abidan, Gideoni bi lɛ, 23ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ. 24No hewɔ lɛ, Efraim aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ oha. Amɛ, amɛ ji asafo ni ji etɛ̃ ni baafã kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ.
25“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Dan aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kooyigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa. Danbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ; 26ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo. 27Asherbii lɛ atsa Dan akutso lɛ nɔ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ; 28ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai enumɔ. 29Kɛkɛ lɛ Naftali akutso lɛ hu atsa Asherbii lɛ anɔ. Naftalibii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Ahira, Enan bi lɛ. 30Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ. 31No hewɔ lɛ, Dan aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ekpaa.”
32Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni akane yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa yɛ amɛshitoohei lɛ amli naa shiɔ mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. 33Shi akaneee Levibii lɛ ashiii Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ.
34No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ. Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe lɛ, amɛtoɔ shi yɛ amɛflaŋaai lɛ ashishi; ni kɛji amɛfã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ tsɛmɛiawei lɛ anaa.

Title: NUMERI 3
Content:
Aaron musuŋbii lɛ
1 Be mli ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bii ni Aaron kɛ Mose yɔɔ lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: 2 Aaron bihii lɛ ji Nadab, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar. 3Aaron fɔ ebihii nɛɛ mu, ni ewo amɛ osɔfo koni amɛtsu osɔfoyeli nitsumɔ. 4 Shi Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi be ni amɛhiɛ la ko ni he tseee kɛtee Yehowa hiɛ be ni ayɔɔ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Amɛshiii bii. Eleazar kɛ Itamar pɛ sɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi yɛ amɛtsɛ Aaron walabeiaŋ.
Ato Levibii lɛ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ awalɔi
5Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 6 “Ŋɔɔ Levi akutso lɛ kɛba ni owo amɛ yelikɛbualɔi, mɛi ni baawa Osɔfo Aaron yɛ esɔfoyeli nitsumɔ lɛ mli. 7Amɛbaasɔ̃mɔ kɛtsu nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni kɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he, ni amɛbaatsu nii amɛhã Osɔfo Aaron kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hu. 8Amɛbaakwɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli saamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛbaawa maŋbii foji lɛ kɛji amɛba koni amɛbaja yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ. 9Ojɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. Oŋɔ amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni ojɔɔ amɛnɔ kwraa ohã koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii osɔfoi lɛ. 10Ojɔɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ ohã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ pɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ efee ehe osɔfo lɛ agbe lɛ.”
11Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 12 “Naa, miŋɔ Levibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ mikɛmiito kromɔbii ni gbeleɔ musu naa yɛ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ anajiaŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, Levibii lɛ etsɔ̃ minɔ. 13Ejaakɛ gbi ni migbe Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii akromɔbii fɛɛ anɔ mihã mihe, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ kromɔbi nɔ kɛyashi shĩa kooloo kromɔbi nɔ. Minii ji amɛ fɛɛ. Mi ji Yehowa.”
Levibii lɛ akanemɔ
14Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai shiaŋa lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 15“Kanemɔ Levi we lɛ hii fɛɛ kɛjɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛwekui anaa.” 16Mose kane amɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 17 Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃, ni amɛgbɛii ji Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari. 18Gershon bihii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui anaa ji Libni kɛ Shimei. 19Kohat yɛ bihii ejwɛ; amɛgbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa ji Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel, 20ni Merari bihii enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa ji Maheli kɛ Mushi. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii lɛ awekui lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
21Gershon shwiei lɛ ji Libnibii lɛ kɛ Shimeibii lɛ. 22Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ, ana mɛi akpei kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ. 23Gershonbii awekui nɛɛ lɛ, akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛ ni ji anaigbɛ hã amɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbui lɛ yɛ jɛi. 24Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli wekunukpa lɛ ji Eliasaf, Lael bi lɛ. 25Amɛ amɛdɛŋ atu nibii nɛɛ anɔkwɛmɔ kɛ kuramɔ awo: Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ buu lɛ yiteŋ nɔhaanɔ lɛ, kɛ eshinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ, 26kɛ kpo ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ he mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai lɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ hu. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
27Kohat shwiei lɛ ji Amrambii lɛ kɛ Izeharbii lɛ kɛ Hebronbii lɛ kɛ Uzielbii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Kohatbii lɛ. 28Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ ana mɛi akpei kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa. 29Kohatbii awekui nɛɛ lɛ akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kɛyaa wuoyigbɛ lɛ hã amɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbui lɛ yɛ jɛi. 30 Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpa lɛ ji Elizafan, Uziel bi lɛ. 31 Nibii ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ ji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ muhɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
32Levibii lɛ anukpa fe fɛɛ ji Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron bi lɛ; ni lɛ ekwɛɔ mɛi ni tsuɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ.
33Merari shwiei lɛ ji Mahelibii lɛ kɛ Mushibii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Meraribii lɛ. 34Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ, ana mɛi akpei ekpaa kɛ ohai enyɔ. 35Meraribii nɛɛ awekui lɛ fɛɛ awekunukpa lɛ ji Zuriel, Abihail bi lɛ. Ahã Meraribii nɛɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ koŋ nɔ kɛyaa kooyigbɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbui lɛ yɛ jɛi. 36Nibii ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ ni amɛkwɛ nɔ ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nibii ni ji mplaŋi lɛ kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ, kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛhe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni. 37Amɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ kpo lɛ he akulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛ amɛhe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ taŋkpei lɛ hã koni amɛkwɛ nɔ.
38Shi mɛi ni baamãmɔ amɛbui yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ ni amɛkɛ jɛi afee amɛshihilɛhe ji Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ kusumi fɛɛ ni sa akɛ atsu ahã Israel maŋbii lɛ, amɛ esa akɛ amɛtsu. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛ ehe aaawo amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe lɛ. 39Levibii hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ amɛwekui anaa yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ ayikulɛ shɛɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Levibii lɛ ye kromɔ bihii anajiaŋ
40Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋmaa Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ; kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, agbɛii koni okane amɛyikulɛ, 41ni otse Levibii lɛ ohã mi, Yehowa, koni okɛ amɛ ato Israelbii kromɔ bihii lɛ fɛɛ anajiaŋ. Nakai nɔŋŋ oŋɔ̃ Levibii ashĩa kooloi ohã mi koni okɛto Israelbii fɛɛ ashĩa kooloi akromɔ bihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ.” 42Mose kane Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 43Kromɔ bihii ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa agbɛii ni aŋma lɛ ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃.
44Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 45“Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ, ni ojɔɔ Levibii ashĩa kooloi anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ashĩa kooloi akromɔbihii anajiaŋ. Levibii lɛ minii ji amɛ. Mi, mi ji Yehowa. 46Israelbii akromɔbihii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃ ni edɛŋ Levibii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akpɔ̃ amɛ. 47Hemɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ yɛ mɔ kome yi, shekel kome feɔ garai nyɔŋmai enyɔ. 48Ni shika ni akɛbaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni edɛŋ nɔ nɛɛ lɛ okɛhã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ.” 49No hewɔ lɛ, Mose he shika ni awo akɛkpɔ̃ mɛi ni edɛŋ Levibii lɛ anɔ lɛ, 50yɛ Israelbii lɛ akromɔbii lɛ adɛŋ. Ena jwiɛtɛi shekeli akpe kome kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ; 51ni Mose kɛ mɛi ni akpɔ̃ lɛ shika lɛ hã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ efee lɛ.

Title: NUMERI 4
Content:
Kohatbii, Levibii lɛ, agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Kanemɔ Kohatbii ni yɔɔ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ ayikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, 3kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii. 4Kohatbii lɛ anitsumɔ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he lɛ kɔɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe.
5“Kɛji maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyajie muhɔɔ ni tsiɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛ muhɔɔ nɛɛ aha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he. 6No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ abotia hewolo aha muhɔɔ ni akɛha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he lɛ nɔ; ni yɛ no hu sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ mama bluu krɔŋŋ alɛɛ Adeka lɛ nɔ. Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
7“Amɛkɛ mama bluu aha okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Yehowa aboloo lɛ mãa nɔ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛkɛ plɛtei lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma woɔ mli lɛ, kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ kpuji ni akɛ afɔleshãa dãa woɔ mli lɛ amãmɔ nɔ. Be fɛɛ be lɛ aboloo amã okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ. 8Kɛkɛ lɛ alɛɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ lɛ mli akɛha okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ abotia hewolo alɛɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ lɛ nɔ; ni no hu sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
9 “Amɛkɔ mama bluu, ni amɛkɛha kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe kanei lɛ, kɛ lagbeenii lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kanei lɛ woɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ ahe. 10No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛfi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛwo abotia wolo mli koni amɛkɛwo tso adeka ni akɛtereɔ lɛ mli.
11“Shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, amɛlɛɛ mama bluu lɛ mli amɛkɛha nɔ, koni amɛkɛ abotia wolo aha mama bluu lɛ hu nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ latɛ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli. 12Amɛfi tsɛnsii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ amɛwo mama bluu mli; ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛfi nii lɛ ekoŋŋ amɛwo abotia hewolo mli. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛma nɔ ni akɛtereɔ lɛ nɔ. 13Amɛloo lamlu fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ mama afaseo aha latɛ lɛ nɔ; 14ni amɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ashwie latɛ lɛ nɔ. Nibii nɛɛ ji lajee tsɛnsii lɛ, kɛ fakai lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ. Akɛ abotia hewolo aha nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli. 15 Kɛji Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ eha Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Buu lɛ mli nibii lɛ hu fɛɛ ahe amɛgbe naa, ni maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, no mli dani Kohatbii lɛ abahole nibii lɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnine akata nibii lɛ eko he koni amɛkagboi. Enɛɛmɛi ji Kpee Buu lɛ he nibii ni Kohatbii lɛ baatere lɛ.
16“Nibii ni atu awo Osɔfo Eleazar, Aaron bi lɛ, dɛŋ koni ekwɛ nɔ ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ daa niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ, kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.”
17Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, 18“Nyɛkahãa Kohatbii akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ ashishi miibule yɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ, 19kɛtsɔ̃ gboimɔ ni amɛaagboi kɛji amɛmiibɛŋkɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ. Shi moŋ nɔ ni nyɛfee nyɛhã amɛ koni amɛyi ana wala ji akɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ abote Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Kohatbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ kɛ ejatsu hu. 20 Ejaakɛ kɛji Kohatbii lɛ bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli ni amɛhiŋmɛi gba nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbaagboi.”
Gershonbii, Levibii lɛ, agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi
21Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 22“Kanemɔ Gershonbii lɛ hu ayikulɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa, 23kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii. 24Jatsui ni Gershonbii lɛ atere ji: 25Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ mama ni haa Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ abotia hewolo ni haa Buu lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ. 26Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtere kpo lɛ ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai nɛɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni. 27Jatsu ni Gershonbii lɛ baatere kɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni amɛbaatsu lɛ, amɛbaafee yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ afãmɔ naa; ni nyɛ nyɛkɛ jatsui fɛɛ ni amɛbaatere lɛ baawo amɛdɛŋ. 28Enɛɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Gershonbii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.”
Meraribii, Levibii lɛ, agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi
29Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kanemɔ Meraribii lɛ hu ayikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, 30kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsuɔ nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii. 31Ni jatsui ni amɛbaatere kɛ amɛnitsumɔ fɛɛ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ, kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ, kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, 32kɛ kpo lɛ he akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii ni amɛmamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ taŋkpei lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu. Ni nyɛtsɔ̃a mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ejatsu ni ebaatere lɛ gbɛi. 33Enɛɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Meraribii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.”
Levibii lɛ ayikulɛ kanemɔ
34Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kane Kohatbii hii lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa. 35Kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsuɔ nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii. 36Mɛi ni ana lɛ ayikulɛ ji mɛi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ 37be ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane Kohatbii hii lɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he lɛ. 38Gershonbihii ni akane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, 39kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ, 40amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. 41Gershonbii hii ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa, koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ ayikulɛ nɛ. 42Meraribihii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni akane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, 43kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ, 44amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enyɔ. 45Meraribihii ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ naa lɛ nɛ. 46No hewɔ lɛ, Levibii hii fɛɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, 47kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli loo Kpee Buu lɛ he loo jatsu teremɔ lɛ, 48amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.
49Mose nine nɔ atsɔ̃ akane Levibii nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa, ni Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɔŋŋ adamɔ ni ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ kɛ ejatsu.

Title: NUMERI 5
Content:
Mɛi ni ahe tseee
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2 “Fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛ jie mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miiye kpiti aloo ehe miiho nu aloo eta gbonyo he ekɛbule ehe yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ. 3Nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ, nyɛjiea amɛ kɛyaa koni amɛkabule shitoohe lɛ he ni mihiɔ nyɛteŋ yɛ lɛ.”
4Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose lɛ, ni amɛ jie gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ato tɔ̃mɔ najiaŋ
5Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 6 “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nuu ko loo yoo ko booo Yehowa toi, ni efee enaanyo esha, ni ekɛkwa Yehowa ni nakai mɔ lɛ ye fɔ lɛ, 7no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ, ni eto mɔ ni efee lɛ esha lɛ najiaŋ; asaŋ ekɛ nii ni ekɛtoɔ mɔ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome afata he ehã mɔ lɛ. 8Shi kɛji mɔ nɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ egbo, ni anaaa ewekunyo ko ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ koni akɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ ahã mɔ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ atsɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni akɛhã osɔfo lɛ; esoro ojwɛni ni tɔ̃lɔ lɛ baahã koni akɛshã afɔle ekɛdãi efɔŋ ni efee lɛ. 9Asaŋ nibii fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛaabahã akɛ amɛkɛbake Yehowa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni. 10Osɔfo fɛɛ osɔfo lɛ, nii ni akɛaabahã lɛ lɛ, enɔ ni.”
Kɛji nuu kɛɛ eŋa eje esɛɛ
11Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 12“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nuu ko ŋa je esɛɛ, 13ni ehã nuu kroko kɛ lɛ bɔ, ni etɔ̃ ewu lɛ nɔ, shi eshiu ewu lɛ sane nɛɛ nɔ ejaakɛ odasefonyo bɛ he, ni asaŋ amɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ yoo lɛ ena ebule ehe 14loo kɛji awuŋayeli te shi yɛ nuu ko mli, ni eye eŋa he awuŋã lɛ, yoo lɛ ebule ehe jio, ebuleko ehe jio, 15nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Nuu lɛ ahiɛ akoko mamu kilo kome hu kɛba. Ekɛ mu akashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ krɔbɔo hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ eji awuŋayeli he niyenii afɔle ni akɛmiitao anɔkwale lɛ ale.’
16“Osɔfo lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba, ni ehã ebadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ. 17 Osɔfo lɛ kɛ nu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko awo su kpulu mli, ni ekpiti shikpɔŋ su yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ewo nu lɛ mli. 18Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ afɛne yoo lɛ yitsɔi yɛ eyiteŋ beiaŋ ni edamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ mamu, ni ji niyenii afɔle ni akɛjieɔ mɔ shi lɛ, ahã yoo lɛ ni ehiɛ. Osɔfo lɛ ahiɛ nu ni joɔ ni gbalaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, 19koni ekamɔ kitã eshwie yoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nuu kroko kɛ bo ebɔko, ni ojeko owu sɛɛ owoko ohe muji lɛ, no lɛ ohe aje loomɔ ni nu ni joɔ nɛɛ gbalaa kɛbaa lɛ mli; 20shi kɛji oje owu lɛ sɛɛ, ni nuu kroko kɛ bo ebɔ, ni owo ohe muji lɛ, 21(Osɔfo lɛ alomɔ yoo lɛ agbɛnɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ) no lɛ Yehowa ahã otsɔ̃ musumɔ ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛlomɔɔ, aloo akɛkãa kitã yɛ omaŋbii ateŋ. Yehowa ahã oyoohe abɛ, ni omusu afuu. 22Kɛji nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ ni gbalaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ bote omli lɛ, ehã omusu afũu, ni oyoohe abɛ.’ ”
Yoo lɛ ahere osɔfo lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Amen. Amen!”
23Osɔfo lɛ aŋmã loomɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɔ ko nɔ; no sɛɛ lɛ, efɔ niŋmaa lɛ ewo nu ni joɔ lɛ mli, 24ni ehã yoo lɛ anu nu ni joɔ ni gbalaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, koni kɛji nu lɛ bote yoo lɛ mli lɛ epiŋ lɛ waa. 25Dani yoo lɛ baanu nu lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ahe mamu ni ji niyenii afɔle lɛ ni akɛjieɔ mɔ shi lɛ yɛ yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ewo afɔle lɛ nɔ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. 26Osɔfo lɛ akpiti niyenii afɔle lɛ edɛ̃ kɔkɔ obɔ̃ kome, akɛ nɔ ni ekɛmiiye he odase, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ ehã yoo lɛ anu nu lɛ. 27Kɛji yoo lɛ eje ewu lɛ sɛɛ ekɛwo ehe muji lɛ, kɛji enu nu ni joɔ lɛ ni ebote emli lɛ, nu lɛ baahã epiŋ waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni emusu baafũu, ni eyoohe baabɛ, ni lɛ yoo lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ musumɔ yɛ emaŋbii ateŋ. 28Shi kɛji yoo lɛ ejeko ewu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe baaje loomɔ lɛ mli, ni ebaawo shwiei.
29Enɛ ji mla ni kɔɔ nuu awuŋayeli he lɛ. Kɛji yoo je ewu sɛɛ ni ewo ehe muji, 30aloo nuu ye eŋa he awuŋã akɛ eje esɛɛ lɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba koni yoo lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ atsu yoo lɛ he nii yɛ nɛkɛ mla nɛɛ naa pɛpɛɛpɛ. 31Nuu lɛ yeŋ sɔ̃ ko kwraa; shi yoo lɛ kɛji etɔ̃ lɛ no lɛ eyi sɔ̃ lɛ aaatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ.

Title: NUMERI 6
Content:
Nazirnyofeemɔ he mlai
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘nuu fɛɛ nuu loo yoo fɛɛ yoo ni eje gbɛ ewo shi akɛ eeefee ehe Nazirnyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ, 3 ekanu wain loo dãa ni wa; ekanu vinega ni akɛ wainyibii loo dãa ni wa fee. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ wainyibii fee lɛ ekanu; ni wainyibii ŋmɔŋ jio, nɔ ni aka lɛ egbiŋ jio, ekaye. 4Bei abɔ fɛɛ ni etsɛɔ ehe Nazirnyo lɛ ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛ wain tso he nɔ ko fee. Eyibii lɛ mli wui tete loo ehetoto po ekaye eko.’
5 “Kɛyaashi eeeye ebe ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa etã lɛ, ekaku eyi, ni yishɛɛ kakla naa akasa eyiteŋ. Shiwoo lɛ fĩɔ lɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ. Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ; ni eŋmɛ eyi kusuu. 6Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekaya gbonyo ko masɛi 7 Kɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ loo enyɛmi nuu loo enyɛmi yoo tete gbo lɛ, ekaya gbonyo lɛ masɛi ni ekɛbule ehe, yɛ ehe nɔ ni ejɔɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ 8bei abɔ fɛɛ ni Nazirnyo ji lɛ lɛ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ hã Yehowa.
9“Kɛji mɔ ko tswa shi egbo trukaa yɛ emasɛi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebule eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ ni ejɔɔ nɔ lɛ, eshɛ eyi lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛtsuu ehe. 10 Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpoi bibii enyɔ ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. 11Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ okpoi lɛ ekome koni ekɛshã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome lɛ hu ashã shãa afɔle koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ; ejaakɛ gbonyo lɛ ewo ehe muji. Nakai gbi lɛ, mɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ ejɔɔ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ehã Yehowa. 12Esaa ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa ekoŋŋ ejaakɛ be ni ewo shi tsuutsu lɛ eho. Ekɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu ni eye afi aba ekɛbashã fɔyeli he afɔle, ejaakɛ ebule ehe nɔ ni ejɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhã be ni eye momo lɛ efee yaka.
13 “Kɛji Nazirnyo eye be ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa egbe naa lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ: akɛ lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. 14Ehiɛ edɛŋ toi etɛ̃ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ni akɛshã afɔle akɛhã Yehowa nɛkɛ: ekɛ gwantɛŋ binuu ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle, ni ekɛ gwantɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ too ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shidaa afɔle. 15Ehiɛ nibii nɛɛ hu efata kooloi lɛ ahe: aboloo ni akɛŋmãa mã akpiti ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛntɛŋ kome, kɛ akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mamu muɛmuɛ fɛɛfɛo ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛ mã akpiti aboloo kekeree ni akpa hiɛ fɔ. Ekɛ abele kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ hu ashi nɔ.
16“Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ̃ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni ekɛshã esha he afɔle lɛ kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ ehã Nazirnyo lɛ. 17Ekɛ too ojwɛni lɛ afata mã akpiti aboloo kɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ he koni ekɛshã shidaa afɔle ekɛhã Yehowa. Osɔfo lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔle lɛ he niyenii kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ hu afata he. 18 Nazirnyo lɛ ashɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ni eto kɛjɛ be ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ, koni eloo eyitsɔi lɛ ewo la ni yɔɔ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ shishi lɛ mli.
19“Kɛji loo lɛ be lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɔ ojwɛni lɛ nine kome, ni ekɛfata kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli mã akpiti aboloo lɛ akwaabɔ kome kɛ akpiti akpãanɔɔ hu kome he koni ekɛwo Nazirnyo lɛ dɛŋ be ni eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ sɛɛ. 20 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ahe afɔle lɛ ni efɔ̃ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ akɛ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nii nɛɛ ji nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛhãa osɔfo lɛ kɛfataa too lɛ tsitsinaa lɛ kɛ eshuɔ lɛ he. Agbɛnɛ Nazirnyo lɛ baanyɛ enu wain kɛjɛ enɛ sɛɛ.
21“Mla kɛ kusum ni yɔɔ afɔle ni esa akɛ Nazirnyo, mɔ ni ewo shi kɛjɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa, nɛ. Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ ewo shi fe tɛ ni afo afɔ̃ shi ahã Nazirnyo lɛ, no lɛ eye eshiwoo lɛ nɔ, ehã bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.”
