22Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 23 “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ kɛji amɛmiijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ,
24 ‘Yehowa ajɔɔ bo, ni eto bo!
25 Yehowa atse ehiɛ ehã bo, ni eduro bo.
26 Yehowa ana bo mɔbɔ, ni ehã bo hejɔlɛ!’
27“Kɛji amɛtsɛ migbɛi nɛkɛ amɛkɛjɔɔ Israelbii lɛ, mibajɔɔ maŋbii lɛ.”

Title: NUMERI 7
Content:
Afɔlei ni maŋ onukpai lɛ ashã
1 Gbi ni Mose gbe Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ekɛtsuu amɛhe, ni asaŋ efɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ hu mu nakai nɔŋŋ ekɛfee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. 2Maŋbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi ni ji Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ anɔ onukpai, ni ji akutsei lɛ atsɛmɛi, mɛi nɔŋŋ hu ni kwɛ maŋbii lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 3hiɛ amɛdɛŋ nikeenii kɛba amɛkɛbahã Yehowa. Nibii nɛɛ ji shwiilii ekpaa ni awo amɛ nibii obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; shwiilii lɛ, onukpai enyɔ anɔ ekome, ni tsinai lɛ mɔ kome nɔ ekome. Amɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ba Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ. 4Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 5“Hemɔ nibii ni amɛkɛba lɛ koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii. Ojara ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ naa.” 6No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ shwiilii kɛ nibii lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ hã Levibii lɛ. 7Ehã Gershonbii lɛ shwiilii enyɔ kɛ tsinai hu ejwɛ, 8 ni ehã Meraribii lɛ shwiilii ejwɛ kɛ tsinai hu kpaanyɔ. Ekɛ nibii lɛ wo Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ kui nɛɛ anɔ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli. 9Shi Kohatbii lɛ shwiili jio, tsina jio, Mose hãaa amɛ eko ejaakɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni amɛkwɛɔ nɔ lɛ, kɔ̃ŋ nɔ atereɔ yɛ.
10 Maŋ onukpai lɛ hiɛ nikeenii hu kɛba gbi ni afɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mu lɛ. Be ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ amɛnikeenii lɛ ba lɛ amɛshã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, 11Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Onukpai lɛ aba mɔ kome mɔ kome amɛkɛ amɛnikeenii lɛ abahã, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbi ni ato ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ koni akɛjɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ kɛgbele naa.” 12Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ni kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã ji Nahashon ni eji Aminadab bi, ni lɛ ji Yuda akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ. 13Enikeenii lɛ fee jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ koni akɛshã niyenii afɔle. 14Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, 15tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle, 16kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle, 17kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ too ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
18Gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Netanel ni ji Zuar bi, ni lɛ ji Isakar akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã. 19Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle. 20Nikee nii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, 21tsina oblanyo kome kɛ too ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle, 22kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle, 23kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. 24Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Eliab ni eji Helon bi ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Zebulon akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã. 25Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni etsiimɔ ji kilo kome kɛ fã, kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle. 26Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, 27kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle 28kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle 29kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Eliab ni ji Helon bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
30Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Elizur ni eji Shedeur shwie ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Ruben akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã. 31Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. 36Gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Shelumiel ni eji Zurishadai bi, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Simeon akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ baha. 37Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ; jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Ahiezer ni ji Amishadai bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
72Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ lɛ, Pagiel ni eji Okran bi, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Asher akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã. 73Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle. 74Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma 75kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle 76kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle 77kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Pagiel ni ji Okran bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
78Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahira ni eji Enan bi lɛ, ni lɛ ji Naftali akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã. 79Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
80Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma 81kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle; 82kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle 83kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Ahira, Enan bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ ji enɛ.
84Nibii fɛɛ ni Israel akutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛbahã koni akɛshã afɔle kɛgbele afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa gbi nɔ ni afɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mu kɛjɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛtei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolui hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ shika tsɛnsii hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. 85Jwiɛtɛi plɛtei lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ okpolu fɛɛ okpolu ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo. Jwiɛtɛi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ tsiimɔ ji shekeli akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. 86Shika okpolui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛmli tsofakɛŋma obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma, shika ŋmiiŋmi okpolui lɛ fɛɛ feɔ shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ. 87Tsinai ni akɛbahã koni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ ayibɔ ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Abahã ojwɛnii hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii ni eye afi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle hu. Abahã too kpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ hu ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle. 88Kooloi fɛɛ ni akɛbahã koni akɛshã shidaa afɔle lɛ ayibɔ ji tsinai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ojwɛnii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ too kpakpoi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii ni eye afi nyɔŋmai ekpaa. Nibii nɛɛ akɛbahã koni akɛshã afɔle kɛgbele afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa be ni afɔ latɛ lɛ mu kɛtsuu he sɛɛ lɛ.
89 Be ni Mose bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni ekɛ Yehowa ayawie lɛ, enu Yehowa gbee ni ekɛ lɛ, Mose lɛ, miiwie kɛjɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ gbɛ yɛ kerubim enyɔ lɛ ateŋ.

Title: NUMERI 8
Content:
Akɛ kanetsei lɛ mamɔ̃ shi
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ kɛji ekɛ kanei lɛ miimamɔ kanetsei kpawo lɛ anɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ amãmɔ shi bɔ ni amɛbaakpɛ kɛya kanetso lɛ hiɛgbɛ.” 3Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ, ni ekɛ kanei lɛ mamɔ shi bɔ ni amɛbaakpɛ kɛya kanetso lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
4 Bɔ ni kanetso lɛ yɔɔ ji akɛ atswia lɛ shika sɔŋŋ nii kɛjɛ eshitamɔnɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛmɔ ehe fɔfɔii lɛ aahu kɛyagbe naa emuu. Bɔ ni nɔkwɛmɔnɔ lɛ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Mose lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ afee kanetso lɛ.
5Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 6 “Halamɔ Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ koni otsuu amɛhe. 7 Ni bɔ ni ofee amɛ ni otsuu amɛhe nɛ. Okɛ nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he lɛ ashwã amɛnɔ; amɛshɛ amɛhe tsɔi fɛɛ kɛ kakla, ni amɛfɔ amɛtadei ahe koni amɛhe atse. 8Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ohã amɛŋɔ tsina oblanyo, ni akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli mu afata he; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oŋɔ̃ tsina oblanyo kroko ni okɛshã esha he afɔle. 9Ohã Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ababɔ gwa; ni ohã Levibii lɛ adamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ. 10Israelbii asafo lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie Levibii lɛ ayitsei anɔ be mli ni ohã Levibii lɛ ebadamɔ Yehowa Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ. 11No sɛɛ lɛ, Aaron ajɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ahã mi, Yehowa, akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ni jɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ mi. 12Levibii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsinahii lɛ ayiteŋ; ni okɛ ekome ashã esha he afɔle, ni okɛ ekome hu ashã shãa afɔle okɛhã Yehowa koni okɛkpãtã ohã Levibii lɛ.
13“Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi koni amɛwa Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ, 14koni ojie Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ oto afã akɛ minɔ. 15Otsuu amɛhe koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛba Kpee Buu lɛ mli amɛbasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi. 16Ejaakɛ miiŋɔ amɛ kwraa yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ miihã mihe; mikɛ amɛ eto nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbeleɔ musu naa ni ji Israelbii akromɔbii lɛ anajiaŋ. 17 Ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni mitswia kromɔbii fɛɛ anii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi kɛ shĩa kooloo kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi hu nɔ mihã mihe, ni mifee lɛ minɔ. 18Levibii lɛ mikɛto Israelbii lɛ akromɔbii fɛɛ anajiaŋ 19ni mikɛ Levibii lɛ miihã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kwraa akɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ nikeenii koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Israelbii lɛ anajiaŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkpãtã efɔŋ ni baaba maŋbii anɔ kɛji amɛbɛŋkɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”
20No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ jɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ amɛhã. Bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee yɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nakai Israelbii lɛ fee Levibii lɛ. 21Levibii lɛ tsu kusum kɛfɔ amɛhe eshai; amɛfɔfɔɔ amɛtadei ahe, ni Aaron jɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã akɛ keenii krɛdɛɛ hã Yehowa. Asaŋ etsuu amɛhe hu. 22No sɛɛ lɛ, Levibii lɛ tee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ashishi. Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee yɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nakai efee amɛ.
23Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 24“Levibii lɛ ahe gbɛjianɔtoo nɛ: Mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛyaa lɛ, amɛtsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, 25ni mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, afɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔ lɛ ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe. 26Be nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛaanyɛ amɛwa amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli; shi moŋ nitsumɔ ko akakã amɛnɔ. Gbɛjianɔ ni oto ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ nɛ.”

Title: NUMERI 9
Content:
Hehoo gbijurɔyeli ni ji enyɔ lɛ
1Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 2“Hã ni Israelbii lɛ aye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli. 3Nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, nyɛyea gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli; nyɛyea lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa pɛpɛɛpɛ.” 4No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ koni amɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ; 5 ni amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi, yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee.
6Shi hii komɛi yata gbonyo he, ni amɛbule amɛhe; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ amɛye yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, hii nɛɛ ba Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔɔ yɛ Hehoo gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ. 7Amɛbakɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔyabule wɔhe kɛ gbonyo ko he ni wɔyata lɛ. Mɛni hewɔ ni atsiɔ wɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔnikeenii akabahã Yehowa yɛ ebe ni eto lɛ mli tamɔ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ?”
8Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɛa kɛyashi Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi nɔ ni afee yɛ nyɛhewɔ.”
9Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 10“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko loo nyɛshwiei lɛ eko yata gbonyo he ni ekɛbule ehe, aloo edom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ko tete lɛ, ebaanyɛ eye Hehoo lɛ ehã Yehowa kɛ̃. 11Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi. Amɛkɛ mã akpiti kɛ shwie ni joɔ aye; 12 amɛkashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ, ni asaŋ amɛkajwa kooloo ni agbe akɛye lɛ wui lɛ eko. Amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa. 13Shi mɔ ni he tse, ni asaŋ edomko, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekwa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yeli lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ ehiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ Yehowa nikeenii lɛ baaa ebahãaa yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli. Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.’
14“Ni kɛji mɔkpɔŋ ko bato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni eesumɔ akɛ eye Yehowa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ, eye; shi eye yɛ Hehoo lɛ he akpɔ kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ anaa. Akpɔ kome akã shi ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, gbɔ jio, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio.”
Atatu ni kpɛɔ kɛ la lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 40.34-38)
15 Gbi nɔ ni ashi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amã shi lɛ, atatu lɛ baha nɔ. Gbɛkɛ lɛ kɛ aakwɛ lɛ atatu lɛ tsoɔ tamɔ la yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashiɔ leebi. 16Ni nakai eyɔɔ daa; atatu lɛ haa Buu lɛ nɔ ni gbɛkɛ lɛ etsoɔ tamɔ la. 17Be fɛɛ be ni atatu lɛ aaawo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ; ni he ni atatu lɛ aaayawa yɛ lɛ, jɛi Israelbii lɛ toɔ shi yɛ. 18Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛtoɔ shi hu yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ nɔŋŋ naa. Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni atatu lɛ ma shi yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hiɔ shitoohe lɛ mli. 19Kɛji atatu lɛ tsɛ akɛ amɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ boɔ Yehowa toi, ni amɛfãaa kɔkɔɔkɔ. 20Bei komɛi lɛ atatu lɛ yeɔ gbii fioo ko kɛkɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni eba lɛ ehã lɛ, Israelbii lɛ toɔ shi yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛfãa nyiɛmɔ hu yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa. 21Kɛji atatu lɛ hi shi kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ, ni ewo ehe nɔ leebi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni eye gbi muu kɛmɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ hu, be fɛɛ be ni atatu lɛ woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fãa. 22Ni kɛ gbii enyɔ atatu lɛ ye yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio, nyɔŋ kome jio, be kakadaŋŋ jio, gbii abɔ ni eyɔɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ efãaa. Shi kɛji ewo ehe nɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛfã. 23Amɛtoɔ shi yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛfãa yɛ Yehowa nɔŋŋ fãmɔ naa. Amɛye Yehowa gbee nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɔ Mose nɔ efã amɛ akɛ amɛfee lɛ.

Title: NUMERI 10
Content:
Jwiɛtɛi tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Okɛ jwiɛtɛi ni atswia afee tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi enyɔ koni akɛtsɛ asafo lɛ kɛkpe, ni asaŋ okɛhã amɛfã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ. 3Kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ shikome ni gbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ tsɛ naakpa lɛ, maŋbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa abakpe shi yɛ oŋɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa. 4Shi kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kome kɛkɛ akpã lɛ, no lɛ Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ababua amɛhe naa yɛ oŋɔɔ. 5Kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ akɛbɔ oshe ni egbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ lɛ, asafo ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ afã. 6Kɛ akpã kɛbɔ oshe nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ asafoi ni jwere wuoyigbɛ lɛ anɔ ni, amɛ amɛfã. Belɛ kɛji aatao akɛ maŋ lɛ afã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ, akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ kɛbɔ oshe. 7Shi kɛji aatsɛ maŋ lɛ koni amɛnaa abakpe shi lɛ, akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni egbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ atsɛ, shi akɛkabɔ oshe. 8Aaron bihii ni ji osɔfoi lɛ ji mɛi ni akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ.
“Gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ akpɔ ni akã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi nɛɛ akpãmɔ he ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ nɛ: 9Kɛji nyɛkɛ henyɛlɔ ko ni gbaa nyɛnaa miiwu yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ kɛbɔa oshe; ni mi, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibaye mabua nyɛ, ni mibahere nyɛyiwala yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ. 10 Asaŋ nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ yɛ gbii ni nyɛmiinya hu anɔ, kɛ gbii juji ni ato lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee shishijee gbi lɛ hu nɔ be mli ni nyɛshãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ yɛ mihiɛ lɛ, ni maye mabua nyɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ
11Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 12Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii asafo lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Atatu lɛ yawa yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.
13Enɛ ji Israelbii lɛ aklɛŋklɛŋ fãa ni amɛfã nyiɛmɔ yɛ fãmɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ efã amɛ lɛ naa. 14Yudabii akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ tsutsu fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ. 15Mɔ ni ji Isakar akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ, 16ni mɔ ni ji Zebulon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliab, Helon bi lɛ.
17Kɛkɛ ni afã Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni Gershonbii lɛ kɛ Meraribii lɛ, ni amɛ amɛtereɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu fã nyiɛmɔ.
18Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Ruben akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ. 19Mɔ ni ji Simeon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ; 20ni mɔ ni ji Gad akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliasaf, Deuel bi lɛ.
21Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ ateŋ Kohatbii lɛ ni tereɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nibii lɛ fã. Ashiɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amãa shi dani asafo lɛ yashɛɔ he ni ayaato shi yɛ ehee lɛ.
22Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Efraim akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ. 23Mɔ ni ji Manase akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ; 24ni mɔ ni ji Benyamin akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Abidan, Gideon bi lɛ.
25Kɛkɛ ni Dan akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ ni nyiɛɔ Israelbii asafoi lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ. 26Mɔ ni ji Asher akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ; 27ni mɔ ni ji Naftali akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahira, Enan bi lɛ. 28Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ toɔ naa fãa, asaŋ ni amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ anaa kɛji amɛshi shitoohe ko lɛ.
29Be ni Israel asafoi lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ eŋa nyɛmi nuu Hobab, ni ji eshaanuu Yetro, Midiannyo lɛ, binuu lɛ akɛ, “Wɔmiifã kɛya he ni Yehowa wo wɔ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ. Fatamɔ wɔhe ni wɔtee. Yehowa ewo shi akɛ ebaahã Israel aye ejurɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔɔfee bo ejurɔ.”
30Shi Hobab here Mose nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ehiŋ mi yaa; shi moŋ matee mi diɛŋtsɛ mijaku shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ mimaŋbii aŋɔɔ.”
31Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Hobab akɛ, “Ofainɛ, kaashi wɔ. Gbii abɔ ni bo ole hei ni sa akɛ wɔtotoo shi yɛ, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ wɔhiɛ. 32Kɛji okɛ wɔ nyiɛ lɛ, ejurɔ fɛɛ ni Yehowa aaafee wɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkɛaafee bo.”
Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ
33No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Sinai, ni ji Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ he; ni amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃; ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ amɛshitoohe. 34Be fɛɛ be ni amɛaafã nyiɛmɔ amɛshi amɛshitoohe ko lɛ Yehowa atatu lɛ haa amɛnɔ shwane.
35 Kɛji eshɛ be ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, “Wo ohe nɔ, Yehowa, koni ohenyɛlɔi lɛ agbɛ ashwã, koni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ bo lɛ ajo foi yɛ ohiɛ.” 36Ni kɛji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miito shi lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ, Yehowa, kɛba Israelbii akpeiakpei abɔ lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ.”

Title: NUMERI 11
Content:
He ni atsɛ jɛi Tabera lɛ
1 Yehowa toi gbe huhuuhu ni maŋbii lɛ wie tamɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi ni miina nɔ. Be ni Yehowa nu lɛ, emli wo la ni ehã la here yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli ni ekpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ afãgbɛ. 2Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Mose, ni Mose kpa Yehowa fai, ni la lɛ gbo. 3No hewɔ lɛ, awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Tabera, ejaakɛ Yehowa la shã nii yɛ amɛteŋ.
Mose hala onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo
4 Maŋsɛɛbii komɛi ni futu Israelbii lɛ, amɛsuɔmɔnaanii kwraa ji loo; ni no hewɔ lɛ, loo bɔ̃i amɛtsine baa; ni asaŋ, Israelbii lɛ hu bɔ̃i amɛmli gbigblimɔ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ po wɔɔna loo yɛ wɔye. 5Loo ni jara waaa enyiɛ po wɔnaaa wɔye yɛ Ijipt? Wɔkaiɔ kokumba kɛ waatrɛ kɛ shwie kɛ sabolai! 6Shi naa wɔ ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔtɔ biti, ni wɔnaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa wɔye akɛ ja nɛkɛ mana nɛɛ pɛ.”
7Mana nɛɛ tamɔ dumɔ wui bibiibii kɛ esu wuɔfɔ oo ko. 8 Maŋbii lɛ yakɔlɔɔ, ni amɛbawiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ nɔ, aloo amɛshiɔ yɛ fufuitso mli, ni amɛhoɔ yɛ kukwɛi mli amɛkɛfeɔ niyenii, eŋɔ̃ɔmɔ tamɔ akpiti ni awo mli fɔ ŋɔɔmɔ. 9 Nyɔɔŋ be mli ni bɔ nyɔɔ shitoohe lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai be mli mana lɛ hu bashwieɔ shi.
10Mose nu ni maŋbii lɛ miifofoi yɛ amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ damɔ ebuu shinaa naa. Yehowa mli fu naakpa; ni sane lɛ eŋɔ̃ɔɔ Mose hu naa kwraa. 11No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni okɛ mi, otsulɔ, yeɔ kɛ joomɔ nɛɛ, ni oná mi mlifu? Mɛɛba ni okɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ fɛɛ yi sɔ̃ etere mi nɛɛ? 12Ani mi, mibɔ maŋ muu nɛɛ, aloo mi, mifɔ amɛ, hewɔ ni okɛɛ mi akɛ mihiɛ amɛ yɛ mikpɔkɔiaŋ tamɔ bɔ ni bihiɛlɔ hiɛɔ bi abifao kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni owo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi yɛ he lɛ nɔ lɛ? 13Nɛgbɛ maná loo yɛ mahã nɛkɛ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiifo amɛmiiwo mi akɛ mihã amɛ loo amɛye? 14Mi kome too minyɛŋ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ makura. Nitsumɔ nɛɛ da fe mi. 15 Kɛji nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni okɛ mi baaye lɛ, no lɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ koni ogbe mi moŋ nyɔŋlo koni mikana mihiɛnaanɔnii.”
16 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Halamɔ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo ni ji hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɛi, ni okɛ amɛ aba miŋɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he, ni ohã amɛdamɔ omasɛi. 17Mibakpeleke shi mikɛ bo abawie yɛ jɛi, ni maŋɔ mumɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ eko mahã amɛ hu koni amɛwa bo kɛtere maŋ lɛ jatsu lɛ bɔ ni afee ni okome okatere. 18 Ni okɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛtoa wɔ; shi nyɛbaana loo nyɛye. Yehowa enu yaafo ni nyɛfo akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaahã wɔ loo ni wɔye, ejaakɛ be mli ni wɔyɔɔ Ijipt lɛ ehi moŋ ehã wɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ Yehowa baahã nyɛ loo ni nyɛye.’ 19Ni jeee gbi kome, loo gbii enyɔ, loo gbii enumɔ, loo gbii nyɔŋma, loo gbii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛkɛ nyɛbaaye loo nɛɛ; 20shi moŋ nyɔŋ kome muu sɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni loo lɛ baaje fu ewo nyɛ, ni ebaaje nyɛtsine. Ejaakɛ nyɛgbe Yehowa ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni nyɛfo nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔyɛ Ijipt moŋ kulɛ ehi.’ ”
21Shi Mose here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Maŋbii ni mikɛyɔɔ lɛ ayifalɛ shɛɔ akpei ohai ekpaa, ni okɛɛ obaahã amɛ loo amɛye nyɔŋ kome sɔŋŋ. 22 Ani toi kɛ tsinai aaagbe ahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa aloo ŋshɔŋ loo fɛɛ abaaya ayahɛ abahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa?”
23 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ani Yehowa bɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɔ lo? Miwiemɔ lɛ aaaba mli jio, ebaŋ mli jio, obaana ŋmɛnɛ!”
24No hewɔ lɛ, Mose tee ni eyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ lɛ. Ebua maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ ateŋ hii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ anaa, ni ehã amɛdamɔ shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu lɛ he kɛkpe. 25Ni Yehowa kpeleke shi yɛ atatu mli, ni ekɛ Mose bawie, ni eŋɔ mumɔ lɛ ni ekɛhã Mose lɛ eko ekɛhã onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ hu. Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni mumɔ lɛ yi amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛgbagbai; shi kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛgbaaa dɔŋŋ.
26Maŋ onukpai ni Mose hala lɛ ateŋ hii enyɔ komɛi, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Eldad, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Medad, naaa afata maŋ onukpai lɛ ahe kɛya Kpee Buu lɛ he. Kɛ̃lɛ mumɔ lɛ yi amɛ hu amɛnɔ, ni amɛgba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli. 27Ni oblanyo ko jo foi ni ebatsĩ tã etsɔ̃ɔ Mose akɛ Eldad kɛ Medad miigba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli.
28 Enɛ hã Nun bi Yoshua ni ji Mose sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛjɛ eblahiaŋ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, tsii amɛ gbɛ!” 29 Shi Mose kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Mi oyeɔ awuŋã ohã nɛɛ? Miná ni kulɛ Yehowa maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃mɔ gbalɔi, ni Yehowa fɔse emumɔ lɛ eshwie amɛnɔ.” 30Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ mli.
Yehowa hã trakɔkɔi
31 Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko tswa, ni eloo trakɔkɔi babaoo kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛba ni ekɛ amɛ bashwie shitoohe lɛ mli kɛ ehewɔ fɛɛ kɛbɔle kpula bɔ ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ jekɛmɔ aaafee ninetalɔi enyɔ. 32Ni nakai gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enyɔɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ fɛɛ lɛ maŋbii lɛ mɔmɔ trakɔkɔi lɛ. Mɔ ni naaa kwraa lɛ ena loo ni tsiimɔ fee kiloi akpe. Amɛgbɛ loo lɛ mli amɛka kɛbɔle shitoohe lɛ he kpula. 33Ayeko loo nɛɛ atãko, ni Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ, ni ehã hela ko babote amɛteŋ ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ naakpa. 34 Sane nɛɛ hã awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Kibrot Hataava (eshishi ji Tsinebalɔi Agbonyobui), ejaakɛ jɛi ji he ni afu mɛi ni nii ba amɛtsine lɛ yɛ.
35Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Kibrot Hataava kɛtee Hazerot, ni amɛto shi yɛ jɛi.

Title: NUMERI 12
Content:
Agbala Miriam toi
1 Miriam kɛ Aaron wie amɛshi Mose yɛ Kushyoo ko ni Mose yaŋɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ, 2ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ani Mose kome kɛkɛ Yehowa kɛwieɔ? Ani wɔ hu ekɛ wɔ ewieko pɛŋ?” Yehowa nu Miriam kɛ Aaron wiemɔ nɛɛ. 3Nɛkɛ nuu Mose nɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwa, eji ehe humi fe shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
4Kɛkɛ ni trukaa lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam akɛ, “Nyɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛjea kpo ni nyɛbaa Kpee Buu lɛ he.” Ni amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ amɛtee. 5 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpeleke shi yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli, ni ebadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni etsɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam. Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ; 6ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa mi toi! Kɛji gbalɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ɔ ninaa nɔ mihãa eleɔ mi, ni wɔlamɔ mli mitsɔ̃ɔ mikɛ lɛ wieɔ. 7 Shi mitsulɔ Mose nɔ bɛ nakai. Lɛ edɛŋ mitu mimaŋ Israel fɛɛ kuramɔ miwo. 8 No hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ faŋŋ; shi jeee yɛ abɛbuai amli; ni enaa mi, Yehowa, misu. Mɛɛba nyɛsheee gbeyei, ni nyɛwie nyɛshi mitsulɔ Mose lɛ?”
9Yehowa mli fu Aaron kɛ Miriam; ni eyiŋ etee. 10 Shi be ni atatu kutuu lɛ jeɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, naa Miriam ni hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ futaa oookɛɛ kpiti. Aaron yaakwɛ Miriam lɛ, hewolo nɔ hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ oookɛɛ kpiti. 11Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ofainɛ, kaahã agbala wɔtoi yɛ kwashiaianii kɛ esha ni wɔfee nɛɛ hewɔ. 12Kaahã obiyoo tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɔmɔ ni be mli ni enyɛ fɔɔ lɛ beebe lɛ egbo, ni eheloo fã ekpɔtɔ momo.”
13No hewɔ lɛ, Mose bo etsɛ Yehowa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ, tsa obiyoo.”
14 Yehowa here Mose nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Miriam tsɛ fɛ̃ lajɔ̃ shwie Miriam hiɛ lɛ, ani ashwieko Miriam hiɛ shi kɛyashi gbii kpawo lo? Ashwie Miriam kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ gbii kpawo; no sɛɛ dani ahã eba shitoohe lɛ mli.” 15Ashwie Miriam yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ afã nyiɛmɔ kɛyashi aŋɔ Miriam kɛba shitoohe lɛ mli ekoŋŋ. 16Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lɛ fã yɛ Hazerot kɛtee, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Paran.

Title: NUMERI 13
Content:
Mɛi yasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii
(Deuteronomio 1.19-33)
1Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 2“Tsu hii koni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛbaahã Israelbii lɛ. Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli lɛ tsu mɔ kome ni eji onukpa yɛ amɛteŋ.” 3Mose ye Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etsu Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii onukpai akɛ saralɔi kɛjɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ. 4Ni mɛi ni etsu lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Ruben akutso lɛ mɔ lɛ ji Shamua, Zakur bi lɛ; 5ni Simeon akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Shafat, Hori bi lɛ; 6 ni Yuda akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ. 7Isakar akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Igal, Yosef bi lɛ; 8 ni Efraim akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Hoshea, Nun bi lɛ; 9ni Benyamin akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Palti, Rafu bi lɛ. 10Zebulon akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Gadiel, Sodi bi lɛ; 11ni Manase, Yosef bi lɛ, akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Gadi, Susi bi lɛ. 12Dan akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Amiel, Gemali bi lɛ. 13Asher akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Setur, Mikael bi lɛ; 14ni Naftali akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Nahebi, Vofsi bi lɛ, 15ni Gad akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Geuel, Maki bi lɛ. 16 Hii nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Mose tsu koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsake Nun bi Hoshea lɛ gbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Yoshua.
17Mose tsu bɔfoi nɛɛ koni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a kooyigbɛ nɛɛ kɛyaa Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ; ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ nyɛkwɔa gɔji lɛ, 18ni nyɛyasaraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ nɔ, akɛ amɛhe wa aloo amɛhe waaa, akɛ amɛyi fa aloo amɛyi faaa. 19Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni shikpɔŋ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ ehã, akɛ ehi aloo ehiii, akɛ maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe aloo akrowai amli amɛyɔɔ. 20Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɔɔ, akɛ ebaa nii aloo ebaaa nii jogbaŋŋ, akɛ tsei yɛ nɔ aloo tsei bɛ nɔ. Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtserɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ eko kɛbaa.” Nakai be mli lɛ eshɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wain yibii atsulɛ be.
21Bɔfoi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii kɛjɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ, aahu kɛyashi Rehob, he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa Hamat lɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ. 22Bɔfoi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashɛ Hebron he ni Ahimanbii lɛ kɛ Sheshaibii lɛ kɛ Talmaibii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi gojogojoo ni, ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ Anakbii lɛ ashwiei ni. Ato Hebron maŋ lɛ afii kpawo dani ato Zoan maŋ ni yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ. 23Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi lɛ bashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Amɛfo wain tso nine kome kɛ enɔ yibii shao yɛ jɛi, ni gbɔmɛi enyɔ wo yibii shao lɛ tsoŋ, ni amɛtere kɛba. Amɛtserɛ akutui lɛ eko kɛ agbãmii lɛ hu eko kɛba. 24Wain yibii shao ni Israelbii abɔfoi lɛ fo yɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ hewɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ.
25Gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, saralɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ saramɔ lɛ amɛba. 26Amɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kadesh yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛbagba amɛ bɔ ni amɛyana nibii amɛhã, ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 27 Amɛbɔ Mose amaniɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔtee shikpɔŋ ni otsu wɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ; ni anɔkwale ji akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ewo fɔ ni ebaa nii hu, ni enɔ tsei ayibii po nɛ. 28Shi moŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛhe wa; ni amɛmaji lɛ atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe akɛwaje amɛ, ni maji lɛ dara naakpa hu; asaŋ wɔna Anakbii oblaŋi lɛ hu yɛ jɛi. 29Amalekbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni Hitbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni Kanaanbii lɛ kã ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛ Yordan Faa lɛ hu naa.”
30Shi Kaleb tswa bɔfoi lɛ anaa mã yɛ Mose hiɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa kɛ̃ koni wɔyaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ ejaakɛ wɔbaanyɛ amɛnɔ kunim wɔye aahu.”
31Shi hii lɛ ni kɛ Kaleb tee amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnyɛŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ wɔdamɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe wɔ.” 32Hii lɛ tsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛyasara lɛ he sane lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi amɛhã Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, shikpɔŋ lɛ ni wɔyakpa nɔ wɔsara lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni egbo ni ebaaa nii ni enɔ bii ana aye; ni gbɔmɛi ni wɔna yɛ nɔ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni; 33 ni wɔna Anakbii ashwiei, gbɔmɛi oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi hu yɛ jɛi. Kɛji wɔkɛ wɔhe to amɛhe lɛ, wɔtamɔ agãi; ni nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amɛ hu amɛnaa wɔ.”

Title: NUMERI 14
Content:
Maŋbii lɛ wie huhuuhu
1Nakai gbi lɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ bolɔ, ni maŋ lɛ fo nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, 2 ni amɛwie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔgboi moŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ po kulɛ bɛ ehi? 3 Mɛɛba Yehowa ekpala wɔ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ koni wɔbanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa koni aŋɔ wɔŋamɛi kɛ wɔbifabii anom nɛɛ? Ani ehiii moŋ akɛ wɔkpale kɛya Ijipt ekoŋŋ?” 4No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔwoa wɔteŋ mɔ ko onukpa koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ, ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛya Ijipt.”
5Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi yɛ Israelbii asafo ni ebabɔ gwa lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. 6Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, ni ji hii ni atsu ni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛkwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ lɛ, gbala amɛtadei; 7ni amɛkɛɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni wɔyakpa nɔ wɔsara wɔkwɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ kpakpa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni. 8Kɛji Yehowa yɛ wɔhe tsui lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ wɔ aaayashɛ jɛi, ni eeeŋɔ nakai shikpɔŋ ni hi ni baa nii lɛ ehã wɔ. 9 Shi moŋ Yehowa hiɛ atua kɛkɛ ni nyɛkatsea; ni asaŋ nyɛkashea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛshɛŋ wɔwaosɛɛkpelɔ tete; amɛkɔlɔ eje amɛnɔ momo; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.” 10Asafo lɛ fɛɛ to amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbaatswia amɛ tɛ pɛ kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anunyam la lɛ pue yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Mose sɔle yɛ Maŋbii lɛ ahewɔ
11Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ maŋ nɛɛ aaakwa mi kɛyashi? Mɛni shwɛɔ dɔŋŋ dani amɛaahe minɔ amɛye yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee mikɛto amɛ okadii lɛ asɛɛ? 12Mibahã gbele hela ababote amɛteŋ koni mikɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ; shi mahã oshwiei atsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa fe maŋ nɛɛ.”
13 Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ baanu he, ejaakɛ amɛteŋ ojie maŋ nɛɛ kɛjɛ yɛ onineshiwalɛ naa, 14ni amɛaagba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ enu momo akɛ, bo Yehowa, okɛ wɔ yɛ, ni anaa bo faŋŋ kɛ faŋŋ kɛji atatu lɛ bashi edamɔ wɔnɔ; ni bo onyiɛɔ wɔhiɛ yɛ atatu kutuu mli. 15No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji okpãtã maŋ nɛɛ blublu hiɛ lɛ, majimaji ni enu ogbɛi he lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, 16‘Nyɛ ni Yehowa, onyɛɛɛ okɛ omaŋbii lɛ ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni owo shi yɛ he akɛ okɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, hewɔ ni oyaplenee amɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.’ 17No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, ofainɛ, hã wɔna ohewalɛ lɛ, ni ohã shi ni owo lɛ aba mli tamɔ okɛɛ oto lɛ akɛ, 18 ‘Mi, Yehowa, mimli fuuu mra, ni mimɔbɔnalɛ hu fa; ni mikɛ tɔ̃mɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ faa; shi kɛ̃lɛ mihãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋɔ ehe aye, ni miwoɔ bii anyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete nɔ.’ 19No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ maŋ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ afa amɛ yɛ osuɔmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni okɛfa nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt aahu kɛbashi bianɛ lɛ.”
20Yehowa to he ehã Mose akɛ, “Mikɛfa amɛ bɔ ni obi lɛ. 21Shi moŋ anɔkwale sane kome ji akɛ gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, ni asaŋ mi, Yehowa, minunyam lɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ lɛ, 22mɛi fɛɛ ni na minunyam la kaŋkaŋ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee yɛ Ijipt kɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni nomɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ amɛka mi shii nyɔŋma sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi lɛ, 23 amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo ehe shi mito akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni kwa mi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 24 Shi akɛni soro mumɔ ni mitsulɔ Kaleb hiɛ, ni asaŋ eye mi anɔkwa kɛwula shi hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ baaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ ni etee ayasara lɛ nɔ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ eshwiei anɔ. 25Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ amrɔ nɛɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔ lɛ, nyɛdɔa nyɛyi koni nyɛtsɔ̃a Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ he gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyajea ŋa lɛ nɔ.”
Yehowa gbala maŋ lɛ toi
26Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, 27“Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nɛkɛ asafo fɔŋ nɛɛ baawie huhuuhu amɛshi mi kɛyashi? Huhuuhu lɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ shiɔ mi lɛ, minu fɛɛ. 28No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ, ‘Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, bɔ ni nyɛwie nyɛwo mitoiŋ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mibafee nyɛ. 29 Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛbaagboi yɛ. Nyɛteŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni wie huhuuhu shi mi lɛ, 30amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo shi yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛ koni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ, akɛ ja Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ. 31Ni nyɛbii bibii lɛ ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, mibakpala amɛ kɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛkpoo lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaale jɛi. 32Nyɛ lɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛbaagboi yɛ. 33 Nyɛbii lɛ baatsomlo, ni amɛbaana nɔ yɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ kwamɔ ni nyɛkwa mi lɛ hewɔ, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛteŋ naagbee mɔ lɛ baagbo. 34 Gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ ni nyɛye nyɛkɛsara shikpɔŋ lɛ, emli gbi kome fɛɛ gbi kome baatsɔ afi ahã nyɛ, ni nyɛbaana nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ nyɛtoigbele lɛ hewɔ koni nyɛkɛna akɛ mikwa nyɛ. 35Mi, Yehowa, minã miwie; ni anɔkwa, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mafee nɛkɛ asafo fɔŋ ni fee ekome wo mi nɛɛ. Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛaagboi ni nyɛyi aaatã yɛ.’ ”
36 Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ ni Mose tsu yasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba ni amɛbatã shikpɔŋ lɛ he sane fɔŋ amɛkɛhã maŋ lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Yehowa lɛ, 37gbele hela fɔŋ ko bashi amɛnɔ, ni amɛtswia shi amɛgboi yɛ amɛnajiaŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 38Ni eshwɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, pɛ yɛ hii ni tee yasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛyi na wala.
Israelbii lɛ ka shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ
(Deuteronomio 1.41-46)
39Be ni Mose jaje wiemɔi ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ye ŋkɔmɔ babaoo. 40Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kwɔ kɛtee gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ̃; ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa wɔ, wɔbaaya he ni Yehowa ewo shi yɛ he lɛ kɛ̃; ejaakɛ wɔfee esha!”
41Shi Mose here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛkuɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɛɛ? Nyɛyeŋ omanye. 42Nyɛkayaa, ejaakɛ Yehowa bɛ nyɛteŋ, koni nyɛkayanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ. 43Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛkɛ nyɛ baakpe, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛ, ejaakɛ gbii abɔ ni nyɛkpale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hu fiŋ nyɛsɛɛ.”
44Shi maŋbii lɛ shi amɛtsitsi, ni amɛkã akɛ amɛaakwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛya eyiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ Mose fɛɛ shiii shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyaaa. 45Kɛkɛ ni Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ kpeleke shi, ni amɛbaye Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛshwie amɛ aahu kɛtee Horma tɔ̃ɔ.

Title: NUMERI 15
Content:
Afɔleshãa he mlai
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ ni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 3 kɛji nyɛkɛ tsina loo too baashã afɔle nyɛkɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ, shãa afɔle ni jio, gbee afɔle ni jio, afɔle ni akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa afɔle ni jio, nyɛgbii juji ni ato lɛ eko nɔ afɔle ni jio, afɔle lɛ ŋma asa mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ. 4 Mɔ ni baashã afɔle lɛ ekɛ niyenii hu afata kooloo lɛ he kɛba. Niyenii nɛɛ afee ŋmãa mamu kilo kome ni akɛ mu lita kome efutu mli, 5kɛ wain hu lita kome. Akɛ nibii nɛɛ afata toobi kome ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle lɛ he. 6Kɛji akɛ ojwɛni baashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ ŋmãa mamu kiloi enyɔ ni akɛ mu lita kome kɛ fã efutu mli afee kooloo lɛ he niyenii afɔle lɛ; 7ni akɛ wain lita kome kɛ fã afata he koni afɔle lɛ ŋma lɛ asa mihiɛ. 8Shi kɛji akɛ tsina oblanyo baashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle akɛ akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ loo akɛ shidaa afɔle akɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ, 9no lɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛfata tsina oblanyo lɛ he lɛ afee ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu litai enyɔ efutu mli; 10ni akɛ wain litai enyɔ hu afata he. Afɔle ni akɛ la shãa hãa mi Yehowa, ni misumɔɔ eŋma ji enɛ.’
11“Niyenii ni afata tsinanuu fɛɛ tsinanuu, loo ojwɛni fɛɛ ojwɛni, loo gwantɛŋbi fɛɛ gwantɛŋbi loo abotiabi fɛɛ abotiabi he nɛ. 12No hewɔ lɛ, kooloi abɔ ni akɛbaashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ eko fɛɛ eko he niyenii afɔle ni ato lɛ afata he yɛ amɛyibɔ lɛ naa. 13Israel fɔmɔbi fɛɛ fɔmɔbi afee enɛ kɛji eba ebaashã niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa. 14Kɛji mɔkpɔŋ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ aloo ebadɔmɔ nyɛ kwraa miisumɔ akɛ eshã afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa, bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ hu efee. 15 Gbɛjianɔtoo kome baakã shi ahã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ; ni ekã shi akɛ naanɔ akpɔ ahã nyɛ, Israel fɔmɔbii kɛ mɔkpɔŋ ni ebato nyɛ gbɔ lɛ fɛɛ ashwiei. Israelnyo kɛ mɔkpɔŋ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ pɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 16 No hewɔ lɛ, mla kome kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo kome baahi shi ahã nyɛ Israel fɔmɔbii kɛ gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ.”
17Yehowa kɛ Mose wie akɛ, 18“Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 19 shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii ni nyɛaana nyɛye lɛ, nyɛkɛ eko ashãa afɔle nyɛhãa mi, Yehowa. 20 Nyɛkɛ nyɛkpokploku mã lɛ eko ashãa aboloo nyɛhãa mi akɛ nɔwomɔ afɔle. Bɔ ni nyɛshãa ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ he afɔle lɛ, nakai nyɛshã enɛ hu. 21Nyɛbaashã kpokploku mã aboloo afɔle nɛɛ nyɛkɛhã Yehowa yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli.
22 “Kɛji nyɛtɔ̃ ni nyɛyeee kitãi nɛɛ ni Yehowa ewo Mose lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, 23kitãi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo nyɛ, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Yehowa wo nakai mlai lɛ, kɛyashi nyɛyinɔi ayinɔi blublu anɔ lɛ, 24ni atɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ ko, yɛ leee ni asafo lɛ leee hewɔ lɛ, no lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ amɛdɛŋ tsina oblanyo kome koni amɛkɛshã shãa afɔle amɛkɛhã mi, akɛ afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa. Akɛ niyenii kɛ dãa afɔle hu bɔ ni afo akɛ kusum lɛ afata he. Too kpakpo kome hu afata he koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle. 25Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ aaafa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ kãaa he, ni asaŋ, tɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ. 26Akɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ aaafa Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gbɔi ni ebato amɛ lɛ hu ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shi nɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ.
27 “Kɛji mɔ ko fee esha ni ehiɛ kãaa he lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ abotiayoo ni eye afi aba koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle. 28Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ ni akɛaafa lɛ. 29Mla kome akã shi ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee kwa ekwa efee esha lɛ, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, mɔkpɔŋ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni jio.
30 “Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehiɛ kã he ni efee nɔ fɔŋ ko lɛ, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, gbɔ ni jio, ebɔ musu ejaakɛ ekwɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ gbe agbe lɛ; 31ejaakɛ ebuuu Yehowa wiemɔ, ni etɔ̃ ekitã nɔ. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ agbe lɛ koni emusu atere lɛ.”
Nuu ko tɔ̃ hejɔɔmɔ gbi mla nɔ
32 Be ko be mli ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lolo lɛ, ayana nuu ko ni etee eelɛ lai yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ. 33Mɛi ni yana nuu lɛ kpala lɛ kɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. 34 Awo nuu lɛ tsuŋ ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ anako nɔ pɔtɛɛ ni sa akɛ afee lɛ. 35Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Agbe nuu lɛ. Akɛ lɛ aje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi ni agbe lɛ.” 36No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpala nuu lɛ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛi, ni agbe lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.
Atade naa ahwanya he mlai
37Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 38 “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛfee ahwanyai amɛwo amɛtadei akoji anaa, ni akɛ kpãa bluu amɔ̃mɔ̃ amɛ. Yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ bii afee nakai. 39Ahwanyai nɛɛ atsɔ̃ kaimɔnii; ni be fɛɛ be ni hiŋmɛi aaagba nɔ lɛ ehã nyɛkai Yehowa kitãi lɛ fɛɛ koni nyɛye nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkanyiɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi akɔnɔ nibii lɛ asɛɛ, nibii asɛɛ ni nyɛyadiɔ ni nyɛkɛkwaa Yehowa lɛ. 40Ahwanyai lɛ baakai nyɛ mikitãi lɛ koni nyɛye nɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi nyɛhã mi, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 41Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”

Title: NUMERI 16
Content:
Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram tse atua
1 Izehar bi Kora, ni eji Kohat nabi, ni asaŋ eji Levi nanakansowa lɛ na Ruben akutso lɛ mli gbɔmɛi etɛ̃ komɛi shi enɔ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Datan kɛ Abiram, Eliab bii lɛ, kɛ On, Pelet bi lɛ. 2Amɛte shi amɛwo Mose. Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni ji asafo lɛ mli onukpai kɛ hiɛnaanɔbii ni yɔɔ gbɛi komɛi hu fata amɛhe. 3Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kpe amɛwo Mose kɛ Aaron he, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃. Ejaakɛ asafo muu lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni; ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ. Mɛɛba ni nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Yehowa asafo lɛ nɔ mɔ?”
4 Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni esɔle. 5 Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Kora kɛ asafo lɛ ni ekɛba lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔ ni ji wɔ leebi lɛ Yehowa baahã ale mɔ ni ji enɔ; mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ. Mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ, lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. 6Nɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Kora, bo kɛ osafo lɛ nyɛkɔlɔa lajee tsɛnsii; 7nyɛjea la nyɛwoa amɛmli kɛbaa wɔ, koni nyɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma abashwiea nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Jɛi wɔbaana yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ akɛ lɛ ji mɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃, nyɛ Levibii.”
8Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Kora akɛ, “Nyɛboa mi toi koo, nyɛ Levibii! 9Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etse nyɛ yɛ Israel asafo lɛ he, ni ehãa nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛbɛŋkɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛtsuɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nii; ni asaŋ nyɛdamɔɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛ, aso no faaa hãaa nyɛ lo? 10Yehowa ehã bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ lɛ; ni fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmiitao osɔfoyeli lɛ hu nyɛfata he? 11 Naa, kpee ni bo kɛ osafo lɛ bakpe nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa he nyɛkpe nyɛwo lɛ, ni huhuuhu ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ Aaron lɛ, Yehowa moŋ nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ lɛ.”
12Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsu koni ayatsɛ Datan kɛ Abiram, Eliabbii lɛ, kɛba. Shi amɛhã hetoo akɛ, “Wɔbaaa he ko he ko! 13Kɛji obakpala wɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ewo fɔ nɔ, ni obaagbegbee wɔ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no kɛkɛ faaa hãaa bo; shi no sɛɛ hu lɛ ootao akɛ oyeɔ lumɔ yɛ wɔnɔ lo? 14 Asaŋ jeee shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ewo fɔ nɔ okɛ wɔ ba; ni obahãko wɔ ŋmɔji kɛ wain tromi akɛ wɔgboshinii. Obaakã he ni olaka wɔ sɔŋŋ nakai? Wɔbaaa hekoheko!”
15 Sane lɛ wo Mose mli la naakpa; ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kaahe amɛfɔlei lɛ. Mishɔ̃ko amɛteŋ mɔ ko teji yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, miyeko amɛteŋ mɔ ko sane fɔŋ ko!”
16Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Kora akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, bo kɛ osafo lɛ fɛɛ aba Yehowa hiɛ. Bo kɛ amɛ kɛ Aaron fɛɛ. 17Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, bo kɛ osafoŋbii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛ Aaron hu, akɔ elajee tsɛnsi, ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma awo mli koni nyɛkɛba Yehowa hiɛ.” 18No hewɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔ elajee tsɛnsi, ni eje la ewo mli; ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛkɛba amɛbadamɔ shi yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, amɛ kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron fɛɛ.
19Kora bua maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa ewo Mose kɛ Aaron; amɛbabɔ gwa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni amɛmiikwɛ Mose. Yehowa anunyam la lɛ pue trukaa yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. 20Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, 21“Nyɛtsia nyɛhe yɛ nɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ he koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.”
22 Shi Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ, heloo fɛɛ awala jɛɛhe! Aso mɔ kome aaafee esha, ni okɛ ehe nu aaaju maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he lo?”
23Yehowa hã Mose hetoo akɛ, 24“Kɛɛmɔ maŋ muu lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shihilɛhei lɛ ahe kɛya sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.’ ”
25Mose te shi, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Datan kɛ Abiram ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛtee. 26Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛhe oya kɛjea nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji nɛɛ abui lɛ ahe kɛyaa sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ni nyɛkataa amɛnɔ ko nɔ ko he koni akakpãtã nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.” 27Wiemɔ nɛɛ hã asafo lɛ gbala amɛhe shi kɛshi Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram bui lɛ ahe kɛtee sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Datan kɛ Abiram je kpo amɛbadamɔ amɛbui lɛ ashinai lɛ ashi, ni amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛbifabii lɛ fɛɛ hu fata amɛhe. 28Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsu mi akɛ mibatsu nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni mifeɔ lɛ, shi jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ mito miyiŋ ni mifeɔ. 29Kɛji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gboi tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi fɛɛ gboiɔ, aloo amɛkɛ osharã ko kpe ni eji adesã he nɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee Yehowa ni tsu mi nii ni mitsuɔ lɛ tsumɔ. 30Shi kɛji Yehowa fee nɔ ko ni bako dã, ni shikpɔŋ gba ni emĩ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ, ni amɛkpeleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ ebuuu Yehowa.”
31 Mose naa ni nyɔ shi nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ gba yɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shishi, 32ni amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ hɔi kɛ Kora hu webii lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɔ bu lɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ mi amɛ fɛɛ. 33No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ. Shikpɔŋ ni gba lɛ bashi hiɛ ni etsa ekoŋŋ, ni emii amɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛhiɛkpãtã kwrakwra yɛ amɛjakumɛi lɛ ateŋ. 34Bolɔmɔ ni amɛbolɔ lɛ hã Israelbii fɛɛ ni ewo shi yɛ jɛi kɛkpe lɛ jojoo foi, ni amɛ hu amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Akakwɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ bamii wɔ hu.”
35 Yehowa hã la bayi hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ ni kɛ tsofakɛŋma ba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ anɔ ni eshã amɛ wɛɛ.
Lajee tsɛnsii lɛ
36Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 37“Kɛɛmɔ Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron binuu lɛ, akɛ ehole lajee tsɛnsii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ ni eshã lɛ ateŋ, ni egbɛ amɛmli la lɛ eshwã kɛya sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsɛnsii lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, 38No hewɔ lɛ, atswia hii nɛɛ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛwala wo esha lɛ he nyɔmɔ lɛ, atsɛnsii lɛ tɛtɛrɛbii, ni akɛha afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni etsɔ̃ okadi ehã Israelbii fɛɛ.” 39No hewɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Eleazar kɔlɔ akɔɔble lajee tsɛnsii lɛ ni hii lɛ ni la lɛ shã lɛ kɛba lɛ, ni atswia akɛfee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hehaanii, 40koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔnɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni jeee Aaron shwie ko akatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ akɛ ebaashã tsofakɛŋma ekɛhã Yehowa, koni ekabatsɔ̃ tamɔ Kora kɛ esafo lɛ. Eleazar fee bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Aaron here maŋbii lɛ ayiwala
41Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ saa wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛgbe Yehowa webii.” 42Be ni maŋbii lɛ anaa ebabua kɛbaaya ayanina Mose kɛ Aaron lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ amɛkwɛ Kpee Buu lɛ, ni naa, atatu kutuu lɛ ebaha Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anunyam la lɛ epue. 43Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron badamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ, 44ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 45“Nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjea nɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ he kɛyaa sɛɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.” Shi Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, 46ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Kɔ olajee tsɛnsi lɛ, ni oje afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ la lɛ eko owo mli, ni okɛ tsofakɛŋma ashwie nɔ, ni okɛya asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ mramra okɛyakpãtã ohã amɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa mlifu ete shi momo, ni gbele hela lɛ ebɔ̃i mɛi ahiɛ kpãtãmɔ.” 47Aaron fee bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ lɛ lɛ. Ekɔ elajee tsɛnsi lɛ, ni ekɛjo foi kɛtee maŋbii lɛ ateŋ. Eyanina ni gbele hela lɛ ebɔ̃i mɛi ahiɛkpãtãmɔ momo. Eshã tsofakɛŋma lɛ, ni ekɛkpãtã ehã maŋbii lɛ. 48Aaron damɔ gbohii lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ateŋ, ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo. 49Gbɔmɛi ni gbele hela lɛ gbe lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai kpawo, soro mɛi ni gboi yɛ Kora sane lɛ hewɔ lɛ. 50Be ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo lɛ, Aaron ku esɛɛ kɛba Mose ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

Title: NUMERI 17
Content:
Aaron dɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 2“Bi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ abahã bo dɛhiɛmɔtsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, akutso fɛɛ akutso lɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso kome. Ŋmãa akutso fɛɛ akutso gbɛi yɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso ni ekɛba lɛ he; 3ni oŋmã Aaron gbɛi yɛ tso ni Levibii kɛba lɛ he. No hewɔ lɛ, akutsotsɛ fɛɛ akutsotsɛ lɛ ebaana dɛhiɛmɔtso kome. 4Kɔlɔmɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ kɛya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni okɛyashwie Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ he ni mi kɛ bo kpeɔ yɛ lɛ. 5Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ji mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ, edɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ baagba afofro; ni mikɛ enɛ baahã huhuuhu ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ amɛshiɔ nyɛ yɛ mihewɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo.”
6No hewɔ lɛ, Mose bi Israelbii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ bahã lɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso komekome yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa. Fɛɛ fee dɛhiɛmɔtsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni akɛ Aaron tso lɛ hu fata he. 7Mose kɛ tsei lɛ tee eyashwie Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
8Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Mose tee Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ, naa Aaron tso lɛ ni ji Levibii awe lɛ tso lɛ ni efrɔke ni egba afofro, ni ewo yibii hu. 9Mose loo tsei lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛje kpo kɛba Israelbii lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ekɛbatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni akutsotsɛ fɛɛ akutsotsɛ kɔ etso. 10 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpalemɔ ni okɛ Aaron tso lɛ ayafɔ̃ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ ekoŋŋ koni akɛto okadi ahã toigbolɔi lɛ bɔ ni afee ni huhuuhu ni amɛwieɔ amɛshiɔ mi lɛ sɛɛ afo, koni amɛkagboi.” 11 Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
12Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, wɔmiiplene, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã! Wɔ bluublu wɔhiɛ miikpãtã. 13Kɛji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ baagbo lɛ, belɛ no lɛ wɔ fɛɛ lɛ, gboimɔ wɔgboi lɛ!”

Title: NUMERI 18
Content:
Osɔfoi anitsumɔi kɛ Levibii hu anitsumɔi
1 Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Bo kɛ obihii kɛ Levibii fɛɛ ji mɛi ayi ni sɔ̃ baatere kɛji abɔ musu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ gbɛfaŋ; shi yɛ osɔfo nitsumɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ bo kɛ obihii lɛ pɛ baatere sɔ̃ kɛji tɔ̃mɔ ko ba. 2Ŋɔɔ onyɛmimɛi, Levibii ni ji otsɛ akutso lɛ mli bii lɛ, ofata ohe koni amɛwa bo be ni bo kɛ obii lɛ tsuɔ osɔfoi anitsumɔi lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ. 3Amɛsɔ̃mɔ kɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ kɛkɛ yɛ oshishi; shi amɛkabɛŋkɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ loo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ akagboi. 4Amɛ, amɛfata ohe koni amɛtsu amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛŋ lɛ: shi moŋ mɔ ko ni jeee Levinyo akabɛŋkɛ nyɛ ni ebatsu jɛi nitsumɔ lɛ eko. 5Bo kɛ obii lɛ pɛ akwɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ bɔ ni afee ni mimli akafu Israelbii lɛ dɔŋŋ. 6Ni naa, mijie nyɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ateŋ, ni mikɛ amɛ eke nyɛ akɛ mi, Yehowa, minikeenii, koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli. 7Shi bo kɛ obihii lɛ pɛ asɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ mligbɛ hu. Miŋɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ mihã nyɛ akɛ sɔɔ̃mɔ ni aŋɔ ke. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ejeee osɔfo ni eeebɛŋkɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ.”
Osɔfoi agbɛnaanii
8 Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Naa, nibii ni Israelbii kɛbahãa mi akɛ afɔle lɛ, amɛmli nibii fɛɛ ni ashãaa lɛ, mijɔɔ nɔ mikɛke bo kɛ obihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛnaanii kɛmiiya naanɔ. 9Afɔlei krɔŋkrɔŋi ni fe fɛɛ lɛ amli nibii fɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ afɔleshãa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛnɔ ni. Nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbakeɔ mi akɛ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, niyenii afɔle ni jio, esha he afɔle ni jio, sɔ̃yeli he afɔle ni jio, mijɔɔ nɔ tswaa mikɛke bo kɛ oshwiei. 10Nyɛyea nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nuu fɛɛ nuu aaanyɛ aye eko; nyɛbua lɛ akɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
11 “Mikɛ nibii ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahã mi akɛ shidaa afɔle lɛ hu eke nyɛ, ni ji bo kɛ oshwiei hii kɛ yei fɛɛ, akɛ amɛgbɛnaanii kɛmiiya naanɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehe tse yɛ oshwiei ateŋ lɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.
12“Miijɔɔ mu kɛ wain kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ abele ni akuɔ lɛ mli ekpakpa fe fɛɛ ni Israelbii kɛbahãa mi Yehowa nɔ mihã bo. 13 Klɛŋklɛŋ aduawai ni amɛtseɔ yɛ amɛŋmɔji amli ni amɛkɛhãa mi Yehowa lɛ, onɔ ni. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehe tse yɛ oshwiei ateŋ lɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.
14 “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ajɔɔ nɔ akɛke mi yɛ Israel lɛ etsɔ̃ onɔ.
15“Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbeleɔ musu naa ni akɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, mijɔɔ enɔ mihã nyɛ. Shi gbɔmɔ kromɔbi lɛ ohã akpɔ̃ lɛ; kooloi ni he tseee lɛ ohã akpɔ̃ amɛ 16kɛji amɛye nyɔŋ kome lɛ, jara ni akɛkpɔ̃ amɛ ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ jwiɛtɛi jara naa. Shekel kome feɔ gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ. 17Shi tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia kromɔbi lɛ, okahã akpɔ̃ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ amɛhe tse; amɛ okɛshã afɔle okɛhã mi. Okɛ amɛlá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni oshã amɛmli fɔ lɛ koni efee afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa. 18Amɛloo lɛ nyɛnɔ ni tamɔ bɔ ni kooloi krokomɛi ni akɛshãa afɔle atsitsinaa kɛ ninejurɔ shuɔji lɛ feɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ.
19“Nibii fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahãa mi akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ miijɔɔ fɛɛ nɔ miihã bo kɛ oshwiei hii kɛ yei fɛɛ akɛ amɛgbɛnaanii ni kã shi daa. Kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ bo kɛ oshwiei ekpãŋ nɛɛ akuŋ mli kɛmiiya naanɔ.”
20 Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Onaŋ gboshinii ko yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ onaŋ shikpɔŋ ni abaaja lɛ eko. Mi, Yehowa, mi ji ogbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ ogboshinii ni he hiaa bo yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.”
Nɔ ni ahã Levibii lɛ
21“Too fɛɛ too ni ji nii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome ni awoɔ yɛ Israel ni akɛbahãa mi lɛ, mijɔɔ nɔ mihã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ gboshinii yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ kɛtsuɔ Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ hewɔ. 22Ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ akabɛŋkɛ Kpee Buu lɛ dɔŋŋ koni amɛkabaloo musu ni amɛgboi. 23Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni baatsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii; ni kɛji nɔ ko tɔ̃ yɛ he lɛ sɔ̃yeli lɛ tere amɛ. Akpɔ nɛɛ akã shi daa ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei. Levibii lɛ, amɛnaŋ gboshinii ko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, 24ejaakɛ nibii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ni Israelbii woɔ akɛ too ni amɛkɛbahãa mi Yehowa akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ, mikɛhã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii. Enɛ hewɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛnaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.”
Too ni Levibii lɛ baawo
25Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 26“Kɛɛmɔ Levibii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛnine shɛ nibii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ni mibi Israelbii koni amɛwo amɛhã nyɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛjiea mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome nɛɛ mli mlijaa nyɔŋma kome koni nyɛkɛbahãa, mi Yehowa, akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ. 27Ni abaabu nyɛfɔle krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ tamɔ abuɔ okwaafonyo ŋmãa hee kɛ wain hee ni ekɛbashãa afɔle lɛ. 28Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu nyɛbashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa kɛjɛ nyɛmlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome ni nyɛheɔ kɛjɛɔ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ mli. Nyɛŋɔa afɔle nɛɛ nyɛhãa Osɔfo Aaron. 29Nyɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ amli nii kpakpa ni fe fɛɛ lɛ ashãa afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa. 30No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Levibii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛnibii lɛ amli nii kpakpa fe fɛɛ lɛ eshã afɔle lɛ, nyɛŋɔa nibii fɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ sɛɛ lɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ tamɔ okwaafonyo ŋɔɔ eŋmɔshi nii loo wain ni shwɛɔ lɛ akɛ enɔ lɛ. 31 Nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ayea nii ni shwɛɔ hãa nyɛ nɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ nyɛnii ni nyɛtsuɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo ni. 32Nyɛyeee sɔ̃ ko yɛ no hewɔ, kɛji nyɛna nyɛkɛ nii lɛ mli nii kpakpa fe fɛɛ lɛ eshã afɔle momo lɛ. Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ koni nyɛkabule nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni Israelbii kɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ koni nyɛbagboi.’ ”

Title: NUMERI 19
Content:
Tsinayoo tsuru lamlu lɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, 2 “Akpɔ ni mi, Yehowa, miwoɔ nɛ: Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛbahã bo tsinayoo tsuru ni kpa ko kpa ko bɛ ehe, ni asaŋ akɛ apã woko lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ tsuko nii dã. 3Akɛ tsina lɛ ahã Osɔfo Eleazar, ni ekɛ kooloo lɛ aje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni agbe kooloo lɛ yɛ Eleazar hiɛ. 4 Osɔfo Eleazar asɔo tsina lɛ lá lɛ eko, ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli ni etsɛŋe lá lɛ eshwã Kpee Buu lɛ naagbɛ shii kpawo. 5Ama tsinayoo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa la koni ashã lɛ kɛ ehewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ kɛ elá lɛ kɛ ewamɔ fɛɛ. 6Osɔfo lɛ akɔlɔ tsenedru tso kɛ hisopo tso kɛ kpãa tsuru koni efɔ̃ ewo la ni akɛshãa tsinayoo lɛ mli. 7 No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni eju ehe dani ebote maŋbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli. Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ he tseee aahu kɛyashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ. 8Mɔ ni shã tsina lɛ hu afɔ etadei ahe, ni eju ehe. Lɛ hu ehe tseee kɛyashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ. 9Kɛkɛ lɛ mɔ ko ni he tse aloo tsinayoo lɛ lamlu lɛ, ni ekɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni tse koni akɛ lamlu lɛ ayato jɛi. Akɛ lamlu nɛɛ awo nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he akɛdãiɔ esha ni afee yɛ Israel lɛ mli. Enɛ ji hetsuumɔ afɔle. 10Lɛ mɔ ni ebaaloo tsinayoo lɛ lamlu lɛ hu, ebaafɔ etadei ahe. Lɛ hu ehe tseee kɛyaashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ. Akpɔ nɛɛ baakã shi daa ahã Israelbii kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ni ebato amɛ gbɔ fɛɛ.
Mɔ ni eyata gbonyo he
11“Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata gbonyo ko he lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbii kpawo. 12Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ aju nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he lɛ eko, yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, ni ehe aaatse. Shi kɛji ejuuu nu lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ etsuuko ehe ni ehe tseŋ. 13 Mɔ ni aaata gbonyo ko he ni etsuuu ehe lɛ, eebule Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ ejuko nu ni akɛtsuɔ he lɛ ekɛdãiko ehe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekã muji lɛ mli lolo.
14“Kɛji mɔ ko gbo yɛ buu mli lɛ, ehe mla ni kã shi nɛ: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ buu lɛ mli be ni mɔ lɛ nyɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatee buu lɛ mli lɛ ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbii kpawo; 15asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ buu lɛ mli ni abuko naa lɛ abule lɛ. 16Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baata mɔ ko ni enyɔ yɛ klante naa gbonyo he, loo mɔ ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele gbonyo aloo eeeta gbonyo wu loo gbonyobu ko he yɛ jwɛiaŋ lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
17“Bɔ ni atsɔ̃ atsuu mɔ ni ebule ehe lɛ he nɛ: akpiti tsina tsuru ni ashã lɛ lamlu lɛ eko awo nɔ̃ mli, ni ayɛ faa ni hoɔ mli nu awo lamlu lɛ he. 18Mɔ ko ni ehe tse kɛ hisopo atsɔ nu kɛ lamlu lɛ mli koni ekɛshwã buu lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi kɛ mɛi hu ni tee mli lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ akɛ nu nɛɛ ashwã mɔ ni eyata mɔ ni nyɔ yɛ klante naa gbonyo he loo mɔ ni gbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele gbonyo he loo gbonyowu loo gbonyobu he lɛ nɔ. 19Mɔ ni he tse lɛ kɛ nu nɛɛ baashwã mɔ ni he tseee lɛ nɔ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ. Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ebaatsuu mɔ ni ebule ehe lɛ he; ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baafɔ etadei lɛ ahe, ni ebaaju ehe, ni gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ mɔ ni kulɛ ehe tseee lɛ he aaatse.
20“Shi mɔ ni ebule ehe, shi etsuuu ehe koni ekɛfɔ ehe muji lɛ, abaashwie lɛ yɛ asafo lɛ mli, ejaakɛ eebule Yehowa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Ejuko nu ni akɛtsuɔ he lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekã muji lɛ mli lolo. 21Akpɔ nɛɛ akã shi ahã Israelbii lɛ daa. Mɔ ni kɛ hetsuumɔ nu lɛ shwãa lɛ, lɛ hu efɔ etadei lɛ ahe; ni mɔ ni aaata hetsuumɔ nu lɛ he lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ. 22Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mɔ ni ebule ehe aaata he lɛ, ebule nɔ lɛ; ni mɔ ni aaata nii ni abule he lɛ, lɛ hu ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbɛkɛ.”

Title: NUMERI 20
Content:
Saji ni ba yɛ Kadesh
(Ɛksodɔs 17.1-7)
1 Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yashɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛto shi yɛ Kadesh. Biɛ Miriam gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ.
2Nu bɛ shitoohe nɛɛ hã maŋ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ bakpe 3amɛwo Mose kɛ Aaron he. Amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔgboi tamɔ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ gboi yɛ Yehowa Buu lɛ hiɛ moŋ kulɛ bɛ ehi: 4Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ wɔ, Yehowa asafo lɛ, ebaŋa nɛɛ nɔ? Ani jeee koni wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi fɛɛ wɔbagboi yɛ biɛ? 5Ni mɛni hewɔ nyɛkpala wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba shikpɔŋ gbonyo tamɔ enɛ nɔ? Shikpɔŋ gbonyo ni ehiii enɔ nidumɔ, ni agbãmi kɛ waintso kɛ akutu ko bɛ enɔ he ko he ko; ni nu ni anuɔ tete po bɛ nɔ?” 6Mose kɛ Aaron je gwabɔɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛtee Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi; kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ pue yɛ amɛnɔ.
7Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, 8“Kɔ tso lɛ, ni, bo kɛ onyɛmi Aaron, nyɛbuaa asafo lɛ naa, ni okɛ tɛsaa ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ awie yɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ ehã nu ni yɔɔ emli lɛ atue. Nu baajɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli aba ahã maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛkooloi lɛ koni amɛnu.” 9Mose kɔ tso lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
10 Mose kɛ Aaron bua maŋ lɛ naa yɛ tɛsaa lɛ he, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi koo, nyɛ atuatselɔi! Ani wɔhã nu ajɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ mli ahã nyɛ lo?” 11Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo enine nɔ, ni ekɛ etso lɛ tswa tɛsaa lɛ shii enyɔ, kɛkɛ ni nu tue babaoo, ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛkooloi lɛ na nu amɛnu.
12Shi Yehowa kã Mose kɛ Aaron hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Akɛni nyɛheee minɔ nyɛyeee koni nyɛhã maŋbii lɛ ana mihewalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ kpele lɛ, nyɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ eyaŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.”
13 Awo nu lɛ gbɛi akɛ Meriba nu lɛ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yehowa taa naa yɛ jɛi, shi Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi akɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ lɛɛlɛŋ.
Edom Maŋtsɛ eŋmɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ gbɛ
14 Ni Mose tsu bɔfoi kɛjɛ Kadesh kɛtee Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni onyɛmimɛi Israelbii kɛɛ nɛ: Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole, amanehului fɛɛ ni wɔna: 15bɔ ni wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ tee Ijipt, kɛ bɔ ni wɔhi shi yɛ Ijipt be kplaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛ bɔ ni Ijiptbii fee wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ niseniianii aahu. 16 Wɔfo wɔtsɛ Yehowa, ni ebo wɔ toi, ni etsu bɔfo ni ebajie wɔ kɛje Ijipt. Wɔbashɛ Kadesh amrɔ nɛɛ, ni ji maŋ ni yɔɔ ohusu lɛ naa kpaakpa. 17Ofainɛ, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho kɛkɛ. Wɔyaŋ ŋmɔji loo wain tromi amli lɛ, wɔnuŋ nubui lɛ amli nu lɛ eko hu. Tɛmpɔŋ wulu lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku kɛyaashi wɔɔfo mli yɛ okpokpai lɛ anɔ.”
18Shi Edombii lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Dabida! Nyɛkabatsɔ̃a wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ wɔbaafã ta wɔwo nyɛ.”
19Israelbii lɛ to he akɛ, “Tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ. Kɛji wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi lɛ aaanu nyɛnu lɛ eko po lɛ, wɔbaawo nyɛ nyɔmɔ. Sane ko bɛ sɛɛ fe akɛ wɔmiitao wɔfo mli kpoo kɛkɛ.”
20Edombii lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ!” Ni amɛfã ta kpeteŋkple kɛyasa Israelbii lɛ anaa. 21Akɛni Edombii lɛ eyaŋmɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ gbɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ dɔ amɛyi, ni amɛyatsɔ̃ he kroko.
Aaron gbele
22Israelbii asafo tso muu lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Kadesh, ni amɛba Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he, 23yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ naa. Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ jɛi akɛ, 24“Aaron naji enyɔ yiŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhã Israelbii lɛ nɔ; ebaagbo ejaakɛ nyɛbooo mi toi be ni nyɛyɔɔ Meriba lɛ. 25Ŋɔ̃ɔ Aaron kɛ ebinuu Eleazar koni okɛ amɛ aya Hor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 26 Jiemɔ osɔfoyeli atadei lɛ yɛ Aaron he yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni okɛwo ebinuu Eleazar. Aaron baagbo yɛ jɛi.” 27Ni Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. Amɛkwɔ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, 28 ni Mose jie osɔfoyeli atadei lɛ yɛ Aaron he, ni ekɛwo Aaron binuu Eleazar. Ni Aaron gbo yɛ jɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ, ni Mose kɛ Eleazar kpeleke shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 29Be ni Israel asafo tso muu lɛ fɛɛ na akɛ Aaron eje jeŋ lɛ, amɛfo Aaron gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.

Title: NUMERI 21
Content:
Israelbii ye Kanaanbii anɔ kunim
1 Be ni Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni gbɛi ji Arad lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ etsɔ̃ Atarim gbɛ kɛmiiba lɛ, efã ta kɛtee eyatua Israelbii lɛ, ni eŋɔ mɛi komɛi nom, 2Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wo Yehowa shi, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ; “Kɛji ooohã wɔye gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ kunim lɛ, no lɛ wɔbaakpãtã amɛmaji lɛ ahiɛ butubutu.” 3Yehowa bo Israelbii lɛ atoi, ni ehã amɛye Kanaanbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛkpãtã Kanaanbii amaji lɛ ahiɛ butubutu, ni amɛwo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Horma (eshishi ji niihiɛkpãtãmɔ.)
Akɔɔble onufu lɛ
4 Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni amɛtsɔ̃ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naagbɛ, he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Akaba Ble lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛtswa Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛfɔ̃. Nyiɛmɔ lɛ je Israelbii lɛ atsine yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, 5ni amɛwie amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba kwraa po nyɛjie wɔ yɛ Ijipt koni wɔbagboi yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɛɛ? Niyenii bɛ lɛ, nu hu bɛ; niyenii gbonyogbonyo nɛɛ yeli eje wɔtsine.” 6 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã onufui ni anaa jaraa babote Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛkɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii gboi. 7Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ba Mose ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔfee esha akɛ wɔwie wɔshi Yehowa kɛ bo fɛɛ. Kpa Yehowa fai ohã wɔ koni ejie onufui nɛɛ kɛje wɔteŋ.” Mose kpa fai lɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ. 8Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Okɛ dade ni kpɛlɛɔ afee onufu ni okɛtsotsoro tso bloblo nɔ, ni okɛma shi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni onufui lɛ eko ekɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, kɛji ewo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ onufu lɛ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ lɛ, eyi baana wala.” 9 No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ akɔɔble fee onufu, ni ekɛtsotsoro tso bloblo nɔ ni ekɛma shi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni onufui lɛ eko ekɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛɔ akɔɔble onufu lɛ, ni eyi naa wala.
Israelbii lɛ yashɛ Moabbii ajɔɔ lɛ mli
10Israelbii lɛ fã ekoŋŋ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Obot. 11Kɛjɛ Obot lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Abarim maŋ amaŋfɔ̃ ko ni yɔɔ ŋa ni kã Moabbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ. 12Be ni amɛfã ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛyato shi yɛ Zered Jɔɔ lɛ mli; 13ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yato shi yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kooyigbɛ ŋa kplanaa ni kã shi aahu kɛyaboteɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ. Arnon Faa nɛɛ ji Moabbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ ahusu. 14 No hewɔ lɛ, aŋmã yɛ Yehowa Tai Ahe Wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Wɔtsɔ̃ Waheb yɛ Sufa, kɛ Arnon Faa lɛ jɔi lɛ amli, 15kɛ gɔji lɛ hu ni amɛjɔi lɛ yaa kɛyashɛɔ Ar maŋ lɛ shikãmɔhe lɛ anɔ ni ji Moab kpokpai lɛ ahusu lɛ.”
16Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kooyigbɛ ni amɛyato shi yɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Nubuianaa, he ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ akɛ, “Buamɔ maŋbii lɛ anaa, ni mahã amɛ nu koni amɛnu” lɛ. 17Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Israelbii lɛ la nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ:
“Nubu, hã nu atue,
ni wɔɔɔbɔ oshe kɛhere lɛ atuu!
18Nubu ni lumɛi lɛ tsa,
ni maŋ abladei je
kɛ amɛtsii kɛ amɛdɛhiɛmɔ tsei lɛ.”
Israelbii lɛ shi ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛtee Matana, 19ni be ni amɛfã yɛ jɛi hu lɛ amɛtee Nahaliel, ni amɛjɛ Nahaliel kɛtee Bamot. 20Kɛjɛ Bamot lɛ amɛtee jɔɔ lɛ ni kã Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ mli yɛ Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ shishi. Kɛjɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ yiteŋ lɛ anaa shiaŋa kplanaa lɛ.
Aye Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Maŋtsɛ Og fɛɛ nɔ kunim
(Deuteronomio 2.26—3.11)
21 Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ŋɔ̃ɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 22“Ofainɛ, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho kɛkɛ. Wɔgbaŋ ŋmɔ ko loo waintrom ko mli lɛ, wɔnuŋ nubui lɛ amli nu lɛ eko hu. Maŋtsɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku kɛyaashi wɔɔɔfo mli yɛ okpokpai lɛ anɔ.” 23Shi Maŋtsɛ Sihon ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ akɛ Israelbii lɛ atsɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho. No hewɔ lɛ, ebua etabilɔi anaa, ni efã ta kɛyanina Israelbii lɛ yɛ Yahaz ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ wu. 24Shi Israelbii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Amorbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ naa aahu kɛyashwie Yabok Faa lɛ naa, ni ji Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ naa lɛ, ejaakɛ Amonbii lɛ etswa gbogboi yɛ amɛhusu lɛ naa. 25Ni Israelbii lɛ shɔ̃ Amorbii amaŋ ni ji Heshbon lɛ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛhi mli. 26Heshbon ji Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon lɛ maŋtsɛmaŋ. Sihon kɛ tsutsu Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ wu ni eshɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ kɛbashi Arnon Faa lɛ naa. 27No hewɔ ni alaa akɛɔ akɛ,
“Nyɛbaa Heshbon, nyɛhãa atswaa;
asaa atswa Maŋtsɛ Sihon maŋ lɛ ama shi.
28Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ, Heshbon maŋ nɛɛ mli
Sihon tabilɔi fã kɛjɛ oookɛɛ la.
Kɛyakpãtã Moab Ar maŋ lɛ hiɛ
kɛ Arnon gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
29 Kpoo hã bo, bo Moab!
Nyɛgbe nyɛjeŋ naa, nyɛ Kemosh jalɔi.
Ehã ebihii lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi,
ni ebiyei lɛ hu etsɔ̃mɔ
Amor Maŋtsɛ Sihon nomii.
30No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshwiei ahiɛ ekpãtã
kɛjɛ Heshbon aahu kɛyashwie Dibon tɔ̃ɔ;
kɛjɛ Nashim kɛtee Nofa
yɛ Medeba masɛi.”
31Bɔ ni fee ni Israelbii lɛ hi Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ. 32Mose tsu mɛi ni amɛtee amɛyasara Yazer maŋ lɛ amɛba; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ yatua maŋ lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛshwie Amorbii ni yɔɔ jɛi momo sa lɛ.
33 Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ dɔ amɛyi, ni amɛyi Bashan gbɛ. Bashan maŋtsɛ Og fã ta, lɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ, koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ abawu yɛ Edrei. 34 Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kaashe lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ miwo odɛ̃ŋ. Obaaye enɔ kunim, koni ofee lɛ bɔ ni ofee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni ye lumɔ yɛ Heshbon lɛ.” 35Israelbii lɛ gbe Maŋtsɛ Og kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni ashiii gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ; ni amɛŋɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi nɔ.

Title: NUMERI 22
Content:
Moab Maŋtsɛ tsu ayatsɛ Balaam abahã lɛ
1Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee ni kã Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ. 2Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, ena enu nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ efee Amorbii lɛ 3kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayifalɛ hu; ni no hewɔ lɛ, lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ she gbeyei naakpa. Israelbii lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi mɔ Moabbii lɛ. 4Moabbii lɛ kɛɛ Midian maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Ataamɛi, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni baa kɛ ta nɛɛ baakpãtã nibii ni yɔɔ wɔkpokpai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ tsina kpeɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak 5 tsu bɔfoi akɛ amɛya Petor ni kã Eufrate Faa lɛ naa yɛ Amawo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ koni amɛyakpee Balaam, Beor bi lɛ amɛbahã lɛ. Wiemɔ ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛyahã Balaam ji, “Naa, mɛi komɛi, jaku muu, efã kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba, ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Ni miwieɔ nɛɛ amɛbɛŋkɛ biɛ amɛtã, mihiɛ tua amɛ. 6No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, ba nɔŋŋ, shi amɛyi fa fe wɔ, koni obalomɔ amɛ ohã mi akɛ aleenɔ minine aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ koni mashwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lo. Mile akɛ kɛji ojɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, jɔɔmɔ baa mɔ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji olomɔ mɔ ko hu lɛ, loomɔ baa mɔ lɛ nɔ.”
7 Moab onukpai lɛ kɛ Midian onukpai lɛ yi mli amɛtee; ni amɛhiɛ klamɔ nyɔmɔwoo shika kɛtee. Be ni amɛyashɛ Balaam ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ wiemɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Balak kɛtsu amɛ lɛ hã lɛ. 8Balaam kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwɔa biɛ ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ lɛ mibaba mibakɛɛ nyɛ nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Moab onukpai lɛ kɛ Balaam hi shi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ.
9Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ba Balaam ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hii yɔɔ oŋɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?”
10Balaam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, tsu amɛ miŋɔ̃ɔ akɛ 11maŋ muu ko, ni jɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba, ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ mibalomɔ amɛ mihã lɛ koni enyɛ amɛ ekɛwu, ni eshwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
12Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Okɛ bɔfoi lɛ akaya tsɛmɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ okalomɔ nakai mɛi lɛ hu, ejaakɛ mɛi ni mijɔɔ amɛ ni.”
13No hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Balaam tee Balak bɔfoi lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa nyɛmaŋ. Yehowa ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ehãaa mi akɛ mikɛ nyɛ aya.” 14Kɛkɛ ni Moab onukpai lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba Balak ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Balaam ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ eba otsɛmɔ lɛ.”
15Maŋtsɛ Balak saa tsu bɔfoi ni ahiɛ tsii, asaŋ ni amɛyi fa fe tsutsubii lɛ; 16ni amɛtee Balaam ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, ni okahã nɔ ko nɔ ko miitsi bo tsɛmɔ lɛ baa gbɛ! 17Ejaakɛ mibawo ohiɛ nyam babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni obaakɛɛ mi lɛ, mibafee; no hewɔ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba koni obalomɔ mɛi ni ebaje nɛɛ ohã mi kɛkɛ.’ ”
18 Kɛkɛ ni Balaam here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Balak bɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Balak ŋɔ̃ ewe lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi tsu obɔ̃ kɛ kpo obɔ̃ tete eke mi po, minyɛŋ maje Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wiemɔ sɛɛ ni mafee nɔ ko ni fe aloo nɔ ko ni shɛɛɛ bɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ mi lɛ. 19Shi kɛ̃lɛ, nyɛ hu, nyɛwɔa biɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ tamɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ koni mabo nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ toi.”
20Nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Kɛji tsɛmɔ kɛkɛ hii nɛɛ ba bo tsɛmɔ lɛ, saamɔ ohe koni okɛ amɛ aya; shi moŋ nɔ pɛ ni makɛɛ bo lɛ no ofee.” 21No hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Balaam wo eteji nɔ nii, ni ekɛ Moab onukpai lɛ yi mli ni amɛtee.
Balaam kɛ eteji lɛ
22Shi Nyɔŋmɔ mli wo la akɛ Balaam miiya tsɛmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Balaam ta eteji lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ni eblahii enyɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ badamɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ koni esa enaa. 23 Be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni egbala eklante ehiɛ edɛŋ lɛ, ewi gbɛ lɛ, ni eyanyiɛ ŋa lɛ mli. Balaam yi teji lɛ koni ekɛdɔ eyi kɛba gbɛ lɛ nɔ. 24Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tee ni eyadamɔ gbɛ leleoo ko ni kã waintromi ateŋ lɛ nɔ; gbogbo yɛ gbɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ. 25Be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ekɛ ehe yakpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ, ni emia Balaam nane ekpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Balaam yi teji lɛ ekoŋŋ. 26Yehowa bɔfo lɛ saa etsi kɛtee ehiɛ, ni eyasa Balaam naa yɛ nififiaŋ he ko, he ni gbɛ bɛ ni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ he kɛyaa ninejurɔgbɛ loo abɛkugbɛ. 27Agbɛnɛ be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ, eho ebu shi. Balaam mli wo la ni ebɔ̃i teji lɛ yii. 28 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã teji lɛ wie, ni ebi Balaam akɛ, “Mɛni mifee bo hewɔ ni oyi mi shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛɛ?”
29Balaam here teji lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ oofee mi buulu. Eji mihiɛ klante kulɛ benɛ migbe bo momo.”
30Teji lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Ani jeee mi ji oteji ni otaa minɔ daa nɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ? Ani mifee bo nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã lo?”
Balaam jie naa akɛ, “Dabida!”
31Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gbele Balaam hiŋmɛii, ni ena Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛ eklante ni egbala ehiɛ edɛŋ. Balaam mã eyi shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi. 32Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni oyi oteji lɛ shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛɛ? Naa, miba koni mibasa onaa, ejaakɛ nyiɛmɔ nɔ ni onyiɛ nɛɛ ejaaa yɛ mihiɛ. 33Teji lɛ na mi, ni ewi ehe kɛje mihiɛ shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ. Ewiii ehe kɛjeee mihiɛ kulɛ, benɛ migbe bo momo, ni mihere teji lɛ kɛkɛ yiwala.” 34Balaam hã Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mifee esha; ejaakɛ mileee kwraa akɛ oba oosa minaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji minyiɛmɔ nɛɛ esaaa ohiɛ lɛ, maku misɛɛ mɔ.”
35Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Okɛ hii lɛ aya kɛkɛ; shi moŋ wiemɔ ni mikɛ bo aaawie lɛ, no nɔŋŋ pɛ owie.” Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛ Maŋtsɛ Balak bɔfoi lɛ tsa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtee.
Maŋtsɛ Balak here Balaam atuu
36Be ni Balak nu akɛ Balaam miiba etsɛmɔ lɛ, eyi mli kɛtee lɛ kpeemɔ yɛ Ar, ni ji Moabbii amaŋ ko ni kã Arnon Faa lɛ naa lɛ mli. Arnon Faa nɛɛ ji Moabbii ahusu. 37Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Ani jeee tsu mitsu kpɛkpɛ̃ɛkpɛ akɛ abatsɛ bo kɛba? Mɛɛba obaaa klɛŋklɛŋ tsɛmɔ lɛ? Ani osusuɔ akɛ minyɛŋ bo majuro bɔ ni sa lo?”
38Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Naa mi; miba. Shi moŋ, mɛɛ hewalɛ miyɔɔ? Wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛbaawo minaa lɛ, no nɔŋŋ mawie.” 39Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛ Balak shwie nɔ kɛba maŋ ni gbɛi ji Huzot lɛ mli; 40ni Balak kɛ tsinai kɛ toi shã afɔle yɛ jɛi, ni ehã ayahã Balaam kɛ onukpai ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ afɔleshãa loo lɛ eko. 41Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Balak tsɛ Balaam fata ehe, ni amɛkwɔ Baal Gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ; ni Balaam jɛ jɛi ni ena Israelbii asafo muu lɛ ayifalɛ.

Title: NUMERI 23
Content:
Balaam klɛŋklɛŋ gbalɛ
1Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Mãamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ biɛ ohã mi; ni obahã mi tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo.”
2Balak fee nɔ ni Balaam kɛɛ lɛ lɛ ni lɛ kɛ Balaam shã tsinanuu kome kɛ ojwɛni hu kome yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ. 3Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Yaadamɔ oshãa afɔle lɛ he, koni maya akɛ aleee nɔ mikɛ Yehowa aaakpe lo. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeekɛɛ mi lɛ, mibaba mibakɛɛ bo.” Kɛkɛ ni eyi mli etee gɔŋ kpataa ko nɔ.
4Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Balaam kpe, ni Balaam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Mimamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo, ni mishã tsinanuu kome kɛ ojwɛni hu kome yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.” 5Ni Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ wo Balaam naa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ kɛya Balak ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ bo lɛ.” 6Be ni Balaam ku esɛɛ kɛba Balak ŋɔɔ lɛ, Balak kɛ Moab lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ Balak shãa afɔle lɛ he.
7Kɛkɛ ni Balaam wo egbee nɔ, ni ebɔi gbaa ekɛɛ,
“Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak yaŋɔ mi kɛjɛ Siria,
yɛ bokã gɔji lɛ anɔ ekɛɛ:
‘Ba, baalomɔ Yakob;
Baalomɔ Israelbii ohã mi!’
8Shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ malomɔ
mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ lomɔko lɛ hu?
Te aaafe tɛŋŋ mashwe musu mahã mɔ ko
be ni Yehowa ekɛko nakai?
9Tɛsai ayiteŋ mijɛ mina amɛ;
ni gɔŋkpɔi anɔ mijɛ mikwɛ amɛ
akɛ maŋ ni amɛkome too amɛyɔɔ.
Amɛle akɛ ajɔɔ amɛ fe maji fɛɛ.
10 Israel shwiei ayikulɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu,
Amɛyi fa fe bɔ ni aaanyɛ akane.
Hã magbo jalɔi agbele
koni minaagbee atamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔ.”
11Kɛkɛ ni Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Te okɛ mi yeɔ tɛŋŋ nɛɛ? Miyaŋɔ bo kɛba koni obalomɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, shi jɔɔmɔ sɔŋŋ moŋ ojɔɔ amɛ nɛɛ!”
12Balaam here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ani esaaa akɛ makwɛ jogbaŋŋ koni mawie nɔ ni Yehowa kɛwo minaa lɛ?”
Balaam gbalɛ ni ji Enyɔ
13Agbɛnɛ Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ba ni wɔtee he kroko, he ni ooona Israelbii lɛ yɛ. Obaana amɛfã ko kɛkɛ; onaŋ amɛ fɛɛ; koni olomɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi ohã mi.” 14Balak kɛ Balaam tee Zofim ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ, ni eyamãmɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ jɛi, ni ekɛ tsinanuu komekome kɛ ojwɛni hu komekome shã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
15Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Baadamɔ biɛ yɛ oshãa afɔle lɛ he, koni matsi kɛya hiɛ fioo koni mikɛ Yehowa ayakpe.”
16Yehowa kɛ Balaam kpe, ni ekɛ wiemɔ wo enaa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ kɛya Balak ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ bo lɛ.” 17Ni Balaam ku esɛɛ kɛba, ni ebanina Balak kɛ Moab onukpai lɛ fɛɛ damɔ Balak shãa afɔle lɛ he. Kɛkɛ ni Balak bi Balaam akɛ, “Mɛni Yehowa kɛɛ?” 18Balaam wo egbee nɔ, ni ebɔ̃i gbaa, ni ekɛɛ,
“Tee shi, Balak, ni obo mi toi;
Zipor binuu, feemɔ toi ohã mi.
19 Nyɔŋmɔ jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ni eeemale,
aloo gbɔmɔ ni eeeshwa ehe yɛ nɔ ni efee hewɔ.
Mɛni ekɛɛ dã ni efeee;
aloo ewo ehe shi ni eyeee nɔ?
20Naa, jɔɔmɔ efã mi akɛ mijɔɔ;
Ena ejɔɔ amɛ momo, ni minyɛŋ hiɛ matsake
21Minaaa akɛ osharã ko basharã Israel,
aloo Israel he baajara lɛ.
Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ yɛ;
lɛ amɛbɔɔ oshe amɛhãa akɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ.
22Nyɔŋmɔ jie amɛ kɛje Ijipt;
amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ he wa oookɛɛ wuo.
23Ŋkunyaa ko nyɛŋ Israel,
ni klamɔ ko hu mɔŋ lɛ.
Odase ni abaaye yɛ Israel he ji akɛ,
‘Nyɔŋmɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ.’
24Naa, Israel teɔ shi tamɔ jata yoo;
ni ewoɔ ehe nɔ tamɔ jata nuu.
Ebuuu shi, ja egbe ni eye,
ni enu mɛi ni egbegbee alá etã dã.”
25Kɛkɛ ni Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Kaalomɔ amɛ, ni kaajɔɔ amɛ hu.”
26Shi Balaam here Balak nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ lɛ no mibafee lo?”
Balaam gbalɛ ni ji Etɛ̃ lɛ
27Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ hã wɔya he kroko. Eko lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaana he tsui, ni eeeŋmɛ bo gbɛ akɛ olomɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ jɛi ohã mi.” 28Ni Balak kɛ Balaam shwie nɔ kɛtee Poer Gɔŋ ni kwɛɔ shiaŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ lɛ yiteŋ. 29Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Mãamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ biɛ ohã mi; ni obahã mi tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo yɛ biɛ.” 30Balak fee nɔ ni Balaam kɛɛ lɛ lɛ; ni Balak kɛ tsinanuu kɛ ojwɛni shã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.

Title: NUMERI 24
Content:
1Shi Balaam eyɔse akɛ Yehowa suɔmɔ naa ji akɛ ejɔɔ Israelbii lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, eyaaa tamɔ bei krokomɛi lɛ akɛ eyaatao okadii. Shi moŋ ewo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ekwɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ. 2Ena Israelbii lɛ ni amɛjwere shi yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa. Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ bayi Balaam nɔ, 3 ni ewo enaa nɔ, ni egba ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Balaam, Beor bi lɛ, ninaa nɛ,
nuu ninalɔ lɛ ninaa nɛ,
4 mɔ ni nuɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ
ni enaa ninaa ni Ofe lɛ jieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ,
mɔ ni buɔ shi, shi enaa nii lɛ.
5Kwɛ bɔ ni Israel bui lɛ yɔɔ fɛo!
Israel shihilɛhei amli yɛ akɔnɔ
6tamɔ faa he jɔi ni elɛɛ shi
oookɛɛ faa toi abɔi,
tamɔ tsei fɛɛfɛji ni Yehowa tɛo
oookɛɛ faa toi tsenedrutsei.
7Nu aaajɛ onubui amli, Israel,
ashwie shi ni oshwiei kɛaadu nii.
Omaŋtsɛ lɛ baaje agbo fe Maŋtsɛ Agag,
ni aaawo emaŋtsɛyeli nɔ.
8Nyɔŋmɔ yajie amɛ yɛ Ijipt,
ni amɛhe wa tamɔ wuo.
Amɛbaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ amaji anɔ,
ni amɛbaajwara amɛwui wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ,
ni amɛkɛ amɛgãii lɛ baatsɛ̃rɛ amɛ.
9 Edɛke shi;
ebu shi tamɔ jata, tamɔ jatayoo;
namɔ aaatsiɛ lɛ?
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɔɔ bo lɛ, aaajɔɔ lɛ,
ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lomɔɔ bo lɛ, aaalomɔ lɛ.”
10Balak kɛ mlifu tswa edɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Miyakpee bo kɛba koni obalomɔ mihenyɛlɔi ohã mi lɛ, jɔɔmɔ sɔŋŋ moŋ ojɔɔ amɛ shii etɛ̃ nɛɛ fɛɛ. 11No hewɔ lɛ, kuu osɛɛ ni oya omaŋ. Mito miyiŋ akɛ majuro bo; shi Yehowa etsi juromɔ ni majuro bo lɛ naa.”
12Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ obɔfoi ni otsu amɛ miŋɔɔ lɛ tete akɛ, 13‘Naa, kɛji Balak ŋɔ̃ ewe lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi tsu obɔ̃ tete eke mi lɛ, minyɛŋ maje Yehowa wiemɔ sɛɛ koni mato miyiŋ mafee nɔ kpakpa loo nɔ fɔŋ ko. Nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ lɛ no nɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni mawie.’ ”
Balaam naagbee gbalɛ
14Balaam tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Mi lɛ miiya mimaŋ, shi dani mashwie nɔ lɛ, mibatswa bo adafi yɛ nɔ ni Israel maŋ nɛɛ baafee omaŋ lɛ wɔsɛɛ ko he.”
15Kɛkɛ ni Balaam wo enaa nɔ, ni ebɔ̃i gbaa ekɛɛ, “Balaam, Beor binuu lɛ, ninaa nɛ. Nɔ ni mɔ ni agbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ kɛɛ nɛ:
16‘Mɔ ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ,
ni eleɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ yiŋtoi lɛ,
ni Ofe lɛ jieɔ ninai etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ,
ni ehiɛ bu shi, shi enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ:
17 Miina Israel, shi jeee bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ minaa lɛ,
shi eyɛ shɔŋŋ.
Ŋulami ko baaje yɛ Yakob,
Maŋtsɛ tso ko baate shi yɛ Israel,
ni ebaatswia Moab hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ anii,
ni ebaaye Set shwiei lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
18 Ebaaye Edom nɔ,
ni eeeye Seir hu nɔ,
eeeye ehenyɛlɔi lɛ hu anɔ
ni eeeŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ
be mli ni Israel yeɔ kunim lɛ.
19 Israel jaku baanaanaa
amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ,
ni eeekpãtã mɛi ni aaashwɛ
yɛ maji lɛ amli lɛ ahiɛ.’ ”
20 Agbɛnɛ Balaam na Amalekbii lɛ yɛ ninaa lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ gbalɛ lɛ kɛtee amɛnɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Amalek ji majimaji lɛ ateŋ
mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ fe fɛɛ;
shi naagbee mli aahu lɛ,
ehiɛ baakpãtã kwraa.”
21 Balaam na Kenbii lɛ hu yɛ ninaa lɛ mli, ni egba yɛ amɛhe akɛ,
“Oshihilɛhe lɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe
tamɔ loofɔlɔ tsu ni mã tɛsaa nɔ.
22Kɛ̃lɛ Kenbii ahiɛ baakpãtã
ni etsɛŋ ni Asiria aaaŋɔ̃ bo nom.”
23Balaam tee nɔ ni egba gbalɛ nɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Ao, namɔ aaahi walaŋ,
ni ena be ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaafee nii nɛɛ?
24Akɛ ta lɛji aaajɛ Kipro aba
ni aaabaye Asiria kɛ Eber nɔ.
Shi tatsɛmɛi nɛɛ hu ahiɛ aaakpãtã kɛya naanɔ.”
25Kɛkɛ ni Balaam yi mli, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋ, ni Balak hu ku esɛɛ kɛtee ejɛɛhe.

Title: NUMERI 25
Content:
Israelbii lɛ ashihilɛ yɛ Peor kpokpai anɔ
1Be ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ Shitim, Akasia tso Jɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ, amɛhii lɛ kɛ Moab yei lɛ bɔ̃i ajwamãŋbɔɔ. 2Moab yei lɛ kpeɔ Israelhii lɛ kɛyaa hei ni amɛshãa afɔlei amɛkɛhãa amɛmaŋ wɔji lɛ yɛ lɛ; ni Israelhii lɛ yayeɔ afɔleshãa niyenii lɛ eko, ni amɛjaa Moabbii lɛ awɔji lɛ hu. 3 Ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ amɛhe yabɔ jemawɔŋ Peor lɛ he.
