Nyɛ kɛ amɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko, ni asaŋ nyɛkanaa amɛ mɔbɔ. 3 Nyɛkɛ amɛ akabotea gbãlãshihilɛ mli; nyɛkɛ nyɛbiyei akahãa amɛbihii gbãlã lɛ, nyɛkaŋɔa amɛbiyei nyɛhãa nyɛbihii hu gbãlã. 4Ejaakɛ amɛbiyei lɛ aaahã nyɛbihii lɛ akpale yɛ misɛɛ ni amɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi. Enɛ baahã Yehowa mli awo nyɛ la, ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ. 5 Bɔ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ aye ahã moŋ nɛ: amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ nyɛkumɔa, ni amɛshiui ni amɛmamɔ lɛ nyɛjwaraa, ni amɛwɔŋkoi lɛ nyɛgbaa nyɛshwiea shi, ni amɛmãgãi lɛ nyɛmamɔa amɛnaa la nyɛshãa.
6 “Nyɛfea nakai ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ nyɛ ehã ehe akɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ. Eje gbɛ ni eŋɔ nyɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛtsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii krɛdɛɛ. 7Jeee fa ni nyɛyi fa fe maji fɛɛ hewɔ ni Yehowa sumɔ nyɛ, ni eŋɔ nyɛ akɛ ewebii lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ moŋ po ji mɛi komɛi ni nyɛyi faaa kwraa yɛ maji fɛɛ ateŋ. 8Shi moŋ suɔmɔ ni esumɔɔ nyɛ hewɔ, shi bɔ ni afee ni eye shi ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nineshiwalɛ jie nyɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje nyɔŋ ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ. 9 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ koome lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo, mɔ ni yeɔ shi ni ewo nɔ, asaŋ ni esuɔmɔ tsakeee yɛ mɛi ni esumɔɔ ni amɛyeɔ ekitãi anɔ kɛyashiɔ amɛshwiei ni ji akpe lɛ ayinɔ tɔ̃ɔ lɛ. 10Shi mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ, egbalaa amɛtoi, ni amɛnaa kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi; ekɛ mɔ ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ toigbalamɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ shi; shi efeɔ, ni mɔ lɛ naa. 11No hewɔ lɛ, kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛyea nɔ.”
Toiboo sɛɛ jɔɔmɔi
(Deuteronomio 28.1-14)
12“Kɛji nyɛbo nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ toi, ni nyɛye nɔ lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baaye kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaasumɔ nyɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi eto lɛ. 13Ebaasumɔ nyɛ, ni ebaajɔɔ nyɛ, ni ebaahã nyɛyi afa. Ebaajɔɔ nyɛmusuŋbii hu kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii bɔ ni nyɛbele kɛ nyɛwaintsei kɛ mu kɛ nyɛtsinai kɛ nyɛtoi baashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ nɔ. 14Aaajɔɔ nyɛ fe jeŋ maji fɛɛ; nyɛteŋ nuu ko loo yoo ko ehiŋ shi ni efɔŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛkooloo ko hu ehiŋ shi ni efɔŋ. 15Ni Yehowa baajie helai fɛɛ kɛje nyɛteŋ; ehaŋ Ijipt helai fɔ̃ji lɛ eko kwraa aye nyɛ; shi moŋ ebaahã helai nɛɛ aye nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ. 16 Maji fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatu awo nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli; ni nyɛkajaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ no baahã nyɛdu tsɔne.
17 “Nyɛkakɛa nyɛhe akɛ, ‘Maji nɛɛ ayi fa fe wɔ; te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔnyɛ amɛ wɔshwie lɛ?’ 18Nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, shi moŋ nyɛkaia nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ. 19Nyɛkaia helai wuji kɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii lɛ kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛkpɔ̃ nyɛ lɛ. Nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baafee maji fɛɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛsheɔ amɛ gbeyei lɛ. 20 Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã sosomootii ababote amɛteŋ kɛbahao amɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni amɛteiaŋ mɛi ni baajo nyɛnaa foi amɛyatee amɛhe lɛ tete ahiɛ aaakpãtã. 21Nyɛtsui akafãa yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ji mɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ. 22Shi fiofio ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baashwie maji nɛɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ. Nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛkpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ shi kome, no lɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi lɛ ayi baafa fe nine awo nyɛ. 23Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baatu amɛ awo nyɛdɛŋ, ni ebaahã amɛ jijaa jijaamɔ wulu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. 24Ebaatu maji lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ewo nyɛdɛŋ; ni nyɛaagbe amɛ, ni amɛgbɛii baalaaje yɛ jeŋ. Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ nyɛhiɛ adamɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakpãtã amɛhiɛ. 25Nyɛmamɔa amɛnyɔŋmɔi ni ji amãgãi lɛ anaa la nyɛshãa. Nyɛhiɛ akakɔ̃a jwiɛtɛi loo shika ni yɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ anɔ ni nyɛŋɔ eko nyɛhã nyɛhe, koni no akafee kaa miihã nyɛ, ejaakɛ musu nii ni hã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 26 Nyɛkɛ musu nii ko akayaa nyɛshĩai amli ni no hã nyɛloo musu tamɔ nii lɛ nɔŋŋ. Nyaŋemɔ nyɛnyaŋea, ni hi nyɛhia amɛ, ejaakɛ alomɔ amɛ.

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 8
Content:
Shikpɔŋ Kpakpa ni ayaaŋɔ lɛ
1“Kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nɔ koni nyɛyi ana wala, ni nyɛshwere, ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ. 2 Nyɛkaia gbɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ tsɔ̃ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ nɛɛ mli lɛ, koni ekɛhã nyɛhumi shi, ni asaŋ koni etsɔ̃ nɔ ekɛka nyɛ ekwɛ ni ekɛle nɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ nyɛaaye ekitãi lɛ anɔ lo, aloo nyɛyeŋ nɔ. 3 Ehã hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, ni ehã nyɛhumi shi; ni ehã nyɛ mana ni nyɛye, niyenii ko ni nyɛleee, ni nyɛtsɛmɛi hu tete leee nɔ ni ji lɛ, koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ jeee aboloo pɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala, shi moŋ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni jɛɔ Yehowa daaŋ lɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala. 4Nɛkɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ nyɛtadei tserɛɛɛ yɛ nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛnaji efuufuu hu. 5Belɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miitsɔse nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ tsɔseɔ ebi. 6No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei. 7Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ miiya shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ fai kɛ kpaakpoi kɛ shikpɔŋ nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛɔ jɔi kɛ gɔji amli; 8shikpɔŋ ni ebaa ŋmãa kɛ abele kɛ wainyibii kɛ agbãmi kɛ akutu kɛ mutso kɛ wo hu. 9Daaŋŋmãa ni nyɛaaye he esɛŋ, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaŋ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Dade yɛ emli tɛi lɛ amli; ni nyɛaana akɔɔble hu nyɛtsa yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ amli. 10Nyɛbaaye nii nyɛtɔrɔ, ni nyɛbaajie Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ehã nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Hiɛ akakpa Yehowa nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ
11 “Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia koni nyɛhiɛ akakpa Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni no hã nyɛyeee ekitãi kɛ emlai kɛ ekpɔi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ. 12Kɛji nyɛna nii nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ, ni nyɛmamɔ shĩai fɛɛfɛji nyɛhi mli, 13ni nyɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛ nyɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ nyɛshika kɛ nyɛnibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ shwere lɛ, 14nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni nyɛkawo nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ miikpa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. Lɛ mɔ ni ejie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ. 15 Lɛ ji mɔ ni kpala nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ shiaŋa kpeteŋkple ni nɔ yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ nɔ lɛ, he ni onufui ni naa jaraa kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi kɛ nu hɔmɔ yɔɔ lɛ. Lɛ ehã nu tue kɛjɛ tswɛrɛbo tɛsaa mli hã nyɛ, ni nyɛna nyɛnu; 16ni ekɛ mana ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee lɛ, lɛ nyɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ koni ehã nyɛhumi shi, ni asaŋ koni ekɛka nyɛ ekwɛ, koni naagbee mli lɛ efee nyɛ ejurɔ. 17No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni nyɛkakɛɛ yɛ nyɛtsuiŋ yɛ he akɛ, ‘Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ naa hã wɔshwere nɛkɛ nɛɛ.’ 18Shi moŋ nyɛkaia akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni duro nyɛ hewalɛ ni nyɛkɛna nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, koni ehã ekpãŋmɔ ni ekã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he lɛ ama shi, tamɔ nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ. 19Shi naa, kɛji nyɛhiɛ je Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ, ni nyɛshi lɛ sɛɛ, ni nyɛtee nyɛyasɔmɔ ni nyɛja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, no lɛ, miigba mli kpoo miikɛɛ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ kpãtãmɔ kɛ̃ nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. 20Bɔ ni Yehowa baahã maji ni nyɛkɛaakpe lɛ ahiɛ akpãtã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã kɛji nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ wiemɔ toi lɛ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 9
Content:
Maŋ lɛ gbo toi
1“Nyɛboa toi, Israelbii! Nyɛbaafo Yordan Faa lɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔji yɛ maji ni dara, ni asaŋ amɛhe wa hu fe nyɛ adɛŋ, shikpɔji kɛ amɛnɔ maji wuji kɛ amɛhe gbogboi ni atswa kɛtee ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ akɛwaje amɛ. 2 Shikpɔji nɛɛ anɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ dara ni amɛkwɔlɔ hu. Anakbii lɛ ashwiei ji amɛ, ni tamɔ nyɛle momo lɛ, nyɛnuɔ akɛ akɛɔ yɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Namɔ baanyɛ Anakbii lɛ ahiɛ adamɔ?’ 3Shi moŋ nyɛnaa nyɛlea ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛyaa lɛ etamɔ la grigri ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ. Lɛ ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ebaaye amɛnɔ, ni ebaajɔɔ amɛhe yɛ nyɛhiɛ koni nyɛshwie amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ oya tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛ shi eto momo lɛ.
4“Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eshwie amɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ lɛ, nyɛkakɛa yɛ nyɛtsuiŋ akɛ, ‘Ja ni wɔja hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ ba koni wɔbaŋɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ.’ Dabida! Ejaakɛ Yehowa baashwie gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ hewɔ. 5Jeee nyɛjalɛ loo nyɛtsuiŋ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ hewɔ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ; shi moŋ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miishwie amɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ hewɔ, bɔ ni afee ni, shi ni lɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob lɛ ema nɔ mi. 6 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ jeee nyɛjalɛ hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɛɛ hãa nyɛ koni nyɛŋɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ tuuŋtu lɛ maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ.
7“Nyɛkaia, ni nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ, bɔ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛwo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mlifu nyɛhã be mli ni nyɛyɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hiɛ atua sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ nyɛtseɔ. 8 Nyɛwo Yehowa mli la yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he hu, ni emli fu nyɛ, ni kulɛ eehe nyɛhiɛ ekpãtã. 9Be ni mikwɔ gɔŋ lɛ koni miyahe tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ ni aŋma kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ kpãŋ lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ; mihi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ; miyeee nii lɛ, minuuu nu hu. 10Ni Yehowa kɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ hã mi, nɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewao eŋma wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ, wiemɔ ni Yehowa jɛ la lɛ teŋ ekɛ nyɛ wie kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbi nɔ ni maŋ lɛ kpe kpee wulu lɛ. 11Shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ anaagbee lɛ, Yehowa kɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni aŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ, hã mi.
12“Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kpelekemɔ shi oya ni oya, ejaakɛ omaŋbii lɛ ni okpala kɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ eye sane fɔŋ. Yeee be ko kwraa nɛɛ lɛ, amɛkwa bɔ ni miwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛhi shi amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛshwie amãgã amɛhã amɛhe.’
13“Yehowa kɛɛ hu akɛ, ‘Mikwɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ aahu, ni mina akɛ amɛkuɛŋ ti. 14No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni mabule amɛshishi kwraa yɛ je lɛ mli. No sɛɛ lɛ, mahã oshwiei ashwere ni efɛo ni etsɔ̃ jaku ni da, ni yɛ hewalɛ fe amɛ.’
15“No hewɔ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ mihe, ni mikpeleke gɔŋ lɛ, ni mihiɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni aŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ miniji enyɔ. Nakai be mli fɛɛ lɛ gɔŋ lɛ miitso kɛ la. 16Ni mikwɛ, ni naa nyɛfee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shishi esha; nyɛfee tsina ni ashwie; amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛkpale kɛjɛ gbɛ ni Yehowa ewo nyɛ he kitã lɛ nɔ. 17Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni mihiɛ kɛ miniji enyɔ lɛ tswia shi, ni mijwara amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ. 18Kɛkɛ ni mitee ekoŋŋ, ni miyagbee shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ. Miye nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni miyeee nii lɛ, minuuu nu hu, yɛ nyɛtoigbele kɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee Yehowa ni nyɛkɛwo emli la lɛ hewɔ. 19 Mishe gbeyei akɛ Yehowa kɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ baakpãtã nyɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee kralo akɛ ebaafee nakai. Shi naagbee lɛ Yehowa bo mi toi nakai be lɛ hu. 20Yehowa mli fu Aaron hu jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, bɔ ni he eheɔ lɛ egbe nɛɛ. Shi mikpa fai mihã Aaron hu. 21Kɛkɛ ni miwo tsina amãgã ni nyɛshwie lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛkɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, ni mishã, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ mishimɔ, ni miwiɛ lɛ kɛyashi efee munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ mlu, ni mitsi mlu nɛɛ mishwie faa ni jɛɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ hoɔ lɛ mli. 22Nyɛku sɛɛ nyɛwo Yehowa mlifu yɛ Tabera kɛ Masa kɛ Kibrot Hataava fɛɛ. 23Ni be ni Yehowa wo nyɛ gbɛ yɛ Kadesh Barnea akɛ nyɛya koni nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni ekɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛŋɔ lɛ, no mli hu nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ atua, ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee, ni nyɛbooo lɛ toi hu. 24Yehowa hiɛ atua sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ nyɛtseɔ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni mile nyɛ lɛ.
25“Miho mikã shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ ebaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ. 26Mikpa Yehowa fai mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, kaakpãtã bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi lɛ, ni ji gbɔmɛi ni oyakpɔ̃ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahiɛ. 27Kwɛmɔ otsuji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ahewɔ; kaadi gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akuɛŋtilɛ loo amɛnifɔɔjianii kɛ nishaianii lɛ asɛɛ,’ 28 koni shikpɔŋ ni oyakpɔ̃ wɔ kɛje nɔ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ ni Yehowa nyɛɛɛ ekɛ amɛ ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo amɛ shi yɛ he lɛ nɔ, kɛ agbɛnɛ hu nyɛ ni enyɛɔ amɛ moŋ hewɔ ni eyakpala amɛ kɛtee lɛ, koni eyagbe amɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. 29Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi ni oje gbɛ oŋɔ ji amɛ, ni oyakpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa.’

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 10
Content:
Aŋma Kitãi lɛ ahã Mose ekoŋŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 34.1-10)
1 “Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ ni tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ tɛi lɛ; asaŋ okɛ tso akpɛ adeka. Kɔlɔmɔ tɛi lɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 2 Mibasaa maŋma wiemɔi ni yɔɔ tsutsu tɛi lɛ ni ojwara lɛ anɔ lɛ mawo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii nɛɛ anɔ ni okɛ tɛi lɛ ato adeka lɛ mli.’
3“No hewɔ lɛ, mikpɛ tso adeka ko, ni miko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ tsutsu tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni mihole tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ mihiɛ kɛkwɔ gɔŋ lɛ. 4Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fee klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, eŋma kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ. Kitãi nɛɛ ji wiemɔ ni Yehowa jɛ la lɛ teŋ ekɛ nyɛ wie kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbi nɔ ni maŋ lɛ kpe kpee wulu lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ hã mi, 5ni mitsɔ̃ mihe, ni mikpeleke shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba. Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ mifee lɛ, mikɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ bawo adeka lɛ ni mikpɛ lɛ mli, ni amɛyɛ mli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.” 6 (Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Yaakanbii lɛ anubui lɛ ahe kɛtee Mosera. Jɛi Aaron gbo yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ afu lɛ yɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ebinuu Eleazar baye esɛɛ akɛ osɔfo. 7Kɛjɛ Mosera lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã kɛtee Gudgoda; ni kɛjɛ Gudgoda lɛ amɛtee Yotbata, ni ji shikpɔŋ ko ni fai yɔɔ nɔ lɛ. 8 Be ni ayɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔ Levi akutso lɛ akɛ amɛ amɛtere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ. Asaŋ amɛ amɛdamɔ ehiɛ amɛsɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛ pɛ amɛkɛ egbɛi ajɔɔ mɛi. Nitsumɔi nɛɛ amli amɛhiɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. 9No hewɔ ni Levibii akutso lɛ naaa amɛ kɔkrɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ tamɔ akutsei krokomɛi lɛ. Amɛ lɛ, amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ji akɛ amɛ amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ.)
10 “Mihi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ tamɔ tsutsu lɛ nɔŋŋ. Yehowa bo mi toi nakai be lɛ mli hu, ni eŋɔ nɔ akɛ ekpãtãaa nyɛhiɛ dɔŋŋ. 11Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa ni oyanyiɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ koni amɛya ni amɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ.’ ”
Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ
12 “No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ Israel, mɛni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, taoɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ dɔŋŋ fe akɛ nyɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛsumɔ lɛ ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ hu asɔmɔ lɛ. 13Nyɛyea Yehowa kitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi ni miwo nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ koni ahi ahã nyɛ. 14Naa, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ enɔ ni; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ emli nii lɛ fɛɛ hu enɔ ni. 15Kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa na suɔmɔ krɛdɛɛ hã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni eŋɔ nyɛ, ni ji amɛshwiei lɛ, yɛ maji fɛɛ ateŋ; ni nakai ekɛ nyɛ yɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. 16No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛkpliŋ lɛ, ni nyɛkafea nyɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi dɔŋŋ. 17 Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ aNyɔŋmɔ kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi anuŋtsɔ; lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe ni je agbo, ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ; mɔ ni kwɛɛɛ hiɛiaŋ, ni asaŋ eheee nyɔɔŋnii lɛ. 18Eyeɔ awusã kɛ okulafo sane ehãa amɛ, ni edɔɔ gbɔ he, ni ehãa amɛ nɔ ni amɛaaye kɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛaahã amɛhe. 19 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdɔa gbɔ he ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyato gbɔ pɛŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 20Nyɛshea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei; nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ; nyɛkpɛtɛa ehe, ni lɛ egbɛi lɛ pɛ nyɛkɛkã kitã. 21Nyɛjiea eyi ejaakɛ lɛ ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni asaŋ nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni etsu ehã nyɛ lɛ. 22 Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni tee Ijipt lɛ ayikulɛ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo; shi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛyi efa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 11
Content:
Yehowa agbojee
1“No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛye egbei kɛ ekpɔi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ daa nɛɛ. 2Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nyɛkaia tsɔsemɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsɔse nyɛ lɛ, kɛ egbojee lɛ kɛ enineshiwalɛ lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ hu. Ejaakɛ jeee nyɛbii ni amɛnako aloo amɛleko nibii nɛɛ ji mɛi ni mikɛ wieɔ nɛɛ. 3 Shi moŋ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛle okadii ni efee kɛ nibii ni efee Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Ijipt lɛ. 4 Nyɛna nɔ ni Yehowa fee Ijiptbii ata lɛ kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ; bɔ ni ehã Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ baha amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtã be mli ni amɛtiuɔ nyɛ lɛ. 5Nyɛle nibii ni Yehowa tsu ehã nyɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi beyinɔ ni nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ. 6 Nyɛkaiɔ nɔ ni efee Datan kɛ Abiram ni ji Ruben bi Eliab bii lɛ. Nyɛ Israel fɛɛ, nyɛhiɛ ni shikpɔŋ gba, ni emi amɛ kɛ amɛshiaŋbii kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛtsuji kɛ amɛkooloi fɛɛ hu. 7Nyɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi na nibii wuji nɛɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu lɛ.”
Shiwoo Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔɔmɔi
8“No hewɔ lɛ, kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhe awa koni nyɛnyɛ nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ mli kɛya nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ; 9 asaŋ koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei lɛ nɔ. 10Ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ etamɔɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ, he ni nyɛjɛ lɛ, he ni kɛji nyɛdu nii lɛ ja nyɛkɔ nyɛnane nyɛyashwie dumɔ nii lɛ nɔ nu dã, tamɔ afeɔ abɔɔ mli nii lɛ. 11Shi moŋ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ, gɔji kɛ jɔi ashikpɔŋ ni; ni nu nɛɔ nɔ; 12eji shikpɔŋ ko ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baa yi, ni ehiŋmɛi yɛ he afi muu lɛ fɛɛ.
13“Kɛji nyɛye kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ hu asɔmɔ lɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 14no lɛ ebaahã nu anɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ ebe mli, Agbiɛnaa kɛ Gbo fɛɛ, koni nyɛbele kɛ nyɛwaintso yibii kɛ mutso mu aba ahã nyɛ ni nyɛkpa. 15Ŋa nɔ jwɛi afu ahã nyɛkooloi. Nyɛbaana nii nyɛye ni nyɛtɔrɔ. 16Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia, bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ko akalaka nyɛ ni nyɛkpale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛja amɛ. 17 Kɛji nyɛfee nɛkɛ nɔ ko lɛ, Yehowa mli baafu nyɛ, ni ebaatsi nu naa, ni nu enɛŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baŋ nii, ni nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã oya yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
18“No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miwiemɔi lɛ atoa nyɛtsuiiaŋ kɛ nyɛmumɔ mli; nyɛkɛfimɔa nyɛnijiashi kɛ nyɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ akɛ hekaimɔ nii. 19Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbii; nyɛwiea he be ni nyɛtara shi yɛ shĩateŋ kɛ be ni nyɛnyiɛ gbɛ, kɛ be ni nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe kɛ be ni nyɛtsuɔ nii fɛɛ. 20 Nyɛŋmaa yɛ nyɛshĩai lɛ ashinaatsei lɛ kɛ nyɛmaji lɛ agboi lɛ hu ahe, 21koni nyɛwala kɛ nyɛbii lɛ hu awala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ gbii abɔ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɔɔ nɛɛ.
22“Kɛji nyɛjwɛŋ nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni nyɛye nɔ, ni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛhi shi pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkpɛtɛ ehe lɛ, 23no lɛ Yehowa baashwie maji nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛbaashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ maji ni dara ni amɛhe wa fe nyɛ ashikpɔji yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni nyɛbaaŋɔ akɛ nyɛnɔ. 24He fɛɛ he ni nyɛnane aaasa lɛ jɛi aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ. Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baajɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, kɛyanina Lebanon gɔji lɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ; ni ebaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa yɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ yɛ anaigbɛ. 25 Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã nyɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ nyɛhe gbeyei amɔmɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛaayashɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ bii, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ nyɛhiɛ adamɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi lɛ.
26“Naa, mikɛ jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ miishwie nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. 27Ebaafee jɔɔmɔ ehã nyɛ kɛji nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ; 28shi eeefee loomɔ ehã nyɛ kɛji nyɛyeee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ; kɛji nyɛyahiii shi bɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ nyɛhi shi lɛ, ni nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee sa lɛ. 29 Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, daamɔ Gerizim Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ koni ojaje nɔ ni ji jɔɔmɔ lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ; ni loomɔ lɛ odamɔ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ ojaje otsɔ̃ɔ. 30 (Gɔji enyɔ nɛɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ anaigbɛ yɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ More tsei lɛ amasɛi yɛ Gilgal maŋ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ). 31Ejaakɛ nyɛbaafo Yordan lɛ koni nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ. Kɛji nyɛtee nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ, 32nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛye akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mlai lɛ hu fɛɛ ni mikɛshwieɔ nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ anɔ.

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 12
Content:
Jamɔhe Koome
1“Akpɔi kɛ mlai ni nyɛjwɛŋ nɔ nyɛye nɔ gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɛ. 2Fitemɔ nyɛfitea hei fɛɛ ni maji ni nyɛyaashwie lɛ jaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɛ, yɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ anɔ jio gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ jio, tsei kusukusuu lɛ fɛɛ ashishi jio. 3 Nyɛkumɔa amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ shiui ni amɛkɛ tɛi emamɔ lɛ nyɛshwiea; ni amɛ, Ashera, wɔŋ koi lɛ nyɛshãa; amɛtso amãgãi lɛ nyɛfolɔa mli nyɛshwiea shi, koni akaja amɛ yɛ hei nɛɛ dɔŋŋ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ.
4“Shi bɔ ni amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jeee nakai nyɛbaaja Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛkɛ. 5Shi moŋ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baaŋɔ yɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ fɛɛ mli akɛ jɛi afee eshihilɛhe kɛ he ni aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nyɛyaa. 6Nyɛkɛ kooloi ni agbeɔ akɛ afɔle kɛ afɔlei ni ashãa lɛ kɛ ekrokomɛi lɛ, nyɛnibii amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛshiwoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa nikeenii lɛ kɛ nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai akromɔbii lɛ, ayaa jɛi. 7Nyɛyea nii lɛ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ jɛi, koni nyɛ kɛ nyɛshĩaŋbii fɛɛ amii ashɛ nyɛhe yɛ nyɛninenaa nitsumɔ nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
8“Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, nyɛkafea tamɔ wɔfeɔ yɛ biɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ; bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni sa ehiɛ lɛ, 9ejaakɛ nyɛnako nyɛshɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, he ni nyɛbaana hejɔlɛ yɛ lɛ. 10 Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baahã nyɛfee shweshweeshwe bɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi ni baabɔle nyɛ kɛkpe lɛ gbaŋ nyɛnaa, ni nyɛhe baajɔ nyɛ. 11Nakai be lɛ, he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nyɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã yɛ he lɛ ayaa. Nibii nɛɛ ji kooloi ni agbeɔ akɛ nyɛfɔlei kɛ afɔlei ni ashãa lɛ kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwo Yehowa shi yɛ he lɛ. 12 Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii hu ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ. Ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ agbaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko ahaŋ amɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. 13Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia koni nyɛkayashãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛkɛ ni nyɛaana, 14akɛ ja he pɛ ni Yehowa baaŋɔ yɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ ateŋ ekome mli lɛ. Jɛi pɛ nyɛshãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ; ni jɛi nyɛfee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ yɛ.
15“Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛgbeɔ nyɛkooloi ni Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, kɛduro nyɛ lɛ nyɛyeɔ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli. Mɔ ni he tse kɛ mɔ ni he tseee fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye tamɔ baayelɔ loo ofrote nɛkɛ. 16 Shi moŋ loo lɛ mli lá lɛ eko kɛkɛ ni nyɛkayea; nyɛtsia no nyɛshwiea tamɔ nu. 17Nii ni nyɛkɛmiishã afɔle lɛ, nyɛkayea eko yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ eko kwraa mli. Nyɛbele jio, nyɛwain jio, nyɛmu mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ jio, nyɛtoi loo nyɛtsinai akromɔbii lɛ jio, nii ni nyɛkɛwo shi lɛ jio, nyɛtsuijurɔnaa nikeenii lɛ jio, niyenii afɔlei lɛ jio nyɛkayea yɛ nyɛmaji amli. 18He pɛ ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ aye afɔlei lɛ yɛ kɛkɛ ji Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ he ni lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni nyɛaatsu lɛ hewɔ. 19Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ nyɛshikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni nyɛhiɛ akakpaa Levibii lɛ anɔ.
20“Kɛji be ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, elɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi lɛ, ni eba nyɛtsine akɛ nyɛye loo lɛ, nyɛyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛyeɔ loo bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ. 21Kɛji nyɛmaji lɛ kɛ he koome ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ teŋ jɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛgbea nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ ni Yehowa kɛduro nyɛ lɛ, yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli, koni nyɛye bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ. 22Mɔ ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni he tse fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye tamɔ baayelɔ loo ofrote nɛkɛ, 23 shi moŋ nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ koni nyɛkaye loo lɛ lá lɛ eko; ejaakɛ lá lɛ wala ni. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea wala lɛ kɛ loo lɛ fɛɛ. 24Nyɛkayea lá lɛ; atsi ashwie tamɔ nu. 25Nyɛkayea la lɛ bɔ ni afee ni kɛji nyɛfee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, ahi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ. 26Shi nyɛnikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ nyɛshiwoonii lɛ, nyɛkɛyaa he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, 27koni kooloo afɔle ni ashãa lɛ loo lɛ kɛ lá lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshã yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shi afɔlei krokomɛi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛtsia lá lɛ nyɛshwiea afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; shi loo lɛ nyɛyea. 28Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaahi ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ kɛya naanɔ, kɛ nyɛfee nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ lɛ.
Amãgãjamɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
29“Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã maji ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhi nɔ lɛ, 30nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni be ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni nyɛyadu tsɔne, ni nyɛkabia amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ahe sane ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Te amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ amɛhãa tɛŋŋ,’ ni nyɛ hu nyɛfee nakai. 31Nyɛkajaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ, nomɛi moŋ amɛfeɔ amɛkɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ. Amɛgbeɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei tete amɛkɛshãa afɔle amɛhãa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
32 “Nyɛyea nibii fɛɛ ni miwo nyɛ he kitã lɛ anɔ; nyɛkɛ nɔ ko akafataa he, ni nyɛkajiea nɔ ko hu yɛ mli.

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 13
Content:
1“Kɛji gbalɔ ko loo mɔ ko ni laa lamɔi te shi yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ okadi loo naakpɛɛ nɔ ko miiba, 2ni okadi lɛ loo naakpɛɛ nɔ lɛ na ba mli anɔkwaleŋ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛɛ ‘Nyɛhãa wɔyaa ni wɔyajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee koni nyɛsɔmɔ amɛ lɛ, 3nyɛkaboa nakai gbalɔ lɛ loo lamɔ shishitsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ toi; ejaakɛ kaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛkaa nyɛ lɛ. Eetao ena akɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ fɛɛ miisumɔ lɛ Yehowa lɛ lo. 4Nyɛjaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei; nyɛyea ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛboa lɛ toi; nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ, ni lɛ ehe nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akpɛtɛa. 5 Shi nakai gbalɔ lɛ loo mɔ ni laa lamɔi lɛ agbe lɛ. Ejaakɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli lɛ, hiɛ̃ atua. Eetao akɛ nyɛkahi shi bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo nyɛ kitã akɛ nyɛfee lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛgbe lɛ koni nyɛjie nakai su fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.’
6“Onyɛmi ni ji onyɛ musuŋbi, loo obinuu, loo obiyoo, loo oŋa ni kãa osɛɛ, loo oshieŋtsɛ ko ni okɛ lɛ shɛɔ hulu wɔɔ aaalaka bo akɛ ohã nyɛya ni nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛ loo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee lɛ, 7maji ni bɔle nyɛ kpaakpa lɛ kɛ maji ni kɛ nyɛteŋ jɛkɛ, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ biɛ kɛyashi biɛ lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ, 8kaakpɛlɛ̃, ni kaabo lɛ toi hu, kaana lɛ mɔbɔ, okabaa eyi, ni okatee enɔ hu, 9shi moŋ ogbe lɛ. Bo tsutsu otswa lɛ tɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi. 10Atswia lɛ tɛi ni egbo, ejaakɛ eetao akɛ akpala nyɛ kɛje Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ. 11No baahã Israel muu fɛɛ anu nɔ ni eba lɛ, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei koni akaye nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ eko yɛ nyɛteŋ dɔŋŋ.
12“Kɛji nyɛaanu yɛ maji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ ni nyɛhi amɛmli lɛ eko he akɛ 13nyɛteŋ hii yakagbɔmɛi komɛi ete shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛlaka maŋ lɛ mli bii, ni amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee lɛ, 14nyɛtaoa sane nɛɛ mli fitsofitso. Kɛji sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ abɔ nɛkɛ musu yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, 15no lɛ nyɛfãa klante yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ anɔ; nyɛgbea gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ. 16 Nyɛbuaa maŋ lɛ mli nibii fɛɛ ni ji haanii lɛ naa nyɛbuaa shi, yɛ maŋ blohu lɛ mli koni nyɛma maŋ lɛ kɛ haanii lɛ fɛɛ naa la nyɛshãa akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Akasaa maŋ lɛ ama dɔŋŋ koni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ. 17Nyɛkaŋɔa musunii lɛ eko kwraa nyɛtoa nyɛhãa nyɛhe bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa afo emlifu ni naa wa lɛ sɛɛ. Eeena nyɛ mɔbɔ, ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni eeehã nyɛyi afa tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi lɛ, 18 ejaakɛ nyɛbo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛye ekitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 14
Content:
Nɔ ni akafee yɛ yarafeemɔ mli
1 “Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bii ji nyɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛmiiye mɔ ko ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, nyɛkafolɔa nyɛhe gbɛ̃i, ni nyɛkashɛa nyɛhiɛnaa yɛ gbonyo lɛ hewɔ. 2Ejaakɛ Yehowa je gbɛ eŋɔ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ ateŋ ehã ehe akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Kooloi ni aye kɛ nii akaye
(Levitiko 11.1-47)
3“Nyɛkayea nɔ ko nɔ ko ni Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ ehe tseee. 4Kooloi ni nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nɛ: tsina kɛ gwantɛŋ kɛ abotia, 5kɛ ofrote kɛ baayelɔ kɛ odabɔ kɛ soŋai kɛ duŋ kɛ wuo kɛ otrɔ̃ŋ. 6Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni agba enane kokloto mli enyɔ, ni asaŋ egɔiɔ eniyenii, ni esaa etaa ni emiɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ, nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye. 7Shi nyɛkayea kooloo ko kooloo ko ja eyɛ kokloto ni agba mli, ni asaŋ egɔiɔ eniyenii, ni esaa etaa ni emiɔ ekoŋŋ. Kooloi tamɔ yooma kɛ kpɛŋkplɛ kɛ afutuɔkɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii ni amɛsaa amɛtaa amɛmiɔ ekoŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi agbalako amɛkoklotoi amli lɛ, amɛhe tseee hãaa nyɛ. 8Nyɛkayea kplotoo hu ejaakɛ agba enane kokloto mli enyɔ moŋ nɛ, shi egɔiii eniyenii etaaa. Nyɛkayea kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko loo; ni kɛji agbe eko lɛ ehe tete po nyɛkataa.
9“Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nu mli loo fɛɛ loo ni yɔɔ fiji ni eyɛ totoi hu yɛ ehe. 10Shi nɔ ni bɛ fiji ni totoi hu bɛ ehe lɛ nyɛkayea; ehe tseee hã nyɛ.
11“Loofɔji fɛɛ ni he tse lɛ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye. 12Shi enɛɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkayea: okropɔŋ kɛ akpaŋa kɛ ŋshɔŋ akroma, 13kɛ oka kɛ laalɔɔ kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ fɛɛ. 14Loofɔji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji kwãakwãalabite henɔi fɛɛ, 15kɛ duguma kɛ patu kɛ yaalai kɛ akroma kɛ amɛhenɔi fɛɛ. 16Ekrokomɛi ji omiɔhɔɔ henɔi lɛ, kɛ 17kpokukpoku kɛ guŋ kɛ oka, 18kɛ gɔ̃dɔ̃ kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ, kɛ obleku kɛ aputupata.
19“Kooloi nyɛ́ŋɛ́nyɛ́ŋɛ́ ni filikiɔ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛhe tseee, nyɛkayea. 20Kooloi ni filikiɔ ni he tse fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea.
21 “Nyɛkayea kooloo ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo. Aaanyɛ akɛ kooloo lɛ ahã gbɔ ni nyɛkɛyɔɔ nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli koni eye, aloo ahɔ̃ɔ ahã gbɔ kroko ko, ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ji nyɛ.
“Nyɛkahoa toobi kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu.”
Mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ he mla
22 “Nyɛjiea nyɛŋmɔshi nii mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome daa afi; 23ni nyɛkɛyaa he koome ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Nyɛyayea nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai akromɔbii kɛ nyɛbele kɛ nyɛmu ni nyɛnu nyɛwain mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ, koni nyɛkɛkase Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ nyɛwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ. 24Kɛji mɔ oshihilɛhe kɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ teŋ jɛkɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni owoŋ oŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ teremɔ kɛ jɛiyaa lɛ, 25no lɛ hɔɔmɔ ŋmɔshinii lɛ koni okɛ shika lɛ ahiɛ odɛ̃ kɛya he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. 26Okɛ shika nɛɛ ahe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baa otsine, too loo jio, tsina loo jio, wain jio, dãa ni wa jio, koni bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ aye yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ yɛ jɛi ni nyɛmii ashɛ nyɛhe.
27“Nyɛkashĩa Levibii ni nyɛkɛyɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ asɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ ahãaa amɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ loo gboshinii ko. 28Daa afii etɛ̃ naagbee lɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ amli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ fɛɛ anaa nyɛtoa yɛ nyɛmaji amli. 29Nyɛkɛ niyenii nɛɛ eko ahãa Levibii lɛ ni ahãaa amɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ko lɛ, kɛ gbɔi kɛ awusai kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ koni amɛna nii amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ; ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ nyɛninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 15
Content:
Heyeli Afi lɛ
(Levitiko 23.1-7)
1 “Daa afii kpawo lɛ heyeli afi ni. 2Bɔ ni afee yɛ afi lɛ nɔ nɛ: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efa enyɛmi Israelnyo nɔ ko lɛ, ekɛ nɔ lɛ ake mɔ lɛ; ekabi nɔ lɛ shi yɛ enaanyo loo enyɛmi lɛ dɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa efã akɛ ahã mɛi fɛɛ aye amɛhe. 3Kɛji mɔkpɔŋ ji mɔ ni hiɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ ahe yɛ edɛŋ, shi kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni lɛ, no lɛ onɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ edɛŋ lɛ okɛke lɛ.
4“Ohiafo kome nɛkɛ ehiŋ nyɛteŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baajɔɔ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ, koni nyɛŋɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ, 5kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi kɛkɛ, ni nyɛaajwɛŋ nɔ nyɛye kitã fɛɛ kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ. 6Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ. Nyɛbaafala maji babaoo nii, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko dɛŋ; nyɛaaye maji babaoo anɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ maŋ ko yeŋ nyɛnɔ.
7 “Kɛji nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo ko miiye ohia yɛ maŋ ko mli yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akawa lɛ yi, musuŋ akajoo yɛ nyɛmi ohiafo lɛ nɔ. 8Shi moŋ odɛ̃ŋ akpɔ ahã lɛ, ni ofa lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ehia lɛ bɔ ni efĩ lɛ ehã lɛ naa. 9Kwɛmɔ koni jwɛŋmɔ gbonyo akaba oyiŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Afi ni ji kpawo ni ji heyeli afi lɛ eshɛ etã’ hewɔ lɛ, otũ ohiɛ owo onyɛmi ohiafo lɛ, ni ohãaa lɛ nɔ ni ebaa ebafa lɛ. Kɛji nyɛmi ohiafo nɛɛ fo etsɛ Yehowa lɛ, eeebu bo fɔ. 10Shi moŋ hã lɛ nii lɛ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ onitsumɔi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛ onine aaata he lɛ. 11 Ejaakɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, ohiafo kpãŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã nɛɛ, akɛ nyɛdɛŋ akpɔ ahã nyɛmi Israelnyo ohiafo ni efĩ lɛ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni akɛ nyɔji aye ahã
(Ɛksodɔs 21.1-11)
12“Kɛji ahɔ̃ɔ onyɛmi Hebrinyo ahã bo lɛ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, esɔmɔ bo afii ekpaa; afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, oŋmɛɛ ehe koni eye ehe tswaa. 13Shi kɛji oŋmɛɛ nyɔŋ lɛ he koni eye ehe tswaa lɛ, kaahã eeya kɛ edɛ̃ folo. 14Shi moŋ okɛ otoi lɛ kɛ obele lɛ kɛ owain lɛ eko awo lɛ gbɛ. Okwɛ jɔɔmɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɔɔ bo lɛ nɔ koni ohã lɛ nii lɛ bɔ ni sa ni okɛwo lɛ gbɛ. 15Kaimɔ akɛ bo hu kulɛ nyɔŋ ji bo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa kpɔ̃ bo. No hewɔ ni miwoɔ bo nɛkɛ kitã nɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ. 16Shi kɛji nyɔŋ lɛ aaakɛɛ bo akɛ esumɔɔɔ akɛ eshi bo, akɛni esumɔɔ bo kɛ owe lɛ ejaakɛ eyɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ, 17no lɛ ŋɔɔ nyɔŋ lɛ kɛba shinaa lɛ naa, ni akɔ fitii ni akɛgbu nyɔŋ lɛ toi. Enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ etsɔ̃ onyɔŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ afee yoo nyɔŋ hu. 18 Omusuŋ akashã bo akɛ oooŋmɛɛ nyɔŋ he koni eye ehe tswaa, ejaakɛ ekome lɛ, etsu apaafoi enyɔ anitsumɔ ehã bo afii ekpaa nɛɛ fɛɛ. Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔ bo yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ofeɔ mli.
Toi kɛ Tsinai akromɔbii
19“Nyɛjɔa nyɛtoi lɛ kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ hu akromɔbii hii fɛɛ ni aaafɔ lɛ anɔ nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Nyɛkɛ tsinai akromɔbii lɛ akatsua nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni nyɛtoi akromɔbii lɛ hu nyɛkakua amɛhe tsɔi. 20Nyɛ kɛ nyɛwekui kɛ nyɛwebii baaya he ni Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ daa afi koni nyɛyagbe kooloi nɛɛ yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛye yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 21 Shi kɛji kpa ko yɛ kooloo ko he lɛ, akpake ni jio, shwilamɔ ni jio, kpa fɛɛ kpa ni eji lɛ, nyɛkɛ no akashãa afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 22Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nakai kooloo lɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli tamɔ nyɛyeɔ soŋai loo ofrote nɛkɛ lɛ. Mɔ ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni he tse fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye eko. 23 Kooloo lɛ mli lá lɛ moŋ kɛkɛ nyɛkaye; nyɛtsia lá lɛ nyɛshwiea tamɔ atsiɔ nu ashwieɔ shi.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 16
Content:
Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ
(Ɛksodɔs 12.1-20)
1“Nyɛhiɛ ahia Abib nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ nyɛhã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ Abib nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋteŋ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 2No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyaa he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni nyɛgbea too kɛ tsina akɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa. 3Nyɛkɛ masha nii akayea Hehoo niyenii lɛ. Nyɛyea ma akpiti aboloo gbii kpawo akɛ amanehulu aboloo, ejaakɛ nyɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ hejojomɔ. Nyɛyea ma akpiti aboloo nɛɛ koni nyɛwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛkai gbi ni nyɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 4 Akana mashanii ko yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko gbii kpawo lɛ fɛɛ. Asaŋ kooloo ni agbe akɛshã afɔle lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛ lɛ, loo lɛ, akahã je miitsɛre eko nɔ.
5“Nyɛkayea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmaji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ eko eko mli, 6akɛ ja yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Jɛi nyɛgbe Hehoo afɔle kooloo lɛ yɛ, gbɛkɛnaashi mli be ni hulu yaanyɔ shi lɛ, ejaakɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa mli nyɛshi Ijipt. 7Nyɛhoa kooloo lɛ, ni nyɛyea yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ; ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa nyɛshĩaiaŋ. 8Nyɛyea ma akpiti aboloo lɛ gbii ekpaa, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, akpe kpee wulu akɛja Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ.”
Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔyeli
(Ɛksodɔs 34.22; Levitiko 23.15-21)
9“Nyɛkanea otsii kpawo kɛjɛ be mli ni abɔiɔ abelekuu lɛ, 10koni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa nikeenii ayea otsii agbijurɔ lɛ nyɛkɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eduro bo ehã lɛ naa. 11Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli kɛ maŋsɛɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ. Nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. 12 Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛyatsɔ̃mɔ nyɔji yɛ Ijipt, ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni nyɛyea akpɔi nɛɛ anɔ.”
Asesei Agbijurɔyeli
(Levitiko 23.33-43)
13“Kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛbele ni nyɛkpa lɛ kɛ nyɛwain ni nyɛŋa lɛ eto sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo. 14Nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ kɛ miishɛɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii kɛ maŋsɛɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ. 15 Nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ gbii kpawo nyɛkɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam yɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ nyɛnine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
16“Afi fɛɛ afi mli lɛ nyɛteŋ hii fɛɛ abapuea yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ shii etɛ̃, yɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Bei nɛɛ ji Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ be lɛ kɛ Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔ be lɛ kɛ Asesei Agbijurɔ be lɛ. Mɔ ko mɔ ko akabapue yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ kɛ edɛ̃ folo; 17mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni eeenyɛ. Ekwɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ lɛ ehã koni ehã nikee bɔ ni eeenyɛ.
18“Nyɛwoa kojolɔi kɛ maŋnɔkwɛlɔi yɛ nyɛmaji fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hãa nyɛ lɛ amli, yɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ anaa, koni amɛkojo maŋbii ateŋ yɛ jalɛ naa. 19Amɛkaye toikɔdɔmɔ sane; amɛkakwɛ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ lɛ, amɛkahe nyɔɔŋnii hu, ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋniihemɔ shwilaa nilelɔi tete po ahiŋmɛi, ni ehãa atsɔ̃ɔ jalɔ sane hiɛ abuɔ shi. 20Naa, nyɛyea jalɛ sane pɛ kɛkɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi ana wala, ni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
21“Kaatɛo tsei ni okɛfee wɔŋ koo ofata Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ ni nyɛbaama lɛ he. 22 Asaŋ nyɛkamaa shiu ko shiu ko ni ji nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɔ lɛ nyɛhãa nyɛhe.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 17
Content:
1 “Nyɛkaŋɔa tsina loo too ni kpa ko yɔɔ ehe nyɛkɛshãa afɔle nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eehi nakai kooloo.
2“Kɛji ana nuu ko loo yoo ko yɛ nyɛmaji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hãa nyɛ lɛ eko mli ni eku Yehowa kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, 3 ni nii ni migu nyɛ lɛ, etee eyafee, tamɔ akɛ etee eyaja, ni esɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, loo hulu, loo nyɔɔŋtsere loo ŋulamii lɛ eko, 4ni abatswa nyɛ adafi lɛ, nyɛtaoa sane lɛ mli fitsofitso. Kɛji nyɛna akɛ eyɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ efee nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ yɛ Israel lɛ, 5nyɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ajea kpo kɛjea maŋ lɛ mli kɛya maŋ agbo lɛ sɛɛ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, koni nyɛtswia lɛ tɛi ni egbo. 6 Shi moŋ odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ odaseyeli nɔ adamɔ agbe lɛ; akadamɔ odasefonyo kome wiemɔ nɔ agbe lɛ. 7 Odasefoi lɛ tsuutsu atswa gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tɛ; ni no sɛɛ dani maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi ni egbo. Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaajie nɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
8“Kɛji sane ni kɔɔ gbɔmɔgbee loo niiaheplemɔ loo awuyeli he ba, ni naataamɔ te shi yɛ sane lɛ yeli mli lɛ, nakai maŋ lɛ mli kojolɔi lɛ kɛ sane lɛ aya he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, 9koni amɛkɛ sane lɛ ayafɔ̃ Levibii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kojolɔ hu ni yɔɔ jɛi nakai be lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ koni amɛkojo. 10Bɔ ni amɛaagbe sane lɛ naa amɛhã, yɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛŋɔa lɛ. 11Nyɛŋɔa bɔ ni amɛaabua sane lɛ he amɛhã lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛnyiɛa gbɛjianɔ ni amɛaato amɛhã nyɛ lɛ sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛkatsakea amɛsanebuamɔ lɛ hiɛ; bɔ ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nakai nyɛfea. 12Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaje gbɛ eshi etsitsi etse kojolɔ lɛ loo osɔfo ni yɔɔ jɛi esɔmɔɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ atua lɛ, esa akɛ agbe lɛ koni akɛgu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii ateŋ. 13Kɛ afee nakai lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baanu he, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei, ni mɔ ko ekaŋ asa akɛ eeeye etsui naa sane nakai dɔŋŋ.
Maŋtsɛyeli he Akpɔi
14 “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛfee nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛhe shi yɛ nɔ lɛ, eeeba nyɛsusumɔ mli akɛ nyɛwo maŋtsɛ nyɛhã nyɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ efee lɛ. 15Nyɛaanyɛ nyɛwo maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi efee mɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ni jie lɛ ehã nyɛ. Mɔ lɛ afee nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo. Nyɛkawoa gbɔ ni ejeee Israelnyo nyɛmaŋtsɛ. 16 Shi moŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ akahi okpɔŋɔi pii; asaŋ ekawo maŋbii lɛ gbɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyahe okpɔŋɔi, ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛ shi akɛ nyɛkaku nyɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt kɔkɔɔkɔ. 17 Agbɛnɛ hu maŋtsɛ lɛ akaŋɔ yei pii; ni ekadi shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi sɛɛ tuutu hu koni ekaje Yehowa sɛɛ.
18 “Kɛji maŋtsɛ nɛɛ bata maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlai nɛɛ anɔ wolo lɛ ni yɔɔ Levibii osɔfoi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ nɔ, koni eŋma nakai wolo lɛ henɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kome ehã ehe. 19Wolo lɛ ahi eŋɔɔ, ni ekane ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ekase Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ; ni asaŋ eye mlai kɛ akpɔi nɛɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 20No ji nɔ ni baahã maŋtsɛ nɛɛ akawo ehe nɔ yɛ enyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni no hã ekwa kitãi lɛ eko ni egba kɛtee ninejurɔ loo abɛku. Enɛ baahã lɛ kɛ eshwiei hu amaŋtsɛyeli sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ Israel.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 18
Content:
Osɔfoi agbɛfaŋnɔ
1“Levibii ni ji osɔfoi akutso lɛ, akahã amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ; amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ji afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa mi, Yehowa, akɛ migbɛnaanii lɛ. Mijɔɔ no nɔ mihã amɛ koni amɛye. 2Akahã amɛ shikpɔŋ ni abaaja lɛ eko tamɔ abaahã amɛnyɛmimɛi akutsei krokomɛi lɛ. Mi ji amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo amɛ shi lɛ.
3“Kɛji akɛ tsina loo too bashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ kooloo lɛ nine lɛ kɛ kadaa lɛ kɛ musuŋ kotoku lɛ ahã osɔfoi lɛ akɛ osɔfoi agbɛnaanɔ ni yɔɔ afɔle lɛ mli. 4Klɛŋklɛŋ obele ni obaaku kɛ owain kɛ omu klɛŋklɛŋ ni oooŋa kɛ otoi ahetsɔi ni oooku lɛ okɛhã osɔfoi lɛ tsuutsu. 5Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ Levi kɛjɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni lɛ kɛ eshwiei lɛ asɔmɔ yɛ ehiɛ akɛ osɔfoi kɛya naanɔ.
6“Levinyo ni miisumɔ baanyɛ eshi Israel maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ koni eya he ni Yehowa eto akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, 7esɔmɔ Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ osɔfo tamɔ enyɛmimɛi Levibii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ. 8Ekɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ ana afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa niyenii lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; shi nii ni eeena kɛjɛ etsɛmɛiawe lɛ ekome enɔ ni.
Wɔŋjamɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
9“Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkakasea jɛibii lɛ amusubɔɔ nii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ. 10 Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akagbe ebinuu loo ebiyoo ekɛshã afɔle; akana klamɔfonyo loo ashwãifeelɔ loo okɔmfo loo ŋkunyaayelɔ 11loo hoŋkpãatsɛ loo sisatsɛlɔ loo ayɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. 12Ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko lɛ; ni no hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ. 13 Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akana tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ nyɛhe.
Awo Gbalɔ he shi
14“Maji anɔ bii ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛboɔ klamɔfoi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi atoi; shi nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛfee nakai nɔ ko.
15 “Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi yɛ nyɛ nyɛteŋ, ni lɛ toi esa akɛ nyɛbo. 16“Gbi ni akpe yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, nyɛkpa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔnyɛŋ wɔnu Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ gbee aloo wɔna enunyam ni kpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram lɛ dɔŋŋ koni wɔkagboi.’ 17Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Amɛwiemɔ lɛ ja naakpa. 18Mibatee gbalɔ ko shi tamɔ bo mahã amɛ, yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ebaakɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ nɔ ni mikɛhã lɛ akɛ ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ. 19No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni booo wiemɔi ni ebaawie yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ toi lɛ, mibagbala mɔ lɛ toi yɛ no hewɔ. 20Shi gbalɔ ni aaato lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ni ewie wiemɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli, be mli ni jeee mi mifã lɛ akɛ ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ, ja agbe lɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ gbalɔ ko ni aaawie yɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi agbɛi amli hu agbe lɛ.’
21“Nyɛaabi nyɛhe akɛ, ‘Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔle gbalɛ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ hu?’ 22Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ kɛji gbalɔ ko wie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli, ni gbalɛ lɛ baaa mli loo ebɛ mli lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ jeee Yehowa dɛŋ nakai wiemɔ lɛ jɛ. Gbalɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni to eyiŋ ni ewie, ni no hewɔ lɛ, kaashe nakai gbalɔ lɛ gbeyei.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 19
Content:
Abobaa Maji lɛ
(Numeri 35.9-28; Yoshua 20.1-9)
1“Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã maji anɔ bii lɛ ni eŋɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ amɛmaji lɛ kɛ amɛshĩai lɛ ni nyɛhi mli lɛ, 2-3nyɛhalaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji etɛ̃ nyɛtoa. Nyɛjaa shikpɔŋ tso muu ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli etɛ̃. Nyɛhalaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji etɛ̃ nyɛtoa bɔ ni afee ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni egbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, enyɛ ejo foi oya kɛya jɛi eyaba abo.
4“Mla ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni aaajo foi kɛya abobaa maŋ ko mli koni ehere eyiwala lɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni nine aaayakpa yɛ enaanyo nɔ, be mli ni jeee akɛ ebɛ mɔ lɛ ewo emli momo sa lɛ, ejo foi kɛya abobaa maji lɛ eko mli, koni efee shweshweeshwe. 5Wɔŋɔ lɛ akɛ nyɛyi enyɔ nyɛtee koo ko mli nyɛyaafo tso, ni be ni nyɛ teŋ mɔ kome wo elema lɛ nɔ koni efo tso lɛ, lema lɛ fã yɛ etso lɛ he, ni eyatswa mɔ kome ni egbe lɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaanyɛ ajo foi kɛya maŋ nɛɛ eko mli, ni eyi aaana wala. 6Ejaakɛ kɛji abobaa maŋ kome too ayɔɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli baajekɛ, ni mɔ ni agbe lɛ lɛ wekunyo ni baatɔ mɔ ni egbo lɛ lá lɛ he owele lɛ, baatiu gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ, be mli ni etsui he ejɔko, ni kɛji eyanina lɛ lɛ, eeetswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ; tsɛbelɛ esaaa akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ agbo, ejaakɛ enyɛko mɔ ni egbe lɛ lɛ etoko. 7No hewɔ ni mifãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛhala maji etɛ̃ nyɛto lɛ.
8-9“Nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ krokomɛi hu nyɛkɛfataa abobaa maji etɛ lɛ ahe kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli ehã nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ fɛɛ hã nyɛ lɛ. Kɛji nyɛye nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni kitãi lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, eeeŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ. 10Nyɛfea enɛ koni akashwie mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá shi yakatswaa yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaye lá yi sɔ̃.
11“Shi kɛji mɔ ko miinyɛ enyɛmi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eyawo enyɛmi lɛ ka, ni etua lɛ, ni etswa lɛ nɔ, ni epila lɛ ablaŋ, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo, ni gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ jo foi kɛtee nɛkɛ abobaa maji nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli lɛ, 12gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ atsu koni ayaŋɔ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yɛ abobaa maŋ lɛ mli kɛba. Kɛji akɛ lɛ ba lɛ onukpai lɛ atu lɛ awo mɔ ni esa akɛ etɔ lá he owele lɛ dɛŋ koni egbe gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ. 13Akana lɛ mɔbɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ajie mɔ ni eye bem lɛ lá yi sɔ̃ kɛje Israel nɔ, koni ahi ahã nyɛ.
Blema husui lɛ
14 “Kaajie onaanyo kɛ bo teŋ husu nɔ okadi ni blemabii lɛ eto jeeŋmɔ lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa nyɛ koni etsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Odaseyeli he akpɔi
15 “Akadamɔ odasefonyo kome naa wiemɔ nɔ abu mɔ ko fɔ. Esa akɛ ana odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ anaa wiemɔ dani adamɔ no nɔ kɛbu fɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane mli. 16Kɛji mɔ ko to yiŋ sha yɛ enaanyo he, ni ekata sane efɔ̃ enaanyo lɛ nɔ lɛ, 17mɛi enyɔ ni sane kã amɛteŋ lɛ aba osɔfoi kɛ kojolɔi ni tsuɔ nii nakai be lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Yehowa jamɔhe lɛ. 18Kojolɔi lɛ atao sane lɛ mli fitsofitso. Kɛji ana akɛ sanetsɛ lɛ je gbɛ ekata sane efɔ̃ enyɛmi lɛ nɔ yaka, ni eye amale odase eshi enyɛmi lɛ, 19afee lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni etao akɛ afee enyɛmi lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛkɛjie nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. 20Mɛi krokomɛi baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ, ni ebaahã amɛshe gbeyei, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko efeŋ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ eko yɛ nyɛteŋ dɔŋŋ.” 21 Akana mɔbɔ kwraa; akɛ wala atse wala; akɛ hiŋmɛi atse hiŋmɛi; akɛ nyanyɔŋ atse nyanyɔŋ; akɛ nine atse nine, ni akɛ nane atse nane.

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 20
Content:
Tawuu he akpɔi
1“Kɛji nyɛmiiya nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ayawu ta, ni nyɛna amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu shwiilii kɛ tabilɔi babaoo ni ayi fa fe nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ. 2Kɛji be lɛ shɛ ni nyɛbaabɔ̃i ta lɛ wuumɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ aje kpo kɛba koni ekɛ tabilɔi lɛ abawie, 3ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Hiiabii Israelbii, nyɛboa toi! Ta ebanina nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi yaakpe. Nyɛtsui akafãa; nyɛkashea gbeyei, ni nyɛhe akakpokpoa; nyɛkahãa ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔa nyɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ, 4ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yaa ta lɛ koni ekɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayawu ahã nyɛ koni nyɛye kunim.’
5“Osɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni ema tsu hee ni egbeleko naa lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baagbele tsu lɛ naa. 6 Mɔ hu ni efee waintrom hee, shi ebɔiko emli yibii yeli lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaye trom lɛ mli nii lɛ. 7Ni mɔ hu ni etsɛ yoo he baa, shi eyaŋɔko yoo lɛ, lɛ hu eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaŋɔ yoo lɛ.’
8“Asaŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni miishe gbeyei, ni etsui efã lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe koni ekahã enyɛmimɛi tabilɔi krokomɛi lɛ atsui miifã tamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.’ 9Kɛji asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ wie gbe naa lɛ, afãmɔ tatsɛmɛi ni amɛnyiɛ asafoiasafoi lɛ ahiɛ.
10 “Kɛji nyɛyanina maŋ ko ni nyɛbaatua maŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃a hiɛ koni nyɛbia maŋbii lɛ kɛji amɛmiisumɔ hejɔlɛ loo ta. 11Kɛji ahã nyɛ naajɔlɛ hetoo, ni agbele maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ ahã nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, nyɛnyɛa amɛnɔ koni amɛtsu nii amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛsɔmɔ nyɛ. 12Shi kɛji maŋ lɛ kɔɔɔ hejɔlɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɔ ta lɛ, no lɛ nyɛsaa maŋ lɛ yi. 13Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛye maŋ lɛ nɔ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛgbea emli hii fɛɛ. 14Shi maŋ lɛŋ yei lɛ kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ kɛ shĩa kooloi lɛ, no ji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, nyɛŋɔa akɛ ta mli nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛduro nyɛ. 15Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni nyɛkɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔji krokomɛi ni kɛ nyɛteŋ jɛkɛ pii anɔ lɛ aye ahã.
16 “Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea amɛmaji lɛ amli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ. 17Nyɛbulea amɛshishi wɛɛ, ni ji Hitbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã nyɛ ni nyɛfee lɛ. 18Nyɛgbea amɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ musubɔɔ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛkɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ koni nyɛkafee esha nyɛshi Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ.
19“Kɛji nyɛkɛ maŋ ko miiwu ni nyɛsa maŋ lɛ yi, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛŋɔ lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni maŋ lɛ yisamɔ lɛ sɛɛ etsɛ ehã lɛ, nyɛkafolɔa maŋ lɛ yeli tsei nyɛshwiea, ejaakɛ tsei nɛɛ ayibii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ nyɛbaana nyɛye. Ani tsei lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni nyɛkɛna ta lɛ lo? 20Shi moŋ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛfolɔ tsei ni ayeee amɛyibii lɛ koni nyɛkɛfee tawuu nibii koni nyɛkɛsa maŋ lɛ yi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaye maŋ lɛ nɔ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 21
Content:
Mɔ ko ni aleee mɔ ni gbe lɛ
1“Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni agbe lɛ afɔ̃ ŋa nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni aleee mɔ ni gbe lɛ lɛ, 2nyɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ kojolɔi lɛ aya, ni amɛyasusu he ni agbe gbɔmɔ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ kɛ maji ni yɔɔ jɛiniiaŋ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko jekɛmɔ. 3Maŋ ni kɛ gbonyo lɛ bɛŋkɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ amɔ tsina oblayoo ni akɛtsuko nii dã. 4Amɛkpala tsina lɛ kɛya jɔɔ ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli, he ni ahuko ni aduko nii yɛ dã. Amɛkũ tsina lɛ kuɛ mli yɛ jɛi. 5Osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levibii lɛ, atsi aba ejaakɛ amɛ ji mɛi ni Yehowa ehala akɛ amɛsɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkojo bei loo mɔnɔtswaa sane fɛɛ sane yɛ egbɛi mli. 6 Kɛkɛ lɛ maŋ ni bɛŋkɛ gbonyo lɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ afɔ amɛdɛ̃ amɛshwie tsina oblayoo lɛ nɔ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ aku tsina lɛ kuɛ mli yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli. 7Nakai be mli lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Jeee wɔ ni wɔshwie lá nɛɛ shi, ni asaŋ wɔleee mɔ hu ni gbe lɛ. 8Yehowa, ofainɛ, ona omaŋ Israel ni oyakpɔ̃ lɛ mɔbɔ koni okɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ lá shi ni ashwie yaka nɛɛ sɔ̃ akatere Israel.’ 9 Nyɛtsɔ̃a nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ koni nyɛfea nɔ ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ afee lɛ koni nyɛkɛjie mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ lɛ lá yi sɔ̃ kɛje Israel nɔ.”
Ta mli yei nomii
10“Kɛji otee ta, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã oye ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, ni omɔ nomi, 11ni yoo fɛɛfɛo ko yɛ nomii lɛ ateŋ, ni oosumɔ lɛ, ni otao akɛ oŋɔ lɛ ofee oŋa lɛ, 12no lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aya owe, ni ohã eshɛ eyi, ni ejie ewaobii anaa; 13ni etsake ehe nom atade lɛ. Yoo lɛ ahi owe lɛ, ni efo etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛyashi nyɔŋ kome. No sɛɛ dani oŋɔ yoo lɛ koni otsɔ̃ ewu, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ oŋa. 14Kɛji eshɛ be ko ni osumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ oŋmɛɛ yoo lɛ he koni eye ehe tswaa, koni eya he ni lɛ esumɔɔ. Obɛ hegbɛ akɛ ohɔ̃ɔ yoo lɛ oheɔ shika, ni okaye lɛ nyɔŋ hu ejaakɛ ona ota ehe.”
Binuu kromɔ gbɛnaa nɔ
15 “Kɛji nuu ko yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, ni esumɔɔ mɔ kome lɛ, shi esumɔɔɔ mɔ kome; ni ekɛ yei enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ fɔ bihii, shi eŋa ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ ji kromɔbi lɛ, 16kɛji shɛ be, ni ebaaja egboshinii ehã ebii lɛ, ebɛ hegbɛ akɛ eŋɔɔ yoo ni esumɔɔ esane lɛ binuu akɛ ekromɔ binuu yɛ yoo ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ najiaŋ. 17Yoo ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ ji ekromɔbi, ni lɛ eŋɔ egboshinii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai lɛ toi enyɔ lɛ ehã akɛ kromɔbi gbɛnaa nɔ.”
Bi toigbolɔ he akpɔ
18“Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ binuu toigbolɔ kɛ atuatselɔ, bi ni booo efɔlɔi atoi, tsɛbelɛ amɛmiikã lɛ nɔŋŋ, shi ebooo toi lɛ, 19no lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛya amɛmaŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ ahiɛ yɛ koishi. 20Amɛkɛɛ maŋ lɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔbi nɛɛ toigbolɔ kɛ atuatselɔ ni, ebooo wɔ toi lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋtswi ebɔɔ, ni etɔɔ dãa hu.’ 21 Maŋ lɛ mli hii fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi koni egbo bɔ ni afee ni akɛjie su fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Israel fɛɛ baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei.”
Mlai srɔtoi
22“Kɛji abu efɔŋfeelɔ ko gbele fɔ, ni asɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ lɛ, 23 akahã egbonyo lɛ miihi tso lɛ nɔ ni je tsɛre nɔ. Afu mɔ lɛ gbi nɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ loomɔ kã enɔ koni nyɛkabule shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhã nyɛ lɛ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 22
Content:
1“Kɛji ona onyɛmi tsina loo etoo ni edu gbɛ lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ ohiɛ oto afã; shi moŋ kplamɔ kooloo lɛ kɛku sɛɛ oyahã onyɛmi lɛ. 2Kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ shĩa bɛŋkɛɛɛ bo, aloo oleee lɛ lɛ, no lɛ kplamɔ kooloo lɛ kɛya bo diɛŋtsɛ owe, koni kooloo lɛ ahi oŋɔɔ kɛyashi nɔtsɛ lɛ aaababi shi, ni okɛ enii aku sɛɛ ahã lɛ. 3 Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ofee onyɛmi teji loo etade loo enɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni elaaje ni ooona; okaho he ni otee.
4“Kɛji ona onyɛmi teji loo etsina ni egbee shi lɛ, kaaho ehe ni otee; shi moŋ ye obua koni awo kooloo lɛ nɔ adamɔ shi.
5“Yoo akawo hii atade, ni nuu akawo yei atade ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi mɔ ni feɔ nakai.
6“Kɛji ona loofɔlɔ tsu, eyɛ tso nɔ jio, eyɛ shikpɔŋ jio, ni loofɔlɔ nyɛ lɛ bu ebii lɛ loo ewɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ mli lɛ, kaamɔ loofɔlɔ nyɛ lɛ kɛ bii lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee. 7 Obaanyɛ omɔmɔ loofɔlɔ bii lɛ ni oŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ nyɛ lɛ he, ni ebaahi ehã bo, ni owala sɛɛ baatsɛ hu.
8“Kɛji oma tsu hee lɛ, foo afabaŋ okɛbɔle tsu lɛ yiteŋ naabu fɔfɔoo lɛ, koni mɔ ko akaje tsu lɛ yiteŋ ebagbee shi ni obaye elá yi sɔ̃.
9 “Kaadu nɔ kroko ofutu wain yɛ owain trom mli; no lɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli nii fɛɛ kwa, wain yibii lɛ ni jio, nii ni odu ofutu lɛ lɛ ni jio, baatsɔ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni fɛɛ baaŋmɛɛ bo.
10“Kaatsa tsina kɛ teji fɛɛ okɛhu.
11“Kaawo atade ni akɛ odonti kpãa kɛ kuntu kpãa lo lɛ asaasaa.
12 “Feemɔ ahwanya owo otade koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe.
Oblayoo foro hemujiwoo he mlai
13“Kɛji nuu yaŋɔ yoo, ni be ni ekɛ lɛ ena bɔlɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ esumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ dɔŋŋ, 14ni no hewɔ lɛ, efolɔ hiɛgbeji asaji eshwie yoo lɛ nɔ akɛ be ni ekɛ lɛ bɔ lɛ enaaa lɛ akɛ oblayoo foro lɛ, 15no lɛ oblayoo foro lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ akɔ okadi ni yeɔ he odase akɛ amɛbi lɛ oblayoo foro ni lɛ, kɛya onukpai lɛ ahiɛ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi. 16Oblayoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ akɛɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, ‘Mikɛ mibiyoo nɛɛ hã nuu nɛɛ gbãlã; shi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ etaooo lɛ. 17No hewɔ lɛ, efolɔ heguɔgbee saji eshwie mibiyoo lɛ nɔ akɛ enaaa lɛ oblayoo foro. Shi naa okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mibiyoo lɛ oblayoo foro ni.’ No sɛɛ lɛ, fɔlɔi lɛ alɛɛ mama lɛ mli amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ onukpai lɛ. 18Maŋ onukpai lɛ amɔ nuu lɛ koni agwao lɛ. 19Gwaomɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, agbe lɛ shika gbele jwiɛtɛi shekeli oha; ni akɛ shika nɛɛ ahã oblayoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ewo Israel fɔmɔbi oblayoo foro lɛ he muji yakatswaa. Yoo lɛ atsa nɔ ni ekɛ nuu lɛ ahi shi akɛ eŋa; ni nuu lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ eshwieɔ yoo nɛɛ kɛyaashi lɛ nuu lɛ aaashi jeŋ.
20“Shi kɛji sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ nuu lɛ enaaa oblayoo lɛ akɛ oblayoo foro lɛ, 21 maŋ onukpai lɛ akpala oblayoo lɛ kɛya etsɛ agbo naa, koni maŋ lɛ mli hii atswia oblayoo lɛ tɛi ni egbo, ejaakɛ efee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel akɛ ele nuu dani eshi etsɛ we lɛ etee gbãlã. Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaajie su fɔŋ nɛɛ kɛje nyɛteŋ.
22 “Kɛji ana nuu ko ni ekɛ mɔ ko ŋa miina bɔlɛ lɛ, agbe nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ koni akɛgu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ Israel.
23“Kɛji atsɛ oblayoo foro ko he baa, ni nuu kroko kɛ lɛ kpe yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, no lɛ 24nyɛkpalaa nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ kɛyaa nakai maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa koni atswia amɛ tɛi yɛ jɛi ni amɛgboi. Yoo lɛ sa gbele ejaakɛ maŋ teŋ eyɔɔ, ni ebaanyɛ ebo etsɛ; shi ebooo; nuu lɛ hu sa gbele ejaakɛ efite enaanyo ŋa. Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaagu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
25“Shi kɛji ŋa mli nuu lɛ na oblayoo ni atsɛ ehe baa lɛ yɛ, ni nuu lɛ mɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, no lɛ agbe nuu lɛ kome pɛ. 26Oblayoo lɛ, akafee lɛ nɔ ko ejaakɛ efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko ni sa akɛ agbe lɛ yɛ no hewɔ. Bɔ ni mɔ ko teɔ shi etuaa enaanyo ni egbeɔ lɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ji nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ. 27Ejaakɛ mɔ nuu lɛ mɔ oblayoo ni atsɛ ehe baa lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ; ni oblayoo lɛ bolɔ, shi mɔ ko bɛ jɛi ni aaahere lɛ.
28“Kɛji nuu ko kɛ oblayoo foro ni mɔ ko etsɛko ehe baa kpe, ni emɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, 29 nuu lɛ awo oblayoo foro yinii, ni ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ehã oblayoo foro lɛ tsɛ. Yoo lɛ atsɔ̃ nuu lɛ ŋa, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ni nyɛ oblayoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ; asaŋ nuu lɛ wala beiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ enyɛŋ yoo nɛɛ eshwie gbi ko gbi ko.
30 “Nuu ko nuu ko bɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛ etsɛ ŋa loo etsɛ hemɔ naa bɔlɛ, koni ekɛshwie etsɛ hiɛ shi.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 23
Content:
Mɛi ni jeee Yehowa webii
1“Nuu ni afo enuutso aloo asa lɛ lɛ, ekaya Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
2“Ajwamãŋbi ko akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli; ni eshwiei kɛyashi yinɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ bii tete akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
3 “Amonnyo loo Moabnyo akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli. Amɛshwiei ayinɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ bii tete amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akaba gwabɔɔ lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko; 4 ejaakɛ be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt ni nyɛbaa lɛ, amɛhiɛɛɛ niyenii kɛ nu amɛkɛbakpeee nyɛ, shi moŋ amɛyabɔ Beor binuu Balaam apaa kɛjɛ Petor yɛ Mesopotamia akɛ ebalomɔ nyɛ. 5 Shi Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, booo Balaam toi, shi moŋ ehã loomɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miisumɔ nyɛ. 6Nyɛkataoa amɛ ekpakpa loo ejurɔyeli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
7 “Nyɛkanyaŋea Edombii ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi ji amɛ, ni nyɛkanyaŋea Ijiptbii hu ejaakɛ nyɛyato gbɔ yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pɛŋ. 8Amɛshwiei ayinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛyaa lɛ nɔ bii baanyɛ amɛba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Muji akahi tabilɔi ahe
9“Kɛji nyɛfã ta ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi yaawu ni nyɛyato shi yɛ he ko lɛ, nyɛlea nyɛhenɔ kwɛmɔ koni nyɛkafee nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko. 10 Kɛji muji ba nuu ko he yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli ejaakɛ eshwie ehe shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ aje shitoohe lɛ mli koni eyahi sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. 11Gbɛkɛnaashi mli lɛ ekɛ nu aju ehe, ni kɛ hulu nyɔ shi lɛ eku esɛɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli.
12“Ato he ko akɛ kuŋtso yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni aya jɛi. 13Mɔ ni miiya kuŋtso nɔ ahiɛ tso hu afata etawuu nii he. Ekɛ tso nɛɛ atsa bu koni esɔ̃ nɔ; ni kɛji egbe naa lɛ etsi wamɔ lɛ nɔ. 14 Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yɛ jɛi bɔ ni afee ni ebu nyɛhe, ni asaŋ ehã nyɛye nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim. No hewɔ lɛ, muji nɔ ko akahi shitoohe lɛ mli koni ehã Yehowa kpa yɛ nyɛsɛɛ.”
Mlai krokomɛi
15“Kɛji nyɔŋ ko jo foi yɛ enuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ, ni ebaba Israelbii abo lɛ, akakpale nyɔŋ lɛ ayahã enuŋtsɔ lɛ. 16Nyɛhãa ekɛ nyɛ ahia shi yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ mli; ni nyɛkayea lɛ nyɔŋ.
17 “Israel fɔmɔbi, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, akafee ehe jamɔhe lɛ mli ajwamãŋbɔlɔ. 18Nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mli shika akabahã yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ mli yɛ eshiwoo ko hewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi jamɔhe lɛ mli ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ shika lɛ fɛɛ.
19 “Kɛji ofa onyɛmi Israelnyo shika loo niyenii loo nɔ ko ni aheɔ ehe kpa lɛ, lɛ lɛ kaahe lɛ nii lɛ he kpa. 20Mɔkpɔŋ lɛ, hemɔ lɛ nii lɛ he kpa; shi Israelnyo lɛ kaahe lɛ nii he kpa. Nyɛyea mla nɛɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaatsu nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ nɛɛ nɔ.
21 “Kɛji owo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi lɛ kaahã shiwoo lɛ nɔyeli lɛ sɛɛ miitsɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, baabi bo nyɔmɔ yɛ shiwoo lɛ he; ni no aaafee esha ehã bo. 22Ejeee tɔ̃mɔ kɛji owooo Yehowa shi; 23shi kɛji ona owo shi lɛ, esa akɛ ojwɛŋ nɔ koni oye shiwoo lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni owo Yehowa shi yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ.
24“Kɛji otee onaanyo waintrom mli lɛ, obaanyɛ oye wain yibii lɛ bɔ ni ooonyɛ; shi moŋ okatse yibii lɛ eko owo onii amli akɛ okɛmiiya shĩa. 25 Kɛji oyabote onaanyo ŋmaaŋmɔ mli lɛ, obaanyɛ okɛ onine aku ŋmaa lɛ eko ni okpe bɔ ni ooonyɛ, shi okɛ nikpamɔ kakla akakpa ŋmaa lɛ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 24
Content:
Gbãlãmligbalamɔ kɛ gbãlãmlibotemɔ ekoŋŋ
1 “Kɛji nuu ko ŋɔ yoo ko efee eŋa, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ nuu nɛɛ naaa yoo lɛ he miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ ena hiɛgbejianii ko yɛ yoo lɛ he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eŋma mligbalamɔ wolo ekɛwo yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ehã eje ewe lɛ, 2ni yoo nɛɛ tee ni eyagbã nuu kroko, 3ni sɛɛkpee wu nɛɛ hu eyasumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ, ni lɛ hu eŋma mligbalamɔ wolo ekɛwo yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ehã eje ewe lɛ, aloo sɛɛkpee wu nɛɛ gbo lɛ, 4no lɛ yoo nɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wu ni shwie lɛ lɛ aka ŋɔ yoo lɛ ekɛmiifee eŋa ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ abule yoo lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ miihi nɛkɛ gbãlãshihilɛ. Nyɛkafea nɛkɛ esha ni nyɛkɛmiibule shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ.
Mlai krokomɛi
5“Kɛji nuu ko kpee yoo hee lɛ, ekaya ta; ni akɛ nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko akafɔ̃ enɔ akɛ etsu. Ahã eye ehe afi naakplɔ yɛ eshĩa teŋ koni ehã eŋa ni ekpee lɛ mii ashɛ ehe.
6“Mɔ ko akahe enaanyo wiɛ loo wiɛbi akɛ awabatoonɔ, ejaakɛ kɛji efee nakai lɛ belɛ gbɔmɔ wala eheɔ akɛ awaba lɛ.
7 “Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni eju enyɛmi Israelnyo, ni eeye lɛ nyɔŋ aloo eyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ, agbe nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ koni akɛgu nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
8 “Kɛji hewolo nɔ hela gbonyo ko mɔ mɔ ko lɛ, ekwɛ ni ahi, ni ejwɛŋ nɔ, ni efee bɔ ni osɔfoi ni ji Levibii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ efee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛfea bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ osɔfoi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 9 Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Miriam yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt nyɛbaa lɛ.
10 “Kɛji ofa onaanyo ko nɔ ko lɛ, kaatiu lɛ kɛtee eshĩa mli koni oyahe nɔ ni ekɛbaato bo awaba lɛ; 11shi moŋ daamɔ agbo naa, ni mɔ ni okɛ nii lɛ efa lɛ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ekɛtoɔ awaba lɛ baaje kpo ekɛbahã bo. 12Kɛji ohiafo ji lɛ lɛ kaahã ehebo lɛ hi oŋɔɔ ni obu kɛwɔ ni je tsɛre nɔ. 13Kpalemɔ ohã lɛ kɛji hulu yaanyɔ shi, bɔ ni afee ni ohiafo lɛ ana ehebo lɛ ebu kɛwɔ koni eda bo shi; ni osane baasa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
14“Kaawa apaafonyo ohiafo ni efĩ lɛ yi. Nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo ni jio, gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ ateŋ eko ni jio, akawa lɛ yi. 15 Wo lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ apaa ni obɔ lɛ lɛ he nyɔmɔ dani hulu anyɔ shi (ejaakɛ ohiafo ji lɛ, ni nakai nyɔmɔwoo lɛ nɔŋŋ ebɔleɔ), koni ekafo etsɛ Yehowa ewo bo, ni no tsɔ̃ esha ehã bo.
16 “Tsɛmɛi akagbo bii ayi gbele, ni bii hu akagbo tsɛmɛi ayi gbele; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efɔŋ ni efee hewɔ.
17“Kaatsɔ̃ gbɔ loo awusã sane hiɛ obu shi; ni kaahe okulafo hebo akɛ awaba. 18 Shi nyɛkaia akɛ aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje jɛi; no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã nɛɛ koni nyɛye nɔ lɛ.
19 “Kɛji okpa oŋmɔshinii, ni ohiɛ kpa ke kome nɔ yɛ ŋmɔ lɛŋ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ oyawo; shi moŋ oshi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ. 20Kɛji otse omutso yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ okpa niji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ otserɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ; shi nomɛi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo. 21Kɛji otse owaintrom mli yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ trom lɛ mli dɔŋŋ; shi yibii ni eshwɛ kpɛkpɛo lɛ ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo. 22Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɔji ji nyɛ yɛ Ijipt, ni no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitãi akɛ nyɛfee nɛkɛ lɛ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 25
Content:
1“Kɛji mɛi enyɔ miibe, ni amɛkɛ amɛsane lɛ tee kojomɔhe koni akojo lɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ bem lɛ abu lɛ bem, ni mɔ ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ abu lɛ fɔ. 2Kɛji mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ sa yii lɛ, kojolɔ lɛ ahã abu lɛ shi koni ayi lɛ kpãa, yɛ lɛ kojolɔ lɛ ehiɛ, yɛ efɔŋ ni efee lɛ naa. 3 Kɛji efa aahu lɛ atswa lɛ kpãa nyɔŋmai ejwɛ; akateke nɔ, no lɛ ashwie onyɛmi Israelnyo lɛ hiɛ shi yɛ ohiɛ.
4 “Tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele lɛ akawo enaabu kotoku.
Nɔ ni afee ahã nyɛmi ni egbo
5“Kɛji nyɛmimɛi hii enyɔ hi shi yɛ he kome, ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome gbo ni ebɛ binuu lɛ, mɔ ni egbo lɛ ŋa lɛ akashi weku lɛ mli eyagbã mɔkpɔŋ. Ewu ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ gbɛnaa ji akɛ eŋɔ yoo lɛ akɛ eŋa koni etsu wu gbɛnaanii ehã lɛ. 6 Kromɔ binuu ni yoo nɛɛ aaafɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ nuu ni egbo lɛ bi kɛ niyelɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ. 7Shi kɛji mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ eŋɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ, no lɛ enyɛminuu lɛ ŋa lɛ aya maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Miwu nyɛmi nuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ mi awo shwie ahã enyɛmi nuu lɛ koni enyɛmi lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israel; esumɔɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ wu nyɛminuu gbɛnaanii ehãa mi.’ 8Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ atsɛ mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛmi nuu lɛ, koni amɛ kɛ lɛ awie he. Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ma nɔ mi ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Misumɔɔɔ akɛ maŋɔ lɛ akɛ ŋa lɛ’, 9no lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ nyɛmi nuu lɛ okulafo lɛ atsi abɛŋkɛ ewu lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ yɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni ejie nuu lɛ tokota nane kome yɛ ehe, ni efɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie nuu lɛ hiɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni sa nuu ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ esaa enyɛminuu we nɛ.’ 10 Ni nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ abaatsɛ ewe yɛ Israel akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni ajie etokota we’.
Mlai krokomɛi
11“Kɛji hii miinɔ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ŋa tsi ebɛŋkɛ koni ebahere ewu lɛ yɛ enaanyo ni enine etsɔ̃ ewu lɛ nɔ dɛŋ, ni yoo nɛɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ nuu kome lɛ nuutso lɛ, 12afo yoo nɛɛ nine lɛ; akana yoo lɛ mɔbɔ ko kwraa.
13“Kaato nsɛnitɛi srɔtoi enyɔ, nɔ ni shɛɔ kɛ nɔ ni shɛɛɛ yɛ oflɔtɔ mli; 14ni kaato susumɔ nii hu srɔtoi enyɔ yɛ shĩa, nɔ ni da kɛ nɔ ni edaaa. 15Nyɛhãa nsɛnitɛ kɛ susumɔ nii lɛ ashɛa shishiishi koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ; 16 ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi mɛi fɛɛ ni shishiuɔ mɔ.
17“Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Amalekbii lɛ fee nyɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt nyɛbaa lɛ, 18bɔ ni amɛyasheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ ni amɛtua nyɛ, be ni etɔ nyɛ ni nyɛtɔ biti lɛ, ni amɛgbegbee nyɛsɛɛbii fɛɛ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ. 19 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, nyɛbulea Amalekbii lɛ ashishi kwraa koni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ. Nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 26
Content:
Ŋmãakpamɔ
1“Kɛji oyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa bo akɛ onɔ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ohi nɔ lɛ, 2 okɛ klɛŋklɛŋnii ni obaakpa, yɛ oŋmɔ mli yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa eŋɔ ehã bo lɛ nɔ lɛ, eko awo kɛntɛŋ mli koni okɛya he koome ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. 3Yaa osɔfo ni tsuɔ jɛi nii nakai be mli lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Miikɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ mibashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ehe shi akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ nɔ.’
4“Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfo lɛ baahe kɛntɛŋ lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, koni ekɛma Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ. 5 No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, ‘Aramnyo ni ebɔ ko ji mitsɛ; ekɛ mɛi fioo ko tee Ijipt, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ jɛi. Shi eshwiei ayi bafa, ni etsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa yɛ jɛi. 6Shi Ijiptbii lɛ hiɛ wɔ soisoi, ni amɛwa wɔ yi, ni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ. 7Kɛkɛ ni wɔbolɔ wɔtsɛ Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ebo wɔ toi, ni ena bɔ ni ahaoɔ wɔ lɛ kɛ deŋme ni wɔgboɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ wɔ lɛ. 8Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bakpɔ̃ wɔ yɛ Ijipt yɛ ehewalɛ kɛ enineshiwalɛ naa. Ehã naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei nibii ba, ni ekɛto okadi. 9Ni ekɛ wɔ eba biɛ nɛɛ, ni ekɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ hã wɔ, shikpɔŋ ni ewo fɔ ni baa nii babaoo lɛ. 10No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni bo, Yehowa, okɛhã mi lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii ni mikpa lɛ eko eba.’
“Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ okɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ ama Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni oja yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ hiɛ. 11Onya nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eduro bo lɛ he, bo kɛ owe lɛ mli bii kɛ Levibii kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ.
12 “Afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni ji mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome hãmɔ afi lɛ, kɛji okɛ oŋmɔshi nii mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ehã Levibii lɛ kɛ gbɔi lɛ kɛ awusãi lɛ kɛ okulafoi lɛ ogbe naa, koni amɛna nii amɛye yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ, 13yaakɛɛ yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, ‘Mijie nii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ minii mli yɛ miwe lɛ, ni mikɛhã Levibii kɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi bɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ. Mitɔ̃ko okitãi lɛ eko nɔ, ni mihiɛ hu kpako kitã ko nɔ. 14Miyeko nii nɛɛ ni mijie lɛ eko yɛ mikɔmɔyeli beiaŋ lɛ, mifiteko nii lɛ eko be ni mibule mihe lɛ, mikɛ eko hu eshãko afɔle mihãko gbonyo ko. Miye Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee nɔ, ni mifee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ. 15Jɛɛ oshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, ni okwɛ koni ojɔɔ omaŋ Israel kɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni okɛhã wɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni okã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã lɛ.’
Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ webii
16“Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miiwo bo kitã akɛ oye ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ koni okɛ otsui kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ aye nɔ. 17Ogba mli kpoo ŋmɛnɛ okɛɛ Yehowa akɛ lɛ ji oNyɔŋmɔ, ni obaaba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, ni obaaye ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ, ni obaabo lɛ toi. 18 Yehowa hu egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ bo, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ji bo tamɔ bɔ ni ewo bo shi lɛ, ni eebi bo koni oye ekitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, 19 koni yɛ yijiemɔ kɛ gbɛi kɛ anunyam gbɛfaŋ lɛ, Israel agbojee akwɔ fe maji fɛɛ agbojee yɛ je lɛ mli. Oootsɔ̃ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 27
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ Mlai ni akpɛ yɛ tɛi anɔ
1Agbɛnɛ Mose kpã ewo maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ, yɛ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyea kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ. 2 Ni gbi nɔ ni nyɛaafo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛholea tɛi kpelei nyɛmamɔa shi, ni nyɛmaa hiɛ ni amɛnɔ afee trotro, 3koni nyɛŋmã nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ fɛɛ nyɛwo amɛnɔ, ni nyɛkɛya shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi eto lɛ. 4Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛtee lɛ, nyɛkɛ tɛi ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ amãmɔa shi yɛ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛmaa hiɛ ni amɛnɔ afee trotro. 5 Nyɛmaa afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ tɛi ni akɛ dade naa esako amɛhe dã, 6ejaakɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni amaa akɛhã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ tɛi ni dade naa esako he ama. Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 7Nyɛshãa shidaa afɔlei lɛ hu yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛyea nii yɛ jɛi koni nyɛnyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ. 8Ni nyɛŋmaa nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ, koni amɛje shi faŋŋ yɛ tɛi lɛ anɔ.”
9Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ osɔfoi ni ji Levibii lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ, “Israelbii, nyɛfea diŋŋ ni nyɛboa toi. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ maŋ; 10no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛyea ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ.”
Toigbele he Loomɔi
11Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Mose fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 12 “Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ, akutsei nɛɛ adamɔ Gerizim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛjɔɔ maŋ lɛ: Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda kɛ Isakar kɛ Yosef kɛ Benyamin. 13Ni akutsei nɛɛ hu adamɔ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛlomɔ: Ruben kɛ Gad kɛ Asher kɛ Zebulon kɛ Dan kɛ Naftali. 14Ni Levibii lɛ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛɛ Israel muu fɛɛ akɛ,
15 “‘Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ŋaalɔ nilee nɔ ekɛ su loo tso loo dade feɔ amãgã ni ejaa lɛ yɛ teemɔŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
16 “Alomɔ mɔ ni wooo etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ. Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
17“‘Alomɔ mɔ ni tsiɔ lɛ kɛ enaanyo teŋ husu nɔ okadi kɛyaa sɛɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
18 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni hãa shwilafo duɔ gbɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
19 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo sane hiɛ ebuɔ shi.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
20 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ewo etsɛ hiɛ mama nɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
21 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo wɔɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
22 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ enyɛmiyoo ni ji etsɛbi loo enyɛbi wɔɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
23 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ eshaayoo ni ji eŋa nyɛ wɔɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
24 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni gbeɔ enaanyo gbɔmɔ yɛ teemɔŋ lɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
25 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni heɔ nyɔɔŋnii koni eyagbe mɔ ko ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’
26 “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni yeee nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ anɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehaŋ mlai lɛ ama shi lɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ ”

Title: DEUTERONOMIO 28
Content:
Toiboo he Jɔɔmɔi
(Levitiko 26.3-13; Deuteronomio 7.12-24)
1 “Kɛji ooobo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni ooojwɛŋ nɔ, ni oooye kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baawo onɔ gojoo fe shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ. 2Obaana Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, dɛŋ jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ aaanina bo yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛji ooobo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee toi.
3“Aaajɔɔ bo yɛ maŋ, ni aaajɔɔ bo yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.
4“Aaajɔɔ omusuŋ bii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ oshĩaŋ kooloi abii kɛ otoi kɛ otsinai abii fɛɛ.
5 “Aaajɔɔ okɛntɛŋ ni okɛyakpaa nii lɛ kɛ otsese hu.
6“Aaajɔɔ oyaa kɛ obaa mli fɛɛ.
7“Yehowa aaahã oplene ohenyɛlɔi ni aaabatua bo. Amɛaanyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛaabatua bo, shi amɛaatsɔ̃ gbɛi kpawo nɔ amɛaajo foi kɛaaje ohiɛ.
8“Yehowa aaajɔɔ onitsumɔ, ni eeehã oboŋoi ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛ onine taa he aaashwere; ni eeejɔɔ bo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
9“Yehowa aaaŋɔ bo, Israel, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã bo kitã lɛ, kɛji oye Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ, ni oba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ. 10No lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaana akɛ Yehowa kɛ egbɛi ewo bo akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ, ni amɛbaashe bo gbeyei. 11Yehowa baahã oshwere babaoo. Omusuŋ bii kɛ okooloi abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii fɛɛ aaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo otsɛmɛi lɛ he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã bo lɛ nɔ. 12Yehowa aaagbele eŋwɛi niikpakpai anaa ehã bo; eeehã nu anɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ be ni sa mli; eeejɔɔ onine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ; ooona nii, ni ooofala maji pii nii, shi bo lɛ ofaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko dɛŋ. 13-14Kɛji oooye Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ, ni ji kitãi ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ni oookwɛ ni oooye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, asaŋ kɛji okplaŋ kɛjeŋ kitã ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ eko he, ni ogbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku, ni oyanyiɛŋ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni oyajaŋ amɛ lɛ, Yehowa aaafee bo yitso, shi jeee lei; onɔ sɔŋŋ ebaawo, ni ebaŋ bo shi kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Toigbele yibii
(Levitiko 26.14-46)
15“Shi kɛji aaaba mli akɛ obooo Yehowa toi ni ojwɛŋŋ nɔ ni oye ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ miimɛ bo:
16“Aaalomɔ bo yɛ maŋ, ni aaalomɔ bo yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.
17“Aaalomɔ okɛntɛŋ kɛ otsese hu.
18“Aaalomɔ omusuŋ bii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ otsinai abii kɛ otoi abii.
19“Aaalomɔ bo yɛ oyaa mli, ni aaalomɔ bo yɛ obaa mli hu.
20“Yehowa aaalomɔ bo, ni eeehã ojijaa, ni onijiaŋ aaaje wui yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofee mli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni aaafite bo, ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã oya mli yɛ nibii fɔ̃ji ni ofee lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ okwa Yehowa. 21Yehowa aaahã oye gbele hela kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã ohiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni oyaa koni oyaŋɔ okɛfee onɔ lɛ nɔ. 22 Yehowa aaahã oye wɔlɔmɔ fɔŋ kɛ atridii kɛ fuumɔ hela; ebaahã jeŋ adɔ waa, ni nu enɛŋ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ tamɔ la aaatswa, ni nibii aaaŋala. Nibii nɛɛ aaanyiɛ osɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã. 23Ŋwɛi ni yɔɔ oyiteŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ akɔɔble, ni shikpɔŋ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ dade. 24Yehowa aaahã shia kɛ mlu atsɔ̃ onu ni aaanɛ ahã bo; amɛaajɛ ŋwɛi amɛbayi bo yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.
25“Yehowa aaahã henyɛlɔi aye onɔ. Ooonyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛyatua amɛ; shi gbɛi kpawo nɔ oootsɔ̃ ojo foi kɛje amɛhiɛ. Osane lɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelihei fɛɛ atsui afã. 26Ogbonyo aaatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, ni onaŋ mɔ ko po ashwie amɛ kɛje ohe. 27 Yehowa aaahã asanei ni ye Ijiptbii lɛ eko kɛ fala kɛ abuasha kɛ kpla ni ehiii tsamɔ aye bo. 28Yehowa aaahã oye sɛkɛ, ni oooshwila, ni oyiŋ baakã bo. 29Ooogbugbuu shi shwane fintiŋŋ tamɔ shwilafo ni yɔɔ duŋ mli be fɛɛ be. Obaatsɔ ogbutsɛ, ni onɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa shwereŋ, ni aaahi bo nyɔŋyeli kɛ ojotswaa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ daa nɛɛ, ni onaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni aaahere bo.
30 “Oootsɛ yoo he baa, shi nuu kroko moŋ ni kɛ lɛ aaawɔ; oooma tsu, shi owɔŋ mli; ni ooofee waintrom, shi oyeŋ emli yibii. 31Ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ otsina agbe, shi onaŋ eloo lɛ eko oye, ni ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ oteji akranaŋ naa kɛya, ni akpaleŋ lɛ abahaŋ bo dɔŋŋ. Abaahã ohenyɛlɔi abamɔmɔ otoi kɛya, ni onaŋ mɔ ko abahere bo. 32Abaaŋɔ obihii kɛ obiyei akɛ nomii ahã mɛi kpɔ̃ji be mli ni oona kɛ ohiŋmɛi nɔŋŋ, ni obaakwɛ amɛsɛɛkuu gbɛ kɛ tɔlɛ daa gbi; shi onyɛŋ he nɔ ko ofee. 33 Maŋsɛɛ maŋ ko ni oleee kwrakwra aaaba ebaloo oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ nii ni otsu oto fɛɛ kɛya eyaye. Yi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaawa bo, ni shi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaashwishwia bo daa nɛɛ, 34ni ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni ooona lɛ aaaye bo sɛkɛ. 35Yehowa aaahã asanei ni anaa jaraa ni ehiii tsamɔ atsɛ̃rɛ onakutsei anaa kɛ oshuɔji ahe; ebaatsɛ̃rɛ kɛjɛ oyiteŋ aahu kɛyashi onaneshi.
36“Yehowa aaakpala bo kɛ omaŋtsɛ ni oto ohã ohe lɛ fɛɛ kɛaatee maŋsɛɛ maŋ ko ni bo loo otsɛmɛi leee mli; jɛi oooyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni akɛ tso kɛ tɛ fee yɛ. 37 Oootsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ kɛ naakpɛɛ nɔ ni akɛbaabu abɛ yɛ maji amli he ni Yehowa kɛ bo aaatee lɛ.
38 “Okɛ dumɔ wui babaoo baaya oyadu yɛ ŋmɔ mli, shi nii fioo pɛ obaana okpa kɛba, ejaakɛ baalabii aaaye tsiimɔ. 39Ooofee waintromi, ni obaakura amɛ, shi onaŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko onu lɛ, onaŋ amɛmli yibii lɛ eko hu oye, ejaakɛ gɔgɔmii aaaye. 40Obaahi mutsei yɛ okpokpai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nɛ, shi onaŋ mutso mu okpa, ejaakɛ omutsei lɛ ayibii lɛ aaakpala be mli ni amɛsrako. 41Ooofɔ bihii kɛ biyei nɛ, shi ohiŋ bi, ejaakɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ nom. 42Otsei lɛ kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii lɛ baalabii aaaye fɛɛ.
43“Gbɔ ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ agbojee aaakwɔ fe ogbojee, shi bo lɛ ogbojee lɛ aaaba shi daa. 44Lɛ lɛ ebaana nii efa bo, shi bo lɛ onaŋ nɔ ko ofa lɛ; eeetsɔ̃ yitso, ni bo lɛ oootsɔ̃ lei.
45“Naa, nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ aaaba onɔ, ni amɛaanyiɛ osɛɛ, ni amɛaanina bo yɛ hei fɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã, ejaakɛ obooo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbee toi, ni oyeee ekitãi ni ewo bo lɛ anɔ. 46Amɛaatsɔ̃ naakpɛɛ okadi amɛhã bo kɛ oshwiei kɛaatee naanɔ,
47“Ejaakɛ yɛ nii ni Yehowa jɔɔmɔ hã ona babaoo lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ jaaa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 48No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ hɔmɔ kɛ kumai kɛ yayai kɛ hiamɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli aaasɔmɔ ohenyɛlɔi ni Yehowa baahã abatua bo lɛ. Henyɛlɔi nɛɛ kɛ dade apã aaawo okuɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã ohiɛ. 49 Yehowa kɛ maŋ ko aaajɛ shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛaajɛ je lɛ naagbeehe, abatua bo trukaa, shwim tamɔ okropɔŋ filikiɔ, maŋ ko ni onuuu amɛwiemɔ, 50 maŋ ni hiɛ yɔɔ kramakrama; amɛhiɛ eshwieee onukpa hiɛiaŋ lɛ, amɛnaaa gbekɛ mɔbɔ hu. 51Amɛbaaye otsinai abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛyaashi aaakpãtã ohiɛ; amɛshiŋ abele loo wain loo mu loo otsinabii loo otoobii lɛ eko amɛhaŋ bo kɛyaashi amɛaakpãtã ohiɛ. 52Amɛaasa oyi amɛwo omaji lɛ fɛɛ amli kɛyashi omaji lɛ ahe gbogboi grɔŋŋi ni awaje, ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ lɛ, amɛaakumɔ ogbogboi lɛ amɛshwie shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
53“Hiamɔ ni ohenyɛlɔi aaahã ahia bo, be mli ni asa oyi lɛ hewɔ lɛ oooye bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋbii, obihii kɛ obiyei, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã bo lɛ aloo. 54Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛteŋ nuu ni he jɔ, asaŋ ni ekpaaa niiaŋ po musuŋ aaajoo yɛ enyɛmi kɛ eŋa ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛ emusuŋbii ateŋ mɔ ni eshwɛ ehã lɛ tete nɔ, 55bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehaŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko abi lɛ loo ni eyeɔ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ oyi ni asa kɛ fimɔ ni ohenyɛlɔ ehã efi bo yɛ omaji fɛɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, obɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ. 56Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛteŋ yoo ni he jɔ ni alɛ lɛ fɔfɔɔle, mɔ ni ekaŋ akɛ eeenyiɛ enane folo ejaakɛ eyɛ wɔrɔmii kɛ bɔdɔbii, musuŋ aaajoo yɛ ewu ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛ emusuŋ binuu kɛ emusuŋ biyoo fɛɛ hu nɔ. 57 Ebaaye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi ni efɔ eŋmɔŋ sɛɛnii kɛ emusuŋ bii nigii, ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he esɛ̃ yɛ omaji lɛ ayi ni ohenyɛlɔ esa kɛ fimɔ ni efi bo lɛ hewɔ.
58“Kɛji okwɛɛɛ ni ahi koni oye nɛkɛ mlai ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anɔ, ni oooshe Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi ni yɔɔ nyam kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, 59no lɛ Yehowa aaahã helai ni anaa wa abaye bo kɛ oshwiei, helai ni anaa wa, asaŋ ni amɛsɛɛ efooo. 60Eeehã helai lɛ ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei, nɔ ni ona Ijiptbii ye eko lɛ aye bo; ni helai nɛɛ baaka ohe. 61Hela fɛɛ hela kɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ hu ni atsĩko tã yɛ nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa aaahã eko aye bo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã. 62Tsɛbelɛ sa lɛ nyɛyi fa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii, shi nyɛyi fioo kɛkɛ aaashwɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi. 63 Bɔ ni Yehowa nya he akɛ efee nyɛ ejurɔ koni ehã nyɛyi afa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeenya he akɛ ekpãtã nyɛhiɛ koni efite nyɛ, ni aaashwie nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
64“Ni Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, kɛjɛ je lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyashi naagbeehe kome hu, ni nyɛbaaya nyɛyaja tso kɛ tɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni nyɛ loo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ leee. 65Onaŋ hejɔlɛ, ni asaŋ onaŋ nanemaahe hu yɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ; aaahã otsui afã, ni ooofee yeyeeye kɛ tsuiyeli yɛ jɛi; 66oyiŋ aaafee bo kɔshikɔshi yɛ owala he, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmiŋmi aaamɔ bo, ni oleŋ kɛji oyi aaana wala lo. 67Leebi lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina ni je ena’, ni gbɛkɛ lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina ni je etsɛre’. Obaakɛɛ nɛkɛ yɛ ŋmiŋmi ni emɔ bo kɛ ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni onaa lɛ ahewɔ. 68 Ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ aaawo lɛji amli kɛaaya Ijipt ekoŋŋ, tsɛbelɛ eji gbɛ ko ni ewo nyɛ he shi akɛ nyɛfaŋ dɔŋŋ; ni nyɛaahɔ̃hɔ̃ɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛhã nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ akɛ nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko heŋ nyɛ tete.”
