22Abimelek ye Israelbii anɔ afii etɛ̃. 23Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã nyɛɛ ba Abimelek kɛ Shekembii lɛ ateŋ; Shekembii lɛ yeee Abimelek anɔkwa. 24Afee enɛ bɔ ni afee koni gbe ni agbe Gideon musuŋbii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, agbala amɛnyɛmi Abimelek, kɛ Shekembii lɛ atoi yɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛwo Abimelek hewalɛ ni egbe enyɛmimɛi lɛ. 25Shekembii lɛ to kawolɔi yɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteŋ koni amɛwo Abimelek ka. Kawolɔi nɛɛ shɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ anii yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Ayagba Abimelek.
26Kɛkɛ ni Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba Shekem, ni Shekembii lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ. 27Amɛje kpo kɛtee amɛŋmɔji ashi. Amɛkpa amɛwaintromi lɛ amli yibii ni amɛŋã wain lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛye gbijurɔ. Amɛtee amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ. Amɛyeyee nii; amɛnunuu dãi, ni amɛye Abimelek he fɛo. 28 Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, kɛɛ: “Namɔ ji Abimelek, ni namɛi ji wɔ Shekembii ni wɔsɔmɔɔ lɛ? Ani Gideon bi lɛ kɛ esafoiatsɛ Zebul lɛ, jeee Hamor ni to Shekem lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ be ko ni eho? Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ esa akɛ wɔɔsɔ̃mɔ lɛ? 29Mina ni maŋ nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ ni kulɛ makpa Abimelek. Makɛɛ Abimelek akɛ, ‘Hã ota lɛ yi afa, ni ofã kɛba.’ ”
30Be ni Zebul, maŋ lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ, nu Ebed bi Gaal wiemɔi lɛ, emli wo la, 31ni etsu mɛi kɛtee Abimelek ŋɔɔ yɛ Aruma ekɛɛ, “Ebed bi Gaal kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ eba Shekem, ni amɛmiiwo maŋ lɛ yiŋ ni amɛte shi amɛwo bo. 32No hewɔ lɛ, tee shi nyɔɔŋ, bo kɛ omɛi lɛ, ni oyawo ka yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ. 33Leebi, kɛ hulu te shi pɛ, tee shi mra ni obatua maŋ lɛ. Kɛji Gaal kɛ emɛi lɛ je kpo banina bo lɛ, feemɔ amɛ bɔ ni ooonyɛ.”
34Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ fɛɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ. Amɛjara amɛmli kui ejwɛ, ni amɛwo Shekem he ka. 35Kɛkɛ ni Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, je kpo, ni eyadamɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ te shi kɛjɛ kawoohe lɛ. 36Gaal na mɛi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, gbɔmɛi miijɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteŋ miikpeleke shi.” Zebul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gɔji lɛ asusuma onaa tamɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ.”
37Shi Gaal wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Naa, gbɔmɛi miijɛ gɔŋ lɛ teŋ miikpeleke shi kɛmiiba, ni ku kome jɛ klamɔfoi atso kpele lɛ he gbɛ kɛmiiba.”
38Kɛkɛ ni Zebul bi Gaal akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nɛgbɛ onaabu ni okɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Namɔ ji Abimelek ni wɔsɔmɔɔ lɛ’ lɛ yɔɔ? Ani jeee gbɔmɛi lɛ ni ojɛɔ amɛ lɛ nɛ? Agbɛnɛ jee kpo ni okɛ amɛ ayawu.” 39Kɛkɛ ni Gaal je kpo kɛnyiɛ Shekembii lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ Abimelek bawu. 40Shi Abimelek wo Gaal foi, ni enyiɛ Gaal sɛɛ. Apilapilai, ni mɛi babaoo nyɔnyɔɔi aahu kɛyashi maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa tete. 41Abimelek hi Aruma; ni Zebul shwie Gaal kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛje Shekem ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehiii amɛ jɛihilɛ dɔŋŋ.
42Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, maŋbii lɛ je kpo kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ. 43Ayagba Abimelek. Hewɔ lɛ eŋɔ emɛi lɛ, ni ejara amɛmli kui etɛ̃. Eyawo ka yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaakwɛ lɛ, naa maŋbii lɛ ni amɛmiije kpo kɛmiijɛ maŋ lɛ mli. Abimelek te shi wo amɛ, ni etswia amɛ nii. 44Abimelek kɛ ku ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛtee amɛhiɛ ni amɛyadamɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Kɛkɛ ni kui krokomɛi enyɔ lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛyanina Shekembii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbe Shekembii lɛ fɛɛ. 45Abimelek kɛ Shekem maŋ lɛ wu nakai gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ. Egbe gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ. Ebutu maŋ lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋoo shwã mli. 46Be ni Shekem mɔɔ lɛ mli hii lɛ fɛɛ nu enɛ lɛ, amɛyabote El-Berit we lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli. 47Ayagba Abimelek akɛ Shekem mɔɔ lɛ mli hii lɛ fɛɛ eyabua amɛhe naa. 48Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ fɛɛ kwɔ Zalmon gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ. Abimelek kɔ lema ehiɛ edɛ̃. Eyafo tso nine ko, ni ewo etswa ekoŋ. Ekɛɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni nyɛna ni mifee nɛɛ, nyɛhe afea oya ni nyɛfea nakai.” 49No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yafo tso nine, ni amɛkɛnyiɛ Abimelek sɛɛ. Amɛkɛbashwie mɔɔ lɛ he ni amɛma mɔɔ lɛ naa la. Gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, hii kɛ yei aaafee akpe lɛ fɛɛ hu gboi.
50Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek yiŋ etee Tebez. Eyabɔ nsra ewo maŋ lɛ he, ni eŋɔ. 51Shi mɔɔ ni wa ko yɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, ni maŋbii lɛ jo foi kɛtee jɛi, hii kɛ yei fɛɛ. Amɛŋã amɛyi, ni amɛkwɔ mɔɔ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ. 52Abimelek ba, ni ebatua mɔɔ lɛ. Etsi ebɛŋkɛ mɔɔ lɛ shinaa lɛ koni ema mɔɔ lɛ naa la. 53Shi yoo ko ŋmɛɛ wiɛbi he etswa Abimelek yiteŋ, ni ejwa Abimelek yitsoŋoŋo lɛ. 54 Oya nɔŋŋ ni Abimelek tsɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ lɛ Abimelek lɛ etawuunii lɛ, ni efã oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Gbalamɔ oklante ni ogbe mi, koni akakɛɛ yɛ mihe akɛ, ‘Yoo po gbe lɛ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, oblanyo lɛ tsu Abimelek nɔ, ni egbo. 55Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Abimelek enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yiŋ etee emaŋ.
56Efɔŋ ni Abimelek fee etsɛ akɛ egbe etsɛ lɛ bii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo he nyɔmɔ nɛ. 57Asaŋ efɔŋ ni Shekembii fee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbala amɛtoi yɛ fɛɛ he; ni Yotam Gideon bi lɛ, loomɔ lɛ ba amɛnɔ.

Title: KOJOLƆI 10
Content:
Tola
1Abimelek sɛɛ lɛ mɔ ni te shi akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni ehere Israelbii lɛ ji Tola, Isarkanyo lɛ. Dodo bi Pua bi ji lɛ. Ehi Shamir yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ. 2Enyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃, ni egbo. Afu lɛ yɛ Shamir.
Yair
3 Tola sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ni te shi akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Yair, Gileadnyo lɛ. Enyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ. 4 Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃; amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ eteji ni etaa nɔ. Amɛyɛ maji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Atsɛɔ maji nɛɛ Yair akrowai kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. 5Yair gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Kamon.
Yefta
6Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ amɛshi Yehowa ekoŋŋ. Amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ Astarte nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni ji Siriabii kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Filistibii anyɔŋmɔi lɛ. Amɛkwa Yehowa, ni amɛsɔmɔɔɔ lɛ hu. 7No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli wo Israel la, ni ehã Filistibii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ye Israel nɔ. 8Filistibii kɛ Amonbii nɛɛ hao Israelbii lɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i amɛ nyɔŋyeli yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ. Amɛye Israelbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan sɛɛ yɛ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔŋŋ. 9Agbɛnɛ hu Amonbii lɛ bafo Yordan koni amɛkɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin we lɛ kɛ Efraim abawu. Enɛ hã Israelbii lɛ fee yeyeeye naakpa.
10Kɛkɛ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa amɛkɛɛ: “Wɔfee esha wɔshi bo; ejaakɛ wɔkwa bo, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni wɔyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.”
11Yehowa kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Be ni nyɛbolɔ nyɛtsɛ mi lɛ, ani jeee mi mihere nyɛ yɛ Ijiptbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Filistibii 12kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Amalekbii kɛ Midianbii ni wa nyɛ yi lɛ adɛŋ? 13Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwa mi, ni nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, mihereŋ nyɛyiwala dɔŋŋ. 14 Nyɛyaa nyɛyabolɔa nyɛtsɛa nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni nyɛhala lɛ; amɛ, amɛhere nyɛ yɛ amanehulu be nɛɛ mli.”
15Shi Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Wɔfee esha; bo lɛ feemɔ wɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa ohiɛ; shi ofainɛ ni ojie wɔ ŋmɛnɛ kɛkɛ.” 16 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ jie nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ amɛshwie, ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa. Amɛnii fee Yehowa mɔbɔ yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ hewɔ.
17Agbɛnɛ Amonbii lɛ hoo ta ni amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Gilead. Israelbii hu bua amɛhe naa, ni amɛyabɔ nsra yɛ Mizpa. 18 Kɛkɛ ni Gilead maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ bibii amɛhe akɛ, “Namɔ ji nuu ni kɛ Amonbii lɛ aaababɔ̃i wuu? Lɛ eeefee Gileadbii fɛɛ anukpa.”

Title: KOJOLƆI 11
Content:
1Yefta, Gileadnyo lɛ, tawulɔ kãkãlɔ ji lɛ; shi yoo ajwamãŋ ko bi ni. Yefta lɛ etsɛ ji Gilead. Gilead kɛ eŋã diɛŋtsɛ hu yɛ bihii krokomɛi. 2 Be ni bii nɛɛ badara lɛ, amɛshwie Yefta, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oyeŋ gboshinii yɛ wɔtsɛ we lɛ, ejaakɛ yoo kroko bi ji bo.” 3Kɛkɛ ni Yefta jo foi yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni eyahi Tob shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yakayaka gbɔmɛi komɛi bua amɛhe naa amɛyafata Yefta he, ni amɛkɛ lɛ fãa ta, amɛyayeɔ ojo.
4No sɛɛ lɛ, Amonbii lɛ fã ta wo Israel. 5Ni fee nakai lɛ, Gilead onukpai lɛ yiŋ amɛtee amɛyaŋɔ Yefta yɛ Tob shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba. 6Amɛkɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “Ba ni obaye asafoiatsɛ ohã wɔ ni wɔkɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu.”
7Shi Yefta kɛɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee nyɛ nyɛhe tsɛ̃ mi, ni nyɛshwie mi yɛ mitsɛ we lɛ? Mɛɛ hewɔ ni agbɛnɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ amanehulu mli ni nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ lɛ?”
8 Gilead onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “No hewɔ moŋ ni wɔgba wɔtua bo agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, koni okɛ wɔ aya ni wɔ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu, ni otsɔ̃ wɔ Gileadbii fɛɛ wɔnukpa.”
9Yefta kɛɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛ kɛ mi na ku sɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni wɔkɛ Amonbii lɛ yawu, ni Yehowa hã miye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, mi, mibaye nyɛnɔ.”
10Gilead onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “Yehowa afee wɔ kɛ bo teŋ odase akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ wɔɔɔye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.” 11 No hewɔ lɛ, Yefta kɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ yiŋ tee, ni maŋ lɛ wo lɛ onukpa kɛ asafoiatsɛ amɛhã maŋ lɛ. Ni Yefta yawie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa.
12Kɛkɛ ni Yefta tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ayabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sane okɛ mi yɔɔ hewɔ ni obaa minɔ ni okɛ mimaŋ lɛ abawu nɛɛ?”
13Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ hã bɔfoi ni atsu lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Ejaakɛ be ni Israel jɛ Ijipt baa lɛ, ekɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ he kɛyashi Yabok Faa lɛ kɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he; no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛ minii aku sɛɛ ahã mi kpoo!”
14Yefta saa tsu mɛi kɛtee Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, 15 ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yefta kɛɛ nɛ: Israelbii kɔko Moabbii loo Amonbii ashikpɔŋ ko; 16shi moŋ be ni Israelbii jɛ Ijipt amɛbaa lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛyashɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa, ni amɛba Kadesh. 17 Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsu mɛi kɛtee Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, hã wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho.’ Shi Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ. Amɛtsu Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ hu ŋɔɔ, shi ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ; ni Israelbii lɛ hi shi yɛ Kadesh. 18 Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ ŋã lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyalɔgɔ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛyashɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni amɛbato shi yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ sɛɛgbɛ. Shi amɛboteee Moab shikpɔŋ mli, ejaakɛ Arnon Faa lɛ ji Moab husu. 19 Agbɛnɛ Israelbii lɛ tsu mɛi kɛtee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni ji Heshbon maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, hã wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni wɔyaa nɔ lɛ nɔ.’ 20Shi Sihon yiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe bɔ ni eeehã amɛtsɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Sihon bua emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ naa. Eyabɔ nsra yɛ Yahaz, ni ekɛ Israel wu. 21Shi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã Israelbii lɛ ye Sihon kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim. No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ. 22Amɛŋɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ he kɛyashi Yabok Faa lɛ he; amɛŋɔ kɛjɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛyashi Yordan naa tɔ̃ɔ. 23No hewɔ lɛ, belɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Amorbii lɛ adɛŋ ehã emaŋ Israel; ni bo otaoɔ ni oŋɔ nɛɛ? 24 Ani nɔ ni onyɔŋmɔ Kemosh kɛhã bo akɛ onɔ lɛ, oŋɔɔɔ? Wɔ hu, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã wɔ lɛ, wɔɔŋɔ akɛ wɔnɔ. 25 Aso oyɛ hewalɛ fe Balak, Zipor bi lɛ ni ji Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ? Ani ekɛ Israel epele nii ahe pɛŋ aloo ekɛ amɛ ewu pɛŋ? 26Israel ehi Heshbon kɛ Aroer kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ kɛ majimaji ni jwere Arnon Faa lɛ he lɛ amli afii ohai etɛ̃. Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛshɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛnii nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ? 27No hewɔ lɛ, mifeko bo efɔŋ ko; shi bo moŋ ni ofeɔ mi efɔŋ akɛ ofã ta kɛba minɔ. Yehowa ni ji kojolɔ lɛ akojo Israelbii kɛ Amonbii ateŋ sane ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.” 28Shi kɛ̃lɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ wiemɔ ni Yefta kɛtsu eŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ.
29 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bayi Yefta nɔ. Yefta tsɔ̃ Gilead kɛ Manase kɛfoŋ kɛtee Mizpa yɛ Gilead, ni efoŋ yɛ Mizpa kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ. 30Yefta wo Yehowa shi ni ekɛɛ: “Kɛji ooohã maye Amonbii lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ, 31no lɛ, kɛ miyaye omanye ni miku misɛɛ kɛjɛ Amonbii lɛ aŋɔɔ miiba lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ miwe lɛ agbo lɛ mli aaaba kpee mi lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; ni mikɛ lɛ aaafee shãa afɔle.”
32Kɛkɛ ni Yefta fã kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ ayawu. Yehowa hã eye amɛnɔ kunim, 33ni Yefta tswia amɛ nii ni egbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Aroer aahu kɛtsɔ̃ Minit kpokpai anɔ, he ni maji nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɔɔ lɛ, aahu kɛtee Abel-Keramim. Agbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni Israelbii lɛ ye Amonbii lɛ anɔ kunim.
Yefta Biyoo lɛ
34Be ni Yefta ku esɛɛ kɛbaa ewe lɛ yɛ Mizpa lɛ, naa, ebiyoo lɛ je kpo kɛ fabii kɛ joi kɛba koni ebakpee lɛ. Yefta bi koome pɛ ji lɛ; esɛɛ lɛ ebɛ binuu lɛ, ebɛ biyoo hu. 35 Be ni Yefta na lɛ lɛ, egbala ehe atadei, ni ekɛɛ: “Ao mibi, ohã mihe ejɔ̃ mihe naakpa; bo pam ohã oshara bashara mi nɛɛ! Ejaakɛ miwo Yehowa shi, ni minyɛŋ minaa makpale.”
36Ebiyoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛ, owo Yehowa shi, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni Yehowa tɔ ohe owele yɛ ohenyɛlɔi ni ji Amonbii lɛ anɔ nɛɛ, feemɔ mi bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni owo shi lɛ.” 37Shi ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ enɛ pɛ ohã mi. Ŋmɛ̃ɛ mi gbɛ kɛyashi biɛ nyɔji enyɔ, koni maya mikɛ minanemɛi lɛ ayakpa shi yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ maye ŋkɔmɔ akɛ oblayoo foro.” Etsɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa!” 38Ni ewo lɛ gbɛ eyaye nyɔji enyɔ. Ekɛ enanemɛi lɛ tee eyaye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ akɛ ebaagbo oblayoo foro. 39Nyɔji enyɔ lɛ naagbee lɛ, eku esɛɛ eba etsɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni Yefta fee ebiyoo lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ, ni ebiyoo lɛ gbo akɛ oblayoo foro. Enɛ tsɔ̃ kusum yɛ Israel, 40akɛ daa afi lɛ Israel oblayei yaa amɛyayeɔ gbii ejwɛ amɛkɛyeɔ Yefta Gileadnyo lɛ biyoo lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ.

Title: KOJOLƆI 12
Content:
Yefta kɛ Efraimbii lɛ
1 Efraim hii lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛhã ta. Amɛfo mli kɛtee Zafon ni amɛyakɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ be ni ofã ni okɛ Amonbii lɛ yaa ayawu lɛ, obakpeee wɔ ni wɔkɛ bo aya lɛ? Wɔkɛ la baashã oshĩa lɛ wɔshwie oyiteŋ.”
2Yefta kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ mimaŋbii lɛ, bei ni mli wa ba wɔ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ateŋ, shi be ni mitsɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛbahereee mi yɛ Amonbii lɛ adɛŋ. 3Be ni mina akɛ nyɛhereŋ mi lɛ, mikɛ mihe wo osharã mli, ni mifã kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ. Yehowa hã miye amɛnɔ kunim. No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni hewɔ nyɛfã kɛba minɔ ŋmɛnɛ ni nyɛkɛ mi abawu lɛ?” 4Kɛkɛ ni Yefta bua Gileadhii lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛ Efraimbii lɛ wu, ni amɛye Efraimbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Gileadbii lɛ, kobɔfoi ni bafata Efraimbii kɛ Manasebii ahe ji nyɛ.” 5Gileadbii tsĩ Efraimbii lɛ gbɛ yɛ hei ni afoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ yɛ lɛ. Kɛji Efraimbii ni ejo foi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ akɛ, “hã mafo faa lɛ,” Gileadbii biɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ani Efraimnyo ji bo lo?” Ni kɛ ekɛɛ “Dabi” lɛ, 6Gileadbii lɛ kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ kɛɛmɔ, ‘Shibolet’; ni kɛ enyɛɛɛ etsɛ wiemɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ ni ekɛɛ ‘Sibolet’ ” lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbeɔ lɛ yɛ hei ni afoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ yɛ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Efraimbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ nyɔnyɔɔi.
7Yefta nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii ekpaa. Kɛkɛ ni Yefta, Gileadnyo lɛ gbo. Afu lɛ yɛ emaŋ lɛ mli yɛ Gilead.
Ibzan, Elon kɛ Abdon
8Yefta sɛɛ lɛ, Ibzan ni jɛ Betlehem lɛ ji hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ. 9Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ biyei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ. Ekɛ ebiyei lɛ bahã gbãlã yɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli, ni eyaŋɔ yei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛjɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli ebahã ebihii lɛ. 10Ibzan nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii kpawo; kɛkɛ ni egbo. Afu lɛ yɛ Betlehem.
11Ibzan sɛɛ lɛ, Elon ni jɛ Zebulon lɛ ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ. Enyiɛ amɛhiɛ afii nyɔŋma; 12kɛkɛ ni egbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Ayalon yɛ Zebulon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
13Elon sɛɛ lɛ, Abdon ni ji Hilel ni jɛ Piraton lɛ bi lɛ ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ. 14Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ nabii hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Ebii kɛ enabii nɛɛ taraa tejii nyɔŋmai kpawo anɔ. Abdon nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii kpaanyɔ. 15Kɛkɛ ni Abdon, Hilel ni ji Piratonnyo lɛ bi lɛ gbo. Afu lɛ yɛ Piraton yɛ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Amalekbii agɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Title: KOJOLƆI 13
Content:
Samson fɔmɔ
1Israelbii lɛ fee esha amɛshi Yehowa ekoŋŋ, ni Yehowa hã Filistibii ye amɛnɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. 2Nuu ko yɛ Zora ni ejɛ Danbii aweku lɛ mli. Egbɛi ji Manoa. Eŋã lɛ kene ji lɛ, ni ebɛ bi. 3Yehowa bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kene ji bo, ni obɛ bi; shi agbɛnɛ obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu. 4No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ le ohe nɔ kwɛmɔ. Kaanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa, ni kaaye nɔ ko ni he tseee hu. 5 Ejaakɛ naa, obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu. Asooyi naa akasa eyiteŋ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ baafee mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ musuŋ beebe. Lɛ ebaabɔi Israelbii lɛ heremɔ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.”
6Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ ba ni ebakɛɛ ewu akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ko ba miŋɔɔ. Ehiɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hiɛ, ehe yɛ gbeyei naakpa. Shi mibiii lɛ he ni ejɛ, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔɔ mi egbɛi. 7Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Naa, obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu; no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ, kaanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa; ni kaaye nɔ ko ni he tseee; ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ baafee mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ musuŋ beebe kɛyashi gbi ni eeegbo.’ ”
8Kɛkɛ ni Manoa kpa Yehowa fai ni ekɛɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, hã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni otsu lɛ aba wɔŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ gbekɛ lɛ ni abaafɔ lɛ wɔhã.”
9Nyɔŋmɔ fee nɔ ni Manoa bi lɛ ehã lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ ba yoo lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ be ni eta shi yɛ ŋmɔ mli; shi ewu Manoa bɛ jɛi. 10Yoo lɛ he fee oya, ni esha foi eyakɛɛ ewu lɛ akɛ, “Naa nuu lɛ ni ba miŋɔɔ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ ebajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi.”
11Kɛkɛ ni Manoa te shi ni enyiɛ eŋã lɛ sɛɛ ni ebanina nuu lɛ. Ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji nuu lɛ ni kɛ yoo nɛɛ bawie lɛ?” Nuu lɛ to he akɛ, “Miŋ.”
12Manoa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ kɛ owiemɔi lɛ na ba mli lɛ, te gbekɛ lɛ shihilɛ baatamɔ ahã tɛŋŋ, ni mɛni ebaafee?”
13Yehowa bɔfo lɛ to he akɛ, “Nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ yoo lɛ, ehiɛ ahi ehe nɔ yɛ he. 14 Ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni jɛɔ waintso mli, ni asaŋ ekanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa. Asaŋ ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he tseee. Nibii fɛɛ ni miwo lɛ he kitã lɛ eye nɔ.”
15 Manoa kɛɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã wɔtsi onaa fioo, ni wɔkɛ too abotiabi afee niyenii ahã bo.” 16Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Manoa akɛ, “Kɛji otsi minaa tete po, miyeŋ niyenii lɛ eko; shi kɛji shãa afɔle obaashã lɛ, no lɛ shãa ohã Yehowa.” Manoa leee akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni.
17 No hewɔ lɛ, Manoa bi bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Te atsɛɔ bo tɛŋŋ? Koni kɛ owiemɔi lɛ na ba mli lɛ, ni wɔwo ohiɛ nyam.”
18Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Manoa akɛ, “Mɛɛba obiɔ migbɛi? Migbɛi lɛ, naakpɛɛ gbɛi ni.”
19No hewɔ lɛ, Manoa ŋɔ too abotiabi ni ekɛ no kɛ ŋmãa afɔle shã afɔle yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa mɔ ni tsuɔ naakpɛɛnii lɛ.
20Be ni lalilɛi lɛ te shi kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tsɔ̃ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lalilɛi lɛ mli ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi. Manoa kɛ eŋã lɛ na kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi. 21Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ebajieee ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ Manoa kɛ eŋã lɛ dɔŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni Manoa na le akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni.
22 Manoa kɛɛ eŋã lɛ akɛ, “Gboimɔ wɔbaagboi lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔna Nyɔŋmɔ.”
23Shi eŋã lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Eji Yehowa miitao wɔ egbe kulɛ eheŋ wɔdɛŋ shãa afɔle kɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ, ni asaŋ kulɛ etsɔ̃ŋ wɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni ejieŋ saji ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi kpo etsɔ̃ŋ wɔ.”
24Yoo lɛ fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ Samson. Gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni Yehowa jɔɔ lɛ. 25 Yehowa Mumɔ bɔ̃i Samson nɔ baa be ni eyɔɔ Dan Shitoohe lɛ, yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol teŋ lɛ.

Title: KOJOLƆI 14
Content:
Samson kɛ Timna yoo lɛ
1Samson yiŋ etee Timna ni eyana yoo ko yɛ jɛi ni eji Filistibii lɛ eko. 2Kɛkɛ ni Samson ku esɛɛ eba, ni ebakɛɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ akɛ, “Miyana Filisti oblayoo ko yɛ Timna; nyɛyaŋɔa lɛ nyɛbahãa mi ni mikɛ lɛ afea miŋã.”
3 Shi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aso yoo ko yoo ko bɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ abiyei lɛ ateŋ aloo wɔjakubii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ hewɔ ni esa akɛ oyaŋɔ yoo yɛ Filistibii foolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ?” Shi Samson kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Yaaŋɔ lɛ obahã mi, ejaakɛ lɛ misumɔɔ.”
4Shi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ leee akɛ Yehowa dɛŋ jɛ ni Filistibii lɛ ahe gbɛ Yehowa taoɔ, ejaakɛ nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Filistibii lɛ yeɔ Israel nɔ.
5Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ yiŋ kɛtee Timna. Amɛshɛ Timna waintromi lɛ ahe; kɛkɛ ni jata oblanyo ko bɔ̃i huumɔ kɛ Samson woo. 6 Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ba Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ, ni Samson tserɛ jata lɛ mli tamɔ atserɛɔ too abotiabi mli, tsɛ ehiɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ. Shi Samson ekɛɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ.
7Samson kɛ yoo lɛ yawie, ni yoo lɛ sane sa Samson hiɛ naakpa. 8Be fioo sɛɛ lɛ Samson tee ni eyaŋɔ yoo lɛ. Be ni eyaa lɛ egba koni eyakwɛ jata gbonyo lɛ, ni eyana akɛ wobii asafo eto wo yɛ jata lɛ musuŋ. 9Samson jie wo lɛ eko ehiɛ edɛ̃, ni ehiɛ yeli kɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ. Ebanina etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni ehã amɛ eko amɛye; shi ekɛɛɛ amɛ akɛ jata gbonyo lɛ musuŋ ejie wo lɛ yɛ.
10Etsɛ yiŋ etee ni eyana yoo lɛ; ni Samson ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ nakai oblahii lɛ feɔ. 11Be ni Filistibii lɛ na Samson lɛ, amɛyaŋɔ oblahii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛbafata ehe. 12Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibagba nyɛ ajenu ko. Kɛ nyɛaanyɛ mi shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ nɛkɛ gbii kpawo ni akɛŋmɛɔ ayɛmforo okplɔ̃ nɛɛ mli, ni nyɛaana nɔ ni ji lɛ, no lɛ mibahã nyɛ shikpɔŋ boi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ hewulamɔ atadei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. 13Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ mi shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛbaahã mi shikpɔŋ boi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ hewulamɔ atadei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.”
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gba ojenu lɛ ni wɔbo toi.” 14Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛɛ akɛ,
“Niyenii jɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ mli;
Ŋɔɔmɔ jɛ hewalɔ lɛ mli.”
Gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ baho ni amɛnyɛko ajenu lɛ shishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
15Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ Samson ŋã lɛ akɛ, “Lakamɔ owu lɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ bo ajenu lɛ shishi; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔɔshã bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ. Aso nyɛkpee wɔ kɛba biɛ ni nyɛshɔ̃ wɔdɛŋ nii?”
16Kɛkɛ ni Samson ŋã lɛ fo wo lɛ ni ekɛɛ: “Onyɛɔ mi; osumɔɔɔ mi. Ogba mijakubii ajenu, shi otsɔ̃ɔɔ mi shishi.”
Shi Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ; “Mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ tete po mitsɔ̃ko amɛ shishi, ni bo mibatsɔ̃ɔ lo?” 17 Yoo lɛ fo wo Samson gbii kpawo lɛ fɛɛ ni aŋmɛɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ; ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ Samson tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋã lɛ miiye etsui. Kɛkɛ ni eŋã lɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ ejakubii lɛ ajenu lɛ shishi. 18No hewɔ lɛ, gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, hulu nako anyɔ shi ni maŋ lɛ mli hii lɛ kɛɛ Samson akɛ,
“Mɛni ŋɔɔ fe wo?
Mɛni he wa fe jata?”
Samson hã amɛ hetoo akɛ,
“Nyɛkɛ mitsina oblayoo lɛ huuu jikulɛ
Nyɛnaŋ mijenu lɛ shishi.”
19Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã mumɔ bayi Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ kpele. Eyiŋ etee Ashkelon, ni eyagbe maŋ lɛ mli hii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Ejie amɛhe nibii, ni ekɛ hewulamɔ atadei lɛ yahã mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ ajenu lɛ shishi lɛ. Samson mli fu waa ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee etsɛ we lɛ. 20Ni akɛ eŋã lɛ hã enaanyo ni ekɛbɔɔ.

Title: KOJOLƆI 15
Content:
1Be fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ, Samson hiɛ abotiabi kɛtee eyaasara eŋã lɛ yɛ ŋmãakuu be lɛ mli. Ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Matee miŋã ŋɔɔ yɛ sɛɛtsu lɛ mli.”
Shi eŋã lɛ tsɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ ni eya tsu lɛ mli. 2 Ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Anɔkwale mli lɛ, misusu akɛ osumɔɔɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ hã onaanyo lɛ. Bɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo fe lɛ? Ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ enajiaŋ.”
3Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ kɛji mifee Filistibii lɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, amɛsɔ̃ ko wulaaa miyiteŋ.” 4No hewɔ lɛ, Samson yiŋ etee, ni eyamɔmɔ osɔi ohai etɛ̃, ni ekɔlɔ kɔtii. Ekɛ osɔi lɛ aleii tsara enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni ekɛ kɔti wo lei kɛ lei tsamɔhe lɛ mli. 5Kɛkɛ ni ema kɔtii lɛ anaa la, ni eŋmɛɛ osɔi lɛ ahe ewo Filistibii lɛ aŋmãa ni mamɔ shi lɛ mli, ni Samson shã ŋmãa kei lɛ kɛ ŋmãa ni mamɔ shi kɛ mutsei abɔi lɛ fɛɛ. 6Filistibii lɛ bi akɛ, “Namɔ po ni fee enɛ?” Akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Samson, Timnanyo lɛ shaanuu lɛ, ni, ejaakɛ eshaanuu lɛ eŋɔ eŋã lɛ ehã Samson naanyo lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ yiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyashã yoo lɛ kɛ etsɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
7Samson kɛɛ Filistibii lɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛfee nɛ? Mina mitsɛ nane akɛ ja mitɔ mihe owele yɛ nyɛnɔ dani mafɔɔ.” 8Kɛkɛ ni etswia amɛgbeji kɛ amɛshuɔji anii ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu, ni eyiŋ etee eyahi tɛkplo ko mli yɛ Etam tɛsaa lɛ mli.
Samson ye Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim
9Filistibii lɛ ba amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Yuda, ni amɛyatua Lehi. 10No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda hii lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛfã kɛba wɔnɔ nɛɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Samson fĩi wɔba nɛɛ, koni bɔ ni efee wɔ lɛ, wɔfee lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.” 11No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda hii akpei etɛ̃ yiŋ amɛtee tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Etam tɛsaa lɛ mli lɛ mli, ni amɛyakɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Ani oleee akɛ Filistibii lɛ amɛ amɛ ji mɛi ni yeɔ wɔnɔ lo? Hewɔ lɛ, mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ?”
Eto he akɛ, “Bɔ ni amɛfee mi lɛ, nakai mi hu mifee amɛ lɛ.”
12Yuda hii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo fĩi wɔba nɛɛ, koni wɔkɛ bo ayawo Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.”
Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkãa mi kitã akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛgbeŋ mi.”
13Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dabi, fĩi kɛkɛ wɔbaafĩ bo, koni wɔkɛ bo ayawo amɛdɛŋ; shi gbee lɛ wɔgbeŋ bo.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛfĩ lɛ kɛ taŋkpei hei enyɔ, ni amɛ jie lɛ kɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli kɛje kpo.
14 Be ni eshɛ Lehi lɛ, Filistibii lɛ bɔ oshe amɛkɛ lɛ bakpe. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bayi Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ kpele, ni taŋkpei lɛ ni yɔɔ eniji lɛ tsɔmɔ tamɔ odonti ni akɛ la esa he, ni taŋkpei lɛ tserɛ yɛ eniji. 15Kɛkɛ ni ena teji kadaa ŋmɔŋ ko. Ekpã enine mli ekɔ, ni ekɛgbe hii akpe. 16No hewɔ lɛ, Samson kɛɛ:
“Teji kadaa mikɛgbe amɛ mibua shi;
gbohii jwere gbohii anɔ,
Teji kadaa mikɛgbe hii akpe.”
17Be ni ewie egbe naa lɛ, eshɛ kadaa ni ehiɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ efɔ̃; ni awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Ramat-Lehi.
18Kɛkɛ ni kumai ye Samson waa naakpa. Ebo etsɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, “Otsɔ̃ otsulɔ nine nɔ otsu yiwalaheremɔ nitsumɔ kpele nɛɛ; ni mɛɛba ni magbo kɛ kumai moŋ ni magbee foolɔi nɛɛ adɛŋ?” 19 Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ he ko ni enyɔ yɛ Lehi lɛ gba, ni nu tue kɛba. Kɛkɛ ni Samson nu. Ni be ni enu nu lɛ emumɔ ku esɛɛ eba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ En-Hakoree. Eyɛ Lehi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
20 Samson nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ be ni Filistibii yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli.

Title: KOJOLƆI 16
Content:
Samson yɛ Gaza
1Samson yiŋ etee Filistibii amaŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gaza lɛ mli. Eyana yoo ajwamãŋ ko yɛ jɛi, ni etee eyawɔ eŋɔɔ. 2Ayagba Gazabii lɛ akɛ, “Samson eba biɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛsa eyi, ni amɛwo lɛ ka nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Amɛsɛ̃ koniŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ: “Nyɛhãa wɔmɛa kɛyashi je aaatsɛre koni wɔgbe lɛ.” 3Shi Samson kã shi kɛyashi nyɔɔŋteŋ, ni ete shi nyɔɔŋ te lɛ mli. Emɔmɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ shinai lɛ kɛ shinaatsei enyɔ lɛ amli, ni efã kɛ esɛɛlaa adabaŋ lɛ fɛɛ. Ekɛtswa ekɔŋ, ni etere kɛtee gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Hebron hiɛ lɛ yiteŋ.
Samson kɛ Delila
4Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Samson tsui mɔ yoo ko yɛ Sorek jɔɔ lɛ mli. Egbɛi ji Delila. 5 Filistibii alumɛi lɛ ba Delila ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lakamɔ lɛ ni ona nɔ mli ni ehewalɛ kpele lɛ yɔɔ kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔɔnyɛ lɛ wɔmɔ koni wɔfĩ lɛ ni wɔjɔɔ ehe. Kɛkɛ lɛ wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaahã bo jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kɛ oha.”
6No hewɔ lɛ, Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Ofainɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi nɔ mli ni ohewalɛ kpele lɛ yɔɔ kɛ bɔ ni aaafee afĩ bo ni anyɛ ohe ajɔɔ.”
7Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji amɛkɛ kpãi hei ŋmɔji kawekawee kpawo fĩ mi lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.”
8Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii alumɛi lɛ kɛ kpãi hei ŋmɔji kawekawee kpawo bahã Delila, ni ekɛfĩ Samson. 9 Shi Delila yɛ mɛi ni ewo antɛo yɛ pia lɛ mli. No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Samson tserɛ kpãi lɛ amli tamɔ anaanu kpãa hwiãa tseɔ kɛ esa la he lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Samson hewalɛ lɛ teemɔŋ sane lɛ ejeee kpo.
10Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Naa, mihe fɛo sɔŋŋ oyeɔ nɛɛ, ni olaka mi. Ofainɛ, agbɛnɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni aaafee afĩ bo.”
11Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji amɛkɛ taŋkpee kpãi hei ni akɛtsuko nɔ ko dã fĩ mi lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.”
12No hewɔ lɛ, Delila ŋɔ taŋkpee kpãi hei ekɛfĩ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ!” Shi mɛi ni ewo antɛo lɛ yɛ pia lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Samson tserɛ taŋkpee kpãi lɛ yɛ eniji oookɛɛ kpãa hwiãa ko kɛkɛ ni.
13Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ, mihe fɛo sɔŋŋ oyeɔ, ni olakaa mi. Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni aaafee afĩ bo.” Ni ekɛɛ Delila akɛ, “Kɛji omɔmɔ miyitsɔi akuklu kpawo lɛ ofĩ, ni okɛ piŋ mɔ lɛ kpɛŋŋ lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ, ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.”
14No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Samson ewɔ lɛ, Delila mɔmɔ Samson, yitsɔi akuklui kpawo lɛ efĩ, ni ekɛ piŋ mɔ lɛ kpɛŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ.” Shi Samson hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli, ni efã piŋ lɛ yɛ eyitsɔi lɛ mli.
15No hewɔ lɛ, Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ oosumɔ mi be ni otsui bɛ mihe lɛ? Shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛ ni olakaa mi, ni otsɔ̃ko mi nɔ mli ni ohewalɛ kpele lɛ yɔɔ.” 16 Bɔ ni Delila yeɔ Samson tsui sɔŋŋ daa gbi kɛ ewiemɔi lɛ, ni ehiɛ Samson doo lɛ, ehã jeŋshihilɛ po je Samson tsine. No hewɔ lɛ, 17egba Delila eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ ekɛɛ, “Asooyi naa esako miyiteŋ pɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi kɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ beebe. Kɛji ashɛ miyi lɛ, no dani mihewalɛ lɛ aaaje mimli, ni magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.”
18Be ni Delila na akɛ Samson egba lɛ eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ lɛ, etsu koni ayakpee Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ kɛba; ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa shi kome nɛɛ hu, ejaakɛ egba mi eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii alumɛi lɛ ba. Amɛhiɛ shika lɛ kɛba. 19Delila wɔle Samson be ni Samson yitso kã enakutsei anɔ. Etsɛ nuu ko, ehã ebashɛ Samson yitsɔi akuklui kpawo lɛ, ni ehewalɛ lɛ je emli. 20 Kɛkɛ ni Delila kɛɛ “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ.” Samson hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ ewɔ lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Maje kpo tamɔ tsutsu lɛ ni mahoso mihe.” Shi eleee akɛ Yehowa ekpa yɛ esɛɛ. 21Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ mɔ lɛ ni amɛfamɔ ehiŋmɛii. Amɛkɛ lɛ tee Gaza. Amɛkɛ akɔɔble gboklɛi enyɔ wo lɛ, ni amɛhãa ewiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli. 22Shi eyitsɔi ni ashɛ lɛ, bɔ̃i tsaa ekoŋŋ.
Samson gbele
23 Eba mli akɛ Filistibii alumɛi lɛ babua amɛhe naa koni amɛshã afɔle kpele amɛhã amɛnyɔŋmɔ Dagon lɛ, koni amɛnya, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã wɔye wɔhenyɛlɔ Samson lɛ nɔ kunim.” 24Be ni Filistibii lɛ na Samson lɛ, amɛ jie amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔhenyɛlɔ ni ekpãtã wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni egbegbee wɔteŋ mɛi babaoo lɛ, wɔnyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã wɔye enɔ kunim.” 25Be ni amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɛa Samson kɛbaa ni ebajie wɔhiɛtserɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyatsɛ Samson yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli, koni ebajie amɛhiɛtserɛ. Amɛhã edamɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ateŋ. 26Samson kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ enineshi lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛ̃ɛ mi gbɛ ni matara akulashiŋi ni tsu lɛ ma nɔ lɛ ahe makwɛ, ni makpasa amɛ.” 27Agbɛnɛ shĩa lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ hii kɛ yei. Filistibii alumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ jɛi; ni hii kɛ yei aaafee akpei etɛ̃ yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ amɛmiikwɛ bɔ ni Samson jieɔ mɛi ahiɛtserɛ lɛ.
28Kɛkɛ ni Samson tsɛ Yehowa ni ekɛɛ, “Ao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa bo fai, kaimɔ mi ni ohã mi hewalɛ shi kome nɛɛ kɛkɛ. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã matɔ mihiŋmɛii enyɔ nɛɛ he owele shi kome yɛ Filistibii lɛ anɔ!” 29Kɛkɛ ni Samson mɔmɔ teŋ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ni tsu lɛ ma nɔ lɛ mli; ekɛ eninejurɔ mɔ ekome mli, ni ekɛ ebɛku hu mɔ ekome mli. Ekɛ etsiimɔ ŋmɛ amɛnɔ, 30ni ekɛɛ, “Hã mi kɛ Filistibii lɛ agboi.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsi akulashiŋi lɛ, ni shĩa lɛ wule shwie lumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Mɛi ni Samson gbe yɛ egbele mli lɛ ayi fa fe mɛi ni egbe be ni ehiɛ kã lɛ.
31 Kɛkɛ ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee ni amɛyawo lɛ. Amɛkɛ lɛ ba amɛbafu lɛ yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol teŋ yɛ etsɛ Manoa fuuhe lɛ. Samson nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ.

Title: KOJOLƆI 17
Content:
Mika wɔji lɛ
1Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mika hi shi yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ. 2 Ekɛɛ enyɛ akɛ, “Jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kome kɛ oha lɛ ni awo yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, nɔ ni olomɔ yɛ he ni owie he hu yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, naa, eyɛ midɛŋ; mi miwo.”
Enyɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ bo mibi.” 3Mika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kɛ oha lɛ ku sɛɛ hã enyɛ. Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ kɛɛ, “Mijie jwiɛtɛi nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ, ni mijɔɔ nɔ mihã Yehowa yɛ mibi lɛ hewɔ; akɛfee amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ nɔ ni ashwie; enɛ hewɔ lɛ mikɛmiiku sɛɛ mahã bo.” 4 Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ ku sɛɛ hã enyɛ. Enyɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli kukuji ohai enyɔ hã nishwielɔ, koni ekɛfee amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ nɔ ni ashwie; ni akɛba Mika we lɛ.
5 Nuu Mika nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni ejaa yɛ. Efee amãgã ni akɛgbaa kɛ wɔji; ni ewo ebihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome osɔfo koni eye osɔfo ehã lɛ. 6 Nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni sa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ. 7 Shi oblanyo ko yɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ. Ejɛ Yuda weku lɛ mli; Levinyo ji lɛ, ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Betlehem. 8Oblanyo nɛɛ fã yɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ koni eyahi he fɛɛ he ni eeena. Egbɛfãa lɛ mli lɛ, eyaje Mika we lɛ yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ. 9Mika bi oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛɛ?”
Oblanyo lɛ to he akɛ, “Levinyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ. Miiya miyahi he fɛɛ he ni mina.”
10Mika kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ mi abahi shi ni otsɔ̃ ŋaawolɔ kɛ osɔfo ohã mi. Daa afi naakplɔ lɛ, mahã bo jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ atade kɛ oniyenii.” 11Levinyo lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ Mika aaahi shi, ni ekɛ Mika hi shi tamɔ ebihii lɛ eko. 12Mika wo oblanyo lɛ osɔfo, ni oblanyo lɛ tsɔ̃ Mika osɔfo, ni ehi Mika we lɛ. 13Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛɛ, “Kpaako mina mile akɛ Yehowa baahã mashwere, ejaakɛ mina Levinyo akɛ osɔfo.”

Title: KOJOLƆI 18
Content:
Mika kɛ Dan akutso lɛ
1 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel. Nakai be lɛ mli hu lɛ Dan akutso lɛ miitao amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ko amɛhã amɛhe koni amɛyahi nɔ; ejaakɛ kɛbashi nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛnako amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ. 2 No hewɔ lɛ, Danbii lɛ tsu hii kãkãlɔi enumɔ kɛjɛ amɛweku lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛjɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol, koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛkpa lɛ shi. Amɛkɛɛ mɛi ni atsu lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakpaa shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ shi.” Amɛba Mika shĩa lɛ yɛ Efraim gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbawɔ jɛi. 3 Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Mika shĩa lɛ, oblanyo lɛ wiemɔ hã amɛyoo akɛ Levinyo ji lɛ. Amɛgba kɛtee shĩa lɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ kɛ bo ba biɛ? Mɛni ofeɔ yɛ biɛ? Mɛni otsuɔ yɛ biɛ?”
4Oblanyo lɛ to he akɛ, “Mika kɛ mi eye efua, ni ebɔ mi apaa koni maye osɔfo mahã lɛ.”
5Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ni obi Nyɔŋmɔ ohã wɔ bɔ ni afee ni wɔle akɛ wɔgbɛ ni wɔnyiɛ nɛɛ aaafee omanye lo?”
6Osɔfo lɛ to he hã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa kɛ omanye. Yehowa hiŋmɛi kã nyɛhe yɛ gbɛ ni nyɛnyiɛ nɛɛ mli!”
7Kɛkɛ ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ kɛshwie nɔ kɛtee Laish. Amɛna jɛibii lɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ shweshweeshwe amɛhã, tamɔ Sidonbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ kpoo ni amɛyiŋ efeee amɛ kɔshikɔshi yɛ mɔ ko he lɛ. Nɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni he hiaa amɛ; niiatsɛmɛi ji amɛ. Amɛkɛ Sidonbii lɛ ateŋ jɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ sharamɔ. 8Be ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol lɛ, amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Te nyɛyana tɛŋŋ?” 9Mɛi ni atsu lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛtea shi ni wɔyaa wɔyatua amɛ, ejaakɛ wɔyana shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ehi naakpa. Mɛni nyɛtara shi nyɛfeɔ? Nyɛkashashaoa shi kwraa ni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛfea nyɛnɔ. 10Kɛ nyɛtee lɛ, nyɛbaaya nyɛyanina gbɔmɛi ni kwɛɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ko gbɛ. Shikpɔŋ ni da ni. Anɔkwale mli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã nyɛ. Eji he ko ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nibii fɛɛ mli ekoeko he bɛ ona yɛ.”
11Kɛkɛ ni hii ohai ekpaa ni jɛ Danbii aweku lɛ mli ni emia kɛ tawuunii fã kɛjɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol, 12ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee amɛyabɔ nsra yɛ Kiriat-Yearim yɛ Yuda. No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Dan Shitoohe kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Eyɛ Kiriat-Yearim anaigbɛ. 13 Amɛfo mli yɛ jɛi kɛtee Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni amɛba Mika shĩa lɛ masɛi.
14 Kɛkɛ ni hii enumɔ lɛ ni tee yasara Laish shikpɔŋ lɛ bi amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛle akɛ shĩai nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli lɛ efod kɛ wɔji kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie yɛ mli lo? No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkwɛa nɔ ni nyɛaafee.” 15No hewɔ lɛ, amɛgba jɛi; ni amɛba Levinyo oblanyo lɛ shĩa ni ji Mika shĩa lɛ, Amɛŋã oblanyo lɛ. 16Ni Danbii mɛi ohai ekpaa lɛ ni emia kɛ amɛtawuu nii lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa. 17Ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ ni tee yasara shikpɔŋ lɛ bote shĩa lɛ mli ni amɛyahole amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ kɛ efod lɛ kɛ wɔji lɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie lɛ.
18Be ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ bote Mika shĩa lɛ ni amɛyahole amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ kɛ efod lɛ kɛ wɔji lɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie lɛ, osɔfo lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ?”
19Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ diŋŋ; okɛ onine ato onaabu, ni obaho ni wɔtee koni oyatsɔ̃ wɔŋaawolɔ kɛ wɔsɔfo. Te emli nɔ ni hi hã bo lɛ, akɛ oooye osɔfo ohã gbɔmɔ kome we aloo akɛ oooye ohã Israel muu fɛɛ?” 20Sane lɛ ŋɔɔ osɔfo lɛ naa. Ehole amãgã ni akɛgbaa lɛ kɛ wɔji lɛ kɛ efod ni akpɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba mɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
21Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee. Amɛhã gbekɛbii lɛ kɛ shĩa kooloi lɛ kɛ nibii lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛgbɛ. 22Be ni amɛkɛ Mika shĩai lɛ teŋ gbɛ ejekɛ lɛ, abo atsɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shĩai ni bɛŋkɛ Mika shĩa lɛ amli lɛ, ni amɛtiu Danbii lɛ. 23Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Danbii lɛ ayisɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Danbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbi Mika akɛ, “Mɛni feɔ bo hewɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɛi babaoo baa nɛɛ?”
24Mika to he akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔ minyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni mifee lɛ kɛ osɔfo lɛ, kɛmiiya; mɛni eshwɛ mi dɔŋŋ? Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛbiɔ mi akɛ, ‘Mɛni feɔ bo’ lɛ?”
25Danbii lɛ kɛɛ Mika akɛ, “Kaahã anu ogbee yɛ wɔteŋ ni mlilatsɛmɛi nɛɛ miitsɛ̃ kɛmiiba onɔ ni amɛbakpãtã bo kɛ owe lɛ mli bii ahiɛ.” 26Kɛkɛ ni Danbii lɛ kɛshwie nɔ. Be ni Mika na akɛ amɛhe wa fe lɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee eshĩa.
27Danbii lɛ ŋɔ nibii ni Mika efee lɛ kɛ esɔfo lɛ, ni amɛtee Laish. Emli bii lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ kpoo ni amɛkwɛɛɛ efɔŋ ko gbɛ ji amɛ; shi Danbii lɛ kɛ klante gbe amɛ ni amɛshã maŋ lɛ. 28Mɔ ko bɛ ni hereɔ Laishbii lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ Sidon jɛkɛ ni amɛ Laishbii lɛ, amɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nɔ ko feemɔ. Laish maŋ lɛ kã Bet-Rehob jɔɔ lɛ mli. Danbii lɛ saa to maŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi mli. 29 Amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ Dan ni ji Yakob bi lɛ gbɛi Dan lɛ wo maŋ lɛ. Shi sa lɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Laish. 30 Danbii lɛ kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ ma shi hã amɛhe. Yonatan, Mose bi Gershom bi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ ye osɔfo hã Dan akutso lɛ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nom lɛ. 31 No hewɔ lɛ, Danbii lɛ kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ ni Mika fee lɛ ma shi hã amɛhe gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ yɔɔ Shilo lɛ.

Title: KOJOLƆI 19
Content:
Levinyo ko kɛ ehemɔ
1 Nakai bei lɛ amli be ni maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel lɛ, Levinyo ko yato gbɔ yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ he ko shɔŋŋ. Ekɛ yoo ko ni jɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda lɛ fee hemɔ. 2Shi yoo lɛ mlifu nuu lɛ ni eshi nuu lɛ etee etsɛ we yɛ Betlehem Yuda, ni eyaye nyɔji ejwɛ yɛ jɛi. 3Kɛkɛ ni ewu lɛ yiŋ etee koni eyatiu esɛɛ ni ekɛ lɛ awie yɛ tsuijurɔ naa koni ekpala lɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ. Nuu lɛ kɛ etsulɔ kɛ tejii enyɔ tee. Be ni Levinyo lɛ yashɛ yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ we lɛ ni eshaanuu lɛ na lɛ lɛ, ehere lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ. 4Shaanuu lɛ tsĩ Levinyo lɛ naa, ni Levinyo lɛ kɛ shaanuu lɛ hi shi gbii etɛ̃. No hewɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ ye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko ni amɛhi shi yɛ jɛi. 5Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛte shi leebi maŋkpa, ni Levinyo lɛ miitao eyi mli, kɛkɛ ni eshaanuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ aboloo atrɔma kome ko asa onaa koni no sɛɛ dani nyɛyi mli.”
6No hewɔ lɛ, hii enyɔ lɛ ho amɛtara shi, ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ eshaanuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpɛlɛ̃mɔ ni owɔ biɛ ŋmɛnɛ hu ni omii ashɛ ohe!”
7Be ni nuu lɛ te shi ni ebaayi mli lɛ, eshaanuu lɛ tsĩ enaa, ni ewɔ jɛi ekoŋŋ. 8Gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa ni ebaaya, kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wo onaa nɔ ko dã. Hii shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi.” No hewɔ lɛ, shaahiimɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ye nii.
9Be ni nuu lɛ kɛ ehemɔ lɛ kɛ etsulɔ lɛ te shi ni amɛbaayi mli lɛ, eshaanuu lɛ ni ji yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Amrɔ nɛɛ, je ena etã, nyɛwɔa; duŋ baawo nɔŋŋ. Wɔ biɛ ni omii ashɛ ohe, koni nyɛte shi maŋkɛ mra ni nyɛyi mli, ni oya omaŋ.”
10 Shi nuu lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni ewɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ete shi ni eyi mli. Ebɛŋkɛ Yebus ni ji Yerusalɛm ŋlɛnɔ. Ekɛ ehemɔ lɛ nyiɛ kɛ tejii enyɔ ni awo amɛnɔ nii. 11Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛɔ Yebus lɛ, je ena etã. No hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni wɔgba kɛya Yebusbii amaŋ nɛɛ mli ni wɔyawɔ jɛi.”
12-13Shi enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔgbaŋ kɛyaŋ mɛi kpɔji amaŋ ko mli, maŋ ni jeee Israelbii amaŋ. Shi moŋ wɔbaafoŋ kɛya Gibea.” Ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔtsi wɔshɛ wɔhiɛgbɛ he ko ni wɔyawɔ Gibea loo Rama.” 14No hewɔ lɛ, amɛfoŋ kɛtee amɛhiɛ. Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Gibea ni ji Benyaminbii amaŋ lɛ lɛ, hulu nyɔ shi wo amɛ. 15No hewɔ lɛ, amɛgba Gibea koni amɛyawɔ jɛi. Be ni amɛshɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Levinyo lɛ ho eta maŋ lɛ blohuŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ amɛ kɛyaaa eshĩa koni amɛyawɔ jɛi.
16Kɛkɛ lɛ naa nuumo ko ni eyatsu nii yɛ eŋmɔ mli ni eku esɛɛ eeba gbɛkɛnaashi mli. Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ nyo ji lɛ, ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Gibea maŋ lɛ mli. Gibeabii lɛ Benyaminbii ni. 17Be ni nuumo lɛ yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena nuu gbɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ yɛ blohu lɛ mli. Nuumo lɛ bi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyaa, ni nɛgbɛ ojɛ?”
18Levinyo lɛ to he akɛ, “Wɔjɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ; wɔmiifo mli kɛya Efraim gɔji lɛ asɛɛgbɛ shɔŋŋ. Efraimnyo ji mi. Mitee Betlehem yɛ Yuda, shi mimaŋ miyaa nɛɛ; ni mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ mi kɛyaaa eshĩa. 19Shi wɔyɛ jwɛi kɛ niyenii hã wɔtejii lɛ, ni aboloo hu yɛ hã mi kɛ oblayoo lɛ kɛ oblanyo lɛ ni fata wɔhe lɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehĩaaa wɔ.”
20Nuumo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Oba kɛ omanye. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaahia bo lɛ, mahã bo; blohu lɛ mli kɛkɛ ni okawɔ.” 21No hewɔ lɛ, nuumo lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee eshĩa. Ehã tejii lɛ anii. Gbɔi lɛ fɔfɔɔ amɛnaji ahe; ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko.
22Shi be ni amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli bii komɛi ni ji hii yakagbɔmɛi babɔle shĩa lɛ kɛkpe. Amɛshimɔ shinaa lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ shĩatsɛ ni ji nuumo lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ nuu lɛ ni bato oshĩa lɛ aje kpo kɛba ni wɔkɛ lɛ awɔ.”
23 Shi nuumo lɛ ni ji shĩatsɛ lɛ je kpo kɛba amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Dabida, minyɛmimɛi! Nyɛkafea efɔŋ ni tamɔ enɛ; akɛni nuu nɛɛ ebato mishĩa nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛkafea nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ. 24 Naa, mibi oblayoo foro kɛ nuu lɛ hu hemɔ. Mikɛ amɛ moŋ baaje kpo kɛba ni nyɛfite amɛ ni nyɛfee amɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; shi nuu nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkafea lɛ nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ.” 25Shi hii lɛ booo lɛ toi. No hewɔ lɛ, Levinyo lɛ ŋɔ ehemɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ je kpo kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ blohu lɛ mli. Amɛnyɛ yoo lɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛ lɛ wɔ, ni amɛfee lɛ niseniianii nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ ni be ni je bɔi tsɛremɔ lɛ, amɛŋmɛ̃ɛ ehe.
26Hiɛfutɛfutɛ mli lɛ, yoo lɛ ba ni ebaho ebu shi yɛ nuumo lɛ shĩa lɛ he ni ewu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ shinaa lɛ shi kɛyashi be ni hiɛ gbele. 27Be ni ewu lɛ te shi leebi ni egbele shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ ni ebaaje kpo eya lɛ, naa yoo lɛ ni ji ehemɔ lɛ bu shi yɛ shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eniji jwere kpoku lɛ nɔ. 28Ewu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni wɔtee” shi fɛɛ lɛ kranaa. Kɛkɛ ni ewu lɛ wo egbonyo lɛ eŋmɛ eteji lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛshwie nɔ kɛtee emaŋ. 29 Be ni eshɛ ewe lɛ, ekɔ kakla, ni emɔ ehemɔ lɛ mli, ni efolɔ emli yɛ etalɔi lɛ anɔ kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Ehã akɛtee akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amli akɛyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 30Mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Afeko nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã ni asaŋ anako nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã kɛjɛ gbi ni Israelbii jɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Nyɛsusua he, nyɛwoa he ŋaa, nyɛwiea he.”

Title: KOJOLƆI 20
Content:
Israel saa ehe hã ta
1 Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ Dan yɛ kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi Beersheba yɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ fã kɛba. Amɛbabua amɛhe naa amɛfee asafo kpele kome yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa. 2Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpai lɛ badamɔ shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ mli. Asafo lɛ yibɔ ji, hii ni nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ, mɛi akpei ohai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ ni le tawuu. 3Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ nu he akɛ Israelbii lɛ efã kɛtee Mizpa. Agbɛnɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ bɔ ni fee ni aye nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ.” 4 Levinyo lɛ ni ji yoo ni agbe lɛ wu lɛ hã hetoo ni ekɛɛ, “Mikɛ mihemɔ ba Benyaminbii amaŋ ni ji Gibea koni wɔbawɔ jɛi. 5Gibea hii lɛ te shi wo mi, ni amɛgba nyɔɔŋ amɛbɔle shĩa ni miyɔɔ mli lɛ, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe. Amɛgbɔnyɔ mihemɔ lɛ aahu ni egbo. 6Miwo mihemɔ lɛ, ni mifolɔ emli dukuduku ni mikɛmaje Israelbii ashikpɔŋ ni ji amɛgboshinii lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ Benyaminbii ebɔ musu ni amɛfee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel. 7Naa, nyɛ Israelbii fɛɛ nɛ. Mɛni nyɛkɛɔ; nyɛwoa he ŋaa!”
8Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi damɔ shi tamɔ gbɔmɔ kome, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaŋ ebuu mli, ni wɔteŋ mɔ ko ekuŋ esɛɛ eyaŋ eshĩa. 9Shi nɔ ni wɔbaafee ji akɛ wɔbaafɔ̃ oshiki koni wɔkɛna bɔ ni wɔbaatua lɛ wɔhã. 10Wɔbaajie hii nyɔŋma yɛ mɛi oha fɛɛ oha mli, hii oha yɛ akpe fɛɛ akpe mli, hii akpe yɛ akpei nyɔŋma fɛɛ akpei nyɔŋma mli kɛjɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli koni amɛyaŋɔ niyenii amɛbahã maŋ lɛ. Ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaya amɛyagbala Gibeabii atoi yɛ hiɛgbejianii ni amɛtsu yɛ Israel lɛ hewɔ.” 11No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fĩ tɔo, ni amɛfee jwɛŋmɔ kome amɛwo Gibea maŋ lɛ.
12Israel akutsei lɛ tsu mɛi kɛtee Benyamin akutso muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ yiŋsha sane pam aye yɛ nyɛteŋ nɛɛ? 13No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛjiea hii, yakagbɔmɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Gibea lɛ kɛbaa, koni wɔgbea amɛ ni wɔkɛjie nɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ Israel.” 14Shi Benyaminbii lɛ booo amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ atoi. Shi moŋ amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛjɛ maji lɛ amli kɛtee Gibea, koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ ayawu. 15Nakai gbi lɛ Benyaminbii lɛ bua hii tawulɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa naa kɛjɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli; 16esoro hii ohai kpawo ni jɛ Gibea ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ. Hii abɛkulɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɛɔ yitsɔi gaŋŋ kome akromia efɔ̃ɔ ni eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ. 17Kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ bɛ mli lɛ, Israel tabilɔi lɛ anaa shiɔ hii akpei ohai ejwɛ ni emĩa kɛ klante; ni atsɔse amɛ jogbaŋŋ hã tawuu.
Ta ni afã ashi Benyaminbii lɛ
18 Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel, ni amɛyabi Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ŋaawoo akɛ, “Wɔteŋ namɔ tsutsu afã kɛya ni ekɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu?” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Yuda tsutsu afã.”
19No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ te shi leebi ni amɛyabɔ nsra amɛwo Gibea. 20Amɛfã kɛtee koni amɛkɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu. Israelbii lɛ gba ta wo Benyaminbii lɛ yɛ Gibea. 21Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ fã kpo kɛjɛ Gibea, ni amɛbakpãtã Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ ahiɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa nakai gbi lɛ. 22Shi Israelbii lɛ na ekãa, ni amɛgba ta lɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ he ni amɛgba yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ. 23Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee ni amɛyafo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ, ni amɛbi Yehowa nii akɛ, “Ani wɔtsi wɔbɛŋkɛ ekoŋŋ ni wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi, Benyaminbii lɛ, ayawu?”
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfãa ni nyɛkɛ amɛ ayawua.”
24No hewɔ lɛ, gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ekoŋŋ. 25 Benyaminbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Gibea gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakpãtã Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ hiɛ; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii tawulɔi ni. 26 Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ni ji ta muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel ni amɛyafo. Amɛho amɛtara shi yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛhi ŋmãa nakai gbi lɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Amɛshãshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 27Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ jɛi, 28 ni mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ji Finehas, Aaron bi Eleazar bi lɛ. Israelbii lɛ bi Yehowa akɛ, “Ani wɔfã ekoŋŋ ni wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu aloo wɔfɔ̃ɔ?”
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛfãa kɛyaa, ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛye amɛnɔ kunim.”
29Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ to kawolɔi kɛbɔle Gibea kɛkpe. 30Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã kɛyanina Benyaminbii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛgba ta amɛwo Gibea tamɔ tsutsu lɛ. 31Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ fã kpo kɛbanina Israelbii lɛ. Agbala Benyaminbii lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛbɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ nitswiamɔ kɛ amɛgbee tamɔ tsutsu lɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni kã kɛyaa Betel kɛ nɔ ni kã kɛyaa Gibea yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ. Amɛgbe Israel hii aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. 32Benyaminbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Wɔgbɛ amɛta lɛ tamɔ tsutsu lɛ nɔŋŋ.”
Shi Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔjoa foi ni wɔkɛgbala amɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛba gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ.” 33Kɛkɛ ni Israel hii lɛ fɛɛ tetee shi yɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ ni amɛyagba ta yɛ Baal-Tamar. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii ni ewo ka lɛ fãfãa kpo kɛjɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ yɛ Gibea anaigbɛ; 34ni hii akpei nyɔŋma ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ kɛjɛ Israel fɛɛ lɛ te shi wo Gibea. Ta lɛ mli bawa po ni ehiii; shi Benyaminbii lɛ leee akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ etã. 35Yehowa hã Israelbii lɛ ye amɛnɔ kunim. Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãtã Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛ oha hiɛ; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii tawulɔi sɔŋŋ. 36Agbɛnɛ Benyaminbii lɛ na faŋŋ akɛ aye amɛnɔ.
Bɔ ni Israelbii fee ye kunim
Akɛni Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kã mɛi ni amɛhã amɛwo ka kɛbɔle Gibea lɛ anɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛnaa sɛɛsɛɛ amɛhã Benyaminbii lɛ. 37Hii ni ewo ka lɛ he fee oya, ni amɛtsɛ̃ kɛba Gibea nɔ. Amɛgba amɛyi maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ klante gbe maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ. 38Shi okadi ni Israel hii lɛ kɛ kawolɔi lɛ eto yɛ amɛteŋ ji akɛ kɛ kawolɔi lɛ na lasu te shi kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli akɛ okadi lɛ, 39Israelbii lɛ adɔ amɛyi kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli. Agbɛnɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ebɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nitswiamɔ kɛ amɛgbee, ni amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnine etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ba yɛ tsutsu ta lɛ mli lɛ.” 40Shi be ni lasu kutuu lɛ bɔ̃i shitee kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ ŋwɛiyaa lɛ, Benyaminbii lɛ kwɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛna akɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miitso kɛmiiya ŋwɛi. 41Kɛkɛ ni Israel hii lɛ dɔ amɛhe. Ŋmiŋmi mɔ Benyamin hii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ. 42No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛ̃hã Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ; shi ta lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ waa. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fã nɔŋŋ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛbote Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛgbegbee Benyaminbii lɛ. 43Israelbii lɛ sa Benyaminbii lɛ ayi, ni amɛnyiɛ Benyaminbii lɛ asɛɛ kɛyashi Noha. Amɛnaanaa Benyaminbii lɛ anɔ aahu kɛyashi Gibea ŋlɛnɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ. 44Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋma-kɛ-kpaanyɔ nyɔnyɔɔi; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni. 45Mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛyaa Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he gbɛ lɛ. Agbe amɛteŋ hii akpei enumɔ yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ; anyiɛ amɛsɛɛ waa kɛtee Gidom, ni asaa agbe amɛteŋ hii akpei enyɔ. 46No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɔ nakai gbi lɛ yɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ ji hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ tawulɔi kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni.
47 Shi hii ohai ekpaa pɛ tse yɛ ta lɛ naa, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛtee Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he. Amɛhi jɛi nyɔji ejwɛ. 48Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛwo Benyaminbii krokomɛi lɛ. Amɛkɛ klante gbegbee Benyaminbii lɛ; amɛgbe gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli kɛ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baje amɛgbɛ nɔ. Asaŋ maji fɛɛ ni amɛyanina lɛ, amɛmamɔ fɛɛ naa la.

Title: KOJOLƆI 21
Content:
Ŋamɛi ni Benyamin akutso lɛ na
1 Agbɛnɛ Israel hii lɛ ekãmɔ kitãi yɛ Mizpa akɛ, “Wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ebiyoo akahã Benyaminnyo gbãlã.” 2 No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel. Amɛhi shi yɛ jɛi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Amɛfo waa kɛ dɔlɛ 3amɛkɛɛ: “Ao Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba enɛ ba yɛ Israel akɛ ŋmɛnɛ akutso kome elaaje yɛ Israel?”
4Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ te shi maŋkɛ mra, ni amɛma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi. Amɛshã shãa afɔlei kɛ hejɔlɛ afɔlei. 5 Israelbii lɛ bi akɛ, “Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ, te akutso ni fataaa Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he kɛbaaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ amɛkã kitã wulu akɛ mɔ ni baaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa lɛ, ‘Gbe agbe lɛ.’ ” 6Benyaminhii lɛ anii fee amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ mɔbɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ atse akutso kome yɛ Israel he ashɛ afɔ̃. 7 Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ hu ni wɔna ŋamɛi wɔhã mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, akɛni wɔkã Yehowa kitã akɛ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei haŋ Benyaminbii gbãlã nɛɛ?”
8Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Te Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni lɛ lɛ ebɛ mli ni atee Yehowa ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa lɛ?” Ana akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko jɛɛɛ Yabesh ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ baaa nsra lɛ mli kɛ kpee wulu lɛ. 9Ejaakɛ be ni akane maŋ lɛ, ana akɛ Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ folo bɛ jɛi. 10No hewɔ lɛ, kpee lɛ tsu hii ni feɔ ekãa fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni amɛfã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbea Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ kɛ klante, yei kɛ hii fɛɛ hu. 11 Bɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Hii fɛɛ kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni le nuu lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ butubutu.” 12Mɛi ni atsu lɛ yana oblayei froi ohai ejwɛ yɛ Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ ateŋ ni leko nuu, ni amɛkɛ oblayei nɛɛ ba nsra lɛ mli yɛ Shilo ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
13 Kɛkɛ ni kpee muu lɛ fɛɛ tsu akɛ wiemɔ yahã Benyaminbii ni yɔɔ Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he lɛ akɛ akɛ amɛ ekpãtã. 14Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba nakai be lɛ mli, ni akɛ yei ni ahere amɛyiwala yɛ Yabesh-Gilead yei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hã amɛ gbãlã; shi no tete lɛ eshɛɛɛ amɛ.
15Benyaminbii lɛ anii fee maŋ lɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã mligbalamɔ eba Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ. 16No hewɔ lɛ, kpee lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛɛ, “Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ wɔna ŋamɛi wɔhã mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, akɛni akpãtã Benyamin yei lɛ ahiɛ nɛɛ?” 17Amɛkɛɛ, “Esa akɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko ahi shi ahã Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni yi na wala lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akutso ko seshi akabule yɛ Israel. 18 Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei lɛ ahã amɛ gbãlã, ejaakɛ Israelbii ekã kitã akɛ, ‘Alomɔ mɔ ni aaaŋɔ yoo ko ahã gbãlã yɛ Benyamin.’ ”
19No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ: “Daa afi lɛ ayeɔ Yehowa gbijurɔ yɛ Shilo. Shilo kã Betel kooyigbɛ kɛ Lebona wuoyigbɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni kã kɛjɛ Betel kɛyaa Shekem lɛ bokãgbɛ.” 20Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã Benyaminbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyatea yɛ waintromi lɛ amli. 21Kɛji Shilo oblayei lɛ je kpo ba amɛbajo lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛfãa kpo kɛjɛa waintromi lɛ amli kɛbaa koni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abamɔ eŋã yɛ Shilo oblayei lɛ ateŋ, koni nyɛkɛ amɛ aya Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 22Ni kɛji amɛtsɛmɛi loo amɛnyɛmimɛi ba nyɛŋɔɔ amɛkɛ nyɛ babe lɛ, nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkwɛa wɔhewɔ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ ahãa wɔ; ejaakɛ jeee ta mli wɔshɔ̃ amɛ yɛ, yɛ nyɛdɛŋ koni wɔkɛ amɛ afee wɔŋamɛi; ni asaŋ jeee nyɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ hã wɔ ni eeeba lɛ akɛ nyɛaatere wɔyi sɔ̃ ko.’ ”
23Benyaminbii lɛ fee nakai. Amɛmɔmɔ ŋamɛi yɛ amɛyikulɛ naa yɛ mɛi ni bajo lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ kɛtee. Kɛkɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ. Amɛsaa maji lɛ amɛmamɔ, ni amɛhi mli. 24Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hu shi jɛi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ku esɛɛ kɛtee ekutso kɛ eweku mli, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
25 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ ko bɛ Israel; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni ja yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.

Title: RUT WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Rut wolo ni gbaa wɔ hejɔlɛ be mli sane lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Hiɛnyiɛlɔi aloo Kojolɔi lɛ abe mli. Be nɛɛ mli eyi obɔ kɛ haomɔ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Rut ni ji Moabyoo lɛ kɛ Israelnyo ko hi shi. Be ni Rut wu lɛ gbo lɛ ejie suɔmɔ kple ko kpo etsɔɔ eshaayoo Naomi. Ni eŋɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ etsui fɛɛ. Naagbee lɛ ena wu yɛ ewu ni gbo lɛ wekumɛi ateŋ. Ni kɛtsɔ nɛkɛ gbala nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, Rut tsɔ Israelbii amaŋtsɛ kpanaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ David lɛ nanakansowa.
Kojolɔi Awolo lɛ mli saji lɛ gbaa wɔ jaramɔ ni baa kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii kwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Rut wolo lɛ tsɔɔ wɔ jɔɔmɔi ni Moabyoo ni ji gbɔ yɛ Israel lɛ na kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ. Ene ha etsɔ heyelɔi lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ Israel.
Mlijaramɔi
Naomi ku esɛɛ kɛba Betlehem ni Rut fata ehe 1.1-22
Rut kɛ Boaz kpe 2.1—3.18
Boaz kpee Rut 4.1-22

Title: RUT 1
Content:
Elimelek kɛ eŋa kɛ bii tee Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ
1Be ko, be ni Israelbii nako ana maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, hɔmɔ ko ba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Hɔmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ nuu ko fã kɛjɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda, ni eyiŋ etee eyato gbɔ yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebihii enyɔ. 2Nuu lɛ gbɛi ji Elimelek, eŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Naomi, ni ebihii lɛ hu agbɛii ji Malon kɛ Kilion. Amɛjɛ Efrata akutso lɛŋ. 3Naomi wu, Elimelek, gbo ni ebashwɛ Naomi kɛ ebihii enyɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi. 4Bihii nɛɛ ŋɔ Moabyei. Yei nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbɛi ji Orpa, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Rut. Amɛhi jɛi aaafee afii nyɔŋma. 5Fee sɛɛ lɛ Malon kɛ Kilion hu gboi, ni ebashwɛ yoo okulafo lɛ kɛkɛ; ebɛ wu lɛ, ebɛ bii hu.
Naomi ku esɛɛ kɛtee Betlehem
6-7Naomi nu yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ Yehowa ebaduro emaŋ Israel niyenii. No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ eshaayei lɛ yiŋ kɛmiiku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya Yuda. 8Be ni amɛyaa lɛ, Naomi kɛɛ eshaayei enyɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa; nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya enyɛ we. Yehowa afee nyɛ ejurɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee mi kɛ gbohii lɛ ejurɔ lɛ. 9Ehã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana he ko eta yɛ ewu we.” Ni eshwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa, ni ekɛ amɛye shɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛjwa yaafo. 10Ni amɛkɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Dabi, shi wɔkɛ bo aaatee omaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ moŋ.”
11Shi Naomi kɛɛ, “Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ, mibii! Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ mi aaatee? Ani bihii yɛ mimusuŋ lolo ni amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ nyɛwumɛi? 12Mibii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa, ejaakɛ migbɔ tsɔ̃ bɔ ni mikɛ nuu aaayahi shi. Ni kɛji mikɛɛ miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ tete, ni maya nuu ko ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ koni mafɔ bihii tete lɛ, 13 aso no hewɔ ni nyɛaamɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaadara? Aloo no hewɔ ni nyɛaatsi nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛkɛ nuu ehiŋ shi? Dabi, mibii! Shi nyɛsane miidɔ mi naakpa; ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ.”
14Kɛkɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛjwa yaafo ekoŋŋ. Ni Orpa shwɔ eshaayoo lɛ naa, ni eku esɛɛ; shi Rut lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekpɛtɛ Naomi lolo. 15Ni Naomi kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Naa, obienyɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ etee emaŋ kɛ esɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Kuu osɛɛ ni otiu lɛ.” 16 Shi Rut to he akɛ, “Kaahiɛ mi doo akɛ mishi bo, ni miku misɛɛ ni mifɔ̃ɔ osɛɛnyiɛmɔ! Shi he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ matee, ni he ni oooyahi lɛ jɛi mahi. Omaŋ aaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni oNyɔŋmɔ aaatsɔ mi hu miNyɔŋmɔ. 17He ni ooogbo yɛ lɛ jɛi magbo yɛ, ni he ni aaafũ bo yɛ lɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ aaafu mi yɛ. Yehowa kɛ mi aye ni ekɛ mi aye ekoŋŋ, kɛjeee gbele kɛkɛ aaagbala mi kɛ bo teŋ fĩi.”
18Agbɛnɛ be ni Naomi na akɛ Rut eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaatee lɛ, efɔ̃ɔ Rut kɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wieɔ lɛ he wiemɔ.
19No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛkɛshwie nɔ ekoŋŋ, kɛyashi amɛshɛ Betlehem. Be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ bu, ni yei lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Naomi kɛ̃ nɛ?”
20Shi ehere amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkatsɛa mi Naomi dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ nyɛtsɛa mi Mara, ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ tsɔ̃. 21Mitee obɔ̃, shi Yehowa kɛ mi eku sɛɛ kɛba efolo. Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtsɛɔ mi Naomi, mi ni Yehowa kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ, ni Ofe lɛ eshwishwia mi shi lɛ?”
22Bɔ ni Naomi ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba nɛ, lɛ kɛ eshaayoo Rut, Moabyoo lɛ. Ni be ni amɛba Betlehem lɛ abɔi akoko foo.

Title: RUT 2
Content:
Rut yaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ Boaz ŋmɔshi
1Shi Naomi wu Elimelek yɛ wekunyo niiatsɛ ko. Egbɛi ji Boaz. 2 Be ko lɛ Rut kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Hã maya ŋmɔji lɛ amli mayanyiɛ mɔ ni aaana mi mɔbɔ nikpalɔi lɛ asɛɛ koni maye akoko kpɛkpɛo.” Naomi kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oba oŋ, mibi.”
3Rut tee ni eyaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ mɛi ni foɔ akoko lɛ asɛɛ yɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli. Ni eba mli akɛ eyaje Boaz, Elimelek wekunyo lɛ, ŋmɔshi.
4Boaz jɛ Betlehem eba, ni ehã nikpalɔi lɛ aekoo ekɛɛ, “Yehowa kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!” Ni amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ bo!”
5Kɛkɛ ni Boaz bi etsulɔ ni ekɛto enikpalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ oblayoo nɛ?”
6Tsulɔ lɛ to he akɛ, “Moab oblayoo lɛ ni kɛ Naomi jɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba lɛ ni. 7Ebakɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, hã manyiɛ akoko kei lɛ ateŋ yɛ nikpalɔi lɛ asɛɛ maye kpɛkpɛo koni mabua naa.’ Ni kɛjɛ leebi tɔ̃ɔ ni eba lɛ, ejɔko ehe kwraa kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ.”
8Kɛkɛ ni Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Mibi yoo, oobo toi? Kaaya ni oyaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ mɔ kroko ŋmɔshi, ni asaŋ okaje biɛ nɛɛ hu; shi moŋ kpɛtɛmɔ miblayei lɛ ahe yɛ biɛ nɔŋŋ. 9Ohiɛ ahi ŋmɔ ni amɛfoɔ akoko lɛ yɛ mli lɛ nɔ koni onyiɛ amɛsɛɛ. Miwo miblahii lɛ kitã akɛ mɔ ko akagba onaa. Kɛ kumai miiye bo lɛ, yaa gbɛi lɛ ahe koni oyanu nu ni oblahii lɛ eyayɛ lɛ eko.”
10Kɛkɛ ni Rut ho ekula shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni omli ejɔ ehã mi, ni otseɔ ohiɛ ohãa mi, mi mɔkpɔŋ nɛɛ?”
11 Boaz to he ehã lɛ akɛ, “Nii ni ofee ohã oshaayoo lɛ yɛ owu gbele lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, agba mi fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ ni oshi otsɛ kɛ onyɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni afɔ bo yɛ nɔ lɛ, ni oyiŋ kɛba mɛi ni oleee oto sa aŋɔɔ. 12Yehowa ato bo nii ni otsu lɛ najiaŋ. Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ abo ni obaba nɛɛ ato bo najiaŋ shishiishi.”
13Kɛkɛ ni Rut kɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, omli jɔ hã mi, ejaakɛ oshɛje mimii, ni okɛ oweyoo ewie yɛ mlihilɛ naa, tsɛbelɛ mi kɛ oweyei lɛ ekoeko tete yeee hegbɔ.”
14Be ni shɛ niyeli be lɛ, Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Tsi oba biɛ koni obaye aboloo lɛ eko ni bo hu okɛ otrɔma lɛ atsɔ wain lɛ mli eko.” Ni Rut ba ebata nikpalɔi lɛ amasɛi; ni Boaz hã lɛ abelefɔ ni ashĩ lɛ eko, ni ekpe, ni etɔ, ni eshwɛ eko. 15Be ni Rut te shi eyaaye kpɛkpɛo lɛ, Boaz wo eblahii lɛ shi akɛ, “Nyɛhãa eyea kpɛkpɛo lɛ yɛ kei ni afĩmɔ lɛ ateŋ hu; nyɛkanyafia lɛ. 16 Asaŋ nyɛfamɔa akoko lɛ eko yɛ kei lɛ amli nyɛshwiea shi nyɛhãa lɛ koni eye lɛ kpɛkpɛo; ni nyɛkawiea ehiɛ.”
17Rut ye kpɛkpɛo yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi. Egbee kpɛkpɛo ni eye lɛ, ni ena yiteremɔ aaafee kiloi nyɔŋma tsiimɔ. 18Ewo kɛtee maŋ lɛŋ, ni ekɛ kpɛkpɛo ni eyaye lɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ eshaayoo lɛ. Rut jie niyenii ni eye etɔ ni shwɛ lɛ ehã eshaayoo lɛ. 19Kɛkɛ ni Naomi bi Rut akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyatsu nii yɛ? Namɔ ŋmɔshi otee oyaye kpɛkpɛo lɛ yɛ ŋmɛnɛ? Mɔ ni tse ehiɛ ehã bo lɛ, aaajɔɔ lɛ.” Rut gba eshaayoo lɛ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni eyatsu nii yɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuu ni miyatsu nii yɛ eŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ gbɛi ji Boaz.”
20Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, mɔ ni hãko emɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ.” Naomi tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuu lɛ wɔwekunyo ni; weku lɛ mli mɛi ni aaanyɛ akwɛ wɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji lɛ.”
21Kɛkɛ ni Rut, Moabyoo lɛ, kɛɛ, “Belɛ no hewɔ esaa ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kpɛtɛmɔ mipaafoi lɛ ahe kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaagbe minikpamɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ.’ ”
22Ni Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo Rut akɛ, “Ehi, mibi, akɛ okɛ Boaz oblayei lɛ anyiɛ koni akagba onaa yɛ mɔ kroko ŋmɔshi.”
23No hewɔ lɛ, Rut kpɛtɛ Boaz oblayei nitsulɔi lɛ ahe, ni eye kpɛkpɛo lɛ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe akoko kɛ ŋmãa fɛɛ kpamɔ naa.
Rut tee nɔ ekɛ eshaayoo lɛ hi shi.

Title: RUT 3
Content:
Naomi wo Rut ŋaa
1 Gbi ko lɛ Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo Rut akɛ, “Mibi, jeee ja mitao he ko mihã bo ota ni ahi ahã bo? 2Boaz mɔ ni okɛ eblayei lɛ yatsu nii lɛ, wɔwekunyo ni. Naa, eesha ekoko gbɛkɛnaashi nɛɛ yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ. 3No hewɔ lɛ, juu ohe, ni okpa mu, ni owo otade ni yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛya ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ. Shi moŋ kaahã nuu lɛ miiyoo bo kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeye nii, ni eeenu nɔ ko dã. 4Shi kɛ eyakã shi lɛ kadimɔ eshikamɔhe lɛ, ni oya oyakpa mama lɛ yɛ enane he, ni oho okã shi; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ofee.”
5Rut kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Nɔ ni okɛɛ mi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mafee.”
6Kɛkɛ ni Rut yiŋ etee ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ, ni eyafee bɔ ni eshaayoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 7Agbɛnɛ be ni Boaz eye nii, ni enu nɔ ko, ni emii eshɛ ehe lɛ, etee eyakã shi yɛ akoko ku lɛ sɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Rut dɛke shi, ni eyakpa mama lɛ yɛ Boaz nane he, ni eho ekã shi. 8Ni nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ Boaz hɛle shi, ni etsɔ̃ ehe, ni naa, yoo ko kã enajiaŋshi. 9 Ni Boaz bi akɛ, “Bo namɔŋ?” Ni Rut kɛɛ, “Mi oweyoo Rut ni. Ofainɛ, haa mi omama lɛ eko; ejaakɛ weku lɛ mli niyelɔ ji bo.”
10 Boaz here nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ bo, mibiyoo. Ejurɔ ni ofee sɛɛkpee nɛɛ fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ tete akɛ onyiɛɛɛ oblahii asɛɛ, niiatsɛmɛi jio, ohiafoi jio. 11Ni agbɛnɛ, mibiyoo, kaashe gbeyei. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛɔ lɛ mafee mahã bo, ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ le akɛ yoo kpakpa ji bo. 12Eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ owu lɛ wekunyo ni aaanyɛ aŋɔ bo ji mi moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ niyelɔ lɛ eko yɛ ni eyeɔ dani mi miyeɔ. 13Hii shi ni je atsɛre. Kɛji je tsɛre ni eeefee niyelɔ gbɛnaanii lɛ ehã bo lɛ, ehi; shi kɛji esumɔɔɔ akɛ efee lɛ, no lɛ gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã nɛɛ mafee. Kã shi ni je atsɛre.”
14Kɛkɛ ni Rut ho ekã Boaz najiashi kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ. Ni ete shi dani hiɛ gbele bɔ ni aaanyɛ mɔ ayoo. Shi Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Kaahã mɔ ko le akɛ yoo ko eba ŋmãagbeemɔhe nɛɛ.” 15Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Okɛ mama ni okɛha oyiteŋ lɛ aba, ni olɛɛ mii.” Rut kɛ mama lɛ ba, ni elɛɛ mli, ni Boaz ka akoko susumɔ tsenei ekpaa ni etsiimɔ aaafee kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ewo mli, ni ekɛtere Rut, ni ekɛtee maŋ lɛ mli. 16Be ni Rut yashɛ eshaayoo lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, eshaayoo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Te emli tamɔ tɛŋŋ, mibi?” Rut gba lɛ nɔ ni Boaz fee hã lɛ lɛ fɛɛ; asaŋ 17Rut kɛɛ akɛ, “Ehã mi akoko tsenei ekpaa nɛɛ ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ ni okɛ odɛ̃ folo yaa oshaayoo lɛ ŋɔɔ.’ ”
18Ni Naomi kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Mɛɛ mibi, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ooona bɔ ni sane lɛ naa aaayakpa; ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ejɔŋ ehe ja ena sane lɛ naa ŋmɛnɛ.”

Title: RUT 4
Content:
Boaz ŋɔ Rut
1Boaz tee maŋ agbo lɛ naa ni ji amɛkoishi lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ naa niyelɔ lɛ ni Boaz tsi etã lɛ miiho. Kɛkɛ ni Boaz tsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmi nuu, ofainɛ, baata shi fioo.” Ni eba ebata shi. 2Kɛkɛ ni Boaz tsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛbataraa shi fioo.” Amɛbatara shi. 3Ni Boaz kɛɛ niyelɔ lɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ kuku ni ji wɔnyɛmi Elimelek shikpɔŋ lɛ, Naomi ni jɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba lɛ miihɔ̃ɔ. 4 Hewɔ lɛ mikɛɛ mawo otoi nɔ koni ohe yɛ mɛi ni tara biɛ nɛɛ kɛ mimaŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ. Kɛ ooosumɔ ni oye mɔ ni egbo lɛ nii lɛ wiemɔ, ni kɛji osumɔɔɔ hu hã male; ejaakɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni eyeɔ nii lɛ fe bo; ni osɛɛ dani mi.”
Niyelɔ lɛ jie naa ekɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, masumɔ maye.”
5 Boaz kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbi nɔ ni oooŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Naomi dɛŋ lɛ, belɛ ooŋɔ Rut, Moabyoo lɛ, ni ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ ŋa lɛ hu oofata he nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ, koni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akagbo yɛ egboshinii lɛ he.”
6Kɛkɛ ni niyelɔ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Minyɛŋ maye nii lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛji miye lɛ tɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ baaba, mi diɛŋtsɛ migboshiniiyeli mli. Ŋɔɔ migbɛnaanii lɛ ohã ohe.”
7 Blema lɛ kɛji abaaye mɔ ko nii aloo aahɔ̃ɔ nɔ ko yɛ Israel lɛ, nɔ ni akɛmaa nɔ aduatsɔ nɛ: Mɔ ni ŋmɛɔ nii ahe lɛ aloo ehɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ jieɔ etokota ehãa mɔ ni ŋɔɔ nii lɛ. Enɛ akɛyeɔ nii ni ahɔ̃ɔ aloo ahe lɛ he odase yɛ Israel. 8No hewɔ lɛ, be ni niyelɔ lɛ kɛɛ Boaz akɛ eye nii lɛ, niyelɔ lɛ jie etokota ekɛhã Boaz. 9Kɛkɛ ni Boaz kɛɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “nyɛ ji midasefoi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ miŋɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Elimelek nɔ, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Kilion kɛ Malon nɔ lɛ yɛ Naomi dɛŋ. 10Asaŋ Rut, Moabyoo, ni ji Malon ŋa lɛ hu miiŋɔ lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ miŋa, koni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akagbo yɛ egboshinii he, ni egbɛi akalaaje yɛ enyɛmimɛi ateŋ kɛ emaŋ koishi hu, nyɛ ji odasefoi ŋmɛnɛ.”
11Ni maŋbii ni yɔɔ maŋ koi lɛ shi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔji odasefoi! Yehowa ahã yoo lɛ ni baa owe lɛ atamɔ Rahel kɛ Lea ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ mli Israel we lɛ jɛ lɛ. Otsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ agbo yɛ Efrata, ni ogbɛi ahehe yɛ Betlehem. 12Ni shwiei ni Yehowa aaahã oblayoo nɛɛ awo ahã bo lɛ, ahã owe lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ Tamar kɛ Yuda bi Perez we.”
Boaz shwiei
13 Boaz ŋɔ Rut ni etsɔ̃ eŋa; ni Boaz ta Rut he, ni Yehowa hã ena musu ni efɔ binuu. 14Ni maŋ lɛŋ yei lɛ kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa! Ejaakɛ ehã bo gboshiniiyelɔ kɛ nabi ŋmɛnɛ. Ehã gbɛkɛ lɛ gbɛi ahehe yɛ Israel. 15Gbekɛ nɛɛ, eeehã owala sɛɛ atsɛ, ni eeekwɛ bo yɛ ogbɔlɛ mli; ejaakɛ oshaayoo ni sumɔɔ bo, ni ehi hã bo fe bihii kpawo tete lɛ, ni fɔ lɛ.” 16Ni Naomi he abifao lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ, ni etsɔ̃ abifao lɛ kwɛlɔ.
17 Ni Naomi kuuŋyei lɛ nya amɛkɛɛ, “Afɔ binuu ahã Naomi eei!” Ni amɛwo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ Obed. Obed nɛɛ lɛ efɔ Ishai, ni Ishai hu fɔ Maŋtsɛ David.
18Agbɛnɛ Perez shwiei nɛ: Perez fɔ Hezron. 19 Hezron fɔ Ram; Ram fɔ Aminadab. 20 Aminadab fɔ Nahashon; Nahashon fɔ Salmon, ni 21Salmon fɔ Boaz; Boaz fɔ Obed. 22 Obed fɔ Ishai, ni Ishai fɔ Maŋtsɛ David.

Title: 1 SAMUEL WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Samuel Klɛŋklɛŋ Wolo lɛ mli saji lɛ kɔɔ Israel blema saji ni ba kɛjɛ Kojolɔi, ni ji maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, abe lɛ kɛyashi Israelbii bɔi maŋtsɛtoo. Tsakemɔ nɛɛ ni ba Israelbii amaŋnɔkwɛmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo mli nɛɛ kɔ mɛi etɛ̃ krɛdɛɛ komɛi ahe. Amɛ ji Samuel, maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi wuji lɛ anaagbee mɔ lɛ, kɛ Saul, Israel klɛŋklɛŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ David. Dani David baye maŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ Samuel kɛ Saul fɛɛ eshãrã aahu.
Wolo nɛɛ mli sane oti lɛ tamɔ Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli blema saji krokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ. No ji akɛ kɛji abo Nyɔŋmɔ toi lɛ shweremɔ kɛ shade baa, ni kɛji agbo Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ toi lɛ piŋmɔ nyiɛɔ sɛɛ. Yehowa fee enɛ faŋŋ ehã Osɔfo Eli be ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni buɔ mi lɛ mibawo amɛhiɛ nyam; shi mɛi ni ebuuu mi lɛ, abuŋ amɛ ahaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko” lɛ. (2.30)
Ejeɔ kpo faŋŋ hu yɛ saji lɛ amli akɛ mɛi ayiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ amɛ ekpakpa ko yɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni babla Israelbii ashihilɛ lɛ he. Israelbii ŋɔ Yehowa akɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ pɔ̃tɛɛ, shi akɛni Israelbii lɛ bi hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔ mɔ ko ehã amɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, sane oti lɛ ji akɛ Israelbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ni jio, maŋbii lɛ ni jio, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shishi. (2.7-10)
Yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlai anaa lɛ, esa akɛ abaa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ agbɛnai yi, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi fɛɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Samuel akɛ Israel maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔ 1.1—7.17
Saul too akɛ maŋtsɛ 8.1—10.27
Saul maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee 11.1—15.35
David kɛ Saul 16.1—30.31
Saul gbele kɛ ebihii lɛ ahe saji 31.1-13

Title: 1 SAMUEL 1
Content:
Elkana kɛ eweku yɛ Shilo
1Nuu ko hi shi yɛ Rama yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ. Egbɛi ji Elkana, ni etsɛ gbɛi ji Yeroham. Zuf bi Tohu bi Elihu bi ji Elkana nɛɛ. 2Elkana yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Hana, ni mɔ kome lɛ hu gbɛi ji Penina. Penina yɛ bii shi Hana bɛ bi. 3Daa afi lɛ Elkana yaa Shilo eyasɔleɔ ni eshãa afɔle ehãa Yehowa ni ji Taiatsɛ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, ni ji Hofni kɛ Finehas, miiye osɔfoi kɛha Yehowa yɛ Shilo. 4Gbi fɛɛ gbi ni Elkana baaya eyashã afɔle lɛ, ehãa eŋa Penina kɛ Penina bihii lɛ kɛ ebiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ loo kukuli. 5Shi Hana lɛ eyɛ mli akɛ Elkana sumɔɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi loo kukuli kome nɔŋŋ ehãa lɛ hu, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãko lɛ bi. 6Enɛ hãa Hana bienyɛ Penina kɛ fɔmɔ yeɔ Hana he fɛo, ni ekɛwoɔ emli la naakpa bɔ ni ehãa Hana gbigbliɔ emli akɛ Yehowa etsi efɔmɔ naa. 7Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni nibii tee nɔ daa afi. Shii abɔ fɛɛ ni amɛyaa Yehowa we lɛ, ebienyɛ Penina yeɔ ehe fɛo. Kɛkɛ lɛ efeɔ Hana yaafo, ni eyeee nii. 8Kɛfee nakai lɛ ewu Elkana kɛɔ Hana akɛ, “Hana, mɛɛba ni ofoɔ ni asaŋ oyeee nii? Mɛɛba ni oyeɔ otsui? Mihiii hãaa bo fe musuŋ bihii nyɔŋma?”
Hana kɛ Eli
9-10Be ko be ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nɔ ko yɛ Shilo sɛɛ lɛ, Hana te shi ni ewerɛ eho ehe naakpa. Ni efo waa be ni esɔleɔ etsɛɔ Yehowa lɛ. Nakai beiaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ Osɔfo Eli ta sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinaatso lɛ masɛi.
11Hana wo shi ekɛɛ, “Yehowa Taiatsɛ, kɛji oookwɛ mi, oweyoo, mimanehulu nɛɛ, ni oookai mi, ni ohiɛ kpaŋ mi, oweyoo, nɔ shi moŋ ooohã mi, oweyoo, binuu lɛ, no lɛ majɔɔ enɔ mahã bo, Yehowa, ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ; ni asooyi naa esaŋ eyiteŋ.”
12Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Hana hiɛ sɔlemɔ lɛ aahu yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, Eli kwɛ enaabu. 13Shi Hana miiwie yɛ etsui mli. Anuuu egbee akɛ fe enaabu kɛkɛ ni tsɔmɔɔ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Eli susu akɛ dãa Hana etɔ. 14Ni Eli kɛɛ Hana akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni oootɔ dãa kɛyashi? Hã ni owain lɛ atserɛ yɛ ohiɛ.” 15 Shi Hana here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Dabida, minuŋtsɔ, mi ji yoo ko ni miwerɛ eho mihe naakpa. Minuko wain loo dãa ko ni wa; shi moŋ miifɔse mitsui mli awerɛho sane mashwie Yehowa hiɛ. 16Kaabu mi, oweyoo akɛ yoo yakagbɔmɔ ko shi mikɔmɔ kɛ mlila ni awoɔ sɔŋŋ naa miwieɔ yɛ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ nɛɛ.”
17Eli to he hã Hana ekɛɛ, “Omanye abla bo, ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ahã bo nii ni obi lɛ lɛ.”
18Hana kɛɛ Eli akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ohã misane nɛɛ akã otsui nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Hana yiŋ etee, ni agbɛnɛ eyatao nɔ ko eye, ni ehiɛ efeee tɔtɔɔtɔ dɔŋŋ.
Samuel fɔmɔ kɛ enɔjɔɔmɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ
19 Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Elkana kɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa, be ni amɛtee amɛyaja Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Rama. Elkana kɛ eŋa Hana yawɔ, ni Yehowa mɔbɔnalɛ naa lɛ, 20be ni shɛɔ afi naakplɔ lɛ Hana ena musu, ni efɔ binuu. Hana wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ Samuel, ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ miba lɛ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.”
21Be ni afi shɛ lɛ, Elkana kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii lɛ tee koni amɛyashã daa afi naakplɔ afɔle yɛ shi krɛdɛɛ ni ewo lɛ hewɔ. 22Shi Hana eyaaa eko ejaakɛ ekɛɛ ewu Elkana akɛ, “Mamɛ kɛyashi matse gbekɛ lɛ fufɔ dani mikɛ lɛ ayapue yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni ehi jɛi kwraa.”
23Elkana to he ekɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ; feemɔ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ. Hii shi kɛyashi oootse abifao lɛ fufɔ. Yehowa ahã eshiwoo lɛ aba mli kɛkɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Hana hi shi, ni ekwɛ abifao lɛ kɛyashi etse lɛ fufɔ lɛ.
24Be ni Hana tse gbekɛ lɛ fufɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ tee Yehowa we lɛ yɛ Shilo, ni ehiɛ edɛŋ tsinanuu ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ ŋmaa mamu kiloi nyɔŋma kɛ wain tɔ kome. Nakai be mli tete lɛ Samuel edako. 25Agbe tsinanuu lɛ, ni akɛ gbekɛnuu fioo lɛ ba Eli ŋɔɔ, 26ni Hana kɛɛ Eli akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ookai mi. Mi ji yoo lɛ ni badamɔ omasɛi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ nyɛsɛɛ ko, ni ebakpa Yehowa fai ni eba lɛ nii lɛ. 27Gbekɛ nɛɛ he fai mibakpa lɛ, ni Yehowa ehã mi nɔ ni mibaba lɛ lɛ hu. 28 No hewɔ lɛ, miijɔɔ enɔ kwraa miihã Yehowa. Mikɛ lɛ miike Yehowa ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛja Yehowa yɛ jɛi.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 2
Content:
Hana sɔle
1 Kɛkɛ ni Hana sɔle yɛ jɛi ni ekɛɛ
“Yehowa, ohã mimli efili mi,
ni minyɛ mihiɛ nɔ miwo.
Mibaŋmɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ,
ejaakɛ ohere mi.
2“Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko bɛ tamɔ bo, Yehowa,
osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ;
Mɔ ko bɛ hewalɛ tamɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
3Nyɛkawiea kɛ henɔwomɔ nɛkɛ dɔŋŋ;
nyɛkawiea kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ,
ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nilelɔ ni,
ni lɛ ekojoɔ adesai anifeemɔnii.
4Kãkãlɔi lɛ agãitsei lɛ ekumɔ,
ni mɛi ni he waaa lɛ ena hewalɛ.
5Mɛi ni kulɛ amɛyeɔ nii amɛtɔrɔɔ lɛ,
amɛmiiye apaa yɛ daaŋ ŋmãa hewɔ,
ni mɛi ni kulɛ amɛwɔɔ hɔmɔ lɛ,
amɛwɔɔɔ hɔmɔ dɔŋŋ.
Naa, kene lɛ efɔ kpawo,
ni biianyɛ lɛ moŋ etsɔ̃ mɔ kome mɔ.
6 Yehowa ni gbeɔ mɔ, ni etsiɛɔ mɔ hiɛ hu;
ehãa ayaa gbohiiaje,
ni ehãa akpaleɔ abaa ekoŋŋ.
7 Yehowa ni hãa ayeɔ ohia,
ni ehãa anaa nii hu;
Lɛ ebaa mɔ shi,
asaŋ lɛ ewoɔ mɔ nɔ hu.
8 Eteɔ ohiafo shi kɛjɛɔ mlu mli,
ni ewoɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ nɔ yɛ tumo nɔ,
koni amɛ kɛ abladei atara shi,
ni amɛna sɛii ni yɔɔ nyam anɔ amɛtara,
ejaakɛ je lɛ shishitoo lɛ enɔ ni,
ni lɛ etswa je lɛ ema nɔ.
9 Eeebaa enɔkwafoi lɛ ayi,
shi mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ duŋ mli,
ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hewalɛ naa
eyeɔ kunim yɛ.
10 Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ,
aaakumɔ amɛ dukuduku ashwie shi;
eeehã ŋwɛi ashimɔ awo amɛ;
Yehowa ji je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ;
ebaahã emaŋtsɛ lɛ ana hewalɛ,
ni emɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ
eeehã eye kunim.”
11Kɛkɛ ni Elkana ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ yɛ Rama, ni eshi gbekɛnuu fioo, Samuel, lɛ koni esɔmɔ Yehowa yɛ Osɔfo Eli shishi.
Osɔfo Eli bihii lɛ
12Osɔfo Eli bihii lɛ yafee amɛhe yakagbɔmɛi, ni amɛbuu Yehowa, 13 loo osɔfoi lɛ agbɛnaanii ni sa akɛ amɛhe yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ. Nɔ ni afeɔ ji akɛ kɛji mɔ ko ba afɔleshãa lɛ, osɔfo lɛ tsulɔ baa, be mli ni ahoɔ loo lɛ, ni ehiɛ faka kɛ enyanyɔji etɛ̃. 14Tsulɔ lɛ kɛ faka lɛ tsuɔ loo ni ahoɔ lɛ yɛ tsɛnsi loo dadesɛŋ loo kukwɛi lɛ mli, ni loo fɛɛ loo ni faka lɛ baatsu kɛje kpo lɛ osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Nɛkɛ afeɔ Israelbii fɛɛ ni yaa afɔleshãa yɛ Shilo lɛ. 15 Shi agbɛnɛ be mli ni anako ashã loo lɛ mli fɔ lɛ tete lɛ, osɔfo lɛ tsulɔ lɛ baa ni ebakɛɔ mɔ ni shãa afɔle lɛ akɛ, “Jiemɔ loo ohã ni ayashã ahã osɔfo lɛ ejaakɛ esumɔɔɔ loo ni ahoo lɛ, eetao loo lɛ eŋmɔŋ.”
16Kɛji mɔ ni shãa afɔle lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ koni ashã fɔ lɛ dã; no sɛɛ koni ojie loo lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ” lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ toɔ he akɛ, “Dabida, jiemɔ loo lɛ ohã nɔŋŋ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ majie loo lɛ ekãa naa.”
17No hewɔ lɛ, Eli bihii lɛ anɔsha lɛ da yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ eyasɔɔɔ nii ni akɛshãa afɔle ahãa Yehowa lɛ.
Samuel yɛ Shilo
18Samuel sɔmɔɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Ewoɔ tsitsinɔhaanii ni akɛ klala kpɛ, ni efiɔ emliteŋ. 19Enyɛ kpɛɔ atade yuu pɛmpɛoo ko, ni ekɛbahãa Samuel koni ewo kɛji ekɛ ewu ba daa afi afɔleshãa lɛ. 20Kɛji amɛba lɛ, Eli jɔɔ Elkana kɛ eŋa lɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ahã yoo nɛɛ awo shwiei ahã bo yɛ ebi nɛɛ ni ejɔɔ enɔ ehã Yehowa hewɔ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛmaŋ.
21 Yehowa jɔɔ Hana, ni efɔ Samuel sɛɛ bihii etɛ̃ kɛ biyei enyɔ hu. Ni oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ bada yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Eli kɛ ebihii lɛ
22 Eli egbɔ naakpa; ni ababɔɔ lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ebihii lɛ feɔ Israelbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni amɛkɛ yei ni batsuɔ nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ wɔɔ. 23No ni Eli kɛɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni nyɛyeɔ nɛkɛ saji? Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miiwie nibii gbohii ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ ahe, ni miinu. 24Nyɛkafea nakai kɔkɔɔkɔ, mibii. Saji ni minuɔ yɛ Yehowa webii anaa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ, ehiii. 25Kɛji gbɔmɔ fee enyɛmi gbɔmɔ esha lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni kojoɔ lɛ; shi kɛji gbɔmɔ fee esha eshi Yehowa lɛ, namɔ po ni aaakpa fai ahã lɛ?”
Shi oblahii lɛ eyabooo amɛtsɛ, Eli, toi ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ ebaagbe amɛ.
26Oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ bada ni esane sa gbɔmɛi kɛ Yehowa fɛɛ hiɛ.
Agba ashi Eli weku
27Gbalɔ ko ba Eli ŋɔɔ be ko ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Mijie mihe mitsɔ̃ɔ otsɛ we lɛ be mli ni amɛyɔɔ Ijipt akɛ Farao nyɔji lɛ. 28 Ni miŋɔ otsɛ we lɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni eye osɔfo ehã mi, ni esɔmɔ mi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa, ni eshã tsofakɛŋma ehã mi, ni ewo efod lɛ kɛsɔmɔ mi. Ni no hewɔ lɛ, miŋɔ afɔlei fɛɛ ni akɛ la shãa mihã lɛ. 29 Mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ mi hu migbɛfaŋnii ni yɔɔ gbee afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ amli lɛ anɔ, be mli ni miwo nyɛ he kitã; ni obuɔ obihii lɛ moŋ fe mi, ni nyɛkɛ mimaŋbii lɛ afɔle fɛɛ afɔle mli nii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ lɛɔ nyɛ moŋ nyɛhe lɛ? 30 No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛɛ akɛ owe lɛ kɛ otsɛmɛi awe lɛ ni baasɔ̃mɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi kɛya naanɔ, shi agbɛnɛ miigbala nakai shiwoo lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni buɔ mi lɛ, mawo amɛhiɛ nyam: shi mɛi ni ebuuu mi lɛ, abuŋ amɛ ahaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko. 31 Naa, be lɛ miiba, ni mibagbe owe lɛ kɛ otsɛmɛiawe lɛ mli bii fɛɛ yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ koni akana nuumo yɛ oweku mli. 32Ni okɛ hejaramɔ baana shweremɔ ni abaahã Israel ashwere lɛ: shi owe lɛ nuumo ehiŋ mli kɛaatee naanɔ. 33 Ni owekunyo ni mahã ashwɛ ni esɔmɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa lɛ tete, ehiŋmɛii baajwara, ni ebaaye awerɛho kɛteke nɔ; ni shwiei fɛɛ ni abaawo yɛ owe lɛ baagbo akranaŋ naa gbele. 34 Nɔ ni baaba obihii enyɔ lɛ, Hofni kɛ Finehas, nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ okadi ahã bo. No ji akɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaagboi gbi kome. 35Matee osɔfo anɔkwafo ko shi mahã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, mɔ ni baafee miyiŋtoo kɛ mitsuinaanii, ni mahã ewo shwiei ni shishi etaŋ, mɛi ni baasɔ̃mɔ yɛ mɔ ni mifɔ lɛ mu lɛ hiɛ daa. 36Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mahã ashwɛ yɛ owe lɛ aaaba abakoto gbɔmɔ nɛɛ koni ebaba edɛŋ jwiɛtɛi loo aboloo akwaabɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Miikpa bo fai ni ohã mi osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eko matsu bɔ ni afee ni mana midaaŋ ŋmaa kɛkɛ.’ ”

Title: 1 SAMUEL 3
Content:
Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Samuel
1 Oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ sɔmɔɔ Yehowa yɛ Eli shishi. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ daaŋwiemɔ he efɔɔɔ kaa; asaŋ afɔɔɔ ninaa hu namɔ. 2Gbi ko lɛ Eli kã shi yɛ ewɔɔhe lɛ; no mli lɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ ebɔ̃i haa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, enaaa nii jogbaŋŋ; 3ni Yehowa kane lɛ ma nɔ lolo ni enako egbo, ni Samuel hu kã shi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli he ni Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. 4Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsɛ Samuel ekɛɛ, “Samuel! Samuel!” Ehere nɔ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, Naa mi!” 5Samuel sha foi kɛtee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi; minu akɛ ootsɛ mi.” Shi Eli kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Mitsɛko bo, mibi; kuu osɛɛ ni oyakã shi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Samuel tee ni eyakã shi.
6Yehowa saa tsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Samuel!” Samuel te shi ni etee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi; minu akɛ ootsɛ mi.” Eli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛko bo, mibi; kuu osɛɛ ni oyakã shi ekoŋŋ.” 7Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Samuel nako ale Yehowa ni asaŋ Yehowa kɛ lɛ ewieko dã.
8Yehowa saa etsɛ Samuel nɔ ni tĩa shii etɛ̃; ni Samuel te shi etee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi, minu akɛ ootsɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Eli bayoo sɛɛ agbɛnɛ akɛ Yehowa ni tsɛɔ oblanyo fioo lɛ lɛ. 9No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Yaakã shi; kɛji atsɛ bo ekoŋŋ lɛ, heremɔ nɔ akɛ, ‘Wiemɔ Yehowa, shi mi, otsulɔ, miibo bo toi!’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel tee eyakã shi yɛ ewɔɔhe lɛ.
10Yehowa ba ni ebadamɔ shi, ni etsɛ lɛ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ akɛ, “Samuel! Samuel!” Samuel here nɔ akɛ, “Wiemɔ, shi otsulɔ miibo toi.”
11Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Naa, mibafee nɔ titri ko yɛ Israel, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ he aajɔ̃ ehe. 12Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ mahã nibii fɛɛ ni miwie yɛ Eli we lɛ he lɛ aba mli kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyashi naagbee. 13 Mikɛɛ lɛ mito akɛ mibagbala ewe lɛ toi kɛya naanɔ yɛ nɔ sha ni ele lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ebihii lɛ bɔ musu amɛshi mi, Nyɔŋmɔ, shi etutuuu ehiɛ ewooo amɛ. 14No hewɔ lɛ, mikã Eli we lɛ he kitã akɛ kɛji akɛ gbee afɔle loo niyenii afɔle ko aaakpãta Eli we lɛ nɔ sha lɛ kɛyashi naanɔ fĩi.”
15Kɛkɛ ni Samuel ho ekã shi kɛyashi je tsɛre ni egbele Yehowa we lɛ shinai lɛ. Samuel she he gbeyei akɛ eeegba Eli ninaa lɛ. 16Shi Eli tsɛ Samuel ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mibi Samuel,” Ehere nɔ akɛ, “Naa mi.”
17Eli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni Yehowa kɛɛ bo lɛ? Kaashiu mi nɔ. Kɛji oshiu mi wiemɔi fɛɛ ni ekɛ bo wie lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baagbala otoi yɛ no hewɔ.” 18 Kɛkɛ ni Samuel gba Eli nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eshiuuu lɛ sane lɛ eko nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Eli to he ekɛɛ, “Lɛ ji Yehowa, nɔ ni hi yɛ lɛ ehiɛ lɛ efee!”
19Samuel bada, ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ, ni ehãaa Samuel naa wiemɔ ko afee yaka. 20No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ Dan aahu kɛyashwie Beersheba, na le akɛ Samuel lɛ Yehowa gbalɔ anɔkwafo ni. 21Yehowa kã he etsɔ̃ɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ejieɔ ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Samuel yɛ Shilo. Ni kɛji Samuel wie lɛ, Israel fɛɛ boɔ lɛ toi.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 4
Content:
Ashɔ̃ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ
1 Filistibii lɛ fã ta koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ ayawu. Israelbii lɛ yagba ta yɛ Ebenezer, ni Filistibii lɛ hu gba ta yɛ Afek. 2Filistibii lɛ gba wo Israelbii lɛ, ni be ni akɛ ta lɛ lɛɛ shi lɛ, Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni Israel tabilɔi aaafee akpei ejwɛ nyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. 3 Be ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛba amɛshitoohe lɛ, Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni Yehowa ŋmɛ gbɛ ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ wɔnɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛkɛ? Nyɛhãa ni wɔyaŋɔa Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Shilo kɛbaa biɛ koni ebahi wɔteŋ, koni ehere wɔyiwala yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.” 4 No hewɔ lɛ, atsu atee Shilo, ni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enɔ kerubim lɛ, ni ji Yehowa sɛ̃i lɛ, kɛba. Hofni kɛ Finehas, ni ji Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, fata he ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ba lɛ.
5Be ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bashɛ shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ bɔ oshe waa bɔ ni ehã shikpɔŋ hoso. 6Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu oshebɔɔ lɛ, amɛbi akɛ, “Mɛɛ oshe abɔɔ waa yɛ Hebribii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli nɛkɛ nɛɛ?” Be ni amɛbana amɛle akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ebashɛ Israelbii lɛ ata lɛ mli lɛ, 7Filistibii lɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Jemawɔŋ ko eba amɛta lɛ mli. Sane eye wɔ ei! Nɛkɛ nɔ ko bako dã. 8Sane eye wɔ! Namɔ po aaajie wɔ yɛ jemawɔji ni ahe yɔɔ gbeyei nɛɛ adɛŋ? Jemawɔji nɛɛ ni hã haomɔ ba Ijiptbii lɛ anɔ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. 9 Nyɛwajea nyɛhe, Filistibii, ni nyɛfea hii koni nyɛkatsɔmɔ Hebribii lɛ anyɔji tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛye amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ.”
10Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Filistibii lɛ wu ta lɛ ekãa naa, ni amɛye Israelbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni Israelbii lɛ jo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ kɛtee amɛbuui amli. Agbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ Israel tabilɔi aaafee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni nyiɛɔ amɛnane nɔ nyɔnyɔɔi. 11Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ashɔ̃, ni Hofni kɛ Finehas, Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, nyɔ.
Eli gbele
12Benyaminnyo ko jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛba Shilo nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ atade ni etserɛ kɛ eyiteŋ su. 13Nuu nɛɛ bashɛ shi be mli ni Eli ta sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa ni eesra, ejaakɛ etsui enyɔɔɔ emli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ. Nuu lɛ bote maŋ lɛŋ ni be ni ebabɔ amaniɛ ni ekɛjɛ ta lɛ naa lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ wo yara. 14Be ni Eli nu blɔmɔ hoo lɛ ebi akɛ, “Te blɔmɔ ni abolɔɔ hoo nɛɛ shishi hu?” Nuu lɛ sha ehe ni ebabɔ Eli amaniɛ lɛ. 15 No mli lɛ Eli eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni ehiŋmɛii anɔ eha, ni enaaa nii ekpakpa ko.
16Nuu lɛ kɛɛ Eli akɛ, “Mi ji mɔ ni jɛ ta lɛ naa ba lɛ, ni ŋmɛnɛ nɔŋŋ mijo foi yɛ ta lɛ naa.” Kɛkɛ ni Eli bi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Ni te emli tamɔ tɛŋŋ, mibi?”
17Bɔfo lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Israel ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, wɔmaŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ enyɔ. Obihii, Hofni kɛ Finehas hu enyɔ, ni asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ashɔ̃.” 18Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tã ni atsi nɛkɛ pɛ ni Eli kpa yɛ esɛi lɛ nɔ eyagbee esɛɛgbɛ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ he, ni ekuɛŋ wu kũ, ni egbo, ejaakɛ egbɔ ni egbɔmɔtso tsii. Nakai be mli lɛ Eli ekwɛ Israelbii anɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Finehas ŋa lɛ hu gbele
19Eli shaayoo, ni ji Finehas ŋa lɛ, hiɛ musu, ni eshɛ efɔmɔ be etã. Be ni yoo lɛ nu amaniɛ lɛ akɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni eshaanuu lɛ kɛ ewu lɛ fɛɛ hu egboi lɛ, fɔmɔ ta ehe amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni eho esɔ̃ shi ni efɔ. 20 Be ni yoofɔyoo lɛ heɔ egbo yɛ fɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, yei ni yɔɔ emasɛi ni amɛwaa lɛ kɛ fɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, shi ofɔ binuu.” Shi efooo mli, asaŋ ekɛ ejwɛŋmɔ efɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ. 21 Ewo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, “Ikabod,” ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Israel nyam etã,” hewɔ lɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee, ni asaŋ eshaanuu lɛ kɛ ewu lɛ fɛɛ egboi. 22Esaa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Israel nyam etã, ejaakɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.”

Title: 1 SAMUEL 5
Content:
Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ
