Etamɔ minyɛmi pɛ!” 33Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ eka amɛtoi kɛmiibo Ahab naa toi; no hewɔ lɛ, oya nɔŋŋ ni amɛtse naa akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ onyɛmi ji Ben-Hadad.” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa koni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa!” No hewɔ lɛ, Ben-Hadad je kpo kɛba Ahab ŋɔɔ. Ahab hã Ben-Hadad kwɔ etayaa shwiili lɛ. 34Kɛkɛ ni Ben-Hadad kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Maji ni mitsɛ shɔ̃ yɛ otsɛ dɛŋ lɛ mibadãi mahã bo. Obaanyɛ hu obafo jara yɛ Damasko ohã ohe, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɛ bafee yɛ Samaria lɛ.” Ahab dãi sɛɛ ekɛɛ, “Mi hu miidãmɔ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ nɔ miiŋmɛɛ ohe.” Amɛkpãŋ yɛ jɛi, kɛkɛ ni Ahab jie Ben-Hadad gbɛ.
Gbalɔ ko bu Ahab fɔ
35Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ, gbalɔi abii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ enaanyo gbalɔi abii lɛ nɔŋŋ eko akɛ, “Ofainɛ, tswaa mi nɔ!” Shi enaanyo lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni etswa lɛ nɔ. 36 No hewɔ lɛ, gbalɔ bi lɛ kɛɛ enaanyo lɛ akɛ, “Akɛni obooo Yehowa gbee toi hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni oooshi mi lɛ jata aaagbe bo.” Be ni enaanyo nɛɛ kɛ lɛ egbɛ mli ni eyaa lɛ jata ko yatua enaanyo lɛ, ni egbe lɛ.
37Gbalɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ na nuu kroko ko, ni ekɛɛ mɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, tswaa mi nɔ!” Mɔ lɛ tswa lɛ nɔ, ni epila lɛ. 38Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ tee, ni eyadamɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ eemɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab hoo mli. No mli lɛ gbalɔ lɛ kɛ yitsofii nɔ efĩ ehiɛsɛɛ ekɛtsake ehe. 39 Be ni Maŋtsɛ Ahab hoɔ lɛ, gbalɔ lɛ bo etsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Otsulɔ tee ta lɛ eko. Ta lɛ mli lɛ tabilɔ ko kɛ henyɛlɔ ko ni emɔ bahã mi shitoo, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Okɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ato. Kɛji ejo foi lɛ, no lɛ okɛ owala baatse, aloo obaawo eyi nyɔmɔ jwiɛtɛi talenta kome.’ 40Shi be ni otsulɔ hiɛ edɔ yɛ nibii krokomɛi ahe lɛ, nuu lɛ jo foi.”
Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛɛ akɛ, “Obu atɛŋ lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ. Ja ona owo shika lɛ.”
41Gbalɔ lɛ he fee oya nɔŋŋ ni ekpɔ yitsofii nɔ lɛ yɛ ehiɛsɛɛ. Jɛi ni Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ yoo lɛ akɛ gbalɔi lɛ eko ni. 42Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Akɛni oŋmɛɛ mɔ ni mijɔɔ enɔ mihã bo koni ogbe lɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, okɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe baatse yɛ enajiaŋ kɛ omaŋ lɛ hu yɛ emaŋ lɛ najiaŋ.’ ”
43Maŋtsɛ Ahab yiŋ etee ewe yɛ Samaria be mli ni efee gblinii, asaŋ ni ehao hu.

Title: 1 MAŊTSƐMƐI 21
Content:
Nabot waintrom lɛ
1Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ sane ko hu ni ba nɛ. Nuu ko ni egbɛi ji Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, yɛ waintrom yɛ Yezreel. Waintrom nɛɛ yɛ Samaria Maŋtsɛ Ahab mɔɔ lɛ masɛi kpaakpa. 2Gbi ko lɛ Ahab kɛɛ Nabot akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ owaintrom lɛ ohã mi koni mikɛfee ameo kɛ shitɔ kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ abɔɔ, ejaakɛ ebɛŋkɛ miwe nɛɛ; mikɛ waintrom ni hi fe onɔ lɛ baato bo najiaŋ, aloo kɛji ooosumɔ lɛ, mawo bo nyɔmɔ kɛji oootsɔ̃ɔ mi ejara.” 3Shi Nabot kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Yehowa akahã enɛ miigbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ maŋɔ mitsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ mahã bo.”
4Ahab ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ ni efee gblinii, ni emli ewo la yɛ wiemɔ ni Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, kɛ lɛ wie lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ. “Mikɛ mitsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ haŋ bo.” Eho ekã esaa nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbogbo, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ niyeli. 5Eŋa Yezebel ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni ofee gblinii nɛkɛ, ni oyee nii nɛɛ?”
6Ahab here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ mikɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, wie ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ŋɔɔ owaintrom lɛ ohã mi, ni mahe, aloo kɛji oosumɔ lɛ mikɛ waintrom kroko aaato bo no najiaŋ.’ Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, mikɛ miwaintrom lɛ hãaa bo.”
7Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Aso maŋtsɛ kɛ̃ oyeɔ yɛ Israel nɛɛ? Tee shi ni oye nii, ni ona tsui. Mi, mahã onine ashɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, waintrom lɛ nɔ.”
8Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel ŋma woji yɛ Ahab gbɛi mli, ni ekɛ Ahab wolonaasɔomɔnɔ lɛ sɔo woji lɛ anaa, kɛkɛ ni ekɛmaje Yezreel maŋ onukpai kɛ abladei ni kɛ Nabot yɔɔ jɛi lɛ. 9Eŋma yɛ woji lɛ amli akɛ, “Nyɛshiɛa akɛ ahĩ ŋmãa; no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛa maŋbii lɛ kpee, ni nyɛhãa Nabot ataa kpee lɛ yitso; 10 ni nyɛhãa hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ ataraa shi ni amɛmiikwɛ Nabot hiɛ, koni amɛye odase amɛshi lɛ akɛ, ‘Olomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ.’ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ akpala lɛ kɛje kpo koni ayatswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.”
11Yezreel maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛ abladei lɛ ye wiemɔ ni yɔɔ wolo ni Yezebel kɛmaje amɛ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 12Amɛshiɛ akɛ ahĩ ŋmãa, ni amɛhã Nabot yata kpee ni atsɛ lɛ yitso. 13Amɛhã hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ komɛi sɛ̃i, ni amɛmiikwɛ Nabot hiɛ. Hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ kɛ sane shi Nabot yɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ akɛ Nabot lomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kpala Nabot kɛshi maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ. 14Kɛkɛ ni atsu ayakɛɛ Yezebel akɛ, “Atswia Nabot tɛ agbe lɛ.”
15Shɛɛ lɛ ni shɛ Yezebel dɛŋ nɔŋŋ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Tee shi koni oyaŋɔ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, abɔɔ lɛ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ ekɛaahã bo ni ohe kɛ shika lɛ, ejaakɛ Nabot egbo.” 16Be ni Ahab nu akɛ Nabot egbo lɛ, oya nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni Ahab ŋɔ shwie nɔ kɛmiiya Yezreel koni eyaŋɔ abɔɔ lɛ.
Elia tsɔ̃ɔ fɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebu Ahab
17Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ, 18“Yaa koni okɛ Ahab, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Samaria lɛ ayakpe. Naa, eyɛ Nabot waintrom lɛ mli; etee akɛ eyaaŋɔ trom lɛ. 19 Kɛɛmɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ei Ahab, ogbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, koni oŋɔ enii lɛ okɛfee onɔ bɛɛ?’ Kɛɛmɔ lɛ ofata he akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: He ni gbei lɛmɔ Nabot lá yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ gbei aaalɛmɔ bo hu olá yɛ.’ ”
20Be ni Ahab na Elia lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ei mihenyɛlɔ, bo onine egbe mi nɛɛ.”
Elia here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Minine egbe bo lɛɛlɛŋ, ejaakɛ ohã efɔŋfeemɔ eŋɔ bo nom yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 21 No hewɔ lɛ, naa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ bo: ‘Mahã sane fɔŋ aye nyɛ, mibaplene bo kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni okɛyɔɔ weku yɛ Israel, nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ. 22Mafee owe lɛ tamɔ mifee Nebat bi Yeroboam we lɛ kɛ Ahia bi Baasha hu we lɛ, ejaakɛ ohã mimli efu, ni ohã Israel efee esha.’ 23 Ni yɛ Yezebel hu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ ‘Gbei baaye eloo yɛ Yezreel maŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.’ 24 Kɛji owekunyo ko gbo yɛ maŋ lɛ, gbei aaaye eloo, ni owekunyo ni aaayagbo yɛ ŋa nɔ lɛ, loofɔji aaaye eloo.”
25(Anɔkwa, mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni eŋɔ ehe ehã efɔŋfeemɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahab. Fɛɛ jɛ ehe ni eŋmɛɛ ehã eŋa Yezebel mɔ ni tsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛfee efɔŋ lɛ. 26Efee esha ni yɔɔ hiɛgbele kɛ ja ni eyaja amãgãi lɛ, tamɔ Amorbii ni Yehowa shwie yɛ Israelbii ahiɛ lɛ fee lɛ.)
27Be ni Ahab nu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, egbala etadei lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni ehi ŋmãa, ni ebuɔ kpekpe lɛ tete kɛwɔɔ, ni eyaa ni ebaa ni efee gblinii.
28Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ, 29 “Ona bɔ ni Ahab humiɔ shi yɛ mihiɛ agbɛnɛ? Akɛni eba ehe shi yɛ mihiɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihaŋ efɔŋ lɛ aba yɛ eyinɔ nɛɛ; ebi yinɔ moŋ ni mahã efɔŋ lɛ aba ewe lɛ nɔ yɛ.”

Title: 1 MAŊTSƐMƐI 22
Content:
Gbalɔ Mikaia bɔ Ahab kɔkɔ
(2 Kronika 18.2-27)
1Israel kɛ Siria hi shi afii etɛ̃ ni ta ko kwraa bɛ amɛteŋ. 2Shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat yiŋ etee eyasara Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab.
3 Ahab kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Bɛ nyɛle akɛ Ramot-Gilead lɛ wɔnɔ ni? Ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔtara shi, ni wɔfeee he eko koni wɔshɔ̃ yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ?” 4 Kɛkɛ ni Ahab bi Yehoshafat akɛ, “Bɛ okɛ mi aaatee koni wɔyatua Ramot-Gilead?” Yehoshafat kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Mi nɔŋŋ ji bo; mimaŋbii lɛ omaŋbii ni, mikpɔŋɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni.”
5Shi Yehoshafat kɛshi nɔ akɛ, “Shi, wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ wɔbi Yehowa daaŋ gbee dã.”
6No hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab bua gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛkpe, amɛyi aaafee ohai ejwɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Miya miyatua Ramot-Gilead lo, aloo mikaya?” Gbalɔi lɛ to he akɛ, “Yaa, ni Yehowa baatu maŋ lɛ ewo odɛ̃ŋ.”
7 Shi Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Ani Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ, koni wɔyabi nii yɛ eŋɔɔ?”
8Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Mɔ kome ko yɛ, ni kulɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔyabi Yehowa daaŋ gbee yɛ eŋɔɔ. Lɛ ji Imla bi Mikaia lɛ; shi moŋ misumɔɔɔ esane, ejaakɛ egbako gbalɛ kpakpa ko yɛ mihe dã, fe akɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ gbalɛ gbonyo.” Shi Yehoshafat kɛɛ akɛ, “Nii akakɛɛ nakai!”
9Kɛkɛ ni Ahab tsɛ piafonyo ko, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa koni okɛ Imla bi Mikaia lɛ ashɛ biɛ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ!”
10Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat ewula kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi atadei kɛtara amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ, yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe ni yɔɔ Samaria agbo lɛ naa kpataa lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ miigba yɛ amɛhiɛ. 11Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni ji Kenaana bi Zedekia lɛ fee dade akloŋtoi, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Enɛɛmɛi okɛbaashimɔ Siriabii lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni oookpãtã amɛhiɛ.’ ” 12Gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ miigba gbalɛ koome akɛ: “Yaa koni oyatua Ramot-Gilead, ni obaaye omanye, ejaakɛ Yehowa baatu maŋ lɛ ewo maŋtsɛ dɛŋ.”
Mikaia gba musu gbalɛ
(2 Kronika 18.12-27)
13Bɔfo ni tee Mikaia tsɛmɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ naabu kome egba gbalɛ kpakpa ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, hã ogbalɛ lɛ kɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome pɛ nɔ afee pɛ.”
14Shi Mikaia to he akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi lɛ, no mawie.”
15Be ni Mikaia shɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab hiɛ lɛ, Ahab bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat aya koni wɔyatua Ramot-Gilead, aloo wɔkaya?” Mikaia here nɔ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa; nyɛbaaye omanye. Yehowa baajɔɔ maŋ lɛ nɔ ahã nyɛ.”
16Shi Ahab kɛɛ Mikaia akɛ, “Shii enyiɛ po mahã okã mi kitã akɛ, kɛji okɛ mi miiwie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, okagba mi nɔ kroko fe anɔkwale lɛ kɛkɛ?”
17 Mikaia to he akɛ, “Miina Israel tabilɔi lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ toi ni bɛ kpalalɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hii nɛɛ bɛ nuŋtsɔ; hã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aku esɛɛ eya shĩa yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.’ ”
18Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ egbaŋ gbalɛ jurɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ yɛ mihe, fe efɔŋ pɛ?”
19 Mikaia tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ bo Yehowa naa wiemɔ toi! Mina Yehowa ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebɔfoi asafo lɛ fɛɛ damɔ emasɛi yɛ eninejurɔ nɔ kɛ ebɛku nɔ. 20Ni Yehowa bi akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaayalaka Ahab koni eya ni eyanyɔ yɛ Ramot-Gilead?’ ” Bɔfoi lɛ ekomɛi kɛɛ nɛkɛ, be mli ni mɛi komɛi hu miikɛɛ nɔ kroko. 21 Ahiɛ nakai aahu kɛyashi mumɔ ko je kpo kɛbadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ; ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi maya mayalaka lɛ.” 22Ni Yehowa bi lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ?” Mumɔ lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Maya, ni mibatsɔ̃ amale mumɔ yɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yaa koni oyalaka lɛ; onine baashɛ enɔ.”
23Ni Mikaia mu ewiemɔ lɛ naa nɛkɛ, “Enɛ ji nɔ ni eba lɛ. Yehowa ehã ogbalɔi nɛɛ egba amale gbalɛ amɛkɛlaka bo. Shi lɛ lɛ eto akɛ okɛ amanehulu baaya ayakpe!”
24Kɛkɛ ni Kenaana bi Zedekia, gbalɔ lɛ, tsi bɛŋkɛ Mikaia, ni egba Mikaia hiɛ mã, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ be nɛ ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ je minɔ, ni ekɛ bo bawie?”
25Mikaia to he akɛ, “Gbi ni obaajɛ pia kome mli kɛya pia kroko mli ni oootee ohe lɛ, gbi lɛ nɔ ooona ole.”
26Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahab fã etsulɔ ko ekɛɛ, “Mɔ Mikaia koni okɛ lɛ ayawo Amon maŋ lɛ amralo lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛbi Yoash dɛŋ.” 27Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Nyɛwoa lɛ tsuŋ, ni ahã lɛ aboloo fioo kɛ nu fioo pɛ daa gbi akɛ eniyenii kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maya mayaye omanye maba.’ ”
28Shi Mikaia kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji otee, ni oyaye omanye, ni oba fĩi, belɛ jeee Yehowa ni tsɔ̃ minɔ wie lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ toi.”
Ahab gbele
(2 Kronika 18.18-34)
29Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat fã kɛtee koni amɛyatua Ramot-Gilead. 30Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Mibatsake mihe kɛya ta lɛ naa; shi bo lɛ wulamɔ kɛ obladei atadei lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ahab tsake ehe kɛtee ta lɛ naa.
31Shi Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo etayaa shwiilii lɛ anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ kitã akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko, mɔ wulu ni jio, mɔ bibioo ni jio, akawua akɛ ja Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ.” 32No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Siria asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ na Yehoshafat lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ pi nɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛgba kɛtee koni amɛkɛ lɛ ayawu. Shi Yehoshafat bolɔ, kɛkɛ ni ayoo lɛ. 33Be ni shwiilii lɛ anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ na akɛ jeee Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni lɛ, amɛkpa esɛɛnyiɛmɔ. 34 Shi Siria asraafonyo ko gãi ni etsɛ̃ ni jeee gbɛ eje etsɛ̃ lɛ yatsu Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ trukaa, yɛ eŋwɛigbɛ dama lɛ kɛ shishigbɛ dama lɛ kpeehe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ eshwiili kudɔlɔ lɛ akɛ, “Dɔɔ oyi koni okɛ mi aje ta lɛ naa, shi mipila.”
35Ta lɛ mli wa pam nakai gbi lɛ; ni ahiɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ mli kɛdamɔ shi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli yɛ Siriabii ahiɛ; lá ni jɛ epilamɔ lɛ mli lɛ bua shwiili lɛ mli; egbo gbɛkɛnaashi mli. 36Hulushinyɔɔ mli lɛ, ashiɛ yɛ ta lɛ naa akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya eshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ emaŋ.”
37Belɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab nyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli, ni akɛ egbonyo lɛ ba Samaria, ni abafu lɛ yɛ jɛi. 38 Ayafɔ Ahab shwiili lɛ he yɛ Samaria kpaakpo lɛ naa, ni gbei yalɛmɔ Ahab lá lɛ, ni yei ajwamãŋi yaju amɛhe yɛ mli taakɛ Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
39Ahab he saji krokomɛi ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ shuɔ wu tsu ko ni ema kɛ maji fɛɛ ni eto lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 40Ahab gbele sɛɛ lɛ, ebi Ahazia baye esɛɛ akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat maŋtsɛyeli
(2 Kronika 20.31—21.1)
41Asa bi Yehoshafat bɔ̃i Yuda maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ. 42Yehoshafat eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm. Enyɛ ji Shilhi biyoo ni egbɛi ji Azuba lɛ. 43Yehoshafat ba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ tamɔ etsɛ Asa. Efee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, shi moŋ efiteee jemawɔji ajamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ tee nɔ amɛshã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋma yɛ hei nɛɛ. 44Yehoshafat kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kpãŋ, ni amɛhi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.
45Agbɛnɛ Yehoshafat he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ ekãa ni efee kɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ ewuwuu tai ehã lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 46Eshwie hii kɛ yei ajwamãŋbɔlɔi ni ashi yɛ etsɛ Asa yinɔ, yɛ jemawɔji afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ anaa lɛ fɛɛ kɛje jɛi.
47Be nɛɛ mli lɛ maŋtsɛ ko bɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amralo ko ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ najiaŋ yɔɔ jɛi.
48Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kpɛ Tarshishbii alɛlɛ henɔi komɛi koni akɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛya Ofir yɛ jɛi shika tsuru hewɔ; shi ayanyɛɛɛ akɛya, ejaakɛ lɛji lɛ jwara yɛ Ezion-Geber. 49 Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia, Ahab bi lɛ, kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Hã otsuji lɛ abashi mitsuji lɛ anɔ yɛ lɛji lɛ amli.” Shi Yehoshafat eyakpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ. 50Yehoshafat gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ eblematsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni ebi Yehoram baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia
51 Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahab bi Ahazia baye Israel maŋtsɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Samaria. 52Ekɔ etsɛ Ahab kɛ enyɛ Yezebel yitsoŋwalɛ jeŋba lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛ Nebat bi Yeroboam, mɔ ni hã Israel fee esha lɛ, hu jeŋba lɛ. 53 Esɔ̃mɔ, ni eja Baal, ni ewo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli la tamɔ etsɛ fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo ni ji Enyɔ lɛ, tsaa Israelbii amaŋtsɛyelii enyɔ lɛ ahe sane lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛɔ he ni Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo lɛ kɛ saji lɛ yawa lɛ. Aaanyɛ aja wolo lɛ mli enyɔ.
1. Israel maŋtsɛyelii enyɔ lɛ ahe saji, kɛjɛ afii ohai nɛɛhu Dani afɔ Kristo aahu kɛmɔ Samaria nomŋɔɔ lɛ, kɛyashi Israel Kooyi Jaku lɛ naagbee yɛ afi 722 Dani Afɔ Kristo.
2. Yuda Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kɛjɛ Israel Kooyi Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shigbeemɔ lɛ kɛmɔ be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baye Yerusalɛm nɔ, asaŋ ni ekpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ afi 586 Dani Afɔ Kristo mli lɛ.
Naagbee sane ni muɔ wolo lɛ naa ji Gedalia, mɔ ni Babilonbii to lɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amralo lɛ, he sane kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin heŋmɛɛmɔ akɛ gboklɛfonyo kɛje kpabuŋ yɛ Babilon.
Oshrãi nɛɛ bashrã Israel kɛ Yudabii lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ eyayeee Naa Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa. Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtãmɔ kɛ Yudabii babaoo nomŋɔɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ Yuda Jaku lɛ blema saji wuji lɛ ateŋ ekome.
Gbalɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ehe sane yɔɔ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo ni ji Enyɔ lɛ mli ji Elisha mɔ ni ye Gbalɔ Elia sɛɛ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Jaku ni mli egba lɛ 1.1—17.41
a. Gbalɔ Elisha 1.1—8.15
b. Yuda kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ 8.16—17.4
d. Samaria Butumɔ 17.5-41
Yuda Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ 18.1—25.30
a. Kɛjɛ Hezekia kɛyashi Yosia yinɔ 18.1—21.26
b. Yosia Maŋtsɛyeli 22.1—23.30
d. Yuda Naagbee Maŋtsɛmɛi 23.31—24.20
e. Yerusalɛm Butumɔ 25.1-30

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 1
Content:
Gbalɔ Elia kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahazia
1Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ tse Israel hiɛ atua.
2 Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia, jɛ eŋwɛi asa ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ samflɛ mli eyagbee shi, ni epila waa. No hewɔ lɛ, etsu bɔfoi koni amɛyabi Baal-Zebub, Filistibii anyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ Ekron lɛ nii akɛ, “Ani hela ni yeɔ mi nɛɛ, mana hewalɛ lo?” 3 Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ fã Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya koni okɛ Samaria maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ ayakpe, ni obi amɛ akɛ, ‘Aso Nyɔŋmɔ ko ni bɛ Israel hewɔ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ nɛɛ?’ 4No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.’ ”
No hewɔ lɛ, Elia yiŋ etee taakɛ Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. 5Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ?”
6Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nuu ko kɛ wɔ bakpe, ni ekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa maŋtsɛ ni tsu nyɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛyakɛa lɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, aso Nyɔŋmɔ ko ni bɛ Israel hewɔ ni otsuɔ koni ayabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ nɛɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.’ ”
7Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Nuu ni kɛ nyɛ bakpe ni ekɛ nyɛ wie nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, te esu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?”
8 Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔiatsɛ ni. Ewo atade wuyaa, ni ekɛ kooloo hewolo efi emliteŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ ni”.
9Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu asafoiatsɛ ni yeɔ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ anɔ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛtee koni amɛyaŋɔ Elia kɛba. Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ emɛi lɛ tee Elia ŋɔɔ; amɛyana lɛ ní eta shi yɛ gɔŋ ko yiteŋ. Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Maŋtsɛ kɛɛ okpeleke shi ni oba!”
10 Shi Elia kɛɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji mi lɛ, no lɛ, la ajɛ ŋwɛi ayi shi koni ebashã bo kɛ omɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni la jɛ ŋwɛi yi shi, ni ebashã lɛ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.
11 Maŋtsɛ lɛ saa etsu asafoiatsɛ kroko kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛtee Elia ŋɔɔ. Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kwɔ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyakɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Maŋtsɛ efã bo akɛ okpeleke shi ni oba nɔŋŋ.”
12Shi Elia hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji mi lɛ, no lɛ, la ajɛ ŋwɛi ayi shi, ni ebashã bo kɛ omɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni la jɛ ŋwɛi yi shi, ni ebashã lɛ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.
13Maŋtsɛ lɛ saa etsu asafoiatsɛ kroko hu kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ hu, nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ nɔ. Ni mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Etee eyakula shi yɛ enakutsei anaa yɛ Elia hiɛ, ni ekpa lɛ fai, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, miikpa bo fai, naa mi kɛ otsuji nɛɛ mɔbɔ. 14Naa, la ejɛ ŋwɛi ebayi shi, ni ebashã klɛŋklɛŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛmɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔi lɛ fɛɛ; shi agbɛnɛ, mi lɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ, hã misusuma jara awa yɛ ohiɛ.”
15Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Okɛ lɛ akpeleke shi kɛya, kaashe lɛ gbeyei!” Kɛkɛ ni Elia te shi, ni ekɛ lɛ tee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 16“Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Akɛ nɔ kɛ̃ ni otsu bɔfoi kɛtee koni amɛyabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ Israel ni aaabi edaaŋ gbee, hewɔ lɛ oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ, gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.’ ”
17No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ Ahazia gbo yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni Elia wie lɛ naa; ni akɛni Ahazia bɛ bi kwraa hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmi Yoram baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Yehoram ni ji Yehoshafat bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.
18Agbɛnɛ nibii fɛɛ ni maŋtsɛ Ahazia fee lɛ, aŋmã fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 2
Content:
Aŋɔ Elia kɛtee ŋwɛi
1Agbɛnɛ be bashɛ ní Yehowa baaŋɔ Elia kɛya ŋwɛi yɛ lasuogbele mli. Elia kɛ Elisha nyiɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ Gilgal; 2ni be ni amɛyaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Betel.”
Shi Elisha to he akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi mli kɛtee Betel.
3Gbalɔi aku ko ni yɔɔ Betel lɛ mli bii lɛ je kpo kɛba Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani ole akɛ ŋmɛnɛ Yehowa baaŋɔ onuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya?” Ni ehã amɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi hu mile; nyɛfea diŋŋ kɛkɛ!”
4Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Elisha, mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Yeriko.” Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiii bo!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛba Yeriko.
5Gbalɔi aku ko ni yɔɔ Yeriko lɛ mli bii lɛ ba Elisha ŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani ole akɛ ŋmɛnɛ Yehowa baaŋɔ onuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya?” Ni ehã amɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi hu mile, nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea diŋŋ kɛkɛ!”
6Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Yordan Faa lɛ naa.”
Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo.” Hewɔ lɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛyi mli kɛtee. 7Ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛtee lɛ, yadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, shi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛdamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ naa. 8 Kɛkɛ ni Elia jie etade yuu lɛ ni ekota, ni ekɛtswa nu lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ mli gba kɛtee biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛnyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo faa lɛ. 9 Be ni amɛfo faa lɛ kɛtee faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Bi mi nɔ ni osumɔɔ ni mafee mahã bo, dani aŋɔ mi kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya.”
Ni Elisha kɛɛ, “Hã mana omumɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ eko bɔ ni aaaha matsɔ mɔ ni baaye onajiaŋ.”
10Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Obi nɔ ko ni wa naakpa, shi kɛ̃lɛ kɛji oona mi ni aawo mi kɛmiije oŋɔɔ kɛya lɛ, no lɛ aaaba mli nakai ahã bo; shi kɛji onaaa mi lɛ, no lɛ onine shɛŋ nɔ.”
11 Be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa ni amɛwieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, la shwiili kɛ la okpɔŋɔi ba, ni amɛbagbala Elia kɛ Elisha teŋ. Ni Elia tsɔ̃ lasuogbele lɛ mli kɛtee ŋwɛi. 12 Elisha na nii nɛɛ, ni ebo etsɛ Elia akɛ, “Mitsɛ, mitsɛ! Israel hefãlɔ kpele! Ao, tee otee lɛ?” Ni enɛ sɛɛ lɛ enaaa Elia dɔŋŋ.
Ni emɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etade yuu lɛ mli ni etse mli enyɔ. 13Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ Elia atade lɛ ni je ehe egbee shi lɛ, ni eku esɛɛ, ni eyadamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ naa. 14Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ Elia atade ni je ehe egbee shi lɛ, ni ekɛtswa nu lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yehowa, Elia Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɔɔ?” Ni be ni ekɛ atade lɛ tswa nu lɛ mli lɛ, nu lɛ mli gba enyɔ, kɛtee biɛ kɛ biɛ. Ni Elisha tsɔ̃ mli kɛho.
15 Be ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni jɛ Yeriko lɛ ni damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Elia mumɔ lɛ ebayi Elisha nɔ.” Amɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni amɛkoto lɛ, 16ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ lɛ, naa wɔ otsuji hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ omasɛi, wɔmiikpa bo fai, hã wɔya ni wɔyatao onuŋtsɔ lɛ; eko lɛ aleee nɔ, Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ewo lɛ kɛtee, ni eyashɛ lɛ efɔ̃ gɔji lɛ eko nɔ aloo jɔi lɛ eko mli.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Dabida, nyɛkatsũa kɛyaa.”
17Shi be ni amɛhiɛ enaagbamɔ aahu ni efee lɛ ahuntoo lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsũa kɛyaa.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsũ hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛtee, ni amɛyatao lɛ gbii etɛ̃, shi amɛnaaa lɛ.
18Ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Elisha ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ Yeriko, he ni emɛɔ yɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛkaya lo?”
Elisha naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ
19Agbɛnɛ hii komɛi ní jɛ Yeriko maŋ lɛ mli tee Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, maŋ nɛɛ kãmɔhe lɛ hi moŋ nɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni, bo wɔnuŋtsɔ, onaa nɛɛ; shi nu lɛ ehiii, ni ehã asharãkeɔ bii, asaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ hãaa niyenii aba.”
20Ni efã mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ ŋoo awoa kã hee mli ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi.” Ni amɛkɛbahã lɛ. 21Ni etee nuhiŋmɛi lɛ he, ni eyatsi ŋoo lɛ ewo mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifee nu nɛɛ krɔŋŋ, ni ehaŋ gbele loo sharakemɔ aba dɔŋŋ.’ ” 22Ni nakai nu lɛ fee krɔŋŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, yɛ Elisha wiemɔ lɛ naa.
23Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Elisha jɛ Yeriko eeya Betel; ni be ni eyaa lɛ, gbekɛbii hii bibii komɛi jɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbaye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Yiteŋ kpataatsɛ, jee biɛ ní oya! Yiteŋ kpataatsɛ, jee biɛ ní oya!”
24Elisha tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ekwɛ amɛ, ni ekɛ Yehowa gbɛi lomɔ amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni oshishibrishi yei enyɔ jɛ koo lɛ mli ba, ni amɛbatserɛ gbekɛbii hii lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ mli.
25 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Elisha tee Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejɛ jɛi kɛtee Samaria.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 3
Content:
Israel kɛ Moab ta lɛ
1 Yuda maŋtsɛ, Yehoshafat maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahab bi Yehoram baye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. 2 Efee esha eshi Yehowa, shi kɛ̃lɛ etamɔɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ Yezebel nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, ekumɔ Baal amãgãi lɛ ni etsɛ fee lɛ eshwie shi. 3 Shi kɛ̃lɛ esha ni klɛŋklɛŋ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, fee lɛ, nakai esha lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ hu efee, ejaakɛ ehã Israel fee esha, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekpaleee.
4Moab maŋtsɛ Mesha lɛ lɛɔ toi, ni daa afi lɛ eyahãa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ too gwantɛŋ bii akpei oha kɛ too ojwɛnii akpei oha ahe tsɔi akɛ daa afi too ni ewoɔ ehãa lɛ. 5Shi be ni Israel maŋtsɛ Ahab gbo lɛ, Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ tse Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atua. 6No hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yehoram fã kɛjɛ Samaria ni eyabua etabilɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ naa. 7 Kɛkɛ ni etsu ayakɛɛ Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ etse mihiɛ atua; ani ooofata mihe ni mikɛ Moabbii lɛ ayawu lo?”
Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat hã hetoo akɛ, “Matee; mi nɔŋŋ ji bo, mimaŋ lɛ omaŋ ni, ni mikpɔŋɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni.” 8Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ wɔɔɔtsɔ̃ kɛtua amɛ lɛ?” Yehoram hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Wɔbaatsɔ̃ Edom ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.”
9Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ amɛtee. Amɛkpa shi gbii kpawo, ni anaaa nu ahã tabilɔi lɛ kɛ kooloi ni amɛkɛnyiɛ lɛ. 10Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ, koni etu wɔ ewo Moabbii adɛŋ!”
11 Shi Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Ani Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ ni wɔɔtee wɔyabi Yehowa nii yɛ eŋɔɔ?”
Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ ni fɔse nu shwie Elia niji anɔ lɛ, yɛ biɛ.”
12Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat kɛɛ akɛ “Yehowa gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat lɛ kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ tee Elisha ŋɔɔ.
13Ni Elisha kɛɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ? Yaa koni oyabi otsɛ gbalɔi kɛ onyɛ gbalɔi lɛ anii.” Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat here nɔ akɛ, “Dabida, ejaakɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ kɛbakpe koni etu wɔ ewo Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.”
14 Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa, tai aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ hiɛ kã nɛɛ, eji jeee Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛaŋ mihiɛ shwieɔ kulɛ, mikwɛŋ bo hiŋmɛileishi po, aahu ni makwɛ ohiɛ. 15Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛyaŋɔa saŋkutswalɔ ko nyɛbahãa mi”. Agbɛnɛ be ni saŋkutswalɔ lɛ tswaa esaŋku lɛ, Yehowa hewalɛ bayi Elisha nɔ; 16ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛtsaa bui yɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ mli fɛɛ. 17Nyɛnaŋ ahum, ni asaŋ nyɛnaŋ nunɛmɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ baayi tɔ kɛ nu, koni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ kɛ nyɛlɛɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ anu.’ ” 18Elisha tee nɔ akɛ, “Shi enɛ tete lɛ ejeee nɔ ko ni wa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; asaŋ ebaatu Moabbii lɛ hu ewo nyɛdɛŋ; 19ni nyɛaaye maŋ wulu fɛɛ maŋ wulu ni atswa gbogbo awo he, kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ fɛo nɔ, ni nyɛaatoo tso kpakpa fɛɛ tso kpakpa, ni nyɛaatsimɔ nubu fɛɛ nubu, ni nyɛkɛ tɛi aaafite amɛshikpɔŋ kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ.”
20Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi afɔle shãa be mli lɛ, naa nu jɛ Edom gbɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ nu.
21Be ni Moabbii lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ lɛ efã kɛmiiba ni amɛkɛ amɛ abawu lɛ, ayabua mɛi fɛɛ ni eshɛ tayaa, kɛjɛ oblahii anɔ kɛyashi onukpai anɔ, anaa kɛba, ni akɛ amɛ badamɔ husu lɛ nɔ. 22Ni be ni amɛte shi leebi maŋkpa, ni hulu miikpɛ yɛ nui lɛ anɔ lɛ, Moabbii lɛ na nu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛhiɛ lɛ akɛ eetsu faa tamɔ lá. 23Ni Moabbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Lá nɛ; maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ewuwui, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔyahaa amɛshitoohe lɛ mli nii.”
24Shi be ni Moabbii lɛ shɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ he lɛ, Israelbii lɛ te shi, ni amɛtua Moabbii lɛ, ni amɛtswia amɛ nii; ni Moabbii lɛ jo foi kɛje Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ bote Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛgbegbee Moabbii lɛ. 25 Kɛkɛ ni amɛbutu maji wuji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kpakpa fɛɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ lɛ, Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo shɛ etɛ efɔ̃ nɔ kɛyashi shikpɔji lɛ anɔ yi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ tɛ. Amɛtsimɔ nubui fɛɛ; ni amɛtoo tsei kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ. Naagbee lɛ, maŋ wulu ni ashi pɛ ji Kir-Heres; kɛkɛ ni akromiafɔ̃lɔi lɛ yabɔle maŋ lɛ ni amɛŋɔ.
26Be ni Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ na akɛ ta lɛ naa wa tsɔ̃ hã lɛ lɛ, eŋɔ hii ohai kpawo ni hiɛ klante efata ehe, koni amɛgba kɛtsɔ̃ henyɛlɔi lɛ ata lɛ mli kɛjo foi kɛya Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ.
27Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ ebi nuu ni ji ekromɔbi, ni kulɛ ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ shã shãa afɔle yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ, ehã Moabbii anyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Enɛ wo Israelbii lɛ ahe gbeyei ni amɛgbala amɛhe shi kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 4
Content:
Elisha ye ebua yoo ohiafo okulafo ko
1Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ŋa okulafo tee Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, naa, otsulɔ ni ji miwu lɛ egbo, ni ole akɛ esheɔ Yehowa gbeyei. Shi amrɔ nɛɛ mɔ ko ni miwu lɛ hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ ebamɔmɔ mibihii lɛ kɛtee eyafee amɛ enyɔji.”
2 Elisha bi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mifee mihã bo? Kɛɛmɔ mi. Mɛni oyɔɔ yɛ shĩa?” Yoo lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Otsulɔ yoo bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ shĩa, akɛ ja mu tɔ kometoo pɛ kɛkɛ.”
3Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa akutso lɛ mli bii fɛɛ aŋɔɔ ni oyamala gbɛi foji babaoo, bɔ ni ooonyɛ. 4Kɛkɛ lɛ yaa shĩa lɛ mli koni oŋa shinaa lɛ owo bo kɛ obii lɛ ayi; koni obɔ̃i mu lɛ fɔsemɔ kɛwo gbɛi lɛ fɛɛ amli; kɛji eko yi obɔ̃ lɛ, wo oma sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.”
5Kɛkɛ ni yoo okulafo lɛ shi gbalɔ Elisha, ni etee eyaŋa shinaa lɛ ewo ekɛ ebihii lɛ ayi. Ni be ni amɛholeɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛbaa lɛ, belɛ eefɔse mu lɛ eewowoo amɛmli. 6Be ni gbɛi lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛɛ ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Wo gbɛ kroko hu kɛba!” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbɛ lɛ eko bɛ dɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni mu lɛ sɛɛ fo. 7Yoo okulafo lɛ tee Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ ni eyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ. Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ mu lɛ koni okɛwo onyɔmɔ lɛ; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, okɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkɛkwɛa nyɛhe.”
Elisha kɛ Shunem yoo niiatsɛ lɛ
8 Gbi ko lɛ Elisha tee Shunem; yoo niiatsɛ ko yɛ jɛi. Yoo nɛɛ kpee Elisha kɛtee ewe lɛ koni ebaye nii. No hewɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni Elisha tsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛhoɔ lɛ, egbaleɔ jɛi eyayeɔ nii. 9Yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ ewu akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ, miyoo akɛ nuu nɛɛ ni batsɔ̃ɔ wɔŋɔɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni. 10Hã wɔma gbogbo tsu fioo ko, ni wɔkɛ saatso kɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ sɛi kɛ kane amãmɔ mli ahã lɛ, koni be fɛɛ be kɛji eba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ ebahi jɛi.”
11Gbi ko lɛ Elisha ku esɛɛ kɛba Shunem, ni etee tsu lɛ mli, ni eyajɔɔ ehe yɛ jɛi. 12Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ Gehazi akɛ, “Yaatsɛ Shunem yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni be ni eyatsɛ yoo lɛ kɛba lɛ, yoo lɛ badamɔ Elisha hiɛ. 13Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ yoo lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ogba ohe naa yɛ wɔhewɔ; mɛni ooosumɔ akɛ mifee mihã bo? Ani oyɛ sane ko ni ooosumɔ akɛ ayakɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ loo asraafoiatsɛ lɛ lo?’ ”
Yoo lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋbii ateŋ miyɔɔ lɛ, ni nɔ ko he ehiaaa mi.”
14Elisha bi Gehazi akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni afee ahã lɛ mɔ?” Gehazi to he akɛ, “Ebɛ binuu, ni ewu hu egbɔ.”
15Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Tsɛ yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni etsɛ lɛ, ni ebadamɔ shinaa lɛ shi. 16 Elisha kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Wɔsɛɛ afi naakplɔ benɛ lɛ, ooohiɛ binuu yɛ okpɔkɔiaŋ.”
Yoo lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Dabida minuŋtsɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji bo, kaalaka mi.” 17Be ni shɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu tamɔ bɔ ni Elisha ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
18Be ni gbekɛ lɛ bada lɛ, gbi ko lɛ etee etsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋmãakulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ. 19Trukaa lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ bolɔ ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Miyitso miigba mi, miyitso miigba mi.”
Etsɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wo lɛ oyahã enyɛ!” 20Ni ewo lɛ eyahã enyɛ. Gbekɛ lɛ ta enyɛ shuɔ nɔ kɛyashi shwane, ni egbo. 21Ni ewo gbonyo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee eyafɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ saa lɛ nɔ, ni eŋa shinaa ewo eyi, ni eje kpo. 22Ebo etsɛ ewu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ hã mi oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ teji yei lɛ ateŋ ekome koni masha mihe maya Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ maba! 23Ewu lɛ bi lɛ akɛ “Mɛni hewɔ otaoɔ ni oya eŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?” Ŋmɛnɛ jeee nyɔŋ hee, asaŋ ejeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi. Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Kaaye otsui.” 24Ehã awo teji yoo lɛ nɔ nii ahã lɛ; kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wo teji lɛ foi ni wɔtee; kaagbɔjɔ foijee lɛ mli yɛ mihewɔ, ja mikɛɛ bo akɛ ogbɔjɔ mli.” 25Ni eyi mli etee Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ na lɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ Gehazi akɛ: “Naa, Shunamyoo lɛ baa lɛ.
26“Sha foi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ koni okɛ lɛ ayakpe, ni obi lɛ akɛ: ‘Te oyɔɔ tɛŋŋ? Te owu hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ? Te gbekɛ lɛ hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?’ ”
Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ jogbaŋŋ!”
27Be ni Shunamyoo lɛ shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebamɔmɔ enaji amli. Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi tsi bɛŋkɛ koni etsi lɛ kɛya sɛɛ. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛɛ lɛ gbɛ ni emɔ mimli, ejaakɛ esusuma ehao naakpa yɛ emli; ni Yehowa kɛtee mi, ni ejieko etsɔ̃ko mi.”
28Kɛkɛ ni Shunamyoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ani mibaba bi nuu ko yɛ minuŋtsɔ dɛŋ? Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ okalaka mi?”
29 Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Miamɔ, ni okɔ midɛŋhiɛmɔtso lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni oya. Kɛji okɛ mɔ ko kpe yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kaaŋa lɛ; ni kɛji mɔ ko ŋa bo lɛ, kaahere lɛ nɔ, ni oya ni okɛ mitso lɛ ayafɔ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ.”
30Kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ lɛ nyɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɔɔ, ni bo hu oyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo miyaŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛyi mli amɛtee. 31Gehazi tsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ kɛtee, ni ekɛ tso lɛ yafɔ̃ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ. Shi gbekɛ lɛ ewieee, ni nɔ ko etsɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ wala yɛ emli. Hewɔ lɛ Gehazi ku esɛɛ ni ekɛ Elisha yakpe, ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ etsɛ̃ko.”
32Be ni Elisha bote shĩa lɛ mli lɛ, ena gbekɛ lɛ ni egbo lɛ kã esaa lɛ nɔ. 33 No hewɔ lɛ, ebote tsu lɛ mli, ni eŋa shinaa lɛ ewo amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛyi, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai. 34 Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ saatso lɛ ni eyabu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛ enaabu bu enaabu nɔ; ni ekɛ ehiŋmɛii bumɔ ehiŋmɛii anɔ, ni ekɛ eniji hu shwie eniji anɔ, ni ekpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ. Ni gbekɛ lɛ he dɔ la. 35Kɛkɛ lɛ, Elisha te shi, ni eshara shi kɛtee kɛba shi kome yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni esaa eyakpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. Gbekɛ lɛ tsine shii kpawo, kɛkɛ ni egbele ehiŋmɛi. 36 Elisha tsɛ Gehazi kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Tsɛ Shunam yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni etee eyatsɛ lɛ kɛba. Be ni yoo lɛ ba lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wo obi lɛ.” 37Kɛkɛ ni eba, ni ebaho egbee Elisha najianaa, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi; no sɛɛ lɛ ewo ebi lɛ kɛje kpo.
Naakpɛɛ nibii enyɔ komɛi hu ni Elisha fee
38Be ni Elisha ku esɛɛ eba Gilgal ekoŋŋ lɛ, no mli lɛ hɔmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Gbi ko be mli ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii tara shi lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ kukwɛi wulu lɛ oma la nɔ, ni ohoo nii ohã gbalɔi nɛɛ.” 39Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome je kpo etee ŋa nɔ koni eyatse shwie. Eyana ŋa nɔ baa ko ni haa shi; ni etserɛ baa nɛɛ eko ewo emama naa obɔ̃; ebafolɔ mli ewo kukwɛi ni ma la lɛ nɔ lɛ mli; tsɛbelɛ amɛleee nɔ baa ni ji.
40Amɛtsɔ niyenii lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ ni amɛye. Be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, ebɔɔ yɛ niyenii lɛ mli.” Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ niyenii lɛ amɛye. 41Elisha kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ mamu abaa!” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ mamu lɛ wo kukwɛi lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɔa nyɛhãa mɛi lɛ ni amɛyea.” Ni nɔ ko fɔŋ ko efeee amɛ.
42Be kroko lɛ, nuu ko jɛ Baal-Shalishah ba ni ebahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, akoko kpokploku aboloi akwaabɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ abelefɔ hu yɛ kotoku mli. Ni Elisha kɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ ohã gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ni amɛye.” 43 Shi etsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ani niyenii nɛɛ aaashɛ mɛi oha naa lo?”
Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bo lɛ, ŋɔɔ ohã mɛi lɛ ni amɛye! Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Amɛaaye aahu ni eko aaashwɛ.’ ” 44 No hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ niyenii lɛ ema amɛhiɛ, ni amɛye, ni eko shwɛ, yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 5
Content:
Atsa Naaman kpitiyelɔ lɛ
1Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Naaman; gbɔmɔ wulu ji lɛ, ni enuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ buɔ lɛ ejaakɛ lɛ enɔ Yehowa tsɔ̃ ehã Siriabii lɛ ye kunim. Eyɛŋ akɛ eji asraafonyo kãkãlɔ kpanaa nɛ, shi eeye kpiti. 2Be ko lɛ, Siriabii lɛ yatua Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ gbekɛ oblayoo fioo ko nom ni eyasɔ̃mɔ Naaman ŋa lɛ. 3Gbi ko lɛ gbekɛ yoo lɛ kɛɛ ewula lɛ akɛ, “Mina ni minuŋtsɔ yaje gbalɔ ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ ŋɔɔ, kulɛ eeetsa ekpiti lɛ ehã lɛ.” 4Be ni Naaman nu sane nɛɛ lɛ, etee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyagba lɛ nɔ ni oblayoo lɛ ni jɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ. 5Ni Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Yaa mɔ! Maŋma wolo mahã bo kɛyahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.”
No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋma kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi shekel akpei ekpaa kɛ hewulamɔ atadei srɔtoi nyɔŋma kɛtee. 6Ni ekɛ wolo lɛ yahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni aŋmã yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Mikɛ wolo nɛɛ miihã ole akɛ mi ji mɔ ni miwo Naaman gbɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Eba koni otsa ekpiti lɛ ohã lɛ.”
7Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kane wolo lɛ, egbala ehe atadei ni ekɛɛ, “Aso Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi ni migbeɔ mɔ, ni mihãa mɔ yi naa wala, hewɔ ni mɔnɛ tsuɔ miŋɔɔ akɛ mitsa mɔ ko kpiti mihã lɛ nɛɛ? Nyɛjwɛŋa he nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛaana akɛ minaa bei kɛkɛ etaoɔ nɛɛ.” 8Shi be ni Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, nu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ egbala ehe atadei lɛ, etsu atee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ogbala ohe atadei lɛ? Hã eba miŋɔɔ, ni eeena ele akɛ gbalɔ ko yɛ Israel.”
9No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kɛ ekpɔŋɔ kɛ eshwiilii lɛ ba ni amɛbadamɔ Elisha we lɛ agbo lɛ naa. 10Elisha tsu bɔfo ko kɛtee eŋɔɔ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaju ohe shii kpawo yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ mli ni aaatsa ohela lɛ ahã bo kwraa.” 11Shi Naaman mli fu ni eyiŋ kɛmiiya, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ eeeje kpo kɛba miŋɔɔ ebadamɔ shi, ni eeetsɛ Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi, ni ekɛ enine aaahuu jɛi koni etsa kpiti lɛ. 12 Ani Abana Faa kɛ Farpar Faa ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ, amɛhiii fe Israel fai lɛ fɛɛ lo? Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, kulɛ mɛɛba mijuuu mihe yɛ nomɛi amli ni mihe tã mɔ?” Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni eyi mli ni kulɛ eeya kɛ mlifu.
13Shi etsuji lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wie akɛ, “Ataa, ani nɔ ko wulu ko gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ ofee kulɛ, ofeŋ lo? Aahuu moŋ ni ekɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Yaaju ohe kɛkɛ ni ohe atã lɛ.’ ” 14No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kpeleke shi, ni ekɛ ehe yatsɔ Yordan Faa lɛ mli shii kpawo tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ wie lɛ, ni ehe tã, ni ehewolo nɔ bafee trotro ekoŋŋ tamɔ gbekɛ fioo hewolo.
15Kɛkɛ ni Naaman ku esɛɛ eba Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, lɛ kɛ emɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ. Eba ni ebadamɔ shi yɛ Elisha hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, kpaako mina mile akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ ni ohe otsulɔ dɛŋ nikeenii ko.”
16Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, hiɛ kã nɛɛ, miheee nɔ ko.” Ni enyɛ enɔ doo akɛ ehe kɛ̃, shi Elisha ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ. 17Kɛkɛ ni Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji oheee midɛŋ nikee lɛ, belɛ ofainɛ ni ohã ni ahã mi sũ, bɔ ni teji okpɔŋɔi enyɔ aaatere; ejaakɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, mi otsulɔ, mishaŋ shãa afɔle loo afɔle kroko mihaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja Yehowa kɛkɛ. 18Kɛji minuŋtsɔ tee Rimmon, Siria nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ ni eyaaja lɛ, ekpasaa minine. Kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ koto shi eeja lɛ, esa akɛ mikɛ lɛ akoto shi eko yɛ Rimmon we lɛ. Kɛji eeeba lɛ nakai lɛ, Yehowa aŋɔfa mi, otsulɔ.”
19Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Naaman yi gbɛ etee.
20Naaman shɛko he ko shɔŋŋ ko kɛkɛ ni Gehazi, Elisha Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Naa, minuŋtsɔ eŋɔ Naaman, Sirianyo nɛɛ, he eke lɛ, ni eheee nɔ ni ekɛba lɛ yɛ edɛŋ. Akɛni Yehowa hiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, masha foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ koni mayahe nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ.” 21Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi ŋɔ shwie Naaman sɛɛ. Shi be ni Naaman na akɛ mɔ ko hiɛ foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ eyi shi kɛjɛ eshwiili lɛ mli koni ekɛ lɛ ayakpe. Naaman bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni eba?”
22Ni Gehazi hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nɔ ko bako. Minuŋtsɔ tsu mi koni mibakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ ejɛ Efraim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba miŋɔɔ; ofainɛ ni ohã amɛ jwiɛtɛi talenta kome kɛ hewulamɔ atadei enyɔ.’ ”
23Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã ni mahã bo jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ koni okɛya!” Ni enyɛ enɔ, ni efimɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ lɛ ewo kotokui enyɔ amli, kɛ hewulamɔ atadei fɛɛfɛji srɔtoi enyɔ lɛ. Ni eŋɔ tere etsuji enyɔ kɛnyiɛ Gehazi hiɛ. 24Shi be ni amɛshɛ gɔŋ ni Elisha yɔɔ nɔ lɛ he lɛ, Gehazi he kotokui lɛ yɛ Naaman tsuji lɛ adɛŋ, ni ekɛyato shĩa lɛ mli, ni ewo Naaman tsuji lɛ agbɛ, ni amɛtee. 25Kɛkɛ ni etee eyadamɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ. Elisha bi lɛ akɛ, “Gehazi, nɛgbɛ ojɛ?” Ni ehã hetoo akɛ, “Otsulɔ eyako he ko he ko.” 26Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ oleee akɛ yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ miyɛ jɛi, be mli ni nuu lɛ yi shi kɛjɛ eshwiili lɛ mli ni ekɛ bo bakpe lɛ? Ani be ni aŋɔɔ shika kɛ atadei kɛ mutsei kɛ waintromi kɛ too gwantɛŋi kɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ wehii kɛ weyei yɛ mɔ dɛŋ nɛ? 27Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kpiti lɛ aaatsɛŋe bo kɛ oshwiei fɛɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.” Ni eje ehiɛ eje kpo kɛ ehe kpiti sakoo tamɔ ayilɔ.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 6
Content:
Lema ko he sane
1Gbi ko lɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Naa, he ni wɔ owebii nɛɛ wɔyɔɔ lɛ, yɛ kplokotoo tsɔ̃ hã wɔ. 2Hewɔ lɛ ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ ní wɔya Yordan Faa lɛ naa wɔyafolɔ tsei ni wɔkɛbafee shihilɛhei wɔhã wɔhe yɛ jɛi.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa.”
3Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ni okɛ wɔ otsuji aya.” Ni ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi kɛ nyɛ baaya.” 4Hewɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ tee. Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ amɛtootoo tsei lɛ. 5Shi be ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome toɔ tso lɛ eko lɛ, dade lɛ fã yɛ lema lɛ yitso eyagbee nu lɛ mli. Ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Ao, minuŋtsɔ, lema lɛ ma po ayama!”
6Kɛkɛ ni Elisha bi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyagbee lɛ?” Be ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ jɛi lɛ, Elisha fo tso kuku ko ni eshɛ efɔ̃ jɛi, kɛkɛ ni amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni dade lɛ batɛo nu lɛ hiɛ. 7Ni efã akɛ, “Yaakɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kpã enine mli ni ekɔ.
Aye Siria ta nɔ kunim
8Be ko lɛ ta te shi yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etatsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋɔ, ni amɛkɔɔ he ni amɛkɛbaafee amɛshitoohe. 9Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Elisha lɛ leɔ enɛ, ni etswaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ adafi akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛmiiho ejaakɛ Siriabii lɛ miiya jɛi.” 10Kɛkɛ lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ etsu kɛtee he ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ etswa lɛ he adafi lɛ. Enɛ tee nɔ shii abɔ.
11Enɛ ye Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui naakpa; no hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ etsuji lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛtsɔ̃ŋ mi wɔteŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lo?”
12Ni etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jeee wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ; shi moŋ, Elisha, gbalɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni gbaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔi ni owieɔ yɛ osɛɛtsu lɛ mli tete lɛ.”
13Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyataoa he ni eyɔɔ, ni matsu ni ayamɔ lɛ kɛba.” Kɛkɛ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, eyɛ Dotan.” 14No hewɔ lɛ, etsu ta kpele kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛtee jɛi. Amɛshɛ jɛi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ. 15Leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Elisha Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ te shi, ni eje kpo, ni ena Siria tabilɔi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii ni amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ. Tsulɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ etee Elisha ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ao minuŋtsɔ, te wɔbaafee tɛŋŋ?”
16 Elisha here nɔ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei ejaakɛ mɛi ni kɛ wɔ yɔɔ lɛ fa fe mɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ.” 17Kɛkɛ ni Elisha sɔle akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, gbelemɔ ehiŋmɛii ni ena nii!” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbele oblanyo lɛ hiŋmɛii ni ena nii; ni naa, gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ la shwiilii kɛbɔle Elisha he kɛkpe.
18 Be ni Siriabii lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba Elisha mɔmɔ lɛ, Elisha kpa Yehowa fai akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashwi la!” Ni amɛshwi la yɛ Elisha sɔlemɔ lɛ naa. 19Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee gbɛ lɛ nɛ, ni jeee maŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ hu nɛ. Nyɛnyiɛa misɛɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛ baaya nuu lɛ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” Ni ekɛ amɛ tee Samaria tɔ̃ɔ.
20Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛshɛ Samaria lɛ Elisha sɔle akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, gbelemɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahiŋmɛii koni amɛna nii.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbele amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛna nii; ni naa, amɛna akɛ amɛyɛ Samaria.
21Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ na amɛ lɛ, ebi Elisha akɛ, “Mitsɛ, ani mitswia amɛ nii? Ani migbe amɛ lo?”
22 Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Dabida, kaatswia amɛ nii ni ogbe amɛ. Ani mɛi po ni okɛ oklante kɛ ogãi yaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, ogbeɔ amɛ? Ŋmɛɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ koni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nii koni ohã amɛya amɛnuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ.” 23No hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ kpele ko, ni be ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ Siriabii lɛ baaa Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbayeee ofɔ̃ dɔŋŋ!
Asa Samaria Yi
24Be kplaŋŋ ko sɛɛ lɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bua eta lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni amɛfã kɛtee amɛyasa Samaria maŋ lɛ yi. 25No hewɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni naa wa ba Samaria, aahu po ní ahɔ̃ɔ teji yitso jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni ahɔ̃ɔ okpo wamɔ okpolu mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ. Afɔɔ ŋaŋ sabolai tsɛmɔ ŋaŋ “okpo fee.”
26Agbɛnɛ eba lɛ akɛ be ni Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ sheraa shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, yoo ko bolɔ kɛtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ofainɛ, ye obua mi.”
27Maŋtsɛ lɛ here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dabi, hã ni Yehowa aye abua bo, te mafee tɛŋŋ maye mabua bo hu? Ani mijɛ miŋmãagbeemɔhe loo mijɛ miwainbu mli?” 28Maŋtsɛ lɛ biyoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni gbaa onaa?”
Yoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kɛ obinuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ ŋmɛnɛ, koni wɔ lɛ, wɔye mi hu mibinuu lɛ.’ 29 Kɛkɛ ni wɔhoo mibi lɛ, ni wɔye. Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛ obinuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ’; shi lɛ lɛ eŋɔ ebi lɛ etee.”
30Be ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ nu yoo lɛ wiemɔi lɛ, egbala etadei lɛ yɛ ehe; ni maŋbii ni bɛŋkɛ gbogbo lɛ he lɛ na akɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ wo kpekpe atade yɛ etadei ni ewo lɛ ashishi. 31Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi, ni esaa egbe mi ekoŋŋ, kɛji Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ, yitso tsa eyitso nɔ ŋmɛnɛ!” 32Ni etsu tsulɔ koni eyamɔ Elisha. Shi no mli lɛ Elisha ta shi yɛ eshĩa lɛ ni onukpai komɛi ni ba lɛ saramɔ lɛ tara emasɛi. Shi dani tsulɔ lɛ shɛɔ Elisha ŋɔɔ lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛle akɛ nakai nuu mɔgbelɔ lɛ ewo mɔ gbɛ ni abafo miyitso lo? Naa, kɛji tsulɔ lɛ ba lɛ, nyɛŋaa shinaa lɛ nyɛwoa eyi kpɛŋŋ ni ekaba mli. Enuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛmiiba.” 33 Be ni Elisha kɛ enukpai lɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ bashɛ eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛ. Mɛni mimɛɔ dɔŋŋ? Mɛni feemɔ shwɛɔ mi dɔŋŋ?”

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 7
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Wɔ be nɛ mli lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria.” 2 Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpasaa enine lɛ here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Naa, kɛji Yehowa aaagbele samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo?” Ni Elisha kɛɛ, “Na ooona kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
Siria tabilɔi lɛ jo foi
3 Hii kpitiyelɔi ejwɛ komɛi yɛ Samaria maŋ agbo lɛ naa. Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ: “Mɛni hewɔ ni wɔɔɔtara biɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔɔɔgboi?” 4 Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbotea maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, hɔmɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni wɔɔɔgboi yɛ jɛi. Ni kɛji wɔtara biɛ hu gboimɔ nɔŋŋ wɔbaagboi. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa; nyɛhãa wɔyagbea Siriabii lɛ ata lɛ mli moŋ; kɛji amɛhere wɔyi wala lɛ, wɔyi aaana wala; ni kɛji amɛgbe wɔ lɛ belɛ wɔɔgboi kɛkɛ.” 5No hewɔ lɛ, gbɛkɛnaashi, be ni hiɛ bɔ̃i tuutuu feemɔ lɛ, kpitiyelɔi lɛ te shi amɛtee Siriabii lɛ ata lɛ mli; shi be ni amɛshɛɔ jɛi lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ jɛi. 6 Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã Siriabii lɛ nu shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi anane shi gbɛɛmɔi kɛ ta babaoo he; ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ eyabɔ Hitbii kɛ Ijiptbii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ apaa koni amɛkɛ wɔ abawu.” 7Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, gbɛkɛnaashi be ni hiɛ feɔ tuutuu lɛ, amɛjo foi amɛshi amɛshitoohe lɛ: amɛshi amɛbuui kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ amɛtejii fɛɛ. Amɛjo foi koni amɛhere amɛyiwala.
8Agbɛnɛ be ni nɛkɛ kpitiyelɔi nɛɛ shɛ shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, amɛbote buu kome ko mli, ni amɛyeyee nii, ni amɛnunuu dãi; ni amɛloo jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ mamai, ni amɛkɛyatee. Amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛbabote buu kroko hu mli, ni amɛloo jɛi nii lɛ hu, ni amɛkɛyato. 9Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nɔ ni wɔfeɔ nɛɛ ejaaa. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, omanye gbi ni. Shi moŋ kɛji wɔfee diŋŋ ni wɔmɛ kɛyashi jetsɛre leebi lɛ, wɔɔye sɔ̃. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔyaa ni wɔyabɔa amaniɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.” 10Kɛkɛ ni amɛshi Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ kɛtee Samaria. Kɛkɛ ni kpitiyelɔi lɛ bo amɛtsɛ maŋ lɛ agbonaabulɔi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔtee Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ; ni naa, anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko lɛ, anuuu mɔ ko mɔ ko he hu akɛ ja okpɔŋɔi ni afimɔ amɛ aŋmɔlɔ̃ shi; ni tejii lɛ hu ŋmɔlɔ shi; ni bui lɛ hu mamɔ shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Siriabii lɛ shi amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.”
11Kɛkɛ ni agbonaabulɔi lɛ tswa adafi, kɛkɛ ni sane lɛ yashɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ. 12Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ yiŋtoo ni Siriabii nɛɛ kɛfee enɛ nɛɛ. Amɛle akɛ hɔmɔ miiye wɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛje shitoohe lɛ mli amɛtee amɛyateetee amɛhe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔbaaje maŋ lɛ mli wɔyatao niyenii, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaamɔmɔ wɔ hiɛkãalɔi koni amɛbote wɔmaŋ lɛ mli ni amɛŋɔ maŋ lɛ hu.”
13Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, amɛtamɔ mɛi ni egboi momo lɛ nɔŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsua hii komɛi; amɛŋɔ okpɔŋɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ enumɔ kɛya jɛi koni amɛyakwɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ.” 14Kɛkɛ ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu amɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔ shwiilii kɛtee Siria ta lɛ mli. Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyakwɛa.” 15Ni amɛtiu amɛ kɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa tɔ̃ɔ; ni naa, gbɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ eyi tɔ kɛ atadei kɛ nibiinibii ni Siria tabilɔi lɛ eshɛrɛ eshwie yɛ amɛoyaiyeli lɛ mli. Bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba, ni amɛbabɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ. 16Kɛkɛ ni Samariabii lɛ je kpo kɛtee, ni amɛyaha Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ. Ni yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, akɛ talenta kome he ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria.
17Agbɛnɛ eba mli akɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ asafoiatsɛ, mɔ ni ekpasaa enine lɛ, eto maŋ wulu lɛ agbo lɛ naa akɛ agbonaakwɛlɔ nukpa. Maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, taakɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, kɛɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ. 18Ejaakɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ benɛ beiaŋ lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa, yɛ Samaria, yɛ nakai agbo lɛ naa lɛ,” 19nakai asafoiatsɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji Yehowa aaagbele samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po, ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo?” lɛ. Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ ooona kɛ ohiŋmɛii, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ lɛ.” 20Nakai nɔŋŋ eba enɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni egbo.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 8
Content:
Shunemyoo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛba
1 Agbɛnɛ, Elisha ekɛɛ yoo lɛ ni etsiɛ̃ ebi lɛ hiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ, ni oya koni oyato gbɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni ooona; ejaakɛ Yehowa baahã hɔmɔ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii kpawo.” 2No hewɔ lɛ, yoo lɛ te shi, ni efee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ wie lɛ. Ekɛ ewe lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii kpawo.
3Afii kpawo lɛ naagbee mli lɛ, yoo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Be ni eyashɛ jɛi lɛ, etee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyafo ewo enijiaŋ koni akpale eshĩa lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ ahã lɛ. 4Yoo lɛ yanina maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Gehazi, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, miiwie akɛ, “Gbaa mi nibii wuji fɛɛ ni Elisha efee lɛ.” 5Gehazi miigba maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔ ni Elisha tsɔ̃ etsĩɛ gbonyo hiɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛkɛ lɛ naa yoo lɛ ni etsĩɛ ebi hiɛ lɛ. Ebafo ewo maŋtsɛ lɛ nijiaŋ yɛ eshĩa lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, yoo lɛ nɛ, ni ebi lɛ ni Elisha tsĩɛ ehiɛ lɛ hu nɛ.” 6Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi yoo lɛ, ni yoo lɛ gba lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã piafonyo ko ehã lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dãimɔ nibii fɛɛ ni ji yoo nɛɛ nii lɛ ohã lɛ, kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii fɛɛ ni ahɔ̃ɔ kɛjɛ afii kpawo nɛɛ ni eshi eshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ.”
Elisha kɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad
7Ni Elisha tee Damasko be mli ni Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad lɛ he miiye. Be ni ayagba maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ eba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ,” 8maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hazael epiafoi lɛ eko akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ nikeenii ko ohiɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni okɛyahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ koni otsɔ̃ enɔ ni obi Yehowa nii akɛ, ‘Aleee nɔ, hela ni miyeɔ nɛɛ lɛ mihe aaawa mi lo?’ ” 9No hewɔ lɛ, Hazael tee Elisha ŋɔɔ. Eŋɔ nikeenii ni ji Damasko nibii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ eko ehiɛ edɛ̃, yoomai nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yiteremɔ. Be ni Hazael kɛ Elisha kpe lɛ, Hazael kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Otsulɔ Ben-Hadad tsu mi oŋɔɔ koni mibabi bo akɛ ehe ni yeɔ nɛɛ lɛ eeena hewalɛ kɛ̃ lo?”
10Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ohe baawa bo!’ Tsɛbelɛ, Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaagbo.” 11Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tsu ehiŋmɛi eshwie Hazael nɔ gãa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Hazael he bɔ̃i lɛ jaramɔ. Kɛkɛ ni trukaa nɔŋŋ ni Elisha bɔ̃i yaafo. 12Hazael bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ minuŋtsɔ foɔ nɛɛ?”
Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Ejaakɛ mile nɔ efɔŋ ni bo obaafee Israelbii: amɛmɔji ni he wa lɛ obaamamɔ naa la, ni amɛblahii lɛ okɛ klante baagbe amɛ, ni amɛbii fufɔbii lɛ obaaŋɔ amɛ otswia shi, ni amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ obaagbalagbalaa amɛmli.”
13 Kɛkɛ ni Hazael kɛɛ akɛ, “Mi, otsulɔ ni tamɔ gbee nɛɛ, namɔ ji lɛ ni eeetsu nɔ ko wulu ni tamɔ nɛkɛ?” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bo obaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Siria.”
14Ni Hazael ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Elisha ŋɔɔ kɛtee enuŋtsɔ Ben-Hadad ŋɔɔ; ni Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni Elisha kɛɛ bo?” Tsulɔ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Ekɛɛ mi akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ohe baawa bo!”
15Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Hazael kɔ saanɔbo, ni ekɛtsɔ nu mli, ni eŋɔ hã maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui su aahu kɛyashi egbo. Kɛkɛ ni Hazael baye Ben-Hadad sɛɛ akɛ Siria maŋtsɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram
(2 Kronika 21.1-20)
16 Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoshafat bi Yehoram babɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda. 17Eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ be ni awo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii kpaanyɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm. 18Eba ejeŋ gbonyogbonyo tamɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi lɛ; eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ, ejaakɛ Ahab biyoo ji eŋa, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 19 Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekpãtãa Yuda hiɛ yɛ etsulɔ David hewɔ; ejaakɛ ewo lɛ shi akɛ eeehã lɛ kɛ eshwiei atsɔ̃ kane ni baakudɔ Yuda kɛaatee naanɔ.
20 Maŋtsɛ Yehoram yinɔ lɛ, Edom tse Yuda hiɛ atua, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwo maŋtsɛ amɛhã amɛhe. 21Kɛkɛ ni Yehoram kɛ eta shwiilii lɛ fɛɛ foŋ kɛtee Zair. Edombii lɛ gba kɛbɔle amɛ kɛkpe yɛ jɛi. Shi Yehoram kɛ eshwiilii nɔtalɔi lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba kɛtsɔ̃ Edombii ata lɛ mli, ni amɛjo foi, ni etabilɔi lɛ gbɛ shwã, ni amɛtee amɛshĩaiaŋ. 22No hewɔ lɛ, Edombii lɛ tse Yuda hiɛ atua kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Libna maŋ wulu lɛ hu tse atua.
23Shi Yehoram he saji kɛ nibii ni efee fɛɛ lɛ aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 24Ni Yehoram gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni ebi Ahazia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia
(2 Kronika 22.1-6)
25Ahab bi Yoram, ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahazia Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram bi lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda. 26Ahazia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ. Eye maŋtsɛ afi kome yɛ Yerusalɛm. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Atalia, Israel Maŋtsɛ Omri nabi lɛ. 27Eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Ahab we lɛ bii lɛ ashaanuu ji lɛ.
28Maŋtsɛ Ahazia yafata Ahab bi Yoram he, ni amɛkɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael yawu yɛ Ramot-Gilead; ni Siriabii lɛ pila Yoram. 29Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yoram ku esɛɛ kɛtee Yezreel koni ayatsa pilamɔ ni Siriabii pila lɛ lɛ yɛ Rama lɛ. Ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram bi Ahazia tee Yezreel koni eyasara Yoram, ejaakɛ ehe miiye.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 9
Content:
Afɔ Yehu mu kɛwo lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ
1Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Elisha tsɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mĩamɔ, wo nɛkɛ mu kɛ tɔ nɛɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃ oya Ramot-Gilead. 2Ni kɛji oshɛ jɛi lɛ taomɔ Yehu, Yehoshafat bi lɛ, ni ji Nimshi nabi lɛ. Ohã ete shi yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, koni okɛ lɛ abote sɛɛtsu mli. 3 Kɛkɛ lɛ wo mu kɛ tɔ lɛ koni ofɔse oshwie eyiteŋ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, miiwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ!’ Kɛkɛ lɛ gbelemɔ shinaa lɛ ni ojo foi; kaashashao shi.”
4Kɛkɛ ni oblanyo lɛ ni ji gbalɔ lɛ, yiŋ etee Ramot-Gilead. 5Be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, naa ta lɛ mli asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ tara shi amɛkpe; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Asafoiatsɛ, mihiɛ sane ko mihã bo!” Ni Yehu bi akɛ, “Wɔteŋ namɔ okɛwieɔ lɛ?” Ni ehã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bo, asafoiatsɛ Yehu tuuŋtu ni!” 6No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu te shi ni amɛbote shĩa lɛ mli, ni oblanyo lɛ fɔse mu lɛ eshwie Yehu yiteŋ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifɔ bo mu kɛwo bo Yehowa maŋbii ni ji Israel maŋtsɛ. 7 Ni obaabutu onuŋtsɔ Ahab we lɛ, koni mikɛtɔ Yezebel kɛ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ alá, kɛ Yehowa tsuji lɛ fɛɛ alá he owele. 8 Ejaakɛ Ahab we lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã; ni maplene nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ Ahab we lɛ, nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ, yɛ Israel. 9 Ni mafee Ahab we lɛ tamɔ mifee Israel maŋtsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, we lɛ, kɛ Baasha, Ahia bi lɛ we lɛ. 10 Ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko efuŋ lɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ gbele shinaa lɛ, ni ejo foi.
11Be ni Yehu ku esɛɛ kɛba enuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi, lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani hejɔlɛ sane ni lo? Mɛni hewɔ ni mɔnɛ sɛkɛyelɔ nɛɛ ba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ewiemɔ yɔɔ.” 12Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ “Oolaka wɔ, gbaa wɔ nɔ ni ekɛɛ moŋ.” Ni Yehu kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni ekɛɛ mi nɛ; ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Mifɔ bo mu, miwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ.’ ”
13 Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe fee oya, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ jie etade, ni eŋɔ ha shi yɛ atrakpoi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛkpãkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi amɛkɛɛ, “Yehu eye maŋtsɛ!”
Agbe Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram
14Kɛkɛ ni Yehu, Yehoshafat bi ni ji Nimshi nabi lɛ, kpãŋ Yoram yinɔ. Nakai be mli lɛ Yoram kɛ Israel fɛɛ miibu Ramot-Gilead he, yɛ Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ. 15Maŋtsɛ Yoram eku esɛɛ kɛtee Yezreel koni eyatsa pilamɔi ni Siriabii lɛ pila lɛ lɛ, be ni ekɛ Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ yawu lɛ. Ni Yehu kɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛ kɛ mi kɛɛmɔ ni lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko joa foi kɛmiijɛa maŋ lɛ mli ni eyagba yɛ Yezreel.” 16Ni Yehu ho ta shwiili mli ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yezreel ejaakɛ Yoram kã shi kɛ hela yɛ jɛi. Ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia eba eŋɔɔ ebaasara lɛ.
17Bulɔ ko damɔ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yezreel; ena Yehu kɛ esafo ku lɛ ni amɛmiiba, ni ekɛɛ, “Miina asafo ku ko.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ akɛ, “Tsɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko ni otsu lɛ koni ekɛ amɛ ayakpe, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ”
18Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko tee ni ekɛ Yehu yakpe, ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ”
Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.”
Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ. 19Kɛkɛ ni etsu okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ni ji enyɔ kɛtee. Be ni eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Ni Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.”
20Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ. Ni bulɔ lɛ kɛfata he akɛ, “Shwiili lɛ foiwoo tamɔ Yehu Nimshi nabi lɛ shwiili foiwoo, ejaakɛ ewoɔ shwiili foi tamɔ sɛkɛyelɔ”.
21Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ, “Nyɛfea mishwiili lɛ kralo.” Ni amɛfee eshwiili lɛ kralo. Ni Yoram, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ Ahazia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, je kpo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ta eshwiili mli; ni amɛ kɛ Yehu yakpe. Amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 22Be ni Yoram na Yehu lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ “Yehu, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?”
Yehu here nɔ akɛ, “Te baafee tɛŋŋ ni hejɔlɛ aba hu, bei abɔ ni ŋkunyaayeli kɛ wɔŋjamɔ ni onyɛ Yezebel bato shishi lɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ?” 23Kɛkɛ ni Yoram tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ejo foi; ni be ni ejoɔ foi lɛ, ekɛɛ Ahazia akɛ, “Ahazia, atsɔ̃ wɔ akpa!” 24Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɔ egãi lɛ ni eŋɔ tsɛ̃ Yoram kɔ̃ji ateŋ, ni gãi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yoram tsui mli kɛje kpo, ni egbee eshwiili lɛ mli. 25 Yehu kɛɛ esafoiatsɛ Bidikar akɛ, “Wo lɛ oshɛ ofɔ̃ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kaimɔ akɛ mi kɛ bo fɛɛ ni tara shwiili mli kɛnyiɛ etsɛ Ahab sɛɛ be ni Yehowa ŋɔ nɛkɛ toigbalamɔ nɛɛ efɔ̃ enɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 26‘Nabot lá ni afɔse ashwie shi kɛ ebii lɛ hu alá ni afɔse ashwie shi, ni mina nyɛ, lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikã mihe kitã akɛ mawo he nyɔmɔ yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.’ Yehowa kɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wo lɛ oshɛ ofɔ̃ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.”
Agbe Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia
27 Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia na nɔ ni eba lɛ, ejo foi kɛtsɔ̃ Bet-Hagan gbɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehu tiu lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Lɛ hu nyɛtsɛ̃a lɛ gãi.” Ni atsɛ̃ lɛ gãi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli yɛ Gur ŋmeŋme lɛ ni yɔɔ Ibleam masɛi lɛ he. Kɛkɛ ni ejo foi kɛtee Megido, ni eyagbo yɛ jɛi, ni 28etsuji lɛ wo egbonyo lɛ amɛwo shwiili lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbafu lɛ yɛ efuuhe lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.
29Ahazia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Agbe Maŋnyɛ Yezebel
30Yehu ba Yezreel. Be ni Yezebel nu he lɛ, ediki ehiŋmɛii asɛɛ, ni ehɔ eyi fɛɛfɛo, ni eyabu samflɛ naa, ni eekwɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ. 31 Be ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ, Yezebel bi akɛ, “Zimri ni ogbe onuŋtsɔ, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?”
32Yehu wo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ samflɛ lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ migbɛfaŋ?” Namɔ? Ni piafoi enyɔ loo piafoi etɛ̃ ko gbo amɛyi naa shi amɛkwɛ lɛ. 33Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛshɛa nyɛfɔ̃a shikpɔŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo lɛ amɛtswa shi; ni elá lɛ eko tsɛŋe shwie gbogbo lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe. Yehu kɛ eshwiili ni eta mli lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yezebel gbonyo lɛ nɔ kɛho. 34Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni eyaye nii, ni enu nɔ ko eshwie nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakwɛa ni nyɛfua nɛkɛ yoo musumɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ biyoo ni.” 35Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee lɛ fuu; shi amɛnaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja eyitsoŋoŋo kɛ enaji kɛ enine kɔkɔi pɛ. 36 Be ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbabɔ Yehu amaniɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa wiemɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, nɔ ewie lɛ nɛ: ‘Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ, 37ni Yezebel gbonyo baatsɔ̃ tamɔ tumo nɔ wamɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko yooo lɛ ni eeekɛɛ akɛ Yezebel nɛ.’ ”

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 10
Content:
Agbe Maŋtsɛ Ahab shwiei
1Ahab yɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ Samaria. No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu ŋmala woji ni etsu akɛtee Samaria akɛyahã maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ Ahab bii lɛ atsɔselɔi lɛ akɛ, 2“Amrɔ pɛ ni nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ aaashɛ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, akɛni nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛŋɔɔ, ni shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu nii kɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he hu yɔɔ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, 3nyɛkwɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni hi kɛ mɔ ni sa fe fɛɛ koni nyɛŋɔ lɛ nyɛta etsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛwu kɛhere nyɛnuŋtsɔ we lɛ.”
4Shi Samaria lumɛi lɛ she gbeyei naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, Maŋtsɛ Yoram kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahazia nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ adamɔ, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ ehiɛ wɔdamɔ hu?” 5No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋ lɛ kɛ bii lɛ atsɔselɔi lɛ hu tsu Yehu ŋɔɔ akɛ, “Otsuji ji wɔ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni oookɛɛ wɔ lɛ wɔɔfee. Wɔwooo mɔ ko mɔ ko maŋtsɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, feemɔ kɛkɛ.”
6Kɛkɛ ni Yehu ŋmã wolo ni ji enyɔ eyahã amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyɛ migbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛfee kralo akɛ nyɛaabo migbee toi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛŋɔa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ayitsei ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ Yezreel wɔ́ aaafee nɛkɛ be mli pɛpɛɛpɛ.”
Maŋtsɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ ni tsɔseɔ amɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ amɛyɔɔ. 7Be ni wolo lɛ bashɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ, amɛmɔmɔ maŋtsɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛyitsei lɛ amɛwo kɛntɛŋi amli, ni amɛtsu akɛyahã Yehu yɛ Yezreel.
8Be ni bɔfo bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Akɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ ayitsei lɛ eba lɛ,” Yehu fã akɛ, “Nyɛtoa yitsei lɛ kui enyɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi leebi.” 9Ni leebi lɛ, Yehu je kpo ebadamɔ shi yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ, “Naa, sɔ̃ ko tereee nyɛ. Mi ji mɔ ni tee minuŋtsɔ yinɔ apam, ni migbe lɛ. Shi namɔ gbegbee mɛnɛɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ hu? 10 Agbɛnɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni ewie yɛ Ahab we lɛ he lɛ, emli ekome folo efeŋ yaka, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee nɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ.” 11 No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu gbe mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Ahab we lɛ yɛ Yezreel lɛ: egbɔmɛi wuji lɛ kɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ emɔ ko mɔ ko.
Agbe Maŋtsɛ Ahazia wekumɛi
12Yehu shi Yezreel, ni eyiŋ kɛmiiya Samaria. Ni be ni eshɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Tookwɛlɔi Atoohetsɔikuuhe lɛ, 13 Yehu na Maŋtsɛ Ahazia wekumɛi lɛ ekomɛi yɛ jɛi, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɛi ji nyɛ?”
Amɛto he akɛ, “Ahazia wekumɛi ji wɔ, ni wɔmiiya wɔyasara maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ odehei krokomɛi lɛ.” 14Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɔmɔa amɛ hiɛkãalɔi!” Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ hiɛkãalɔi, ni amɛgbe amɛ yɛ Toohetsɔikuuhe bu lɛ he, hii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ, ni eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko.
Agbe Ahab weku ni eshwɛ fɛɛ
15 Ni be ni eje jɛi eŋɔ shwie nɔ lɛ, ena Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, ni eeba ni ekɛ lɛ abakpe. Yehu ŋa lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani otsui mli tse hã mi tamɔ bɔ ni mitsui mli tse hã bo lɛ?” Ni Yohanadab hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Hɛɛ, nakai ni.” Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ taa midɛ̃.” Kɛkɛ ni eta edɛ̃; kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã ekwɔ shwiili lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ. 16Yehu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni wɔtee koni oyakwɛ bɔ ni miyeɔ Yehowa he awuŋã mihãa.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã eta eshwiili lɛ mli. 17 Be ni Yehu shɛ Samaria lɛ, Yehu gbe Ahab weku fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ yɛ Samaria; ni eshiii mɔ kome nɛkɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ.
Agbe mɛi ni jaa Baal lɛ
18 Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bua Samaria maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ahab sɔ̃mɔ Baal fioo ko kɛkɛ, shi Yehu baasɔ̃mɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi. 19No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛyakpea Baal gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbahãa mi, akashwɛ mɔ ko; ejaakɛ miyɛ afɔle wulu ko ni mibashã mahã Baal. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaa lɛ eyi naŋ wala.” Shi ŋaa Yehu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni afee ni ekpãtã Baal sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ahiɛ. 20Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtoa gbi jurɔ wulu ko ni akɛja Baal.” No hewɔ lɛ, ato gbi lɛ. 21Ni Yehu kɛ wiemɔ tsu akɛtee Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Ni Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ba ni eshwɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni baaa. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛba Baal we lɛ, ni Baal we lɛ yi obɔ̃ tɔ. 22Ni Yehu fã mɔ ni kwɛɔ jamɔ atadei lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, “Yaajie atadei ohã Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ!” Ni eyajie atadei lɛ ebahã amɛ. 23Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛ Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, bote Baal we lɛ mli; ni ekɛɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia ni Yehowa jalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabafutu nyɛ yɛ biɛ, akɛ ja nyɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ kɛkɛ.” 24 Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛ Yehonadab tee koni amɛyashã afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei amɛhã Baal. Shi Yehu eŋɔ hii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ eto kpo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛhã hii ni mikɛbawo nyɛteŋ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome jo foi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni hã ejo foi lɛ kɛ ewala baatse.”
25 Ni eba mli akɛ be ni eshã shãa afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, Yehu kɛɛ bulɔi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbea amɛ, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko miije kpo!” Ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni bulɔi lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ hole amɛ ni amɛshɛrɛ amɛ amɛshwie kpo lɛ nɔ, kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee Baal we lɛ pia mli, 26 ni amɛyahole Baal we lɛ amãgãi lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyashã. 27 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkumɔ Baal amãgã lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛsaa amɛkumɔ Baal we lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu amɛshwie shi, ni amɛkɛ Baal we lɛ fee kuŋtso kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
28Nɛkɛ Yehu fee, ni ekpãtã Baal hiɛ yɛ Israel. 29 Shi Yehu efɔ̃ɔɔ tsinabi amãgã ni Yeroboam, Nebal bi lɛ, kɛma Betel kɛ Dan, ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ jamɔ. 30 Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yehu akɛ, “Ofee jogbaŋŋ kɛ feemɔ ni ofee nii ni sa mihiɛ, ni ofee Ahab we lɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ mitsui mli fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, oshwie aaata Israel sɛi lɛ nɔ kɛyashi yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.” 31Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehu ediii sɛɛ ni eye Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mla lɛ nɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ. Efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam fee ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ feemɔ.
Yehu gbele
32 Nakai be lɛ mli Yehowa hã Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ dalɛ nɔ bɔ̃i gbɔmɔ. Hazael ni jɛ Siria lɛ ye Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; 33kɛjɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he bokãgbɛ aahu kɛtee wuoyigbɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Aroer ni yɔɔ Arnon Faa lɛ he lɛ he. No ji Gilead kɛ Bashan shikpɔji lɛ, he ni Gadbii kɛ Rubenbii kɛ Bokã Manasebii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
34Shi Yehu he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ ekãa fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 35 Yehu gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria, ni ebi Yehoahaz baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ. 36Ni afii abɔ ni Yehu ye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria lɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 11
Content:
Yuda Maŋnyɛ Atalia
(2 Kronika 22.10—23.15)
1Agbɛnɛ be ni Ahazia nyɛ Atalia na akɛ ebi lɛ egbo lɛ, ete shi ni ekpãtã maŋtsɛ shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ. 2Shi Ahazia bi Yoash pɛ ji mɔ ni he je mli. Kulɛ abaagbe lɛ hu kɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, shi moŋ enyɛkwɛ̃ ni ji Yehosheba, ni ji maŋtsɛ Yehoram biyoo kɛ Ahazia nyɛmiyoo lɛ, here eyiwala. Yehosheba ju shi, ni emɔ Yoash kɛ efufɔhãlɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ yatee sɛɛtsu ko mli yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ koni Atalia akana lɛ ni egbe lɛ. 3Ni Yehosheba ŋɔ lɛ eyatee yɛ Yehowa we lɛ afii ekpaa, be mli ni Atalia yeɔ maŋnyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
4Shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Yehoiada tsu atee ni ayaŋɔ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hebulɔi lɛ abahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ. Ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ, ni ehã amɛkã lɛ kitã yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛ bi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 5Ni efã amɛ akɛ bɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni baabɔ̃i amɛnitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome afee maŋtsɛ we lɛ he bulɔi, 6ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ahi Sur Agbo lɛ naa; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu ahi agbo ni yɔɔ bulɔi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ naa, koni nyɛbu maŋtsɛ we lɛ he, ni nyɛfã he. 7Shi nyɛteŋ asafokui enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eyaŋ nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni amɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he yɛ Yehowa we lɛ. 8Ni nyɛbɔlea maŋtsɛ Yoash he kɛkpe, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahiɛ etawuu nii yɛ edɛ̃ŋ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabɛŋkɛ tabilɔi aku lɛ agbe lɛ. Ni kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ miije kpo jio, eeba shĩa jio, nyɛhĩa ehe.”
9Ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fee bɔ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada fã amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋɔ ewebii ni baaa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni kpaa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛba Osɔfo Yehoiada ŋɔɔ. 10 Ni osɔfo lɛ, ekɔlɔ akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi ni ji maŋtsɛ David nii ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ ehã mɛi ohahai anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ. 11Ni bulɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ etawuu nii yɛ edɛ̃ŋ, ni amɛdamɔ shi kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛtee maŋtsɛ we lɛ kooyigbɛ kɛbɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he kɛkpe, koni amɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he. 12Kɛkɛ ni Yehoiada jie maŋtsɛ bi, Yoash, lɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ akekre lɛ fi lɛ, ni eŋɔ kpãŋmɔ wolo ni maŋtsɛyeli he mlai yɔɔ mli lɛ ewo edɛŋ; ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ, ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu; ni maŋbii lɛ tswatswaa amɛdɛ̃, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala!”
13Be ni Maŋnyɛ Atalia nu bulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ he lɛ, eba maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ. 14 Be ni eyaakwɛ lɛ, naa maŋtsɛ hee lɛ damɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo lɛ naa akulashiŋ lɛ he, bɔ ni ji gbɛnaa lɛ; ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛkpãlɔi yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ masɛi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ miinya, ni amɛmiikpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi. Kɛkɛ ni Atalia gbala ehe atadei, ni ebolɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋjwaa sane nɛ, maŋjwaa sane nɛ!”
15Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada fã asraafoi ohahai anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ Atalia ajea asraafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛyaa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanyiɛ esɛɛ ni aaaba lɛ shɔ̃mɔ lɛ nyɛgbea lɛ.” Ejaakɛ osɔfo lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Akagbe lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.” 16No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ mli kɛmiiya maŋtsɛ we lɛ; shi jɛi amɛgbe lɛ yɛ.
Yehoiada tsake nibii ahiɛ
(2 Kronika 23.16-21)
17Ni osɔfo Yehoiada hã Maŋtsɛ Yoash kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ Yehowa kpãŋ akɛ amɛbaaba amɛjeŋ akɛ Yehowa maŋ. Ni ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ hu kpãŋ. 18 Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ ni amɛyabote Baal we lɛ, ni amɛkumɔ Baal we lɛ amɛshwie shi. Baal afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ emãgãi lɛ amɛkumɔ amɛ dukuduku; ni Mattan, ni ji Baal osɔfo lɛ, amɛgbe lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfo Yehoiada to gbɛjianɔ ni bulɔi abu Yehowa we lɛ he. 19Kɛkɛ ni lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he bulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛkpeleke shi kɛjɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛtsɔ Bulɔi Agbo lɛ naa gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛba maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni amɛhã eyata maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ. 20Akɛni agbe Atalia kɛ klante yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli jɔ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ.
21Yoash baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda be ni eye afii kpawo.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 12
Content:
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash
1Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehu maŋtsɛyeli yinɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni Yoash bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Zibia ni jɛ Beersheba lɛ. 2Yoash fee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni ehi shi lɛ, ejaakɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii. 3 Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeŋbii ajamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ akumɔɔɔ ashwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔlei kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai yɛ jɛi lolo.
4Yoash kɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Shika fɛɛ ni ajɔɔ nɔ ake ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ too ni sa akɛ ewo lɛ, kɛ shika fɛɛ shika ni mɔ ko jɛɔ etsui mli ekɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ, 5osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahe, yɛ mɔ ni lɛ ele lɛ dɛŋ, koni amɛkɛsaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ kɛ he fɛɛ he ni sa akɛ asaa lɛ.”
6Shi eba mli akɛ kɛbashi Yoash maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ esako Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ eko eko kwraa lolo. 7No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yoash tsɛ osɔfo Yehoiada kɛ osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsaaa Yehowa we lɛ tsu koi lɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, nyɛkɛ shika ni nyɛheɔ lɛ akatoa dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ nyɛŋɔa nyɛhãa koni akɛsaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.” 8Osɔfoi lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ amɛheŋ shika yɛ maŋbii lɛ adɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ni amɛsaŋ Yehowa we lɛ hu.
9Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada wo adeka ko, ni egbu enaanɔ lɛ mli folɔ, ni ekɛ adeka lɛ ma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi. Kɛji oobote Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ, adeka lɛ ye oninejurɔgbɛ; ni osɔfoi ni kwɛɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ shika fɛɛ ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ amɛwoɔ mli. 10Ni ebaa mli akɛ be fɛɛ be kɛji amɛna akɛ shika lɛ efa yɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ baa, ni amɛbakaneɔ shika ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ni amɛbafimɔɔ shika lɛ amɛwoɔ kotokui amli. 11Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛtuɔ shika ni ana lɛ amɛwoɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ; ni amɛ hu amɛkɛwoɔ kapintafoi kɛ tsumalɔi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Yehowa we lɛ anyɔmɔ. 12Ni akɛ eko woɔ bliglɛfoi kɛ tɛkolɔi anyɔmɔ, ni akɛ eko heɔ mplaŋi kɛ tɛ ni akɛsaa Yehowa we lɛ tsukoi lɛ, ni akɛ eko woɔ nyɔmɔ ni abɔɔ yɛ shĩa lɛ saamɔ he lɛ. 13Shi shika ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ aŋɔɔɔ no eko akɛfeee Yehowa we lɛ jwiɛtɛi kãi, lagbee nii, lalakãi, tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi aloo shika nii loo jwiɛtɛi nii krokomɛi; 14shi akɛhãa mɛi ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, koni akɛsaa Yehowa we lɛ. 15 Akɛni mɛi adɛŋ ni akɛ shika lɛ woɔ lɛ yeɔ anɔkwa hewɔ lɛ, ehe ehiaaa akɛ amɛbuɔ shika lɛ he akɔntaa ko. 16 Shi shika ni anaa kɛjɛɔ sɔ̃ afɔle kɛ esha afɔle lɛ mli lɛ, akɛ nomɛi baaa Yehowa we lɛ, nomɛi lɛ osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
17 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael fã ta kɛba, ni ekɛ Gat, maŋ wulu lɛ, bawu, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ. Shi be ni Hazael jie ehiɛ eka Yerusalɛm lɛ, 18 Yoash, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fɛɛ ni etsɛmɛi Yehoshafat kɛ Yehoram kɛ Ahazia, ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi ni eho lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ eke lɛ, kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ shika fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohe lɛ hu, ni etsu akɛyahã Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Hazael shi Yerusalɛm sɛɛ ni etee.
19Agbɛnɛ Yoash he saji kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 20 Maŋtsɛ Yoash tsuji lɛ te shi, ni amɛkpãŋ eyi nɔ, ni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Milo lɛ, yɛ gbɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛyaa Sila lɛ nɔ. 21Mɛi ni tswia lɛ nii ni egbo lɛ ji Yozakar, Shimeat bi lɛ kɛ Yehozabad, Shomer bi lɛ. Ni amɛfu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni Yoash bi Amazia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 13
Content:
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoahaz
1 Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash, Ahazia bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoahaz, Yehu bi lɛ bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo. 2 Efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; eshai ni Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, hã Israel fee lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ efee, ni efɔ̃ɔɔ feemɔ. 3Ni Yehowa mli wo Israel la, ni no hewɔ lɛ, daa nɛɛ Yehowa tuɔ amɛ ewoɔ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael kɛ ebi Ben-Hadad dɛŋ. 4Shi Yehoahaz kpa Yehowa fai, ni Yehowa bo lɛ toi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, ena bɔ ni Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ haoɔ Israel ehãa lɛ. 5Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jie herelɔ ko ehã, koni ebakpɔ̃ amɛ kɛje Siriabii lɛ adɛŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hi amɛshĩai lɛ amli tamɔ tsutsu lɛ yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli. 6 Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam we lɛ fee ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ; shi amɛkã he amɛfee eshai lɛ lolo; ni Ashera amãgã lɛ hu ma Samaria lolo.
7No hewɔ lɛ, Yehoahaz lɛ, asraafoi pɛ ni shwɛ hã lɛ ji okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ tayaa shwiilii nyɔŋma kɛ nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma; ejaakɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ eplene Israelbii lɛ, ni efee amɛ munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu.
8Yehoahaz he saji kɛ nibii ni efee kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 9No hewɔ lɛ, Yehoahaz gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ yɛ Samaria; ni ebi Yehoash baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash
10Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoash bɔ̃i Israel maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria. Eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa. 11Lɛ hu efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ fee, ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ, shi ekã he efee eshai lɛ lolo. 12 Ni Yoash he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee, kɛ ekãa ni efee yɛ ta ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia lɛ wu lɛ mli lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 13 Ni Yoash gbo ni ebi Yeroboam bata esɛ̃i lɛ nɔ. Afu Yoash yɛ Samaria yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi.
Elisha gbele
14 Agbɛnɛ, be ni hela ni baagbe gbalɔ Elisha lɛ mɔ lɛ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoash tee eŋɔɔ eyasara lɛ. Eyafo yɛ ehiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛ, mitsɛ! Israel hefãlɔ kpele!”
15Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɔ gãi kɛ emlibii kɛba!” Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɔ gãi kɛ emlibii kɛba eŋɔɔ. 16Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ta gãi lɛ!” Ni eta. Ni Elisha ŋɔ eniji eshwie maŋtsɛ lɛ niji anɔ. 17Ni Elisha kɛɛ, “Gbelemɔ bokãgbɛ samflɛ lɛ.” Ni egbele. Ni Elisha kɛɛ “Tsɛ̃!” Ni etsɛ̃ gãi lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa kunimyeli gãimlibi kɛ Siria nɔ kunimyeli gãimlibi nɛ, ejaakɛ obaatswia Siriabii lɛ nii yɛ Afek kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooplene amɛ.”
18Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “kɔlɔmɔ gãimlibii lɛ. Tsɛ̃rɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ gãi!” Ni etsɛ̃rɛ shii etɛ̃, ni ekpa. 19Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli fu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Eji otsɛ̃rɛ shii enumɔ loo shii ekpaa kulɛ, no lɛ obaatswia Siriabii lɛ nii aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni oooplene amɛ; shi enɛ lɛ, shii etɛ̃ pɛ obaaye Siriabii anɔ kunim.”
20Kɛkɛ ni Elisha gbo, ni afu lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, Moab ojoyeli tai lɛ batua Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ nakai afi lɛ mli. 21Ni eba mli akɛ, gbi ko be ni amɛyaafu nuu ko lɛ, naa, amɛna ojoyeli ta ko. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshɛ nuu lɛ gbonyo amɛfɔ̃ Elisha gbonyo bu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni amɛjo foi. Ni be ni nuu lɛ gbonyo lɛ he yasa Elisha wui lɛ ahe pɛ, kɛkɛ ni gbonyo lɛ hiɛ tsɛ̃, ni ete shi edamɔ enaji anɔ.
Israel kɛ Siria wu ta
22Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael hao Israelbii yɛ Yehoahaz maŋtsɛyeli be mli fɛɛ. 23 Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni etse ehiɛ ehã amɛ yɛ ekpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kɛ Yakob kɛ Isak ekpãŋ lɛ hewɔ, ni esumɔɔɔ akɛ ekpãtã amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ ehiɛ kpako emaŋ Israel lɛ nɔ kɛbashi benɛ.
24Be ni Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael gbo lɛ, ebi Ben-Hadad baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ. 25Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, Yehoahaz bi lɛ, ye Ben-Hadad, Hazael bi lɛ, nɔ kunim shii etɛ̃, ni eshɔ̃ maji ni Hazael shɔ̃ yɛ etsɛ Yehoahaz dɛŋ yɛ ta mli lɛ.

Title: 2 MAŊTSƐMƐI 14
Content:
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia
(2 Kronika 25.1-24)
1Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yoash bi Amazia, bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda. 2Be ni ebɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalɛm. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yehoadin, ni jɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ. 3Efee Yehowa suɔmɔnaanii, kɛ̃lɛ etamɔɔɔ David, mɔ seshi mli ni ejɛ lɛ. Bɔ ni etsɛ Yoash fee lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ efee. 4Ekumɔɔɔ wɔŋjamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ eshwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ miishã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai lɛ yɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ lolo.
5Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Amazia maŋtsɛyeli he shi lɛ, emɔmɔ tsuji ni gbe etsɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni egbe amɛ. 6 Shi mɛi ni gbe etsɛ lɛ abii lɛ, egbeee amɛ; ejaakɛ edamɔ Yehowa Mla ni ewo yɛ Mose Wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Akagbe fɔlɔi yɛ amɛbii atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ, ni asaŋ akagbe bii hu yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, efɔŋ ni eeefee lɛ, no he gbele lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo.”
7Amazia gbe Edombii asraafoi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ Ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni eŋɔ Sela maŋ wulu lɛ yɛ ta mli, ni ewo lɛ Yokteel kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
8No mli Amazia tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, Yehu bi Yehoahaz bi lɛ bi, ŋɔɔ ayatsɛ lɛ ŋa nɔ akɛ, “Ba ni wɔkpe nuu kɛ nuu.” 9 Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash tsu ayakɛɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia akɛ, “Naa, gbi ko lɛ ŋmei tso ko ni yɔɔ Lebanon tsu ayakɛɛ tsenedru tso ni yɔɔ Lebanon akɛ, ‘Ŋɔɔ obiyoo lɛ ohã mibinuu lɛ gbãlã.’ Ni ŋaŋ kooloo ko ni yɔɔ Lebanon lɛ baho, ni ebanaanaa ŋmei tso lɛ nɔ. 10Ogbe Edombii, hewɔ lɛ no ehã oowo ohe nɔ. Okɛ no ashwã; shi okɛ no awa owe lɛ. Mɛɛba oshwɛɔ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ he, koni bo okɛ Yuda fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã nɛɛ?”
11Shi Amazia booo toi. No hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash fã kɛtee, ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia yakpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ yɛ ta mli yɛ Bet-Shemesh ni yɔɔ Yuda nɔ mli lɛ. 12Israel ta lɛ ye Yuda ta lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ jo foi kɛtee ewe. 13Ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash mɔ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia, yɛ Bet-Shemesh, ni eŋɔ lɛ nom. Ni eba Yerusalɛm, ni ebakumɔ Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ, kɛjɛ Efraim Agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi Koŋ Agbo lɛ naa ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ohai ejwɛ. 14Ni eloo shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohei lɛ kɛ nomii hu kɛku esɛɛ kɛtee Samaria.
15Yehoash he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii ni efee lɛ, kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia wu ehã lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 16Ni Yehoash gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria yɛ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ. Ni ebi Yeroboam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia gbele
(2 Kronika 25.1-24)
17Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia hi shi eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ. 18Maŋtsɛ Amazia he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
19 Atee Amazia yinɔ apam koni agbe lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm; no hewɔ lɛ, ejo foi etee Lakish maŋ wulu lɛ mli; shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ tiu lɛ kɛtee Lakish, ni ayagbe lɛ yɛ jɛi. 20Ni awo egbonyo lɛ afɔ̃ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni abafu lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ etsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli. 21Ni Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ Azaria, ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ Amazia sɛɛ. 22Azaria ye Elat nɔ kunim, ni ekpɔ̃ maŋ lɛ ehã Yuda, yɛ etsɛ Amazia gbele sɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam ni ji enyɔ lɛ
