1Be ni nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ shɛ ni Israelbii ni ba lɛ ehe shi yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ, amɛ bluublu amɛbabua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalɛm. 2 Kɛkɛ ni Yeshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ enanemɛi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ ewekumɛi kɛ nitsumɔ wo mli, ni amɛma Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koni amɛshã shãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gbɔmɔ Mose Mla lɛ mli lɛ. 3 Tsɛbelɛ nomii lɛ she maŋsɛɛbii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ agbeyei moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɛ eshimaahe lɛ nɔŋŋ. Amɛshã leebi shãa afɔlei kɛ gbɛkɛ shãa afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa. 4 Amɛye asesei agbijurɔ lɛ hu, tamɔ bɔ ni ato lɛ, ni amɛshã daa gbi shãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ yibɔ ni ato ahã daa gbi lɛ naa. 5 Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ hu amɛshã daa shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee afɔlei lɛ kɛ gbii krɔŋkrɔŋi fɛɛ anɔ shãa afɔlei ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ashã lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nii ni ekɛbakeɔ Yehowa yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ. 6Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ amɛjɛ amɛbɔ̃i shãa afɔlei lɛ ashãa kɛ Yehowa hãmɔ, tsɛbelɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ anako ato shishi.
Abɔ̃i Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa
7Maŋbii lɛ hã shika kɛhã gbogbotswalɔi kɛ srɛŋkifoi lɛ anyɔmɔwoo. Asaŋ amɛhã niyenii kɛ dãa kɛ mu akɛ akɛhã Sidonbii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ, koni amɛyaŋɔ tsenedru tsei kɛjɛ Lebanon kɛba Yopa ŋshɔ lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Koresh, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ, ehã amɛ hegbɛ akɛ afee lɛ.
8No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Israelbii lɛ ba Yehowa we lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, enɔ afi ni ji enyɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Yeshua, Yozadak bi lɛ, kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba Yerusalɛm lɛ bɔ̃i nitsumɔ lɛ. Amɛfamɔ Levibii fɛɛ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ koni amɛkwɛ Yehowa we lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ. 9Yeshua kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, kɛ Kadmiel kɛ ebii lɛ ni ji Yuda weku lɛ, fee ekome kɛkɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ lɛ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ. Levibii ni jɛ Henadad weku lɛ mli kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi hu ye bua amɛ.
10 Be ni tsumalɔi lɛ to Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shishi lɛ, osɔfoi ni ewula kɛ amɛtadei lɛ badamɔ shi kɛ amɛtɛtrɛmantrɛi ni amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛ Levibii lɛ ni ji Asafbii lɛ hu kɛ amɛŋoŋoi, koni amɛkafo Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ David eto gbɛjianɔ lɛ. 11 Amɛla ni amɛhereheree nɔ amɛkɛkafo Yehowa, ni amɛkɛda lɛ shi amɛkɛɛ,
“Ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ Israel lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.”
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔ oshe waa amɛkɛkafo Yehowa yɛ Yehowa shĩa lɛ shishitoo lɛ hewɔ. 12Shi Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii, mɛi ni ji hiimeji ni na klɛŋklɛŋ shĩa lɛ fo waa, be ni ato shĩa nɛɛ shishi yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ; shi mɛi babaoo hu bɔ oshe waa kɛ nyamɔ. 13No hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ yooo emli nɔ ni ji nyamɔ oshebɔɔ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji yaafo blɔmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ bɔ oshe waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni anu yɛ shɔŋŋ.

Title: EZRA 4
Content:
Atsi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa naa
1Agbɛnɛ be ni Yuda kɛ Benyamin henyɛlɔi lɛ nu akɛ mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ miima Sɔlemɔtsu amɛha Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, 2 amɛba Zerubabel kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ nyɛ amãa; ejaakɛ nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni nyɛjaa lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔjaa, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔshãa afɔle wɔhãa kɛjɛ Esar-Hadon Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ŋɔ wɔ kɛba biɛ lɛ yinɔ.”
3Shi Zerubabel kɛ Yeshua kɛ Israel tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ wɔmiima shĩa wɔhã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeee wɔkɛ nyɛ sane ni; shi wɔ sɔŋŋ wɔɔɔma wɔhã Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni maŋtsɛ Koresh, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo wɔ kitã lɛ.”
4Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni eba ebahi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tao akɛ amɛhã Yudafoi lɛ anijiaŋ aje wui ni amɛwo Yudafoi lɛ ahe gbeyei koni amɛkama shĩa lɛ. 5Amɛbɔ amralofoi apaa amɛwo Yudafoi lɛ koni amɛhã Yudafoi lɛ ayiŋtoo lɛ afee efolo kɛjɛ Koresh, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ, be mli aahu kɛyashi Dario, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ.
6 Be mli ni Ahashwerosh bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ŋmãa wolo kɛyafolɔɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ anaa.
7Asaŋ Artashasta yinɔ lɛ Bislam kɛ Mitredat kɛ Tabeel kɛ enanemɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ŋmã wolo yahã Artashasta, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ. Aŋmã wolo lɛ yɛ Siriabii aniŋmãa mli, ni atsɔ̃ɔ shishi hu yɛ Siria wiemɔ mli.
8Rehum, ajinafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ ŋma Yerusalɛm he wolo amɛyahã maŋtsɛ Artashasta akɛ,
9“Mɛi ni ŋmã wolo nɛɛ ji Rehum, ajinafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni fata amɛhe kɛtsuɔ nii lɛ kɛ, kojolɔi lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ mlijai anɔyelɔi kɛ tsujinukpai kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Erek kɛ Babilon kɛ Susa, ni ji Elambii lɛ, 10kɛ mɛi krokomɛi ni eshwɛ ni Osnapar gbɔmɔ wulu ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ loo amɛ ebato Samaria maji lɛ amli kɛ hei krokomɛi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ.”
11Wolo lɛ mli sane nɛ,
“Aaŋmã wolo nɛɛ ayahã maŋtsɛ Artashasta. Maŋtsɛ Artashasta tsuji ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ adɛŋ wolo nɛɛ jɛ. 12Wɔmiitao ni Maŋtsɛ ana ale akɛ Yudafoi lɛ ni jɛ oŋɔɔ ba wɔŋɔɔ nɛɛ ebahe shi yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛmiito atuatselɔi amaŋ fɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Amɛtswa ehe gbogboi lɛ amɛgbe naa etã, ni amɛmiisaa eshishitoo lɛ hu. 13Shi belɛ, Maŋtsɛ ana ale akɛ kɛji ato nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ ni agbe ehe gbogboi lɛ anaa lɛ, no lɛ maŋbii lɛ woŋ onia kɛ maŋ too kɛ gbɛjee too lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni be ni yi yaawula shi lɛ, ebaaye maŋtsɛ fotro lɛ awui. 14No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni Nii dɛŋ nii wɔyeɔ hewɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ wɔɔɔkwɛ ni Maŋtsɛ he guɔ agbo; ni no hewɔ wɔtsu koni abatswa Maŋtsɛ adafi nɛɛ, 15koni atao yɛ otsɛmɛi awolo ni aŋmã nibii ni eba awo mli afɔ̃ shi lɛ mli. Kɛji akwɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, abaana yɛ mli akɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni. Amɛwoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ mlijai anɔyelɔi anaagba; ni kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, mɛi ayiŋ amɛwoɔ koni atse atua. Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ ajwa maŋ nɛɛ. 16Wɔmiihã Maŋtsɛ ale akɛ kɛji ato nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni atswa ehe gbogboi lɛ, no lɛ, bo Nii, onaŋ nɔyeli he ko yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ.”
17Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu akɛ hetoo ba akɛ,
“Miiŋma wolo nɛɛ mayahã Rehum, ajinafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛhefatalɔi ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ Samaria kɛ hei krokomɛi yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛ lɛ, miiŋa nyɛ.
18“Wolo ni nyɛkɛtsu akɛbahã wɔ lɛ, akane shishitsɔɔmɔ atsɔ̃ɔ mi. 19Mifã ni atao mli; ni ana akɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ maŋ nɛɛ teɔ shi ewoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; atseɔ atua, yɛ mli, ni awoɔ mɛi ayiŋ yɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ ahe. 20Asaŋ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji hu ehi Yerusalɛm ni amɛye Eufrate Faa lɛ biɛgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni atsuɔ onia kɛ maŋ too kɛ gbɛjee shika ahãa amɛ. 21No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛwoa akpɔ koni nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ afɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ too, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni akpɔ aaajɛ miŋɔɔ aba. 22Nyɛkɛ sane nɛɛ akashashaoa shi, koni nibii akabafite waa wo mi.”
23Be ni akane Maŋtsɛ Artashasta wolo ni eŋmã lɛ yɛ Rehum kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni fata amɛhe kɛtsuɔ nii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, amɛyiŋ kɛba Yerusalɛm oya, ni amɛbanina Yudafoi lɛ. Amɛkɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔnyɛɛ tsi Yudafoi lɛ anaa.
Abɔ̃i Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa ekoŋŋ
24 Kɛkɛ ni afɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ he nitsumɔ; ni ekã shi nakai kɛyashi Maŋtsɛ Dario, Persia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.

Title: EZRA 5
Content:
1Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ Hagai kɛ gbalɔ Zakaria, Ido bi lɛ, gba yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli amɛhã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ. 2 Kɛkɛ ni Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Yeshua, Yozadak bi lɛ, te shi ni amɛbɔi Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ mãa. Nyɔŋmɔ gbalɔi enyɔ lɛ fĩ amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛwa amɛ.
3Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Tatnai ni ji amralo ni kwɛɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ kɛ Shetar-Boznai kɛ amɛnanemɛi lɛ, ba mɛi ni maa tsu lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nɔ ni amɛbi mɛi ni maa lɛ nɛ, “Namɔ fã nyɛ akɛ nyɛma nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ ni nyɛgbe naa?” 4Asaŋ amɛbi mɛi ni maa tsu lɛ akɛ, “Hii ni maa lɛ, te amɛgbɛii hu?” 5 Shi Yudafoi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiŋmɛi kã Yudafoi onukpai lɛ ahe, ni mɛi ni ba lɛ, atsiii amɛ gbɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni sane lɛ yashɛ Dario ŋɔɔ ni eŋma hetoo kɛba.
6Wolo ni Tatnai ni ji amralo ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ kɛ Shetar-Boznai kɛ mɛi ni fata amɛhe ni ji amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ tsu akɛyahã maŋtsɛ Dario lɛ mli lɛ, amɛbɔ lɛ amaniɛ, ni amaniɛ lɛ nɛ,
7“Akɛ wolo nɛɛ miitsu ayahã Maŋtsɛ Dario. Nii hã manye!
8Wɔmiitao ni Maŋtsɛ ana ale akɛ wɔyiŋ wɔtee Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔtee Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ we lɛ. Aama kɛ tɛi kpeleikpelei, ni akɛ tsei eshwie egbogboi lɛ anɔ. Ahiɛ nɛkɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ mli kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ, ni eeya nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii lɛ adɛŋ.
9Kɛkɛ ni wɔbi amɛnukpai lɛ mɔ ni fã amɛ akɛ amɛma nɛkɛ shĩa nɛɛ ni amɛsaa ehe kɛ emli amɛgbe naa lɛ. 10Asaŋ wɔbibii amɛgbɛii hu, koni wɔŋmala amɛnukpai lɛ agbɛii ni wɔhã ole.
11Hetoo ni amɛhã wɔ nɛ, ‘Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji ji wɔ. Wɔmiisaa shĩa ni Israel maŋtsɛ agbo ko ma ni egbe naa jeeŋmɔ afii babaoo nɛ lɛ. 12 Shi akɛni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wo ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli la hewɔ lɛ, ehã Babilon maŋtsɛ, Nebukadnezar, Kaldeanyo lɛ, baye amɛnɔ kunim. Nebukadnezar kumɔ nɛkɛ shĩa nɛɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋbii lɛ nom kɛtee Babilon. 13 Shi Koresh, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yinɔ klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo akpɔ akɛ abama nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ. 14Shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛ jwiɛtɛi nibii ni Nebukadnezar baloo yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ mli ni ekɛyawo Sɔlemɔtsu ni yɔɔ Babilon lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ Koresh jie yɛ Babilon Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli. Etu ewo mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sheshbazar ko ní ewo lɛ amralo yɛ Yuda lɛ dɛŋ; 15ni efã Sheshbazar koni ekɛ nibii nɛɛ aya ni ekɛyawo Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ mli koni ehã asaa ama Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ yɛ eshimaahe lɛ. 16Kɛkɛ ni nɛkɛ Sheshbazar nɛɛ ba ni ebato Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ shishi. Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ mli aahu kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ akã he aama, shi agbeko naa lolo.’
17No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji esa Maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehã atao yɛ he ni akɛ saji ni aŋmala ashwie shi lɛ toɔ, yɛ Babilon lɛ, akɛ eyɛ mli akɛ Maŋtsɛ Koresh ewo akpɔ akɛ ayama nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ Yerusalɛm lo, koni Maŋtsɛ atsu ni abakɛɛ wɔ nɔ ni esumɔɔ ni afee yɛ sane nɛɛ he.”

Title: EZRA 6
Content:
Ayana akpɔ ni Koresh wo lɛ
1Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Dario fã koni ayatao yɛ shĩa ni akɛ saji ni aŋmala ashwie shi lɛ toɔ mli yɛ Babilon lɛ. 2Shi Ekbatana, maŋtsɛmaŋ ni yɔɔ Media shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli ji he ni ayana wolo ko yɛ; ni sane ni aŋmã yɛ mli nɛ,
3“Maŋtsɛ Koresh klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo akpɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ he akɛ:
‘Nyɔŋmɔ shĩa ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm ni ashãa afɔlei yɛ mli lɛ, ama, ni ahã eshishitoo lɛ awa. Ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. 4Egbogboi lɛ bɔ ni abaatswa lɛ nɛ, Kɛ atswa tɛi wuji klɛmpɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ ashwie nɔ tso klɛmpɛ kome. Nyɔmɔ ni aaabɔ yɛ he lɛ, ajɛ maŋtsɛ we fotro lɛ mli awo. 5Asaŋ shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛ jwiɛtɛi nibii ni Nebukadnezar yaloo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ mli ni ekɛba Babilon lɛ, akɛku sɛɛ ahã ni akɛya Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ mli ni akɛyato amɛtoohe koni ahã ahi Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.’ ”
Dario fã ni aya nɔ atsu nii lɛ
6Kɛkɛ ni Dario ŋmã hetoo eyahã Tatnai, faa lɛ anaigbɛ amralo lɛ, kɛ Shetar-Boznai kɛ amraloi ni fata amɛhe yɛ faa lɛ anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni efã amɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛjea jɛi nyɛyaa sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. 7Nyɛŋmɛa gbɛ koni atsu Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ; nyɛkagbaa nitsumɔ lɛ naa. Nyɛhãa Yudafoi lɛ amralo lɛ kɛ amɛ onukpai lɛ amã Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ yɛ emãahe lɛ. 8Asaŋ miiwo akpɔ matsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni esa akɛ nyɛfee nyɛhã nɛkɛ Yudafoi onukpai nɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shĩa lɛ maa lɛ gbɛfaŋ. Onia ni atsuɔ yɛ faa lɛ anaigbɛ ahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, aye oyai ni ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ emli eko ni amɛkɛwo nyɔmɔ ni aaabɔ lɛ fɛɛ koni nitsumɔ lɛ akakpɛŋsɛŋ. 9Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he hiaa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ: tsinai oblahii, ojwɛnii, toi aloo toobii ni akɛshãa shãa afɔlei ahãa ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋmãa, ŋoo, wain loo mu lɛ, ahã osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ; ahã amɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi; ni akafo mli, 10koni amɛshã afɔlei ni jeɔ ŋma amɛhã ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkpa fai koni maŋtsɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ ayi ana wala. 11Asaŋ miiwo akpɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsake fãmɔ ni mifã nɛɛ hiɛ lɛ, ajie etsu nɔ mplaŋ ni agbɔ naa akɛtsu emli. Ahã eshĩa lɛ atsɔ̃ tumo. 12Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni fee shĩa nɛɛ ejamɔhe lɛ abutu maŋtsɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaka akɛ eeetsake fãmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ aloo akɛ eeekumɔ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ. Mi, Dario, miwo akpɔ nɛɛ. Aye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.”
Agbele Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa
13Kɛkɛ ni Tatnai, faa lɛ anaigbɛ amralo lɛ, kɛ Shetar-Boznai kɛ amɛnanemɛi nitsulɔi lɛ fee bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Dario fã akɛ afee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 14 Yudafoi onukpai lɛ ma Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etee nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Hagai, gbalɔ lɛ, kɛ Zakaria, Ido bi lɛ, gbalɛ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛma, ni amɛgbe naa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã lɛ kɛ Persia maŋtsɛ Koresh kɛ Dario Artashasta akpɔ lɛ naa. 15Agbe shĩa lɛ naa yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, yɛ Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ. 16 Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ, osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ye gbi ni agbeleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ naa lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ. Amɛye lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ. 17Ni Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ naagbelemɔ lɛ mli lɛ amɛkɛ tsinai oha, ojwɛnii ohai enyɔ, toobii ohai ejwɛ shã afɔle; ni amɛkɛ too kpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ shã shãa afɔle amɛhã Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ayibɔ lɛ naa. 18 Ni amɛto osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛsafokui lɛ, kɛ Levibii yɛ amɛmlijai lɛ anaa amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, taakɛ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mose wolo lɛ mli lɛ.
Hehoo lɛ
19 Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ ye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ. 20Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ bluublu etsɔ̃ hiɛ amɛtsuu amɛhe, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhe etse. Amɛgbe Hehoo toobii lɛ amɛhã mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe. 21Israelbii lɛ ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ ye Hehoo toobi lɛ. Mɛi krokomɛi hu ni ye ji mɛi fɛɛ ni etse amɛhe yɛ nii ni buleɔ mɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔŋjalɔi feɔ lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe ebabɔ Israelbii lɛ ahe koni amɛtao Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ lɛ. 22Amɛkɛ nyamɔ ye Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo; ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã amɛmli efili amɛ, akɛni ehã Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui emɔ amɛ koni ewo amɛ hewalɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ.

Title: EZRA 7
Content:
Ezra bashɛ Yerusalɛm
1 Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ yɛ Persia Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ lɛ, nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ezra lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Babilon kɛba. Lɛ ji Ezra, Seraia bi kɛ Azaria nabi lɛ. Ezra kaŋsowa kɛ nanashishiu kɛ nanadadao kɛ nii kɛ nii ji Hilkia kɛ 2Shalum kɛ Zadok kɛ Ahitub kɛ 3Amaria kɛ Azaria kɛ Meraiot kɛ 4Zerahia kɛ Uzi kɛ Buki kɛ 5Abishua kɛ Finehas kɛ Eleazar kɛ osɔfonukpa Aaron.
6 Ezra ni jɛ Babilon ba nɛɛ, eji mlatsɔɔlɔ, ni mla ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ, ele mli jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ yɛ enɔ; hewɔ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa lɛ. 7Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ Osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu fata Ezra he kɛba. 8Amɛbashɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ maŋtsɛ Artashasta maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ. 9Be ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ Babilon ji klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ, ni nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbashɛ Yerusalɛm, yɛ Ezra Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yelikɛbuamɔ naa. 10Ejaakɛ nɔ ni kã Ezra tsui nɔ ji akɛ eeekase Yehowa mla lɛ ni eye nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akpɔi lɛ kɛ mlai lɛ yɛ Israel maŋ lɛ mli.
Wolo ni Artashasta kɛhã Ezra
11Wolo ni Maŋtsɛ Artashasta kɛhã Ezra, osɔfo kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ lɛ ni le Yehowa kitãi kɛ akpɔi ni ewo Israel lɛ amli jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli sane nɛ,
12 “Artashasta, maŋtsɛmɛi amaŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋmã ehã osɔfo Ezra ni ji mlatsɔɔlɔ ni le ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ.
13“Miiwo akpɔ akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni jɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛaatee Yerusalɛm lɛ, amɛkɛ bo aya. 14Maŋtsɛ kɛ ejinafoi kpawo lɛ tsuɔ bo koni oyatao Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm saji amli yɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla ni ohiɛ lɛ naa. 15Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni maŋtsɛ kɛ ejinafoi lɛ eke Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni eshihilɛhe yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, ŋɔɔ kɛya. 16Ŋɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ hu ni ooona yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛya. Asaŋ, nikeenii ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ aaake yɛ tsuijurɔ naa yɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ no hu kɛya.
17“Nɛkɛ shika nɛɛ kwɛmɔ ni akɛhe tsinai, ojwɛnii, toobii kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔle, koni okɛyashã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ nɔ. 18Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni aaashwɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfea nɔ ni sa okɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ahiɛ ni nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sumɔɔ. 19Asaŋ nibii ni akɛhã bo ni akɛsɔmɔ yɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, tuu ohã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ hiɛ. 20Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaahia lolo yɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ hewɔ ni sa akɛ ohã lɛ, jɛɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli ohe.
21“Mi, Maŋtsɛ Artashasta, miiwo jwetritolɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ akpɔ akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni osɔfo Ezra, mlatsɔɔlɔ ni le ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ, aaabi nyɛ lɛ, aye oyai ni afee, 22kɛyashi jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha, kɛ ŋmaa nsɛnitɛ wulu akpei nyɔŋma, kɛ wain litai akpei enyɔ kɛ mu litai akpei enyɔ, kɛ ŋoo tsiimɔ bɔ ni he ehia. 23Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ŋwɛi maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo he akpɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa ni afea fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We lɛ he koni emli akafu maŋtsɛ kɛ ebii ni baaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ. 24Asaŋ wɔmiihã nyɛna nyɛle akɛ osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ lalɔi kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ tsuji ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛŋ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etsuɔ amɛ onia loo too loo gbɛjee shika ko.
25“Ni bo, Ezra hu, yɛ nilee ni oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã bo lɛ naa lɛ, fãamɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ sane amɛyeɔ kɛ kojolɔi fɛɛ ni le oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ koni amɛkojo mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ ateŋ saji. Mɛi ni leee lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃a amɛ ni amɛle. 26Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeee oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, akojo lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ koni toigbalamɔ ni sa lɛ akɛhã lɛ. Gbele jio, naneshitutswaa jio, nii anaatsii jio, tsuŋwoo jio.”
Ezra jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi
27Kɛkɛ ni Ezra kɛɛ, “Ajie Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi akɛ ekɛ nɛkɛ nɔ ko wo maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ akɛ ewula Yehowa we ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ. 28Yɛ mɔbɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ena mi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mina hiɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ejinafoi lɛ kɛ elumɛi agboi lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. Hewalɛ ni ewo mi hewɔ lɛ mina ekãa mikɛbua Israelbii lɛ ateŋ onukpai lɛ anaa koni amɛkɛ mi afã kɛba.”

Title: EZRA 8
Content:
Mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba
1Mɛi ni kɛ mi, Ezra, fã kɛjɛ Babilon, be mli ni Artashasta yeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai nɛ:
2Finehas we lɛ, Gershom ji mɔ ni jɛ jɛi. Itamar we lɛ, Daniel. David we lɛ, Hatush, Shekania bi lɛ.
3Parosh we lɛ, Zakaria kɛ hii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni aŋmala amɛgbɛii ashi enɔ.
4Pahat-Moab we lɛ, Elihoenai, Zeharia bi lɛ ni hii ohai enyɔ shi enɔ.
5Zatu we lɛ, Shekania, Yahaziel bi lɛ, ni hii ohai etɛ̃ shi enɔ.
6Adin we lɛ, Ebed, Yonatan bi lɛ, ni hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ shi enɔ lɛ.
7Elam we lɛ, Yeshaia, Atalia bi lɛ, ni hii nyɔŋmai kpawo shi enɔ.
8Shefatia we lɛ, Zebadia, Mikael bi lɛ; hii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ shi enɔ.
9Yoab we lɛ, Obadia, Yehiel bi lɛ, ni hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ shi enɔ.
10Bani we lɛ, Shelomit, Yosifia bi lɛ, ni hii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa shi enɔ.
11Bebai we lɛ, Zakaria, Bebai bi lɛ; hii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ shi enɔ.
12Azgad we lɛ, Yohanan, Hakatan bi lɛ; ni hii oha kɛ nyɔŋma shi enɔ.
13Adonikam we lɛ bii ba sɛɛkpee. Amɛgbɛii nɛ: Elifelet, Yeuel kɛ Shemaia; ni hii nyɔŋmai ekpaa shi amɛnɔ.
14Bigewai we lɛ, Utai kɛ Zakur; ni hii nyɔŋmai kpawo shi amɛnɔ.
Ezra tao Levibii hã Sɔlemɔ We lɛ nitsumɔ
15Mibua amɛnaa kɛtee faa ko ni hoɔ kɛyaa Ahawa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ toi. Wɔhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃. Be ni mikpa maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ lɛ minaaa Levinyo ko yɛ jɛi. 16No hewɔ lɛ, mitsu ayatsɛ Eliezer kɛ Ariel kɛ Shemaia kɛ Elnatan kɛ Yarib Elnatan kɛ Natan kɛ Zakaria kɛ Meshulam ni ji hiɛnaanɔbii, kɛ Yoiarib kɛ Elnatan ni ji tsɔɔlɔi hu lɛ kɛba. 17Mitsu amɛ Ido, Kasifia maŋ lɛ mli onukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ. Mihã amɛ wiemɔ ni amɛkɛyahã Ido kɛ enanemɛi Sɔlemɔ We sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni yɔɔ Kasifia maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, koni amɛwo mɛi agbɛ kɛba Kasifia maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛbasɔmɔ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ. 18WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dromɔ naa lɛ, amɛkɛ Sherebia, nuu ko ni hiɛ kã shi ni jɛ Maheli ni ji Levi bi kɛ Israel nabi lɛ tsɛmɛiawebii lɛ ateŋ, kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfeɔ gbɔmɛi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ bahã wɔ. 19Amɛkɛ Hashabia kɛ Yeshaia ni jɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni ji enyɛmimɛi kɛ ebii hu bahã wɔ. 20Sɔlemɔ We sɔ̃ɔlɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni David kɛ etsuji lɛ hala ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Levibii lɛ fata he. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, atsi amɛgbɛii atã.
Ezra hã maŋbii lɛ kɛ lɛ hi ŋmãa
21Kɛkɛ ni mishiɛ yɛ jɛi akɛ ahi ŋmãa yɛ Ahawa Faa lɛ naa, koni wɔba wɔhe shi wɔhã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni wɔkpa lɛ fai koni ehã wɔ kɛ wɔbii kɛ wɔnabii fɛɛ afee shweshweeshwe yɛ wɔgbɛfãa lɛ mli. 22Ejaakɛ eefee mi hiɛgbele akɛ makpa maŋtsɛ lɛ fai ni ehã wɔ asraafoi kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtaralɔi ni amɛbu wɔhe yɛ henyɛlɔi ni yɔɔ gbɛteŋ lɛ ahewɔ. Eefee mi hiɛgbele ejaakɛ wɔkɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ: wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yeɔ buaa mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, shi mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ efeee nɔ ko lɛ enaaa amɛhe miishɛɛ ni egbalaa amɛtoi waa. 23No hewɔ lɛ, wɔhi ŋmãa, ni wɔkpa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai yɛ enɛ hewɔ, ni efee nɔ ni wɔbi lɛ lɛ ehã wɔ.
Nibii ni ake yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hewɔ
24 Kɛkɛ ni mifamɔ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ onukpai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ: Sherebia kɛ Hashabia kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma. 25Miŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ nibii ni ji Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nikeenii ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ejinafoi lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ Israel fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ kekee lɛ miwo amɛdɛŋ. 26-27Nɔ ni miŋmɛ miwo amɛdɛŋ lɛ nɛ:
Jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ; jwiɛtɛi tsɛnsii ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha; shika kpuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni tsiimɔ ji dalei akpe kome, tsɛnsii enyɔ ni akɛ akɔɔble kaŋkaŋ ni jara wa tamɔ shika fee. 28Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhã Yehowa, ni nibii lɛ hu he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ. Jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ tsuijurɔ naa akɛhã Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 29Nyɛbua he ni nyɛkɛtoa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaŋmɛ yɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahiɛ, yɛ Yehowa we lɛ piai lɛ amli.” 30Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ loo jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ kɛ nibii ni aŋmɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛya wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm
31Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔfã yɛ Ahawa Faa lɛ naa kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm. WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ bu wɔhe, ni ejie wɔ yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi abɔ ni yawo wɔ ka yɛ gbɛteŋ lɛ hu adɛŋ. 32Wɔshɛ Yerusalɛm, ni wɔye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi. 33Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ kɛ nibii lɛ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni atu awo Meremot, Uria bi ni ji osɔfo lɛ, kɛ Eleazar, Finehas bi ni fata ehe lɛ adɛŋ. Mɛi ni fata amɛhe ji Levibii enyɔ ni ji Yozabad, Yeshua bi lɛ, kɛ Noadia, Binui bi lɛ. 34Akane nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aŋmɛ, ni aŋma afɔ̃ shi nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ.
35Mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ bashã shãa afɔlei amɛhã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ: tsinahii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ha Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ojwɛnii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ ekpaa, kɛ toobii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo, kɛ esha he afɔle tookpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ akɛshã shãa afɔle ahã Yehowa. 36Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ mlai lɛ hã amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ye amɛbua maŋ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.

Title: EZRA 9
Content:
Yudafoi kɛ mɛi ni jeee Yudafoi miiye yooŋɔɔ
1Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ, onukpai lɛ ba miŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ mi akɛ, Israel maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tseko amɛhe yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahe, yɛ nii ni amɛfeɔ ni Yudafoi hiɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ. Nii nɛɛ ji nii ni Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Yebusbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Ijiptbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ feɔ lɛ. 2 Yudahii eŋɔŋɔɔ maŋsɛɛ yei amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe akɛ ŋamɛi, ni amɛbihii hu efee nakai nɔŋŋ. Belɛ jaku ni he tse lɛ ebule amɛhe. Onukpai lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ titri tɔ̃ɔ mla nɛɛ. 3 Be ni minu nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, migbala mihe atade kɛ mihebo, ni mifãmɔ miyiteŋ tsɔi kɛ mitsɛŋ; ni mihe jɔ̃ mihe kɛta shi. 4Kɛkɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ yɛ wiemɔi ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ wie yɛ mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ mla ni amɛtɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ miŋɔɔ. Shi mi lɛ, mihe jɔ̃ mihe kɛta shi aahu kɛyashi gbɛkɛ afɔleshãa be lɛ mli.
5Be ni gbɛkɛ afɔleshãa be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mite shi kɛ ŋkɔmɔ ni miyeɔ lɛ kɛ mihe atade kɛ mihebo ni etserɛ lɛ, ni miho mikula minakutsei anaa. Migbɛ minijiaŋ mitsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, 6 ni mikɛɛ “Ao, miNyɔŋmɔ, mihiɛ egbo, ni eefee mi hiɛgbele akɛ mawo mihiɛ nɔ makwɛ ohiɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ esu wɔ, ni wɔfɔ ni wɔye lɛ da ni ekwɔ tamɔ ŋwɛi. 7Fɔbuu kã wɔnɔ kɛjɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ayinɔ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Wɔnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ ohã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anine eshɛ wɔ kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ wɔsɔfoi lɛ anɔ. Akɛ klante ekpãtã wɔhiɛ, aŋɔ wɔ nom, wɔnibii ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ aha, ni ashwie wɔhiɛ shi tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ. 8 Agbɛnɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, oduro wɔ be kukuoo ko. Ohã wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi eye amɛhe kɛjɛ nyɔŋyeli mli, ni ohã wɔ he ko yɛ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni wɔfee shweshweeshwe yɛ jɛi; koni wɔhiŋmɛii agbele, ni wɔyi ana wala be mli ni wɔyɔɔ nyɔŋyeli mli lɛ. 9 Ejaakɛ nyɔji ji wɔ; shimɔ kɛkɛ oshiko wɔ yɛ wɔnyɔŋyeli lɛ mli; shi moŋ ohã Persia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ena wɔ mɔbɔ, ni ohã wɔyi ena wala koni wɔma oshĩa lɛ ni wɔsaa emli tsukoi lɛ. Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ efo afabaŋ ewo wɔhe yɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm, koni wɔfee shweshweeshwe.”
10“No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, mɛni wɔɔɔkɛɛ yɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ? Wɔyeee okitãi lɛ ni otsɔ̃ otsuji, gbalɔi lɛ, anine nɔ owo lɛ anɔ. 11 Amɛkɛɛ wɔ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni wɔyaa ni wɔyaŋɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni enɔ bii lɛ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii ni ahiɔ lɛ ebule lɛ. Amɛkɛ amɛnihiinii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ muji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ he. 12 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, ogbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei akahã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii agbãla; ni asaŋ, wɔkaŋɔ amɛbiyei wɔhã wɔbihii. Gbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ wɔkatao hejɔlɛ loo shweremɔ wɔhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbi ko gbi ko. Amɛkɛɛ wɔfee nakai bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe awa ni wɔye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii kpakpai lɛ ni wɔshi wɔhã wɔbii akɛ gboshinii kɛya naanɔ. 13Nii ni ba wɔnɔ akɛ toigbalamɔ yɛ wɔnishaianii kɛ wɔfɔ kpeteŋkple ni wɔye lɛ hewɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, bo wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, owoko wɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa wɔnifɔ̃jianii lɛ, ni ohã wɔhiɛ kã. 14Aso wɔɔku okitãi lɛ amli ekoŋŋ, ni wɔkɛ wɔhe ayabɔ maji ni feɔ nihiinii nɛɛ ahe ni wɔkɛ amɛ aye yooŋɔɔ lo? Aso omli fuŋ wɔ kɛyashiŋ beyinɔ ni oookpãtã wɔhiɛ ogbe naa bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko aloo mɔ ko mɔ ko hu ejeŋ mli lo? 15 Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, jalɔ ji bo; ejaakɛ ashi wɔ akɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Naa, wɔyɛ ohiɛ akɛ mɛi ni eye fɔ. Ejaakɛ wɔfɔ ni wɔye lɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ ohiɛ adamɔ.”

Title: EZRA 10
Content:
1Shi be mli ni Ezra sɔleɔ ekpaa fai ni ekɛ ehe tswiaa shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ, ni ejajeɔ eshai ni Israel efee lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii, babua amɛhe naa kɛbɔle lɛ. Amɛmiifo blobloblo. 2Kɛkɛ ni Shekania, Yehiel bi lɛ ni jɛ Elam tsɛmɛiawebii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kɛ Ezra wie ekɛɛ, “Wɔtɔ̃ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ wɔyaŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ateŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ tete hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ hã Israel yɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ. 3No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔkɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ akpãŋa, koni wɔshwie yei lɛ kɛ bii lɛ hu yɛ minuŋtsɔ kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã lɛ gbeyei lɛ aŋaawoo naa, koni wɔye mla lɛ nɔ. 4Kwɛmɔ ni ofee, ejaakɛ bo osane ni. Wɔfĩ osɛɛ; feemɔ ekãa ni otsu he nii.”
5Kɛkɛ ni Ezra te shi, ni ebi osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ nukpai lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛkãmɔ kitã akɛ amɛbaafee bɔ ni akɛɛ lɛ ni amɛkãmɔ kitã lɛ. 6Kɛkɛ ni Ezra te shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Yehohanan, ni ji Eliashib bi lɛ, sɛɛtsu lɛ mli. Ehi jɛi ni eyeee nii lɛ, asaŋ enuuu nu hu, ejaakɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ mla ni mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ etɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.
7Agbɛnɛ ashiɛ yɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm fɛɛ ahã mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba lɛ akɛ amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛbakpe yɛ Yerusalɛm. 8Akɛɛ kɛshi nɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaa kɛyashi gbii etɛ̃, tamɔ bɔ ni lumɛi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ efã akɛ aba lɛ, aaajɔɔ enii anɔ ake, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu aaajie lɛ yɛ mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ ateŋ. 9Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛ Benyaminhii lɛ babua amɛhe naa kɛkpe yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ mli, yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baho tara he ko kpataa ko ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ lɛ. Gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ yɛ sane nɛɛ he, ni asaŋ nu ni nɛɔ waa lɛ ehã amɛmiikpokpo.
10Osɔfo Ezra te shi damɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtɔ̃, ejaakɛ nyɛyaŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei, ni nyɛkɛhã Israel fɔ ni eye lɛ eda. 11No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjajea nyɛtsɔ̃a Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; nyɛfea esuɔmɔnaanii, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ ahe.”
12Kɛkɛ ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ waa amɛkɛɛ, “Nakai ni; esa akɛ wɔfee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ. 13Shi wɔyi fa babaoo naakpa yɛ biɛ, ni nunɛmɔ be nɛ. Wɔnyɛŋ blohu nɛɛŋ wɔdamɔ, be mli ni nitsumɔ lɛ ejeee gbi kome loo gbii enyɔ tete nitsumɔ, ejaakɛ wɔfee efɔŋ waa yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli. 14No hewɔ lɛ, hã wɔlumɛi lɛ aye asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ najiaŋ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ wɔmaji lɛ amli ni amɛŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ aba yɛ be ni ato mli. Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli onukpai kɛ emli kojolɔi afata amɛhe kɛba, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mlifu ni naa wa ni kã wɔnɔ lɛ aaaje wɔnɔ.” 15Mɛi pɛ ni te shi shi nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ ji Yonatan, Asahel bi lɛ, kɛ Yahezeia, Tikwa bi lɛ; ni Meshulam kɛ Shabetai, Levinyo lɛ, fĩ amɛsɛɛ.
16Mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ fee tamɔ bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ lɛ. Afãmɔ osɔfo Ezra kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, ni atsi amɛ fɛɛ amɛgbɛii atã. Nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛyatara shi koni amɛtao sane lɛ mli. 17Be ni shɛɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ hii fɛɛ ni eŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ egbe naa.
Hii ni ŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ agbɛii
18Yɛ osɔfoi abii agbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɛi ni ana yɛ tsɛmɛi awe ji Yeshua, Yozadak bi lɛ ni enyɛmimɛi abii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni amɛŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei ji: Maseia kɛ Eliezer kɛ Yarib kɛ Gedalia.
19Amɛwo shi akɛ amɛaashwie amɛŋamɛi lɛ. Amɛfɔ ni amɛye hewɔ lɛ amɛhã ojwɛni koni akɛshã sɔ̃ afɔle.
20Imer tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ mɛi ni hiɛ maŋsɛɛ yei ji Hanani kɛ Zebadia.
21Harim tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Maaseia kɛ Elia kɛ Shemaia kɛ Yehiel kɛ Uzia.
22Pashur tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Elioenai kɛ Maaseia kɛ Ishmael kɛ Netanel kɛ Yozabad kɛ Elasa.
23Levibii ateŋ lɛ, Yozabad kɛ Shimei kɛ Kelaia ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Kelita hu lɛ, kɛ Petania kɛ Yuda kɛ Eliezer.
24Lalatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Eliashib. Agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Shalum kɛ Telem kɛ Uri.
25Parosh tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Ramia kɛ Izia kɛ Malkia kɛ Miyamin kɛ Eleazar kɛ Malkia kɛ Benaia.
26Elam tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Matania kɛ Zakaria kɛ Yehiel kɛ Abdi kɛ Yeremot kɛ Elia.
27Zatu tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Elivenai kɛ Eliashib kɛ Matania kɛ Yeremot kɛ Zabad kɛ Aziza.
28Bebai tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Yehohanan kɛ Hanania kɛ Zabai kɛ Atlai.
29Bani tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Meshulam kɛ Maluk kɛ Adaia kɛ Yashub kɛ Sheal kɛ Yeremot.
30Pahat-Moab tsɛmɛi awe lɛ abii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Adna kɛ Kelal kɛ Benaia kɛ Maaseia kɛ Matania kɛ Bezaleel kɛ Binui kɛ Manase.
31Harim tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Eliezer kɛ Ishia kɛ Malkia kɛ Shemaia kɛ Simeon,
32kɛ Benyamin kɛ Maluk kɛ Shemaria.
33Hashum tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Matenai kɛ Matata kɛ Zabad kɛ Elifelet kɛ Yeremai kɛ Manase kɛ Shimei.
34Bani tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ: Maadai kɛ Amram kɛ Uel,
35kɛ Benaia kɛ Bedeia kɛ Keluhi
36kɛ Vania kɛ Meremot kɛ Eliashib
37kɛ Matania kɛ Matenai kɛ Yaasu.
38Bani tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ: Shimei kɛ Binui
39Shelemia kɛ Natan kɛ Adaia,
40kɛ Maknadebai kɛ Shashai kɛ Sharai
41kɛ Azarel kɛ Shelemia kɛ Shemaria
42kɛ Shalum kɛ Amaria kɛ Yosef.
43Nebo tsɛmɛi awe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ: Yeiel kɛ Matitia kɛ Zabad kɛ Zebina kɛ Yadau kɛ Yoel kɛ Benaia.
44Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei; hewɔ lɛ amɛ shwie yei lɛ kɛ amɛbii lɛ fɛɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Aaanyɛ aja Nehemia wolo lɛ mli ejwɛ.
1. Nehemia ku esɛɛ eba Yerusalɛm. Persia Maŋtsɛ Wulu lɛ wo lɛ gbɛ akɛ ebaye amralo yɛ Yuda.
2. Asaa Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ atswa, ni Nehemia ji mɔ ni kwɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ.
3. Ezra kane Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ, ni amɛjaje amɛhe eshai.
4. Nibii krokomɛi ni Nehemia fee akɛ amralo yɛ Yuda.
Nɔ ko ni je kpo faŋŋ yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli ji odase ni aye yɛ Nehemia he akɛ ekɛ ehe fɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ jogbaŋŋ, ni esɔle kpitiookpitioo hu lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Nehemia ku esɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm 1.1—2.20
Asaa Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ atswa 3.1—7.73
Akane Mla lɛ, ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ saa kpãŋ ekoŋŋ 8.1—10.39
Nibii krokomɛi ni Nehemia fee 11.1—13.31

Title: NEHEMIA 1
Content:
Nehemia hao yɛ Yerusalɛm
1Nehemia, Hakalia bi lɛ, saji nɛ. Yɛ Kislev nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, miyɛ Susa, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli, 2ni Hanani ni ji minyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ kɛ hii komɛi jɛ Yuda ba. Mibi amɛ Yudafoi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni hiɛ kã lolo lɛ ahe sane kɛ Yerusalɛm hu he sane. 3Amɛto he akɛ, “Mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni hiɛ kã lolo ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ miina amanehulu kpele, ni amɛhiɛ eshwie shi. Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ akumɔ ashwie shi, ni enaa agboi lɛ ashã.
4Be ni minu wiemɔ nɛɛ miho mita shi, ni mifo.
“Miye ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ, ni mihi ŋmãa. Misɔle mikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, 5ni mikɛɛ, ‘Oo Yehowa, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ni oda ni ohe yɔɔ gbeyei! Okɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee yeɔ kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ mɛi ni sumɔɔ bo, ni amɛyeɔ okitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ kpãŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo. 6Kwɛmɔ, ni oka otoi ohã fai ni mi, otsulɔ, mikpaa bo nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane mihãa otsuji Israelbii lɛ. Miijaje akɛ wɔ, Israelbii, wɔfee esha wɔshi bo; ni mi kɛ mitsɛwe lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ fɔ yɛ enɛ mli. 7Wɔfee efɔŋ ni naa wa naakpa wɔshi bo, ejaakɛ wɔyeko kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni owo kɛtsɔ̃ otsulɔ Mose nɔ lɛ anɔ.’ 8 Kaimɔ wiemɔ ni okɛ otsulɔ Mose wie akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛyeee mi anɔkwa lɛ, magbɛ nyɛ mashwã maji anɔ, 9shi kɛji nyɛkpale kɛba miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛye mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛji mɛi ni agbɛ ashwã lɛ yaje jeŋ naagbeehe tete lɛ, mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ jɛi tɔ̃ɔ, ni makpala amɛ kɛaaba he ni mito ni aja mi yɛ lɛ.’
10“Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji otsuji kɛ omaŋ ni okɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ekpɔ̃ lɛ. 11 Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ka otoi ohã fai ni otsulɔ kpaa bo lɛ. Ka toi ohã fai ni otsuji ni sumɔɔ akɛ amɛshe bo gbeyei lɛ kpaa bo lɛ. Hã otsulɔ aye omanye ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni hã maŋtsɛ lɛ ana mi mɔbɔ.”
Nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ dãawolɔ ji mi.

Title: NEHEMIA 2
Content:
Nehemia tee Yerusalɛm
1Gbi ko yɛ Nisan nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ miiye nii, ni wain ma ehiɛ. Miwo wain lɛ, ni mikɛhã lɛ. Enako mi ni mifee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ ehiɛ pɛŋ. 2Ebi mi akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni ohiɛ efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ, ni jeee akɛ ohe hu ni yeɔ lɛ? Jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni fe akɛ ooye awerɛhoo yɛ otsui mli.”
Mihɛle shi amrɔ nɛkɛ, 3 ni mikɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ! Nii, mɛɛba ni esaaa akɛ mihiɛ afee mɔbɔmɔbɔ be ni maŋ ni ji he ni mitsɛmɛi asaŋi yɔɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni ashã ehe agboi lɛ?”
4Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Mɛni ji nɔ ni otaoɔ?”
No hewɔ lɛ, misɔle mikpa ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, 5ni mikɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji esa maŋtsɛ hiɛ, ni kɛji otsulɔ hiɛ eba nyam yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, no lɛ hã maya Yuda yɛ maŋ ni afu mitsɛmɛi yɛ mli lɛ mli, koni mayasaa mama maŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ.”
6Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Maŋnyɛ lɛ ta maŋtsɛ lɛ masɛi, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Gbii enyiɛ oyaaye, ni mɛɛbe oooku osɛɛ oba ekoŋŋ?” Esa maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ akɛ eŋmɛ mi gbɛ ni maya; ni mito lɛ be.
7Asaŋ mikɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ kɛji eesumɔ lɛ, no lɛ ehã mi woji ni mikɛyahã amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ, koni amɛŋmɛ mi gbɛ ni mafo mli kɛya Yuda. 8 Asaŋ mibi wolo ko hu ni mikɛyahã Asaf, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ koo lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni ehã mi tsumaa tsei. Tsei nɛɛ mikɛbaakpɛ mɔɔ agboi mawo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he, kɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ kɛ shĩa ni miyahi mli lɛ he. Akɛni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ fee nɔ ni mitaoɔ lɛ fɛɛ ehã mi.
9Maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi eto mihe. Miyashɛ amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ; ni mikɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ woji lɛ hã amɛ. 10Shi be ni Sanbalat, Horonnyo lɛ, kɛ Tobia, Amonnyo ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nu lɛ, edɔ amɛ naakpa akɛ nuu ko eba ni ebatao Israelbii lɛ ejurɔyeli.
11Mibashɛ Yerusalɛm, ni miye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi. 12Ni mite shi nyɔɔŋ, mi kɛ hii fioo ko ni fata mihe lɛ. Shi migbako mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛwo mitsui mli akɛ miyafee mihã Yerusalɛm lɛ. Asaŋ mihiɛɛɛ kooloo ko kooloo ko hu akɛ ja kooloo ni mita nɔ lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ. 13Mitsɔ̃ jɔɔ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa nyɔɔŋ kɛje kpo kɛtsɔ̃ Drako Nubu lɛ he kɛtee Tumo Agbo lɛ naa. Misra Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ mikwɛ bɔ ni amɛkumɔ amɛshwie shi, kɛ enaa agboi ni ashã lɛ. 14Kɛkɛ ni mifoŋ kɛtee Nubu Agbo lɛ naa kɛ Maŋtsɛ Kpaakpo lɛ hu naa; shi kooloo ni mita nɔ lɛ naaa he ko etsɔ̃ yɛ nikikiŋkoi lɛ amli kɛho. 15No hewɔ lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli lɛ mitsɔ̃ faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli kɛtee miyakwɛ gbogbo lɛ; ni miku misɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ jɔɔ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli.
16Shi nɔyelɔi lɛ leee he ni mitee kɛ nɔ ni miyafee. Yudafoi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni ji mɛi ni baatsu nii lɛ hu, migbako amɛ. 17Shi agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiina nɔ amane mli ni wɔyɔɔ, bɔ ni Yerusalɛm ekumɔ kɛbua shi, ni ehe agboi lɛ hu ashã. Nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔtswaa Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ koni wɔhiɛshishwiemɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ afo.” 18Ni migba amɛ akɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ. Migba amɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔ ni ekɛ mi wie lɛ hu.
Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbɔia gbogbo lɛ tswaa! Ni amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã nitsumɔ kpakpa lɛ.”
19Shi be ni Sanbalat, Horonnyo lɛ, kɛ Tobia, Amonnyo ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ kɛ Geshem, Arabianyo lɛ, nu lɛ, amɛŋmɔ wɔ, ni amɛye wɔhe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane nyɛyeɔ nɛɛ? Aso nyɛmitse Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atua?”
20 Mito he akɛ, “Ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ eeehã wɔnyɛ wɔfee. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔ, ni ji etsuji lɛ, wɔbaawo gbogbo lɛ tswaa nɔ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko loo hegbɛ ko loo kaimɔ nɔ ko yɛ Yerusalɛm.”

Title: NEHEMIA 3
Content:
Atswa Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ ekoŋŋ
1Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa Eliashib, kɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ tswa Toi Agboi lɛ agbogbo lɛ; amɛtara enaa shinai lɛ, ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ kɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ. Amɛfee gbogbo lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ aahu kɛyashi Hamea mɔɔ gojoo lɛ kɛ Hananel mɔɔ gojoo lɛ he.
2Yeriko hii lɛ tswa gbogbo kɛtsa nɔ; ni Zakur, Imri bi lɛ, hu tswa kɛtsa Yeriko hii lɛ anɔ lɛ nɔ.
3Hasenabii lɛ tswa Loi Agboi lɛ agbogbo lɛ. Amɛsɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛtara enaa shinai kɛ sai kɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
4Meremot, Hakoz bi ni ji Uria nabi lɛ, saa gbogbo ni tsa nɔ lɛ. Amɛnɔtsamɔ lɛ Meshulam ni ji Meshezabel bi Berekia bi lɛ basaa.
Nɔ ni tsa enɛ hu nɔ lɛ, Bana bi Zadok tswa.
5Enɛ nɔtsamɔ lɛ Tekoa hii lɛ ji mɛi ni tswa, shi abladei ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhe wooo amɛNuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ mli.
6Agbo Momo lɛ, Yoiada, Pasea bi lɛ, kɛ Meshulam, Besodeia bi lɛ, basaa. Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛsɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛtara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai lɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
7Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ kɛyashi faa lɛ anaiagbɛ, he ni amralo lɛ shihilɛhe lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, Melatia, Gibeonnyo lɛ, kɛ Yadon, Meronotnyo lɛ, kɛ Gibeon kɛ Mizpabii lɛ ji mɛi ni basaa.
8Enɔtsamɔ lɛ, Harhaia bi Uziel ni jɛ shika ŋaalɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ ji mɔ ni basaa. Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ lɛ, Hanania, ojeŋmafeelɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni batswa. Amɛsaa Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ kɛyashi Agbo Lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ he.
9Nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ, Refaia, Hur bi lɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni basaa.
10Enɛ nɔtsamɔ lɛ, Yedaia, Harumaf bi lɛ, basaa; eyɛ eshĩa lɛ ŋlɛnɔ.
Nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ, Hashabneia bi Hatush ji mɔ ni basaa.
11Malkia, Harim bi lɛ, kɛ Hashub, Pahat-Moab bi lɛ, basaa nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ kɛ Flɔnɔi Amɔɔ lɛ hu.
12Enɔtsamɔ lɛ Shalum, Halohesh bi lɛ, ni ji Yerusalɛm mlija fã lumɔ lɛ basaa; ebiyei lɛ ye bua lɛ kɛsaa. 13Hanun kɛ Zanoa maŋ lɛ mli bii basaa Jɔɔ Agbo lɛ. Amɛma ni amɛtara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai lɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Amɛtswa gbogbo ninetalɔi akpe kɛyashi Tumo Agbo lɛ naa.
14Tumo Agbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mɔ ni saa ji Malkia, Rekab bi lɛ ni ji Bet-Hakerem mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ. Lɛ ema ni etara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
15 Nubu Agbo lɛ Shallum, Kol-Hoze bi lɛ ni ji Mizpa mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni basaa. Lɛ ema, ni eha nɔ, ni etara enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Lɛ nɔŋŋ etswa Shela Kpaakpo lɛ he gbogbo lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ, aahu kɛyashi atrakpoi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛjɛɔ David maŋ lɛ mli lɛ he.
16Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ lɛ, Nehemia, Azbuk bi lɛ ni ji Bet-Zur mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, basaa. Esaa kɛyashi David saŋi lɛ kɛ kpaakpo ni aje gbɛ afee lɛ kɛ tabilɔi ashihilɛhe lɛ ŋlɛnɔ.
Levibii ni tswa gbogbo lɛ eko lɛ
17Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Levibii ni abaatsi amɛgbɛii atã nɛɛ batswa gbogbo lɛ hei komɛi: Rehum, Bani bi lɛ, batswa fã ko; Hashabia, Keila kpokpai anɔ mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, batswa he ni yɔɔ enɔ mli.
18Esɛɛ lɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ batswa eko: Bawai, Henadad bi lɛ, ni ji Keila mlijaa fã kome lɛ lumɔ lɛ, basaa fã, 19ni Ezer, Yeshua bi lɛ ni ji Mizpa lumɔ lɛ, basaa fã hu yɛ he ni atsɔ̃ɔ akwɔɔ kɛyaa tawuunii toohe lɛ yɛ gbogbo lɛ koŋ lɛ.
20Esɛɛ lɛ, Baruk, Zabai bi lɛ, basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko kɛjɛ gbogbo lɛ koŋ kɛyashi osɔfonukpa Eliashib shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
21 Baruk sɛɛ lɛ, Meremot, ni ji Hakoz bi Uria bi lɛ, basaa fã kroko kɛjɛ Eliashib we lɛ shinaa lɛ naa kɛyashi Eliashib we lɛ naagbeehe lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Levi Osɔfoi ni tswa gbogbo lɛ eko lɛ
22Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kpokpai anɔ lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã ni tsa nɔ lɛ.
23Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Benyamin kɛ Hashub basaa fã ni yɔɔ amɛshĩai lɛ ahiɛ lɛ. Maaseia bi Azaria ni enii ji Anania basaa fã ni tsa nɔ ni yɔɔ eshĩa lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
24Azaria sɛɛ lɛ Binui, Hanadad bi lɛ, basaa fã kroko kɛjɛ Azaria shĩa lɛ he kɛyashi gbogbo lɛ koŋ kɛ he ni gbogbo lɛ dɔ eyi yɛ lɛ.
25 Palal, Uzai bi lɛ, batswa gbogbo lɛ fã ni kwɛɔ koŋ lɛ kɛ mɔɔ ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shĩa lɛ sɔɔdo ni ji enyɔ lɛ he yɛ bulɔi akpo lɛ masɛi lɛ.
26Palal sɛɛ lɛ, Pedaia, Parosh bi lɛ, kɛ Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni hiɔ Ofel lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko kɛyashi he ko ni yɔɔ Nu Agbo lɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ mɔɔ ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo lɛ masɛi.
Gbogbotswalɔi krokomɛi
27 Pedaia sɛɛ lɛ, Tekoabii lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã ni kwɛɔ mɔɔ wulu somromoo ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo lɛ. Amɛsaa gbogbo lɛ aahu kɛyashi Ofel gbogbo lɛ he.
28Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ basaa fã kroko. Amɛsaa kɛjɛ Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ sɛɛ kɛtee kooyigbɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tswa gbogbo lɛ fã ni yɔɔ eshĩa hiɛ lɛ.
29Osɔfoi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Zadok, Imer bi lɛ, basaa fã ni yɔɔ eshĩa lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Esɛɛ lɛ, Shemaia, Shekania bi lɛ ni kwɛɔ Bokãgbɛ Agbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko lɛ.
30Shemaia sɛɛ lɛ, Hanania, Shelemia bi lɛ, kɛ Hanun, Zalaf bi ni ji ekpaa lɛ, basaa fã kroko.
Amɛsɛɛ lɛ, Meshulam, Berekia bi lɛ, basaa fã ni yɔɔ esɛɛtsu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ.
31Esɛɛ lɛ Malkia ni ji shika ŋaalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ batswa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko lɛ. Etswa kɛyashi Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ jarayelɔi lɛ awe lɛ he, yɛ Henaabuamɔ Agbo lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Malkiya nɛɛ nɔŋŋ saa gbogbo lɛ kɛyashi ŋwɛitsu ni ma gbogbo lɛ koŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he.
32Gbogbo lɛ naagbee fã ni kã ŋwɛitsu lɛ kɛ Toi Agboi lɛ teŋ lɛ, mɛi ni saa no ji shika ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ jarayelɔi lɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 4
Content:
Nehemia ye mɛi ni tsiɔ nitsumɔ lɛ naa lɛ anɔ kunim
1Be ni Sanbalat nu akɛ wɔ, Yudafoi lɛ, wɔmiitswa gbogbo lɛ, emli fu ni emli wo la naakpa. Eye wɔhe fɛo, 2ni ekɛɛ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ Samaria tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nɛkɛ Yudafoi wudɔwudɔi nɛɛ feɔ nɛɛ? Ani aŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ? Ani amɛsusuɔ akɛ kɛji amɛshã afɔlei lɛ amɛaanyɛ nitsumɔ lɛ naa amɛgbe gbi kome jenamɔ lo? Kolɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛ jie tɛi lɛ yɛ tsu koi ni ashã ni bua shi kuikui lɛ amli lo?”
3Kɛkɛ ni Tobia, Amonnyo ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ, kɛɛ, “Tɛ gbogbo tete po ni amɛtswaa nɛɛ lɛ, kɛ osɔ tete tu eyi nɔ lɛ, eeekumɔ eshwie shi.”
4 Misɔle mikɛɛ, “Bo toi, wɔNyɔŋmɔ. Bo bɔ ni agbeɔ wɔhe guɔ toi. Hã ni ahora ni amɛbɔɔ wɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ; hã aŋɔ amɛ nom, ni aha amɛnii. 5Okɛ esha ni amɛfeɔ lɛ akafa amɛ, ni ohiɛ akakpa amɛhe eshai lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɔ wɔ ahora, ni amɛwo omli la yɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔtswaa gbogbo lɛ ahiɛ.”
6No hewɔ lɛ, wɔtswa gbogbo lɛ kɛkpe kɛyashi enɔkwɔlɛ lɛ mlijaa, ejaakɛ maŋ lɛ yɛ nitsumɔ lɛ he tsui.
7Shi be ni Sanbalat kɛ Tobia kɛ Arabiabii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Ashdodbii lɛ nu akɛ atsara Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ kɛkpe, ni abɔ̃i fɔji lɛ tsiimɔ lɛ, amɛmli wo la naakpa. 8Amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛtee apam akɛ amɛmiiba ni amɛbatua Yerusalɛm ni amɛhã jɛi afee basabasa. 9Shi wɔsɔle wɔkpa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, ni wɔto bulɔi wɔto amɛhe koni amɛbu nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
10Yudabii yɛ lala ko ni amɛlaa akɛ,
“Wɔhewalɛ nɔ miigbɔ kɛ wɔjatsui ni wɔtere lɛ.
Tsu gbogbo kukuji ni sa akɛ aloo lɛ fa tsɔ̃.
Hewɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ gbogbo lɛ wɔtswa dɔŋŋ.”
11Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ susu akɛ wɔleŋ, ni asaŋ wɔnaŋ amɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaabote wɔteŋ ni amɛmiigbe wɔ koni nitsumɔ lɛ yi ahɛ shi. 12Shi Yudafoi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ ba shii abɔ amɛbatswa wɔ adafi akɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ baajɛ hei srɔtoi ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ amɛbatua wɔ. 13No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ mɛi to gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ hei ni kwɔɔɔ ni kã shi kplanaa lɛ. Mito maŋ lɛ yɛ amɛwekui anaa; amɛhiɛ amɛklantei kɛ amɛkpɔlɔi kɛ amɛgãii.
14Kɛkɛ ni mikwɛ bɔ ni nibii yɔɔ hãa, ni mikɛɛ maŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea henyɛlɔi lɛ agbeyei; shi moŋ nyɛkaia Nuŋtsɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ni nyɛwua nyɛhãa nyɛnyɛmimɛi kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛshĩaiaŋ lɛ.”
15 Be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ nu akɛ abatswa wɔ adafi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ jina lɛ efee yaka lɛ, wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛba gbogbo lɛ he ekoŋŋ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee enitsumɔhe.
16Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, miwebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi fã tsuɔ nii lɛ, ni mɛi fã hiɛɔ akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi kɛ gaii ni amɛwo damai. Onukpai lɛ fi Yudawe lɛ fɛɛ ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ. 17Mɛi ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ kɛ mɛi ni tereɔ nibii ni akɛtswaa lɛ tete ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enine kome miitsu nii, belɛ ekɛ ekome hiɛ tawuunii. 18Mɛi ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ klante ŋmɔ ehɛ, ni ekɛtswaa gbogbo lɛ; ni mɔ ni kpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ yɛ mimasɛi. 19Mikɛɛ maŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nitsumɔ lɛ fa, ni egbɛ eshwã, ni wɔmli kã haŋŋhaŋŋ yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ, mɔ kɛ enaanyo teŋ jɛkɛ. 20No hewɔ lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaanu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ yɛ lɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛbaa wɔŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi; wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaawu ahã wɔ.” 21No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni wɔtsu nii lɛ nɛ, mɛi lɛ fã hiɛɔ akplɔi kɛjɛɔ hulu shitee kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni ŋulamii pueɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.
22Asaŋ nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ ewebii awɔ Yerusalɛm koni amɛbu wɔhe nyɔɔŋ, ni shwane lɛ amɛtsu nii lɛ. 23No hewɔ lɛ, mi jio, minanemɛi nitsulɔi lɛ jio, miwebii lɛ kɛ mihebulɔi lɛ jio, wɔjieee wɔtadei; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tawuunii yɛ emasɛi.”

Title: NEHEMIA 5
Content:
Ohiafoi ayiwaa
1Maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ wie amɛshi amɛnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ yɛ sane ni eŋɔɔɔ ni amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛyeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ. 2Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔ kɛ wɔbii lɛ, wɔyi fa yɛ wɔshĩai amli. Ahã wɔ abele bɔ ni sa ni wɔye koni wɔyi ana wala.”
3Mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, “Hɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromi kɛ wɔshĩai totoɔ awaba koni wɔna shika wɔkɛhe abele.”
4Asaŋ mɛi komɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ onia lɛ tsumɔ hewɔ lɛ wɔyafala shika, ni wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromi lɛ eto naa. 5Wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ hewolo kome, ni wɔbii lɛ tamɔ amɛbii lɛ, shi wɔtsiɔ wɔbii lɛ wɔwoɔ nyɔŋyeli mli, koni amɛtsɔmɔ nyɔji; ni wɔbiyei lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, afee amɛ nyɔji momo. Wɔnyɛɛɛ enɛ he nɔ ko wɔfee; ni wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromi yɛ mɛi krokomɛi adɛŋ.”
6Be ni minu saji ni eŋɔɔɔ amɛnaa kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, mimli wo la naakpa, 7 ni mito miyiŋ nɔ ni sa akɛ mafee. Saji ni ayɔɔ yɛ abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ ahe lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ heɔ enyɛmi hekpa ni fe nine.”
Mibɔ gwa kpeteŋkple miwo amɛ; 8ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, wɔkpɔ̃ wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi ni ahɔ̃ɔ ahã jeŋmaji lɛ bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛmiihɔ̃ɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ? Nyɛmiihɔ̃ɔ amɛ nyɛhã wɔ!” Amɛhãaa hetoo; amɛnãaa nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ.
9Kɛkɛ ni mitsa miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛɛ, “Nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ ejaaa. Ani esaaa akɛ nyɛkɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ he gbeyeishemɔ baa nyɛjeŋ koni wɔkɛku wɔhe fɛo ni jemajiaŋbii ni ji wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ yeɔ lɛ naa lo? 10Mi kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ miwebii lɛ hu, wɔfaa wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ shika kɛ abele. Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ nɛkɛ hekpawoo nɛɛ akea. 11Nyɛkɛ amɛŋmɔji kɛ amɛwain tromi kɛ amɛmu tromi kɛ amɛshĩai lɛ akũa sɛɛ ahãa amɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ. Nyɛkɛ shika kɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ mu mlijai oha mli ekome ni ji hekpa ni nyɛheɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ hu akũa sɛɛ ahãa amɛ.”
12Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔkɛbaaku sɛɛ wɔhã amɛ ni wɔheŋ nɔ ko yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Wɔɔɔfee tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.” Mitsɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛba, ni mihã maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ kamɔ kitã akɛ amɛaafee bɔ ni amɛwo shi nɛɛ. 13Asaŋ mitswa mimlifiinɔ lɛ mli, ni mikɛɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeee nɛkɛ shiwoo nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatswa emli kɛjie lɛ kɛjɛ ewe kɛ enitsumɔ mli nɛ; bɔ nɔŋŋ ni aaatswa emli ni afee lɛ shwɛm nɛ.”
Asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Amen!” Ni amɛ jie Yehowa yi. Maŋ lɛ ye amɛshiwoo nɛɛ nɔ.
Nehemia fooo ekome enɔ mli
14Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni awo mi amralo ni kwɛɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ, no ji afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ sɔŋŋ nɛ lɛ, mi kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ wɔheko niyenii ni ahãa amralo fɛɛ amralo akɛ egbɛnaa niyenii lɛ eko. 15Shi sa amraloi ni nyiɛ mihiɛ lɛ hã etɔ maŋ lɛ yɛ shika ni naa shiɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni amɛheɔ kɛshiɔ aboloo kɛ wain ni amɛheɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ. Amraloi nɛɛ atsuji tete gbaa maŋ lɛ naa. Shi mi lɛ, gbeyei ni misheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ lɛ, mifeee nakai. 16Asaŋ mikɛ mihewalɛ fɛɛ wo gbogbo lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ mli, ni mitaooo shikpɔŋ ko mihãaa mihe; ni miwebii lɛ fɛɛ bakpeɔ yɛ gbogbo lɛ he kɛhã nitsumɔ lɛ. 17Asaŋ Yudafoi lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ bayeɔ nii yɛ mikpɔlɔ̃ he; dani esoro mɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji ni bɔle wɔ lɛ ateŋ ni baa wɔŋɔɔ hu. 18Nii ni ahoɔ ahãa mi gbi kome ji tsinanuu kome kɛ toi ni eshwi ekpaa kɛ wuɔi; ni daa gbii nyɔŋma sɛɛ lɛ, akɛ wain srɔtoi fɛɛ hu babaoo baa, migbɛnaa niyenii lɛ, mibiii shi, ejaakɛ onia ni atsuɔ maŋ lɛ efee jatsu ehã maŋ lɛ.
19 MiNyɔŋmɔ, nibii fɛɛ ni mifee mihã nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, kaimɔ mi ni ahi ahã mi.

Title: NEHEMIA 6
Content:
Akpãŋ Nehemia yi nɔ
1Sanbalat kɛ Tobia kɛ Geshem, Arabianyo lɛ, kɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi krokomɛi lɛ nu akɛ mitswa gbogbo lɛ, ni ehe ko ni ekumɔ bɛ dɔŋŋ; ni eshwɛ agboi lɛ anaa shinai lɛ pɛ ni matara. 2No hewɔ lɛ, Sanbalat kɛ Geshem tsu aba miŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ mikɛ lɛ abakpe yɛ Ono ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ akrowai lɛ eko mli. Shi efɔŋ amɛtaoɔ mi amɛfee. 3Mitsu mɛi kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ koni ayakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nitsumɔ ni mitsuɔ lɛ da, hewɔ lɛ minyɛŋ maba. Mɛɛ hewɔ ni esa akɛ mahã afɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔ lɛ ni mashi maba nyɛŋɔɔ?”
4Amɛtsu kɛba miŋɔɔ shii ejwɛ sɔŋŋ kɛ nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni mito he mihã amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
5Kɛkɛ ni Sanbalat tsu miŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shii enumɔ. Mɔ ni etsu lɛ hiɛ wolo ni asɔoko naa yɛ edɛŋ. 6Wolo lɛ mli sane nɛ, “Aatã yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli, ni Geshem hu kɛɛ akɛ akɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ miitao atse atua, ni no hewɔ otswaa gbogbo lɛ. Asaŋ akɛɛ ootao maŋtsɛ oye. 7Akɛɛ hu akɛ owo mɛi komɛi gbalɔi ni amɛshiɛ yɛ ohe yɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, ‘Maŋtsɛ ko yɛ Yuda!’ Agbɛnɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ baaya ayashɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ toiŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, ba ni wɔya he ajina.” 8Kɛkɛ ni mitsu Sanbalat ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, “Nibii ni okɛɔ nɛɛ, afeko nakai nɔ ko; bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fo otã.” 9Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, wɔhe gbeyei kɛkɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛwo, ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnijiaŋ baaje wui yɛ nitsumɔ lɛ he koni egɔ̃. Shi misɔle mikɛɛ, “Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, wo mi ekãa.”
10Gbi ko lɛ mitee Shemaia ni ji Delaia bi ni asaŋ eji Mehetabel nabi lɛ shĩa; shi eŋa eyi, ni ekɛɛ, “Hã wɔyakpe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni wɔŋamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinai lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaba ni amɛbagbe bo. Amɛbaaba amɛbagbe bo nyɔɔŋ tete.”
11Shi mikɛɛ, “Aso nuu tamɔ mi baajo foi? Ani nuu tamɔ mi aaajo foi kɛya Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, koni eyi ana wala? Miyaaa!”
12Miyoo akɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsu Shemaia, shi moŋ Tobia kɛ Sanbalat ni ebɔ lɛ apaa hewɔ ni egba nɛkɛ gbalɛ nɛɛ eshi mi lɛ. 13 Amɛbɔ lɛ apaa bɔ ni afee ni ewo mihe gbeyei ni mafee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ koni mafee esha. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛbaana sane fɔŋ ko yɛ mihe amɛyatã kɛbɔ mi ahora. 14 Misɔle mikɛɛ, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ ni okɛ Tobia kɛ Sanbalat aye kɛ joomɔ yɛ nibii ni amɛfee lɛ naa. Kaimɔ gbalɔyoo Noadia kɛ gbalɔi krokomɛi lɛ hu koni okɛ amɛ aye; amɛ amɛtaoɔ ni kulɛ amɛwo mihe gbeyei lɛ.”
Nitsumɔ lɛ naagbee
15Gbii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, agbe nitsumɔ lɛ naa. Agbe naa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji Elul lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ. 16Be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nu lɛ, jeŋmaji ni bɔle wɔ lɛ fɛɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛhiɛ gboi wo amɛyitseiaŋ, ejaakɛ amɛyoo akɛ, nitsumɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa ni anyɛ atsu.
17Shi nɛkɛ bei amli fɛɛ lɛ, Yuda abladei lɛ miiŋmala woji pii amɛmiimaje Tobia, ni Tobia hu miiŋmala amɛ woji. 18Ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ Yuda ni kɛ Tobia ji ekome, ejaakɛ Ara bi Shekania shaanuu ji lɛ, ni asaŋ, lɛ Tobia lɛ, ebinuu Yehohanan ebaŋɔ Meshulam biyoo ni ji Berekia nabi akɛ ŋa. 19Mɛi bawieɔ Tobia he ekpakpa amɛhãa mi, ni amɛyagbaa lɛ nɔ ni mi hu mikɛɔ. Tobia ŋmalaa mi woji, ni ekɛwoɔ mihe gbeyei.

Title: NEHEMIA 7
Content:
1Agbɛnɛ atswa gbogbo lɛ agbe naa, ni mitara agboi lɛ anaa shinai lɛ, ni ato agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ Levibii lɛ. 2Kɛkɛ ni mitu Yerusalɛm miwo minyɛmi Hanani kɛ Hanania, mɔɔ lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ, dɛŋ, ejaakɛ nuu anɔkwafo ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei fe mɛi pii ji Hanania. 3Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa agbelea Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ aŋmɛ; ja hulu naa ewa dã. Kɛji bulɔi lɛ damɔ shi amɛmiibu lɛ, aŋamɔ shinai lɛ ni alalaa sɛɛ. Nyɛtoa bulɔi ni ji Yerusalɛmbii. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahi ebuu nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ adamɔ shi ni eekwɛ eshĩa lɛ hiɛ.”
Mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba lɛ agbɛii
(Ezra 2.1-70)
4Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ da, ni emli lɛɛ hu, shi mɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ faaa, ni tsui lɛ hu amamɔko.
5Kɛkɛ ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã eba mijwɛŋmɔ mli akɛ mibua abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ naa koni aŋmã amɛgbɛi yɛ amɛwekukpãa naa. Miyana mɛi ni ba klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ awekukpãa wolo lɛ. Mina ni aŋma yɛ mli akɛ:
6Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli ba lɛ. Amɛ ji mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee emaŋ lɛ. 7Mɛi ni nyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛba ji Zerubabel, Yeshua, Nehemia, Azaria. Raamia, Nahamani, Mɔdekai, Bilshan, Misperet, Bigewai, Nehum kɛ Baana.
Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ, amɛyibɔ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛiawei lɛ anaa nɛ:
8Paroshbii lɛ: akpei enyɔ kɛ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ. 9Shefatiabii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ.
10Arabii lɛ: ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
11Pahat-Moabbii ni ji Yeshua kɛ Yoab shwiei lɛ: akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
12Elambii lɛ: akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
13Zatubii lɛ: ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
14Zakaibii lɛ: ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
15Benuibii lɛ: ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
16Bebaibii lɛ: ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
17Azgadbii lɛ: akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
18Adonikambii lɛ: ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpawo.
19Bigewaibii lɛ: akpei enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpawo.
20Adinbii lɛ: ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enumɔ.
21Aterbii ni jɛ Hezekia nɔ lɛ mli lɛ: nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ kpaanyɔ.
22Hashumbii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
23Bezaibii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
24Harifbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
25Gibeonbii lɛ: nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ.
26Betlehembii kɛ Netofabii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
27Anatotbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
28Bet-Azmavetbii lɛ: nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
29Kiriat-Yearimbii kɛ Kefirabii kɛ Beerotbii lɛ: ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃.
30Ramabii kɛ Gebabii lɛ: ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome.
31Mikmasbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
32Betelbii kɛ Aibii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
33Nebo kroko lɛ mli bii lɛ: nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
34Elam kroko lɛ mli bii lɛ: akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
35Harimbii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
36Yerikobii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
37Lodbii kɛ Hadidbii kɛ Onobii lɛ: ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome.
38Senaabii lɛ: akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Osɔfoi awekui
39Osɔfoi lɛ ni ji Yedaiabii ni jɛ Yeshua we lɛ: ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃.
40Imerbii lɛ: akpe kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
41Pashurbii lɛ: akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpawo.
42Harimbii lɛ: akpe kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo.
43Levibii lɛ ni ji Yeshuabii kɛ Kadmielbii ni jɛ Hodaviabii ateŋ lɛ: nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ.
44Lalatsɛmɛi ni ji Asafbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
45Agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ abii ni ji Shalumbii kɛ Aterbii kɛ Talmonbii kɛ Akubbii kɛ Hatitabii kɛ Shobaibii lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
46Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ: Zihabii kɛ Hasufabii kɛ Tabaotbii lɛ.
47Kerosbii kɛ Siabii kɛ Padonbii lɛ.
48Lebanabii kɛ Hagababii kɛ Shalmaibii,
49Hananbii kɛ Gidelbii kɛ Gaharbii lɛ,
50Reaiabii kɛ Rezinbii kɛ Nekodabii lɛ,
51Gazambii kɛ Uzabii kɛ Paseabii lɛ,
52Besaibii kɛ Meunimbii kɛ Nefushesimbii lɛ.
53Bakbukbii kɛ Hakufabii kɛ Harhurbii lɛ,
54Bazlitbii kɛ Mehidabii kɛ Harshabii lɛ,
55Barkosbii kɛ Siserabii kɛ Temabii lɛ.
56Neziabii kɛ Hatifabii lɛ,
57Solomon tsuji lɛ abii lɛ: Sotaibii kɛ Soferetbii kɛ Peridabii lɛ,
58Yaalabii kɛ Darkonbii kɛ Gidelbii lɛ,
59Shefatiabii kɛ Hatilbii kɛ Pokeret-Hazebaimbii kɛ Amonbii lɛ.
60Sɔlemɔ we lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Solomon tsuji ashwiei lɛ fɛɛ feɔ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enyɔ.
61Naa mɛi ni fã kɛjɛ Tel-Mela kɛ Tel-Harsha kɛ Kerub kɛ Adan kɛ Imer kɛba, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei loo amɛseshi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Israelbii ji amɛ. 62Amɛ ji Delaiabii kɛ Tobiabii kɛ Nekodabii lɛ. Amɛfeɔ mɛi ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
63Osɔfoi aweku mli bii ni anaaa amɛgbɛii yɛ wolo ko mli ji Hoabaiabii kɛ Hakozbii kɛ Barzilaibii. (Barzilaibii nɛɛ ablematsɛ lɛ baŋɔ Barzilai ni jɛ Gilead lɛ biyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni eŋɔ eshaanuu lɛ gbɛi). 64Akɛni anaaa amɛweku gbɛii wolo ko lɛ hewɔ lɛ aŋɔɔɔ amɛ akɛ osɔfoi ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
65 Amralo lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkaye nii krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ eko, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni osɔfoi lɛ aaaba ni aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ Urim kɛ Tumim nɔ akɛle nɔ gbɔmɛi ni ji amɛ.
66Asafo ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ naa shɛɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
67Soro amɛtsuji hii kɛ amɛweyei ni naa shɛɔ akpei kpawo kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo, kɛ hii lalatsɛmɛi kɛ yei lalatsɛmɛi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
68Amɛkpɔŋɔi ayibɔ ji ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa; amɛtejiokpɔŋɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
69Amɛyoomai ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ; amɛtejii akpei ekpaa ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
70Tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi bake nii yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ saamɔ hewɔ. Amralo lɛ hã shika ŋmiiŋmi kiloi kpaanyɔ, lalakãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, osɔfoi atadei ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
71Tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi bake shika ŋmiiŋmi kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ, kɛ jwiɛtɛi kiloi akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Akɛ fɛɛ wo fotro ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ mli.
72Nɔ ni maŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ hã ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ osɔfoi atadei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpawo.
73Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ lalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ bahi amɛmaji lɛ amli.

Title: NEHEMIA 8
Content:
Ezra kane Mla lɛ hã maŋ lɛ
1 Be ni shɛɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli. Maŋ lɛ bluublu bakpe yɛ blohu ko ni yɔɔ Nu Agbo lɛ hiɛ lɛ mli. Amɛkɛɛ Ezra, osɔfo kɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ, akɛ eyakɔ wolo ni Mose Mla ni Yehowa wo Israel lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛba. 2 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Ezra kɛ Mla lɛ ba asafo lɛ hiɛ. Hii kɛ yei kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛji amɛnu wiemɔi lɛ ni amɛaanu shishi lɛ yɛ jɛi. 3Ekane yɛ blohu ni yɔɔ Nu Agbo lɛ hiɛ lɛ mli, kɛjɛ leebi kɛyashi shwane fintiŋŋ yɛ hii kɛ yei kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni aaanyɛ shishi anu lɛ hiɛ. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miibo Mla Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ toi.
4Ezra, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, damɔ nɔ ko ni kwɔ ni akɛ tso fee nɔ. Afee yɛ Mla lɛ kanemɔ lɛ hewɔ. Matitia kɛ Shema kɛ Anaia kɛ Uria kɛ Hilkia kɛ Maaseia damɔ emasɛi yɛ eninejurɔ, ni Pedaia kɛ Mishael kɛ Malkiya kɛ Hashum kɛ Hash-Badana kɛ Zakaria kɛ Meshulam damɔ ebɛku.
5Ezra gbele wolo lɛ mli yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. He ni edamɔ lɛ kwɔ fe he ni maŋ lɛ damɔ lɛ. Be ni egbele wolo lɛ mli lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi damɔ shi.
6Kɛkɛ ni Ezra jie Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ, yi. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Amen! Amen!” Amɛhole amɛniji anɔ. No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛmamɔ amɛyi shi, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛja Yehowa.
7Yeshua kɛ Bani kɛ Sherebia kɛ Yamin kɛ Akub kɛ Shabetai kɛ Hodia kɛ Maaseia kɛ Kelita kɛ Azaria kɛ Yozabad kɛ Hanan kɛ Pelaia kɛ Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ Mla lɛ shishi. Be ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ shishi lɛ, belɛ maŋ lɛ damɔ amɛdaamɔhe lɛ. 8Mɛi ni kaneɔ wolo lɛ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, kane lɛ faŋŋ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ shishi koni anu nɔ ni akaneɔ lɛ shishi faŋŋ.
9 Kɛkɛ ni Nehemia ni ji amralo lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Ezra ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ Levibii ni tsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii lɛ kɛɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea ŋkɔmɔ, ni nyɛkafoa hu!” Amɛkɛɛ maŋ lɛ nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ be ni maŋ lɛ nu Mla lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo. 10Ezra kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyayea nii ni hi naakpa, ni nyɛnua wain ni ŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ. Ni nyɛkɛ eko amajea mɛi ni afeko nɔ ko atoko amɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hã wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ. No hewɔ hu lɛ nyɛwerɛ akahoa nyɛhe, ejaakɛ Yehowa he nyamɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni baawo nyɛ hewalɛ.”
11Levibii lɛ shɛje maŋ lɛ fɛɛ mii amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛfɔa ŋkɔmɔyeli, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni, hewɔ lɛ nyɛwerɛ akahoa nyɛhe.” 12No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyaye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Amɛkɛ eko maje, ni amɛna miishɛɛ babaoo; ejaakɛ wiemɔi ni akane atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛnu shishi faŋŋ.
Asesei Agbijurɔ
13Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai ni yɔɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ Ezra, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ koni amɛbabo Mla Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ toi. 14 Amɛna akɛ aŋma yɛ Mla ni Yehowa tsɔ Mose nine nɔ ewo lɛ mli, akɛ Israelbii lɛ ahi asesei amli yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, be ni ayeɔ Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ. 15Amɛna akɛ aŋma hu akɛ amɛjaje, ni amɛshiɛ yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ amli kɛ Yerusalɛm hu akɛ, “Nyɛjea kpo nyɛyaa gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyaŋɔa mutsei aniji kɛ ŋkutsei aniji kɛ merto tsei aniji kɛ blɛoi kɛ tsei kusukusui aniji koni nyɛkɛbafee asesei, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ.”
16Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lɛ je kpo amɛtee, ni amɛyaŋɔ tsei aniji lɛ kɛba, ni amɛkɛbafee asesei amɛhã amɛhe, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ etsu yiteŋ. Amɛfee asesei yɛ amɛkpoi anɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ Nu Agbo lɛ naa blohu lɛ mli kɛ Efraim Agbo lɛ naa blohu lɛ mli. 17Mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ fee asesei, ni amɛhi mli. Israelbii lɛ efeko nakai nɔ ko dã kɛjɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, yinɔ aahu kɛbashi nakai gbi lɛ nɔ. Amɛmii shɛ amɛhe naakpa. 18Gbi fɛɛ gbi, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ kɛyashi naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, akaneɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla Wolo lɛ. Amɛye gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo, ni gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkpe naagbee kpee, tamɔ bɔ ni ato lɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 9
Content:
Maŋ lɛ jaje amɛhe eshai
1Nakai nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ bakpe. Amɛhi ŋmãa; amɛbumɔ kpekpe, ni amɛkɛ mlu wo amɛyiteŋ. 2Mɛi ni ji Israel fɔmɔbii lɛ tse amɛhe yɛ mɛi kpɔji lɛ fɛɛ ahe; amɛho amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛjaje amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ. 3Amɛte shi amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛkɛ ŋmɛlɛtswai etɛ̃ kane Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Mla Wolo lɛ. Amɛkɛ ŋmɛlɛtswai etɛ̃ hu jaje amɛhe eshai, ni amɛja Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
4Yeshua kɛ Bani kɛ Kadmiel kɛ Shebania kɛ Buni kɛ Sherebia kɛ Bani kɛ Kenani ho damɔ Levibii lɛ akpoku lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsɔle waa amɛtsɛ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
5Kɛkɛ ni Yeshua kɛ Kadmiel kɛ Bani kɛ Hashabneia kɛ Sherebia kɛ Hodia kɛ Shebania kɛ Patahia ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ Levibii ji amɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛjiea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi;
nyɛjiea eyi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ!
Aaajie egbɛi ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ yi,
tsɛbelɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ajieɔ egbɛi yi ni akafoɔ lɛ
ahãa tete lɛ, eshɛɛɛ egbɛi lɛ dalɛ.”
6“Bo okome too ji Yehowa,
Bo obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi
kɛ ŋwɛinii huhai abɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Bo obɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ,
ŋshɔi kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ amɛmli;
ni bo nɔŋŋ ohãa amɛ fɛɛ kwa naa wala
ni ŋwɛinii babaoo lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ amɛjaa.
7 Bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ oŋɔ Abram.
Ojie lɛ kɛjɛ Ur yɛ Babilon,
ni otsake egbɛi ofee lɛ Abraham.
8 Ona akɛ eyeɔ bo anɔkwa,
ni okɛ lɛ kpãŋ akɛ okɛ Kanaanbii
kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii
kɛ Yebusbii kɛ Girgashbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ baahã eshwiei lɛ;
ni oye oshiwoo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ jalɔ ji bo.
9 “Ona amanehulu ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ na yɛ Ijipt lɛ,
ni obo amɛtsɛmɔ ni amɛtsɛ bo lɛ toi yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.
10 Ofee okadii, ni otsu naakpɛɛnii yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ
kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ,
ejaakɛ ole akɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ
wo amɛhe amɛwo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ;
okɛ enɛ he gbɛi ohã ohe,
tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
11 Ohã ŋshɔ lɛ mli gba yɛ amɛhiɛ,
ni amɛnyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ
kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ.
Shi mɛi ni tiuɔ amɛ lɛ
oshɛrɛ amɛ oshwie ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli
ni amɛshiu tamɔ tɛ yɛ nu hamahama lɛ mli.
12Okɛ atatu ni ma shi kutuu tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ shwane,
ni nyɔɔŋ hu lɛ, okɛ la kutuu tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ
koni amɛna nii yɛ gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
13 Okpeleke shi kɛba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni ojɛ ŋwɛi okɛ amɛ wie;
ohã amɛ mlai kpakpai kɛ akpɔi
kɛ kitãi kpakpai.
14Ohejɔɔmɔ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ohã amɛle,
ni otsɔ̃ otsulɔ Mose nine nɔ owo amɛ
kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai.
15 “Be ni hɔmɔ ye amɛ lɛ,
ohã amɛ aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi,
ni be ni kumai ye amɛ hu,
ohã nu jɛ tɛsaa mli ba,
ni amɛkɛgbe amɛkumai.
Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛba ni amɛbaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ
ni okã he kitã akɛ okɛbaahã amɛ lɛ.
16Shi amɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wo amɛhe;
amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi,
ni amɛyeee okitãi lɛ anɔ.
17 Amɛbooo bo toi,
ni asaŋ amɛkaiii onaakpɛɛnii ni ofee yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ;
shi moŋ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi.
Amɛtse atua,
ni amɛto asafoiatsɛ ni ekɛ amɛ aku sɛɛ kɛya nyɔŋyeli mli ekoŋŋ yɛ Ijipt.
Shi bo lɛ oji Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ eshai faa,
durolɔ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɔ ni toɔ etsui shi ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa,
hewɔ lɛ oshiii amɛ.
18 Amɛfee tsinabi ni ashwie amɛhã amɛhe,
ni amɛkɛɛ no ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ ni jie amɛ kɛje Ijipt;
amɛbɔ musu babaoo amɛshi bo.
19Omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
oshiii amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ;
shwane lɛ atatu ni ma shi yɛ amɛhiɛ
ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ lɛ, ejeee amɛhiɛ;
ni nyɔɔŋ hu la ni damɔ amɛhiɛ
ni hãa amɛnaa nii yɛ gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
ejeee amɛhiɛ.
20Okɛ omumɔ kpakpa lɛ hã amɛ
koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii;
ohã amɛ mana amɛye,
ni ohã amɛ nu amɛkɛgbe amɛkumai.
21 Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ okwɛ amɛ
yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaaa amɛ;
amɛtadei suuu lɛ,
amɛnaji hu efuuu.
22 “Ohã amɛye maji kɛ maŋtsɛyelii anɔ kunim.
Amɛye shikpɔji ni bɛŋkɛ amɛ lɛ anɔ,
kɛyashi amɛŋɔ Heshbon
ni ji Maŋtsɛ Sihon shikpɔŋ lɛ,
kɛ Bashan ni ji Maŋtsɛ Og shikpɔŋ lɛ.
23 Ohã amɛbii lɛ hu ayi fa tamɔ ŋulamii,
ni oŋɔ amɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ
ni okɛɛ amɛtsɛmɛi akɛ amɛya amɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
24 Kɛkɛ ni bii lɛ ba koni amɛbaye
Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ;
amɛfee amɛ bɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ.
25 Amɛyaye maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe
kɛ shikpɔji ni baa nii anɔ kunim,
ni amɛna shĩai ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nibii kpakpai fɛɛ:
nubui ni atsatsai, wain tromi kɛ mutso tromi kɛ yelitsei babaoo
amɛye, ni amɛtɔrɔ, ni amɛshwishwii;
ni amɛmii shɛ amɛhe yɛ omlihilɛ kpele lɛ hewɔ.
26“Shi enɛ moŋ sɛɛ lɛ amɛtoi gbo,
ni amɛtse ohiɛ atua;
amɛkɛ mla lɛ efeee nɔ ko nɔ ko;
amɛgbe gbalɔi lɛ ni bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ lɛ,
koni amɛkɛkpale amɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ;
ni amɛfee musubɔɔ nibii wuji amɛshi bo.
27No hewɔ lɛ, oŋmɛɛ amɛhe ohã amɛhenyɛlɔi,
ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ hao amɛ.
Amɛhaomɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ amɛfo amɛtsɛ bo,
ni ohere amɛ nɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi.
Omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ,
ojie hiɛnyiɛlɔi ohã amɛ koni amɛhere amɛ
yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
28 Shi kɛ amɛna hejɔlɛ pɛ lɛ,
kɛkɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ efɔŋ amɛshiɔ bo,
ni oŋmɛɔ amɛhe owoɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ;
ni henyɛlɔi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ kɛ amɛtao osɛɛgbɛ ekoŋŋ,
ni amɛfo amɛtsɛ bo lɛ,
oboɔ amɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi,
ni omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ,
ohereɔ amɛ shii abɔ yɛ amɛnɔnaa lɛ mli.
29 Obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ koni amɛbɔ̃i omla lɛ nɔyeli ekoŋŋ;
shi amɛwo amɛhe, ni amɛbooo okitãi lɛ atoi;
amɛfee esha amɛshi omlai lɛ
ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ
ni eyi naa wala lɛ.
Amɛtsi amɛhe kɛje ohe;
amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi,
ni amɛbooo bo toi.
30 Kɛ̃lɛ oto otsui shi ohã amɛ afii pii;
okɛ omumɔ lɛ wo gbalɔi lɛ amli,
ni otsɔ̃ amɛnɔ obɔ obii lɛ kɔkɔ;
shi amɛbooo toi;
No hewɔ lɛ, ohã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ye amɛnɔ.
31Shi kɛ̃lɛ omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ,
oŋmɛɛɛ amɛhe, ni asaŋ okpãtãaa amɛhiɛ,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ
ni enaa mɔbɔ ji bo.
32 “WɔNyɔŋmɔ, oje agbo!
Ohe wa, ohe yɛ gbeyei, ni onaa mɔbɔ;
kɛji okɛ mɔ ko kpãŋ ni owo shi lɛ, oyeɔ nɔ.
Kɛjɛ Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ayinɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ,
kaahã amanehulu ni ba
wɔ kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi
kɛ wɔnukpai kɛ wɔsɔfoi
kɛ wɔgbalɔi kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ
kɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ,
miifee sane bibioo yɛ ohiɛ.
33Shi bo lɛ, saji ni eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ,
onɔ ja, ejaakɛ bo lɛ oye anɔkwa,
shi wɔ lɛ wɔfee efɔŋ.
34Wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu kɛ wɔnukpai lɛ
kɛ wɔsɔfoi lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ
yeko omla lɛ nɔ,
ni asaŋ amɛboko okitãi kɛ kɔkɔ ni obɔ amɛ lɛ toi.
35Be mli tete ni ohã amɛmaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ma shi
ni amɛyeɔ shikpɔŋ kplɛlɛɛ
ni ewo fɔ nɔ nii lɛ,
amɛsɔ̃mɔɔɔ bo,
ni amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ feemɔ.
36Naa, ŋmɛnɛ wɔtsɔmɔ nyɔji.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okɛhã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ
akɛ amɛye enɔ yibii kɛ enɔ nii kpakpai lɛ,
naa, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ nyɔji yɛ nɔ.
37Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii babaoo lɛ yaa
maŋtsɛmɛi ni akɛto wɔnɔ
yɛ wɔhe eshai ahewɔ lɛ moŋ aŋɔɔ.
Amɛyeɔ wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi anɔ bɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ:
ni wɔyɛ haomɔ kpeteŋkple mli.”
Maŋbii lɛ kpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ko
38Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ahewɔ lɛ, wɔ Israelbii, wɔmiikpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni mli wa, ni wɔmiiŋma; ni wɔnukpai lɛ kɛ wɔLevibii lɛ kɛ wɔsɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛgbɛii miiwo shishi amɛkɛmiisɔo naa.

Title: NEHEMIA 10
Content:
1Mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni sɔo naa lɛ ji Nehemia, amralo lɛ, ni ji Hakalia bi lɛ, ni lɛ esɛɛ lɛ Zedekia. Mɛi komɛi hu ni kɛ amɛnine wo shishi nɛ: osɔfoi 2Seraia, Azaria, Yeremia, 3Pashur, Amaria, Malkia, 4Hatush, Shebania, Maluk, 5Harim, Meremot, Obadia, 6Daniel, Gineton, Baruk, 7Meshulam, Abia, Miyamin 8Maazia, Bilgai, kɛ Shemaia.
9Levibii lɛ ji: Yeshua, Azania bi lɛ, Binui ni jɛ Henadad tsɛmɛi awe lɛ, Kadmiel, 10Shebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaia, Hanan 11Mika, Rehob, Hashabia 12Zakur, Sherebia, Shebania 13Hodia, Bani kɛ Beninu. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Hiɛnyiɛlɔi
14 Parosh, Pahat-Moab, 15Elam, Zatu, Bani, Bunui, Azgad, Bebai, 16Adonia, Bigewai, Adin, 17Ater, Hezekia, Azur 18Hodia, Hashum, Bezai, 19Harif, Anatot, Nebai, 20Magpiash, Meshulam, Hezir 21Meshezabel, Zadok, Yadua, 22Pelatia, Hanan, Anaia, 23Hoshea, Hanania, Hashub, 24Halohesh, Pilha, Shobek, 25Rehum, Hashabna, Maseia, 26Ahia, Hanan, Anan, 27Maluk, Harim kɛ Baana.
Kpãŋmɔ lɛ
28 Wɔ, Israelbii, osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ hu ni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ toiboo naa lɛ amɛtse amɛhe yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahe lɛ, wɔ kɛ wɔŋamɛi kɛ wɔbii hii kɛ yei ni hiɛ efã, 29wɔ kɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi ni ji wɔhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ efee ekome kɛmiikã kitã. Kɛ wɔku mli lɛ, efee loomɔ ehã wɔ. Wɔmiikã kitã akɛ wɔbaaye Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ ni atsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose nine nɔ awo lɛ nɔ. Wɔbaajwɛŋ nɔ ni wɔye Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, kitãi kɛ emlai kɛ ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. 30 Wɔkɛ wɔbiyei haŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbãlã, ni asaŋ wɔŋɔŋ amɛbiyei wɔhaŋ wɔbihii. 31 Kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ guɔnii loo abele ba hɔ̃ɔmɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ loo gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko nɔ lɛ wɔheŋ. Asaŋ daa afi nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔhuŋ wɔŋmɔji lɛ, ni nyɔmɔ fɛɛ nyɔmɔ ni ahiɛ wɔ lɛ wɔkɛbaake. 32 Asaŋ wɔmiikã kitã akɛ daa afi lɛ, wɔɔhã jwiɛtɛi talenta kome mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni asɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi hu hewɔ. 33Nibii nɛɛ ji aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ daa gbi lɛ, kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ anɔ nii lɛ kɛ nyɔji hei anɔ afɔlei lɛ kɛ gbii juji ni ato lɛ anɔ nii lɛ kɛ nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ esha afɔlei lɛ ni akɛkpãtã ahãa Israel lɛ. Wɔbaahã kɛhã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
34Wɔ ni ji osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ maŋbii lɛ, wɔfɔ̃fɔ̃ɔ oshiki yɛ laihamɔ hewɔ, koni ato naa akɛba wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, yɛ bei ni ato lɛ amli daa afi, koni ashã yɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ mla lɛ mli lɛ. 35 Asaŋ wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nibaanii kɛ tso fɛɛ tso nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii aaaba Yehowa we lɛ daa afi.
36 Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔkromɔbihii kɛ wɔkooloi akromɔbii hu kɛ wɔtsinai akromɔbii kɛ wɔtoi akromɔbii aaaba wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ wɔkɛbahã osɔfoi lɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ.
37 Wɔkɛ mã ni ana yɛ abele ni akpa klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ mli kɛ tso fɛɛ tso klɛŋklɛŋ yibii, kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wain kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ mu aaaba abahã osɔfoi lɛ koni akɛwo wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ nitoohe lɛ mli. Wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔshi nibaanii amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome kome baahã Levibii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ ji mɛi ni baŋɔɔ nibaanii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome kome lɛ yɛ akrowai ni wɔhuɔ yɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ.
38 Kɛ Levibii lɛ miihe nibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ ni ji Aaron bii lɛ afata amɛhe. Levibii lɛ kɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ hu mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome aba wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ ni akɛwo nitoohe lɛ mli.
39Ejaakɛ esa akɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ abele kɛ wain hee kɛ mu lɛ aya ayawo nitoohe lɛ mli he ni he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nibii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ lalatsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Wɔŋmɛŋ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ he wɔfɔŋ shi dɔŋŋ.

Title: NEHEMIA 11
Content:
Mɛi ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ
1Maŋbii lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ hi Yerusalɛm, ni maŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ fɔ̃fɔ̃ɔ oshikii koni akɛtao mɔ kome yɛ mɛi nyɔŋma fɛɛ mɛi nyɔŋma ateŋ koni ebahi Yerusalɛm, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, koni mɛi nɛɛhu ni eshwɛ lɛ ayahi maji krokomɛi lɛ amli. 2Maŋbii lɛ jie hii fɛɛ ni here amɛhe akɛ amɛaahi Yerusalɛm lɛ yi. 3 Yuda maji lɛ amli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ: Israelbii, kɛ osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ Sɔlemɔ we sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Solomon tsuji abii lɛ.
4Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ onukpai komɛi hi Yerusalɛm. Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ Yudabii ji amɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu Benyaminbii ni. Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Ataia ni ji Uzia bi, Zakaria bi lɛ. Eseshi mli mɛi krokomɛi ji Amaria kɛ Shefatia kɛ Mahalalel ni jɛ Perez weku lɛ mli lɛ.
5Yudabii krokomɛi ji Maaseia, Baruk bi lɛ ni eji Kol-Hoze nabi lɛ. Eseshi mli bii krokomɛi ji Hazaia kɛ Adaia kɛ Yoiarib kɛ Zakaria, Yuda bi Shela shwie lɛ.
6Perizbii fɛɛ ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ ayibɔ feɔ mɛi ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ; hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ji amɛ fɛɛ.
7Benyaminbii lɛ ekomɛi ji Salu, Meshulam bi lɛ ni eji Yoed nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi krokomɛi hu ji Pedaia kɛ Kolaia kɛ Maaseia kɛ Itiel kɛ Yeshaia.
8Salu seshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi hu ji Gabai kɛ Salai.
Benyaminbii ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ fɛɛ naa shiɔ mɛi ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
9Yoel, Zikri bi lɛ, ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ; ni Yuda, Hasenua bi lɛ, ji esɛɛmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
10Osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Yedaia, Yoiarib bi, kɛ Yakin.
11Kɛ Seraia, Hilkia bi ni ji Meshulam nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi ji Ahitub, mɔ ni ye Osɔfonukpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ. 12Amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ayibɔ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ sɔmɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. Mɔ kroko hu ji Adaia, Yeroham bi lɛ ni ji Pelaia nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi ji Amzi kɛ Zakaria kɛ Pashur kɛ Malkiya.
13Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ateiaŋ mɛi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ fee wei amli onukpai. Ekomɛi ji Amashsai Azarel bi ni eji Ahazia nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ emli mɛi komɛi ji Meshilemot kɛ Imer.
14Enyɛmimɛi lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni amɛyibɔ ji oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ. Mɔ ni kwɛɔ amɛnɔ ji Zabdiel, Gedolim bi lɛ.
15Levibii lɛ ji Shemaia, Hashub ni ji, Azrikam nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi ji Hashabia Buni.
16Shabetai kɛ Yozabad ji Levi onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni kwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ. 17Mɛi komɛi hu ji Matania, Mika bi ni ji Zabdi nabi mɔ ni eji Asaf shwie lɛ. Lɛ enyiɛ lalɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛlaa kɛdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ. Mɔ ko hu ji Bakbukia ni ji Matania sɛɛmɔ kɛ Abda, Shamua bi lɛ ni ji Galai ni ji Yedutun nabi lɛ. 18Levibii fɛɛ ni hi Yerusalɛm, Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ ayibɔ ji ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ejwɛ. 19Agbonaabulɔi lɛ ji Akub kɛ Talmon kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ. Amɛyibɔ ji mɛi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ. 20Israelbii ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hi Yuda maji lɛ fɛɛ amli, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ. 21Shi mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hi Ofel. Amɛnukpai ji Ziha kɛ Gishpa.
22Mɔ ni kwɛ Levibii ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ nɔ ji Uzi, Bani bi Hashabia bi Matania bi Mika bi lɛ. Ejɛ Asaf bii alalatsɛmɛi ni kwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.
23Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo kitã yɛ lalatsɛmɛi lɛ ahewɔ, ni ato amɛgbɛnaa afɔ̃ shi kɛhã gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ nitsumɔ.
24Petahia, Meshezabel ni jɛ Zera tsɛmɛi awe lɛ kɛ Yuda weku lɛ mli lɛ bi lɛ ji Persia Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni kɔɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ mli.
Maji bibii kɛ ewuji krokomɛi lɛ amli bii
25 Yɛ akrowai kɛ humɔhei amlihilɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hi Kiriat-Arba kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli, kɛ Dibon kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli, kɛ Yekabzeel kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli.
26Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hu hi Yeshua, Molada, kɛ Bet-Pelet 27kɛ Hazar-Shual kɛ Beersheba kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli, 28 kɛ Ziklag kɛ Mekona kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli. 29Mɛi komɛi hu hi En-Rimon kɛ Zora kɛ Yarmut 30kɛ Zanoa kɛ Adullam kɛ amɛhe akrowai lɛ amli. Amɛhi Lakish kɛ ehumɔhei lɛ kɛ Azeka kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli. 31 Benyaminbii lɛ hi Geba, Mikmash, Aia kɛ Betel kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ ni ji 32Anatot kɛ Nob kɛ Anania amli. 33Mɛi komɛi hu hi Hazor kɛ Rama kɛ Gitaim 34kɛ Hadid kɛ Zeboim kɛ Nebalat, 35kɛ Lod kɛ Ono ni ji Ŋaalɔi Ajɔɔ lɛ mli. 36Levibii akui lɛ ekomɛi ni hi Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe yabɔ Benyaminbii lɛ ahe.

Title: NEHEMIA 12
Content:
Osɔfoi kɛ Levibii agbɛii
1 Osɔfoi kɛ Levibii ni kɛ Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Yeshua jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ agbɛii nɛ:
Osɔfoi
Seraia kɛ Yeremia kɛ Ezra 2kɛ Amaria kɛ Maluk kɛ Hatush, 3Shekania kɛ Rehum kɛ Meremot, 4 Ido kɛ Ginetoi kɛ Abia, 5Miyamin kɛ Maadia kɛ Bilga, 6Shemia kɛ Yoiarib kɛ Yedaia 7Salu kɛ Amok kɛ Hilkia kɛ Yedaia.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ onukpai yɛ Yoshua be lɛ mli.
Levibii
8 Levibii lɛ ji Yeshua kɛ Binui kɛ Kadmiel kɛ Sherebia kɛ Yuda kɛ Matania. Matania ji lalɔi akui lɛ atsɛ, 9 ni ekɛ enyɛmimɛi ni ji Levibii: Bakbukia kɛ Uno damɔɔ shi ni mɛnɛɛmɛi miikwɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi ahiɛ, ni amɛhereɔ lala lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Osɔfonukpa Yoshua shwiei
10Yeshua fɔ Yoiakim, ni Yoiakim fɔ Eliashib, ni Eliashib fɔ Yoiada.
11Yoiada fɔ Yonatan, ni Yonatan fɔ Yadua.
Osɔfoi awei lɛ ayitsei
12Be ni Yehoiakim yeɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ, osɔfoi atsɛmɛi awei lɛ ayitsei nɛ: Seraiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Meraiatsɛ we; Yeremia lɛ yitso ji Hanania.
13Ezratsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Meshulam, Amariatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Yehohanan.
14Melukitsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Yonatan; Shebaniatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Yosef.
15Harimtsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Adna; Meraiottsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Helkai.
16Idotsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Zakaria; Ginetontsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Meshulam.
17Abiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Zikri; Miniamin ni ji Moadiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Piltai.
18Bilgatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Shamuatsɛ we; Shemaia lɛ yitso ji Yehonatan.
19Yoairibtsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Matenai; Yedaiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Uzi.
20Salaitsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Kalai; Amoktsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Eber.
21Hilkiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Hashabia; Yedaiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Netanel.
Aŋmã osɔfoi awei kɛ Levibii awei ayitsei agbɛii
22Osɔfonukpai ni ji Eliashib kɛ Yoiada kɛ Yohanan kɛ Yadua yinɔ lɛ, aŋmã Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ ayitsei lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ agbɛii. Agbe gbɛiŋmaa nɛɛ naa yɛ Dario, Persianyo lɛ maŋtsɛyeli be lɛ mli.
23Shi Levibii ni ji tsɛmɛi awei lɛ amɛyitsei lɛ, aŋmã amɛgbɛii yɛ wolo ni Yinɔi Anɔ Saji yɔɔ mli lɛ mli. Aŋmã Levibii awei lɛ ayitsei lɛ agbɛii nɛɛ kɛyashi Yohanan, Eliashib nabi lɛ, yinɔ.
Aja Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ
24Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ ayitsei ni ji Hashibia kɛ Sherebia kɛ Yeshua, Kadmiel bi lɛ, to gbɛjianɔ. Afee kui enyɔ; ku kome miijie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛmiida lɛ shi; belɛ ku ni ji enyɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhiɛ lɛ miihere nɔ. Amɛ jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛda lɛ shi tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ David ewo kitã lɛ.
25 Matania kɛ Bakbukia kɛ Obadia kɛ Meshulam kɛ Talmon kɛ Akub ji agbonaakwɛlɔi. Amɛ amɛbuɔ agboi lɛ anaa nitoohei lɛ ahe.
26 Mɛnɛɛmɛi hi shi yɛ Yoakim, Yozadak bi Yeshua bi lɛ, kɛ Amralo Nehemia kɛ Osɔfo Ezra ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ yinɔ.
Nehemia fee Yerusalɛm Gbogbo lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ
27Be ni abaajɔɔ Yerusalɛm gbogbo lɛ nɔ afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ayatao Levibii yɛ hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ amɛ ba Yerusalɛm koni amɛbaye hetsuumɔ gbijurɔ lɛ kɛ nyamɔ kɛ shidaa lalai kɛ ŋoŋoi kɛ kpãa saŋkui. 28Levibii Lalɔi awekui lɛ babua amɛhe naa. Mɛi ni jɛ Yerusalɛm niiaŋ kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Netofat akrowai lɛ akpokpai anɔ fɛɛ ba. 29Mɛi komɛi hu jɛ Bet-Gilgal kɛ Geba koi asɛɛ kɛ Azmavet, ejaakɛ lalɔi nɛɛ etotoo akrowai kɛbɔle Yerusalɛm. 30Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tsuu amɛhe. Asaŋ amɛtsuu maŋ lɛ kɛ agboi lɛ kɛ gbogbo lɛ hu ahe.
31Kɛkɛ ni mihã Yuda onukpai lɛ kwɔ kɛba gbogbo lɛ nɔ. Mifee lalɔi akui kpelekplei enyɔ koni amɛto kɛnyiɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛ shidaa lalai.
Ku kome tsɔ̃ ninejurɔgbɛ yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya Tumo Agbo lɛ naa gbɛ. 32Hoshaia kɛ Yuda onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi fã nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ. 33Mɛi ni fata he ji Azaria kɛ Ezra kɛ Meshulam kɛ 34Yuda kɛ Benyamin kɛ Shemaia kɛ Yeremia. 35Be ni ayaa lɛ belɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi miikpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi. Amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji Zakaria, Yonatan bi lɛ. Enii kɛ ekaŋsowai ji Shemaia kɛ Matania kɛ Mikaia kɛ Zakur kɛ Asaf. 36Ewekumɛi ji Shemaia kɛ Azarel Malalai kɛ Gilalai kɛ Maai kɛ Netanel kɛ Yuda kɛ Hanani. Amɛ hu amɛnyiɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ David nibii ni akɛtswaa lalai aloo akɛkpãa lalai lɛ. Ezra, woloŋmalɔ kpanaa lɛ nyiɛ ku nɛɛ hiɛ. 37Amɛtsɔ̃ Nubu Agbo lɛ he; ni amɛtee amɛhiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛyakwɔ atrakpoi ni akwɔɔ kɛyaa David maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Amɛkwɔ yɛ kwɔɔhe lɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ David we lɛ he kɛtee Nu Agbo lɛ he yɛ bokãgbɛ.
