38Lalɔi ni daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ aku ni ji enyɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ abɛkugbɛ. Mi kɛ maŋ lɛ fã nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Flɔɔnɔi Amɔ̃ɔ lɛ yiteŋ aahu kɛyashi Gbogbo Lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ he. 39Wɔtse mli kɛtsɔ̃ Efraim Agbo lɛ kɛ Agbo Momo lɛ kɛ Loi Agbo lɛ he. Wɔyawa wɔdamɔ shi yɛ Bulɔi Agbo lɛ naa.
40No hewɔ lɛ, lalɔi akui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ni daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ kɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi fã ni fata mihe lɛ yashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ. 41Osɔfoi ni fata he ji Eliakim kɛ Maaseia kɛ Miniamin kɛ Mikaia kɛ Elioenai kɛ Zakaria kɛ Hanania ni amɛhiɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi. 42Mɛi ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ ji Maaseia kɛ Shemaia kɛ Eleazar kɛ Uzi kɛ Yohanan kɛ Malia kɛ Elam kɛ Ezer. Yezrahia kɛ elalɔi aku lɛ la waa diɛŋtsɛ.
43Nakai gbi lɛ amɛshã shãa afɔlei babaoo, ni amɛnyã, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe waa naakpa. Yei kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ hu nyãnyãa waa bɔ ni anu nyamɔ ni anyãa yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ he yɛ shɔŋŋ tete.
Ato gbɛjianɔ ahã jamɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ
44Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, afamɔ hii komɛi ato nitoohei lɛ anɔ: nitoohei nɛɛ ji hei ni akɛ nɔwomɔ afɔlei kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii afɔlei lɛ kɛ nibii amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ toɔ. Afamɔ hii nɛɛ koni amɛbua ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ maji lɛ ahe lɛ amli nii lɛ amlijai nyɔŋma ni mla lɛ to lɛ naa amɛwo nitoohei lɛ amli amɛhã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ. Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii na osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii ni damɔɔ shi sɔmɔɔ lɛ ahe miishɛɛ; 45 ejaakɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ ye hetsuumɔ mlai lɛ kɛ gbɛnai krokomɛi ni amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ to lɛ anɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ lalɔi lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ tsu amɛgbɛnaanii tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ ebi Solomon wo kitã ni afee lɛ. 46Ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Lalatsɛ Asaf yinɔ beebe ato lalɔi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ; ni amɛla yijiemɔ kɛ shidaa lalai amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ. 47Zerubabel yinɔ kɛ Nehemia yinɔ lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ hãa nikeenii daa gbi, ni akɛkwɛɔ lalɔi lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ. Maŋ lɛ jieɔ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ amɛfɔ̃ɔ shi; ni Levibii lɛ hu jieɔ nɔ ni ji Aaronbii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ amɛfɔ̃ɔ shi amɛhãa amɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 13
Content:
Israel maŋ lɛ tse amɛhe yɛ maŋsɛɛbii ahe
1 Nakai gbi lɛ be ni akaneɔ Mose Mla lɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ lɛ, ana ni aŋmã yɛ mli akɛ Amonnyo loo Moabnyo akaba Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii lɛ ahenaabuamɔ lɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ; 2ejaakɛ amɛkɛ aboloo kɛ nu ebakpeee Israelbii lɛ, shi moŋ amɛyabɔ Bileam apaa akɛ ebalomɔ amɛ; shi wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã loomɔ lɛ moŋ tsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ. 3Be ni Israelbii lɛ nu mla lɛ, amɛ jie mɛi fɛɛ ni ji futufutu gbɔmɛi lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Nehemia tsake nibii komɛi
4Shi dani abaafee enɛ lɛ, osɔfoi Eliashib ni akɛ lɛ eto nitoohei ni yɔɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛ Tobia efee ekome kɛto gbɛjianɔ. 5Eliashib saa tsu kpeteŋkple ko ehã Tobia ni ehi mli. Tsu nɛɛ, sa lɛ akɛ nibii komɛi toɔ mli. Nibii nɛɛ ji niyenii afɔlei kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ Sɔlemɔ we tsɛnsii kɛ ŋmɔshinii ni ji abele kɛ wain kɛ mu mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ, ni awo he kitã akɛ akɛhã Levibii lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lalɔi lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ. Nɔ ni fata nibii ni akɛtoɔ tsu nɛɛ mli lɛ he ji afɔlei ni akɛhãa osɔfoi lɛ. 6Shi nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ mibɛ Yerusalɛm, ejaakɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mitee eŋɔɔ. Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, mibi maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛ, 7ni miku misɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm. Mibana sane gbonyo ni Eliashib eye akɛ esaa tsu ehã Tobia yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ. 8Mimli wo la naakpa, ni mijie Tobia nibii fɛɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli mishwie. 9Kɛkɛ ni mifã akɛ asha nitoohei lɛ amli koni akɛtsuu amɛmli: ni mihã akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nibii lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ krɔbɔo lɛ ku sɛɛ akɛbato jɛi ekoŋŋ.
10Minu hu akɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lalɔi lɛ ni amɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ejo foi etee eŋmɔ mli, ejaakɛ ahãaa amɛ amɛgbɛnaa niyenii lɛ. 11No hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ dɔ wo hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, ni mibi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ajo foi ashi Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ?” Mibua Levibii lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lalɔi lɛ anaa kɛba, ni mikɛ amɛ yato amɛgbɛhe. 12Kɛkɛ ni Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i abele kɛ wain kɛ mu mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ nitoohei lɛ amli woo ekoŋŋ. 13Mito nitoohe lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi: amɛ ji Osɔfoi Shelemia kɛ Zadok, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Pedaia ni jɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ. Amɛsɛɛmɔ ji Hanan, Matania bi Zakur bi lɛ. Mito gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ abuɔ amɛ anɔkwafoi. Amɛnitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛja nii lɛ amɛhã amɛnyɛmimɛi nitsulɔi lɛ.
14 MiNyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ mi yɛ enɛ hewɔ, ni ohiɛ akakpa nitsumɔi kpakpai ni mitsu yɛ owe lɛ kɛ emli sɔ̃ɔmɔ ahe lɛ anɔ. 15 Nakai be lɛ mli mina akɛ mɛi ŋaa wainyibii yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ yɛ Yuda. Mina akɛ akɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ wainyibii kɛ agbãmi jatsui kɛ jatsui srɔtoi fɛɛ tereɔ tejii kɛbaa Yerusalɛm yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ. Migbɛ miwo amɛ yɛ gbi nɔ ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ hewɔ.
16Tirobii komɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ kɛ loo kɛ guɔnii srɔtoi fɛɛ baa amɛbahɔ̃ɔ amɛhãa Yudabii lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ tete yɛ Yerusalɛm. 17Mikã Yuda abladei lɛ ahiɛ, ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sane fɔŋ nyɛyeɔ ni nyɛkɛbuleɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɛɛ? 18Ani jeee nɛkɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã efɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ ba wɔ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ? Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkɛ bulemɔ ni nyɛbuleɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ miitsɛ mlifu kɛba Israel nɔ nyɛfata he.”
19No hewɔ lɛ, dani aaaje hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛji hiɛ bɔ̃i tuutuu feemɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ amli pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ mifãa ni aŋamɔ agboi lɛ, ni miwoɔ kitã akɛ akagbele, ja hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eho dã. Asaŋ mifamɔ mitsuji lɛ ekomɛi mito agboi lɛ anaa koni akɛ jatsu ko akaba maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ. 20Jarayelɔi lɛ kɛ guɔyelɔi ni hɔ̃ɔ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ lɛ bato agboi lɛ asɛɛ shi kome loo shii enyɔ. 21Mibɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛbatoɔ gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ? Kɛ nyɛfee nakai ekoŋŋ lɛ, mibamɔmɔ nyɛ.” Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛbaaa hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ. 22Kɛkɛ ni mifã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛtsuu amɛhe koni amɛba amɛbabu agboi lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni afee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ mi yɛ enɛ hu hewɔ koni okɛ mihe eshai afa mi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni fa lɛ hewɔ.
23Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ mina akɛ Yudafoi pii eŋɔ Ashdodyei kɛ Amonyei kɛ Moabyei. 24Amɛbii lɛ wieɔ Ashdod wiemɔ lɛ loo wiemɔ kroko fã kɛ fã, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ Yudafoi awiemɔ lɛ amɛwie. 25 Mihiɛ dɔ wo amɛ, ni milomɔ amɛ. Miyi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi, ni mifamɔ amɛyiteŋ tsɔi. Mihã amɛkã Nyɔŋmɔ kitã akɛ amɛkɛ amɛbiyei lɛ haŋ maŋsɛɛbii abihii gbãlã, ni amɛŋɔŋ maŋsɛɛbii abiyei amɛhaŋ amɛbihii lɛ. Asaŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu amɛkɛ maŋsɛɛbii ehiŋ shi. 26 Mikɛ amɛ wie ni mikɛɛ, “Ani jeee yei tamɔ Mɛnɛɛmɛi nɔŋŋ hã Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon fee esha, tsɛ maŋtsɛ ko maŋtsɛ ko bɛ je nɛɛŋ maji babaoo lɛ eko nɔ ni tamɔ lɛ? Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ maŋtsɛ ni eye Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Kɛ̃lɛ Solomon po maŋsɛɛ yei hã efee esha. 27Aso wɔɔkɔ nyɛnane ni wɔfee nɛkɛ efɔŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ? Aso wɔɔŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei ni wɔje wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ?”
28Osɔfonukpa Eliashib bi ji Yoiada. Yoiada bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome yaŋɔ Sanbalat Horonnyo lɛ biyoo, ni ekɛ Sanbalat fee shaanuu. No hewɔ lɛ, mishwie Yoiada bi lɛ yɛ mihe.
29MiNyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ wo osɔfoyeli he muji ni amɛfite kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ.
30Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ mitsɔ̃ mijie maŋ lɛ kɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni buleɔ mɔ mli. Mito osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ gbɛjianɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale enitsumɔ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ. 31Ni mito gbɛjianɔ mihã be ni akɛ afɔleshãa lai kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yelitso yibii aba.
MiNyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ mi ni ahi ahã mi.

Title: ESTER WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Ester wolo lɛ gbaa wɔ saji komɛi ni ba yɛ Persia Maŋtsɛ lɛ maŋtsɛwe he ni eyayeɔ fɛ̃i be yɛ lɛ. Ni mɔ ko ni he sane yɔɔ saji lɛ amli titri ji Yuda fɔmɔbi yoo ko ni egbɛi ji Ester lɛ. Bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Ester dɔɔ emaŋbii Yudafoi lɛ ahe hewɔ lɛ, ebɔ he mɔdɛŋ jogbaŋŋ ni etsĩ yiŋsha ni ato kɛbaakpãtã Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ naa. Wolo lɛ gbaa bɔ ni fee ni Yudafoi na afi gbijurɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Purim lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Ester tsɔ̃ Maŋnyɛ 1.1—2.23
Yiŋsha ni Haman to lɛ 3.1—5.14
Haman gbele 6.1—7.10
Yudafoi ye amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ 8.1—10.3

Title: ESTER 1
Content:
Maŋnyɛ Vashti tse Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh hiɛ atua
1Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ye shikpɔji oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo anɔ akɛ maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ India aahu kɛyashi Etiopia.
2Susa maŋ lɛ mli ji he ni emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ yɔɔ, ni jɛi ejɛɔ ni eyeɔ maji lɛ anɔ.
3Emaŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ ehã elumɛi kɛ etsuji fɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli. Mɛi okplɔ̃ ni eŋmɛ lɛ ji Persia kɛ Media shikpɔji lɛ anɔ tatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amralofoi lɛ. 4Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɔ nyɔji ekpaa, ni ekɛjie emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ he nibii ni woɔ ehiɛ nyam, asaŋ ni tsɔ̃ɔ egbojee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ.
5Be ni akɛ nibii lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ agbe naa lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsɛ mɛi wujiwuji kɛ mɛi bibii hu fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli nakai beiaŋ lɛ okplɔ̃, gbii kpawo yɛ trom ko ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he lɛ kpo teŋ lɛ mli. 6Bɔ ni awula kpo teŋ lɛ mli ahã nɛ. Akɛ tɛi eŋɔlii kɛ tɛi yɛji kɛ tɛi bluu kɛ tɛi diji eka kpo lɛ nɔ; ni akɛ tɛi yɛji akulashiŋi emamɔ tɛi ni aka lɛ anɔ. Jwiɛtɛi gai yɛ akulashiŋi nɛɛ ahe. Akɛ kpãa yɛŋ fɛɛfɛo kɛ kpãa afaseo emɔmɔ mamai yɛji fɛɛfɛji kɛ mamai bluu lɛ hu anaa; kɛkɛ ni akɛŋmɔlɔ jwiɛtɛi akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ, ni ehã mamai lɛ tsotsoro shi. Mlikpãmɔ saatsei pɛmpɛbii ni akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi fee mamɔ kpo teŋ lɛ mli hei komɛi. 7Gbi lɛ awo dãa yɛ shika kpuji srɔtoisrɔtoi amli. Maŋtsɛ lɛ hã awo mɛi ni ekpee lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edãa ni enuɔ lɛ eko babaoo, bɔ ni ewo ehiɛ nyam akɛ maŋtsɛ. 8Maŋtsɛ lɛ wo ewe lɛ mli tsuji lɛ mla akɛ ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ dãa bɔ ni mɔ lɛ baanyɛ anu; mɔ ni enuuu lɛ akɛkafi enɔ; ni mɔ ni baanu lɛ akakama lɛ. 9Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Maŋnyɛ Vashti ŋmɛ yei sɔŋŋ hu okplɔ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli diɛŋtsɛ.
10Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ be ni dãa lɛ ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ mli efili lɛ lɛ, etsɛ epiafoi kpawo ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ. Amɛ ji Mehuman kɛ Bizta kɛ Harbona kɛ Bitha kɛ Abagta kɛ Zeter kɛ Karkas. 11Kɛkɛ ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛya koni amɛyaŋɔ Maŋnyɛ Vashti kɛba ehiɛ; ebu emaŋnyɛ fai lɛ kɛba. Anɔkwa emaŋnyɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo jogbaŋŋ, ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh miitao akɛ egbɔi lɛ ana emaŋnyɛ lɛ he fɛo lɛ. 12Shi Maŋnyɛ Vashti kwa, ni eyaaa tsɛmɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu piafoi lɛ akɛ abatsɛ lɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ mli fu naakpa ni emli wo la.
13Kɛji sane ko ba nɛkɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh sumɔɔ akɛ ebi ŋaawoo yɛ nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni le shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mlai amli kɛ saneyeli mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ adɛŋ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ eŋaawolɔi lɛ.
14Mɛi adɛŋ ŋaawoo ni efɔɔ bimɔ ji Karshena kɛ Shetar kɛ Admata kɛ Tarshish kɛ Meres kɛ Marsena kɛ Memukan ni ji Persia kɛ Media lumɛi ni hiɛ gbɛnai wujiwuji yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ. 15Ekɛɛ ŋaawolɔi nɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛni, yɛ mla lɛ naa, esa akɛ afeɔ Maŋnyɛ Vashti akɛni mi, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh, mitsu piafoi kɛ wiemɔ kɛtee eŋɔɔ, ni ekwa, ni eyeee wiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ?” 16Kɛkɛ ni Memukan kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ akɛ, “Jeee Maŋtsɛ kɛkɛ nɔ Maŋnyɛ Vashti etɔ̃ lɛ, shi moŋ etɔ̃ lumɛi fɛɛ kɛ majimaji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh shishi shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ lɛ mli bii lɛ anɔ. 17Ejaakɛ kɛji ayagba akɛ, ‘Naa, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh fã akɛ ayatsɛ Maŋnyɛ Vashti abahã lɛ lɛ, maŋnyɛ lɛ baaa lɛ,’ sane lɛ baagbɛ eshwã yei fɛɛ ateŋ, ni ebaahã yei awumɛi ahe guɔ agbo yɛ amɛŋamɛi ahiɛ. 18Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Persia kɛ Media lumɛi lɛ aŋamɛi ni baanu nɔ ni maŋnyɛ lɛ efee lɛ baabɔ amɛwumɛi amaniɛ. Wumɛi ahe guɔ baagbo yɛ ŋamɛi ahiɛ, ni enɛ kɛ mlifu babaoo baaba. 19No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Maŋtsɛ miisumɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ awo akpɔ, ni aŋma ashi Persia kɛ Media mlai lɛ anɔ, (asaŋ ni akɛɛ hu) akɛ Maŋnyɛ Vashti akana Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh hiɛ dɔŋŋ. No sɛɛ lɛ, Nii, okɛ emaŋnyɛyeli lɛ ahã yoo kroko ni fe lɛ. 20Kɛji ashiɛ Maŋtsɛ dɛŋ akpɔ nɛɛ yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli shikpɔŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ heihei fɛɛ lɛ, ebaahã yeigbãyei fɛɛ ahiɛ asɔ amɛwumɛi, mɛi wuji kɛ mɛi bibii fɛɛ.”
21Ŋaawoo lɛ sa Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛ elumɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ fee nɔ ni Memukan kɛɛ lɛ. 22Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsu kɛ woji kɛtee eshikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Aŋma shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ wolo lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niŋmaa kɛ ewiemɔ mli akɛ, “Nuu fɛɛ nuu lɛ, lɛ eye ewe nɔ; ni nɔ ni lɛ ebaakɛɛ lɛ, no afee naagbee.”

Title: ESTER 2
Content:
Ester tsɔ̃ Maŋnyɛ
1Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ, be mli ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh mlila lɛ naa eba shi tete po lɛ, kɛfee lɛ ekaiɔ Vashti kɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ, kɛ nɔ hu ni afee lɛ lɛ. 2Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko wo maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, hã atao oblayei froi ni ahe yɔɔ fɛo lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ahã bo. 3Maŋtsɛ baanyɛ eto tsuji yɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ koni amɛbua oblayei froi ni ahe yɔɔ fɛo lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛba yei awe lɛ mli yɛ Susa, ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli. Atu oblayei nɛɛ awo Hegai ni ji maŋtsɛ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ yei asaji anɔ lɛ dɛŋ koni ekwɛ ni ahiɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ. 4Ni oblayoo ni baasa maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ aŋɔ lɛ akɛ maŋnyɛ ato Vashti najiaŋ.”
Maŋtsɛ lɛ na akɛ ŋaawoo lɛ hi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eye nɔ.
5Nakai be mli lɛ Yudanyo ko yɛ Susa, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mɔdekai. Benyaminnyo Yair bi ji lɛ, ni efeɔ Shimei nabi kɛ Kish nanakansowa.
6Eshi nomii ni fata Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yekonia he lɛ anɔ, be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yaŋɔ Yekonia nom kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛba Babilon lɛ.
7Be ni Mɔdekai baa lɛ ekɛ etsɛkwɛ̃ ko biyoo ko ba, ejaakɛ awusa ni. Oblayoo nɛɛ gbɛi ji Ester, shi Hebri mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Hadasa. Oblayoo lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni ehiɛŋtso yɛ akɔnɔ pam. Be ni enyɛ kɛ etsɛ fɛɛ gboi lɛ, Mɔdekai ŋɔ lɛ ekɛfee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebiyoo.
8Be ni ashiɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kitã kɛ akpɔ lɛ, ni abua oblayei pii anaa kɛtee Susa mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Ester fata he eko kɛtee, ni akɛ amɛ yahã Hegai yei akwɛlɔ lɛ. 9Ester hiɛ ba nyam yɛ Hegai hiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, etsɛɛɛ kwraa kɛkɛ ni Hegai kɛ mui kɛ niyenii kpakpai kuma Ester. Fee sɛɛ lɛ Hegai jie Ester ni ekɛ lɛ yato yei awe lɛ mli he ko ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni eje gbɛ hu ehala oblayei kpawo yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli ablawai lɛ ateŋ, ni ekɛ amɛ to Ester he koni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ.
10Ŋaa ni Mɔdekai wo Ester hewɔ lɛ, Ester (kɛ ŋaawoo lɛ to eyiŋ) ni egbaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko emaŋ kɛ eweku mli ni ejɛ. 11Daa gbi lɛ Mɔdekai yasharaa shi yɛ yei awe lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni ele bɔ ni Ester yɔɔ, kɛ bɔ ni eyaa nɔ ehãa.
12Be ni ayeɔ akɛsaa oblayoo gbɔmɔtso ji nyɔji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Oblayoo lɛ kɛ mire mu gbɔleɔ egbɔmɔtso nyɔji ekpaa; ni ekɛ nyɔji ekpaa kroko hu kpaa krɔbɔo kɛ tsofakɛŋmai. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, atoɔ naa ni aŋɔɔ oblayoo fɛɛ oblayoo akɛyahãa Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh. 13Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni oblayoo lɛ biɔ lɛ ahãa lɛ yɛ yei awe lɛ mli ni ekɛ saa ehe kɛyaa maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 14Eyaa maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ gbɛkɛ, ni enɔ leebi lɛ akpalaa lɛ kɛyaa yei awe kroko mli, ni akɛ lɛ yawoɔ Shaashgaz, maŋtsɛ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ hemɛi lɛ, dɛŋ. Oblayoo lɛ eyaaa maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ bɛja maŋtsɛ lɛ ena ehe tsui ni etsu kɛ yoo lɛ gbɛi akɛ atsɛ lɛ ahã lɛ. 15Agbɛnɛ ebashɛ Ester ni ji Mɔdekai tsɛkwɛ Abihail biyoo mɔ ni eŋɔ lɛ efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaya maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Ester diɛŋtsɛ biii nɔ ko nɔ ko koni ekɛsaa ehe kɛya. Nɔ ni Hegai, maŋtsɛ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ yei lɛ, kɔ hã lɛ lɛ, no Ester kɛsaa ehe. Ni Ester he fee mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ lɛ akɔnɔ pam. 16Kɛkɛ ni aŋɔ Ester ayahã Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli we lɛ mli. Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji kpawo lɛ mli Tebet nyɔŋ lɛ ni ji nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ akɛ Ester yahã lɛ lɛ. 17Maŋtsɛ lɛ sumɔ Ester fe oblayei krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Ester hiɛ ba nyam jogbaŋŋ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ fe yei fɛɛ; ni ena ehe miishɛɛ fe oblayei lɛ fɛɛ ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ maŋnyɛyeli akekre lɛ fi Ester yitso kɛkɛ ni ewo lɛ maŋnyɛ yɛ Vashti najiaŋ. 18Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple ekɛwo Ester hiɛ nyam; ni ekpee eshishi lumɛi kɛ etsuji fɛɛ kɛba okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi. Ehã eshishi shikpɔji lɛ ye gbi ko akɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi; ni ekekee mɛi nii babaoo bɔ ni sa maŋtsɛ.
Mɔdekai here Maŋtsɛ lɛ yiwala
19Be ko hu be ni abua oblayei lɛ anaa ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ ahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, no mli lɛ Mɔdekai shi maŋtsɛ koishi onukpai lɛ anɔ. 20Nɛkɛ be mli fɛɛ lɛ Ester egbako mɔ ko kwraa akɛ Yudayoo ji lɛ, taakɛ bɔ ni Mɔdekai ewo lɛ kitã lɛ. Ejaakɛ Ester miiye Mɔdekai gbee nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ tamɔ be mli ni Mɔdekai kwɛɔ enɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
21Be mli ni Mɔdekai tsuɔ nii yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ koishi lɛ, Bigtan kɛ Teresh, maŋtsɛ piafoi enyɔ komɛi ni shi mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli shinai anaa lɛ ahe lɛ, na maŋtsɛ lɛ he mlifu; ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbaagbe Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh. 22Be ni Mɔdekai na nu yiŋtoo nɛɛ lɛ, eyakɛɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester; ni Ester hu bɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ lɛ ni Mɔdekai ebabɔ lɛ lɛ. 23Be ni atao sane lɛ mli lɛ, ebakã shi faŋŋ akɛ eyɛ mli anɔkwale. No hewɔ lɛ, asɛŋ Bigtan kɛ Teresh yɛ tso nɔ, ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh fã, ni aŋma sane nɛɛ awo Yinɔ Asaji wolo lɛ mli yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hiɛ.

Title: ESTER 3
Content:
Haman to Yudafoi lɛ ehe yitso fɔŋ
1Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh wo nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Haman lɛ maŋsɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa ni fe fɛɛ. Haman nɛɛ tsɛ gbɛi ji Hamedata, ni ejɛ Agag seshi mli. 2Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh fã akɛ etsuji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ esɔ̃ɔmɔ mli lɛ akula shi ni amɛkoto Haman be fɛɛ be. Tsuji lɛ fɛɛ fee nakai, ja Mɔdekai pɛ ni kotooo Haman. 3Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsuji krokomɛi lɛ bi Mɔdekai akɛ, “Mɛɛba otɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ kitã lɛ?” 4Be ni tsuji lɛ kɛ Mɔdekai ewie gbii abɔ, shi fɛɛ lɛ Mɔdekai ekpɛlɛɛɛ akɛ eeekoto Haman lɛ, Mɔdekai kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ Yudanyo ji lɛ ni no hewɔ lɛ, enyɛŋ ekoto Haman. Tsuji lɛ yabɔ Haman amaniɛ koni amɛkwɛ kɛji Haman baakpɛlɛ nɔ ehã Mɔdekai lo. 5Ni be ni Haman na akɛ Mɔdekai kulãaa shi haaa lɛ, ni ekotooo lɛ lɛ, Haman mli fu naakpa. 6Akɛni akɛɛ Haman akɛ Yudanyo ji Mɔdekai hu hewɔ lɛ, Haman to eyiŋ akɛ ekpãtãŋ Mɔdekai kome kɛkɛ hiɛ, shi moŋ ekɛ Mɔdekai he nu baaju Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ahe.
7Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nisan lɛ nɔ lɛ, Haman hã abɔ̃i oshiki, ni ji Pur, fɔ̃ɔ daa gbi kɛtao gbi ni hi hã eyiŋtoo lɛ he nitsumɔ. Afɔ̃ oshiki nɛɛ aahu kɛyashi nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni ji Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
8Kɛkɛ ni Haman kɛɛ maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh akɛ, “Nii, Gbɔmɛi komɛi egbɛ eshwã omaŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji kɛ kpokpai fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛ lɛ esoro amɛkusum kwraa yɛ maŋbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ he, ni amɛyeee maŋtsɛ mlai lɛ anɔ hu. Enɛ lɛ esaaa akɛ Nii aŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ nakai. 9Kɛji esa Maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, no lɛ Nii awo akpɔ akɛ agbe amɛ. Kɛji maŋtsɛ kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ nakai lɛ, no lɛ miiwo shi akɛ mahã jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei nyɔŋma koni akɛwo maŋ fotro lɛ mli koni akɛtsu maŋ lɛ he nii.”
10Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ jie ewolonaasɔomɔ waoga ni ewo lɛ yɛ enine, ni ekɛhã Hamedata bi Haman ni ji Yudafoi lɛ ahenyɛlɔ lɛ. 11Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛɛ Haman akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni jio, shikai ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ni jio, mikɛ fɛɛ ewo odɛ̃ŋ. Feemɔ amɛ bɔ ni osusuɔ akɛ esa.”
12No hewɔ lɛ, afi lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Haman kpee maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔi lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛnaa bakpe shi. Amɛŋma wolo lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Haman fã amɛ akɛ amɛŋma lɛ koni akɛyahã amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi ni kwɛɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli onukpa fɛɛ onukpa hu. Shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ aŋma ewolo lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniŋmãa mli, ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ lɛ aŋma ewolo lɛ yɛ ewiemɔ mli. Aŋmala woji lɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh gbɛi mli, ni akɛ ewolonaasɔomɔ waoga lɛ sɔo naa. 13Kɛkɛ ni akɛ woji lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛtee maŋtsɛ lɛ shishi shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Wiemɔ ni yɔɔ woji lɛ amli ji akɛ gbi kome jenamɔ, ni ji nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni ji Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aplenee Yudafoi ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he, oblahii jio, hiimeji jio, gbekɛbii jio, yei, jio agbe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akɛbule amɛshishi ni asaŋ aha nibii ni amɛyɔɔ. 14Wolo lɛ fã hu akɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, ashiɛ akpɔ nɛɛ koni maji fɛɛ ana ale koni asaa he ato gbi ni ato lɛ.
15Bɔfoi lɛ kɛ woji lɛ shi kɛ foi yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fãmɔ naa kɛtee shikpɔji lɛ anɔ. Ashiɛ akpɔ lɛ yɛ Susa ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli hu. Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛ Haman ho tara shi ni amɛnu dãa, be mli ni akpɔ lɛ ehã Susa maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ejijaa lɛ.

Title: ESTER 4
Content:
Mɔdekai bi Ester dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ
1Be ni Mɔdekai na le nibii fɛɛ ni afee lɛ, ekɛ awerɛho gbala ehe atadei lɛ, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu; asaŋ eloo lamlu ewo eyiteŋ. Kɛkɛ ni eje kpo kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli kɛ yaafo gegeege. 2Etee eyawa maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbo lɛ naa; ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ebuɔ kpekpe kɛboteɔ maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ mli. 3Shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kitã kɛ akpɔ lɛ yashɛ lɛ, ŋkɔmɔyeli kpeteŋkple bagbee shi yɛ jɛi Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ. Amɛhi ŋmãa, amɛye ŋkɔmɔ, amɛwo yara amɛfo, ni mɛi babaoo kɔlɔ kpekpe amɛbu, ni amɛho amɛkamɔ lamlu mli.
4Be ni Ester ablawai lɛ kɛ epiafoi lɛ bagba lɛ nɔ ni Mɔdekai feɔ lɛ, Ester ye jaramɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Etsu ni akɛ atadei tee yahã Mɔdekai koni ekɛtsake kpekpe lɛ yɛ ehe; shi Mɔdekai heee atadei lɛ. 5Kɛkɛ ni Ester tsɛ Hatak, maŋtsɛ lɛ piafoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko ni ato akɛ esɔmɔ lɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ, ni etsu lɛ Mɔdekai ŋɔɔ koni eyatao nɔ sane ni eba lɛ kɛ nɔ ni kɛba hu. 6Hatak tee Mɔdekai ŋɔɔ yɛ blohu ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ mli. 7Mɔdekai gba lɛ sane ni eba enɔ lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ shika hu ni Haman ewo shi akɛ ebaana ewo maŋ fotro lɛ mli kɛji ana aplenee Yudafoi lɛ. 8Ekɛ mla ni awo yɛ Susa akɛ akpãtã Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ nɔ wolo hã Hatak akɛ ekɛyatsɔ̃ɔ Ester. Asaŋ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ eya maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyakpa lɛ fai, ni ewie he ehã emaŋbii Yudafoi lɛ. 9Hatak tee ni eyabɔ Ester nɔ ni Mɔdekai kɛɛ lɛ lɛ. 10Ester kɛ wiemɔ tsu Hatak koni eyakɛɛ Mɔdekai akɛ, 11“Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, ni eeeya eyanina maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ trukaa, be mli ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuko kɛ mɔ lɛ gbɛi tuuŋtu akɛ atsɛ mɔ lɛ ahã lɛ lɛ, mla ni kã shi ji akɛ abaagbe mɔ lɛ. Mla ni kã shi ni ale kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji anɔ aahu kɛyashi maŋbii fɛɛ anɔ ji enɛ. Shi kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ wo eshika tsi lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ no dani mɔ lɛ yi naa wala. Kɛjɛ gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuko koni atsɛ mi ahã lɛ.”
12Be ni wiemɔ nɛɛ shɛ Mɔdekai dɛŋ lɛ, 13Mɔdekai hu tsu kɛ hetoo nɛɛ koni akɛyahã Ester, “Kaasusu akɛ ni oyɔɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ bo lɛ ohe baaje Yudafoi fɛɛ asane nɛɛ mli. 14Ejaakɛ kɛji omua onaa kɛta shi yɛ nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli tete, yelikɛbuamɔ baajɛ he ko kɛ̃ aba ahã Yudafoi, ni abaahere amɛyiwala, shi bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã. Namɔ aaale akɛ eko lɛ nɛkɛ be nɛɛ hewɔ ni ahã obatsɔ̃ maŋnyɛ nɛɛ lɛ.”
15Ester kɛ hetoo nɛɛ tsu akɛyahã Mɔdekai. 16“Yaa ni oyabua Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ anaa kɛkpe; ni nyɛhia ŋmãa, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mi. Nyɛkayea nii, ni nyɛkanua nu hu shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃. Mi hu mi kɛ miblayei lɛ baahi ŋmãa nakai nɔŋŋ. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mibaya mayana maŋtsɛ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ mla eŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ nakai. Kɛji miyagbo yɛ no hewɔ po jiŋŋ efeee nɔ ko.”
17Kɛkɛ ni Mɔdekai yiŋ etee, ni eyafee bɔ ni Ester kɛɛ eyafee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Title: ESTER 5
Content:
Ester ŋmɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh okplɔ̃ kɛ Haman
1Be ni Ester ehi ŋmãa gbii etɛ̃ lɛ ekɔlɔ emaŋnyɛ atadei lɛ ewo, kɛkɛ ni ebote maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli, ni etee eyadamɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ asa lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Nakai be mli lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ asa lɛ nɔ. Eta emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni ehiɛ miikwɛ asa lɛ shinaa lɛ naagbɛ. 2Be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ na Maŋnyɛ Ester damɔ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ena maŋnyɛ lɛ he tsuijurɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekpã enine mli ni ekɛ shika tsi ni ehiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Ester hiɛ. Ester tsi ebɛŋkɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ enine ta tsi lɛ (yitso lɛ) he. 3Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maŋnyɛ Ester, mɛni sane ni, mɛni otaoɔ? Nɔ ni ji lɛ bi, ni abaafee ahã bo aahu, kɛji mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlijaa ni po.”
4Ester to he akɛ, “Kɛji Maŋtsɛ baasumɔ lɛ, no lɛ Nii kɛ Haman aba okplɔ̃ ko ni miiŋmɛ mahã Nii lɛ he ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ.”
5Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ atsɛ Haman kɛba mramra koni amɛya Ester okplɔ̃ ni eŋmɛɔ lɛ lɛ he amɛyaye nii. Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Haman tee okplɔ̃ ni Maŋnyɛ Ester ŋmɛ lɛ he. 6Be mli ni anuɔ wain lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ bi Ester akɛ, “Mɛni ji osane lɛ; mɛni otaoɔ? Nɔ ni ji lɛ bi, ni mafee mahã bo aahu kɛji mi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlijaa ni po.” 7Ester here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 8“Kɛji mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ Maŋtsɛ hiɛ, ni Nii yɛ he suɔmɔ akɛ eeefee nɔ ni mabi lɛ ehã mi lɛ, no lɛ Nii kɛ Haman aba okplɔ̃ kroko ko ni mibaŋmɛ amɛ wɔ lɛ he koni mikɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ ni mabi lɛ aŋmɛ Nii hiɛ wɔ.”
Haman to Mɔdekai gbele he ŋaa
9Haman shi maŋtsɛ we lɛ gbi lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ mliflimɔ. Shi be ni ena Mɔdekai yɛ maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi, ni Mɔdekai eteee shi ehãaa lɛ, asaŋ ni ehe hu kpokpooo lɛ, Haman mli wo Mɔdekai la naakpa. 10Shi kɛ̃lɛ Haman ye ehe nɔ, ni eyiŋ etee ewe lɛ, ni etsu ayatsɛ enanemɛi abahã lɛ; etsɛ eŋa Zeresh hu ebafata enanemɛi lɛ ahe. 11Haman kɛ enii ni eyɔɔ kɛ emusuŋbii ayifalɛ kɛ bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo enɔ grɔŋŋ kɛ bɔ ni ehiɛ hewalɛ fe lumɛi kɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ shi ehe nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 12Etee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋnyɛ Ester po hãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ aba okplɔ̃ ni eŋmɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he akɛ ja mi, ni wɔ hu ekpee mi kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛmiiya wɔyaye nii. 13Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni minaa Mɔdekai Yudanyo lɛ ta maŋtsɛ koi shi lolo lɛ mitsui etɔɔɔ.” 14No hewɔ lɛ, eŋa lɛ kɛ enanemɛi lɛ fɛɛ wo lɛ ŋaa akɛ, “Hã akla tsei ama shi; ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Obi maŋtsɛ lɛ koni asɛŋ Mɔdekai yɛ nɔ wɔ leebi. No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ aya okplɔ̃ lɛ he kɛ miishɛɛ.” Ŋaa ni awo nɛɛ ŋɔɔ Haman naa; ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehã akla sɛŋmɔtso lɛ ama shi.

Title: ESTER 6
Content:
Maŋtsɛ lɛ wo Mɔdekai hiɛ nyam
1Nakai gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ wɔ tse yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiŋmɛiŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ ayakɔ yinɔi asaji ahe wolo lɛ kɛba koni abakane atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ. 2Sane ko ni akane lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Mɔdekai hã ana ale akɛ Bigtan kɛ Teresh, ni ji maŋtsɛ piafoi enyɔ komɛi ni fata mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli shinai anaa ahe lɛ, to yiŋ akɛ amɛbaagbe Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh.
3Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi akɛ, “Mɛni afee akɛwo Mɔdekai hiɛ nyam yɛ nɔ ni etsu nɛɛ hewɔ?”
Maŋtsɛ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni yɔɔ emasɛi lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Afeko nɔ ko nɔ ko ahãko lɛ.”
4Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi akɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ?” No mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Haman ebashɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni eeba ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ abawie he koni asɛŋ Mɔdekai yɛ tso ni ehã akla ama shi ahã Mɔdekai sɛŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. 5No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Haman eshɛ shi, edamɔ kpo lɛ nɔ.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã ni eba mli!”
6Be ni Haman ba lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji maŋtsɛ miisumɔ akɛ ewo nuu ko hiɛ nyam lɛ, mɛni esa akɛ afee ahã mɔ lɛ?”
Haman susu yɛ eyiŋ ekɛɛ, “Namɔ po maŋtsɛ baasumɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam nɛɛ akɛ ja mi?”
7No hewɔ lɛ, Haman hã maŋtsɛ lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nuu lɛ ni maŋtsɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ hewɔ lɛ, 8Maŋtsɛ ahã akɔlɔ maŋtsɛ atadei ni maŋtsɛ woɔ daa lɛ ekomɛi, ni aŋɔ okpɔŋɔ ni maŋtsɛ eta nɔ dã, ni akɛ maŋtsɛ akekre afata he. 9Atu atadei kɛ okpɔŋɔ lɛ awo maŋtsɛ lumɛi onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome dɛŋ koni ekɛwula nuu lɛ ni Maŋtsɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ. Nuu nɛɛ ni awoɔ ehiɛ nyam lɛ ata okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ kɛfo blohuiaŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli be mli ni onukpa lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ. Abɔ oshe kɛnyiɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ abaafee ahã mɔ ni maŋtsɛ miisumɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ nɛ.’ ”
10Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Haman akɛ, “Ohe afee oya, koni oŋɔ atade kɛ okpɔŋɔ lɛ, ni oyafee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ohã Mɔdekai, Yudanyo lɛ, ni taa maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi lɛ. Okashi nɔ ko ni otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ afee lɛ ekoeko.”
11No hewɔ lɛ, Haman ŋɔ atade lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔ lɛ kɛtee. Ekɛ atade lɛ yawula Mɔdekai, ni ehã ekwɔ eta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eta nɔ kɛfo blohuiaŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni Haman bɔ oshe kɛnyiɛ Mɔdekai hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, bɔ ni afeɔ ahãa mɔ ni Maŋtsɛ miisumɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ nɛ!”
12Kɛkɛ ni Mɔdekai ku esɛɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi; shi Haman he fee oya ni eyiŋ kɛtee ewe lɛ kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli ni eha eyi nɔ. 13Egba eŋa Zeresh kɛ enanemɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ osharã ni eyasharã lɛ lɛ. Haman nanemɛi nilelɔi lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ hu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji abɔ̃i bo shibaa yɛ Mɔdekai ni jɛ Yudafoi aseshi mli lɛ hiɛ lɛ, belɛ no lɛ onyɛŋ lɛ mɔ; bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaafe bo.”
Haman gbele
14Ahiɛ sanegbaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ piafoi komɛi bashɛ shi, ni amɛbaŋɔ Haman kplakpla kɛtee Maŋnyɛ Ester okplɔŋmɛɛ lɛ he.

Title: ESTER 7
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Haman tee amɛkɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester yaaye nii. 2Be ni anuɔ dãa yɛ niyenii lɛ ashi yɛ gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Ester ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Maŋnyɛ Ester, mɛni ji osane lɛ; mɛni otaoɔ? Nɔ ni ji lɛ bi, ni mafee mahã bo aahu, kɛji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlijaa po ni.” 3Maŋnyɛ Ester here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, kɛji mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ ohiɛ, ni maŋtsɛ yɛ he tsuijurɔ akɛ ebaafee nɔ ni mibabi lɛ lɛ, nɔ ni mibiɔ ji akɛ akɛ miwala ake mi; asaŋ akɛ mimaŋbii hu awala ake amɛ. 4Amrɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ahɔ̃ɔ wɔ, mi kɛ mimaŋbii lɛ, ahã koni akpãtã wɔhiɛ, ni agbe wɔ kɛbule wɔshishi. Eji ahɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei kɛkɛ kulɛ egbaŋ minaa, ni kulɛ mikɛŋ nɔ ko, ejaakɛ piŋmɔ ni abaapiŋ wɔ lɛ ejeee nɔ ko kwraa kɛji akɛto maŋtsɛ nii ni baafite he.”
5Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh here nɔ, ni ebi Maŋnyɛ Ester akɛ, “Namɔ to yiŋ kɛbaafee nɛkɛ nɔ ko? Namɔ ni, ni nɛgbɛ mɔ lɛ yɔɔ?”
6Maŋnyɛ Ester to he akɛ, “Wɔhenyɛlɔ kɛ wɔyinɔ apamtolɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Haman, gbɔmɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Haman tsui fã yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ hiɛ. 7Maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi kɛ mlifu kɛshi okplɔ̃ lɛ he kɛtee trom ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he lɛ mli. Haman na maŋtsɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi sha akɛ kɛji ena lɛ Haman lɛ efɔŋ lɛ, eeefee. No hewɔ lɛ, Haman te shi koni ekpa Maŋnyɛ Ester fai koni akɛ ewala ake lɛ.
8Ho ni Haman ho egbee shi yɛ saatso fioo ko ni Ester ta nɔ lɛ naa, koni ekpa lɛ fai pɛ, kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ jɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he trom lɛ mli kɛba he ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ yɛ lɛ. Ni ebanina Haman nɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Aso ebaatua maŋnyɛ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ miwe mli lo?”
Maŋtsɛ lɛ naa ni nyɔɔ shi nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni piafoi lɛ ha Haman hiɛ. 9Kɛkɛ ni piafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko ni gbɛi ji Harbona lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nii, bɛ Haman ekala tso ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ ema ewe lɛ akɛ ekɛbaasɛŋ Mɔdekai mɔ ni here oyiwala lɛ.”
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, “Nyɛyasɛŋa lɛ yɛ nɔ!”
10No hewɔ lɛ, atee ni ayasɛŋ Haman moŋ yɛ tso ni ekala akɛ ebaasɛŋ Mɔdekai yɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ mlila lɛ jɔ.

Title: ESTER 8
Content:
Akɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ amɛfã amɛhe
1Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ŋɔ Haman, Yudafoi lɛ ahenyɛlɔ lɛ, shĩa ni ekɛhã Maŋnyɛ Ester; ni Mɔdekai bɔ̃i maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ yaa ejaakɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester tsɔ̃ɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh emɔ ni ji Mɔdekai. 2Maŋtsɛ lɛ jie ewaoga ni ekɛsɔoɔ wolo naa, ni ehe yɛ Haman dɛŋ lɛ yɛ ewao ni ekɛhã Mɔdekai. Ester tu Haman shĩa lɛ ewo Mɔdekai dɛŋ koni ekwɛ nɔ.
3Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Ester kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yawie ekoŋŋ. Eyaho ekula Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh naji anaa, ni ekɛ yaafo kpa lɛ fai akɛ efo efɔŋ ni Haman, Agagnyo lɛ, eto akɛ afee Yudafoi lɛ mli ehã amɛ. 4Maŋtsɛ lɛ kpã enine mli ni ekɛ tsi ni ehiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Ester hiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Ester te shi edamɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ, 5ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, kɛji esa ohiɛ lɛ, no lɛ hã aŋmã wolo koni akɛyatsi yiŋsha ni Hamedata bi Haman, Agagnyo lɛ, to koni ekɛkpãtã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ahiɛ lɛ naa. 6Ejaakɛ aso manyɛ naa madamɔ kɛji sane fɔŋ nɛɛ banina mimaŋbii lɛ, ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ kɛbule amɛshishi?”
7Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester kɛ Mɔdekai, Yudafonyo lɛ, akɛ, “Naa, mihã asɛŋ Haman yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ayinɔ ni ekpãŋ lɛ hewɔ, ni mikɛ shĩa lɛ hu eke Ester. 8Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛŋma Yudafoi lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaasumɔ yɛ sane nɛɛ he yɛ mi, migbɛi mli. Asaŋ nyɛkɛ miwolo naasɔomɔ ga lɛ asɔoa wolo lɛ naa, ejaakɛ wolo ni aŋmã yɛ maŋtsɛ gbɛi mli, asaŋ ni akɛ ewolo naasɔomɔ ga lɛ esɔo naa lɛ, anyɛŋ emli sane lɛ mli afo.”
9Sane nɛɛ ba yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji etɛ̃ ni ji nyɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Siwan lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ. Mɔdekai tsɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔi lɛ kɛkpe; ni amɛŋmã wolo lɛ bɔ ni Mɔdekai fã akɛ amɛŋmã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni akɛtee ayahã Yudafoi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ shikpɔji srɔtoi lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ kɛjɛ India aahu kɛbashi Kush. Fɛɛ fee shikpɔji oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo. Shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ aŋmã ewolo lɛ yɛ lɛ eniŋmãa mli, ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ lɛ aŋmã ewolo lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewiemɔ mli. Yudafoi lɛ hu awolo lɛ aŋmã yɛ amɛniŋmãa kɛ amɛwiemɔ mli. 10Mɔdekai hã aŋmala woji lɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh gbɛi mli, ni akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ wolonaasɔomɔ ga lɛ sɔo amɛnaa. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ woji lɛ tsu bɔfoi ni tara maŋtsɛ lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni afoijee naa wa lɛ ekomɛi anɔ kɛtee.
11Woji lɛ kɛɛ akɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ehã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ hegbɛ koni amɛbua amɛhe naa amɛbɔ asafoi ni amɛdamɔ shi kɛfã amɛhe. Kɛji mɛi komɛi aaabatua amɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ko nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ mɛi lɛ awu kɛfã amɛhe ni amɛgbe amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛ hɔi kɛ yei fɛɛ kɛbule amɛshishi; ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛha mɛi nɛɛ anibii amɛhã amɛhe, 12yɛ gbi kome nɔ. Gbi nɛɛ ji nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni egbɛi ji Adar, lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyeli shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ. 13Wolo lɛ fã akɛ ashiɛ emli sane lɛ akɛ akpɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ koni maŋbii fɛɛ ana ale, asaŋ koni Yudafoi lɛ asaa amɛhe amɛto nakai gbi lɛ, ni amɛtɔ amɛhe owele yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ. 14Kɛkɛ ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi ho tara maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ okpɔŋɔi komɛi anɔ, yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ naa, ni amɛhe fee oya amɛkɛ woji lɛ tee. Ashiɛ akpɔ nɛɛ yɛ Susa ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ hu mli.
15Mɔdekai je maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ etee, ni ewo maŋtsɛ atade ni akɛ mama bluu kɛ mama yɛŋ ekpɛ, kɛ enɔ atade wuyaa ni akɛ klala yɛŋ kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kpɛ. Shika akekre agbo fi eyitso. Susa maŋ lɛ nya ni amɛna miishɛɛ. 16Yudafoi lɛ ahe tse amɛ, ni amɛnya, ni amɛmli fili amɛ jogbaŋŋ; asaŋ hiɛ sɔ amɛ. 17Anɔkwa shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh shɛɛ kɛ akpɔ lɛ yashɛ lɛ, jɛi Yudafoi lɛ na miishɛɛ, ni amɛnya, ni amɛŋmɛŋmɛɛ okplɔ̃, ni amɛyeyee gbii juji. Shikpɔji anɔ bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo tsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe Yudafoi tete, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ.

Title: ESTER 9
Content:
Yudafoi lɛ kpãtã amɛhenyɛlɔi ahiɛ
1Kɛkɛ ni nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Adar lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ bashɛ, ni ji gbi ni abaaye maŋtsɛ kitã kɛ akpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Be mli ni Yudafoi lɛ ahenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ kã nɔ akɛ amɛbaana Yudafoi lɛ anɔ hewalɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ tsake ekroko, ni Yudafoi lɛ moŋ na hewalɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ. 2Yudafoi lɛ buabua amɛhe naa kuikui yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyelihei lɛ amli majimaji lɛ amli akɛ amɛkɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni baatua amɛ lɛ baawu. Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ amɛhiɛ adamɔ, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ. 3Anɔkwa, shikpɔji lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ maŋtsɛ nii ye bua Yudafoi lɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miishe Mɔdekai gbeyei. 4Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Mɔdekai etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli, ni daa gbi lɛ nɛkɛ ehewalɛ lɛ daa kɛyaa nɔ; ni egbɛi ehehe kɛkpele shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. 5No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ fee amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ. Amɛfã klante yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbegbee amɛ, ni amɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ.
6Yɛ Susa, ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ mli lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kpãtã mɛi ohai enumɔ ahiɛ. 7Amɛgbe Parshandata kɛ Dalfon kɛ Aspata, 8kɛ Porata kɛ Adalia kɛ Aridata, 9kɛ Parmashta kɛ Arisai kɛ Aridai kɛ Waizata, 10ni ji Hamedata bi Haman, Yudafoi ahenyɛlɔi lɛ, bihii nyɔŋma lɛ fɛɛ hu. Shi Yudafoi lɛ ehaaa mɛi anii.
11Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ayabɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh mɛi ayibɔ ni agbe yɛ Susa ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli lɛ. 12Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester akɛ, “Yɛ Susa maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ kɛkɛ mli lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ egbegbee mɛi ohai enumɔ kɛ Haman bihii nyɔŋma lɛ hu. Belɛ te amɛfee tɛŋŋ mɔ yɛ nɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ hu? Kɛ̃lɛ mɛni oyɔɔ ni obaabi lolo? Mɛni otaoɔ ekoŋŋ, ni aaafee ahã bo!”
13Ester to he ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nii baasumɔ lɛ, aŋmɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ agbɛ koni wɔ hu lɛ, amɛfee bɔ ni amɛfee ŋmɛnɛ yɛ mla lɛ naa lɛ ekoŋŋ; asaŋ akɛ Haman bihii nyɔŋma lɛ agbohii lɛ atsotsoro tso nɔ.” 14Maŋtsɛ lɛ fee nakai. Awo mla yɛ Susa, ni ahole Haman bihii nyɔŋma lɛ agbohii lɛ, ni akɛ amɛ tsotsoro shi yɛ maŋ jara nɔ. 15Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ bua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsaa amɛgbegbee mɛi ohai etɛ̃ yɛ Susa; shi moŋ amɛhaaa mɛi anii.
16Yudafoi krokomɛi ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔyelihei krokomɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ hu buabua amɛhe naa kuikui ni amɛfã amɛwala he, ni amɛgbegbee amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ, ni amɛna hejɔlɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Shi moŋ amɛhaaa mɛi anii. 17Afee nii nɛɛ yɛ Adar nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ. Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ jɔɔ amɛhe ni amɛgbeee mɔ ko. Amɛye gbi lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ, ni amɛtsɛtsɛɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ nyamɔ. 18Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ gbe amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛkɛ ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe yɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛfee okplɔŋmɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ gbijurɔ. 19No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi ni yɔɔ akrowai amli, ni ji maji ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe lɛ, yeɔ Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ kɛ okplɔŋmɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ, ni amɛkekeɔ amɛhe nii.
Purim Gbijurɔyeli lɛ
20Mɔdekai hã aŋmãla nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ, ni ekɛ woji tsu, ni akɛyahã Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ fɛɛ, 21ni ekɛfo efɔ̃ shi ehã Yudafoi lɛ akɛ amɛye Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ daa afi, 22ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ anɔ Yudafoi lɛ ahe jɔ amɛ kɛjɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ. Nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ amɛwerɛho lɛ tsɔ̃ miishɛɛ, ni amɛkɔmɔyeli lɛ tsɔ̃ nyamɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛfee nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ okplɔŋmɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ kɛ henikee kɛ ohiafoi anikee gbii. 23Yudafoi lɛ kɔ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ ni amɛfee tamɔ bɔ ni Mɔdekai ŋmã akɛ amɛfee lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ afiyeli ehã amɛ.
24Haman, Hamedata, Agagnyo lɛ bi lɛ, ni fee ehe Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ ahenyɛlɔ tsɔ̃ ŋaa koni ekpãtã Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ. Efɔ̃ oshiki, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Pur lɛ, koni ena gbi nɔ ni akpãtã Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ kɛbule amɛshishi.
25Shi Ester yana maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋmã wolo, ni naagbee mli lɛ ehã Yudafoi lɛ ayinɔ ŋaa fɔŋ ni Haman etsɔ̃ lɛ babua lɛ moŋ eyiteŋ, ni asɛŋ lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ tso nɔ yɛ maŋ jara nɔ. 26No hewɔ lɛ, awo gbii nɛɛ gbɛi akɛ Purim yɛ gbɛi Pur lɛ hewɔ. Wolo ni Mɔdekai ŋmã lɛ mli saji lɛ kɛ nɔ ni amɛ, Yudafoi lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ hu na yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli, kɛ nɔ ni ba amɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ lɛ, 27Yudafoi lɛ to gbii nɛɛ akɛ gbijurɔ. Amɛfo amɛŋmɛ shi amɛhã amɛhe kɛ amɛshwiei kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni aaabadɔmɔ amɛ akɛ amɛye gbii enyɔ nɛɛ daa afi, yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli kɛbɔ hu ni ato akɛ aye amɛ ahã lɛ; ni ekaho amɛyi kɔkɔɔkɔ. 28Amɛfo akɛ Yudafoi aweku fɛɛ weku ni yɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ, yɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ, yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ amli hiɛ ahi nɛkɛ gbii enyɔ nɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛye Purim gbii nɛɛ, ni ekaho amɛyi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei akai gbii nɛɛ kɛya yinɔi ayinɔi fɛɛ.
29Maŋnyɛ Ester, Abihail biyoo lɛ, kɛ Mɔdekai, Yudanyo lɛ, ŋma wolo yɛ hewalɛ ni amɛna lɛ naa, ni amɛkɛma Purim gbijurɔyeli lɛ he wolo ni Mɔdekai eŋmã lɛ nɔ aduatsɔ. 30Atsu ni akɛ wolo nɛɛ tee ayahã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyelihei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ. Akɛ wolo lɛ mli wiemɔ ba omanye ahã amɛ; asaŋ abi amɛ koni amɛhi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ anɔkwale mli, 31koni amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei aye Purim gbii lɛ yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni amɛto be kɛ gbɛjianɔ ni amɛkɛhiɔ ŋmãa, ni amɛkɛfeɔ yara lɛ. 32Maŋnyɛ Ester wolo ni eŋmã lɛ ma nɛkɛ Purim gbijurɔyeli kusum nɛɛ nɔ aduatsɔ ni aŋmã awo wolo mli afɔ̃ shi.

Title: ESTER 10
Content:
Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛ Mɔdekai agbojee
1Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsu enɔyeli shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ onia kɛjɛ ŋshɔnaa aahu kɛyagbee koiasɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ. 2He ni egbojee shɛ kɛ nibii ni etsu yɛ ehewalɛ kɛ enyɛmɔ naa, kɛ he ni ewo Mɔdekai nɔ grɔŋŋ kɛyashɛ lɛ aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Media kɛ Persia Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. 3Mɔdekai, Yudanyo lɛ, batsɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh diɛŋtsɛ sɛɛmɔ tuuŋtu, kɛ gbɔmɔ wulu hu yɛ enyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ; amɛbuɔ lɛ, ni amɛsumɔɔ esane; ni lɛ hu be fɛɛ be lɛ etaoɔ emaŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛshwiei fɛɛ ekpakpa; ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ.

Title: HIOB WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Hiob wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ kɔɔ gbɔmɔ kpakpa ko he. Amanehulu ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ na hã efee butuu. Emusuŋbii kɛ nii ni eyɔɔ yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ hiɛ kpãtã, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu eye hela gbonyo ko. Mɔ ni ŋma Hiob wolo lɛ gba wiemɔi ni Hiob kɛ enanemɛi etɛ̃ komɛi wie yɛ amanehulu ni ba enɔ lɛ he. Nanemɛi nɛɛ kɛ Hiob sanegbaa lɛ mli lɛ, nanemɛi nɛɛ tsi Naa Nyɔŋmɔ tã shii abɔ kɛ bɔ hu ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ adesa yeɔ ehãa.
Hiob nanemɛi lɛ bɔ mɔdɛŋ koni amɛhã Hiob adamɔ amɛmaŋbii ajamɔ mli tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anɔ koni enu amanehulu lɛ shishi. Nanemɛi lɛ kɛɛ akɛ amɛle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ mɔ yɛ ekpakpa hewɔ, ni egblaa mɔ toi yɛ efɔŋ hewɔ. Amɛsusu akɛ Hiob amanehulu lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efee esha. Shi Hiob nuuu shishi ehãaa amɛ, nɔ hewɔ ni eeena amanehulu kple nakai, ejaakɛ ewala mli fɛɛ lɛ, ekpakpa kɛ nɔ ni ja sɔŋŋ efeɔ. Hiob enaaa nɔ hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ koni sane kɛ joomɔ nakai aye lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ eje Nyɔŋmɔ he ŋwane kɛ ekãa; shi moŋ Hiob eŋmɛɛɛ ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ he, ni ebɔ mɔdɛŋ koni Nyɔŋmɔ abu lɛ bem, asaŋ koni ehiɛ aba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ kpakpa.
Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa saji komɛi ni Hiob bi lɛ ahetoo. Shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ damɔ Hiob hemɔkɛyeli nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ Hiob, lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, ehewalɛ kɛ enilee mlikwɔlɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Hiob humi shi, ni ekplɛ̃ nɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ le nii, ni eje agbo; ni Hiob shwa ehe akɛ ekɛ mlifu wie wiemɔi komɛi ni esaaa.
Wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ naagbee mli lɛ, wɔnaa akɛ Hiob saa eshwere fe tsuutsu lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ kã Hiob nanemɛi lɛ ahiɛ akɛ amɛnuuu Hiob amanehulu lɛ shishi. Hiob pɛ ji mɔ ni nu shishi yɛ nanemɛi lɛ ateŋ, akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwɔ fe bɔ ni jamɔ mli tsɔ̃ɔmɔi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekwɔ lɛ.

Title: HIOB 1
Content:
Abonsam ka Hiob ekwɛ
1 Nuu ko hi shi yɛ Uz shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; egbɛi ji Hiob. Esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe yɛ efɔŋ he. Eji gbɔmɔ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe, asaŋ efeɔ nii ni ja hu. 2Hiob fɔ bihii kpawo kɛ biyei etɛ̃. 3Eyɛ toi akpei kpawo kɛ yoomai akpei etɛ̃ kɛ tsinai akpe kɛ teji yei ohai enumɔ kɛ tsuji babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Hiob ji bokãgbɛbii lɛ ateŋ niiatsɛ fe fɛɛ.
4Hiob bihii lɛ toɔ naa ekomekome ni amɛŋmɛɔ amɛhe okplɔ̃. Kɛji eshɛ mɔ ko nɔ lɛ, ebihii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ yaa mɔ lɛ we lɛ. Hii lɛ tsuɔ kɛyaa, ni ayatsɛɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi yei etɛ̃ lɛ hu kɛbaa, ni amɛkɛ amɛ bayeɔ nii, ni amɛnuɔ dãa. 5Kɛji aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛbɔle bihii lɛ anɔ kɛkpe lɛ, Hiob teɔ shi daa leebi maŋkpa, ni eyashãa shãa afɔlei ehãa ebii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, yɛ amɛyibɔ naa koni akɛtsuu amɛhe. Ejaakɛ Hiob kɛɔ akɛ, “Benɛ mibihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko efee esha ko ni aleee, ni ekwa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ etsuiŋ. Enɛ ji nɔ ni Hiob feɔ daa.”
6 Be ko lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ni sɔmɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ tee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Abonsam futu amɛ kɛtee, ni lɛ hu eyadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ eko. 7Nyɔŋmɔ bi Abonsam akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛɛ?”
Abonsam to he akɛ, “Mijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikpaa kɛ shisharamɔ yɛ nɔ.”
8Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi Abonsam akɛ, “Osusu mitsulɔ Hiob he akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni tamɔ lɛ ni eji nuu anɔkwafo ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe yɛ efɔŋ he, ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja?”
9Abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani yaka Hiob sheɔ bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, gbeyei lɛ? 10Bɛ ofo afabaŋ okɛbaa lɛ kɛ ewe kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ yi shweshweeshwe. Ojɔɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ nɔ, ni ekooloi eshwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 11 Shi agbɛnɛ bo lɛ kpã onine mli ofite enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ, koni okwɛ akɛ ekwaŋ bo yɛ ohiɛ lo.”
12Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abonsam akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, mijɔɔ enii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ nɔ miwo odɛ̃ŋ. Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛkɛ ni okɛ onine akasa.” Kɛkɛ ni Abonsam je Yehowa hiɛ ni etee.
Hiob bii lɛ kɛ ejwetri hiɛ kpãtã
13Gbi ko lɛ Hiob bihii lɛ kɛ ebiyei lɛ eyakpe, ni amɛmiiye nii, ni amɛmiinu wain yɛ amɛnyɛmi nuu onukpa lɛ we lɛ mli. 14Bɔfo ko ba Hiob ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsinai lɛ miihu, ni teji yei lɛ hu miiye nii yɛ amɛmasɛi. 15 Trukaa ni Sabiabii batua amɛ, ni amɛmɔmɔ kooloi lɛ kɛtee; amɛgbe otsuji lɛ kɛ klante; mikome too pɛ mihe je mli, ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ.”
16Tsulɔ lɛ hiɛ wiemɔ lɛ mli lolo kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ kroko ko ba, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, “Srawa gba kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni ebayi toi lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ anɔ, ni eplene amɛ fɛɛ; mikome too pɛ mihe je mli, ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ.”
17 Be ni lɛ hu ewieɔ lolo lɛ, tsulɔ kroko ko hu bashɛ shi, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, “Kaldeabii ba kɛ kui etɛ̃ amɛbatua yoomai lɛ, ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ kɛtee, ni amɛkɛ klante gbe tsuji lɛ, mikome too pɛ mihe je mli, ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ.”
18Tsulɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ma enaa lolo kɛkɛ lɛ naa tsulɔ kroko ko hu eba, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, “Obihii lɛ kɛ obiyei lɛ miiye nii, ni amɛmiinu wain yɛ amɛnyɛmi nuu nukpa lɛ we lɛ mli 19kɛkɛ ni ahum kpele ko tswa kɛjɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni ebabote shĩa lɛ mli, ni eshimɔ shĩa lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ, ni eshĩa lɛ wule eshwie oblahii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛgboi; mikome too pɛ mihe je mli ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ.”
20Kɛkɛ ni Hiob te shi, ni ekɛ awerɛho gbala ehe atade lɛ, eshɛ eyi, ni eho ebu shikpɔŋ, ni esɔle. 21 Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yayai mikɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ miba, ni yayai mikɛaaku misɛɛ kɛaatee. Yehowa ni ŋɔ hã, ni Yehowa ebaŋɔ kɛtee; aaajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi kɛ̃!”
22Saji ni ba nɛɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ Hiob shwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni no atsɔ̃ esha ahã lɛ.

Title: HIOB 2
Content:
Abonsam ka Hiob ekwɛ ekoŋŋ
1Be ni eshɛ gbi ko ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi ni sɔmɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ tee amɛyadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, Abonsam futu amɛ kɛtee, ni lɛ hu eyadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ eko.
2Yehowa bi Abonsam akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛ?”
Abonsam to he akɛ, “Mijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; miyakpa nɔ; ni miyashara shi yɛ nɔ.”
3Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi Abonsam akɛ, “Osusu mitsulɔ Hiob he akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni tamɔ lɛ, ni anɔkwafo ni, ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe yɛ efɔŋ he; ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja? Ehiɛ enɔkwayeli lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ lolo tsɛbelɛ ohã mite shi miwo lɛ koni mikpãtã ehiɛ yakatswaa!”
4Abonsam to he hã Yehowa akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ baaŋmɛɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ he bɔ ni afee kɛkɛ ni eyi ana wala. 5Shi bo lɛ taa egbɔmɔtso he kɛkɛ okwɛ akɛ ekwaŋ bo yɛ ohiɛ lo?”
6Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abonsam akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, mijɔɔ enɔ miwo odɛ̃ŋ; shi obaa ewala yi kɛkɛ.”
7No hewɔ lɛ, Abonsam shi Yehowa hiɛ, ni etee; ni ehã asane ni waa mɔ he waa tsɛ̃rɛ Hiob kɛjɛ enaneshi aahu kɛyashi epampam. 8Hiob kɛ ŋɛsuko wamɔɔ ehe, ni eho eta mlu mli. 9Hiob ŋa bi lɛ akɛ, “Ohiɛ anɔkwayeli nɛɛ mli kpɛŋŋ lolo? Mɛɛba okwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ koni ogbo?”
10Hiob kɛɛ eŋa lɛ akɛ, “Oowie tamɔ bɔ ni yei kwashiai lɛ wieɔ lɛ. Nɔ kpakpa lɛ wɔhe kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ. Mɛɛba ni nɔ fɔŋ lɛ wɔkahe?” Enɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, Hiob naa tɛɛɛ shi, ni ewieee wiemɔ gbonyo ko.
Hiob nanemɛi ba eŋɔɔ
11 Be ni nanemɛi etɛ̃ komɛi ni Hiob yɔɔ lɛ nu amanehulu fɛɛ ni eba Hiob nɔ lɛ he lɛ, amɛjɛjɛɛ amɛshihilɛhei amɛba Hiob ŋɔɔ. Enaanyo Elifaz jɛ Teman, ni Bildad jɛ Shua, ni Zofar jɛ Naama. Nanemɛi nɛɛ ye fua akɛ amɛaatee kutuu amɛyaye Hiob ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛshɛje emii. 12Nanemɛi nɛɛ na Hiob yɛ shɔŋŋ, shi amɛyooo lɛ. Shi be ni amɛyoo Hiob lɛ, amɛfo waa; amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ dɔlɛ gbala ehe atade, ni amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteiaŋ. 13Nanemɛi lɛ ho amɛta Hiob masɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ, shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii kpawo sɔŋŋ. Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ Hiob ewieee wiemɔ kome nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ eena nɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.

Title: HIOB 3
Content:
Hiob kɛ esane ŋmɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ
1 Be nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Hiob gbele enaa, ni elomɔ gbi ni afɔ lɛ lɛ. 2Hiob kɛɛ akɛ,
3“Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, hã gbi nɔ
ni afɔ mi lɛ hiɛ akpãtã;
hã gbi gbɛkɛ ni akɛɛ akɛ,
‘Ana binuu musu lɛ hiɛ akpãtã.’
4Hã jeŋ awo duŋ nakai gbi lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ akatiu esɛɛ,
ni jeŋ akatse yɛ nɔ.
5Hã enɔ atsi kpii kɛ duŋ;
hã atatu kabitii atsi yɛ enɔ,
hã duŋ ni ewo kpii shwane lɛ
awo ehe gbeyei.
6Hã duŋ kpii awo nakai nyɔŋ lɛ mli;
kaahã emii shɛ ehe yɛ afi lɛ mli
gbii lɛ ateŋ eko nɔ;
akabu lɛ ashi afi lɛ mli nyɔji lɛ anɔ.
7Hɛɛ, hã nakai gbi lɛ
atsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo kene;
akanu miishɛɛ gbee he yɛ nɔ!
8Hã mɛi ni lomɔɔ gbi alomɔ lɛ,
mɛi ni le bonso hiɛlawoo lɛ.
9 Hã emaŋkɛ̃ ŋulamii lɛ afɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ;
hã etao la, shi ekana eko;
ni ekana hulu haaigbalamɔ.
10Ejaakɛ eŋmɛ gbɛ ni afɔ mi
ni etsiii minyɛ musu naa,
ni ehã miina jaramɔ.
11“Mɛɛba migbooo yɛ mifɔmɔ mli;
mɛɛba minyɔɔɔ be ni ashwie
mi shi lɛ?
12Mɛɛba shuɔ he mi fɔ̃ enɔ;
ni mɛɛba fufɔ hã mina
lɛ miye?
13Kulɛ benɛ miho mikã shi kpoo;
kulɛ bɛ miwɔ ni kulɛ
benɛ mihe ejɔ mi
14kɛkã maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ jeŋ ajinafoi lɛ,
mɛi ni saa mamɔɔ mɔji
ni ekumɔ hãa amɛhe lɛ,
15loo tamɔ lumɛi shikatsɛmɛi,
mɛi ni shĩaiaŋ eyimɔ kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ ateŋ.
16Aloo mɛɛba mitsɔ̃ɔɔ sharakemɔ bi
ni enãaa hulu la lɛ?
17Jɛi lɛ yitsoŋwalɔi kpaa
mɔ haomɔ;
ni mɛi ni etɔ amɛ woɔ amɛtsui.
18Gboklɛfoi fɛɛ ahe jɔɔ amɛ
yɛ jɛi;
ni amɛnuuu kpalalɔ gbee dɔŋŋ.
19Mɔ bibioo kɛ mɔ wulu feɔ pɛ
yɛ jɛi,
ni nyɔŋ yeɔ ehe yɛ enuŋtsɔ dɛŋ.
20“Mɛɛba ahãa mɔ ni yɔɔ haomɔ
mli lɛ lá;
ni ahãa mɔ ni werɛ eho ehe wala?
21 Mɔ ni shweɔ gbele, shi gbele baaa lɛ,
ni etsaa shi etaoɔ gbele fe bɔ ni atsaa shi
ataoɔ jwetri ni akɛtee lɛ;
22mɔ ni mii shɛɔ fe nine,
ni enyaaa kɛji ena gbonyobu lɛ.
23Mɛɛba ahãa gbɔmɔ ni aŋɔ
ewala atee,
gbɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ esa eyi lɛ la?
24Ŋkɔmɔyeli etsɔ̃ miniyenii,
ni mifɔseɔ mligbigblimɔ mishwieɔ shi
tamɔ nu.
25Ejaakɛ nɔ gbeyei ni misheɔ lɛ,
no nɔŋŋ baa minɔ,
ni nɔ ni mitsui fãa yɛ he lɛ,
no ji nɔ ni minaa.
26Mihe ejɔko mi,
ni minako miyitso toohe;
mibɛ hejɔlɛ
shi haomɔ miiba lolo.”

Title: HIOB 4
Content:
Klɛŋklɛŋ sanegbaa lɛ
(4.1—14.22)
Elifaz wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, hã Hiob hetoo ekɛɛ,
2“Kɛji aka bo kɛ wiemɔ lɛ, eeefee bo mlifu lo?
Shi kɛ̃lɛ namɔ aaanyɛ enaa emua?
3Naa, otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi babaoo anii kɛho,
ni owo mɛi hu ni nijiaŋ eje wui
hewalɛ.
4Owiemɔ ehere mɔ ni etɛ́
ni eyaagbee shi;
mɛi ni nakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ lɛ,
owo amɛ hewalɛ;
ni amɛnyɛ shi amɛdamɔ.
5Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ eshɛ onɔ,
shi onaaa tsui;
esa ohe, no ojijaa nɛɛ.
6Kwɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni osheɔ lɛ
no nɔ ohiɛ kã,
ni onɔkwayeli jeŋba lɛ
ji ohiɛnɔkãmɔ?
7“Kɛ ohiɛ awo mli okwɛ!
Namɔ hiɛ ekpãtã pɛŋ
be mli ni efeko efɔŋ ko?
Aloo nɛgbɛ aplene mɛi ni
feɔ jalɛnii yɛ pɛŋ?
8 Bɔ pɛ ni mina nɛ:
Mɛi ni huɔ nɔsha ŋmɔ,
ni amɛduɔ yiwalɛ wui lɛ
nomɛi nɔŋŋ amɛkpaa.
9Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ ni shwieɔ amɛnɔ lɛ
kpãtãa amɛhiɛ,
ni emlifu kɔɔyɔɔ pleneɔ amɛ.
10Ajɔɔ jata huumɔ kɛ oloowɔ gbee he,
ni akumɔ jatabii atsoji fɛɛ.
11Jata ni he wa gboɔ
kɛ enaaa kooloo emɔ ni eye,
ni jata yoo bii gbɛɔ shwãa.
12“Be ko lɛ, minu wiemɔ ko;
efo mitoi naa nyɔɔŋ
13 be ni wɔ ni tsii nyɔɔ mɛi anɔ,
ni ninai ahejwɛŋmɔ
14hã ŋmiŋmi mɔ mi,
ni mikpokpo kɛshɛ miwuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
15Mumɔ ko bafo mihiɛ;
mihe tsɔi te shi damɔ shi.
16Mumɔ lɛ wa edamɔ shi keŋŋ;
shi miyooo esu.”
Shi su ko badamɔ mihiɛ,
jɛi fee koniŋŋ,
kɛkɛ ni minu gbee ko:
17“Aso adesa ko aaaja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ?
Aso adesa ko he aaatse yɛ ebɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ?
18Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ etsuji anɔ,
ni enaa tɔ̃mɔ yɛ ebɔfoi tete ahe lɛ,
19ani osusuɔ akɛ ekɛ ehe
baafɔ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ,
gbɔmɔ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ su mli
ni afufluɔ lɛ tamɔ omlɛgɛ?
20Gbɔmɔ hiɛ kãa leebi,
shi egboɔ trukaa gbɛkɛnaashi.
Ehiɛ kpãtãa, ni mɔ ko ebuuu
ehe akɔntaa.
21Kɛji atserɛ emli fãi lɛ;
aso amɛgboiii yɛ be mli
ni amɛnako jwɛŋmɔ lolo lɛ?”

Title: HIOB 5
Content:
1“Agbɛnɛ Hiob, boo ni otsɛ
akɛ mɔ ko kwraa yɛ ni aaahere
bo nɔ lo?
Bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ŋɔɔ oootee?
2Eji anɔkwale sane
akɛ mlila sɔŋŋ gbeɔ kwashia,
ni awuŋayeli gbeɔ mɔ ni hiɛ etɛ̃ɛɛ.
3 Mina kwashiai ni miihe shi ahe dã;
shi amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni milomɔ amɛwe lɛ.
4Amɛbii kɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ teŋ jɛkɛ,
anaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ koishi,
ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ
ni aaahere amɛ.
5Hɔmɔwɔlɔi aaaye enikpamɔ nii,
ŋmei ateŋ nii eeena ekɔlɔ;
mɛi aaaye enii he kumai.
6Amanehulu jɛɛɛ mlu mli
baaa,
ni haomɔ hu ekwɛ̃ɛɛ kɛjɛɛɛ
shikpɔŋ;
7shi gbɔmɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ ahã haomɔ,
tamɔ bɔ ni lalilɛi tsɛ̃rɛɔ
kɛjɛɔ la mli kɛyaa ŋwɛi lɛ.
8“Mi ji bo kulɛ, matao Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ matu misane lɛ mawo,
9lɛ mɔ ni efeɔ nibii wuji
ni anaaa naa,
kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii hu ni ehiii kanemɔ lɛ.
10Ehãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni eshwieɔ ŋmɔji anɔ nu;
11 Eholeɔ humii anɔ grɔŋŋ,
ni eshɛjeɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi amii.
12Efiteɔ ŋai ni hiɛtɛ̃lɔi tsɔ̃ɔ,
ni ehãa amɛnine nyɛɔ shi.
13 Ekɛ ŋaatsɔlɔi nɔŋŋ aŋaa duɔ amɛ,
ni efiteɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ayiŋtoi fɔ̃ji lɛ.
14Duŋ woɔ amɛ shwane fintiŋŋ,
ni amɛgbugbuɔ shi shwane mlemle
tamɔ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ nyɔɔŋ.
15Ehereɔ awusai ayiwala
kɛjeɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji adaaŋ,
ni ehereɔ ohiafo yɛ yiwalɔ dɛŋ.
16No hewɔ lɛ, ohiafo yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ,
ni toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli muɔ shi kɔ̃i.
17 “Naa, ajɔɔ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kãa lɛ lɛ,
no hewɔ lɛ, ekafee bo dɔlɛ
kɛji Ofe lɛ kã bo.
18 Ejaakɛ epilaa mɔ, shi lɛ nɔŋŋ efiɔ nɔ,
etswaa mɔ nɔ, ni enine nɔŋŋ tsaa.
19Ebaajie bo yɛ amanehului babaoo amli hu,
nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ bo.
20Hɔmɔ be mli lɛ
ebaajie bo yɛ gbele mli,
ni ta mli hu lɛ,
oooje klante naa.
21Nyɔŋmɔ baabaa oyi
kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ naabu fitemɔ mli;
ni kɛji hiɛkpãtãmɔ miiba lɛ
osheŋ gbeyei.
22Oooŋmɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ hɔmɔ fɛɛ,
ni osheŋ ŋaŋ kooloi agbeyei.
23Tɛi ehiŋ shikpɔŋ ni ohuɔ nɔ,
ni ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ bo aaahi
shi kpoo.
24Enɛ aaahã ole akɛ owe
lɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe,
ni oookpa otoi anaa,
ni ooona akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe.
25Ooona hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ oshwiei
ayi aaafa tamɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ
jwɛi.
26Ooogbɔ kotokoto dani ooogbo,
tamɔ bɔ ni ŋmãa tsɛɔ ni esaa
dani ebashɛɔ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
27Hiob, nɔ ni wɔkpa shi wɔna nɛ.
Anɔkwale ni, no hewɔ lɛ, okɛbu ohe.”

Title: HIOB 6
Content:
Hiob wiemɔ
1Hiob here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
2“Oo, mina ni aŋmɛ minaagbai
kɛ mihejaramɔ fɛɛ yɛ nsɛni mli.
3Ejaakɛ aaana akɛ etsii fe ŋshɔnaa shia,
ni no hewɔ ni minaa wiemɔi
lɛ efeŋ yiŋ flɛflɛ lɛ.
4 Ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ etsɛ̃rɛ mi gãi,
ni miinu gãimlibii lɛ anaa ebɔɔ lɛ he yɛ mimli;
Nyɔŋmɔ he ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi emuu.
5Ani ŋaŋ teji bolɔɔ be ni ena jwɛi eekpe,
aloo tsina bolɔɔ yɛ eniyeniiashi?
6Ani ayeɔ nii mutɛ
ni ŋoo bɛ mli?
Aloo mɛɛ ŋɔɔmɔ yɔɔ wuɔwɔlɔ mli
eyɛŋ lɛ mli?
7Nii ni misusuma sumɔɔɔ
akɛ eyeɔ lɛ
nomɛi nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ miniyenii
ni minyaŋeɔ nɛɛ.
8“Oo, mina ni kulɛ mina mitaomɔnii;
ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mi mishweenii.
9Mina ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpãtã mihiɛ;
eeeŋmɛ enine gbɛ ni
etsɛ̃rɛ mimli!
10Kulɛ mimii aaashɛ mihe,
mimli aaafli mi pam
yɛ minɔnaa ni akɛfaaa lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ,
ejaakɛ mikwako Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ
wiemɔi lɛ.
11Mihewalɛ enyiɛ hewɔ ni mamia
mihiɛ mamɛ?
Mɛɛ ji minaagbee hewɔ ni
mato mitsui shi?
12Ani mihewalɛ lɛ tɛ hewalɛ ni?
Loo miheloo lɛ akɔɔble ni?
13Anɔkwa, mibɛ hewalɛ ko dɔŋŋ,
minyɛmɔ fɛɛ etã.
14“Mɔ ni kwaa enaanyo ejurɔfeemɔ lɛ,
esheee Ofe lɛ gbeyei.
15 Minyɛmimɛi lɛ yeee anɔkwale
tamɔ faa ni hoɔ,
tamɔ jɔɔ mli faa ni hoɔ kɛyaa ni eŋalaa;
16amɛhiɛ diɔ oookɛɛ aisi,
ni amɛyi tɔ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ yɛŋ muɛmuɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ snoo.
17Kɛji dɔlɛ ba pɛ amɛlaaje;
kɛ jeŋ dɔ pɛ amɛmii.
18Gbɛnyiɛlɔi asafo gbaa afã kɛjeɔ amɛgbɛ nɔ,
amɛyafoɔ shi kɛtaoɔ nu yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ
ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.
19Tema kɛ Sheba gbɛfalɔi asafoi
taoɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ,
20shi amɛhiɛ gboiɔ akɛ
amɛŋɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ nɔ;
ejaakɛ kɛji amɛshɛ he pɛ,
amɛhiɛ shwieɔ shi.
21Bɔ pɛ ni nyɛ ji nyɛhã mi nɛ,
mimanehulu ni nyɛna lɛ,
ehã nyɛmiishe gbeyei.
22Ani mibi akɛ nyɛke mi nɔ ko,
aloo nyɛkɛ nyɛnii ni nyɛyɔɔ
ayawo mɔ ko daaŋnii ahã mi?
23Aloo nyɛhere mi yɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ,
aloo nyɛkpɔ̃ mi yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ?
24Nyɛtsɔa mi; nyɛhãa manua shishi,
koni nɔ mli ni mitɔ̃ yɛ lɛ,
mafee diŋŋ.
25Anɔkwa wiemɔ yɛ hewalɛ;
shi mɛni kãmɔ ni nyɛkãa mi lɛ
baanyɛ etsu?
26Ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛkã
gbɔmɔ yɛ wiemɔ hewɔ,
be mli ni mɔ ni bɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ
wiemɔ lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ ni lɛ?
27Nyɛaafɔ̃ awusa nɔ oshiki,
ni nyɛaaye nyɛnaanyo yi jara.
28Shi agbɛnɛ, nyɛtɛjea nyɛhiɛ
nyɛkwɛa mi;
ejaakɛ mimaleŋ
mitsɔŋ nyɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ!
29Nyɛfainɛ, awa jɛi!
Nyɛkafea esha;
awa jɛi, misane lɛ ja.
30Ani wiemɔ ko ni ejaaa
eje minaa dã?
Ani mileee nɔ kpakpa
yɛ nɔ fɔŋ he?”

Title: HIOB 7
Content:
1“Ani gbɔmɔ wala yɛ shikpɔŋ
nɛɛ nɔ jeee tɔlɛ kɛ deŋmegbomɔ?
Ani ewala gbii tamɔɔɔ
apaafonyo wala gbii?
2Ani etamɔɔɔ bɔ ni apaafonyo
kwɛɔ epaabɔɔnii gbɛ lɛ?
3Nakai mihi shi shwɛm nyɔji abɔ
ni mikã jaramɔ mli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
4Kɛji miho mikã shi lɛ,
bɔ ni mibablaa shi nɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɔɔŋ hu
sɛɛ jɛkɛɔ,
ni mibiɔ mihe akɛ,
mɛɛbe je aaatsɛre ni mate shi?”
5Miheloo ewo gɔgɔmi kɛ muji;
miheloo lɛ hiɛ gbiɔ
kɛkɛ lɛ eflɛ.
6Migbii lɛ hoɔ oyayaaya
fe mamalolɔ akokrowa tete,
ni amɛmiitã ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko bɛ.
7“Nyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ akɛ miwala lɛ
kɔɔyɔɔ ni,
ni nɔ kpakpa bɛ
ni mihiŋmɛi baana dɔŋŋ.
8Mɔ hiŋmɛi ni naa mi nɛɛ,
enaŋ mi dɔŋŋ.
Ookwɛ mi nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ,
ni malaaje.
9Bɔ ni atatu tseɔ, ni elaajeɔ lɛ,
nakai mɔ ni yaa gbohiiaje
ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ;
10ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa ewe dɔŋŋ,
ni hiɛ kpaa enɔ kwraa.
11No hewɔ lɛ, mimuaŋ minaa!
Mikɛ mimumɔŋ hejaramɔ baawie;
mibawie misusuma nidɔɔnii.
12Ani ŋshɔ loo bonso ji mi
hewɔ ni otoɔ mɔ ko ni
ebu mihe lɛ?”
13Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Misaa
aaashɛje mimii,
ni mipiŋmɔ he aaajɔ yɛ misaa nɔ lɛ,
14kɛkɛ lɛ okɛ lamɔi miiwo mihe gbeyei,
ni okɛ ninai hãa ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi.
15Ni no hewɔ lɛ, masumɔ
ni amia misɛ̃ ni magbo moŋ
fe nɔ ni makã lootãa wuiwui nɛɛ amli.
16 Jeŋhilɛ eje mitsine;
mihiŋ shi kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
Ŋmɛɛmɔ mihe,
ejaakɛ miwala tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
17 Namɔ ji gbɔmɔ, hewɔ ni obuɔ ehe
akɔntaa nɛkɛ,
ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe kwraa po;
18ni osaraa lɛ daa leebi,
ni okaa lɛ okwɛɔ hiŋmɛitswaa
fɛɛ hiŋmɛitswaa nɛɛ?
19Mɛɛ beyinɔ okpaŋ nii kwɛmɔ;
mɛɛbe po oooŋmɛɛ mihe,
koni mana be mami misɛŋ nu?
20Bo adesai ahebulɔ,
kɛji mifee esha lɛ,
mɛni po mina mifee bo?
Mɛɛba ni ojie ohiɛ oka mi?
Mɛɛba mitsɔ̃ jatsu mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ
nɔŋŋ mihe nɛɛ?
21Mɛɛba okɛ mitɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaaa mi
koni ofɔ minɔsha lɛ yɛ mihe?
Ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ su mli makã
ni obaatao mi,
shi onaŋ mi yɛ he ko he ko.”

Title: HIOB 8
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, here Hiob nɔ ekɛɛ:
2“Mɛɛbe po ooohiɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ amli
kɛyashi,
onaa wiemɔi ni tamɔ ahum
wulu nɛɛ?
3Ani Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ jalɛ hiɛ ebuɔ shi?
Aloo Ofe lɛ kɔdɔ̃ɔ etoi eyeɔ sane?
4Kɛji obii lɛ tɔ̃ enɔ lɛ,
no lɛ egbala amɛtoi bɔ ni sa amɛ.
5Kɛji obaatao Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ
ni okpa Ofe lɛ fai,
6ni kɛji ohe tse ni oja lɛ,
no lɛ anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ baaye ebua bo,
ni ebaaduro bo we kpakpa ekoŋŋ.
7Osa shihilɛ lɛ baafee nɔ ko bibioo,
shi owɔsɛɛ shihilɛ baafe nɔ wulu.
8“Ofainɛ, bo lɛ bi tsutsu yinɔbii,
ni obo nɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi ekpa shi
ni amɛna lɛ toi.
9 Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, nyɛ kpaakpa nyɛ afɔ wɔ,
ni wɔleee nɔ ko nɔ ko,
ejaakɛ wɔgbii yɛ jeŋ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ.
10Ani blematsɛmɛi nɛɛ etsɔŋ bo nii;
ani amɛgbaŋ bo, ani amɛwieŋ
amɛnilee mli wiemɔi?
11“Ani adã kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ he ni
ŋmiamɔ bɛ lo?
Ani glã shwereɔ yɛ he ni nu bɛ?
12Be mli ni amɛgba afofro,
ni anako afolɔ lɛ,
amɛŋalaa amɛshiɔ jwɛi krokomɛi fɛɛ.
13Mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kpaa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ,
bɔ ni amɛnaagbee yɔɔ nɛ;
mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ,
ehiɛnɔkãmɔ aaafite.
14Ehiɛnɔkãmɔ mli tserɛɔ,
ehiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ tamɔ anaanu ntaŋ.
15Ehoɔ ekpasaa ewe lɛ,
shi ewe lɛ nyɛɛɛ shi ema;
emɔɔ mli waa;
shi no nyɛɛɛ lɛ asɔo.”
16Gbɔmɔ shwereɔ yɛ hulu hiɛ,
ni niji ni etsɛ̃rɛ lɛ haa
etrom lɛ nɔ.
17Efãi blaa tɛi kui,
etsɔ̃ɔ tɛsai amli tete.
18Kɛji akpãtã ehiɛ yɛ he ni
eyɔɔ lɛ,
no lɛ he ni ehi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ
baatso yɛ ehe ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Minako bo dã!”
19Shi naa, miishɛɛ ni eyɔɔ
ji akɛ gbɔmɛi krokomɛi
baakwɛ̃ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
20“Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ kwaaa
mɔ ni tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ehe;
ni asaŋ etooo he nine
ehãaa efɔŋfeelɔi.
21Ebaahã odaa aaayi obɔ̃ kɛ ŋmɔlɔ,
ni odaa ayi obɔ kɛ oshebɔɔ.
22Ohenyɛlɔi ahiɛ aaagboi,
ni yiwalɔi awei aaalaaje.”

Title: HIOB 9
Content:
Hiob wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob hã Bildad hetoo ekɛɛ:
2 Mile lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nakai ji sane lɛ,
shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni adesa
aja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛŋ?
3Kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
aaataa naa lɛ, mɔ lɛ
nyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ saji akpe mli
ekome kɛkɛ naa ejie.
4Nilelɔ ji lɛ, ni eyɛ hewalɛ;
namɔ ete shi ewo lɛ,
ni eye kunim pɛŋ?
5Efãmɔɔ gɔji, ni amɛleee kwraa
kɛji etsɔ̃mɔ amɛ ebu shi
yɛ emlifu mli.
6Ehosoɔ je lɛ kɛmɔɔ eshishitoo;
ni ekulashiŋi ni tere je lɛ hosoɔ.
7Efãa hulu, ni ehiii lɛ shitee;
ni esɔoɔ ŋulamii anaa, ni amɛkpɛɛɛ.
8 Lɛ ekoome ekpã ŋwɛi mli
elɛɛ shi,
ni enaanaa bonso nɔ yɛ ŋshɔŋ.
9 Lɛ ebɔ Jeŋ kpawo kɛ Oŋwɛ
kɛ Wuɔ kɛ ebii kɛ wuoyigbɛ ŋulamii lɛ.
10Efeɔ nibii wuji ni anaaa naa;
kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni aleee amɛyibɔ.
11Naa Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mihe kɛhoɔ,
ni minaaa lɛ;
ehoɔ eyaa, ni miyooo lɛ.
12Naa, nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ ekɔɔ;
namɔ aaanyɛ enaa atsi?
Namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
“Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ?
13Nyɔŋmɔ eŋmɛŋ emlifu lɛ he,
ni mɛi ni ye bua Rahab lɛ aaabakua lɛ.
14Te mafee tɛŋŋ mahã lɛ hetoo hu?
Mɛɛ wiemɔi anɔ matsɔ̃
mi kɛ lɛ awie?
15Yɛ mli akɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe moŋ,
shi minyɛŋ lɛ hetoo mahã;
hewɔ lɛ fai moŋ makpa mikojolɔ lɛ.
16Kɛji mitsɛ lɛ ni ehere minɔ po,
miheŋ miyeŋ akɛ eebo mi toi.
17Ejaakɛ ekɛ ahum kumɔɔ mi,
ni ehãa mifaji lɛ faa yakatswaa.
18Ehãaa mana mumɔhe,
shi ewoɔ mi jaramɔ moŋ.
19Kɛji aaye lɛ hewalɛ naa lɛ,
naa, lɛ nɛ;
ni kɛji aafee jalɛnii lɛ,
namɔ kɛ lɛ kedeɔ?
20Yɛ mli akɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe,
kɛ̃lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minaa wiemɔ
baabu mi fɔ.
Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe moŋ nɛ,
shi eeetsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mihiii.
21Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe,
shi mitsɛɛɛ mihe nɔ ko.
Jeŋshihilɛ eje mitsine.
22Fɛɛ ekome!”
No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ,
“Jeŋshihilɛ eje mitsine;
mɔ ni shwamɔ bɛ ehe,
kɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ
baakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
23Kɛji osharã gbe mɔ ko
ni tɔ̃mɔ bɛ ehe lɛ,
Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɔɔ.
24Ekɛ je lɛ ewo mɔ fɔŋ dɛŋ;
eha enɔ kojolɔi ahiɛ.
Kɛjeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ,
namɔ ni mɔ?
25“Migbii lɛ ahe yɛ oya fe foijolɔ,
amɛhoɔ amɛyaa,
ni amɛnaaa nɔ kpakpa ko.
26Amɛhoɔ amɛyaa shwiaa
tamɔ glã lɛji,
tamɔ okropɔŋ gbaa eyiɔ kooloo nɔ.
27Kɛji mikɛɛ majie mihiɛ yɛ mikɔmɔi lɛ anɔ,
ni masaa mihiɛ, ni mana tsui lɛ,
28mipiŋmɔi lɛ aaawo mihe gbeyei moŋ,
ejaakɛ mile akɛ obuŋ mi bem.
29Ni abaabu mi fɔ kɛ̃;
mɛɛba mɔ magba mihe naa yaka?
30Kɛji miju mihe kɛ snoo nu,
ni mifɔ midɛ̃ hu kɛ samla lɛ,
31kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, oootsi mi
owo bu mli;
ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe atade tete
aaahã mihe anyaŋe mi.
32Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee adesa tamɔ mi
koni mahã lɛ hetoo;
ni wɔya ni akojo wɔ yɛ kojomɔhe.
33Mɔ ko bɛ ni aaadamɔ wɔteŋ,
ni eeeŋɔ enine efɔ̃ wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔnɔ,
ni ekpãtã wɔteŋ.
34Hã ekpa mi piŋmɔ,
koni ehe ŋmiŋmi akamɔ mi.
35Kɛkɛ lɛ mawie, ni lɛ gbeyeishemɔ
bɛ mli;
ejaakɛ jeee nakai miyɔɔ.”

Title: HIOB 10
Content:
1“Mijeŋshihilɛ eje mitsine.
Mikɛ mikɔmɔi lɛ baashwie shi
kpookpoo.
Mibawie mitsui mli dɔlɛ fɛɛ.
2Mibakɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, ‘Kaabu mi
fɔ!’
Tsɔɔmɔ mi nɔ hewɔ ni
okɛ mi ena nɛɛ.
3Aso eja gbɛ yɛ ohiɛ,
akɛ owa mɔ yi, ni onyaŋe
bo diɛŋtsɛ oninenaa nitsumɔnii.
Ni ona mɛi fɔ̃ji ayiŋtoi
moŋ ahe tsuijurɔ lo?
4Ani adesa hiŋmɛi ohiɛ,
ni okwɛɔ nii tamɔ adesa?
5Ani ogbii tamɔ adesa gbii,
loo ofii tamɔ adesa afii;
6hewɔ ni otiuɔ mitɔ̃mɔi asɛɛ,
ni odiɔ esha ni mifee sɛɛ;
7tsɛbelɛ ole akɛ miyeee fɔ,
ni mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ ashɔ̃
mi yɛ odɛ̃ŋ?
8Oniji shɔ̃ mi, ni amɛbɔ mi,
ni agbɛnɛ ofo ohe,
ni okɛ nakai niji lɛ nɔŋŋ
miikpãtã mihiɛ.
9 Kaimɔ akɛ okɛ sũ bɔ mi.
Ani oohã matsɔ̃ sũ ekoŋŋ?
10Ohã mitsɛ hewalɛ, ni ekɛfɔ mi,
ni ohã mida yɛ minyɛ musuŋ.
11Okɛ wui kɛ fãi tsara migbɔmɔtso,
ni okɛ loo kɛ hewolo ha mihe.
12Oduro mi wala, ni suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi sɛɛ efooo,
ni odɛ̃ŋ kwɛmɔ ebaa miyi.
13Kɛ̃lɛ okɛ nibii ni eba minɔ nɛɛ tee mi yɛ otsui mli,
yɛ oyiŋtoo naa.
14Kɛji mifee esha lɛ, okadiɔ ohãa mi,
ni okɛ mitɔmɔ lɛ efaaa.
15Kɛji mifee nɔ fɔŋ lɛ, kpoo hã mi!
Kɛji mifee nɔ ni ja tete lɛ,
minyɛɛɛ miyi nɔ mawo,
ejaakɛ mihiɛ egbo kpɔtɔɔ,
ni miikwɛ mihejaramɔ lɛ moŋ.
16 Kɛji mikanya mihe lɛ,
ogbɔbiɔ mi tamɔ jata,
ni ofeɔ naakpɛɛ nibii oshiɔ mi.
17Otsakeɔ odasefoi ni wieɔ shiɔ mi,
ni ohãa omlifu naa waa yɛ minɔ,
ni ohãa ta nyiɛɔ ta sɛɛ kɛtuaa mi.
18Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba oŋmɛ gbɛ ni afɔ mi mɔ?
Mina ni migbo dani hiŋmɛi ko
na mi;
19ni kɛjɛ musuŋ lɛ
awo mi ayafu,
ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko
ni afɔko lɛ kwraa.
20Te miwala gbii faaa?
Ŋmɛɛmɔ mihe koni mawo mitsui fioo,
21dani maya he ni kɛ mitee,
ni mijɛŋ jɛi mibaŋ dɔŋŋ,
he ni ji duŋ kpii kɛ gbele hɔ̃ɔŋ
shikpɔŋ lɛ,
22duŋ kpii shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ sakasaka,
he ni la ji duŋ lɛ.”

Title: HIOB 11
Content:
Zofar wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Zofar, Naamanyo lɛ here Hiob nɔ, ni ekɛɛ,
2“Ani awieɔ babaoo nɛkɛ
ni ahãaa hetoo,
ni ahãa naafuutsɛ ŋɔɔ ehe eyeɔ?
Ani naafuu wiemɔ
hãa mɔ sane jaa?
3Hiob, aso owiemɔi babaoo nɛɛ
aaahã mɛi afee dioo?
Ni kɛji oye mɛi ahe fɛo lɛ,
mɔ ko akawo bo hiɛgbele?
4Okɛɛ nɔ ni owieɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni,
ni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ ohe tse.
5Oo, kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ awie,
egbɛ edaaŋ ekɛ bo awie,
6koni egbele teemɔŋ nilee hiɛ
etsɔ̃ɔ bo,
ejaakɛ enilee yɛ naakpɛɛ.
Na ole akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo yeko
bɔ ni sa otɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
7Ani ooonyɛ ona Nyɔŋmɔ
teemɔŋ nibii anaa?
Ani ooonyɛ ole he ni Ofe lɛ hewalɛ yatãa?
8Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ kwɔ fe ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi;
mɛni obaanyɛ ofee yɛ he?
Ni emli kwɔ voo fe gbohiiaje;
mɛni obaanyɛ ofee yɛ he?
9Ekɛ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ,
ni elɛɛ fe ŋshɔ.
10Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ ba,
ni ebamɔ bo ewo kpabuŋ,
ni etsɛ bo kojomɔ lɛ,
namɔ aaanyɛ enaa atsi?
11Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ le mɛi ni ji yakagbɔmɛi lɛ,
kɛji ena nɔ sha lɛ,
aso eeeku ehiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ?
12Kwashiai baabɔ̃i jwɛŋmɔ namɔ,
be ni ŋaŋ teji baafɔ bi
ni he jɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ.
13Kɛji osaa otsuiŋ ekpakpa lɛ,
ooohole oniji anɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
14Kɛji nɔ sha ko yɛ odɛ̃ŋ lɛ,
hã eya sɛɛ flɛŋŋ
ni ogu nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ
yɛ owe lɛ mli.
15Kɛkɛ lɛ, anɔkwa, ooonyɛ
ohiɛ nɔ owo,
ni kpa ko bɛ ohe,
ni ooona ekãa
ni osheŋ gbeyei.
16Ejaakɛ ohiɛ aaakpa ohaomɔi
lɛ fɛɛ nɔ;
obaakai haomɔi lɛ tamɔ faaŋ
nu ni eho etee kɛkɛ.
17Owala be mli aaatse fe shwane,
ni kɛji duŋ wo yɛ mli tete lɛ,
eeetsɔ tamɔ leebi.
18Otsui aaakã omli, ejaakɛ oyɛ
hiɛnɔkãmɔ;
Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu ohe, ni ooojɔɔ ohe,
ni ooofee shweshweeshwe.
19Oookã shi, ni mɔ ko woŋ ohe gbeyei;
mɛi babaoo aaababi odɛ̃ŋ wamɔ.
20Shi mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ aaashwila,
ni amɛnaŋ foijeehe.
Amɛhiɛnɔkãmɔ pɛ ji gbele.”

Title: HIOB 12
Content:
Hiob Wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
2“Ŋwanejee bɛ he akɛ nyɛ ji maŋ lɛ,
ni kɛji nyɛgboi pɛ,
nilee hu egbo.
3Shi mi hu miyɛ jwɛŋmɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ;
Nyɛfeee mi nilee.
Namɔ leee wiemɔi ni nyɛwie nɛɛ?
4Naa mi ni mitsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli nɔ
mihã minanemɛi.
Mi ni mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni ehereɔ mi nɔ,
ni miyeɔ jalɛ sane,
ni shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe lɛ;
mi, mitsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli nɔ nɛɛ.
5Mɔ ni he ejɔ lɛ lɛ,
ejwɛŋmɔ ji akɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ amanehulu mli lɛ
esa ehefɛoyeli.
No ji nɔ ni sa mɔ ni eshane
ni eyaagbee shi lɛ.
6Julɔi atoiiaŋ ejɔ amɛ yɛ amɛshĩai amli,
ni mɛi ni woɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli la hu
yɛ shweshweeshwe,
tsɛbelɛ amɛhewalɛ ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ.
7Bo lɛ bi kooloi, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nii;
bi loofɔji, ni amɛaagba bo sane;
8loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei,
ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nii;
ni ŋshɔŋ loi hu aaagba bo sane.
9Te nibii nɛɛ ateŋ nɔ ni leee
akɛ Yehowa nine ji nɔ ni bɔ lɛ lɛ?
10 Lɛ edɛŋ nibii fɛɛ ni muɔ awala
kɛ adesa mumɔ fɛɛ yɔɔ.
11Bɔ ni toi kaa wiemɔi ekwɛɔ lɛ,
nakai lilɛi hu saa niyenii naa ekwɛɔ.
12Nilee yɛ onukpai adɛŋ,
shi walasɛɛtsɛlɛ mli jwɛŋmɔ yɔɔ.
13Shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eyɛ nilee kɛ hewalɛ
kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ.
14Kɛji ekumɔ nɔ ko eshwie shi lɛ,
mɔ ko bɛ ni baanyɛ esaa etswa ema shi;
ni kɛji eŋa mɔ ko yi lɛ,
mɔ ko nyɛŋ agbele mɔ lɛ.
15 Kɛji etsi nunɛmɔ naa lɛ,
fai miiɔ;
ni kɛji eŋmɛɛ he lɛ fai yimɔɔ,
ni amɛjeɔ ŋa kɛhaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
16Lɛ edɛŋ hewalɛ kɛ nilee fɛɛ yɔɔ;
mɔ ni eshishiuɔ mɔ kɛ
mɔ ni ashishiuɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ,
enɔ ji amɛ fɛɛ.
17Ehãa nilee ŋmɛɔ ajinafoi,
ni ehãa kojolɔi tsɔ̃ɔ kwashiai.
18Ekpaa maŋtsɛmɛi,
ni ekɛ kpãa fimɔɔ amɛhɛ.
19Ekpɔlɔɔ osɔfoi ahewulamɔnii yɛ amɛhe,
ni ebaa mɛi ni hiɛ hewalɛ shi.
20Ehãa wiemɔ tete ŋmɛɔ mɛi
ni hiɛ kã amɛnɔ,
ni eshɔ̃ɔ hiimeji anilee yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
21Ehãa lumɛi ahe guɔ gboɔ,
ni efoɔ hewalɔi ahewalɛ sɛɛ.
22Ejieɔ nibii ni hɔlɔ dujiaŋ lɛ kpo,
ni ehãa la kpɛɔ yɛ hei ni duŋ yɔɔ.
23Ehãa maji jeɔ agbo,
ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpãtãa amɛhiɛ.
Elɛɔ maji amli, ni amɛdaraa,
ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpãtãa amɛhiɛ.
24Eshɔ̃ɔ nilee yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii
amaŋtsɛmɛi adɛŋ;
ni ehãa amɛtsomloɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ
he ni nanegbɛ tete bɛ.
25Amɛgbugbuɔ shi yɛ duŋ
ni la ko bɛ mli lɛ mli,
ni ehãa amɛdidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔi.

Title: HIOB 13
Content:
1Naa, mina nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ
kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛi,
ni mitoi hu enu, ni minu shishi.
2Nɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, mi hu mile;
nyɛfeee mi yɛ enɛɛmɛi agbɛfaŋ.
3Shi mi lɛ Ofe lɛ mitaoɔ mikɛwie,
Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni mitaoɔ mikɛyiyi
ni matsɔ̃ɔ lɛ misane lɛ naa.
4Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ abla eto nyɛhiɛ,
tsofatsɛmɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko mli ji nyɛ fɛɛ.
5Oo, nyɛmuaa nyɛnaa moŋ kulɛ eeehi pam,
ejaakɛ no aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnilee.
6Agbɛnɛ nyɛboa misane lɛ toi,
ni nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa minaajiemɔ lɛ.
7Ani nyɛaato abla nyɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ naa,
ni nyɛaawie nɔ ni bɛ mli nyɛhã lɛ?
8Ani nyɛmiiwie kɛmiifã Nyɔŋmɔ he lo?
Ani nyɛbaawie nyɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ?
9Ani kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ tao nyɛsaji amli lɛ,
nyɛaaye nyɛhe?
Ani nyɛaanyɛ nyɛlaka Nyɔŋmɔ
tamɔ alakaa adesa lo?
10Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ baakã nyɛhiɛ
kɛji nyɛkwɛ hiɛiaŋ yɛ dujiaŋ tete.
11Aso egbojee lɛ woŋ nyɛhe gbeyei
ni ehe ŋmiŋmi hu mɔŋ nyɛ?
12Abɛi ni nyɛbubuɔ lɛ tamɔ lamlu;
wiemɔi ni nyɛkɛfãa nyɛhe lɛ
tamɔ magbɛ.
13Nyɛfea dioo koni manyɛ mawie,
ni nɔ ni aaaba minɔ lɛ aba.
14Mɛɛ hewɔ maŋɔ miheloo makɔ̃ minaa
koni mahiɛ miwala yɛ midɛŋ?
15Naa, kɛji eeegbe mi tete lɛ,
mibɛ sane ko;
mibafã mijeŋba he yɛ ehiɛ kɛ̃.
16Enɛ nɔŋŋ aaatsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ,
ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ nyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ aba.
17Nyɛboa nɔ ni mawie nɛɛ toi jogbaŋŋ,
ni nyɛhãa minaajiemɔ lɛ
aya nyɛtoiiaŋ.
18Naa, misaa minaajiemɔ mito;
mile akɛ abaabu mi bem.
19Namɔ yɔɔ jɛi ni ekɛ mi
batao naa?
Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ,
no lɛ mibafee diŋŋ
koni magbo kɛkɛ.
20Feemɔ nibii enyɔ nɛɛ pɛ
ohã mi,
ni miteŋ mihe yɛ ohiɛ.
21Suu onine yɛ mihe kwraa,
ni kaahã ohe ŋmiŋmi miimɔ mi.
22Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɛ mi, ni mibahere bo nɔ,
aloo ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni mawie
ni ohã mi hetoo.
23Minishaianii kɛ mihe eshai lɛ, enyiɛ ni?
Hã male minishaianii kɛ mihe eshai lɛ.
24Mɛɛba okɛ ohiɛ teɔ mi,
ni obuɔ mi akɛ ohenyɛlɔ lɛ?
25Aso obaafã baa ni kɔɔyɔɔ ehuu lɛ tsui;
ni obaanyiɛ abele shishi tutuu sɛɛ?
26Ejaakɛ okɛ saji ni naa wa miishi mi,
ootsɛ miblahiaŋ tɔ̃mɔi tete asɛɛ.
27 Obɔ minaji apã,
ni ohiŋmɛi kã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ
ni mifeɔ he;
minanefaamɔi hu owo he husu.
28Adesa tamɔ nɔ ko ni ekpɔtɔ,
etamɔ mama ni omlɛgɛ eye.

Title: HIOB 14
Content:
1Gbɔmɔ ni yoo fɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ,
kukuoo kɛkɛ ji ewala be lɛ;
ni emli eyi tɔ kɛ haomɔ sɔŋŋ.
2Ewala nɛɛ tamɔ fɔfɔi;
ekwɛ̃ɔ, ni eŋalaa shwiaa;
ehoɔ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ, ni etsɛɛɛ.
3Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ
ona be ookwɛ lɛ,
ni ootao okɛ lɛ aye sane lo?
4Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ana nɔ ni
he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee
teŋ srɔto lɛ?
5Akɛni ato ewala be lɛ,
ni nyɔji abɔ ni ebaaye yɛ odɛ̃ŋ lɛ,
belɛ owo ewala he husu momo.
6Jiemɔ ohiɛ yɛ enɔ; kaafo edaaŋ
koni emii ashɛ ehe yɛ ewala mli
tamɔ apaafonyo.
7Tso tete yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ
akɛ kɛji atoo lɛ lɛ,
eeehere ekoŋŋ, ni niji
ni ebaatsɛ̃rɛ lɛ baadara, amɛgboiŋ.
8Yɛ mli akɛ efãi baatsɛ̃
yɛ sũ mli
ni etsoku lɛ baagbo yɛ suŋ,
9shi nu ni eeena nɛkɛ pɛ,
eeetsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ, ni eeetsɛ̃rɛ niji
tamɔ tso ŋmɔŋ.
10Shi gbɔmɔ gboɔ, ni enyɔɔ shi.
Kɛji mumɔ na fã yɛ emli lɛ,
nɛgbɛ lɛ yɔɔ dɔŋŋ?
11Bɔ ni nu tãa yɛ kpaakpo mli,
ni faa miiɔ ni egbiɔ lɛ,
12nakai gbɔmɔ hoɔ ekãa shi
ni eteee shi dɔŋŋ.
Kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ŋwɛi aaaho aya lɛ,
ehiɛ etsɛŋ, ni atsiɛŋ lɛ yɛ wɔ lɛ mli.
13Mina ni kulɛ oŋɔ mi otee
yɛ gbohiiaje,
ni oŋɔ mi ohɔ shi
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni
omlifu lɛ aaaho,
koni oto be ohã mi,
ni okai mi.
14Kɛji gbɔmɔ gbo lɛ,
ehiɛ aaakã ekoŋŋ?
Mibato mitsui shi mamɛ yɛ
misɔ̃ɔmɔ be lɛ mli
kɛyaashi be aaashɛ
ni aaaŋmɛ̃ɛ mihe.
15Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobo otsɛ mi, ni mahere bo nɔ;
ni oootao oninenaa bɔɔnii
lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.
16Ni ohiŋmɛi baakã minyiɛmɔ he,
ni obuŋ minifɔɔjianii ahe akɔntaa;
17aaasɔo minifɔɔjianii anaa awo
kotoku mli,
ni obaatsimɔ minifɔɔjianii lɛ anɔ.
18Shi bɔ ni gɔŋ tete gbeɔ shi,
ni efufluɔ,
ni atsiɔ tɛsaa kɛjeɔ eshimaahe,
19 ni nu yeɔ tɛi ahe,
ni eloɔ shikpɔŋ su kɛyaa lɛ,
nakai ofiteɔ gbɔmɔ adesa hiɛnɔkãmɔ.
20Oyeɔ gbɔmɔ hewalɛ nɔ kɛyaa naanɔ,
otsakeɔ ehiɛ, ni oshwieɔ lɛ kɛyaa,
ni ehoɔ eyaa.
21Kɛji ebii ahiɛ miiba nyam lɛ, eleee;
ni kɛji amɛhiɛ miishwie shi hu
eleee.
22Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ pɛ egbɔmɔtsoŋ piŋmɔ
he enuɔ,
ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ pɛ ehe ŋkɔmɔ eyeɔ.”

Title: HIOB 15
Content:
Sanegbaa ni ji enyɔ lɛ
(15.1—21.34)
Elifaz wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
2“Aso nilelɔ hãa sane hetoo
kɛ wiemɔ huu nɛkɛ,
ni ehãa emusu ayi obɔ̃ kɛ
bokã kɔɔyɔɔ?
3Aso ekɛ wiemɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ
baajie enaa;
aloo eeejie enaa kɛ wiemɔ
ni shishinumɔ bɛ he?
4Ojie Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ yɛ ojwɛŋmɔŋ,
ni ootsi sɔlemɔ naa yɛ ehiɛ;
5ejaakɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miijie onifɔ̃jianii
lɛ kpo,
ni ohiɛ shishiulɔi alilɛi.
6Bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miibu bo fɔ,
shi jeee mi;
bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miiye odase
miishi bo.
7Ani bo ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ ni afɔ
yɛ je nɛɛŋ?
Aloo aŋɔ bo hɔ dani abɔ gɔji lɛ?
8Ani ona onu Nyɔŋmɔ ajinaŋ sane?
Ani bo pɛ odɛ̃ŋ nilee yɔɔ?
9Mɛni kwraa ole ni wɔ lɛ wɔleee?
Mɛni shishi onu, ni wɔ lɛ efeko faŋŋ
ehãko wɔ lolo?
10Wajiatsɛmɛi kɛ hiimeji fɛɛ yɛ wɔteŋ
ni amɛye otsɛ ni fɔ bo onukpa kwraa.
11Omii ni Nyɔŋmɔ shɛjeɔ lɛ, efaaa lo?
Aloo wiemɔ ni akɛ bo wieɔ
kɛ naajɔlɛ lɛ jeee nɔ ko hã bo?
12Mɛɛba otsui sha bo,
ni mɛɛba ohiŋmɛii tswaa kpɛlɛkpɛlɛ,
13ni ote shi owo Nyɔŋmɔ
yɛ omumɔ mli,
ni ohãa wiemɔi ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi
jeɔ onaa?
14 Namɔ ji adesa ni ehe aaatse,
loo gbɔmɔ ni jɛ yoo musuŋ
ni eeefee nɔ ni ja?
15Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ
emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ tete anɔ;
ni ŋwɛi tete he tseee yɛ ehiɛ.
16Te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ,
ni mɔ ni feɔ musubɔɔnii,
asaŋ ni efite
adesa ni nifɔɔjianiifeemɔ
ji enu ni enuɔ lɛ,
ekɛ ehe aaafɔ̃ enɔ lɛ?
17Hiob, bo mi toi;
mibagba bo nɔ ni mina yɛ jeŋ,
18nɔ ni nilelɔi egba,
ni ji nɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi kɛteee amɛ lɛ.
19Amɛ tuuŋtu aŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã;
gbɔi futuuu amɛ.
20 Yiwalɔ, mɔ ni waa mɛi krokomɛi ayi lɛ,
piŋɔ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
21Gbee ni yɔɔ gbeyei gbɛɔ yɛ etoiiaŋ,
ni julɔ batuaa lɛ be mli ni
ehe ejɔ lɛ.
22Eheee eyeee akɛ eeeku esɛɛ
kɛaajɛ duŋ mli,
ni klante ji nɔ ni aaagbe lɛ,
23ni akpaŋai miimɛ ni amɛye eloo.
Ele akɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ lɛ etã.
24Jaramɔ kɛ fimɔ woɔ ehe gbeyei;
amɛyeɔ enɔ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ni efã ta.
25Ete shi ewo Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni ewo ehe nɔ yɛ Ofe lɛ nɔ.
26Ehiɛ tsɛŋ kpakpataa, ni etsɛ̃
kɛ kuɛŋtimɔ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.
27Eshwi kɛbamɔ ehiɛ fɛɛ.
28Maji amaŋfɔ̃i amli ehi,
yɛ shĩai ni esaaa akɛ gbɔmɔ
aaahi mli,
hei ni baatsɔmɔ koikoi lɛ.
29Enaŋ nii, ni enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ
tete etsɛŋ,
asaŋ etsɛ̃ŋ fã yɛ su mli.
30Ejeŋ duŋ lɛ mli; la baashã
niji ni etsɛ̃rɛ lɛ;
ni kɔɔyɔɔ baakpala efɔfɔi ashwie.
31Ekaŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ yakanii anɔ
ni ekɛmiilaka ehe,
ejaakɛ yakanii nɔŋŋ ebaakpa.
32Eshɛŋ ebe ni ebaaŋala
tamɔ tso nine,
ni eyi baa frɔkeŋ dɔŋŋ.
33Eyibii ŋmilikiti lɛ eeekpala eshwie shi
tamɔ waintso;
34Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji woŋ shwiei,
ni shĩai ni akɛ nyɔɔŋnihemɔ
mamɔ lɛ, la aaakpãtã hiɛ.
35Nifɔ̃ji ahe ŋaa amɛtoɔ,
ni amɛfeɔ nifɔ̃jianii;
ni mɔshishiumɔ eyi
amɛtsuiiaŋ tɔ.”

Title: HIOB 16
Content:
Hiob wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob to he akɛ,
2“Minu saji ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi aahu;
miishɛjelɔ gbohii ji nyɛ fɛɛ.
3Aso yaka wiemɔi nɛɛ agbeŋ naa?
Ni mɛni ta omli
hewɔ ni ohere wiemɔ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ?
4Eji nyɛgbɔmɔtso baje migbɔmɔtso
mli jikulɛ,
mi hu mawie tamɔ nyɛwieɔ nɛɛ;
mawie mashi nyɛ,
ni mahoso miyitso mawo nyɛ.
5Nakai nɔŋŋ kulɛ mawo nyɛ hewalɛ
kɛ midaaŋ wiemɔ,
ni midaaŋ wiemɔ baahã
nyɛwerɛho lɛ naa aba shi.
6Kɛji miwie lɛ, mipiŋmɔ lɛ ejɔɔɔ,
ni kɛji mifee dioo hu,
enɔ enyiɛ po ni gbɔɔ?
7Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ ehã eje mitsine;
ehã mihe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ etã.
8Ehã mikũakũai
ni enɛ yeɔ odase eshiɔ mi;
milootãa lɛ yeɔ odase shiɔ mi faŋŋ.
9Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mlifu etserɛ mimli;
ebɛ mi ewo emli;
ekpe enyanyɔji ashi ewo mi;
etsu ehiŋmɛi eshwie minɔ
tamɔ henyɛlɔ feɔ.
10Mɛi gbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ
amɛwoɔ mi kɛ naakpɛɛ;
amɛgbalaa mitoiiaŋ ma
kɛbɔɔ mi ahora;
amɛbuaa amɛhe naa amɛwoɔ mi.
11Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ mi ehã mɛi fɔ̃ji,
ni etu mi ewo yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
12Kulɛ mihe ejɔ mi,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɔ miyinɔ tɛ;
emɔ mikuɛ, ni ekɛ mi tswia shi,
ni ekumɔ mi dukuduku.
13Egãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ bɔle mi kɛkpe kpula;
ekɛ kakla gbala misabai amli,
ni ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii kwraa;
efɔse midrɔ eshwie shikpɔŋ.
14Epila mihei srɔtoi;
ni etsɛ̃ kɛba minɔ oookɛɛ
henyɛlɔ tabilɔ.
15Mikpɛ kpekpe miha miheloo he.
Naa mi, mita mlu mli
tamɔ mɔ ni aye enɔ kunim.
16Yaafo ehã mihiɛ etsu fɔɔ,
ni mihiŋmɛii anaa etitii,
ni edi tuŋŋ;
17tsɛbelɛ mikɛ minine yeko awui ko,
ni misɔleɔ mikpaa Nyɔŋmɔ fai kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ.
18Oo shikpɔŋ, kaaha milá lɛ nɔ!
Oo, shikpɔŋ, kaatsimɔ sane fɔŋ
ni aye mi lɛ nɔ;
hã miyaafo ashɛ hei fɛɛ.
19 Naa, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ tete
midasefonyo yɛ ŋwɛi;
mɔ ni baawie ehã mi lɛ
yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo.
20Minanemɛi miiye mihe fɛo;
shi miifo miitsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
21Mina mɔ ko ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ awie
ahã mi,
tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ damɔɔ mli hãa
enaanyo gbɔmɔ lɛ.
22Ejaakɛ biɛ afii fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ,
mibaya he ni
mikuŋ misɛɛ kɛjɛŋ kɛbaŋ dɔŋŋ.

Title: HIOB 17
Content:
1“Misusuma etɔ bahao;
miwala gbii lɛ etã,
gbonyobu miimɛ mi!
2Anɔkwa ji akɛ hefɛoyelɔi ebɔle mi,
ni mihiŋmɛii jwere mlilawoo
nibii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ anɔ.
3Miiye bo anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ, he mi oye!
4Akɛni oŋamɔ amɛjwɛŋmɔi anaa
koni amɛkanu sane shishi hewɔ lɛ,
ohaŋ amɛye minɔ kunim ko.
5Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ enanemɛi asɛɛgbɛ,
bɔ ni afee ni kɛji aja amɛnii lɛ,
ena eko lɛ, ebii ahiŋmɛii tete aaafite.
6Efee mi nɔ ni akɛbuɔ abɛ
ehã maŋbii,
ni mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni afɛ̃ɔ lajɔ̃
ashwieɔ ehiɛ.
7 Awerɛho sɔŋŋ ehã mihiŋmɛi
nɔ efee kusuu,
ni miniji kɛ mi naji efee kanyakanya,
amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ.
8Enɛ hãa mɛi ni feɔ jalɛ nii
ahe jɔ̃ɔ amɛhe;
ni mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ griɔ
ewoɔ mɔ fɔŋ.
9Kɛ̃lɛ jalɔ lɛ fiɔ shi yɛ egbɛ lɛ nɔ,
ni mɔ ni niji ahe tse hewalɛ shwereɔ
kɛyaa naanɔ.
10Shi nyɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ,
nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛbaa;
shi minaŋ nilelɔ ko nilelɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ.
11Migbii lɛ eho etee;
miyiŋtoi, ni ji nɔ ni mitsui shwe
lɛ, fɛɛ efee yaka.
12Amɛkɛ gbɛkɛ feɔ shwane,
ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ,
“La ebɛŋkɛ”.
13Kɛji miŋɔ miwe lɛ akɛ gbohiiaje,
kɛ miŋmɛ misaa lɛ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli,
14ni kɛji mikɛɛ bu lɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛ ji bo”,
ni mikɛɛ gɔgɔmi akɛ, “Minyɛ loo
minyɛmi yoo ji bo lɛ”,
15no lɛ nɛgbɛ mihiɛnɔkãmɔ yɔɔ?
Namɔ baana mihiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ?
16Ani hiɛnɔkãmɔ hu aaaya Gbohiiaje?
Ani wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ baakpleke shi
kɛya su mli lo?”

Title: HIOB 18
Content:
Bildad wie
1Kɛkɛ ni Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ,
here Hiob nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
2“Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ooogbe wiemɔ naa?
Susumɔ he koni wɔwie.
3Mɛɛba obuɔ wɔ tamɔ tsinai?
Mɛɛba wɔtamɔ mɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ
yɛ ohiɛ lɛ?
4Bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛ omlifu yeɔ bo nɔŋŋ
ohe awui.
Aso ootao akɛ ashi je lɛ ahã bo,
aloo ohewɔ lɛ abaafamɔ tɛsai
ashwie?
5Hɛɛ, abaagbe mɔ fɔŋ kane lɛ,
ni ela lɛ etsoŋ dɔŋŋ!
6 Ewe lɛ mli kane egbo,
ni agbe kane ni ye eyiteŋ lɛ.
7Enaji ni efamɔɔ waawaa lɛ
nɔ baagbɔ,
ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋtoi
baatsi lɛ atswa shi.
8Ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyiɛɔ
kɛyaboteɔ yaa mli,
ni yaa lɛ duɔ lɛ.
9Enanetsitsi aaadu jwao,
ni kpãa ni akɛtsɔ tsɔne
aaadu lɛ.
10Akɛ kpãa etee sũ mli eto lɛ,
ni atsɔ̃ lɛ akpa yɛ gbɛteŋ.
11Ehewɔ nibii fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ
ehã ŋmiŋmi emɔ lɛ,
ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ kpaakpa.
12Ehewalɛ baatã,
ni amanehulu efee kralo eto
etɛmɔ kɛ shigbeemɔ.
13Hela baakpãtã ehewolo hiɛ,
gbele kromɔbi lɛ baaye eniji kɛ enaji.
14Aaakpɔ lɛ yɛ shĩa
ni ehiɛ kã nɔ lɛ mli;
ni akɛ lɛ aaatee maŋtsɛ
ni hãa ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
15Mɔkpɔŋ aaayahi ewe lɛ mli
kɛji ashwã mli swɔɔ
kɛgbe emli muawa sɛɛ.
16Eshishifãi lɛ aaagbi yɛ shishigbɛ
ni eniji hu aaaŋala yɛ eyiteŋ.
17Akaiŋ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni atsiŋ egbɛi atã yɛ blohuŋ.
18Ashwie lɛ kɛje la hiɛ kɛtee duŋ mli,
ni ashwie lɛ kɛje jeŋ.
19Ebi loo eshwie bɛ emaŋbii ateŋ,
ni eshwɛko mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ shihilɛhe lɛ mli.
20 Anaigbɛbii ahe aaajɔ̃ amɛhe,
yɛ nɔ ni eba enɔ lɛ hewɔ,
ni ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ bokãgbɛbii hu.
21Anɔkwa, bɔ pɛ ni mɛi ni sheee
Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ashĩai feɔ nɛ;
mɔ ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ
nɛkɛ eshihilɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ.”

Title: HIOB 19
Content:
Hiob wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ akɛ,
2“Mɛɛ beyinɔ nyɛaagba minaa,
ni nyɛkɛ wiemɔ aaasu mitsui
kɛaayashi?
3Shii abɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ,
nyɛmiibɔ mi ahora;
efeee nyɛ hiɛgbele akɛ nyɛmiitɔ̃ minɔ?
4Kɛji eyɛ mli tete akɛ mifee efɔŋ lɛ,
mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ nyɛhe?
5Kɛji nyɛmiiwo nyɛhe nɔ yɛ minɔ,
ni nyɛmiiŋɔ mimanehului lɛ
akɛ minɔ fɔŋ lɛ he okadi lɛ,
6no lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea
akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ebu mi fɔ,
ni ekɛ eyaa lɛ ebɔle mi kɛsa miyi.
7Naa, mibolɔɔ akɛ aawa mi yi,
shi ahereee mi nɔ;
miboɔ koni aye abua mi,
shi ayeee mi jalɛ sane.
8 Etswa gbogbo ekɛsa minaa,
ni no hewɔ lɛ, minyɛɛɛ maho;
ni ehã migbɛ lɛ nɔ ewo duŋ.
9Ekpakpla mininamɔ fɛɛ yɛ mihe,
ni efo minunyam fɛɛ sɛɛ.
10Ekpãtã mihiɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he,
ni egbe naa ehã mi;
ni efo mihiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efɔ̃ shi
tamɔ atoɔ tso.
11Nyɔŋmɔ mli ewo la ewo mi,
ni ebuɔ mi akɛ ehenyɛlɔ.
12Etabilɔi lɛ ba kutuu,
amɛfo sa amɛwo mihe,
ni amɛbɔle miwe lɛ kɛkpe.
13Nyɔŋmɔ ehã minyɛmimɛi ekwa mi,
ni mɛi ni le mi etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe
mɛi kpɔji amɛhã mi.
14Miwekumɛi egbala amɛhe shi,
mishieŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ ekpa minɔ;
15mishĩa mli gbɔi ahiɛ ekpa minɔ,
mitsuji yei buɔ mi akɛ gbɔ,
mitsɔ̃ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ.
16Kɛji mitsɛ mitsulɔ lɛ, efooo midaaŋ;
kɛji mikpa lɛ fai tete, nakai nɔŋŋ.
17Midaaŋ lamɔ eje fu ewo miŋa,
minyɛ musuŋbii tete nyɛɛɛ
mihe fu naa amɛdamɔ.
18Mihe guɔ egbo yɛ gbekɛbii
tete ahiɛ,
ni amɛshwieɔ shi kɛ ŋmɔlɔ
kɛji amɛna mi.
19Mishieŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ miinyaŋe mi,
ni mɛi ni misumɔɔ
etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhiɛ amɛwo mi.
20 Miwui ekpɛtɛ mihewolo,
ni dromɔ naa kɛkɛ ni miyɔɔ
wala mli nɛɛ.
21 Oo, minanemɛi, nyɛnaa mi mɔbɔ!
Nyɛnaa mi mɔbɔ,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nine eta mihe!
22 Mɛɛba nyɛwaa mi yi
tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee mi lɛ?
23Oo, mina ni kulɛ aŋmã
minaa wiemɔi lɛ!
Oo, mina ni kulɛ aŋmã awo wolo mli!
24Mina ni kulɛ akɛ pɛi kpɛ
wiemɔ lɛ,
ni akɛ sumui wo mli
yɛ tɛsaa nɔ,
koni ehi shi kɛya naanɔ.
25 Ejaakɛ mile akɛ,
mikpɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ kã,
ni naagbee mli lɛ
eeedamɔ misɛɛ;
26 ni kɛji mihewolo hiɛ kpãtã
nɛkɛ sɛɛ,
ni heloo bɛ mihe lɛ, mana Nyɔŋmɔ.
27 Lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ mana, ni mayoo lɛ;
ejeee mɔkpɔŋ ko.
Mitsui miitse yɛ mimli!
28Kɛji nyɛmiikɛɛ akɛ,
“Bɔ ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ wɔwa lɛ yi!”
Kɛ “Sane tso muu fɛɛ lɛ jɛ lɛ” lɛ,
29nyɛshea klante gbeyei,
klante lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu
kɛ kojomɔ kɛbaa lɛ,
koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ
kojomɔ ko yɛ.”

Title: HIOB 20
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Zofa, Naamanyo lɛ, here Hiob nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
2“Miyiŋ kɛ mi ewie,
ni mihe miitswa shi ni mahã bo hetoo.
3Minu jɛmɔi ni ojɛ mi lɛ,
ni mile hetoo ni mahã bo.
4Aso oleee kɛjɛ teteete,
kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni abɔ gbɔmɔ
adesa ato shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ,
5akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anyamɔ sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ,
ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei
amiishɛɛ yeɔ hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ!
6 Egbojee aaakwɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi,
ni eyitso tete aaashɛ atatuiaŋ;
7 kɛ̃lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã kɛya naanɔ
tamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ.
Mɛi ni ena amɛ pɛŋ lɛ aaabi akɛ,
‘Nɛgbɛ amɛtee?’
8Ebaalaaje tamɔ lamɔ,
ni anaŋ lɛ;
ebaalaaje tamɔ nyɔɔŋ ninaa.
9 Mɛi ni ena lɛ lɛ, enaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ,
ni eshihilɛhe lɛ enaŋ
lɛ dɔŋŋ.
10 Ekɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ eniji baadãi
enii ni ena kɛjɛ ohiafoi adɛŋ
lɛ ehã amɛ.
Ebii baatao koni ohiafoi ana
amɛhe tsuijurɔ.
11Egbɔmɔtso yɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ kɛ
oblahiiaŋ hewalɛ nɛ,
shi fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ sũ.
12Yɛ mli akɛ nɔfɔŋfeemɔ ŋɔɔ enaa,
ni ekɛteɔ yɛ elilɛi shishi,
13ni emiii akɛ eŋmɛɔ he,
shi etsiɔ̃ naa yɛ edaaŋ;
14kɛ̃lɛ eniyenii lɛ tsakeɔ
yɛ emusuŋ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ
tamɔ shinɔi adrɔ yɛ emli.
15Emimiɔ mɛi ajwetrii
shi eshweɔ fɛɛ ekoŋŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ fɛɛ kɛjɛɔ emusuŋ.
16Eeeshwɔ shinɔi anaa ebɔɔ,
ni no aaagbe lɛ
tamɔ nɔ ni blikã ekɔ̃ lɛ.
17Ehiŋmɛi enaŋ fai lɛ ekwɛ,
fai ni hoɔ
ni eyi kɛ wo kɛ fufɔ lɛ.
18 Eeedãi nibii ni egbo he deŋme
fɛɛ ehã,
ni enaŋ hegbɛ eye eninenaa nitsumɔ
mli ŋɔɔmɔ,
19ejaakɛ ewa ohiafoi ayi, ni ekwa amɛ,
ni shĩa ni jeee lɛ ema lɛ,
eshɔ̃ɔ ekãa naa.
20Akɛni fufeemɔ leee mitɔ hewɔ lɛ,
eyeee nii ni ŋɔɔ enaa ni eshwɛ eko.
