21Kɛji eye nii lɛ eshwɛɛɛ eko,
no hewɔ lɛ, eninamɔ sɛɛ etsɛŋ.
22Enii ni ena babaoo lɛ mli po,
eeefĩ lɛ,
ni hejaramɔ ni baaba enɔ lɛ
naa baawa pam.
23Nyɔŋmɔ baahã emlifu ni naa wa
lɛ anina lɛ, ni ebaanɛ eshwie enɔ,
ni ebaatsɔ̃ eniyenii ni aaayi emusu obɔ̃.
24Ebaajo dade tawuunii anaa foi;
shi akɔɔble gãi aaagbu emli kɛho.
25 Abaagbala gãi lɛ, ni ebaaje kpo
yɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli;
gãi lɛ naa kaŋkaŋ lɛ fãa kɛjɛɔ
edɔrɔ mli;
ni gbele ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ.
26 Ejwetri ni ena fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã;
la ni mɔ ko mɔ ko huuu
baashã enii ni eshwɛ yɛ eshĩa mli fɛɛ.
27Ŋwɛi aaajie enifɔɔji anii kpo etsɔ̃ɔ,
ni je lɛ aaate shi awo lɛ.
28Enii ni ena fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã,
yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
29Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto ehã gbɔmɔ
fɔŋ nɛ,
gboshinii ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ hã lɛ nɛ.”

Title: HIOB 21
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob hã hetoo ekɛɛ:
2“Nyɛboa nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ toi jogbaŋŋ,
ni no afee nɔ ni nyɛkɛaashɛje mimii.
3Nyɛnaa tsui nyɛhãa mi, ni mi hu mawie;
ni kɛji miwie migbe naa lɛ,
koni nyɛye mihe fɛo.
4Ani gbɔmɔ mikɛna lɛ?
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mato tsui shi?
5Nyɛkwɛa mi, ni nyɛhe aaajɔ̃ nyɛhe;
ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnine aaato nyɛnaabu.
6Kɛji mijwɛŋ he lɛ, miwerɛ hoɔ,
ni ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi.
7 Mɛni hewɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ayi naa wala,
amɛgbɔlɔɔ, ni amɛjeɔ agbo
kɛ hewalɛ?
8Amɛnaa amɛbii ashweremɔ,
ni amɛnabii daraa yɛ amɛhiɛ.
9Asheee gbeyei yɛ amɛshĩai amli,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ edɔɔɔ kpãa etooo amɛnɔ.
10Amɛtsina hii lɛ kwɔɔ; ni efeee yaka,
ni amɛtsina yei lɛ sharakeee.
11Amɛhãa amɛbii jeɔ kpo, ni
amɛtumɔɔ kɛ shwɛmɔ tamɔ toobii.
12Amɛlaa kɛnyiɛɔ milɛ̃ kɛ saŋku sɛɛ;
ni amɛnyaa kɛji blɛ gbɛɛ.
13Amɛyeɔ ejurɔ yɛ amɛwala mli,
ni amɛyaa gbohiiaje kpoo kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
14 Yiwalɔi kɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Jee wɔnɔ!
Wɔtaooo wɔle bɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ
aba jeŋ ahã.
15Namɔ ji Ofe lɛ, ni esa akɛ
wɔsɔmɔ lɛ lɛ?
Ni mɛni sɛɛ wɔɔna kɛji
wɔsɔle wɔkpa lɛ fai?”
16 Naa, amɛshweremɔ lɛ aso
jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ mli eyɔɔ?
Shi yiwalɔi asusumɔ nɛɛ lɛ,
mi lɛ miŋɔɔɔ nɔ.
17 Shii enyiɛ agbe mɛi fɔ̃ji akane lɛ,
ni amanehulu eba amɛnɔ,
aloo Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛpiŋ
yɛ emlifu naa
18 ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi
yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa,
loo tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa?
19 Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ etĩa amɛnifɔɔjianii
lɛ anaa eto ehã amɛbii.
Dabida! Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala
efɔŋfeelɔ toi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ
enɔ fɔŋ lɛ hewɔ,
koni amɛna amɛle nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛfee lɛ.’
20Hã ena lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛkpãtãmɔ
kɛ ehiŋmɛii
ni esa enaa Ofe lɛ mlifu lɛ eko.
21Ejaakɛ mɛɛ ŋkɔmɔ eyeɔ
yɛ ebii ni eshi he,
kɛji egbii asɛɛ efo yɛ jeŋ?
22 Aso mɔ ko aaanyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee etsɔ̃ɔ,
lɛ mɔ ni ekojoɔ ŋwɛibii tete po lɛ?
23Mɔ ko gboɔ ni eyɛ hewalɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ
be mli ni eyɔɔ hejɔlɛ,
ni etoiŋ hu ejɔ lɛ,
24ni egbɔmɔtso eshwi
ni ewui amli eyi
obɔ̃ kɛ fɔ tsɔtsɔɔ tsɔ lɛ.
25Mɔ ko hu gboɔ yɛ awerɛhoo mli,
ni eyeko ŋɔɔmɔ ko kwraa dã.
26 Amɛ fɛɛ amɛyajwereɔ su mli,
ni gɔgɔmii haa amɛhe.
27Naa, mile nyɛjwɛŋmɔi
kɛ ŋaa ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ kɛgba minaa fɛɛ.
28Ejaakɛ nyɛbiɔ akɛ,
‘Nɛgbɛ lumɔ lɛ we lɛ yɔɔ agbɛnɛ,
gbɔmɔ ni ji yiwalɔ lɛ?’
29Nyɛbiko gbɛfalɔi lɛ anii,
ni odase ni amɛyeɔ lɛ nyɛŋɔɔɔ nɔ,
30akɛ abaa yiwalɔ yi
yɛ amanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ;
ni mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ahereɔ
eyiwala?
31Namɔ kãa yiwalɔ hiɛ,
ni namɔ woɔ lɛ nɔ ni
efee he nyɔmɔ?
32Kɛji atere lɛ ni ayaafu lɛ,
abuɔ esaŋ lɛ he tete.
33Nakai mɛi fɛɛ aaanyiɛ esɛɛ;
ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee
ayifa babaoo.
34Mɛɛba mɔ nyɛaasumɔ akɛ
nyɛkɛ yaka wiemɔi ashɛje mimii lɛ?
Nyɛwiemɔi lɛ amale sɔŋŋ ni.”

Title: HIOB 22
Content:
Sanegbaa ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ
(22.1—27.23)
Elifaz wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, here Hiob nɔ ekɛɛ,
2“Aso adesa ko he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ
hã Nyɔŋmɔ?
Anɔkwa, nilelɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ
ehe sɛɛ enaa.
3 Ani eji miishɛɛ sane hã Ofe lɛ
kɛji ofeɔ nii ni ja?
Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ naa he sɛɛ
kɛji ohi shi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ohe?
4Ani gbeyei ni osheɔ lɛ hewɔ
ni Nyɔŋmɔ kãa ohiɛ,
ni ekojoɔ bo nɛɛ?
5Ani jeee oyiwalɛ nifeemɔi ni naa wa
kɛ onifɔɔjianii ni aleee naa lɛ
hewɔ ekɛ bo yeɔ nɛɛ?
6 Ejaakɛ onyɛ onyɛmimɛi anɔ,
ni amɛto bo awaba yakatswaa;
ni oshɔ̃ amɛheboi oŋmɛ amɛyayai.
7Mɔ ni etɔ lɛ lɛ,
ohãaa lɛ nu ni enu;
ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ hu
okamaa lɛ niyenii.
8Mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ,
lɛ eŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ,
ni mɔ ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ,
lɛ ehiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
9 Yei okulafoi lɛ, ashwieɔ amɛ,
amɛyaa kɛ amɛdɛ̃ folo.
10No hewɔ lɛ, tsɔnei ebɔle bo kɛkpe,
ni ŋmiŋmi emɔ bo trukaa,
11duŋ ewo bo, ni no hewɔ lɛ,
onaaa nii,
ni nu afua eha onɔ.
12Aso Nyɔŋmɔ bɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ?
Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni ŋulamii lɛ
ekomɛi yɔɔ shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ hã.
13No hewɔ lɛ, okɛɔ akɛ,
‘Mɛni ji nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ le?
Ani eeenyɛ etsɔ̃ duŋ kpii
lɛ mli ekojo lo?’
14Osusuɔ akɛ atatui kabitii etsimɔ enɔ,
ni no hewɔ lɛ, enaaa nii,
ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ
husu lɛ naa esharaa shi yɛ?
15Ani obaaba blema jeŋba gbonyo
ni yiwalɔi lɛ ba lɛ eko?
16 Mɛi ni ashara amɛ kɛtee dani
eshɛ amɛbe,
ni afɔ amɛshishitoo ashwie kɛ nu?
17 Amɛkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ,
‘Jee wɔnɔ!’
Ni ‘Mɛni Ofe lɛ baanyɛ wɔ efee?’
18 Tsɛbelɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni
hã amɛshĩai shwere kɛ nii.
Minuuu mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ashishi!
19 Mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii naa,
ni efeɔ amɛ miishɛɛ;
mɛi ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ
yeɔ amɛhe fɛo.
20Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwa, akpãtã
wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ,
ni nii ni amɛshi hu
la ekpãtã hiɛ.’
21Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpãtã,
koni otoiŋ ajɔ bo;
no nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ni oooye ejurɔ.
22No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ enaa wiemɔi lɛ amli,
ni okɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ato otsuiŋ.
23 Kpalemɔ kɛya Ofe lɛ ŋɔɔ,
ni oba ohe shi.
Kpa nibii ni ejaaa feemɔ lɛ
yɛ owe lɛ mli.
24 Kɛ okɛ oshika yawo mlu mli,
ni okɛ Ofir shika yawo
faa ni hoɔ shishi tɛi amli,
25ni oŋɔ Ofe lɛ ofee oshika,
kɛ ojwiɛtɛi ni jara wa lɛ,
26 no dani omli aaafli bo
yɛ Ofe lɛ hiɛ,
ni ooowo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ!
27 Sɔlemɔ okpa lɛ fai
ni eeebo bo toi;
ni oooye oshiwoi lɛ anɔ.
28Nɔ ni oooto oyiŋ akɛ ooofee lɛ
eeeye omanye ehã bo,
ni la aaakpɛ ahã bo yɛ ogbɛ nɔ!
29 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baa mɔ ni
woɔ ehe nɔ shi,
ni heshibalɔ lɛ, ehereɔ
eyiwala.
30 Ehereɔ mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko yiwala.
Eeehere oyiwala kɛji ofeko esha.”

Title: HIOB 23
Content:
Hiob wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ akɛ,
2“Ŋmɛnɛ hu mikɔmɔyeli lɛ naa wa;
minyɛɛɛ mitsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ naa mamɔ.
3Oo, mile he ni mana lɛ yɛ kulɛ
maya esɛi lɛ hiɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
4Mikɛ misane lɛ baafɔ̃ ehiɛ,
ni mibakɔlɔ misane lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
5Mana male nɔ hetoo ni eeehã mi
ni mana manu nɔ ni eeekɛɛ mi lɛ shishi.
6Aso Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi aaatao naa
yɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa?
Dabida; eeebo mi toi kɛ̃.
7Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaayiyi yɛ jɛi;
ni mikojolɔ lɛ aaabu mi bem
ni maye mihe kɛaatee naanɔ.
8Naa, kɛji mitee bokãgbɛ lɛ, ebɛ jɛi,
ni miba anaigbɛ hu, minaaa lɛ.
9Mitao lɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ,
shi minaaa lɛ;
mitsɔ̃ mihe kɛtee wuoyigbɛ hu,
shi mihiŋmɛi gbaaa enɔ.
10 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ le minanefaamɔi fɛɛ;
kɛji eka mi ekwɛ lɛ
ebaana mi akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi.
11Minyiɛ enanefãamɔ sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ;
no mli minyiɛ; migbako afã.
12Mitswako Nyɔŋmɔ naa wiemɔ ko
mifɔ̃ko afã dã;
mikɛto mitsui shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
13Etsakeee; ni
Lɛ lɛ eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛ sa,
ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa eku.
Nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.
14Nɔ ni eto ehã mi lɛ,
ebaafee kɛgbe naa;
ni nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi
pii yɛ eyiŋ.
15No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi
yɛ ehiɛ;
kɛji mishwie miyiŋ lɛ,
misheɔ lɛ gbeyei.
16Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mitsui efã;
Ofe lɛ ewo mihe gbeyei,
17ejaakɛ duŋ ebɔle mi kɛkpe
ni duŋ kabitii ha mihiɛ.

Title: HIOB 24
Content:
Hiob wiemɔ
1“Mɛɛba Ofe lɛ etooo be pɔtɛ̃ɛ
ni ekojoɔ,
ni mɛɛba mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ
tete leee ekojomɔ bei lɛ?
2 Mɛi tsirɛɔ husui kɛyaa sɛɛ,
amɛshɔ̃ɔ mɛi akooloi
ni amɛkɛshiɔ amɛkooloi anɔ
amɛlɛɔ.
3Amɛshɔ̃ɔ awusãi atejii yɛ amɛdɛŋ
kɛyaa;
amɛhãa okulafo kɛ etsina
toɔ amɛ awaba.
4Amɛtsirɛɔ ohiafoi kɛjeɔ gbɛteŋ,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shitswialɔi fɛɛ
teeteɔ amɛhe.
5No hewɔ lɛ, naa, ohiafoi lɛ
nyiɛ ŋa nɔ ni amɛmiitao
niyenii tamɔ ŋaŋ teji
amɛhã amɛbii koni amɛye.
6Ŋa nɔ amɛfolɔɔ kooloi aniyenii yɛ;
ni yiwalɔi awaintromi amli
amɛyeɔ kpɛkpɛo yɛ.
7Amɛkamɔɔ shi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ
kɛ amɛhe yayai,
ni fɛ̃i be hu amɛbɛ
hehaanɔ.
8Gɔji lɛ anɔ nyɔŋmɔ eyi amɛ,
ni amɛhɔlɔ tɛkploi amli,
ejaakɛ amɛbɛ abobaahe
yɛ he ko he ko.
9Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi tseɔ
abifao ni kã fufɔ naa awusã;
ni amɛbiɔ, ni ohiafo kɛ ebi abifao
tete batoɔ amɛ awaba.
10Ohiafoi nyiɛ yayai
ni mama bɛ amɛhe;
ni amɛtereɔ jatsu kɛ hɔmɔ.
11 Amɛfeɔ mu yɛ yiwalɔi amutsei ateŋ;
amɛŋaa wain kɛ wain tsɔnei nɛ,
shi kumai yeɔ amɛ.
12Aanu mɛi ni miigboi akɛ̃ɛmɔ
kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli,
ni pilafoi miibolɔ kɛmiitsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ;
kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ booo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.
13Mɛi yɛ ni amɛkwa la lɛ,
amɛnuuu egbɛjianɔtoo shishi,
ni amɛhiii shi yɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ hu.
14Gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ teɔ shi leebi mra
ni eyaa eyagbeɔ ohiafo kɛ shitswialɔ,
ni kɛji je na hu lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ julɔ.
15Ni gbãlãfitelɔ hu mɛ̃ɔ hiɛbulɛ
ni ekɛ nɔhaanɔ haa ehiɛ
ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ko yooŋ mi.”
16Amɛjwaraa shĩai yɛ duŋ mli nyɔɔŋ;
ni shwaneshwane lɛ
amɛŋmɛɔ amɛyi amɛwoɔ tsuŋ;
ni amɛkɛ hulu la lɛ bɛ sane ko.
17Ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ duŋ kpii lɛ
ji amɛleebi;
ejaakɛ duŋ kpii mli gbeyei nibii
lɛ ji amɛnanemɛi.
[Zofa]
18 Yiwalɔ lɛ, faa shaa lɛ kɛyaa shwiaa,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ lomɔɔ eshikpɔŋ ni eshi lɛ;
eyaaa ewaintrom lɛ mli gbɛ dɔŋŋ
eyaŋaaa wain.
19Jeŋ gbimɔ kɛ dɔlɛ hereŋŋ hãa snoo nu miiɔ,
nakai gbohiiaje hu loɔ eshafeelɔi kɛyaa.
20Hiɛkpaa amɛ nɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ,
akaiii amɛgbɛii tete dɔŋŋ;
ni no hewɔ lɛ, akuɔ yiwalɛ mli
tamɔ tso.
21Amɛyeɔ yoo kene ni bɛ bi dɛŋ nii,
ni amɛfeee yoo okulafo ejurɔ ko kwraa.
22Kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ehewalɛ nɔ
ehãa hewalɔi awala sɛɛ tsɛɔ;
amɛteɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ, kɛji
jeŋshihilɛ je amɛtsine.
23Nyɔŋmɔ hãa amɛhiɔ shi shweshweeshwe,
ni amɛkɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ no nɔ,
shi ehiŋmɛi kã amɛjeŋba he daa.
24Awoɔ amɛ nɔ be kukuoo ko,
kɛkɛ lɛ amɛlaaje;
amɛgbiɔ tamɔ jwɛi, ni afolɔɔ
amɛ ashwieɔ tamɔ akuɔ abele.
25Kɛji jeee nakai ji sane lɛ,
namɔ baanyɛ ekɛɛ akɛ
amalelɔ ji mi,
asaŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miwiemɔi lɛ
ekome nɛkɛ bɛ mli?”

Title: HIOB 25
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
2“Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ,
mɛi fɛɛ ashe lɛ gbeyei;
ehã toiŋjɔlɛ ehe shi yɛ eŋwɛi
maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
3Ani aaanyɛ etabilɔi ayibɔ akane?
Namɔ kwraa nɔ ela lɛ etsooo yɛ?
4Te aaafee tɛŋŋ hu ni adesa
aaaja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ hu?
Te aaafe tɛŋŋ ni gbɔmɔ
ni jɛ yoo musuŋ lɛ he aaatse hu?
5Naa, yɛ ehiɛ lɛ
nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛɛɛ,
ni ŋulamii lɛ hu ahe tseee;
6mbasroo adesa ni ji omlɛgɛ,
adesa fɔmɔbi ni ji gɔgɔmi nɛɛ?”

Title: HIOB 26
Content:
Hiob wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
2“Ei, bɔ ni oyeɔ obuaa
mɔ ni bɛ hewalɛ nɛ?
Ei, bɔ ni ohereɔ mɔ ni
egbɔjɔ lɛ yiwala nɛ?
3Kwɛ, bɔ ni owoɔ mɔ ni
bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ŋaa
ni ojieɔ nilee babaoo kpo
otsɔ̃ɔ nɛ?
4Namɔ wa bo kɛwie lɛ,
ni namɔ mumɔ jɛ omli je kpo nɛɛ?
[Bildad]
5Gbohii asusumai lɛ miikpokpo,
ni fai lɛ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ miikpokpo.
6 Gbohiiaje kã shi kpetekplee
yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko ehaaa nɔ
yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
7Elɛɛ kooyigbɛ ŋwɛi lɛ mli
eha shi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli,
ni eŋɔ je lɛ etsotsoro shi
ni etsotsorooo nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ.
8 Nyɔŋmɔ tiaa nu naa yɛ atatu
mli,
kɛ̃lɛ nu lɛ tsiimɔ fɛɛɛ atatu lɛ.
9Ehãa atatu lɛɔ shi,
ni ehaa nyɔɔŋtsere hiɛ fɛɛ.
10 Efo akrabatsa yɛ ŋshɔ sɛɛ
ni no etsɔ̃ husu ni kã
la kɛ duŋ lɛ teŋ.
11Akulashiŋi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi lɛ
ahe kpokpoɔ,
ni amɛhe jɔ̃ɔ amɛhe
kɛji ekã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
12Ejɔɔ ŋshɔ he yɛ ehewalɛ naa,
ni ekɛ enilee kpãtãa sasabonsam lɛ hiɛ.
13 Emumɔ ji nɔ ni hãa ŋwɛi tseɔ,
ni ekɛ enine kpãtãa onufu
ni miijo foi ni eya lɛ hiɛ.
14Naa, ehewalɛ lɛ he okadii
nyɔkɔsiɔ̃ɔi komɛi kɛkɛ nɛ;
ni ewiemɔ ablɛbi fioo kɛkɛ
wɔnuɔ lɛ.
Shi namɔ aaanyɛ ele
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛwula shi.”

Title: HIOB 27
Content:
Hiob wie ekoŋŋ
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob wo ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ,
2“Mina Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ,
mɔ ni tswa misane lɛ efɔ̃ lɛ,
kɛ Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni hã
miwerɛ ho mihe lɛ, akɛ,
3gbii abɔ ni wala yɔɔ mimli,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ hãa mimuɔ nɛɛ,
4 amale ejeŋ minaa,
ni mililɛi lakaŋ mɔ ko.
5Enɛ akagbale mi akɛ mabu
nyɛ bem;
kɛyaashi magbo lɛ, miŋmɛŋ
mibemyeli lɛ he.
6 Mihiɛ mijalɛ lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ,
ni miŋmɛŋ he;
mihenilee ebuuu mi fɔ
yɛ miwalaŋ
gbii lɛ eko kwraa ahe.
7Hã mihenyɛlɔ atsɔ̃ tamɔ yiwalɔ,
ni hã mɔ ni teɔ shi ewoɔ mi lɛ
atsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ fɔŋ.
8 Ejaakɛ mɛni ji mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ
gbeyei lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ,
be ni Nyɔŋmɔ efo ewala sɛɛ,
ni eshɔ̃ ewala yɛ edɛŋ lɛ?
9Kɛji fimɔ ba enɔ lɛ, ani
Nyɔŋmɔ aaabo ebolɔmɔ toi?
10Ani emii shɛɔ yɛ Ofe lɛ hewɔ,
aloo esɔleɔ ebiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ
be fɛɛ be?
11Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ tsuɔ;
mikɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ Ofe lɛ he eteŋ nyɛ.
12Naa, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛna;
mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni nyɛwieee
wiemɔi ni ahe yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ?
13Nɔ ni mɔfɔŋ naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
dɛŋ nɛ;
nɔ ni Ofe lɛ yɔɔ hã yiwalɔ nɛ.
14 Kɛji ebii ayi fa babaoo lɛ,
klante amɛyi fa amɛhã,
ni eshwiei lɛ aboloo shɛŋ amɛnaa.
15Bii ni eshiɔ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ,
gbele hela gbeɔ amɛ;
ni amɛkulafoi lɛ foŋ amɛ tete.
16Yiwalɔ buaa jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu,
ni eeebua atadei anaa eto tamɔ mɛ;
17 eeebua naa nɛ, shi mɔ ni baawo ji jalɔ,
ni mɔ ni fɔbuu bɛ ehe
ji mɔ ni baaja ejwiɛtɛi lɛ.
18Shĩa ni emaa lɛ etamɔ
anaanu ntaŋ, loo
asese ni bulɔ efee.
19Eyakãa shi akɛ niiatsɛ,
shi ebaŋ lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ;
be ni eeegbele ehiŋmɛi lɛ
enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ.
20Ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ tamɔ faa
ni eje ŋa loɔ nibii;
ahum woɔ lɛ kɛyaa nyɔɔŋ.
21Bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ woɔ lɛ kɛyaa,
ebɛɔ lɛ kɛjeɔ eshĩaŋ kɛyaa.
22Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa enɔ
ni enaaa lɛ mɔbɔ,
be ni etaoɔ foi ejo kɛjɛ edɛŋ lɛ.
23Nyɔŋmɔ tswaa edɛŋ eshwieɔ enɔ,
ni eboɔ lɛ ‘tsiaa!’ kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ mli.

Title: HIOB 28
Content:
Nilee kafomɔ
1“Anɔkwa, bui yɛ ni atsaa
jwiɛtɛi yɛ mli,
ni hei yɛ ni anaa shika
ni asereɔ yɛ.
2Atsaa dade yɛ shikpɔŋ
ni asereɔ akɔɔble kɛjɛɔ tɛ mli.
3Mɛi sheee duŋ gbeyei, ni amɛboteɔ duŋ
mli amɛyataoɔ tɛi ni yɔɔ
duŋ kabitii lɛ mli kɛyaa
duŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
4Mɛi yatsaa shika bui
yɛ hei ni gbɔmɔ bɛ.
Gbɛfalɔi ahiɛ kpaa amɛnɔ;
amɛtsotsoroɔ kpãa naa
kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ shika bui
lɛ amli.
5Shikpɔŋ mli niyenii jɛɔ;
shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ shishi lɛ,
efee tamɔ nɔ ni
la eshã.
6Emli tɛi amli anaa safiro yɛ,
ni shika futru hu yɛ mli.
7Okropɔŋ leee jɛigbɛ lɛ,
akroma ko hiŋmɛi enako jɛi dã.
8Kooloi kakawuai lɛ eko kwraa
nane yiko gbɛ lɛ nɔ dã,
ni jata tsɔ̃ko enɔ kɛhoko dã.
9Gbɔmɔ kɛ enine tsaa tswɛrɛbo tɛ,
ni etsaa gɔji ashishi ekɛwuleɔ
amɛ eshwieɔ shi.
10Be mli ni ekpɛɔ gbɛ
kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tɛsai amli lɛ,
ehiŋmɛi naa ojarawatɛi fɛɛ.
11Etsĩɔ fai anaa koni
amɛkanyɛ amɛho,
ni nii ni akɛtee shishi lɛ,
ejieɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ.
12Shi nɛgbɛ abaana nilee yɛ?
Ni nɛgbɛ ji he ni niiashishinumɔ yɔɔ?
13Gbɔmɔ leee ejarawalɛ;
ni anaaa lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi
ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
14Ŋshɔŋ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ mimli!’
Ni ŋshɔ hu kɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ miŋɔɔ!’
15 Atseee shika aheee,
ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi ni baashɛ enyɔmɔwo.
16 Ofir shika shɛɛɛ ejara;
nakai nɔŋŋ ji ojarawatɛ onike loo safiro.
17Shika kɛ ashwishwɛ kɛ lɛ yeee hegbɔ;
ni akɛtsakeŋ shika jwinei kpakpai diɛŋtsɛ.
18Atsiŋ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o kɛ kɔli tã yɛ he ni eyɔɔ;
nilee jara wa fe adiagba.
19 Etiopia ojarawatɛ topasiɔn kɛ lɛ yeee hegbɔ,
ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni baashɛ ejara.
20Belɛ nɛgbɛ nilee jɛɔ mɔ,
ni nɛgbɛ ji he ni niiashishinumɔ yɔɔ?
21Aŋɔ tee, ni hiɛkãalɔ ko hiŋmɛi enaŋ;
akɛtee loofɔji ni filikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi tete.
22Gbele kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛɛ,
‘He kɛkɛ wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi ni aawie.’
23 Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ni le gbɛ ni kã kɛyaa he;
ni lɛ ele he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.
24Ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, enaa jeŋ naagbee hei bluublu,
ni enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi.
25 Be ni eŋmɛ kɔɔyɔɔ hewalɛ ehã lɛ,
ni esusu ŋshɔi kɛ fai afalɛ,
26be ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni nu anɛ ahã,
kɛ bɔ ni srawa agba kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi ahã lɛ;
27no mli Nyɔŋmɔ na nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ji nilee;
ni eka etɛ naa ekwɛ ni eŋɔ nɔ.
28 Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ adesã akɛ,
‘Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, no ji nilee,
ni hewii kɛ efɔŋ hejee ji jwɛŋmɔ.’ ”

Title: HIOB 29
Content:
Hiob naagbee naajiemɔ
1Hiob bɔ̃i wiemɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ,
2“Oo, mina ni kulɛ mitsɔ̃ tamɔ
bɔ ni miyɔɔ be ko ni eho lɛ,
be mli ni Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ mihe lɛ,
3 be ni ela lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ miyiteŋgbɛ
ni minaa nii yɛ duŋ mli lɛ.
4 No be mli lɛ, minibii shwere,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanyobɔɔ bu miwe lɛ he.
5Ofe lɛ kɛ mi yɛ,
ni mimusuŋbii hu bɔle mihe kɛkpe.
6Mitsinai kɛ mitoi hãa mi fufɔ babaoo,
ni mimutsei shwere yɛ tɛsai amli.
7Kɛji mije kpo kɛtee maŋ koi lɛ shi,
ni miyata shi yɛ blohuŋ lɛ,
8oblahii lɛ hãa mi gbɛ kɛji amɛna mi,
ni onukpai lɛ teɔ shi hãa mi,
9lumɛi tete fɔ̃ɔ wiemɔ,
ni amɛkɛ amɛniji toɔ amɛnaabu;
10abladei agbei laajeɔ,
ni amɛlilɛi kpɛtɛɔ amɛdaaŋ.
11Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ mihe lɛ jɔɔ mi,
ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛkafoɔ mi.
12 Ejaakɛ mihereɔ ohiafo ni foɔ
kɛ awusã ni bɛ bualɔ lɛ.
13Mɔ ni hiɛ heɔ akpãtã lɛ jɔɔmɔ baninaa mi,
ni mihãa okulafo tsui nyɔɔ emli kɛ nyamɔ.
14Jalɛ ji mimama ni mibuɔ,
ni mijalɛ saneyeli ji mitade kɛ akekre.
15Mitsɔ̃ hiŋmɛi mihã shwilafo,
ni mitsɔ̃ naji mihã obubuafo.
16Mitsɔ̃ tsɛ mihã ohiafoi
ni mɛi ni mileee amɛ tete
mitao amɛsaji amli mihã amɛ.
17 Mikumɔ mɔfɔŋ lɛ nyanyɔji yɛ edaaŋ,
ni ehã eŋmɛɛ nɔ ni kɔ̃ enaa
ni eyaaye lɛ he efɔ̃ shi.
18Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ mihe akɛ,
“Mishĩa teŋ magbo yɛ
ni migbii baafa tamɔ shia.
19Mitamɔ tso ni efãi etsɛ̃rɛ
kɛtee kɛyanina nu,
ni bɔ nyɔɔ ebai anɔ
nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
20Mɛi ahiɛ sɔɔ mi be fɛɛ be,
ni migãi lɛ hu naa hewalɛ hee yɛ midɛŋ.”
21Mɛi bo mi toi, ni amɛmɛ,
ni amɛfee kpoo kɛmɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ.
22Kɛji miwie sɛɛ lɛ,
mɔ ko ewieee dɔŋŋ;
ni miwiemɔi lɛ boteɔ amɛmli.
23Amɛkwɛɔ miwiemɔ gbɛ
tamɔ okwaafonyo kwɛɔ nunɛmɔ gbɛ.
24Miŋmɔɔ kɛji mina akɛ amɛtsui miiye,
ni mihiɛ ŋmɔlɔ lɛ woɔ amɛ hewalɛ.
25Mi, mito amɛshihilɛ lɛ he gbɛjianɔ,
ni mihi shi mihã amɛ akɛ yitso;
mihi shi yɛ etabilɔi ateŋ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Mihi shi akɛ mɔ ni shɛjeɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi amii.

Title: HIOB 30
Content:
1 Shi agbɛnɛ mɛi ni miye amɛ onukpa miiŋmɔ mi;
mɛi ni mibuŋ amɛtsɛmɛi bɔ ni maŋɔ amɛ mafata
gbei ni buɔ tookui tete ahe lɛ anɔ.
2Mɛɛ sɛɛ mibana yɛ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ ahe?
3Ohia kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa
hãa amɛkpeɔ ŋa gbiŋ nɔ tsei ashishifãi.
4Amɛfamɔɔ shiaŋaŋ tsei,
ni amɛtsɛrɛɔ koowie bai
ni amɛshɛreɔ blɔtsei amɛwereɔ.
5Ashwieɔ amɛ kɛjeɔ gbɔmɛi ateŋ,
ni awɔɔ amɛyi tamɔ awɔɔ julɔ yi.
6Nujɔi ajɔi amli kɛ shikpɔŋ bui
kɛ tɛkploi amli amɛaahi.
7Koowiei ashishi amɛbolɔɔ yɛ;
sɔŋsrɔ shishi amɛbuaa amɛhe naa yɛ.
8Kwashiai yakagbɔmɛi abii;
ayi amɛ, ashwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
9Shi agbɛnɛ, mitsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ kotsa,
ni mitsɔ̃ fɛoyeli wiemɔ mihã amɛ.
10 Amɛnyaŋeɔ mi;
amɛwiɔ amɛhe yɛ mihe,
kɛji amɛna mi lɛ amɛtsɛ̃ɔ lajɔ̃.
11Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã migbɔjɔ
ni eba mi shi hewɔ lɛ,
amɛhiɛ gbooo nɔ ni amɛfeɔ he yɛ mihiɛ.
12Yakagbɔmɛi teɔ shi yɛ mininejurɔ nɔ,
ni amɛshwieɔ mi kɛyaa sɛɛ,
ni amɛkaa mihiɛ kpãtãmɔ tete.
13Amɛtsimɔɔ migbɛ ni matsɔ̃ nɔ lɛ,
ni amɛbɔɔ mihiɛkpãtãmɔ he mɔdɛŋ,
ni mɔ ko ebooo amɛ tswai!
14Amɛkeɔ kɛbaa tamɔ mɛi
ni egbu gbogbo ewo mli
ni amɛbashwieɔ minɔ.
15Adɔ gbeyei nibii ayi kɛba minɔ,
minunyam etã oookɛɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni etswa kɛtee;
kɔɔyɔɔ etswa nii ni mina fɛɛ kɛtee tamɔ atatu.
16 Agbɛnɛ eshɛ migbele be,
ni mikã nɔnaa mli gbii abɔ nɛɛ.
17Duŋ lɛ hãa miwui amli kpeɔ mi,
mipiŋmɔ lɛ ejɔɔɔ.
18 Enaawalɛ lɛ kpitiɔ mitade lɛ:
efiɔ lɛ kɛmɔɔ misɛ̃.
19Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ mi efɔ̃ ŋmɔtɔ mli,
ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu kɛ lamlu.
20 Mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo, shi ohereee mi nɔ;
mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi misɔleɔ;
shi okwɛɛɛ mi po.
21Oowa mi yi;
okɛ ohewalɛ fɛɛ miipiŋ mi.
22Owoɔ mi owoɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli,
ni etswaa mi kɛfoɔ shi;
ni otswiaa mi shi kɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ ahum mli.
23Hɛɛ, mile akɛ okɛ mi baaya ayahã gbele,
ni ji shĩa ni ato ahã hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ lɛ.
24Kɛ̃lɛ aso mɔ ni kã hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli kpãaa enineŋ
yɛ emanehulu lɛ mli ni ebi yelikɛbuamɔ lo?
25Ani mifooo mihãaa mɔ ni yɔɔ haomɔ mli?
Ani misusuma werɛ hooo hãaa ohiafo?
26 Shi be ni mikwɛ nɔ kpakpa gbɛ lɛ,
nɔ fɔŋ moŋ ni ba;
ni be ni mimɛ la lɛ, duŋ moŋ wo mi.
27Mitsui miitswa kɛ hejaramɔ,
ni enyɔɔɔ shi;
amanehulu gbii enina mi.
28Duŋ ewo mi kɛmiiya kɛmiiba;
ni hulu etsooo ehãaa mi kwraa,
mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi yɛ maŋ,
ni mibiɔ yelikɛbuamɔ.
29Mitsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei anyɛmi
kɛ okpɔŋɔloofɔji anaanyo.
30Mihewolo edĩ, ni eekpɔlɔ yɛ mihe eeshwie shi;
ni miwui amli miishã mi.
31 Mikpãa saŋku lɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli,
ni mibɛlɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ yaafolɔi agbee.

Title: HIOB 31
Content:
1 Mikã mihiŋmɛi kitã
ni no hewɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ mahã oblayoo foro he
afee mi akɔnɔ hu?
2Mɛni mana kɛaajɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi nɛɛ dɛŋ?
Ni mɛni aaafee migbɛfaŋ nɔ
ni Ofe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ baahã mi?
3Ani jeee hiɛkpãtãmɔ kã shi
hã mɛi ni feɔ nɔ fɔŋ?
Kɛ osharã hã mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii?
4 Ani Nyɔŋmɔ leee mijeŋba,
ni ekaneee minanefaamɔi?
5Kɛji miba mijeŋ kɛ kutumpɔo,
ni miye oyai mishishiu mɔ ko lɛ,
6no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nsɛni ni ja aŋmɛ mi
koni ena akɛ kpako bɛ mihe.
7 Kɛji migba afã yɛ minyiɛmɔŋ,
ni mitsui eyadi mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ,
ni muji ko kpɛtɛ miniji ahe lɛ,
8no lɛ nii ni madu lɛ,
mɔ kroko aaaye,
ni ŋmɔshinii ni aaakwɛ̃ ahã mi lɛ, afãmɔ ashwie.
9Kɛji minaanyo ŋa he efee mi akɔnɔ pɛŋ,
ni miyawo ka yɛ minaanyo shinaa shi pɛŋ lɛ,
10 no lɛ hã miŋa ahoo nii ahã nuu kroko,
ni mɛi krokomɛi kɛ lɛ ana bɔlɛ.
11Ejaakɛ hiɛgbeji asane kpeteŋkple ni;
eji nɔ fɔŋ ni kojolɔi lɛ baagbala etoi,
12ejaakɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ la ni baashã
nii kɛshɛ abonsamiiaje,
ni ebaashã nii ni miyɔɔ fɛɛ wɛɛ kɛmɔ shi.
13Kɛji miyeee mitsulɔ nuu loo mitsulɔ yoo
jalɛ sane be ni amɛ kɛ mi ena lɛ,
14no lɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ
kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ te shi wo mi lɛ?
Kɛji eba kojomɔ lɛ,
te majie minaa makɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
15 Ani mɔ ni bɔ mi ewo musuŋ lɛ
jeee lɛ nɔŋŋ ebɔ amɛ?
Ani jeee mɔ koome shɔ̃ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ musuŋ?
16 Kɛji mikãma ohiafoi anii ni amɛtaoɔ,
aloo mihã jeŋ fee okulafo awerɛho,
17aloo miye nii mikome pɛ,
ni mihãaa awusãi eko
18tsɛbelɛ mi mihiɛ lɛ akɛ tsɛ kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ,
ni kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe lɛ mi miwa lɛ.
19 Kɛji mina mɔ ko ni efĩ lɛ ni mama bɛ ehe,
loo ohiafo ko ni bɛ nɔ ni ehaa lɛ,
20no lɛ mahã lɛ mama
ni akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoo he tsɔi lo
koni ehe afee kulɔɔ,
kɛkɛ lɛ ebaajie miyi kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ.
21 Kɛji miwo minine nɔ yɛ awusã ko nɔ,
ejaakɛ mile akɛ abaabu mi bem yɛ kojomɔhe lɛ,
22no lɛ mikɔ̃ŋ lɛ akpɔ yɛ mikɔ̃ŋ wu lɛ he,
ni minine hu atse kɛje kɔ̃ŋ wu lɛ he.
23 Ejaakɛ misheɔ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni minyɛŋ Ofe lɛ hiɛ madamɔ.
24Kɛji miŋɔ shika mifee mihiɛnɔkãmɔ,
aloo mitsɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi mihiɛnɔkãmɔ,
25ni minya ejaakɛ minii ni mina fa babaoo,
ni minine eshɛ nii babaoo nɔ
26 kɛji mikwɛ hulu ni eetso,
loo nyɔɔŋtsere bɔ ni ekpɛɔ fɛɛfɛo kɛhoɔ.
27 Kɛji nɔ ko elaka mitsui
ni miwo amɛ yɛ teemɔŋ
ni mishwɔ minine naa
kɛ hiɛsɔlɛ mihã amɛ lɛ,
28no hu nifɔɔjianii ni esa akɛ
kojolɔi lɛ awo he nyɔmɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ kulɛ miyeko Nyɔŋmɔ
ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anɔkwa.
29 Minyako yɛ osharã ni esharã
mihenyɛlɔ hewɔ,
ni mimli efiliko mi
be ni amanehulu eba enɔ.
30 Miŋmɛko minaabu gbɛ ni efee esha,
ni mitaoko egbele kɛ kitãkãmɔ.
31Mishĩaŋbii ekɛŋ akɛ,
‘Wɔteŋ namɔ yeko edɛŋ niyenii
etɔko dã?’
32 Gbɔ ko gbɔ ko etooo blohuŋ;
migbeleɔ mishinaa mihãa gbɔ be fɛɛ be.
33Mitsimɔko mitɔ̃mɔi anɔ
tamɔ Adam,
ni mikɛ minɔsha lɛ etoko mimli.
34Miishe mɛi asafo lɛ gbeyei,
ni bɔ ni wekui baanyaŋe mi hu
woɔ mihe gbeyei,
ni no hewɔ ni mifee diŋŋ,
ni mishiii shĩa mijeee kpo
ejaakɛ miishe amɛ gbeyei.
35 Oo, mina mɔ ko ni aaabo mi toi!
Naa, minine naa okadi!
Ofe lɛ ahã mi hetoo!
Oo, mina ni kulɛ mɔ ni kɛ mi ena lɛ
eŋmala saji ni ekɛshiɔ mi lɛ
ewo wolo hiɛ!
36Anɔkwa, kulɛ makɔ matswa
mikɔŋ,
ni mikɛbaafee akekre mafi miyitso.
37Kulɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nibii fɛɛ
ni mifee,
ni matsi mabɛŋkɛ lɛ tamɔ lumɔ
38kɛji shikpɔŋ ni mihu nɔ bolɔ wo mi
ni enɔ akofii wo yara kutuu;
39 kɛji mikpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yibii miye
ni miwooo nyɔmɔ,
ni no nɔ tsɔ̃ ni nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gboi lɛ,
40no lɛ ŋmei akwɛ̃ yɛ ŋmãa najiaŋ,
ŋmei gbohii akwɛ̃ yɛ abele najiaŋ.”
Hiob wiemɔ lɛ naagbee nɛ.

Title: HIOB 32
Content:
Elihu wiemɔ
1Kɛkɛ ni hii etɛ̃ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Hiob hetoohãmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ Hiob wiemɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko. 2 Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel ni jɛ Ram weku lɛ mli lɛ, mli wo la. Emli wo la ewo Hiob, ejaakɛ Hiob bu ehe jalɔ ni eshwa Nyɔŋmɔ. 3 Emlifu Hiob nanemɛi etɛ̃ lɛ hu, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa hetoo ko amɛhã Hiob, tsɛbelɛ amɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ amɛbua he akɛ Hiob yeɔ fɔ. 4Elihu mɛ be fioo dani ekɛ Hiob wie, ejaakɛ Hiob nanemɛi lɛ ye lɛ onukpa. 5Be ni Elihu na akɛ hii etɛ̃ nɛɛ bɛ nɔ ko dɔŋŋ ni amɛkɛɔ Hiob lɛ, emli wo la.
6Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel bi lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Gbekɛ ji mi yɛ afii amli,
shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛdara;
no hewɔ lɛ, mishe gbeyei
ni mikɛ misusumɔ aŋmɛ
nyɛhiɛ.
7 Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ nyɛ ji mɛi
ni esa akɛ nyɛwie;
nyɛ waŋtsɛmɛi nyɛwieɔ
ni akaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ.
8Shi kɛ̃lɛ mumɔ ni yɔɔ adesa mli,
Ofe lɛ mumɔ ni ekɛmuɔ lɛ,
no hãa enaa jwɛŋmɔ.
9Jeee dalɛ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii,
ni jeee gbɔlɛ hu ni hãa
anuɔ sane shishi.
10No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi
koni mi hu mawie mijwɛŋmɔ.
11Naa, mito mitsui shi mibo
nyɛwiemɔi lɛ atoi,
mimɛ beiaŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ
nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ lɛ.
12Mibo nyɛ toi aahu;
ni naa, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko
ekuuu ewooo Hiob naa;
aloo nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ehã ewiemɔi lɛ ahetoo.
13Nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakɛa akɛ,
‘Wɔle nii. Nyɔŋmɔ ni
aaaku enaa, shi jeee gbɔmɔ.’
14Ewieko eshiko mi,
ni mikɛ nyɛnaa wiemɔi lɛ
haŋ lɛ hetoo.
15Ashi amɛ shi, amɛhãaa
hetoo dɔŋŋ;
amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛɔ dɔŋŋ.
16Ni esa akɛ mimɛɔ
ejaakɛ amɛwieee;
amɛdamɔ shi diŋŋ
ni amɛhãaa wiemɔ ko hetoo dɔŋŋ?
17Mi hu makɛɛ minɔ;
ni mi hu mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.
18Ejaakɛ minyɛɛɛ mamua minaa
dɔŋŋ;
mumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ
mi dɔŋŋ.
19Naa, mitsui etsɔ̃ tamɔ wain
ni atsi naa kpɛŋŋ,
ni ebɛ mumɔhe,
etamɔ wain wolotɔi hei
ni heɔ aflɛ.
20Mawie koni mana hejɔlɛ.
Ja migbele minaa mihã hetoo.
21Mikwɛŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ,
ni midɔkɔŋ minaa mihaŋ mɔ ko.
22Ejaakɛ mileee mɔhɔlɔmɔ;
nakai ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, miBɔlɔ lɛ,
aaafo miwala sɛɛ biɛ be kukuoo mli.”

Title: HIOB 33
Content:
1“Ni agbɛnɛ, Hiob, bo toi,
ni ofee toi ohã miwiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
2Naa, migbele minaa
ni mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.
3Wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mawie lɛ
jɛ mitsui mli krɔŋŋ;
ni mawie nɔ ni mile anɔkwaleŋ.
4Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni bɔ mi,
ni Ofe lɛ mumɔ lɛ hãa
miyi naa wala.
5Kɛji ooonyɛ lɛ, too he ohã mi;
saamɔ ohe; saamɔ nɔ ni obaakɛɛ lɛ oto.
6Naa, mi kɛ bo yeɔ hegbɔ
yɛ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ;
mi hu sũ nɔŋŋ akɛshɔ̃ mi.
7Naa, mihe ŋmiŋmi akawo
ohe gbeyei;
minyɛŋ onɔ.
8Lɛɛlɛŋ, owie owo mitoiiaŋ,
ni minu owiemɔi lɛ.
9Okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mihe tse,
tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe;
miyeɔ bem, ni mifeko esha ko.
10 Naa, eetao sane efo eŋmɛ minɔ;
ebuɔ mi akɛ ehenyɛlɔ.
11 Ebɔ minaji apã,
ejie ehiɛ eka mi.’
12Naa, miikɛɛ bo akɛ,
enɛ mli lɛ osane lɛ ejaaa; ejaakɛ
Nyɔŋmɔ da aahu fe adesa.
13Mɛni hewɔ oshwaa Nyɔŋmɔ
ni okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ehãaa miwiemɔi
lɛ eko kwraa hetoo lɛ.’
14Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wieɔ shii abɔ,
fɛɛ ni adesa ediii sɛɛ.
15 Nyɔɔŋ be ni wɔ ni tsii
enyɔ adesai anɔ
yɛ amɛsai amli lɛ,
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔ kɛ nyɔɔŋ
ninaa nɔ
16 ni egbeleɔ adesai atoiiaŋ
ni ekɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ woɔ amɛhe gbeyei
17 koni ehã adesa akpale
kɛjɛ enifeemɔnii ahe,
ni ehã adesa akpa ehenɔwomɔ lɛ.
18Etsiɔ adesa susuma naa
koni ekayagbee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli;
ebuɔ ewala hu he koni akakpãtã
hiɛ kɛ klante.
19Nyɔŋmɔ gbalaa adesa toi
kɛ saa mli piŋmɔ
kɛ ewuiaŋ kpemɔ,
20ni no hãa edaaŋ gboɔ kɛ niyeli,
ni ekpoɔ niyenii ni kpɔɔ ewɔlɔmɔ tete.
21Etãa loo ni ehiii lɛ kwɛmɔ,
ni egbɔmɔtsoŋ wui ni kulɛ
anaaa lɛ bajwereɔ shi faŋŋ.
22Ebɛŋkɛɔ gbohiiaje, ni ewala
bɛŋkɛɔ gbele bɔfoi lɛ.
23 Kɛji ena bɔfoi akpe
lɛ ateŋ eko damɔ mli hã lɛ,
ni etsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ ni hi hã lɛ,
24ni ena gbɔmɔ mɔbɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
‘Jiemɔ lɛ kɛjɛ gbohiiajeyaa mli,
mina eyinii ni akɛkpɔ̃ lɛ.’
25No lɛ eheloo aaatsɔ̃ efɔ́ tamɔ
gbekɛ nɔ,
ni eeeku sɛɛ etsɔ̃ oblanyo ekoŋŋ.
26Eeekpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, ni eeeduro lɛ;
ni eeeba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ nyamɔ.
Eeegba eyiwalaheremɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi.
27Ni eeela yɛ adesai ahiɛ,
ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mifee esha,
ni mikɔ̃dɔ̃ nɔ ni ja;
ni akɛ mihe fa mi;
28Ehere misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje
ni mihiɛ kã lolo.’
29Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ
shii abɔ ehãa gbɔmɔ,
30 koni ehere eyiwala kɛjɛ gbohiiaje,
koni wala afee enɔ.
31Oo Hiob, ka otoi!
Bo mi toi, feemɔ diŋŋ,
mibawie!
32Kɛji oyɛ nɔ ko ni oookɛɛ lɛ,
kɛɛmɔ mi!
Wiemɔ, shi miitao bo bem mabu.
33Kɛjeee nakai lɛ,
bo moŋ bo mi toi;
feemɔ diŋŋ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee.”

Title: HIOB 34
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Elihu kɛɛ akɛ,
2“Nyɛ nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi,
nyɛboa miwiemɔ toi,
nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa mi,
3 ejaakɛ toi akɛŋmɛɔ wiemɔ akwɛɔ,
tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ lilɛi saa niyenii
anaa akwɛɔ lɛ.
4Nyɛhãa wɔkɔa nɔ ni ja,
nyɛhãa wɔsusua he yɛ wɔteŋ
wɔna nɔ ni hi.
5Ejaakɛ Hiob ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Miyeɔ bem’
shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi yeee yɛ jalɛ naa;
6bem ni miyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
abu mi amalelɔ:
Mifala lɛ bɛ tsabaa,
tsɛbelɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe.
7Namɔ ena mɔ ko tamɔ Hiob,
mɔ ni bɔɔ musu tamɔ anuɔ nu pɛŋ?
8Mɔ ni kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii
bɔɔ naanyo,
ni ekɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji nyiɛɔ?
9Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ
hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
aaabɔ naanyo!’
10No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ,
nyɛboa mi toi.
Enɛ akagbale Nyɔŋmɔ fɔɔŋfɔ akɛ eeefee nɔ fɔŋ,
aloo Ofe lɛ, eeefee nɔ ko ni ejaaa hu.
11 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔmɔ
yɛ enitsumɔ naa,
ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ yeɔ yɛ ejeŋba naa.
12 Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ yeee
toikɔdɔmɔ sane;
ni Ofe lɛ tsɔ̃ɔɔ sane hiɛ ebuuu shi.
13Namɔ ji mɔ ni kɛ je lɛ
nɔkwɛmɔ hã lɛ?
Namɔ kɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ
hã lɛ?
14Kɛji eeeŋɔ emumɔ lɛ yɛ je lɛŋ,
ni eeehã mumɔ lɛ akpale kwraa
kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ,
15 no lɛ heloo fɛɛ heloo hiɛ aaakpãtã;
ni gbɔmɔ aaatsɔ̃ sũ ekoŋŋ.
16Kɛji oyɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ bo toi!
Bo nɔ ni makɛɛ lɛ toi!
17Ani mɔ ni taooo jalɛ saneyeli
baanyɛ mɛi anɔ eye?
Ani ooobu mɔ ni ja
ni eyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ fɔ?
18Ani ooobu mɔ ni kɛɔ maŋtsɛ akɛ ‘Yakagbɔmɔ’
kɛ lumɛi hu akɛ, ‘Yitsoŋwalɔi?’
19Ni ekwɛɛɛ lumɛi ahiɛ
ni ebuuu niiatsɛ fe ohiafo,
ejaakɛ lɛ eninenaa nitsumɔnii
ji amɛ fɛɛ kwa lɛ bem?
20Trukaa gbɔmɔ gboɔ;
ahosoɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ,
ni ehoɔ eyaa;
hewalɔi hoɔ amɛyaa,
ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ adesa nine nɔ.
21 Ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛi jwere
gbɔmɔ adesa jeŋba nɔ,
ni onaa enyiɛmɔhei fɛɛ.
22 Duŋ kabitii bɛ he ko he ko
ni mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii
aaanyɛ atee amɛhe yɛ mli.
23Ejaakɛ etoko be pɔtɛɛ ko
ehãko adesa ko
ni eeeya kojomɔ yɛ lɛ ehiɛ.
24Ekpãtãa hewalɔi ahiɛ
ni etaooo amɛsaji amli,
ni eholeɔ mɛi krokomɛi
etoɔ amɛnajiaŋ.
25Akɛni ele amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ,
ebutuɔ amɛ nyɔɔŋ,
ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.
26Egbalaa mɛi fɔ̃ji atoi
yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.
27Ejaakɛ amɛkpale yɛ esɛɛ,
ni amɛbuuu egbɛi lɛ ekoeko;
28 ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã
ohiafoi ayaafo yashɛ eŋɔɔ;
ni enu mɛi ni efĩ amɛ lɛ abolɔmɔ.
29Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ fee diŋŋ lɛ,
namɔ baanyɛ lɛ ashwa?
Kɛji ekɛ ehiɛ tee lɛ
namɔ baanyɛ ehiɛ lɛ ena?
30Nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ afee
koni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ akaye maŋ nɔ,
ni ekahã maŋbii bote kaa mli.
31Ejaakɛ ani mɔ ko ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
dã akɛ ‘Agbala mitoi. Mifeŋ nɔ ni
ehiii dɔŋŋ;
32tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi nibii ni minaaa;
koni kɛji mifee nɔ ni ehiii lɛ
mikafee nakai dɔŋŋ?’
33Akɛni okwa egbɛi lɛ,
ani Nyɔŋmɔ baafee nɔ ni
otaoɔ ehã bo lo?
Kɛɛmɔ nɔ ni ole lɛ,
ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ esa akɛ
okɔɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ;
shi jeee mi matsɔ̃ɔ bo.
34Mɛi ni nuɔ nii ashishi lɛ
baakɛɛ mi;
ni nilelɔi ni nuɔ nɔ ni
miwieɔ lɛ baakɛɛ akɛ,
35‘Hiob wieɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli;
nilee bɛ ewiemɔ mli.’
36Mina ni kulɛ aka Hiob
akwɛ kɛyashi naagbee,
ejaakɛ hetoi ni ehãa lɛ
tamɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji anaa wiemɔ.
37Ejaakɛ eetse atua efata
esha ni efee lɛ he,
eetswa edɛ̃ eshwie wɔnɔ
ni eewie babaoo eeshi Nyɔŋmɔ.”

Title: HIOB 35
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Elihu saa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ,
2“Aso osusuɔ akɛ eja gbɛ
akɛ oookɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ
tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ohe,
3hewɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ,
‘Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he?
Mɛɛ ejurɔ miyeɔ kɛji
mifee esha lɛ?’
4Mahã bo kɛ onanemɛi ni fata ohe lɛ fɛɛ hetoo.
5Kwɛmɔ ŋwɛi!
Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni atatui lɛ
yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ yɛ oyiteŋ!
6Kɛji ofee esha lɛ,
mɛni ona ofee Nyɔŋmɔ?
Kɛji ofee esha lɛ shii abɔ po,
mɛɛ awui no yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ?
7Kɛji jalɔ ji bo lɛ,
mɛni okɛwa Nyɔŋmɔ,
aloo mɛni enaa kɛjɛɔ odɛ̃ŋ?
8 Esha ni ofeɔ lɛ, adesa tamɔ bo
awui eyeɔ,
ni ojalɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔ eyeɔ ebuaa.
9Yiwaa babaoo hãa maŋbii
lɛ bolɔɔ;
amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ
yɛ ojei ayiwalɛ nifeemɔnii ahewɔ.
10 Shi mɔ ko kwraa ekɛɛɛ akɛ,
‘Nɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, miBɔlɔ lɛ yɔɔ,
mɔ ni hãa hiɛnɔkãmɔ
yɛ fĩmɔbe mli kɛ
11mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii
fe bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ
nɔ kooloi lɛ,
ni ehãa wɔleɔ nii fe ŋwɛi loofɔji lɛ?’
12Amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ
shi Nyɔŋmɔ efooo amɛdaaŋ
yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii kɛ
amɛhenɔwomɔ hewɔ.
13 Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ booo yaka yaafo toi,
ni Ofe lɛ ebuuu hu.
14Nɔ ni wa fe fɛɛ ji akɛ,
oookɛɛ akɛ onaaa lɛ,
ni sane lɛ kã ehiɛ,
ni oomɛ lɛ.
15 Shi agbɛnɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu
gbalaaa mɔ toi, ni ediii
tɔ̃mɔ sɛɛ yrɛdɛɛ hewɔ lɛ,
16Hiob, oowie huu,
oowie babaoo ni nilee bɛ mli.”

Title: HIOB 36
Content:
1Elihu tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
2“Na tsui ohã mi fioo,
ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ko naa,
ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔ ko lolo
ni mibawie mahã Nyɔŋmɔ.
3Minilee babaoo lɛ mli majɛ
matsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miBɔlɔ lɛ
yeɔ jalɛ sane.
4Ejaakɛ anɔkwa wiemɔ miwieɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ko ni le nii jogbaŋŋ
damɔ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
5Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo,
ni enyaŋeee mɔ ko mɔ ko;
eniiashishinumɔ naa wa jogbaŋŋ.
6 Ehãaa mɔ fɔŋ yi ana wala,
shi ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ
eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ.
7Ehiŋmɛi kãa jalɔ he,
ni ehãa amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ tamɔ
maŋtsɛmɛi ni tara sɛii anɔ
ni awoɔ amɛnɔ gojoo.
8Kɛji awo amɛ gboklɛi
ni amanehulu efĩmɔ amɛ lɛ,
9kɛkɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ
nɔ fɔŋ ni amɛfee, amɛtɔ̃mɔi
kɛ amɛhenɔwomɔ lɛ.
10 Egbeleɔ amɛtoiiaŋ, ni amɛnuɔ
kãmɔ ni ekãa amɛ akɛ
amɛkpa nishaianii feemɔ lɛ.
11Kɛji amɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ lɛ,
amɛaaye amɛwala be lɛ
yɛ ejurɔyeli mli,
kɛ amɛfii lɛ hu yɛ miishɛɛ mli.
12Shi kɛji amɛbooo toi lɛ,
no lɛ amɛleŋ nii, ni amɛaagboi
yɛ klante naa.
13Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ,
eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ mlifu he;
kɛji efĩ amɛ tete lɛ
amɛbiii Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ.
14Amɛgboiɔ yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ,
ni amɛwala sɛɛ foɔ
kɛ hiɛgbele kɛ tɔlɛ.
15Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔseɔ gbɔmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ
amanehulu nɔ,
ni ekɛ nɔnaa gbeleɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi.
16Nyɔŋmɔ jie bo kɛje jaramɔ mli
kɛba he ko ni ohe jɔ bo yɛ,
ni okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ niyenii.
17Shi agbɛnɛ aagbala otoi
bɔ ni sa bo pɛpɛɛpɛ;
aagbala otoi yɛ jalɛ naa.
18Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni akɛ
nyɔɔŋnihamɔ akalaka bo;
ni kaahã ninamɔ miihã oodu gbɛ.
19Aso oyaafo baanyɛ bo ahere,
aloo ohewalɛ kɛ oshika
aaanyɛ nɔ ko afee?
20Kaashwe ni duŋ awo,
be ni maji ahiɛ aaakpãtã lɛ.
21Kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ ni okabɔ̃i
eshafeemɔ:
ejaakɛ oosumɔ enɛ moŋ
fe nɔnaa.
22 Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo
yɛ ehewalɛ lɛ naa;
ni mɛɛ tsɔɔlɔ kɛ lɛ yeɔ hegbɔ?
23Namɔ baanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ
nɔ ni sa akɛ efee,
aloo namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
akɛ, ‘Ofee nɔ ko ni ejaaa’.
24Kaimɔ koni okafo enifeemɔ
ni adesai fɛɛ ewo he lala lɛ.
25Adesai fɛɛ miikwɛ enifeemɔ
kɛmiijɛ shɔŋŋ;
shi kɛ̃lɛ adesa nuuu shishi.
26Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ da, shi
wɔleee lɛ;
ni wɔnyɛŋ efii ni eye wɔkane.
27Ejaakɛ egbalaa nu kulibii
kɛyaa ŋwɛi,
ni ehãa afua tsɔ̃ɔ nu,
28ni ŋwɛi fɔseɔ shwieɔ shi,
ni ebashwieɔ adesai fɛɛ anɔ babaoo.
29 Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ anu
bɔ ni atatui ha ŋwɛi lɛ shishi,
aloo eeenu ŋwɛi shiimɔ shishi?
30Naa, egbɛ ŋwɛi srawa mli kɛbɔle ehe;
shi ehã ŋshɔ shishi wo duŋ.
31Ejaakɛ gbɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ
elɛɔ adesai nɛ,
ni ekumaa amɛ niyenii babaoo.
32Ekɛ enine mɔɔ ŋwɛi srawa mli
ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ he ni egba kɛyayi.
33Ŋwɛi srawa gbɛɛmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ
bɔ ni eji,
akɛ mɔ ko ni mli fũɔ yɛ
nishaianii hewɔ.”

Title: HIOB 37
Content:
1“Ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ hãa mitsui tswaa
ni tse po eheɔ etse yɛ mimli nɛɛ.
2 Nyɛboa Nyɔŋmɔ gbee ni ji ŋwɛi shiimɔ
lɛ toi,
kɛ shiimɔ ni jɛ edaaŋ lɛ.
3Eŋmɛɔ he ewoɔ ŋwɛi shishi fɛɛ,
ni ŋwɛi srawa gbalaa kɛyaa
shikpɔŋ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
4Ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
ewoɔ egbee kɛ agbojee;
ni etsiii srawa naa
be mli ni eshiɔ lɛ.
5Nyɔŋmɔ gbeeshiimɔ yɛ naakpɛɛ
ni efeɔ nibii wuji ni wɔjwɛŋmɔ
shɛɛɛ he.
6 Ekɛɔ snoo akɛ, ‘Nɛɛ oshwie
shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
ni ekɛɔ nu kɛ futufuli akɛ, nɛɛ waa!’
7Ejieɔ gbɔmɔ nine yɛ
nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ he,
koni adesai fɛɛ ana ale
akɛ lɛ efeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
8 Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋaŋ kooloi yaa amɛbuiaŋ,
ni amɛhɔlɔ amɛshihilɛhei lɛaŋ.
9Ahum jɛɔ wuoyigbɛ ebaa,
ni fɛ̃i hu jeɔ kooyigbɛ.
10Mumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ muɔ lɛ
hãa nu fĩɔ kpɔ,
ni fai fɛɛ fĩɔ tɔo tsɔ̃ɔ aisi.
11Ehãa atatui yiɔ kɛ nu
ni ehãa srawa kpɛlɛɔ
yɛ atatui lɛaŋ.
12Amɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ egbɛjianɔtoo
naa;
amɛyeɔ efãmɔ nɔ
yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
13Bei komɛi lɛ, ehãa
enɛɛmɛi baa koni egbala
gbɔmɛi atoi,
bei komɛi lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ
yibaamɔ hewɔ,
ni bei komɛi hu koni
ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ ni eyɔɔ.
14Oo, bo enɛ toi, Hiob,
da gãa koni ojwɛŋ
Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
15Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ
efãa amɛ ehãa,
ni ehãa la kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ
atatu mli?
16Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ,
mɔ ni le nii kɛwula shi lɛ
feɔ etsuɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔ
ni hãa atatu sɛŋɔ shi lɛ?
17Ele bo bɔ ni otadei
amli dɔɔ la,
be ni ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ
efee shiŋŋ yɛ wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ
lɛ hewɔ lɛ?
18Ani obaanyɛ olɛɛ ŋwɛi,
ni tamɔ dade kaŋkaŋ ni ashwie nɛɛ,
mli oha shi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee lɛ?
19Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ;
ejaakɛ wɔjwɛŋmɔ naa etã,
wɔbɛ nɔ ko ni wɔbaakɛɛ.
20Akakɛɛ lɛ akɛ masumɔ mawie;
mɔ ko bɛ ni baasumɔ
akɛ ekpãtã ehiɛ.
21Ni agbɛnɛ adesa nyɛɛɛ
la lɛ ekwɛ kɛ jeŋ tse tete,
ejaakɛ atatui eha hiɛ;
shi kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa lɛ
eloɔ atatui lɛ kɛyaa.
22La tsuru fɔɔ kpɛɔ
kɛjɛɔ kooyigbɛ kɛbaa.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ he anunyam lɛ
hãa wɔsheɔ gbeyei.
23 Ofe lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ lɛ wɔna;
ehewalɛ da, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane;
ekpaŋ jalɛ saneyeli.
24No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ adesai fɛɛ,
nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei,
ejaakɛ mɛi ni buɔ amɛhe
nilelɔi lɛ, ebuuu amɛ.”

Title: HIOB 38
Content:
1 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli ehã Hiob hetoo ekɛɛ,
2 “Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi
ni nilee bɛ mli ehã
mijwɛŋmɔ hiɛ ehua nɛɛ?
3 Feemɔ kralo odamɔ shi
tamɔ nuu,
shi mibabi bo sane ni ohã
hetoo.
4Be ni mito je lɛ shishi lɛ,
nɛgbɛ oyɔɔ?
Kɛji ole he nɔ ko lɛ,
kɛɛmɔ mi!
5 Namɔ ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ
bɔ ni eda ehã;
aloo namɔ ji mɔ ni
mɔ kpãa mli kɛsusu edalɛ lɛ?
Bɛ ole?
6Mɛni nɔ ato je lɛ shishi ama?
Namɔ ji mɔ ni to ekoŋtɛ lɛ?
7Be ni leebi ŋulamii lɛ fɛɛ la kutuu
ni ŋwɛibii lɛ bɔ oshe
kɛ nyamɔ lɛ?
8 Aloo namɔ ŋamɔ agboi lɛ
ekɛtsi ŋshɔ lɛ naa,
be ni etue kɛjɛ je lɛ
shishitoo he lɛ.
9Be ni mihã atatui tsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hebo,
ni mihã duŋ kpii hu tsɔ̃
mama ni mikɛbala lɛ lɛ?
10 Be ni mito je lɛ husui
ni mikɛ agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi
tsi enaa,
11ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Biɛ nɛɛ obaawa,
ni okafo mli;
ni biɛ oshɔkei wuji lɛ baawa.’
12Hiob, ni oba jeŋ nɛɛ, ofã
ni je etsɛre dã?
Ni otsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ egbɛhe pɛŋ?
13Ani ofã jetsɛremɔ ni emɔmɔ
shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee hei lɛ amli
koni ehwanya mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ
kɛjɛ nɔ eshwie dã lo?
14Jetsɛremɔ hãa gɔji kɛ jɔi jeɔ
shi faŋŋ
tamɔ atade ni akumɔ mli
loo tamɔ naasɔomɔnɔ ni ta magbɛ hiɛ.
15Ehãa mɛi fɔɔji enãaa hei
ni amɛaatsɔ̃,
ni amɛniji ni amɛkɛtsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ
kumɔɔ yɛ amɛhe.
16Aso oshɛ he ni ŋshɔ
jɛɔ lɛ pɛŋ;
ni oshara shi kɛnyiɛ ŋshɔ shishi dã?
17Ani ajie gbohiiaje agboi lɛ akpo
atsɔ̃ɔ bo,
aloo ajie duŋ kpii lɛ naa agboi
lɛ akpo atsɔ̃ɔ bo?
18Ani ole je lɛ dalɛ?
Kɛji ole nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, wiemɔ!
19Nɛgbɛ atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa he ni la jɛɔ,
loo nɛgbɛ ji duŋ shihilɛhe,
20koni otsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ ni kã shi
kɛyaa eshihilɛhe lɛ mli,
koni oŋɔ lɛ oyato ehusu nɔ?
21Bɛ ole, ejaakɛ ofii fa babaoo
ni no mli lɛ afɔ bo!
22Obote tsui ni mito snoo yɛ mli,
lɛ mli pɛŋ
loo ona tsui ni mito nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi yɛ mli,
23 ni ji nii ni mito mihã
amanehulu be
loo nɔmɔ kɛ ta be lɛ?
24Nɛgbɛ gbɛ ni yaa he ni hulu
la lɛ jɛɔ egbɛɔ eshwãa,
loo he ni bokãgbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ
jɛɔ eshwãa je lɛ mli lɛ kã?
25 Namɔ egba nujɔɔ efɔ̃ shi
koni nu ni miinɛ anyiɛ mli,
ni eje gbɛ ehã srawa,
26bɔ ni afee ni nu anɛ
ashwie shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko
bɛ nɔ, kɛ shiaŋa he ni
adesa ko bɛ hu nɔ?
27Namɔ hãa shikpɔŋ olɛŋlɛ
ni kã shi efolo naa ofɔ̃,
ni jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ?
28Ani nu ni nɛɔ yɛ tsɛ,
loo namɔ ni fɔ bɔ́?
29 Namɔ musuŋ aisi jɛ,
ni namɔ fɔ ŋwɛi bɔ́
ni efimɔ kpɔbii.
30Nu fiɔ, ni ewaa tamɔ tɛ,
ni ŋshɔ hiɛ fɛɛ waa keketee.
31 “Ani obaanyɛ okɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ
afimɔ Wuɔ kɛ ebii?
Aloo obaanyɛ kpãi ni fimɔ
Oŋwɛ ofɛne?
32Ani obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii
ni kpɛlɛɔ lɛ he ni amɛtsɔ̃
kɛya kɛji amɛje,
aloo obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Jeŋ Kpawo
kɛ ebii lɛ gbɛ?
33Ani ole akpɔi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi,
aloo obaanyɛ ohã nakai
akpɔi lɛ aye shikpɔŋ lɛ
hu nɔ?
34Ani obaanyɛ owo ogbee nɔ
ni ofã atatui lɛ
koni amɛnɛ nu amɛshwie
onɔ?
35Ani obaanyɛ ofã srawai
akɛ amɛgbala,
ni ani amɛaaba oŋɔɔ
amɛbakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Naa wɔ?’
36Namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ loofɔlɔ ibis
be ni Nilo baasraŋ nɔ?
Aloo namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ wuɔ nuu
akɛ nu baanɛ?
37 Namɔ yɔɔ nilee ni ekɛbaanyɛ
atatui lɛ ekane?
Aloo ebaanyɛ ekpoo amɛnaa shi
koni amɛnɛ nu
38ni baahã su akpɔtɔ
ni efimɔ kukulibii efee tɔo?
39Ani bo omiɔ milɛloo ohãa jata,
aloo ohãa jatabii loo amɛyeɔ
shɛɔ amɛnaa
40be ni amɛbumɔ amɛbui amli,
aloo amɛhɔlɔ odɔtɔi amli
amɛwo ka lɛ?
41 Namɔ hã kwãakwãalabite niyenii,
be ni ebii bibii bolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ
Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni amɛtsomloɔ ejaakɛ niyenii
bɛ lɛ?

Title: HIOB 39
Content:
1“Ani ole be mli ni afɔɔ gɔji anɔ
abotiai lo?
Ona ofrote ni eefɔ dã?
2Ole nyɔji abɔ ni amɛhiɛɔ musu?
Ole amɛfɔmɔ be lo?
3Ani ole be mli ni amɛsɔ̃ɔ shi
amɛfɔɔ amɛbii lo?
4Amɛbii lɛ naa hewalɛ,
ni amɛdaraa yɛ jwɛiiaŋ;
amɛjeɔ kpo, ni
amɛkuuu amɛsɛɛ amɛbaaa dɔŋŋ.
5Namɔ ŋmɛ̃ɛ ŋaŋ teji he
koni eye ehe?
Namɔ fɛne kpãa lɛ ehã teji?
6Ni miŋɔ ŋa kplanaa lɛ mihã lɛ
akɛ eshĩa,
ni miŋɔ mukpo shikpɔŋ lɛ mihã lɛ
akɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ.
7Esumɔɔɔ hoo ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ,
ni enuuu mɔ ko ni miikpala lɛ gbee.
8Gɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ɔ eniyelihe,
ni etaoɔ nii ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃
yɛ jɛi eyeɔ.
9Ani koo mli tsina aaakpɛ̃lɛ
ni esɔ̃mɔ bo?
Aloo eeesumɔ ni ebawɔ
kooloi awɔɔhe?
10Ani obaanyɛ owo tsinanuu kpãa
ni etsa akofii,
aloo eninɛ ŋmɔ
yɛ jɔi amli kɛnyiɛ osɛɛ?
11Ani okɛ ohe aaafɔ̃ enɔ
yɛ ehewalɛ kpele lɛ hewɔ,
aloo oooshi nitsumɔ muu
lɛ fɛɛ oŋmɛ enɔ?
12Ani oheɔ lɛ oyeɔ akɛ
ekɛ onikpamɔnii lɛ baaku
esɛɛ; naa,
ni ebua obele lɛ naa ewo aboŋo mli?
13Duguma tswaa efijiaŋ kɛ ntɛŋ;
shi hewalɛ kome nɛkɛ bɛ mli
ni ekɛaa sumɔ bo.
14Ejaakɛ eshiɔ ewɔji lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ
koni shikpɔŋ mlu mli dɔlɛ lɛ ahã
amɛhe adɔ la.
15Ni ehiɛ kpaa nɔ akɛ
mɔ ko kɛ enane aaanyɛ ajwara
amɛ;
ni ŋaŋ kooloi aaanyɛ
amɛnaanaa nɔ.
16Ewaa ebii bibii lɛ ayi,
tamɔ nɔ ni jeee ebii ni;
etɔlɛ lɛ aaanyɛ afee yaka
kɛ̃lɛ esheee no gbeyei.
17Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã nilee ebɔ lɛ,
ni jwɛŋmɔ hu ehãaa lɛ eko.
18Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ, ni ebaabɔ̃i foijee lɛ,
eŋmɔɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
19“Hiob, bo ji mɔ ni hã okpɔŋɔ
hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ?
Ekuɛ he tsɔi funyaŋŋ lɛ bo ohã lɛ?
20Ani bo ohãa okpɔŋɔ huluɔ
tamɔ baalabi tuɔ lɛ?
Etsinemɔ gbɛɛmɔ yɛ gbeyei!
21Ekɛ enane gbɛɔ shi yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli,
eshwaa efɔɔ ehewalɛ nɔ;
ejeɔ kpo ekɛ tabilɔi yakpeɔ.
22Eleee nɔ ni ji gbeyei,
no haaa ekpokpo tete;
ejooo foi yɛ klante naa.
23Gãimlibii gbɛɔ woɔ lɛ,
akplɔ kɛ damfojai kpɛlɛɔ woɔ lɛ.
24Ekɛ hiɛdɔɔ kɛ grimɔ kpitiɔ shi;
enyɛɛɛ shi edamɔ kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛ.
25Kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛ lɛ,
ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yiɛ, eshɛ!’
Enyiɛ shɔŋŋ ni enuɔ ta he fu,
kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ afaamɔi kɛ blɔmɔ he.
26Ani bo onilee naa
ni laalɔɔ filikiɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi,
ni egbɛɔ efijiaŋ etsɔ̃ɔ wuoyigbɛ?
27Ani bo ofamɔ naa
ni okropɔŋ woɔ ehe nɔ
ni eyafeɔ etsu yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ?
28Tɛsaa ni kwɔ fe fɛɛ nɔ
he ni yɔɔ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ,
efeɔ eshihilɛhe yɛ.
29Jɛi ejɛɔ ni enaa kooloo ni eeemɔ;
ehiŋmɛi naa shɔŋŋ nii.
30 He ni gbohii jwere lɛ,
jɛi okropɔŋ yɔɔ;
ni ebii bibii lɛ nuɔ gbohii lɛ alá.”

Title: HIOB 40
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Hiob akɛ,
2 “Aso mɔ ni miitao mɔ he tɔ̃mɔ ekɛɛ lɛ,
ebaanyɛ ekɛ Ofe lɛ ataa naa?
Mɔ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitaa naa lɛ,
hã ehã hetoo.”
3Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here Yehowa nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
4“Naa, mijeee mɔ ko;
mɛɛ hetoo mahã?
Mikɛ minine eto minaabu.
5Miwie shi kome, ni mitoŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Miwie shii enyɔ; ni miyaŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ.”
6Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli
ekɛ Hiob wie ekoŋŋ,
7 “Miamɔ tamɔ nuu;
mibabi bo sane
koni ojie mi naa.
8Aso ooka ni otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mitɔ̃?
Oobu mi fɔ koni oye bem?
9 Aso ohewalɛ shɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ,
ni obaanyɛ ohã ogbee ashi
tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ lo?
10Kɛji nakai lɛ,
no lɛ wulamɔ ohe
koni ogbojee akwɔ ni onunyam
ada kpele.
11Grimɔ kɛ mlifu ni okɛnina
hewolɔ fɛɛ hewolɔ koni
oba lɛ shi;
12hɛɛ hewolɔ fɛɛ hewolɔ lɛ oba
lɛ shi,
ni otsirɛ yiwalɔi otswia shi
yɛ hei ni amɛdamɔ.
13Tsiimɔ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ owo shikpɔŋ,
ni ofimɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yɛ gbohiiaje,
14kɛkɛ lɛ mi hu makplɛ̃ nɔ
mahã bo akɛ oyɛ hewalɛ
ni baanyɛ ehã oye kunim.
15Kwɛmɔ nuŋshwuɔ;
mi mibɔ lɛ tamɔ mibɔ bo.
Ekpeɔ jwɛi tamɔ tsina,
16shi kwɛmɔ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehɛ mli,
kɛ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehewojiaŋ fãi lɛ mli.
17Ehãa elei shɔ̃ɔ keketee tamɔ tsenedru,
ni atswɛ̃tswɛ̃ fãi ni yɔɔ eshuɔji amli lɛ.
18Ewui wa tamɔ akɔɔble,
ni eniji kɛ enaji
tamɔ dade adabãŋ.
19Lɛ ji Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔi
lɛ ateŋ titri ko;
mɔ ni bɔ lɛ lɛ pɛ nyɛɔ enɔ eyeɔ,
20Ejaakɛ ŋmei tsei lɛ hãa lɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ
yɛ he ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ yashwɛɔ
yɛ lɛ.
21Ehoɔ ekãa shi yɛ ŋmei tsei ashishi,
ni eteɔ ehe yɛ glãi amli yɛ
ŋmiamɔ mli,
22ejaakɛ ŋmei tsei lɛ hãa lɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ
ni faa lɛ mli jwɛi lɛ bɔleɔ ehe kɛkpeɔ.
23Naa, kɛji faa lɛ fee hamahama tete
ewooo ehe gbeyei;
kɛji Yordan yi kɛbata esɛ̃ tete po
eyoyrooo.
24Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ eje ehiɛgbɛ
ni emɔ lɛ,
aloo ekɛ tsɔne adu egugɔ?”

Title: HIOB 41
Content:
1 “Obaanyɛ okɛ kpoŋ asha leviatan
aloo okɛ kpãa afi elilɛi
akpɛtɛ edaaŋ?
2Ani ooonyɛ owo egugɔŋ taŋkpee
aloo okɛ kpoŋ ala ekadaa?
3Ani eekpa bo fai babaoo?
Aloo ekɛ bo aaawie naajɔlɛ wiemɔi?
4Ani ekɛ bo aaakpãŋ akɛ
oŋɔ lɛ ofee otsulɔ kɛya naanɔ lo?
5Ani okɛ lɛ baashwɛ
tamɔ akɛ loofɔlɔ shwɛɔ,
aloo obaafi lɛ ohã oblayei lo?
6Ani wolɛi baaba amɛbaye enaa?
Ani amɛfolɔ emli amɛhã jarayelɔi lo?
7Ani ooonyɛ otsulɔ akplɔi
owo ehewojiaŋ obɔ̃,
aloo oootsulɔ eyitso kɛ wuoyaa akplɔ?
8Kɛ onine ata ehe okwɛ,
ni ofeŋ nakai ekoŋŋ;
ohiɛ kpaŋ nɔmɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ nɔ.
9Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baana leviatan lɛ
enijiaŋ jeɔ wui, ni egbeɔ shi.
10Kãkãlɔ ko kãkãlɔ ko bɛ
ni aaanyɛ awo ehiɛ la.
Belɛ namɔ ji mɔ ni aaanyɛ
mi mihiɛ adamɔ mɔ?
11Namɔ kwraa etsɔ̃ hiɛ
efee nɔ ko ehã mi,
koni mato lɛ najiaŋ?
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ, minɔ ni.
12Mibawie eniji kɛ enaji
kɛ ehewalɛ kpele kɛ egbɔmɔtso he daa.
13Mɔ ko bɛ ni baanyɛ ehewolo
lɛ ekpɔ;
aloo eta enyanyɔji nta lɛ ahe.
14Namɔ baanyɛ agbele edaa
kɛyanina enyanyɔji ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ.
15Ehe totoi ni ato amɛ klɛmpɛiklɛmpɛi
tsara nɔ ha ekoto sɛɛ,
ni atsara amɛ tamɔ
nɔ ni asɔo amɛnaa.
16Eko tsa eko nɔ tsikitsiki,
bɔ ni kɔɔyɔɔ tete nyɛɛɛ
amɛteŋ etsɔ̃.
17Akɛ eko etsa eko nɔ,
amɛkpɛtɛ amɛhe bɔ ni
ehiii amɛteŋ tsemɔ.
18Kɛji etsine lɛ ekpɛlɛɔ la,
ni ehiŋmɛiiaŋ tamɔ leebi hulu haai.
19La fãa kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ tamɔ haai;
la srɛmii fɛlɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ.
20Egugɔŋ fãa lasu
tamɔ lamɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ kukwɛi
ni ma la nɔ mli,
loo tamɔ jwɛi ni miishã lasu.
21Egugɔŋ mumɔ tsɛ̃ɔ ŋai,
ni edaaŋ fãa la.
22Ekuɛ mli ehewalɛ yɔɔ,
hewɔ lɛ eyɛ gbeyei kɛji
oyaje ehiɛgbɛ.
23Eheloo lɛ kpɛtɛ ehe kpɛŋŋ
bɔ ni anyɛɛɛ akpɔ.
24Etsui wa tamɔ tɛ,
ewa tamɔ wiɛ.
25Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ lɛ,
kãkãlɔi sheɔ gbeyei;
ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ amɛ
kɛji ekãnya ehe.
26Kɛji abã lɛ klante lɛ, efooo;
ni akplɔ loo gãi
loo loogbee akplɔ
nyɛɛɛ lɛ afo.
27Dade tamɔ jwɛi ni egbi,
ni akɔɔble tamɔ tso
ni ekpɔtɔ hã lɛ.
28Gãimlibi wooo lɛ foi;
ni aklomia mli tɛ
tsɔ̃ɔ gbetseli hãa lɛ.
29Tsokpoti tamɔ gbetseli,
ni efeɔ lɛ ŋmɔlɔ kɛji
atsɛ̃rɛ lɛ akplɔ.
30Emlishi totoi lɛ tamɔ
gbɛ ko naabu sakasaka lɛ,
ni ehoɔ ekãa ŋmɔtɔ lɛ mli
tamɔ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso.
31Ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa
tamɔ nula;
ni afui ni etswaa lɛ
tamɔ mu ni ma la nɔ.
32Esɛɛ mo kpɛɔ
ni ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa afui
tamɔ waŋ.
33Esaso kooloo ni sheee nɔ ko nɔ ko
gbeyei bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
34Ebuuu nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he wa,
lɛ ji kooloi hewalɔi fɛɛ atsɛ.”

Title: HIOB 42
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here Yehowa nɔ ekɛɛ,
2“Yehowa, mile akɛ
onyɛɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ofeɔ,
ni oyiŋtoo ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ
naa aku.
3 Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi
ni nilee bɛ mli teɔ nilee
nɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ, miwie nibii
ni minuuu shishi,
nibii ni ahe yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃
hã mi bɔ ni minuuu amɛshishi.
4 Okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bo toi;
ni mawie.
Mibabi bo sane koni ohã
mi hetoo!’
5Mitoi kɛkɛ mikɛnu ohe,
shi agbɛnɛ mihiŋmɛi ena bo.
6No hewɔ lɛ, eedɔ mi,
ni miishwa mihe
yɛ sũ kɛ lamlu mli.”
Sane lɛ fɛɛ naagbee
7Be ni Yehowa kɛ Hiob ewie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, akɛ, “Mimli ewo bo kɛ onanemɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ala, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ mitsulɔ Hiob fee lɛ. 8No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛmɔmɔa tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo kɛyaa mitsulɔ Hiob ŋɔɔ koni nyɛkɛyashãa shãa afɔle nyɛhãa nyɛhe. Mitsulɔ Hiob baakpa fai ehã nyɛ ni mibabo efaikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni mikɛ nyɛ yeŋ yɛ nyɛkooloofeemɔ lɛ naa, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ Hiob fee lɛ.”
9 No hewɔ lɛ, Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, kɛ Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, kɛ Zofar, Naamanyo lɛ, yiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyafee bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ lɛ; ni Yehowa mɔ Hiob faikpamɔ lɛ mli.
10 Be ni Hiob ekpa fai ehã enanemɛi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hã Hiob saa eshwere ekoŋŋ. Yehowa ku nii fɛɛ ni Hiob yɔɔ sa lɛ ebɔ he toi enyɔ ehã lɛ. 11Kɛkɛ ni Hiob nyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi yei lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni le lɛ sa lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni amɛ kɛ lɛ ye nii, ni amɛye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛshɛje emii yɛ sane fɔŋ ni Yehowa hã ye lɛ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ke Hiob jwiɛtɛi kuku kɛ shika ga.
12Yehowa jɔɔ Hiob yɛ enaagbee wala beiaŋ fe bɔ ni ejɔɔ lɛ tsutsu lɛ. Hiob na gwantɛŋi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ yoomai akpei ekpaa kɛ tsinai akpei enyɔ kɛ teji yei akpe kome. 13Esaa efɔ bihii kpawo kɛ biyei etɛ̃. 14Ewo ebiyoonukpa lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yemima, ebiyoo ni ji enyɔ lɛ ewo lɛ Kezia, ni ebiyoo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ewo lɛ Keren-Hapak. 15Yoo ko kwraa bɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni ehe yɛ fɛo tamɔ amɛ. Amɛtsɛ Hiob hã amɛ egboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ ehã amɛnyɛmimɛi hii lɛ.
16Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Hiob saa ehi shi afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni ena eshwiei kɛyashi amɛyinɔ ni ji ejwɛ nɔ bii. 17 Ni Hiob gbo be ni eji nuumo kotokoto ni eye afii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.

Title: LALA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Lalai Awolo nɛɛ ji lala wolo kɛ sɔlemɔ wolo ni yɔɔ Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli. Mɛi srɔtoisrɔtoi ŋmala; ni amɛye bei babaoo yɛ he dani amɛgbe naa. Israelbii bua lalai kɛ sɔlemɔi nɛɛ anaa, ni nomɛi amɛkɛja Nyɔŋmɔ; ni nosɛɛ lɛ aŋɔ ni akɛfata amɛŊmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he.
Nɛkɛ jamɔ lalai nɛɛ srɔtoisrɔtoi ni: akɛ lalai nɛɛ ekomɛi jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni akɛ ekomɛi jaa lɛ; akɛ ekomɛi sɔleɔ kɛbiɔ yelikɛbuamɔ loo hebuu loo yiwalaheremɔ. Akɛ lalai lɛ ekomɛi biɔ eshaifaa; ni akɛ ekomɛi daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ ejɔɔmɔi ahewɔ. Yudafoi lɛ kɛ lalai nɛɛ ekomɛi kpaa Naa Nyɔŋmɔ fai bɔ ni afee ni egbla henyɛlɔi atoi. Akɛsɔleɔ ahãa he, ni akɛsɔleɔ ahãa maŋ hu. Sɔlemɔi lɛ ekomɛi tsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ nuɔ nii ahe ehãa enyɛmi gbɔmɔ; ni ekomɛi hu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni nibii ahe hiãa Nyɔŋmɔ webii, kɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ webii fɛɛ nuɔ nii ahe hu hãa amɛnyɛmimɛi gbɔmɛi.
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ lalai nɛɛ tsu nii, ni mɛi hu ni ŋmala Kpãŋmɔ Hee lɛ tsĩ lalai lɛ ekomɛi atã yɛ amɛniŋmãa mli. Hewɔ lɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ batsɔ̃ Kristo Asafo lɛ wolo ni jra wa kɛjɛ Kristo Asafo lɛ shishijee mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Mlijaramɔi
Lalai oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ ajra mli enumɔ. Nomɛi ji:
Lalai 1—41
Lalai 42—72
Lalai 73—89
Lalai 90—106
Lalai 107—150

Title: LALA 1
Content:
KLƐŊKLƐŊ WOLO LƐ
(Lalai 1—41)
Miishɛɛ Krɔŋŋ
1 Ajɔɔ mɔ ni booo mɛi fɔ̃ji aŋaawoo toi,
ni ekɛ eshafeelɔi ebɔɔɔ,
ni etaaa hefɛoyelɔi ateŋ.
2 Shi moŋ emii shɛɔ Yehowa Mla lɛ he,
ni ejwɛŋɔ he daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ.
3 Etamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ fai atoi,
ni woɔ yibii yɛ amɛbe mli,
ni amɛbai kpalaaa,
ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ shwereɔ.
4 Mɛi fɔ̃ji bɛ nakai;
amɛ lɛ amɛtamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa.
5No hewɔ lɛ, eshafeelɔi nyɛŋ
kojomɔ naa amɛdamɔ;
amɛnaŋ gbɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ateŋ.
6 Ejaakɛ Yehowa kudɔɔ jalɔi agbɛ lɛ,
shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ ekɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji
yaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.

Title: LALA 2
Content:
Maŋtsɛ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ
1 Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ toɔ atuatsemɔ he ajina?
Ni maŋbii lɛ kpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi fɔ̃ji?
2 Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tseɔ atua,
ni lumɛi lɛ hu feɔ ekome;
amɛkpãŋɔ Yehowa kɛ maŋtsɛ
ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ yinɔ.
3 Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔkumɔa amɛgboklɛi lɛ;
ni wɔtserɛ amɛkpai lɛ yɛ wɔhe.”
4 Mɔ ni ta ŋwɛi lɛ miiŋmɔ
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miiye amɛhe fɛo po;
ni eyeɔ amɛhe fɛo hu.
5Ekɛ amɛ aaawie yɛ emlifu naa,
ni ekɛ mlila aaawo amɛhe gbeyei.
6Ekɛɛ, “Miwo mimaŋtsɛ yɛ Zion,
migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
7 “Mashiɛ akpɔ ni Yehowa ewo mi lɛ,”
Ekɛɛ, “Mibi ji bo, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ mifɔ bo.
8 Bi mi, ni maŋɔ majimaji lɛ mahã bo akɛ ogboshinii;
ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ ogbɛfaŋnɔ.
9 Okɛ dade dɛhiɛmɔtso aaakumɔ amɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ,
ni ooojwara amɛ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ.”
10No hewɔ lɛ, Oo, nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, nyɛlea nii;
Oo, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelɔi, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ.
11 Nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa kɛ gbeyeishemɔ;
12 nyɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ akotoa lɛ;
kɛjeee nakai lɛ emli baafu nyɛ oya, ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.

Title: LALA 3
Content:
Leebi sɔlemɔ hã yelikɛbuamɔ
1Oo Yehowa, kwɛ mɛi abɔ sɔŋŋ ni haoɔ mi!
Mɛi babaoo ni teɔ shi woɔ mi!
2Mɛi pii kɛɔ yɛ mihe akɛ,
“Mɔ nɛ lɛ, enaŋ yiwalaheremɔ ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.”
Sela
3 Shi Yehowa, bo ji mihebuu tsɛŋ, bo ji minunyam,
bo ohãa mihiɛ baa nyam.
4Miwoɔ migbee nɔ,
mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ Yehowa,
ni ejɛɔ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ehereɔ mi nɔ.
5 Mikãa shi miwɔɔ, ni mihiɛ tsɛ̃ɔ;
ejaakɛ Yehowa buɔ mihe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
6 Misheee mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ
ni ebɔ nsra ewo mihe lɛ gbeyei.
7 Oo Yehowa, tee shi,
miNyɔŋmɔ, baahere miyiwala,
ejaakɛ bo otswiaa mihenyɛlɔi anii;
ni okumɔɔ amɛnyanyɔji owoɔ amɛdaaŋ.
8 Kunimyeli lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ,
Yehowa, ojɔɔmɔ aba omaŋ lɛ nɔ.
Sela

Title: LALA 4
Content:
Gbɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni akɛ kpaa saŋku atswa.
1Mijalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛ mitsɛ lɛ heremɔ mi nɔ.
Kɛ efi mi lɛ bo ofɛneɔ mi.
Naa mi mɔbɔ, ni obo mifaikpamɔ toi.
2Nyɛ gbɔmɛi adesai,
mɛɛ beyinɔ nyɛaagbe minunyam lɛ he guɔ kɛyaashi?
Shii enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛaasumɔ yakanii
ni nyɛaatao amale sɛɛgbɛ?
3 Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa eŋɔ jalɔ lɛ ehã ehe;
hewɔ lɛ kɛ́ mitsɛ lɛ lɛ, eboɔ mi toi.
4 Kɛji agba nyɛnaa lɛ, nyɛkafea esha;
nyɛjwɛŋa enɛ he jogbaŋŋ yɛ nyɛsai anɔ, ni nyɛfea dioo.
5 Nyɛshãa afɔlei ni sa,
ni nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ.
6 Mɛi pii kɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ aaafee wɔ ejurɔ!
Oo Yehowa, tse ohiɛ ohã wɔ.”
7Ohã mimli efili mi aahu
fe bɔ ni amɛbele kɛ amɛwain pii
aaanyɛ ahã amɛmli afili amɛ.
8 Hejɔlɛ mli makã shi mawɔ yɛ,
ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa,
okoome pɛ ohãa mihiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.

Title: LALA 5
Content:
Sɔlemɔ kɛhã hebuu
David Lala kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni akɛ bɛlɛ akpa.
1Oo Yehowa, bo miwiemɔi lɛ toi,
koni onu mikɔmɔ ni miyeɔ lɛ he ohã mi!
2 Mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ,
feemɔ toi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ,
ejaakɛ bo fai mikpaa nɛɛ.
3Oo Yehowa, leebi lɛ bo migbee toi;
leebi lɛ bo fai mikpaa,
ni bo ohetoo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.
4Ejaakɛ ojeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni naa efɔŋfeemɔ he tsui;
ni mɔ fɔŋ hu kɛ bo ehiii shi.
5Hewolɔi nyɛɛɛ ohiɛ amɛdamɔ,
ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeelɔi fɛɛ.
6Okpãtãa amalelɔi ahiɛ.
Lashishwielɔi kɛ shishiulɔi lɛ Yehowa miihi amɛ.
7 Shi mi lɛ, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ maba owe lɛ;
mikɛ woo aaaja bo yɛ oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ.
8Oo, Yehowa, kplamɔ mi yɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa
yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Hã ogbɛ akã shi faŋŋ ahã mi.
9 Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kome nɛkɛ bɛ amɛdaaŋ;
amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ fitemɔ;
amɛsɛ̃ lɛ gbonyobu ni agbele naa ni;
amɛkɛ amɛlilɛi wieɔ dɔkɔbii.
10Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, hã amɛsɔ̃ abua amɛyiteŋ.
Hã amɛyiŋshai lɛ nɔŋŋ akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Shɛrɛmɔ amɛ oshwie,
ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ onɔ babaoo,
ni amɛtse ohiɛ atua.
11 Shi mɛi fɛɛ ni baa bo abo lɛ, amɛmli filiɔ amɛ.
Hã amɛla lalai be fɛɛ be kɛ miishɛɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ ogbɛi lɛ,
fã amɛhe ni ohã amɛnya.
12 Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ojɔɔ,
ni okɛ mlihilɛ buɔ ehe tamɔ tsɛŋ.

Title: LALA 6
Content:
Sɔlemɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ yɛ haomɔ beiaŋ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni akɛ kpaa saŋku atswa yɛ Sheminth gbɛjianɔtoo naa.
1Oo Yehowa, kaakã mihiɛ yɛ omlifu mli,
ni okɛ mlila hu akagbala mitoi.
2Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ miigbɔjɔ.
Oo Yehowa, tsa mi ejaakɛ miikpokpo kɛ gbeyei.
3Misusuma hu miikpokpo naakpa.
Shi ao Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
4Oo Yehowa, kuu osɛɛ, heremɔ miyiwala,
baakpɔ̃ mi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.
5Ejaakɛ akaiii bo yɛ gbele mli;
ni gbohiiaje hu namɔ aaajie oyi yɛ jɛi?
6Etɔ mi kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ;
mifɔɔ misaa tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ daa nyɔɔŋ kɛ yaafonu.
7 Awerɛhoo ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu,
ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ,
mihiŋmɛii anɔ eha.
8 Nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa,
nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ;
ejaakɛ Yehowa enu miyaafo gbee lɛ.
9Yehowa enu mifaikpamɔ lɛ,
Yehowa ebo misɔlemɔ toi.
10 Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ aaagboi,
ni amɛaahao naakpa.
Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi yɛ be kuku mli.

Title: LALA 7
Content:
Jalɛ saneyeli he sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko ni ela eha Yehowa ni kɔɔ Benyaminnyo Kush wiemɔ ko he.
1 Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo abo mibaa!
Heremɔ miyiwala ni ojie mi yɛ
mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ adɛŋ.
2 Heremɔ mi koni henyɛlɔi lɛ
akagbala mi kɛtee he ni jielɔ ko bɛ,
ni amɛyatserɛ mimli tamɔ jata.
3-4 Oo Yehowa miNyɔŋmɔ,
kɛji mitɔ̃ mɔ ko nɔ,
kɛji mifee naanyo ko efɔŋ,
kɛji miwa mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ ayi lɛ,
5no lɛ, hã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ atiu mi ni amɛmɔ mi,
ni amɛnaanaa minɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni magbo, ni makã mlu mli.
6Oo, Yehowa, tee shi kɛ mlila,
wo ohe nɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ agirimɔ lɛ hewɔ;
Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, ohiɛ atsɛ̃;
bo ni oto kojomɔ ofɔ shi.
7Buamɔ asafokui lɛ anaa
kɛbɔle ohe kɛkpe,
ni ojɛ ŋwɛi oye amɛnɔ.
8 Yehowa, bo okojoɔ mɛi fɛɛ!
Oo Yehowa, kojomɔ mi yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa,
ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mifeko efɔŋ ko.
9 Oo, hã mɛi fɔ̃ji anɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo;
Shi jalɔi lɛ, ojuro amɛ;
ejaakɛ bo ji jalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni okaa tsui kɛ jwɛŋmɔ okwɛɔ.
10 Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji mitsɛŋ!
Lɛ ehereɔ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ.
11 Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jalɛ naa kojolɔ ni;
ebuɔ efɔŋfeelɔ fɔ be fɛɛ be.
12 Kɛji gbɔmɔ tsakeee etsui lɛ,
Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔ eklante naa;
ni edɔ egãi lɛ mli ni eta.
13Esaa emɔgbee dadei lɛ eto bo,
ni ehã egãimlibii lɛ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ la.
14Mɛi fɔ̃ji jwɛŋɔ efɔŋ,
ni amɛŋɔɔ efɔŋ hɔ,
ni amɛfɔɔ amale.
15 Etsaa bu, ni ehãa emli kwɔɔ,
ni lɛ nɔŋŋ egbeɔ bu ni etsa lɛ mli;
16emusu buaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ,
ni eyiwalɛ lɛ wulaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eyiteŋ.
17Mada Yehowa shi yɛ ejalɛ naa,
ni mala majie Yehowa,
Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ gbɛi lɛ yi.

Title: LALA 8
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ Agbojee kɛ gbɔmɔ anunyam
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni akɛ gbee ko ala.
1Oo Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ,
Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo
yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ!
Okɛ onunyam eha ŋwɛi flooflo.
2 Ohenyɛlɔi ahewɔ lɛ, osaa hewalɛ oto
yɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii anaa,
bɔ ni afee ni ohã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ
amua amɛnaa ni amɛfee diŋŋ.
3 Kɛ mikwɛ oŋwɛi kɛ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ,
nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii ni obɔ lɛ,
4 mɛni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe?
Namɔ po ji gbɔmɔbi ni ogbaa ohenaa yɛ ehe?
5 Kɛ̃lɛ, shwɛ shrao ni ohã ekɛ bo Nyɔŋmɔ aye hegbɔ;
ni okɛ anunyam kɛ woo efi lɛ akekre.
6 Bo ohã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛyeɔ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Oŋɔ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ oto enajiaŋshi ni eye amɛnɔ:
7toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ tswɛm kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hu,
8kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ
kɛ bɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli hu.
9Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ,
Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo
yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

Title: LALA 9
Content:
Shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ jalɛ saneyeli hewɔ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni akɛ Muth-labben gbee ala.
1Mada Yehowa shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ,
ni magba onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
2Ohewɔ lɛ manya; ni mimli aaafli mi.
Bo Ofe ni oyɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo,
mala, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
3Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ;
amɛgbeegbee shi, ni amɛplene yɛ ohiɛ.
4 Anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyelɔ ji bo yɛ okojomɔ mli.
Ota omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ ni oye jalɛ sane ohã mi.
5Okã majimaji lɛ ahiɛ,
okpãtã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahiɛ.
Ogbe amɛgbɛi kwrakwra kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ.
6 Henyɛlɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo kɛmiiya naanɔ;
obutu amɛmaji wuji lɛ;
ni kaimɔ po, akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
7 Shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, eeye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ;
emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã kojomɔ.
8 Ekojoɔ je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa,
ekwɛɛɛ hiɛaŋ ekojooo mɛi.
9Yehowa ji abobaahe hã mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ,
eji abobaahe yɛ fimɔ bei amli.
10Ni mɛi ni le ogbɛi lɛ ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ onɔ; ejaakɛ bo Yehowa,
okwaaa mɛi ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
11 Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Yehowa ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ yi!
Nyɛgbaa enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli.
12 Ejaakɛ lɛ mɔ ni etɔɔ lá he owele lɛ, ekaiɔ mɛi ni piŋɔ;
ni ehiɛ kpaaa nɔnalɔi abolɔmɔ nɔ.
13Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ!
Kwɛmɔ mimanehulu ni minaa yɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ.
Oo, bo mɔ ni owoɔ minɔ kɛjɛɔ gbohiiaje agboi lɛ amli,
14 koni majaje oyijiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ agboi lɛ amli,
mimli aaafli mi, ejaakɛ ohere miyiwala.
15 Jeŋ maji lɛ egbee bu ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtsa lɛ mli.
Tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛtee lɛ edu amɛ.
16 Yehowa kɛ ejalɛ kojomɔ ehã ale lɛ;
mɛi fɔ̃ji edu tsɔne ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.
17Mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni
hiɛ kpaa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ baaya gbohiiaje.
18 Shi ohiafo lɛ, jeee daa hiɛ aaakpa enɔ,
ohiafo hiɛnɔkãmɔ efeŋ yaka, kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
19Oo, Yehowa, tee shi;
kaahã adesa miiye kunim.
Hã ni akojo majimaji lɛ yɛ ohiɛ.
20 Oo Yehowa, wo amɛhe gbeyei
koni majimaji lɛ ana ale akɛ
gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ.

Title: LALA 10
Content:
Sɔlemɔ hã jalɛ saneyeli
1 Oo Yehowa, mɛɛba okɛ mi teŋ ejekɛ nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba otee ohe yɛ fimɔ bei amli nɛɛ?
2Mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ ntɛŋ haoɔ ohiafoi.
Hã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.
3Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ
etsuiŋ sɛɛdii nibii anɔ;
ni amimyelɔ lomɔɔ, ni ekwaa Yehowa.
4Mɔ fɔŋ hewoo mli lɛ etaooo Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ;
eyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.”
5 Egbɛi fɛɛ shwereɔ be fɛɛ be;
okojomɔ lɛ kwɔ fe lɛ,
ejwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he;
eyeɔ ehenyɛlɔi ahe fɛo.
6 Ekɛɔ ehe akɛ, “Eshiii mi kpu!
Amanehulu ko baŋ minɔ gbi ko gbi ko.”
7 Loomɔ kɛ kutumpɔo kɛ yiwaa eyi edaaŋ obɔ̃;
haomɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ hɔ elilɛi shishi.
8Ewoɔ ka yɛ akrowai amli;
egbeɔ mɔ ni efeko nɔ ko yɛ nififiaŋ;
ejieɔ ehiɛ ekaa mɔ ni efĩ lɛ.
9 Edɛkeɔ shi tamɔ jata yɛ olɔtɔ mli;
ewoɔ ka koni emɔ ohiafo;
ekɛ akpa duɔ ohiafo;
ni eshãtãa lɛ kɛyaa.
10Ekotoɔ shi, edɛkeɔ shi,
ni mɛi ni he waaa lɛ gbeɔ ekaa mli.
11 Mɔ fɔŋ susuɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ,
“Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekpa nɔ, ekɛ ehiɛ etee;
ni enaŋ gbi ko gbi ko.”
12Oo Yehowa, tee shi!
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, jiemɔ ohewalɛ kpo,
ohiɛ akakpa nɔnalɔi lɛ anɔ.
13Mɛni hewɔ ni mɔ fɔŋ kwaa Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni ekɛɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ, “Etsɛŋ wɔ akɔntaabuu?”
14 Shi bo lɛ onaa nii,
lɛɛlɛŋ bo lɛ okadiɔ haomɔ kɛ awerɛhoo fɛɛ,
koni kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ tu ehe ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ,
oye obua lɛ, ejaakɛ bo ji awusai abualɔ.
15 Fitemɔ yiwalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hewalɛ lɛ;
kolimɔ enifɔɔjianii lɛ amli
kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni onaaa eko dɔŋŋ.
16 Yehowa ji maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ.
Jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã kɛaaje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
17Oo Yehowa, oboɔ humii asɔlemɔ toi;
owoɔ amɛ hewalɛ;
ni obaa otoi shi ohãa mi,
18koni oye awusai kɛ mɛi ni
awaa amɛyi lɛ asane ohã amɛ,
koni gbɔmɔ adesa ni jɛ su mli,
akawo mɔ he gbeyei dɔŋŋ.

Title: LALA 11
Content:
Yehowa nɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1 Yehowa, bo abo mibaa; mɛɛba nyɛkɛɔ mi akɛ,
“Filikimɔ tamɔ loofɔlɔ kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ.
2 Ejaakɛ naa, yiwalɔi edɔrɔ amɛgãii,
ni amɛkɛ gãimlibii lɛ emamɔ
kpãi lɛ anɔ koni amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ mɛi kpakpai yɛ dujiaŋ.
3Kɛji afite shishitoo lɛ,
mɛni jalɔ aaanyɛ afee dɔŋŋ?”
4 Yehowa yɛ eSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ,
Ŋwɛi emaŋtsɛ Sɛi lɛ ma.
Ehiŋmɛi jwere nɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesaiabii feɔ lɛ nɔ.
5 Yehowa kaa jalɔ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ,
shi yiwalɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi lɛ.
6 Eeehã la ni tsoɔ glegle kɛ swɔɔ
anɛ ashwie mɔ fɔŋ nɔ;
kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la ekɛaagbala etoi.
7 Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ni,
ni esumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli;
mɔ ni ja aaana ehiɛ.

Title: LALA 12
Content:
Sɔlemɔ hã yelikɛbuamɔ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ yɛ Sheminith gbɛjianɔtoo naa.
1Yehowa, ye obua wɔ!
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ;
ni anɔkwafoi etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
2Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lakaa enaanyo.
Amɛnaa dɔkɔbii kɛ amɛlilɛi nta.
3Yehowa ahã mɛi ni wieɔ
dɔkɔbii lɛ afee dioo,
kɛ lilɛi ni shwãa nibii wuji lɛ,
4 mɛi hu ni kɛɔ akɛ,
“Wɔkɛ wɔlilɛi aaana nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ.
Wɔnaabui lɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnɔ ni.
Namɔ yeɔ wɔnɔ Nuŋtsɔ?”
5Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ,
“Akɛni awaa ohiafoi ayi,
ni mɛi ni efĩ amɛ lɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ hewɔ lɛ,
agbɛnɛ, mate shi,
ni mɔ ni shweɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ mahere eyiwala.”
6 Yehowa shiwoi lɛ,
shiwoi ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ ni;
amɛtamɔ jwiɛtɛi ni aka yɛ shikpɔŋ flɔnɔɔ mli,
ni atsuu he nɔtoonɔtoo shii kpawo.
7 Oo Yehowa, buu wɔhe;
baamɔ wɔyi daa kɛjɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ.
8Mɛi fɔ̃ji foɔ sa kɛkpeɔ,
ni mɛi fɔ̃ji nyaa yaka saji ahe yɛ gbɔmɛi abii ateŋ.

Title: LALA 13
Content:
Sɔlemɔ hã yelikɛbuamɔ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1 Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po
ni ohiɛ aaakpa minɔ?
Kɛyaashi naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ lo?
Okɛ ohiɛ baatee mi kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
2Mɛɛbe misusuma aaapiŋ,
ni maye awerɛho yɛ mitsuiŋ gbi muu fɛɛ.
Mɛɛbe mihenyɛlɔ aaawo ehe nɔ yɛ minɔ kɛyashi?
3Oo, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ,
kwɛmɔ mi ni ohere mi nɔ;
tsiɛ̃mɔ mi koni mikawɔ gbele wɔ.
4Kaahã mihenyɛlɔ miikɛɛ akɛ,
“Miye enɔ”,
ni mihaolɔi lɛ akanya yɛ mishigbeemɔ hewɔ.
5 Shi mi lɛ, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.
Manya kɛ mitsui fɛɛ,
ejaakɛ obaahere miyiwala.
6Oo Yehowa, mala mahã O,
ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.

Title: LALA 14
Content:
Gbɔmɛi ayitsoŋwalɛ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1Kwashiai kɛɔ yɛ amɛtsuiŋ akɛ,
“Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ!”
Amɛfite, ni amɛfeɔ nyaŋemɔ nii;
mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ nɔ̃ kpakpa.
2 Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ gbɔmɛi abii,
akɛ aleee nɔ eeena akɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni le nii
ni etaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lo?
3 Amɛ fɛɛ amɛdu gbɛ,
amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfite.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ ekpakpa.
Dabida, mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ bɛ.
4 Ani nɔfɔŋfeelɔi lɛ amɛleee nii?
Mɛi ni yeɔ mimaŋbii tamɔ ayeɔ kɔmi,
ni amɛsɔleee amɛtsɛɛɛ Yehowa lɛ, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ!
5Gbeyei kpele aaamɔmɔ amɛ,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ jalɔi lɛ yɛ.
6 Nɔfɔŋfeelɔi aaanyɛ afite ohiafo yiŋtoo nɛ;
shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa ji ebobaahe.
7Oo, kulɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ajɛ Zion aba!
Kɛji Yehowa hã emaŋ lɛ ku sɛɛ na nii ekoŋŋ lɛ,
no lɛ Yakob aaanya,
ni Israel mii aaashɛ ehe.

Title: LALA 15
Content:
Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ
David Lala.
1 Yehowa, namɔ aaabote obuu lɛŋ?
Namɔ aaaja yɛ Zion, ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ?
2 Namɔ baaba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ,
ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja,
ni ewieɔ anɔkwale kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ;
3mɔ ni kɛ elilɛi yeee mɔ he osheku
ni efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko;
ni ebɔɔɔ enaanyo gbɔmɔ ahora.
4Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa amɛ,
shi moŋ ewoɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ ahiɛ nyam;
mɔ ni kɛ ekã kitã ni eeena amane yɛ he po lɛ, etsakeee.
5 Mɔ ni kɛ eshika efaaa eheee hekpa ni fe nine;
ni eheee nyɔɔŋnii koni ewie eshi mɔ ni yeɔ bem.
Mɔ ni feɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, edidãŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.

Title: LALA 16
Content:
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, buu mihe,
ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.
2 Mikɛɔ Yehowa akɛ,
“Bo ji miNuŋtsɔ;
osɛɛ lɛ mibɛ nɔ kpakpa ko.”
3Hetselɔi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
amɛ lɛ, anunyam gbɔmɛi ji amɛ,
ni miyɛ amɛhe tsuijurɔ.
4Shi mɛi ni yanyiɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko sɛɛ lɛ, amɛhaomɔi faa.
Mifɔseŋ lá ni amɛkɛba afɔleshãa lɛ mishwieŋ shi akɛ afɔle;
ni mikɛ minaabu etsiŋ amɛgbɛii atã tete.
5 Yehowa, bo ji minɔ fɛɛ nɔ,
bo ohãa mi mihiamɔ nii fɛɛ.
Bo odɛ̃ŋ miwala yɔɔ.
6Mihusu kpãi eyaje
he ni yɔɔ fɛo ehã mi;
lɛɛlɛŋ, mina gboshinii ni hi naakpa.
7 Majie Yehowa mɔ ni woɔ mi ŋaa lɛ yi;
Mitsui tete kɛ mi wieɔ nyɔɔŋ.
8Mikɛ Yehowa ema mihiɛ daa;
akɛni eyɔɔ mininejurɔ nɔ nɛɛ, mididaŋ.
9 No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui enyɔ mimli,
ni misusuma tete miinya;
migbɔmɔtso hu yɛ shweshweeshwe.
10 Ejaakɛ oŋmɛŋ mihe ohaŋ gbohiiaje,
ni mɔ ni heɔ onɔ eyeɔ lɛ enaŋ gbohiiaje.
11Bo otsɔ̃ɔ mi wala gbɛ.
Ohiɛ lɛ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ;
ni mimii eshɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

Title: LALA 17
Content:
Mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko sɔlemɔ
David sɔlemɔ ko.
1Oo Yehowa, bo jalɛ sane toi;
too otoi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ.
Feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ ni jeee amale ni lɛ.
2 Bo diɛŋtsɛ buu mi bem,
ejaakɛ bo onaa nɔ ni ja.
3 Kɛji oka mitsui okwɛ,
kɛ otao mimli nyɔɔŋ,
ni oka mi okwɛ lɛ,
onaŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko kwraa yɛ mimli;
mikɛ minaabu efeee efɔŋ.
4Yɛ gbɔmɛi adesai anifeemɔnii agbɛfaŋ lɛ,
mibo odaaŋ wiemɔ toi,
ni minyiɛɛɛ yiwalɔi agbɛ lɛ nɔ.
5Minane emɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni mishaneko.
6Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, miibo miitsɛ bo,
ejaakɛ ooohere mi nɔ;
ba otoi shi ohã mi ni obo miwiemɔi lɛ atoi.
7 Jiemɔ onaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ
ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Oo, bo yiwalaherelɔ ni okɛ ohewalɛ
hereɔ mɛi ni taoɔ abobaa lɛ
ayiwala kɛjɛɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
8 Baamɔ miyi tamɔ abaa hiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ yi.
Okɛ mi atee ofiji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli.
9Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ni waa mi yi,
kɛ mihenyɛlɔi kakawuai ni ebɔle mi kɛkpe lɛ adɛŋ.
10Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui,
ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ,
ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabui wieɔ hewoo wiemɔi.
11Amɛjaa misɛɛ mo,
amɛbɔleɔ mihe kɛkpeɔ kpula;
amɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka mi
koni amɛtsi mi amɛtswa shi.
12 Amɛtamɔ jata ni kɛ hiɛdɔɔ
baatserɛ emilɛ loo;
amɛtamɔ jatabi ni ewo antɛo yɛ odɔtɔ mli.
13Oo Yehowa, tee shi owo mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni obutu amɛ.
Okɛ oklante lɛ ajie misusuma yɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.
14 Yehowa, kɛ onineshiwalɛ ajie mi
kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ni amɛna amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ
yɛ wala be nɛɛ mli lɛ adɛŋ.
Hã amɛmusui ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃
kɛ toigbalamɔ ni osaa oto ohã amɛ lɛ;
ni pii ashwɛ ahã amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii.
15Mi lɛ, mana ohiɛ, yɛ jalɛ mli;
ni kɛ mihiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, mitsui aaatɔ,
ejaakɛ mina bɔ ni oyɔɔ.

Title: LALA 18
Content:
David kunimyeli lala
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa be mli ni Yehowa jie lɛ yɛ ehenyɛlɔi kɛ Saul dɛŋ.
1Oo Yehowa, miisumɔ bo; bo ji mihewalɛ.
2 Yehowa ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔɔ ni wa, kɛ mijielɔ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ kɛ mitɛsaa,
mɔ mli ni mibaa abo yɛ;
bo ji mitsɛŋ kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ akloŋto.
Bo ji mimɔɔ ni wa.
3Mibo mitsɛ Yehowa,
mɔ ni sa yijiemɔ lɛ,
ni ehere miyiwala kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
4 Gbele kpãi lalaa mi,
ni ŋshɔkei wuji lota mi.
5Gbohiiaje kpãi lalaa mi kɛkpe,
migbee gbele tsɔnei amli.
6Mifĩmɔ mli lɛ, mitsɛ Yehowa;
mibo mitsɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
koni eye ebua mi.
Ejɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tɔ̃ɔ ni enu migbee;
ni mibolɔmɔ lɛ bote etoiŋ.
7Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo,
ni gɔji lɛ ashishitoo lɛ hu hoso,
ni amɛjo bliblibli;
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli efu.
8 Lasu fã kɛjɛ egugɔ mli kɛtee ŋwɛi;
ni la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ jɛ edaaŋ;
ŋai ni miitso jɛ edaaŋ.
9 Nyɔŋmɔ hã ŋwɛi kpoo enaa shi,
kɛkɛ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebayi shi
ni duŋ kabitii yɛ enajiaŋshi.
10 Eta kerub nɔ, ni efiliki;
eta kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ kɛkpeleke shi oya.
11 Ekɛ duŋ ha ehe;
oblɔtu kpii ni eshi lutulutu
eshi yɛ eyiteŋ tamɔ akatamanso.
12Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi kɛ ŋai ni miitso
kpɛlɛ kɛtsɔ̃ oblɔtu kabitii lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ ehiɛ.
13Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa shi yɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ ŋwɛi shiimɔ,
ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ wo egbee.
14 Etsɛ̃rɛ egãimlibii lɛ,
ni ekɛgbɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ eshwã.
Ehã srawa gbalagbalai
ni ekɛgbɛ amɛ eshwã kɛ foi.
15Oo Yehowa, oyiŋaa naa
kɛ ogugɔŋ mumɔ gbɛɛmɔ naa
hã ŋshɔ mli ŋkajai lɛ je kpo,
ni je lɛ shishitoo lɛ bakamɔ shi faŋŋ.
16 Ekpã enine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni ebawo mi,
ni egbala mi kɛjɛ nui babaoo mli.
17Ejie mi kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni he wa
lɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni hetsɛ̃ɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ;
ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe mi kwraa.
18Amɛbatua mi yɛ mimanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ;
shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã mihe.
19Ejie mi kɛtee he ni lɛɛ lɛkɛtɛɛ.
Ejie mi, ejaakɛ eyɛ mihe tsui.
20Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa;
ejuro mi, ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ mihe.
21Ejaakɛ miba mijeŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ,
ni mijeko miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.
22 Ejaakɛ miye emlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ,
ni mikuko ekpɔi lɛ ekoeko mli.
23 Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe yɛ ehiɛ,
ni miwiɔ mihe kɛjeɔ nɔsha he.
24Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ naa,
ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ midɛŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
25Yehowa, mɛi ni yeɔ bo anɔkwa lɛ,
bo diɛŋtsɛ oyeɔ amɛ anɔkwa;
ni mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ,
ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ
bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ shwamɔ bɛ ohe.
26Mɔ ni he tse lɛ, ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ oyɛ krɔŋŋ;
ni mɔ ni bɛ eŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yeee.
27 Mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ, ohereɔ amɛ;
shi hiŋmɛii ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ, obaa amɛ shi.
28Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ,
lɛɛlɛŋ bo ohãa mi kane;
ni ohãa miduŋ mli kpɛɔ kɛ la.
29 Lɛɛlɛŋ, ohewalɛ naa lɛ,
mabutu henyɛlɔi asafo.
MiNyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ,
mahuru gbogbo.
30 Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, enifeemɔinii fɛɛ hi kɛwula shi.
Yehowa yeɔ eshiwoi anɔ.
Eji tsɛŋ kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
31Shi namɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ Yehowa sɛɛ?
Ni namɔ ji wɔbobaahe yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
32Lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni miãa mi kɛ hewalɛ;
ni ehãa mifeɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ migbɛi fɛɛ amli.
33 Ehã minajiaŋ wa tamɔ ofrote,
ni eŋɔ mi edamɔ gɔji anɔ shweshweeshwe.
34 Etsɔ̃ɔ mi tawuu,
koni manyɛ akɔɔble gãi po mli madɔ.
35 Oo Yehowa, okɛ oyiwalaheremɔ tsɛŋ
lɛ ehere miyiwala;
ni ohewalɛ hiɛ mimli,
ni oyibaamɔ lɛ ehã mije agbo.
36 Ohãa mifamɔɔ minaji zãaŋzãaŋ, ni mishaneee.
37Mitiu mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ni minina amɛ;
mikpaleee kɛjeee amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi miplenee amɛ.
38Mitswia amɛ nii bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ.
Amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ minaji anaa.
39Ejaakɛ omia mi, ni mina hewalɛ kɛhã tawuu,
ni ohã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔnyɔɔi yɛ mihiɛ.
40Ohã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ tsɔ̃
amɛsɛɛ amɛhã mi,
ni mikpãtã mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.
41 Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ;
shi mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaaa amɛ.
Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa,
shi efooo amɛdaaŋ.
42Miwiɛ amɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ
ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu
ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa.
Miloo amɛ mishwie tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
43Ohãaa maŋsɔ̃ aba
mi kɛ maŋbii ateŋ.
Ofee mi majimaji lɛ atsɛ;
mɛi ni mileee amɛ po basɔmɔ mi.
44Maŋsɛɛbii ba amɛhe shi amɛhã mi;
amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛaanu mihe lɛ,
amɛkotoɔ mi.
45Maŋsɛɛbii atsui fã,
ni amɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ je kpo
kɛjɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli kɛba.
46Yehowa hiɛ kã;
ajie mitɛsaa lɛ yi;
ni awo miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
47Nyɔŋmɔ ni tɔɔ mihe owele,
ni ebaa maji ashi ewoɔ mishishi lɛ.
48Lɛ mɔ ni ehereɔ mi
kɛjɛɔ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Hɛɛ, bo owoɔ minɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi anɔ;
bo ojieɔ mi yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
49 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ,
ni mala majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
50 Yehowa hãa emaŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ kunim kpelekplei,
ni ejieɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ
kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ;
ni ji David kɛ eshwiei lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.

Title: LALA 19
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam ni yɔɔ adebɔɔ mli
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1 Ŋwɛi gbaa Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ,
ni atatu jieɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ lɛ kpo.
2Gbi fɛɛ gbi gbaa anunyam lɛ,
ni nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔɔŋ shiɛɔ enilee lɛ.
3Anuuu gbee ko, anuuu wiemɔ ko.
Ni anuuu amɛgbee ko nɛ,
4 shi kɛ̃lɛ nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ kpeleɔ jeŋ fɛɛ,
ni anuɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Nyɔŋmɔ eshi buu yɛ ŋwɛi ehã hulu,
ni hulu fãa kɛjeɔ kpo,
5tamɔ ayɛmforowu jeɔ kpo kɛjɛɔ epia mli;
ni emliflimɔ lɛ, etamɔ foidalɔ
mliflimɔ ni ekɛdaa foi.
6 Ejeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome,
ni ebɔleɔ shi kɛyaa naagbeehe kroko,
ni nɔ ko nɔ ko eteee ehe
yɛ enaa la lɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ
7 Yehowa mla lɛ hi kɛwula shi;
ehãa gbɔmɔ susuma naa hewalɛ hee.
Yehowa mla lɛ maa shi shiŋŋ;
ehãa humii leɔ nii.
8 Yehowa akpɔi lɛ ja pɛ,
amɛhãa mɔ tsui nyaa.
Yehowa kitãi lɛ yɛ krɔŋŋ,
amɛhãa mɔ hiŋmɛi gbeleɔ.
9Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ he tse,
ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Yehowa kojomɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni,
fɛɛ ja kɛmɔ shi.
10 Amɛyɛ akɔnɔ fe shika,
amɛfe shika krɔŋŋ tete;
amɛŋɔɔ fe wo hu,
amɛŋɔɔ fe wo agbaku po.
11Asaŋ nomɛi bɔɔ otsulɔ kɔkɔ;
amɛnɔyeli lɛ, sɛɛnamɔ kpele yɛ mli.
12 Namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etɔmɔi ena?
Yehowa, jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ midujiaŋ tɔ̃mɔi amli.
13 Baamɔ mi otsulɔ, miyi kɛjɛ
eshai ni gbɔmɔ hiɛ kã he ni efeɔ lɛ mli.
Kaahã eshai lɛ miiye minɔ;
no dani mahi kɛwula shi,
ni mihe aaaje tɔ̃mɔi kpelei amli.
14Yehowa, hã midaaŋ wiemɔ
kɛ mitsuiŋ susumɔi asa ohiɛ;
bo mitɛsaa kɛ mikpɔlɔ lɛ!

Title: LALA 20
Content:
Kunimyeli he sɔlemɔ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1 Yehowa abo bo toi yɛ ofimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ!
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu ohe.
2Ejɛ ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eye ebua bo,
ni ejɛ Zion ewaje bo.
3Ekai afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ kwa,
ni oshãa afɔlei lɛ asa ehiɛ.
4 Ehã bo nii ni otsui shweɔ lɛ,
ni ehã oyiŋtoi fɛɛ aba mli.
5Wɔɔbɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ
yɛ okunimyeli hewɔ;
ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli
wɔɔshi wɔflaŋai yɛ.
Yehowa ahã bo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni obiɔ lɛ.
6 Agbɛnɛ mina mile akɛ
Yehowa yeɔ ebuaa maŋtsɛ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ,
ni eeejɛ eŋwɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ebo lɛ toi,
ni Yehowa aaahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛye kunim.
7 Mɛi komɛi shwãa fɔ̃ɔ
tayaa shwiilii anɔ,
ni mɛi komɛi hu okpɔŋɔi anɔ;
shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
hewalɛ nɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ.
8Nakai mɛi lɛ, amɛaatswia shi,
ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi;
shi wɔ lɛ, wɔɔte shi,
wɔɔdamɔ shi shiŋŋ.
9Oo Yehowa, hã maŋtsɛ lɛ aye kunim;
kɛ wɔfo wɔtsɛ bo lɛ,
heremɔ wɔ nɔ.

Title: LALA 21
Content:
Yijiemɔ yɛ kunimyeli hewɔ
David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ yɛ;
ni oyelikɛbuamɔ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ nyaa yɛ.
2 Nɔ ni etsui shweɔ lɛ, ohãa lɛ;
ni nɔ ni ebiɔ lɛ, okamãaa lɛ.
3 Ejaakɛ okɛ nii kpakpai amli jɔɔmɔi kumaa lɛ,
ni okɛ shika krɔŋŋ akekre fiɔ eyitso.
4Eba wala yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, ni ohã lɛ;
wala kakadaŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.
5Oyelikɛbuamɔ hewɔ lɛ, enunyam lɛ da;
oduro lɛ woo kɛ agbojee.
6Ojɔɔ lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Na ni enaa bo hãa emii shɛɔ ehe.
7Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ;
ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ suɔmɔ
ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, edidãŋ.
8Maŋtsɛ lɛ nine aaashɛ ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ anɔ;
mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ,
onine aaashɛ amɛnɔ.
9Kɛ ojie ohe kpo lɛ,
oooŋala amɛ tamɔ flɔɔnɔɔ mli la.
Yehowa aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ emlifu lɛ naa,
ni la lɛ aaashã amɛ wɛɛ.
10 Oookpãtã amɛshwiei lɛ ahiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
oookpãtã amɛbii lɛ hu ahiɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi adesai ateŋ.
11 Kɛ amɛjwɛŋ ohe efɔŋ,
ni amɛto ohe ŋaa gbonyo lɛ, amɛyeŋ kunim.
12 Ejaakɛ ooota ogãi lɛ oma amɛhiɛ
ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛjo foi.
13Oo, Yehowa, wɔmiiwo onɔ gojoo
yɛ ohewalɛ kpele lɛ hewɔ!
Wɔbaala kɛjie ohewalɛ lɛ yi.

Title: LALA 22
Content:
Piŋmɔŋ blɔmɔ kɛ yijiemɔ lala
David Lala ko ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1 MiNyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ,
mɛɛba okwa mi?
Mɛɛba okɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ teŋ jɛkɛ nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba okɛ mikɛ̃ɛmɔ teŋ jɛkɛ nɛkɛ?
2Oo, miNyɔŋmɔ, mibolɔɔ shwane,
shi ohereee mi nɔ.
Mibolɔɔ nyɔɔŋ hu, ni mijɔɔɔ mihe.
3Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji bo;
mɔ koome pɛ yi ni Israel jieɔ kɛ lalai lɛ.
4Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ he bo ye,
ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ onɔ ni ojie amɛ.
5 Bo amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ,
ni ohere amɛ.
Bo onɔ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ ni amɛhiɛ gboiii!
6 Shi mi lɛ, gɔgɔmi kɛkɛ ji mi,
mishɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ.
Mɛi bɔɔ mi ahora,
ni mɛi nyaŋeɔ mi.
7 Mɛi fɛɛ ni naa mi lɛ yeɔ mihe fɛo;
amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ, ni amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei,
8 Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Tuu osane lɛ owo Yehowa dɛŋ;
hã ni lɛ ehere bo,
hã ni lɛ ehere mɔ he miishɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ.”
9 Bo ojie mi kɛjɛ minyɛ musu mli,
ohiɛ mi shweshweeshwe,
be ni mikã minyɛ fufɔ naa.
10Kɛjɛ mifɔmɔ mli beebe,
aŋɔ mi aŋmɛ onɔ.
Kɛjɛ be ni minyɛ fɔ mi nɛɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.
11Okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ,
ejaakɛ shi haomɔ ebɛŋkɛ,
ni bualɔ ko bɛ.
12Henyɛlɔi babaoo ebɔle mi kɛkpe kpula,
tamɔ tsina hii,
amɛtamɔ Bashan tsina hii hewalɔi,
ni efo sa ewo mihe.
13Amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ hatohatoo amɛwoɔ mi;
amɛtamɔ jata kramakrama ni miihuu.
14 Aloo mi ashwie tamɔ nu,
ni mitalɔi amli egoi:
ni mitsui esere yɛ mimli tamɔ wo agbaku.
15 Misɛŋ egbi tamɔ ŋɛsuko mli,
mililɛi ekpɛtɛ midaaŋ;
ni oshi mi oŋmɛ su mli tamɔ gbonyo.
16 Henyɛlɔi ebɔle mi kɛkpe tamɔ shifɔji;
mɛi fɔ̃ji asafo efo sa ewo mihe kpula,
amɛtserɛ miniji kɛ minaji.
17Manyɛ makane mimli wui fɛɛ;
mihenyɛlɔi lɛ taa gãa amɛkwɛɔ mi.
18 Amɛja mitadei lɛ amli amɛhã amɛhe,
ni mihebo lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki.
19Oo Yehowa, kaahi sɛɛ shɔŋŋ.
Oo, bo mihewalɛ, feemɔ oya ni oye obua mi.
20 Jiemɔ misusuma kɛjɛ klante naa gbele mli,
heremɔ miyiwala kɛjɛ shifɔji lɛ adɛŋ.
21Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ jatai adaaŋ,
heremɔ miyiwala kɛje wuoi akoji ateŋ.
22 Majaje onifeemɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ minyɛmimɛi lɛ,
ni majie oyi yɛ asafo lɛ mli.
23Nyɛ Yehowa gbeyeishelɔi,
nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
Nyɛ Yakob shwiei fɛɛ,
nyɛwoa ehiɛ nyam;
ni nyɛ Israel shwiei bluublu,
nyɛkɛ woo ahãa lɛ.
24 Ejaakɛ ekwaaa nɔnalɔ nɔnaa lɛ,
ni ekuuu ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ nɔnalɔ nɔ.
Shi be ni nɔnalɔ bo etsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehere lɛ nɔ.
25 Bo ohãa mijieɔ oyi yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli;
maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei
ni amɛjaa bo lɛ ahiɛ.
26 Ohiafoi aaaye nii, ni amɛaatɔrɔ;
mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, aaajie eyi.
Amɛyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ.
27Jeŋ koji kpawo lɛ aaakai,
ni amɛaakpale kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ;
ni majimaji lɛ amli akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaakula shi amɛja lɛ.
28Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni,
ni lɛ eyeɔ majimaji lɛ anɔ.
29 Lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewolɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaakoto.
Mɛi ni egboi momo,
kɛ mɛi ni baagboi fɛɛ baakoto lɛ.
30 Yinɔbii fɛɛ aaasɔmɔ lɛ,
gbɔmɛi baagba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he sane
atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ.
31 Abaajaje atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni afɔko tete lɛ akɛ lɛ, Yehowa lɛ,
ehere maŋ lɛ yiwala.

Title: LALA 23
Content:
Yehowa ji mikwɛlɔ
David Lala ko.
1 Yehowa ji mikwɛlɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko ehiaŋ mi.
2 Ehãa mibuɔ shi yɛ lɛɛhei ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃.
Ewaa mi kɛyaa nui ni he jɔ lɛ ahe.
3 Ehãa minaa hewalɛ hee.
Ekpalaa mi kɛtsɔ̃ɔ jalɛ gbɛi anɔ yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
4 Asaŋ kɛ minyiɛ gbele hɔ̃ɔŋ jɔɔ lɛŋ tete lɛ,
misheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei,
ejaakɛ okɛ mi yɛ.
Otookplamɔtso kɛ odɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ,
nomɛi shɛjeɔ mimii.
5 Oŋmɛɔ mi okplɔ̃ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ahiɛ.
Okɛ mu fɔɔ miyitso
mikpulu lɛ eyi kɛteke nɔ.
6 Lɛɛlɛŋ, ejurɔyeli kɛ omɔbɔnalɛ
aaanyiɛ misɛɛ yɛ miwala be lɛ fɛɛ mli;
ni asaŋ, mahi Yehowa we lɛ
miwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.

Title: LALA 24
Content:
Maŋtsɛ Wulu lɛ
David Lala ko.
1Shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ,
Yehowa nɔ ni;
ni je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, enɔ ni.
2 Ejaakɛ lɛ eto shishi
yɛ ŋshɔi ashishi tɔ̃ɔ̃
ni ehã ema shi shiŋŋ yɛ fai anɔ.
3 Namɔ aaakwɔ Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ?
Ni namɔ aaadamɔ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?
4 Mɛi ni amɛdɛŋ bɛ esha ko
ni amɛtsuii amli tse.
Mɛi ni kɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei hãaa yakayaka nifeemɔ,
ni amɛkãaa amale kitã.
5 Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ,
amɛaana jɔɔmɔ kɛaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.
Amɛaana bembuu kɛaajɛ
amɛyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
6 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji gbɔmɛi ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ,
mɛi ni baa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
7 Oo nyɛ agboi, nyɛholea nyɛyitsei anɔ!
Oo nyɛ blema shinai,
nyɛholea nyɛhe nɔ koni anunyam maŋtsɛ lɛ aba mli.
8Namɔ ji anunyam maŋtsɛ nɛɛ?
Lɛ ji Yehowa, hewalɔ kɛ kãkãlɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ji Yehowa, ta mli kunimyelɔ lɛ.
9Nyɛgbelea agboi lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a,
nyɛgbelea blema shinai lɛ,
koni anunyam maŋtsɛ lɛ aba mli.
10Namɔ ji anunyam maŋtsɛ nɛɛ?
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni.
Lɛ ji anunyam maŋtsɛ lɛ.

Title: LALA 25
Content:
Sɔlemɔ kɛhã kudɔmɔ kɛ hebuu
David Lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, bo miwoɔ misusuma nɔ mihãa.
2Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, bo onɔ mihiɛ kã,
kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi,
kaahã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ.
3 Lɛɛlɛŋ, mɛi ni
kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ onɔ lɛ,
ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ
eshwieŋ shi.
Mɛi ni ji yaka atuatselɔi lɛ
moŋ ahiɛ aaagboi.
4 Oo Yehowa, hã male ogbɛ̃i lɛ;
tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi otempɔ̃ŋi lɛ.
5Kplamɔ mi kɛnyiɛ onɔkwale lɛ mli,
ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii;
ejaakɛ bo ji miyiwalaheremɔ
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Bo onɔ mihiɛ kã daa nɛɛ.
6Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ omɔbɔnalɛ
kɛ omlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ,
ejaakɛ amɛyɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe.
7 Oo Yehowa, kaakai miblahiaŋ eshai kɛ tɔ̃mɔi lɛ;
shi moŋ kaimɔ mi yɛ omlihilɛ
kɛ okpakpafeemɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ.
8Yehowa hi, ni jalɔ ji lɛ,
hewɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ eshafeelɔi gbɛ ni ja.
9Ekpalaa heshibalɔi kɛnyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ,
ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ egbɛ lɛ.
10Suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo,
kɛ anɔkwayeli sɔŋŋ ji Yehowa gbɛi fɛɛ,
kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ
kɛ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
11Oo Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
ŋɔɔ mihe esha lɛ ofa mi, ejaakɛ eda.
12 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ,
lɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ ni enyiɛ nɔ.
13 Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeshwere,
ni eshwiei aaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
14 Mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ,
amɛ ekɛbɔɔ naanyo,
ni ehãa amɛleɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.
15Mihiŋmɛii kwɛɔ Yehowa gbɛ daa nɛɛ;
ejaakɛ lɛ eeejie minaji kɛaaje yaa mli.
16Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã mi,
ni ona mi mɔbɔ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ kome mɔ ji mi;
minii yɛ mɔbɔ.
17Mitsui mli haomɔi lɛ fa;
jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mifimɔi lɛ amli!
18Kwɛmɔ minɔnaai lɛ,
kɛ mihaomɔi lɛ;
ni okɛ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ afa mi.
19 Kwɛmɔ mihenyɛlɔi,
ejaakɛ amɛyi fa;
kwɛ bɔ ni amɛkɛ yiwaa nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ.
20 Oo, buu miwala he ni ohere mi;
kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi,
ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.
21 Emuuyeli kɛ jalɛ abaa miyi;
ejaakɛ bo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.
22 Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, kpɔ̃ Israel kɛje ehaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.

Title: LALA 26
Content:
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ko sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, buu mi bem,
ejaakɛ miiba mijeŋ jogbaŋŋ,
ni mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ kwraa ni migbaŋ afã.
2 Oo Yehowa, taomɔ mimli ni oka mi okwɛ.
