ni osrawai kpɛlɛ ni je lɛ mli tse,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo, ni ehoso.
19Ofo ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ.
Onyiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔkei lɛ amli;
shi anaaa onanemaamɔhei.
20 Otsɔ̃ Mose kɛ Aaron nɔ,
okpala omaŋbii lɛ tamɔ akpalaa tooku.

Title: LALA 78
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ewebii lɛ
Asaf lala ko.
1Oo mimaŋ, nyɛboa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ atoi;
nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ!
2 Magbele minaa mawie yɛ abɛbuaiaŋ,
magbala blema teemɔŋ saji amli,
3 nii ni wɔnu, ni wɔle,
ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gba wɔ lɛ.
4Wɔshiuŋ amɛbii lɛ saji lɛ ekoeko nɔ;
shi wɔɔgba yinɔbii ni baa lɛ
Yehowa anunyam nitsumɔi lɛ
kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ.
5Ewo mlai ehã Yakob shwiei
kɛ akpɔi ehã Israelbii.
Ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã
akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii mlai nɛɛ;
6bɔ ni afee ni nyɛbii
ni baaba lɛ ana ale nii nɛɛ;
bii ni anako afɔ tete,
koni amɛ hu amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii.
7Ewo mlai nɛɛ
bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ afɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ,
koni amɛhiɛ akakpa Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ,
shi amɛye ekitãi lɛ anɔ,
8 koni amɛkatamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi
kaniŋkajelɔi kɛ yinɔbii atuatselɔi lɛ,
yinɔbii ni amɛhemɔkɛyeli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli fiii shi kpɛŋŋ,
ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ.
9Tawuu gbi lɛ, Efraimbii
ni emia kɛ gãi lɛ jo foi.
10Amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ,
ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛaaba amɛjeŋ yɛ emla lɛ naa.
11Amɛhiɛ kpa nɔ ni etsu
kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni efee etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ anɔ.
12 Efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ
yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ.
13 Egba ŋshɔ lɛŋ, ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃ mli kɛho;
ni ehã ŋshɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo ni ma shi.
14 Shwane lɛ ekɛ atatu tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ,
ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ la gboŋaa tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ.
15 Ehã tɛsai amli gbalagbalai yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ,
ni ehã amɛ nu babaoo ni jɛ shikpɔŋ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ amɛnu.
16Ehã nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛŋ,
ni ehã nu ho tamɔ faa.
17Shi amɛkã he amɛfee esha amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni amɛtse Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ hiɛ atua yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
18 Amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ
kɛ niyenii ni baa amɛtsine ni amɛbi lɛ.
19Amɛwie amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkɛɛ:
“Ani Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lo?
20Etswa tɛsaa lɛ nɔ,
ni nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ mli;
ni eyi kɛteke nɔ etsɔ̃ faa tete.
Ani eeenyɛ niyenii hu eduro,
aloo ehã emaŋ lɛ loo lo?”
21 No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yehowa nu lɛ,
emli fu naakpa eje la ewo Israel he;
emlifu te shi ewo Israel naakpa,
22ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ amɛyeee,
ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eyiwalaheremɔ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ.
23Kɛ̃lɛ efã ŋwɛi,
ni egbele ŋwɛi agboi lɛ anaa,
24 ni enɛ mana eshwie amɛnɔ koni amɛye;
ehã amɛ ŋwɛiŋmãa lɛ eko.
25Gbɔmɔ adesã ye ŋwɛi bɔfoi aniyenii;
ehã amɛ niyenii babaoo amɛye amɛtɔrɔ.
26Ehã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa yɛ ŋwɛi,
ehã wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa yɛ ehewalɛ naa.
27Enɛ loo eshwie amɛnɔ tamɔ mlu;
enɛ loofɔji hu tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.
28Ehã loofɔji lɛ shwie shi
yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ teŋ kɛbɔle amɛwɔɔhei lɛ.
29Amɛye, ni amɛtɔrɔ kɛteke nɔ,
ejaakɛ ehã amɛ nɔ ni baa amɛtsine lɛ.
30Shi amɛtsinebaanii lɛ nako eje amɛtsine,
amɛmiiye nii lɛ lolo,
31 kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ te shi wo amɛ,
ni egbe amɛteiaŋ oblaŋi lɛ,
ni ji Israel oblahii kãkãlɔi lɛ.
32Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
amɛkã he amɛfee esha;
enaakpɛɛnii lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
amɛheee lɛ amɛyeee.
33 No hewɔ lɛ,
ehã amɛwala sɛɛ fo tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ;
amɛfii lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ haomɔ.
34Kɛ egbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ,
fãbii lɛ taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ;
amɛshwaa amɛhe,
ni amɛtaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
35Amɛkaiɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛbobaahe,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, ji amɛkpɔ̃lɔ.
36Shi amɛhɔlɔ lɛ kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi,
ni amɛmale amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
37Amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛfi shi kɛye lɛ anɔkwa,
amɛyeee ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli anɔkwa.
38Shi lɛ lɛ, akɛni mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
ekɛ amɛnɔsha lɛ fa amɛ,
ni ekpãtãaa amɛhiɛ.
Bei pii lɛ, emiɔ ŋɔɔ,
ni ehãaa emli awo la kɛteke nɔ.
39 Ekai akɛ adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ,
kɔɔyɔɔ ni hoɔ eyaa
ni ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.
40 Kwɛ shii abɔ ni amɛtse
ehiɛ atua yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ,
ni amɛfee lɛ nidɔɔnii yɛ shiaŋa lɛŋ.
41Amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ nɔtoonɔtoo,
ni amɛwo Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli la.
42Amɛhiɛ kpa ehewalɛ lɛ,
kɛ gbi ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ nɔ;
43amɛhiɛ kpa ekadii lɛ ni efee yɛ Ijipt,
kɛ enaakpɛɛ nibii lɛ yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.
44 Ehã amɛfai lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ lá
ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ fai lɛ amli nu amɛnu.
45 Ehã ofɔii bashwie amɛnɔ, ni amɛye amɛ;
ni ehã kɔkɔdenei hu, kpãtã amɛhiɛ.
46 Ehã gɔgɔmii ye amɛŋmɔshinii,
ni baalabii kpãtã amɛnitsumɔnii ahiɛ.
47 Ekɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi bibii kpãtã amɛwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ,
ni ekɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji gbe amɛsikamore tsei lɛ.
48Ekpãtã amɛtsinai lɛ ahiɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi,
ni ekpãtã amɛtoi ahiɛ kɛ srawai.
49Ehã emlifu ni naa wa lɛ,
kɛ egrimɔ kɛ emlila kɛ hejaramɔ ba amɛnɔ;
ehã bɔfoi fɔ̃ji asafo bakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
50 Ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii kwraa,
ni ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko he ekeee lɛ,
shi ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã gbele hela.
51Egbe Ijiptbii akromɔbii fɛɛ,
Ham shwiei akromɔbii lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ.
52 Ejie emaŋbii lɛ kɛje kpo tamɔ toi,
ni ekpala amɛ kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ tooku.
53 Ekpala amɛ shweshweeshwe bɔ ni amɛsheee gbeyei;
shi ŋshɔ lɛ gbe amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ,
54 ni ekɛ amɛ ba Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ,
gɔŋ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ shɔ̃ lɛ he.
55Eshwie majimaji lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ,
ni eja shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnii,
ni ehã Israel akutsei lɛ hi nɔ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe.
56Kɛ̃lɛ amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ,
ni amɛtse ehiɛ atua,
ni amɛyeee ekitãi lɛ anɔ.
57 Amɛgba afã, ni amɛyeee anɔkwa
tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ;
amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãi ni ekɔ̃dɔ̃.
58 Amɛkɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ wo emli la,
ni amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ hã eye awuŋã.
59Nyɔŋmɔ mli wo la be ni ena amãgãi lɛ,
no hewɔ lɛ, ekwa Israel kwrakwra.
60 Ekwa eshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ Shilo lɛ,
ni ji buu mli ni ehi yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ.
61Eŋmɛ gbɛ ni henyɛlɔi shɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ,
enunyam kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ he okadi lɛ, kɛtee.
62Emli wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi lɛ la,
ni ehã amɛgboi yɛ klante naa.
63La kpãtã oblahii lɛ ahiɛ,
ni amɛblayei lɛ,
alaaa yookpeemɔ lala ko ahãaa amɛ.
64 Amɛsɔfoi nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa,
ni amɛkulafoi lɛ wooo yara amɛfooo amɛ.
65Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ te shi,
tamɔ mɔ ko ni jɛ wɔ mli,
oookɛɛ kãkãlɔ ni dãa eba ehiɛ.
66Eshwie ehenyɛlɔi lɛ,
ewo amɛ naanɔ hiɛgbele.
67Shi egbɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ eshwã,
ni eŋɔ̃ɔɔ Efraim akutso lɛ hu.
68Shi moŋ eŋɔ Yuda akutso lɛ,
Zion Gɔŋ lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ.
69Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ jɛi
tamɔ shihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
Eto lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ebɔ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.
70Ehala etsulɔ David,
eŋɔ lɛ kɛje ŋa lɛ nɔ.
71Ekpala lɛ kɛjɛ toi yei ni hãa fufɔ lɛ asɛɛ,
koni ebakpala emaŋ Israelbii,
Israelbii ni ji egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.
72David jie etsuiŋ fɛɛ kɛlɛ amɛ,
ni ekɛŋaa kpakpa kpala amɛ.

Title: LALA 79
Content:
Maŋ lɛ kpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ
Asaf lala ko.
1Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, jeŋmajiaŋbii ebabote oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
amɛbule oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,
ni amɛfee Yerusalɛm koikoi.
2Amɛkɛ otsuji lɛ agbohii hã ŋwɛi loofɔji, ni amɛye;
amɛkɛ omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbohii hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi.
3Amɛshwie omɛi lɛ alá shi tamɔ nu kɛbɔle Yerusalɛm;
ni anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko po afu amɛ.
4 Wɔhewɔ maji lɛ miibɔ wɔ ahora;
amɛŋmɔɔ wɔ, ni amɛyeɔ wɔhe fɛo.
5 Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ omli aaafu kɛyaashi?
Ani omli aaafu kɛya naanɔ lo?
Ani owuŋayeli atso tamɔ la lo?
6 Okɛ omlila lɛ atua maji ni leee bo lɛ
kɛ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ ni jaaa bo lɛ,
7ejaakɛ amɛgbe omaŋbii, Israelbii lɛ,
ni amɛfee amɛshihilɛhe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
8Kaakwɛ wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ
anishaianii lɛ ahewɔ ni ogbala wɔtoi.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, ni oba wɔŋɔɔ mra,
ejaakɛ aba wɔ shi naakpa.
9Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,
ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam hewɔ lɛ,
heremɔ wɔyiwala!
Ni okɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ afa wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
10 Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ maji lɛ akɛɛ akɛ,
“Nɛgbɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?”
Hã majimaji lɛ ale,
ni hã wɔ hu wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛi,
nɔ owele ni obaatɔ yɛ otsuji lɛ ala shi ni ashwie lɛ hewɔ.
11 Bo gboklɛfoi lɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔi atoi;
ni yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ,
heremɔ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ ayiwala.
12 Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ahora ni maji
ni yɔɔ wɔmasɛi ebɔ bo lɛ,
bɔɔ he nakai toi kpawo oshãkã amɛtsitsi.
13Kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ owebii,
olɛɛhe lɛ toi lɛ,
wɔɔda bo shi kɛaatee naanɔ;
ni wɔɔgba onifeemɔi lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ kɛjie oyi
kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyashi yinɔ.

Title: LALA 80
Content:
Israel shitee ekoŋŋ he sɔlemɔ
Odaseyeli. Asaf lala ko.
1 Oo Israel Kpalalɔ, bo toi!
Bo ni okpala Yosef tamɔ tooku,
Bo ni ota kerubim anɔ,
baajie ohe shi faŋŋ otsɔ̃ɔ.
2Yɛ Efraim kɛ Benyamin kɛ Manase hiɛ.
Teemɔ ohewalɛ lɛ shi ni oba obahere wɔ!
3Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala!
4Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ,
kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po
ni omlifu aaajɛle awo omaŋ,
ni oboŋ omaŋbii asɔlemɔ toi?
5 Ohã yaafo tsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ ŋmaa,
ni ohã yaafonu pii tsɔ̃ amɛnu ni amɛnu.
6Ohã wɔhewɔ maji lɛ pele
wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ he;
ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ŋmɔ wɔ.
7Oo Tai aNyɔŋmɔ,
okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala.
8 Wɔba tamɔ waintso kɛjɛ Ijipt;
oshwie maji lɛ,
ni obatɛo wɔ yɛ jɛi.
9Osaa shikpɔŋ ohã lɛ;
etsɛ̃rɛ fãi kɛtee shikpɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ,
ni ekpele shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
10Ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ ha gɔji lɛ anɔ,
ni eniji lɛ ha tsenedrui wuji lɛ anɔ;
11ekpã eniji lɛ amli kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ,
aahu kɛyanina Eufrate Faa lɛ.
12 Mɛni hewɔ mɔ okumɔ waintso lɛ he afabaŋ lɛ,
ni mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ tserɛɔ enɔ yibii nɛɛ?
13Batafo jeɔ koo mli ebakpãtãa ehiɛ,
ni ŋaŋ kooloi hu miiye eyibii.
14Oo Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, kwɛmɔ wɔ!
Jɛɛ ŋwɛi okwɛ ni ohere omaŋbii ayiwala.
15Ba koni obabaa waintso lɛ
ni otɛo yɛ ohewalɛ naa lɛ yi!
16Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ema enaa la amɛshã,
ni amɛtoo amɛfɔ̃ shi.
Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo amɛ kɛ mlifu
koni okpãtã amɛhiɛ!
17Baamɔ omaŋbii ni ji owebii
ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ ayi,
maŋ ni ohã ena hewalɛ lɛ.
18Kɛkɛ lɛ wɔkpaleŋ yɛ osɛɛ dɔŋŋ!
Hã wɔyi ana wala,
ni wɔɔja bo.
19Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ,
okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ
ni ona wɔ mɔbɔ,
koni wɔyi ana wala.

Title: LALA 81
Content:
Gbijurɔyeli lala
Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni atswa yɛ Gittith gbɛjianɔtoo naa lɛ.
1Nyɛlaa waa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ
mɔ ni ji wɔhewalɛ lɛ;
nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ nyamɔ nyɛhãa
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!
2Nyɛwoa lala,
ni nyɛtswaa ŋoŋo;
nyɛkɛ saŋku kɛ obenta
atswaa lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.
3 Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ
yɛ wɔgbijurɔyeli gbi lɛ nɔ,
be ni nyɔŋ hee eje,
kɛ be hu ni nyɔŋ lɛ eye emuu,
4ejaakɛ eji akpɔ hã Israel,
akpɔ ni jɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
5Eŋɔ hã Israelbii lɛ,
be ni ete shi ewo Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Minu gbee ko ni mileee kɛɛ akɛ,
6“Miwo jatsu lɛ yɛ nyɛkɔ̃ji anɔ,
ni mijie nyɛniji yɛ kɛntɛŋ he.
7 Nyɛhaomɔ mli lɛ,
nyɛtsɛ mi, ni mihere nyɛ.
Mihere nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔhe lɛ.
Mika nyɛ mikwɛ yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he.
8Oo mimaŋbii, nyɛboa toi,
be mli ni mibɔɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ!
Oo Israel, mina ni obo mi toi!
9Nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko kwraa akahi nyɛteŋ;
nyɛkajaa maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko kwraa.
10Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Gbɛɛ odaaŋ hatoo ni mawo lɛ obɔ̃ mahã bo.
11“Shi mimaŋ lɛ booo migbee toi;
Israel baaa ehe shi ehãaa mi.
12 No hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛɛ amɛhe
koni amɛhi shi
yɛ amɛtsuiwalɛ lɛ mli,
koni amɛhi shi bɔ ni
amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ.
13Mina ni mimaŋ lɛ bo mi toi,
ni Israel ba ejeŋ bɔ ni, mi, mitaoɔ.
14Kulɛ etsɛŋ ni mibaba amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashi,
ni maye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
15Mɛi ni nyɛɔ Yehowa lɛ,
aaaba abakoto lɛ,
ni amɛtoigbalamɔ lɛ
aaakã he aya nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
16 Malɛ nyɛ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa fe fɛɛ,
ni mahã nyɛ tɛsaa mli wo ni nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ.”

Title: LALA 82
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ nɔyelɔ kpele lɛ
Asaf lala ko.
1Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ta ŋwɛi gwabɔɔ wulu lɛŋ;
eta nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ eekojo.
2 “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaaye toikɔdɔmɔ sane,
ni nyɛaakwɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahiɛiaŋ kɛyaashi?
3 Nyɛyea ohiafo kɛ awusã sane nyɛhãa amɛ;
nyɛfãa nɔnalɔ kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ he.
4Nyɛherea gbɔjɔlɔ kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ lɛ;
nyɛjiea amɛ yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
5“Amɛleee nii lɛ,
amɛnuuu nii ashishi hu;
dujiaŋ amɛnyiɛ
ni jalɛ saneyeli etã yɛ
shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
6 Mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ;
Ŋwɛinyo lɛ bii ji nyɛ blublu kwa;’
7kɛ̃lɛ nyɛbaagboi tamɔ gbɔmɛi adesai gboiɔ,
nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ tamɔ abladei lɛ ekomɛi nɔŋŋ.”
8Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ba!
Ba ni obaye je lɛ nɔ;
ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, onɔ ni.

Title: LALA 83
Content:
Israel henyɛlɔi anɔkunimyeli he sɔlemɔ
Asaf lala ko.
1Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, kaafee dioo!
Kaamua onaa, ni kaafee kpoo,
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ!
2Ejaakɛ, naa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mifee hoo;
mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ bo lɛ amɛhole amɛhe nɔ.
3 Amɛyaa omaŋ lɛ yinɔ apam yɛ ŋaa mli;
amɛkpãŋɔ mɛi ni obuɔ amɛhe lɛ ayinɔ.
4Amɛkɛɔ akɛ,
“Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpãtãa amɛhiɛ,
koni amɛkafee maŋ dɔŋŋ;
ni akakai Israel gbɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ.”
5Naa, amɛkpãŋ, amɛfee gbee kome, amɛkpãŋ oyinɔ:
6Edombii lɛ kɛ Ishmaelbii lɛ
kɛ Moabbii lɛ kɛ Hagarbii lɛ,
7kɛ Gebalbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ
kɛ Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Filistiabii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ hu.
8Asiriabii lɛ hu eyafata amɛhe;
amɛwo mli nine amɛhã Lot shwiei lɛ.
9 Feemɔ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ofee Midianbii lɛ
kɛ Sisera kɛ Yabin lɛ yɛ Kishon Faa lɛ naa lɛ,
10mɛi ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ En-Dor
ni amɛtsɔ̃ tumo amɛhã shikpɔŋ.
11Feemɔ amɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ
ofee Oreb kɛ Zeeb lɛ;
ye amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim
tamɔ ofee Zeba kɛ Zalmuna,
12 mɛi ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔŋɔa
Yehowa ŋa shikpɔŋ lɛ wɔfea wɔnɔ lɛ.”
13Oo miNyɔŋmɔ,
gbɛɛ amɛ oshwã tamɔ lasuogbele mlu,
tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa.
14Bɔ ni la shãa koo wɛɛ,
bɔ ni lalilɛi maa gɔji anaa la lɛ,
15nakai okɛ ahum ashwie amɛ,
ni okɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ awo amɛhe gbeyei.
16Hã amɛhiɛ agboi
bɔ ni afee ni amɛtao bo, Yehowa, ogbɛi sɛɛgbɛ.
17Hã amɛhiɛ agboi koni amɛye hejaramɔ kɛya naanɔ;
hã amɛgboi kɛ hiɛgbele.
18 Hã amɛna amɛle akɛ bo mɔ ni ogbɛi ji Yehowa lɛ,
bo pɛ ji Ofe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.

Title: LALA 84
Content:
Shwe ni ashweɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ
Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ. Korahbii alala ko.
1Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni
oSɔlemɔ we lɛ yɔɔ akɔnɔ hã!
2 Misusuma hiɛ miitse Yehowa kpoi lɛ anɔ;
hiɛtselɛ lɛ hãa misusuma tɔɔ biti po.
Mikɛ mitsui kɛ migbɔmɔtso fɛɛ
laa kɛ miishɛɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ.
3 Aflimata po naa eshihilɛhe;
ni nyɔŋmɔbitɛte hu naa etsu he ni ekɛ ebii aaato
yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe!
Oo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ,
4kwɛ bɔ ni mɛi ni hiɔ owe lɛ yɔɔ miishɛɛ hã,
ni amɛlaa daa kɛjieɔ oyi.
5Ajɔɔ mɛi ni odɛ̃ŋ amɛhewalɛ jɛɔ,
mɛi ni gbɛfãa kɛyaa Zion Gɔŋ nɔ lɛ kã amɛtsui nɔ.
6Kɛji amɛnyiɛ Baka jɔɔ lɛŋ kɛmiiho lɛ,
amɛhãa jɛi tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi;
ni Agbiɛnaa nu taraa shi yɛ jɛi.
7Amɛnyiɛɔ ni amɛhewalɛ nɔ gbɔɔɔ;
amɛyanaa nyɔŋmɔi amli Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ Zion.
8Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ,
bo misɔlemɔ lɛ toi!
Oo Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã mi!
9 Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, jɔɔmɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ,
jɔɔmɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
10 Gbi kometoo shihilɛ yɛ oSɔlemɔ we lɛ,
ehi fe gbii akpe ni aaaye yɛ he kroko.
Masumɔ matsɔ̃ shinaa naabulɔ
yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ,
fe nɔ ni mahi efɔŋfeelɔi awe mli.
11 Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
hulu kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ ji lɛ;
eduroɔ mɔ, ni ewoɔ mɔ hiɛ nyam.
Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ
Yehowa kãmãaa amɛ nɔ kpakpa ko nɔ kpakpa ko.
12Oo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ,
ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ onɔ lɛ!

Title: LALA 85
Content:
Sɔlemɔ hã maŋ ejurɔyeli
Korahbii alala ko.
1Yehowa, ona oshikpɔŋ lɛ mɔbɔ;
ohã Israel esaa eshwere ekoŋŋ.
2 Okɛ omaŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ efa amɛ,
ni okɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa amɛ.
3Ofo omli ni fu amɛ lɛ sɛɛ,
ni oŋmɛɛ omlila kpele lɛ he.
4Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,
ŋɔɔ wɔ oto wɔtoohe ekoŋŋ
ni ofo omli ni efu wɔ lɛ sɛɛ!
5 Aso omli aaafu wɔ kɛaatee naanɔ?
Oookã omlifu lɛ he kɛaaya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ?
6Aso ohaŋ wɔyi ana wala ekoŋŋ,
koni omaŋ lɛ anya kɛkafo bo?
7Oo Yehowa, hã wɔna osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ,
ni ohã wɔyi ana wala!
8 Hã mabo nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawie toi,
ejaakɛ ekɛ emaŋ lɛ kɛ ehetselɔi lɛ
kɛ mɛi ni kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa eŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ,
baawie hejɔlɛ wiemɔ.
9Lɛɛlɛŋ efee kralo kɛbaahere
mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ayiwala
koni anunyam ahi wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
10Suɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ
anɔkwayeli baakpe;
ni jalɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ aaafua amɛhe atuu.
11Anɔkwayeli aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ,
ni jalɛ aaajɛ ŋwɛi egboo ehiɛ shi ekwɛ.
12Hɛɛ! Yehowa aaaŋɔ nɔ kpakpa ehã,
ni wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii babaoo.
13Jalɛ saneyeli aaatsɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ eba;
ni ebaasaa gbɛ ehã lɛ.

Title: LALA 86
Content:
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ
David sɔlemɔ ko.
1Oo Yehowa, gboo otoi shi ohã mi,
ni ohã mi hetoo!
Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi, ni efĩ mi!
2 Baamɔ miwala yi,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ji mi.
Heremɔ otsulɔ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ yiwala.
3 Oo Nuŋtsɔ, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ;
naa mi mɔbɔ,
ejaakɛ bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ daa jenamɔ.
4Hã otsulɔ susuma mii ashɛ,
ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, bo misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ.
5Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ ohi,
ni oŋɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ ofaa;
ni suɔmɔ ni osumɔɔ
mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔleɔ tsɛɔ bo lɛ fa babaoo.
6Oo Yehowa, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ,
ni obo mifaikpamɔ blɔmɔ toi!
7 Mihaomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ,
mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo,
ejaakɛ ohereɔ mi nɔ.
8 Oo Nuŋtsɔ, nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ
eko eko bɛ ni tamɔ bo;
ni nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko bɛ
ni kɛ onitsumɔ yeɔ hegbɔ.
9Oo Nuŋtsɔ, jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ ni bo obɔ lɛ
aaaba abakoto bo;
ni amɛbaawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.
10Ejaakɛ oje agbo,
ni ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii.
Bo okoome pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
11 Oo Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni miba mijeŋ mihã
koni maba mijeŋ yɛ onɔkwale lɛ naa.
Hã mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ashe bo gbeyei.
12Oo Nuŋtsɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ,
miida bo shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ,
ni mawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam kɛaatee naanɔ.
13Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ kpele
ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ fa hã mi.
Ohere misusuma kɛje gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ.
14Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hewolɔi ete shi ewo mi;
yiwalɔi asafo miitao misusuma sɛɛgbɛ,
ni amɛkwɛɛɛ bo kwraa.
15 Oo Nuŋtsɔ, shi bo lɛ
Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ durolɔ ji bo!
Omli fuuu mra,
ni osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ fa babaoo.
16 Kwɛmɔ mi ni oduro mi,
ŋɔɔ ohewalɛ ohã otsulɔ;
heremɔ oweyoo bi lɛ yiwala.
17Too mi suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔɔ mi lɛ he okadi ko,
koni mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ana, ni amɛhiɛ agboi;
ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa, oye obua mi, ni oshɛje mimii.

Title: LALA 87
Content:
Yerusalɛm yijiemɔ
Korahbii alala ko.
1Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ
maŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to lɛ ma!
2Yehowa sumɔɔ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ
fe Israel shihilɛhei fɛɛ!
3Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ,
agbaa ohe anunyam saji lɛ.
4 Matsi Ijipt kɛ Babilon tã mafata maji ni le mi lɛ ahe.
Makane Filistibii kɛ Tirobii kɛ Kush
mafata mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahe.
Ejaakɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ:
“Mɔnɛ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, jɛi afɔ lɛ yɛ.”
5Shi Zion lɛ, aaakɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ,
“Majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii yɛ ni jɛi afɔ amɛ yɛ;”
ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baahã ema shi shiŋŋ.
6Yehowa aaaŋmala maŋ lɛŋ bii
agbɛii ewo woloŋ akɛ Yerusalɛmbii.
7Mɛi ni laa kɛ mɛi ni joɔ fɛɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ:
“Wɔjɔmɔi fɛɛ kwa jɛɔ Zion.”

Title: LALA 88
Content:
Aafo aatsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ
Korabii alala.
1Oo Yehowa, miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,
nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ lɛ, mibolɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ.
2Hã misɔlemɔ ashɛ ohiɛ;
gboo otoi shi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ.
3Ejaakɛ haomɔi babaoo eba minɔ,
ni miwala miibɛŋkɛ gbohiiaje.
4Abuɔ mi ashiɔ mɛi ni yaa gbohiiaje anɔ.
Mihewalɛ fɛɛ etã.
5Mitamɔ mɛi ni akwa amɛ yɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ eko.
Mitamɔ mɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔi
ni amɛkamɔ amɛgbonyobuiaŋ,
tamɔ mɛi ni ohiɛ ekpa amɛnɔ kwraa lɛ eko,
ejaakɛ obɛ wamɔ ko ni okɛbaawa amɛ dɔŋŋ.
6Oshɛ mi ofɔ gbonyobu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ,
he ni mli kwɔ ni ewo duŋ kpii lɛ.
7 Omlifu lɛ kã minɔ,
ni ohã oshɔkei lɛ fɛɛ ekumɔ eshwie minɔ.
8 Ohã minanemɛi ekwa mi;
ohã mitsɔ̃ musumɔ mihã amɛ;
aŋa miyi koni mikanyɛ kpo mije.
9Awerɛho ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu.
Oo Yehowa, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo daa gbi,
ni mikpãa miniji amli mihãa bo.
10 Ani ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii ohãa gbohii lo?
Ani sisai teɔ shi amɛ jieɔ oyi lo?
11Ani agbaa omlihilɛ
ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he sane
yɛ gbonyobu mli lo?
Aloo awieɔ onɔkwayeli lɛ he
yɛ he ni hiɛkpãtãmɔ yɔɔ?
12Ani anaa onaakpɛɛnii
yɛ he ni ewo duŋ lo?
Aloo akaiɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ
yɛ shikpɔŋ ni hiɛ kpaa nii anɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ?
13Oo Yehowa, mi lɛ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo;
daa leebi maŋkpa lɛ misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ bo.
14Oo Yehowa, mɛɛba oshɛ mi ofɔ̃?
Mɛɛba ni okɛ ohiɛ etee mi?
15Kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi beebe lɛ minii yɛ mɔbɔ;
ni miihe magbo.
Ohe ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi, ni mijijaa.
16Omlifu ni naa wa lɛ esu mi!
Ohe ŋmiŋmi ekpãtã mihiɛ!
17Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, ohe ŋmiŋmi lɛ
ebɔle mihe tamɔ nu afua, efo mihe sa kɛkpe.
18Ohã shieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ nanemɛi fɛɛ ekwa mi,
ni duŋ pɛ ji minaanyo ni eshwɛ.

Title: LALA 89
Content:
Maŋ amanehulu be mli lala
Ethan Maskil lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, mala osuɔmɔ
ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he lala kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Mikɛ minaabu baajaje onɔkwayeli lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.
2Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ,
ni onɔkwayeli lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ŋwɛi.
3 Okɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ mɔ ni mihala lɛ ekpãŋ.
Mikã mitsulɔ David kitã akɛ,
4‘Oshwiei ji mɛi ni baaye maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ;
ni mahã omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ama shi kɛya yinɔi fɛɛ.’ ”
5Oo Yehowa, hã ŋwɛi ajie onaakpɛɛnii yi;
ni mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ajie onɔkwayeli lɛ hu yi yɛ asafo lɛ mli!
6 Ejaakɛ namɔ yɔɔ atatuiaŋ
ni ekɛ bo, Yehowa, ye hegbɔ?
Ŋwɛibii lɛ ateŋ namɔ yɔɔ ni etamɔ Yehowa?
7Nyɔŋmɔ ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei
yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi agwabɔɔ lɛŋ,
Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ
gbeyei fe mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ.
8 Oo Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ,
Oo! Namɔ ji hewalɛtsɛ tamɔ bo, Yehowa?
Onɔkwayeli ebɔle ohe kpula kɛkpe!
9 Oyɛ ŋshɔ grimɔ nɔ hewalɛ!
Kɛji emli ŋshɔkei lɛ hole amɛhe nɔ lɛ,
bo ojɔɔ amɛhe.
10 Otserɛ Rehab ni ji ŋshɔŋ kooloo
awuiyelɔ lɛ mli, ni ogbe lɛ,
ni okɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ
gbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã.
11 Ŋwɛi lɛ onɔ ni,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu onɔ ni;
je lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ lɛ,
bo nɔŋŋ obɔ.
12Bo obɔ kooyi kɛ wuoyi fɛɛ.
Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ
kɛ miishɛɛ jieɔ ogbɛi lɛ yi.
13Okɔ̃ɔjiaŋ wa waa!
Onineshi wa naakpa!
Ohewalɛ lɛ nɔ kwɔ gojoo!
14 Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ato shishi ama
jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ.
Anaa suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwayeli
yɛ onɔ fɛɛ nɔ feemɔ mli.
15Ajɔɔ mɛi ni le gbijurɔyeli lala lɛ,
mɛi ni baa amɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa bo, Yehowa, ohiɛ lɛ;
16mɛi ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ
gbi muu fɛɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ
ni amɛkafoɔ ojalɛ lɛ;
17ejaakɛ bo ji amɛhewalɛ lɛ nyam.
Oduromɔ hãa wɔyeɔ kunim.
18 Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã wɔhe lɛ;
ni bo, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ,
bo owo maŋtsɛ ohã wɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ wo David shi
19 Blema ko lɛ okɛ otsuji anɔkwafoi lɛ wie
yɛ ninaa mli akɛ,
“Miye mibua kãkãlɔ ko,
miŋɔ mɔ ko yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ ni miwo enɔ.
20 Mina mitsulɔ David;
mifɔ lɛ mimu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mikɛto lɛ maŋtsɛ.
21No hewɔ lɛ, minine aaahiɛ emli daa;
mihewalɛ lɛ aaahã efi shi.
22Ehenyɛlɔ nine tsɔŋ enɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ;
yiwalɔ ko yeŋ enɔ kunim.
23Mibakpãtã ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ yɛ ehiɛ,
ni mibatswia mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ nii.
24 Maye lɛ anɔkwa, ni masumɔ lɛ
kɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ;
ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
ehewalɛ lɛ nɔ aaakwɔ.
25 Mibagbele emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli
kɛjɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa
kɛyamɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ.
26 Eeebo, ni eeekɛɛ mi akɛ,
‘Bo ji miTsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ
kɛ mihebuu Tɛsaa!’
27Mafee lɛ mikromɔbi
kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ
ateŋ mɔ wulu fe fɛɛ.
28 Majɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ mli
mana lɛ mɔbɔ kɛaatee naanɔ;
ni mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ
aaama shi shiŋŋ.
29Mahã eseshi ahi shi daa,
ni emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ aaahi shi,
beiaŋ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɔɔ nɛɛ.
30Kɛji eshwiei lɛ kwa mimla lɛ,
ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa,
31kɛji amɛbule mikpɔi lɛ,
ni amɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ,
32no lɛ mikɛ dade tete aaagwao amɛ,
yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ;
ni mikɛ kpelebi aaayi amɛ,
yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ.
33Kɛ̃lɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee
ni miyɔɔ hã David lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ,
ni shi ni miwo lɛ lɛ, mikwaŋ.
34Mikuŋ mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli,
ni nɔ ni eje minaa lɛ, mikpaleŋ.
35“Mina mikɛ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ
ekã mihe kitã momo;
milakaŋ David.
36 Eshwiei aaahi shi daa kɛaatee naanɔ,
ni emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ aaahi shi
gbii abɔ ni hulu teɔ shi
ni enyɔɔ shi nɛɛ.
37 Eeehi shi kɛya naanɔ tamɔ nyɔɔŋtsere;
ni eeeye odase yɛ ŋwɛi kɛya naanɔ.”
Maŋtsɛ butumɔ he ŋkɔmɔyeli
38 Shi agbɛnɛ okwa lɛ, ni oshɛ lɛ ofɔ̃;
omli efu mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
39Oku okɛ otsulɔ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli,
okɛ ekekre lɛ eshwishwia shikpɔŋ, ni obule lɛ.
40Okumɔ emaŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ oshwie shi,
ni ofee emɔji lɛ koikoi.
41 Mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ lɛ haa enii;
ni ehe gbɔmɛi tete bɔɔ lɛ ahora.
42Ohã ehenyɛlɔi anine etsɔ̃ enɔ;
ohã ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ miinya.
43Ohã eklante lɛ naa fee kutuushii yɛ ta mli,
ni owaaa lɛ yɛ ta naa.
44Oshɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli tsi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ,
ni oŋɔ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ otswa shi.
45Ohã esha egbɔ;
ohã hiɛgbele eloo lɛ.
Kpɔmɔ he sɔlemɔ
46 Oo Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
Oooŋɔ ohe otee kɛyashi naanɔ lo?
Mɛɛbe omlifu lɛ aaatso tamɔ la kɛyashi?
47 Oo Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ
wala be shɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko,
ni obɔ adesã akɛ yaka nɔ ko kɛkɛ.
48Mɛɛ adesã yɔɔ jeŋ,
ni lɛ lɛ esaŋ enaa gbele?
Namɔ aaanyɛ ehe ehere yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ?
49Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ oblema suɔmɔ
ni tsakeee lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɔ ni ojɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ mli
okã David ehe kitã lɛ?
50Oo Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ bɔ ni
abɔɔ otsulɔ ahora ahãa lɛ,
bɔ ni mɛi adɛŋ ahorabɔɔ
hãa migbigbliɔ mimli lɛ.
51Oo Yehowa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ
mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ ahora;
amɛbɔɔ lɛ ahora yɛ he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ kɛhoɔ.
52Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa kɛya naanɔ!
Amen! Amen!

Title: LALA 90
Content:
WOLO NI JI EJWƐ
(Lalai 90—106)
Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose sɔlemɔ
Mose sɔlemɔ ko.
1Oo Nuŋtsɔ, bo ji wɔbobaahe yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.
2Be ni onako obɔ gɔji lɛ,
ni onako obɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋ lɛ,
bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
3 Okɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii,
nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa!”
Ni ohãa adesa kuɔ esɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ sũ.
4 Ejaakɛ ohiɛ lɛ, afii akpe
tamɔ nyɛ kpaakpa nyɛ,
ni ebaho kɛtee;
etamɔ nyɔɔŋ buu be pɛ.
5 Oloɔ adesai kɛyaa tamɔ faa loɔ nii;
amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ lamɔ ni alaa;
amɛtamɔ jwɛi ni feɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ leebi mli;
6amɛfeɔ floŋŋ, ni amɛgbaa afofro;
gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ amɛgbiɔ, ni amɛkpalaa.
7Wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ omlifu lɛ naa;
ni omlila lɛ he ŋmiŋmi emɔ wɔ.
8Oŋɔ wɔnishaianii lɛ oto ohiɛ,
ni wɔdujiaŋ eshai lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ faŋŋ.
9Ejaakɛ wɔgbii lɛ hoɔ oya yɛ omlifu lɛ naa;
wɔyeɔ wɔfii lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.
10 Wɔwalaŋ afii lɛ,
afii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni.
Kɛji efa aahu lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ,
kɛji gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ yɛ;
shi amɛmli shwãanii lɛ,
tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme sɔŋŋ ni.
Wɔwala sɛɛ foɔ oya,
ni wɔlaajeɔ kwraa.
11Namɔ le omlifu lɛ mli walɛ?
Namɔ le gbeyei ni esa akɛ asheɔ bo
yɛ omlila lɛ hewɔ?
12 Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ koni wɔle
wɔwalagbii lɛ ayibɔ
koni wɔhiɛ akã shi?
13Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ be yinɔ nɔŋŋ
omli aaafu kɛyashi?
Naa otsuji mɔbɔ.
14Hã wɔtɔrɔ leebi kɛ osuɔmɔ
ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ,
koni wɔnya ni wɔmii ashɛ,
wɔwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
15Hã wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe gbii babaoo;
tamɔ ohao wɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ;
ni wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe afii babaoo
tamɔ gbii abɔ kɛ afii abɔ ni wɔye jaramɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
16Hã wɔ ni ji otsuji lɛ
ana onitsumɔi wuji lɛ,
ni wɔshwiei hu ana onunyam kpele lɛ.
17Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ana wɔ mɔbɔ;
ehã wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi ashwere ahã wɔ!
Hɛɛ! Wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi lɛ hã amɛshwere.

Title: LALA 91
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔyibaalɔ
1Mɔ ni hiɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ teemɔhe lɛ,
ni ehiɔ Ofe lɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ,
2 eeekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ,
“Mibobaahe kɛ mimɔɔ ji bo,
miNyɔŋmɔ hu ni mihiɛ kã enɔ.”
3 Ejaakɛ lɛ ebaajie bo kɛje
henyɛlɔi adujiaŋ tsɔne
kɛ gbele hela ni naa wa mli.
4Ekɛ etsɛji aaaha onɔ,
ni ooona abobaahe yɛ efiji ashishi.
Enɔkwayeli lɛ, tsɛŋ kɛ dama ni.
5Osheŋ nyɔɔŋ ŋmiŋmi loo gãimlibi
ni atsɛ̃ shwane gbeyei;
6loo gbele hela ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli,
loo hela ni kpãtãa mɔ hiɛ shwane lɛ.
7Kɛji mɛi akpe nyɔ yɛ omasɛi,
ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋma nyɔ
yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ po lɛ,
bo lɛ ebɛŋkɛŋ bo.
8 Ohiŋmɛi kɛkɛ okɛaakwɛ,
ni ooona mɛi fɔ̃ji anyɔmɔwo.
9Ejaakɛ okɛ Yehowa efee ohebulɔ;
Ofee Ŋwɛinyo lɛ oteemɔhe,
10no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ ko efeŋ bo,
ni haomɔ ko haomɔ ko bɛŋkɛŋ oshihilɛhe lɛ.
11 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawo ebɔfoi lɛ
kitã yɛ ohewɔ ni amɛbu ohe,
koni amɛbaa oyi yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.
12Amɛaahiɛ bo yɛ amɛdɛ̃,
koni okaŋɔ onane oshi tɛ ko.
13 Ooonyiɛ jata kɛ shikpãa nɔ po,
ooonaanaa jatabi kɛ jeŋ nɔ.
14Mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, majie amɛ,
ni mɛi ni le migbɛi lɛ mabu amɛhe.
15Kɛji amɛtsɛ mi lɛ, mahere amɛ nɔ.
Mi kɛ amɛ aaahi shi yɛ haomɔ mli;
mahere amɛ, ni mawo amɛhiɛ nyam.
16Mahã amɛtɔ kɛ walasɛɛtsɛlɛ,
ni mahã amɛna miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ.

Title: LALA 92
Content:
Yijiemɔ lala
Lala ko. Lala kɛha Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ.
1 Ehi akɛ ada Yehowa shi,
ni ala kɛjie, bo Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, ogbɛi lɛ yi.
2Ehi akɛ ashiɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he sane daa leebi,
koni agba onɔkwayeli lɛ he sane daa gbɛkɛ
3 kɛ kpãa saŋku kɛ obenta.
4Ejaakɛ, bo Yehowa, onifeemɔ nii
ehã mimii eshɛ mihe,
ni oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ
hãa milaa kɛ miishɛɛ.
5 Oo Yehowa, kwɛ bɔ ni onitsumɔi lɛ dara hã!
Ni ojwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.
6Enɛ ji nɔ ko ni buulu nyɛɛɛ ale,
ni kwashia hu nyɛɛɛ shishi anu,
7 akɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji miifu gblɔ̃gblɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi,
ni efɔŋfeelɔi miishwere;
kɛ̃lɛ naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ;
8ejaakɛ, bo, Yehowa ji Ofe kɛmiiya naanɔ.
9Ejaakɛ Oo Yehowa! Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ,
Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã kɛ̃.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ nishaianii lɛ,
aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã.
10 Shi ohã mihe ewa tamɔ wuo,
ni ohã mimii eshɛ mihe.
11 Mina mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ashigbeemɔ kɛ mihiŋmɛi,
ni mikɛ mitoi hu enu mɛi ni te shi wo mi lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ.
12 Jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ tɛŋ,
ni eeeda tamɔ tsenedru ni ma Lebanon.
13 Amɛtamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ Yehowa we lɛŋ;
amɛfrɔkeɔ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ.
14 Amɛaakã he amɛwo yibii
yɛ amɛgbɔlɛ beiaŋ tete,
ni amɛaahi frɔ̃frɔ̃ kɛ amɛmli nu daa
15 koni amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ
Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ni.
Lɛ ji mitɛsaa,
ni nɔ ko ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ egbɛfaŋ.

Title: LALA 93
Content:
Yehowa ji Maŋtsɛ
1 Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ;
ewula kɛ agbojee;
Yehowa ewula;
emia kɛ hewalɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ,
ni anyɛŋ ahoso.
2Oo Yehowa, omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ
ema shi shiŋŋ kɛjɛ teteete,
ni bo oyɔɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe.
3Oo Yehowa, fai lɛ ewo amɛhe nɔ;
fai lɛ ewo amɛgbee nɔ,
fai lɛ ewo amɛhũumɔ lɛ nɔ.
4Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ je agbo fe fɛɛ.
Eje agbo fe nui babaoo lɛ agbɛɛmɔ;
efe ŋshɔkei ahewalɛ.
5 Yehowa, okpɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni,
Owe lɛ he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛyaashi naanɔ.

Title: LALA 94
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɛi fɛɛ akojolɔ
1 Oo Yehowa, bo Nuŋtsɔ ni otɔɔ owele,
bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni otɔɔ owele,
hã ana omlifu.
2 Oo je lɛ kojolɔ,
wo ohe nɔ,
koni owo hewolɔi lɛ nyɔmɔ
bɔ ni sa amɛ.
3Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ,
mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni
mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ aaanya kɛyashi?
4Amɛwieɔ amɛdaa obɔ̃,
amɛwieɔ hewoo wiemɔi;
mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ shwãa.
5Oo Yehowa, amɛmiinaanaa
owebii lɛ anɔ,
ni amɛmiipiŋ omɛi lɛ.
6Oo Yehowa, amɛgbeɔ yoo okulafo kɛ gbɔi,
ni amɛgbeɔ awusai hu,
7 ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ
“Yehowa enaaa,
ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yooo sɛɛ.”
8 Oo, nyɛ maŋ lɛŋ kwashiai,
nyɛyoa sɛɛ!
Ni nyɛ, buului, te be ni
nyɛaale nii lɛ?
9 Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ toi lɛ,
aso enuuu nii?
Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ,
aso enaaa nii?
10 Lɛ mɔ ni ekuneɔ jeŋ maji lɛ,
aso etsɔseee mɔ lo?
11Lɛ mɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi anii lɛ,
lɛ Yehowa lɛ, eleee akɛ
gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kɛkɛ ni lo?
12Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni bo, Yehowa,
otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii,
gbɔmɔ ni ojɛɔ omla lɛ mli otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii lɛ,
13bɔ ni afee ni ohã ehe ajɔ lɛ fioo,
yɛ fimɔ gbii amli,
kɛyaashi aaatsa bu ni akɛdu mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
14Ejaakɛ Yehowa kwaŋ emaŋ lɛ,
ejeŋ emɛi lɛ asɛɛ,
15ejaakɛ aaaku sɛɛ aye
jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔhei lɛ,
ni jalɔi fɛɛ aaafĩ sɛɛ kɛ amɛtsuiŋ fɛɛ.
16Namɔ aaate shi awo efɔŋfeelɔi ahã mi?
Namɔ aaadamɔ shi ashi
mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii ahã mi?
17 Kɛjeee Yehowa ni ye bua mi lɛ,
kulɛ benɛ misusuma yɛ gbohiiaje kpoo.
18Be ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miishane lɛ!”
Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ mɔ mimli.
19 Kɛji mikɔmɔyeli fa yɛ mimli lɛ,
oshɛjeɔ mimii, ni mimii shɛɔ mihe.
20Ani kojolɔi fɔ̃ji aaanyɛ amɛkɛ bo abɔ,
amɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mla moŋ nɔ kɛfeɔ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ?
21Amɛkpãŋɔ jalɔ yinɔ,
ni amɛbuɔ lá ni efeko efɔŋ ko gbele fɔ.
22Shi Yehowa ji mimɔɔ ni wa,
ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mibobaa tɛsaa.
23Ebaahã amɛnishaianii lɛ
abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ;
ni eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ
yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ.
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ
aaabɛɛ amɛ ashwie.

Title: LALA 95
Content:
Yijiemɔ lala
1Oo nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔlaa
wɔhãa Yehowa!
Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa oshe wɔhãa
wɔYiwalaheremɔ Tɛsaa lɛ!
2Nyɛhãa wɔbaa ehiɛ kɛ shidaa,
wɔkɛ lala abɔa oshe kɛjiea eyi.
3 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ji Yehowa,
Maŋtsɛ ni fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
4Edɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi yɔɔ,
gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ hu enɔ ni.
5Ŋshɔ lɛ enɔ ni, ni lɛ ebɔ;
ni shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ hu eniji ni shɔ̃.
6Oo, nyɛbaa!
Nyɛhãa wɔkotoa lɛ,
ni wɔjaa lɛ!
Nyɛhãa wɔkulaa shi
yɛ Yehowa, wɔBɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ.
7 Ejaakɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ,
ni wɔji elɛɛhe lɛŋ mɛi kɛ edɛŋ toi.
Oo, mina ni kulɛ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛbo egbee toi!
8Nyɛkawajea nyɛtsuii tamɔ eba lɛ yɛ Meriba lɛ,
tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfee yɛ Masa gbi lɛ nɔ,
yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
9 Be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ minaa,
amɛka mi amɛkwɛ,
tsɛbelɛ, amɛna nibii ni mifee mihã amɛ lɛ.
10Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ,
nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ asane je mitsine,
ni mikɛɛ akɛ “amɛ ji maŋ ko ni yeee anɔkwa,
ni amɛbuuu mimlai lɛ.”
11 No hewɔ lɛ, mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu mli akɛ,
“Kɛ amɛna amɛshɛ hejɔlɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ fĩĩ!”

Title: LALA 96
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Maŋtsɛ Ofe
(1 Kronika 16.23-33)
1 Oo, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa!
Jeŋ fɛɛ, nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa!
2Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa,
nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!
Nyɛgbaa wɔyiwala ni ehere he sane lɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi.
3Nyɛshiɛa enunyam lɛ,
yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ!
Nyɛgbaa naakpɛɛnii ni efee lɛ nyɛtsɔa mɛi fɛɛ!
4Ejaakɛ Yehowa je agbo,
ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo,
ni esa akɛ asheɔ lɛ gbeyei fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
5Ejaakɛ maji krokomɛi anyɔŋmɔi lɛ, amãgãi ni;
shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
6Anunyam kɛ agbojee ebɔle ehe,
hewalɛ kɛ fɛo eyi ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃.
7Oo maji amli wekui, nyɛkafoa Yehowa;
nyɛkafoa enunyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ!
8 Nyɛkɛ anunyam ni sa Yehowa gbɛi lɛ ahãa lɛ;
nyɛhiɛa afɔlei kɛbaa, nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ!
9Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkotoa kɛjaa Yehowa
kɛji epue yɛ egbojeiaŋ!
Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ,
nyɛhe akpokpoa yɛ ehiɛ!
10 Nyɛkɛa yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ akɛ,
“Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ!
No hewɔ je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ,
ni anyɛŋ lɛ ahoso.
Eeekojo gbɔmɛi yɛ jalɛ naa.”
11 Ŋwɛi anya!
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ!
Hã ŋshɔ ahũu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ!
12Ŋa abɔ oshe kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ emli!
Kɛkɛ lɛ kooŋ tsei fɛɛ aaala kɛ miishɛɛ,
13 yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ejaakɛ eeba;
eeba koni ebakojo shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa;
ebaakojo adesa yɛ anɔkwayeli naa.

Title: LALA 97
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Nɔyelɔ Ofe lɛ
1 Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ!
Shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ!
Ŋshɔkpɔi babaoo lɛ anya!
2 Oblɔtu kɛ duŋ kpii ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe!
Emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ.
3 La tsoɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ehiɛ,
ni ekpãtãa ehenyɛlɔi
ni bɔle lɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
4Esrawai lɛ hãa jeŋ tseɔ,
je lɛ naa enɛ, ni ekpokpoɔ.
5Gɔji lɛ sereɔ tamɔ wo agbaku yɛ Yehowa hiɛ,
yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
6 Ŋwɛi jajeɔ ejalɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ,
ni maji fɛɛ tswɛm naa enunyam lɛ.
7 Amãgã jalɔi fɛɛ,
mɛi ni shwãa fɔ̃ɔ yakayaka amãgãi anɔ lɛ,
ahiɛ aaagboi.
Nyɛ nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ tswɛm, nyɛkotoa Yehowa.
8 Oo Yehowa, Zion nu he,
ni emii shɛ ehe;
ni Yuda maji lɛ amli fili amɛ,
yɛ okojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
9 Ejaakɛ Yehowa, bo ji Ofe,
mɔ ni kwɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke nyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
10 Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsumɔɔ Yehowa lɛ, nyɛnyɛa efɔŋ!
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa emɛi anɔkwafoi lɛ awala yi;
ehereɔ amɛyiwala kɛjeɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ.
11 La aaakpɛ ahã jalɔ,
ni miishɛɛ aaaba ahã mɔ ni ja yɛ etsuiŋ lɛ.
12Oo, nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛnyaa yɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efee hewɔ!
Ni nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi kɛ shidaa.

Title: LALA 98
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Je lɛ Nɔyelɔ
Lala ko.
1 Oo, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa,
ejaakɛ efee naakpɛɛnii.
Ejɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ krɔŋŋ lɛŋ
eye kunim ehã ehe.
2Yehowa ehã ale kunim ni eye lɛ;
ejie edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kpo faŋŋ
etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ.
3 Ekai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ
kɛ enɔkwayeli ni eyɔɔ hã Israel we lɛ.
Je lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ ena
kunim ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ye lɛ.
4Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe
kɛ miishɛɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa;
nyɛlaa miishɛɛ lalai,
nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai!
5Nyɛkɛ kpãa saŋku alaa
yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa Yehowa.
Hɛɛ! Nyɛtswaa kpãa saŋku kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.
6 Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi,
nyɛkpãa koofɛŋi!
Ni nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ abɔa oshe
yɛ wɔmaŋtsɛ Yehowa hiɛ!
7 Ŋshɔ ahũu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ;
je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli abɔ oshe!
8Fai atswa amɛdɛ̃,
ni gɔji bluublu ala kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ;
9ejaakɛ eeba ebaye je lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.
Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa,
ni ebaakojo gbɔmɛi bɔ ni sa pɛ.

Title: LALA 99
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Maŋtsɛ Ofe
1 Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ;
maji lɛ ahe akpokpo!
Eta maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ yɛ kerubim anɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ahoso!
2Yehowa je agbo yɛ Zion,
awo enɔ gojoo fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
3Aaajie ogbɛi kpeteŋkple
ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ yi.
Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ!
4 Maŋtsɛ Ofe ni sumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli,
ohã jalɛ saneyeli ema shi;
ni aafee nɔ ni ja yɛ Israel.
5Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ;
nyɛjaa yɛ enaneshi maaŋoo lɛ hiɛ!
Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
6 Mose kɛ Aaron fata osɔfoi lɛ ahe;
ni Samuel hu shi mɛi ni ja Yehowa lɛ anɔ.
Amɛbo amɛtsɛ Yehowa,
ni ehere amɛ nɔ.
7Ekɛ amɛ wie yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli;
amɛye emlai kɛ akpɔi ni eŋɔ hã amɛ lɛ anɔ.
8Oo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, ohere amɛ nɔ;
otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
ni ŋɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ efaa ji bo;
tsɛbelɛ ogbala amɛtoi
yɛ eshai ni amɛfeefee ahewɔ.
9Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ!
Nyɛjaa yɛ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.

Title: LALA 100
Content:
Yijiemɔ lala
Lala kɛha shidaa.
1Shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛhãa Yehowa!
2Nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa kɛ miishɛɛ;
nyɛbaa ehiɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala!
3 Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ!
Lɛ ebɔ wɔ, ni lɛ enii ji wɔ;
emaŋ kɛ elɛɛhe lɛ toi ji wɔ.
4Nyɛbotea egboi lɛ amli kɛ shidaa!
Nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ yijiemɔ!
Nyɛdaa lɛ shi, nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!
5 Ejaakɛ Yehowa hi;
esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɛ kɛyaa naanɔ;
ni enɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ!

Title: LALA 101
Content:
Jalɛ saneyeli he shiwoo
David Lala ko.
1Mala anɔkwayeli
kɛ jalɛ saneyeli he lala!
Hɛɛ, bo Yehowa, oyi mala majie.
2Mikɛ nilee baaba mijeŋ
koni shwamɔ ko akahi mihe.
Te be ni manyɛ enɛ he mashɛ hu?
Mikɛ tsui krɔŋŋ aaaba mijeŋ yɛ miwe lɛŋ.
3 Mikɛ nɔ ko gbonyo ko emaŋ mihiɛ.
Mihiɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji anifeemɔnii;
egbaleŋ mi fɔŋfɔ̃.
4Tsui ni yeee anɔkwa
akagbale mi fɔŋfɔ̃.
Miyeŋ kɛyaŋ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.
5Mɔ ni yeɔ enaanyo he osheku
yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ, makpãtã ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ gegeege
kɛ henɔwomɔ tsui lɛ mikɛ lɛ yeŋ.
6 Mana shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anɔkwafoi lɛ mɔbɔ,
bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ mi ahi shi.
Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ
ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ eeesɔmɔ mi.
7Shishiulɔ ko ehiŋ miwe lɛŋ;
ni amalelɔ ko damɔŋ mihiɛ.
8 Daa leebi lɛ,
makpãtã mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ ahiɛ
yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ,
mafolɔ amɛ fɛɛ mashwie
kɛje Yehowa maŋ lɛŋ.

Title: LALA 102
Content:
Oblanyo ni ehao sɔlemɔ
Sɔlemɔ kɛha mɔ ko ni efee yeyeeye ni ejaje ehaomɔi lɛ etsɔɔ Yehowa.
1Oo, Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi;
hã mibolɔmɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ.
2 Mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ,
kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi.
Ba otoi shi ohã mi.
Gbi nɔ ni mabɔlɔ matsɛ bo lɛ,
heremɔ mi nɔ nɔŋŋ.
3Ejaakɛ migbii lɛ hoɔ yaa tamɔ lasu,
ni miwui ahe edɔ tamɔ latɛŋ.
4Mitsui eboo, ni egbi tamɔ jwɛi.
Mihiɛ kpaa miniyeli tete po nɔ.
5Mikɛ̃mɔɔ waa;
mitã loo kanyakanya.
6Mitsɔ ŋa nɔ patu,
mitsɔ̃ tamɔ amaŋfɔ̃i amli patu.
7 Mibɛɛɛ mihiŋmɛi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ loofɔlɔ
ni ekome too eyɔɔ tsu yiteŋ.
8Mihenyɛlɔi bɔɔ mi ahora gbi muu fɛɛ.
Mɛi ni yeɔ mihe fɛo lɛ kɛ migbɛi lomɔɔ.
9 Ejaakɛ lamlu etsɔ̃ miniyenii tamɔ aboloo;
ni midãa lɛ mikɛ yaafonu futuɔ mli,
10yɛ omlila kɛ omlifu lɛ hewɔ;
ejaakɛ owo mi, ni oshɛ mi ofɔ̃.
11Miwala gbii hoɔ tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔɔŋ
ni migbi tamɔ jwɛi;
12 shi, bo Yehowa,
ooye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
13Obaate shi,
ni obaana Zion mɔbɔ;
ejaakɛ omɔbɔnalɛ be nɛ;
be ni ato lɛ eshɛ.
14 Ejaakɛ Zion mli tɛi lɛ ajara wa yɛ otsuji lɛ ahiɛ;
ni amɛmusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.
15Majimaji lɛ aaashe Yehowa gbɛi lɛ gbeyei,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaashe onunyam lɛ.
16Kɛji Yehowa tswa Zion ema shi ekoŋŋ lɛ,
eeepue yɛ enunyam mli.
17Eeegboo etoi shi ehã shitswialɔi asɔlemɔ;
ni enyaŋeŋ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ.
18Hã aŋma enɛ afɔ shi ahã yinɔbii ni baa lɛ,
koni mɛi ni afɔko amɛ tete po ajie Yehowa yi.
19Ejaakɛ Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ,
ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekwɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
20Koni ebo gboklɛfoi lɛ akɛ̃ɛmɔ toi
koni ekpɔ̃ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ.
21 Bɔ ni afee ni ashiɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yɛ Zion;
ni ajie eyi hu yɛ Yerusalɛm;
22be mli ni majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛyelii
aaabuabua amɛhe naa amɛja Yehowa lɛ.
23 Yehowa egbɔjɔ mi yɛ miblahiaŋ;
etse miwala gbii lɛ anɔ.
24Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo miNyɔŋmɔ,
Bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ lɛ,
kaaŋɔ mi kɛmiiya yɛ miwala be lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
25Blema beebe oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi,
ni ŋwɛi lɛ, onijianaa nitsumɔ ni.
26 Nomɛi ahiɛ aaakpãtã,
shi bo lɛ oyɛ daa.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaatserɛ tamɔ atade;
otsakeɔ amɛ tamɔ mama,
ni amɛhoɔ amɛyaa.
27 Shi bo lɛ oyɛ bɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ,
ni ofii lɛ bɛ naagbee.
28Otsuji abii aaahi shi,
ni amɛshwiei hu aaahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ ohiɛ.

Title: LALA 103
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ suɔmɔ
David Lala ko.
1Jiemɔ Yehowa yi misusuma,
ni nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mimli,
nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
2Oo, misusuma,
jiemɔ Yehowa yi,
ni ohiɛ akakpa nibii juji ni efeɔ lɛ fiaa nɔ.
3 Lɛ ji mɔ ni kɛ onishaianii fɛɛ faa;
ni etsaa ohelai fiaa kwa lɛ.
4 Lɛ ehereɔ oyiwala kɛjeɔ gbonyobu mli,
ni ekɛ mlihilɛ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ fiɔ bo akekre.
5 Lɛ ekɛ nii kpakpai duroɔ bo owalabeiaŋ fɛɛ;
ni oblahiiaŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee tamɔ okropɔŋ.
6Yehowa kojoɔ,
ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane
ehãa mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim.
7 Lɛ ehã Mose le eyiŋtoi lɛ,
ni ehã Israelbii lɛ le enifeemɔnii lɛ.
8 Mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ durolɔ ji Yehowa,
emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.
9 Jeee be fɛɛ be ekãa mɔ,
ni ebɛɛɛ mɔ ewooo emli.
10Ekɛ wɔ yeee yɛ wɔhe eshai anaa,
ni ewooo wɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ wɔnishaianii lɛ anaa.
11 Shi moŋ, bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ,
nakai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ.
12Bɔ ni bokã kɛ anai teŋ jɛkɛ lɛ,
nakai ehãa wɔ kɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ateŋ jekɛɔ.
13Bɔ ni tsɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ahe lɛ,
nakai Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe.
14 Ejaakɛ ele wɔsu kɛ wɔbaŋ;
ekaiɔ akɛ sũ kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
15 Gbɔmɔ adesa lɛ, egbii tamɔ jwɛi;
efeɔ floŋŋ tamɔ jwɛiiaŋ fɔfɔi.
16Kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa nɔ kɛho pɛ, ebɛ dɔŋŋ;
ni he ni ema lɛ leee lɛ dɔŋŋ.
17 Shi Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ
eyɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Eyɛ hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ,
ni ejalɛ lɛ yɛ hã bii abii.
18Eyɛ hã mɛi ni toɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ,
ni amɛkaiɔ ekitãi lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ.
19Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ
ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi;
ni lɛ eyeɔ jeŋ fɛɛ nɔ.
20 Oo, nyɛ ebɔfoi ni he wa,
ni nyɛyeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ,
ni nyɛboɔ egbee toi,
nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
21Nyɛ etai lɛ fɛɛ kwa,
nyɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi ni feɔ esuɔmɔnaanii,
nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
22 Nyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa bɔ
ni yɔɔ enɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ,
nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
Oo mikla, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 104
Content:
Bɔlɔ lɛ yijiemɔ
1Oo, misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, oda naakpa!
Owula naakpa kɛ woo kɛ agbojee.
2Oha la tamɔ ahaa mama,
ni olɛɛ ŋwɛi mli oha shi tamɔ buu.
3Oma oshĩa lɛ yɛ nui anɔ;
oŋɔ atatui okɛfee oshwiilii;
otaa kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ okɛsheraa shi.
4 Oŋɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ofeɔ otsuji;
ni oŋɔɔ la kɛ la srɛmi ofeɔ osɔ̃ɔlɔi.
5Oto shikpɔŋ lɛ oma shi shiŋŋ
yɛ shishitoo nɔ koni ekahoso kɔkɔɔkɔ.
6Okɛ nu ha he tamɔ mama,
ni nu lɛ su gɔji lɛ ayi.
7 Oŋa nui lɛ ayi, ni amɛjo foi;
oŋwɛi shiimɔ naa lɛ, amɛjo foi oya.
8Gɔji lɛ holeholee amɛhe nɔ,
ni jɔi lɛ hu babaa shi kɛtee he ni oto ohã amɛ lɛ.
9Oto husu ohã nui koni amɛkateke
ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
10Ohãa nuhiŋmɛii tueɔ kɛjɛɔ jɔi amli,
ni amɛhoɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ.
11Amɛhãa ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ nu amɛnuɔ,
ni ŋaŋ tejii lɛ kɛgbeɔ amɛkumai.
12Loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ fai lɛ ahe;
ni amɛlaa yɛ tsei aniji lɛ ateŋ.
13Ojɛɔ oshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ,
onɛɔ nu oshwieɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Onitsumɔi amli yibii lɛ
hãa shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔɔ.
14Ohãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ hãa kooloi
ni tsei kwɛ̃ɔ hãa gbɔmɛi
koni niyenii ajɛ shikpɔŋ aba;
15 kɛ wain ni hãa adesa tsui nyɔɔ emli,
kɛ mu ni hãa gbɔmɔ hiɛ kpɛɔ;
kɛ aboloo ni hãa gbɔmɔ adesa hewalɛ lɛ.
16Lebanon tsei lɛ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ tɛo lɛ,
eshwie amɛnɔ nu jogbaŋŋ.
17Tsei nɛɛ anɔ loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ.
Gɔ̃dɔ̃i lɛ, sɛsɛoi lɛ amli amɛtsui yɔɔ.
18Gɔji somromoi lɛ anɔ ji duji abobaahe;
ni afutuɔkɔi anɔ ji tɛsai amli.
19 Oto nyɔɔŋtsere koni ekadi nyɔji lɛ;
hulu hu le eshinyɔɔ be.
20Ohãa duŋ woɔ, ni je naa;
no mli kooŋ kooloi fɛɛ jeɔ kpo.
21Jatabii hũɔ kɛtaoɔ milɛ loo;
amɛkɛtaoɔ amɛniyenii kɛjɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
22Kɛji hulu je lɛ amɛgbalaa amɛhe shi;
ni amɛyabumɔɔ amɛwɔɔhei.
23Kɛkɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ jeɔ kpo eyaa enitsumɔ,
ni eyagboɔ deŋme kɛyashiɔ gbɛkɛ.
24Oo Yehowa, onitsumɔi lɛ fa naakpa,
fɛɛ jɛ onilee mli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ onibɔɔnii sɔŋŋ.
25Ŋshɔ nɛ, eda, ni elɛɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ;
nibii ni anyɛɛɛ akane wamɔɔ yɛ mli,
loi bibii kɛ ewuji fɛɛ.
26Lɛji nyiɛɔ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ;
emli nɔŋŋ leviatan ni obɔ lɛ shwɛɔ yɛ.
27 Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ bo pɛ gbɛ amɛkwɛɔ,
koni ohã amɛ amɛniyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.
28Ohãa amɛ nii, ni amɛbuaa naa;
Ogbeleɔ odɛ̃, ni amɛtɔrɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.
29 Kɛ okɛ ohiɛ tee lɛ, amɛhaoɔ,
kɛ oŋɔ amɛmumɔ lɛ, amɛgboiɔ;
ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛyaa amɛsu ni amɛjɛ
mli lɛŋ ekoŋŋ.
30Kɛji okɛ omumɔ lɛ wo amɛmli lɛ,
wala baa amɛmli;
ni wala hee baa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
31Yehowa anunyam lɛ aaahi shi kɛya naanɔ.
Yehowa aaanya enitsumɔi lɛ ahe!
32 Lɛ ji mɔ ni kɛ ekwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ,
shikpɔŋ lɛ hosoɔ,
kɛ eta gɔji lɛ ahe lɛ, amɛjeɔ lasu.
33Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ,
mala mahã Yehowa.
Gbii abɔ ni miyɔɔ wala mli nɛɛ,
mala majie miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
34Miyiŋsusumɔ asa Yehowa hiɛ,
ejaakɛ lɛ ehãa minaa miishɛɛ.
35Hã eshafeelɔi atã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
ni efɔŋfeelɔi akahi shi dɔŋŋ.
Oo misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 105
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ewebii
(1 Kronika 16.8-22)
1 Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi,
Nyɛtsɛa lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ.
Nyɛhãa alea enifeemɔnii lɛ
yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
2Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa lɛ;
nyɛlaa nyɛjiea eyi.
Nyɛgbaa enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fiaa.
3Nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃a egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ atsui anyɔ amɛmli.
4Nyɛtaoa Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ;
nyɛtaoa ehiɛgbɛ daa.
5-6Oo nyɛ, etsulɔ Abraham shwiei,
nyɛ Yakobbii ni ehala,
nyɛkaia naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi ni etsu lɛ;
kɛ kojomɔi ni ekojo lɛ.
7Lɛ ji Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
emlai lɛ yɛ hã jeŋ muu fɛɛ.
8Ehiɛ yɛ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ehiɛ yɛ ewiemɔ ni ekɛ ma shi ehã yinɔi akpe lɛ nɔ;
9 kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kpãŋ lɛ,
kitã ni ekã Isak lɛ;
10 kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa ma nɔ mi ehã Yakob akɛ akpɔ lɛ;
nɔ ni ekɛhã Israel hu akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ.
11Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bo maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã
akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ gboshinii.”
12No be mli be ni amɛyi faaa ko,
ni amɛyi shɛɛɛ nɔ ko,
ni gbɔi ji amɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
13ni amɛtsomlo kɛjɛ maŋ kome nɔ
kɛtee maŋ kroko nɔ;
kɛjɛ maŋtsɛyelihe kome nɔ
kɛtee ekroko mli lɛ.
14 Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ,
ni efee amɛ efɔŋ ko;
ni ekã majiatsɛmɛi ahiɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ.
15Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkataa mimɛi ni mifɔ amɛmu lɛ ahe;
ni migbalɔi lɛ hu, nyɛkafea amɛ efɔŋ ko.”
16 Be ni Yehowa hã hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni anaaa nii aye lɛ,
17 etsu nuu ko kɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ,
Yosef mɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ.
18Awo enaji gboklɛ, ni apiŋ lɛ,
ni awo ekuɛ dade kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ,
19kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ewiemɔ lɛ ba mli,
ni Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ ma ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mi.
20 Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu ni ayafɛne lɛ;
maji anɔyelɔ lɛ hã eye ehe tswaa.
21 Ewo lɛ onukpa yɛ ewe lɛ,
ni efee lɛ enibii fɛɛ nɔyelɔ;
22koni etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ amɛfee,
ni etsɔ̃ɔ emaŋ onukpai lɛ hu nilee.
23 Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tee Ijipt,
ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Ham shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
24 Ni Yehowa hã Yakobbii lɛ shwere naakpa;
ni ehã amɛhe wa hu fe amɛhenyɛlɔi kwraa.
25Yehowa hã Ijiptbii lɛ nyɛ Yakob webii lɛ,
ni amɛkɛ amɛ ye ŋaa mli.
26 Kɛkɛ ni etsu etsulɔ Mose
kɛ Aaron, mɛi ni ehala lɛ.
27 Amɛtsu Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ Ijipt;
amɛfee naakpɛɛ nii lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
28 Nyɔŋmɔ hã duŋ wo,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wo duŋ;
shi kɛ̃lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ booo efamɔ lɛ toi.
29 Ehã amɛfai amli nui lɛ tsɔ̃ lá,
ni amɛmli loi lɛ gboi.
30 Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ kɔkɔdenei;
amɛbote amɛmaŋtsɛ we lɛ piai amli tete.
31 Nyɔŋmɔ fã, kɛkɛ ni
adɔdɔji kɛ ofɔii bayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ.
32 Ehã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ nɛ yɛ nu najiaŋ;
ni srawa gbala yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ.
33Ekumɔ amɛwaintsei kɛ agbãmitsei lɛ;
ekpãtã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei fɛɛ ahiɛ.
34 Efã, kɛkɛ ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi
ni aleee amɛyibɔ ba.
35Amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bai fɛɛ,
ni amɛ ye ŋmɔjiashi nii fɛɛ hu.
36 Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtã kromɔbi fɛɛ
ni ji amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ shishijee lɛ
ahiɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
37 Ni ejie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
ni amɛhiɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika, ni Israelbii lɛ
amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hewalɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ
38Ijipt nya yɛ amɛjɛijee lɛ hewɔ,
ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ.
39 Yehowa lɛɛ atatu mli ekɛha amɛnɔ.
Ehã amɛ la ni hã jeŋ tse nyɔɔŋ.
40 Amɛbi, ni ehã trakɔkɔi ba;
ni ehã amɛ niyenii,
babaoo ni jɛ ŋwɛi.
41 Egbele tɛsaa naa, ni nu tue kɛho;
nu lɛ ho kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ faa.
42Ejaakɛ ekai eshiwoo krɔŋkrɔŋ,
ni ewo etsulɔ Abraham lɛ.
43Hewɔ lɛ ejie emaŋ lɛ kɛje kpo kɛ miishɛɛ,
ehalamɔbii lɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala.
44 Eŋɔ majimaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ ehã amɛ,
ni amɛŋɔ mɛi lɛ adeŋmegbomɔ mli
nitsumɔnii lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ,
45bɔ ni afee ni amɛto ekpɔi lɛ ni amɛye nɔ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 106
Content:
Yehowa mlihilɛ hã ewebii
1 Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi,
ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
2Namɔ aaanyɛ Yehowa hewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ agba?
Namɔ aaanyɛ eyijiemɔ lɛ agba kɛwula shi?
3Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ jalɛ sane
ni amɛfeɔ nɔ ni ja be fɛɛ be lɛ.
4Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ mi
kɛji ona omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ.
Kɛji oohere amɛyiwala lɛ,
ye obua mi,
5koni mana ohalamɔbii lɛ ashweremɔ,
bɔ ni afee ni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ,
koni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ anya kɛ yijiemɔ.
6 Wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, wɔfee esha;
wɔfee efɔŋ, ni wɔye yiwalɛ sane.
7 Be ni wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ,
amɛyooo onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ asɛɛ,
amɛkaiii osuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ;
shi moŋ, amɛtse Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ hiɛ atua,
yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.
8Shi kɛ̃lɛ ehere amɛyiwala yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ;
koni ehã ale ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ.
9 Eŋa Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ yi, ni egbi;
ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli,
oookɛɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
10Kɛkɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala
kɛjɛ mɔ ni hetsɛ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ dɛŋ,
ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
11Nu lɛ su amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi gbidigbidi,
eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ.
12 Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe ewiemɔi lɛ amɛye;
amɛla amɛ jie eyi.
13Shi yeee be ko, ni amɛhiɛ
kpa nii ni etsu ehã amɛ lɛ anɔ,
ni amɛmɛɛɛ eŋaawoo dɔŋŋ.
14 Amɛyadi amɛkɔnɔnii asɛɛ fe nine yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ,
ni amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
15Ehã amɛ amɛnitaomɔnii lɛ,
shi ehã lootãa hela ko ni naa wa babote amɛteŋ.
16 Amɛkɔlɔ Mose kɛ Aaron,
Yehowa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, lɛ nɔ, yɛ shitoohe lɛŋ,
17ni shikpɔŋ gba, ni emi Datan,
ni etsimɔ Abiram kɛ eŋa kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ anɔ gbidigbidi.
18La je yɛ amɛsafo lɛ mli,
ni la lilɛi shã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ.
19 Amɛfee shika tsinabi amãgã hu yɛ Sinai,
ni amɛja amãgã ni ashwie lɛ.
20 Amɛŋɔ anunyam lɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ
amɛhã tsina ni kpeɔ jwɛi amãgã lɛ moŋ.
21 Amɛhiɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ,
amɛyiwalaherelɔ lɛ,
mɔ ni fee nii wuji yɛ Ijipt lɛ, nɔ.
22Lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni efee gbeyei nibii yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛŋ lɛ.
23 Nyɔŋmɔ to akɛ ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ;
shi etsulɔ Mose, mɔ ni eŋɔ lɛ lɛ,
damɔ mli ehã amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ,
ni ejɔɔ mlifu lɛ he koni ekakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
24 Amɛgbe shikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ he guɔ,
ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo lɛ amɛyeee.
25Amɛwie huhuuhu yɛ amɛbuui amli;
ni amɛbooo Yehowa gbee toi.
26No hewɔ lɛ, ekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
27 Ni eshɛrɛ amɛshwiei lɛ eshwã majimaji lɛ amli;
egbɛ amɛ eshwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ.
28 Amɛkɛ amɛhe yabɔ jemawɔŋ Baal jalɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Peor;
ni amɛye nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã gbohii.
29Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii wo Yehowa mlifu;
ni gbele hela bote amɛteŋ.
30Shi Finehas te shi,
ni edamɔ mli ehã amɛ;
kɛkɛ ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo.
31 Hewɔ lɛ, abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ
kɛjɛ yinɔ kome nɔ kɛtee ekroko nɔ,
aahu kɛya shi naanɔ fɛɛ.
32 Amɛwo Yehowa mlifu yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he,
ni amɛhewɔ lɛ, Mose na amane.
33Amɛwo Mose mli la,
ni amɛhã enaa tɛ shi.
34 Amɛkpãtãaa jeŋbii lɛ ahiɛ
tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ,
35shi moŋ amɛfutu amɛ
ni amɛkase amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ.
36Yehowa webii lɛ ja maŋsɛɛbii amãgãi lɛ,
ni no hã amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃.
37 Amɛŋɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ,
amɛkɛshãshãa afɔlei amɛhã wɔji.
38 Amɛshwie amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei ni efeko
efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi amɛkɛshã afɔle amɛhã Kanaan amãgãi lɛ
ni amɛkɛ lá lɛ bule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
39Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ wo amɛhe muji,
ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa.
40 No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli fu emaŋ lɛ,
ni enyaŋe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii lɛ.
41Etu amɛ ewo jeŋbii adɛŋ,
no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ye amɛnɔ.
42Amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ wa amɛyi waa,
ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ba amɛ shi
amɛwo amɛhewalɛ shishi.
43Yehowa jie amɛ shii abɔ,
shi amɛkɛ amɛkuɛŋtilɛ tse ehiɛ atua;
ni aba amɛ shi yɛ amɛhe esha lɛ hewɔ.
44Shi kɛ̃lɛ, be ni enu amɛbolɔmɔ lɛ,
enu amɛhaomɔ lɛ he ehã amɛ.
45Ekai ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ,
ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
46Ehã majimaji fɛɛ ni ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ na amɛ mɔbɔ.
47 Oo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala;
ni obua wɔnaa kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛba,
koni wɔda bo shi, ni wɔjie ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
48 Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ;
ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛɛ akɛ,
“Amen!”
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 107
Content:
WOLO NI JI ENUMƆ
(Lalai 107—150)
Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ kafomɔ
1 Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi
ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.
2Mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ akɛɛ nakai,
mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ haomɔ mli lɛ.
3Mɛi ni ebua amɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ,
kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ lɛ,
kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, akɛɛ nakai.
4Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi tsomlo
yɛ shiaŋa ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ;
amɛnaaa gbɛ ko ni kã
kɛyaa maŋ ni gbɔmɛi yɔɔ mli mli.
5Hɔmɔ kɛ kumai ye amɛ,
ni amɛtɔ biti.
6Kɛkɛ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli,
ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli;
7ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ trɔmɔɔ nɔ,
kɛyashɛ maŋ ni gbɔmɔ hiɔ mli mli.
8Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi,
yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ,
yɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ
ehãa gbɔmɛi abii lɛ hewɔ.
9 Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ,
ehãa lɛ nu enuɔ;
ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ lɛ,
ehãa etɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.
10Mɛi komɛi hu tara duŋ kɛ awerɛho mli,
gboklɛfoi ni awo amɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni amɛyɔɔ amanehulu mli.
11Ejaakɛ amɛte shi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ,
ni amɛnyaŋe Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ ŋaawoo lɛ.
12Akɛ nitsumɔ keketee jɔɔ amɛhe;
amɛgbeegbee shi ni bualɔ ko bɛ.
13Ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli;
ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
14Ejie amɛ kɛjɛ duŋ kɛ awerɛhoo mli,
ni etserɛ amɛkɔsɔŋkɔsɔi lɛ amli.
15Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi
yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee
kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa
gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ ahewɔ.
16Ejaakɛ ekumɔ akɔɔble agboi lɛ,
ni efolɔ dade adabaŋi lɛ amli.
17Mɛi komɛi lɛ, amɛnishaianii wo amɛ hela;
ni amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ amɛna nɔ.
18Niyenii ko niyenii ko baaa amɛtsine,
ni amɛbɛŋkɛ gbonyobu naa kpaakpa,
19ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli;
ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
20Efã, ni ewiemɔ lɛ tsa amɛ;
ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.
21Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi,
yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee
kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa
gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.
22Hã amɛshã shidaa afɔlei,
ni amɛkɛ nyamɔ lalai agba enitsumɔi lɛ.
23Mɛi komɛi kɛ lɛji yanyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ,
ni amɛtsu nii yɛ nui wuji lɛ ahiɛ;
24amɛ amɛna Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ;
amɛna enaakpɛɛnii lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
25Ejaakɛ lɛ efã ni ehã ahum ni naa wa tswa;
ni ehã ŋshɔkei lɛ fee hamahama.
26Ŋshɔkei lɛ holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi,
ni amɛnyɔɔ shi kɛyaa ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ,
ni amlakui lɛ atsui fãa yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ mli.
27Amɛkpaa, ni amɛdidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔi,
ni amɛŋaa fɛɛ laajeɔ amɛ.
28Ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli,
ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
29Ehã ahum lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa kwraa,
ni ŋshɔkei lɛ ŋmɛ dɛŋŋ.
30Amɛmii shɛ amɛhe ejaakɛ haomɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo,
ni ekɛ amɛ eshɛ amɛbele ni amɛshweɔ lɛ mli shweshweeshwe.
31Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee
kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.
32Hã amɛkafo lɛ yɛ maŋ asafo lɛŋ,
ni amɛ jie eyi yɛ onukpai akpee lɛŋ.
33Ehãa fai tsɔ̃mɔɔ shiaŋa;
ni ehãa he ni nuhiŋmɛi baa yɛ tsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.
34Ehãa shikpɔŋ ni baa nii tsɔ̃ɔ ŋoo shikpɔŋ
yɛ mɛi ni hiɔ jɛi lɛ anifeemɔnii hewɔ.
35Ehãa shiaŋa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo
ni ehãa nuhiŋmɛi tueɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ mli.
36Ehãa mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ hiɔ jɛi,
ni amɛtoɔ maŋ amɛhiɔ mli.
37Amɛfeɔ ŋmɔji, ni amɛduɔ nii;
amɛfeɔ waintromi,
ni amɛkpaa nii babaoo.
38Ejɔɔ amɛ, ni amɛyi faa naakpa;
ehãaa amɛtsinai ayifalɛ nɔ agbɔ.
39Kɛji akɛ yiwalɛ kɛ haomɔ
kɛ awerɛho hã amɛnɔ gbɔ,
ni aba amɛshi tete lɛ,
40egbeɔ lumɛi ahiɛ,
ni ehãa amɛtsomloɔ yɛ shiaŋa
ni gbɛ kadimɔ nɔ bɛ nɔ;
41shi ejieɔ ohiafoi kɛjɛɔ amanehului amli,
ni ehãa amɛshwiei shwereɔ tamɔ tookui.
42 Jalɔi naa kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi,
ni amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe,
shi efɔŋfeelɔi tɔɔ mu.
43Hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji nilelɔ lɛ
ekase nii kɛjɛ enɛɛmɛi amli;
Hã amɛsusu Yehowa suɔmɔ
ni tsakeee lɛ he.

Title: LALA 108
Content:
Henyɛlɔi anɔkunimyeli he sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko.
1 Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ,
mitsui enyɔ mimli!
Mala lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ mahã bo.
Misusuma, ohiɛ atsɛ̃!
2Obenta kɛ saŋku, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a!
Mahã leebi hiɛ atsɛ̃ mra!
3Oo Yehowa, mada bo shi,
yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ,
ni majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ!
4Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ
kwɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi,
ni onɔkwayeli lɛ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
5Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi,
ni onunyam lɛ ekpele shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
6Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere wɔyiwala.
Bo mifaikpamɔ toi,
bɔ ni afee ni ohere mɛi ni osumɔɔ lɛ ayiwala.
7Nyɔŋmɔ ewie yɛ
Ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ:
Ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mikɛ miishɛɛ aaaja Shekem mli,
ni maja Sukot Jɔɔ lɛ mahã miwebii.
8Minɔ ji Gilead;
ni minɔ ji Manase;
Efraim ji midade fai,
ni Yuda lɛ, mimaŋtsɛ tsi ni.
9Moab ji mihejuu goga;
majie mitokota matswa Edom;
Mabɔ kunimyeli oshe mawo Filistia.”
10Namɔ aaaŋɔ mi kɛaatee
maŋ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ mli?
Namɔ aaanyiɛ mihiɛ kɛaatee Edom?
11Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ani okwa wɔ lɛɛlɛŋ?
Onyiɛɛɛ wɔtai lɛ ahiɛ kɛyaaa ta dɔŋŋ?
12Oo, ye obua wɔ koni wɔkɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi awu;
ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ jeee fɛifɛi.
13Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa lɛ wɔɔye kunim,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ aaanaanaa wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kɛmɔ shi.

Title: LALA 109
Content:
Mɔ ko ni ehao mligbigblimɔ
David Lala kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
1Oo bo Nyɔŋmɔ,
mɔ yi ni mijieɔ,
kaamua onaa!
2Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ osatofoi miitswa mi lilɛi;
amɛmiimale mihe.
3Amɛhetsɛ̃ wiemɔi efo sa ewo mihe;
amɛtua mi yakatswaa ni mifeko nɔ ko.
4Be ni miisumɔ amɛ ni miisɔle miihã amɛ lɛ,
amɛ lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi moŋ.
5 Amɛkɛ efɔŋ toɔ mi ekpakpa najiaŋ,
ni amɛkɛ nyɛɛ toɔ misuɔmɔ lɛ najiaŋ.
6Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Fãa yiwalɔ ko owo ehe,
hã naafolɔlɔ ko afolɔ enaa.
7Kɛ akojo lɛ lɛ, hã abu lɛ fɔ;
ni aŋɔ esɔlemɔ po akɛ eshafeemɔ.
8 Afo ewala gbii anɔ kuku;
ni enii fɛɛ atsɔ̃ mɔ kroko nɔ.
9Hã ebii atsɔ̃mɔ awusãi,
ni eŋa atsɔ̃ okulafo.
10Hã ebii akpa shi amɛsisɛ̃;
hã ashwie amɛ yɛ amaŋfɔ̃i tete ni amɛyɔɔ mli lɛ amli.
11Enyɔmɔtsɛ ashɔ̃ nii ni eyɔɔ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ;
ni gbɔi hu aha edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli nii fɛɛ.
12Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafee lɛ ejurɔ,
ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hu akana ebii awusãi lɛ mɔbɔ.
13Hã aplenee eshwiei fɛɛ,
ni agbe egbɛi yɛ yinɔi ni baaba lɛ ateŋ.
14 Yehowa akai etsɛmɛi lɛ anishaianii lɛ,
ni akɛ enyɛ he esha lɛ hu akafa lɛ.
15 Yehowa akai amɛhe eshai lɛ daa;
amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, akakai amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
16Ejaakɛ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ejwɛŋŋ ejurɔfeemɔ he;
shi moŋ ewa ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ
kɛ mɔ ni ewerɛ eho ehe lɛ yi,
kɛyashiɔ egbele mli.
17Esumɔɔ loomɔ;
hewɔ lɛ loomɔ aba enɔ;
esumɔɔɔ jɔɔmɔ;
hewɔ lɛ ekɛ jɔɔmɔ teŋ ajekɛ.
18 Ewo loomɔ tamɔ atade;
loomɔ lɛ abote ehewojiaŋ tamɔ nu,
ni ebote ewuiaŋ tamɔ mu.
19Loomɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ mama ni ebu daa;
kɛ mlifiinɔ, ni ekɛfi emli daa.
20Hã enɛ afee nyɔmɔwoo
ni aaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ahã
minaaflɔlɔi kɛ mɛi ni
wieɔ mihe efɔŋ lɛ.
21Oo miNuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,
Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ ye misane lɛ ohã mi;
ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ heremɔ mi.
22Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi,
ni minii yɛ mɔbɔ;
ni mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli.
23Milaaje tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔ̃ɔŋ
ahwanya mi tamɔ baalabi.
24Ŋmaahilɛ sɔŋŋ ehã minakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ,
mitã loo, ni mifee kanyakanya.
25Mitsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔnɔ mihã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ;
ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei.
26Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, ye obua mi.
Heremɔ miyiwala yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
27Hã amɛle akɛ, bo Yehowa,
oninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ,
akɛ bo ohere miyiwala.
28 Hã amɛ lɛ, amɛlomɔ mi;
shi bo lɛ ojɔɔ mi!
Hã mɛi ni heɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi.
Shɛjemɔ otsulɔ mii.
29 Hã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ awula kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ;
ni amɛhiɛgbele lɛ akpɛtɛ amɛhe tamɔ mama.
30Mikɛ minaabu aaada Yehowa shi babaoo,
ni majie eyi yɛ mɛi babaoo ateŋ,
31ejaakɛ lɛ efãa ohiafo he,
ni ehereɔ eyiwala kɛjɛɔ mɛi ni buɔ lɛ gbele fɔ lɛ adɛŋ.

Title: LALA 110
Content:
Yehowa kɛ Emaŋtsɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ
David Lala ko.
1 Yehowa kɛɛ minuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ,
“Ta mininejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ
ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.”
2 Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ekɛ omaŋtsɛ tsi wulu lɛ ahã bo.
Eeekɛɛ akɛ, “Ye lumɔ yɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.”
3 Gbi nɔ ni ooofã ta lɛ,
omaŋbii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ
yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa.
Oblahii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ
tamɔ leebi bɔ yɛ ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
4 Yehowa ekã kitã,
ni etsakeŋ ejwɛŋmɔ,
“Bo ji osɔfo kɛmiiya naanɔ
yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa.”
5 Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ;
eeetswia maŋtsɛmɛi ashi yɛ emlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
6Eeekojo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ,
ni amɛmli aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbohii.
Eeeplenee maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ
yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
7 Eeenu faa ni yɔɔ gbɛ toi mli nu,
no hewɔ lɛ, eeeye omanye.

Title: LALA 111
Content:
Yehowa yijiemɔ
1Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Mada Yehowa shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ,
yɛ jalɔi agwabɔɔ lɛ mli,
yɛ asafo lɛ mli.
2 Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ;
ni mɛi fɛɛ ni naa he tsui lɛ kaseɔ.
3Enitsumɔ lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ woo kɛ agbojee;
ni ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
4Ehãa akaiɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.
Durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa.
5 Ehãa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ yeɔ nii tɔrɔɔ;
be fɛɛ be lɛ ekaiɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.
6Ehãa emaŋ lɛ leɔ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ;
ejaakɛ ekɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ hãa emaŋ lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii.
7Eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ,
anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyeli ni;
ni ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.
8Amɛma shi shiŋŋ daa kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ;
koni akɛ anɔkwaleyeli kɛ jalɛ atsu he nii.
9Ehã akpɔ̃ ewebii lɛ,
ni ekɛ amɛkpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ,
Egbɛi lɛ he tse,
ni egbɛi lɛ he yɛ gbeyei.
10 Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ amɛnaa niiashishinumɔ kpakpa.
Eyijiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.

Title: LALA 112
Content:
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa miishɛɛnamɔ
1 Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei,
ni eyɔɔ ekitãi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ lɛ.
2 Eshwiei aaatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔmɛi wuji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
aaajɔɔ jalɔ lɛ shwiei.
3Ninamɔ kɛ shika aaahi ewe lɛ,
ni ejalɛ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaaya naanɔ.
4 Jalɔi lɛ, la tsoɔ yɛ duŋ mli hãa amɛ;
durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ jalɔ ji lɛ.
5 Mɔ ni mli hi, ni efaa mɔ nɔ,
ni ekɛ anɔkwayeli feɔ enii fɛɛ lɛ, aaahi ahã lɛ.
6Jalɔ lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko tsakeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko;
aaakai lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
7Esheee sane fɔŋ ko he adafitswaa gbeyei,
ehemɔkɛyeli mli wa, ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa nɔ.
8 Etsui efãaa, ni esheŋ gbeyei
kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena
ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anaagbee.
9 Edɛŋ kpɔɔ pam hãa ohiafoi,
ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ;
aaahã ena hewalɛ,
ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam.
10 Mɛi fɔ̃ji naa enɛ,
ni amɛmli woɔ la,
amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi, ni amɛlaajeɔ;
mɛi fɔ̃ji ataomɔnii fɛɛ feɔ yaka.

Title: LALA 113
Content:
Ajie Yehowa mlihilɛ yi
1Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Oo nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea,
nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi!
2Ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi,
kɛjɛ benɛ mli aahu kɛyaashi naanɔ!
3Esa akɛ ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi
kɛjɛ hulu shiteehe aahu kɛyaashi eshinyɔɔhe!
4Yehowa kwɔ gojoo kɛteke majimaji fɛɛ,
ni enunyam lɛ teke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi.
5 Namɔ tamɔ Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi,
6ni emaa ehiɛ shi,
ni ekwɛɔ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ?
7 Eteɔ ohiafo shi kɛjɛɔ mlu mli,
ni ewoɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ nɔ kɛjɛɔ tumo nɔ,
8koni ehã ekɛ abladei ni ji emaŋ lɛ mli
abladei lɛ atara shi.
9 Ehãa yoo kene tsɔ̃ɔ shĩanyɛ,
ni etsɔ̃ɔ biianyɛ ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 114
Content:
Hehoo Gbijurɔ lala
1 Be ni Israelbii lɛ je Ijipt
ni Yakob shwiei lɛ je maŋ
ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ lɛŋ lɛ,
2Yuda tsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ,
ni Israel tsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.
3Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ na, ni ejo foi;
Yordan hu kpa hoo.
4 Gɔji lɛ tumɔ tamɔ ojwɛnii,
ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu tumɔ tamɔ gwantɛŋbii.
5Oo Ŋshɔ, te aye tɛŋŋ,
ni ojoɔ foi nɛɛ?
Bo Yordan hu, ni okpa hoo nɛɛ?
6Oo nyɛ gɔji,
mɛni eba ni nyɛtumɔɔ
tamɔ ojwɛnii nɛɛ?
7 Bo shikpɔŋ, ohe akpokpo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ,
yɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ,
8 mɔ ni hãa tɛsaa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo,
ni ehãa tswɛrɛbo tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi lɛ!

Title: LALA 115
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ Anɔkwafo koome lɛ
1Jeee wɔ,
Yehowa, jeee wɔ,
shi ogbɛi lɛ moŋ aŋɔ anunyam ahã,
yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ!
2 Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ,
“Nɛgbɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?”
3WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
Ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ eyɔɔ;
ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.
4 Amɛmãgãi lɛ,
jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni;
gbɔmɔ adesa ninenaa nitsumɔ ni.
5Amɛyɛ naabui, shi amɛwieee;
amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii.
6Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii;
amɛyɛ gugɔji, shi amɛfuuu nii.
7Amɛyɛ niji, shi amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ mli;
amɛyɛ naji hu, shi amɛnyiɛɛɛ;
ni amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ tete.
8Mɛi ni fee amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ;
nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ
amɛnɔ lɛ hu tamɔ amɛ.
9 Oo Israelbii,
nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔ̃a Yehowa nɔ!
Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.
10 Oo Aaronwe,
nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ!
Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ!
11Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei,
nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ.
Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.
12Yehowa ekai wɔ, ni eeejɔɔ wɔ;
Eeejɔɔ Israel we lɛ;
eeejɔɔ Aaron we lɛ.
13Eeejɔɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ,
mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ.
14Yehowa aaahã nyɛshwere babaoo,
nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii fɛɛ.
15Yehowa, ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ nyɛ.
16Ŋwɛi lɛ, Yehowa ŋwɛi ni;
shi shikpɔŋ lɛ, eŋɔ ehã gbɔmɛi abii.
17 Jeee gbohii jieɔ Yehowa yi,
ni jeee mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ;
18shi wɔ, hiɛkãalɔi lɛ moŋ wɔɔjie Yehowa yi,
kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli, aahu kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 116
Content:
Mɔ ko ni ahere lɛ miijie Nyɔŋmɔ yi
1Miisumɔ Yehowa,
ejaakɛ ebo migbee kɛ mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi.
2Akɛni egboo etoi shi ehã mi hewɔ lɛ,
gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ mabolɔ matsɛ.
3 Gbele tsɔnei lɛ bɔle mi kɛkpe,
gbohiiaje gbeyei lɛ mɔ mi;
mina nɔ̃, ni miwerɛ ho mihe.
4Kɛkɛ ni mibo mitsɛ Yehowa akɛ,
“Oo Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, heremɔ miyiwala!”
5Durolɔ kɛ jalɔ ji Yehowa;
wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ni.
6Yehowa baa humii ayi;
be ni aba mi shi lɛ ehere miyiwala.
7 Oo, misusuma,
kuu osɛɛ ni oyajɔɔ ohe,
ejaakɛ Yehowa efee bo ejurɔ pii.
8Ejaakɛ ojie mi yɛ gbele dɛŋ,
ofo mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu sɛɛ,
ni ohãaa mashane ni magbee shi.
9 Yehowa hiŋmɛi aaakã mihe
yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
10 Mihiɛ mihemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ,
be ni mikɛɛ akɛ,
“Ahao mi naakpa” lɛ.
11 Mikɛ tsuifãa kɛɛ akɛ,
“Gbɔmɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaaŋɔ he afɔ enɔ.”
12Mɛni maŋɔ to Yehowa najiaŋ,
yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni efee mi lɛ hewɔ?
13Mawo yiwalaheremɔ kpulu lɛ nɔ,
ni matsɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ.
14 Maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
15 Yehowa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ
agbele jara wa yɛ ehiɛ.
16Oo Yehowa, otsulɔ ji mi;
otsulɔ kɛ oweyoo bi ji mi.
Okpɔlɔ migboklɛi lɛ.
17Mashã shidaa afɔle mahã bo,
ni maja Yehowa.
18Maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ
mahã Yehowa yɛ emaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ,
19yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ yɛ bo omli.
Oo Yerusalɛm!
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.

Title: LALA 117
Content:
Yehowa yijiemɔ
1Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ maji anɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛkafoa lɛ!
2 Ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ kpele ni tsakeee lɛ fa yɛ wɔnɔ;
ni Yehowa anɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 118
Content:
Kunimyeli he shidaa
1 Oo, nyɛdaaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi,
ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.
2 Hã Israelbii akɛɛ akɛ,
“Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.”
3Hã Aaronwe lɛ akɛɛ akɛ,
“Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.”
4Hã mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ akɛɛ akɛ,
“Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.”
5Mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ mibolɔ mitsɛ Yehowa,
ni Yehowa here mi nɔ, ni ehã miye mihe.
6 Akɛni Yehowa yɛ misɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, misheee gbeyei!
Mɛni gbɔmɔ aaanyɛ mi afee?
7 Yehowa damɔ mimasɛi akɛ mibualɔ;
ni mana mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ anaagbee.
8Ehi akɛ abaa Yehowa abo,
fe nɔ ni akɛ hiɛ aaafɔ̃ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ.
9 Ehi akɛ abaa Yehowa abo,
fe nɔ ni akɛ hiɛ aaafɔ̃ abladei anɔ.
10Majimaji bɔle mihe kɛkpe kpula;
Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ,
mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.
11Amɛbɔle mi,
hɛɛ, amɛbɔle mi kɛkpe kpula;
Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ,
mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.
12 Amɛbɔle mi tamɔ wobii;
amɛtso grigri tamɔ ŋmei la;
Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ,
mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.
13Atsi mi waa,
ni kulɛ miyagbee shi;
shi Yehowa ye ebua mi.
14 Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala;
Yehowa etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
15Nyɛboa toi,
kunimyeli nyamɔ lalai miigbɛɛ yɛ jalɔi abuui amli.
16Yehowa hewalɛ kpele lɛ ni fee enɛ!
Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ehã wɔye kunim.
Ehewalɛ kpele lɛ ehã wɔye ta mli kunim.
17Migboŋ, shi moŋ miyi aaana wala,
ni majaje Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
18 Yehowa egbala mitoi waa moŋ,
shi eŋɔko mi ehãko gbele.
19Nyɛgbelea jalɛ agboi lɛ nyɛhãa mi,
koni matsɔ̃ mli ni mayada Yehowa shi.
20Yehowa agbo lɛ nɛ.
Jalɔi lɛ baatsɔ̃ mli kɛbote mli.
21Miida bo shi akɛ ohere mi nɔ,
ni otsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
22 Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ kwa lɛ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.
23Yehowa nifeemɔnii nɛ;
eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiɛ.
24Ŋmɛnɛ ji gbi ni Yehowa fee lɛ,
nyɛhãa wɔmli afilia wɔ,
ni wɔnyaa yɛ mli.
25Oo Yehowa, ofainɛ,
heremɔ wɔyiwala koo!
Oo Yehowa, hã omanye aba koo!
26 Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛŋ lɛ!
Wɔmiijɔɔ nyɛ kɛmiijɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
27Yehowa lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni ehã la etso ehã wɔ.
Nyɛhiɛa gbijurɔ blɛo lɛ
kɛyaa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe tɔ̃ɔ.
28Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, mada bo shi.
Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, makafo bo.
29Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi;
ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.

Title: LALA 119
Content:
Yehowa Mla lɛ
1 Ajɔɔ mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛjeŋba he,
ni amɛyeɔ Yehowa mla lɛ nɔ lɛ.
2Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ
ni amɛkɛ amɛtsui muu fɛɛ taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ,
3mɛi ni efeee nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ hu,
shi amɛbaa amɛjeŋ yɛ Yehowa gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
4Yehowa, okɛ omlai lɛ hã wɔ,
ni ofã wɔ akɛ wɔye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
5Oo, mina ni kulɛ mikɛ anɔkwayeli
aaaye omlai lɛ anɔ.
6Kɛji mikɛ okitãi lɛ fɛɛ eto mihiɛ lɛ,
no lɛ mihiɛ eshwieŋ shi.
7Mikɛ tsui krɔŋŋ aaajie oyi
kɛji mikase ojalɛ mlai lɛ.
8Maye okpɔi lɛ anɔ,
Oo, kaakwa mi kwrakwra.
Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli
9Te oblanyo aaafee tɛŋŋ,
ni eeehã ejeŋba he atse hu?
No ji akɛ ekwɛ ehe nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
10Mitaoɔ osɛɛgbɛ kɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ;
kaahã migba afã kɛje okitãi lɛ ahe.
11Mikɛ owiemɔ lɛ eto mitsui mli
koni mikafee esha mishi bo.
12Oo Yehowa, majie oyi,
tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi okpɔi lɛ.
13Mikɛ minaabu jajeɔ omlai lɛ
fɛɛ ni jɛɔ onaa lɛ.
14Minaa okpɔi lɛ ahe miishɛɛ
fe bɔ ni mimli filiɔ mi
yɛ ninamɔ kpɔtɔɔ he.
15Majwɛŋ okpɔi lɛ ahe,
ni mihiɛ aaakã otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ.
16 Mimli aaafli mi yɛ okpɔi lɛ ahe;
mihiɛ kpaŋ owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ he miishɛɛnamɔ
17Okɛ otsulɔ aye mlihilɛ naa
koni miyi ana wala,
koni maye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
18Gbelemɔ mihiŋmɛii koni mana
omla lɛ mli naakpɛɛnii lɛ.
19 Gbɔ ji mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
kaaŋɔ okitãi lɛ otee mi.
20Shwee ni mishweɔ omlai lɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ,
ewo misusuma hela.
21 Okãa hewolɔi, ni mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ
kɛjeɔ okitãi lɛ ahe lɛ, alomɔ amɛ.
22Jiemɔ mi kɛje ahorabɔlɔi kɛ heguɔgbelɔi adɛŋ,
ejaakɛ miye omlai lɛ anɔ.
23Lumɛi tete po taraa shi amɛkpãŋɔ miyi nɔ;
shi mi, otsulɔ lɛ, majwɛŋ okpɔi lɛ ahe.
24Otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ hãa mimli filiɔ mi,
nomɛi woɔ mi ŋaa.
Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli he hiɛdɔɔ
25Misusuma kã mlu mli;
hã miyi ana wala yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
26Be ni mijaje mijeŋba fɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ, obo mi toi;
tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi okpɔi lɛ.
27Hã manu omlai lɛ ashishi
koni majwɛŋ onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
28Miwerɛ eho kɛteke nɔ;
wo mi hewalɛ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
29Kaahã amale jeŋba miigbale mi;
ni omlihilɛ naa lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi omla lɛ.
30Miŋɔ anɔkwayeli gbɛ,
mikɛ omlai lɛ eto mihiɛ.
31Oo Yehowa, mikpɛtɛ omlai lɛ,
kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi.
32Manyiɛ okitãi agbɛ lɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ
kɛji ogbele mijwɛŋmɔ mli.
Niiashishinumɔ he Sɔlemɔ
33Oo Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi omlai lɛ ashishi;
koni maye nɔ be fɛɛ be.
34Dromɔ mi niiashishinumɔ,
bɔ ni afee ni maye omla lɛ nɔ kɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ.
35Kplamɔ mi kɛnyiɛ okitãi lɛ agbɛ lɛ nɔ,
ejaakɛ nomɛi ahe mimii shɛɔ.
36Hã mashwe omlai lɛ anɔyeli fe ninamɔ.
37Kaahã minya yakanii kwɛmɔ he,
shi moŋ hã mana wala yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
38Shi ni owo mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ,
hã aba mli nakai ahã mi, otsulɔ.
39Hã ahorabɔɔ ni misheɔ lɛ akagbale mi,
ejaakɛ okpɔi lɛ fɛɛ hi.
40Naa, miishwe omlai lɛ;
ni ojalɛ naa lɛ hã miyi ana wala.
Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ
41Oo Yehowa, hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ,
kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ afee minɔ yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa;
42kɛkɛ lɛ, mana hetoo mahã mɛi ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ;
ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
43Asaŋ kaajie anɔkwa wiemɔ lɛ kɛmiije midaaŋ kwrakwra;
ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã omlai lɛ anɔ.
44Maye omla lɛ nɔ daa
kɛyaashi naanɔi anaanɔ;
45ni maye mihe kɛnyiɛ,
ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ mitao.
46 Majaje okpɔi lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ,
ni mihiɛ gboŋ he;
47ejaakɛ mimii shɛɔ mihe
yɛ okitãi ni misumɔɔ lɛ ahewɔ.
48Mibuɔ okitãi ni misumɔɔ lɛ,
ni mijwɛŋɔ okpɔi lɛ ahe.
Yehowa Mla lɛ mli ekãanamɔ
49Kaimɔ owiemɔ ni okɛ otsulɔ wie
ni ehã mina hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.
50 Enɛ ji mimiishɛjemɔ
yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli,
akɛ owiemɔ lɛ hãa miyi naa wala.
51Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei
yeɔ mihe fɛo naakpa;
kɛ̃lɛ mijeko omla lɛ sɛɛ.
52Oo Yehowa, kɛji mikai oteteete mlai lɛ,
ehãa mimii shɛɔ mihe.
53Mimli ewo la naakpa
yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ni kwaa omla lɛ ahewɔ.
54Okpɔi lɛ ji lalai ni milaa
yɛ migbɔtoo be yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
55Oo Yehowa, nyɔɔŋ tete mikaiɔ ogbɛi,
ni miyeɔ omla lɛ nɔ.
56Nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ feɔ minɔ,
ejaakɛ miyeɔ okpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli
57Yehowa, bo ji migbɛfaŋnɔ;
miiwo shi akɛ maye owiemɔi lɛ anɔ.
58Mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ miikpa fai
koni ona mi mɔbɔ yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.
59Kɛji mijwɛŋ mijeŋba he lɛ,
mikuɔ misɛɛ kɛbaa okpɔi lɛ ahe.
60Mihe feɔ oya koni maye okitãi lɛ anɔ,
ni mishashaooo shi.
61Mɛi fɔ̃ji akpãi lɛ fimɔɔ mi moŋ nɛ;
shi kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa omla lɛ nɔ.
62 Miteɔ shi nyɔɔŋteŋ mijieɔ oyi
yɛ ojalɛ kojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
63Mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ
kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ okpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ anaanyo ji mi.
64 Oo Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ
eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ;
tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi koni male omlai lɛ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ jarawalɛ
65Oo Yehowa, ofee otsulɔ ejurɔ
yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
66Hã mi jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa kɛ nilee,
ejaakɛ miheɔ okitãi lɛ miyeɔ.
67 Midu gbɛ dani agbala mitoi lɛ,
shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mibo owiemɔ lɛ toi.
68Ohi, ni ofeɔ ejurɔ;
tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi okpɔi lɛ.
69Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei
folɔɔ amale saji shwieɔ minɔ;
shi mi lɛ, mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ
yeɔ otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ.
70Hewolɔi nɛɛ, amɛtsui wa,
shi mi lɛ, omla lɛ he mimii shɛɔ.
71Ehi akɛ agbala mitoi,
koni makase okpɔi lɛ.
72 Mla ni jɛ onaa lɛ, ehi hã mi
fe shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi akpei abɔ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ jalɛ
73Bo obɔ mi, ni okɛ oniji shɔ̃ mi;
hã mi niiashishinumɔ koni makase okitãi lɛ.
74Mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ
aaana mi, ni amɛaana miishɛɛ;
ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
75Oo Yehowa, mile akɛ okojomɔi lɛ ja,
ni anɔkwayeli okɛgbala mitoi!
76 Hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ ashɛje mimii,
tamɔ bɔ ni owo otsulɔ shi lɛ.
77Naa mi mɔbɔ koni miyi ana wala;
ejaakɛ omla lɛ he mimii shɛɔ.
78Mɛi ni sheee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, gbeyei lɛ,
hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi;
ejaakɛ yakatswaa amɛfolɔ minaa lɛ;
shi mi lɛ, majwɛŋ otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ahe.
79Hã mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ
akpale kɛba miŋɔɔ koni amɛbale okpɔi lɛ.
80Kaahã kpa ko miihi mitsui mli
yɛ omlai lɛ agbɛfaŋ,
koni mihiɛ akashwie shi.
Kpɔmɔ he sɔlemɔ
81Misusuma miiye oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he kumai,
ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
82Mihiŋmɛi miiye oshiwoo lɛ he kumai.
Mibiɔ akɛ, “Te be ni oooshɛje mimii hu?”
83Ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ tamɔ wain wolo tɔ momo yɛ lasu mli;
kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa okpɔi lɛ anɔ.
84Mɛɛbe otsulɔ aaamɛ kɛyashi?
Mɛɛbe ooogbala mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ atoi.
85Mɛi ni sheee bo gbeyei,
mɛi ni yeee omlai lɛ anɔ lɛ,
etsatsaa bui amɛto mi.
86Okitãi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni;
amɛkɛ amale folɔɔ minaa; ye obua mi.
87Shwɛ shrao ni amɛplenee mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
shi mi lɛ, mikwako okpɔi lɛ.
88Yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ hã miyi ana wala,
koni maye okpɔi ni jɛ onaa lɛ anɔ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ
89 Oo Yehowa, owiemɔ lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ
yɛ ŋwɛi kɛmiiya naanɔ.
90Onɔkwayeli lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ema shi shiŋŋ nɛɛ.
91Bo ofãmɔ naa lɛ, amɛyɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ;
ejaakɛ otsuji ji nibii fɛɛ kwa.
92Eji jeee omla lɛ he mimii shɛɔ kulɛ,
be nɛ mihiɛ ekpãtã momo,
yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli.
93Mihiɛ kpaŋ omlai lɛ anɔ gbi ko gbi ko;
ejaakɛ nomɛi anɔ otsɔ̃ ni ohã miyi na wala.
94Onɔ ji mi, heremɔ mi,
ejaakɛ mitao omlai lɛ asɛɛgbɛ.
95Mɛi fɔ̃ji woɔ mi ka koni amɛkpãtã mihiɛ,
shi mi lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ omlai lɛ anɔ.
96Mina akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ naagbee,
shi okitã lɛ, ebɛ naagbee.
Yehowa Mla lɛ he suɔmɔ
97 Oo, misumɔɔ omla lɛ akɛ nɔ ko!
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, no he mijwɛŋɔ.
98 Okitãi lɛ hãa mileɔ nii fe mihenyɛlɔi lɛ;
ejaakɛ mihiɛ mli kpɛŋŋ.
99Miyɛ niiashishinumɔ fe mitsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ,
ejaakɛ okpɔi lɛ ahe mijwɛŋɔ.
100Minuɔ niiashishi kwraa fe hiimeji tete po,
ejaakɛ miyeɔ okpɔi lɛ anɔ.
101Mikɔ minane kɛje gbɛ fɔŋ fɛɛ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ,
koni maye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
102Migbako afã kɛjeko owiemɔi lɛ ahe,
ejaakɛ bo otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii.
103 Owiemɔi lɛ ŋɔɔ minaa akɛ nɔ ko;
eŋɔɔ minaa fe wo tete!
104Kɛtsɔ̃ omlai lɛ anɔ lɛ, minaa niiashishinumɔ;
hewɔ lɛ miihi jeŋba fɔŋ fɛɛ jeŋba fɔŋ.
La ni kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ Yehowa Mla lɛŋ lɛ
105 Owiemɔ ji kane hã minanefaamɔ,
kɛ la ni kpɛɔ yɛ migbɛ nɔ.
106Mikã kitã, ni mima nɔ mi akɛ
maye ojalɛ mlai lɛ anɔ.
107Miina nɔ naakpa!
Oo Yehowa, hã miyi ana wala yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa!
108 Oo Yehowa, ŋɔɔ oyi ni mijieɔ lɛ akɛ afɔle,
koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.
109Mihiɛ miwala yɛ midɛŋ be fɛɛ be;
shi omla lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa nɔ.
110Mɛi fɔ̃ji etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne moŋ nɛ,
shi miduko gbɛ kɛjeko otsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ahe.
111Miŋɔ omlai lɛ mifee migbɛfaŋnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ,
ejaakɛ nomɛi ahe miishɛɛ mitsui naa.
112Mikpɛ miyiŋ akɛ maye omlai lɛ anɔ daa kɛyaashi naanɔ.
Shweshweeshwe yɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ naa
113Jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛi lɛ miihi amɛ;
shi misumɔɔ omla lɛ.
114 Bo ji miteemɔhe kɛ mitsɛŋ;
owiemɔ lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.
115Nyɛ efɔŋfeelɔi, nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa,
koni maye miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ.
116Hiɛmɔ mimli yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa, koni miyi ana wala;
ni mihiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi.
117Hiɛmɔ mimli koni mafee shweshweeshwe,
koni maye okpɔi lɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be.
118Mɛi fɛɛ ni duɔ gbɛ kɛjeɔ okpɔi lɛ ahe lɛ, okwaa amɛ;
ejaakɛ amɛnilee fɛɛ lɛ shishiumɔ ni.
119Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ lɛ,
oshɛrɛɔ amɛ oshwieɔ tamɔ dadefei;
no hewɔ lɛ, miisumɔ okitãi lɛ.
120Ohe gbeyei naa lɛ, mihe kpokpoɔ;
ni miishe odɛ̃ŋ kojomɔi lɛ agbeyei.
Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli
121Nɔ ni ja ni hi lɛ, mifee;
kaaŋmɛɛ mihe ohã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ.
122Daamɔ mli ohã otsulɔ, koni ahi ahã lɛ;
kaahã mɛi ni sheee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, gbeyei miiwa mi yi.
123Etɔ mi kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ
kɛ ojalɛ shiwoo lɛ gbɛkwɛmɔ.
124Okɛ otsulɔ aye yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa;
ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi omlai lɛ.
125Otsulɔ ji mi; dromɔ mi niiashishinumɔ,
koni male omlai lɛ.
126Be ni Yehowa baafee nɔ ko lɛ eshɛ;
ejaakɛ akwa omla lɛ.
127 No hewɔ lɛ, miisumɔ okitãi lɛ fe shika;
hɛɛ fe shika krɔŋŋ.
128No hewɔ lɛ, mibaa mijeŋ yɛ okpɔi lɛ anaa.
Miihi kutumpɔo gbɛi fɛɛ.
Ashweɔ Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔyeli
129Omlai lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ,
no hewɔ lɛ, misusuma yeɔ nɔ.
130 Owiemɔi lɛ amlitsɔ̃ɔmɔ,
gbeleɔ jwɛŋmɔ mli fãŋŋ,
ni ehãa mɔ ni leee nii leɔ nii.
131Migbɛɔ midaaŋ kɛ tsuisuu,
yɛ shwee ni mishweɔ okitãi lɛ ahewɔ.
132Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ okwɛ mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ,
tamɔ bɔ ni ofeɔ ohãa mɛi ni sumɔɔ ogbɛi lɛ.
133 Hã minane amɔ shi yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa,
ni kaahã nɔsha ko miiye minɔ.
134Heremɔ mi kɛjɛ adesa yiwalɛ mli,
koni maye omlai lɛ anɔ.
135Tse ohiɛ ohã otsulɔ
koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.
136Mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu hoɔ tamɔ faa,
ejaakɛ ayeee omlai lɛ anɔ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ naa jalɛ saneyeli
137Oo Yehowa, jalɔ ji bo,
ni okojomɔi lɛ hu ja kɛmɔ shi.
138Kitãi ni awo yɛ omlai lɛ ahe lɛ,
jalɛ kɛ anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni.
139 Mihiɛdɔɔ hãa mimli woɔ la fe nine;
ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ kpaa owiemɔi lɛ anɔ.
140Aka oshiwoo lɛ akwɛ,
ni ana akɛ anɔkwale ni;
no hewɔ ni otsulɔ sumɔɔ oshiwoi lɛ.
141Mi lɛ, fufɔoo ji mi, ni abuuu mi;
shi kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kpaaa omlai lɛ anɔ.
142Ojalɛ lɛ, naanɔ jalɛ ni,
ni omla lɛ, anɔkwale ni.
143Haomɔ kɛ piŋmɔ kã minɔ,
shi kɛ̃lɛ okitãi lɛ ji nɔ ni shɛjeɔ mimii.
144Omlai lɛ ja kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Hã mi niiashishinumɔ koni miyi ana wala.
Kpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ
145Mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ bolɔɔ tsɛɔ bo!
Oo Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ,
ni maye omlai lɛ anɔ.
146Miibolɔ miitsɛ bo!
Heremɔ miyiwala koni maye omlai lɛ anɔ.
147Miteɔ shi maŋkɛ mra mibolɔɔ.
Hɛɛ, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ!
Mihiɛ kã owiemɔi lɛ anɔ.
148Mibɛɛɛ mihiŋmɛi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ;
koni majwɛŋ oshiwoi lɛ ahe.
149Bo mi toi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
Oo Yehowa, yɛ ojalɛ naa lɛ baamɔ miyi!
150Mɛi ni kɛ yiŋsha waa mi yi lɛ miibɛŋkɛ mi.
Amɛ lɛ amɛkɛ omla lɛ tsuuu nii.
151Shi Yehowa, bo lɛ obɛŋkɛ mi,
ni okitãi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.
152Mile kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe, kɛtsɔ̃ omlai lɛ anɔ,
akɛ oto omlai lɛ oma shi shiŋŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he faikpamɔ
153Kwɛmɔ mimanehulu, ni ohere mi;
ejaakɛ mihiɛ kpaaa omla lɛ nɔ.
154Ye misane lɛ ohã mi ni okpɔ̃ mi;
hã miyi ana wala yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.
155Mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahereŋ amɛyiwala;
ejaakɛ amɛdiii omlai lɛ asɛɛ.
156Oo Yehowa, omɔbɔnalɛ fa babaoo,
ojalɛ saneyeli naa lɛ, hã miyi ana wala.
157Mɛi ni waa mi yi kɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi fa naakpa;
kɛ̃lɛ mishiko omlai lɛ.
158Mikwɛɔ mɛi ni bɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ni amɛnii feɔ mi taŋ;
ejaakɛ amɛyeee okitãi lɛ anɔ.
159Kwɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ omlai lɛ!
Hã miyi ana wala, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
160 Owiemɔ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni;
ni ojalɛ kojomɔi lɛ fɛɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Henɔjɔɔmɔ kɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ hãmɔ
161Lumɛi folɔɔ minaa yakatswaa kɛ yiwalɛ
shi mijɛɔ mitsui mli mibuɔ owiemɔi lɛ.
162Minaa owiemɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ
tamɔ mɔ ko ni eto jwetri wulu ahuu.
163Minyɛɔ, ni mihiɔ apasa;
shi misumɔɔ omla lɛ.
164Mijieɔ oyi shii kpawo daa gbi,
yɛ ojalɛ mlai lɛ ahewɔ.
165Mɛi ni sumɔɔ omla lɛ,
amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ babaoo naakpa
ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni woɔ amɛnajiaŋ.
166 Oo Yehowa, mihiɛ kã oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ;
ni miyeɔ okitãi lɛ anɔ.
167Misusuma yeɔ omlai lɛ anɔ;
miisumɔ mlai lɛ naakpa.
168 Miyeɔ omlai kɛ okpɔi lɛ anɔ,
ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛi jwere nɔ fɛɛ nɔ
ni mifeɔ nɔ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ
169Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔmɔ toi;
hã mi niiashishinumɔ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
170Hã mifaikpamɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ;
heremɔ mi yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.
171Minaabu aaafɔse oyijiemɔ,
ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.
172 Mililɛi aaala omla lɛ he lala,
ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ fɛɛ ja.
173Feemɔ kralo ni oye obua mi,
ejaakɛ miŋɔ omlai lɛ.
174Oo Yehowa, miishwe odɛ̃ŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ;
ni omla lɛ ji nɔ ni shɛjeɔ mimii.
175Hã miyi ana wala bɔ ni afee ni majie oyi;
ni ohã omlai lɛ aye abua mi.
176 Midu gbɛ tamɔ too ni elaaje;
blɛ baatao mi, otsulɔ, ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ mihiɛ kpako nɔ.

Title: LALA 120
Content:
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ mibo mitsɛ Yehowa,
koni ebo mi toi.
2Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo Yehowa,
heremɔ miyiwala kɛje amalelɔi kɛ shishiulɔi adɛŋ.
3Bo shishiulɔ, mɛni Yehowa baahã bo,
ni mɛni hu ebaafee efata he ehã bo?
4Etamɔ tabilɔ gãimlibii ni naa ba
kɛ ŋai la ni tsoɔ!
5Kpoo hã mi akɛ mibato gbɔ yɛ Mesek,
ni mibahi Kedar bui lɛ amasɛi.
6Mibahi mɛi ni miihi toiŋjɔlɛ ateŋ be babaoo tsɔ̃.
