7Mi lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ gbɔmɔ ji mi;
shi kɛji miwie pɛ,
amɛ lɛ, amɛto ta amɛwo mi.

Title: LALA 121
Content:
Yehowa wɔhebulɔ lɛ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1Miiwo mihiɛ nɔ makwɛ gɔji lɛ;
nɛgbɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ aaajɛ aba?
2Miyelikɛbuamɔ jɛɔ Yehowa,
mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ!
3Ehaŋ oshane;
mɔ ni buɔ ohe lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i.
4Naa, mɔ ni buɔ Israel he lɛ,
ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i, ni esaa ewɔŋ gbi ko gbi ko.
5Yehowa ji ohebulɔ!
Yehowa ji ohɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ.
6Shwane lɛ hulu eshaŋ bo,
ni nyɔɔŋ hu nyɔɔŋtsere efeŋ bo nɔ ko nɔ ko.
7 Yehowa aaabu ohe kɛje efɔŋ fɛɛ mli.
Eeebu owala he shweshweeshwe.
8Yehowa aaabu okpojee kɛ omlibaa he,
kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ.

Title: LALA 122
Content:
Yerusalɛm kafomɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala. David Lala ko.
1 Mimii shɛɔ mihe kɛji akɛɛ mi akɛ,
“Ba ni wɔtee Yehowa we lɛ.”
2Oo Yerusalɛm, wɔnaji mamɔ ogboi lɛ mli.
3Yerusalɛm, bo maŋ ni atswa ama shi kɛtsara nɔ kɛkpe
maŋ ni ama lɛ kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
4Jɛi akutsei ni ji Yehowa akutsei lɛ yaa,
taakɛ bɔ ni awo amɛ mla lɛ,
koni amɛyada Yehowa shi.
5Jɛi akɛ kojomɔ sɛii emamɔ,
David we lɛ kojomɔ sɛii lɛ.
6 Nyɛbaa hejɔlɛ nyɛhãa Yerusalɛm.
“Mɛi ni sumɔɔ bo lɛ ashwere.”
7Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi ogbogboi lɛ amli,
ni shweshweeshwefeemɔ ahi omɔji lɛ amli.
8Minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ minanemɛi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ,
makɛɛ bo Yerusalɛm akɛ,
“Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi omli.”
9Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
matao bo ekpakpa.

Title: LALA 123
Content:
Sɔlemɔ kɛhã mɔbɔnalɛ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1Oo, bo miwoɔ mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛɔ,
bo mɔ ni ota maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
2Naa, bɔ ni tsuji kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ amɛnuŋtsɔ nɔ,
ni weyoo hu kɛ ehe fɔ̃ɔ ewula nɔ lɛ,
nakai nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkwɛɔ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛ
kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena wɔ mɔbɔ.
3Naa wɔ mɔbɔ!
Oo Yehowa, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!
Ejaakɛ agbe wɔhe guɔ babaoo kɛteke nɔ.
4Wɔhe fɛo ni mɛi ni he ejɔ amɛ lɛ yeɔ,
kɛ wɔhe guɔ ni hewolɔi lɛ gbeɔ lɛ miisu wɔtsui fe nine.

Title: LALA 124
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ ewebii ahe
Zion Gɔŋ lala. David Lala ko.
1Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ, hã Israel akɛɛ akɛ,
2“Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ
kulɛ be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi te shi wo wɔ,
3ni amɛmli wo la wo wɔ lɛ,
amɛaamimii wɔ hiɛkãalɔi;
4 kulɛ nu afua lɛ su wɔyi,
ni fai lɛ ha wɔnɔ;
5kulɛ fai ni fee hamahama lɛ su wɔyi.”
6Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ ekɛ wɔ hãaa ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ
amɛnyanyɔji anaa loo.
7Wɔwala eje amɛdɛŋ tamɔ loofɔlɔ jeɔ loofɔlɔdulɔi atsɔne mli.
Tsɔne kpãa lɛ etse ni wɔje mli.
8 Wɔyelikɛbuamɔ yɛ Yehowa,
mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.

Title: LALA 125
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ webii shweshweeshwefeemɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1Mɛi ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ,
amɛtamɔ Zion Gɔŋ ni hosooo,
shi moŋ ema shi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.
2 Bɔ ni gɔji ebɔle Yerusalɛm kɛkpe kpula lɛ,
nakai Yehowa hu ebɔle emɛi lɛ ahe kɛkpe,
kɛjɛ benɛ mli kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
3Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, eyeŋ jalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ,
koni jalɔi lɛ akafee efɔŋ.
4Oo Yehowa, feemɔ mɛi ni hi
kɛ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuii amli lɛ ejurɔ.
5 Shi mɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛyaa amɛgbɛi gbohii anɔ lɛ,
Yehowa aaaloo amɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ kɛaatee.
Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!

Title: LALA 126
Content:
Kpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1 Be ni Yehowa kpala wɔ,
Zion nomii lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ lɛ,
efee wɔ tamɔ nɔ ni lamɔ wɔlaa.
2No mli lɛ wɔdaaŋ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmɔlɔ,
ni wɔbɔ oshe hu kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, akɛɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli akɛ,
“Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã amɛ.”
3Lɛɛlɛŋ, Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã wɔ,
ni wɔmii eshɛ wɔhe nɛɛ.
4Oo Yehowa, kpalemɔ wɔblema nibii ni ŋmɛɛ wɔ lɛ kɛba,
tamɔ nunɛmɔ hãa faa ni emli egbi yiɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ.
5 Hã mɛi ni duɔ nii kɛ amɛhiɛ yaafonu lɛ,
akpa kɛ nyamɔ lala.
6 Mɛi ni kɛ hiɛ yaafonu hiɛɔ dumɔ wui kɛyaa dumɔ lɛ,
amɛkɛ ŋmãa yiteremɔi aaaba shĩa kɛ nyamɔ.

Title: LALA 127
Content:
Akɛjie Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ yi
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko. Solomon lala.
1Kɛjeee Yehowa ni mãa tsu lɛ,
no lɛ yakatswaa mɛi ni mãa lɛ gboɔ he deŋme lɛ!
Kɛjeee Yehowa ni buɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ,
no lɛ yakatswaa bulɔ lɛ shiɔ he kpe lɛ.
2 Yakatswaa nyɛteɔ shi maŋkɛ mra,
ni nyɛgboɔ deŋme aahu dani nyɛyawɔɔ.
Nyɛgboɔ deŋme kɛtaoɔ nyɛdaaŋ ŋmaa;
shi mɛi ni Yehowa sumɔɔ amɛ lɛ,
ehãa amɛ amɛhiamɔ nibii
kɛji amɛwɔ po tete.
3 Naa, Yehowa gboshinii ni ehãa ji bii;
nikeenii kpele ji musuŋbii.
4Bɔ ni gãimlibii yɔɔ yɛ tabilɔ dɛŋ lɛ,
nakai oblahiiaŋ bihii ji.
5Ajɔɔ nuu ni nɛkɛ gãimlibii eyi ekotoku mli tɔ lɛ.
Kɛji ekɛ ehenyɛlɔi kpe yɛ koishi lɛ,
ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi.

Title: LALA 128
Content:
Sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ Yehowa toiboo mli
Zion Gɔŋ lala.
1Ajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa,
ni eyeɔ emlai lɛ anɔ lɛ.
2Oooye oninenaa nitsumɔ mli nii,
omii aaashɛ, ni aaahi ahã bo!
3 Oŋa aaatamɔ waintso ni woɔ yibii yɛ owe lɛ.
Obii aaatamɔ mutsei bibii kɛaabɔle okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
4Naa, nuu ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ,
bɔ ni abaajɔɔ lɛ nɛ.
5Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ajɔɔ bo!
Ooona Yerusalɛm shweremɔ lɛ owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
6 Ooohi shi, ni ooona obii abii.
Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!

Title: LALA 129
Content:
Israel henyɛlɔi ahe sɔlemɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1“Amɛwa mi yi aahu kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ!”
Israel akɛɛ akɛ,
2“Amɛwa mi yi aahu kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ,
shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ mi.
3 Amɛkplebii fãmɔ mikotosɛɛ,
ni faji lɛ tamɔ ŋmɔ mli akofii kakadaji.”
4Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ji lɛ;
efolɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ataŋkpei lɛ amli.
5Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ Zion lɛ ahiɛ aaagboi,
ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.
6Hã amɛfee tamɔ tsu yiteŋ jwɛi
ni ŋalaa dani edaa lɛ.
7Amɛtsɔ̃ jwɛi ni yiii jwɛiflɔlɔ kɔkɔŋ,
ni mɔ ni fimɔɔ lɛ hu kɛshakãaa etsitsiŋ.
8 Mɛi ni hoɔ tete ekɛɛɛ akɛ,
“Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ!
Wɔmiijɔɔ nyɛ yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli!”

Title: LALA 130
Content:
Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1 Oo Yehowa, bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ
mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo kɛjɛɔ nɛɛ.
2Nuŋtsɔ, bo migbee toi;
ka otoi ohã migbee ni mikɛkpaa bo fai lɛ.
3 Oo Yehowa, kɛji okɛɛ ooodi
wɔnishaianii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ,
Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ po aaaŋɔ ehe eye?
4 Shi bo odɛ̃ŋ eshaifaa yɔɔ,
bɔ ni afee ni ashe bo gbeyei.
5Miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ!
Misusuma miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ!
Ni ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.
6Misusuma miimɛ Yehowa
fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ.
Eemɛ fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ.
7Oo Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ;
ejaakɛ Yehowa dɛŋ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee yɔɔ,
ni edɛŋ kpɔmɔ ni fa yɔɔ.
8 Lɛ eeekpɔ̃ Israel kɛaajɛ enishaianii lɛ fɛɛ mli.

Title: LALA 131
Content:
Heshibaa hemɔkɛyeli he sɔlemɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko. David lala.
1Oo Yehowa, mitsui wooo ehe nɔ,
ni mitsɛɛɛ mihe hu.
Ni misaa minyiɛɛɛ nibii wuji
loo nibii ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃ hã mi lɛ asɛɛ.
2Shi moŋ, migbe mitsui,
ni misusuma efee kpoo
tamɔ abifao feɔ yɛ enyɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ.
Misusuma efee kpoo yɛ mimli
tamɔ abifao ni atse lɛ fufɔ.
3 Oo Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ,
kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyashi naanɔ.

Title: LALA 132
Content:
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kafomɔ
Zion lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ David
kɛ amanehului fɛɛ ni ena lɛ:
2 bɔ ni ekã bo Yehowa kitã,
ni ewo bo, Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ
Hewalɔ Koome lɛ shi akɛ,
3“Miboteŋ miwe lɛ mli,
ni mikwɔŋ misaatso lɛ hu;
4mibɛŋ mihiŋmɛi, ni mijieŋ mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ
5kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mana he ko mahã Yehowa.
Hɛɛ, kɛyaashi mana shihilɛhe mahã
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ Koome lɛ.”
6 Naa, wɔnu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he yɛ Betlehem,
ni wɔyana yɛ Yearim ŋa lɛ nɔ.
7Wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbotea Yehowa we lɛŋ;
nyɛhãa wɔjaa yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛ!”
8Oo Yehowa, wo ohe nɔ ni oya ohejɔɔmɔhe lɛ,
bo kɛ ohewalɛ Adeka lɛ.
9Hã osɔfoi lɛ awula kɛ jalɛ tamɔ atade,
ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ abɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.
10Otsulɔ David hewɔ lɛ,
kaakwa maŋtsɛ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
11 Yehowa kã David kitã
yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni ekuŋ mli.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋɔ omusuŋbii lɛ eko mata omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.
12Kɛji obii lɛ ye mikpãŋmɔi lɛ
kɛ mimlai ni matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
no lɛ amɛ hu amɛbii aaata
omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ daa.”
13 Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Zion,
ni eesumɔ akɛ ekɛfee eshihilɛhe.
14“Mihejɔɔmɔhe nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ;
biɛ mahi, ejaakɛ biɛ misumɔɔ.
15Majɔɔ niyenii babaoo nɔ mahã Zion,
ni ohiafoi lɛ hu, mahã amɛtɔrɔ kɛ ŋmaa.
16Esɔfoi lɛ, mikɛ miyiwalaheremɔ aaawo amɛ tamɔ atade;
ni emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aaabɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.
17 Mahã Maŋtsɛ wulu ko ajɛ David shwiei lɛ amli,
ni mahã mɔ ni mifɔ lɛ mu lɛ lumɔyeli lɛ ama shi.
18Ehenyɛlɔi lɛ, mawo amɛ hiɛgbele,
shi lɛ lɛ, ekekre lɛ aaakpɛlɛ.”

Title: LALA 133
Content:
Akɛkafoɔ nyɛmi suɔmɔ
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1Kwɛ bɔ ni ehi, bɔ ni eyɔɔ fɛo,
kɛji nyɛmimɛi fee ekome kɛhi shi lɛ!
2 Etamɔ mu kpakpa ni jara wa ni yɔɔ yiteŋ
ni tsereɔ eshwieɔ tsɛŋ mli,
ni ji Aaron tsɛŋ lɛ.
Etsereɔ kɛbashwieɔ etade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ nɔ.
3Etamɔ Hermon bɔ ni nyɔɔ Zion gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo Zion jɔɔmɔ kɛ wala he shi kɛyaashi naanɔ.

Title: LALA 134
Content:
Nyɛbaa wɔjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi
Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
1Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi,
nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ
ni sɔmɔɔ nyɔɔŋ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ!
2Nyɛholea nyɛniji anɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ mli
yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ;
ni nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
3 Yehowa ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ
ajɛ Zion ajɔɔ bo!

Title: LALA 135
Content:
Yijiemɔ lala
1Nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi!
Nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea eyi,
2nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdamɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ
yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
3Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi,
ejaakɛ Yehowa hi!
Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi,
ejaakɛ emli hi!
4 Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Yakob ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe,
eŋɔ Israel efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.
5 Ejaakɛ mile akɛ Yehowa je agbo,
ni wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, efe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
6Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ,
yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
yɛ ŋshɔ kɛ bui voovoi lɛ amli lɛ, no efeɔ.
7 Lɛ ji mɔ ni hãa atatui woɔ
kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ.
Lɛ ehãa srawa gbalaa kɛfataa nunɛmɔ he
ni ehãa kɔɔyɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ enitoohe lɛ.
8 Etswia Ijipt kromɔbii lɛ nii
kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloo nɔ.
9 Ijipt lɛ efee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii yɛ mli
ekɛgbala Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ toi;
10ni etswia majimaji pii anii;
ni egbegbee majiatsɛmɛi hewalɔi.
11 Egbe Sihon, Amorbii lɛ amaŋtsɛ,
kɛ Og, Bashan maŋtsɛ lɛ hu,
kɛ Kanaan maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
12Eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã akɛ gboshinii,
akɛ gboshinii ehã emaŋ Israelbii lɛ.
13 Oo, Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ!
Oo Yehowa, ohiɛ nyam lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
14 Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaabu emaŋbii lɛ bem,
ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ etsuji lɛ ahe.
15Jeŋmaji lɛ amãgãi lɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni,
gbɔmɛi aninenaa nitsumɔi ni.
16Amɛyɛ naabui, shi amɛwieee;
amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii.
17Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii,
asaŋ wala bɛ amɛmli.
18Mɛi ni fee amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ;
nakai nɔŋŋ ji mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ lɛ.
19 Oo Israel we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Oo Aaron we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
20Oo Levi we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei,
nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
21Ajɛ Zion ajie Yehowa yi,
lɛ mɔ ni eyɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ!
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 136
LALA 137
Content:
Israelbii nomii lɛ awerɛho
1Babilon fai lɛ anaa wɔ ho wɔtara shi yɛ ni wɔfofoo,
be ni wɔkai Zion lɛ.
2Jɛi faa naa gãlãi lɛ anɔ
wɔŋɔ wɔsaŋkui lɛ wɔtsotsoro.
3Ejaakɛ jɛi mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ
bi wɔ koni wɔla lalai yɛ.
Wɔhaolɔi lɛ tao akɛ wɔjie amɛhiɛtserɛ:
Amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛlaa Zion lalai lɛ eko nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ!”
4Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔla Yehowa lala
yɛ mɛi kpɔji aje hu?
5 Oo Yerusalɛm, kɛji mihiɛ kpa onɔ lɛ,
no lɛ, hã mininejurɔ agbo yɛ mihe.
6Yerusalɛm, kɛji mikaiii bo,
ni mibuuu bo fe mimiishɛɛ nɔ titri ko lɛ,
hã mililɛi akpɛtɛ midaaŋ.
7 Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni Edombii lɛ fee lɛ,
gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, bɔ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛkumɔa, nyɛkumɔa kɛyamɔa eshishitoo lɛ tɔ̃ɔ” lɛ!
8Oo, Babilon, abaakpãtã ohiɛ;
Aaajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatɔ nɔ ni ofee wɔ lɛ he owele.
9 Aaajɔɔ mɔ ni aaaŋɔ obii bibii lɛ atswia tɛsaa lɛ!

Title: LALA 138
Content:
Shidaa sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ miida bo shi,
mala majie oyi yɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ahiɛ!
2Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mahã oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni makula shi,
ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ;
ejaakɛ ohã ogbɛi lɛ kɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehehe fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
3Gbi nɔ ni mitsɛ bo lɛ, ohere mi nɔ;
owo mi ekãa, ni misusuma na hewalɛ.
4Oo Yehowa, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaajie oyi;
ejaakɛ amɛnu onaa wiemɔi lɛ.
5Amɛaala Yehowa nifeemɔi lɛ ahe lala,
ejaakɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ da!
6Yehowa yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ moŋ nɛ,
shi kɛ̃lɛ ehiɛ kã humi he;
shi hewolɔ nyɛɛɛ ehe etee yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
7Kɛji minyiɛ haomɔ mli lɛ,
ohãa miyi naa wala.
Kɛji mihenyɛlɔi amli fu mi lɛ,
owoɔ onine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ,
ni okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ hereɔ miyiwala.
8Yehowa aaahã eyiŋtoo lɛ aba mli ahã mi.
Oo Yehowa, naanɔ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa;
gbee bo diɛŋtsɛ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anaa.

Title: LALA 139
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ nilee kɛ emɔkuramɔ
Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa. David Lala ko.
1 Oo Yehowa, taomɔ mimli koni ole mi.
2 Ole mishitamɔ kɛ mishitee mli fɛɛ;
oyoɔ miyiŋtoo yɛ shɔŋŋ beebe.
3Ole minyiɛmɔ kɛ mishikãmɔ fɛɛ mli,
ni ole minifeemɔi fɛɛ.
4Ejaakɛ wiemɔ ko wiemɔ ko
bɛ mililɛi nɔ ni bo Yehowa oleee oto.
5Ofo afabaŋ owo mihe kɛkpe,
ni okɛ onine eŋmɛ minɔ.
6Onilee nɛɛ miifee mi naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃;
emli kwɔ, ni mijwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he.
7Nɛgbɛ maje omumɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛaatee;
ni nɛgbɛ majo foi kɛaajɛ ohiɛ kɛaatee?
8 Kɛji mikwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, oyɛ jɛi;
ni kɛji miyaŋmɛ misaa yɛ gbohiiaje tete, oyɛ jɛi.
9 Kɛji miŋɔ leebi fiji
ni miyahi ŋshɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ,
10jɛi tete lɛ, onine aaakpala mi,
ni oninejurɔ aaamɔ mimli tswɛ.
11 Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Duŋ kabitii
abaha minɔ, ni la ni bɔle mihe lɛ atsɔ̃ duŋ” lɛ,
12 no tete po lɛ, duŋ wooo duŋ yɛ ohiɛ,
ni nyɔɔŋ tseɔ heŋŋ tamɔ shwane nɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛ;
ejaakɛ duŋ jio, la jio fɛɛ lɛ ekome ni yɛ ohiɛ.
13Ejaakɛ bo obɔ mimli nibii fɛɛ;
bo oshɔ̃ mi yɛ minyɛ musuŋ.
14Miijie oyi, ejaakɛ bɔ ni obɔ mi lɛ,
eyɛ naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ.
Onitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ;
mile enɛ krɛdɛɛ.
15 Aŋɔɔɔ mi ateee bo,
be ni abɔɔ migbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ teemɔ mli,
ni ashɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
16 Be ni mi ji lá kukuli tete po lɛ,
ohiŋmɛi ena mi momo.
Wala gbii ni ato ahã mi lɛ,
aŋma fɛɛ yɛ owolo lɛ mli
dani mije wala shishi tete.
17 Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, oyiŋtoi lɛ ajara wa
yɛ mihiɛ akɛ nɔ ko;
efa babaoo naakpa.
18 Kɛji mika akɛ makane lɛ,
amɛyi fa fe ŋshɔnaa shia.
Be ni mihiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ omasɛi nɔŋŋ miyɔɔ.
19Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mina ni ogbe mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ,
gbɔmɛi lashishwielɔi akabɛŋkɛ mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃.
20Amɛwieɔ ohe kɛ yiŋsha,
ni amɛteɔ shi amɛwoɔ bo.
21Oo Yehowa, aso mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ mikanyɛ amɛ?
Ni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ bo lɛ,
mikate shi miwo amɛ?
22Minyɛɔ amɛ naakpa,
miŋɔɔ amɛ mihenyɛlɔi.
23Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, taomɔ mimli koni ole mitsuiŋ.
Kaa mi okwɛ, koni ole mijwɛŋmɔi.
24 Kwɛmɔ akɛ minyiɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ lo,
koni okpala mi kɛya naanɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.

Title: LALA 140
Content:
Hebuu sɔlemɔ
Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa. David Lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ;
baamɔ miyi yɛ yiwalɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
2Amɛkpãŋɔ nifɔɔjianii yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ,
ni amɛhãa ta teɔ shi daa.
3 Amɛjɔ amɛlilɛii anaa tamɔ onufu,
ni shikpãi anaa ebɔɔ yɛ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi.
4Oo Yehowa, buu mihe kɛje mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ,
ni obaa miyi kɛje gbɔmɛi yiwalɔi adɛŋ,
mɛi ni ekpãŋ koni amɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ minane lɛ.
5Hewolɔi etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne;
ni amɛŋmɛ mi yaa,
ni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mi akpa yɛ gbɛ toi.
6 Mikɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.”
Oo Yehowa, bo mifaikpamɔ gbee lɛ toi!
7Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ,
miyiwalaherelɔ ni he wa,
bo obaa miyi yɛ ta gbi nɔ.
8Oo Yehowa, kaahã mɔ fɔŋ nine shɛ
nɔ ni eshweɔ lɛ nɔ;
ni kaahã eyiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ miiba mli miihã lɛ.
9 Mɛi ni efo sa ewo mihe lɛ,
hã efɔŋ ni jɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ
amɛnaa lɛ abua amɛyiteŋ.
10Hã ŋãi la atso yɛ amɛyiteŋ,
hã ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie
bui kwɔŋkwɔŋi amli,
ni amɛkate shi dɔŋŋ.
11Kaahã oshekuyelɔ ko he shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
hã efɔŋ akpãtã yiwalɔ lɛ hiɛ mra.
12Mile akɛ Yehowa yeɔ nɔnalɔ sane ehãa lɛ;
ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ehãa mɔ ni efi lɛ.
13Lɛɛlɛŋ, jalɔi aaajie oyi,
ni mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii aaahi shi yɛ ohiɛ.

Title: LALA 141
Content:
Gbɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ;
ba miŋɔɔ mra!
Ba otoi shi ohã mi kɛji mitsɛ bo lɛ.
2 Hã mifaikpamɔ afee tamɔ tsofakɛŋma yɛ ohiɛ;
ni miniji anɔholemɔ afee tamɔ gbɛkɛ afɔle!
3Oo Yehowa, wo mililɛi manyoflɛ;
ni ahã mamɔ minaabu mli.
4 Kaadɔ mitsui kɛmiiya nɔ fɔŋ ko he,
ni mikafata mɛi fɔ̃ji ahe kɛtsu yiwalɛnii;
ni kaahã miye amɛdɔkɔdɔkɔ nii lɛ eko.
5 Hã jalɔ agbala mitoi kɛ mlihilɛ;
hã anɔkwafoi akã mi;
shi kɛji mɔ fɔŋ miiwo mihiɛ nyam lɛ, hã makwa;
ejaakɛ misɔleɔ daa mishiɔ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ.
6Kɛji aŋɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahã kojolɔi,
ni amɛbu amɛ fɔ lɛ,
no dani amɛaale akɛ miwiemɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni.
7Bɔ ni kɛ mɔ ko miihu ni egbɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ,
nakai agbɛ wɔwui ashwã gbonyobu toi.
8Shi bo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ,
bo onɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ.
Bo nɔŋŋ abo mibaa!
Kaashi mi tamɔ mɔ ni bɛ hefãlɔ.
9Buu mihe yɛ tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ he
buu mihe kɛjɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii akpai lɛ ahe.
10 Hã mɛi fɔ̃ji adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne lɛ,
ni mi lɛ, hã maje mli sɔkee.

Title: LALA 142
Content:
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko be mli ni eyɛ tɛkpolo lɛ mi. Sɔlemɔ ko.
1 Miiwo migbee nɔ miibolɔ miitsɛ Yehowa,
mikɛ migbee miikpa Yehowa fai.
2Miifɔse mikɔmɔi lɛ miishwie ehiɛ,
miijaje mihaomɔi lɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
3 Be ni mimumɔ tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ,
bo ole migbɛ lɛ.
Mihenyɛlɔi etsɔ̃ tsɔne kɛtee mi
yɛ gbɛ ni minyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
4Kwɛ mininejurɔgbɛ, ni ooona
akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni le mi.
Abobaahe ebɔ mi;
Mɔ ko mɔ ko jwɛŋŋ mihe.
5Oo Yehowa, miibolɔ miitsɛ bo!
Mikɛɛ akɛ bo ji mibobaahe,
bo ji migbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
6 Feemɔ toi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ,
ejaakɛ aba mi shi fe nine.
Jiemɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ,
ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe mi.
7Jiemɔ mi kɛje gboklɛfoi atsuŋ,
koni mada bo shi.
Jalɔi aaabɔle mi kɛkpe,
ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.

Title: LALA 143
Content:
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ
David Lala ko.
1Oo Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi,
feemɔ toi ohã mifaikpamɔ lɛ;
heremɔ mi nɔ yɛ onɔkwayeli kɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa.
2 Okɛ otsulɔ akakojo,
ejaakɛ hiɛkãalɔ ko hiɛkãalɔ ko yeŋ bem yɛ ohiɛ.
3Ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ etiu mi,
ekpãtã miwala hiɛ kɛmɔ shi;
ehã mita duŋ mli tamɔ mɛi ni egboi jeeŋmɔ lɛ.
4No hewɔ lɛ, mimumɔ etɔ biti yɛ mimli;
mitsui efee shikplikpii yɛ mimli.
5 Mikaiɔ blema gbii lɛ,
mijwɛŋɔ nii ni ofee lɛ fiaa he;
misusuɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
6 Miholeɔ miniji anɔ mihãa bo yɛ sɔlemɔ mli;
ohe kumai yeɔ misusuma tamɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.
7 Oo Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ oya;
mimumɔ miitɔ biti;
kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi,
kɛjee nakai lɛ,
matamɔ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ.
8Leebi lɛ hã manu osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he,
ejaakɛ bo onɔ mihiɛ kã.
Hã male gbɛ ni sa akɛ manyiɛ nɔ,
ejaakɛ bo miŋɔɔ misusuma mihãa.
9Oo Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ!
Bo oŋɔɔ mijoɔ foi kɛbaa mibatee yɛ!
10 Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi koni mafee osuɔmɔnaanii,
ejaakɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.
Hã omumɔ kpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ
mi gbɛ kɛnyiɛ gbɛ tɛ̃ɛ nɔ.
11 Oo Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
hã miyi ana wala!
Ojalɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
jiemɔ mi kɛje haomɔ mli.
12 Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee hã mi lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
folɔmɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwie;
ni okpãtã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ;
ejaakɛ otsulɔ ji mi.

Title: LALA 144
Content:
Maŋtsɛ ko da Nyɔŋmɔ shi
David Lala.
1 Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, mitɛsaa lɛ,
mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ miniji tawuu kɛ miwaobii nɔmɔ lɛ.
2 Lɛ ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ,
mibobaa mɔɔ ni wa,
kɛ mijielɔ, mitsɛŋ kɛ mɔ abo ni mibaa lɛ.
Lɛ ebaa mimaŋbii shi ewoɔ mishishi.
3 Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ ji gbɔmɔ adesa
ni obuɔ ehe akɔntaa,
loo gbɔmɔ bi ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe?
4Gbɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ,
egbii lɛ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ ni hoɔ.
5 Oo Yehowa, kpoo oŋwɛi lɛ naa shi koni oyi shi!
Taramɔ gɔji lɛ ahe koni amɛje lasu!
6Hã srawai agbala,
koni ogbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã.
Tsɛ̃rɛ̃mɔ ogãimlibii lɛ
koni owo amɛ foi.
7Kpã onine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi;
shɔ̃ mi koni ojie mi kɛjɛ nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli,
kɛjɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ,
8mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ
amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.
9 Oo, Nyɔŋmɔ, mala lala hee mahã bo!
Kpãi nyɔŋma saŋku matswa kɛjie oyi.
10Bo ohãa maŋtsɛmɛi yeɔ kunim,
ni ohereɔ otsulɔ David yiwala.
11Shɔ̃ mi kɛje yiwalɔ klante naa;
kpɔ̃ mi kɛje mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ,
mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ
amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.
12 Wɔbihii adara yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ,
tamɔ tsei ni atɛo ni amɛdara;
ni wɔbiyei lɛ hu atãmɔ koŋtɛ
ni ako ni akɛmaa maŋtsɛ we.
13Wɔboŋoi lɛ ayimɔ obɔbɔ̃,
kɛ niyenii srɔtoi fɛɛ;
wɔtoi hu afɔfɔɔ akpekpei,
kɛ akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai yɛ ŋa nɔ.
14Wɔtsinai hu afɔ babaoo;
amɛkasharake, ni amɛkalaaje;
akanu haomɔ blɔmɔ ko yɛ wɔblohuiaŋ.
15 Ajɔɔ maŋ ni naa nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ!
Ajɔɔ maŋ ni Yehowa ji eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

Title: LALA 145
Content:
Yijiemɔ lala
Yijiemɔ lala. David Lala.
1Makafo bo, miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ miMaŋtsɛ,
ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
2Daa gbi lɛ majie oyi,
ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa
kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
3Yehowa je agbo;
ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo,
ni egbojee lɛ anaaa naa.
4Yinɔ kome aaakafo onitsumɔi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔ kroko;
ni amɛaajaje ohewalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
5Majwɛŋ onunyam falɛ
kɛ ogbojee kɛ onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
6Mɛi aaagba ohewalɛ nitsumɔi ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ,
ni majaje ogbojee lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
7Amɛaajaje omlihilɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ;
amɛaala ojalɛ lɛ he lala waa.
8 Durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa;
emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ
ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.
9Yehowa hi hã mɛi fɛɛ,
ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ he.
10Yehowa, obɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ aaada bo shi;
ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ aaajie oyi.
11Amɛaawie omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ anunyam lɛ he,
ni amɛaagba ohewalɛ lɛ,
12koni amɛhã gbɔmɛi adesai abii ale ohewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ,
kɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nyam kɛ egbojee.
13Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni;
ni olumɔyeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
14 Yehowa sɔoɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni miigbee shi lɛ,
ni eholeɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni edɔrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ.
15 Bɔɔnii fɛɛ kwɛɔ bo gbɛ,
ni bo ohãa amɛ niyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.
16Ogbɛɔ odɛ̃ŋ, ni ohãa
nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã tɔɔ kɛ nii ni etaoɔ.
17 Yehowa ja yɛ egbɛi fiaa mli,
ni emli hi yɛ enifeemɔi fiaa mli.
18Yehowa bɛŋkɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ;
ebɛŋkɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
19 Mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ,
efeɔ amɛnitaomɔnii ehãa amɛ;
eboɔ amɛbolɔmɔ toi ni ehereɔ amɛyiwala.
20Yehowa baa mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ ayi;
shi yiwalɔi lɛ, eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ.
21Minaabu aaajie Yehowa yi ni bɔɔnii fɛɛ aaajie
egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.

Title: LALA 146
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ yijiemɔ
1Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Oo misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
2Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ,
majie Yehowa yi!
Mala majie miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi miwala be fɛɛ.
3 Nyɛkaŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa lumɛi
loo gbɔmɔ adesa bi ko ni yelikɛbuamɔ bɛ edɛŋ lɛ nɔ.
4 Kɛji emumɔ je emli lɛ,
ekuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa esu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ;
nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ eyiŋtoo fɛɛ laajeɔ.
5Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji eyelikɛbualɔ,
mɔ ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
6 Lɛ ebɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ;
lɛ lɛ eyeɔ anɔkwa kɛyaa naanɔ.
7Mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim lɛ,
eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ;
mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ,
ehãa amɛ niyenii.
Yehowa fɛneɔ gboklɛfoi agboklɛi.
8 Yehowa gbeleɔ shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii;
Yehowa holeɔ mɛi ni edɔrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ;
Yehowa sumɔɔ jalɔi.
9 Yehowa baa gbɔi ayi;
efĩɔ awusa kɛ okulafo sɛɛ;
shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ, ebutuɔ.
10 Yehowa baaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ,
Zion, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 147
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ yijiemɔ
1 Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Ehi akɛ ala ajie wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi;
ejaakɛ durolɔ ji lɛ,
ni yijiemɔ lala sa lɛ.
2Yehowa ji mɔ ni maa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ;
ebuaa Israelbii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa.
3 Lɛ etsaa mɛi ni tsuii ekumɔ lɛ,
ni efimɔɔ amɛpilamɔi lɛ anɔ.
4 Lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii lɛ ayibɔ,
ni ewoɔ eko fɛɛ eko gbɛi lɛ.
5WɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ je agbo;
ni ehewalɛ fa naakpa,
ni enilee lɛ anaaa naa.
6 Yehowa woɔ heshibalɔi anɔ,
shi yiwalɔi lɛ etsirɛɔ amɛ etswiaa shi.
7Nyɛlaa shidaa lala nyɛhãa Yehowa,
nyɛkɛ saŋku alaa kɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
8Lɛ ekɛ atatui haa ŋwɛi,
ni ehãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni ehãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi anɔ.
9 Lɛ ehãa kooloi niyenii,
ni elɛɔ kwãakwãalabitei abii ni bolɔɔ lɛ hu.
10Emiishɛɛnamɔ bɛ okpɔŋɔ hewalɛ mli,
ni ebɛ tabilɔi ahewalɛ he miishɛɛ hu.
11Shi moŋ Yehowa naa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe miishɛɛ,
kɛ mɛi hu ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
12Oo Yerusalɛm, kafomɔ Yehowa!
Oo Zion, jiemɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi!
13Ejaakɛ lɛ ewajeɔ ogboi lɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ kpɛŋŋ;
ejɔɔ obii ni yɔɔ omli lɛ.
14 Ehãa ohusui anɔ jɔɔ;
ehãa otɔɔ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa.
15Efãa shikpɔŋ lɛ,
ni nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ afeɔ lɛ oya.
16 Ehãa snoo nyɔɔ futaa tamɔ too he tsɔi yɛŋ;
egbɛɔ bɔ́ ni efĩ eshwãa tamɔ lamlu.
17Eshɛrɛɔ enutɛi lɛ eshwieɔ shi tamɔ fɔbitɛi.
Namɔ aaanyɛ efɛ̃i lɛ naa edamɔ?
18Efãa, ni ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ,
nutɛi lɛ sereɔ.
Ehãa ekɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa,
ni nui lɛ hoɔ.
19Ejajeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israel,
ekɛ ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ hãa Israel.
20 Efeko nakai nɔ ko ehãko maŋ ko maŋ ko dã;
emlai lɛ hu, amɛleee.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 148
Content:
Jeŋ fɛɛ ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi
1Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi!
Nyɛjɛa ŋwɛi nyɛjiea Yehowa yi;
nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!
2 Nyɛ, ebɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛ, etai lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi!
3 Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere, nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛŋulamii ni kpɛlɛɔ fiaa, nyɛjiea eyi!
4Nyɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi,
kɛ nui ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ,
nyɛjiea eyi!
5Hã amɛ jie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi,
ejaakɛ lɛ efã, ni abɔ amɛ.
6Eŋɔ amɛ emamɔ shi kɛmiiya naanɔ;
ewo amɛ akpɔ, ni amɛnyɛŋ nɔ amɛku.
7Nyɛjɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ
nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nuŋ loi wuji ni he yɔɔ gbeyei,
bui ni mli kwɔlɔ fɛɛ,
8la kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ,
snoo kɛ afua,
ahum ni yeɔ efãmɔ nɔ.
9Nyɛjiea eyi
nyɛ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi fiaa,
tsei ni woɔ yibii
kɛ tsenedrui fɛɛ!
10Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ shĩa kooloi fɛɛ,
waamɔ nibii kɛ loofɔji.
11Shikpɔŋ nɔ majiatsɛmɛi kɛ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ,
lumɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kojolɔi fɛɛ,
12oblahii kɛ oblayei fɛɛ,
onukpai kɛ gbekɛbii bluublu,
13hã amɛ jie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi,
ejaakɛ ekoome egbɛi lɛ nɔ awo gojoo fe gbɛii fɛɛ.
Lɛ enunyam lɛ kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi fɛɛ tete.
14 Ekɛ ehewalɛ kpele lɛ ewo emaŋbii anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ajie eyi,
Israelbii, ni ji emaŋ ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ,
nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 149
Content:
Yijiemɔ lala
1 Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa,
nyɛjiea eyi yɛ anɔkwafoi
agwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
2 Hã Israel anya ebɔlɔ lɛ he,
ni Zion bihii lɛ amli afili amɛ
yɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ.
3Hã amɛkɛ joo ajie egbɛi lɛ yi,
ni amɛkɛ miji kɛ saŋku ala amɛkɛjie eyi.
4Ejaakɛ Yehowa naa emaŋbii lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ;
ehãa humii yeɔ ta mli kunim.
5Hã anɔkwafoi lɛ anya yɛ anunyam mli;
hã amɛla nyamɔ lala yɛ amɛsai anɔ.
6Hã Nyɔŋmɔ kafomɔ akã amɛlilɛi nɔ,
ni amɛhiɛ klante kɛ enaa nta yɛ amɛdɛ̃,
7koni amɛkɛtɔ owele yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ,
koni amɛkɛgbala maŋbii lɛ atoi,
8koni amɛkɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi afimɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ,
ni amɛwo amɛbladei lɛ dade gboklɛi,
9koni amɛkɛ toigbalamɔ ni aŋma ato agbala amɛtoi.
Enɛ ji anunyam hã emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: LALA 150
Content:
Kafomɔ Yehowa
1Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ;
nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ atatu lɛŋ!
2Nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ;
nyɛjiea eyi yɛ egbojee kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ!
3Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kpãmɔ;
nyɛjiea eyi kɛ obenta kɛ saŋku!
4Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ miji kɛ joo,
nyɛjiea eyi kɛ kpãa saŋku kɛ bɛji!
5Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋo ni naa wa;
nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋoi ni jijeɔ!
6 Nyɛhãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni muɔ ajiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

Title: ABƐI WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Abɛi ni abua naa ni yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ kɔɔ jeŋba kpakpa kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔi ahe. Saŋŋ kɔɔ nɔ ni sa akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa afee daa gbi he. Abɛi awolo lɛ kaiɔ wɔ akɛ, “Dani mɔ ko baale nii lɛ, ja ena Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ.” Jeee Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ kɛ jeŋba kpakpa kɛkɛ he abɛi nɛɛ wieɔ, shi moŋ amɛwieɔ hiɛshikamɔ kɛ agwaseiaŋ nifeemɔnii hu ahe.
Abɛi lɛ aŋmala amɛ kukujikukuji moŋ nɛ, shi pii tsɔ̃ɔ niiashikpamɔ jogbaŋŋ ni blema Israel tsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ na yɛ bɔ ni sa akɛ nilelɔ afee kɛji sane ba enɔ. Abɛi lɛ ekomɛi kɔɔ wekumɛi ashihilɛ he; ekomɛi kɔɔ nitsumɔ he; ekomɛi tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ ahãa yɛ adesai ateŋ. Ekomɛi hu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni esa akɛ aye he nɔ ahã. Nibii ni abɛi nɛɛ wieɔ he ji heshibaa kɛ tsuishitoo kɛ bulɛ ni sa akɛ akɛhã ohiafoi; asaŋ abɛi lɛ wieɔ nanemɛi ateŋ anɔkwayeli hu he babaoo.
Mlijaramɔi
Nilee yijiemɔ 1.1—9.18
Solomon Abɛi lɛ 10.1—29.27
Agur wiemɔi lɛ 30.1-33
Wiemɔi kukuji krokomɛi 31.1-31

Title: ABƐI 1
Content:
Abɛi ahe sɛɛnamɔ
1 Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon, David bi lɛ, abɛi nɛ.
2Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ nilee, ni amɛhãa mɔ naa tsɔsemɔ. Amɛhãa mɔ nuɔ wiemɔi ni jwɛŋmɔ yɔɔ mli ashishi faŋŋ hu.
3Amɛhãa mɔ leɔ nii, eleɔ nɔ ni ja, ni eleɔ anɔkwayeli.
4Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni nako jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃ɛ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblanyo hu nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
5Nilelɔ hu nuɔ, ni ekaseɔ nii efataa enilee he. Amɛhãa mɔ ni nuɔ niiashishi hu leɔ ŋaa.
6Ebaanu abɛi kɛ wiemɔi ni amɛshishinumɔ wa kɛ nilelɔi awiemɔi kɛ amɛjenui ashishi.
Ŋaawoo kɛhã oblahii
7 Nilee fɛɛ shishijee ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ; shi kwashiai gbeɔ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ.
8 Mibi, bo otsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi, ni kaashɛ mla ni onyɛ woɔ bo lɛ ofɔ̃. 9 Ejaakɛ nomɛi ji anunyam akekre ni fi oyitso kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni kã okuɛ. 10Mibi, kɛji eshafeelɔi miilaka bo lɛ, kaakpɛlɛ̃. 11Kɛji amɛkɛɛ bo akɛ, “Ba wɔtee ni wɔyawo mɔ ko antɛo, ni wɔyawo mɔ ko lá ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ ko ka yakatswaa lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃. 12Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ bo akɛ hã wɔmĩĩ amɛ hiɛkãalɔi tamɔ bɔ ni gbohiiaje mĩiɔ mɛi emuu, aloo tamɔ akpelekeɔ shi aboteɔ gbonyobu mli, ni akuuu sɛɛ abaaa dɔŋŋ lɛ. 13Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ akɛ no wɔbaana nibii srɔtoi wɔwo wɔshĩai amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃. 14Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ akɛ bo lɛ kɛ ohe abɔ wɔhe kɛkɛ; wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaato fotro kome, ni nɔ ni wɔbaana lɛ wɔbaaja lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃.”
15Mibi, okɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi akabɔ. Tsi ohe kɛje amɛhe kwraa. 16Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ; amɛhe feɔ oya kɛ láshishwiemɔ. 17Eji yaka nɔ ko feemɔ akɛ aaatsɔ̃ loofɔlɔ tsɔne be mli ni eekwɛ. 18Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe tsɔne amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwala antɛo. 19Mɛi fɛɛ ni shɔ̃ɔ nii ekãa naa yɛ mɛi adɛŋ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛnaagbee tamɔ nɛ, nɔ ni amɛkɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ diɔ sɛɛ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ gbeɔ amɛ.
Nilee miitsɛ kwashiai
20Bo toi! Nilee miibolɔ waa yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni eewo egbee yɛ jaji anɔ. 21 Ebolɔɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa kɛ he fɛɛ he ni mɛi ebua amɛhe naa kutuu yɛ.
22Oo, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛjwɛŋmɔ naa waaa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaahiɛ nyɛkwashiafeemɔ nɛɛ mli kɛyashi? Ni mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ kwashiai hu aaanyɛ nilee kɛyashi? 23Kɛji mikã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛboa toi. Naa, mafɔse mimumɔ mawo nyɛmli, ni mahã nyɛyoo minilee wiemɔi lɛ hu. 24 Mitsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛbooo mi toi; mikpã miniji amli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔɔɔ mli. 25Miŋaawoo lɛ hu nyɛkwa fɛɛ, ni nyɛbuuu mikãmɔ lɛ. 26 No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu nyɛmanehulu mli lɛ, maŋmɔ nyɛ; ni kɛji gbeyei nɔ ko ba lɛ, maye nyɛhe fɛo. 27Kɛji tsuifãa nɔ ko batua nyɛ tamɔ ahum, ni nyɛmanehulu te shi tamɔ lasuogbele; ni kɛji hejaramɔ kɛ tsuiyeli ba nyɛnɔ lɛ, 28 no mli lɛ nyɛaatsɛ mi, shi mihereŋ nɔ; nyɛaatao misɛɛgbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃, shi nyɛnaŋ mi. 29Akɛni amɛsumɔɔ nilee, ni amɛsheee Yehowa gbeyei; 30asaŋ akɛni amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ ŋaa ni miwoɔ amɛ lɛ ekoeko, ni amɛgbe mikãmɔ lɛ fɛɛ he guɔ 31 hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛdu lɛ, no yibii amɛaakpa, ni ŋaa ni amɛtotoo lɛ he sɛɛ amɛaana. 32 Mɛi ni jwɛŋmɔ naa waaa kpaleɔ kɛjeɔ nilee he kɛyaa nɔ kroko he, ni no nɔŋŋ gbeɔ amɛ; ni jwɛŋmɔ ni kwashiai jwɛŋɔ akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe lɛ, no nɔŋŋ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ. 33 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boɔ mi toi lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe, ehe aaajɔ lɛ, ni esheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei.

Title: ABƐI 2
Content:
Nilee he nyɔmɔwoo
1Mibi, mɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato. 2Ba otoi shi ohã nilee, ni oto otsui shi ohã sanesɛɛkɔmɔ. 3Mibi, fo otsɛ́ niiasɛɛyoomɔ, ni odi niiashishinumɔ sɛɛ. 4Taomɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ tamɔ ataoɔ jwiɛtɛi aloo jwetri ko ni akɛtee. 5No dani ooonu Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ shishi, ni ooona Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee; 6ejaakɛ Yehowa hãa aleɔ nii; edaaŋ nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jɛɔ. 7Ehãa jalɔi leɔ nii jogbaŋŋ ni eji tsɛŋ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ. 8Ebuɔ jalɔi ajalɛ saneyeli he, ni ebaa emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbɛi ayi.
9No dani obaanu jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ anɔkwayeli kɛ nɔ ni ji jeŋba kpakpa shishi. 10Ni obaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni nilee baahã osusuma mii ashɛ ehe. 11Jwɛŋmɔ aaabaa oyi, ni niiashishinumɔ aaabu ohe. 12Eeejie bo kɛjɛ jeŋba fɔŋ gbɛ nɔ, kɛaajɛ mɛi ni wieɔ yaka wiemɔ adɛŋ, 13kɛ mɛi ni ekwa jalɛ gbɛi ni amɛyanyiɛɔ dujiaŋ gbɛi anɔ lɛ. 14Eeejie bo kɛjɛ mɛi ni nyaa efɔŋfeemɔ he, ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ yɛ nɔ fɔŋ feemɔ he lɛ adɛŋ. 15Eeejie bo kɛjɛ mɛi ni amɛgbɛi ekɔ̃dɔ̃ ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ adɛŋ.
16 Nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ; nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ yoo kɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ. 17Eeejie bo kɛjɛ yoo ni ekwa eblayeiaŋ wu, ni ehiɛ ekpa kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ lɛ kpãŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ. 18Nɛkɛ yoo lɛ, ewe lɛ gbele gbɛ ni; egbɛi fɛɛ anaa kã kɛmiiya gbohiiaje. 19Mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa eŋɔɔ, ni eku esɛɛ eba pɛŋ, walagbɛ bɔɔ mɔ lɛ. 20No hewɔ lɛ, kasemɔ mɛi kpakpai ajeŋba koni ojeŋba atamɔ jalɔi anɔ. 21 Ejaakɛ mɛi ni ja lɛ, amɛaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ ji mɛi ni aaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 22 Shi yiwalɔi lɛ aaafolɔ amɛ kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ashwie, ni kutumpɔfoi lɛ aaafamɔ amɛ kɛ amɛshishifãi kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Title: ABƐI 3
Content:
Ŋaawoo kɛhã oblahii kɛ oblayei
1Mibi, ohiɛ akakpa mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato otsui mli, 2ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ baahã owala sɛɛ atsɛ afii babaoo, ni obaashwere yɛ wala mli. 3Kaahã mlihilɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli miishi bo; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ, ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ; 4no dani ooona nyam kɛ bulɛ kpakpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
5Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ kɛ otsui fɛɛ, ni okɛ ohe akakpasa bo diɛŋtsɛ ojwɛŋmɔ; 6kaimɔ lɛ yɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ amli, ni lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ ni ja ni onyiɛ nɔ. 7Kaabu ohe nilelɔ; she Yehowa gbeyei, ni owi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he. 8Enɛ aaafee tsamɔ ahã bo, ni eeewo owui amli hewalɛ. 9Okɛ onii ni oyɔɔ kɛ onibaanii fɛɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ awo Yehowa hiɛ nyam; 10no dani aaahã oboŋoi lɛ ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa, ni owain gbɛi lɛ hu aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ wain.
11 Mibi, kaagbe Yehowa tsɔsemɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni kaahã ekãmɔ hu miije otsine. 12Bɔ ni tsɛ kãa ebi ni eyɔɔ ehe tsuijurɔ lɛ, nakai pɛ Yehowa kãa ebi ni esumɔɔ lɛ hu. 13Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni leɔ nii, ni enaa niiashishinumɔ hu lɛ, 14ejaakɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ no mli lɛ, ehi fe sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika mli. 15Nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jara wa aahu fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ akɛto nilee he. 16Wala sɛɛtsɛlɛ yɛ eninejurɔ kɔkɔŋ, ni ninamɔ kɛ anunyam yɛ ebɛku kɔkɔŋ. 17Miishɛɛ yɛ etɛmpɔŋi anɔ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ egbɛi anɔ. 18Nilee lɛ wala tso ni hã mɛi ni kɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛɔ lɛ, ni mɛi ni hiɛ emli kpɛŋŋ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ. 19Yehowa kɛ nilee to shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni jwɛŋmɔ ni mli kwɔ ekɛhã ŋwɛi ma shi shiŋŋ. 20Enilee naa hãa fai tueɔ, ni ehãa atatui lɛ nyɔɔ bɔ shwieɔ shi.
21Mibi, kɛ nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ ato; kaahã ohiɛ miije nɔ kwraa, 22ni eeehã ona wala kɛ hewulamɔnii. 23No dani ooonyiɛ ogbɛ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe, ni otɛŋ onane. 24Kɛ oho okã shi lɛ, osheŋ gbeyei; shi moŋ oookã shi, ni owɔ lɛ aaaŋɔɔ. 25Kaashe kpatu nɔ ko ni baahã otsui afã, aloo bɔ ni ahum fɔŋ tswaa mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ gbeyei, 26 ejaakɛ Yehowa ji ohiɛnɔkãmɔ, ni lɛ eeebu ohe, ni ooofee shweshweeshwe.
27Mɛi ni esa amɛ ejurɔfeemɔ lɛ, kaakãmã amɛ, kɛji eyɛ ohewalɛ mli akɛ ooonyɛ ofee lɛ. 28Kɛji nɔ ko yɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛfee onaanyo lɛ ejurɔ lɛ, kaafee lɛ “Yaa ni oba, yaa ni oba”. 29Kaato onaanyo ko he ŋaa fɔŋ, be mli ni lɛ lɛ ehiɛ kã onɔ akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ omasɛi. 30Okɛ mɔ ko akabe yakatswaa, kɛji efeko bo efɔŋ ko. 31Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ yiwalɔ ko nɔ, ni egbɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ hu kaakɔ amɛmli ekoeko; 32 ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi nɔfɔŋfeelɔ, shi jalɔi lɛ eheɔ amɛ eyeɔ. 33Yehowa loomɔ kã mɛi fɔ̃ji awe nɔ; shi jalɔi awe lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ. 34 Yehowa yeɔ hefɛoyelɔi ahe fɛo, shi mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ enaa amɛ mɔbɔ. 35Nilelɔi ahiɛ baa nyam, shi kwashiai naa hiɛshishwiemɔ.

Title: ABƐI 4
Content:
Nilee he sɛɛnamɔ
1Bii, nyɛboa nyɛtsɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ toi, ni nyɛfea toi ni nyɛlea sanesɛɛkɔmɔ. 2Jeŋba kpakpa he ŋaa miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ; nyɛkakwaa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ. 3Be ni mi ji gbekɛnuu yɛ mitsɛ masɛi, ni minyɛ bi koome ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe ji mi lɛ, mitsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 4“Hã otsui amɔ miwiemɔi amli, ye mikitãi ni miwoɔ bo lɛ anɔ, ni oyi aaana wala. 5Na nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ. Ohiɛ akakpa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ni kaaŋmɛɛ he hu. 6Kaakwa nilee, ni eeebaa oyi; suɔmɔ lɛ, ni eeebu ohe. 7Nilee shishijee ji ona nilee, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ona lɛ okɛtao sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛgbɛ. 8Buu nilee akɛ nɔ ko ni jara wa, ni eeewo onɔ; kɛji oloo lɛ atuu lɛ, eeewo ohiɛ nyam. 9Nilee aaafi bo anunyam akekre, ni eeebu bo maŋtsɛ fai ni yɔɔ fɛo.”
10Mibi, bo toi, ni omɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ. 11Mitsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee gbɛ lɛ; mikɛ bo etsɔ̃ jalɛ tɛmpɔŋi anɔ. 12Kɛji onyiɛ gbɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ onane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ, ni kɛji ojo foi yɛ nɔ po, otɛŋ. 13Mɔ tsɔsemɔ mli waa, kaaŋmɛɛ he. Okɛto jogbaŋŋ, shi no ji owala. 14 Kaayi yiwalɔi agbɛ nɔ, ni mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ hu okanyiɛ nɔ. 15Wii ohe kɛje gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ, kaayi nɔ; tsi ohe kɛje nɔ kwraa, ni ofo mli kɛya. 16Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji wɔɔɔ akɛ ja amɛfee efɔŋ dã. Wɔ po tseɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ ja amɛna mɔ ko awui amɛye dã. 17Ejaakɛ efɔŋfeelɔi aŋmãa ji yiwalɛ, ni amɛwain ji basabasafeemɔ.
18Shi jalɔi agbɛ lɛ etamɔ leebi la ni kpɛɔ, ni eyaa nɔ ekpɛɔ aahu kɛyashiɔ shwane. 19 Mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ etamɔ duŋ kabitii; amɛtɛrɛɔ, ni amɛnaaa nibii ni amɛtɛrɛɔ lɛ.
20Mibi, ka otoi ohã miwiemɔi lɛ; ba otoi shi ohã nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ. 21Ohiɛ akaje nɔ. Kɛto otsui mli tɔ̃ɔ. 22Ejaakɛ wala eji hã mɔ ni nine shɛɔ nɔ, ni eji tsabaa hã ehewojiaŋ fɛɛ. 23Ohiɛ akã otsui he fe nii fɛɛ; ejaakɛ no mli wala jɛɔ. 24Wiemɔ gbonyo akaje onaa; ni kaaye kutumpɔo. 25Too ohiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ohiɛ ama he ni oyaa lɛ nɔ. 26 Le onanefãamɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ aaaja ahã bo. 27 Kaagba ejurɔ loo abɛku. Tsi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he.

Title: ABƐI 5
Content:
Gbãlãfitemɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
1Mibi, bo minilee lɛ toi, ni oka otoi ohã miniiashishinumɔ; 2koni ole sanesɛɛkɔmɔ, ni odaaŋ wiemɔi aaajie onilee kpo. 3 Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, enaa ŋɔɔ tamɔ wo, ni edaaŋ shamɔɔ fe eŋmɔmi. 4Ni naagbee mli lɛ ejoɔ tamɔ taatso; enaaba tamɔ klante kɛ enaa nta. 5Enyiɛ gbele gbɛ, ni ebaakpala bo kɛya gbohiiaje. 6Enyiɛɛɛ wala gbɛ, hewɔ lɛ eduɔ gbɛ ni eleee. 7No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mibi, bo mi toi, ni kaashi miwiemɔi lɛ asɛɛ. 8Tsi ohe kɛje nɛkɛ yoo he kwraa. Kaabɛŋkɛ ewe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa tete. 9Kɛjeee nakai lɛ obulɛ baalaaje, ni yiwalɔi aaafo owala sɛɛ; 10asaŋ nii ni okɛ ohewalɛ tsu lɛ gbɔi baaye amɛtɔrɔ; ni nibii ni ogbo deŋme yɛ amɛhe lɛ aaaya mɔkpɔŋ ko we. 11Ni onaagbee mli lɛ, be ni ohewolo kɛ ogbɔmɔtso hiɛ ekpãtã lɛ obaakɛ̃mɔ. 12No be mli oookɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ kwraa minyɛ tsɔsemɔ, ni mikpoo kamɔ̃ kɛjɛ mitsui mli tɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ? 13Mibooo mitsɔ̃ɔlɔi atoi, ni mikaaa mitoi mihãaa mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii lɛ. 14Shwɛ shrao ni mihiɛ akpãtã kwraa yɛ asafo lɛ mli.”
15Ye oŋa anɔkwa, ni oŋɔ suɔmɔ ohã lɛ ekoome pɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ mli nu lɛ. 16Ejaakɛ bii ni okɛ yei krokomɛi aaafɔ lɛ, onaŋ amɛhe sɛɛ. 17Obii lɛ adara yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owe, koni amɛye amɛbua bo diɛŋtsɛ, shi jeee mɛi kpɔ̃ji. 18No hewɔ lɛ, na oŋa he miishɛɛ koni omii ashɛ oblahiiaŋ yoo ni oyakpee lɛ he. 19Ehe fɛo tamɔ ofrote, ni ehe yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ yɔɔ; ehe akɔnɔ lɛ ashɛje omii be fɛɛ be; hã ni esuɔmɔ aŋɔ bo nom. 20Shi mibi, mɛɛba yoo ni bɛ jeŋba he feɔ bo akɔnɔ, ni oloɔ yoo mɔkpɔŋ atuu? 21Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ, ni eekwɛ oyaa kɛ obaa fɛɛ. 22Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ enifɔji anii lɛ nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tamɔ tsɔne, ni eshai ni efeɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ fimɔɔ lɛ tamɔ kpãa. 23 Egboɔ ejaakɛ ebɛ tsɔsemɔ, ni ekwashiafeemɔ babaoo hewɔ lɛ ehiɛ kpãtãa.

Title: ABƐI 6
Content:
1 Mibi, kɛji owo onaanyo ko shi yɛ sane ko mli, aloo okɛ mɔ ko ta abasa yɛ onaanyo ko hewɔ, 2ni atsɔ̃ olilɛi nɔ adu bo, aloo atsɔ̃ odaaŋ wiemɔ nɔ amɔ bo lɛ, 3mibi, feemɔ enɛ ni okɛjie ohe; ejaakɛ onaanyo lɛ nine egbe bo. Yaa oya mramra ni oyakpa onaanyo lɛ fai. 4Kaahã ohiŋmɛii miina wɔ miiwɔ. Kaahã wɔ miiba ohiɛsɛɛ kwraa. 5Jiemɔ ohe kɛjɛ edɛŋ tamɔ soŋai jieɔ ehe yɛ gbɔbilɔ dɛŋ, aloo tamɔ loofɔlɔ jieɔ ehe yɛ loofɔlɔdulɔ dɛŋ lɛ. 6 Hejɔ̃lɔ, yaa tsatsu ŋɔɔ, jwɛŋmɔ enifeemɔi ahe ni ole nii. 7Lɛ po ni ebɛ maŋtsɛ loo nɔkwɛlɔ loo nɔyelɔ ko kwraa lɛ, 8etaoɔ eniyenii etoɔ yɛ latsaa be mli, ni ebuaa eŋmãa naa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli. 9Hejɔ̃lɔ, mɛɛbe oookã shi owɔ kɛyashi? Mɛɛbe nɔŋŋ ooote shi kɛaajɛ owɔ mli? 10 Hejɔ̃lɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mawɔ fioo; majie mihiɛsɛɛ fioo; makota miniji majɔɔ mihe fioo.” 11Be ni ooohɛle shi lɛ, ohia ebatua bo tamɔ ojotswalɔ; ni fimɔ aaatua bo tamɔ tabilɔ ni hiɛ tsɛŋ.
12 Yakagbɔmɔ, nɔfɔŋfeelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, enyiɛɔ eyeɔ kutumpɔo. 13Ebɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi, ekɛ enaji tete wieɔ, ni ekɛ ewaobii toɔ okadi. 14Etoɔ nibii fɔ̃ji yɛ etsui mli, eshwieɔ eyiŋ ŋaa fɔŋ daa, bei sɔŋŋ ewoɔ. 15No hewɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakpãtã trukaa, ni aaakumɔ lɛ trukaa ashwie shi bɔ ni ebɛ tsabaa.
16Yehowa miihi nibii kpawo: 17hewoo; amale lilɛi kɛ niji ni shwieɔ lá ni efeko efɔŋ ko shi. 18Tsui ni shwieɔ yiŋ fɔŋ, naji ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ. 19Mɔ ni yeɔ amale odase, ni efoɔ sane ni bɛ mli etãa; mɔ ni woɔ nanemɛi ateŋ bei.
Gbãlãfitemɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
20 Mibi, ye otsɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nii ni onyɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ kaakwa ekoeko. 21 Ŋɔɔ kitãi lɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ oto otsui mli daa nɛɛ; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ. 22 Kɛji onyiɛ lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ; kɛji okã shi owɔ lɛ, eeebu ohe, ni kɛji ohiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, ekɛ bo aaagba sane. 23Ejaakɛ kitã lɛ, kane ni, ni mla lɛ, la ni, ni tsɔsemɔkãmɔ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni. 24Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ aaabaa oyi kɛje yoo fɔŋ dɛŋ, eeekpɔ̃ bo kɛje yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lilɛi dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ. 25Kaadi ehe fɛo sɛɛ yɛ otsui mli, ni kaahã ekɛ ehiɛsɛɛ miimɔ bo. 26Abaanyɛ akɛ aboloo akwaabɔ abɔ yoo ajwamãŋ apaa, shi yoo gbãlãfitelɔ aaahã nuu wala tete abɔ lɛ.
27Aso mɔ ko aaaje la ashwie emiinaa, ni etadei eshãŋ? 28Aloo mɔ ko aaanyiɛ ŋai kɛ la nɔ, ni enaji eshaŋ? 29 Nakai eji hã nuu ni nyiɛɔ mɔ kroko ŋa sɛɛ; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaata ehe ni eeeye ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ. 30Kɛji hɔmɔ naa kɛkɛ ni julɔ yaju lɛ, agbeee ehe guɔ. 31Shi kɛji amɔ lɛ lɛ, ani ahaŋ eto najiaŋ toi kpawo lo? Ekɛ ewe nii fɛɛ tswɛm hãa. 32 Shi nuu ni fiteɔ gbãlã lɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ; mɔ ni feɔ nakai lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efiteɔ. 33Pilamɔ kɛ heguɔgbee eeena, ni ehiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ atsumɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. 34Ejaakɛ awuŋayeli hãa nuu mlifu naa waa, ni kɛji eetɔ owele lɛ, ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii. 35Eheŋ kpãtãmɔ nii ko, ni nyɔɔŋnii pii po ebaakwa.

Title: ABƐI 7
Content:
1Mibi, ye miwiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato. 2Ye mikitãi lɛ anɔ ní oyi ana wala; ni obu mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tamɔ ohiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ. 3Hã ehi owaobii anaa. Ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ. 4Tsɛ nilee akɛ, “Minyɛmi yoo,” koni otsɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ akɛ oshieŋnyɛ. 5Amɛ amɛaabaa oyi kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ, amɛaakpɔ̃ bo kɛjɛ yoo ni naa yɔɔ dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.
Yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ
6Ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ miwe lɛ samflɛ lɛ mli mikwɛ, 7ni mina oblanyo ko ni bɛ yitsoŋ, yɛ oblahii komɛi ni ajwɛŋmɔ esako komɛi ateŋ. 8Oblanyo lɛ nyiɛ gbɛjegbɛ ko ni tsɔ̃ɔ yoo nɛɛ shĩa lɛ koŋ lɛ nɔ; ni eyi yoo lɛ we lɛ gbɛ. 9Gbɛkɛ ni, ni hiɛ efee tuutuu, ni duŋ kpii miihe awo. 10Ni naa, yoo ko kɛ oblanyo lɛ bakpe. Yoo lɛ wo ajwamãŋ atade, ni etsui esa. 11Enaa wa, ni etoi egbo, ni etaaa shĩa. 12Bianɛbianɛ etee agbo lɛ naa; bianɛbianɛ etee jara lɛ nɔ, ni ewoɔ ka yɛ tsu koŋ fɛɛ tsu koŋ. 13Yoo nɛɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni eshwɔ enaa, ni yoo lɛ mia ehiɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 14 “Kulɛ esa akɛ mashã afɔle, shi ŋmɛnɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ miyawo mishiwoonii lɛ. 15No hã mije kpo koni mabɔ mɔdɛŋ matao bo ni mikɛ bo akpe, ni trukaa mibana bo nɛɛ. 16Mikɛ saanɔboi ni akɛ kpãi sui srɔtoi ni akɛjɛ Ijipt loo eha misaa lɛ nɔ. 17Mikɛ mire kɛ aloe kɛ sinamon ewo misaa lɛ mli ŋma. 18Ba ni wɔkɛ suɔmɔ ajie wɔkɔnɔ kɛyashi leebi. Wɔkɛ suɔmɔ anya kɛ miishɛɛ. 19Ejaakɛ miwu bɛ, efã gbɛ kɛtee shɔŋŋ. 20Ehiɛ shika pii kɛ kotoku kɛtee. Nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ baaye emuu dani ebaaba.” 21Yoo lɛ kɛ ewiemɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ kɔne oblanyo lɛ yiŋ, ni eyitsoŋ tsɔ̃. Ekɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee ewe. 22Oblanyo lɛ nyiɛ yoo lɛ sɛɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ kɛtee ewe lɛ tamɔ tsina ni ayaagbe lɛ, aloo ofrote ni tsɔne edu lɛ kpɛŋŋ 23kɛyashi beyinɔ ni gãimlibi tsuɔ emusuŋ nii amli. Etamɔ loofɔlɔ ni shaa foi kɛyaduɔ tsɔne ni eleee akɛ lɛ ewala hewɔ atsɔ̃ tsɔne lɛ.
24Oo, mibii, nyɛboa mi toi agbɛnɛ. Nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ. 25Kaahã otsui mɔ nɛkɛ yoo. Kaadu gbɛ kɛyaje egbɛ nɔ; 26ejaakɛ yoo ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi pii ahiɛ, mɛi ni egbe lɛ ayi fa naakpa. 27 Ewe lɛ, gbohiiaje gbɛ ni, ekã kɛmiiya gbele piai amli tɔ̃ɔ.

Title: ABƐI 8
Content:
Nilee yijiemɔ
1Ani jeee blɔmɔ nilee bolɔɔ kɛtsɛɔ lɛ;
ni jeee niiashishinumɔ hu woɔ egbee lɛ?
2Edamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ he yɛ ŋmaŋmashai lɛ.
3 Ebolɔɔ gegeege yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa yɛ maŋ lɛ klotia yɛ shinaa lɛ shi akɛ,
4“Oo, nyɛ hii, nyɛ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ,
ni nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii,
nyɛ miwoɔ migbee nɔ mihãa.
5Oo, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnako jwɛŋmɔ, nyɛkasea hiɛtɛ̃ɛ.
Oo, nyɛ hii kwashiai hu, nyɛboa toi jogbaŋŋ.
6Nyɛboa toi, ejaakɛ mibawie wiemɔi wuji ni he jaraa;
ni minaa ni magbele nɛɛ,
wiemɔi ni ja sɔŋŋ aaajɛ mli.
7Ejaakɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ aaajɛ midaaŋ;
minaabu miihi nɔ fɔŋ.
8Midaaŋ wiemɔi fɛɛ lɛ, jalɛ ni,
ekoeko bɛ mli ni ji amale loo kutumpɔo.
9Fɛɛ kã shi faŋŋ hã mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ
lɛ, ni amɛja yɛ nilelɔ hiɛ.
10 Nyɛmɔa mitsɔsemɔ lɛ moŋ mli fe jwiɛtɛi,
kɛ nilee hu mli fe shika ŋmiiŋmi.
11Ejaakɛ nilee hi fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o,
ni nɔ ko bɛ ni obaatao ni kɛ lɛ ye hegbɔ.
12Mi, nilee, mihiɛ tɛ̃;
mile nii, ni mibuɔ atɛŋ kpakpa.
13 Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji ohi nɔ fɔŋ.
Hewoo kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ miihi.
14Minɔ ji ŋaawoo kɛ nilee kpakpa,
miyɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ;
miyɛ hewalɛ hu.
15 Minɔ maŋtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ maŋtsɛ,
ni nɔyelɔi hu woɔ jalɛ mla.
16Minɔ lumɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ lumɔ,
ni abladei yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
17Misumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi;
ni mɛi ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ taoɔ mi lɛ, naa mi.
18Ninamɔ kɛ anunyam fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ;
ninamɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ kɛ shweremɔ fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ.
19Miyibii hi fe shika, efe shika ŋmiiŋmi;
ni minibaanii lɛ hu hi fe jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ.
20Minyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ,
ni mikojoɔ jalɛ naa.
21Ni mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, mifeɔ amɛ niiatsɛmɛi,
ni miwoɔ amɛfotroi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
22Mi Yehowa bɔ kɛje enitsumɔ shishi;
mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ yɛ eblema nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ.
23Kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe abɔ mi klɛŋklɛŋ dani aje jeŋbɔɔ shishi.
24Be ni ŋshɔ tete po bɛ lɛ, afɔ mi momo,
be ni nuhiŋmɛi bɛ lɛ, miyɛ momo.
25Dani ashɔ̃ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ, afɔ mi momo.
26Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ nako ebɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ jwɛii kɛ je lɛ mli mlu tete lɛ,
mi lɛ, abɔ mi momo.
27 Be ni ebɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, miyɛ jɛi; be ni efo ŋshɔ he akrabatsa lɛ, miyɛ.
28Be ni eŋɔ atatui lɛ esɛŋ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi,
ní etsi ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ naa lɛ, miyɛ.
29 Be ni efo husu ewo ŋshɔ lɛ he,
ni nu akaku ekitã lɛ nɔ,
be ni eto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ,
30miyɛ emasɛi akɛ ŋaawolɔ.
Ni mi ji emiishɛjelɔ daa.
Ni mimii shɛɔ mihe yɛ ehiɛ.
31 Minaa je lɛ he miishɛɛ,
minaa gbɔmɛiabii ahe tsuijurɔ.
32No hewɔ lɛ, mibii nyɛboa mi toi!
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ mimlai anɔ lɛ!
33Nyɛboa tsɔsemɔ toi koni nyɛle nii;
ni nyɛkakwaa lɛ kwraa.
34Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni boɔ mi toi ni ebuɔ migboi lɛ anaa daa
ní emɛɔ daa yɛ mishinai lɛ anaa lɛ.
35Ejaakɛ mɔ ni aaaná mi lɛ,
ena wala ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
36Shi mɔ ni nine shɛɛɛ minɔ lɛ,
eeye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma awui.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ, amɛmiisumɔ gbele.”

Title: ABƐI 9
Content:
Nilee kɛ kwashiafeemɔ
1Nilee ema etsu kɛ ehe akulashiŋi kpawo. 2 Egbe elɛɛ kooloi; efutu ewain lɛ, ni eŋmɛ ekpɔlɔ̃ lɛ hu. 3Etsu etsuji yei lɛ kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli hei grɔŋŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni amɛyatsɛ mɛi akɛ, 4“Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, ebatsɔ̃ biɛ,” ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ, 5“Ba ni obaye miniyenii lɛ eko ni obanu wain ni mifutu lɛ eko. 6Kaaŋɔ ohe obɔ kwashia he, koni oyi ana wala; ni dii sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛ.”
7Mɔ ni jajeɔ hefɛoyelɔ jeŋba lɛ, enaa jɛmɔ; ni mɔ ni kãa yiwalɔ lɛ, enaa pilamɔ. 8Hɛfɛoyelɔ lɛ kɛ okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ bo; shi nilelɔ lɛ kɛji okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaasumɔ bo. 9Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nilelɔ nii, ni eeele nii efata nɔ ni ele momo lɛ he; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ jalɔ nii, ni enilee aaafa.
10 Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee; ni Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ lee ji sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
11Ejaakɛ minɔ baatsɔ̃ ni ogbii baafa; ni owala afii lɛ asɛɛ baatsɛ. 12Kɛ ole nii lɛ, ole ohã ohe; shi kɛ hefɛoyelɔ ji bo lɛ, bo okome obaatere.
13Yoo kwashia lɛ, naawalɔ ni, ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni ehiɛgbele tɔ ejwa. 14Etaa shi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshinaa shi; etaa hei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; 15ni etsɛɔ mɛi ni hoɔ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛ nɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ. 16Ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, eba biɛ,” ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ, 17 “Nu ni ayaju lɛ, enumɔ ŋɔɔ. Ni aboloo ni ateɔ ayeɔ lɛ eyɛ akɔnɔ.” 18Mɛi ni ekpeɔ kɛyaa ewe lɛ leee akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yaa jɛi lɛ gboiɔ; amɛleee akɛ mɛi ni akpee kɛtee jɛi momo lɛ gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ amɛyɔɔ lɛ.

Title: ABƐI 10
Content:
Solomon Abɛi
1 Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi bi kwashia lɛ, ehãa enyɛ tsui yeɔ.
2Efɔŋfeemɔ mli ninamɔ lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ; shi jalɛ hereɔ mɔ yiwala yɛ gbele dɛŋ.
3 Yehowa hãaa hɔmɔ aye jalɔi; shi nɔ ni efɔŋfeelɔi shweɔ akɛ amɛna lɛ, etswaa yɛ amɛdɛŋ. 4 Mɔ ni nijiaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ohia hiaa lɛ, shi mɔ ni nine kãaa shi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ niiatsɛ.
5Bi ni buaa ŋmãa naa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, bi nilelɔ ni; shi bi ni wɔɔ yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, bi ni woɔ mɔ hiɛgbele ni.
6Ajɔɔ mɛi ni feɔ jalɛ nii, shi efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ haa amɛyitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.
7 Kɛ akai jalɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ; shi efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ atsiŋ egbɛi tã ajɔŋ lɛ.
8Nilelɔ kpɛlɛ̃ɔ kãmɔ; shi kwashia naafuutsɛ hiɛ kpãtãa.
9Anɔkwayelɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe, shi mɔ ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, aaayoo lɛ.
10Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ ewoɔ bei; shi mɔ ni kɛ ekãa kãa mɔ lɛ hãa toiŋjɔlɛ baa.
11Jalɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; shi efɔŋfeelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ haa yitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.
12 Nyɛɛ teɔ bei shi; shi suɔmɔ haa tɔ̃mɔi fɛɛ anɔ.
13Niiashishinulɔ daaŋ anaa nilee yɛ; shi mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ kpãa kã ekotosɛɛ.
14Nilelɔ tiaa nilee, shi kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa.
15Niiatsɛ nii ji emɔ̃ɔ ni wa lɛ, shi ohia kpãtãa ohiafo hiɛ.
16 Jalɛ nitsumɔ he nyɔmɔwoo lɛ wala ni, efɔŋfeemɔ he sɛɛnamɔ ji esha.
17Mɔ ni boɔ tsɔsemɔ toi lɛ, enyiɛɔ gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli nɔ; shi mɔ ni kwaa kãmɔ lɛ, eduɔ gbɛ.
18Mɔ ni kɛ nyɛɛ teɔ lɛ, amalelɔ ni; mɔ ni yeɔ mɔ he osheku lɛ, kwashia ji lɛ.
19Wiemɔ babaoo yɔɔ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ kpaaa yɛ mli; shi mɔ ni le enaabu mli mɔmɔ lɛ, nilelɔ ni.
20Jalɔ lilɛi lɛ, etamɔ jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ; shi mɔ fɔŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.
21Jalɔ naabu lɛɔ mɛi babaoo, shi kwashia lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ ni ebɛ hewɔ lɛ egboɔ.
22 Yehowa jɔɔmɔ lɛ, no feɔ mɔ niiatsɛ; shi odeŋmegbomɔ nyɛŋ ekɛ nɔ ko afata he.
23Kwashia lɛ efɔŋfeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ, shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nilee feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ.
24 Nɔ ni mɔ fɔŋ sheɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baaba enɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ enine aaashɛ etaomɔnii anɔ.
25Kɛ ahum tswa pɛ, mɔ fɔŋ yi etã, shi jalɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe kɛyaa naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
26Bɔ ni ashiŋ feɔ nyanyɔji ni lasu feɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, nakai anihaolɔ feɔ mɛi ni tsu lɛ lɛ.
27 Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ hãa wala sɛɛ tsɛɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji afii lɛ, aaafo nɔ.
28 Jalɔi ahiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ baafee miishɛɛ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛkwɛmɔ lɛ baafee yaka.
29Yehowa ji mɔɔ ni wa hã mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, shi eji hiɛkpãtãmɔ hã efɔŋfeelɔ.
30 Jalɔ lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ ehiŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
31 Jalɔi alilɛi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi kutumpɔo lilɛi lɛ, aaafo ashɛ afɔ̃.
32Jalɔi anaabu le nɔ ni sa wiemɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ wieɔ kutumpɔo wiemɔ.

Title: ABƐI 11
Content:
1 Yehowa miihi shishiumɔ nsɛni, shi nsɛnitɛ shishiishi lɛ enaa he miishɛɛ.
2 Kɛ hewoo ba pɛ, hiɛgbele nyiɛɔ esɛɛ, shi heshibalɔ lɛ nilelɔ ni.
3 Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ; shi kutumpɔfo lɛ eshishiumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kpãtãa ehiɛ.
4Mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ninamɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko; shi jalɛ jieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele dɛŋ.
5Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli hãa egbɛ jaa ehãa lɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔjianii lɛ gbeɔ lɛ shi.
6Mɛi ni ja lɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ aajie amɛ, shi kutumpɔfoi lɛ, amɛkɔnɔ ŋɔɔ amɛ nom.
7Kɛ mɔ fɔŋ gbo lɛ; ehiɛnɔkãmɔ laajeɔ; ni mɔ ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeɔ yaka.
8Ajieɔ jalɔi kɛjɛɔ haomɔ mli; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji yanyɔɔ haomɔ mli.
9Mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi fiteɔ amɛnanemɛi; shi atsɔ̃ɔ nilee nɔ, ni ajieɔ jalɔi.
10Kɛji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tee nɔ jogbaŋŋ hã jalɔ lɛ maŋ fɛɛ nyaa; ni kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ji ahiɛ kpãtã lɛ, maŋ fɛɛ bɔɔ oshe kɛ miishɛɛ.
11 Jalɔi adɛŋ jɔɔmɔ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji anaabu butuɔ maŋ.
12Mɔ ni gbeɔ enaanyo he guɔ lɛ, ebɛ yitsoŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ efeɔ diŋŋ.
13Mɔ ni tãa sane kɛfoɔ shi lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ etsimɔɔ sane nɔ.
14He ni maŋ kudɔmɔ bɛ lɛ, maŋ gbeɔ shi; shi he ni ŋaawolɔi pii yɔɔ lɛ, maŋ feɔ shweshweeshwe.
15Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, eeeshwa ehe; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe wooo mli lɛ ehi hã lɛ.
16Yoo ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam tiuɔ woo sɛɛ, ni nuu yiwalɔ tiuɔ ninamɔ sɛɛ.
17Mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ejurɔ efeɔ; shi mɔ ni yitsoŋ wa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efɔŋ efeɔ.
18Mɔ fɔŋ naa shishiumɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo; shi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛ nii lɛ enaa anɔkwale mli nyɔmɔwoo.
19Mɔ ni fiɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ jalɛ mli lɛ, eyi aaana wala; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ sɛɛ lɛ egboɔ.
20Yehowa miihi mɛi ni hiɛ yitso fɔŋ; shi Yehowa sumɔɔ mɛi ni shwamɔ bɛ amɛjeŋba he.
21Na ole akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ efɔŋfeelɔ yeŋ ehe; shi jalɔ lɛ aaahere eyiwala.
22Yoo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni ebɛ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ etamɔ kplotoo ni awo egugɔ mli shika ga.
23Jalɔi shweɔ nibii kpakpai sɔŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛkwɛmɔnii lɛ mlifu ni.
24Mɔ ko yɛ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ, shi eyaa nɔ eshwereɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ kɛ̃, mɔ ko hu feɔ kpɛkpɛɛ, shi eyeɔ ohia moŋ.
25Mɔ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, enaa nii, ni mɔ ni hãa mɛi tɔrɔɔ lɛ, lɛ hu etɔɔ.
26Mɔ ni tiaa abele etoɔ lɛ, maŋ lomɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ maŋ jɔɔ lɛ. 27Mɔ ni tiuɔ nɔ kpakpa sɛɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ naa nɔ kpakpa; shi mɔ ni diɔ efɔŋ sɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ blaa lɛ.
28 Mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ eninamɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ baa gbiŋ ni kpalaa; shi jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ baa ŋmɔŋ. 29Mɔ ni gbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩaŋbii anaa lɛ, eyeɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔ; ni buulu tsɔ̃ɔ tsulɔ hãa nilelɔ be fɛɛ be.
30 Jalɛ yibii lɛ wala ni; shi mla kwamɔ lɛ wala hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni. 31 Kɛji jalɔ lɛ enaa enyɔmɔwoo yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ kɛ eshafeelɔ lɛ te amɛnyɔmɔwoo aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ?

Title: ABƐI 12
Content:
1 Mɔ ni sumɔɔ tsɔsemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ nilee; shi mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, kwashia ni.
2Gbɔmɔ kpakpa hiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, shi mɔ ni toɔ yiŋ fɔŋ lɛ, ebuɔ lɛ fɔ.
3Efɔŋfeemɔ hãaa mɔ afi shi; shi jalɔi ashishi fã lɛ, anyɛŋ afã kɔkɔɔkɔ.
4 Yoo kpakpa lɛ ewu akekre ji lɛ; shi yoo ni shwieɔ ewu hiɛ shi lɛ, etamɔ wuiaŋ sasabro.
5 Jalɔ jwɛŋmɔ ja; shi mɔ fɔŋ ŋaawoo lɛ, kutumpɔo ni.
6Mɛi fɔ̃ji woɔ lá antɛo, shi jalɔi awiemɔ hereɔ mɔ yiwala.
7Abutuɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ; shi jalɔi awe maa shi shiŋŋ.
8Gbɔmɔ nilee akɛjieɔ eyi, shi mɔ ni hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, abuuu lɛ.
9Ohiafo humi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko.
10 Jalɔ nuɔ he ehãa eshĩa kooloo tete; shi mɔ fɔŋ musuŋtsɔlɛ tete lɛ, yiwaa ni.
11 Mɔ ni huɔ eŋmɔ lɛ eeetɔ kɛ ŋmãa pii; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yakanii asɛɛ lɛ ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
12Mɔ fɔŋ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa; shi jalɔ shishifã maa shi shiŋŋ.
13Mɔ fɔŋ diɛŋtsɛ daaŋ wiemɔ nɔŋŋ ni duɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejeɔ haomɔ mli.
14 Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni nɔ ni gbɔmɔ tsuɔ lɛ no he nyɔmɔ awoɔ lɛ.
15Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ, egbɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ; shi nilelɔ lɛ, eboɔ ŋaawoo toi.
16Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ anaa emlifu oya; shi nilelɔ lɛ ebuuu jɛmɔ tete.
17Mɔ ni wieɔ anɔkwale lɛ, eyeɔ anɔkwa odase; shi amale odasefonyo lɛ mɔ elakaa.
18 Mɔ ko yɛ ni ewiemɔ bambam dumɔɔ mɔ tamɔ kakla; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ etsaa mɔ.
19Anɔkwale wiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; shi amale lɛ, ehiɔ shi hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ.
20Mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi kɛ mɔshishiumɔ; shi mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa kpakpa lɛ amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe.
21Haomɔ baaa jalɔ nɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ haomɔi jwere enɔ.
22 Yehowa miihi amalelɔ; shi mɔ ni yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ enaa ehe miishɛɛ.
23 Nilelɔ kɛ enilee teɔ; shi kwashia jieɔ ekwashiafeemɔ kpo.
24Mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ yeɔ onukpa; shi hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ ayeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ.
25 Mligbigblimɔ dɔɔ mɔ kɔmɔɔ; shi wiemɔ kpakpa yɔɔ nɛɛ ehãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe.
26Jalɔ tsɔ̃ɔ enaanyo gbɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ hãa mɛi duɔ gbɛ moŋ.
27Hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, enine shɛɛɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ nɔ; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ lɛ enaa nii ni jara wa.
28Jalɛ lɛ wala gbɛ ni; shi gbɛ gbonyo lɛ, gbele gbɛ ni.

Title: ABƐI 13
Content:
1 Bi nilelɔ boɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi; hefɛoyelɔ lɛ ebooo kãmɔ toi.
2 Gbɔmɔ kpakpa daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai; shi nɔ ni kutumpɔfoi taoɔ ji basabasafeemɔ.
3 Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni mɔɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eekpãtã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ.
4Hejɔ̃lɔ shweɔ nɔ ko, ni enaaa; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ naa nii kɛtekeɔ nɔ.
5Jalɔ miihi amale, shi mɔ fɔŋ feɔ hiɛgbejianii, ni ebɔɔ ehe ahora.
6Jalɛ buɔ mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ he; shi eshafeemɔ butuɔ mɔ fɔŋ. 7 Mɔ ko yɛ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; mɔ ko hu yɛ ni feɔ ehe ohiafo, tsɛbelɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
8Gbɔmɔ kpɔ̃mɔ nii ji enii ni eyɔɔ; shi ohiafo bɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛkpɔ̃ɔ ehe.
9 Jalɔi akane tsoɔ hɛŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji akane lɛ aaagbo.
10 Hewoo lɛ bei kɛkɛ ekɛbaa; shi mɛi ni boɔ ŋaawoo toi lɛ, amɛleɔ nii.
11Nii ni anaa oya lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa; shi nii ni akpɛteɔ shi anaa lɛ eshwereɔ.
12Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni baaa mli mra lɛ, ewoɔ mɔ tsui hela; shi kɛji nɔ ni ashweɔ lɛ na ba mli lɛ, ehãa wala.
13Mɔ ni gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ, ekpãtãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kitã lɛ, ebaana he sɛɛ.
14Nilelɔ nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; ejieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele akpa mli.
15Nilee kpakpa hãa mɔ hiɛ baa nyam; shi kutumpɔfoi agbɛ lɛ ekpãtãa amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ.
16 Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ feɔ enii kɛ nilee; shi kwashia gbɛɔ ebuulufeemɔ eshwãa.
17Tsulɔ fɔŋ lɛ ekɛ mɛi woɔ haomɔ mli; shi bɔfo anɔkwafo lɛ ekɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baa. 18Mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ ohia kɛ hiɛgbele ji enɔ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kãmɔ lɛ awoɔ ehiɛ nyam.
19Kɛji susuma na nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ; shi kwashiai sumɔɔɔ akɛ amɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.
20Mɔ ni kɛ nilelɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni kɛ kwashiai bɔɔ lɛ eeena jaramɔ.
21Eshafeelɔi lɛ efɔŋ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ; shi jalɔi lɛ amɛshwereɔ.
22 Gbɔmɔ kpakpa shiɔ gboshinii ehãa ebii abii; shi eshafeelɔ nii lɛ jalɔ atiaa ahãa.
23Ohiafoi ashikpɔŋ ni kã shi efolo baa niyenii pii; shi jalɛ sane ni ayeee hewɔ lɛ, nii lɛ ŋmɛɔ amɛ.
24Mɔ ni emiii ni etsɔseɔ ebi kɛ kpãa lɛ, eenyɛ ebi lɛ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔ ebi lɛ, ejeɔ mra etsɔseɔ lɛ.
25 Jalɔ yɛ nii pii ni eyeɔ etɔɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ musuŋ hɔmɔ po yeɔ lɛ.

Title: ABƐI 14
Content:
1Yoo nilelɔ kpɛɔ eshĩa; shi yoo kwashia jwaa eshĩa.
2Mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ efeɔ jalɛnii; shi mɔ ni gbeɔ Yehowa he guɔ lɛ efeee jalɛ nii.
3Buulu daaŋ wiemɔ gwaoɔ lɛ; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ baa eyi.
4He ni tsina hii bɛ lɛ, niyenii bɛ jɛi; shi he ni tsinanuu hewalɔ yɔɔ lɛ jɛi ŋmãa babaoo yɔɔ.
5Odasefonyo anɔkwafo maleee; shi apasa odasefonyo maleɔ pam.
6Hefɛoyelɔ taoɔ nilee, shi enaaa; shi nilee taomɔ waaa hãaa niiashishinulɔ.
7Jee kwashia hiɛ; ejaakɛ onaŋ nilee wiemɔ yɛ edaaŋ.
8Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ ni ehiɛ tɛ̃ lɛ, ele he ni eyaa; shi kwashiai abuulufeemɔ hãa amɛduɔ gbɛ.
9Kwashia ebuuu eshafeemɔ akɛ eji nɔ fɔŋ; shi jalɔi tiuɔ eshaifaa sɛɛ.
10Tsui pɛ ni le enidɔɔnii; ni nɔ ni ji emiishɛɛ lɛ ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ejaaa.
11 Mɔ fɔŋ we hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi jalɔ we aaashwere.
12 Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.
13Ŋmɔlɔ mli tete lɛ, tsui werɛ hoɔ ehe; ni miishɛɛ naagbee lɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baa.
14Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eeena ejeŋba he nyɔmɔwoo; ni mɔ kpakpa lɛ, eeena enifeemɔnii kpakpa he nyɔmɔwoo.
15Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔɔɔ heɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ eyeɔ; shi hiɛtɛ̃lɔ leɔ enanenaa kwɛmɔ.
16Nilelɔ sheɔ ehe gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; shi kwashia feɔ kakampu ni efeɔ anyagbã.
17Mɔ ni mli etsɛɛɛ fumɔ lɛ, efeɔ kwashiaianii, ni yitsofɔŋtsɛ lɛ anyɛɔ lɛ.
18 Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔɔɔ lɛ, abuɔ lɛ buulu fai; shi nilelɔ lɛ afiɔ lɛ nilee akekre.
19Mɛi fɔ̃ji kotoɔ mɛi kpakpai, ni efɔŋfeelɔi kotoɔ jalɔi yɛ agboi anaa.
20 Ohiafo lɛ, enaanyo tete sumɔɔɔ lɛ, shi niiatsɛ lɛ, esuɔlɔi faa babaoo.
21Mɔ ni nyaŋeɔ enaanyo lɛ, eshafeelɔ ni; shi mɔ ni feɔ ohiafo ekpakpa lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ. 22Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ ani jeee tɔ̃ etɔ̃ɔ lɛ lo? Shi mɔ ni toɔ ŋaa kpakpa lɛ, afiɔ esɛɛ, ni ayeɔ lɛ anɔkwa.
23Sɛɛnamɔ yɛ deŋmegbomɔ mli; shi ohia kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ naabu folo wiemɔ mli.
24Nilelɔi akekre ji amɛnilee. Shi kwashiai akekre ji amɛbuulufeemɔ.
25 Anɔkwa odasefonyo lɛ ehereɔ gbɔmɛi ayiwala; shi amalelɔ lɛ mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni.
26 Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ mli hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni mli wa yɔɔ; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ no lɛ ebii naa abobaahe.
27 Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hãa wala ni, ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbele tsɔnei amli.
28Maŋbii ayifalɛ ji maŋtsɛ anunyam; shi kɛji maŋbii bɛ lɛ, lumɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni.
29 Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, eyɛ niiashishinumɔ kpele; shi mɔ ni mli fuɔ mramra lɛ ejieɔ ebuulufeemɔ kpo.
30Toiŋjɔlɛ hãa gbɔmɔtso naa hewalɛ; shi awuŋayeli woɔ wuiaŋ hela.
31 Mɔ ni waa ohiafo yi lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ahora; shi mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, eewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
32Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔjianii lɛ nɔŋŋ butuɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejalɛ ji ebobaahe.
33Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ ele nii; shi kwashia lɛ, ebɛ niiashishinumɔ.
34Jalɛ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi esha lɛ, maŋ ahorabɔɔ ni.
35 Tsulɔ nilelɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ hiɛ sɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ, emli fuɔ lɛ.

Title: ABƐI 15
Content:
1 Naajɔlɛ hetoo kuɔ mlila naa; shi mlila wiemɔ teɔ mlifu shi.
2 Nilelɔi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi buului awiemɔi jɛɔ kwashiai adaaŋ.
3Yehowa hiŋmɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he; ni ekwɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai fɛɛ.
4Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ walatso ni; shi kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ efiteɔ mɔ mumɔ.
5Kwashia gbeɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ; shi mɔ ni kpɛlɛ̃ɔ kãmɔ lɛ ehiɛ tɛ̃ɔ.
6Jwetri babaoo yɛ jalɔ we, shi mɔ fɔŋ ninamɔ lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa.
7Nilelɔi awiemɔ gbɛɔ nilee shwãa; shi kwashiai anɔ efeee nakai.
8 Mɛi fɔ̃ji afɔle lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi jalɔi asɔlemɔ lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ.
9 Mɔ fɔŋ jeŋba lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi mɔ ni tiuɔ jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, esumɔɔ lɛ.
10 Toigbalamɔ kpele kã shi hã mɔ ni tɔ̃ɔ, ni mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, gbo eeegbo.
11 Gbohiiaje kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ bu lɛ tete po naa kã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; aahu ni gbɔmɛi adesai atsuii.
12 Hefɛoyelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ akãa lɛ; ni ebɛŋkɛɛɛ nilelɔi hu.
13Tsui ni eyi kɛ miishɛɛ lɛ, ehãa mɔ tseɔ ehiɛ; shi tsui ni eyi kɛ awerɛho lɛ ehãa mɔ feɔ gblinii.
14Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ; shi kwashiai anaabu tiuɔ buulufeemɔ sɛɛgbɛ.
15Nɔnalɔ gbii fɛɛ lɛ, gbii fɔ̃ji sɔŋŋ ni; shi mɔ ni tsui enyɔ emli lɛ, lɛ lɛ daa nɛɛ eeye gbijurɔ.
16 Nii fioo ni Yehowa he gbeyeishemɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe jwetri babaoo ni haomɔ yɔɔ he.
17Shwie folo ni akɛŋmɛ okplɔ̃ ni suɔmɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe tsina ni ewo fɔ ni nyɛɛ yɔɔ he.
18 Mlilatsɛ teɔ bei shi; shi mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, ekpãtãa bei. 19 Anihaolɔ gbɛ tsaa kɛ ŋmei; shi jalɔ gbɛ lɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni.
20Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi kwashia gbeɔ enyɛ he guɔ.
21Mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, buulufeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ebaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ.
22 He ni ajinatoo bɛ lɛ, yiŋtoi feɔ yaka; shi ŋaawolɔi pii hãa yiŋtoi yeɔ omanye.
23Wiemɔ hetoohãmɔ ni sa lɛ, ehãa mɔ naa miishɛɛ; ni wiemɔ ni awie yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ, ehi pam.
24Nilelɔ gbɛ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa ŋwɛi ni; ni ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbohiiaje bu lɛ mli.
25Yehowa wuleɔ hewolɔ we; shi ehãa okulafo husu hiɔ shi.
26Mɛi fɔ̃ji ayiŋtoi lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi wiemɔi ni he tse lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ. 27Hiɛjoolɔ hãa haomɔ baa ewe nɔ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ nyɔɔŋnii hemɔ lɛ, eyi aaana wala.
28Jalɔ jwɛŋɔ bɔ ni eeehã sane hetoo ehã; shi wiemɔi gbohii jɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji adaaŋ.
29Yehowa kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ateŋ jɛkɛ; shi eboɔ jalɔi afaikpamɔ toi.
30 Hiɛtsemɔ kɛ mɔhamɔ lɛ, ehãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe; ni sanekpakpa hãa mɔ wuiaŋ woɔ fɔ.
31Mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ krɔŋŋ toi lɛ, ehiɔ nilelɔi ateŋ.
32Mɔ ni booo tsɔsemɔ toi lɛ, egbeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe guɔ; shi mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ toi lɛ, enaa niiashishinumɔ.
33 Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji tsɔsemɔ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii; ni anunyam yɔɔ nɛɛ heshibaa nyiɛɔ ehiɛ.

Title: ABƐI 16
Content:
1Yiŋtoo lɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ ni; shi nɔ ni lilɛi wieɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛɔ.
2Gbɔmɔ gbɛi fɛɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, ekwɛɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ.
3 Tuu onitsumɔi owo Yehowa dɛŋ, ni oyiŋtoi aaama shi shiŋŋ.
4Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fee lɛ, eyɛ nɔ hewɔ ni efee; gbi fɔŋ tete lɛ, ekã shi ehã mɔ fɔŋ.
5Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe; kɛ ata abasa yɛ nɔ po, abaagbala etoi.
6Anɔkwayeli nɔ Yehowa damɔɔ ni ekɛ eshai faa; ni mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.
7 Kɛji gbɔmɔ adesa jeŋba sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, ehãa ehenyɛlɔi tete kɛ lɛ kpãtãa.
8Nii fioo ni ana yɛ anɔkwayeli mli lɛ, ehi fe nii babaoo ni atsɔ̃ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ ana.
9Gbɔmɔ adesa toɔ egbɛi ahe ŋaa; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni kudɔɔ enanefãamɔi.
10Ŋwɛi hewalɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ wiemɔ mli; ni maŋtsɛ naa kpaaa yɛ atɛŋbuu mli.
11Nsɛni kɛ nsɛnitɛ ni yɔɔ shishiishi lɛ, Yehowa nii ni; ni kotoku lɛ mli nsɛnitɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enitsumɔnii ni.
12 Eji nihiinii akɛ maŋtsɛ aaafee efɔŋ; ejaakɛ jalɛ ni hãa maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i maa shi shiŋŋ.
13Maŋtsɛ nyaa mɔ ni wieɔ jalɛ wiemɔ he, ni esumɔɔ mɔ ni wieɔ jalɛ wiemɔ.
14Kɛji maŋtsɛ mli fu lɛ, gbele aaanyɛ ajɛ mli aba; shi nilelɔ jɔɔ maŋtsɛ tsui he.
15Maŋtsɛ hiɛ ni etseɔ ehãa mɔ lɛ, no mli wala yɔɔ, ni emɔhetsuinamɔ tamɔ atatu ni nɛɔ gbo nu.
16 Kɛji ole nii lɛ ehi aahu fe shika; ni kɛji oyɛ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, ehi fe jwiɛtɛi.
17Jalɔi agbɛ gbaa kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; mɔ ni kwɛɔ ejeŋba jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi.
18Hewoo tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; ni hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ mumɔ tsɔ̃ɔ shigbeemɔ hiɛ.
19Ehi akɛ ohi shi akɛ humi yɛ ohiafoi ateŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ hewolɔi aaaja nomŋɔɔnii.
20Mɔ ni yeɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ lɛ, eeeshwere; ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ.
21Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ; ni wiemɔ ni ŋɔɔ lɛ, no tsakeɔ mɔ jwɛŋmɔ.
22 Nilee lɛ wala nubu ni hã nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ buulu nii lɛ, eefee kwashiaianii.
23Nilelɔ susuɔ nii ahe dani ewieɔ, ni ehãa ewiemɔ ŋɔɔ mɔ naa.
24 Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ, etamɔ wo agbaku; eŋɔɔ susuma naa, ni ehãa gbɔmɔtso hewalɛ.
25 Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.
26Nitsulɔ lɛ, nii ni baa etsine lɛ, no hãa etsuɔ nii waa, ni no nɔŋŋ woɔ lɛ ekãa.
27Yakagbɔmɔ toɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa fɔŋ, ni edaaŋ wiemɔ shãa mɔ tamɔ la.
28Kutumpɔfo gbɛɔ bei eshwãa, ni oshekuyelɔ tserɛɔ nanemɛi ateŋ.
29Basabasafeelɔ lakaa ehe gbɔmɔ, ni ekpalaa lɛ kɛyaa gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ.
30Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, etoɔ yiŋ fɔŋ; ni mɔ ni kɔ̃ɔ enaa ablafa lɛ, ehãa efɔŋ baa mli.
31Waŋ lɛ, anunyam akekre ni; jalɛ shihilɛ mli pɛ anaa yɛ.
32Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ ehi fe kãkãlɔ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ emumɔ nɔ lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni yeɔ maŋ nɔ kunim.
33Afɔ̃ɔ oshiki kɛtaoɔ nii anaa; shi bɔ ni eeetamɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ.

Title: ABƐI 17
Content:
1 Atrɔma gbiŋ ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe niyenii kpɔtɔɔ ni yɔɔ shĩa ni bei yɔɔ mli lɛ mli.
2Nyɔŋ ni le nii lɛ, eeeye bi ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ nɔ; ni eeena gboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ musuŋbi lɛ.
3 Akɛ kukwɛi kaa jwiɛtɛi akwɛɔ, ni akɛ flɔnɔɔ kaa shika; shi gbɔmɔ tsui lɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni kaa ekwɛɔ.
4Efɔŋfeelɔi boɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji awiemɔ toi, ni amalelɔ kaa etoi ehãa wiemɔi ni fiteɔ mɔ.
5Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo he fɛo lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni bɔ ohiafo lɛ ahora; ni mɔ ni naa miishɛɛ yɛ mɔ ko amanehulu he lɛ, eyeŋ ehe.
6 Hiimeji akekre ji amɛnabii; ni bii ahiɛnyam ji amɛtsɛmɛi.
7Wiemɔ ni bɛ hiŋmɛi nɔ esaaa kwashia po, aahu ni apasa wiemɔ aaasa ablade.
8Nyɔɔŋnihamɔ yɛ mɔ ni hãa lɛ hiɛ lɛ, etamɔ ashwã awuja; ni he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, efeɔ lɛ akɛ ebaashwere.
9Mɔ ni kɛ tɔ̃mɔ faa lɛ, lɛ ehãa naanyobɔɔ mli waa; shi mɔ ni niɔ sane he lɛ, efiteɔ shieŋtsɛmɛi ateŋ.
10Mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enuɔ kãmɔ he fe kwashia ni amãmɔ lɛ atswɛrɛi oha.
11Gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ atuatsemɔ pɛ amɛtaoɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ ni yitsoŋ wa atsuɔ kɛyaninaa amɛ.
12Ehi akɛ gbɔmɔ kɛ oshishibrishi yoo ni amɔ ebi akpe, fe nɔ ni ekɛ kwashia moŋ aaakpe yɛ ebuulufeemɔ mli.
13 Mɔ ni kɛ efɔŋ toɔ ekpakpa najiaŋ lɛ, efɔŋ kpaŋ yɛ ewe.
14Beibɔ̃imɔ lɛ etamɔ nu ni miitsere kɔikɔi; no hewɔ lɛ, be ni naataamɔ mli wako nɛɛ lɛ, ŋmɛɛmɔ he.
15 Mɔ ni buɔ efɔŋfeelɔ bem, kɛ mɔ ni buɔ jalɔ fɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
16Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ kwashia baana, kɛji ekɛ shika yahe nilee; ejaakɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ.
17Naanyo sumɔɔ mɔ be fɛɛ be; ni nyɛmi hu fimɔ be hewɔ ni afɔ lɛ.
18Mɔ ni bɛ yitsoŋ lɛ, lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɔ nɔ akɛ eeedamɔ enaanyo sɛɛ.
19Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eshafeemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ bei; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ pupuupu lɛ, ejieɔ amane.
20Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, ehiŋ haŋ lɛ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ kutumpɔo lɛ egbeɔ haomɔ mli.
21Bi kwashia lɛ eji awerɛho kɛhã etsɛ; ni tsɛ ni efɔ bi kwashia lɛ enaaa miishɛɛ ko.
22 Tsuijurɔ lɛ tsofa kpakpa ni; shi ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ egbeɔ mɔ blɛoo.
23Efɔŋfeelɔ heɔ nyɔɔŋnii koni etsɔ̃ jalɛ hiɛ ebu shi.
24Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ, shi kwashia woɔ ehiɛ emaa he fɛɛ he.
25Bi kwashia lɛ etsɛ awerɛho ji lɛ; ni eji tsuiyeli hã enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ.
26Ehiii akɛ agbala jalɔ toi aloo ayi ablade yɛ jalɛ sane hewɔ.
27 Mɔ ni wiemɔ faaa lɛ ele nii, ni mɔ ni mumɔ he jɔ lɛ, enuɔ nii ashishi.
28 Kwashia tete ni feɔ dioo lɛ, abuɔ lɛ nilelɔ; ni kɛji emua enaa lɛ abuɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ.

Title: ABƐI 18
Content:
1Mɔ ni tseɔ ehe kɛjeɔ mɛi ahe lɛ, lɛ pɛ enɔ mli efoɔ; ni jalɛ sane ko bɛ ni abaawie ni ebaaŋɔ nɔ.
2Kwashia naaa mɛi ashishinumɔ he miishɛɛ, fe akɛ eeewie nɔ ni etsui kɛɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
3Be ni efɔŋfeemɔ baa lɛ, heguɔgbee hu miiba.
4Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ nubu ni mli kwɔ ni; nilee hu tamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni tueɔ.
5 Ehiii akɛ akwɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hiɛ ni abu lɛ bem, aloo atsɔ̃ jalɔ sane hiɛ abu shi.
6Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ bei; ni ewiemɔ hãa ayiɔ lɛ.
7Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ kpãtãa ehiɛ, ni ewiemɔ nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tamɔ tsɔne.
8Ablɛbiwielɔ wiemɔ ŋɔɔ tamɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔnii; ekpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbɔmɔ musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
9Mɔ ni kɛ enitsumɔ shashaoɔ shi lɛ, nifitelɔ nyɛmi ni.
10 Mɔɔ ni wa ji Yehowa gbɛi lɛ, ni no mli jalɔ shaa foi kɛyaa, ni ehiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.
11Niiatsɛ nii ni eyɔɔ lɛ ji emɔɔ ni wa; ni etamɔ gbogbo grɔŋŋ ni buɔ ehe?
12 Henɔwomɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; shi heshibaa tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛnyam hiɛ.
13Bo sane toi jogbaŋŋ dani ohã hetoo, kɛjee nakai lɛ, obaafee kwashia kɛ buulu.
14 Gbɔmɔ mli ekãa hãa enyɛɔ hela naa edamɔɔ; shi mumɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ, mɛni no aaanyɛ etsu?
15Jwɛŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã shi naa nilee; ni nilelɔ toi tiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ.
16 Gbɔmɔ dɛŋ nikee jeɔ gbɛ hãa lɛ; ni ekɛ lɛ yaa mɛi wuji ahiɛ.
17Mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni jajeɔ esane lɛ, efeɔ tamɔ nɔ ni lɛ esane ja; shi kɛ mɔ ni ekɛna lɛ ba ni ebabɔi lɛ sanebimɔ lɛ, no dani akpaa lɛ shi.
18Oshikifɔ̃ɔ hãa bei sɛɛ foɔ, ni ebuɔ atɛŋ ehãa kãkãlɔi ni peleɔ nɔ ko he.
19Kɛ ofee onyɛmi ekpakpa lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ maŋ ni wa ehãa bo; shi kɛji okɛ lɛ be lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ agbo sɛɛ adabãŋ ehãa bo.
20 Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ yibii hãa lɛ; ni edaaŋ wiemɔ hãa etɔɔ.
21Gbele kɛ wala yɛ gbɔmɔ lilɛi dɛŋ; amɛteŋ nɔ ni gbɔmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ no eŋɔɔ.
22 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni naa ŋa lɛ, ena nɔ kpakpa, ni ehiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
23Ohiafo lɛ fai ekpaa kɛ naajɔlɛ; shi niiatsɛ lɛ ewieɔ kpɛŋkpɛŋ.
24Nanemɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛfeɔ amɛnii oookɛɛ nanemɛi ji amɛ; shi naanyo krɔŋŋ lɛ ekpɛtɛɔ mɔ gbãgbãlii fe nyɛmi tete.

Title: ABƐI 19
Content:
1Ohiafo anɔkwafo lɛ, ehi fe kwashia kutumpɔfo.
2Shwe ni ashweɔ nɔ ko ni nilee bɛ mli lɛ ehiii; ni mɔ ni nyiɛɔ kplakpla lɛ eduɔ gbɛ.
3 Gbɔmɔ buulufeemɔ kɛ lɛ woɔ haomɔ mli, ni eshwaa Yehowa moŋ.
4Ninamɔ hãa anaa nanemɛi pii; shi ohiafo lɛ enaanyo tete tsiɔ ehe yɛ ehe.
5 Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ he ejeŋ sane mli.
6Mɛi pii taoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛɔ mlijɔlɔ dɛŋ; ni mɔ ni dɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naanyo ni.
7Ohiafo nyɛmimɛi tete nyɛɔ lɛ; enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni enanemɛi tsiŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ? Enyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛ wiemɔ, shi amɛfooo mli.
8Mɔ ni sumɔɔ nilee lɛ, esumɔɔ ehe; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ eshwereɔ.
9Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ hiɛ aaakpãtã.
10Ninamɔ kpɔtɔɔ esaaa kwashia, aahu ni nyɔŋ aaaye lumɛi anɔ.
11Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ mlifũuu mra; ni ehiɛ ni ekuɔ efɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ nɔ lɛ woɔ ehiɛ nyam.
12 Maŋtsɛ mlifu tamɔ jata huumɔ; shi kɛ ena mɔ he tsui lɛ, etamɔ bɔ ni jwere jwɛi nɔ.
13Bi kwashia lɛ ekpãtãa etsɛ hiɛ; ni yoo beilɔ lɛ etamɔ tsu yiteŋ nu ni tsereɔ kɔikɔi eshwieɔ shi.
14Shĩa kɛ nii lɛ, fɔlɔi ni gboɔ shiɔ hãa mɔ; shi yoo nilelɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.
15 Anihaofeemɔ hãa wɔ ni tsii nyɔɔ mɔ nɔ; ni hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ.
16Mɔ ni yeɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni kwaa wiemɔ lɛ, eeegbo.
17Mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, ekɛ miifa Yehowa; ni ejurɔ ni efee lɛ, Yehowa aaato lɛ najiaŋ kɛteke nɔ.
18 Tsɔsemɔ obi egbekɛbiiashi be ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɔɔ lɛ; shi ekaba oyiŋ akɛ oookpãtã ehiɛ.
19Mɔ ni mlifu naa wa lɛ, enaa he nyɔmɔwoo; kɛji ojie lɛ kɛje haomɔ kome mli lɛ, ebaabote ekroko hu mli.
20Bo ŋaawoo toi, ni okpɛ̃lɛ tsɔsemɔ koni wɔsɛɛ lɛ, ole nii.
21 Yiŋtoi pii yɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔŋ; shi nɔ ni Yehowa eto lɛ, no baa mli obɔ̃.
22Anɔkwayeli ataoɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ; ni ohiafo hi fe amalelɔ.
23Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ enɛ lɛ etsui tɔɔ; efɔŋ ko baŋ enɔ.
24Anihaolɔ kɛ enine tĩɔ nii yɛ kã mli, ni emiii po ni ekɛ enine lɛ woɔ edaaŋ tete.
25Tswaa hefɛoyelɔ nɔ, ni mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ eeekase nɔ ko yɛŋ. Kã mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ hiɛ, ni eeele nii.
26Mɔ ni yiɔ etsɛ, ni ewoɔ enyɛ foi kɛjeɔ shĩa lɛ, bi ni woɔ mɔ hiɛgbele ni ebɔɔ mɔ ahora ni.
27Mibi, tsɔsemɔ ni hãa aduɔ gbɛ kɛjeɔ nilee he lɛ, kpa toiboo.
28Odasefonyo fɔŋ ŋmɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; ni efɔŋfeelɔ naabu nyaa nɔ fɔŋ he.
29Fɔbuu kã shi hã hefɛoyelɔi; ni kpãa hu kã shi hã kwashiai akotosɛɛ.

Title: ABƐI 20
Content:
1 Wain lɛ hefɛoyelɔ ni, ni dãa ni wa lɛ hoofeelɔ ni; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni dãa hãa eduɔ gbɛ lɛ, eleee nii.
2 Maŋtsɛ mlifu ni naawa lɛ etamɔ jata huumɔ; mɔ ni woɔ maŋtsɛ mlifu lɛ, ewala ŋmɛɔ lɛ.
3Eji hiɛ nyam kɛhã nuu kɛji enyaaa bei he; shi kwashia fɛɛ kwashia lɛ, bei ebeɔ.
4 Hejɔ̃lɔ ni huuu yɛ humɔ be mli lɛ, nikpamɔ be mli lɛ enaŋ nɔ ko ekpa.
5Adesa yiŋtoo mlikwɔ tamɔ nubu, shi nilelɔ jieɔ yiŋtoi lɛ kpo.
6Mɛi babaoo tsɛɔ amɛhe anɔkwafoi; shi anɔkwafo lɛ namɔ yoɔ lɛ?
7 Gbɔmɔ ni ji jalɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ajɔɔ eshwiei.
8Maŋtsɛ ni taa kojomɔ sɛi nɔ lɛ, enaa efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ.
9Namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ, mitsuu mitsui he, ni esha ko be mihe?”
10Nsɛnitɛi srɔtoi kɛ susumɔ nii srɔtoi lɛ Yehowa miihi fɛɛ.
11 Gbekɛbii tete hãa akɛ amɛnifeemɔnii yoɔ amɛ, nifeemɔnii lɛ he tse jio, eja jio.
12Toi ni nuɔ nii kɛ hiŋmɛi ni naa nii lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni fee enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
13Wɔ akaŋɔɔ onaa, kɛjeee nakai lɛ obaaye ohia. Gbelemɔ ohiŋmɛii, ni ooona nii oye otɔ.
14Nihelɔ kɛɔ akɛ nɔ ni eheɔ lɛ, “Ehiii, ehiii!” Shi kɛji eyi gbɛ pɛ, eeshwã akɛ ena lɛ ofoo.
15Shika kɛ ojarawatɛi babaoo yɛ; shi nilee wiemɔ lɛ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o ni.
16 Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ etade ato bo awaba; ni mɔ ni damɔɔ maŋsɛɛnyo sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ato awaba.
17Ŋmaa ni akɛ kutumpɔo na lɛ eŋɔɔ; shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ daaŋ yiɔ tɔ kɛ ŋmlitsa.
18Ŋaawoo akɛtoɔ yiŋ, ni nilee akɛwuɔ ta.
19Sanetãlɔ lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; no hewɔ lɛ, okɛ naa blɛblɛtsɛ akabɔ.
20Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, ewala sɛɛ foɔ tamɔ kane ni agbe yɛ duŋ kpii mli.
21Gboshinii ni ana lɛ gidigidi yɛ shishijee mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ baaa nɔ yɛ naagbee mli.
22 Kaakɛɛ akɛ, “Matɔ efɔŋ he owele.” Mɛɛ Yehowa, ni eeeye ebua bo.
23Nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ lɛ Yehowa miihi. Shishiumɔ nsɛnii ehiii.
24Gbɔmɔ nanefaamɔi lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ eyɔɔ; te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni eeele nɔ ni yɔɔ egbɛ nɔ hu?
25Eji tsɔne hã gbɔmɔ akɛ eeesha ehe ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni! Ni shiwoo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ kpaako dani ejwɛŋɔ he” ni naashiwoo sɛɛ dani ejwɛŋ he.
26 Maŋtsɛ nilelɔ shaa efɔŋfeelɔi amli, ni ekɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ kɛgbɛlɛɔ amɛ.
27 Gbɔmɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ, Yehowa kane ni; ni ekpaa gbɔmɔ mligbɛ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ.
28 Anɔkwayeli baa maŋtsɛ yi, ni jalɛ saneyeli hãa emaŋtsɛ sɛi maa shi shiŋŋ.
29 Oblahii anunyam ji amɛhewalɛ; shi hiimeji ahefɛo ji amɛyiteŋ waŋ lɛ.
30Yii pilamɔ fala lɛ etsumɔɔ esha; ni kpãa yii hu tsuɔ tsui mli fɛɛ.

Title: ABƐI 21
Content:
1 Maŋtsɛ tsui lɛ etamɔ faa ni hoɔ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ. Etsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ.
2 Gbɔmɔ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ja yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, tsui mli ekwɛɔ.
3 Jalɛ saneyeli kɛ kojomɔ kpakpa lɛ, esa Yehowa hiɛ fe afɔleshãa.
4 Henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo tsui lɛ, efɔŋfeelɔi akane ni, ni esha ni.
5 Hiɛshikãlɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛ shweremɔ baa; shi mɔ ni kɛ hejojomɔ feɔ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ ohia baa.
6Jwetri ni akɛ lakamɔ na lɛ, lamɔ ni hoɔ ni, ni gbele taomɔ ni.
7Efɔŋfeelɔi anifeemɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, no nɔŋŋ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛfee nɔ ni ja.
8Mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, egbɛ ejaaa; shi bemyelɔ lɛ, lɛ egbɛ ja.
9Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi tsu yiteŋ kpokplobiiaŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ aaahi shĩa komeŋ.
10Yiwalɔi nyaa efɔŋfeemɔ he, amɛnanemɛi po anii efeee amɛ mɔbɔ.
11 Kɛ agbala hefɛoyelɔ toi lɛ, mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako kaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ mli; ni kɛ atsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ nii lɛ, eleɔ nii.
12Nyɔŋmɔjalɔ lɛ, enaa nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ mɔ fɔŋ we; etsiɔ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ etswaa shi, ni ekpãtãa ehiɛ.
13Mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi ni ekanu ohiafo blɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eeebolɔ ni aboŋ lɛ toi.
14 Teemɔŋ nikeenii kpãtãa mlifu; ni nikeenii ni jɛ tsui mli hu kuɔ mlila ni naa wa naa.
15Kɛ aye jalɛ sane lɛ, jalɔi naa miishɛɛ; shi edɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔi.
16Mɔ ni kɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enaagbeehe ji gbohiiaje; eeeyahi gbohii agwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
17Mɔ ni daaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ni eyeɔ pɔkũu nii lɛ, ohĩa hiaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ wain lɛ, enaŋ nii.
18 Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, jalɔ kpɔ̃mɔnii ni; ni kutumpɔfo lɛ, mɔ ni eye emuu kpɔ̃mɔnii ni.
19Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi shiaŋa nɔ moŋ fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ yrɛdɛɛ aaahi shi.
20Abaa jwetri ni jara wa kɛ mu yi yɛ nilelɔ we; shi kwashia lɛ, kpãtãmɔ ekpãtãa hiɛ.
21Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ jalɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, enaa wala kɛ hiɛnyam.
22Nilelɔ kwɔɔ kãkãlɔi amaŋ he gbogbo, ni ekumɔɔ mɔɔ ni amɛhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.
23Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu kɛ elilɛi mli lɛ, ejieɔ ehe kɛjeɔ haomɔ mli.
24Mɔ ni woɔ ehe, ni etsɛɔ ehe, ni etsɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ “hefɛoyelɔ.”
25Anihaolɔ nitaomɔnii gbeɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eniji ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nitsumɔ.
26Daa gbi lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ hiɛ miikɔ̃ nii nɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ ehãa, ni ekãmãaa.
27Efɔŋfeelɔ afɔle lɛ, nihiinii ni; blɔblɔ ni ekɛba kɛ yiŋsha.
28 Amale odasefonyo hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi wiemɔ ni jɛɔ mɔ ni nu sane daaŋ lɛ, ehiɔ shi daa.
29Mɔ fɔŋ kwaa ehãhãa ehiɛ, shi jalɔ toɔ egbɛjianɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
30 Gbɔmɔ nilee loo eniiashishinumɔ, loo eŋaawoo ko bɛ ni kɛ Yehowa nɔ lɛ aaafu daa.
31 Asaa okpɔŋɔ atoɔ tawuu gbi; shi kunimyeli lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.

Title: ABƐI 22
Content:
1 Gbɛi kpakpa hi fe ninamɔ babaoo, ni hiɛnyam hi fe jwiɛtɛi loo shika.
2Niiatsɛ kɛ ohiafo lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ amɛ fɛɛ.
3 Hiɛtɛ̃lɔ naa osharã miiba ni eteɔ ehe; shi mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako kɛ lɛ yakpeɔ, ni ehiɛ kpãtãa.
4Heshibaa kɛ Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ he sɛɛnamɔ ji ninamɔ kɛ hiɛnyam kɛ wala.
5Ŋmeii kɛ tsɔnei yɛ kutumpɔfo gbɛ nɔ; mɔ ni leɔ ehenɔkwɛmɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛteŋ aaajekɛ.
6 Tsɔsemɔ gbekɛ bɔ ni eba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ ehã, ni edalɛ mli lɛ etsakeŋ.
7Niiatsɛ yeɔ ohiafo nɔ; ni mɔ ni yafaa nii tsɔ̃ɔ nyɔŋ ehãa mɔ ni fa lɛ nii lɛ.
8 Mɔ ni yeɔ toikɔdɔmɔ sane lɛ, enaa amanehulu, ni eyitsoŋwalɛ lɛ sɛɛ foɔ.
9 Mɔ ni mli jɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ eniyenii lɛ eko kumaa ohiafo.
10 Shwiemɔ hefɛoyelɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ blɔmɔ kɛ bei kɛ jɛmɔ sɛɛ aaafo.
11Mɔ ni tsui mli tse, ni ewiemɔ he tse lɛ, maŋtsɛ kɛ lɛ bɔɔ naanyo.
12Yehowa hiŋmɛii baa nilee yi; shi amalelɔi awiemɔi lɛ ebaaa yi.
13 Anihaolɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Jata yɛ agbo lɛ naa; kɛji mije kpo kɛtee blohuŋ lɛ magbo.”
14Yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ edaa tamɔ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ, mɔ ni Yehowa mli efu lɛ lɛ eeegbee mli.
15 Buulufeemɔ kpɛtɛ gbekɛ tsui he; shi tsɔsemɔ kpãa lɛ aaashwie buulufeemɔ lɛ kɛaaje ehe kɛya sɛɛ flooflo.
16Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo amim koni ekɛna nii, shi ekeɔ niiatsɛ nii lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ohia kɛ̃ hiaa lɛ.
Nilee wiemɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃
17Ba otoi shi koni obo nilelɔi awiemɔi toi; ni okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ akase nii kɛjɛ minilee lɛ mli. 18Ejaakɛ kɛji okɛto ojwɛŋmɔ mli, ni onyɛ okai yɛ owiemɔi amli lɛ, eyɛ fɛo pam. 19Miihã bo tuuŋtu ole enɛɛmɛi ŋmɛnɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ona hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Yehowa mli. 20Miŋma nilee wiemɔi kɛ ŋaawoi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ miha bo. 21Wiemɔi ni baatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale; koni okɛ anɔkwa hetoo ayahã mɛi ni tsu bo lɛ.
- 1 -
22Kaatswa ohiafo ojo yɛ ohiafo ni eji lɛ hewɔ; asaŋ kaagba nɔnalɔ naa yɛ saneyelihe; 23ejaakɛ Yehowa yeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ; ni mɛi ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ amɛ hu Yehowa aaahao amɛ.
- 2 -
24Okɛ mlifutsɛ akabɔ naanyo, ni okɛ mlilatsɛ akanyiɛ; 25koni okɔ amɛjeŋba lɛ ni oyadu tsɔne.
- 3 -
26Kaafee ohe mɛi ni woɔ shi, loo mɛi ni damɔɔ nyɔmɔtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ eko; 27kɛji obɛ nɔ ko ni okɛaawo nyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashɔ̃ osaa tete yɛ odɛ̃ŋ.
- 4 -
28 Kaatsi blema shikpɔŋ husu kadimɔ nɔ ni otsɛmɛi lɛ eto efɔ̃ shi lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ.
- 5 -
29Nuu ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, ni ele ŋaa jogbaŋŋ yɛ enitsumɔ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ tete eeedamɔ; edamɔŋ mɛi ni abuuu amɛ ahiɛ.

Title: ABƐI 23
Content:
- 6 -
1Kɛ ota shi, ni okɛ lumɔ ko baaye nii lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ mɔ hiɛ ni ota lɛ he jogbaŋŋ. 2Kɛ oji mɔ ni yeɔ ŋmaa lɛ, kaaye pii, tse nɔ. 3Kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miitsɛ̃ onaa, ejaakɛ niyenii ni lakaa mɔ ni.
- 7 -
4 Kaagbo deŋme yɛ ninamɔ he; Okɛ jwɛŋmɔ ato he. 5Ohiŋmɛi ni aaagba nɔ pɛ etee; ejaakɛ ekwɛ̃ɔ fiji oya, ni efilikiɔ tamɔ okropɔŋ kɛyaa ŋwɛi.
- 8 -
6Kaaye kpɛkpɛɛlɔ dɛŋ nii, ni kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miiba otsine. 7Ejaakɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni buɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he akɔntaa yɛ eyitsoŋ. Ekɛɔ bo akɛ, “Ye ni onu!” Shi jeee kɛ etsui mli fɛɛ.
8Atrɔmai abɔ ni oye lɛ oooshwe oshwie, ni owiemɔi dɔkɔbii lɛ aaafee yaka.
- 9 -
9Kaawie ni kwashia nu; ejaakɛ eeegbe onilee wiemɔi lɛ ahe guɔ.
- 10 -
10Kaatsi blema husu nɔ̃ okadi hu kɛtee sɛɛ, ni kaaŋɔ awusãi ashikpɔŋ yɛ amɛdɛ̃. 11Ejaakɛ amɛkpɔ̃lɔ lɛ hewalɔ ni; ni ekɛ bo baaye ehã amɛ.
- 11 -
12Okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ̃ tsɔsemɔ nɔ, ni obo nilee wiemɔi atoi.
- 12 -
13Kaatsi gbekɛ tsɔsemɔ naa, ejaakɛ kɛ oyi lɛ kɛ kpãa lɛ egboŋ. 14Bo lɛ okɛ kpãa ayi lɛ, ni ooohere eyiwala.
- 13 -
15Mibi, kɛji ooona jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, mi hu mitsui aaanyɔ mimli. 16Kɛji wiemɔi ni ja miije onaa lɛ, mi hu mimli aaafli mi.
- 14 -
17Kaahã ohiɛ miikɔ̃ eshafeelɔi anɔ; shi moŋ kã he oshe Yehowa gbeyei daa nɛɛ. 18Ejaakɛ eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ wɔsɛɛ ko yɛ, ni ohiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeŋ yaka.
- 15 -
19Mibi, bo lɛ, bo toi, koni ole nii, ni oba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ. 20Okɛ ohe akabɔ dãatɔlɔi loo ŋmaayelɔi ahe. 21 Ejaakɛ dãatɔlɔi kɛ ŋmaayelɔi lɛ amɛaaye ohia, ni wɔdɔiwɔlɔi aaabu mama shwɛishwɛi.
- 16 -
22Bo otsɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ toi, ni kaagbe onyɛ he guɔ kɛji egbɔ lɛ. 23Tse shika ohe anɔkwale kɛ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ, ni okahɔ̃ɔ eko eko. 24Jalɔ tsɛ aaanya babaoo, ni mɔ ni fɔɔ bi nilelɔ lɛ aaana ebi lɛ he miishɛɛ. 25Hã otsɛ kɛ onyɛ mii ashɛ amɛhe, ni hã onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ anya.
- 17 -
26Mibi ŋɔɔ otsui ohã mi, ni okɔ minane. 27Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ ni, ni mɔ kroko ŋa lɛ bu kplokotoo ni. 28Ewoɔ ka tamɔ ojotswalɔ, ni ehãa mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa ayi faa yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
- 18 -
29Namɔ naa nɔ? Namɔ yeɔ awerɛho? Namɔ naa bei? Namɔ naa sane? Namɔ naa pilamɔ yakatswaa?
