2Be ni Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Aram kɛ Efraim efee ekome lɛ, Ahaz kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ atsui fã, ni amɛkpokpo tamɔ kooŋ tsei ni ahum ebote amɛteŋ.
3Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yesaia akɛ, “Bo kɛ obi Shear-Yashub nyɛyaa. Nyɛ kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz baakpe yɛ yiteŋgbɛ kpaakpo lɛ naa, yɛ niiahefɔlɔi abɔɔ lɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 4Kɛɛmɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ ohe ni ahi, ni ofee dioo; kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui hu akafã yɛ grimɔ waa ni Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Siriabii kɛ Remalia bi Maŋtsɛ Peka egri lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ tsei kukuji ni miije lasu kɛkɛ. 5Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Siriabii lɛ kɛ Israel kɛ emaŋtsɛ, Remalia bi lɛ, etee oyinɔ ajina fɔŋ. Amɛkpãŋ akɛ 6amɛbaatua Yuda koni amɛwo ehe gbeyei ni amɛŋɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã amɛhe koni amɛto Tabeel binuu akɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
7“Shi mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, miikɛɛ akɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ baŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ, 8ejaakɛ Siria he waaa fe Damasko, ni Damasko he waaa fe Maŋtsɛ Rezin. Yɛ Israel gbɛfaŋ lɛ biɛ afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ mli lɛ abaabutu lɛ, ni efeŋ maŋ dɔŋŋ. 9Israel he waaa fe Samaria, emaŋ wulu lɛ, ni Samaria he waaa fe Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia binuu lɛ. Kɛji nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhiŋ shi akɛ maŋ.”
Imanuel he Okadi lɛ
10Yehowa saa ekɛ wiemɔ tsu yaha Maŋtsɛ Ahaz akɛ, 11“Bi Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadi. Ooonyɛ oyabi yɛ gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ, loo yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tete.”
12Shi Ahaz to he akɛ, “Mibiŋ ni ahã mi okadi ko, ni mikaŋ Yehowa mikwɛŋ.”
13Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia to he akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi koo, agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Maŋtsɛ David shwiei! Aso gbɔmɛi ni nyɛhao lɛ faaa hãaa nyɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhao miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu nɛɛ? 14 No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ okadi. Naa, Oblayoo foro ko baana musu, ni ebaafɔ binuu, ni eeewo lɛ gbɛi Imanuel 15Be ni binuu nɛɛ hiɛ aaafã ni eeele nɔ ni ji ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ lɛ, no mli lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɔ, ni aana fufɔ kɛ wo aye. 16Ejaakɛ be ni gbekɛ nɛɛ aaada ni ekwa nɔ fɔŋ ni ekɔ nɔ kpakpa lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei nɛɛ lɛ ashi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
17“Yehowa baahã bo kɛ omaŋbii lɛ kɛ David shwiei fɛɛ atsɔ̃ gbii kɛ joomɔ komɛi amli ni eko bako dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni Israel tse ehe yɛ Yuda he nɛɛ, eeekpala Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛbanina nyɛ.
18“Nakai be lɛ Yehowa baakpã blɛ kɛtsɛ Ijiptbii, ni amɛaabu kɛba tamɔ adɔdɔji kɛjɛ Nilo Faa lɛ jɛɛhe kɛ̃. Ni ebaatsɛ Asiriabii, ni amɛaake tamɔ wobii kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba. 19Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛaaba amɛbasɔmɔ jɔi voovoi kɛ tɛsai amli fɔji lɛ amli kɛ ŋmei tsei fɛɛ anɔ amɛbaatsĩ jwɛi fɛɛ jwɛi nɔ.
20“Nakai be lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaabɔ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ apaa kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ tamɔ asooyi, ni eeebashɛ nyɛyiteiaŋ tsɔi kɛ nyɛnaji ahe tsɔi kɛ nyɛtsɛŋi hu fɛɛ.
21“Nakai be lɛ mɔ ni aaalɛ tsina biyoo kome kɛ gwantɛŋi enyɔ lɛ, 22fufɔ ni eeena lɛ falɛ naa sɔŋŋ lɛ, eeena butru eye, ejaakɛ butru kɛ wo sɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaye.
23“Nakai be lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni sá lɛ waintsei akpe ŋmɔ yɔɔ, nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ aheɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai akpe lɛ, jɛi baatsa kɛ kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii sɔŋŋ shikpɔŋ. 24Mɛi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii aaaya ayagbɔbi yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii shikpɔŋ. 25Ni gɔji fɛɛ ni akɛ kɔi hu amɛnɔ sa lɛ, nyɛyaŋ amɛnɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaashe kpitikpiti kɛ ŋmei lɛ gbeyei. Jɛi baatsɔ̃ tsinai kɛ gwantɛŋi aniyelihe.”

Title: YESAIA 8
Content:
Akɛ Yesaia Binuu to okadi ahã maŋbii
1Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɔ tao kpeteŋkple koni akɛ niŋmaa okadii ni dara aŋma wiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ nɔ, ‘Haanii yaa oya! Ofɔ̃yelinii yaa mramra.’ ”
2Mina odasefoi anɔkwafoi enyɔ, ni ji Osɔfo Uria kɛ Zakaria, Yeberekia bi lɛ, ye mi odase.
3Mitee yoo, ni ji gbalɔyoo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ena musu, ni efɔ binuu. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ ‘Oya Haanii,’ ‘Ofɔ̃yeli mramra,’ 4 ejaakɛ dani gbekɛ lɛ aaale ‘Ataa loo Awo tsɛmɔ lɛ,’ aaaloo nii ni Damasko yɔɔ kɛ haanii ni Samaria yɔɔ hu kɛnyiɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ hiɛ kɛaatee.”
Asiria Maŋtsɛ miiba
5Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, 6“Maŋ nɛɛ kwa Shiloa Faa lɛ mli nu ni hoɔ blɛoo lɛ, ni amɛkpokpo yɛ Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, hiɛ. 7No hewɔ lɛ, naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ miiba koni amɛbatua amɛ. 8Amɛbaashwie amɛnɔ tamɔ faa wulu Eufrate. Emli nu babaoo lɛ aaasram nɔ boboobo, ni eeeha nujɔi fɛɛ anɔ, ni eeeje ŋa kɛaayabote Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaayi kɛyaashi eeeyata gbɔmɔ kuɛ, ni eeekple shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ fɛɛ, Ao Imanuel.”
9 Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛ tsuifãa! Nyɛ majimaji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe. 10Nyɛkpãŋa; shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka. Nyɛkɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ, shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ.
Yehowa bɔ Gbalɔ lɛ kɔkɔ
11Yehowa kɛ mi wie kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ni ebɔ mi kɔkɔ akɛ mikaba mijeŋ tamɔ maŋbii lɛ. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 12“Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni maŋbii nɛɛ tsɛɔ lɛ apam lɛ, nyɛkatsɛa lɛ apam; asaŋ nyɛkashea nɔ ni amɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛtsuii akafãa hu. 13 Shi moŋ nyɛbua Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, akɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni lɛ moŋ gbeyei nyɛshea, ni lɛ ehe ŋmiŋmi amɔa nyɛ, 14ni eeetsɔ̃ he krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã nyɛ; eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ tɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ehã Israel akutsei enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ yaa kɛ tsɔne hu ehã Yerusalɛmbii lɛ. 15 Mɛi babaoo aaatɛrɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ, ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. Aaadu amɛ yɛ tsɔne mli, ni aaamɔmɔ amɛ.”
Abɔ Sisatsɛmɔ he kɔkɔ
16Nyɛ mikaselɔi lɛ, nyɛbaa tsɔsemɔ wiemɔi lɛ ayi yɛ nyɛteŋ. 17 Miikwɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ etee Yakob we lɛ gbɛ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ enɔ.
18 Naa, mi kɛ bii ni Yehowa ehã mi lɛ, wɔji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni hiɔ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii hã Israel.
19 Kɛji mɔ ko aaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyabia okɔmfoi kɛ klamɔfoi ni wieɔ gugɔjiaŋ kɛ akroma gbee lɛ nii lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ aso esaaa akɛ maŋbii biɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ moŋ nii? Aso esa akɛ abiɔ gbohiinii ahaa hiɛkãalɔi moŋ?”
20Nyɛtoa he akɛ, “Nyɛmɔa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ kɛ ehe odaseyeli lɛ mli. Anɔkwa, nɔ ni nifeelɔi lɛ kɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, nɔ kpakpa ko ejɛŋ mli.”
Haomɔ be
21Amɛaakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ hejaramɔ kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa, ni amɛbaalomɔ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Amɛaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ amɛkwɛ ŋwɛi, 22 ni amɛaakwɛ shikpɔŋ hu. Shi naa, amɛnaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko fe hejaramɔ kɛ duŋ kabitii; ni aaatsi amɛ awo duŋ kabitii lɛ mli.

Title: YESAIA 9
Content:
1Shi kɛ̃lɛ duŋ kabitii lɛ woŋ mɔ ni aaahi jaramɔ mli lɛ he gbeyei.
Wɔsɛɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ
Sa lɛ eha Zebulon kɛ Naftali fɛɛ hiɛ shwie shi; shi agbɛnɛ eeewo ŋshɔnaa shikpɔŋ lɛ, Yordan sɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, jeŋmaji Galilea lɛ, hiɛ nyam.
2 Mɛi ni nyiɛ duŋ mli lɛ,
ena la kpeteŋkple ko;
mɛi ni hi duŋ kabitii shikpɔŋ
nɔ lɛ,
la ekpɛ ehã amɛ.
3Ohã maŋbii lɛ ayi efa,
Ohã amɛnyamɔ efa.
Amɛmiinya yɛ ohiɛ
tamɔ anyaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli,
loo tamɔ mɛi nyaa
kɛji amɛmiija haanii.
4 Ejaakɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni tsɔ̃ jatsu lɛ,
kɛ amɛkpalamɔ tso lɛ
kɛ amɛnɔyelɔ lɛ dɛŋ kpãa lɛ
okumɔ fɛɛ mli,
tamɔ ofee Midian ta lɛ.
5Ejaakɛ aspaatre fɛɛ aspaatre
ni tabilɔ kɛbaashimɔ shi
yɛ ta lɛ mli
kɛ atade fɛɛ atade ni lá
ewu mli lɛ,
akɛbaafee lai ni ashã.
6 Ejaakɛ afɔ bi ahã wɔ!
Afɔ binuu ahã wɔ.
Elumɔyeli kã ekɔŋ.
Abaatsɛ lɛ “Naakpɛɛ Ŋaawolɔ,”
“Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ, Naanɔtsɛ,
Hejɔlɛ Lumɔ.”
7 Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ shweremɔ
kɛ edɛŋ toiŋjɔlɛ lɛ,
esɛɛ efoŋ yɛ David
maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ,
kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli hei fɛɛ.
Ekɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ nɔ ni
ja feemɔ
baahã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ
ama shi kɛya naanɔ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hiɛdɔɔ baafee enɛ.
Yehowa baagbala Israel toi
8Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ wiemɔ emaje ekɛmiishi Israel, ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ, 9ni Efraimbii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Samaria fɛɛ aaana ale, amɛ mɛi ni amɛkɛ henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo jwɛŋmɔ kɛɔ akɛ, 10“Brikisi tsui lɛ ekumɔ, shi wɔ lɛ wɔkɛ tɛ ni ako baatswa tsui lɛ, ni atoo sikamore tsei lɛ ashwie shi, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔɔtɛo tsenedru tsei yɛ amɛnajiaŋ.”
11Yehowa aaatee henyɛlɔi ashi awo amɛ. 12Siriabii miijɛ bokãgbɛ, ni Filistibii hu miijɛ anaigbɛ amɛba kɛ amɛdaaŋ ni amɛgbɛ hatoo amɛkɛbami Israel. Kɛ̃lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ naa ejɔŋ; etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo. 13Israelbii lɛ kpaleee amɛbaaa mɔ ni gbala amɛtoi lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛtaooo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ. 14Hewɔ lɛ gbi kometoo nɔ lɛ Yehowa baafo Israel yitso kɛ elei fɛɛ; ebaafo blɛo kɛ glã fɛɛ gbi kome. 15Maŋ onukpa kɛ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɔ ji yitso lɛ, ni gbalɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji lei lɛ. 16Ejaakɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ehã maŋbii lɛ edu gbɛ, ni amɛ mɛi ni anyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã. 17No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ naŋ amɛblahii lɛ ahe miishɛɛ, ni emusuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛwusãi kɛ amɛkulafoi lɛ ahe. Ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, ebɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ, ni asaŋ efɔŋfeelɔ ni, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wieɔ kwashiai awiemɔ. Kɛ̃lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ; etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
18Maŋbii lɛ ayitsoŋwalɛ tsoɔ tamɔ la. Eshãa kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii fɛɛ; esɔoɔ koo hayii anaa la, ni elasu pukɔŋŋ lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi. 19Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu lɛ naa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ shã. Maŋbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ latso ni tsoɔ; mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaa enyɛmi. 20Amɛaashara nii amɛye yɛ ninejurɔgbɛ, shi hɔmɔ aaaye amɛ kɛ̃, ni amɛaaye nii yɛ amɛbɛkugbɛ hu, shi amɛtɔrɔŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye enaanyo loo. 21Manase aaate shi awo Efraim, ni Efraim hu aaatua Manase, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaate shi amɛwo Yuda. Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ, ni etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.

Title: YESAIA 10
Content:
1Kpoo ha mlawolɔi ni woɔ mlai ni ejaaa, kɛ mɛi ni ŋmalaa mlai ni akɛfeɔ mɛi niseniianii lɛ. 2Mlai nɛɛ hãa atsɔ̃ɔ ohiafo sane hiɛ abuɔ shi, ni akɛshɔɔ mimaŋbii ateŋ ohiafoi lɛ agbɛnaanii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni aha okulafoianii, ni ashɔ̃ awusãi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ. 3Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ yɛ nakai toigbalamɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni ahum baatswa kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ kɛba lɛ? Namɔ ŋɔɔ nyɛaajo foi kɛaaya nyɛyatao yelikɛbuamɔ; ni nɛgbɛ nyɛaashi nyɛnii ni nyɛna lɛ yɛ? 4Eshwɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ fe akɛ amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ yɛ gboklɛfoi ateŋ, aloo amɛ hu amɛnyɔnyɔi. Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ; ni etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ baatsu nii
5Ao! Asiria, mimlifu kpoti, mimlila tso! 6 Mifã lɛ miwo maŋ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ he. Mifã lɛ koni eyatua mɛi ni mimli efu amɛ lɛ, koni eyaha amɛ, koni eshɔ̃ amɛdɛŋ nii, koni enaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa blohuŋ ŋmiamɔ.
7Shi jeee nakai ji Asiria yiŋtoo, ni jeee nakai ejwɛŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ. Shi moŋ nɔ ni yɔɔ eyiŋ ji akɛ eyaakpãtã maji ahiɛ wɛɛ, ni jeee maji fioo ko hu, 8ejaakɛ nɔ ni ekɛɔ ji akɛ, “Ani mitatsɛmɛi lɛ jeee maŋtsɛmɛi sɔŋŋ ni? 9Ani Kalno tamɔɔɔ Karkemish, ni Hamat tamɔɔɔ Arpad, ni Samaria tamɔɔɔ Damasko hã mi? 10Bɔ ni miye shikpɔji ni jaa amãgãi ni tsiitsii fe Yerusalɛm kɛ Samaria amãgãi anɔ lɛ, 11enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni mifeŋ Yerusalɛm kɛ emli amãgãi lɛ tamɔ mifee Samaria kɛ emli amãgãi lɛ?” 12Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbe enitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, ebaagbala Asiria maŋtsɛ toi yɛ eshwãa kɛ ehewoo lɛ hewɔ.
13Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ kɛ minilee naa mitsu enɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã shi, Mitsirɛ majimaji ahusui kɛtee sɛɛ, ni mishɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ amɛmli jwetri; mitsirɛ mɛi ni tara maŋtsɛ sɛii anɔ mitswia shi tamɔ tsina feɔ. 14Minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii ni amɛna anɔ tamɔ aloɔ loofɔlɔ wɔji yɛ etsu mli be ni ebɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii anɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baatswa efijiaŋ aloo etswa esɛŋ ekɛɛ nɔ ko.”
15Shi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, “Ani lema baanyɛ eshwã ewo mɔ ni hiɛ emli lɛ lo? Aloo ani saalai baanyɛ ete shi ewo mɔ ni hiɛ lɛ lɛ? Ani tso nyɛɔ mɔ ni hiɛ lɛ lɛ moŋ nɔ ewoɔ? Aloo kplamɔ tso moŋ nyɛɔ mɔ ni ejeee tso nɔ ewoɔ.”
16No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, lootãa hela aye etabilɔi ni eshwishwii lɛ, ni aaawo enyam lɛ shishi la, ni eeetso tamɔ la. 17 Nyɔŋmɔ, Israel kane lɛ atsɔ̃ la, ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ la lilɛi, ni ebaatso, ni ebaashã ŋmeii kɛ kpitikpitii ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ fɛɛ gbi ko. 18Israel koo ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ, Yehowa baakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ kɛmɔ shi wɛɛ tamɔ gbele hela kpãtãa helatsɛ hiɛ lɛ. 19Kooŋ tsei ni aaashwɛ afalɛ shɛŋ nɔ ko bɔ sɔŋŋ ni gbekɛ tete aaanyɛ amɛyibɔ akane.
Mɛi fioo kɛ̃ aaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛba
20Be miiba, ni nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel kɛ Yakob shwiei ni ahe eje gbele mli lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ efɔŋ mɔ ni tswia amɛ nii lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ, nɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli. 21Mɛi fioo ni eshwɛ aaaba Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 22Eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛwebii, Israelbii, ayi fa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia moŋ, shi nyɛyi fioo ko pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba. Hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni ato miimɛ nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ jalɛ yɛ mli. 23 Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baakpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛmɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.
Yehowa baagbala Asiria toi
24Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Ao mimɛi ni yɔɔ Zion, nyɛkashea Asiriabii lɛ gbeyei kɛji amɛkɛ dadei kɛ amɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtsei tswia nyɛ tamɔ Ijiptbii lɛ fee nyɛ lɛ. 25Ejaakɛ eshwɛ be fioo, kɛkɛ lɛ mimli ni efu nyɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni mibatsɔ̃ mlifu lɛ mahã amɛ, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ. 26 Ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mibadɔ kpelebi mato amɛnɔ magwao amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Midianbii lɛ yɛ Oreb Tɛsaa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Mibawó tso nɛɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ tamɔ mifee yɛ Ijipt lɛ. 27Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibawo Asiria jatsu lɛ kɛje nyɛkɔŋ, ni abaakumɔ apã ni kã nyɛkuɛ lɛ.”
Henyɛlɔi lɛ ebatua
28Henyɛlɔ lɛ ejɛ Rimon ebashɛ Ai. Etsɔ̃ Migron kɛho, ni ekɛ Mikmash efee ejatsutoohe. 29Amɛtsɔ̃ gɔji ateŋ tsɔ̃mɔhe lɛ, ni amɛwɔ yɛ Geba. Rama miikpokpo, ni Maŋtsɛ Saul maŋ Gebea ejo foi. 30Ao Galimbii, nyɛbolɔa! Ao Laishabii, bo toi! Anatotbii, nyɛhãa amɛ hetoo. 31Madmenabii hiɛ foi, ni Gebim maŋ lɛ mli bii miijo foi kɛyatao abobaahe. 32Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ ebaato shi yɛ Nob, ni ebaawo atswɛrɛ nɔ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ Zion Gɔŋ, ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ.
33Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hewalɛ ko baafolɔ tsei aniji lɛ eshwie shi. Nii ni ekwɔlɔ gojogojoo lɛ, abaafolɔ amɛ ashwie shi; ni nii ni ehole amɛhe nɔ lɛ, abaafolɔ nɔ. 34Yehowa kɛ lema baagba koo hayii lɛ, ni Lebanon baagbee shi kɛ etsei wujiwuji lɛ fɛɛ.

Title: YESAIA 11
Content:
Toiŋjɔlɛ Maŋtsɛyeli
1 Tso fɔ aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ Ishai tso kuku lɛ mli, ni tso nine ko aaahere kɛaajɛ eshishi fã lɛ mli awo yibii.
2Ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ baahi enɔ,
ni ebaaduro lɛ nilee
kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ mumɔ
kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ hewalɛ mumɔ
kɛ Yehowa he nilee
kɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ mumɔ.
3Eeena Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ
he miishɛɛ.
Bɔ ni ehiŋmɛii naa lɛ,
jeee nakai ebaakojo;
bɔ ni etoi nuɔ lɛ,
jeee nakai ebaakojo.
4 Shi moŋ eeekojo ohiafoi lɛ
yɛ jalɛ naa;
ni eeebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ humii
lɛ atɛŋ yɛ jalɛ naa.
Ekɛ edaaŋ wiemɔ aaaplene
shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii,
ni ekɛ emumɔ lɛ aaagbe mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
5 Ni eeeye emaŋ
lɛ nɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ
anɔkwayeli.
6 Klaŋ kɛ gwantɛŋbi baahi shi,
ni kootsɛ kɛ abotiabi baabumɔ shi,
ni tsinabi kɛ jatabi baahi he kome,
ni gbekɛ bibioo baakpala amɛ.
7Tsinayoo kɛ oshishibrishi
baaye nii yɛ he kome,
ni amɛbii hu baabumɔ shi
yɛ he kome,
ni jata baakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina nɔŋŋ.
8Gbekɛ fufɔoo baashwɛ
yɛ shikpãa bu naa,
ni bi ni atse lɛ fufɔ
kɛ enine baawo onufu bu mli,
ni efeŋ lɛ nɔ ko.
9 Afeŋ efɔŋ, ni afiteŋ nii
yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Zion,
nɔ dɔŋŋ,
ejaakɛ Yehowa he nilee baayi
shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ
tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi obɔ kɛ nu lɛ.
Nomii baaku amɛsɛɛ amɛba
10 Be miiba be ni maŋtsɛ ni aaajɛ Ishai mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ aflaŋaa ni ashi ahã majimaji lɛ. Lɛ esɛɛgbɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaatao, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ hiɛ baaba nyam. 11Nakai be mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ baakpɔ̃ ewebii ni eshwɛ lolo lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, kɛjɛ Asiria kɛ Ijipt kɛ Patros kɛ Kush kɛ Elam kɛ Babilon kɛ Hamat, asaŋ kɛ ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ anɔ kɛaaba. 12Yehowa aaashi aflaŋaa etsɔ̃ɔ maji lɛ kɛto okadi akɛ eebua Israelbii ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie lɛ kɛ Yudabii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ kɛbakpe. 13 Ni Israel yeŋ Yuda he awuŋã dɔŋŋ, ni Yuda hu efeŋ Israel henyɛlɔ dɔŋŋ. 14Shi amɛbaafee ekome amɛyatua Filistibii yɛ anaigbɛ, ni amɛbaafee ekome amɛyaha bokãgbɛbii lɛ anibii. Amɛbaaye Edom kɛ Moab nɔ kunim, ni Amonbii baabo amɛtoi. 15 Yehowa baafite he ni Ijipt Faa lɛ kɛ enaa woɔ ŋshɔŋ yɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baahã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ atswa yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaŋala Faa lɛ niji kpawo lɛ, ni mɛi aaanyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo. 16 Ni eeetsɔ̃ tɛmpɔŋ ehã emaŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, mɛi ni eshwɛ ni aaajɛ Asiria aba lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni jɛi tsɔ̃ gbɛ ha Israel be ni amɛje Ijipt lɛ.

Title: YESAIA 12
Content:
Shidaa Lala
1Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ
obaala okɛɛ akɛ,
“Yehowa, miida bo shi,
ejaakɛ omlifu mi moŋ,
shi omlifu lɛ enaa ejɔ,
ni oshɛje mimii.
2 Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji miyiwalaherelɔ.
Mihiɛ baakã enɔ,
ni misheŋ gbeyei
ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mihewalɛ
kɛ milala,
ni lɛ nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
3 Nyɛkɛ nyamɔ aaayɛ nu
yɛ yiwalaheremɔ bui lɛ amli.’
4 Ni nakai gbi lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi,
nyɛtsɛa egbɛi lɛ.
Nyɛhãa majimaji lɛ
alea nibii ni efee;
nyɛhãa alea akɛ egbɛi tsii.
5Nyɛlaa kɛkafoa Yehowa,
ejaakɛ efee nibii wuji.
Nyɛhãa alea enɛ yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ.
6Ao, nyɛ Zion maŋbii,
nyɛbolɔa, ni nyɛnyaa,
ejaakɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome
ni da lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.”

Title: YESAIA 13
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Babilon toi
1 Babilon toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Amoz bi Yesaia nɔ nɛ.
2Nyɛshĩa aflaŋaa yɛ gɔŋ kɛ eyiteŋ kpataa nɔ, nyɛbolɔa nyɛtsɛa amɛ, nyɛfɔa amɛ nine, koni amɛbabote lumɛi agboi amli. 3Mi diɛŋtsɛ mifã mimɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni ji mitabilɔi kakabãi lɛ, koni amɛkɛ mɛi ni nyaa kɛ hewoo lɛ aye yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa.
4Nyɛboa toi! Aafee hoo yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ mɛi babaoo ahoofeemɔ. Naa jeŋ majimaji ni jɛ maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji anɔ ahoofeemɔ ni; Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, miibua tabilɔi asafo naa kɛha tawuu. 5Amɛjɛ shikpɔji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ anɔ; Yehowa miiba kɛ mlifu kɛ tawuunii koni ebakpãtã je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
6 Nyɛwɔa lele ejaakɛ gbi ni Yehowa to lɛ eshɛ shi etã. Akɛni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ jɛ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, ebaaba mli kɛ̃. 7No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ niji baagboi yɛ ehe, gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ atsuii baafã, 8ni amɛbaajijaa; ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛbaababla shi tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ; amɛaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛhiŋmɛii aaatsu tamɔ lá. 9Naa, gbi ni Yehowa eto lɛ miiba. Gbi lɛ baafee yiwalɛ gbi ni jɛ mlila kɛ mlifu ni naa wa mli. Ebaaha je lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aaakpãtã emli eshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛje je lɛ mli. 10 Ejaakɛ gbi lɛ ŋulamii krokomɛi lɛ kɛ oŋwɛ̃i fɛɛ kpɛŋ, ni hulushitee mli tɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ.
11Mibagbala je lɛ toi yɛ emli nifɔɔjianii hewɔ, ni mibagbala mɛi fɔ̃ji atoi yɛ amɛnɔshai lɛ ahewɔ. Mibaha hewolɔi ahetsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo, ni mibaba yiwalɔi ahenɔwomɔ lɛ shi. 12 Mibahã gbɔmɔ adesa he asɛ̃ fe shika ŋmiiŋmi; adesa he baasɛ̃ fe Ofir shika ŋmiiŋmi. 13No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu ni naa wa lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, yɛ emlila naa lɛ, ebaahã ŋwɛi he akpokpo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaakpokpo kɛjɛ egbɛhe.
14“Gbɔmɔ adesa baatsɔ tamɔ soŋai ni afã lɛ, loo tamɔ too gwantɛŋi ni mɔ ko bɛ ni buaa amɛnaa. Ni no hewɔ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛmaŋbii aŋɔɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawo foi kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ. 15Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana lɛ lɛ, aaatsu lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaamɔ lɛ lɛ, eeenyɔ yɛ klante naa. 16 Amɛmiikwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaaŋɔ amɛbii atswia shi yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛshĩa lɛ, aaahahaa amɛmli nii, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ abaato amɛ kabonaa.”
17Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miitee Midiabii ashi mawo Babilon. Amɛ lɛ amɛbuuu jwiɛtɛi, ni shika ekɔ̃ɔ amɛhiɛ. 18Amɛgãii baagbe oblahii lɛ, amɛmusuŋ etsɔŋ amɛ yɛ bii ni yɔɔ musuŋ tete he, ni amɛnaŋ gbekɛbii mɔbɔ. 19 Babilon, maŋtsɛyelii amli oje lɛ ni ji Babilonbii anunyam kɛ shwãanii lɛ, baatsɔ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora be ni Nyɔŋmɔ butu amɛ lɛ. 20Mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ, asaŋ akɛ jɛi efeŋ shihilɛhe yɛ yinɔ ko yinɔ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ. Arabnyo ko eshiŋ ebuu yɛ jɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔ ko kɛ etoi eyaŋ niyeli yɛ jɛi. 21 Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋ kooloi ashibumɔhe, ni tsui ni yɔɔ jɛi aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ patui. Dugumai kɛ jɛi aaafee amɛshihilɛhe, ni sasabonsami aaajo kɛnyiɛ jɛi. 22Klãji aaabolɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛmɛi ashĩai fɛɛfɛji lɛ amli. Babilon be lɛ eshɛ etã; atsiŋ ebe lɛ kɛyaŋ sɛɛ ahaŋ lɛ.”

Title: YESAIA 14
Content:
Sɛɛkuu kɛjɛ Nomŋɔɔ mli
1 Yehowa musuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ Yakob he, ni eeena Israel he tsuijurɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛ Israelbii lɛ aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ. Maŋsɛɛbii aaabafata amɛhe, ni amɛaadɔmɔ Yakob we lɛ. 2Maŋsɛɛbii aaawa Israelbii lɛ kɛaayashɛ Israelbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ hii nyɔji kɛ yei nyɔji aha Israelbii lɛ. Israelbii lɛ aaaŋɔ mɛi ni ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ nom, ni amɛaaye mɛi ni fee amɛ niseniianii lɛ anɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi.
Babilon Maŋtsɛ yɛ gbohiiaje
3Kɛji Yehowa ha nyɛ hejɔlɛ kɛjɛ piŋmɔ kɛ tɔlɛ kɛ nyɔŋ keketee ni aye nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ, 4nyɛkɛ wiemɔi aaabɔ Babilon maŋtsɛ ahora akɛ,
“Te aye tɛŋŋ ni mlifu ni shimɔɔ shi lɛ sɛɛ efo nɛɛ? Te aye tɛŋŋ ni haolɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ nɛɛ? 5Yehowa efo yiwalɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni Yehowa ekumɔ nɔyelɔi adɛŋ tsi lɛ mli, 6mɔ ni kɛ mlila tswia majimaji lɛ nii babaoo ni etooo enine shi lɛ, yɛ maji ni eye amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 7Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ena hejɔlɛ, ni enɔ ejɔ; ni amɛmiila nyamɔ lalai. 8Sɛsɛoi lɛ miiye bo yɔɔ, ni Lebanon tsenedru lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛjɛ ni aba bo shi nɛɛ lɛ, tsotoolɔ ko bɛŋkɛko wɔ.’
9“Gbohiiaje ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi esaa ehe eeba ebakpee bo. Ekanya mɛi fɛɛ ni ye onukpa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ ohewɔ; ni mɛi ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ maji amli miihole amɛhe nɔ kɛmiijɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ. 10Amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛbaabi bo akɛ, ‘Bo hu ogbɔjɔ nɛkɛ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ? Otsɔ̃ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ, pɛpɛɛpɛ?’ 11 Aba ogbojee shi kɛba gbohiiaje, bo kɛ osaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu. Omlɛgɛ ji saa ni obaakã nɔ, ni gɔgɔmii ji mama ni obaaha.
12 “Bo Tooloo, Jetsɛremɔ okadi, te aye tɛŋŋ ni ojɛ ŋwɛi obaagbee shi nɛɛ? Te aye tɛŋŋ ni, bo ni oba majimaji ashi lɛ, akɛ bo etswa shi nɛɛ? 13Shi bo lɛ okɛɛ ohe akɛ, ‘Mibakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi kɛho Nyɔŋmɔ ŋulamii lɛ ahe. Mawo mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ni mata nɔ yɛ kpee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ. 14Makwɔ kɛteke atatui lɛ, ni mibafee mihe tamɔ Ŋwɛi Grɔŋŋnyo lɛ.’ 15 Shi moŋ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee gbohiiaje, kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
16“Mɛi ni aaana bo lɛ, aaakwɛ bo gãa, ni amɛaabi amɛhe akɛ, ‘Kwɛɛ nuu lɛ ni hã shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ni ehã maŋtsɛyelii ahe kpokpo lɛ, 17mɔ ni kpãtã maji ahiɛ, ni ehã je lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ shiaŋa kpataa, ni eŋmɛɛɛ enomii ahe koni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ?’ 18Jeŋ maji lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kamɔ shi kɛ anunyam, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ egbonyobu mli. 19 Shi bo lɛ ashɛ bo afɔ̃ kɛjɛ ogbonyobu lɛ mli tamɔ bi ni ashrake lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, aaanyaŋe lɛ. Nɔ ni ona okɛha ohe ji mɛi ni akɛ klante egbe amɛ lɛ agbohii, ni amɛkpeleke shi kɛtee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ gbohii ni anaanaa amɛnɔ lɛ. 20Akɛ bo fataŋ amɛhe afuŋ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ okpãtã oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni ogbe omaŋbii lɛ. Atsiŋ efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei atã dɔŋŋ gbi ko gbi ko. 21Nyɛsaa gbɛhe nyɛtoa maŋtsɛ nɛɛ bii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi anɔsha lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkate shi amɛmiiŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛmiifee amɛnɔ, ni amɛmiimamɔ maji amɛmiiwo je lɛ mli obɔ̃.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Babilon hiɛ
22Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibate shi mawo Babilonbii, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ, egbɛi kɛ enii ni eyɔɔ kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ. 23Mibahã jɛi atsɔ̃ shadeboai ashihilɛhe kɛ kpaakpoi ashikpɔŋ. Mikɛ bolɔ baabɛɛ lɛ mashwie.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Asiriabii ahiɛ
24Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ bɔ ni misusu lɛ, nakai ebaaba mli; ni bɔ ni mito miyiŋ lɛ, ja ena eba mli nakai. 25No ji akɛ mibakpãtã Asiriabii ni yɔɔ mishikpɔŋ, Israel, nɔ lɛ ahiɛ. Mibanaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ migɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛbaawó Asiriabii apã ni kã Israelbii anɔ lɛ kɛje amɛkuɛ.” 26Enɛ ji yiŋ ni ato yɛ je lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ, ni ji minine ni akpã mli kɛtee maji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ nɛ. 27 Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto eyiŋ, ni namɔ baaku naa? Ekpã enine mli, ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa aku?
Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Filistibii ahiɛ
28 Afi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz gbo lɛ, ajie ninaa nɛɛ ahã. 29Ao Filistia, kaanya, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkanyaa akɛ tso ni yi nyɛ lɛ eku; ejaakɛ blikã baajɛ klɛŋklɛŋ onufu lɛ mli eba, ni lɛ ebi lɛ aaafee onufu filikilɔ. 30Ohiafoi amli ohiafo lɛ aaana nii eye, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ehia lɛ aaakamɔ shi yɛ hejɔlɛŋ shweshweeshwe; shi mikɛ hɔmɔ baagbe nyɛ, ni nyɛmɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ mibagbe amɛ.
31 Nyɛ Filistia maji fɛɛ, nyɛwoa yara; nyɛbolɔa, nyɛfoa, nyɛtsui afãa, ejaakɛ lasu ko efã kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ; ni tabilɔi ni baa lɛ, yakagbɔmɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ.
32Mɛɛ hetoo aaahã Filistia bɔfoi lɛ? Aaakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa eto Zion shishi akɛ maŋ, ni jɛi ewebii shitswialɔi lɛ aaababa abo yɛ.”

Title: YESAIA 15
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ
1 Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ nɛ: Akɛni akpãtã Ar maŋ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ, Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ. Ni Kir maŋ lɛ hiɛ ni akpãtã nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ. 2 Dibonbii lɛ ekwɔ kɛtee amɛwɔŋjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyafo. Moabbii ewɔ lele yɛ Nebo kɛ Medeba maji lɛ ahewɔ. Amɛshɛ yi fɛɛ yi kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ tsɛŋ. 3Amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛnyiɛ blohuiaŋ, ni amɛwo lele kɛ yaafo tsoo yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ kɛ jaji anɔ. 4Heshbon kɛ Eleale majiaŋbii lɛ miibolɔ, ni aanu amɛgbee yɛ Yahaz tɔ̃ɔ. Moab tabilɔi lɛ miibolɔ waa; amɛyoyro. 5Mitsui miiye miihã Moab. Emli foijelɔi eshɛ Zoar kɛ Eglat Shelishiya; mɛi kɛ yaafo miikwɔ kɛmiiya Luhit, ni mɛi hu ewo maŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he yara yɛ Horonaim gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ. 6Nimrim Faa lɛ egbi; jɛi jwɛi eŋala, ni jwɛfɔ bɛ he ko he ko, ni baa ŋmɔŋ hu bɛ he ko he ko. 7No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtereteree nii babaoo ni amɛyɔɔ kɛ nii ni amɛtĩa fɛɛ kɛmiifo faa naa kpãi ajɔɔ lɛ kɛya. 8Ejaakɛ Moab husui anaa fɛɛ lɛ yaafo sɔŋŋ. Yaafo lɛ shɛ Eglaim kɛ Beer-Elim tɔ̃ɔ, 9ejaakɛ Dibon Faa lɛ eyi kɛ lá. Shi mibahã Dibon ana amanehulu ni naa wa fe nakai. Mɛi ni na foijee hegbɛ kɛje Moab lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibafã jata mawo amɛhe.

Title: YESAIA 16
Content:
Moab sane lɛ yɛ mɔbɔ
1 Amɛkɛ toobii emaje kɛjɛ Sela maŋ lɛ mli, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, koni akɛyahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 2Moabbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ loofɔji ni miitsomlo kɛmiiya kɛmiiba, amɛtamɔ loofɔji abii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ faafoohe lɛ.
3Amɛmiikɛɛ Yudabii akɛ, “Nyɛwoa wɔ ŋaa, ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane nyɛhãa wɔ. Nyɛfea tamɔ shwane fintiŋŋ hɔ̃ɔŋ nyɛhãa wɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ lɛ atea, ni nyɛkatsɔa foijelɔi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ. 4Nyɛhãa Moabbii ni ashwie amɛ lɛ abato nyɛ gbɔ; nyɛfea nyɛhe teemɔhe nyɛhãa amɛ yɛ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ dɛŋ. Kɛji mɔ ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo, ni mɔ ni naanaa mɛi anɔ lɛ elaaje yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 5abaajɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee mli afo maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i ko ama shi. Mɔ ko baajɛ David shwiei ateŋ eta sɛ̃i nɛɛ nɔ, ni ebaaye maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli; ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔ mli, ni ebaakwɛ akɛ aaye jalɛ sane.”
6Yudabii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnu bɔ ni Moab wo ehe ehã; ewo ehe tsɔ̃. Wɔnu ehetsɔɔmɔ kɛ ehewoo kɛ ehetsɛmɔ. Shwãa ni eshwã lɛ fɛɛ asomoaŋ efolo ni.”
7Belɛ nyɛhãa Moab awoa yara; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo yara ahã Moab. Aye ŋkɔmɔ waa yɛ Kir-Heres wainyibii ni abɔlɔ lɛ hewɔ. 8Ejaakɛ Heshbon ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã, ni Sibma waintsei lɛ hu ahiɛ ekpãtã. Waintso ni eyibii hã majimaji alumɔ tɔrɔ dãa lɛ niji eyashɛ Yazer tɔ̃ɔ, ni egba bokãgbɛ kɛtee shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni etee anaigbɛ kɛyashɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ. 9 No hewɔ lɛ, mifo miha Sibma waintsei lɛ taakɛ mifo miha Yazer wainyibii lɛ. Ao Heshbon kɛ Eleale, mikɛ yaafonu baaju nyɛhe, ejaakɛ miishɛɛ ni okɛkpaa wainyibii kɛ oŋmãa lɛ sɛɛ efo. 10Nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ etã yɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli, ni alaaa yɛ waintromi lɛ amli lɛ, abɔɔɔ oshe yɛ jɛi; wainŋalɔ ko eŋaaa wain lɛ, lala emu shi kɔ̃i yɛ jɛi. 11No hewɔ lɛ, misusuma miifo emli tamɔ kpãa saŋku yɛ Moab hewɔ, ni mitsui mli miishã mi miihã Kir-Heres. 12Kɛji Moabbii gba amɛhe naa kɛtee amɛwɔjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyasɔle yɛ amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, nɔ ko jɛŋ mli baŋ. 13Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Moab he nyɛsɛɛ ko nɛ. 14Shi amrɔ nɛɛ Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, “Biɛ afii etɛ̃ mli lɛ, tamɔ afii ni apaafonyo yeɔ yɛ apaayelihe lɛ, Moab anunyam lɛ he guɔ baagbo, tsɛbelɛ amɛyi fa babaoo, ni emɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayifalɛ shɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni amɛnaŋ hewalɛ ko.”

Title: YESAIA 17
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Siria kɛ Israel toi
1Damasko he gbalɛ nɛ, “Naa, abuŋ Damasko ashiŋ maji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ, shi ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. 2Abaashi Siria maji lɛ ashwie shi kɛya naanɔ. Toi kɛ tsinai kɛ jɛi baafee amɛniyelihe, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei. 3 Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko ni wa eshwɛŋ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Damasko yeŋ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ; ni mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ Siria lɛ ahiɛ aaashwie shi tamɔ Israel. Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.”
4Yehowa kɛɛ, “Gbi miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ Israel anunyam lɛ nɔ baagbɔ, ni eninamɔ ni ehã eshwi lɛ baatsɔ̃ ohia, ni ebaatã loo. 5Israel baatsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmɔ ni ŋmãakulɔ efolɔ emli abeletsei lɛ eshwie shi, ni eku amɛyi abele lɛ; ebaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli ŋmɔ ni aye emli ŋmãa kpɛkpɛo butuu. 6Shi kɛ̃lɛ eeeshwɛ mɛi fioo yɛ Israel tamɔ bɔ ni kɛji ahoso mutso ni eshwɛɔ yibii enyɔ loo etɛ̃ kɛ̃ yɛ tso lɛ yiteŋ fɔfɔoo lɛ; loo bɔ ni eshwɛɔ yibii ejwɛ loo enumɔ oo ko yɛ aduawa tso ni ewo babaoo nɔ lɛ. Mi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ.”
7Nakai gbi lɛ mɛi ahiɛ baasɔ amɛ-Bɔlɔ lɛ; ni amɛbaakwɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ gbɛ. 8Amɛbuŋ afɔleshãa latɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛniji fee lɛ amɛhaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko. Amɛkɛ nii ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛniji fee tamɔ Asherim wɔŋkoi lɛ loo tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi lɛ efeŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
9Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛmaji ni he wa lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ maji ni Hivbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ jo foi shi ni amɛtsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i be ni amɛjoɔ Israelbii lɛ anaa foi lɛ, ni nibii ahiɛ baakpãtã lɛ.
10 Israel, ohiɛ ekpa oyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okaiii obobaa Tɛsaa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ mli akɛ oootɛo tsei fɛɛfɛji, ni ooofee wɔŋkoo oha maŋsɛɛ wɔŋ, 11ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ ahere gbi nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ, ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ agba afofro gbi leebi lɛ nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ nɔ, shi nikpamɔ lɛ baaje odɛ̃ŋ, ni gbi lɛ aaatsɔ ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ hejaramɔ ni naa wa gbi.
Aye Henyɛlɔi amaji anɔ
12Ao! Mɛi babaoo ahoofeemɔ nɛ; amɛhoofeemɔ lɛ miigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ! Ao! Maji ahoofeemɔ nɛ; amɛmiigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔkei wuji agbɛɛmɔ. 13Maji lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ tamɔ ŋshɔi agbɛɛmɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋa amɛyi, ni amɛaajo foi kɛaatee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni aaawo amɛ foi tamɔ gɔŋ nɔ tutuu yɛ lasuogbele mli. 14Ni gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ aaahã ŋmiŋmi amɔmɔ mɛi, shi be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ anaŋ amɛ yɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ! Mɛi fɛɛ ni tswaa wɔ ojo kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni haa wɔ nii lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni amɛnaagbee aaatamɔ ahã.

Title: YESAIA 18
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Kush toi
1Ao! Shikpɔŋ ko yɛ Kush fai lɛ asɛɛ ni anuɔ fijiaŋtswaa yɛ nɔ, 2ni etsuɔ ebɔfoi ni taraa ada lɛji amli kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nilo faa lɛ hiɛ. Nyɛ bɔfoi ni nyɛhe yɔɔ oya, nyɛyaa maŋ ko ni emli bii kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro lɛ aŋɔɔ. Asheɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gbeyei yɛ kpaakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ ji amɛ. Fai ejara amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
3Nyɛ jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji ashi aflaŋaa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa, ni kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ nyɛboa toi. 4Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Majɛ mishihilɛhe lɛ makwɛ kpoo tamɔ hulutsoo mli dɔlɛ, loo tamɔ atatu mli bɔ yɛ nikpamɔ be mli. 5Dani aaashɛ nikpamɔ be lɛ, be ni afofro lɛ ekpala, ni wainyibii bibii lɛ epue lɛ, ekɛ klante aaafolɔ niji lɛ ni etsɛ̃rɛ lɛ kɛ niji ni egbalagbalai lɛ eshwie. 6Abaashi gbohii lɛ ashwie shi ahã gɔji lɛ anɔ loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi; ni loofɔji lɛ baaye amɛ hulutsoobe mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ baaye amɛ yɛ fɛibe mli.”
7 Nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro ni asheɔ amɛ gbeyei yɛ kpaakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ, ni fai ejara amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli baatere nikeenii kɛbaha Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni ajaa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ.

Title: YESAIA 19
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Ijipt toi
1 Ijipt toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ nɛ.
Naa, Yehowa ta atatu ni hiɛ foi nɔ kɛmiiba Ijipt. Ijipt amãgãi lɛ atsui efã yɛ ehiɛ. 2Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mahã Ijiptbii ate shi awo Ijiptbii nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛhe baawu: mɔ kɛ enyɛmi, mɔ kɛ enaanyo, maŋ kɛ maŋ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli kɛ maŋtsɛyeli. 3Mahã Ijiptbii awerɛ aho amɛhe fe nine, ni amɛyiŋtoi fɛɛ baafee yaka. Amɛbaaya amãgãi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ sisai aŋɔɔ amɛyabi nii. 4Mibaŋɔ Ijiptbii mawo nɔyelɔ yitsoŋwalɔ ko dɛŋ, ni maŋtsɛ ko ni esane wa baaye amɛnɔ. Mi Yehowa, ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ.”
5Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu baaŋala, ni faa lɛ baagbi; 6nujɔi ni agbala awo faa lɛ he lɛ amli nu baasha; ni Ijipt Nilo Faa lɛ niji lɛ amli nu baakpɔŋ ni ebaagbi, ni neŋ kɛ glãi lɛ hu baakpɔtɔ. 7Nilo Faa lɛ toi hei komɛi baakamɔ shi efoji, ejaakɛ ŋmɔshi nii ni adu yɛ Nilo Faa lɛ toitoi lɛ baaŋala, ni kɔɔyɔɔ baatswa amɛ kɛya. 8Mɛi ni ji wolɛi ni hɛɔ baaye ŋkɔmɔ; mɛi fɛɛ ni shaa loo yɛ Nilo Faa lɛ mli lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ŋmɛɔ yaa yɛ faa lɛ mli anine baanyɛ shi. 9Mɛi ni kpooɔ ananaŋse anijiaŋ baaje wui, ni mɛi fɛɛ hu ni loɔ klala aaaye jaramɔ. 10Mamalolɔi kɛ ninenaa nitsulɔi fɛɛ atsui baaye.
11Zoan maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kwashiai sɔŋŋ ni. Farao ŋaawolɔi ni le nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ etsɔ buuluiaŋaawoo. Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ Farao akɛ, “Nilelɔi abii ji wɔ, ni blema maŋtsɛmɛi ashwiei ji wɔ lɛ?” 12Agbɛnɛ Ijipt, nɛgbɛ onilelɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Hã amɛgba koni amɛhã ole nɔ yiŋtoo ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto yɛ ohe. 13Zoan lumɛi lɛ etsɔmɔ kwashiai, ni Memfis lumɛi hu alaka amɛ. Mɛi ni ji Ijipt akutsei lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ehã Ijipt edu gbɛ. 14 Yehowa ehã awo Ijipt ŋaa gbonyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Ijipt yiŋ feɔ lɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni edidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ didãa kɛji eeshwe. 15Belɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ awa Ijipt. Maŋ lɛ mli niiatsɛ jio, ohiafo jio, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi jio, mɛi ni bɛ gbɛi jio amɛnyɛŋ lɛ amɛwa.
Ijipt baaja Yehowa
16Be miiba ni Ijiptbii baatsɔmɔ tamɔ yei. Amɛhe baakpokpo kɛ gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, nine nɔ ni ebaawo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ. 17Yudabii ahe baaba gbeyei ahã Ijiptbii. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aatsĩ Yuda gbɛi tã yɛ etoiŋ lɛ, eeeshe gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yiŋ ni eto yɛ Ijiptbii ahe lɛ hewɔ.
18 Nakai be lɛ abaawie Hebribii awiemɔ lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji enumɔ amli; ni amɛaakã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kitã. Abaatsɛ nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ ekome akɛ, “Hulu Maŋ.”
19Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, abaama afɔleshãa latɛ ahã Yehowa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu, ni abaatswa akulashiŋ amã shikpɔŋ lɛ husu nɔ ahã Yehowa. 20Akulashiŋ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ okadi kɛ odaseyeli nɔ ahã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ mɛi ni waa amɛ yi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeetsu yiwalaherelɔ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ, ni eeebafã amɛhe, ni eeehere amɛyiwala. 21Yehowa aaajie ehe shi etsɔ̃ɔ Ijiptbii, ni Ijiptbii aaana ale Yehowa nakai be lɛ, ni amɛkɛ afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle aaabasɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛaawo Yehowa shi, ni amɛaye nɔ. 22Yehowa aaagbala Ijiptbii atoi, eeetswia amɛ nii, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ eeetsa amɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaakpale kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eeebo amɛfaikpamɔ toi, ni eeetsa amɛ.
23Kɛji eshɛ nakai be lɛ, gbɛjegbɛ aaakã shi kɛaajɛ Ijipt kɛya Asiria; ni Asirianyo aaaba Ijipt, ni Ijiptnyo hu aaaya Asiria, ni Ijiptbii kɛ Asiriabii aaaja Yehowa yɛ he kome. 24Nakai be lɛ Israel kɛ Ijipt kɛ Asiria aaatsɔ̃mɔ tipɛŋfoi; ni maji etɛ̃ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ahã je lɛ mli maji fɛɛ. 25Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaajɔɔ amɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ Ijipt, ni ji mimaŋ lɛ, kɛ Asiria, ni ji mininenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ, kɛ Israel, mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ ni mihala lɛ.”

Title: YESAIA 20
Content:
Gbalɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ okadi lɛ
1 Afi nɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sargon tsu etatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ebatua Filistibii amaŋ Ashdod, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ, 2 Yehowa etsɔ̃ hiɛ afii etɛ̃ momo ekɛɛ Amoz bi Yesaia akɛ, “Yaa koni oyajie kpekpe lɛ yɛ ohɛ, ni ojie otokotai lɛ hu.” Yesaia fee nakai, ni enyiɛ yayai kɛ enane folo hu. 3Be ni aŋɔ Ashdod sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni mitsulɔ Yesaia nyiɛ yayai kɛ enane folo afii etɛ̃ ekɛto Ijipt kɛ Kush naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ, 4nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ aaakpala Ijipt kɛ Kush akɛ nomii kɛaatee. Abaakpala gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe yayai kɛ amɛdukui ahe ni kã kɛ amɛnane folo hu; ni Ijipt hiɛ aaashwie shi. 5Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaahao ni amɛnaa aaakpɛ amɛhe yɛ Kush ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ enɔ lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ Ijipt hu ni amɛshwã amɛfɔ enɔ lɛ hewɔ. 6Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nɛkɛ ŋshɔ nɛɛ naa bii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa nɔ ni eba mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kã amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ, mɛi ni wɔjo foi kɛtee wɔyaba abo yɛ amɛŋɔɔ koni ahere wɔ yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ anɔ. Belɛ, wɔ lɛ, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔje mli hu?’ ”

Title: YESAIA 21
Content:
Babilon shigbeemɔ he ninaa
1Babilon he gbalɛ nɛ.
Bɔ ni lasuogbele tswaa kɛjɛɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, nakai haomɔ aaajɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni he yɔɔ gbeyei nɔ aba. 2Ajie ninaa ko ni yɔɔ gbeyei atsɔ̃ɔ mi: mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko sɛɛgbɛ, kɛ nifitelɔ ni miifite nii.
Elam, kwɔɔ kɛya! Media, yaasa maji lɛ ayi! Mahã ŋkɔmɔi fɛɛ ni Babilon eha eyeɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo!
3No hewɔ lɛ, mihɛ mli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ piŋmɔ, kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe; kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ. Mishɔ kwekweekwe, hewɔ lɛ minuuu nii. Mijijaa hewɔ lɛ minaaa nii. 4Mihiɛ miidi mi; ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi; gbɛkɛ ni mishweɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ moŋ ehã mi.
5Ninaa lɛ mli lɛ mina ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃, akɛ kuŋtui lɛɛ shi, aaye nii, ni aanu nii. Trukaa lɛ abo akɛ, “Tatsɛmɛi, nyɛtea shi; nyɛfɔa tsɛŋi lɛ ahe mu.”
6Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi nɛ, “Yaa! Hã ni mɔ ko ayabu, ni nɔ ni eeena lɛ, ehã ni ale. 7Kɛji ena mɛi tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni ena mɛi hu ni tara tejii kɛ yoomai anɔ lɛ, etɛ̃je ehiɛ, ni ebo nɔ ni ebaanu lɛ toi jogbaŋŋ.”
8 Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ bo waa ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, midamɔ buuhe nɛɛ gbi muu fɛɛ, ni mibu nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ hu. 9 Trukaa lɛ, naa okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi komɛi ni miiba; amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ!”
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Babilon egbee shi! Hɛɛ! Egbee shi! Emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ akumɔ ashwie shi nɛɛ!”
10Ao mimaŋ Israel, ni otamɔ ŋmãa ni agbee ni asha mli. Nɔ ni minu yɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, no mikɛɛ bo nɛɛ.
Edom he gbalɛ
11 Edom he ninaa nɛ.
Abo atsɛ mi kɛjɛ Edom akɛ, “Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmɛlɛtswaa be mli nɛ? Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmɛlɛtswaa be mli nɛ?”
12Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Je miitsɛre shi moŋ je baana ekoŋŋ. Kɛji nɔ ko otaoɔ obi lɛ, bi! Kuu osɛɛ ni obabi!”
Arabia he gbalɛ
13Arabia he ninaa nɛ.
Nyɛ Dedan gbɛnyiɛlɔi asafo, Arabia ŋa lɛ mli nyɛbaaya nyɛyato shi yɛ.
14Nyɛ Temabii, nyɛhaa mɛi ni kumai yeɔ amɛ lɛ nu ni amɛnu, ni nyɛhaa abobalɔi lɛ niyenii ni amɛye, 15ejaakɛ amɛjo foi kɛjɛ ta mli gbele naa, kɛjɛ klante ni agbala awo amɛ kɛ gãi ni abaatsɛ̃ kɛ ta mli osharãi fɛɛ anaa.
16Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Biɛ afi mli, tamɔ apaafonyo apaayeli afi be lɛ, Kedar anunyam fɛɛ sɛɛ baafo. 17Kedar hii kãkãlɔi gãitsɛ̃lɔi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayi faŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɛ.”

Title: YESAIA 22
Content:
Yerusalɛm he gbalɛ
1Ninaa ni kɔɔ Ninaa Jɔɔ lɛ he nɛ.
Mɛni ji tsui ayiteŋ ni bo kɛ omɛi fɛɛ ekwɔ kɛtee nɛɛ? 2Maŋ kɛ emli kiŋkaŋŋ, maŋ ni mli efili lɛ, omli eyi kɛ hoofeemɔ. Omɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔi lɛ, jeee klante naa amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ, ni jeee ta mli hu amɛgboi yɛ. 3Olumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kwa ejo foi; ahiɛɛɛ gãi tete ni amɔmɔ amɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni ana amɛ lɛ, amɔmɔ amɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛjojoo foi kɛtee shɔŋŋshɔŋŋ. 4No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, nyɛfɔa mi kwɛmɔ; nyɛhãa mafoa kɛ dɔlɛ. Nyɛkagbaa nyɛhe naa nyɛshɛjea mimii yɛ maŋbii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã lɛ hewɔ. 5Ejaakɛ gidigidifeemɔ kɛ nibii ni anaanaa nɔ kɛho kɛ nibii ni afee basaa yɛ Ninaa Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ jɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ. Akumɔ gbogboi ashwie shi, ni blɔmɔ ni maŋbii lɛ bolɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, ejije kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ.
6Elam tabilɔi ba kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii; ni Kirbii hu ba ni amɛhiɛ amɛtsɛŋi. 7Ojɔi kpakpai lɛ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tayaa shwiilii, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ gba sa yɛ Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ anaa. 8 Akpa Yuda he mama.
Nakai gbi lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ tawuu nibii ni yɔɔ tawuu nibii atoohe lɛ anɔ, 9nyɛna akɛ David maŋ Yerusalɛm hei ni agbugbuu awo mli lɛ fa, ni nyɛtswa nubu koni nyɛkɛto nu ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ kpaakpo lɛ mli lɛ eko. 10 Nyɛkane Yerusalɛm shĩai lɛ, ni nyɛkumɔ shĩai lɛ ekomɛi koni nyɛna tɛ nyɛkɛwaje maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ. 11Nyɛgba nujɔɔ yɛ gbogboi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ koni nyɛkɛbua kpaakpo momo lɛ mli nu lɛ naa yɛ jɛi. Shi nyɛyakwɛɛɛ ni nyɛyabuuu Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni to nɔ ni ba lɛ hegbɛjianɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, ni asaŋ ehã eba mli lɛ.
12Nakai gbi lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, tsɛ koni nyɛfo ni nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛshɛshɛɛ nyɛyi ni nyɛmia kɛ kpekpe. 13 Shi moŋ nyɛnya, ni nyɛmli fili nyɛ. Nyɛgbegbee tsinai kɛ toi, ni nyɛye, ni nyɛnu dãi, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnua dãi ejaakɛ wɔ bɛnɛ wɔgboi.”
14Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ni wie, ni minu kɛ mitoi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwa, aŋɔŋ nɛkɛ nɔsha nɛɛ afaŋ nyɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaagboi.”
Abɔ Shebna kɔkɔ
15Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Ba, yaa Shebna, tsulɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ; ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 16mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ yɛ biɛ; ni namɛi ji owekumɛi yɛ biɛ, hewɔ ni okpɛɔ yɛ he grɔŋŋ nɛɛ, ni okpɛɔ tɛsaa mli otoɔ okɛfeɔ ofũuhe lɛ? 17Naa, bo nuu hewalɔ, Yehowa baawo bo eshɛ efɔ̃. Ebaamɔ omli tswɛ, ni eeefɔ̃ bo kɛbɔle yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ, 18ni eeeshɛ bo efɔ̃ tamɔ bɔɔlo ni ashɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kplanaa nɔ. Jɛi ooogbo yɛ, bo, onuŋtsɔ we lɛ mli hiɛgbejiatsɛ; ni jɛi otayaa shwiilii fɛɛfɛji lɛ aaaka. 19Mashwie bo yɛ onitsumɔ lɛ mli, ni oyelihe aaabɔ bo.”
20Nakai gbi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Shebna akɛ, “Kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibatsɛ mitsulɔ Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ, 21ni maŋɔ otade yuu lɛ mawo lɛ, ni mikɛ ohɛfiinɔ lɛ baafi ehɛ, ni maŋɔ ohewalɛ lɛ mahã lɛ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ tsɛ eha Yerusalɛmbii kɛ Yuda we lɛ. 22 Maŋɔ David we lɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ naa samfee mawo edɛŋ: kɛji egbele lɛ, mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ aŋa; ni kɛji eŋa lɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbele. 23Mahã emã shi shiŋŋ tamɔ shiŋmlitso ni aka sɛɛ kpɛŋŋ; ni ebaahã etsɛ we lɛ hiɛ aba nyam.
24“Eweku lɛ mli bii kɛ hɔi asaji fɛɛ baakã enɔ. Amɛbaatsotsro enɔ tamɔ kɔɔpoi bibii kɛ ewuji tsotsoro tso nɔ lɛ. 25Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, shiŋmlitso lɛ ni aka akɛma shi shiŋŋ lɛ, aaawɔtsɔ, ni ebaagbee shi, ni jatsu ni tsotsoro nɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ.

Title: YESAIA 23
Content:
Tiro he gbalɛ
1 Nyɛ Tiro lɛji amli asrɛfoi, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmaŋ Tiro lɛji amaamɔhe lɛ hiɛ. Ajɛ Kipro shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahã amɛle nɔ ni eba lɛ. 2Ao nyɛ ŋshɔnaabii, Ao Sidon jarayelɔi, nyɛfea kpoo! Nyɛtsulɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ, 3ni amɛnyiɛ fai wuji hu ahiɛ amɛye jara. Amɛye Shihor abele, ni ji Nilo Faa lɛ he nikpamɔnii lɛ, jara. Nyɛ kɛ majimaji ye jara.
4Ao Sidon, ohiɛ agbo; ejaakɛ ŋshɔ ewie, ŋshɔ shishi diɛŋtsɛ ewie akɛ, “Mikɔ̃mɔko dã, asaŋ mifɔko dã. Milɛko oblahii dã lɛ, milɛko oblayei hu dã.”
5Kɛji sane lɛ yashɛ Ijipt lɛ, jɛibii baahao yɛ Tiro sane ni abagba lɛ hewɔ.
6Nyɛ Foinikiabii ni kã ŋshɔnaa, nyɛwoa lele, nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa Tarshish. 7Kwɛ, nyɛmaŋ ni ji blema maŋ Tiro kɛ emli miishɛɛ babaoo lɛ ni yato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɛ. (Tiro) 8 Namɔ to nɛkɛ yiŋ yɛ Tiro he, lɛ maŋ ni etoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi, maŋ ni ejarayelɔi lɛ lumɛi sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, ni eguɔyelɔi ahiɛ ba nyam yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ? 9Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni to nɛkɛ yiŋ. Eto yiŋ nɛɛ koni ekɛba amɛhe ni amɛwoɔ, yɛ hiɛnyam ni amɛna hewɔ lɛ shi, bɔ ni afee ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anunyam gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ agboi.
10 Ao Tarshishbii, nyɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyahua; nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni tsĩɔ nyɛ gbɛ dɔŋŋ. 11Yehowa ewo enine nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ehoso maŋtsɛyelii. Efã akɛ afite Kanaan mɔji lɛ. 12 Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Sidon, ni awaa obii yi, omli akafili bo dɔŋŋ! Sidonbii, nyɛtea shi koni nyɛyaa Kipro, shi jɛi hu nyɛnaŋ hejɔlɛ.”
13Naa Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ. Babilonbii lɛ ji mɛi ni hã jwɛiaŋ kooloi kakawuai kpãtã Tiro maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, shi jeee Asiriabii lɛ. Babilonbii lɛ mamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmɔji ni kwɔlɔ, ni amɛkumɔ Tiro mɔji ni yɔɔ sa lɛ, ni amɛhã Tiro fee koikoi.
14Ao Tarshish lɛji amli bii, nyɛwoa lele, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ ahiɛ.
15Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ, hiɛ aaakpa Tiro nɔ kɛyaashi afii nyɔŋmai kpawo, ni ji be ni maŋtsɛ kome yeɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ lɛ. Afii kpawo lɛ naagbee lɛ, Tiro sane baatsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni alaa yɛ yoo ajwamãŋ he akɛ, 16“Ajwamãŋ ni hiɛ ekpa onɔ,
kɔ saŋku koni okɛyakpa maŋ lɛ mli.
Tswaa saŋku lɛ jogbaŋŋ,
ni ola lalai babaoo
bɔ ni afee ni akai bo ekoŋŋ.”
17Afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ naagbee lɛ, Yehowa baahã Tiro aku sɛɛ ebɔi ejarayeli lɛ ekoŋŋ. Ebaafee ehe apaafonyo ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ. 18Tiro baajɔɔ ejarayeli mli nii kɛ apaa ni abaabɔ lɛ mli nii hu nɔ ehã Yehowa. Atĩaŋ esɛɛnamɔ lɛ naa amaŋ shi, shi ejarayeli lɛ mli nii baahã ana niyenii babaoo kɛ mamai fɛɛfɛji ahã mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ Yehowa lɛ.

Title: YESAIA 24
Content:
Yehowa baagbala Je lɛ toi
1Naa, Yehowa baakpãtã je lɛ hiɛ koni efee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃? Ebaatsɔ̃ je lɛ hiɛ ebu shi, ni ebaagbɛ enɔ bii lɛ eshwã. 2Bɔ ni abaafee maŋbii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee osɔfo lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee nyɔŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee enuŋtsɔ lɛ; bɔ ni abaafee weyoo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee ewula lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee nihelɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee nihɔɔlɔ lɛ; bɔ ni abaafee mɔ ni kɛ nii filiɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee mɔ ni filiɔ nii lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee mɔ ni ahiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee mɔ ni hiɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ. 3Abaakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu, ni abaashi lɛ shwɛm, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, ni ja ena eba mli.
4Shikpɔŋ lɛ miigbi, ni eeŋala; je lɛ miigbede, ni eeŋala; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ miigbede. 5Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ mlai lɛ anɔ, ni amɛyeee akpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛku naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli. 6No hewɔ lɛ, loomɔ miikpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni enɔ bii miina nɔ yɛ amɛfɔyeli hewɔ. Enɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi etã ni eshwɛ mɛi fioo ko kɛkɛ. 7Wain tete miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni waintso lɛ miigbi. Mɛi ni mli fili amɛ fɛɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ. 8 Miji kɛ kpãa saŋkui agbɛɛmɔi kɛ nyamɔ lɛ ejɔ, ni mliflilɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ sɛɛ efo. 9Wainnumɔ kɛ lala sɛɛ efo, ni dãa ni wa miijoo yɛ dãanulɔ daaŋ. 10Maŋ kɛ emli basabasa nifeemɔ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã; aŋamɔ emli shĩai fɛɛ ashinai koni mɔ ko akabote eko mli. 11Aabolɔ yɛ blohui lɛ amli yɛ wain hewɔ; miishɛɛ fɛɛ naa eba shi; afo miishɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 12Afee maŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni akumɔ agboi lɛ amli dukuduku. 13Nɔ ni baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ nɛ. Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mutso ni akpa enɔ yibii loo waintso ni akpa enɔ wainyibii atã.
14Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaahole amɛgbei anɔ amɛaala kɛ miishɛɛ. Mɛi aaajɛ anaigbɛ amɛbɔ oshe kɛkafo Yehowa agbojee, 15No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam yɛ bokãgbɛ. Ŋshɔnaa maji, nyɛwoa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam. 16Wɔmiinu yijiemɔ kɛ Jalɔ Koome lɛ hiɛ nyamwoo lalai kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ.
Shi mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miitã loo! Miitã loo! Kpoo ha mi, ejaakɛ kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo! Kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo waa diɛŋtsɛ! 17Ao shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, gbeyei nii kɛ bu ni atsa kɛ tsɔne ni atsɔ̃ miimɛ nyɛ! 18 Mɔ ni baajo foi kɛji anu gbeyei sane lɛ, ebaagbee bu lɛ mli; ni mɔ ni baakwɔ kɛje kpo yɛ bu lɛ mli lɛ, ebaadu tsɔne; ejaakɛ aaagbele ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo lɛ aaahoso. 19 Shikpɔŋ lɛ ewule, shikpɔŋ lɛ egbala, shikpɔŋ lɛ ehoso waa diɛŋtsɛ. 20Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ dãatɔlɔ ni miididãa, ebaahoso tamɔ aboŋo yɛ ahum mli. Etɔmɔ lɛ tsii yɛ enɔ, ni ebaatsi lɛ egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
21 “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baagbala ŋwɛi asafo lɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebaagbala shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu atoi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 22Abaabua amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa awo bu ko mli tamɔ gboklɛfoi. Abaaŋa amɛyi awo gboklɛfoi atsu ko mli, ni be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, abaagbala amɛtoi. 23 Nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛŋ, ni hulu etsoŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baaye nɔ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni ebaajie enunyam lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ.”

Title: YESAIA 25
Content:
Yijiemɔ Lala
1Ao Yehowa, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ;
mibakafo bo, mibajie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Ejaakɛ otsu naakpɛɛnii.
Oyiŋ ni oto kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ
oye ehe anɔkwa.
2Oha maŋ lɛ fee koikoi;
maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ
etsɔ̃ koikoi;
Maŋsɛɛbii amaŋtsɛ we lɛ ekumɔ,
ni akuŋ sɛɛ amaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
3No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ ko ni he wa
baawo ohiɛ nyam;
ni yiwalɔi amaji lɛ baashe bo gbeyei.
4Ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã ohiafo,
otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã mɔ ni ehĩa
yɛ ehĩamɔ be mli.
Otsɔ̃ abobaahe yɛ ahum mli,
kɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ latsa be mli;
ejaakɛ yiwalɔi amlifu lɛ,
etamɔ ahum ni miitswa,
5loo lamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Shi bo Yehowa, ojɔɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ
ahoofeemɔ lɛ he,
ni yiwalɔ lɛ he ejɔ
tamɔ bɔ ni atatu jɔɔ jeŋ dɔlɛ he lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛ okplɔ̃
6 Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ fɔŋ niyenii sɔkɔɔ kɛ wain momo ni adoo nɔ jogbaŋŋ baaŋmɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. 7Ni yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ebaajie ŋkɔmɔ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ atatu ni ha majimaji fɛɛ anɔ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ; eeewo awerɛho ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ muhɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ. 8 Eeekpãtã gbele hiɛ kɛaatee nanɔ, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ hiɛiaŋ yaafonui fɛɛ. Ebaafo emaŋ lɛ hiɛgbele lɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ wiemɔ nɛ.
9 Nakai be lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɛ. Wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ enɔ akɛ eeehere wɔ. Yehowa ni wɔhiɛ kã enɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa, ni wɔnyaa yɛ edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ hewɔ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Moab toi
10Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ baafã gɔŋ nɛɛ he. Shi Moabbii lɛ abaanaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa jwɛi nɔ yɛ bu ni yɔɔ tumo nɔ. 11Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Moabbii aaakpã amɛniji amli yɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ serelɔ kpãa eniji amli ekɛsereɔ lɛ. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baaba Moab hewoo kɛ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ fɛɛ shi. 12 Ebaakumɔ Moab mɔji grɔŋŋi kɛ ehe gbogboi lɛ; eeekumɔ fɛɛ eshwie shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ mlu aaaye egbɔ.

Title: YESAIA 26
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baahã emaŋ lɛ aye kunim
1Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ
aaala lala nɛɛ
yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ,
“Wɔmaŋ ni wa,
Yehowa tswaa kunimyeli
tamɔ gbogboi kɛ kawoohei ewoɔ he.
2 Nyɛgbelea maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ
koni maŋ ni emli bii feɔ jalɛnii
asaŋ yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ abote mli.
3Yehowa ohãa maŋ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ
naa toiŋjɔlɛ krɔŋŋ,
ejaakɛ bo onɔ amɛhiɛkãa.
4 Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔa Yehowa nɔ daa
ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
naanɔ tɛsaa ni.
5Ejaakɛ eba mɛi ni tara
hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ashi;
ni maŋ ni kwɔ lɛ,
eba lɛ shi, ni ekɛ
shikpɔŋ eye egbɔ;
ewo lɛ etswa mlu mli.
6Mɛi ni aye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ,
amɛmiinaanaa enɔ agbɛnɛ;
ohiafoi miinaanaa enɔ.
7Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ,
egbɛ jaa hãa lɛ.
Ao, Jalɔ Koome, ohãa jalɔ lɛ
gbɛ lɛ nɔ feɔ trɛtrɛ hãa lɛ.
8 Yehowa, wɔmiikwɛ bo gbɛ
yɛ okojomɔi lɛ amli;
wɔmiishwe ogbɛ́i ni kaiɔ wɔ saji lɛ.
9Nyɔɔŋ lɛ, misusuma shweɔ bo,
mimumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli taoɔ bo
kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ ojalɛ saneyeli
yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
je lɛ mli bii kɛkaseɔ jalɛ nifeemɔ.
10 Kɛji ana efɔŋfeelɔi amɔbɔ lɛ,
amɛkɛkaseee nɔ ni ja feemɔ;
shi moŋ amɛyeɔ saji fɔ̃ji
yɛ he ni afeɔ jalɛnii yɛ,
ni enaaa Yehowa agbojee lɛ.
11 Ao Yehowa, owo onine nɔ,
shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnaaa.
Hã amɛna joomɔ ni ojoɔ
yɛ omaŋbii ahe lɛ
koni amɛhiɛ agboi.
Hã la ni oto hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ
akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
12Ao Yehowa, oooha wɔna toiŋjɔlɛ
ejaakɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni wɔtsu lɛ,
bo ji mɔ ni otsu.
13Ao Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ,
nuŋtsɔmɛi krokomɛi
ebaye wɔnɔ kɛho;
shi bo pɛ ogbɛi lɛ kɛkɛ wɔle.
14Amɛgboi, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ;
amɛtsɔmɔ sisai ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ,
ejaakɛ ogbala amɛtoi,
ni okpãtã amɛhiɛ,
ni akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
15Ao Yehowa, ohá maŋ lɛ eshwere,
olɛɛ maŋ lɛ husui amli
ni enɛ ewo ohiɛ nyam.
16 Ao Yehowa, amɛhejaramɔ mli lɛ,
amɛtao osɛɛgbɛ;
amɛsɔle amɛkpa bo fai
be ni ogbalaa amɛtoi lɛ.
17 Ao Yehowa, bɔ ni yoo ni hiɛ musu
kɛ̃mɔɔ ni ebolɔɔ
yɛ enɔnaa lɛ mli
kɛji fɔ̃mɔ eshɛ shi etã lɛ,
nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔyɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
18 Wɔhiɛ musu, ni wɔmiikɛ̃mɔ;
wɔfɔɔɔ gbɔmɔ; shi wɔfɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
Wɔnyɛko shikpɔŋ lɛ yiwala wɔhere;
wɔnyɛko nɔ ko wɔtsu.
19 Omɛi ni egboi lɛ ahiɛ aaatsɛ̃,
ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ aaate shi.
Ao nyɛ su mli bii,
nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a,
ni nyɛlaa kɛ miishɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ obɔ ni nyɔɔ lɛ,
bɔ ni kpɛlɛɔ ni,
ni ooohã gbohii lɛ ate shi.
20Mimaŋbii, nyɛbaa!
Mimaŋbii, nyɛbotea nyɛpiai lɛ amli,
ni nyɛŋamɔa nyɛshinai lɛ
nyɛwoa nyɛyi.
Nyɛtea nyɛhe hiŋmɛitswaa fioo ko
kɛyaashi Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.
21Ejaakɛ, naa, Yehowa miije kpo
kɛmiijɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ
koni ebagbala je lɛ mli bii atoi
yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaajie lá shi ni ashwie
yɛ enɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ,
ni ehaŋ mɛi ni agbe
yɛ enɔ lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.”

Title: YESAIA 27
Content:
1 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ klante agbo ni naa ba ni wa hu baabamɔ Leviatan, onufu lɔgɔligi lɛ, ni eeegbe ogboole ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
2Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛlaa yɛ waintrom fɛɛfɛo lɛ he nyɛkɛa akɛ, 3“Mi, Yehowa, misaa mli; mishwieɔ enɔ nu be fɛɛ be. Mibuɔ ehe nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko akafite emli nɔ ko. 4Mimli fuko. Eji ŋmeii kɛ kpitikpitii baawo mi naagba kulɛ, mate shi mawo amɛ, ni mibashã fɛɛ tswɛm. 5Kɛji miwebii ahenyɛlɔi lɛ miitao mihebuu lɛ, ja amɛbaba mi abo, ni amɛkɛ mi kpãtã. Hɛɛ! Ja amɛna amɛkɛ mi kpãtã!”
6Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel aaatsɛ̃rɛ̃ fãi tamɔ tso, ni Israel aaagba afofro hu, ni eyibii aaayi jeŋ fɛɛ.
7Ani Yehowa eyi Israel tamɔ eyi mɛi ni yi Israel lɛ? Aloo egbe Israel tamɔ egbe mɛi ni gbe Israel lɛ? 8 Okɛ amɛ ye bɔ ni ja gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnomŋɔɔ nɔ. Yehowa kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ loo amɛ kɛtee be ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa lɛ. 9 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Yakob gbɛlɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ amli tɛi lɛ munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ kaaloo tɛi ni afuflu, ni Ashera wɔŋkoi kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi bɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ lɛ, no nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni akɛ Yakob tɔ̃mɔ lɛ baafa lɛ, ni no aaatsɔ̃ yibii ni etɔ̃mɔkɛfaa lɛ aaawo ahã lɛ.
10Ejaakɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shihilɛhe ni ashi afɔ shi ni akwa lɛ tamɔ shiaŋa. Tsinabii miiye nii yɛ jɛi; amɛbumɔɔ shi yɛ jɛi, ni amɛyeɔ nii. 11Kɛji emli tsei aniji lɛ gbi lɛ, akumɔɔ ni yei baa ni amɛbalɛɔ akɛ lai kɛyaa, ni amɛyashãa. Ejaakɛ amɛjeee maŋ ni nuɔ nii ashishi. No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni bɔ amɛ lɛ musuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni enaŋ amɛ mɔbɔ.
12Ao Israel, nakai gbi lɛ, Yehowa aaahala nyɛ ekomekome kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyaashi Ijipt husu lɛ nɔ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni miigbee ŋmãa.
13Aaakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ wulu ko nakai gbi lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni elaaje yɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaba, ni amɛaabaja Yehowa yɛ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.

Title: YESAIA 28
Content:
Abɔ Kooyigbɛ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɔkɔ
1Kpoo hã Israel dãatɔlɔi hewolɔi lɛ! Kpoo hã Israel anunyam fɔfɔi fɛɛfɛo ni kã ekuɛ lɛ! Kpoo hã fɔfɔi akekre ni yɔɔ Israel lumɛi ni etɔrɔ kɛ ŋmãa kɛ wain lɛ ayitsei ahe lɛ. 2Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ hewalɔ kɛ kãkãlɔ ko; etamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ ni miinɛ kɛ ahum ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ; etamɔ nu ni eje ŋa ni eeho boboobo, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baaloo nibii etswia shi. 3Nibii ni Efraim dãatɔlɔi lɛ kɛwulaa amɛhe lɛ akɛ nane aaanaanaa nɔ; 4ni Efraim lumɛi lɛ anunyam fɛɛfɛo ni ŋalaa lɛ baalaaje tamɔ agbãmi ni shaa etsuɔ dani eshɛɔ etsulɛ be, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana nɔŋŋ lɛ, etseɔ eyeɔ oya.
5Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, aaatsɔ̃ anunyam fɔfɔi kɛ akekre fɛɛfɛo ehã ewebii ni aaashwɛ lɛ. 6Eeehã kojolɔ lɛ mumɔ ni hãa ayeɔ jalɛ sane; ni eeewo mɛi ni fãa maŋ agbo lɛ he hewalɛ.
Yesaia kɛ Yuda gbalɔi dãatɔlɔi lɛ wie
7Wain ehã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahiɛ miidĩ amɛ; dãa ni wa ehã amɛmiididã. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ miididã kɛ dãa ni wa. Wain ehã amɛlului, ni amɛmiididãa kɛ dãa ni wa. Amɛnãaa ninaa kpakpa koni amɛgba pɛpɛɛpɛ; dãa hãaa amɛnyɛ amɛbua sane he jogbaŋŋ. 8Amɛshwe amɛkpa okpɔlɔi ni amɛtara sɛɛ lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ; he ko kwraa bɛ ni muji bɛ jɛi.
9Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ kwraa nii ebaatsɔ̃ɔ mɔ, ni namɔ kwraa ebaagbala sane mli etsɔ̃ɔ? Abifabii ni atse amɛ fufɔ, loo mɛi ni ayahole amɛ yɛ fufɔ naa? 10Ebaatsɔ̃ɔ nii bɔ ni mla nyiɛ mla sɛɛ, ni akpɔ nyiɛ akpɔ sɛɛ, biɛ fioo kɛ jɛi hu fioo lo?”
11 Dabida; shi mɛi ni naa tseee kɛ maŋsɛɛbii anɔ Yehowa baatsɔ̃ ekɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ awie. 12Mɛi ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ nɛ. Nyɛhãa mɛi ni etɔ amɛ anaa hejɔlɛ; ni naa tsuiwoohe, kɛ̃lɛ amɛbooo toi.” 13No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ “Mla ni nyiɛ mla sɛɛ, kɛ akpɔ ni nyiɛ akpɔ sɛɛ, kɛ liamɔ ni nyiɛ liamɔ sɛɛ, kɛ biɛ fioo kɛ jɛi hu fioo” ahã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛya sɛɛsɛɛ koni amɛyagbeegbee shi ni akumɔ amɛ ni tsɔne adu amɛ ni amɔmɔ amɛ.
Zion Koŋtɛ
14No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhefɛoyelɔi ni yeɔ Yerusalɛm maŋbii anɔ, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi! 15Akɛni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔ kɛ gbele ekpãŋ, ni wɔ kɛ gbohiiaje hu eye efua, no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ekpelebii ni naa wa lɛ miigwao mɛi kɛmiiho lɛ, ebaŋ he ni wɔyɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ amale efee wɔbobaahe, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ teɔ kutumpɔo sɛɛ.” 16 No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mikɛ tɛ ko miima shi akɛ Zion shishitoo tɛ; eji tɛ ni aka akwɛ, koŋtɛ ni jara wa ni ma shi shiŋŋ; ni aŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ehe kpokpoŋ.’ ” 17Mikɛ jalɛ saneyeli baafee nɔ ni akɛbaasusu shishitoo lɛ, ni mikɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ baafee kpãa ni akɛbaana ejalɛ. Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi baaloo amalei ni nyɛkɛfee abobaahe lɛ kɛya, ni nu baafite nyɛteemɔhe lɛ. 18Kɛkɛ lɛ aaafo nyɛ kɛ gbele teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni bɔ ni nyɛ kɛ gbohiiaje eye efua lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni kɛji ekpelebii ni naa wa lɛ miiho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ. 19Shii abɔ ni ebaaho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ ejaakɛ ebaaho daa leebi kɛ daa shwane kɛ daa nyɔɔŋ, ni sane lɛ shishinumɔ lɛ ebaafee gbeyei pam. 20Ejaakɛ saatso lɛ baafee kuku tsɔ̃ bɔ ni aaanyɛ mli akpã yɛ nɔ; ni saanɔbo lɛ hu elɛŋ bɔ ni aaanyɛ akota he awo mli. 21 Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaaho edamɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni efee yɛ Perazim Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni eeegri tamɔ egri yɛ Gibeon Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ni eeetsu enaakpɛɛ nii. 22 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛkafea fɛoyeli dɔŋŋ koni akamia kpãi ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli kpɛŋŋ moŋ; ejaakɛ minu akpɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, wo yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ he lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Nilee
23Nyɛboa toi koni nyɛnu migbee; nyɛfea diŋŋ koni nyɛnu nɔ ni mawie lɛ! 24Ani okwaafoi ni miitao amɛdu nii lɛ, humɔ lɛ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛhuɔ daa lo? Aloo shi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛtsaa, ni amɛjwaraa emli kpɔi lɛ? 25Kɛji amɛsaa shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ani amɛshwãaa kowɛ, ni amɛduuu sulu? Ani amɛduuu ŋmãa lɛ srɛnɛɛ kɛ akoko lɛ yɛ gbɛhe ni sa lo? Ani amɛduuu abele yɛ husui lɛ anɔ lo? 26Amɛduɔ, ejaakɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii, ni egbalaa mli etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 27Akɛ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso egbeee kowɛ, ni akɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔɔ sulu nɔ kɛhooo; shi moŋ akɛ tso gbeɔ kowɛ lɛ, ni akɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso gbeɔ sulu lɛ. 28Agbɛlɛɔ abele akɛshãa aboloo; agbɛlɛɔ lɛ kɛ ŋaa. Kɛji aha okpɔŋɔi gbala shwiili kɛtsɔ ŋmãa nɔ kɛho blɛoo lɛ, eflɛɛɛ lɛ. 29Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ji mɔ dɛŋ ni nilee nɛɛ hu jɛ. Enilee yɛ naakpɛɛ, ni ejwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.

Title: YESAIA 29
Content:
Yerusalɛm naagbee
1Ni Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kpoo hã Nyɔŋmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm diɛŋtsɛ lɛ. Kpoo hã maŋ he ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ to shi yɛ lɛ! Nyɛyea afi mli gbii juji lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; daa afi lɛ nyɛyea! 2Kɛ̃lɛ mi, Nyɔŋmɔ mahã hejaramɔ aba Yerusalɛm nɔ. Ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ aaaba maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni Yerusalɛm baayi obɔ̃ kɛ lá tamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni lá ewu he kpɔtɔɔ. 3 Ni tamɔ bɔ ni David fee lɛ, mibatua bo, ni mibabɔle ohe kɛkpe, ni mibasa oyi, ni mibatswa kawoo gbogbo mabɔle ohe. 4Kɛkɛ lɛ ooojɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ owie; owiemɔi lɛ aaajɛ su mli agbɛɛ blɛoo; ogbee aaajɛ shikpɔŋ egbɛɛ tamɔ sisa gbee, ni obaawie ablɛbi kɛajɛ su mli.
5“Ohenyɛlɔi gbɔi lɛ ayifalɛ aaatamɔ mlu, ni yiwalɔi lɛ aaafee tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa. Ni trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ, 6Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔ kɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ kɛ gbɛɛmɔ kpeteŋkple kɛ lasuogbele kɛ ahum kɛ la ni kpãtãa nii hiɛ aaakpɔ̃ bo. 7Ni maji fɛɛ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ he ni afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mã lɛ wuɔ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ebatua lɛ kɛ emɔji ni amɛhaoɔ lɛ lɛ, asane lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ lamɔ̃, tamɔ nyɔɔŋ ninaa kɛkɛ. 8Bɔ ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ laa ni ena nii eeye, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ hɔmɔ lɛ miiye lɛ lolo, aloo bɔ ni mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ laa ni eenu nu, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ efee gbedee, ni kumai lɛ miiye lɛ lolo lɛ, nakai maji fɛɛ ni kɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ wuɔ lɛ asane aaafee.
9“Nyɛhãa nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe, ni nyɛlua! Nyɛshwilaa nyɛhe koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa shwilafoi! Nyɛtɔrɔa dãa, shi jeee kɛ wain; nyɛdidãa, shi jeee kɛ dãa ni wa. 10 Ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã wɔ ni mli tsii mumɔ enyɔ nyɛnɔ. Nyɛ gbalɔi, Yehowa eŋamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛ ninalɔi, Yehowa kɛ nɔ̃ eha nyɛhiɛ. 11Enɛɛmɛi ahe ninaa lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ wolo ni asɔo naa mli wiemɔi eha nyɛ. Kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni eeenyɛ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, ‘Kanemɔ’ lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛŋ, ejaakɛ asɔo naa.’ 12Ni kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni nyɛŋ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, ‘Kanemɔ wolo nɛɛ’ lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛŋ makane.’ ”
13Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni maŋbii nɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ mi kɛ amɛnaabu kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabu kɛkɛ woɔ mi, shi amɛtsui kɛ miteŋ jɛkɛ kwraa, ni jamɔ ni amɛjaa mi lɛ ejeee fɛifɛi fe wiemɔi ni amɛkase amɛwo amɛyitseiaŋ kɛkɛ amɛwieɔ 14 hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibafee naakpɛɛ nibii yɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ ahiɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛhe baajɔ̃ amɛhe. Amɛhii nilelɔi lɛ anilee lɛ baafee yaka, ni amɛhii hiɛtɛ̃lɔi lɛ ahiɛtɛ̃ɛ lɛ aaaŋmɛɛɛ amɛ.”
Wɔsɛɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ
15 Kpoo hã mɛi ni kaa akɛ amɛkɛ amɛyiŋtoi aaatee Yehowa, ni amɛfeɔ dujiaŋnii, mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ naa wɔ?” loo “Namɔ le wɔ? lɛ!” 16 Nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nibii ahiɛ nyɛbuɔ shi. Ani abaaŋɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ akɛ nishɔ̃ɔ su? Ani nɔ ko ni mɔ ko fee aaanyɛ ekɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni fee nɔ lɛ he akɛ, “Jeee lɛ efee mi!” lo? Aloo nɔ ko ni ashɔ̃ aaakɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni shɔ̃ nɔ lɛ he akɛ, “Eleee nɔ ko?”
17Te etsɛŋ ni Lebanon koo lɛ baatsɔ ŋa nɔ humɔhe ni baa nii, ni aaaŋɔ ŋa nɔ humɔhe lɛ akɛ koo?
18Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, toimulɔi tete baanu wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi ni shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii anɔ ni ewo duŋ lɛ aaatse, ni amɛaana nii. 19Humii baana miishɛɛ hee yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni ohiafoi amli aaafli amɛ yɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewɔ. 20Ejaakɛ yiwalɔi aaatã, ni hefɛoyelɔi asɛɛ aaafo, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni shiɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he kpe lɛ, aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ, 21 mɛi ni hãa mɔ yeɔ fɔ yɛ saneyeli mli, kɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ kojolɔ tsɔne yɛ koishi, kɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nɔ ni bɛ mli ni no hãa atsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni sane ja sane hiɛ abuɔ shi lɛ.
22No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni kpɔ̃ Abraham lɛ kɛɔ yɛ Yakob we lɛ he nɛ, “Agbɛnɛ Yakob we lɛ hiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ, ni ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi dɔŋŋ. 23 Ejaakɛ kɛji ena ebii lɛ, ni ji mininenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ, amɛaakpɛlɛ̃ Yakob Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛɛlɛŋ, ni amɛaashe Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei. 24Ni mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni mɛi ni wieɔ huhuuhu lɛ aaakase nii.”

Title: YESAIA 30
Content:
Akɛ Ijipt kpãŋ yaka
1Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã bii kaniŋkajelɔi ni yaa ajina ni mi, mibɛ mli, ni amɛkpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi ni jeee mitsui naa yiŋtoi ni, ni amɛkɛfeɔ esha amɛshiɔ esha nɔ. 2Amɛyiŋ amɛtee Ijipt, be mli ni amɛbiii mi ŋaawoo, koni amɛyaba Ijipt maŋtsɛ abo koni amɛyatao teemɔhe yɛ Ijipt. 3Shi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi, ni Ijipt abo ni nyɛyaabɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi. 4Ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ eshɛ Zoan, ni amɛbɔfoi lɛ hu eshɛ Hanes, ni ji Ijipt maji wuji lɛ anɔ nɛ, 5kɛ̃lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaagboi yɛ maŋbii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hã amɛ lɛ hewɔ; amɛyeŋ amɛbuaŋ amɛ, ni amɛnaŋ amɛhe sɛɛ ko; shi hiɛgbele kɛ ahorabɔɔ moŋ amɛaana.”
6Kooloi ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli lɛ ahe ninaa nɛ, “Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ haomɔ kɛ hejaramɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni jatayoo kɛ jatanuu hũuɔ yɛ, he ni shinɔ kɛ onufu filikilɔ yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛloɔ amɛnii ni amɛna lɛ amɛtereɔ tejibii ni amɛkɛ amɛjwetrii tereɔ yoomai kɛyaa maŋ ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ kɛha amɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 7 Akɛni Ijipt dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ bɛ fɛifɛi, ni enyɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko etsu hewɔ lɛ, mitsɛɔ lɛ ‘Naafuutsɛ ni etĩii ehe.’ ”
Maŋbii toigbolɔi
8Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yaa ni oyaŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii anɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni oŋma owo wolo mli koni ekã shi akɛ odaseyelinɔ ehã wɔsɛɛ be kɛya naanɔ. 9Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi atuatselɔi, bii amalelɔi ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ Yehowa toiboo ji amɛ. 10Amɛkɛɔ ninalɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkanaa nii’ ni amɛkɛɔ gbalɔi lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛkagbaa anɔkwale gbalɛ nyɛtsɔa wɔ; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ wɔ awiea wiemɔi ni ŋɔɔ; nyɛgbaa shishiumɔ gbalɛi moŋ; 11nyɛshĩa gbɛ lɛ, nyɛgbaa afã kɛjea tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nyɛ kɛ wɔ akawiea Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he dɔŋŋ.’ ”
12No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nɔ ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Akɛni nyɛkwa wiemɔ nɛɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ yiwalɛ kɛ kutumpɔo nɔ, asaŋ nyɛshwãa hu nyɛfɔɔ nɔ, 13hewɔ lɛ nɔsha ni nyɛfee nɛɛ aaahã nyɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo gojoo ni mli egba, ni ekpa, ni eehe egbee shi, ni trukaa hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ eeekumɔ eshwie shi. 14Ekuumɔ lɛ aaafee tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ ni ajwara lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ bɔ ni anaaa eŋɛsuko kome po nɛkɛ kɛkɛ yɛ ekoi lɛ amli ni aaanyɛ akɛje la yɛ latɛ mli, aloo akɛyɛ nu yɛ dudɔ mli tete.”
15 Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Sɛɛkuu kɛbaa kɛ diŋŋfeemɔ mli nyɛyi aaana wala yɛ; kpoofeemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli nyɛhewalɛ yɔɔ. Shi moŋ nyɛkwa, 16ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Dabida! Wɔɔtara okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛjo foi.’ No hewɔ lɛ, foi kɛ̃ nyɛaajo. Ni nyɛkɛɛ hu akɛ ‘Wɔɔtara okpɔŋɔi ni foijee naa wa nɔ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni aaatiu nyɛ lɛ hu afoijee naa baawa. 17 Gbɔmɔ kometoo yiŋaa naa lɛ, mɛi akpe aaajo foi; nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaajo foi kɛji mɛi enumɔ ŋa nyɛyi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni aaashwɛ mɛi fioo tamɔ aflaŋaa tso ni ma gɔŋ yiteŋ, loo tamɔ aflaŋaa ni ma gɔŋkpɔ yiteŋ. 18No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa miimɛ koni eduro nyɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, efee kralo koni ena nyɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane ni. Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã enɔ lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baajɔɔ emɛi lɛ
19Ao nyɛ Zionbii ni nyɛyɔɔ Yerusalɛm, nyɛwoŋ yara nyɛfoŋ dɔŋŋ. Emusuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe kɛji nyɛbolɔ nyɛtsɛ lɛ. Kɛji enu blɔmɔ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ hetoo. 20Yɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã amanehulu kɛ haomɔ eba nyɛnɔ moŋ nɛ, shi nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ eteŋ ehe dɔŋŋ, shi nyɛhiŋmɛii aaana nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ. 21 Ni ninejurɔgbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, abɛkugbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, nyɛtoii aaanu wiemɔ ko yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ akɛ, “Gbɛ lɛ nɛ, nyɛyia nɔ!” 22 Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaabule nyɛmãgãi ni ashwie he jwiɛtɛi kɛ amãgãi ni ashwie he shika lɛ hu. Nyɛaashɛrɛ amɛ nyɛshwie tamɔ nibii ni ahe tseee; nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Aloo amɛ ashwie kɛje wɔhiɛ.” 23Eeehã nu anɛ ashwie nyɛdumɔ wui ni nyɛdu lɛ nɔ, kɛ ŋmãa ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaawo yibii babaoo. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛtsinai lɛ aaaye nii yɛ ŋa ni lɛɛ nɔ, 24ni nyɛtsinai kɛ tejii ni akɛhuɔ lɛ aaaye nii ni ŋoo yɔɔ mli, ní akɛ sofi kɛ ŋmɔshi faka esha mli. 25Ni gbi nɔ ni aaaplene gbɔmɛi babaoo, ni amɛmɔji lɛ aaagbeegbee shi lɛ, faa baaho yɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi fɛɛ kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi ni kwɔlɔ fɛɛ anɔ. 26Ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaakpɛ tamɔ hulu tsoɔ, ni hulu aaatso bɔ ni etsoɔ daa lɛ toi kpawo, tamɔ gbii kpawo mli hulutsoo ni abua naa, gbi ni Yehowa aaafimɔ emaŋ lɛ pilamɔi anɔ, ni eeetsa faji ni ewo amɛ be ni etswia amɛ nii lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Asiria toi
27Naa Yehowa hewalɛ jɛ shɔŋŋ miiba! Emlifu miitso, ni eeje lasu kpɔŋŋ; enaa miitswa afui kɛ mlila, ni elilɛi tamɔ la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ. 28Emumɔ ni emuɔ lɛ tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛbata kuɛ, ni ebaakpãtã maji ahiɛ koni ekɛsha amɛmli tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa nii amli lɛ. Ebaawo majimaji lɛ adaaŋ manyoflɛ koni ekpala amɛ kɛya. 29Nyɛaala lala ko tamɔ bɔ ni alaa nyɔɔŋ kɛji aaye gbijurɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛtsui aaayimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ tamɔ mɛi ni aakpã blɛ aahã amɛ, be mli ni amɛnyiɛ kɛyaa Yehowa, ni ji Israel Tɛsaa lɛ, we lɛ.
30Ni Yehowa aaahã anu enunyam gbee lɛ, ni eeehã ana ehewalɛ nine ni kpelekeɔ shi lɛ kɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ; la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ aaatso, ni atatui aaaflɛ, ni nu kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi aaanɛ. 31Asiriabii aaayoyoro kɛji amɛnu Yehowa gbee lɛ, be ni ebaatswa amɛ nɔ kɛgbala amɛtoi lɛ. 32Bɔ ni miji kɛ saŋkui agbɛɛmɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, nakai Yehowa baatswa amɛ kpãa kɛgbala amɛtoi. Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Asiriabii lɛ baawu. 33 Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ni asaa he ko ato kɛha Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ shãa. Jɛi kwɔ, ni elɛɛ, ni eyi kɛ la kɛ lai babaoo. Ni Yehowa mumɔ ni emuɔ ni tamɔ la lɛ baama laii lɛ anaa la.

Title: YESAIA 31
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baabu Yerusalɛm he
1Kpoo hã mɛi ni yaa Ijipt amɛyataoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ tayaa shwiilii anɔ ejaakɛ amɛfa, kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi hu anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa naakpa, shi amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ moŋ nɔ, loo amɛbiii Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ po! 2Tsɛbelɛ, lɛ ji nilelɔ, ni ehãa efɔŋ baa, ni ekpaleee enaa, shi eteɔ shi ewoɔ efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ buaa efɔŋfeelɔi. 3Ijiptbii lɛ gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ; jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛ, ni amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ heloo kɛ lá ni, shi jeee mumɔi ni. Kɛji Yehowa wo enine nɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ buaa mɔ lɛ aaatɛ, ni mɔ ni ayeɔ abuaa lɛ lɛ hu aaagbee shi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
4Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi nɛ, “Bɔ ni kɛji jata loo jatabi miihũu yɛ emilɛ loo he, ni atsɛ tookwɛlɔi asafo tete awo ehe, ni amɛbolɔmɔ wooo ehe gbeyei, ni ebuuu hoo ni amɛaafee lɛ tete lɛ, nakai Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaaba abawu yɛ Zion Gɔŋ kɛ ehewɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ. 5 Bɔ ni loofɔji filikiɔ kɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ ŋwɛi kɛbuɔ amɛtsui ahe lɛ, nakai Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, baabu Yerusalɛm he; ebaabu ehe, ni ebaabaa eyi, ekɛ ehe baake lɛ, ni ebaahere lɛ.
6“Ao Israelbii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa mɔ ni nyɛtse ehiɛ atua lɛ ŋɔɔ. 7Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashɛrɛ ejwiɛtɛi amãgãi kɛ eshika amãgãi ni ekɛ eniji fee ni no hã nyɛfee esha lɛ eshwie. 8Asiria hiɛ baakpãtã yɛ klante ni jɛɛɛ adesa dɛŋ naa; klante ni jeee adesa ko sɔ̃ baakpãtã ehiɛ, ni ebaajo klante naa foi; ni eblahii lɛ aaanyɛ amɛnɔ koni amɛtsu nii keketee. 9 Emaŋtsɛ lɛ baajo foi kɛ tsuifãa, ni elumɛi lɛ aaajo foi kɛ hekpokpomɔ amɛshi amɛflaŋaa lɛ.” Yehowa, mɔ ni ajaa lɛ yɛ Zion ni efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli la tsoɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ ekɛɛ.

Title: YESAIA 32
Content:
Maŋtsɛ Anɔkwafo lɛ
1 Naa, maŋtsɛ ko baaba ebaye nɔ; ebaaye jalɛ sane; ni lumɛi hu baaba abaye jalɛ sane. 2Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ teemɔhe be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ miitswa, loo abobaahe be mli ni ahum miitswa; eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa nɔ, loo tamɔ tɛsaa kpele hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ. 3Amɛteŋ mɛi ni hiŋmɛi nɔ tse baana nɔ fɛɛ nɔ faŋŋ, ni mɛi hu ni toiiaŋ tse baabo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ toi jogbaŋŋ. 4Mɛi ni kulɛ amɛtsuii yɔɔ floflo lɛ aaakase nilee kpakpa, ni mumɔhalɔi awiemɔ mli aaatse pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni amɛlilɛii tɛrɛŋ shi dɔŋŋ. 5Atsɛŋ kwashia akɛ ablade dɔŋŋ ni shishiulɔ hu abuŋ lɛ oje dɔŋŋ. 6Kwashia wieɔ kwashiai awiemɔ, ni nishaianii ahe ejwɛŋɔ, ni enifeemɔ etsɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ; ewieɔ eshiɔ Yehowa. Ehãaa mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ niyenii, ni egbeɔ mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ kumai. 7Shishiulɔ nifeemɔ lɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni; etoɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa koni ekɛ amale wiemɔi akpãtã ohiafo hiɛ kɛji ohiafo sane ja tete po lɛ. 8Shi mɔ ni ji ablade lɛ, efeɔ abladei anii, ni efãa nɔ kpakpa he hu.
Toigbalamɔ kɛ Shweremɔ ekoŋŋ
9Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛtea shi, nyɛboa mi toi! Nyɛ biyei hu ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ̃ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa miwiemɔ lɛ! 10Nyɛ yei ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, biɛ afi kɛ nɔ ko fioo mli lɛ, nyɛhe aaakpokpo, ejaakɛ wainyibii aaakpala, ni eko baŋ dɔŋŋ ni aaana atse. 11Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa! Nyɛkpɔlɔa nyɛtadei koni nyɛnyiɛ yayai koni nyɛkɔlɔa kpekpe nyɛŋmɔlɔ nyɛhɛ. 12Nyɛyia nyɛtsitsi nɔ ma yɛ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛ waintsei ni woɔ yibii pii lɛ ahewɔ; 13yɛ ŋmei kɛ kpitikpiti ni aaakwɛ̃ yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ. Hɛɛ! Yɛ shĩai ni eyimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ maji ni miishɛɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ lɛ ahewɔ. 14Ejaakɛ aaajo foi ashi mɔɔ, ni aaashi maŋ ni emli eyi kɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ afɔ̃ shi. Gɔŋkpɔ kɛ buumɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kooloi abui kɛ ŋaŋ tejii amiishɛɛnamɔhe kɛ toi hu aniyelihe kɛaatee naanɔ.
15 Be miiba ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaafɔse Mumɔ lɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi eshwie wɔnɔ, ni shiaŋa lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii, ni shikpɔŋ ni baa nii aaatsɔ̃ koo. 16Kɛkɛ lɛ abaaye jalɛ sane yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni abaafee nɔ ni ja yɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ nɔ. 17Jalɛ saneyeli lɛ hesɛɛnamɔ baafee toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ shihilɛ kɛ nyɛmi hemɔkɛyeli. 18Mimaŋbii ashihilɛhei baayi kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, amɛaahi shi shweshweeshwe kɛ kpoo. 19Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ aaanɛ koo lɛ nɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ lakpatsa, ni aaafite maŋ lɛ kwrakwra. 20Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛduduu nii yɛ fai fɛɛ atoii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛ tsina kɛ teji he koni amɛyanyiɛ hei ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ.

Title: YESAIA 33
Content:
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ
1Kpoo hã bo, fitelɔ, bo mɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ afiteko bo. Kpoo hã bo, bo mɔshishinyiɛlɔ ni mɔ ko enyiɛko oshishi. Kɛji ogbe onifitemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaakpãtã ohiɛ; ni kɛji ogbe mɔshishinyiɛmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaanyiɛ oshishi.
2Ao Yehowa, dromɔ wɔ, shi bo pɛ gbɛ wɔkwɛɔ. Daa gbi lɛ bo ofeɔ wɔhewalɛ kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ yɛ fimɔ be mli. 3 Kɛji oshi yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, mɛi joɔ foi; ni kɛji owo ohe nɔ lɛ maji gbɛɔ shwãa. 4Aaaha nyɛnomŋɔɔnii tamɔ baalabii; ni abaake kɛba onɔ tamɔ otukpɛi.
5Awo Yehowa nɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ eyeɔ nii fɛɛ nɔ. Eeehã Yerusalɛm ayi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ, 6ni eeehã nyɛyinɔ afee shweshweeshwe, ni eeeduro nyɛ nilee kɛ ŋaa babaoo. Ninamɔ kpele ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ.
7Naa, kãkãlɔi lɛ miibolɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni bɔfoi ni bɔ mɔdɛŋ koni toiŋjɔlɛ aba lɛ miifo bloblo. 8Gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kã efolo, ni gbɛnyiɛlɔi eyaaa baaa. Akumɔ kpãŋmɔi amli, ni abuuu fuamɔi ni aye afua, ni abuuu gbɔmɔ adesa ahãaa fɛifɛi. 9Shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni eeŋala. Labanon kooŋ tsei ayibii ekpala, ekoi lɛ miigbi. Sharon jɔɔ shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ etsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni Bashan kɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibai miikpala.
Yehowa miibɔ ehenyɛlɔi kɔkɔ
10Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ, mibate shi! Agbɛnɛ mibawo mihe nɔ! Agbɛnɛ abaawo minɔ! 11Nyɛhiɛ tutuu musu, ni nyɛbaafɔ jwɛi; mumɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛgugɔŋ lɛ, la ni, ni no nɔŋŋ baashã nyɛ. 12 Maŋbii lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ kaaloo ni ashã; amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmei ni afolɔ ashwie shi ni awoɔ mli la ni ashãa. 13Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mifee lɛ toi, ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbɛŋkɛ, nyɛkpɛlɛa mihewalɛ lɛ nɔ.”
14Eshafeelɔi ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ miishe gbeyei, ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ahe miikpokpo. Amɛkɛɛmɔ ji, “Wɔteŋ namɔ baanyɛ la naa edamɔ kɛyashi naanɔ?” 15Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii, ni ewieɔ nɔ ni ja, mɔ ni nyaaa wieyeli mli nii he, ni eheee nyɔɔŋ nii, mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi koni ekanu láshishwiemɔ yiŋtoi ahe, ni eŋamɔɔ ehiŋmɛii koni ekana nɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ, 16lɛ ji mɔ ni baahi gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni tɛsai aaatsɔ̃ mɔji ahã lɛ. Ebaana nii eye, ni ebaana nu enu.
Wɔsɛɛ shihilɛ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ
17Okɛ ohiŋmɛii baana maŋtsɛ lɛ he fɛo, kɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni kã shi shwaŋŋ kɛtee shɔŋŋ. 18Kaimɔ kɛkɛ oookai nyɛsɛɛ ko gbeyei ni oshe lɛ. Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane shika lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni ŋmɛ too ni aye lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane mɔji lɛ yɔɔ? 19 Onaŋ gbɔmɛi hetsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ dɔŋŋ, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔ ni wa ni anuuu shishi, ni amɛwieɔ kɛ mumɔhaa ni anuuu shishi lɛ. 20Kwɛmɔ Zion, maŋ he ni wɔyeɔ wɔgbii juji lɛ yɛ lɛ! Ohiŋmɛii aaana Yerusalɛm akɛ toiŋjɔlɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe. Eyɛ tamɔ buu ni ma shi shiŋŋ, buu ni afamɔŋ ehe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ni ehe taŋkpei lɛ ekoeko tseŋ. 21Jɛi Yehowa aaahi yɛ enunyam mli ahã wɔ. Fai wuji kɛ bibii fɛɛ aaahi jɛi; shi moŋ lɛlɛ agbo ni awiriɔ ko kɛ meele ko nyɛŋ fai lɛ ekoeko mli etsɔ̃ kɛho. 22Ejaakɛ Yehowa ji wɔkojolɔ, Yehowa ji wɔnɔyelɔ. Yehowa ji wɔmaŋtsɛ; lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaahere wɔyiwala. 23Otaŋkpei lɛ amli egbɔjɔ, amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhã shimaatso lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ; amɛnyɛɛɛ abalaa lɛ amɛshi. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshwiea amɛnɔ, nyɛhaa amɛnii; nyɛjaa nyɛhãa bɔ ni obubuafoi tete aaana amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ. 24 Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekɛŋ akɛ, “Mihe miiye.” Akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe eshai aaafa amɛ.

Title: YESAIA 34
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala ehenyɛlɔi atoi
1Ao nyɛ majimaji, nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa koni nyɛbaboa toi. Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, nyɛboa toi. Hã jeŋ muu lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ, je lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ mli afee toi. 2Ejaakɛ Yehowa mli efu majimaji lɛ fɛɛ; egri ewo amɛtai lɛ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ nɔ, ni eŋɔ amɛ eha koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ. 3Abaashɛrɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ashwie, ni gbohii lɛ aaaje fu, ni amɛlá aaakpa gɔji lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ. 4 Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii aaasere, ni aaakota ŋwɛi tamɔ wolo. Amɛtabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaatswiatswia shi tamɔ baa kpalaa yɛ waintso nɔ loo agbãmitso nɔ lɛ.
5 Yehowa esaa klante lɛ eto yɛ ŋwɛi. Naa, klante lɛ baayi Edom nɔ, maŋ ni ajɔɔ enɔ aha hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ. 6Yehowa klante lɛ amɛlá kɛ fɔ ewu he kpɔtɔɔ; tamɔ too gwantɛŋi kɛ too kpakpoi alá kɛ agbɛnɛ ojwɛnii asabai ahe fɔ ni akɛshã afɔle. Ejaakɛ Yehowa miishã afɔle yɛ Bozra, ni ebaakpãtã wala hiɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Edom. 7Gbɔmɛi baanyɔnyɔi tamɔ wuoi kɛ tsina hii kɛ tsina ajebui. Lá baakpa amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpɔtɔɔ, ni amɛshikpɔŋ su baafee ŋɛlɛŋŋ kɛ fɔ. 8Ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ be lɛ ni, be ni ebaaye Zion sane lɛ ehã lɛ koni eto lɛ najiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ.
9 Edom fai lɛ baadi tuŋŋ tamɔ kootaa, ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ su aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ swɔɔ. Eshikpɔŋ tso muu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ kootaa ni miitso. 10 Ebaatso nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ, ni ebaaje lasu kɛya naanɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yinɔi fɛɛ; mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ. 11Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ kpokukpokui kɛ kɔtɔkɔi agboshinii; ni patui kɛ kwãakwãalabitei aaahi jɛi. Yehowa baaha eshikpɔŋ lɛ agbo koni etsɔ̃ olɛŋlɛ, ni nɔ kpakpa ko ehiŋ nɔ. 12Aaawo jɛi akɛ, “Maŋnɔyeli bɛ”, ni akɛ emli lumɛi fɛɛ efeŋ fɛifɛi. 13Ŋmei kɛ sansrɔ kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛ fɛɛ aaakwɛ̃kwɛ̃ɛ yɛ amɛmɔji lɛ kɛ amɛmaji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli. Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe kɛ dugumai hu ahilɛhe. 14Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ klãji aaabakpe yɛ jɛi, ni sasabonsami hu aaatsɛtsɛɛ amɛhe yɛ jɛi. Jɛi nɔŋŋ sisai aaaya koni amɛyatao hejɔɔmɔhe. 15Patu aaafee etsu yɛ jɛi, eeeŋmɛ yɛ jɛi ni eeebu nɔ; eeefɛlɛ, ni eeebu ebii lɛ anɔ yɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ mli. Akromai aaayabua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi ekomekome.
16Nyɛtaoa yɛ Yehowa wolo lɛ mli koni nyɛkanea. Kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ ni eyaŋ jɛi, ni eko eko hefatalɔ ebɔŋ lɛ. Ejaakɛ eje Yehowa naa, ni efã, ni Emumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni baabua amɛnaa. 17Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oshiki eha amɛ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ kɛaatee naanɔ, ni amɛaahi nɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.

Title: YESAIA 35
Content:
Krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ gbɛ
1Shiaŋa lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ aaanya,
shiaŋa lɛ mii aaashɛ ehe
ni eeegba afofro tamɔ fɔfɔi.
2Shiaŋa lɛ aaagba afofro babaoo,
ni emli aaafli lɛ,
ni eeenya kɛ lala.
Aaaŋɔ Lebanon anunyam lɛ ahã lɛ,
kɛ Karmel kɛ Sharon wulamɔ lɛ hu.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana Yehowa anunyam lɛ,
kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ agbojee lɛ.
3 Nyɛwajea mɛi ni anijiaŋ eje wui lɛ,
kɛ mɛi ni anakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ lɛ.
4 Nyɛkɛa mɛi ni tsui fãa lɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛfea ekãa, nyɛkashea gbeyei!
Naa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ baaba
koni ebatɔ nyɛhe owele.
Ebaaba koni ebahere nyɛyiwala.”
5Kɛkɛ lɛ aaagbele shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii,
ni aaagbele toimulɔi hu atoii;
6 obubuafoi aaatumɔ tamɔ ofrote,
ni mumuii baala kɛ nyamɔ;
ejaakɛ nu aaatue, ni eeeho
tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.
7Shiaŋa ni enɔ edɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kpaakpo,
ni shikpɔŋ ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ
baayi obɔ̃ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii.
Ŋaŋgbei ashibumɔhei lɛ
baatsɔmɔ hei ni nu tara,
ni glã kɛ ntoo aaakwɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.
8Gbɛjegbɛ aaakã jɛi,
ni aaatsɛ gbɛ lɛ, “Gbɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.”
Mɔ ko ni he tseee enyiɛŋ nɔ,
ni kwashiai tete eduŋ gbɛ yɛ nɔ.
9Jata ko jata ko ehiŋ jɛi;
kooloo kakawua ko kwraa
tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ,
akɛ ja mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛyiwala lɛ kɛkɛ.
10 Mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛ lɛ,
aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba ekoŋŋ,
ni amɛaaba Zion kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Amɛmii aaashɛ kɛya naanɔ;
amɛaayi kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ,
amɛyeŋ ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛdɔmɔŋ
ŋtsɔi dɔŋŋ.

Title: YESAIA 36
Content:
Asiria fã Yerusalɛm tsui
(2 Maŋtsɛmɛi 18.13-27; 2 Kronika 32.1-19)
1Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sankerib fã ta, ni ebatua Yuda maji fɛɛ ni atswa gbogbo awo he, ni eŋɔ maji lɛ. 2Asiria maŋtsɛ nɛɛ wo etsulɔnukpa kɛ tabilɔi babaoo gbɛ kɛjɛ Lakish kɛbanina Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yɛ Yerusalɛm. Tsulɔnukpa lɛ wa yɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni mamalolɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, yɛ nujɔɔ ni yiteŋgbɛ kpaakpo lɛ mli nu lɛ nyiɛɔ mli lɛ masɛi. 3Kɛkɛ ni tsuji nɛɛ, Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shĩa tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, maŋtsɛ we lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji ni aŋmala lɛ anɔ lɛ, je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛtee eŋɔɔ. 4Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa Hezekia akɛ, bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mɛni po nɔ ohiɛ kã nɛɛ?’ 5Osusuɔ akɛ naabu wiemɔ kɛkɛ ji ŋaa kɛ hewalɛ ni akɛwuɔ ta lo? Namɔ po nɔ ohiɛ kã hewɔ ni otse mihiɛ atua nɛɛ? 6 Ohiɛ kã Ijipt nɔ. Naa, Ijipt lɛ glã dɛhiɛmɔtso ni eku ni, ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ, etsuɔ edɛ̃. Nakai Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ji hã mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kãa enɔ lɛ.”
7Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Shi kɛji oookɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ’, ani jeee lɛ ehei grɔŋŋi kɛ efɔleshãa latɛi lɛ Hezekia kumɔ be ni ekɛɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ koome nɛɛ he nyɛbaaja yɛ lɛ?’ 8Agbɛnɛ ba koni okɛ minuŋtsɔ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ, abata abasa. Maha bo okpɔŋɔi akpei enyɔ kɛji obaana bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi, hii tabilɔi, otara amɛnɔ. 9Te ooofee tɛŋŋ onyɛ minuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi bibii fe fɛɛ, lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome po hiɛ odamɔ be mli ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ Ijipt tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ lɛ? 10Osusuɔ akɛ ba ni miba mibatua shikpɔŋ nɛɛ koni makpãtã hiɛ lɛ, Yehowa fataaa mihe? Yehowa moŋ ni kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Fãa kɛya koni oyatua shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okpãtã hiɛ.’ ”
11Kɛkɛ ni Eliakim kɛ Shebna kɛ Yoa kɛɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, okɛ otsuji awie yɛ Aram wiemɔ mli moŋ, ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ no hu. Okɛ wɔ akawie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli yɛ maŋbii ni jwere gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ atoiŋ.”
12Shi tsulɔnukpa lɛ to he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛ kɛ nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛkɛ ŋɔɔ minuŋtsɔ tsu mi kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ? Dabida! Miba maŋbii nɛɛ ni tara gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ hu kɛ wiemɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛbaaye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ ni amɛbaanu amɛshãmɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ.”
13Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔnukpa lɛ ho edamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ waa, ni ekɛɛ yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ, “Nyɛboa maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ toi! 14Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nyɛ, ejaakɛ enyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ehere.’ 15Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miihã nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ miifɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala; atuŋ maŋ nɛɛ awoŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ 16 Nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi. Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Nyɛjea kpo nyɛbaa koni nyɛ kɛ mi abakpãtãa, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye ewaintso kɛ egbamitso yibii, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anu enubu mli nu, 17kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maba mabaloo nyɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni tamɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ko ni abelei kɛ wain yɔɔ nɔ, aboloo kɛ waintromi ashikpɔŋ. 18 Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nyɛ akɛ Yehowa baahere nyɛyiwala.’ Ani jeŋmaji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ eko ehere eshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ pɛŋ? 19Nɛgbɛ Hamat kɛ Arpad nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ Sefarwaim nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Ani amɛhere Samaria yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ? 20Te nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ ateŋ nɔ ni ehere amɛshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje midɛŋ pɛŋ, hewɔ ni Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ eeehere Yerusalɛm yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ lɛ?”
21Shi Yerusalɛmbii lɛ etswaaa amɛsɛŋ, ni amɛfooo edaaŋ, ejaakɛ shi ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ewo amɛ ji, “Nyɛkahãa lɛ hetoo ko kwraa.” 22Kɛkɛ ni Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, blema woji ni aŋmala anɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, ba Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ amɛhe atadei ni egbala, ni amɛbagba lɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ wiemɔi lɛ.

Title: YESAIA 37
Content:
Hezekia bi Yesaia dɛŋ ŋaawoo
(2 Maŋtsɛmɛi 19.1-7)
