6Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hiɛi ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ, kɛ fiji hu ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ. 7Amɛniji ja trɔmɔɔ, amɛnanetokotai tamɔ tsina koklotoi; ni amɛhe kpɛlɛɔ kaŋkaŋ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he. 8Amɛyɛ gbɔmɔ niji yɛ amɛfiji ashishi yɛ amɛŋmawuiaŋ ejwɛ lɛ; ni amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ amɛfiji lɛ yɔɔ nɛ: 9Amɛfiji lɛ eko kɛ eko kpeɔ; kɛ amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yaa ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
10 Bɔ ni amɛhiɛi yɔɔ nɛ: amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ yɛ ehiɛgbɛ; eninejurɔ hiɛ lɛ, jata hiɛ ni; ni ebɛku hiɛ lɛ, tsina hiɛ; ni esɛɛ hiɛ lɛ, okropɔŋ hiɛ.
11Amɛgbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ, ni fiji lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko saa enaanyo nɔ he; ni amɛyɛ fiji enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ hu; ni nomɛi lɛ amɛkɛ hahaa amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ ahe. 12Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ lɛ kwɛɔ hei srɔtoi ejwɛ shi kome; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyaa amɛhiɛ tɛ̃ɛ shi kome; ni he fɛɛ he ni mumɔ lɛ yaa lɛ, jɛi amɛyaa; ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
13Agbɛnɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ ŋai la ni miitso yɛ nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ateŋ, tuuŋtu, ni enyiɛ amɛteŋ kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ kɔti ni miitso; la lɛ kpɛmɔ naa wa, ni srawa gbalaa kɛjɛɔ la lɛ mli. 14Nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ shaa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ srawa.
15 Agbɛnɛ be ni mikwɛɔ nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ, mina kokolontoi ejwɛ mamɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ nii lɛ amasɛi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ekome.
16Bɔ ni afee kokolontoi lɛ nɛ. Kɛ okwɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛtamɔ ojarawatɛ ni kpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram oookɛɛ ashwishwɛ. Amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ henɔ kome. Ni bɔ ni afee amɛ lɛ tamɔ kokolonto ni hɔ kokolonto mli. 17Kɛji amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛnyiɛɔ kɛyaa amɛkoji ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ eko nɔ, bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe. 18 Gai yɛ kokolontoi ejwɛ lɛ ahe, asaŋ gai lɛ eyimɔ tɔ kɛ hiŋmɛii ni bɔle amɛhe fɛɛ kɛkpe.
19Kɛji nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu nyiɛɔ amɛŋmawuiaŋ; ni kɛji amɛhole amɛhenɔ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu ehole amɛhe nɔ. 20Akɛni nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ mumɔ yɛ kokolontoi lɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni mumɔ lɛ yaa lɛ jɛi amɛyaa, ni amɛkɛ kokolontoi lɛ holeɔ amɛhenɔ shi kome. 21Kɛji nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu fɛɛ nyiɛɔ; ni kɛji amɛwa lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu waa. Shi kɛji amɛhole amɛhe nɔ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, koklolontoi lɛ hu holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛjeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ, nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su lɛ mumɔ lɛ yɛ koklolontoi lɛ hu amli.
22 Nɔ ko ni alɛɛ mli akete nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ayiteŋ, eha shi tamɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram tamɔ ashwishwɛ.
23Nɛkɛ nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ekpã amɛfiji amli trɔmɔɔ yɛ nɔ ni ha shi lɛ shishi, fine kɛ fine miikpe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ ni ekɛha egbɔmɔtso he. 24 Kɛji amɛmiifliki lɛ minuɔ ni amɛfijiaŋ miigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ; asaŋ etamɔ ta mli hoofeemɔ jijemɔ lɛ: etamɔ Ofe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ gbee. Kɛ amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛfiji lɛ baa shi.
25Kɛji amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛba amɛfiji lɛ ashi lɛ, gbee ko gbɛɔ kɛjɛɔ atatu ni yɔɔ amɛyiteŋ lɛ mli.
26 Nɔ ko ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi ni esu tamɔ safiro ojarawatɛ ma nɔ lɛ ni ha shi lɛ yiteŋ. Ni nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su ta nɔ ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.
27 Mina akɛ kɛjɛ he ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛyaa eŋwɛigbɛ lɛ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ akɔɔble; ekpɛlɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la ni ebɔ tɔo. Mina hu akɛ kɛjɛ nɔ ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛbaa eshishigbɛ lɛ tamɔ la. Ehewɔ fɛɛ etse haŋŋ.
28Bɔ ni anaa kwaabuɛtɛ su kɛji efo yɛ atatuiaŋ yɛ nunɛmɔ be mli lɛ, nakai ehe ni ekpɛ haŋŋ lɛ yɔɔ. Bɔ ni Yehowa anunyam su yɔɔ nɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 2
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Ezekiel koni efe gbalɔ
1Ni be ni mina enɛ lɛ miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, kɛkɛ ni minu mɔ ko gbee ni miiwie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tee shi odamɔ shi, mikɛ bo baawie.” 2Be ni ekɛ mi wie lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ bote mimli, ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni minu ni ekɛ mi miiwie. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 3“Gbɔmɔ adesa, miitsu bo Israelbii, ni ji maŋ atuatselɔi ni etse mihiɛ atua lɛ, aŋɔɔ. Amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ etɔ̃ minɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. 4Maŋbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti, ni amɛbuuu mi hu. Miitsu bo amɛŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ nɛ; 5 ni akɛni toigbolɔi ji amɛ nɛɛ, amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, amɛaana amɛle kɛ̃ akɛ gbalɔ ko ebahi amɛteŋ.’
6‘Ni bo, gbɔmɔ adesa, kaashe amɛ gbeyei, ni kaashe amɛwiemɔi lɛ hu gbeyei. Eyɛ mli akɛ oyɛ ŋmei kɛ kpitikpitii ateŋ, ni ota nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi anɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, kaashe amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi gbeyei ni kaahã hiŋmɛi ni amɛkɛbaakwɛ bo lɛ miihao bo; ejaakɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni. 7Bo lɛ ŋɔɔ miwiemɔ lɛ ohã amɛ; amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, na ole akɛ toigbolɔi ji amɛ.’ ”
8“Shi, bo gbɔmɔ adesa, bo nɔ ni mikɛɔ bo lɛ toi; kaafee ohe toigbolɔ tamɔ nakai toigbolɔi amaŋbii lɛ; gbɛɛ odaaŋ ni oye nɔ ni mikɛhãa bo nɛɛ.” 9Ni be ni mikwɛ lɛ mina nine ni akpã mli ni hiɛ wolokpo ni aŋma nii yɛ mli ni akɛmiihã mi. 10 Egbele mli elɛɛ shi yɛ mihiɛ. Aŋma nii yɛ ehiɛ kɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ; ni aŋma yaafo kɛ awerɛho kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli wiemɔi yɛ mli.

Title: EZEKIEL 3
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni gbee lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, nɔ ni akɛhã bo lɛ ye; ye wolokpo nɛɛ, ni oya ni okɛ Israel we lɛ ayawie.”
2Kɛkɛ ni migbɛ midaaŋ, ni ekɛ wolokpo lɛ hã mi ni maye. 3 Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, ye wolokpo ni mikɛhã bo lɛ; ye, ni okɛwo omusu obɔ̃ tɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni miye; ni eŋɔɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo.
4Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, yiŋ ni oya Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ ni okɛ miwiemɔ lɛ ayahã amɛ; 5ejaakɛ mɛi aŋɔɔ ni mitsuɔ bo lɛ, amɛjeee mɛi ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ ko ni wa; shi moŋ miitsu bo Israelbii aŋɔɔ. 6Amɛjeee majimaji babaoo ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ ni wa, ni onuuu shishi. Anɔkwa, kɛji nakai gbɔmɛi aŋɔɔ tete po mitsu bo lɛ, amɛaabo bo toi. 7Shi Israel we lɛ boŋ bo toi, ejaakɛ amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ amɛboɔ mi toi; ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti ni amɛtsui hu wa. 8 Naa, mihã ohiɛ etsii hu fe amɛhiɛ, ni ohiɛ hu ewa fe amɛhiɛ. 9Bɔ ni daiamɔnd wa fe tswɛrɛbo lɛ, nakai mihã ohiɛ ewa fe amɛhiɛ. Kaashe amɛ gbeyei, ni kaahã hiŋmɛi ni amɛkɛbaakwɛ bo lɛ miihao bo; ejaakɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni.” 10Gbee lɛ saa ekɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, bo miwiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛ bo wieɔ lɛ toi, ni okɛto otsuiŋ. 11Agbɛnɛ yi mli ni oya omaŋbii ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Amɛbo bo toi jio, amɛbooo bo toi jio bo lɛ okɛɛ amɛ.’ ” 12 Agbɛnɛ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko gbɛɛmɔ yɛ misɛɛgbɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ, ni gbee lɛ kɛɛ, “Jiemɔ miijie Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anunyam lɛ yi yɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ.” 13Nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su lɛ afiji ni saa eko kɛ eko he lɛ agbɛɛmɔ kɛ kokolontoi ni yɔɔ amɛŋmawuiaŋ lɛ amli gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ kpeteŋkple. 14Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ewo mi kɛtee. Mitee kɛ mlila ni naawa naakpa. 15Kɛkɛ ni miba nomii ni yɔɔ Kebar Faa lɛ naa yɛ Tel-Abib lɛ aŋɔɔ; ni miho mita shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni minaa ekpɛ mihe gbii kpawo sɔŋŋ.
Yehowa to Ezekiel bulɔ
(Ezekiel 33.1-9)
16Gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 17 “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mito bo bulɔ mihã Israel we lɛ; ni be fɛɛ be ni ooonu minaa wiemɔ lɛ, obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ohã mi.
18“Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, gbo ooogbo, ni obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni osaa owieee otsɔ̃ɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ ni eje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni ehere eyiwala lɛ, nakai efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ baagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, shi elá lɛ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mabi shi yɛ. 19Shi kɛji obɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni ekpaaa efɔŋ lɛ feemɔ, ni ejeee egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ mli nɛ, shi bo lɛ ohere oyiwala.
20 “Miikɛ bo ekoŋŋ akɛ, kɛji mɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni ja kpa ejalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ, ni efee nɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, ni mito lɛ pampi lɛ, ebaagbo; ejaakɛ obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, ni ejalɛ nii ni efee pɛŋ lɛ akaiŋ; shi elá lɛ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mabi shi yɛ.
21“Shi kɛ̃lɛ, kɛji obɔ mɔ ni feɔ jalɛ nii lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekafee esha, ni efeee esha lɛ, no lɛ eyi baana wala ejaakɛ ebo kɔkɔbɔɔ toi, ni bo hu ohere oyiwala.”
Ezekiel baatɔ mu
22Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni jɛi mikɛ bo aya wie yɛ.” 23Hewɔ lɛ mite shi ni mitee jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni naa, Yehowa anunyam lɛ ni tamɔ anunyam ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ yɛ jɛi. Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi. 24Shi Mumɔ lɛ babote mimli ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni ekɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaŋa oyi owo owe lɛ. 25Ni bo, gbɔmɔ adesa naa, akɛ kpãi baashwie onɔ ni akɛfi bo, koni okanyɛ oje kpo otee mɛi ateŋ. 26Asaŋ mahã olilɛi akpɛtɛ odaaŋ, ni otɔ mu bɔ ni afee ni okanyɛ okã amɛ; tsɛbelɛ toigbolɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ. 27Shi kɛji mikɛ bo bawie ekoŋŋ lɛ, magbele onaa ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni sumɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ebo toi, ni mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ekabo toi; ejaakɛ toigbolɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ.’ ”

Title: EZEKIEL 4
Content:
Ezekiel fee ehe tamɔ Yerusalɛm tualɔ
1Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, kɔ ntayaa ni okɛfɔ ohiɛ, ni otɛŋ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yɛ nɔ. 2Tɛŋmɔ nibii nɛɛ kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe: kawoo gbogbo kɛ mɔji kɛ kpoku kɛ tabilɔi ni baatua maŋ lɛ, kɛ gbogbokuumɔ nibii ni mamɔ he. 3Okɛ dade ni atswia lɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ afee gbogbo koni efo bo okɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ; ni ojie ohiɛ oka lɛ. Ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ atua maŋ lɛ, ni bo otuaa maŋ lɛ nɛɛ. Enɛ ji okadi hã Israelbii lɛ.
4“Agbɛnɛ kã obɛku nɔ, ni okɛ Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔ lɛ aŋmɛ onɔ ni gbii abɔ ni okã obɛku nɔ lɛ obaatere amɛtɔmɔ lɛ. 5Miiŋɔ amɛ afii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu toigbalamɔ be lɛ mafee gbii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu mahã bo. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ obaatere Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔ lɛ. 6Kɛ ogbe nakai gbii lɛ anaa lɛ, obaakã shi ekoŋŋ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, agbɛnɛ lɛ kã oninejurɔ nɔ, ni okɛtere Yuda we lɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ. Mihao gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni okɛkã shi, ni gbi kome lɛ afi ni.
7“Jiemɔ ohiɛ oka Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ; ni ojie onine he efolo koni ogba oshi lɛ. 8Mikɛ kpãi baafimɔ bo akpɛtɛ shi, ni onyɛŋ ohe otsɔ̃ kɛjɛ abɛku nɔ kɛya ninejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi be ni ooogbe okawoo gbii lɛ anaa dã.
9“Agbɛnɛ, ŋɔɔ ŋmãa kɛ akoko kɛ akpatramɔ kɛ yɔɔ kɛ blɔfoakoko kɛ abele, ni okɛwo nɔ kome mli, ni okɛshã aboloo ohã ohe. Ye aboloo nɛɛ be ni okã obɛku nɔ gbii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu lɛ. 10Oniyenii ni obaaye lɛ ŋmɛɛ kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ gbi kome; ye nii shi kome daa gbi. 11Ni nu hu ni obaanu lɛ susumɔ kpuji enyɔ; nuu nu shi kome daa gbi. 12Ni okɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ afee lai ni okɛshã akoko aboloo lɛ, ni oye yɛ amɛhiɛ.”
13Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai pɛ Israelbii lɛ baaye amɛniyenii ni amɛhiɔ lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei, ni mashwie amɛ kɛya lɛ.”
14 Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mibuleko mihe dã, kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ aahu kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ. Miyeko nɔ ko ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo loo kooloo ko tserɛ lɛ dã. Asaŋ hu loo ko ni ahiɔ esako minaa dã.
15Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, mahã okɛ tsina wamɔ ashã oboloo lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ najiaŋ.”
16 Esaa ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, mahã niyenii he asɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛkɛ tsuiyeli baaŋmɛ aboloo amɛye, ni amɛkɛ hejaramɔ baasusu nu amɛnu. 17Mafee enɛ koni aboloo kɛ nu he ahia amɛ, ni amɛbaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhe kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ, ni amɛaatãra loo yɛ amɛtoigbalamɔ mli.”

Title: EZEKIEL 5
Content:
Ezekiel ku eyi
1Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɔ klante ni naa ba ni okɛfee yikulɔi asooyi, ni okɛshɛ oyi kɛ otsɛŋ. Agbɛnɛ kɔ nsɛni ni oŋmɛ tsɔi lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli, ni oja mli etɛ̃. 2Mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, shãa yɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, be ni agbe kawoo gbii lɛ anaa lɛ. Kɔ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ni okɛ klante afolɔ mli dukuduku be ni obɔleɔ maŋ lɛ kɛkpe lɛ; ni okɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni eshwɛ lɛ ashwã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli, ni magbala klante kɛnyiɛ sɛɛ. 3Ŋɔɔ yitsɔi lɛ fioo ko kɛkɛ ni okɛŋmɔ otade lɛ naa. 4Ŋɔɔ no nɔŋŋ mli eko ni oshɛrɛ oshwie la lɛ mli ni oshã. La baajɛ enɛ mli ebote Israel we lɛ fɛɛ.”
5Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, “Yerusalɛm nɛ; mikɛ lɛ ema majimaji ateŋ, ni shikpɔji krokomɛi ebɔle he kɛkpe. 6Yerusalɛm eku mimlai lɛ amli fe majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ; eku mimlai wuji lɛ hu amli fe shikpɔji krokomɛi ni bɔle ehe kɛkpe lɛ. Ekwa mimlai lɛ ni eyeee mikpɔi lɛ hu anɔ. 7No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ nɛ, “Nyɛfeɔ basabasa fe majimaji krokomɛi ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyeee akpɔi kɛ mlai ni miwo nyɛ lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛye jeŋmaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ moŋ amlai lɛ anɔ lɛ, 8hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Naa, mi, mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛ bo ena, mi magbala otoi yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ. 9Musubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mafee bo nɔ ko ni mifeko dã, ni asaŋ mifeŋ enɔ eko dɔŋŋ. 10 No hewɔ lɛ, tsɛmɛi baagbe amɛbii amɛye yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni bihii baagbe amɛtsɛmɛi amɛye; magbala nyɛtoi! Hiɛkãalɔi ni baashwɛ lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
11 “Asaŋ gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛni okɛ taŋtaŋnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ musubɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ ebule mihekrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ makpãtã ohiɛ; mikuŋ mihiɛ mifɔŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ; ni minaŋ bo mɔbɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. 12Gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ baaplene oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome yɛ omli, mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ maŋ lɛ sɛɛ; ni oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ni mafã klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ. 13Bɔ ni mimlifu naa aaawa ahã nɛ, ni mimli baawo amɛ la waa; ni matɔ mihe owele; koni amɛna amɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie yɛ miwuŋayeli naa, be ni mimli fu amɛ waa lɛ. 14Asaŋ mahã otsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ ahorabɔɔ nɔ yɛ majimaji ni bɔle bo lɛ ateŋ, kɛ mɛi hu ni hoɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
15 “Kɛ mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila kojo bo lɛ, magbala otoi, ni oootsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔ nɔ kɛ heguɔgbee nɔ kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ nɔ kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ nɔ ohã jeŋmaji ni bɔle ohe kɛkpe lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, miwie enɛ. 16 Be ni mikɛ hɔmɔ aaakpãtã ohiɛ tamɔ gãimlibii ni atsɛ̃rɛ kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ, no ni hɔmɔ aaaye bo waa, mi mafo nyɛniyenii namɔ sɛɛ.
17 Mibahã hɔmɔ kɛ kooloi awuyelɔi aba nyɛnɔ ni amɛaakpakpaa obii lɛ yɛ ohe kɛya, ni gbele hela kɛ láshishwiemɔ hu aaaba, ni mikɛ ta aaabakpãtã ohiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 6
Content:
Yehowa miihi wɔŋjamɔ
1 Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
2“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ, ni ogba oshi amɛ ni okɛɛ akɛ, 3Nyɛ Israel gɔji, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ toi. Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi kɛ nujɔi kɛ jɔi voovoi lɛ nɛ. Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mafã klante mawo nyɛ, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ lɛ. 4 Nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aaakumɔ nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ. Mashɛrɛ nyɛmɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ mashwie nyɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ.”
5Mikɛ Israelbii lɛ agbohii lɛ aaashwie amɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni magbɛ gbohii lɛ awui lɛ mashwã nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe.
6Hei fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛmaji lɛ aaatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni aaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, abaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ baakpãtã. Abaakumɔ nyɛmãgãi lɛ, ni abaakpãtã hiɛ, ni nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, abaakumɔ, ni nyɛnitsumɔi lɛ abaagu. 7Mɛi aaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ nyɛteŋ. No nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji, Yehowa.
8 “Shi mashwɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hiɛkãalɔi. Nyɛaana mɛi komɛi ni eje klante naa gbele mli yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ. Kɛji agbɛ nyɛ ashwã majimaji lɛ anɔ lɛ, 9 no lɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ aaakai mi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee lɛ. Kɛji mikumɔ amɛyiŋ flɛflɛ tsuii ni hã amɛkɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ yanyiɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, amɛaanyaŋe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe yɛ nifɔɔjianii kɛ musubɔɔ nii ni amɛfee lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ. 10No dani amɛaana amɛle lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, jeee wiemɔ folo kɛkɛ miwie akɛ mafee amɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ.”
11Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Tswaa odɛ̃ ni okɛ onane ashi shi, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kpoo ha Israel we lɛ yɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii fɔ̃ji lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ. Amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela naa.’ 12Mɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ gbele hela baagbe lɛ, ni mɔ ni bɛŋkɛ hu baagbo yɛ klante naa, ni mɔ ni abaa eyi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu, hɔmɔ baagbe lɛ. Bɔ ni mimlifu ni naawa lɛ baatsu amɛhe nii kɛyata nɛ. 13 Ni nyɛaana nyɛle mi, akɛ mi ji Yehowa, be ni nyɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ lɛ jwere nyɛwɔji lɛ ateŋ yɛ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe; ekomɛi aaajwere gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ gɔji fɛɛ ayiteiaŋ hu, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi, kɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso fɛɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso kusuu shishi; he fɛɛ he ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amɛwɔji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ mɛi aaajwere jɛi. 14Mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ yɛ amɛshihilɛhei lɛ fiaa kwa, ni mafite amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni mafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛjɛ shiaŋa ni yɔɔ ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ kɛyaashi Ribla yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ; no dani amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”

Title: EZEKIEL 7
Content:
Israel naagbee ebɛŋkɛ
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, 2“Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɛ: Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ naagbee lɛ eshɛ! Shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anaagbee lɛ eshɛ etã. 3Naagbee lɛ ebanina bo, ni majie mimlifu lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ bo agbɛnɛ, ni makojo bo yɛ ojeŋba naa; ni magbala otoi yɛ omusubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ hewɔ. 4Bei abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.
5“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, amanehulu nyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ kɛmiiba. 6Naa eeba, naagbee lɛ eshɛ; naagbee lɛ eba kɛ̃, eshɛ etã, ete shi ewo bo. Naa eeba. 7 Naa eeba! Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii nyɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ enina nyɛ! Be lɛ eshɛ; gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, gbi ni abaanu bolɔmɔ, ni ejeee miishɛɛ bolɔmɔ, shi moŋ hejaramɔ bolɔmɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
8“Agbɛnɛ etsɛŋ ni mafɔse mimlila lɛ mashwie onɔ, ni mafã mimlifu kɛ eshishi fɛɛ mashwie onɔ, ni magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba naa, ni mikɛ bo aaaye kɛ joomɔ yɛ omusubɔɔ nibii lɛ fia ahewɔ. 9Be abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa ni tswaa mɔ nɔ lɛ. 10 Naa, gbi lɛ nɛ! Naa, eeba! Ohiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ eshɛ toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli egba afofro; ni hewoo hu egba ahwanya. 11Yitsoŋwalɛ eda aahu esa etsɔ̃ dade. Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛninamɔ kɛ amɛnunyam fɛɛ lɛ ekoeko eshwɛŋ. 12Be lɛ eshɛ, gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. Nihelɔ akanya, ni nihɔɔlɔ lɛ hu akaye ŋkɔmɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kã asafo lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ. 13 Jarayelɔ ko ni yɔɔ wala mli lolo lɛ eyaŋ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ he dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kã asafo mu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu nɛɛ ekpaleŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hereŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala yɛ nishaianii ni efee lɛ hewɔ. 14 Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, afee kralo hu atã; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa ta lɛ, ejaakɛ mimli efu asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ.”
Israel maŋ lɛ he eshai ahenyɔmɔwoo
15“Aawuu yɛ gbɛjegbɛi anɔ, gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ yɛ shĩa mli; mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ nyɔɔ yɛ klante naa; mɔ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela kpãtãa ehiɛ. 16Shi kɛji hiɛkãalɔi komɛi aaaje mli lɛ, amɛaayahi gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ okpoi ni jɛ jɔɔ mli. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baaye ehe esha he ŋkɔmɔ. 17Nijiaŋ fɛɛ tswɛm baaje wui, ni nakutsei fɛɛ tswɛm baakpokpo tamɔ ayawa mli nu. 18Amɛaabumɔ kpekpe, ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛ, amɛyiteaŋ aaakpa ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi hu. 19 Amɛjwiɛtɛi lɛ amɛaashɛrɛ amɛshwie blohuiaŋ, ni amɛaabu amɛshika lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni anyaŋeɔ. Amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika lɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ. Nomɛi haŋ amɛtɔrɔ, ni ehaŋ amɛmusu ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ etsɔ̃ pampi ehã amɛ. 20Amɛjwinei fɛɛfɛji ni amɛkɛsaa amɛhe kɛtaoɔ yaka anunyam lɛ, amɛkɛfee amɛmusubɔɔ amãgãi kɛ nibii ni ahiɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, miha etsɔ̃ nɔ ko ni he tseee ehã amɛ.
21“Mikɛ amɛnii aaawo mɛi kpɔji adɛŋ koni amɛhã; ni maha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ aŋɔ akɛ nomnii, ni amɛaabule lɛ. 22Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã koni amɛbule mihe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; julɔi aaabote mli ni amɛaabule lɛ ni amɛaafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
23“Akɛni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ lashishwiemɔ, ni maŋ lɛ mli eyi tɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ, 24mahã majimaji lɛ ateŋ mɛi fɔ̃ji fe fɛɛ abaŋɔ amɛshĩai lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ. Mibafo amɛhewalɛ ni amɛkɛshwãa lɛ sɛɛ; ni aaabule amɛhei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. 25Kɛ hejaramɔ ba lɛ amɛaatao toiŋjɔlɛ, shi amɛnaŋ eko. 26Amanehulu aaanyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ; akɛɛ akɛɛ sane aaanyiɛ akɛɛ akɛɛ sane sɛɛ. Amɛbaabi gbalɔ lɛ ni egba amɛ ninaa, nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ tete ahiɛ lɛ, mla lɛ jeee fɛifɛi, ni onukpai lɛ wooo ŋaa kpakpa. 27Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaaye ŋkɔmɔ. Ni lumɔ lɛ nijiaŋ aaaje wui, ni gbeyei aaahã gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he aaakpokpo. Bɔ ni amɛjeŋba yɔɔ lɛ nakai mikɛ amɛ baaye; ni bɔ ni amɛkojoɔ mɛi lɛ nakai makojo amɛ; ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi mi ji Yehowa.”

Title: EZEKIEL 8
Content:
GBALƆ EZEKIEL NINAA NI JI ENYƆ YƐ NYƆŊMƆ HE
(8.1—10.22)
Amãgãjamɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm
1 Israelbii anomŋɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be ni mita miwe lɛ, ni Yuda onukpai lɛ tara mihiɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa hewalɛ yi minɔ yɛ jɛi.
2 Mikwɛ, ni naa, mina nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ. Kɛjɛ ehɛgbɛ kɛbaa eshishigbɛ su lɛ anaa lɛ tamɔ la; ni kɛjɛ ehɛgbɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛigbɛ su lɛ kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he. 3Ekpã nɔ ko ni esu tamɔ nine mli ni ekɛmɔ̃ miyiteŋ tsɔi ni efi tɔo lɛ mli. Mumɔ lɛ wo minɔ kɛtee shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi teŋ, ni ekɛ mi tee Yerusalɛm yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he ninai lɛ amli. Ekɛ mi ba mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo ni kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ shinaa lɛ naa, he ni amãgã ni hãa Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ awuŋã lɛ ma lɛ.
4 Ni naa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ kpɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ ninaa ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ.
5Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ kooyigbɛ.” Ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni naa, afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, nakai amãgã lɛ ni haa Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ awuŋã lɛ ma jɛi.
6Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, oona nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ? Musubɔɔnii wuji ni Israelbii lɛ feɔ yɛ biɛ bɔ ni afee ni maje mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛya sɛɛ shɔŋŋ. Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii wuji krokomɛi ni fe enɛ.”
7Ekɛ mi ba kpo lɛ nɔ shinaa lɛ naa, ni be ni mikwɛ lɛ mina folɔ ko yɛ gbogbo lɛ mli. 8Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbuu gbogbo lɛ mli.” Ni be ni migbu gbogbo lɛ mli lɛ mina shinaa ko. 9Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Botemɔ mli ni oyakwɛ nɔ musubɔɔnii ni amɛfeɔ yɛ biɛ.” 10 No hewɔ lɛ, mibote mli ni miyakwɛ; ni mina akɛ atɛŋ waamɔnii kɛ kooloi ni ahiɔ srɔtoi abɔ, kɛ Israel we lɛ wɔji lɛ fɛɛ amɛfonirii yɛ gbogbo lɛ he kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
11Ni Israel we lɛ mli hii onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo damɔ wɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni Shafan bi Yaazania damɔ amɛteŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ etsofakɛŋmashaa ŋɛsu yɛ edɛŋ, ni tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi tamɔ atatu. 12 Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, oona nɔ ni Israel we lɛ onukpai lɛ feɔ yɛ dujiaŋ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miija amãgãi yɛ esɛɛtsu mli lo? Nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Yehowa enaaa wɔ. Yehowa ekwa shikpɔŋ lɛ.’ ”
13Ekɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii krokomɛi ni fe enɛ ni amɛfeɔ.” 14Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba Yehowa shĩa lɛ agbo lɛ shinaa ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ naa; ni naa, yei tara jɛi ni amɛmiifo jemawɔŋ Tamuz. 15Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ona enɛ? Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii wuji ni fe enɛɛmɛi.” 16 Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba Yehowa we lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ; ni naa, yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ koi lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ, hii aaafee nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛtsɔmɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, be mli ni amɛhiɛiaŋ miikwɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, amɛmiija hulu yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ.
17Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ona enɛ? Ani nihiinii ni Yuda we lɛ feɔ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ efaaa ehãaa amɛ lo? Ni amɛhã yiwalɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ kɛmiiwo mimli la amɛfata he nɛɛ lo? Naa, amɛmaa mi gɔnti amɛjɛɔ mi. 18 No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baaye kɛ joomɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa. Mihaŋ amɛŋɔ amɛhe amɛye; minaŋ amɛ mɔbɔ. Amɛaabolɔ amɛwo mitoiŋ kɛ gbee ni wa shi miboŋ amɛ toi.”

Title: EZEKIEL 9
Content:
Agbala Yerusalɛm toi
1Minu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Nyɛbaa biɛ, nyɛ, maŋ blafoi; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahiɛ gbɔmɔgbee dade yɛ edɛŋ.” 2 Ni naa, hii ekpaa jɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ agbo ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ naagbɛ amɛba. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ emɔgbee dade yɛ edɛŋ. Nuu ko hu fata amɛhe ni ewo niyɛŋ, ni etsotsoro nɔ ko ni nibii ni akɛŋmãa nii yɛ mli. Amɛtee mli ni amɛyadamɔ akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi.
3Agbɛnɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ wo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ bɔɔ nibii kɛ amɛfiji lɛ anɔ, he ni eyɔɔ lɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ shi: Etsɛ nuu lɛ ni wo niyɛŋ ni etsotsoro nɔ ko ni akɛŋmãa nii lɛ. 4 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaakpa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ; hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi ni amɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ musubɔɔnii ni afeɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kadimɔ amɛhiɛnai.”
5Ni minu akɛ ekɛɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛkpaa maŋ lɛ mli; nyɛtswiaa mɛi anii; nyɛkakua nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa nɔ ko nɔ, ni nyɛkanaa mɔbɔ hu. 6 Nyɛgbea onukpai kɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ yei blublu, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akadi ehiɛnaa lɛ, lɛ lɛ nyɛkataa ehe. Nyɛjea shishi kɛjɛa mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbɔi kɛjɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ lɛ anɔ.
7Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbulea Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni egboi lɛ agbohii lɛ ashwiea kpoi lɛ anɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃. Agbɛnɛ, nyɛjea kpo!” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛbote maŋ lɛ mli amɛyatswia mɛi anii ni amɛgbe amɛ.
8 Be ni amɛgbeɔ mɛi lɛ ni ashi mikome too lɛ, miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi ni mibo mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ, Yehowa ani ookpãtã Israel mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ omli ni efu Yerusalɛm waa lɛ naa lo?”
9Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Israel kɛ Yuda efee esha kpele, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ lashishwiemɔ, ni toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli hu eyi maŋ lɛ mli obɔ̃; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ekwa shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni Yehowa enaaa wɔ.’ 10No hewɔ lɛ, mihaŋ mɔ ko aŋɔ ehe aye; minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi moŋ mahã amɛmusu abua amɛyiteŋ.”
11Ni naa, nuu lɛ ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ, mɔ ni tsotsoro nɔ ko ni nibii ni akɛŋmãa nii yɔɔ mli lɛ, ku esɛɛ eba, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, “Mifee bɔ ni ofã mi lɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 10
Content:
Yehowa anunyam lɛ je Sɔlemɔ we lɛ
1 Agbɛnɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa nɔ ko pue yɛ atatu ni yɔɔ bɔɔ nibii lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ lɛ mli, nɔ lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi ni akɛ safiro ojarawatɛ fee.
2 Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nuu lɛ ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa kokolontoi ni yɔɔ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ashishi lɛ ateŋ ni oyakpiti ŋai ni miitso owo okɔkɔi amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni okɛshwã maŋ lɛ mli.” Ni etee yɛ mihiɛ.
3Adebɔɔ nibii lɛ damɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ wuoyigbɛ he ni nuu lɛ bote mli yɛ lɛ; kɛkɛ ni atatu ko yi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ tɔ. 4 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ kpɛmɔ lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ bɔɔ nibii lɛ anɔ kɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni atatu lɛ yi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ obɔ̃, ni Yehowa anunyam kpɛmɔ lɛ yi kpo lɛ nɔ obɔ̃.
5Anu adebɔɔ nibii lɛ afijiaŋ gbɛɛmɔ lɛ yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ. Ni gbɛɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ gbee kɛji eewie lɛ.
6Be ni Yehowa fã nuu ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakpiti la ni yɔɔ kokolontoi lɛ ateŋ, yɛ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ”, etee kpo lɛ nɔ, ni eyadamɔ kokolontoi lɛ ateŋ ekome masɛi. 7Kɛkɛ ni adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ateŋ ekome kpã enine mli kɛjɛ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ateŋ ewo la ni yɔɔ adebɔɔ nibii ateŋ lɛ mli, ni ekpiti la lɛ eko, ni ekɛwo nuu ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ kɔkɔiaŋ; nuu lɛ he, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo.
8Mina akɛ adebɔɔ nibii nɛɛ yɛ niji tamɔ gbɔmɛi aniji yɛ amɛfiji lɛ ashishi. 9 Mikwɛ ni mina akɛ kokolontoi ejwɛ yɛ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ahe; kokolonto kome yɛ bɔɔnɔ kome he. Kokolontoi lɛ ahe kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ ojarawatɛ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ krisolito lɛ.
10Kɛji okwɛ amɛ lɛ, kokolontoi ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ su kome, tamɔ nɔ ni eko hɔ eko mli. 11Kɛji nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɛi asu lɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, amɛnyiɛɔ amɛkoji ejwɛ lɛ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe. Shi moŋ koŋ fɛɛ koŋ kokolonto lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni ayaa lɛ, lɛ esɛɛ ekrokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛɔ kɛyaa; ni ekrokomɛi lɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔɔ amɛhe kɛji amɛmiinyiɛ. 12 Hiŋmɛii yɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ fɛɛ ahe: amɛkotosɛɛ kɛ amɛniji ahe kɛ amɛfiji ahe fɛɛ hiŋmɛii sɔŋŋ. Kokolontoi ni adebɔɔ nibii ejwɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ tete ahe eyi obɔ̃ kɛ hiŋmɛii sɔŋŋ.
13Ni kokolontoi lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minu kɛ mitoi akɛ atsɛ amɛ ni amɛtsɔmɔ̃ɔɔ amɛhe.
14 Nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɛi asu nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ hiɛ lɛ tsinanuu hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ jata hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ okropɔŋ hiɛ ni.
15Kɛkɛ ni bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛhe nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ. Enɛɛmɛi ji nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ. 16Kɛji bɔɔ nibii lɛ miinyiɛ lɛ kokolontoi lɛ hu nyiɛɔ, ni kɛ bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ ni amɛfliki kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ koklomɔ. 17Kɛji bɔɔ nibii lɛ wa damɔ shi lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ kokolontoi lɛ hu ewa kɛdamɔ shi, kɛ amɛfliki kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ amɛkɛ kokolontoi lɛ fɛɛ yaa ŋwɛi, ejaakɛ bɔɔ nibii lɛ amumɔ yɛ amɛmli.
18Agbɛnɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ je Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni eyadamɔ bɔɔ nibii lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ. 19Miikwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ, ni amɛfliki kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee, ni kokolontoi lɛ kpɛtɛ amɛhe. Amɛyadamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ kpɛ yɛ amɛnɔ. 20Nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɛi asu ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shishi lɛ nɛ; miyoo akɛ bɔɔ nibii ni.
21Amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ kɛ fiji hu ejwɛ; ni nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ niji yɛ amɛfiji lɛ ashishi. 22Shi amɛhiɛi lɛ tamɔ hiɛi ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ kɛyaa ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 11
Content:
Abu Yerusalɛm fɔ
1Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni ekɛ mi tee Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ naa. Ni naa, mina hii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Azur bi Yaazania kɛ Benaia bi Pelatia, maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ.
2Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni toɔ yiŋshai, ni amɛwoɔ ŋai gbohii yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ. 3Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Be ni akɛmaa tsu shɛko. Maŋ nɛɛ tamɔ dadesɛŋ ni ma la nɔ, ni wɔji emli loo lɛ.’ 4No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi amɛ.”
5Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ yi minɔ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, ‘Nyɛ Israelbii, nakai nyɛsusuɔ; mile nibii ni nyɛsusuɔ yɛ nyɛyitseiaŋ fɛɛ. 6Nyɛha mɛi ni nyɛgbegbee lɛ ayi efa yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni eblohuiaŋ eyi tɔ kɛ gbohii babaoo.’ ”
7No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, “Mɛi ni nyɛgbegbee nyɛshwie maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛ ji loo lɛ, ni maŋ nɛɛ ji dadesɛŋ lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, abaashwie nyɛ kɛje maŋ nɛɛ mli.” 8Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛshe klante gbeyei, shi klante nɔŋŋ mahã afa awo nyɛyi. 9Mibashwie nyɛ kɛbaaje maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni mikɛ nyɛ baawo gbɔi adɛŋ, ni makojo nyɛ. 10 Ni klante naa nɔŋŋ nyɛanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ; makojo nyɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ husu nɔ, ni nyɛkɛaana nyɛle akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa. 11Maŋ nɛɛ tsɔŋ dadesɛŋ ehaŋ nyɛ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛtsɔŋ emli loo. Mikɛ nyɛ baaye yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ husui lɛ fɛɛ anaa. 12Ni nyɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa, ejaakɛ nyɛhiko shi yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbako nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ anaa; shi moŋ maŋsɛɛbii ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ moŋ amlai lɛ anɔ nyɛye.”
13Ni eba mli akɛ be ni migbaa lɛ, Benaia bi Pelatia tswa shi egbo trukaa. Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, ni mibo waa akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ani obaakpãtã mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ?”
Nyɔŋmɔ wo nomii lɛ ashi
14Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, 15“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ miiwie bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi, ojakubii ni ji Israelbii fɛɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ahe. Amɛkɛɛ, ‘Nomii lɛ eyaje shɔŋŋ bɔ ni amɛnyɛŋ Yehowa amɛja. Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ehã wɔ akɛ wɔnɔ.’
16 “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ nomii lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, yɛŋ akɛ mijie amɛ kɛtee shɔŋŋ kɛyafutu maji krokomɛi amli bii, ni migbɛ amɛ mishwã shikpɔji anɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsɔ̃ teemɔhe krɔŋkrɔŋ mihã amɛ be fioo ko kɛ̃ yɛ hei ni amɛtee lɛ.” 17 “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mikɛɛ nɛ, mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ maji amli ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ, shikpɔji hu ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba, ni maŋɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ maha amɛ.’ 18Ni kɛji amɛba lɛ amɛaajie taŋtaŋnii kɛ musubɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛaaje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 19Ni mahã amɛ tsui kroko, ni mikɛ mumɔ hee baawo amɛmli; majie amɛtsui ni wa tamɔ tɛ lɛ kɛje amɛmli ni mahã amɛ loo tsui; 20 bɔ ni afee ni amɛba amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni amɛye mimlai lɛ anɔ, koni amɛtsɔ̃ miwebii ni mi hu matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ. 21Shi mɛi ni atsui nyiɛ taŋtaŋnii kɛ musubɔɔnii asɛɛ lɛ, magbala amɛtoi, ni mahã amɛsɔ̃ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ je Yerusalɛm
22Kɛkɛ ni bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ, ni kokolontoi lɛ kɛ amɛ hole amɛhe nɔ, ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ shĩ yɛ amɛyiteŋgbɛ. 23 Yehowa anunyam lɛ wo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, kɛtee gɔŋ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.
24Mina yɛ ninaa lɛ mli akɛ Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni ekɛ mi tee nomii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon; kɛkɛ ni mumɔ lɛ je minɔ. 25Kɛkɛ ni migba nomii lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa jie kpo tsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 12
Content:
Gbalɔ lɛ yaba abo
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, 2 “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛi ni toi egbo ateŋ oyɔɔ lɛ; shi amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii; amɛyɛ toii hu shi amɛnuuu nii, ejaakɛ maŋ ni toi egbo ji amɛ.”
3No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ adesa, too onibii tamɔ mɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom, koni ofã shwane be ni amɛmiikwɛ bo. Jee he ni oyɔɔ lɛ kɛya he kroko ni amɛmiikwɛ bo. Eko lɛ amɛaakɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ sɛɛ, tsɛ, gbɔmɛi toigbolɔi ji amɛ. 4Okɛ onibii ni tamɔ nomŋɔɔ jatsu lɛ aje kpo shwane yɛ amɛhiɛ; shi yi mli gbɛkɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ tamɔ nɔ ni ooya nomŋɔɔ mli. 5Gbuu gbogbo lɛ mli yɛ amɛhiɛ koni otsɔ̃ jɛi kɛje kpo yɛ amɛhiɛ. 6 Kɛji hiɛ bu lɛ, wo ogbɛfaa jatsu lɛ otswa okɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ ni okɛje kpo. Haa ohiɛ koni okana shikpɔŋ ni oyaa nɔ lɛ. Mikɛ bo miito okadi mahã Israel we lɛ.
7Kɛkɛ ni mifee bɔ ni Yehowa fã mi lɛ. Mikɛ minibii lɛ je kpo shwane tamɔ mɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom, ni gbɛkɛ mli lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbu gbogbo lɛ mli; ni be ni hiɛ bu lɛ miwo mijatsu lɛ mitswa mikɔŋ ni mije kpo yɛ amɛhiɛ.
8Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, 9“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ani Israel we lɛ, ni ji toigbolɔi awe lɛ, biko bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ lo?’ 10Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, nɔ ni ofee nɛɛ gbalɛ ni; ni ekɔɔ lumɔ ni yeɔ nɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, kɛ Israel we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ahe. 11Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni ofee nɛɛ ji okadi hã amɛ; bɔ ni ofee otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ, nakai abaafee amɛ; abaaŋɔ amɛ nom, ni amɛbaatsɔmɔ nomii.’ 12 Amɛteŋ lumɔ lɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ, lɛ ebaawo ejatsu etswa ekɔŋ kɛje kpo be mli ni hiɛ ebu. Ebaatsɔ̃ gbogbo ni agbu aha lɛ mli kɛje kpo. Ebaaha ehiɛ, ni ekana shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni eyaa lɛ kɛ ehiŋmɛi.
13 “Maŋmɛ miyaa lɛ, ni eeedu lɛ tamɔ tsɔne, ni mikɛ lɛ baaba Babilon maŋ wulu lɛ mli. Shi jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ tete ehiŋmɛi enaŋ, tsɛbelɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ eeegbo yɛ. 14Mɛi fɛɛ ni ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ, kɛ eyelikɛbualɔi lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã kɔɔyɔŋ yɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni magbala klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.”
15“Kɛji migbɛ amɛ mishwã majimaji kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ no amɛkɛaale akɛ, mi mi ji Yehowa. 16Shi kɛ̃lɛ mashi mɛi fioo ko ni amɛaaje klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela gbele mli. Amɛaajaje nihiinii ni amɛfee lɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ majimaji ni amɛyaa mli lɛ anɔ, ni amɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Gbalɔ ni miikpokpo lɛ
17Yehowa saa ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ, 18“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye nii; kɛji ooye lɛ, ha ohe akpokpo ni kɛji oonu nu lɛ, ha ohe ajo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ. 19Kɛkɛ lɛ kɛɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ yɛ Yerusalɛmbii ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, amɛniyenii lɛ, tsuiyeli amɛkɛaaye, ni amɛnu lɛ hu, hejɔ̃mɔ amɛkɛaanu; ejaakɛ yiwalɛnii ni maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ fee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ aba niyenii dɔŋŋ. 20Maji ni ahi mli dã lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Abɛi ni ale kɛ gbalɛ ni aleee
21Yehowa kɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ, 22 “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛni ji abɛ ni nyɛbuɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ he akɛ, ‘Gbii miiho kɛmiiya, ni gbalɛ ko baaa mli lɛ?’ 23 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, mibaha nɛkɛ abɛ ni abuɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ afo, ni abuŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel.’ Shi moŋ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ be ni eshɛ, ni gbalɛ fɛɛ gbalɛ baana aba mli. 24Ejaakɛ amale ninaa ko ejeŋ kpo dɔŋŋ, ni gbalɛ ni akɛlakaa mɔ ko hu baŋ mli dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel we lɛ. 25Shi mi, Yehowa, mibawie, ni wiemɔ ni mibawie lɛ baaba mli. Atsiŋ atoŋ dɔŋŋ. Ao! Nyɛ toigbolɔi awe, nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ mibawie, ni mibafee hu. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
26Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, 27“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, Israelbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Oninaa lɛ yeɔ bei pii dani ebaa mli, ni ogbalɛi lɛ hu kɔɔ be ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ he.’ 28No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, atsiŋ miwiemɔ lɛ eko atoŋ dɔŋŋ, shi wiemɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ baaba mli. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 13
Content:
Agba ashi amale gbalɔi
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ, 2“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi Israel gbalɔi lɛ ni sɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbalɛi lɛ. Kɛɛmɔ gbalɔi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
3 Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Kpoo ha gbalɔi kwashiai lɛ ni nɔ ni amɛmumɔ kɛɔ amɛ lɛ, no amɛgbaa, tsɛ amɛnako nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ. 4Ao, Israelbii, nyɛgbalɔi lɛ etsɔmɔ osɔi ni hɔlɔ tsukoi amli. 5Amɛbuuu fɔji lɛ anaa, ni amɛtswaaa gbogbo amɛwooo Israel we lɛ he, bɔ ni eeenyɛ ekpee ta naa yɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ nɔ. 6 Amɛfoɔ amale saji amɛtãa, ni amɛgbaa amale gbalɛi. Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa kɛɛ,’ be mli ni Yehowa tsuko amɛ; ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpaa gbɛ akɛ amɛwiemɔi lɛ aba mli. 7Ani kɛji miwieko, shi nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa kɛɛ’ lɛ, no lɛ ani jeee yaka ninaa nyɛnaa, ni amale gbalɛ nyɛgbaa lɛ lo?”
8No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ amɛ nɛ, “Akɛni nyɛkɛɔ nibii ni bɛ mli, ni nyɛmaleɔ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mikɛ nyɛ ena; mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ. 9Mate shi mawo gbalɔi ni naa ninai ni bɛ mli, ni amɛmaleɔ lɛ; amɛhiŋ mimaŋ lɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ mli, ni asaŋ aŋmaŋ amɛgbɛii yɛ Israel we lɛ wolo lɛ mli, ni amɛyiŋ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu; ni nyɛkɛale akɛ mi, mi ji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa lɛ.
10 “Naa! Akɛni amɛlakaa mimaŋ lɛ akɛ ‘Omanye eba,’ be mli ni omanye ko bɛ lɛ. Mimaŋbii lɛ tswaa gbogbo ni amale gbalɔi lɛ shaa he kaaloo; 11Kɛɛmɔ mɛi ni kɛ kaaloo shaa gbogbo lɛ he lɛ akɛ ebaagbee shi. Nu baanɛ waa, nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji baanɛ, ni ahum baatswa, 12Ni no lɛ gbogbo lɛ baagbee shi; ani abiŋ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Kaaloo lɛ ni nyɛkɛsha gbogbo lɛ he lɛ, nɛgbɛ ehe sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ?’
13“No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mikɛ mlifu aaahã ahum atswa, ni mikɛ mlila aaahã nu anɛ waa, ni mahã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji aaanɛ kɛkpãtã nii ahiɛ. 14Makumɔ gbogbo ni nyɛkɛ kaaloo esha he lɛ mashwie shi; ni eshishitoo lɛ aaaje kpo faŋŋ. Eshigbeemɔ mli lɛ eeegbee nyɛ nɔ, ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
15“No ni mimli baafu gbogbo lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni sha he kaaloo lɛ. No ni makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ gbogbo lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni mɛi ni sha he lɛ hu bɛ dɔŋŋ, 16mɛi ni ji Israel gbalɔi ni gba yɛ Yerusalɛm he, ni amɛna omanye ninai yɛ ehe, tsɛbelɛ, omanye ko bɛ lɛ; mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ.”
Gbalɛ ni kɔɔ yei amale gbalɔi ahe
17Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo omaŋ lɛ mli biyei lɛ ni kaa amɛhiɛ amɛgbaa lɛ; gbaa oshi amɛ. 18Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, kpoo ha yei ni kpɛɔ sɛbɛi amɛŋmɔlɔɔ mɛi anijiashi, ni amɛkpɛɔ yitso fɛɛ yitso dalɛ he yiteŋhaa mama amɛhãa mɛi, ni amɛkɛlakaa gbɔmɛi kɛjeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee he. Ani nyɛbaadu miwebii lɛ, ni nyɛbaa susumai krokomɛi ayi yɛ nyɛsɛɛnamɔ hewɔ? 19Akoko dɛ kɔkɔi obɔ̃bɔ̃i kɛkɛ kɛ aboloo atrɔmai kɛkɛ ahewɔ lɛ, nyɛbuleɔ mi yɛ mimaŋ mli, ni nyɛgbeɔ mɛi ni esaaa akɛ amɛgboiɔ, ni nyɛhereɔ mɛi ni sa akɛ amɛgboi lɛ moŋ ayiwala. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmaleɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ni boɔ toi lɛ.”
20No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mitaooo sɛbɛi ni nyɛkɛlakaa mɛi lɛ, ni matserɛ amɛ yɛ nyɛnijiashi mashwie, ni mibaha susumai ni nyɛdu tamɔ loofɔji lɛ aye amɛhe. 21Ni matserɛ nyɛyiteŋhaa mamai lɛ hu, ni makpɔ̃ miwebii lɛ kɛjɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ni amɛhiŋ nyɛdɛŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
22 “Nyɛkɛ amale hãa jalɔ nijiaŋ jeɔ wui, tsɛbelɛ, mi lɛ mihako enijiaŋ aje wui; ni nyɛwoɔ mɔ fɔŋ moŋ ekãa, no hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ ekpale kɛje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ahere eyiwala. 23Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ lakamɔ ninai dɔŋŋ, ni klamɔ hu nyɛklaŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ makpɔ̃ mimaŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”

Title: EZEKIEL 14
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ miihi wɔŋjamɔ
1Agbɛnɛ Israel onukpai lɛ ekomɛi ba amɛbabi Yehowa nii. Amɛtara shi yɛ mihiɛ 2ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ 3 “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛtsuii eŋmɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛhã amɛnishaianii lɛ etsɔ̃ pampi ma amɛhiɛ. Ani esa akɛ maŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛbabi mi nii kwraa lo?”
4“No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ amɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Israel we ni kɛ etsui ŋmɛɔ emãgãi anɔ, ni ehaa enishaianii tsɔ̃ɔ pampi maa ehiɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ, ebaa gbalɔ ŋɔɔ ebabiɔ nii lɛ, mi, Yehowa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mahã lɛ hetoo yɛ emãgãi lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ naa, 5bɔ ni afee ni matsake Israelbii lɛ atsui, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛmãgãi lɛ anɔ amɛtse amɛhe kɛje mihe. 6 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuii ni nyɛkpalea kɛjea nyɛmãgãi lɛ ahe, ni nyɛjiea nyɛhe kɛjea nihiinii lɛ fɛɛ ahe.”
7“Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Israel we, loo gbɔi ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel he ko ni tseɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ mihe, ni ekɛ etsui ŋmɛɔ amãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni ehãa enishaianii tsɔ̃ɔ pampi ehaa lɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ ebaa gbalɔ ŋɔɔ ni ebi mi nii eha lɛ lɛ, mi, Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ maha lɛ hetoo. 8Majie mihiɛ maka nakai mɔ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ baafee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ni akɛbuɔ abɛ, ni majie lɛ yɛ miwebii lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛkɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
9 “Ni kɛji nɔ ko aaalaka gbalɔ lɛ ni ewie wiemɔ ko lɛ, belɛ mi, Yehowa, mi ji mɔ ni laka nakai gbalɔ lɛ, ni mikɛ lɛ aaaye; makpãtã ehiɛ kɛaaje mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. 10Abaagbala amɛ fɛɛ amɛtoi. Gbalɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yabiɔ gbalɔ lɛ nii lɛ fɛɛ aaana toigbalamɔ kome. 11Mibafee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni Israel we lɛ akatse amɛhe kɛmiije mihe ni amɛyadu gbɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛ nifɔɔjianii lɛ miibule amɛhe dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ amɛtsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mi hu matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.”
Noa, Daniel kɛ Hiob
12Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 13“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛji shikpɔŋ ko nɔ bii fee esha shi mi, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa, ni mite shi miwo amɛ, ni mifo amɛniyeniinamɔ sɛɛ, ni mihã hɔmɔ ba nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 14 kɛji nɛkɛ hii etɛ̃ nɛɛ, ni ji Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob, futu amɛ tete po lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ aaahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala; Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
15“Kɛji miha kooloi awuyelɔi bakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ̃ ni amɛplenee enɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ kɛhooo yɛ kooloi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, 16kɛji nɛkɛ jalɔi etɛ̃ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi tete lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ amɛbihii loo amɛbiyei po yiwala amɛhere. Amɛaahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
17“Aloo kɛji mifã klante miwo nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, akɛ klante akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, 18kɛji nɛkɛ hii jalɔi etɛ̃ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi tete lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ binuu loo biyoo po yiwala ahere; shi amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala amɛaahere.
19“Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛji mihã gbele hela ko ba nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ mlifu hã lá shwie shi koni makpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ lɛ; 20kɛji Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob tete po yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ nɛɛ, mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ akɛ amɛnyɛŋ amɛbihii loo amɛbiyei tete po ayiwala amɛhere; amɛkɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ baahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala.”
21 Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Te eeetamɔ tɛŋŋ kɛji miha nibii ejwɛ ni mikɛgbalaa toi, ni ji klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ kooloi awuiyelɔi kɛ gbele hela lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni miha amɛkpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ahiɛ yɛ mli?
22“Ni kɛji hiɛkãalɔi komɛi aaashwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛaanyɛ amɛhere amɛbihii kɛ biyei ayiwala lɛ, kɛji nakai bihii kɛ biyei lɛ ba nyɛŋɔɔ ni nyɛna amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔi pɛ, nyɛbaanu shishi akɛ toigbalamɔ ni mikɛba Yerusalɛm yɛ enifɔɔji anii ni efee lɛ he lɛ, esa lɛ. 23Kɛji nyɛna amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ pɛ nyɛbaanu shishi, no aaahã nyɛle akɛ nii fɛɛ ni mifee Yerusalɛm lɛ mifee ni shishinumɔ yɛ he.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 15
Content:
Waintso he abɛ
1 Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekɛɛ,
2“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛni waintso kɛfe tso kroko? Mɛni waintso nine kɛfe tsei krokomɛi ni yɔɔ koo lɛ mli lɛ? 3Ani akɛ etso lɛ feɔ nɔ ko kwraa? Ani gbɔmɔ kɛ eko gbɔɔ shiŋmlitso ni akɛ nii tsotsoroɔ nɔ lo? 4 Naa, akɛfeɔ lai ni ashãa. Kɛji enaabu biɛ kɛ biɛ shã, ni eteŋ hu fɛɛ eshã etsɔ̃ ŋai lɛ, ani ehiɔ kɛhã nɔ ko feemɔ kwraa lo? 5Naa, be ni eji waintso muu po, akɛtsuuu nɔ ko, ni kɛji la ŋala lɛ ni etsɔ ŋai lɛ, no lɛ ani aaanyɛ akɛtsu nɔ ko kwraa lo?”
6No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Bɔ ni mihãa la shãa waintso kɛ tsei krokomɛi fɛɛ yɛ koo mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ maŋɔ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ mahã. 7Majie mihiɛ maka amɛ, ni kɛji amɛje la lɛ mli tete lɛ, la lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ baakpãtã amɛhiɛ. No ni nyɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, kɛji mijie mihiɛ mika amɛ lɛ. 8Mibaha shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mi anɔkwa.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 16
Content:
Yerusalɛm ni yeee anɔkwa
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, 2“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, jajemɔ musubɔɔnii ni Yerusalɛm efee lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni okɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, 3Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ Yerusalɛm nɛ, ojɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ nɔ, ni jɛi afɔ bo yɛ. Amornyo ji otsɛ, ni Hityoo ji onyɛ. 4Asaŋ yɛ ofɔmɔ mli lɛ, gbi ni afɔ bo lɛ, afooo olaŋmɔ, akɛ nu hu juuu ohe ni ohe aje, akɛ ŋoo kpaaa ohe hu, ni akɛ mama hu ebalaaa ohe. 5Mɔ ko mɔ ko enaaa bo mɔbɔ ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ ni eeefee nibii nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko ehã bo, shi moŋ ashɛ bo afɔ ŋa kplanaa nɔ, ejaakɛ anyaŋe bo kɛjɛ gbi ni afɔ bo lɛ beebe.
6“No ni be ni mibatsɔ̃ omasɛi kɛho lɛ, mina bo ni ookoklo shi yɛ ola mli. Mikɛ bo wie yɛ ola lɛ mli akɛ, 7‘Oyi ana wala koni oda tamɔ ŋanɔtso.’ Kɛkɛ ni oda, ni okwɔ, ni oshɛ oblayoo, ni oje fufɔ, ni oyitsɔi kɛlɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ onyiɛ yayai kɛ ohe pasaa.
8 “Be ni mibatsɔ̃ omasɛi kɛho ekoŋŋ lɛ, naa, mina akɛ oda ni oshɛ gbãlã, ni miha bo mimama lɛ eko ni mikɛtsi oyayai nɔ. Hɛɛ, misumɔ bo kɛha gbãlãshihilɛ, ni mikɛ bo kpãŋ, ni otsɔ̃ minɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
9“Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ nu ju ohe ni mifɔ ohe lá lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ohe, ni mikpa bo mu. 10Mibu bo mama hu ni aye samai yɛ mli, ni miwo bo nuŋgbee wolo tokota; mifi bo duku yɛŋ, ni mibu bo sliki mama. 11Misaa miwula bo kɛ jwinei, miwo onineshi gai, ni mikɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ŋmɛ okuɛ. 12Miwo ogugɔŋ ga, ni miwo otoiiaŋ toiiaŋnii. Mikɛ akekre fɛɛfɛo fi oyitso. 13Nɛkɛ awula bo kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni owoɔ. Ni ohebo ji klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ sliki kɛ mama ni alo nii awo mli. Oye shikishaŋnii kpakpa kɛ wo kɛ mu, ni ohe fee fɛo jogbaŋŋ naakpa, ni otsɔ̃ maŋnyɛ. 14 Ogbɛi hu hehe kɛtee jeŋ maji srɔtoi anɔ yɛ ohe fɛo lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ bɔ ni miwula bo lɛ hã ohe fee fɛo kɛmɔ shi.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
15 “Shi odi ohe fɛo kɛ ogbɛi ni ehehe lɛ sɛɛ ni obɔ ajwamãŋ; ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ wɔɔ kɛkɛ. 16Okɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ otadei lɛ ekomɛi wulaa ohei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni obɔɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ amɛnɔ, nɔ ni afeko eko dã, ni asaŋ afeŋ nakai nɔ ko hu. 17Osaa oŋɔ ojwinei fɛɛfɛji ni ji mishika kɛ mijwiɛtɛi ni mihã bo lɛ eko okɛfee hii amãgãi ohã ohe, ni okɛ amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ. 18Okɛ otadei ni aye ŋaabii awo amɛmli lɛ ha amãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni okɛ mimu kɛ mitsofakɛŋma lɛ mamɔ amɛhiɛ. 19Asaŋ milɛ bo kɛ ashikishaŋ kpakpa kɛ mu kɛ wo, ni miniyenii ni mikɛhã bo lɛ, nomɛi okɛmamɔ amãgãi lɛ ahiɛ koni eje ŋma ewo amɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
20 “Asaŋ obihii kɛ obiyei ni ofɔ ohã mi lɛ hu ogbe amɛ okɛshã afɔlei ohã amãgãi lɛ ni amɛye. 21Ani ajwamãŋbɔi nɛɛ faaa hãaa bo hewɔ ni ogbe mibii lɛ, ni okɛ amɛ shã afɔlei ohã amãgãi lɛ? 22Be ni ofeɔ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ ni obɔɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ, okaiii be ni oji abifao ni onyiɛ yayai kɛ ohe pasaa, ni okokloɔ yɛ olá mli lɛ.”
Yerusalɛm Ajwamãŋbɔɔ
23Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Kpoo, kpoo hã bo! Ejaakɛ onifɔɔjianii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, 24ofo akrabatsa fɛɛfɛo ohã ohe, ni ofee otutui wuji ohã ohe yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu mli. 25Omamɔ otutui wuji lɛ yɛ ŋmaŋmasha fɛɛ ŋmaŋmasha nɔ, ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ kɛkɛ wɔɔ shii abɔ. 26Okɛ Ijiptbii, mɛi ni amɛkɔnɔ fa, ni okɛ amɛ je husu lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ; ni obɔ ajwamãŋ shii abɔ ni okɛwo mimli la.
27“Naa, agbɛnɛ, mite shi miwo bo, ni magbala otoi; ni mitse nɔ ni ji ogbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ. Mikɛ bo hã ohenyɛlɔi fulɔi ni ji Filistibii lɛ abiyei lɛ ni hiɛ gboɔ yɛ onifɔɔji anifeemɔi lɛ ahe lɛ.
28“Osaa okɛ Asiriabii lɛ hu bɔ ajwamãŋ ejaakɛ otɔɔɔ; okɛ amɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ eshɛɛɛ onaa. 29Nakai nɔŋŋ okɛ Babilonbii ni ji jarayelɔi lɛ hu bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni no tete hu shɛɛɛ onaa.”
30Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni akɔnɔ eyi otsuiŋ obɔ̃, ni okɛbɔɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ohiɛ gbooo he; 31ni omamɔɔ opiai lɛ omaa ŋmaŋmasha fɛɛ ŋmaŋmasha ni ofeɔ ojamɔhe krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu mli; tsɛ ofeee onii tamɔ ajwamãŋ tete; ejaakɛ bo lɛ oheee shika. 32Bo lɛ, oji ohe ŋã gbãlãfitelɔ ni jeɔ ewu sɛɛ. 33Hii keɔ ajwamãŋi fɛɛ anii, shi bo lɛ bo moŋ oŋɔɔ onikeenii lɛ okeɔ osuɔlɔi fɛɛ, ni ohãa amɛ nyɔɔŋnii koni amɛjɛ he fɛɛ he amɛba oŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ bo ababɔ. 34Bo lɛ, esoro bo kwraa yɛ yei ajwamãŋbɔlɔi krokomɛi ahe, ejaakɛ bo lɛ, mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ osɛɛ etɔɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ bo wɔɔ; asaŋ mɔ ko wooo bo nyɔmɔ akɛ ekɛ bo ewɔ, shi bo moŋ owoɔ mɛi anyɔmɔ, no hewɔ ni soro bo kwraa lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ gbala Yerusalɛm toi
35Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, bo ajwamãŋ, bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi. 36Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Oshwie ohiɛ shi, yɛ osuɔlɔi kɛ wɔji ahiɛ, ni ojie oyayaiaŋ kpo yɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mli. Ni ogbe obii okɛshã afɔle oha wɔji. 37 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mabua osuɔlɔi ni okɛ amɛ ye ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ anaa, mɛi ni osumɔɔ kɛ mɛi ni osumɔɔɔ hu fɛɛ naa kɛkpe. Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ hei fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ mawo bo, ni majie oyayaiaŋ matsɔɔ amɛ, koni amɛna oyayaiaŋ fɛɛ. 38Asaŋ makojo bo tamɔ akojoɔ yei ni kuɔ gbãlã mli ni amɛshwieɔ lá shi hu lɛ; ni mikɛ mlifu kɛ awuŋayeli aaatɔ lá he owele yɛ onɔ. 39Ni maŋɔ bo mawo osuɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛbaakumɔ opiai lɛ, ni amɛbaafite ohei grɔŋŋi ni oja yɛ lɛ. Osuɔlɔi lɛ aaakpɔlɔ ohe atadei hu, ni amɛaaŋɔ ojwinei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ni amɛaashi bo kɛ ohe yayai kɛ ohe pasaa.”
40“Osuɔlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi asafo yuu aaate shi awo bo ni atswia bo tɛi, ni amɛ kɛ amɛklantei aaafolɔ omli dukuduku. 41Amɛkɛ la aaashã oshĩai lɛ, ni amɛaakojo bo yɛ yei babaoo ahiɛ; ni maha ofɔ̃ɔ ajwamãŋbɔɔ, ni owoŋ osuɔlɔi ni kɛ bo wɔɔ lɛ anyɔmɔ dɔŋŋ. 42Ni maha mimli ni ewo bo la lɛ naa ajɔ, ni miyeŋ ohe awuŋã, mafee diŋŋ, ni mimli fuŋ bo dɔŋŋ.” 43Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Akɛni okaiii bɔ ni mikɛ bo hi shi hã yɛ oblayeiaŋ, shi moŋ okɛ onifɔɔjianii nɛɛ fɛɛ wo mi mlifu hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, naa, maha onifɔɔjianii lɛ abua oyiteŋ. Bɛ obɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi hu oshi nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ nɔ?
44“Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni buɔ abɛ lɛ, aaabu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ ashi bo akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni nyɛ (awo) yɔɔ lɛ, nakai ebiyoo yɔɔ.’ 45Onyɛ ni nyaŋe ewu kɛ ebii lɛ, ebiyoo ji bo; ni onyɛmimɛi yei ni nyaŋe amɛwumɛi kɛ amɛbii lɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo ji bo. Hityoo ji nyɛnyɛ, ni Amornyo ji nyɛtsɛ.
46“Onyɛmi yoo nukpa ji Samaria, mɔ ni kɛ ekrowai yɔɔ okooyigbɛ lɛ; ni onyɛmi yoo gbekɛ ji Sodom, mɔ ni kɛ ekrowai lɛ yɔɔ owuoyigbɛ lɛ. 47Shi obaaa ojeŋ tamɔ amɛ, ni ofeee amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ eko moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, be fioo mli lɛ ofite fe amɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.”
48Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, onyɛmi yoo Sodom kɛ okrowai lɛ efeee nɔ fɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni bo kɛ obiyei lɛ fee lɛ. 49Naa, efɔŋ ni onyɛmi yoo ni ji Sodom fee lɛ ji akɛ ekɛ ebiyei lɛ woɔ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛyɛ ŋmãa babaoo ni amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ hu, shi amɛyeee amɛbuaaa ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ. 50 Amɛwo amɛhe, ni amɛfee musubɔɔnii yɛ mihiɛ, hewɔ lɛ be ni mina lɛ, mishwie amɛ.
51“Samaria hu efeee eshai ni ofee lɛ mli fã tete po, shi bo lɛ ofee musubɔɔnii babaoo ni fe amɛnɔ lɛ, ni kɛji akɛ omusubɔɔnii lɛ to onyɛmimɛi yei lɛ anɔ lɛ he lɛ abuɔ amɛ jalɔi fe bo. 52Agbɛnɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ hu ohiɛgbele aaatere bo; ejaakɛ obu onyɛmimɛi yei lɛ bem, ejaakɛ musubɔɔnii ni mihiɔ ni ofee lɛ fa fe amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛja fe bo. Agbɛnɛ hã ohiɛ agbo ni otere ohiɛgbele, ejaakɛ obu onyɛmimɛi yei lɛ abem.”
Abaasaa Sodom kɛ Samaria ekoŋŋ
53“Makpale Sodom kɛ ekrowai lɛ anibii lɛ mahã amɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ maha Samaria kɛ ekrowai lɛ anine ashɛ amɛnibii lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ, ni makpale bo hu onibii lɛ maha bo yɛ amɛhiɛ. 54Koni otere ohiɛgbele lɛ ni ohiɛ agbo yɛ musubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ, koni onyɛmimɛi lɛ ana akɛ amɛhi fe bo. 55Onyɛmimɛi yei ni ji Sodom kɛ ekrowai lɛ kɛ Samaria kɛ ekrowai lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba amɛsa shihilɛhe lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ bo hu okɛ okrowai lɛ aaaku nyɛsɛɛ kɛaaba nyɛsa shihilɛhe lɛ. 56Te be mli ni okɛ hewoo yeɔ omle lɛ, onyɛmi yoo ni ji Sodom lɛ ji odaaŋ kotsa, 57dani ajie onifɔɔjianii lɛ kpo. Agbɛnɛ okɛ lɛ eye hegbɔ, ni Edombii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, aaaye ohe fɛo, ni nakai nɔŋŋ Filistibii kɛ amɛkrowai ni amɛhe tsɛ̃ɔ bo lɛ aaaye ohe fɛo. 58Aaagbala otoi yɛ nifɔɔjianii kɛ nihiinii ni ofeɔ lɛ hewɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Kpãŋmɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ
59Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni ofee lɛ nakai pɛ mikɛ bo baaye, ejaakɛ otswa okitã lɛ ofɔ̃ afã, ni oku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli. 60 Shi kɛ̃lɛ makai kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ bo kpãŋ yɛ oblayeiaŋ lɛ, ni mikɛ bo aaakpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ.
61 “No dani oookai ojeŋba fɔŋ lɛ, ni ohiɛ aaagbo, kɛji miŋɔ onyɛmimɛi yei onukpai kɛ onyɛmimɛi yei gbekɛbii lɛ mibahã bo akɛ obiyei lɛ, shi jeee akɛ mikɛ bo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
62“Maha mikɛ bo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ ama shi, ni obaale akɛ mi ji, Yehowa; 63Oookai enɛ ni ohiɛ aaagbo, ni okatswa odaaŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛgbele lɛ hewɔ, be ni mikɛ nifɔɔjianii ni ofee lɛ fɛɛ efa bo lɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 17
Content:
Okropɔŋ lɛ kɛ Waintso lɛ he abɛ lɛ
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 2“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gba Israelbii lɛ ajenu, ni obu amɛ abɛ akɛ 3bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple kɛ efiji agboi kɛ etsɛji kakadaji ko ni yɔɔ. Eyɛ tsɛji fɛɛfɛji bibii kɛ emli samaisamai. Eba Lebanon gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaku tsenedrutso lɛ yiteŋ. 4Eku eniji fɔbii lɛ ayiteŋ fɔflɔoo lɛ eko ni ekɛkɔ̃ enaa kɛtee jarayeli shikpɔŋ ko nɔ. Ekɛtee eyatɛo yɛ guɔyelɔi amaŋ ko mli. 5Agbɛnɛ esaa ekɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dumɔ wu lɛ eko ni ekɛtee eyadu yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ. Ekɛ dumɔ wu lɛ tee he ni nu pii yɔɔ, ni edu yɛ faa lɛ toi kpaakpa. 6Wu lɛ kwɛ̃ ni eda etsɔ waintso agbo ni ebu gbidii; eniji lɛ kwɔlɔ kɛtee okropɔŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ gbɛ, ni tso lɛ shishifãi lɛ he shi. Kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ waintso, ni egbala niji, ni etsɛ̃rɛ bai hu.
7“Shi okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple kroko hu ni yɔɔ kɛ efiji kpelei kɛ etsɛji pii. Ni naa, nɛkɛ waintso nɛɛ dɔrɔ eshishifãi lɛ kɛ eniji lɛ kɛba okropɔŋ kroko nɛɛ ŋɔɔgbɛ, koni okropɔŋ nɛɛ ashwie waintso lɛ nɔ nu pii fe he ni eyɔɔ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ. 8Okropɔŋ lɛ fã waintso lɛ kɛjɛ akofi nɔ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni eyatɛo yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni nu pii yɔɔ no nɔ, koni egbala niji, ni ewo yibii ni etsɔ̃ waintso kpakpa.
9“Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa biɔ nɛ. Ani nɛkɛ waintso nɛɛ aaahere? Ani klɛŋklɛŋ okropɔŋ lɛ baŋ ni ebafã waintso lɛ kɛ eshishifã fɛɛ, ni efolɔ eniji lɛ eshwie, koni eyibaa fɔbii lɛ fɛɛ aŋala? Ebiŋ hewalɛ tsɔ̃ loo mɛi babaoo ni akɛfã tso lɛ kɛ eshishifã fɛɛ afɔ̃ shi. 10Naa, kɛji afã ayatɛo lɛ, ani eeehere? Ani kɛ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa lɛ lɛ jeee ŋalamɔ eeeŋala kwraa yɛ akofi nɔ he ni atɛo lɛ yɛ lɛ!”
Atsɔ̃ɔ Abɛi lɛ shishi
11Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, 12 “Bi atuatselɔi awe lɛ akɛ, ani nyɛnaaa abɛ nɛɛ shishi? Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, naa, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm ni ebaŋɔ emli maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ emli lumɛi lɛ, ni ekpala amɛ eshwie esɛɛ kɛtee Babilon. 13 Ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ odehei lɛ eko, ni ekɛ lɛ kpãŋ; ni ehã odehe lɛ kã lɛ kitã akɛ ebaaye lɛ anɔkwa. Kɛkɛ ni emɔmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ kɛtee, 14koni ekɛba jɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shi ni ekawo ehe nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni kɛ eye ekpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi. 15Shi Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tse Babilon maŋtsɛ nɛɛ hiɛ atua, ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtee Ijipt, koni ahã lɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tabilɔi babaoo. Ani eeehi ehã lɛ? Aso gbɔmɔ ni feɔ nibii tamɔ enɛɛmɛi lɛ eeeye ehe lo? Ani eeeku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni kɛ̃lɛ eeeye ehe lo?”
16Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Babilon, he ni maŋtsɛ, mɔ ni wo lɛ maŋtsɛ, kɛ mɔ ni ekwa ekitã lɛ, kɛ mɔ kpãŋmɔ mli ni eku yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ eeegbo yɛ. 17Kɛji Babilonbii lɛ tswa kpokui, ni amɛtswa kawoo gbogboi koni akɛkpãtã mɛi pii ahiɛ lɛ, Farao kɛ eta kpele lɛ kɛ esafo babaoo lɛ nyɛŋ Yuda eye ebua yɛ ta mli. 18Akɛni ebuuu kitã ni ekã lɛ, ni eku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, akɛni ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ efee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ hewɔ lɛ ehe ejeŋ mli.”
19No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mikitã ni ebuuu lɛ, kɛ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ni eku mli lɛ, mikɛ he sɔ̃ aaabua eyiteŋ. 20Mafɔ̃ enɔ miyaa lɛ, ni eeedu mitsɔne, ni mikɛ lɛ aaaba Babilon, ni magbala etoi yɛ jɛi, yɛ shi ni ete ewo mi lɛ hewɔ. 21Ni akɛ klante aaakpãtã etabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ wo hiɛnɔkãmɔ he shi
22 Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ,
“Mi diɛŋtsɛ maku tsenedrutso yiteŋ
kɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ ni mayatɛo.
Maku eniji fɔbii lɛ ayiteŋ fɔflɔooi lɛ,
ni mayatɛo yɛ gɔŋ ni kwɔ grɔŋŋ ko nɔ.
23 Israel gɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ matɛo yɛ;
ni eeegbala niji, ni eeewo yibii,
ni eeetsɔ̃ tsenedrutso fɛɛfɛo,
ni loofɔji srɔtoi fɛɛ aaabahi enɔ,
amɛaahi eniji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli.
24Ni ŋa nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ
mi, Yehowa, mihãa tso ni kwɔ lɛ baa shi,
ni miwoɔ tso tɛkɛɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi;
Mihãa tso ŋmɔŋ gbiɔ
ni mihãa tso gbiŋ fɛoɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, miwie,
ni mafee hu.”

Title: EZEKIEL 18
Content:
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, 2 “Mɛni ji shishinumɔ ni nyɛkɛbuɔ abɛ nɛɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ he akɛ, ‘Tsɛmɛi lɛ eye wainyibii ŋmilikitii, ni bii lɛ moŋ anyanyɔji eshwã’ lɛ?
3“Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbuŋ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel.” Yehowa kɛɛ. 4“Naa, gbɔmɛi fɛɛ awala lɛ, minɔ ni. Bɔ ni tsɛ wala ji minɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ bi hu nɔ ji minɔ. Gbɔmɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbo.
5“Ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni ji jalɔ, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja. 6 Eyeee nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ. Ni ewooo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛɛɛ Israel we lɛ wɔji lɛ tete, ni enyiɛɛɛ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ, ni ebɛŋkɛɛɛ yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ. 7 Ewaaa mɔ yi; shi ekpaleɔ nyɔmɔtsɛ awabatoonii ehãa lɛ; ni etswaaa ojo; ehaaa mɔ ko nɔ ko, shi moŋ ehãa mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ nii eyeɔ; asaŋ mɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ ebuɔ lɛ mama.
8 “Ekɛ shika efaaa ni ehe hekpa fe nine. Ewiɔ ehe yɛ eshafeemɔ he, ni ekojoɔ mɔ kɛ mɔ teŋ yɛ jalɛ naa. 9 Ebaa ejeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni eyeɔ mimlai lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
10“Agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ fɔ binuu yiwalɔ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ. 11Bi nɛɛ efeee nii ni sa feemɔ nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko; shi moŋ eyeɔ nii ni akɛshãa afɔle ahãa wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ; ni enyiɛɔ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ. 12Ewaa ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ yi. Etswaa ojo, ni ekpaleee nyɔmɔtsɛ awabatoonii ehãaa lɛ. Ejaa amãgã, ni efeɔ musubɔɔnii. 13Efaa shika ni eheɔ hekpa fe nine. Aso nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ yi aaana wala? Eyi naŋ wala. Akɛni efee nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ fɛɛ eko hewɔ lɛ gbo kɛ̃ eeegbo; ela aaabua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ.
14“Shi agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ fɔ binuu ko, ni ebinuu nɛɛ na eshai fɛɛ ni etsɛ lɛ efee lɛ, ni eshe gbeyei, ni efeee nakai eshai lɛ eko. 15Ni eyeee nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni ejaaa Israel we lɛ amãgãi lɛ ekoeko. Ni enyiɛɛɛ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ. 16Ni efeee mɔ ko efɔŋ, eheee mɔ ko awabatoonii; etswaaa mɔ ko ojo. Shi moŋ ehãa mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ aboloo, asaŋ mɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ, ebuɔ lɛ mama. 17Ewiɔ ehe yɛ eshafeemɔ he, ni ekɛ shika efaaa ni ehe hekpa ni fe nine. Ni eyeɔ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni ebaa ejeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa. Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ egboŋ yɛ eshai ni etsɛ efee lɛ ahewɔ, shi moŋ eyi aaana wala kɛ̃. 18Shi etsɛ lɛ, akɛni etswaa ojo, ni ejuɔ enyɛmi, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ehiii yɛ emaŋbii ateŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, gbo eeegbo yɛ ehe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
19“Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ esaaa akɛ bi naa amanehului yɛ esha ni etsɛ efee hewɔ?’ Kɛji bi lɛ yeɔ jalɛ sane, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja, ni eyeɔ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ esa akɛ eyi ana wala kɛ̃. 20 Gbɔmɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ gbo eeegbo. Bi enaŋ amanehulu yɛ eshai ni etsɛ efee ahewɔ, ni tsɛ hu enaŋ amanehulu yɛ eshai ni ebii efee ahewɔ. Jalɔ aaana ejalɛnii ni efee lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo, ni mɔ fɔŋ hu aaana efɔŋ ni efee lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo.
21“Shi kɛji eshafeelɔ fɔ̃ɔ eshai fɛɛ ni efeɔ, ni eye mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni eye jalɛ sane, ni efee nɔ ni ja lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ. 22 Tɔ̃mɔi ni etɔ̃ lɛ akaiŋ ekoeko dɔŋŋ, akɛaafa lɛ. Ejalɛnii ni efee lɛ hewɔ lɛ eyi aaana wala. 23Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa miibi akɛ, “Aso minyaa efɔŋfeelɔ gbele he lo? Dabida, nɔ ni mitaoɔ moŋ ji akɛ etsake ejeŋba koni eyi ana wala.”
24 “Shi kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ ni efee esha, ni efee musubɔɔ nii ni mɔfɔŋ feɔ lɛ, aso eyi aaana wala lo? Jalɛnii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akaiŋ ekoeko. Etɔmɔi ni etɔ̃ lɛ kɛ eshai ni efee lɛ, eeegbo yɛ nomɛi ahewɔ.
25“Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yeee jalɛ sane. Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛboa toi ko! Ani mi, miyeee jalɛ sane? Ani jeee nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛyeee jalɛ sane? 26Kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ, ni efee efɔŋ lɛ, gbo eeegbo yɛ no hewɔ. Ebaagbo yɛ efɔŋ ni efee lɛ hewɔ. 27Asaŋ kɛji mɔ fɔŋ fɔ̃ɔ eshai ni efeɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni eye mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ja ni ehi lɛ, eeehere eyiwala. 28Ejaakɛ ekɔ eyiŋ, ni efɔ̃ɔ enifɔɔji anii lɛ fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ. 29Kɛ̃lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yeee jalɛ sane.’ Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, ani mi ni miyeee jalɛ sane lo? Ani jeee nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛyeee jalɛ sane?
30 “No hewɔ lɛ, Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, makojo nyɛ, makojo nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enifeemɔ nii anaa. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ, ni nyɛfɔ̃a nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ; koni nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ akakpãtã nyɛhiɛ. 31Nyɛkpaa efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛshi mi lɛ feemɔ, ni nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ ni nyɛnaa mumɔ hee. Ao, Israelbii, shi mɛɛba ni nyɛaagboi? 32Minyaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko gbele he. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ koni nyɛyi anaa wala.”

Title: EZEKIEL 19
Content:
Awerɛho lalawiemɔ
1Wo yaafo lala nɔ
okɛfo Israel lumɛi lɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ,
2“Ani onyɛ lɛ jeee jatayoo ni?
Ni ebu jata oblahii ateŋ
ni elɛ ebii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ?
3Ni etsɔse ebii lɛ ateŋ ekome
ni etsɔ̃ jata oblanyo;
ekase loomɔmɔ,
ni eyeɔ gbɔmɔ tete?
4 Jeŋmaji lɛ bɔ ehe oshe;
ni adu lɛ yɛ amɛbu lɛ mli;
ni amɛkɛ kpoji gbala lɛ
kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
5Be ni enyɛ mɛ aahu lɛ,
ehiɛnɔkãmɔ tã.
Esaa eŋɔ ebii lɛ ateŋ ekroko
efee jata oblanyo.
6 Be ni eda etsɔ̃ jata oblanyo lɛ
ekɛ jatai lɛ nyiɛ aahu.
Ekase gbɔbimɔ
ni eyeɔ gbɔmɔ tete.
7Ejwra amɛ mɔji, ni efite maji hu;
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ she gbeyei
yɛ ehuumɔ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ hewɔ.
8Kɛkɛ ni jeŋmaji lɛ gba wo lɛ kɛkpe,
ni amɛfɔ̃ enɔ yaa,
ni adu lɛ yɛ amɛbu lɛ mli.
9 Ni amɛkɛ kpoji gbala lɛ
amɛwo kooloi adeka mli;
ni amɛkɛ lɛ yahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ,
ni akɛ lɛ to mɔɔ lɛ mli;
bɔ ni afee ni akanu egbee
yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
10 Onyɛ tamɔ waintso
ni atɛo yɛ faa toi;
egbala niji, ni ewo yibii babaoo,
ejaakɛ enaa nu pii.
11Eniji lɛ na hewalɛ
tamɔ maŋtsɛ tsi.
Ni ewo ekwɔlɛ nɔ yɛ
niji kusukusuu lɛ ateŋ.
Ni ana ekwɔlɛ kɛ eniji kusukusuu lɛ.
12Shi akɛ mlila fã lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ
ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ,
ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ gbi lɛ,
ni eyibii lɛ kpala,
ni etso ni wa lɛ gbi,
ni eshã wɛɛ.
13Agbɛnɛ afã lɛ ayatɛo
yɛ ŋa nɔ,
yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
14Ni la jɛ tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mli
ni eshã eniji lɛ
kɛ eyibii lɛ fɛɛ;
ni tso bɛ emli dɔŋŋ
ni aaanyɛ akɛfee maŋtsɛ tsi dɔŋŋ.
Awerɛho lala nɛɛ alaa akɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ daa.

Title: EZEKIEL 20
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii kɛ gbɔmɔ atuatsemɔ
1Yɛ wɔnomŋɔɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israel onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ba miŋɔɔ koni amɛbabi Yehowa nii. Amɛbatara shi yɛ mihiɛ. 2Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, 3 “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, okɛ Israel maŋ onukpai nɛɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ani mi nibimɔ nyɛbaa nɛɛ? Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, Mihaŋ nyɛbi mi nii. 4Ani oookojo amɛ, Gbɔmɔ Adesa? Ani oookojo amɛ? Belɛ hã amɛle musubɔɔnii ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 5Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, gbi ni miŋɔ Israel lɛ mikã Yakob shwiei lɛ akitã ni mihã amɛle mi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mikã amɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ 6 Nakai gbi lɛ mikã amɛ kitã akɛ majie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya shikpɔŋ ko ni mito miha amɛ lɛ nɔ; shikpɔŋ ni hi ni ebaa nii, ni eji shikpɔji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ. 7 Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashɛrɛ musubɔɔnii ni ehiŋmɛii nyaa he lɛ eshwie; ni nyɛkɛ Ijipt wɔji lɛ akabulea nyɛhe! Mi ji Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ! 8Shi amɛtse mihiɛ atua, ni amɛbooo mi toi. Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko shɛrɛɛɛ musubɔɔnii ni ehiŋmɛii nyaa he lɛ eshwieee, ni Ijipt wɔji lɛ hu ahewɔ lɛ, mito miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ mlila kɛ mlifu aaafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 9 Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mifeee; mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ yɛ migbɛi hewɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mikagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ, mɛi ahiɛ ni mihã amɛle mi yɛ, be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
10“No hewɔ lɛ, mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ ba ŋa lɛ nɔ. 11 Miwo amɛ mlai kɛ akpɔi lɛ, ni kɛ gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ. 12 Asaŋ miŋɔ mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ mihã amɛ, koni nomɛi atsɔ̃ okadi yɛ mi kɛ amɛteŋ, koni amɛkɛle akɛ mi Yehowa, mi ji mɔ ni tsuɔ amɛhe.
13“Shi Israel we lɛ tse mihiɛ atua yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ anaa, shi moŋ amɛkwa mikpɔi ni kɛ gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ; ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ hu naakpa. No hewɔ lɛ, mito miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ mimlila aaaplene amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kwrakwra. 14Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ; mɛi ahiɛ ni mi mijie Israel kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 15 Asaŋ mikã amɛ kitã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ mikɛ amɛ baŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ nɔ; shikpɔŋ ni hi ni ebaa nii, ni eji shikpɔji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
16“Ejaakɛ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa. Ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ hã amɛwɔji lɛ. 17Kɛ̃lɛ mina amɛ mɔbɔ, ni mikpãtãaa amɛhiɛ ni mipleneee amɛ kwrakwra yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
18“Mikɛɛ amɛbii yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ amlai lɛ anaa, ni nyɛkayea amɛkpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkɛ amɛwɔji lɛ akabulea nyɛhe. 19Yehowa, mi ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ moŋ anaa; ni nyɛyea mimlai lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 20Ni nyɛfea mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni nomɛi atsɔ̃ okadi yɛ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ; koni nyɛkɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’
21“Shi nyɛbii lɛ hu tse mihiɛ atua; amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mlai lɛ anaa, ni amɛyeee mikpɔi lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; mlai ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ; amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ hu. Kɛkɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ mimlifu kɛ mimlila naa yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, 22Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ; mɛi ahiɛ ni mi, mijie Israelbii lɛ yɛ, kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 23Kɛ̃lɛ, mikã amɛ kitã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; 24ejaakɛ amɛyeee mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ yakɔ̃ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ awɔji lɛ anɔ.
25“No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu miwo amɛ mlai ni ehiii, kɛ akpɔi ni haŋ amɛna wala. 26 Mibule amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnikeenii anɔ, no ji amɛkromɔbii ni amɛgbe kɛshã afɔle lɛ, koni mahã amɛhe ajɔ̃ amɛhe. Mifee enɛ, koni amɛkɛna amɛle akɛ, mi ji Yehowa.
27“No hewɔ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, enɛ mli hu nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ bɔ musu amɛshi mi yɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mi anɔkwa. 28Ejaakɛ be ni mihã amɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikã kitã akɛ mikɛaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ, loo tso kusuu fɛɛ tso kusuu ni amɛaana lɛ, amɛyashãa amɛ afɔlei lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛkɛ afɔleshãa nɛɛ wo mimli la; jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛshãa amɛtsofakɛŋmai lɛ yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛfɔse amɛdãa afɔle lɛ amɛshwie shi yɛ. 29Mibi amɛ akɛ, mɛni ji nakai he grɔŋŋ lɛ ni nyɛyaa lɛ? No hewɔ atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ ‘He Grɔŋŋ’ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. 30No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ani nyɛaabule nyɛhe tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ; ani nyɛaanyiɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii lɛ asɛɛ ni nyɛdu gbɛ? 31 Gbii abɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii yahãa wɔji, ni nyɛgbeɔ nyɛbihii nyɛkɛshãa afɔlei nyɛhãa amɛ lɛ, nyɛmiibule nyɛhe kɛ nɛkɛ nyɛwɔji nɛɛ ajamɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Ao, Israel we, nyɛmiiba ni nyɛbabi mi nii? Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mihaŋ nyɛbi mi nii! Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. 32Nɔ ni nyɛsusuɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, wɔɔtamɔ jeŋmaji kɛ shikpɔji anɔ wekui lɛ, ni wɔsɔmɔ tso kɛ tɛ lɛ, ebaŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ gbalaa toi, ni ekɛfaa
33Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ mlila ni naa wa baaye nyɛnɔ maŋtsɛ. 34Mikɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ mlila baajie nyɛ kɛaajɛ shikpɔji ni agbɛ nyɛ ashwã amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ. 35 Ni mikɛ nyɛaaba majimaji lɛ ateŋ ni mabua nyɛnaa kɛaajɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni jɛi magbala nyɛtoi yɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.”
36 Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni migbala nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ atoi yɛ Ijipt ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ magbala nyɛ hu nyɛtoi.
37“Maha nyɛtsɔ̃ kplamɔtso lɛ shishi, ni makane nyɛ ekomekome mawo kpãŋmɔ mli. 38Ni majie atuatselɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni etɔ̃ minɔ lɛ kɛaaje nyɛteŋ. Majie amɛ kɛaajɛ he ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi amɛnane yiŋ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No dani nyɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
39Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ao, nyɛ Israel we, (nyɛ lɛ kɛji nyɛboŋ mi toi lɛ, kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ) nyɛyaa ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ayasɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewɔji lɛ; shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ nyɛabo mi toi kɛ̃, ni migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii lɛ kɛ nyɛwɔŋjamɔ lɛ babuleŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.” 40Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Shi migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji Israel Gɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jɛi Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaasɔmɔ mi yɛ; mana amɛhe tsui yɛ jɛi, ni mabi nyɛfɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛnikeenii kpakpai lɛ kɛ nyɛkeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ shi. 41Kɛji mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ amli, ni mibua nyɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji ni agbɛ nyɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba lɛ, mana nyɛhe tsui tamɔ nɔ ko ni jeɔ ŋma, ni majie mikrɔŋkrɔŋ ni mi ji lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni majimaji aaana. 42Kɛji mikɛ nyɛ bashɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni mikã he kitã akɛ maŋɔ hã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa. 43Ni jɛi nyɛaakai nyɛjeŋba kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛfee ni nyɛkɛbule nyɛhe lɛ yɛ, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe aaafee nyɛ nyaŋemɔ yɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ. 44Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, nyɛ Israel we, kɛji mikɛnyɛ ye yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ, shi jeee yɛ nyɛjeŋba gbohii lɛ ahewɔ, loo nyɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Wuoyigbɛ la lɛ
45Yehowa kɛmi wie ni ekɛɛ, 46“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã wuoyigbɛ; wiemɔ oshi Yuda wuoyigbɛ lɛ; gbaa oshi wuoyigbɛ koo lɛ. 47Kɛɛmɔ Yuda wuoyigbɛ koo lɛ akɛ, bo Yehowa wiemɔ toi. Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: naa, mawo la yɛ omli, ni eeeshã omli tso ŋmɔŋ fɛɛ tso ŋmɔŋ, kɛ tso gbiŋ fɛɛ tso gbiŋ. La ni tsoɔ grigri lɛ agbeŋ, ni eeeshã he fɛɛ he kɛaajɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ. 48Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ baana akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi miwo la lɛ, ni anyɛŋ agbe.” 49Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, amɛkɛɔ yɛ mihe akɛ, ‘Ani jeee abɛbuaŋ sɔŋŋ ewieɔ yɛ?’ ”

Title: EZEKIEL 21
Content:
Yehowa klante lɛ
1Yehowa kɛ miwie ni ekɛɛ, 2“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oha Yerusalɛm ni oshiɛ oshi hei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, he ni ajaa yɛ lɛ; gbaa oshi Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ, 3ni okɛɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ bo ena, ni magbala miklante lɛ kɛaaje ehebo lɛ mli, ni mikɛaagbe jalɔ kɛ mɔfɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. 4Akɛni makpãtã jalɔ kɛ mɔfɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ kɛaaje nyɛteŋ hewɔ lɛ mafã miklante lɛ kɛjɛ ehebo lɛ mli mawo gbɔmɛi kɛjɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ. 5No gbɔmɛi fɛɛ kɛaana ale akɛ, mi Yehowa mifã miklante kɛjɛ ehebo lɛ mli; ni akɛwoŋ ehebo lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
6“No hewɔ lɛ, bo, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, hũumɔ kɛ tsui ni ekumɔ, hũumɔ kɛ awerɛho kpele yɛ amɛhiɛ. 7Ni kɛji amɛbi bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ ohũɔ lɛ?’ Okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Saji ni minu lɛ hewɔ ni. Kɛji eba mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashe gbeyei, ni kɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ baakplɔke, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɔ̃ feetɔ, ni nakutsei fɛɛ tswɛm baakpokpo tamɔ ayawaŋ nu. Naa, be lɛ eshɛ, ni ebaaba mli kɛ̃;’ ” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
8Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, 9 “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ akɛ, nɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ, mikɛɔ nɛ,
Klante! Klante! Ajɔ klante naa,
ni asha he kaŋkaŋ.
10Ajɔ naa koni akɛgbe mɔ;
asha he ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ
tamɔ srawa.
Aso wɔmli afili wɔ?
Mibi, ogbe kpãa kɛ tsɔsemɔ fɛɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ.
11Hewɔ lɛ akɛ klante lɛ ehã
ni asha he,
koni afee lɛ kralo kɛhã nitsumɔ.
Ajɔ naa, ni asha he kaŋkaŋ
koni akɛwo mɔgbelɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
12Gbɔmɔ Adesa, wo yara ni ofo,
ejaakɛ afã klante awo miwebii lɛ.
Afã klante awo Israel lumɛi fɛɛ.
Ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ miwebii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ
ahã klante;
hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyia nyɛhe ma.
13Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa miibi, akɛ,
‘Nyɛjwɛŋa he jogbaŋŋ,
ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ
kɛ nyɛkwa tsɔsemɔ lɛ
toigbalamɔ lɛ baŋ lo?’ ”
14“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, no hewɔ lɛ, gbaa. Tswaa odɛ̃ koni klante lɛ ni baagbe mɛi lɛ abamɔ amɛ nɔtonɔto. No ji klante ni baakpãtã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ lɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, gbele ebɔle amɛhe kɛkpe; 15koni amɛshe gbeyei, ni mɛi babaoo agbeegbee shi hewɔ mitsɔ̃ klante lɛ naa mihã maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa. Mikɛ klante ni kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ srawa lɛ ehã. Ehe miikpɛ tamɔ srawa. Asha he kɛha mɔgbee. 16Klante, bãa kɛya ninejurɔ ni obã kɛya abɛku, tsɔ̃ ohe ni ofo kɛya he fɛɛ he. Hã enyɔ loo mli. 17Mi hu matswa midɛ̃, ni mimlifu lɛ naa aba shi. Mi, Yehowa, miwie.”
Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ klante lɛ
18Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, 19“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kadimɔ gbɛjegbɛi enyɔ nɔ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ eklante lɛ aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba lɛ. Gbɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaanyɛ ajɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ kɛba. Too gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ okadi oma maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ. 20Okadi lɛ ekome atsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛ ni ekɛ eklante lɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba Raba, ni ji Amonbii lɛ amaŋ lɛ mli; okadi kroko lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ kɛya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbote Yerusalɛm ni atswa gbogbo awo ehe lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ. 21Ejaakɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ damɔ gbɛnta lɛ naa, yɛ he ni gbɛi enyɔ lɛ gbaa akloŋta yɛ lɛ. Ebaahoso gãimlibii kɛkla ni eeebi emãgãi lɛ anii, ni eeekwɛ afɔle kooloo ni agbe lɛ mlɛbo mli fitsofitso. 22Eklamɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ ninejurɔgbɛ kɛya Yerusalɛm, koni ebɔ ta oshe, ni awo naa nɔ abolɔ, ni aŋɔ gbogbokuumɔnii apiŋ agboi lɛ ahe, ni atswa kpokui ni amãmɔ mɔji ni wa. 23Eeefee Yerusalɛmbii lɛ akɛ klamɔ ni bɛ mli ni, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ maji ekpãŋ, shi moŋ esa akɛ amɛkai amɛnɔsha lɛ akɛ abaamɔmɔ amɛ.” 24No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Akɛni nyɛha ana eshai ni nyɛfee lɛ, ni nyɛnifɔɔjianii eje kpo yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ mli, ni mikai nyɛ hewɔ lɛ abaamɔmɔ nyɛ kɛya nomŋɔɔ mli. 25Bo Israel lumɔ, yiwalɔ ni he tseee, bo ni obe eshɛ kɛhã onaagbee toigbalamɔ, 26bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ bo nɛ, Jiemɔ oyifiinɔ lɛ, ni jiemɔ okekre lɛ yɛ oyitso. Nibii ehiŋ shi tamɔ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ; nɔ ni eba shi lɛ, awo nɔ; ni nɔ ni awo nɔ lɛ, aba lɛ shi. 27 Butumɔ! Butumɔ! Butumɔ mabutu maŋ lɛ. Anaŋ he okadi ko kwraa kɛyaashi mɔ gbɛnaa ni ji lɛ aaaba, ni lɛ maŋɔ hã.”
Klante lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ
28 “Ni bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ Amonbii lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nyɛ yɛ ahora ni amɛbɔɔ Israel lɛ he nɛ; kɛɛmɔ akɛ: ‘Klante, agbala klante kɛhã gbɔmɔgbee; asha he kaŋkaŋ, ni ekpɛ tamɔ srawa.’ ”
29“Nii ni nyɛnaa lɛ amale ninaa ni, ni nyɛgbalɛi hu amale gbalɛi ni, koni nyɛkɛ sɔ̃ lɛ afɔ̃ lumɛi kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ni egboi lɛ anɔ. Amɛ lɛ, amɛnaagbee hiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ eshɛ. 30Kɛ klante awo ehebo lɛ mli, Makojo bo yɛ he ni abɔ bo yɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ ni ojɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ. 31Mimli baawo bo la, ni mimlifu ni naa wa ni tsoɔ tamɔ la lɛ aaaba onɔ; ni majie bo mawo hii dikalɔi yitsoŋwalɔi ni le nifitemɔ he ŋaa lɛ adɛŋ. 32Nyɛbaatsɔ̃ latɛ naa lai; aaashwie nyɛlá shi akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni akaiŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 22
Content:
Nifɔɔjianii ni Yerusalɛm fee lɛ
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, 2“Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ani oookojo, ani oookojo maŋ ni ashwieɔ lá shi yɛ mli lɛ? Belɛ hã ele emusubɔɔnii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ. 3Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, maŋ ni ashwieɔ lá shi yɛ emli, asaŋ ni efeɔ amãgãi ni ekɛbuleɔ ehe lɛ; ebe aaashɛ, 4lá shi ni oshwie kɛ amãgãi ni ofee okɛbule ohe lɛ hewɔ lɛ oye fɔ; ehã ogbii lɛ ebɛŋkɛ; afii ni ato ahã bo lɛ eshɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, miha jeŋmaji lɛ miibɔ bo ahora, ni shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ miiye ohe fɛo. 5Mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ bo kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ aaaye ohe fɛo, bo mɔ ni ohe guɔ egbo, ni basabasafeemɔ eyi omli obɔ̃. 6Naa, Israel lumɛi ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tswaa efai shi akɛ ebaashwie lá shi yɛ omli, bɔ ni eeenyɛ. 7 Abuuu tsɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ omli, ayeɔ gbɔ amim yɛ omli; awaa awusa kɛ okulafo yi yɛ omli. 8 Obuuu minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni obuleɔ mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ. 9Mɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni yeɔ osheku, bɔ ni afee ni ashwie mɛi alá shi; mɛi komɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni amɛyeɔ afɔlei ni ashã ahã amãgãi lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu yɛ nyɛteŋ ni bɔɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi. 10 Mɛi komɛi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi aŋamɛi naa bɔlɛ yɛ omli, ni mɛi komɛi tuaa yei ni etee tsuiasɛɛ, ni amɛhe tseee lɛ yɛ omli. 11Mɔ kɛ enaanyo ŋa naa bɔlɛ; mɔ ko hu kɛ ebinuu ŋa naa bɔlɛ; mɔ ko hu kɛ enyɛmiyoo ni ji etsɛbi naa bɔlɛ yɛ omli. 12 Mɛi heɔ nyɔɔŋnii, koni ashwie lá shi yɛ omli; aheɔ hekpa ni fe nine, ni atswaa nanemɛi ojo. Nyɛhiɛ ekpa minɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
13“No hewɔ lɛ, mitswa midɛ̃ mishwie onɔ yɛ shishiumɔnii ni ona kɛ lá shi ni oshwie yɛ omli lɛ hewɔ. 14Gbi ni mikɛ bo aaaye lɛ, aso ooonyɛ naa odamɔ? Aloo ooonyɛ onine nɔ po owo? Mi, Yehowa, miwie, ni mafee. 15Magbɛ omlibii lɛ mashwã jeŋmaji kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛaatsuu ohe muji lɛ mashwie. 16Ni ohe guɔ baagbo yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ, ni ooona ole akɛ mi ji Yehowa lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ niiahetsuumɔ flɔnɔɔ lɛ
17Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, 18 “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, Israel we lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ shika shishi ehã mi. Amɛ fɛɛ kwa lɛ, jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ sanyaa kɛ dade kɛ sumui ni asere yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ shishi muji ji amɛ. 19No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Akɛni nyɛ blublu nyɛtsɔmɔ shika shishi hewɔ lɛ, naa, mabua nyɛnaa mawo Yerusalɛm, 20taakɛ bɔ ni mɛi buaa jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ sumui kɛ tsɛnsi naa amɛwoɔ flɔnɔɔ mli ni ahuɔ la awoɔ he, ni asereɔ lɛ, nakai mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila aaabua nyɛnaa, ni mikɛ nyɛ aaawo la mli ni masere nyɛ. 21Mabua nyɛnaa ni mahuu mimlifu mlila lɛ mashwie nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛbaasere. 22Bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi sereɔ yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaasere nyɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm; ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mihuu mimlila lɛ mishwie nyɛnɔ.’ ”
Israel Hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ahe eshai lɛ
23Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekɛɛ, 24“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel akɛ, bo ji shikpɔŋ ko ni ohe tseee, ni nu hu enɛŋ onɔ yɛ mimlifu be lɛ mli. 25 Emli lumɛi lɛ tamɔ jatai ni huuɔ ni amɛmiitserɛ amɛmilɛ loo mli; amɛkpãtã gbɔmɛi awala ahiɛ; amɛshɔ̃ mɛi ajwetri kɛ nii ni jara wa yɛ amɛdɛŋ; amɛhã yei pii etsɔmɔ okulafoi yɛ Yerusalɛm. 26 Omli osɔfoi lɛ ku mimlai lɛ amli, ni amɛbule minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ; amɛhãaa ana srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni abule teŋ; asaŋ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ, ni amɛbuuu mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, abule mi yɛ amɛteŋ.
27“Emli lumɛi lɛ tamɔ klãji ni tserɛɔ milɛloo mli, amɛshwieɔ lá shi, amɛkpãtãa mɛi ahiɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo shishiumɔ ninamɔ. 28Emli gbalɔ lɛ maleɔ ekɛhaa eshai nɛɛ anɔ tamɔ akɛ kaaloo shaa gbogbo he lɛ. Amɛnaa amale ninaa, ni amɛgbaa amale gbalɛi akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.’ Be mli ni mi, Yehowa miwieko tete. 29Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ tswaa ojo, ni amɛjuɔ; amɛwaa ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ ayi, ni amɛyeɔ gbɔ amim, ni atooo lɛ najiaŋ. 30Hewɔ lɛ, mitao akɛ mana mɔ ko kɛjɛ amɛteŋ ni eeetswa gbogbo ni ewule lɛ, ni eeebu folɔ lɛ naa yɛ mihiɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ, koni mikafite lɛ; shi minaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko. 31No hewɔ lɛ, mimli wo amɛ la, ni mikɛ mlifu plenee amɛ, ni miha amɛmusu ebua amɛyiteŋ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 23
Content:
Nyɛmimɛiyei eshafeelɔi lɛ
1Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, 2“Gbɔmɔ Adesa, yei enyɔ komɛi, ni ji yoo kome musuŋbii hi shi. 3Be ni amɛ ji oblayei yɛ Ijipt lɛ amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jɛi, ni jɛi atara amɛfufɔi ahe yɛ, ni jɛi hu afite amɛ yɛ. 4Onukpa lɛ gbɛi ji Ohola, ni fioo lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Oholiba. Mikɛ amɛ hi shi, ni mikɛ amɛ fɔfɔɔ bihii kɛ biyei. Ohola damɔ shi kɛha Samaria, ni Oholiba damɔ shi kɛhã Yerusalɛm. 5Ohola je misɛɛ ni eyabɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ehiɛ yakɔ̃ esuɔlɔi lɛ ni ji Asiriabii lɛ anɔ. 6Tabilɔi ni woɔ afaseo atadei ji amɛ; amraloi kɛ lumɛi kɛ oblahii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi sɔŋŋ ji amɛ. 7Asiria hii ni ajegbɛ ahala lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ amɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ lɛ, eja amɛwɔji lɛ, ni ekɛbule ehe. 8Efɔ̃ko ajwamãŋbɔɔ ni ebɔi kɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ, ejaakɛ hii kɛ lɛ wɔ eblayeiaŋ ni amɛmiamia eblayeiaŋ kpokpoai lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ lɛ basabasa tamɔ ajwamãŋ ko. 9No hewɔ lɛ, mitu lɛ miwo esuɔlɔi lɛ ni ji Asiriabii ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ lɛ adɛŋ. 10Amɛ jie eyayaiaŋ kpo amɛmɔmɔ ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛkɛ klante gbe lɛ; ni etsɔ wiemɔ ni yei kɛyeɔ fɛo akɛ akojo lɛ.
11“Oholiba na nɔ ni ba enyɛmi yoo Ohola nɔ lɛ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ehiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ naa wa fe Ohola nɔ lɛ, ni ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ hu fe enyɛmi yoo lɛ nɔ lɛ. 12Oholiba hiɛ kɔ̃ Asiriabii ni ji amralofoi kɛ lumɛi kɛ tabilɔi ni ewula kɛ tayaa atadei kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi, ni ji oblahii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ lɛ anɔ. 13Kɛkɛ ni mina akɛ ebule ehe, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ.
14“Shi Oholiba tee nɔ lolo kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ; ena Babilon hii mfonirii ni akɛ atiifɔ tsuru etɛŋ yɛ gbogbo he. 15Ena akɛ amɛkɛ hɛfiinii efimɔ amɛhɛi, ni amɛkɛ yitsofiinii kakadaji efimɔ amɛyitsei; mfoniri nɛɛ mli bii lɛ tamɔ Babilon lumɛi ni afɔ yɛ Kaldea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 16Be ni ena amɛfonirii lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtee lumɛi nɛɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon. 17Kɛkɛ ni Babilon hii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ bawɔ, ni amɛkɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ bule lɛ. Agbɛnɛ be ni ekɛ amɛ ewo ehe muji egbe naa lɛ amɛje etsine. 18Bɔ ni ebɔ ajwamãŋ faŋŋ lɛ, ni ejie eyayaiaŋ kpo lɛ hã esane je mitsine tamɔ bɔ ni enyɛmi yoo lɛ sane je mitsine lɛ nɔŋŋ. 19Shi kɛ̃lɛ etee nɔ ebɔ ejwamaŋ lɛ fe nine, ni ekai eblayeiaŋ bei amli ni eyɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ebɔɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ. 20Ehemɛi ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ nɛɛ anuutso tamɔ teji nɔ, ni amɛhenu hu tamɔ okpɔŋɔ he nu. 21Bo, Oholiba, nɛkɛ oshwe oblayeiaŋ basabasa nyiɛmɔi ni onyiɛ, be ni Ijiptbii lɛ miamia ofufɔi, ni amɛfite bo lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ kojo Oholiba
22“No hewɔ lɛ, bo Oholiba, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa mibatee osuɔlɔi ni amɛje otsine lɛ shi mawo bo, ni maha amɛte shi amɛwo bo kɛjɛ he fɛɛ he. 23Maha hii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ ajɛ Babilon kɛ Kaldea kɛ Pekod kɛ Shoa kɛ Koa kɛ Asiria fɛɛ aba. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ oblahii kɛ amraloi kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi kɛ gbɛnaahiɛlɔi kɛ tabilɔi ni tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ ji amɛ. 24 Ni mɛi pii kɛ ta shwiilii kɛ tsɔnei ni gbalaa nii aaajɛ kooyigbɛ aba; ni amɛaagba amɛwo ohe kɛ tsɛŋi bibii kɛ dade fai, ni maha amɛ hegbɛ ni amɛkojo bo yɛ amɛmlai anaa. 25Mimli aaafu bo koni amɛkɛ bo aye yɛ mlila naa. Amɛaafolɔ ogugɔ kɛ otoii, ni amɛkɛ klante aaagbegbee omɛi ni baashwɛ lɛ.
