Ebaaye shikpɔji nɛɛ babaoo anɔ kunim. Shi tatsɛ ko hu baate shi awo lɛ, ni ebaaye enɔ kunim, ni ebaafo Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ henɔwomɔ lɛ sɛɛ. Enɛ baahã Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ henɔwomɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛgbele ahã lɛ. 19Siria maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baaku esɛɛ eyatua mɔji ni yɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi abaaye enɔ kunim yɛ jɛi, ni biɛ enaagbee baaba yɛ.
20“Maŋtsɛ ko baaba yɛ esɛɛ. Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baawo etsulɔ gbɛ akɛ eyanyɛ maŋbii lɛ anɔ koni etsu amɛ onia pii ewo maŋtsɛ fotro lɛ mli. Shi be kukuoo ko sɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni abaagbe lɛ, jeee yɛ mlifu naa loo ta mli.”
Siria Maŋtsɛ fɔŋ lɛ
21 Bɔfo lɛ tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni baanyiɛ sɛɛ ebaye Siria maŋtsɛ agbɛnɛ lɛ ji gbɔmɔ gbonyo ko ni bɛ hegbɛ akɛ eyeɔ maŋtsɛ; shi be ni aaahɛle shi lɛ etsɔ̃ juukɛfɔ̃ kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ nɔ enine eshɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ. 22Tabilɔi fɛɛ ni aaate shi awo lɛ lɛ, ebaabɛɛ amɛ eshwie. Nakai nɔŋŋ ebaafee kpãŋmɔ lɛ lumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ. 23Ekɛ majimaji baakpãŋ, shi eyeŋ anɔkwa. Ebaana hewalɛ kpele, tsɛbelɛ emaŋbii ayi faaa. 24Ebaafã ta trukaa kɛya shikpɔŋ ko ni hi jogbaŋŋ nɔ, ni ebaaya eyafee nii ni etsɛmɛi kɛ eniimɛi tete efeko eko dã yɛ jɛi. Nii ni ebaaha yɛ jɛi lɛ, ebaajara ehã tabilɔi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ. Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ ebaato eyiŋ akɛ ebaafãfãa tai kɛyatua maji tamɔ mɔji; shi eyeŋ omanye.
25“Hewalɛ kɛ ekãa ni yɔɔ emli lɛ baakãnya lɛ koni ebua ta kpele naa koni ekɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ayawu. Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hu kɛ ta kpele baaba ekɛ lɛ abawu; shi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ yeŋ kunim, ejaakɛ abaato eshigbeemɔ he ŋai srɔtoi ashi lɛ. 26Mɛi po ni naa edɛŋ niyenii jurɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ tete baagbee lɛ shi eko. Etabilɔi lɛ babaoo baanyɔnyɔɔ, ni abaabɛɛ eta lɛ ashwie. 27Maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ baatara shi yɛ okplɔ̃ kome he amɛye nii, shi amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ yiŋsha yɛ enyɛmi he; ni amɛaalaka amɛhe yɛ niyenii lɛ shishi tete. Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yiŋtoo lɛ baŋ mli haŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ be ni ato lɛ shɛko. 28Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ nii babaoo ni ena, yɛ taitai ni ewu lɛ amli, lɛ baaku esɛɛ ekɛya eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi etsui baasu jamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ebaafee nɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
29“Kɛji be ni ato lɛ shɛ lɛ, ebaaba ebatua Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ; shi nibii ejaŋ haŋ lɛ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ, 30ejaakɛ Romabii kɛ lɛji baaba abatua lɛ, ni ebaashe gbeyei. Ebaagbala ehe shi, ni ebaaku esɛɛ kɛ mlila, ni ebaaya ni eyaka akɛ eeefite jamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Ebaabo mɛi ni ekwa jamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ moŋ aŋaawoo toi. 31 Ebaawo etabilɔi lɛ ekomɛi agbɛ koni amɛyabule Sɔlemɔ we Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ mɔɔ lɛ hu. Amɛbaagu daa gbi afɔlei ni ashãa lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amãgã ni buleɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ baama jɛi. 32Ekɛ naadɔkɔmɔ baalaka mɛi ni ekwa jamɔ lɛ; shi mɛi ni miiye amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anɔkwa lolo lɛ baadamɔ shi kpɛŋŋ amɛshi lɛ. 33Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ nilelɔi lɛ ekomɛi baatsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ nii, tsɛbelɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa, abaashãshãa mɛi komɛi, abaaha amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi anii, ni abaaŋɔ mɛi komɛi nom kɛyashi be ko. 34Be mli nɔŋŋ ni agbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ, abaaye abua amɛ fioo ko kɛ̃, ni mɛi pii baaba abafata amɛhe, shi jeee kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ. 35Abaagbe maŋbii lɛ ateŋ nilelɔi lɛ ekomɛi; shi akɛ amɛgbele lɛ baatsuu Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ahe koni amɛyɛ futafuta. Nii nɛɛ baaya nɔ kɛyashi naagbee be lɛ baashɛ, ni ji be ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto lɛ.
36 “Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baafee nɔ ni lɛ etsui taoɔ, ni ebaawo ehe nɔ. Ebaatsɛ ehe agbo fe nyɔŋmɔ fɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeewie hepupuumɔ wiemɔ tete eshi nyɔŋmɔi aNyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ. Ebaaya nɔ nɛkɛ aahu kɛyaashi Nyɔŋmɔ emiŋ ŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ, ni agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala etoi. Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto akɛ ebaafee lɛ lɛ, ebaana efee lɛ. 37 Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ ebuŋ nyɔŋmɔ ni etsɛmɛi lɛ ja lɛ tete loo nyɔŋmɔ ni yei sumɔɔ lɛ hu. Ebuŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko, ejaakɛ ebaawo ehe nɔ yɛ fɛɛ nɔ. 38Shi moŋ ebaabu nyɔŋmɔ ni buɔ maji ahe. Ebaahiɛ edɛŋ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ tɛi ni jara wa kɛ nikeenii ni jara wa ekɛyahã nyɔŋmɔ ko ni etsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee koni ekɛwo nakai nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam. 39Nakai ebaafee yɛ mɔji ni wala lɛ amli ehã maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko ni eeekpɛlɛ̃ ehewalɛ nɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni buɔ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔyelɔ lɛ, ebaawo amɛhiɛ nyam, ni eeehã amɛye mɛi pii anɔ; ebaajara shikpɔji lɛ amli ehã amɛ akɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo.
40“Kɛji Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ naagbee be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ baaya eyatua lɛ. Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baafã tamɔ ahum ekɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ abakpe kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔtalɔi kɛ lɛji babaoo. Ebaatua shikpɔji babaoo, ni ebaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ kɛho tamɔ faa ni eje ŋa. 41Ebaatua Shiwoo Shikpɔŋ lɛ tete, ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ baanyɔnyɔɔ; shi hei ni baaje edɛŋ nɛ: Edom kɛ Moab kɛ Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kpotoo. 42Kɛji efã ta nɛɛ ewo nakai shikpɔji lɛ, Ijipt diɛŋtsɛ po yeŋ ehe. 43Ebaaloo Ijipt shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ ejwetri fɛɛ kɛya. Ebaaye Libia kɛ Etiopia hu fɛɛ nɔ. 44Shi saji ni baajɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ aba lɛ baawo ehe gbeyei; ni ekɛ mlila kpele baaya eyakpãtã gbɔmɛi babaoo ahiɛ butuu. 45Ebaamamɔ abladei abui ni eyɔɔ lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ kɛ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ teŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi moŋ jɛi enaagbee baaba yɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko yeŋ ebuaŋ lɛ.”

Title: DANIEL 12
Content:
Naagbee be lɛ
1 Bɔfo lɛ tsa ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Mikael, lumɔ kpeteŋkple ni buɔ omaŋbii lɛ ahe lɛ, aaate shi adamɔ shi; kɛkɛ lɛ fimɔ be ko aaaba ni anako ehenɔ dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni aje maŋtoo shishi kɛbashi nakai be lɛ mli. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, aaahere omaŋ lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana akɛ aŋma egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ yiwala. 2 Ni mɛi ni egboi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii ahiɛ aaatsɛ̃; mɛi komɛi aaatee naanɔ wala mli; shi mɛi komɛi hu aaatee naanɔ hiɛgbele mli. 3 Ni mɛi ni le nii lɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ atatu kpɛmɔ, ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi pii agbɛ kɛtee jalɛ mli lɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ ŋulamii kɛaatee naanɔ.” 4 Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Bo, Daniel, tsiimɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔ, ni osɔo wolo nɛɛ naa kɛyashi naagbee be lɛ. Ni mɛi pii aaagba amɛhe naa kɛya kɛba kɛtao nɔ ni eba lɛ shishi; ni nilee aaafa.”
5Kɛkɛ ni mi, Daniel, mikwɛ ni naa, mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ damɔ shi, mɔ kome yɛ faa lɛ naa biɛ nɛɛ, ni mɔ kome hu yɛ faa lɛ sɛɛ. 6 Ni mɔ kome kɛɛ nuu lɛ ni wo klala ni yɛɔ, mɔ ni yɔɔ faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ aaagbe nɛkɛ naakpɛɛnii nɛɛ anaa?” 7 Ni nuu ni wo klala ni yɔɔ faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ wo eninejurɔ kɛ ebɛku nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni ekã mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ kitã. Minu ni ekɛɛ, “Ebaakã he kɛyashi afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã, beyinɔ ni aaakumɔ hewalɛ ni waa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ayi lɛ agbe naa; kɛkɛ lɛ aaagbe enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ naa.” 8Minu nɔ ni bɔfo lɛ wie lɛ, shi minuuu shishi. No hewɔ lɛ, mibi akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ofainɛ, te enɛɛmɛi anaagbee lɛ aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ?”
9Eto he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Daniel, kwɛmɔ ohiɛgbɛ ni oya! Wiemɔi lɛ atsimɔ nɔ, ni asɔo amɛnaa kɛyaashi naagbee be lɛ aaaba. 10Mɛi pii baatsuu amɛhe koni amɛyɛ futafuta ni amɛhe atse. Shi yitsoŋwalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nuŋ shishi, ni amɛaaya nɔ amɛye yitsoŋwalɛ sane; shi nilelɔi lɛ, amɛ lɛ, amɛbaanu nɔ ni yaa nɔ lɛ shishi.
11 “Kɛji agu daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ, be ni akɛ amãgã ni buleɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ baama shi lɛ, gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu baaho. 12Aaajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baato amɛtsui shi koni amɛye anɔkwa kɛyashi gbii akpe kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ lɛ.
13“Ni bo Daniel, ye anɔkwa kɛyashi naagbee; ni no sɛɛ lɛ obaagbo; shi ooote shi, ni ooona aekoo ni sa bo yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.”

Title: HOSEA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbalɔ Hosea gba yɛ Israelbii akooyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Lɛ ji gbalɔ ni baye Amos sɛɛ. Egba be mli ni maŋ sane hãaa Samaria ajɔ dani maŋsɛɛbii baye Samaria nɔ kunim, yɛ afi 721 Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli. Sane ni ye Hosea tsui jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ji wɔŋjamɔ ni etsɔ̃ maŋbii asubaŋ lɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛkɛ anɔkwayeli jaaa lɛ lɛ. Hosea fee ekãa, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbalãshihilɛ mli anɔkwa ni eŋa Gomer yeee lɛ lɛ fee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ, ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ emaŋbii lɛ anii akɛ nakai amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa yɛ ejamɔ mli. Bɔ ni Gomer jeɔ lɛ Hosea sɛɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amɛ hu ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ amɛjeɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Israel baana amanehulu ni akɛbaagbla etoi. Shi suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛsumɔɔ emɛi lɛ baahã Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋ atsɔ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ yɛ Israel he, ni ebaaba ebahere Israel, ni ekɛ amɛ baaba emasɛi ekoŋŋ koni ekɛ amɛ atsa tamɔ sa ko lɛ. Gbalɛ nɛɛ jieɔ suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ,
“Israel, te mafee tɛŋŋ maŋmɛɛ ohe hu?
Te mafee tɛŋŋ makwa bo hu?
Mitsui eŋmɛŋ mi gbɛ ni mafee nakai
…Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe” (11.8).
Mlijaramɔi
Hosea gblãshihilɛ 1.1—3.5
Saji ni akɛshi Israel 4.1—13.16
Israel tsuitsakemɔ kɛ shiwoo 14.1-9

Title: HOSEA 1
Content:
1 Yehowa wiemɔ ni ekɛ Hosea, ni ji Beeri bi lɛ, wie yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi Uzia kɛ Yotam kɛ Ahaz kɛ Hezekia ayinɔ lɛ nɛ. No mli lɛ Yeroboam, Yoash bi lɛ, miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Hosea ŋa kɛ ebii
2Be ni Yehowa kɛ Hosea bɔ̃i wiemɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaŋɔ yoo ajwamãŋ koni okɛ lɛ afee oŋa; ni bii ni okɛ lɛ baafɔ lɛ baafee ajwamãŋ bii tamɔ bɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ekwa mi, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa lɛ.”
3No hewɔ lɛ, Hosea tee ni eyaŋɔ Diblaim biyoo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gomer lɛ. Gomer na musu ni efɔ binuu.
4 Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, ‘Yezreel’, ejaakɛ eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni lá shi ni Yehu shwie yɛ Yezreel maŋ lɛ mli lɛ mibatɔ he owele yɛ eshwiei anɔ, ni mibagu Yehu we lɛ maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel. 5Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibafite Israel tawuu hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yezreel jɔɔ lɛ mli.”
6Gomer na musu ekoŋŋ, ni efɔ biyoo. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, Lo-Ruhama: ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ etã’, ejaakɛ mikaŋ he mihaŋ mimusuŋ atsɔ̃ mi yɛ Israelbii ahe, ni mikɛfaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ. 7Shi mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ Yuda he, ni mi Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibahere amɛyiwala; shi moŋ mitsɔ̃ŋ gãi loo klante loo ta loo okpɔŋɔi loo tayaa okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ mihereŋ amɛyiwala.”
8Be ni Gomer etse ebi Lo-Ruhama fufɔ lɛ, esaa ena musu, ni efɔ binuu ekoŋŋ.
9Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, Lo-Ammi ‘Nyɛjeee mimaŋ,’ ejaakɛ Israelbii jeee mimaŋ dɔŋŋ, ni mi hu jeee amɛNyɔŋmɔ ji mi.”
Abaatee Israel shi ekoŋŋ
10 Shi kɛ̃lɛ Israelbii ayikulɛ aaatamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia ni anyɛŋ asusu aloo akane. Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, he ni akɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛjeee mimaŋ lɛ,’ jɛi nɔŋŋ abaakɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bii ji nyɛ.” 11No mli Yudabii kɛ Israelbii anaa aaabakpe shi kɛfee ekome, ni amɛaato mɔ koome akɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ, ni amɛaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yezreel gbi lɛ gbi wulu ni.

Title: HOSEA 2
Content:
1No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛa nyɛnyɛmimɛi hii, Israelbii, lɛ akɛ Ammi, “Mimaŋ ji amɛ” kɛ nyɛmimɛi yei lɛ hu akɛ Ruhama, “Mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe.”
Gomer yeee anɔkwa lɛ, Israel hu yeee anɔkwa
2“Mibii, nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛ awiea, ejaakɛ jeee miŋa ji lɛ dɔŋŋ; ni mi hu jeee ewu ji mi. Nyɛkɛ lɛ awiea koni ekpa ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ, ni efo egblãfitemɔ lɛ sɛɛ. 3Kɛjeee nakai lɛ maŋmɛ lɛ yayai tamɔ gbi ni afɔ lɛ lɛ; mahã etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋa nɔ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ egbi, ni mikɛ kumai baagbe lɛ. 4Asaŋ minaŋ emusuŋbii lɛ hu amɔbɔ, ejaakɛ yoo ajwamãŋ bii ji amɛ. 5Ejaakɛ amɛnyɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ; efee hiɛgbejianii kɛna amɛ musu. Ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Hã maya mayatiu mishieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; amɛ amɛhãa mi niyenii kɛ nu kɛ mikuntu kɛ klala lɛ kɛ mimu kɛ dãa.’ 6No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mikɛ ŋmei baafo ehe afabaŋ, ni matswa gbogbo kɛsa eyi koni matsi lɛ gbɛ. 7Eeetiu eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ nɛ, shi eninaŋ amɛ; ni eeetao amɛ, shi enaŋ amɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ lɛ eeekɛɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Hã makpale kɛya miklɛŋklɛŋ wu lɛ ŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ be ni mikɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ehi hã mi moŋ fe amrɔ nɛɛ.’ 8Te eŋɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ mi ji mɔ ni hã lɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛkɛjaa jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ. 9No hewɔ lɛ, mashɔ̃ mibele lɛ kɛ wain lɛ hu kɛ kuŋtu kɛ klala ni enaa ebuɔ lɛ. 10Maŋmɛ lɛ yayai agbɛnɛ matsɔ̃ɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ lɛ ahere yɛ midɛŋ. 11Mafo mliflimɔ gbii juji ni eyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ, nyɔji hei kɛ afi gbii juji lɛ, kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ. 12Ni maŋala ewaintsei lɛ kɛ agbãmi tsei lɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ nomɛi ji nɔ ni enaa yɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ akɛ enyɔmɔwo lɛ. Mahã fɛɛ atsɔ̃ koo koni ŋaŋ kooloi aye amɛnɔ nii. 13Magbala etoi yɛ tsofakɛŋma ni etee eyashã ehã Baal jemawɔji yɛ amɛgbii juji lɛ anɔ lɛ hewɔ. Ewula kɛ jwinei kɛtee eyanyiɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ, ni ehiɛ kpa minɔ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ.
Suɔmɔ ni Yehowa yɔɔ hã ewebii
14“No hewɔ lɛ, mibagbe eyitso ni mi kɛ lɛ aaatee ŋa lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ; mi kɛ lɛ aaayawie naajɔlɛ wiemɔ yɛ jɛi koni eyiŋ atsɔ̃ kɛba shĩa. 15 Makpale ewain tromi lɛ mahã lɛ, ni mahã Amanehulu Jɔɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ Hiɛnɔkãmɔ Agbo ahã lɛ. Eeehere mi nɔ tamɔ efee yɛ eblayeiaŋ lɛ be ni ejɛ Ijipt eba lɛ. 16Nakai be lɛ ebaatsɛ mi ‘Miwu’ ekoŋŋ, shi jeee ‘MiBaal’ dɔŋŋ. 17Ejaakɛ mibakɔ jemawɔji Baali lɛ agbɛii yɛ edaaŋ; ni etsiŋ amɛtã tete po dɔŋŋ.
18“Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mikɛ ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii ni wamɔɔ fɛɛ aaakpãŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ koni amɛkaye nyɛ awui; ni makumɔ gãi kɛ klante amli, ni mahã tawuu sɛɛ afo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaahi shi shweshweeshwe.
19“Israel, mibatsɛ ohe baa akɛ miŋa kɛaatee naanɔ;
Maye bo anɔkwa, ni maye bo jalɛ sane,
Masumɔ bo, ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe.
20Maye mishiwoo nɔ, ni mafee bo miŋa,
ni ooole akɛ mi ji Yehowa.
21Nakai be lɛ mahã mimɛi, Israelbii, asɔlemɔ lɛ hetoo.
22Mahã nu anɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ aba abele kɛ wain kɛ mu ahã Israel.
23 Mahã mimɛi lɛ ahe shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni mahã amɛshwere.
Mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ akɛ ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ etã’ lɛ,
kɛ mɛi hu ni atsɛ amɛ akɛ ‘Nyɛjeee mimɛi’ lɛ,
mibana amɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Ni makɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mimɛi ji nyɛ,’
ni amɛaahere nɔ akɛ ‘bo ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ”

Title: HOSEA 3
Content:
Hosea kɛ Yoo ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ekoŋŋ ni oyasumɔ yoo ni ewu sumɔɔ lɛ, shi lɛ lɛ ekɛ nuu kroko miifite gbãlã. Osumɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, misumɔɔ mimɛi Israelbii lɛ; tsɛbelɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛkwa mi, ni amɛtee wɔji aŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ wain yibii yashãa afɔle amɛhãa amãgãi.”
2No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ akoko kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yahã yoo lɛ; 3ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ hii shi kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ ohã mi; okabɔ ajwamãŋ, ni okayagbã nuu ko; ni mi hu mahi shi mahã bo.”
4Ejaakɛ nakai pɛ Israel baahi shi gbii pii ni amɛbɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛbɛ lumɛi hu; asaŋ amɛshãaa afɔle; ni amɛbɛ shiu lɛ amɛbɛ efod kɛ terafim hu ni akɛbiɔ nii. 5Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii baaku amɛsɛɛ, amɛaakpale, ni amɛaabatao Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, amɛaabatao amɛmaŋtsɛ ni ji David shwie ko hu sɛɛgbɛ. Nakai be lɛ amɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ aaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eeejɔɔ amɛ kɛ nibii kpakpai yɛ naagbee bei lɛ amli.

Title: HOSEA 4
Content:
Yehowa kɛ sane shi Israel
1Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ena. “Anɔkwayeli kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ etã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni aleee Nyɔŋmɔ hu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 2Nɔ ni eshwɛ amɛ pɛ ji kitãkãmɔ kɛ amale kɛ mɔgbee kɛ juu kɛ gbãlãfitemɔ; amɛkuɔ mla fɛɛ mla mli, ni amɛshwieɔ lá shi ni eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ. 3Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baagbi, ni enɔ nibii fɛɛ baagboi. Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ nuŋ loi tete baagboi.”
Yehowa kɛ sane shi Osɔfoi lɛ
4Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko akashwa mɔ ko, ni mɔ ko akakã mɔ ko hiɛ hu, ejaakɛ nyɛ, Osɔfoi lɛ, nyɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni mikɛyɔɔ sane. 5Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛaatɔ̃ shwane, ni gbalɔi lɛ hu kɛ nyɛ baatɔ̃ nyɔɔŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã Israel, nyɛnyɛ lɛ hiɛ. 6Mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã ejaakɛ amɛleee nii. Akɛni okwa nilee hewɔ lɛ, mi hu miikwa bo akɛ misɔfo; ni akɛni ohiɛ ekpa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mihiɛ miikpa obii lɛ anɔ.
7“Bɔ ni amɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, ayi faa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfeɔ esha babaoo amɛshiɔ mi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, mibahã amɛhiɛ nyam lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛgbele. 8Amɛtsɔ̃ esha ni mimɛi lɛ feɔ lɛ nɔ amɛna nii, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛshweɔ akɛ mɛi aya nɔ afee esha. 9Magbala osɔfoi lɛ atoi tamɔ maŋbii lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ amɛjeŋba hewɔ; mawo amɛnishaianii ni amɛfee lɛ he nyɔmɔ. 10Amɛbaaye nii nɛ, shi amɛtɔrɔŋ, ni amɛaabɔ ajwamãŋ nɛ, shi amɛshwereŋ kɛ bii, ejaakɛ amɛkwa mi, Yehowa, ni amɛtee wɔji moŋ aŋɔɔ.”
Yehowa wie eshi wɔŋjamɔ
11Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Wain momo kɛ wain hee fɛɛ hãa nilee ŋmɛɔ mɔ. 12Mimɛi biɔ tso akɛ egba, ni amɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtso lɛ gbaa amɛ teemɔŋ saji, ejaakɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mumɔ ehã amɛkwa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni amɛdu gbɛ, amɛtee wɔji aŋɔɔ. 13Amɛshã afɔlei yɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ, ni amɛshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ; amɛshã yɛ odum kɛ onyai kɛ papao tsei ashishi, ejaakɛ tsei lɛ ahɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli hi.
“Enɛ hewɔ ni nyɛbiyei lɛ bɔɔ ajwamãŋ, ni nyɛbihii aŋamɛi lɛ fiteɔ gbãlã lɛ. 14Shi kɛji nyɛbiyei lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ migbalaŋ amɛtoi, ni kɛji nyɛbihii aŋamɛi lɛ hu fite gbãlã lɛ migbalaŋ amɛtoi, ejaakɛ nyɛ, hii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tete lɛ nyɛ kɛ ajwamãŋi ni yɔɔ jamɔhe lɛ yabɔɔ ajwamãŋ, ni nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ shãa wɔŋjamɔ afɔlei lɛ. Naa, maŋ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ kpãtãa.
15“Kɛji nyɛ, Israelbii, yeee mi anɔkwa yɛ mi jamɔ mli lɛ, nakai su lɛ akabala Yuda hu. Nyɛkayaa Gilgal, ni nyɛkayaa Bet-Aven hu nyɛyajaa; ni nyɛkɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ akakãa kitã akɛ ‘Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ nɛɛ!’ 16Israelbii akuɛŋ ti tamɔ tsina oblayoo. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Yehowa aaalɛ amɛ tamɔ alɛɔ toobii yɛ ŋa shwaŋŋ nɔ hu? 17Israel ekɔ wɔŋjamɔ efɔ enɔ; nyɛŋmɛa ejeŋ he nyɛhãa lɛ. 18Kɛji amɛnunuu dãi ni amɛtɔrɔ sɛɛ lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ etsa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛsumɔɔ hiɛgbele moŋ fe hiɛnyam. 19Kɔɔyɔɔ fɔŋ ko baatswa amɛ waa, ni ebaahã amɛhiɛ agboi yɛ wɔŋjamɔ afɔleshãa hewɔ.”

Title: HOSEA 5
Content:
1“Nyɛ Osɔfoi, nyɛboa sane nɛɛ toi! Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkaa toi! Nyɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli bii, nyɛfea toi, shi naa, abaakojo nyɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe tamɔ akpa ni atsɔ̃ yɛ Mizpa, kɛ yaa ni akɛlɛɛ shi yɛ Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 2Efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ ebote nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ mli vii yɛ Akasia maŋ lɛ mli, mibagbala amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ toi waa diɛŋtsɛ. 3Mile Efraim bɔ ni eyɔɔ tsɔ̃; no hewɔ lɛ, Israel kɛ ehe eteko mi. Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, Efraim, oje misɛɛ, ni Israel ebule ehe.”
Hosea bɔ wɔŋjamɔ he kɔkɔ
4“Amɛnifeemɔnii hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ amɛku kɛba amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mumɔ ebote amɛmli, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛleee mi, Yehowa dɔŋŋ. 5Israel shwãa nii lɛ miiye odase moŋ eeshi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Israel kɛ Efraim hiɛ baakpãtã, ni Yuda hu kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã. 6Amɛkɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai baaya ayashã afɔle kɛtao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, shi amɛnaŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa egbala ehe shi eshi amɛ. 7Akɛni amɛje Yehowa sɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyafɔ gbɔi abii. Shi nyɔŋ hee ni baaje lɛ mli lɛ abaakpãtã amɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ.”
Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ amɛhe wu ta
8“Akpã ta tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Gibea! Akpã koofɛŋ lɛ yɛ Rama! Abɔ oshe yɛ Bet-Aven! Ohe akpokpo, Benyamin! 9Gbi nɔ ni abaagbala Efraim toi lɛ, ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. Naa, nɔ ni baaba Israel akutsei lɛ anɔ lɛ no mikɛɛ nɛɛ.
10“Yuda lumɛi lɛ tsiɔ husu kɛyaa sɛɛ kɛjuɔ shikpɔŋ. Mahã mimlifu ate shi awo amɛ tamɔ nu ni etue. 11Efraim kã piŋmɔ mli. Nyɔŋmɔ ebu lɛ fɔ ejaakɛ etswa efai shi akɛ eyaanyiɛ yaka nii asɛɛ. 12No hewɔ lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mitsɔ̃ omlɛgɛ ni baaye Efraim, kɛ fala ni baakpãtã Yuda hiɛ.
13“Be ni Israel na hela ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ni Yuda hu na fala ni efã lɛ, Efraim tee Asiria maŋtsɛ kpanaa lɛ ŋɔɔ eyabi edɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ, shi Asiria nyɛɛɛ amɛ tsofa efee aloo etsa amɛ. 14Mibahuru tamɔ jata mayi Israel kɛ Yuda hu nɔ, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mibatserɛ amɛmli, kɛkɛ lɛ mishi amɛ mitee. Mashãtã amɛ kɛya ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ehere.
15 “Mibagbala mihe shi mashi amɛ kɛyaashi amɛaakpɛlɛ̃ amɛtɔ̃mɔ nɔ, ni amɛaabatao misɛɛgbɛ. Ekolɛ fimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaatao mi.”

Title: HOSEA 6
Content:
Maŋbii ejeee amɛhe sɛɛ anɔkwale mli
1Maŋbii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Akɛni lɛ etserɛ wɔmli lɛ, lɛ eeetsa wɔ; ni akɛni lɛ etswia wɔ nii lɛ, lɛ eeefi nɔ ehã wɔ. 2Gbii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, eeetsĩɛ wɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ eeetee wɔ shi, ni wɔ kɛ lɛ aaahi shi. 3Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa mɔdɛŋ wɔlea Yehowa. Bɔ ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ daa gbi lɛ je tsɛreɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. Ebaaba wɔŋɔɔ tamɔ Agbiɛnaa nunɛmɔ tueɔ shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” 4Shi Yehowa kɛɔ akɛ, “Ao! Israel, mɛni mafee ohe? Ao! Yuda, te mafee bo tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ leebi atatu; etamɔ leebi bɔ ni kpalaa oya. 5No hewɔ ni mitsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ migbala amɛtoi, ni mikɛ midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ kã amɛ, ni kojomɔ ni mikojo amɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ kane. 6 Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ ji suɔmɔ ni tsakeee shi jeee afɔle; nɔ ni mitaoɔ ji lee ni aleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shi jeee shãaafɔle.
7“Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam fee lɛ, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa. 8Gilead lɛ nɔfɔŋfeelɔi amaŋ ni, ni lá ewu amɛhe. 9Tamɔ bɔ ni ojotswalɔi woɔ mɔ ka lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ pɛ osɔfoi lɛ efee ekome amɛgbeɔ mɛi, ni amɛfeɔ nishaianii yɛ Shekem gbɛteŋ. 10Mina gbeyei nii ko yɛ Israel: Efraim kɛ amãgãjamɔ miibɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jɛi; abule Israel.
11“Ni bo, Yuda, hu mito be ni nɔ ni oduɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, obaakpa eyibii.

Title: HOSEA 7
Content:
1“Kɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ matsa mimɛi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛshwere pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Efraim kɛ Samaria nifɔɔjianii lɛ eje kpo: no ji mɔshishiumɔ kɛ juu kɛ ojotswaa yɛ gbɛteŋ. 2Efeee amɛ kwraa akɛ miina amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ. Shi naa amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ ebɔle amɛ, ni miikwɛ.”
Atoɔ yitso fɔŋ nigii yɛ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ
3Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ hãa maŋtsɛ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe, ni amɛkɛ mɔshishinyiɛmɔ wiemɔ hãa lumɛi hu naa miishɛɛ. 4Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ashishinyiɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa yɛ jamɔ mli. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la ni awo ni nishãlɔ eŋmɛɛ he koni etso kɛyashi ma ni akpɔtɔ lɛ aaafu kɛha shãa. 5Gbi nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ye egbi jurɔ lɛ, lumɛi lɛ kɛ dãatɔɔ wo amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhe hela. Maŋtsɛ ta fɛoyelɔi tete po adɛ̃. 6Yitso fɔŋ ni amɛto yɛ amɛtsui mli lɛ sukɔɔ yɛ amɛmli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni leebi lɛ etsoɔ grigri tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la.
7“Amɛkɛ mlila ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ gbegbee amɛnɔyelɔi lɛ. Amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nyɔnyɔi, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ebooo etsɛɛɛ mi.”
Israel kɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ
8Yehowa kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Israel kɛ ehe fufuaa maŋsɛɛ maji anɔbii lɛ, ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ aboloo ni ebe fã kɛ fã. 9Gbɔi lɛ ehã ehewalɛ etã, shi eyooko; eyiteŋ eje waŋ, shi ekɔɔɔ sɛɛ. 10Israel shwãanii lɛ miiye odase miishi lɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋbii lɛ kpaleee koni amɛba mi, Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, aloo koni amɛtao misɛɛgbɛ. 11Israel etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpo kwashia ni bɛ yitso: ŋmɛnɛ lɛ eetsɛ Ijipt koni ebawa lɛ; wɔ lɛ eetsɛ Asiria. 12Shi kɛji amɛshi kɛmiiya nɔŋŋ lɛ mibafɔ̃ amɛ nɔ yaa madu amɛ tamɔ aduɔ loofɔlɔ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.
13“Kpoo hã amɛ ejaakɛ amɛshi mi, ni amɛbɔ ko. Amɛhiɛ ekpãtã ejaakɛ amɛtse mihiɛ atua. Mi lɛ mitao akɛ mahere amɛyiwala; shi amɛ lɛ amɛmalemaleɔ mihe. 14Amɛfooo amɛtsɛɛɛ mi kɛjɛɛɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ; shi moŋ amɛsai anɔ amɛfoɔ waa yɛ. Kɛji amɛmiisɔle yɛ abele kɛ wain he lɛ, amɛkɛ kakla folɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ feɔ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ etse mihiɛ atua. 15Yɛ mli akɛ mi ji mɔ ni tsɔse amɛ, ni mihã amɛna hewalɛ nɛ, shi daa nɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ pɛ amɛjwɛŋɔ yɛ mihe. 16 Amɛkã he amɛmiija Baal lolo, ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãitso ni waaa. Naafuu wiemɔi ni amɛlumɛi lɛ wieɔ lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa. Ni enɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɔ ni akɛaaye amɛhe fɛo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

Title: HOSEA 8
Content:
Yehowa bu Israel fɔ yɛ amãgãjamɔ hewɔ
1 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ okɛhɛle mɛi ashi. Henyɛlɔ miiba tamɔ okropɔŋ ebayi Yehowa we lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ eku mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛtɔ̃ mimla lɛ nɔ. 2Mi amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ akɛ, ‘WɔNyɔŋmɔ, bo ji mɔ ni wɔ, Israelbii, wɔle.’ 3Israelbii ekwa nɔ kpakpa lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, henyɛlɔi aaanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
4“Amɛto maŋtsɛmɛi, shi jeee mi minɔ amɛtsɔ̃; ni amɛhole lumɛi hu ni mileee mli eko kwraa. Amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika fee amãgãi ni baakpãtã amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ. 5Mitaooo tsinabi ni ajaa yɛ Samaria maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kwrakwra. Mimli ewo amɛ la naakpa. Mɛɛ beyinɔ po amɛaaba amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Israel? 6Ŋaalɔ ko ni fee tsinabi lɛ; shi naa, jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni. Nakai tsinabi lɛ ni ajaa yɛ Samaria lɛ, aaajwara lɛ dukuduku. 7Ejaakɛ akɛni amɛdu kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ lasuogbele ji yibii ni amɛbaakpa. Abele ekpɛŋ bi kome nɛkɛ ni aaana aye. Ni kɛji abele lɛ aaaba tete lɛ, gbɔi moŋ aaabaye. 8Majimaji lɛ emi Israel momo, ni enɛ ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ tsɛnsi ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ. 9Ejaakɛ Israel tsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋaŋ teji ni miifo shi. Etee eyabi Asiria dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ; asaŋ Efraim bɔ maŋsɛɛbii apaa koni amɛbu ehe. 10Amɛbɔ majimaji apaa moŋ, shi agbɛnɛ mibabua amɛnaa kɛkpe, ni magbala amɛtoi. Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ amɛbaakpa maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi too.
11“Israelbii mamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi koni amɛkɛdãi esha ni amɛfee lɛ, shi afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ moŋ etsɔ̃ eshafeemɔ nɔ. 12Kɛji miŋma mimlai lɛ shii akpei abɔ tete mihã amɛ lɛ, amɛbaaŋɔ mlai lɛ akɛ mɔkpɔŋ dɛŋ nii. 13Amɛsumɔɔ afɔleshãa. Amɛgbeɔ kooloi amɛkɛshãa mifɔlei lɛ akɛ loo kɛkɛ ni ayeɔ. Eji nɔ ko ni esaaa mihiɛ. Ni no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mibakai eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ni mibawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ. Ijipt kɛ̃ amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.
14 “Ejaakɛ Israel hiɛ kpa ebɔlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni emamɔ mɔji moŋ ehã ehe; ni Yuda hu tswa gbogbo ewo emaji pii ahe. Shi mawo amɛmaji lɛ amli la ni mashã amɛmɔji lɛ.”

Title: HOSEA 9
Content:
Hosea tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni abaagbala Israel toi ahã
1Israel, omli akafili bo, ni kaanya tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ. Ejaakɛ bo lɛ oje oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni oyeee lɛ anɔkwa. Ohɔ̃ɔ ohe tamɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ he fɛɛ he ohã jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ no hãa anaa abele lɛ. 2Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ abele kɛ mu lɛ shɛŋ nyɛnaa, ni anaŋ wain hu. 3Asaŋ Israel ehiŋ Yehowa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi ebaaku sɛɛ eya Ijipt nyɔŋyeli mli; ni amɛaayaye nii ni he tseee yɛ Asiria. 4Amɛnyɛŋ amɛfɔse wain amɛshwie shi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa, aloo amɛshã afɔlei ni sa amɛhã lɛ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nii ni amɛaaye lɛ aaabule mɛi fɛɛ ni aaaye eko tamɔ yara nɔ nii buleɔ mɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ nii ni amɛaaye lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhɔmɔ kɛkɛ amɛkɛaagbe, shi ekoeko shɛŋ Yehowa hiɛ. 5Te nyɛbaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji eshɛ gbijurɔyeli be loo Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ hu? 6Ejaakɛ amɛbaashi kɛya Asiria, ni Ijipt aaabua amɛgbohii lɛ anaa ni aaafu amɛ yɛ Memfis. Hei ni amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ toɔ lɛ amli baatsa kɛ sɔ̃nsɔ̃rɔ̃i, ni ŋmeitsei hu aaatsa yɛ amɛshĩai amli.
7 Toigbalamɔ gbii lɛ eshɛ, be ni abaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ pɛ ni sa lɛ lɛ eshɛ. Israel baana ele akɛ gbalɔ lɛ buulu ni, ni mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ sɛkɛyelɔ ni yɛ enishaianii hewɔ. 8Gbalɔ lɛ ato lɛ akɛ bulɔ ahã Israel, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ webii lɛ. Shi he fɛɛ he ni eeetsɔ̃ lɛ atsɔ̃ lɛ tsɔne, ni eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shĩa diɛŋtsɛ mli lɛ nyɛɛ anyɛɔ lɛ. 9 Amɛbote eshafeemɔ mli vii tamɔ bɔ ni eba yɛ Gibea lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mibani eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ahe, ni mibawo amɛ nyɔmɔ.
Esha ni Israel fee lɛ kɛ ehe nyɔmɔwoo lɛ
10 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mina Israel lɛ etamɔ wain yibii ni atoɔ lɛ ahuu yɛ ŋa nɔ. Mina nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni tsu yɛ agbãmi tso nɔ. Shi be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shɛ Poer Gɔŋ le he lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i jemawɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Poer lɛ jamɔ. Enɛ hã amɛsane je migugɔŋ fu tamɔ wɔji ni amɛjaa lɛ nɔŋŋ asane. 11Israel agbojee sɛɛ aaafo tamɔ loofɔlɔ filikiɔ lɛ. Afɔŋ bi dɔŋŋ lɛ, ahiɛŋ musu dɔŋŋ, asaŋ anaŋ musu tete dɔŋŋ yɛ amɛteŋ. 12Ni kɛji amɛna bii amɛlɛ tete mibagbe bii nɛɛ, ni mishwɛŋ ekome nɛkɛ. Anɔkwa, kɛji miŋmɛɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe lɛ sane kɛ joomɔ baaye amɛ pam.
13“Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni minaa kã shi hã Efraimbii ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eeekpala ebii lɛ eyahã koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ.” 14Mɛni masumɔ akɛ ofee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ? Yehowa, hã amɛmusu ashrake, ni amɛfufɔi fɛɛ agbi.
Yehowa bu Israel fɔ
15Yehowa kɛɛ, “Amɛto amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ feemɔ shishi yɛ Gilgal, ni jɛi mibɔ̃i amɛ nyɛɛ yɛ. Amɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ mibashwie amɛ kɛje mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Misumɔŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ! Amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ etse mihiɛ atua. 16Israel lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ tso ni egbo; hela emɔ lɛ, ni eha eshishi fãi fɛɛ egboi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, ewooo yibii dɔŋŋ. Kɛji amɛna amɛfɔ lɛ, mibagbe amɛmusuŋbii ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ.”
Gbalɔ lɛ miiwie Israel he
17MiNyɔŋmɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ, baakwa emɛi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛbooo lɛ toi. Amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ateŋ.

Title: HOSEA 10
Content:
1 Israel tamɔ wain tso ni efũ baa ni eewo. Babaoo ni Israelbii lɛ shwereɔ lɛ babaoo ni amɛmamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ji no. Bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baa nii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛsaa shiui ni amɛkɛjaa lɛ hu ahe. 2Amɛyeee anɔkwa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, amɛbaana he nyɔmɔwoo. Yehowa baakumɔ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ eshwie shi, ni ebaafite amɛshiui lɛ.
3Agbɛnɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔbɛ maŋtsɛ ejaakɛ wɔsheee Yehowa gbeyei. Shi kɛji wɔyɛ maŋtsɛ po lɛ mɛni ebaanyɛ efee ehã wɔ?” 4Amɛwieɔ huu kɛkɛ ni amɛleee nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ. Amɛwoɔ shi babaoo ni amɛle akɛ amɛyeŋ nɔ, ni amɛkpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi yaka ni sɛɛnamɔ bɛ he. No hewɔ lɛ, toigbalamɔ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ ebɔɔ ŋmei ni efɛ̃ shi yɛ ŋmɔshi akofii anɔ ahã amɛ.
5Samaria maŋ bii lɛ aaashe gbeyei, ni amɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Bet-Aven shika tsinabi lɛ hewɔ. Amɛ kɛ wulɔmɛi lɛ ni jaa tsinabi lɛ baawo yara amɛfo yɛ enyam ni afo sɛɛ lɛ hewɔ. 6Anɔkwa, abaawo shika tsinabi lɛ kɛya koni akɛyake Asiria maŋtsɛ kpele lɛ. Ni no baahã hiɛgbele amɔ Israel, ni ehiɛ baashwie shi yɛ ŋaa gbonyo toi ni ebo lɛ hewɔ. 7Samaria maŋtsɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tso kuku ni kplaŋɔ yɛ faa hiɛ. 8 Betel gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ hei ni Israelbii lɛ jaa amãgãi yɛ ni amɛkɛgbo toi lɛ, aaakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ. Ŋmei kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛi baakwɛ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ anɔ yɛ jɛi. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baabolɔ amɛkɛɛ gɔji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhaa wɔnɔ!” Ni amɛaakɛɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu akɛ, “Nyɛbashwiea wɔnɔ!”
Yehowa bu Israel fɔ
9 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israel, ofee esha kɛjɛ Gibea esha lɛ nɔ beebe, ni ohiɛ esha lɛ mli oofee lolo. Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ ta ni afã ashi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ninaa bo yɛ Gibea? 10Mibate shi mawo toigbolɔi lɛ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi bɔ ni misumɔɔ. Maji baafee ekome awo Israelbii, ni abaagbala amɛtoi yɛ eshai enyɔ lɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.
11“Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel tamɔ tsina oblayoo ni atsɔse lɛ, ni enyaa he kɛ̃, akɛ akɛ lɛ miigbee ŋmaa lɛ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, miwooo ekuɛ fɛɛfɛo lɛ kɔŋtso. Shi agbɛnɛ mibawo Israel kuɛ kɔŋtso. Yuda baashãtã tsina kɔi ekɛhu; ni Israel baaninɛ nɔ ni ehu lɛ.” 12 Nyɛfea nii ni ja tamɔ aduɔ wu kpakpa, ni nyɛaakpa misuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yibii. Nyɛjea wala hee shishi tamɔ asaa shikpɔŋ atoɔ nidumɔ, ejaakɛ be yɛ lolo bɔ ni sa ni nyɛkɛaatao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ kɛyaashi eeeba ebajɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nii anɔ. 13Nyɛdu efɔŋ, ni nyɛkpa nɔsha, ni nyɛye yibii ni amale wo: “Ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ kɛ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ayifalɛ nɔ. 14No hewɔ lɛ, ta aaabanina nyɛ, ni aaakpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Shalman kpãtã Bet-Arbel maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ ta mli, ni eplenee emli yeifɔyei kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ lɛ. 15Nakai nɔ ko pɛpɛɛpɛ baaba nyɛnɔ, nyɛ Betelbii. Efɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ baagbo leebi maŋkpa.”

Title: HOSEA 11
Content:
Suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ hã toigbolɔi
1 Yehowa kɛɛ,
“Israel gbekɛbiashi beebe misumɔ lɛ kɛjɛ;
Ijipt tɔ̃ɔ eyɔɔ ni mitsɛ lɛ akɛ mibi.
2Shi shii abɔ ni mitsɛɔ lɛ lɛ,
shii abɔ ni eyaa sɛɛsɛɛ moŋ eshiɔ mi ji no;
ni amɛyaa nɔ amɛshãa afɔlei amɛhãa Baal,
ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amãgãi.
3Tsɛbelɛ mi mifee Israel tataa ni ele nyiɛmɔ.
Mihole amɛ mifɔ̃ mikpɔkɔiaŋ,
shi amɛŋɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ mi mihere amɛ.
4Mikɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlitsɔlɛ gbala amɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ;
ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ni fãa amɛdaaŋ manyoflɛ,
ni mikɛ niyenii ma amɛhiɛ.”
5“Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Asiria aaaye amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛkpaleɔ kɛbaa miŋɔɔ. 6Taitai baate shi yɛ amɛmaji lɛ anɔ, ni abaakumɔ amɛmaji lɛ agboi lɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnilee nɔ. 7Beiaŋ ni mimɛi lɛ ekã akɛ shimɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaashi mi lɛ, kɛ̃ɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaakɛ̃mɔ yɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni kã amɛkuɛ lɛ hewɔ, shi mɔ ko woŋ yɛ amɛnɔ.
8 “Ao Israel, te mafee tɛŋŋ maŋmɛɛ ohe hu?
Te mafee tɛŋŋ makwa bo hu?
Aso manyɛ ohiɛ makpãtã tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Adma lɛ;
aloo tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ Zeboim ye lɛ?
Mitsui miitswa yɛ mimli,
ni mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe.
9Mikɛ mlifu yeŋ osane lɛ.
Mikpãtãŋ Israel hiɛ dɔŋŋ
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, shi jeee gbɔmɔ.
Mi, Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ,
mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ mlifu.
10“Mimɛi lɛ baanyiɛ, mi Yehowa, misɛɛ; beyinɔ ni mabo tamɔ jata lɛ amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ. Amɛhe aaakpokpo kɛaajɛ anaigbɛ kɛba. 11Amɛaaba kɛaajɛ Ijipt kɛ hekpokpomɔ tamɔ loofɔji; amɛaaba tamɔ okpoi kɛaajɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩai amli ekoŋŋ. Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.”
Abu Yuda kɛ Israel fɔ
12Yehowa kɛɛ, “Israelbii ebɔle mihe kɛkpe kɛ amale kɛ mɔshishiumɔ, ni Yudabii kã he amɛmiitse miihiɛ atua, mi ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo kɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”

Title: HOSEA 12
Content:
1“Israelbii agbi muu mli tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme lɛ, ehe baaa sɛɛnamɔ ko, shi moŋ efiteɔ nii. Amɛhã amale kɛ yiwalɛ ebu yɛ amɛteŋ. Amɛ kɛ Asiria ekpãŋ, ni amɛ kɛ Ijipt miiye mu jara.”
2“No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yudabii lɛ yɛ sane. Ebaawo Israelbii nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛjeŋba naa; eeegbala amɛtoi yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii anaa. 3 Amɛtsɛ Yakob lɛ ekɛ enyɛmi lɛ na be ni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ musuŋ; ni be ni eda lɛ Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hu. 4Yakob kɛ bɔfo lɛ nɔ, ni eye kunim; efo etsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo lɛ ni ebi edɛŋ jɔɔmɔ. Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpe yɛ Betel, ni jɛi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie yɛ. 5Ni Yehowa, ji Tai aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni Yakob kɛwie lɛ, ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, ni no akɛkaiɔ lɛ. 6Nyɛ hu, enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛhea nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ nyɛyea, ni nyɛkpalea kɛbaa eŋɔɔ. Nyɛnaa mɛi amɔbɔ; nyɛyea jalɛ sane, ni nyɛyea anɔkwa daa kɛkwɛa lɛ gbɛ.”
Fɔ kroko hu ni abu Israel kɛ Yuda
7Yehowa kɛɛ, “jarayelɔ ni kɛ nsɛni ni atse etɛ nɔ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ, shishiulɔ ji lɛ. 8Israel kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Shi bɛ mitsɔ̃ niiatsɛ, bɛ mina nii babaoo?’ Mideŋmegbomɔ mli nii lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ anaaa tɔ̃mɔ ko ni tamɔ esha yɛ mihe? 9 Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛ jɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe kɛba lɛ. Mahã nyɛhi bui amli ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee yɛ gbii juji anɔ lɛ.
10“Mi mikɛ gbalɔi lɛ wie, ni mijie ninaa srɔtoi mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ; asaŋ mitsɔ̃ amɛnɔ mibubuu mimɛi lɛ abɛi lɛ. 11Shi kɛ̃lɛ aaja amãgãi yɛ Gilead; shi mɛi fɛɛ ni jaa amɛ lɛ aaagboi. Aagbe tsinai akɛmiishã afɔle yɛ Gilgal; shi afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tɛi kuikui kɛkɛ yɛ amɛŋmɔjiashi akofii lɛ ateŋ.”
12 Yakob jo foi kɛtee Mesopotamia. Eyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ ŋa hewɔ; eyakwɛ mɔ ko toi yɛ ŋa hewɔ. 13 Yehowa tsu gbalɔ ni eyahere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala kɛje Ijipt kɛba, ni gbalɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ekura amɛ. 14Israelbii ewo Yehowa mli la naakpa; ni no hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ amɛgboi; ni amɛmusu aaatere amɛ. Yehowa baagbala amɛtoi ejaakɛ amɛwo lɛ hiɛgbele.

Title: HOSEA 13
Content:
Naagbee fɔ ni abu Israel
1Kulɛ kɛji Efraim shwiei lɛ wie lɛ, mɛi ahe kpokpoɔ yɛ Israel. Awo Efraim nɔ yɛ Israel; shi kɛtsɔ̃ jemawɔŋ Baal jamɔ nɔ lɛ, Efraim shwiei lɛ tɔ̃, ni no hewɔ amɛgboi. 2Amɛkã he amɛmiifee esha lɛ lolo kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛii yahãa ŋaalɔi, ni amɛhãa akɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ shwieɔ amãgãi kɛ wɔji ahãa amɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Ashã afɔle ahã amɛ!” Mɛi ni yashãa afɔlei lɛ shwɔɔ tsinabi amãgãi lɛ anaa. 3No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baalaaje tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋmãagbeemɔhe kɛyaa lɛ, aloo tamɔ leebi bɔ ni kpalaa, loo afua ni hoɔ oya.
4Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni here nyɛyiwala kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe lɛ. Nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ ko akɛ ja mi; ni mi misɛɛ hu lɛ yiwalaherelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ. 5 Mikwɛ nyɛnɔ yɛ shiaŋa ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, 6shi be ni nyɛna nii nyɛye ni nyɛtɔrɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni nyɛwo nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kpa minɔ. 7No hewɔ lɛ, mibahuru mayi nyɛnɔ tamɔ jata; mibawo nyɛ ka tamɔ mlaŋtswi yɛ gbɛtoi. 8Mibatua nyɛ oookɛɛ oshishibrishi ni amɔmɔ ebii yɛ ehe tuaa mɔ, ni mibatserɛ nyɛmli maye yɛ minajiaŋ tamɔ jata. No ji akɛ mibatserɛ nyɛmli mɛnyɛmɛnyɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ kooloo awuyelɔ tsɛrɛɔ loo mli lɛ.
9“Kwɛ, Israel! Mibakpãtã ohiɛ; ni namɔ aaanyɛ oyiwala ahere? 10 Nɛgbɛ omaŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ koni ehere oyiwala; aloo nɛgbɛ nyɛlumɛi lɛ ni baafã nyɛhe lɛ yɔɔ, mɛi ahewɔ ni nyɛbi akɛ, ‘Ahã wɔ maŋtsɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ?’ 11 Mihã nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, shi yɛ mlifu naa; ni miŋɔ amɛ kɛtee yɛ mlila naa.
12“Abua Israel nishaianii lɛ kɛ etɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa ato ahã lɛ. 13Yoofɔyoo kɔ̃ɔmɔ be miiba ehã Israel; shi ehe bi kwashia ni eji hewɔ lɛ, emaaa eyi shi ebaaa awosojwaahe lɛ. 14 Mibahereŋ amɛ yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ; mibaŋ amɛyi yɛ gbele mli? Gbele, nɛgbɛ otsɛŋemɔ hela yɔɔ; ni Gbohiiaje, nɛgbɛ oniiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ yɔɔ? Minaŋ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ. 15Israel aaafrɔke tamɔ ŋɔi, shi bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la lɛ, ni ji Yehowa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, baafã kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba; ebaŋala amɛnuhiŋmɛii kɛ nubui fɛɛ amli nu; asaŋ eeekpãtã amɛnɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jara hiɛ. 16 Samaria yi sɔ̃ lɛ baatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ; emli bii lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ ta mli, akɛ emli abifabii lɛ aaatswiatswia shi; ni aaagbala amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ amli.”

Title: HOSEA 14
Content:
Sane ni Hosea kɛfɔ̃ Israel hiɛ
1Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkpalea kɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ. Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ehã nyɛtɛrɛ, ni nyɛgbee shi. 2 Nyɛkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ, nyɛyakpaa lɛ fai kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛ efɔŋ ni wɔfee lɛ afa koni omɔ wɔfaikpamɔ nɛɛ mli, ni wɔɔkafo bo. 3Asiria nyɛŋ wɔyiwala ahere gbi ko gbi ko; ni tayaa okpɔŋɔi hu nyɛŋ afã wɔhe. Asaŋ amãgã ni wɔkɛ wɔniji fee lɛ wɔtsɛŋ lɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ dɔŋŋ. Yehowa, bo lɛ omusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ awusãi ahe.”
Yehowa wo Israel shi yɛ wala hee he
4Yehowa kɛɛ,
“Mibahã amɛkpa anɔkwa ni amɛyeee lɛ.
Mibasumɔ amɛ kɛ mitsui fɛɛ,
ejaakɛ miŋmɛɛ mimli ni fu amɛ lɛ he.
5Mibatsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni enyɔ shiaŋa nɔ mahã Israelbii.
Amɛbaagba floŋŋ tamɔ fɔfɔi;
ni amɛfãi aaaya su mli shɔŋŋ tamɔ Lebanon tsei.
6Eniji ni ebaatsɛ̃rɛ aaalɛɛ shi,
ni ehe fɛo aaatamɔ mu tso nɔ.
Eeeje ŋma tamɔ Lebanon seda tsei lɛ.
7Amɛbaaba amɛbahi mifiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Amɛaafɛo tamɔ abɔɔ,
ni amɛaafrɔke tamɔ wain tso,
ni amɛgbɛi aaahehe tamɔ Lebanon wain.
8Israelbii kɛ wɔji naŋ nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mibabo amɛsɔlemɔ toi.
Mibatsɔ̃ tso ni eyi baa kpalaaa mahã amɛ,
ni mibabaa amɛyi;
nyɛjɔɔmɔi fɛɛ baajɛ mi midɛŋ.”
Sane lɛ naamuu
9 Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, enu saji nɛɛ ashishi; ni hiɛshikãlɔ lɛ ekɔ sɛɛ. Naa, Yehowa gbɛi fɛɛ ja, ni nomɛi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛbaa ejeŋ; nomɛi anaa mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii hiɔ shi yɛ; shi eshafeelɔi tswaa egbɛi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛtɛrɛɔ, ni amɛgbeɔ shi.

Title: YOEL WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbalɔ Yoel lɛ aleee ehe nɔ ko tsɔ̃; aleee be pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni ehi shi. Shi eeefee akɛ aŋma wolo nɛɛ yɛ afii 400 loo 500 Dani Afɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu lɛ mli. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Persiabii ji mɛi ni yeɔ jɛigbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ. Yoel gbaa baalabii gbeyeigbeyei komɛi ni batua Palestina shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ nuhɔ̃mɔ ni fite nii babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe sane. Kɛ Gbalɔ Yoel kwɛ nibii ni ba nɛɛ lɛ, enaa lɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa gbi lɛ he okadi ni. Eji gbi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baagbla mɛi ni teɔ shi shiɔ jalɛ sane ni etaoɔ akɛ eye lɛ atoi. Gbalɔ Yoel hã maŋbii lɛ le akɛ Yehowa miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛjeŋba, ni Yehowa miiwo amɛ shi akɛ kɛji amɛtsake lɛ, ebaahã amɛshihilɛ afee tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ dani amanehului lɛ ba lɛ, ni ebaajɔɔ amɛ. Nɔ titri kome ni wɔbaana yɛ wolo lɛ mli ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ shi akɛ ebaahã Emumɔ lɛ aba mɛi fɛɛ anɔ, hii kɛ yei kɛ onukpai kɛ gbekɛbii fɛɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Baalabii atuamɔ lɛ 1.1—2.17
Shiwoo akɛ be kpakpa baaku sɛɛ aba 2.18-27
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ 2.28—3.21

Title: YOEL 1
Content:
1Naa shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã Yoel, Penuel binuu lɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ ye ŋmɔshinii ni afite he ŋkɔmɔ
2Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdara, nyɛboa toi,
nyɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi.
Nɔ ni eba nɛɛ, ani eko eba dã yɛ nyɛyinɔ,
loo yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi ayinɔ tete?
3Nyɛgbaa nyɛbii,
koni nyɛbii lɛ agba amɛbii,
ni amɛbii lɛ hu agba yinɔ
ni baa yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ.
4Baalabii baha wɔŋmɔshinii;
nɔ ni ku kome shwɛ lɛ,
ku ni nyiɛ sɛɛ baye.
5Nyɛ gaalei, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a ni nyɛfoa;
nyɛ wainnulɔi, nyɛwɔa lele,
ejaakɛ nyɛwain dɔkɔdɔkɔ lɛ eje nyɛdaaŋ.
6 Baalabii, ta muu, ebatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ;
amɛhe wa, ni anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane;
amɛnyanyɔji anaa ba
tamɔ jata nyanyɔji.
7Amɛkpãtã wɔwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ;
amɛkpe wɔgbãmitsei lɛ ahe.
Amɛkpɔlɔ tsei lɛ ahe totoi lɛ,
kɛyashi niji lɛ ahe yɛ sakoo.
8Wo yara tamɔ oblayoo
ni foɔ eblayeiaŋ wu.
9Niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa sɛɛ efo
yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ
miiye ŋkɔmɔ,
ejaakɛ afɔlei bɛ hã Yehowa.
10Akpãtã ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ;
shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ,
ejaakɛ akpãtã ŋmaa lɛ hiɛ;
wainyibii lɛ egbi,
mutsei lɛ eŋala.
11Nyɛ okwaafoi, nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ.
Nyɛ waintromkwɛlɔi, nyɛwoa yara
yɛ ŋmaa kɛ akoko hewɔ,
ejaakɛ ŋmɔshinii lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.
12Waintsei lɛ eŋala;
agbãmitsei lɛ egboi;
akututsei kɛ tɛŋi kɛ atĩatsei,
yelitsei fɛɛ egbigbii.
Nyamɔ etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
13Osɔfoi, nyɛbua kpekpe,
ni nyɛwoa yara;
Nyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔlɔi,
nyɛwɔa lele.
Nyɛbotea Sɔlemɔ we lɛ,
ni nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ,
nyɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi,
ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle
ni akɛyaa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, atsi naa.
14Nyɛfãa koni ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ,
nyɛtsɛa kpee hu.
Nyɛbuaa onukpai lɛ
kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ anaa
kɛyaa Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ,
ni nyɛbolɔa nyɛtsɛa lɛ.
15 Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ shi etã!
Gbi ni Ofe lɛ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa lɛ,
nakai gbi lɛ baafee gbeyei!
16Bɛ wɔhiŋmɛi kã nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ
ni akpãtãa wɔniyenii hiɛ,
ni nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ hu sɛɛ efo
yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ?
17Dumɔwui lɛ egboi yɛ su kukulii lɛ ashishi,
aboŋoi lɛ kamɔ efolo,
ŋmaatoohei lɛ ekumɔ,
ejaakɛ ŋmaa lɛ eŋala.
18Kwɛ bɔ ni tsina kui lɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ kɛ nɔnaa,
ejaakɛ amɛbɛ jwɛifɔ,
ni toikui lɛ hu miina nɔ.
19Bo, Yehowa, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ,
ejaakɛ la ekpãtã ŋa nɔ jwɛifɔ lɛ hiɛ,
ni lalilɛi eshã ŋa lɛ nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ.
20Ŋaŋ kooloi tete miibolɔ miitsɛ bo,
ejaakɛ fai lɛ egbi,
ni la ekpãtã ŋa nɔ jwɛifɔ hiɛ.

Title: YOEL 2
Content:
Baalabii akɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ he Kɔkɔbɔɔ
1Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Zion;
nyɛbɔa oshe yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ!
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ahe akpokpo,
ejaakɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ miiba;
eshɛ shi etã.
2Duŋ kɛ jeŋ tuutuufeemɔ gbi ni,
atatu kɛ oblɔtu kpii gbi ni.
Baalabii ta muu miiba
tamɔ duŋ gbɛɔ shwãa gɔji anɔ lɛ.
Nɔ ko ni tamɔ enɛ bako dã,
ni asaŋ esɛɛ lɛ eko baŋ dɔŋŋ
kɛaatee yinɔi ayinɔ.
3Baalabii lɛ yeɔ tsei lɛ
tamɔ la yeɔ nii.
Amɛhiɛgbɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ tamɔ Eden trom,
shi amɛsɛɛgbɛ lɛ etamɔ ŋa kpataa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko ejeee amɛdɛŋ.
4 Amɛsu tamɔ okpɔŋɔi,
amɛshaa foi tamɔ ta okpɔŋɔi.
5Kɛji amɛmiitumɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ,
egbɛɔ tamɔ shwiilii;
egbɛɔ tamɔ lalilɛi
ni miishã gbetseli fɛlɛɔ;
amɛtamɔ ta kpeteŋkple
ni eto kɛbaagba ta.
6Kɛ amɛmiiba lɛ, maji ahe kpokpoɔ,
ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ shaleɔ.
7Amɛtsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ kãkãlɔi,
amɛkwɔɔ gbogboi tamɔ tabilɔi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ egbɛ nɔ;
amɛtsakeee amɛgbɛ koni eeeba akɛ
mɔ ko aaayaje mɔ ko gbɛ nɔ;
8mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛ egbɛ nɔ.
Amɛgbaa shi kutuu
kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tawuu afabaŋi amli,
ni nɔ ko nɔ ko etsiii amɛ gbɛ.
9Amɛyatuaa maŋ;
amɛjoɔ foi yɛ gbogboi anɔ;
amɛkwɔɔ kɛboteɔ shĩai amli,
ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ samfɛji amli tamɔ julɔi.
10 Kɛji amɛmiiba lɛ, shikpɔŋ hosoɔ,
ni ŋwɛi kpokpoɔ bliblibli.
Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere woɔ duŋ,
ni ŋulamii fɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ.
11 Yehowa woɔ egbee,
ni efãa eta lɛ.
Esra lɛ da naakpa,
ni mɛi ni yeɔ efãmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ,
anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane.
Yehowa gbi lɛ, ebaafee gbeyei!
Namɔ po aaanyɛ naa adamɔ?
Aatsɛ mɛi koni amɛtsake amɛtsui
12“Shi amrɔ nɛɛ po Yehowa kɛɛ,
nyɛshwaa nyɛhe anɔkwale mli,
ni nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ
kɛ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli.”
13Nyɛtsɛrɛa nyɛtsuii, shi jeee nyɛtadei;
nyɛkpalea kɛbaa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ,
ejaakɛ durolɔ kɛ mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ;
emli fuu mra, ni eyeɔ eshiwoo nɔ;
ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa,
ni eshwaa ehe yɛ nɔ fɔŋ hewɔ.
14Ekolɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
aaatsake ejwɛŋmɔ,
ni eeejɔɔ nyɛŋmɔshinii,
ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle
aaabahã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
15Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Zion;
nyɛfãa akɛ ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ,
ni nyɛtsɛa kpee ni mli wa.
16Nyɛbuaa maŋ lɛ naa,
nyɛsaa amɛ nyɛhãa kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ;
nyɛbuaa gbekɛbii kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ fufɔ lɛ anaa!
Ayɛmforo wu tete aje kpo yɛ esɛɛtsuŋ,
ni ayɛmforo hu aje kpo yɛ epiaŋ.
17Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ
afo, ni amɛsɔle yɛ koi lɛ
kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ amɛkɛɛ,
“Yehowa, naa bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ;
kaahã maji krokomɛi miiye wɔhe fɛo amɛkɛɛ.
‘Nɛgbɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?’ ”
Nyɔŋmɔ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ ba nii ekoŋŋ
18Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa ye shikpɔŋ lɛ he awuŋã
ni ena emaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ.
19Ehere amɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
“Agbɛnɛ mibahã nyɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ mu,
koni nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ;
maji krokomɛi ebɔŋ nyɛ ahora dɔŋŋ.
20Nɔ ni jɛ kooyigbɛ ba lɛ,
majie yɛ nyɛhe kɛaatee shɔŋŋ,
ni mashwie lɛ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ gbiŋ
ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Eta ni yɔɔ hiɛgbɛ lɛ mashwie amɛ
mawo Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli;
ni amɛta ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ matsi amɛ
mawo Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli.
Amɛgbohii lɛ ahe sã kɛ fu aaate shi;
makpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ
ni amɛfee nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
21“Shikpɔŋ, kaashe gbeyei,
omii ashɛ ohe ni onya,
ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu nii wuji.
22Nyɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, nyɛkashea gbeyei,
ejaakɛ niyelihe lɛ jwɛifɔ lɛ miifrɔke,
ni tsei miiwo amɛyibii,
agbãmi kɛ waintso hu ewo pii.
23“Nyɛ Zionbii, nyɛmli afilia nyɛ
yɛ nɔ ni nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ efee
ehã nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Ehã nu enɛ ehã nyɛ bɔ ni sa,
ehã Gbo kɛ Agbiɛnaa enɛ ehã nyɛ
tamɔ efeɔ daa lɛ.
24Ŋmãagbeemɔhei lɛ aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmaa,
amɛhe bui lɛ aaateke nɔ kɛ wain kɛ mu.
25Nii ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi kɛ gɔgɔmii lɛ
eye, yɛ afii ni amɛba lɛ mli lɛ,
mato nyɛ najiaŋ.
Mi mihã baalabii ta babaoo lɛ ba batua nyɛ.
26Agbɛnɛ nyɛaana nii pii nyɛaaye nyɛaatɔrɔ.
Nyɛaajie Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ yi,
ejaakɛ etsu naakpɛɛ nii ehã nyɛ.
Agbeŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ dɔŋŋ.
27No lɛ Israelbii, nyɛaana nyɛle
akɛ miyɛ nyɛteŋ;
nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi
ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
ni misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Agbeŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa Gbi lɛ
28 “Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ
mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ;
nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba,
nyɛhiimeji lɛ aaala lamɔi,
ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninai.
29Nyɛtsuji hii tete kɛ nyɛtsuji yei hu
mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ mashwie amɛnɔ
yɛ nakai be lɛ mli.
30“Mahã ana gbi lɛ he okadii
yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
láshishwiemɔ kɛ la kɛ lasu kpɔŋŋ.
31 Hulu aaawo duŋ,
ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaatsu faa tamɔ lá.
Dani Yehowa gbi wulu
ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ aaaba.
32 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasɔle atsɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ,
aaahere eyi wala.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi ahe aaaje mli,
yɛ Zion Gɔŋ, Yerusalɛm;
mɛi ni mahala lɛ ayi aaana wala.”

Title: YOEL 3
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo Jeŋmaji lɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ,
“Nakai be lɛ mahã Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm
aku sɛɛ ashwere ekoŋŋ.
2Mabua maji lɛ fɛɛ anaa
ni mikɛ amɛ aaakpeleke shi
kɛaatee Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Makojo amɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ
nii fɛɛ ni amɛfee mimaŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛgbɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ
amɛshwã maji lɛ amli,
ni amɛja Israel shikpɔŋ
ni ji mishikpɔŋ lɛ.
3Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja
nomii lɛ amɛhã amɛhe.
Amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii hii
amɛkɛhe ajwamãŋi,
ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii yei
amɛkɛhe wain amɛnu.
4 “Tiro kɛ Sidon kɛ Filistia shikpɔji fɛɛ, mɛni nyɛtaoɔ nyɛfee mi? Ani nɔ ko ni mifee najiaŋ nyɛtaoɔ nyɛto mi? Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ shwiaa, ni mahã nii ni nyɛfee lɛ aku sɛɛ ababua nyɛyiteŋ; 5ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔ mijwiɛtɛi kɛ mishika lɛ, ni minibii ni jara wa lɛ nyɛloo kɛtee nyɛjamɔhei lɛ. 6Nyɛhɔ̃ɔ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ nyɛhã Helabii, ni nyɛjie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛtee shɔŋŋ. 7Shi agbɛnɛ mibahã amɛshi he ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ amɛ kɛtee lɛ. Mibafee nyɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee amɛ lɛ. 8Mahã ahɔ̃ɔ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ ahã Yudabii lɛ, ni Yudabii lɛ aaahɔ̃ɔ amɛ ahã Shebabii ni ji maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ bii lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, miwie enɛ.
9“Nyɛshiɛa shiɛmɔ nɛɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ akɛ,
‘Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛhãa ta;
nyɛtsɛa nyɛtabilɔi lɛ;
nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi fɛɛ anaa ni nyɛfãa.
10 Nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔii asɔ̃a klantei
ni nyɛkɛ adɔi lɛ asɔ̃a akplɔi;
mɔ ni yɔɔ wudɔwudɔ tete akɛɛ akɛ,
Mihe wa.’
11Nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛkpe,
nyɛhe afea oya kɛbaa,
ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.’ ”
Yehowa, hã ota lɛ aba abatua amɛ.
12“Maji lɛ asaa amɛhe
koni amɛba Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Jɛi, mi Yehowa, mibata makojo
maji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛbɔle lɛ yɛ.
13 Nyɛfolɔa amɛ nyɛshwiea shi
tamɔ afolɔɔ ŋmaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ;
nyɛnaanaa amɛ tamɔ aŋaa wainyibii
yɛ wain tsɔne ni eyi tɔ mli
kɛyashiɔ wain lɛ bɔ̃iɔ hoo lɛ,
ejaakɛ amɛyitsoŋ wa tsɔ̃.”
14Gbɔmɛi akpeiakpei abɔ
yɛ Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Jɛi ji he ni Yehowa Gbi ni eshɛ etã lɛ
baaba yɛ.
15Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere ewo duŋ,
ni ŋulamii efɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ aaajɔɔ emaŋ lɛ
16 Yehowa miihuu kɛjɛ Zion,
ni egbee miijije kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm;
ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ miihoso.
Shi Yehowa ji abobaahe hã emaŋ lɛ,
kɛ mɔɔ ni wa hu hã Israelbii lɛ.
17“Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ,
mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mihiɔ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yerusalɛm aaatsɔ̃ maŋ wulu krɔŋkrɔŋ;
gbɔi nyɛŋ enɔ amɛye kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ.
18Nakai gbi lɛ, gɔji lɛ anɔ
aaayi tɔ kɛ waintromii,
ni aaana tsinai yɛ gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ nɔ;
ni nu aaaho yɛ Yuda jɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli.
Nuhiŋmɛi aaaho kɛaajɛ Yehowa We lɛ,
ni eeeyahã Akasia Jɔɔ lɛ nu.
19“Ijipt aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa,
ni Edom aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni egbo;
ejaakɛ amɛbatua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ,
ni amɛshwie enɔ bii
ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi.
20-21Matɔ mɛi ni agbe lɛ alá he owele.
Mikɛ mɛi ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ ahe ekeŋ amɛ.
Shi kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ lɛ,
gbɔmɛi aaahi Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm,
ni mi, Yehowa, mahi Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”

Title: AMOS WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Amos ji Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni aŋmala egbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ pii. Yudanyo ji Amos moŋ, shi eyashiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii. Amos hi shi afii 800 Dani Afɔ Kristo. Nakai be mli lɛ maŋbii eshwere, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli jogbaŋŋ, ni maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe. Shi moŋ Amos na akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ pɛ ji mɛi ni yaa nɔ shwereɔ, ni niiatsɛmɛi nɛɛ shishiuɔ ohiafoi lɛ; ni no nɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛkɛnaa nii kpɔtɔɔ lɛ. Jamɔ ni amɛjaa lɛ ejeee anɔkwa jamɔ, ni shweshweeshwe ni asusuɔ akɛ maŋ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu, ebɛ mli nakai kwraa. Amos fee ekãa, ni eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii akɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala amɛtoi. Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛfee nii ni ja koni jalɛ saneyeli atsɔ̃ “tamɔ faa ni hoɔ”. Ni no baahã “eko lɛ Yehowa musuŋ atsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ maŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahe.” (5.15)
Mlijaramɔi
Abaagbala mɛi ni bɔle Israel lɛ atoi 1.1—2.5
Abaagbala Israel toi 2.6—6.14
Ninai srɔtoi Enumɔ lɛ 7.1—9.15

Title: AMOS 1
Content:
1 Amos, ni ji tookwɛlɔ ko ni jɛ Tekoa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛ. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jie ninaa nɛɛ yɛ Israel he etsɔ̃ɔ Amos afii enyɔ dani shikpɔŋ hoso, be mli ni Uzia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Yeroboam, Yehoash bi lɛ, hu yeɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.
2 Amos kɛɛ akɛ,
“Yehowa miihũu tamɔ jata
yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni egbee miishi yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Shikpɔji lɛ anɔ jwɛi fɔ aaaŋala,
ni Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ aaagbi.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala mɛi ni bɔle Israel he lɛ atoi
3 Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Damaskobii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛgbɛlɛ Gileadbii tamɔ akɛ dade gbɛlɛɔ nii. 4No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Maŋtsɛ Hazael maŋtsɛ we lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ. 5 Mibakumɔ Damasko maŋ lɛ naa agboi lɛ mashwie shi; mibaplene Aven Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Bet-eden nɔ lɛ hu, ni mibaŋɔ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anom kɛya Kir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yehowa ni kɛɛ.”
Filistia
6 Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Gazabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ jaku muu fɛɛ nom kɛtee amɛyahã Edombii. 7No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Gaza maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ. 8Mibaplene Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli bii kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Ashkelon nɔ lɛ hu; ni mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mawo Ekron hu, ni mibakpãtã Filistibii ni baashwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.”
Tiro
9 Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Tiro etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo Edom dɛŋ, ni amɛkaiii kwraa nyɛmimɛi akpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ. 10No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Tiro maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.”
Edom
11 Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Edombii tɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛtse klante yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ bɔ ni musuŋtsɔlɛ ko bɛ mli kwraa; amɛniŋ nii ahe aahu, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ mlifu he kwrakwra. 12No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Teman maŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Bazra mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.”
Amon
13 Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Amonbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ taitai ni amɛfãfãa bɔ ni afee ni amɛlɛɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ husui amli hewɔ lɛ, amɛgbalagbalaa Gilead yeihɔlɔi amusui amli, ni bii lɛ je shwie shi. 14No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Raba maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã emli mɔji lɛ. Gbi lɛ abaabɔ tawuu oshe, ni ta lɛ naa baawa tamɔ ahum ni efã. 15Abaaŋɔ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛaatee. Yehowa ni kɛɛ.”

Title: AMOS 2
Content:
Moab
1Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Moabbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛshã Edom maŋtsɛ gbonyo wui kɛyashi etsɔ̃ lamlu, ni amɛkɛshwie ehiɛ shi. 2No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Keriot maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ. Moabbii lɛ baagboi yɛ oshebɔɔ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ hoofeemɔ lɛ mli. 3 Mibaplene Moab maŋ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni mibagbe emli lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu mafata he.”
Yuda
4Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Yudabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa mlai lɛ, ni amɛyeee ekpɔi lɛ anɔ. Apasa jemawɔji asɛɛ ni amɛyanyiɛ, tamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yanyiɛ lɛ, hã amɛdu gbɛ. 5No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã Yerusalɛm mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.”
Israel toigbalamɔ
6Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Israelbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ jalɔi amɛhe jwiɛtɛi, ni ohiafo lɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ lɛ tokota jara naa. 7Amɛnaanaa ohiafoi ayitsei anɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ mlu mli, ni amɛtsirɛɔ mɛi ni ehao kɛyaa gbɛsɛɛ. Mɔ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsɛ fɛɛ kɛ oblayoo kome lɛ nɔŋŋ naa bɔlɛ, ni amɛkɛbuleɔ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. 8 Amɛkãmɔɔ atadei ni akɛbato amɛ awaba anɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ naa, ni amɛnuɔ wain ni ahe yɛ mɛi ni abu amɛ fɔ adɛŋ yɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
9 “Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikpãtã Amorbii ni kwɔlɔ tamɔ tsenedru tsei, ni amɛhe wa hu tamɔ odum lɛ ahiɛ yɛ amɛ, Israelbii, ahiɛ. Mikpãtã amɛnɔ yibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni mifite amɛshishi fãi lɛ fɛɛ hu. 10Mijie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpala nyɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba koni nyɛbaŋɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ. 11 Mitee nyɛbihii lɛ ekomɛi ashi, ni mifee amɛ gbalɔi, ni mifee nyɛblahii lɛ ekomɛi hu Nazirifoi. Israelbii, ebɛ mli nakai lo? Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ. 12 Shi nyɛhã Nazirifoi lɛ bɔ̃i dãanumɔ, ni amɛkɛku kitã ni amɛkã Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni nyɛwo gbalɔi lɛ akitã akɛ amɛkagba gbalɛ ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ. 13Naa, mibamia nyɛ makpɛtɛ shi tamɔ shwiili ni ewo ŋmaa tɔtɔɔtɔ miaa nii kpɛtɛɔ shi. 14Foijee aaalaaje mɔ ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ foijee, hewalɛ aaaŋmɛɛɛ hewalɔ, ni kãkãlɔ hu nyɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala po ehere. 15Gãitsɛ̃lɔi nyɛŋ shi amɛdamɔ lɛ, foijelɔ he ejeŋ mli lɛ, mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ nɔ hu hereŋ eyiwala. 16Nakai gbi lɛ kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni tsui esa tete aaajo foi kɛ ehe yayai.” Yehowa ni kɛɛ.

Title: AMOS 3
Content:
1Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ni Yehowa wie yɛ nyɛhe lɛ toi, nyɛ ni nyɛ ji jaku muu ni eyajie kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ, 2 “Jeŋ maji fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, nyɛ pɛ ji maŋ ni mile, ni no hewɔ lɛ, mibawo nyɛ nibii gbohii ni nyɛfee lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ.”
Gbalɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ
3Ani mɛi enyɔ feɔ ekome kɛnyiɛɔ gbɛ kɛji amɛkpãŋko he?
4Ani jata hũuɔ yɛ koo mli be mli ni enako kooloo ko ni eeemɔ lo?
Ani jata oblayoo woɔ egbee yɛ ebu mli kɛji emɔko loo ko lo? 5Ani loofɔlɔ duɔ tsɔne yɛ shikpɔŋ kɛji atsɔ̃ko lɛ tsɔne yɛ jɛi lo?
Ani tsɔne fɛɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ be mli ni eduko nɔ ko?
6 Ani tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɔ yɛ maŋ ni maŋbii lɛ hɛleee shi lo?
Ani amane baa maŋ ko nɔ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ lo?
7Eji anɔkwale akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efeee nɔ ko ni ejieee eyiŋtoo lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ.
8Kɛji jata miihuu lɛ, namɔ sheee gbeyei?
Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ewie lɛ, namɔ baakwa akɛ eshiɛɛɛ gbalɛ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ?
Samaria hiɛkpãtãmɔ
9Kɛɛmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ashdod kɛ Ijipt mɔji lɛ amli lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Samaria gɔji lɛ anɔ koni nyɛkwɛa basabasa ni afeɔ kɛ niseniianii ni yaa nɔ yɛ Samaria.”
10Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ kɛ juu buaa nibii anaa yɛ mɔji lɛ amli. Amɛleee nɔ ni ja gbɛ feemɔ tete. 11No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Henyɛlɔi aaabɔle shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛaakpe, ni amɛaakumɔ nibii ni akɛfãa shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛaaha mɔji lɛ amli nii ofɔ̃ kɛya.’ ”
12Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ shɔ̃ɔ too shuɔji enyɔ loo etoi kuku kɛkɛ po yɛ jata daaŋ lɛ, nakai kɛji eshwɛ saatso tso kuku kɛkɛ loo saashwɛ tete akɛbaahere Israelbii ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ ayiwala.” 13Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛkɛa Yakob shwiei lɛ 14 akɛ, gbi nɔ ni mibagbala Israelbii atoi yɛ amɛtoigbele hewɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã Betel afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ hu ahiɛ. Abaakumɔ akloŋtoi ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ akoji lɛ ashwie shi. 15 Shĩa ni ama ato fɛ̃i be kɛ nɔ ni ama ato latsaa be hu mibakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ shi kome; shĩai ni akɛ shuɔ wu esaa amɛmli fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ni shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu hiɛ baakpãtã,” Yehowa kɛɛ.

Title: AMOS 4
Content:
1Nyɛ Samaria yei ni nyɛshwishwii tamɔ Bashan tsinayei ni yɔɔ Samaria gɔji anɔ lɛ, nyɛboa wiemɔ nɛɛ toi. Te nyɛwaa ohiafoi ayi, ni nyɛshwishwiaa mɛi ni efĩ amɛ shi, ni nyɛkɛɔ nyɛwumɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyataoa nɔ ni wɔɔnu kɛba!” 2Naa, beiaŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, “Gbii miiba ni akɛ kpoŋ baalalaa nyɛ, ni akpala nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛya. Nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ loi ni tsɛ̃rɛ kpoji anaa. 3Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baanyiɛ kɛya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, kɛyashɛ fɔji ni egbulɔ yɛ maŋ gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ ahe, ni aaahole nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ fɔji nɛɛ amli atsirɛ ashwie Harmon,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Israel ekaseee nii
4 “Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛbaa Betel nyɛbatɔ̃a mla; nyɛyaa Gilgal nyɛyahãa mlanɔtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afaa; nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔlei abaa koni ashã daa leebi; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ abaa daa gbii etɛ̃. 5 Nyɛkɛ ma ni esha abashãa shidaa fɔlei lɛ, ni nyɛshiɛa kɛfoa shi akɛ nyɛshãa tsuijurɔ naa afɔlei hu, ejaakɛ nakai feemɔ ji nɔ ni ŋɔɔ nyɛnaa. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
6“Mi, mihã hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, ni daaŋtaa bɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ; aboloo hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ. 7 “Asaŋ be ni eshwɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ ni akɛkpaa ŋmɔshinii lɛ tete mihãaa nu anɛ nyɛ. Mihã nu nɛ maŋ kome ko nɔ, shi mihãaa enɛ maŋ ko hu nɔ. Nu nɛ ŋmɔ ko shi, ni nu enɛɛɛ ŋmɔ ko hu shi, no hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɔ ni enɛɛɛ mli lɛ mli nii ŋala. 8Maji enyɔ loo etɛ̃ mli bii didãa kɛ kumai kɛyagbee maŋ ko nɔ koni amɛyatao nu ni amɛnu; shi nu ni amɛyana lɛ eyashɛɛɛ amɛnaa. Shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
9 “Mihã kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ emli dɔlɛ fã, ni eŋala nyɛŋmɔshinii, ni baalabii kpãtã nyɛbɔ̃ɔi kɛ nyɛwain tromi kɛ nyɛgbami tsei kɛ nyɛmu tsei bluublu ahiɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
10 “Mihã gbele hela tamɔ Ijipt hela lɛ bote nyɛteŋ, ni mihã nyɛblahii lɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli, ni ashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ nyɛkpɔŋɔi yɛ nyɛdɛŋ kɛtee. Mihã nyɛgbohii ni jwere nyɛnsrai amli lɛ je fu wo nyɛ. Shi fɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.”
11 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtã nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ahiɛ tamɔ mifee Sodom kɛ Gomora lɛ. Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyi na wala lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ la tso ni afã yɛ la naa; ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ. 12No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii, agbɛnɛ mibagbala nyɛ toi. Ni akɛni mibafee nyɛ nakai hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛkɛkpea nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ toigbalamɔ naa.”
13 Naa, mɔ ni shɔ̃ gɔji lɛ,
ni ebɔ kɔɔyɔɔ,
ni egbaa gbɔmɔ nɔ ni ji
lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eyiŋtoo.
Lɛ mɔ ni ehãa jetsɛremɔ tsɔ̃ɔ duŋ,
ni enyiɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ,
Egbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.

Title: AMOS 5
Content:
Tsuitsakemɔ he ehĩa
1Israelbii, nyɛboa yaafo lala ni miwoɔ nɔ yɛ nyɛhe nɛɛ toi.
2Israel oblayeiaŋ etã,
egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Akwa lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ,
ni mɔ ko bɛ ni woɔ enɔ.
3Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋ ni baawo asraafoi akpe gbɛ kɛya ta lɛ, eeeshwɛ asraafoi oha pɛ ahã lɛ, ni maŋ ni woɔ asraafoi oha gbɛ lɛ, eeeshwɛ emɛi nyɔŋma pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba Israel we lɛ.”
4 Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Israelbii ji akɛ, “Nyɛtaoa mi misɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi aaana wala, 5 shi nyɛkataoa Betel sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛkayaa Gilgal hu, aloo nyɛmitse mli kɛmiiya Beersheba; ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ Gilgalbii nom, ni Betel hiɛ baakpãtã.”
6Nyɛtaoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi baana wala. Kɛjeee nakai lɛ Yehowa aaaba tamɔ la ni eje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, ni eeeshã nii. La nɛɛ baakpãtã Betel hiɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe ahã Betel. 7 Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni jalɛ saneyeli joɔ hãa nyɛ tamɔ taatso, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkɛ jalɛ saneyeli shwishwia shikpɔŋ!
8 Naa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋulamii,
“Wuɔ kɛ ebii kɛ Oŋwɛ”
mɔ ni hãa duŋ kpii tsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ,
ni ehãa shwane woɔ duŋ
ni etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ.
Lɛ mɔ ni efãa ŋshɔ mli nu,
ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ,
Yehowa ji egbɛi.
9Ehãa hewalɔ hiɛ kpãtãa kɛkɛ lɛ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hu hiɛ ekpãtã. 10 Amɛnyɛɔ mɔ ni kãa mɔ hiɛ yɛ koishi, ni mɔ ni wieɔ anɔkwale lɛ, amɛhiɔ ehiɛ. 11 Akɛni nyɛnaanaa ohiafo nɔ, ni nyɛtsuɔ lɛ abele onia fe bɔ ni sa hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tɛ ni ako emamɔ shĩai; shi moŋ nyɛhiŋ amɛmli; ni nyɛfeefee wain tromi fɛɛfɛji moŋ, shi nyɛnuŋ amɛmli wain. 12Ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛmlanɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa, ni mile eshai ni nyɛfeefee anaawalɛ. Nyɛgbaa jalɔ naa, ni nyɛheɔ nyɔŋnii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ koni ohiafo kɛ esane ashɛ koishi koni aye ahã lɛ. 13No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni le nii lɛ, efeɔ diŋŋ nɛkɛ be mli, ejaakɛ be lɛ be fɔŋ ni.
14-15 Nyɛtaoa nɔ kpakpa, shi jeee nɔ fɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi ana wala, kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kpakpa; ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ koishi akɛ aleee nɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaadro Yosef shwiei ni eshwɛ lɛ lo!
16-17No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, kɛɔ ji akɛ, “Abaawo yara yɛ blohui fɛɛ amli, ni aaabolɔ, ‘Ao, ao!’ Kɛnyiɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ. Abaatsɛ okwaafoi koni amɛbaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni abaatsɛ mɛi ni le yara nɔ yaafo jogbaŋŋ hu koni amɛbafo. Abaawo yara yɛ wain trom fɛɛ wain trom mli ejaakɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛteŋ kɛho kɛgbala nyɛ toi,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
18 Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛshweɔ Yehowa gbi lɛ. Mɛni nyɛbaana yɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ nɔ? Naa, duŋ gbi ni, shi jeee la gbi ni: 19nɔ ni baaba lɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni joɔ jata naa foi, ni ekɛ oshishibrishi kpeɔ, loo be ni eba shĩa ni ekɛ enine mɔ gbogbo mli lɛ onufu kɔ̃ lɛ. 20Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ duŋ aaawo, ni hulu etsoŋ; nakai gbi lɛ duŋ kpii aaawo bɔ ni la bɛ he ko he ko.
21 Miihi nyɛgbii juji lɛ; amɛjeee nɔ ko kɛhã mi; ni nyɛhe naa ni nyɛbuaa kɛjaa mi lɛ tete, mibɛ he miishɛɛ. 22 Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei tete nyɛhãa mi nɛ, shi miheee. Shidaa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛ nyɛkooloi ni eshwishwii shãa lɛ hu, mikwɛɛɛ po. 23Nyɛkɛ nyɛlalai lɛ ajea minɔ; mitaooo nyɛsaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ hu toi mabo. 24Nyɛyea jalɛ sane moŋ koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ nu ni hoɔ; nyɛhãa jalɛ ahea shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ daa.
25 “Israelbii, mɛɛ kooloi afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei nyɛshã nyɛhã mi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ? 26Nyɛbaawo nyɛmãgãi ni nyɛfee nyɛhã nyɛhe ni ji nyɛmaŋtsɛ Sakut kɛ Kaiwan hu nyɛtere; 27ni mahã aŋɔ nyɛ nom kɛya Damasko sɛɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni gbɛi ji Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ.

Title: AMOS 6
Content:
Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ
1Kpoo hã mɛi ni ahe ejɔ amɛ yɛ Zion, kɛ mɛi ni nyɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ Samaria Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, mɛi ni ji lumɛi wuji yɛ maŋ wulu, Israel mli lɛ, mɛi aŋɔɔ ni Israelbii lɛ baa lɛ. 2 Nyɛhoa kɛyaa Kalne maŋ lɛ mli nyɛyakwɛa jɛi; ni nyɛjɛa jɛi nyɛyaa Hamat maŋ wulu lɛ mli; nyɛtsaa nɔ kɛkpelekea shi kɛyaa Filistibii amaŋ ni ji Gat lɛ mli hu. Ani amɛhi fe maŋtsɛyelihei nɛɛ lo; aloo amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ da fe nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, 3 nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtsiɔ gbi fɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ nakai feemɔ moŋ hãa gbi fɔŋ lɛ bɛŋkɛɔ nyɛ lɛ? 4Kpoo hã mɛi ni kãmɔɔ shuɔ wu saatsei anɔ amɛwɔɔ, ni amɛkpãa amɛmli yɛ saatsei bibii anɔ, ni amɛyeɔ too ku lɛ mli gwantɛŋbii kɛ tsina tsui amli tsinabii lɛ. 5 Mɛi ni kɛ saŋku laa yakayaka lalai, ni amɛsɔ̃ɔ saŋkui tamɔ David nɔ lɛ amɛhãa amɛhe. 6Mɛi ni kɛ kpuji wuji nuɔ wain, ni mu ni hi fe fɛɛ amɛkpaa, shi Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ edɔɔɔ amɛ kwraa lɛ. 7No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ tsutsu aaaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛaatee, ni no baahã ahoshwibɔlɔi lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo.
8Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Miihi Israelbii ahewoo lɛ; ni miinyaŋe amɛmɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ amɛmaŋ lɛ kɛ emli nii lɛ fɛɛ mahã.”
9Aaaba mli akɛ kɛji shwɛ shĩa kome mli hii nyɔŋma kɛkɛ po lɛ, amɛbaagboi kɛ̃. 10Ni kɛji mɛi ni egbo lɛ eko wekunyo, mɔ ni fuɔ lɛ, baaba koni ebawo gbonyo lɛ kɛje shĩa lɛ, wekunyo nɛɛ baabi mɔ ni yɔɔ shĩa lɛ mli akɛ, “Ani eshwɛ mɔ ko lolo hɔ shĩa lɛ mli fata ohe lo?”
Mɔ lɛ aaahere nɔ akɛ, “Dabida!”
Gbonyo lɛ wekunyo lɛ baakɛɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ diŋŋ. Wɔkwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni wɔkatsi Yehowa gbɛi tã.”
11Ejaakɛ Yehowa efã ni shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu baawule butuu, ni shĩa bibioo hu baajwa. 12Ani okpɔŋɔ joɔ foi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, aloo akɛ tsinahii huɔ yɛ ŋshɔ mli? Shi nyɛhã jalɛ etsɔ̃ ebɔɔ, ni jalɛ yibii etsɔ̃ taatso.
13Nyɛnyaa yɛ Lo-Debar maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, “Ani jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ mli wɔjɛ ni wɔshɔ̃ Karnaim maŋ lɛ?”
14Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, “Israelbii, naa, mibatee maŋ ko shi mawo nyɛ koni amɛbaŋɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ. Maŋ nɛɛ baahao nyɛ kɛjɛ Lebo-Hamat yɛ kooyigbɛ, aahu kɛyashi ŋa kplenee ni atsɛɔ lɛ Araba Nujɔɔ lɛ naa yɛ wuoyigbɛ.”

Title: AMOS 7
Content:
Balabii ahe ninaa
1Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ. Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ baalabii ku ko. Be nɛɛ mli lɛ afɛ̃ maŋtsɛ jwɛi momo, ni jwɛi lɛ eje shishi eefu kɛmiiba ekoŋŋ. 2Be ni baalabii lɛ eye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛfɔ lɛ amɛgbe naa lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa Ofe, ofainɛ, okɛ Israelbii ahe ake amɛ. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛyi aaana wala hu? Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa.”
3Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni ona nɛɛ baŋ mli.”
La he ninaa
4Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ. Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ miitao akɛ ekɛ la agbala ewebii lɛ atoi. La lɛ ŋala nu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛkɛ ni la lɛ bɔ̃i shikpɔŋ lɛ hu shãa. 5Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao! Yehowa, ofainɛ, foo sɛɛ. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Israelbii, owebii lɛ, ayi aaana wala hu? Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa.”
6Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ hu baŋ mli.”
Plomo he ninaa
7Yehowa jie ninaa nɛɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔ mi. Mina Yehowa ni edamɔ gbogbo ni akɛ plomo susu ni atswa he; ni ehiɛ plomo yɛ edɛŋ. 8 Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?”
Mito he akɛ, “Plomo.”
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ plomo nɛɛ miisusu mimaŋ Israelbii ajalɛ. Mihaŋ amɛye amɛhe dɔŋŋ. 9Hei ni Isak shwie lɛ jaa yɛ lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃, ni hei ni Israelbii jaa yɛ lɛ hu baafee koikoi; ni mibafã ta mawo Yeroboam we lɛ.”
Amos kɛ Osɔfo Amazia
10 Kɛkɛ ni Amazia, Betel osɔfo lɛ, tsu kɛtee Yeroboam, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ akɛ, “Amos etee oyinɔ apam yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. Ewiemɔi lɛ baafite maŋ lɛ.” 11Nɔ ni Amos kɛɛ ji, “Yeroboam baanyɔ yɛ ta mli, ni nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ Israelbii kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee.”
12Osɔfo Amazia kɛɛ Amos akɛ, “Gbalɔ, jee biɛ ni oya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oyaye nii yɛ jɛi koni ogba yɛ jɛi. 13 Kaakã he oogba yɛ Betel nɛɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ biɛ ji he ni maŋtsɛ lɛ jaa yɛ, ni biɛ nɔŋŋ ji he ni maŋtsɛyelihe nɛɛ Sɔlemɔ we wulu ni fe fɛɛ lɛ hu yɔɔ.”
14Amos here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Osɔfo Amazia akɛ, “Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, ni asaŋ jeee gbalɔ bi hu ji mi. Shi moŋ koolookwɛlɔ ji mi, ni misaa sikamore tsei ahe hu; 15ni kooloo mikpalaa ni Yehowa tsɛ mi; ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa, ni oyagba otsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.’ 16No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi ejaakɛ okɛɛ mikagba mishi Israel lɛ, ni mikashiɛ mishi Isak we lɛ. 17Amazia, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Oŋa baatsɔ̃ ajwamãŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta naa; abaaŋɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni abaaja ahã mɛi kpɔji. Bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ maŋsɛɛ obaaya oyagbo yɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ ni ajaaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ; ni Israelbii lɛ nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ amɛ kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee.’ ”

Title: AMOS 8
Content:
Kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii he ninaa
1Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jie ninaa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi, Mina kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsu. 2 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?”
Mihere nɔ akɛ, “Kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsu.”
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mimaŋ Israelbii akpulu eyi agbɛnɛ; mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ; mibagbala amɛtoi.
3Nakai gbi lɛ, lalai ni amɛlaa yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ yara ni awo. Gbɔmɛi babaoo baaplene, ni abaashɛrɛ gbohii ashwie hei fɛɛ nigii, shi mɛi baafee diŋŋ kɛkwɛ.”
Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ
4Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnaanaa mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkpãtãa ohiafoi ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 5Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɛɛbe po nyɔŋ hee lɛ aaanyɔ shi koni wɔbɔ̃i ŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ? Ni mɛɛbe po abaagbe hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ yeli naa koni wɔbɔ̃i wɔŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ susumɔnɔ ni shɛɛɛ, asaŋ kɛ nsɛnitɛ ni atse nɔ? 6Wɔkɛ jwiɛtɛi aaahe ohiafo nyɔmɔtsɛ, ni wɔkɛ tokota aaahe mɔ ni efi lɛ, ni ŋmaa shishi tutuu tete wɔɔhɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ jarawalɛ.”
7Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ; “Anɔkwa, mihiɛ kpaŋ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ eko nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. 8Ni no hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ baahoso, ni enɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ baaye awerɛhoo. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baafee hamahama tamɔ bɔ ni Nilo Faa lɛ yiɔ, ni ekuɔ, ni asaŋ ekpɔŋɔ lɛ.” 9Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibahã hulu anyɔ shi shwane koni duŋ awo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane fintiŋŋ. 10 Mahã gbii juji ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ yarafeemɔ, ni lalai kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni nyɛlaa lɛ baatsɔ̃ yaafo. Nyɛbaabumɔ kpekpe, ni nyɛaashɛshɛɛ nyɛyi, ni nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ fɔlɔi ni miiye amɛbi koome ni egbo he awerɛho. Nakai gbi lɛ naagbee mli baajoo pam.
11“Naa, gbii miiba, ni mahã hɔ̃mɔ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Jeee daaŋŋmãa hɔ̃mɔ mɛi baaye lɛ, ni jeee nu hɔ̃mɔ hu, shi moŋ abaaye Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ he kumai. 12Mɛi baafo shi kɛjɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛya ŋshɔnaa, ni amɛaajɛ kooyigbɛ kɛya bokãgbɛ ni amɛmiitao Yehowa naa wiemɔ lɛ, shi amɛnaŋ. 13Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, oblayei hefɛotsɛmɛi kɛ oblahii fɛɛ baatɔtɔɔ biti kɛ kumai, 14ni mɛi ni kɛ Samaria jemawɔji lɛ kãa kitã amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mina Dan jemawɔŋ lɛ,’ loo ‘Mina Beersheba jemawɔŋ lɛ,’ amɛbaanyɔnyɔi.”

Title: AMOS 9
Content:
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baagbala toi ehã
1Mina Yehowa damɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Okɛ nii atswia Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpɔbii lɛ waa koni kpokui lɛ ahoso, ni ewule eshwie mɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Mɛi ni ahe baaje mli lɛ mibagbe amɛ yɛ ta mli. Mɔ ko mɔ ko ejoŋ minaa foi lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko hu he ejeŋ mli. 2 Kɛji amɛtsa shi kɛtee gbohiiaje tete lɛ, minine baashɛ amɛnɔ yɛ jɛi; ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi hu, mibamɔmɔ amɛ kɛkpeleke shi kɛjɛ jɛi. 3Kɛji amɛyatee amɛhe yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ tete lɛ, mibatao amɛ, ni mibamɔmɔ amɛ; ni kɛ amɛtee ŋshɔ shishi amɛyatee mi yɛ jɛi hu, mibafã ŋshɔŋ onufu gbeyeigbeyei lɛ, ni ebaakɔ̃mɔ amɛ. 4 Ni kɛji amɛhenyɛlɔi baŋɔ amɛ nom tete lɛ, mibafã, ni henyɛlɔi lɛ baafã klante yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛaagbe amɛ. Mijie mihiɛ mika amɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ; ejurɔ ko bɛ ni mibafee amɛ.”
5Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ́ enine
sa je lɛ he
kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ miihoso,
ni emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeɔ awerɛhoo,
mɔ ni hãa je lɛ yiɔ
ni ekpɔ̃ŋɔ tamɔ Nilo Faa lɛ,
6mɔ ni ŋwɛiniiaŋ ji he ni epiai yɔɔ,
ni ekɛ ŋwɛi ebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni etsɛɔ ŋshɔŋ nu lɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛi,
ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
Egbɛi ji Yehowa!
7Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israelbii, mijwɛŋɔ nyɛhe tamɔ mijwɛŋɔ Etiopiabii ahe lɛ. Bɔ ni mijie Israelbii kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai mijie Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Kreta kɛ Siriabii lɛ hu kɛjɛ Kir. 8Naa, mi, Yehowa Ofe, mijie mihiɛ mika Israel, maŋ ni feɔ esha lɛ, ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Shi moŋ mikpãtãŋ Yakob shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ kwrakwra, Yehowa kɛɛ.
9“Naa, mibafã, ni mibasha Israelbii lɛ amli yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ ateŋ tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa ŋmaa mli lɛ, ni ŋmaa kuli nɛkɛ egbeŋ shi. 10Mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ gbɔmɛi eshafeelɔi ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ haŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko anina wɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaanyɔnyɔi yɛ ta mli.’ ”
Abaasaa Israel wɔsɛɛ
11 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibatee David maŋtsɛyeli ni egbee shi lɛ shi mama shi ekoŋŋ. Mibatsimɔ fɔji ni eba maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni masaa matswa lɛ mama shi tamɔ eyɔɔ blema lɛ. 12Ni Israelbii lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ amɛbashɔ̃ Edom shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi fɛɛ ni tsutsu ko lɛ migbɛi kã amɛnɔ lɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni baatsu nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, ekɛɛ nɛ,
13 “Naa, gbii miiba,”
Yehowa kɛɛ
“ni nidulɔi kɛ nidumɔ baanina
nikpalɔ ni ekpako nii egbeko naa;
ni wain yibii baawo babaoo
bɔ ni wainŋalɔ nyɛŋ fɛɛ eŋa,
ni wain baatsere kɛbaajɛ
gɔji lɛ amli, ni eeeho yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ tamɔ faa.
14Mibakpale mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ
kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba
koni amɛbasaa amɛmaji
ni efee koikoi lɛ ni amɛhi mli ekoŋŋ;
amɛaafee wain tromi
ni amɛaanu amɛmli wain;
ni amɛaahu abɔi
ni amɛaaye abɔi lɛ amli nii.
15Mibadu amɛ yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni anyɛŋ amɛ afã yɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.”
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ena ekɛɛ.

Title: OBADIA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Aleee be pɔtɛɛ mli ni aŋma wolo kukuoo nɛɛ; ekolɛ aŋma be ni abutu Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yɛ afi ni ji 586 Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli lɛ sɛɛ. Yuda akutso lɛ teteete henyɛlɔi ni ji Edombii, ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kã Yudabii awuoyi-bokãgbɛ lɛ, nyaaa akɛ ana aye Yerusalɛm nɔ, ni abutu maŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ be ni ta lɛ ba lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyawa Yuda henyɛlɔi ni batua Yerusalɛm lɛ. Edombii lɛ tsɔ̃ tuamɔ nɛɛ nɔ, ni amɛha Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli nii kɛtee amɛmaŋ.
Gbalɔ Obadia gba akɛ be miiba ni abaaye Edombii nɛɛ kɛ Israel henyɛlɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ anɔ kunim kɛgbala amɛtoi.
Mlijaramɔi
Edom toigbalamɔ lɛ 1-14
Yehowa Gbi lɛ 15-21

Title: OBADIA 1
Content:
1Gbalɔ Obadia gbalɛ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ nɛ.
Yehowa baagbala Edom toi
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo kɛtee
majimaji lɛ aŋɔɔ,
ni wɔnu wiemɔ ni ekɛtee lɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛtea shi!
Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔ kɛ Edom ayawua ta!”
2Yehowa kɛɛ Edom akɛ,
“Naa, mibaba ohewalɛ shi
yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ,
ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ebuŋ bo kwraa.
3Ohenɔwomɔ lɛ elaka bo.
Omaŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ tɛsaa nɔ,
ni oshihilɛhe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ nɔ;
ni no hewɔ ni okɛɔ ohe akɛ,
‘Namɔ aaanyɛ mi shi aba?’
4Kɛji oyato oshihilɛhe
yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tamɔ okropɔŋ tsu,
ni shihilɛhe lɛ hɔ ŋulamii ateŋ tete,
kɛ̃lɛ majie bo yɛ jɛi kɛyi shi.
5“Kɛji julɔi ba bo juu nyɔɔŋ,
loo ojotswalɔi bashwie onɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ,
te amɛaakpãtã onii ahiɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ani julɔi lɛ ejuŋ onii
bɔ pɛ ni aaashɛ amɛnaa?
Kɛji wainyibii kpalɔi ni ba lɛ,
ani amɛshiŋ yibii lɛ kpɛkpɛbii lo?
Shi naa, bo lɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ
ekpãtã ohiɛ butuu.
6Esau shwiei, kwɛ bɔ ni aha nyɛ,
kwɛ bɔ ni afãmɔ nyɛjwetrii ni akɛtee lɛ.
7Nyɛhefatalɔi lɛ elaka nyɛ;
amɛshwie nyɛ kɛtee husu lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ;
mɛi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ gbee jurɔ lɛ hu
eye nyɛnɔ kunim.
Nanemɛi ni nyɛkɛye nii lɛ tsɔ̃ nyɛ tsɔne;
nɔ ko ni anuuu shishi.
8Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ,
“Nakai gbi lɛ magbala Edom toi,
mibakpãtã enilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ,
ni mahã amɛnilee hiɛ akpãtã.
9Ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ Teman hii kãkãlɔi lɛ,
ni Edom tabilɔi fɛɛ baanyɔnyɔi.”
Edom toigbalamɔ lɛ shishi
10“Efɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛnyɛmimɛi
ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
ohe baafee hiɛgbele,
ni aaakpãtã ohiɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
11Odamɔ shi yɛ afã banee,
gbi ni gbɔi baloo ejwetri kɛtee lɛ.
Odamɔ afã ni gbɔi bote maŋ lɛ mli
ni amɛfɔ̃ oshiki kɛja emlinii
amɛhã amɛhe lɛ.
12Kulɛ esaaa akɛ bo hu
oyi awa tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ.
Oyeɔ onyɛmimɛi Yudabii lɛ
ayɔɔ yɛ amanehulu
ni banina amɛ lɛ hewɔ;
ni ebɛ akɛ ooonya
yɛ amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ;
ni esaaa akɛ oshwãa
yɛ haomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
13Kulɛ esaaa akɛ oboteɔ
miwebii lɛ amaŋ lɛ mli,
yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ;
ebɛ akɛ oyeɔ amɛ yɔɔ
yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ;
ni esaaa akɛ oyahaa amɛnii
yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ.
14 Kulɛ esaaa akɛ nyɛdamɔɔ gbɛnta
ni nyɛgbegbeɔ
mɛi ni joɔ foi lɛ;
ni esaaa akɛ nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi
hiɛkãalɔi lɛ hãa henyɛlɔi lɛ
yɛ hejaramɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo maji lɛ
15 “Ejaakɛ be lɛ eshɛ etã,
be ni, mi, Yehowa
mibakojo majimaji lɛ.
Bɔ ni ofee lɛ,
nakai aaafee bo, Esau.
Onifeemɔnii lɛ baaku sɛɛ
abawula oyiteŋ.
16 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni nyɛnunuu dãi
yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
nakai majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ
aaamiimii dãa, ni amɛaadidãa,
ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi
ni ebablako dã.”
Israel baaye kunim
17 “Shi mɛi ni aaaje mli lɛ,
aaayato maŋ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eeetsɔ̃ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ,
ni Yakob shwiei lɛ anine aaashɛ
amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
18 Yakob shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ là,
ni Yosef shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ là lilɛi,
ni Esau shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ gbetselii,
ni aaashã amɛ ni aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ
bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko yɛ Esau we lɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
19“Yuda wuoyigbɛbii lɛ aaabashɔ̃
Edom Gɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ;
ni mɛi ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ gɔji lɛ ashishi lɛ
baashɔ̃ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛbaaŋɔ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ,
kɛ Samaria hu;
ni Benyamin baaŋɔ Gilead.
20Israelbii ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ
baaŋɔ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ,
kɛjɛ Foinikia kɛyashi Zarefat;
ni nomii ni jɛ Yerusalɛm
ni akɛ amɛ etee Sarde lɛ
baaŋɔ wuoyigbɛ maji lɛ.
21Tabilɔi kunimyelɔi aaajɛ Yerusalɛm
ayatua Edom, ni amɛaaye enɔ;
ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ aaaye Maŋtsɛ.”

Title: YONA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Esoro Yona wolo lɛ yɛ gbalɛ woji krokomɛi ni yɔɔ Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ wolo lɛ gbaa nibii amli ni Yona, Gbalɔ ni ka akɛ egbo Nyɔŋmɔ fãmɔ nɔ toi lɛ, tsɔ̃mɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ eya Nineve, ni ji Asiria, ni eji Israel henyɛlɔ ni ekɛfuuu kwraa lɛ, maŋ wulu lɛ mli. Shi Yona sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yaa jɛi, ejaakɛ eyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtaŋ Nineve maŋ wulu lɛ hiɛ. Yona shashao shi be saŋŋ, kɛ̃lɛ eye tsumɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etee Nineve. Naagbee mli lɛ Yona werɛ ho ehe be ni ena akɛ hiɛkpãtamɔ ni eyashiɛ akɛ ebaaba Nineve lɛ baaa mli.
Wolo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji Ofe yɛ adebɔɔ fɛɛ nɔ. Shi nɔ ni fe fɛɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛtsɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni ekɛ tɔ̃mɔ faa, ni ehereɔ emaŋbii ahenyɛlɔi ayiwala fe nɔ ni eeegbala amɛtoi kɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Yona tsɛmɔ kɛ etoigbele 1.1-17
Yona tsui tsakemɔ kɛ ekpɔmɔ 2.1-10
Yona gbalɛ ni egba eshi Nineve lɛ 3.1-10
Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ na Nineve mɔbɔ 4.1-11

Title: YONA 1
Content:
Yona gbo Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ toi
1 Gbi ko lɛ Yehowa kɛ Yona, Amitai bi lɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ Yona akɛ, 2“Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli koni oyashiɛ oshi maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni emli bii lɛ feɔ lɛ miina fɛɛ.” 3 Shi be ni Yona yi mli lɛ, ewo ehiɛ ema Tarshish gbɛ moŋ. Eyiŋtoo ji akɛ eejo Yehowa tsumɔ lɛ naa foi. Etee Yopa; eyana lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Tarshish. No hewɔ lɛ, ewo lɛlɛ lɛ mlitamɔ he nyɔmɔ, kɛkɛ ni ebote mli koni ekɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli bii lɛ aya Tarshish, koni ejo foi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 4Shi Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni naa wa jogbaŋŋ tswa yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ. Ahum fã waa, ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni lɛlɛ lɛ baajwa. 5Amlakui lɛ she gbeyei, kɛkɛ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bolɔ etsɛ nɔ ni ejaa akɛ ebahere amɛ. Fee sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ jie lɛlɛ lɛ mli jatsu lɛ amɛwo ŋshɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni lɛlɛ lɛ afee huyɛhuyɛ ahã amɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yona etee lɛlɛ lɛ shishigbɛ eyakã shi, ni lɛ lɛ, ewɔ vii diɛŋtsɛ.
6Lɛlɛtsɛ lɛ yana Yona yɛ eshikamɔhe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, bo lɛ wɔɔ owɔɔ lo? Tee shi ni osɔle otsɛ nɔ ni ojaa akɛ aleenɔ emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ wɔhe koni ebahere wɔ koni wɔhiɛ akakpãtã lo.”
7 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfɔ̃a oshiki kɛtao mɔ koome hewɔ ni nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ.” Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki lɛ; ni oshiki lɛ gbee Yona nɔ. 8Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ gbaa wɔ. Te bo ohewɔ jɛ ni osharã nɛɛ fɛɛ ebasharã wɔ nɛɛ? Mɛni otsuɔ? Nɛgbɛ ojɛ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ? Mɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ojɛ, ni mɛɛ maŋ nɔ fɔmɔbi ji bo?”
9 Yona jie naa akɛ, “Hebrinyo ji mi; ni Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi ni lɛ ebɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ fɛɛ lɛ mijaa.” 10Be ni Yona egba amɛ akɛ eejo foi yɛ Yehowa tsumɔ naa lɛ, amlakui lɛ she gbeyei jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Mɛni ofee nɛɛ?” 11Nakai be mli fɛɛ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ miiya nɔ eefee hamahama sɔŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Mɛni kɛ̃ wɔfee bo, ni eeeha ŋshɔ lɛ aŋmɛ ahã wɔ?”
12Yona hã hetoo akɛ, “Nyɛwoa mi, ni nyɛshɛa mi nyɛfɔa ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni ŋshɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ ahã nyɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ mi mihewɔ ni nɛkɛ ahum kpeteŋkple nɛɛ tswaa nyɛ nɛɛ.”
13Amlakui lɛ mia amɛhiɛ amɛwiri kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ; shi amɛnyɛɛɛ ejaakɛ ŋshɔ lɛ tee nɔ efee hamahama ekpee amɛ. 14Enɛ hã amlakui lɛ sɔle amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, wɔmiikpa bo fai, kaahã wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ nuu nɛɛ wala hewɔ. Ela yi sɔ̃ akatere wɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔle akɛ bo lɛ, ofeɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ.” 15Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ wo Yona, ni amɛshɛ lɛ amɛfɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ. 16Amlakui lɛ she Yehowa gbeyei bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehã amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, asaŋ mɛi wowoo shii srɔtoi hu.
17Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ, ŋshɔŋloo kpeteŋkple ko mi Yona, ni Yona hi loo nɛɛ musuŋ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃.

Title: YONA 2
Content:
Yona sɔlemɔ lɛ
1 Yona yɛ ŋshɔŋloo lɛ musuŋ, kɛkɛ ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, 2ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mibolɔ mitsɛ Yehowa,
ni ehere mi nɔ;
mibolɔ kɛjɛ gbohiiaje musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ,
ni Yehowa, obo migbee toi.
3 Oshɛ mi ofɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli
kɛtee ŋshɔ shishi tɔ̃ɔ,
ni nu babaoo bɔle mihe kɛkpe;
ni oshɔkei kɛ omlɛ̃mɛ̃i lɛ kumɔ shwie minɔ.
4 Misusu akɛ ashwie mi kɛje ohiɛ,
ni te mafee tɛŋŋ mana
oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ?
5 Nu lɛ su mi, ni mitsui bɔ̃i suu;
ŋshɔ lɛ su mi emuu,
ni wosuma bla miyitso fɛɛ.
6 Mikpeleke shi kɛtee gɔji ashishitoo hei
diɛŋtsɛ po,
shikpɔŋ ni enaa agboi lɛ
sa miyi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.
Shi Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, ohere miyiwala
kɛjɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
7 Be ni misusuma tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ,
mikai Yehowa,
ni misɔle, ni onu misɔlemɔ lɛ
yɛ oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.
8 Mɛi ni jaa yaka amãgãi lɛ,
amɛyeee bo anɔkwa.
9 Shi mi lɛ, mala makafo bo,
ni mashã afɔle mahã bo;
shi ni miwo lɛ, maye nɔ.
Yiwalaheremɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.”
10 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa fã ŋshɔŋ loo lɛ, ni
eyashwe Yona eŋmɛ shikpɔŋ.

Title: YONA 3
Content:
Yona ye Nyɔŋmɔ fãmɔ nɔ
1Yehowa kɛ Yona wie ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 2 “Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli, koni okɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ ayahã amɛ.” 3 No hewɔ lɛ, Yona te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Nineve yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa. Nineve lɛ, maŋ kpeteŋkple jogbaŋŋ ni, ejaakɛ ayeɔ gbii etɛ̃ dani anyiɛɔ kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ krotia kome kɛyashɛɔ ekrotia kroko. 4Yona je shishi koni etsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli kɛho. Be ni enyiɛ gbi kome gbɛ lɛ, ewo eshiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, biɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, abaabutu Nineve.”
5 Ninevebii lɛ he Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ amɛye; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛfã akɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ wulu nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ bibioo nɔ lɛ, ahi ŋmaa, ni abu kpekpe kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ.
6Be ni Nineve maŋtsɛ lɛ nu wiemɔ lɛ, ete shi yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni ejie etade fɛɛfɛo ni ewo lɛ yɛ ehe efɔ̃ shi, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eho eta lamlu mli. 7Ewo akpɔ, ni ehã ashiɛ yɛ Nineve maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ miiwo akpɔ akɛ, ‘Gbɔmɔ jio, kooloo jio, tsina kɛ too hu, amɛteŋ ekoeko akasa enaa nɔ ko; akaye nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ, akanu nu hu; 8shi moŋ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ abu kpekpe, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asɔle kɛ hiɛdɔɔ atsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; asaŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsake ejeŋba gbonyo lɛ, ni akpa yitsoŋwalɛ sane ni akɛyeɔ mɛi lɛ, 9 akɛ aleenɔ Yehowa hu aaatsake eyiŋ ni eto lɛ, ni eeeŋmɛɛ emli ni efu waa lɛ he, ni no aaahã wɔhiɛ akakpãtã lo!’ ”
