10 Nyɔŋmɔ na nɔ ni Ninevebii lɛ fee lɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛjeŋba fɔŋ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu ŋmɛɛ efɔŋ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee amɛ lɛ he, ni egbalaaa amɛtoi.

Title: YONA 4
Content:
Yona mli fu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ena mɔbɔ
1Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fee yɛ Ninevebii ahe lɛ eŋɔɔɔ Yona naa kwraa, ni efee lɛ mlifu tete. 2 No hewɔ lɛ, esɔle, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, ani jeee nɔ ni mikɛɛ be mli ni miyɔɔ mimaŋ lɛ eba mli nɛɛ? Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni mijɛ mra mijo foi kɛmiiya Tarshish lɛ. Ejaakɛ mile akɛ bo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ durolɔ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɔ ji bo; omli fuuu mra, ni omɔbɔnalɛ fa, ni otsakeɔ oyiŋtoo yɛ toigbalamɔ he. 3 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, Yehowa, foo miwala nɔ ohã mi, ejaakɛ faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ fe nɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ.”
4Yehowa bi Yona akɛ, “Kolɛ omli ni ewo la nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?”
5Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yona shi Nineve maŋ lɛ mli. Etee ni eyafee asese fioo ko yɛ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni eho eta eshishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli koni emɛ kɛyashi eeena nɔ ni baaba maŋ lɛ nɔ. 6Yehowa hã adedeŋkruma ko kwɛ̃, ni eha Yona yiteŋ koni ehã lɛ hɔɔŋ koni efo ehehiamɔ lɛ sɛɛ ehã lɛ. Yona na adedeŋkruma lɛ he miishɛɛ naakpa. 7Shi gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã gɔgɔmi baye adedeŋkruma lɛ, ni egbe lɛ. 8Ni be ni hulu te shi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni mli edɔ batswa, ni Yona tɔ biti yɛ hulu ni shã epampam lɛ naawalɛ hewɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Yona shwe gbele, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ fe nɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ.”
9Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Kolɛ omli ni ewo la yɛ adedeŋkruma lɛ he nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?”
Yona here nɔ akɛ, “Eja gbɛ akɛ mimli awo la bɔ sɔŋŋ po ni kɛji gbele tete lɛ magbo.”
10Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Adedeŋkruma lɛ ni gbi kome nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ ni ekwɛ̃, asaŋ ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ ehiɛ ekpãtã, tso ni ogboko ehe deŋme ko, ni jeee bo hu ohã ekwɛ̃ lɛ, esane miidɔ bo. 11Mɛɛba esaaa akɛ mi lɛ Nineve sane adɔ mi, maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛkɛ kɛ emli gbɔmɛi fe akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko kɛ emli toi kɛ tsinai babaoo hu lɛ?”

Title: MIKA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbalɔ Mika ni kɛ Yesaia fɛɛ hi shi yɛ be kome mli lɛ, ejɛ Yuda maji lɛ eko mli. Mika na krɛdɛɛ akɛ amanehulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni Amos gba akɛ ebaaba kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ eko miiba ŋshɔŋgbɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eeba yɛ nɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ. Srɔto pɛ ni yɔɔ Amos kɛ Mika gbalɛi lɛ mli ji akɛ, Mika gbalɛ lɛ yɛ faŋŋ fe Amos nɔ lɛ, ni okadii titrii komɛi hu yɛ Mika nɔ lɛ mli ni hãa anaa hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ nibii baahi.
Wolo lɛ mli saji ni esa akɛ akadi ato lɛ ateŋ eko ji nɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ wɔsɛɛ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ je lɛ mli lɛ, hejɔlɛ baaba je lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ (4.1-4); eko hu ji gbalɛ ni agba akɛ maŋtsɛ wulu ko baajɛ David weku lɛ mli aba, ni ekɛ hejɔlɛ baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ (5.2-4a); ekroko hu ji wiemɔ ni wɔnaa yɛ wolo lɛ yitso 6 kuku 8 lɛ mli lɛ. Nibii pii ni Israel gbalɔi lɛ ewie lɛ, yitso 6 kuku 8 nɛɛ foɔ fɛɛ kuku akɛ, “Nɔ ni etaoɔ yɛ wɔdɛŋ ji akɛ wɔfee nɔ ni ja, wɔmli ahi ahã wɔnyɛmimɛi gbɔmɛi bei fɛɛ, ni wɔkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ abɔ naanyo kɛ heshibaa.”
Mlijaramɔi
Abaakojo Israel kɛ Yuda 1.1—3.12
Israel kɛ Yuda baana hejɔlɛ ekoŋŋ 4.1—5.15
Kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ he shɛɛ 6.1—7.20

Title: MIKA 1
Content:
1 Maŋtsɛ Yotam kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz kɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ayinɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ shɛɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ hã Mika ni jɛ maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Moreshet lɛ mli lɛ. Yehowa jie nibii ni kɔɔ Samaria kɛ Yerusalɛm he nɛɛ fɛɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Mika.
Samaria kɛ Yerusalɛm he ŋkɔmɔ
2Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ kwa, nyɛboa toi;
shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi!
Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa, aaajɛ eSɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli
eye odase eshi nyɛ.
3 Naa, Yehowa miije kpo kɛjɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,
ni eeeyi shi ni ebanyiɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
4Gɔji lɛ aaasere yɛ enaneshi
tamɔ wo-agbaku sereɔ yɛ la hiɛ lɛ;
gɔji lɛ aaayiridi awo jɔi lɛ amli
ni jɔi lɛ aaagbalagbalai
tamɔ nu ni jɛ gɔŋ yiteŋ eebote jɔɔ mli.
5 Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baaba yɛ esha ni Israelbii efee eshi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehiɛ atua ni amɛtse lɛ hewɔ. Israelbii atuatsemɔ lɛ, namɔ ejɛ? Ani jeee Samaria, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ? Wɔŋjamɔ ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ, namɔ ejɛ? Ani jeee Yerusalɛm? 6No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mahã Samaria akumɔ abua shi yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ tamɔ he ko ni atɛoɔ waintsei yɛ. Matsi egbogbo koi lɛ mawo jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni mahã tɛi ni akɛto maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ ashishi lɛ ahe akã. 7 Aaajwara emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni nii ni akɛbawoɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ajwamãŋi anyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashã fɛɛ. Makumɔ ewɔji lɛ fɛɛ mabua shi ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gɔŋ. Ajwamãŋi anyɔmɔwo mli Samaria bua nii nɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ, ni agbɛnɛ Samaria henyɛlɔi aaaloo fɛɛ kɛaatee amɛjamɔhei yɛ hei krokomɛi.” 8Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, maye ŋkɔmɔ ni mawo yara; manyiɛ pasaa kɛ mihe yayai. Mawo yara tamɔ ŋaŋgbei, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ loofɔlɔ, 9ejaakɛ Samaria pilamɔi lɛ ni ehiii tsamɔ lɛ eko miiba Yuda nɔ. Hiɛkpãtãmɔ eshɛ Yerusalɛm agboi anaa tɔ̃ɔ; eshɛ he ni mimaŋ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.”
Henyɛlɔi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yerusalɛm
10 Nyɛkagbaa yɛ Gat; nyɛkahãa amɛnaa nyɛ ni nyɛmiifo. Bet-Leafrabii, nyɛkokloa mlu mli. 11Nyɛ Shafirbii, nyɛjea kpo kɛhoa kɛ hiɛgbele kɛ nyɛhe yayai. Zaananbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ kpo aje. Kɛji nyɛnu ni Bet-Ezelbii miiye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ abobaahe bɛ jɛi. 12Marotbii lɛ miishwe heremɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã efɔŋ eshɛ Yerusalɛm agbo lɛ naa etã. 13Nyɛ Lakishbii, nyɛfimɔa shwiilii nyɛkpɛtɛa okpɔŋɔi ni he yɔɔ oya ahe. Israel eshai lɛ nyɛkase feemɔ, ni nyɛkɛhã Yerusalɛm efee esha. 14Belɛ agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛkɛ Moreshet-Gat maŋ lɛ ayea shɛɛ. Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ naŋ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛŋ Akzib maŋ lɛ mli shĩai adɛŋ.
15Mareshabi, Yehowa baajie mɔ ehã ni ebaye nyɛnɔ kunim. Ebaaŋɔ nyɛmaŋ lɛ, ni Israel hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ aaajo foi ayatee yɛ Abdulam tɛkplo lɛ mli. 16Yudabii, nyɛshɛa nyɛyi kɛyea ŋkɔmɔ yɛ nyɛbii ni nyɛsumɔ lɛ ahewɔ. Nyɛkpɔa nyɛyi kuekue tamɔ akpaŋa yiteŋ, ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ nyɛbii lɛ anom kɛaaje nyɛhe kɛya.

Title: MIKA 2
Content:
Nɔ ni baaba mɛi ni waa ohiafoi ayi nɔ
1 Kpoo hã mɛi ni toɔ efɔŋ he ŋaa yɛ amɛsai anɔ lɛ. Kɛji je tsɛre, ni amɛna hegbɛ lɛ, amɛfeɔ efɔŋ ni amɛto he ŋaa amɛfɔ shi lɛ ejaakɛ efɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ. 2Amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ ŋmɔji anɔ, ni amɛshɔ̃ɔ; amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ shĩai anɔ, ni amɛŋɔɔ. Mɔ ko mɔ ko gboshinii kɛ ewe fɛɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe.
3 No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Mito ni mibahã sane fɔŋ aye nyɛ ni nyɛnyɛŋ enaa foi nyɛjo; amanehulu baaba nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛnyiɛ kɛ nyɛhetsɔ̃ɔmɔ. 4Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mɛi kɛ nyɛsane lɛ aaabu abɛ, ni amɛaala nijiaŋwujee lala amɛkɛɛ akɛ,
‘Wɔhiɛ ekpãtã kwrakwra!
Yehowa ehe wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ;
ni ekɛhã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ,
ni eja wɔŋmɔji ehã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ.’ ”
5No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ be shɛ, ni akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miiku sɛɛ ahã Yehowa bii lɛ, kɛji afɔ̃ oshiki lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko naŋ eko.
6 Mɛi shiɛɔ ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Kaashiɛ owo wɔ. Kaashiɛ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ owo wɔ; hiɛgbele ko bɛ ni baaba wɔnɔ. 7Ani osusuɔ akɛ alomɔ Israelbii? Ani Yehowa tsuishitoo lɛ etã? Ani ebaafee nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi? Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja lɛ, ani jeee hi miwiemɔ lɛ hi hã amɛ?”
8Yehowa to he akɛ, “Nyɛteɔ shi nyɛwoɔ mimaŋ lɛ tamɔ ateɔ shi awoɔ henyɛlɔi. Mɛi kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛɔ ta naa kɛbaa, ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛfee shweshweeshwe yɛ shĩa. Shi naa nyɛ ni nyɛmiimɛ amɛ koni nyɛkpɔlɔ amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe. 9Nyɛshwieɔ mimaŋ lɛ mli yei lɛ yɛ amɛshĩai ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ; ni jɔɔmɔi ni mikɛjɔɔ amɛbii lɛ, nyɛshɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ. 10Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛyaa. Biɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe dɔŋŋ yɛ nyɛhe eshai ni kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baaba lɛ hewɔ.
11“Gbalɔ ni maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ ji gbalɔ ni nyiɛɔ ni ewieɔ fuu ni emaleɔ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wain kɛ dãa ni wa baabu ahã nyɛ.’
12 “Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, mabua nyɛnaa, nyɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ni eshwɛ. Mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too gwantɛŋ ku kome; mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too ku yɛ amɛniyelihe yɛ ŋa nɔ; nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baashi hoo ekoŋŋ kɛ gbɔmɛi.”
13 Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni gbeleɔ gbɛ baagbele gbɛ ahã amɛ, ni eeenyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba. Amɛaajwa maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ kɛje kpo kɛya heyeli mli. Amɛmaŋtsɛ ni ji Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ aaanyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛje kpo.

Title: MIKA 3
Content:
Mika wie shi Israelbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ
1Nyɛ Israel onukpai ni ji Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛboa toi! Ani jeee nyɛgbɛnaa ji akɛ nyɛaale nɔ ni ja? 2Shi nyɛnyɛɔ ekpakpa, ni nyɛsumɔɔ efɔŋ. Nyɛkpɔɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ahe wolo yɛ amɛhe be mli ni amɛhiɛ kã; ni nyɛjieɔ amɛheloo yɛ amɛwui ahe. 3 Nyɛyeɔ mimaŋbii lɛ aloo. Nyɛkpɔɔ amɛhe wolo yɛ amɛhe; nyɛkumɔɔ amɛwui, ni nyɛdukuɔ mli tamɔ loo ni akɛyaawo kukwɛi wulu mli. 4Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛaablɔ nyɛtsɛ Yehowa, shi efoŋ nyɛdaaŋ; shi moŋ ekɛ ehiɛ aaatee nyɛ yɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ. 5Gbalɔi lɛ lakaa mimaŋ lɛ. Mɛi ni hãa gbalɔi nɛɛ nɔ ko lɛ, gbalɔi lɛ shiɛɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ hejɔlɛ miiba; shi mɛi ni hãaa amɛ nɔ ko lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛhe gbeyei akɛ ta baaba abatua amɛ. Yehowa miikɛɛ gbalɔi nɛɛ akɛ, 6“Gbalɔi, eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni nyɛbe baaho. Hulu aaanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛnɔ. Akɛni nyɛhã mimaŋ lɛ du gbɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ ninaa ko dɔŋŋ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ gbalɛ ko hu nyɛgba dɔŋŋ.” 7Mɛi ni gbaa nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ ahiɛ aaashwie shi, ni klamɔfoi lɛ hu ahiɛ aaagboi. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaagboi ni amɛaamu shi kɔ̃i, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hereee amɛ nɔ.
8Shi mi lɛ, Yehowa kɛ emumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ woɔ mimli obɔ̃, ni ehãa mileɔ nɔ ni ji jalɛ, ni ehãa mi ekãa ni akɛkɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ji eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ. 9Nyɛ Yakob we onukpai, nyɛ Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhiɔ jalɛ, ni nyɛhãa jalɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ejaaa, nyɛboa toi koo! 10 Nyɛmiima Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ wulu ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ, nyɛmiima lashishwiemɔ kɛ kutumpɔo. 11 Maŋ onukpai lɛ, nyɔɔŋnii amɛheɔ dani amɛbuaa sane he; osɔfoi lɛ, nyɔmɔwoo hewɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ shika hewɔ amɛgbaa nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe kpasaa Yehowa ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ; nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko baŋ wɔnɔ.”
12 No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ, aaatsa Zion ashwie shi tamɔ atsaa ŋa akɛfeɔ ŋmɔ. Yerusalɛm aaatsɔ̃ tsu koi ni bua shi tamɔ gɔŋ, ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaatsa atsɔ̃ koo hayii.

Title: MIKA 4
Content:
Yehowa hejɔlɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ
(Yesaia 2.1-4)
1Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Sɔlemɔ We lɛ gɔŋ lɛ
aaakwɔ fe gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ,
ni eeeta gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Majimaji aaabu kɛaaba enɔ.
2 Ni maji amli bii pii aaaba abakɛɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔyakwɔa Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ,
kɛya Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ;
ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɔ ni etaoɔ ni wɔfee;
koni wɔnyiɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ, Yerusalɛm ebaajɛ;
ekɛ emaŋ lɛ wieɔ kɛjɛɔ Zion.”
3 Eeekojo maji pii ateŋ,
eeebua maji wuji ni bɛŋkɛ
kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ fɛɛ anaa.
Amɛkɛ amɛklantei aaasɔ̃ kɔii,
ni amɛkɛ amɛkpɔlɔi lɛ hu aaasɔ̃ kaklai adɔi
ni akɛkpɔlɔɔ tso he.
Maŋ ko woŋ klante nɔ yɛ maŋ ko nɔ
ni amɛsaŋ amɛhe amɛhaŋ tawuu dɔŋŋ.
4 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaata lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewaintsei
kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbãmitsei ashishi
yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ ni kɛɛ enɛ.
5Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ jaa, ni eboɔ enyɔŋmɔ toi;
shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔja ni wɔɔbo Yehowa,
wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Israelbii lɛ aaajɛ nomŋɔɔ mli aba
6 “Be miiba,” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ni mabua obubuafoi ni egbɔjɔ kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ, mɛi ni migbala amɛtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛaaba. 7Ni mikɛ akpaketsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ, kɛ maŋ, mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaje shishi, ni mafee amɛ maŋ ni da agbo. Ni Yehowa aaaye amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛaajɛ nakai be lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ fɛɛ.”
8 Ni bo, Yerusalɛm, tooku lɛ mɔɔ ni kwɔ, Zion biyoo lɛ gɔŋkpɔ, oootsɔ̃ maŋtsɛmaŋ ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni oyɔɔ tsutsu lɛ. 9 Mɛɛba obolɔɔ? Mɛɛba okɛ̃mɔɔ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ? Maŋtsɛ ni obɛ hewɔ ni, aloo oŋaawolɔ ni egbo hewɔ ni? 10Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛkɛ̃mɔa, ni nyɛkɔ̃mɔa tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eta ehe; ejaakɛ nyɛbaashi maŋ lɛ mli ni nyɛaayahi ŋa lɛ nɔ; nyɛbaaya Babilon tɔ̃ɔ. Shi jɛi lɛ Yehowa aaahere nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ. 11Maji pii ekpe ewo nyɛhe, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Afite Yerusalɛm koni wɔna ni ejwere shi koikoi.” 12Shi maji nɛɛ leee Yehowa jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, amɛyooo eyiŋtoo lɛ sɛɛ hu akɛ Yehowa ebua amɛnaa tamɔ abuaa ŋmãakei anaa yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe.
13Yehowa kɛɛ, “Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛtea shi; ni nyɛgbea nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ tamɔ agbeɔ ŋmãa! Mahã nyɛhe awa tamɔ tsinanuu kɛ eklontoi ni wa tamɔ dade kɛ ekoklotoi hu ni wa tamɔ akɔɔble. Nyɛaaye maji pii anɔ kunim; ni nyɛaajɔɔ haanii ni amɛshɔ̃ aklanaŋ naa lɛ nɔ nyɛhã mi, mi ni ji je lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”

Title: MIKA 5
Content:
1Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi anaa! Asa wɔyi! Atua Israelbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ wo nɔyelɔ ni baajɛ Betlehem he shi
2 Yehowa kɛɛ, “Betlehem Efrata, maji bibii fe fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ ekome ji bo, shi omli majie Israel nɔyelɔ kɛaajɛ. Nɔyelɔ nɛɛ weku kpãa aaajɛ blema beebe.”
3 No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaaŋmɛɛ emaŋ lɛ he ehã amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni yoofɔyoo lɛ aaafɔ ebinuu lɛ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba amɛnyɛmɛi Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ. 4 Kɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ ba lɛ, eeeye emaŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eeelɛ amɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni jɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; eeeye nɔ kɛ agbojee hu ni ji Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ agbojee. Nɔyelɔ lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ aaahi shi shweshweeshwe, ejaakɛ aaakpɛ̃lɛ nɔ akɛ eje agbo yɛ je lɛ mli he fɛɛ he; 5 ni ekɛ hejɔlɛ aaaba.
Jiemɔ kɛ Toigbalamɔ
Kɛji Asiriabii lɛ aaabatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛji amɛaafite wɔmɔji ni buɔ wɔhe lɛ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mli kɛho lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔtee hiɛnyiɛlɔi kãkãlɔi babaoo shi wɔwo amɛ. 6 Amɛkɛ klante aaaye Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Nimrod Shikpɔŋ lɛ. Amɛaahere wɔ kɛaajɛ Asiriabii lɛ adɛŋ, kɛji amɛba amɛbashimɔshimɔɔ shi yɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
7Israelbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ ŋwɛi bɔ ni Yehowa hãa enyɔɔ maji pii anɔ lɛ. Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ futufuli ni shwãa jwɛfɔ nɔ. Amɛkɛ amɛhe aaafɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ko nɔ. 8Israelbii ni aaashwɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ lɛ aaatamɔ jata yɛ kooŋ kooloi ateŋ, aloo tamɔ jata oblanyo yɛ tookui ateŋ. Kɛji eegbɔbi kɛbote kooloi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ehuruɔ eyiɔ amɛnɔ, ni etserɛɔ amɛmli, ni jielɔ ko bɛ. 9Israelbii lɛ aaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
10Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ makpãtã okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni mafite oshwiilii lɛ. 11Mafite maji ni yɔɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni makumɔ mɔji ni buɔ ohe lɛ mashwie shi. 12Makpãtã okunyaayelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni okɔmfo kome nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ haŋ bo. 13Mafite omãgãi lɛ kɛ owɔŋtɛi lɛ, ni ojaŋ nibii ni okɛ oniji fee lɛ dɔŋŋ. 14Wɔŋyoo Ashera wɔŋkoi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, makwao mashwie shi, ni mafite omaji lɛ. 15Mikɛ mlifu kpele kɛ mlila aaatɔ owele yɛ maji fɛɛ ni booo mi toi ni egbo minɔ toi lɛ anɔ.”

Title: MIKA 6
Content:
Sane ni Yehowa kɛ Israel yɔɔ
1Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, “Tee shi ni okɔlɔ ogbee! Hã gɔji kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anu osane lɛ.
2“Nyɛ gɔji, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo ni yɔɔ daa, nyɛboa Yehowa sane lɛ toi! Yehowa kɛ emaŋ Israel ena; ekɛ sane ni eyɔɔ yɛ amɛhe lɛ baashi lɛ.”
3 Yehowa miibi emaŋ lɛ akɛ, “Mimaŋ, mɛni mifee bo? Mɛni mli mihã etɔ bo yɛ? Hã mi hetoo. 4 Ejaakɛ mi mijie bo kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpɔ̃ bo yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli. Mitsu Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam kɛba akɛ ohiɛnyiɛlɔi. 5 Mimaŋbii, nyɛkaia nɔ yiŋ ni Moab maŋtsɛ Balak to yɛ nyɛhe, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni Bileam, Beor bi lɛ, hã lɛ. Nyɛkaia nibii ni ba yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Akasia shitoohe lɛ kɛtee Gilgal tɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Nyɛkaia nibii nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna nibii ni mi, Yehowa, mitsu ni mikɛhere nyɛyiwala lɛ.”
Nɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ
6 Mɛni mikɛaaba Yehowa hiɛ, ni mɛni mikɛaabakoto Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ hiɛ? Miba ehiɛ kɛ shãa afɔlei? Mikɛ tsinabii ni eye afifi abashã shãa afɔlei ahã lɛ? 7Ani toi agboi akpekpei aloo mu tsɛnsii akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ aaasa Yehowa hiɛ? Aso mikɛ mikromɔbi, mimusuŋbi lɛ ahã yɛ mihe esha hewɔ? 8 Dabida! Ao Adesa, Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni hi. Nɔ ni ebiɔ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ nɛ, akɛ ofee nɔ ni ja gbɛ, osumɔ onyɛmimɛi, okɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anyiɛ yɛ heshibaa mli.
9Ehi akɛ ashe Yehowa gbeyei. Eeetsɛ maŋ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛkpeɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli! 10Nɔ ni yɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔi ashĩai amli ni ji jwetri ni atsɔ̃ shishiumɔ gbɛi anɔ ana, kɛ susumɔnii kɛ nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ ni akɛŋmɛɔ nii lɛ, ani mihiɛ aaakpa nɔ? Dabida, miihi! 11Ani mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ susumɔnii kɛ nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ ahe esha aaafa amɛ lo? 12Niiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ shishiuɔ ohiafoi lɛ; ni nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ amalelɔi ji nyɛ. 13No hewɔ lɛ, mije nyɛ nitswiamɔ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ shishi momo yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ. 14Nyɛaaye nii, shi nyɛtɔrɔŋ; ni hɔmɔ aaakã he aye nyɛ. Nyɛaaloo nii nyɛto, shi efeŋ shweshweeshwe, ni nɔ ni nyɛaabaa yi tete lɛ, makpãtã hiɛ yɛ ta mli. 15 Nyɛaadu nii, shi nyɛkpaŋ eko. Nyɛaaŋa mu, shi nyɛnaŋ mu nyɛkpa, ni nyɛaaŋa wain hu, shi nyɛnuŋ wain. 16 Enɛ baaba mli, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ Omri nibii gbohii lɛ kɛ ebi Ahab nibii fɔ̃ji lɛ, nomɛi anɔ nyɛtsa. No hewɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni abuŋ nyɛ, ni aaabo nyɛ ‘tsia’!”

Title: MIKA 7
Content:
Fitemɔ ni Israel efite
1Kpoo hã mi! Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ ni eetao tsoyibii loo wainyibii ko eye, ejaakɛ akpa wainyibii kɛ agbãmii ni ŋɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ atã, ni shao ko bɛ ni aaana aye; agbãmi hee ni mitsui shweɔ lɛ eko bɛ. 2 Gbɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ; mɔ ko bɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miitao akɛ ena hegbɛ ni eshwie lá shi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miigbɔbi enaanyo. 3Amɛhe esa kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni amɛfeɔ lɛ kɛ ŋaa. Lumɛi kɛ kojolɔi lɛ heɔ nyɔɔŋnii. Nɔ fɔŋ ni yɔɔ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɔ tsuiŋ lɛ, ejeɔ enaa; kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãŋ amɛto. 4Mɔ ni kɛɛ ehi fe fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ, etamɔ kpitikpiti ŋmei, ni mɔ ni kɛɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmei afabaŋ po hi fe lɛ. Shi gbi ni Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala amɛtoi lɛ eshɛ taakɛ ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ kɛtsɔ̃ egbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛ jijaa. 5Kaahe onaanyo oye; ni kɛ ohiɛ akafɔ̃ oshieŋtsɛ nɔ. Yoo ni kãa osɛɛ tete po lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ he jogbaŋŋ dani okɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko. 6 Ejaakɛ binuu ebuuu etsɛ, biyoo teɔ shi woɔ enyɛ; ni shaayoo teɔ shi woɔ eshaayoo. Gbɔmɔ henyɛlɔi ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩa teŋ bii.
7Shi mi lɛ, makwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; mamɛ miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabo mi toi.
Yehowa kɛ Yiwalaheremɔ eba
8 Ao mihenyɛlɔ, kaaye mi yɔɔ. Kɛ migbee shi lɛ, mibate shi ekoŋŋ; kɛ duŋ wo mi lɛ, Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ la ahã mi. 9 Makplɛ̃ Yehowa mli ni efu mi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mifee esha mishi lɛ; mamɛ kɛyashi eeefã mihe, ni eeebu mi bem. Eeejie mi kɛaaba la hiɛ ni mana ekpɔmɔ lɛ. 10 Kɛkɛ lɛ mihenyɛlɔ mɔ ni ebi mi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ” lɛ? Aaana, ni ehiɛ aaagbo kpɔtɔɔ. Mihiŋmɛi aaana lɛ; agbɛnɛ aaanaanaa enɔ tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
11Yerusalɛmbii, be miiba ni aaasaa maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ atswa ni aaalɛɛ ehusui amli kɛaatee sɛɛ. 12Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba. Aaajɛ Asiria ni yɔɔ bokã lɛ kɛ Ijipt ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛaaba. Amɛaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ he kɛ ŋshɔi anaa kɛ gɔji anɔ kɛaaba. 13Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa yɛ enɔ bii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ahewɔ.
Yehowa aaana Israel mɔbɔ
14 Yehowa, feemɔ tookwɛlɔ ohã omaŋ lɛ, ni olɛ amɛ, maŋ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ. Amɛyɛ ŋa kplanaa nɔ banee yɛ Gɔŋ Karmel lɛ yiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii bɔle amɛ kɛkpe. Hã ni amɛhi Bashan kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛye enɔ nii tamɔ blema ko lɛ.
15Mafee naakpɛɛnii matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tamɔ be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 16 Maji lɛ aaana, ni yɛ amɛhewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛnijiaŋ aaaje wui. Amɛkɛ amɛnine aaato amɛnaabu ni amɛaatsimɔ amɛtoii. 17 Amɛaalɛmɔ shikpɔŋ su, ni amɛaawamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ tamɔ onufu. Amɛaajɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ. Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ he ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛaashe bo gbeyei.
18 Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ esha faa tamɔ bo. Okuɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ɔ omaŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ amlatɔ̃mɔ nɔ. Ohiɛɛɛ mlifu mli kɛyaaa naanɔ, ejaakɛ onaa mɔbɔnalɛ he tsui. 19Oooku sɛɛ omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo yɛ wɔhe. Okɛ onane aaashwishwia wɔnishaianii lɛ anɔ ni osherɛ oshwie ŋshɔ shishi bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli. 20Obaajie onɔkwayeli kɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ omaŋ lɛ, ni ji Abraham kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni owo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi blema bei lɛ amli beebe lɛ.

Title: NAHUM WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Nahum wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ eji lalawiemɔ ni kɔɔ Nineve maŋ lɛ shigbeemɔ he. Nineve ji Asiriabii ni ji Israelbii teteete ahenyɛlɔi lɛ amaŋtease. Nineve gbee shi kɛyaa afii 700 Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ naagbee mli. Anaa eshigbeemɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ maŋ ni yitsoŋ wa ni ewoɔ ehe nɔ hu.
Mlijaramɔi
Fɔ ni abu Nineve 1.1-15
Nineve shigbeemɔ 2.1—3.19

Title: NAHUM 1
Content:
1 Nineve shigbeemɔ he gbalɛ nɛɛ, ajie atsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Nahum, Elkoshnyo lɛ.
Yehowa mli efu Nineve
2 Yehowa lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ni,
ni asaŋ etɔɔ owele.
Oweletɔlɔ ji Yehowa,
ni emlifu naa wa.
Yehowa tɔɔ owele yɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tswaa anɔ,
ni ekɛ emlifu shakãa ehenyɛlɔi anɔ.
3 Yehowa mli fuuu mra,
ni ehewalɛ da kpele;
ehãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋɔ ehe aye.
Ahum kɛ lasuogbele teɔ shi
yɛ he ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ kɛho,
ni enaneshi mlu ji atatui.
4Eŋãa ŋshɔ yi, ni emiɔ;
ehãa fai fɛɛ miɔ.
Bashan kɛ Karmel gɔji lɛ anɔ ŋãlãa,
ni Lebanon ŋã floŋŋ lɛ hu ŋãlãa.
5 Gɔji hosoɔ yɛ ehiɛ,
gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ sereɔ:
Shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ ehiɛ,
ni je lɛ kɛ emli bii fɛɛ
hu ahiɛ kpãtãa.
6Namɔ aaanyɛ emlila naa adamɔ?
Namɔ aaanyɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa ekpee?
Emlifu tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ la,
ni efɛlɛɔ tɛsai amli.
7 Yehowa hi,
etsɔ̃ɔ teemɔhe yɛ amanehulu be mli,
ni ebaa mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ ayi.
8Shi ebaa tamɔ faa ni eje ŋã,
ni ebakpãtãa ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ;
etiuɔ ehenyɛlɔi kɛyashiɔ egbeɔ amɛ.
9Mɛɛ shi nyɛte nyɛwo Yehowa lɛ?
Ebaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ kwraa.
Etɔɔɔ owele shii enyɔ.
10Abaashã amɛ wɛɛ
tamɔ ŋmei ni eloloo,
loo gbetseli gbiŋ.
11Nineve, ani mɔ ko jɛɛɛ omli ni jwɛŋ Yehowa he efɔŋ, ni to ehe yiŋ fɔŋ? 12Israelbii, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Yɛ mli akɛ Asiriabii lɛ ayi fa po nɛ, shi amɛhiɛ baakpãtã; ni amɛsɛɛ baafo. Mipiŋ nyɛ kɛho; mipiŋŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ. 13Agbɛnɛ, apã lɛ ni Asiria kɛfɔ̃ nyɛkuɛ lɛ mibakumɔ mli; ni mibatserɛ kpãai ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli.”
14Kitã ni Yehowa ewo yɛ Asiria he ji enɛ, “Onaŋ shwiei ni baahã akai ogbɛi. Makumɔ sũ amãgãi kɛ dade amãgãi lɛ ni yɔɔ ojemawɔji lɛ awei lɛ amli lɛ. Masaa gbonyobu mato bo, Asiria ejaakɛ ohiii kwraa.”
15Naa, bɔfo ko miiba yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ sane kpakpa; eeba kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ sane. Yudabii, nyɛyea nyɛgbii juji lɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋnii ni nyɛwo he shi lɛ, nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ. Yitsoŋwalɔi lɛ baŋ abatuaŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ; akpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu.

Title: NAHUM 2
Content:
Nineve Hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ
1 Nineve, nifitelɔ lɛ eba ebaatua bo!
Mɔ ni baakpãtã ohiɛ lɛ eshɛ shi.
Abu maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ he!
Nyɛmiaa; buamɔ otabilɔi blublu anaa!
2(Yehowa miihã Israel hiɛ aba nyam ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ baye enɔ, ni amɛkpãtã eblema nyam lɛ hiɛ.)
3Henyɛlɔi tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ
hiɛ tsɛŋi tsuji,
ni amɛwowoo atadei tsuji.
Amɛmiisaa amɛhe kɛhã maŋ lɛ tuamɔ.
Kɛji amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ to kɛdamɔ shi lɛ,
amɛhe kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ la ni miitso;
amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ miitumɔtumɔɔ.
4Tayaa shwiilii lɛ gbaa shi
yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ;
amɛyaa amɛbaa kɛ foi
yɛ maŋ lɛ mli blohui lɛ amli.
Amɛhe kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ kɔtii,
ni amɛfoɔ hiŋmɛi naa tamɔ srawa.
5Atsɛɔ tabilɔi asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ;
shi amɛnaji tɛrɛɔ shi kɛyaa,
be mli ni henyɛlɔi lɛ
tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaninaa maŋ gbogbo lɛ;
ni amɛmamɔɔ nibii kɛtsĩɔ amɛhiɛ.
6Agbele faa lɛ naagbɛ agboi lɛ,
maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli yiɔ kɛ hejaramɔ.
7Aŋɔ maŋnyɛ lɛ nom kɛtee,
ni eweyei lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ;
amɛgbei etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpoi agbee;
amɛmiiyi amɛtsitsii anɔ mã.
8Ninevebii eke kɛ foi
tamɔ faa ni etue,
amɛke kɛ blɔmɔ akɛ,
“Nyɛdamɔa shi! Nyɛdamɔa shi!”
Shi mɔ ko mɔ ko ekuuu esɛɛ.
9Nyɛhaa jwiɛtɛi!
Nyɛhaa shika!
Jwinei srɔtoi ni abua naa ato
yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, jeee hiɛ nɛ.
10Akpãtã Nineve hiɛ,
afee lɛ butuu
etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃!
Gbeyei emɔmɔ tsuii,
nakutsei miikpokpo
hewalɛ etã yɛ mɛi amli,
ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ eshale.
11 Nɛgbɛ maŋ lɛ ni tsɔ̃
tamɔ jata oblahii ashihilɛhe lɛ yɔɔ,
he ni jata shãtã eniyenii kɛtee ebii aŋɔɔ yɛ,
ni mɔ ko gbaaa enaa lɛ?
12Jata nuu lɛ gbe loo
bɔ ni baashɛ jata yoo kɛ ebii anaa;
ewo etɛkplo lɛ mli obɔ̃,
kɛ ebui lɛ amli kɛ loo ni egbe.
13Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ nyɛ ena. Mibama nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ anaa la mashã. Nyɛtabilɔi ni tamɔ jata lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli. Mashɔ̃ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛshɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ yɛ mɛi adɛŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, asaŋ anuŋ ohewalɛ he yɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.

Title: NAHUM 3
Content:
1 Kpoo hã maŋ ni shwieɔ lá shi
ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ amale kɛ yiwalɛ
kɛ mɛi anii ni ayaha.
2Bo toi! Okpɔŋɔ gwaomɔ kpãa miigbɛɛ,
tayaa shwiilii anaji miigbɛɛ;
okpɔŋɔi esha foi,
ni tayaa shwiilii miihɛlɛ shi!
3Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi ewo foi kɛmiiba,
klante miikpɛlɛ nyramnyram,
ni akplɔ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ srawa!
Gbohii bua shi tsãa;
mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ lɛ, babaoo,
amɛyi fa fe nine,
mɛi miitɛrɛtrɛɛ amɛ!
4 Fɛɛ jɛ Nineve ajwamãŋbɔɔ.
Ehe yɛ fɛo bɔ ni ekɛ ehe fɛo
duɔ maji kɛ gbɔmɛi
ni ekɛyeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ.
5 Yehowa, Tatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji,
“Naa, Nineve, mi kɛ bo ena!
Mibawo ohiɛ mama nɔ,
ni mahã maji ana oyayaiaŋ;
amɛbaana ohiɛshishwiemɔ.
6Mibanyaŋe bo,
ni matsi muji mashwie onɔ,
ni mɛi aaakwɛ bo gãa.
7Mɛi fɛɛ ni baana bo
baasu amɛhe kɛya sɛɛ.
Amɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nineve etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃!
Namɔ yeɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ koo!
Nɛgbɛ mana mɛi aaajɛ abashɛje emii?’ ”
8 Nineve, ani ohi fe Tebes, Nilo Faa lɛ toi maŋ lɛ ni nu efo ehe sa kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni ŋshɔ ewaje lɛ kɛfo ehe, ni nu etsɔ̃ gbogbo ehã lɛ lɛ lo? 9Tebes na hewalɛ kɛjɛ Kush kɛ Ijipt fɛɛ dɛŋ, nakai ehewalɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ naa adamɔ. Putbii kɛ Libiabii fɛɛ ye bua lɛ. 10 Kɛ̃lɛ ana aŋɔ lɛ nom hu, ni akɛ emli bii abifabii tswiatswia shi, ni agbɛgbɛɛ amɛ ashwãshwãa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoii fɛɛ. Emli hiɛnaanɔmɛi lɛ, amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki kɛja amɛ hã amɛhe, ni awo amɛ gboklɛ, ni akpala amɛ kɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli.
11 Nineve, nakai bo hu obaatɔ dãa, ni ohiɛ baaha; ni obaatao abobaahe kɛjo ohenyɛlɔ lɛ naa foi. 12Omɔji lɛ, naa, amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ agbãmitsei ni amɛklɛŋklɛŋ yibii etsu yɛ amɛnɔ. Hosomɔ nɛkɛ ni aaahoso tsei lɛ, yibii lɛ baakpala ashwie yelɔ lɛ daaŋ. 13Naa, otabilɔi lɛ yei sɔŋŋ ji amɛ. Oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ anaa agboi lɛ anaa kãmɔ hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ. La baashã ogboi nɛɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. 14Nyɛyɛa numɔ nu nyɛtoa be ni abaasa nyɛmaŋ lɛ yi lɛ; nyɛwajeɔ nyɛmɔji lɛ; nyɛnaa su ni akɛfoɔ brikisi lɛ, ni asaa brikisifoo adeka lɛ ato. 15Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ, kɛjeee yɛ la mli lɛ no lɛ yɛ ta mli. Abaaplene nyɛ tamɔ baalabii kpãtãa ŋmɔshinii ahiɛ.
Nyɛhãa nyɛyi afaa tamɔ baalabii, nyɛyi afaa tamɔ otukpɛi. 16Nyɛhã nyɛteiaŋ jarayelɔi ayi efa fe ŋwɛi ŋulamii tete! Shi bɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ amɛnɔ egbɔ tamɔ baalabii ni bayeɔ nii ni amɛflikiɔ kɛyaa lɛ? 17Nyɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ agãi, ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ baalabii ni basɔ̃mɔɔ afabaŋi ahe gbi nɔ ni fɛi miiye. Kɛji hulu lɛ te shi pɛ amɛfliki kɛtee, ni aleee he ni amɛyaa.
18Ao! Asiria Maŋtsɛ, omraloi lɛ egboi; ni wɔ enyɔ ohiɛnaanɔbii lɛ anɔ. Agbɛ owebii lɛ ashwã gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni buaa amɛnaa. 19Pilamɔ ni opila lɛ bɛ tsabaa; ni ofaji lɛ ehiŋ tsamɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he lɛ tswaa amɛdɛ̃ amɛshwieɔ onɔ kɛ nyamɔ; ejaakɛ namɔ po ni yɔɔ ni oyeko lɛ sane fɔŋ dã?

Title: HABAKUK WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbalɔ Habakuk gba egbalɛ lɛ aaafee afii 700 Dani Afɔ Kristo. Nakai be mli lɛ Babilonbii ahewalɛ ma shi. Bɔ ni Babilonbii lɛ ayitsoŋ wa yɛ mɛi anɔ lɛ hã Habakuk he jra lɛ waa, bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ebi Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ mɛɛba ni ofee dioo be mli ni efɔŋfeelɔi kpãtãa mɛi ni hi fe amɛ hiɛ?” (1.13) Hetoo ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ hã lɛ ji akɛ kɛji be ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eto lɛ shɛ lɛ, ebaatsu sane lɛ he nii; shi kɛyaashi nakai be lɛ, “Mɛi ni feɔ nii ni ja yi aaana wala, ejaakɛ amɛye Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa” (2.4)
Wolo lɛ mli sane ni eshwɛ lɛ kɔɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ gbalɛ ni kɔɔ mɛi ni efeee jalɛnii ahe. Amu wolo lɛ naa kɛ lala ni akɛmiikafo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ agbojee, asaŋ ni akɛmiiye hemɔkɛyeli kpeteŋkple ni lalawiemɔŋmalɔ lɛ yɔɔ hu he odase.
Mlijaramɔi
Habakuk ŋkɔmɔi lɛ kɛ hetoo ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã 1.1—2.4
Mɛi ni efeee jalɛ nii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ 2.5-20
Habakuk sɔlemɔ 3.1-19

Title: HABAKUK 1
Content:
1Ninaa ni Yehowa jie etsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Habakuk lɛ nɛ.
Habakuk wie eshi toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli
2“Ao, Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mabɔlɔ kɛyashi dani ooobo mi toi? Mɛɛ beyinɔ matsɛ bo kɛyashi dani ooobahere wɔ kɛje yiwalɛ mli? 3Mɛɛba ohãa minaa nifɔɔjianii nɛɛ, ni bo hu okwɛɔ haomɔi nɛɛ lɛ? Nifitemɔ kɛ henitswiamɔ sɔŋŋ ebɔle mihe kɛkpe, ni nɔmɔ kɛ bei ete shi yɛ he fɛɛ he. 4Ejaakɛ mla lɛ hewalɛ egbo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ayeee jalɛ sane. Mɛi fɔ̃ji ebɔle jalɔ lɛ kɛkpe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ abu shi.”
Hetoo ni Yehowa hã
5 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ emɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛhe baajɔ̃ nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ yɛ nii ni nyɛbaana lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ miitsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ amɛteŋ yɛ nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ, ni kɛji agba nyɛ lɛ nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ! 6 Naa, mitee Babilonbii lɛ ni yi wa, asaŋ ni amɛhe ejɔɔɔ lɛ ashi. Amɛfãa kɛkpaa je lɛ mli shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kɛyaŋɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ. 7Amɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ gbeyei mɔmɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛ amɛsumɔɔ lɛ, no amɛfeɔ, ni no ji nɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mla.
8 “Amɛkpɔŋɔi ahe yɛ oya fe mlaŋtswi, ni amɛhiɛ yɛ kramakrama fe klãji ni je ena amɛ kɛ hɔmɔ. Amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ jɛɔ shɔŋŋ amɛbaa; amɛshaneɔ shi kɛ foi tamɔ okropɔŋ shaneɔ shi eshaa eniyenii.
9“Amɛtai lɛ fãa kɛbaa kɛ yiwalɛ kɛbayeɔ shikpɔji anɔ; ni amɛhe ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ mɛi kɛji amɛmiiba. Amɛnomii ni amɛbuaa naa lɛ ayifalɛ tamɔ shia. 10Amɛyeɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ahe fɛo; ni lumɛi ahe feɔ amɛŋmɔlɔ. Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko shɔ̃mɔ waaa hãaa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtereɔ sũ amɛkɛbaa mɔɔ lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ amɛshɔ̃. 11Ni amɛfoɔ mli kɛhoɔ shwiaa kɛyaa tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, amɛ ji amɛhe efɔŋfeelɔi, ni hewalɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ no ji nɔ ni amɛjaa.”
Habakuk gbigbli emli etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa ekoŋŋ
12 “Yehowa, kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome! Ohaŋ wɔgboi! Ao, Yehowa, okɔ Babilonbii lɛ, ni bo ohã amɛma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã wɔtoigbalamɔ. 13Shi te aaafe tɛŋŋ ni okwɛ ni efɔŋ aya nɔ hu? Ohiŋmɛi yɛ krɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni okɛaakwɛ koni nifɔɔjianii aya nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛba ni ofee dioo be mli ni efɔŋfeelɔi kpãtãa mɛi ni hi fe amɛ hiɛ?
14“Ejaakɛ ohã gbɔmɛi etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋshɔŋloo loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waamɔnii ni bɛ nɔyelɔ. 15Babilonbii lɛ kɛ kpoŋ shaa gbɔmɛi oookɛɛ loi ji amɛ; amɛfɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi anɔ yaa, ni amɛgbalaa amɛ tamɔ adrã; ni amɛnyaa ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ. 16No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshãa afɔle amɛkɛjaa amɛyaa lɛ, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛkɛhãa amɛtsãani lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi hãa amɛnaa nii kpɔtɔɔ amɛyeɔ.
17“Aso Babilonbii nɛɛ baakã he aye amɛhewalɛ nɛɛ mli nii daa, koni amɛya nɔ nɛkɛ sɔŋŋ kɛplenee majimaji lɛ amli bii ni mɔbɔnalɛ ko kwraa bɛ mli lo?”

Title: HABAKUK 2
Content:
Hetoo ni Yehowa hã Habakuk
1 Mibakwɔ mayadamɔ shi kɛbu yɛ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ koni makwɛ nɔ ni Yehowa baakɛɛ mi, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni ebaahã mi yɛ mikɔmɔyeli lɛ hewɔ.
2Yehowa hã mi hetoo nɛɛ, “Kpɛ ninaa nɛɛ faŋŋ yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii anɔ koni anyɛ akane oya. 3 Ninaa nɛɛ be lɛ shɛko moŋ, shi eeye ehe oyai kɛba. Kɛji eshashao shi tete po jiŋŋ, bo lɛ mɛɛ, ejaakɛ ebaaba kɛ̃ ni etsɛŋ. 4 Ni shɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɛ: ‘Naa, mɔ ni efeee jalɛnii lɛ, eyi naŋ wala; shi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ ehemɔkɛyeli nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ ni eyi ana wala.’ ”
Mɛi ni efeee jalɛnii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ
5Naa, wain lakaa mɔ. Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ ehe lɛ, enyɛɛɛ shi ehi. Efeɔ fuu tamɔ gbohiiaje; ni etamɔ gbele, etɔko dã. Ebuaa majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii anaa kɛbaa, ni etiãa amɛ ehãa ehe.
6Aso majimaji nɛɛ fɛɛ yeŋ lɛ yɔɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã mɔ ni haa nii ni ele faŋŋ akɛ jeee enɔ ni, kɛ mɔ ni loɔ awabatoonii eshwieɔ enɔ lɛ. Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni?”
7Naa, trukaa ni onyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaate shi awo bo. Mɛi ni hiɛ etsɛ̃ lɛ aaaha onii. 8Akɛ ni oha majimaji babaoo anii hewɔ lɛ, bo hu majimaji lɛ amli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaha onii yɛ gbɔmɛi ala shi ni oshwie, kɛ yi ni owa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
9Kpoo hã mɔ ni etsɔ̃ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ ena nii ehã ewe, ni ebɔ mɔdɛŋ eyama etsu yɛ he ko grɔŋŋ bɔ ni afee ni efee shweshweeshwe koni efɔŋ ko akasa ehe lɛ. 10Ogbɛjianɔtoo lɛ eyagbala hiɛgbele ebashwie owe lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ ni oplenee lɛ ehã bo diɛŋtsɛ owala hiɛ ekpãtã moŋ. 11Gbogbo mli tɛ tete miibolɔ kɛmiishi nyɛ, ni tsu yiteŋ mplaŋ lɛ hu miihere tɛ lɛ blɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.
12 Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛ lashishwiemɔ toɔ maŋ, ni ekɛ efɔŋfeemɔ tswaa maŋ lɛ. 13Naa, aso jeee Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ sane nɛ, akɛ gbɔmɔ atsu nii, ni là abakpãtã hiɛ lo, ni majimaji lɛ agbo deŋme yaka lo? 14 Moŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baayi tɔ kɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ he nilee, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi tɔ kɛ nu lɛ.
15Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni ojɛɔ mlifu mli ohãa onaanyo dãa enuɔ, ni etɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni okwɛ eyayaiaŋ. 16Nakai nɔŋŋ bo hu, yɛ hiɛnyam najiaŋ lɛ, hiɛgbele baamɔ bo. Bo hu obaanu eko koni odidãã. Kpulu ni yɔɔ Yehowa ninejurɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kɛbashɛ onɔ, ni ohiɛnyam lɛ baatsɔ̃ hiɛgbele ni naa wa. 17Awui ni nyɛye Lebanon lɛ baasu nyɛtsui fe nine; emli kooloi lɛ hiɛ ni nyɛkpãtã lɛ baahã nyɛshe gbeyei, ejaakɛ nyɛshwie gbɔmɛi alá shi, ni nyɛwa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ayi.
18 Mɛni ji amãgã he sɛɛnamɔ? Ŋaalɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ kɛkɛ ni; ni egbaaa mɔ ko nɔ ko fe amale. Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mɔ ni fee amãgã lɛ kɛ ehiɛ afɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eninenaa nitsumɔnii, ni ji amãgã mumui nɔ? 19Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni okɛɔ tso akɛ, “Ohiɛ atsɛ̃!” Ni okɛɔ tɛ mumui hu akɛ, “Tee shi!” Ani amãgã baanyɛ ejie ninaa atsɔ̃ɔ bo? Naa, akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi baaha ehe nɛ, shi moŋ wala kome nɛkɛ bɛ emli.
20 Naa, Yehowa yɛ eSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ.

Title: HABAKUK 3
Content:
Sɔlemɔ ni Habakuk sɔle
1Sɔlemɔ ni Gbalɔ Habakuk sɔle nɛ,
2“Ao Yehowa, minu nii ni otsu lɛ he,
ni miishe gbeyei.
Yehowa, tsu onitsumɔi wuji lɛ ekoŋŋ
yɛ wɔyinɔ nɛɛ hu nɔ.
Hã ale yɛ afii nɛɛ amli nɔŋŋ.
Omlifu mli tete lɛ, hã omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo!
3 Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jɛ Edom kɛmiiba;
Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ miiba kɛjɛ
Paran Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Enunyam lɛ ha ŋwɛi,
ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ
kɛ eyijiemɔ.
4Ekpɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la;
la kpɛlɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edɛŋ
he ni ji ehewalɛ teemɔhe lɛ.
5Tsɛŋemɔ hela nyiɛɔ ehiɛ,
ni gbele hela nyiɛ esɛɛ tuuŋtu.
6 Ewa edamɔ shi, ni shikpɔŋ hoso,
Ekwɛ, ni maji lɛ ahe kpokpo.
Naanɔ gɔji lɛ gbɛ shwã
ni naanɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ ba shi,
yɛ hei ni enyiɛ blema ko lɛ.
7Mina, Kushanbii miishe gbeyei,
ni Midianbii ahe miikpokpo.
8Yehowa, ani fai omli wo la wo?
Fai ni omli fu,
loo ŋshɔ ni ogri owo?
No hewɔ ota kunimyeli okpɔŋɔ
kɛ tayaa shwiili mli kɛbaa nɛɛ?
9Ojie ogãi lɛ hebo lɛ,
ni ofee kralo kɛbaatsɛ̃.
Okɛ fai egbala shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
10Gɔji lɛ na bo, ni amɛhosohosoo;
nu tue kɛbaho yoo.
Bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ wo egbee;
ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi.
11 La ni ogãimlibii lɛ kpɛlɛ
kɛ okpɔlɔi lɛ hu akpɛlɛmɔ
hã hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere wa damɔ shi.
12Okɛ mlila shi shi kɛtsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni onaanaa majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛho
yɛ mlifu naa.
13 Otee oyahere omɛi lɛ ayiwala,
koni oyahere mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ yiwala.
Ojwara mɔ fɔŋ lɛ weku lɛ yitso,
ni oŋmɛ lɛ yayai kɛjɛ eshuɔ kɛyata ekuɛ.
14Okɛ okpɔlɔ lɛ gbulɔ etabilɔi
ni ba tamɔ lasuogbele
koni amɛbagbɛ mi amɛshwã
kɛ mliflimɔ,
tamɔ nɔ ni amɛba ohiafo piŋmɔ
yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ.
15Okɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ naanaa ŋshɔ
ni ji nu kpeteŋkple ni
kumɔɔ lɛ nɔ.
16Minu enɛɛmɛi, ni mihe kpokpo;
gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hã minaabu jo bliblibli.
Mikpɔiaŋ fee gbedee,
ni minaji tɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Mibata shi kpoo mamɛ gbi
ni abaahao mɛi ni baa
koni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ abawu lɛ.
17Eyɛ mli akɛ agbãmi tso gbaŋ afofro,
ni yibii ehiŋ wain tsei anɔ;
eyɛ mli akɛ mu tsei ayibii baafee yaka,
ni anaŋ ŋmɔshi niyenii;
eyɛ mli akɛ toi fɛɛ aaagboi,
ni tsinai aaatã yɛ tsina tsui amli nɛ.
18 Kɛ̃lɛ mi lɛ mibanya,
ni mimli aaafli mi yɛ Yehowa
miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli.
19 Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ woɔ mi hewalɛ;
ehãa minaji feɔ tamɔ ofrote naji
kɛnyiɛɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
(Akɛhã Lalatsɛnukpa lɛ koni akɛ kpãa saŋku atswa.)

Title: ZEFANIA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbalɔ Zefania gba yɛ afii 700 Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ naagbee be lɛ mli. Eeefee akɛ egba egbalɛ nɛɛ afii nyɔŋma dani Maŋtsɛ Yosia tsake emaŋbii ajamɔ mli gbɛjianɔtoi ahiɛ yɛ afi 621 Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli lɛ. Ewolo lɛ wieɔ nibii ni gbalɔi lɛ fɔɔ amɛhe wiemɔ lɛ ekomɛi ahe. Nibii nɛɛ ekomɛi nɛ: Akɛ Hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ nɔnaa be miiba; akɛ abaagbla Yudabii atoi yɛ jemawɔji ni amɛjaa hewɔ; akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baagbla maji krokomɛi hu atoi; akɛ eyɛ mli akɛ abaakpãtã Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hiɛ moŋ, shi be baashɛ kɛ̃ ni abaasaa maŋ lɛ atswa ekoŋŋ ahã gbɔmɛi humii kɛ jalɛ saneyelɔi koni amɛhi mli.
Mlijaramɔi
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Kojomɔ Gbi lɛ 1.1—2.3
Israel hewɔ maji ahiɛkpãtãmɔ 2.4-15
Yerusalɛm hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ ekpɔ̃mɔ 3.1-20

Title: ZEFANIA 1
Content:
1 Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Zefania wie be mli ni Amon bi Yosia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ. Zefania Kush bi lɛ, enii ji Gedalia, Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi Amaria bi lɛ.
Yehowa Kojomɔ gbi lɛ
2Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, Mibakpãtã nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 3“Mibakpãtã gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo hiɛ; mibakpãtã loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ ahiɛ, mibakpãtã yiwalɔi ahiɛ; mibaplene gbɔmɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
4“Mibagbala gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ atoi. Mibafã Baal jamɔ shishi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni akaiŋ wulɔmɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jemawɔji lɛ dɔŋŋ. 5Mibakpãtã mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɔɔ kɛyaa tsui ayiteiaŋ amɛyajaa hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii yɛ jɛi lɛ ahiɛ. Mibakpãtã mɛi hu ni kotoɔ Yehowa lɛ, ni amɛkãa lɛ kitã akɛ amɛbaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi amɛkɛ jemawɔŋ Molek gbɛi lɛ kãa kitã ahiɛ. 6Mibakpãtã mɛi fɛɛ ni ekpale, ni amɛjaaa Yehowa lɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ ahiɛ, ni ji mɛi ni taooo mi, Yehowa lɛ, misɛɛgbɛ aloo amɛbiii mi nii dɔŋŋ lɛ.”
7Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ etã, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ. Yehowa esaa afɔle lɛ eto, ni etsuu emɛi ni ekpee lɛ ahe. 8Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbi ni mibaplene mɛi lɛ, mibagbala maŋ lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ maŋsɛɛbii akusum lɛ atoi. 9Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibagbala mɛi fɛɛ ni jaa tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi jaa lɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni tsɔ̃ɔ yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔ nɔ amɛkɛnaa nii amɛwoɔ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi awei amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ atoi.”
10Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, abaanu yaafo he kɛbaajɛ Loo Agbo lɛ naa yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni abaawo lele yɛ maŋ lɛ akutso hee lɛ mli, ni gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ ayiteiaŋ baashimɔ. 11Nyɛ, maŋ lɛ Jɔɔnaabii, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa kɛji nyɛnu gbɛɛmɔi nɛɛ; ejaakɛ akpãtã jarayelɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni aplene mɛi ni yeɔ jwiɛtɛi jara lɛ.
12“Nakai be lɛ mikɛ kane baakpa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni mibagbala emli mɛi ni amɛtsui enyɔ amɛmli, ni amɛheɔ amɛhe amɛyeɔ lɛ atoi. No ji mɛi ni kɛɔ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Yehowa efeŋ ekpakpa, ni esaa efeŋ efɔŋ hu lɛ’. 13Abaaha amɛjarayeli nibii, ni amɛshĩai hu baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃. Amɛaamamɔ tsui nɛ, shi amɛwɔŋ mli, ni amɛaafee waintromi, shi amɛnuŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko.”
14Yehowa gbi wulu lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etã, eeba nɔŋŋ. Gbi lɛ baajoo naakpa, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ, kãkãlɔi tete baafo waa. 15Nakai gbi lɛ, mlifu kɛ amanehulu gbi ni, nifitemɔ kɛ nihiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi ni; duŋ baawo, ni jeŋ baafee kpii; atatu kɛ oblɔtu kabitii hu gbi ni. 16Gbi lɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ baagbɛɛ, ni abaabɔ oshe kɛtua maji ni atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ hu.
17Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibahao gbɔmɛi, ni amɛbaanyiɛ tamɔ shwilafoi. Akɛni amɛgbo Yehowa nɔ toi lɛ, aaashwie amɛlá shi tamɔ nu, ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ wamɔ.”
18Nakai Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ajwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere. Emlifu ni jɛ awuŋayeli mli lɛ naa la lɛ naawalɛ baakpãtã je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ejaakɛ trukaa ni eeeplene shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.

Title: ZEFANIA 2
Content:
Hesɛɛjee he ehia
1Ao, maŋ ni hiɛgbele tɔ ejwa, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛsusua nyɛhe, 2dani aba mli akɛ aaakpala nyɛ kɛya tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa tutuu, dani Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ aba nyɛnɔ, dani ashɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ! 3Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ heshibalɔi fɛɛ ni feɔ Yehowa suɔmɔnaa nii, nyɛtaoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛtaoa jalɛ sɛɛgbɛ; ni nyɛtaoa heshibaa sɛɛgbɛ, ni eko lɛ aaaŋɔ nyɛ atee yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Israel hewɔ maji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ
4Abaashi Gaza maŋ lɛ afɔ̃ shi, ni Ashkelon baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. Abaashwie Ashdod maŋbii lɛ shwane fintiŋŋ, ni abaafã Ekronbii lɛ hu kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ. 5Kpoo ha nyɛ, nyɛŋshɔnaabii, bo Keretibii amaŋ. Kanaan, Filistibii ashikpɔŋ, Yehowa ebu bo fɔ; ni mibakpãtã ohiɛ, bɔ ni eshwɛŋ omɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ. 6Ni bo, ŋshɔnaa niiaŋ, obaatsɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ kooloi alɛɛhei kɛ tookwɛlɔi asesei kɛ toi atsui kɛkɛ. 7 Ŋshɔnaa shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ Yudabii ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ. Jɛi amɛbaalɛ amɛkooloi yɛ, ni Ashkelon maŋ lɛ shĩai lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ kooloi lɛ awɔɔhei; ejaakɛ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, musuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni ebaahã amɛshwere ekoŋŋ.
8 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Minu jɛmɔi ni Moabbii jɛɔ mimaŋbii lɛ, kɛ ahora ni Amonbii hu bɔɔ miwebii lɛ, kɛ shwãa ni amɛshwãa akɛ amɛbaashɔ̃ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ. 9 Beiaŋ ni mi tuuŋtu ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ ja Moab tsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom, ni Amonbii lɛ hu tsɔ̃ tamɔ Gomora. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ ŋoo bui ashikpɔŋ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ; ni sansrɔ baatsa yɛ enɔ. Mimaŋbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaaha Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ hu anii, ni amɛaaŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ.”
10Enɛ akɛaagbala Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ atoi yɛ amɛhenɔ ni amɛwo lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛbɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, webii lɛ ahora. 11Amɛbaashe Yehowa gbeyei naakpa. Yehowa baashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jemawɔji fɛɛ ahiɛ shi; ni kɛkɛ lɛ maji fɛɛ baaja Yehowa yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ diɛŋtsɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.
12 Ni nyɛ, Etiopiabii, Yehowa baaplene nyɛ hu.
13 Yehowa baakpã enine mli kɛshɛ kooyigbɛ kɛkpãtã Asiria hiɛ; ni ebaahã Nineve maŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni enɔ baagbi wesewese tamɔ shiaŋa nɔ. 14Jɛi baatsɔ̃ kooloi kui kɛ kooloi srɔtoi fɛɛ ashibuumɔhe. Akpaŋai kɛ shadeboai kɛ tsui koi lɛ amli baafee amɛshihilɛhei. Patui baabolɔ yɛ samfɛji lɛ anaa, ni kwãakwãalabitei baabolɔ yɛ shinaa kpokui lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ shĩai lɛ fɛɛ ewulewulee ewowoo mli. 15Naa, maŋ lɛ ni emli fili lɛ, ni esusu akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Mi ji mi, ni mi misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ lɛ, te tɛŋŋ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ kooloi kakawuai ashihilɛhe nɛɛ? Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ ehe kɛho lɛ aaahoso eyitso, ni ehe aaajɔ̃ ehe.”

Title: ZEFANIA 3
Content:
Yerusalɛm he esha kɛ eheremɔ
1Kpoo ha Yerusalɛm, maŋ ni yi wa, maŋ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebule ehe! 2Ebooo mɔ ko mɔ ko wiemɔ toi lɛ, ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ hu; ekɛ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, etsiii ebɛŋkɛɛɛ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 3Emli lumɛi lɛ jatai ni huuɔ ni, emli kojolɔi lɛ hu klãji hɔmɔwɔlɔi ni shiii niyenii ko niyenii ko ni je atsɛre nɔ. 4Emli gbalɔi lɛ yiŋflɛflɛtsɛmɛi kɛ kutumpɔfoi sɔŋŋ ni; ni emli osɔfoi lɛ ebule nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni amɛtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi. 5Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni ja pɛ efeɔ; efeee nɔ ko ni ejaaa. Daa leebi lɛ efeɔ nɔ ni ja yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ, leebi ko kwraa bɛ ni efɔ̃ɔ jalɛ nii feemɔ. Shi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble tɔ ejwa.
6Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtã maji ahiɛ dã. Mikumɔ amɛtabilɔi atasui lɛ mishwie shi; ni amɛblohui amli kamɔ shi efoji, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hooo yɛ mli; afite amɛmaji lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ mli, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ amɛmli dɔŋŋ. 7Mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwa, eeeshe mi gbeyei, ni eeekpɛlɛ̃ mitsɔsemɔ lɛ, ni ekuŋ ehiɛ efɔŋ mimlai ni miwo lɛ lɛ eko eko nɔ.’ Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ babaoo moŋ ni amɛfee nibii gbohiigbohii ji no.”
8Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa mi gbɛ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mate shi maye odase mashi jeŋ maji lɛ; ejaakɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mabua majimaji lɛ anaa, ni mabua maŋtsɛmɛi hu anaa kɛkpe, koni amɛsa mimlifu kɛ mimlila ni naa wa lɛ naa amɛkwɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ miwuŋayeli lɛ mli mlifu la lɛ baakpãtã jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
9“Nakai be lɛ mibatsake majimaji lɛ adaaŋ wiemɔ koni amɛwiemɔ he atse; ni amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛbaaja mi, Yehowa, kɛ wiemɔ ni he tse. 10Mijalɔi ni ji mimɛi ni agbɛ ashwã lɛ ashwiei baajɛ Kush fai lɛ asɛɛ niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ amɛkɛ afɔlei abahã mi. 11Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ nibii ni nyɛfeefee nyɛkɛtse mihiɛ atua lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ majie ntɛŋfeelɔi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛwoŋ nyɛhe nɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, 12ejaakɛ mibashi gbɔmɛi omlɛfoi kɛ humii pɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Amɛbaatao abobaahe yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli, 13 amɛ mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ Israel lɛ. Amɛfeŋ nɔfɔŋ lɛ, amɛmaleŋ lɛ, mɔshishiumɔ wiemɔ ko ejeŋ amɛnaa. Amɛbaahi shi, ni amɛbaashwere, ni mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei.”
Nyamɔ lala
14Zion biyoo, la nyamɔ lala waa!
Israel, bɔɔ oshe!
Yerusalɛm biyoo, nya; omli afili bo
kɛ otsui fɛɛ!
15Yehowa efo otoigbalamɔ lɛ sɛɛ;
eshwie ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee.
Yehowa, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yɛ nyɛteŋ;
nyɛsheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei dɔŋŋ!
16Be miiba, be ni abaakɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ,
“Kwɛ, Zion, kaashe gbeyei!
Kaahã onijiaŋ miije wui!
17Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ bo yɛ,
Taiatsɛ ni hãa ayeɔ kunim lɛ.
Eeenya ohe kɛ miishɛɛ,
eeeku sɛɛ esumɔ bo ekoŋŋ.
Ebaala kɛ mliflimɔ yɛ ohewɔ,
18tamɔ alaa yɛ gbijurɔ nɔ lɛ.”
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ,
“Mibawo amanehulu kɛje onɔ
koni ohiɛ akashwie shi yɛ no hewɔ!
19Be lɛ miiba!
Mikɛ mɛi ni haoɔ bo lɛ fɛɛ aaaye;
Mahere mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔɔ oshii ayiwala,
ni makpala mɛi ni ashwie lɛ
kɛba shĩa ekoŋŋ.
Mahã amɛhiɛgbele lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛsɔlɛ,
ni amɛaana gbɛi yɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ.
20Nakai be lɛ
mikɛ nyɛ baaba shĩa,
be mli ni mibabua nyɛnaa lɛ.
Mahã nyɛgbɛi ahehe, ni abaakafo nyɛ
yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ,
ni mahã nyɛshwere ekoŋŋ
yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛiŋ.”
Yehowa wiemɔ nɛ.

Title: HAGAI WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbalɛ wiemɔi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Hagai nɔ, yɛ afi 520 Dani Afɔ Kristo mli lɛ naa abua yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ. Maŋbii lɛ ejɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba amɛbahi shi yɛ Yerusalɛm afii saŋŋ, shi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kã shi koikoi lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ. Wiemɔi nɛɛ kanya maŋbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ koni amɛsaa amɛtswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo shi akɛ akɛni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ gbɔmɛi hei ni atsuu amɛhe lɛ, amɛbaashwere ni amɛbaana toiŋjɔlɛ hu.
Mlijaramɔi
Afã akɛ asaa atswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ 1.1-15
Miishɛjemɔ kɛ Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he Shɛi 2.1-23

Title: HAGAI 1
Content:
Yehowa fã akɛ atswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ
1 Maŋtsɛ Dario, Persia nɔyelɔ lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ hã Gbalɔ Hagai ekɛbahã Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ.
2Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hagai akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛɔ akɛ be ni sa akɛ asaa atswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shɛko.” 3No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ tsu Hagai kɛyahã maŋbii lɛ akɛ, 4“Miwebii, aso esa nyɛhiɛ akɛ nyɛhi nyɛtsui ni asɛŋ nɔ amli, be mli ni miwe nɛɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ lo? 5No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛjwɛŋa nyɛjeŋba he jogbaŋŋ. 6 Nyɛduɔ nii babaoo, shi fioo pɛ nyɛnaa nyɛkpaa. Nyɛyeɔ nii, shi nyɛtɔrɔɔɔ; ni nyɛnuɔ dãa shi nyɛtɔrɔɔɔ dãa. Nyɛbuɔ mama, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko he efeee kulɔɔ. Ni mɔ ni yeɔ apaa ni awoɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ hu lɛ, ekɛwoɔ kotoku ni shishi egbulɔ mli.” 7Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛjwɛŋa, nyɛjeŋba he jogbaŋŋ. 8Nyɛyaa gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛyafolɔa tsei kɛbaa nyɛkɛbamaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni mimii baashɛ mihe, ni mapue yɛ minunyam mli.
9“Nyɛkwɛɔ ŋmɔshi nii babaoo gbɛ, shi ebafeɔ fioo kɛkɛ. Ni kɛji nyɛkɛ nikpamɔnii lɛ ba shĩa hu lɛ, mifiliɔ nii lɛ mishwãa. Mɛni hewɔ mifeɔ nakai lɛ? Ejaakɛ miSɔlemɔ we lɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ edɔ kɛmiitsu ewe he nii. 10 No hewɔ ni ŋwɛi etsi nu naa ni enɛɛɛ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu baaa niyenii lɛ. 11 No hewɔ mihã nuhɔmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni esa abele kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ nibaanii fɛɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi kɛ ninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ ahe nɛɛ.”
Maŋbii lɛ ye Yehowa fãmɔ lɛ nɔ
12Kɛkɛ ni Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni shwɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ fɛɛ, bo Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wiemɔi lɛ atoi. Amɛshe gbeyei yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. 13Kɛkɛ ni Hagai, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ, kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa tsumɔ lɛ naa akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ!” 14Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tee Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli bii ni shwɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba lɛ hu fɛɛ amumɔ shi, ni amɛtee amɛyatsu Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he nii. 15Amɛtsu nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.

Title: HAGAI 2
Content:
Sɔlemɔ we hee lɛ fɛo
1Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 2“Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, 3‘Namɔ eshwɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni na bɔ ni nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ tsutsu anunyam lɛ yɔɔ hãa.’ Te nyɛnaa lɛ tɛŋŋ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ? Bɛ ejeee fɛifɛi yɛ nyɛhiɛ? 4Shi agbɛnɛ Zerubabel, wajemɔ ohe! Bo Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi, bo hu wajemɔ ohe! Nyɛ, maŋbii fɛɛ, nyɛwajea nyɛhe. Nyɛtea shi, nyɛtsua nii, ejaakɛ mi kɛ nyɛ yɛ, 5 tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛ shi be ni nyɛshi Ijipt lɛ. Mimumɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
6Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Eshwɛ be, be kukuoo ko kɛkɛ ni mibahoso ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 7Mibahoso je lɛ mli majimaji lɛ, ni abaaloo amɛmli jwetrii lɛ kɛaaba biɛ mikɛbawo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli, ni eeeyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ anunyam sɔŋŋ. 8Je lɛ mli jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ kɛ shika fɛɛ lɛ mi, minɔ ni. Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ. 9Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ sɛɛkpee anunyam lɛ baafe etsutsu anunyam lɛ, ni biɛ majɛ mahã miwebii lɛ ashwere, Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.”
Gbalɔ lɛ kɛ Osɔfoi lɛ yasusu saji ahe
10Nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wie. 11Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ Hagai akɛ, “Bi osɔfoi lɛ koni amɛhã bo sane nɛɛ hetoo: 12‘Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ loo ni ekɛmiishã afɔle mli eko ehɔ etade naamuu mli, ni atade lɛ naamuu lɛ yasa aboloo loo niyenii ni ahoo loo wain loo mu loo niyenii fɛɛ niyenii ko he lɛ, ani no feɔ nii lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lo?’ ”
Sane nɛɛ hetoo ni osɔfoi lɛ hã ji akɛ, “Dabida”.
13 Kɛkɛ ni Hagai bi osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Shi kɛji mɔ ni eyata gbonyo he ni ekɛbule ehe ta nibii nɛɛ eko he hu lɛ, ani ebule nii lɛ lo?”
Osɔfoi lɛ to he akɛ, “Hɛɛ”.
14Kɛkɛ ni Hagai kɛɛ, “Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ji bɔ ni maŋ nɛɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli bii lɛ ebule amɛhe yɛ mihiɛ ni nakai pɛ hu ji bɔ ni abule amɛninenaa nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛbashãa afɔle amɛkɛhãa mi lɛ.”
Yehowa baajɔɔ ewebii lɛ
15Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ nyɛsusua nɔ ni eba nyɛnɔ kɛho lɛ he. Dani nyɛbɔ̃i Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tswaa lɛ, 16te nyɛyaa ŋmãakuu, ni be mli ni nyɛmiikwɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛbaana ŋmãa kei ohai enyɔ lɛ, nyɛyaninaa kei oha pɛ? Mɔ ni baa wain bu naa akɛ eeba ebayɛ wain gbɛi oha lɛ, ebaninaa wain gbɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ pɛ? 17Mihã hela kɛ lamɔ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi fite nyɛninenaa nitsumɔnii fɛɛ, shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleee kɛbaaa miŋɔɔ. 18Nyɛkadia kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nɔ ni baaba, ŋmɛnɛ ji nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ, ni ji gbi ni nyɛto Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shishi lɛ. 19Bɛ dumɔ wu ko bɛ aboŋo mli, ni wain tso kɛ agbãmi tso kɛ akutu tso kɛ mu tso woko? Shi naa, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ mibajɔɔ nyɛ.”
Yehowa wo Zerubabel shi
20Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ ni ji enyɔ tsu Gbalɔ Hagai, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 21“Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni mibahoso ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu, 22ni mibakpa maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni mibafo amɛlumɔyeli sɛɛ. Mibakpãtã tayaa shwiilii kɛ shwiilii lɛ amlitaralɔi fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ adɔ amɛhe amɛgbegbee amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛhe. 23 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi, mitsulɔ, mibaŋɔ bo koni oye maŋbii lɛ alumɔ yɛ mi migbɛi mli, ejaakɛ bo ji mɔ ni mihala.” Mi, Taiatsɛ, mi mikɛɛ.

Title: ZAKARIA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Zakaria wolo lɛ hiɛ mlijai srɔtoi krɛdɛɛi enyɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ ji, kɛjɛ Yitso 1-8. No kɔɔ gbalɛi ni gbalɔ Zakaria gba eto yɛ bei srɔtoi, kɛjɛ afi 520 Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ amli lɛ ahe. Gbalɛi nɛɛ ji ninai ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ Zakaria; ni amɛkɔɔ bɔ ni asaa atswa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ama shi ekoŋŋ lɛ he, kɛ bɔ ni atsuu Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ahe ahã. Ekɔɔ Kpɔ̃lɔ kɛ yinɔ ni baaba lɛ hu ahe. Mlijaa ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Yitsei 9-14 kɔɔ shɛi srɔtoi ni abua naa yɛ Kpɔlɔ ni akwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ kɛ adesai anaagbee kojomɔ lɛ hu ahe.
Mlijaramɔi
Kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he Shɛi 1.1—8.23
Kojomɔ ni kã shi hã maji ni kɛ Israel bɛŋkɛ lɛ 9.1-8
Wɔsɛɛ shweremɔ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ 9.9—14.21

Title: ZAKARIA 1
Content:
Yehowa tsɛ ewebii akɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba
1 Persia Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ gbalɔ Zakaria ni ji Berekia bi ni eji Ido nabi lɛ wie ni ekɛɛ mɛi lɛ akɛ, 2“Mi Yehowa, mimli efu nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ waa naakpa. 3 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɔ amɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ ni mi hu makpale kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ. 4 Nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ; mɛi ni tsutsu gbalɔi lɛ shiɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛje amɛgbɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ kɛ amɛnifeemɔ nii gbohii lɛ ahe lɛ. Ni amɛbooo toi, shi moŋ amɛkwa mi. 5Nɛgbɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ? Ni gbalɔi lɛ hu ani amɛhiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ lo? 6Shi miwiemɔi kɛ mikpɔi lɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ shɛ amɛdɛŋ, shi amɛyabuuu, ni amɛna he toigbalamɔ hu. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshwa amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, bɔ ni mito akɛ mikɛ amɛ baaye yɛ amɛjeŋba kɛ nifeemɔnii hewɔ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mikɛ amɛ eye nɛɛ.’ ”
Gbalɔ lɛ ninaa yɛ okpɔŋɔi ahe
7Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ, ni ji Shebat nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Zakaria, Berekia bi lɛ, ni eji Ido nabi lɛ wie ekoŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, Zakaria gba ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 8 “Mina ninaa ko nyɔɔŋ ni nuu ko ta okpɔŋɔ tsuru nɔ, ni edamɔ shi yɛ mirto tsei ateŋ yɛ jɔɔ ko mli. Ni okpɔŋɔi tsuji kɛ okpɔŋɔi okɔbɛŋi kɛ okpɔŋɔi yɛji hu damɔ shi yɛ esɛɛ.” 9Kɛkɛ ni, mi Zakaria, mibi nuu lɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?” Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo akɛ, “Mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo amɛshishi.” 10No hewɔ lɛ, bɔfo lɛ ni damɔ mirto tsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni Yehowa tsu koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.”
11Kɛkɛ ni amɛ hu amɛ jie Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ni damɔ shi yɛ mirto tsei lɛ ateŋ ni wie lɛ naa amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔtee wɔyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nɔ ni wɔna ji akɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kã shi butuu ni hewalɛ ko bɛ lɛ.”
12 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ wo egbee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, afii nyɔŋmai kpawo sɔŋŋ nɛ ni omli fu Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda maji lɛ. Mɛɛbe omusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ bo yɛ amɛhe?”
13Yehowa kɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ wie miishɛjemɔ wiemɔ. 14No hewɔ lɛ, bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbaa akɛ bɔ ni Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, Yerusalɛm kɛ Zion maji lɛ fɛɛ asane kã mitsui nɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. 15 Shi mimli efu maji ni he ejɔ amɛ lɛ naakpa, ejaakɛ be ni mimli fu mimaŋ lɛ fioo lɛ, jeŋmaji lɛ kã amɛnɔnaa lɛ mli. 16No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ eku misɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm; aaama miwe lɛ yɛ emli, ni aaatswa Yerusalɛm ama shi ekoŋŋ.”
17 “Shiɛmɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mimaji lɛ aaashwere ekoŋŋ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni aaashɛje Zion mii, ni eeeŋɔ Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ efee emaŋ.’ ”
Akloŋtoi lɛ ahe ninaa
18Ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina akloŋtoi ejwɛ yɛ ninaa kroko mli, 19ni mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi?” Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi ji akloŋtoi ni ji nɔyelɔi ahewalɛi ni gbɛ Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ Yerusalɛm shwã lɛ.” 20Agbɛnɛ Yehowa jie sɔ̃lɔi ejwɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi. 21Ni mibi akɛ, “Mɛni mɛnɛɛmɛi hu baa amɛbafee?” Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo akɛ, “Amɛba koni amɛbawo akloŋtoi ejwɛ ni gbɛ Yuda shwã bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko wooo eyitso nɔ lɛ ahe gbeyei; amɛbakpɔlɔ maji lɛ akloŋtoi ni amɛkɛshilɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛgbɛ Yuda amɛshwã lɛ.”

Title: ZAKARIA 2
Content:
Susumɔ kpãa lɛ he ninaa
1 Misaa miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina nuu ko ni hiɛ susumɔ kpãa yɛ edɛŋ. 2Mibi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyaa?” Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ, “Miyasusu Yerusalɛm koni mana ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ.”
3Ni naa, bɔfo lɛ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ je kpo; ni bɔfo kroko hu je kpo tee kɛ lɛ yakpe. 4 Klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ fã bɔfo kroko lɛ ekɛɛ, “Sha foi ni oyakɛɛ nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ ni hiɛ susumɔ kpãa lɛ akɛ, Yerusalɛm he baakã efolo tamɔ akrowa ni atswako gbogbo awoko he yɛ emli gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ayifalɛ hewɔ. 5Mi, Yehowa, matsɔ̃ la kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe, tamɔ gbogbo, ni matsɔ̃ emli anunyam. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Atsɛ Nomii lɛ akɛ amɛba shĩa
6Yehowa kɛɛ, “Huui! Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛjɛa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa Yerusalɛm; ejaakɛ mi, migbɛ nyɛ mishwã tamɔ ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ, 7“Huui! Kuu osɛɛ oba Zion, bo mɔ ni okɛ Babilon biyoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.” 8 Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Enunyam lɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsu mi kɛtee maji ni hahaa nyɛnii lɛ aŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko ta nyɛhe lɛ eta mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ he. 9Naa, mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ haanii amɛhã amɛtsuji ni sɔ̃mɔ amɛ lɛ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ.”
10“Nyɛlaa, ni nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛ Yerusalɛmbii, shi naa, miba mibahi nyɛteŋ.”
11 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, maji babaoo kɛ amɛhe aaahã Yehowa ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimɛi, ni mahi amɛteŋ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ. 12Agbɛnɛ hu Yehowa aaaŋɔ Yuda akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ; asaŋ eeeŋɔ Yerusalɛm hu akɛ emaŋ ekoŋŋ.
13 Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee dioo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ ete shi kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.

Title: ZAKARIA 3
Content:
Gbalɔ lɛ ninaa yɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ he
1 Agbɛnɛ ehã mina Yoshua ni ji osɔfonukpa lɛ ni edamɔ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hiɛ, ni satan hu damɔ Yoshua ninejurɔ ni ebaafolɔ enaa. 2 Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Satan akɛ, “Satan, Yehowa akã ohiɛ. Yehowa mɔ ni eŋɔ Yerusalɛm akɛ enɔ lɛ aaakã ohiɛ. Ani oleee akɛ latso ni afã yɛ la naa ji mɔ nɛ?”
3No mli lɛ Yoshua wo atadei mujimuji kɛdamɔ bɔfo lɛ hiɛ. 4 Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã mɛi ni damɔ ehiɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea atadei mujimuji lɛ yɛ ehe.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yoshua hu akɛ, “Bɔ ni ajie ohe atadei nɛɛ lɛ, nakai ajie ohe eshai lɛ ashwie, ni mawula bo kɛ atadei ni jara wa.”
5 Ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛ fai ni he tse abu lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ fai ni he tse bu lɛ, ni amɛwula lɛ kɛ atadei. Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ shi yɛ jɛi.
6Agbɛnɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, 7“Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Kɛji oooba ojeŋ bɔ ni mitaoɔ, ni oooye mimlai ni miwo lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ bo obaakwɛ misɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ ehe kpoi lɛ anɔ. Asaŋ mahã bo hegbɛ ni ofata mimɛi ni damɔɔ biɛ lɛ ahe. 8 Agbɛnɛ, bo osɔfonukpa Yoshua, bo toi, bo kɛ onanemɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ fɛɛ. Mɛi nɛɛ ji shade ni baaba lɛ he okadi lɛ. Naa, mibawo mitsulɔ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tsonine, gbɛ kɛba. 9Asaŋ mikɛ tɛ koome ni yɛ hiɛi kpawo ema Yoshua hiɛ, ni makpɛ niŋmaa yɛ nakai tɛ lɛ nɔ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ. Ni mikɛ gbi kome baagbe shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ. 10 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaakpee enaanyo kɛaaba ewaintso kɛ agbãmitso shishi, Yehowa kɛɛ.’ ”

Title: ZAKARIA 4
Content:
Kanetso lɛ he Ninaa
1Bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ batsiɛ mi ekoŋŋ tamɔ atsiɛɔ mɔ yɛ ewɔ mli. 2 Ni ebi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihã hetoo akɛ, “Miina kanetso ni akɛ shika sɔŋŋ fee; ni emutɔ ko ma eyiteŋ. Kanetso nɛɛ yɛ kanei kpawo mamɔ eyiteŋ; ni kanei nɛɛ, eko fɛɛ eko hu yɛ odontii kpawo ni asuɔ. 3 Asaŋ mutsei enyɔ mamɔ kanetso lɛ masɛi; ekome yɛ mutɔ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni ekome hu yɛ ebɛku nɔ.” 4Agbɛnɛ mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?”
5Bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Ani oleee nɔ ni nibii nɛɛ ji?” Ni mikɛɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, dabida.”
Shi ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo Zerubabel
6Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhãa Zerubabel nɛ, ‘Jeee onyɛmɔ baahã oye kunim, loo ohewalɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mimumɔ lɛ ni baahã oye kunim,’ Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” 7 Shi bo gɔŋ kpeteŋkple, mɛni mli oyɔɔ? Obaatsɔ ŋa kplanaa yɛ Zerubabel hiɛ. Ebaakɔ oyiteŋ tɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛba, ni aaabɔ oshe kɛaaba akɛ, “Dromɔ, dromɔ naa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ.”
8Yehowa saa ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 9 “Zerubabel eto shĩa nɛɛ shishi, ni ebaatswa egbe naa hu. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ. 10 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbe nitsumɔ lɛ ni eyaaa nɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ baana Zerubabel ni ehiɛ tsumalɔi akulomulo lɛ yɛ edɛŋ ekɛ miitswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛbaanya. Kanetsei kpawo nɛɛ ji Yehowa hiŋmɛii ni ekɛkwɛɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.”
11Agbɛnɛ mibi bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ kanetso lɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku lɛ? 12Misaa mibi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ akɛ, te mutsei enyɔ ni yɔɔ shika bɛji enyɔ lɛ ni mu hoɔ yɛ mli lɛ ashishi hu?”
13Bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Ani oleee enɛɛmɛi ashishi?” Mihã hetoo akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ Dabida.” 14 Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nibii nɛɛ damɔ shi hã mɛi enyɔ ni ahala amɛ, ni afɔ amɛ mu koni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa mɔ ni ji jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”

Title: ZAKARIA 5
Content:
Wolokpo ni filikiɔ lɛ he ninaa
1Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina wolo kpo ko ni miifiliki. 2Ni bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihã lɛ hetoo mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miina wolo kpo ko ni miifiliki; ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.”
3Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Enɛ ji loomɔ ni gbɛɔ eshwãa shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ. No ji akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni juɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakã kitã ni eyeŋ nɔ lɛ aaana nakai toigbalamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.”
4Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Miihã loomɔ nɛɛ asa julɔ fɛɛ julɔ we he, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsɛɔ migbɛi ekɛkãa kitã ni eyeee nɔ lɛ hu we he. Loomɔ nɛɛ aaahi mɔ lɛ we lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi eeekpatã shĩa lɛ kɛ emli tsei kɛ tɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.”
Yoo ni yɔɔ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli lɛ he ninaa
5Agbɛnɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ nɔ ni baa lɛ.” 6 Mibi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ni?” Ni ehere nɔ akɛ, “Kɛntɛŋ ni, ni edamɔ shi hã je lɛ fɛɛ he esha lɛ.”
7No sɛɛ lɛ, agbele kɛntɛŋ lɛ naa; enaanɔ lɛ sumui akɛfee; ni yoo ko ta shi yɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli.
8Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ naa akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ damɔ shi hã yiwalɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ yoo lɛ nɔ ewo kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ naanɔ ni akɛ sumui fee lɛ bu kɛntɛŋ lɛ naa. 9Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina yei enyɔ ni miifiliki kɛmiiba kɛ fiji ni tamɔ faanaa oka nɔ. Amɛbawo kɛntɛŋ lɛ kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ kɛtee.
10Mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ amɛkɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ yaa nɛɛ?”
11 Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛmiiya Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; koni amɛyama tsu yɛ jɛi amɛha lɛ. Kɛji agbe tsu lɛ maa naa lɛ amɛkɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ baayi shi kɛyama egbɛhe.”

Title: ZAKARIA 6
Content:
Tayaa shwiilii ejwɛ lɛ ahe ninaa
1 Misaa miwo mihiɛ nɔ ni mina tayaa shwiilii ejwɛ komɛi fã kpo kɛjɛ akɔɔble gɔji enyɔ komɛi ateŋ kɛba. 2 Klɛŋklɛŋ tayaa shwiili lɛ okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni gbalaa; ni shwiili ni ji enyɔ lɛ okpɔŋɔi diji ni gbalaa; 3 shwiili ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ okpɔŋɔi yɛji ni gbalaa; ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ okpɔŋɔi truntrãi ni he wa gbalaa. 4Kɛkɛ ni mibi bɔfo lɛ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?”
5Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi damɔ shi hã ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ. Amɛmiiya amɛkɛ amɛhe ayatsɔ̃ɔ jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛya ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ.”
6Tayaa shwiili lɛ ni okpɔŋɔi diji lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi yɛji lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi truntrãi lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 7Shi be ni okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni he wa lɛ fã kpo lɛ, amɛhe tswa shi koni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã amɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakpaa shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. 8Agbɛnɛ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Naa, okpɔŋɔi ni yaa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ejɔɔ mi, Yehowa, mitsui he yɛ nakai kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.”
Afã akɛ abu Yoshua akekre
9Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 10“Ŋɔɔ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii hu ni nomii lɛ ni ji Heldai kɛ Tobia kɛ Yedaia kɛjɛ Babilon kɛbake lɛ, ni okɛya Zefania bi Yosia we lɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ. 11Okɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni oŋɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ afee maŋtsɛ fai ni okɛbu Yehozadak bi Yoshua, ni ji osɔfonukpa lɛ. 12 No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛɛ lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, nuu lɛ ni egbɛi ji Tsonine lɛ, ebaada yɛ enajiaŋ, ni lɛ ebaama Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. 13 Lɛ ji mɔ ni ebaama Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni abaawo ehiɛ nyam akɛ lumɔ, ni ebaata emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ kɛye elumɔ lɛ. Osɔfo ko hu baahi emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ he, ni shishinumɔ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baahi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛteŋ.’ 14Ato nɛkɛ maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli, koni akɛkai Heldai kɛ Tobia kɛ Yedaia kɛ Yosia ni ji Zefania bi lɛ.”
15Mɛi baajɛ maji asɛɛ shɔŋŋ abaye abua kɛma Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, enɛ aaaba mli ahã nyɛ.

Title: ZAKARIA 7
Content:
1Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu, ni ji Kislev nyɔŋ, lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Zakaria wie.
2No mli lɛ Betelbii lɛ etsu Sharezer kɛ Regem-Melek kɛ amɛmɛi kɛba Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ koni amɛbasɔle amɛkpa fai. 3 Asaŋ koni amɛbi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔfo ni wɔhi ŋmãa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ hu nɔ tamɔ wɔfeɔ yɛ afii babaoo ni eho lɛ amli lɛ lo?”
4Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ mi akɛ, 5 “Bi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, be ni nyɛhi ŋmãa ni nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ hu nɔ, yɛ afi nyɔŋmai kpawo nɛɛ mli lɛ, ani mi, Yehowa nyɛhi ŋmãa lɛ nyɛhã lo? 6Be ni nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii lɛ, ani jeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii nyɛhã lɛ?”
7Be ni mɛi yɔɔ Yerusalɛm ni ekɛ emaji kɛ eshikpɔji ni bɔle ehe lɛ shwereɔ lɛ, be mli ni mɛi yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ kɛ ŋa nɔ gbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, ani jeee nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɔŋŋ Yehowa hã ashiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ lo? 8Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Zakaria wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 9 “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkojoa yɛ jalɛ naa, ni nyɛkɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ahia shi akɛ nyɛmimɛi. 10 Nyɛkawaa okulafo loo awusa loo gbɔ loo ohiafo yi. Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akasusu enyɛmi he efɔŋ ko yɛ emli.’
11“Shi moŋ mimaŋ lɛ waje amɛtsui ni amɛkɛ kuɛŋtilɛ booo toi; amɛtsimɔ amɛtoii koni amɛkanu wiemɔ lɛ. 12 Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui koni amɛkabo mla lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ emumɔ lɛ nɔ ekɛtsu eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ ni eŋɔ hã lɛ toi. No hewɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ mlifu amɛ naakpa lɛ. 13Akɛni mitsɛ amɛ shi amɛfooo mli lɛ, no hewɔ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ mi ni mi hu mibooo amɛ toi lɛ. Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ. 14Ni no hã mi kɛ lasuogbele gbɛ amɛshwã kɛtee majiasɛɛ hei ni amɛleee lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ ni amɛshi nɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ amɛsɛɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko eyaaa mli, ni mɔ ko ejeee mli hu lɛ. Amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.”

Title: ZAKARIA 8
Content:
1Yehowa kɛɛ, ebaatswa Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ mi, Zakaria, wie akɛ, 2“Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ nɛ, miiye awuŋã ni naa wa naakpa yɛ Zion he; mikɛ hiɛdɔɔ ni naa wa miiye ehe awuŋã nɛɛ. 3Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, mibaku misɛɛ kɛba Zion, ni mibahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni abaatsɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ anɔkwale maŋ, kɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ gɔŋ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Krɔŋkrɔŋ.’ 4 Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, hiimeji kɛ yeimeji ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso yɛ egbɔlɛ hewɔ baatara Yerusalɛm blohuiaŋ ekoŋŋ; 5Ni maŋ lɛ mli blohuiaŋ aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbekɛbii hii kɛ gbekɛbii yei ni miishwɛ. 6 Kɛji gbalɛ nɛɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ bei nɛɛ amli yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, ani mi hu eeefee naakpɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ lo? Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ. 7Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, naa, mibahere mimaŋbii lɛ ayiwala kɛaajɛ bokã kɛ anai shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; 8 ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba koni amɛbahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ yɛ anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ mli.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ,
9 “Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnuɔ gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli yɛ gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ be ni ato Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, Sɔlemɔ we lɛ maa shishi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnijiaŋ akajea wui bɔ ni afee ni anyɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ama. 10Ejaakɛ be ni nakai be lɛ shɛko lɛ gbɔmɔ nitsumɔ feɔ yaka, ni kooloo nitsumɔ hu feɔ yaka, ni mɔ ni jeɔ kpo loo ebaa mli lɛ naaa hejɔlɛ yɛ haolɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mihã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ete shi ewo enaanyo. 11Shi agbɛnɛ mikɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ nɛɛ yeŋ kɛ joomɔ tamɔ mifee tsutsu bii lɛ.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.
12“Ejaakɛ aaadu nii yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli, waintsei lɛ aaawo yibii, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii, bɔ aaajɛ ŋwɛi anyɔ ashwie nɔ, ni mibahã enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ atsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ. 13 Naa, Yuda we kɛ Israel we, bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ akɛ majimaji, ni amɛkɛ nyɛgbɛi lomɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mahere nyɛyiwala, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ni akɛ nyɛgbɛi baajɔɔ. Nyɛkashea gbeyei, shi moŋ nyɛwajea nyɛhe ni nyɛfea ekãa kɛkɛ.”
14Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Bɔ ni mito miyiŋ ni mafee nyɛ efɔŋ ni mishwaŋ mihe be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ wo mi mlifu lɛ, 15nakai mito miyiŋ bei nɛɛ amli akɛ mibafee Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda we ejurɔ. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei. 16 Nyɛfea nibii nɛɛ: nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awiea anɔkwale; asaŋ nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ nyɛkoii ashi bɔ ni baahã toiŋjɔlɛ aba. 17Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabɛ enaanyo ewo emli. Nyɛkasumɔa amale kitãkãmɔ; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi ji nibii ni minyɛɔ. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.”
18Ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɔ nɛ, 19 “Ŋmãa ni nyɛhiɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ mliflimɔ gbii juji ahã Yudabii. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsumɔa anɔkwale kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.”
20Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, “Mɛi aaakã he ajɛ majimaji babaoo anɔ aba. 21Ni maŋ kome mli bii aaaya maŋ kroko mli ayakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔyakpaa Yehowa fai, ni asaŋ wɔyatao esɛɛ gbɛ hu. Mi hu maya.’ 22Mɛi babaoo kɛ majimaji ni ahe wa tete aaba Yerusalɛm abatao Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ ni amɛaakpa lɛ fai.”
23Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma ni jɛ majimaji ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi anɔ baamɔ Yudanyo kome atade mli, ni amɛaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ha wɔkɛ bo aya, ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ yɛ.’ ”

Title: ZAKARIA 9
Content:
Yehowa kojo jeŋmaji lɛ
1 Yehowa wie eshi Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nakai wiemɔ lɛ saa Damasko hu he; ejaakɛ Siria maji wuji lɛ hu Yehowa nɔ ji fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni enɔ ji Israel akutsei lɛ. 2Enɔ ji Hamat hu ni kɛ Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ je husu lɛ, kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon fɛɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛnilee naa wa naakpa. 3Tiro etswa gbogbo ewo ehe ni ebua jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu kɛ shika tsuru hu naa tamɔ blohuŋ shia. 4 Shi naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baashɔ̃ enii ni ena nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni aaashɛrɛ enii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ ashwie ŋshɔ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ akɛ la aakpãtã ehiɛ.
5Ashkelon maŋ lɛ aaana ni eeeshe gbeyei; Gaza hu aaana ni ehe aaakpokpo naakpa. Ekron hu aaana ejaakɛ ehiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ aaafee yakatswaa. Gaza maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã, ni Ashkelon hu baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. 6Yoo ajwamãŋbii aaahi Ashdod; Filistibii lɛ ahewoo lɛ, mafo sɛɛ. 7Mahã amɛkpa loo ni emli lá fɛɛ tsereko yeli kwraa, ni amɛnihiinii tekeŋ amɛtsɛ̃ŋ, ni emli mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ aaashwɛ ahã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yuda akutsei lɛ eko; ni Ekronbii hu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yebusbii. 8No sɛɛ lɛ, mabu miwebii lɛ ahe tamɔ bulɔ, koni asraafoi akuu ko kuu ko akatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee kɛba. Miŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni haolɔ ko agba miwebii lɛ anaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛi kã amɛhe.
Wɔsɛɛ ko Maŋtsɛ
9 Omli afili bo, bo Zion biyoo;
Bɔɔ oshe waa, bo Yerusalɛm biyoo!
Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ;
Eeba kɛ agbojee kɛ kunimyeli.
Eta teji oblanyo ni ji teji yoo bi ko nɔ.
10 Makpãtã ta shwiilii fɛɛ
ni aaajɛ Efraim aba lɛ ahiɛ;
ni majie ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ hu kɛje Yerusalɛm.
Makumɔ tawuu gãii lɛ amli dukuduku.
Eeeshi maji lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ
ni elumɔyeli aaajɛ ŋshɔnaa
kɛyagbee ŋshɔnaa.
Ni eeejɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi
je lɛ naagbee hei tɔ̃ɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ akpɔ̃mɔ
11 Nuŋtsɔ lɛ saa kɛɛ, “Bo Zion biyoo hu,
Milá ni mikɛsɔo mikɛo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa
hewɔ lɛ,
majie obii ni etsɔ̃mɔ gboklɛfoi lɛ
yɛ bu ni nu bɛ mli lɛ mli.
12 Nyɛ gboklɛfoi ni nyɛyɔɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ,
nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa mɔɔ ni wa lɛ mli.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ
mibato nyɛ najiaŋ toi enyɔ.
13 Ejaakɛ midɔ Yuda mli tamɔ gãitso,
ni mikɛ Efraim efee egãimlibi.
Bo Zion, matee obihii lɛ ashi,
ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ klante
yɛ midɛŋ,
yɛ bo, Hela, obihii lɛ anɔ.”
14Agbɛnɛ Yehowa aaapue
yɛ ewebii lɛ anɔ
ni egãimlibii lɛ aafliki
tamɔ srawa gbalaa lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ
ni aaakpã eta tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ,
ni eeefã tamɔ wuoyigbɛ lasuogbele.
15Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaabu emɛi ahe;
Amɛaatserɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi amli,
ni amɛaanaanaa amɛ nɔ.
Amɛaashwie amɛhenyɛlɔi alá shi
ni lá lɛ aaaho tamɔ afɔleshãa
kooloo lá ni afɔse kɛmiijɛ okpolu
mli aashwie afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
16Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ,
Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahere amɛyiwala;
ejaakɛ etooku ji amɛ;
Amɛaakpɛlɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ
tamɔ akekre he ojarawatɛi.
17Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaaŋɔɔ, eeefee fɛo;
abele aaahã oblahii afrɔke
ni wain hee hu aaahã oblayei afrɔke.

Title: ZAKARIA 10
Content:
Yehowa wo kpɔ̃mɔ he shi
1Nyɛbia Yehowa koni ehã Agbiɛnaa nu anɛ nyɛ. Nyɛbia Yehowa mɔ ni hãa ahum fãa ni ehãa nu nɛɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋa nɔ tsei fɛɛ anɔ lɛ. 2 Nɔ ni amãgãi lɛ kɛɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli, ni klamɔfoi lɛ aninaa lɛ apasa sɔŋŋ ni. Mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔi ashishi lɛ maleɔ, ni amɛshɛjeɔ mɔ mii yakatswaa; no hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ kpaa shi tamɔ toi, amɛnaa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ.
3 Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mimli efu tookwɛlɔi ni ji maŋsɛɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni magbala amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ atoi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jwɛŋɔ etooku ni ji Yudabii lɛ ahe; ni eeehã amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ etayaa okpɔŋɔ ni eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ. 4 Koŋtɛ lɛ aaajɛ Yuda mli, emli nɔŋŋ buu lɛ shiŋmlitso lɛ hu aaajɛ, kɛ tawuu gãitso lɛ kɛ lumɛi srɔtoi fɛɛ hu. 5Yudabii lɛ aaatsɔmɔ kãkãlɔi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛaanaanaa amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ tamɔ anaa ŋmiamɔ. Amɛbaawu tai ni amɛaahã amɛhenyɛlɔi tabilɔi okpɔŋɔianɔtralɔi ahiɛ ashwie shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ amɛ yɛ.
6“Mibahã Yuda he awa,
ni mahere Israel yiwala.
Mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba
ejaakɛ mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe.
Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi ni mikwako amɛ dã,
ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
ni mabo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.
7Nakai be lɛ Efraim aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ kpaanaa,
ni emlibii amli aaafli amɛ
tamɔ mɛi ni enu wain.
Amɛshwiei aaana
nɔ ni Yehowa etsu lɛ;
ni amɛmii aaashɛ amɛhe;
ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ.
8“Mikɛ okadi aaatsɛ amɛ,
ni mabua amɛnaa
ejaakɛ mi mikpɔ̃ amɛ,
ni amɛyi aaafa ekoŋŋ
tamɔ sa.
9 Migbɛ amɛ mishwã maŋsɛɛ maji anɔ moŋ;
shi kɛ̃lɛ, amɛaakai mi,
yɛ hei ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ.
Amɛ kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ yi aaana wala,
ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛaaba ekoŋŋ.
10Makpala amɛ kɛjɛ
Ijipt kɛba.
Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ Asiria hu.
Mikɛ amɛ aaaba Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
kɛ Lebanon shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ
kɛyaashi anaŋ gbɛ yɛ shikpɔji
lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ.
11 Amɛbaafo amanehulu ŋshɔ lɛ,
mahã ŋshɔkei lɛ aŋmɛ dɛŋŋ.
Nilo Faa lɛ fɛɛ kwa baagbi.
Abaaba Asiria hetsɛmɔ lɛ shi,
ni Ijipt hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo.
12Mawo amɛ hewalɛ lɛ
yɛ Yehowa mli,
ni amɛbaanya yɛ egbɛi mli.
Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.”

Title: ZAKARIA 11
Content:
Yiwalɔi lɛ ashigbeemɔ
1“Ao, Lebanon, gbelemɔ oshinai lɛ,
koni la ashã otsenedrui lɛ.
2Ao, sɛsɛo, wo yara ni ofo,
ejaakɛ tsenedru lɛ eku egbee shi;
ejaakɛ tsei ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã.
Bashan odum, wo yara nyɛfoa,
ejaakɛ agba koo haii lɛ tete.
3Bo toi,
tookwɛlɔi lɛ ewo yara.
Bo toi, jatai miihuu,
Naa, Yordan he koo lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.
ejaakɛ amɛnunyam sɛɛ efo.
Tookwɛlɔi enyɔ lɛ
4Bɔ ni Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Feemɔ ohe tamɔ tookwɛlɔ ni kwɛɔ tooku ni ayaagbe amɛ. 5 Mɛni hewɔ tookwɛlɔi lɛ gbeɔ toi nɛɛ ni agbalaaa amɛ toi. Mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ toi nɛɛ hu kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ajie Yehowa yi ejaakɛ wɔtsɔmɔ niiatsɛmɛi.’ Ni amɛkwɛlɔi lɛ tete po enaaa kooloi lɛ amɔbɔ.”
6“No hewɔ lɛ, minaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ; naa, maŋmɛɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he mawo enɔkwɛlɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛ hu dɛŋ. Ni nɔkwɛlɔi nɛɛ baakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni mihereŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yiwala.
7“Hewɔ lɛ mitsɔ̃ toi ni abaagbe ahã tookwɛlɔi nɛɛ akwɛlɔ. Mikɔlɔ kplamɔtsei enyɔ. Miwo ekome gbɛi akɛ, ‘Dromɔ’ kɛ ekome hu akɛ, ‘Ekomefeemɔ!’ Nomɛi mikɛkpalaa tooku lɛ. 8Mikpãtã tookwɛlɔi etɛ̃ ahiɛ yɛ nyɔŋ kome mli, ejaakɛ minaaa amɛhe tsui, ni amɛ hu amɛnyaŋe mi. 9 No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ mifeŋ nyɛkwɛlɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ. Too ni baagbo lɛ, egbo, nɔ ni hiɛ baakpãtã hu, ehiɛ akpãtã; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, amɛyeyee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi aloo.” 10Kɛkɛ ni mikɔ mikplamɔtso ni gbɛi ji ‘Dromɔ’ lɛ, ni miku mli, ni mikɛku kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ miwebii lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli. 11Hewɔ lɛ aku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ni too jarayelɔi lɛ ni kwɛɔ mi lɛ nu shishi akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naanii ni. 12 Agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ jarayelɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji esa nyɛhiɛ lɛ no lɛ nyɛwoa mi nyɔmɔ; shi kɛji esaaa nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɔmɔwoo lɛ ahi shi.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛkɛwo mi nyɔmɔ.
13 Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Okɛyawo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni amɛkɛwo mi nyɔmɔ lɛ yawo Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli. 14 Agbɛnɛ miku kplamɔtso ni ji enyɔ lɛ ni gbɛi ji ‘Ekomefeemɔ’ lɛ mli, ni mikɛfo nyɛmimɛi anaanyobɔɔ ni kã Yuda kɛ Israel teŋ lɛ mli.
15Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “kɔlɔmɔ tookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ nitsumɔ nibii ohiɛ, 16Shi naa, miitee tookwɛlɔ ko shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; lɛ lɛ, jeee ehe sane ko ji too ni miigbo lɛ. Toi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ ebuaŋ amɛnaa. Nɔ ni epila lɛ, etsaŋ lɛ; ni toi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ lɛ ehaŋ amɛ niyenii amɛyeŋ; shi moŋ gbe eeegbe toi ni ewowoi fɔ lɛ eye, belɛ eekpɔlɔ amɛnaji ahe koklotoi lɛ eeshwie. 17Kpoo hã mitookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni shiɔ etooku lɛ; lɛ lɛ, aaafo eninejurɔ yɛ ta mli, ni aaajwa eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi hu yɛ ta mli. Enine agbo kwraa yɛ ehe, ni eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ hu ashwila kwrakwra.”

Title: ZAKARIA 12
Content:
Yerusalɛm kpɔ̃mɔ̃ ni baaba lɛ
1Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Israel he lɛ nɛ. Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi ni ha shi nɛɛ, ni bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ebɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 2 “Naa, mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ tamɔ dãa yɛ kpulu mli mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabasa enaa ekwɛ lɛ aaadidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ. Kɛji maŋ ko fã ta basa Yerusalɛm yi lɛ, belɛ ekɛ ta lɛ etua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ hu. 3 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ tɛ ni tsii mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaka tɛ nɛɛ nɔ womɔ lɛ aaapila. Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ aaafee ekome amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm. 4Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã henyɛlɔi lɛ akpoŋɔi fɛɛ ajijaa, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ hu aye sɛkɛ. Shi be ni mashwila henyɛlɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiŋmɛii lɛ mahã mihiŋmɛii akã Yudabii lɛ ahe. Mi Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ. 5Kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda akutsei lɛ baakɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ahewalɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ni ji amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ ejɛ.’
6 “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mahã Yuda akutsei lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ la kɛ ŋɛsu yɛ laii ateŋ; amɛaatamɔ jatɛŋ ni tsoɔ ni shãa abelebaa gbiŋ; ni amɛaakpãtã maji krokomɛi ni yɔɔ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ. Yerusalɛmbii aaafee shweshweeshwe yɛ Yerusalɛm.
7“Yehowa baahã Yuda akutso lɛ mli tabilɔi tsutsu aye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, bɔ ni afee ni hiɛ akasɔ David shwiei lɛ, kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ hu akunim ni amɛye lɛ fe kunim ni Yudabii baaye lɛ. 8 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ tsɛŋ ko aaabu Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ahe, ni mɔ ni he waaa kwraa yɛ amɛteŋ he aaawa tamɔ David; ni David shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ; amɛaatamɔ Yehowa bɔfo ni nyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ. 9Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ maji fɛɛ ni aaate shi awo Yerusalɛm lɛ makpãtã amɛhiɛ.
10 “Mafɔse mimɔbɔnalɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ mumɔ mashwie David shwiei lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ anɔ bɔ ni kɛ amɛna mɔ ko ni amɛye lɛ awui ko lɛ, amɛaaye mɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ ayeɔ bi koome ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ; ni amɛaafo lɛ kɛ mlishãlɛ tamɔ afoɔ kromɔbi ni egbo. 11 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ yara ni abaawo yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ baatamɔ yara ni awo kɛfo Hadad-Rimmon yɛ Megido ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. 12Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ baawo yara wekuiaŋwekuiaŋ. Davidwe lɛ baawo yara lɛ enɔ aŋkro ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu bawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro; Nakai nɔŋŋ Natanwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro. 13Leviwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro. Shimeiwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro. 14Ni wekui krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ baawo amɛyara aŋkroaŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo amɛnɔ aŋkroaŋkro.”

Title: ZAKARIA 13
Content:
1 “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ abaagbele nu hiŋmɛi naa ahã David we lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, koni akɛfɔ amɛhe eshai kɛ amɛhe muji ashwie.”
2 Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibagbe wɔji lɛ agbɛii kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ majie gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mumɔi ni ahe tseee lɛ hu kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 3 Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaaba ekoŋŋ akɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ lɛ, etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ tete aaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Gbalɔ amalelɔ ji bo, ni osa gbele, ejaakɛ oomale yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.’ Ni kɛji ekã he eegba lolo lɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ baatsu lɛ nɔ̃, koni amɛgbe lɛ. 4 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ fɛɛ gbalɔ hiɛ baagbo yɛ eninaa ni egba lɛ hewɔ, ni ewoŋ gbalɔi atade kɛ ehiɛ fɛŋfɛŋ ni amɛwoɔ kɛshishiuɔ mɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ. 5Shi moŋ nɔ ni ebaakɛɛ ji akɛ, ‘Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, okwaafonyo ji mi, mibɔ̃i humɔ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.’ 6Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni faji anaa yɔɔ osɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ?’ Eeehã hetoo akɛ, ‘Minanemɛi ni pila mi nɛɛ.’ ”
7 Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo klante, wo ohe nɔ owo mitookwɛlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji misɛɛ mɔ lɛ, koni toi lɛ agbɛ ashwã. Mawo minine nɔ yɛ too bibiibii tete anɔ ni maplenee amɛ. 8Aaakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ amlijaa etɛ̃ mli enyɔ hiɛ, ni amɛaagboi; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ lɛ yi aaana wala. 9Nɛkɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baawo la mli ni matsuu amɛhe, tamɔ akɛ la tsuɔ jwiɛtɛi he; makpa amɛ shi makwɛ tamɔ akpaa shika shi akwɛɔ lɛ. Amɛaasɔle kɛtsɛ mi, ni mahere amɛ nɔ. Makɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mimɛi ji amɛ,’ ni amɛ hu amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ.’ Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ.”

Title: ZAKARIA 14
Content:
Yerusalɛm kɛ maji krokomɛi
1 Naa, Yehowa gbi ko miiba, ni ta mli nii ni henyɛlɔi ha yɛ bo Yerusalɛm omli lɛ, abaaja yɛ bo nɔŋŋ omli. 2 Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mabua maji lɛ anaa koni amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm ni amɛkɛ lɛ awu. Amɛbaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ, ni abaashã shĩai lɛ amli nii, ni amɛbaato amɛmli yei lɛ kabonaa. Abaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ mlijaa fã nom, shi mlijaa fã ni baashwɛ lɛ abaashi amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, afeŋ amɛ nɔ ko. 3 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ nakai maji lɛ baawu tamɔ efeɔ yɛ ta beiaŋ lɛ. 4Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baadamɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ ni ma Yerusalɛm bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ. Mugɔŋ nɛɛ mli baagba enyɔ kɛjɛ bokã kɛyashi anai, ni jɔɔ kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ baakã teŋ. Gɔŋ lɛ fã baaye kooyigbɛ, ni fã hu baaye wuoyigbɛ. 5 Nyɛbaajo foi kɛtsɔ̃ jɔɔ ni kã migɔŋ ni emli egba enyɔ lɛ mli. Nyɛbaajo foi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ jo foi be ni shikpɔŋ hoso yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Uzia yinɔ lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ baaba abapue.
6Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛ̃i yeŋ, ni afua hu woŋ. 7 Asaŋ je naŋ; anaŋ be ni ji shwane kɛ be ni ji gbɛkɛ, ejaakɛ gbɛkɛ tete lɛ hulu miitso. (Yehowa pɛ ji mɔ ni le nɛkɛ gbi nɛɛ).
8 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ wala nu baaho kɛaajɛ Yerusalɛm; fã kome kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni fã kome lɛ hu kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli. Hulutsoobe kɛ fɛ̃ibe mli fɛɛ lɛ nu nɛɛ baakã he eho. 9 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaale lɛ akɛ Yehowa kome kɛ egbɛi hu koome; ejaakɛ lɛ ebaaye shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.
