10 Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ ni kã shi kɛjɛ Geba yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ aahu kɛtee Rimon yɛ Yerusalɛm wuoyigbɛ lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ ŋa kplanaa; shi Yerusalɛm baahi shi grɔŋŋ yɛ eblema shimaahe lɛ. Ebaajɛ Benyamin Agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi he ni agbo yɔɔ tsutsu lɛ, ni ji Koŋ Agbo lɛ; ebaatsa nɔ kɛyamɔ Hananel Mɔɔ grɔŋŋ lɛ, aahu kɛyanina maŋtsɛ wainŋaahe lɛ. 11 Mɛi baahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni musu ko yeŋ amɛ, ni Yerusalɛm mlihilɛ baafee shweshweeshwe.
12Majimaji fɛɛ ni baafa tã kɛtua Yerusalɛm lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ amɛ baaye ahã nɛ: amɛheloo baakpɔtɔ be mli ni amɛhiɛ kamɔ; amɛhiŋmɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛyitsei ahe, ni amɛlilɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛdaaŋ.
13Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baahã ehe ŋmiŋmi kpeteŋkple amɔ̃mɔ amɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawo enine nɔ yɛ enaanyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ nɔ. 14Shi Yuda tete po baafata Yerusalɛm he kɛwu ta kɛfã Yerusalɛm he, ni abaaha jwetri ni maji ni bɔle amɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, amɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ atadei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
15Hela gbonyo aaamɔmɔ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi kɛ yoomai kɛ tejii kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ nakai henyɛlɔi lɛ shitoohei lɛ amli lɛ.
16Agbɛnɛ maji ni kulɛ amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm lɛ mli mɛi ni baashwɛ lɛ baaya Yerusalɛm daa afi koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, koni amɛye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ hu. 17Kɛji maŋ ko yɛ ni emli bii lɛ eyaaa Yerusalɛm koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, nu enɛŋ amɛ.
18Ni kɛji Ijiptbii lɛ hu eyaaa Yerusalɛm koni amɛyaye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ amɛhu haomɔ ni Yehowa ha eba maji lɛ ni yayeee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ anɔ lɛ aaaba amɛ hu amɛnɔ. 19Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaagbala Ijiptbii kɛ maji fɛɛ ni amɛyayeee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ atoi.
20 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaŋmalã yɛ ŋmɛji ni tsotsoroɔ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe lɛ anɔ akɛ; “Eyɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hã Yehowa.” Ni kukwɛi ni yɔɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ kãi ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ. 21 Kukwɛi fɛɛ kukwɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda fɛɛ hu baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ; bɔ ni afee ni mɛi fɛɛ ni baashã afɔle ahole amɛ kɛhoo afɔleshãa loo lɛ. Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ jarayelɔ ko jarayelɔ ko eyayeŋ jara yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ we lɛ dɔŋŋ.

Title: MALEAKI WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Gbalɔ Maleaki Wolo nɛɛ mli saji lɛ je kpo afii 500 Dani Afɔ Kristo. No mli lɛ asaa ama Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ. Sane kome ni kã gbalɔ lɛ tsui nɔ ji akɛ etsɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ hu fɛɛ atoi sɛɛ akɛ amɛkpale, ni amɛye anɔkwa yɛ kpãŋmɔ ni kã amɛ kɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ. Ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ jaaa Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni ji amɛgbɛnaa, ni anɔkwayeli bɛ amɛshihilɛ mli yɛ maŋ lɛ mli hu. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ miishishiu Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ni sa akɛ akɛbahã Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛbahãaa lɛ. Asaŋ maŋbii lɛ baaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mlai ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo amɛ lɛ anaa. Gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baaba kɛ̃ koni ebakojo ewebii lɛ, asaŋ ebaatsuu amɛhe efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Shi moŋ ebaawo etsulɔ ko gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛba koni tsulɔ nɛɛ abasaa shi eto lɛ, asaŋ koni ebakai emaŋbii lɛ kpãŋmɔ ni kã shi yɛ amɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Eshai ni Israel fee lɛ 1.1—2.16
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ kojomɔ kɛ emusuŋtsɔ̃lɛ 2.17—4.6

Title: MALEAKI 1
Content:
1Gbalɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Maleaki nɔ koni ekɛhã Israelbii lɛ nɛ.
Suɔmɔ ni Yehowa yɔɔ hã Israel
2Yehowa kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, “Misumɔ nyɛ.”
Shi amɛto he akɛ, “Mɛni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ osumɔ wɔ?”
Yehowa here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Te Esau nyɛmi nuu ji Yakob; shi bɛ misumɔ Yakob kɛ eshwiei, 3 ni minyɛ Esau kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ. Mihã egbɛfaŋ gɔŋ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni ashi jɛi, ni jɛi tsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe?”
4Kɛji Esau shwiei, ni ji Edombii, lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Akpãtã wɔhiɛ moŋ, shi wɔbaaku wɔsɛɛ kɛya ni wɔyasaa wɔtswa wɔtsui ni efee koikoi lɛ,” no lɛ Yehowa baato he akɛ, “Amɛbaanyɛ amɛsaa tsui lɛ amɛmamɔ nɛ, shi mi hu makumɔ tsui lɛ mashwie shi kɛyaashi mɛi aaatsɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋ gbonyo ni Yehowa mli efu amɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ.’ ”
5 Nyɛbaana nɔ ni baaba lɛ kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa da kɛteke Israel kɛ ehusui fɛɛ.”
Yehowa kã osɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ
6 Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, miikɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Bi woɔ etsɛ, ni tsulɔ woɔ enuŋtsɔ. Kolɛ, kɛji tsɛ ji mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ miwoo lɛ yɔɔ? Ni kɛji nuŋtsɔ hu ji mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ gbeyei ni nyɛsheɔ mi yɔɔ? Nyɛgbeɔ migbɛi lɛ he guɔ; shi nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛgbeɔ ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ lɛ?’ 7Nyɛkɛ aboloo ni abule bashãa afɔle yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Agbɛnɛ hu nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ wɔhiɛ esɔɔɔ bo?’ Nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Nyɛnifeemɔ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛbuuu mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.’ 8 Kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloi shwilafoi bashã afɔle lɛ aso ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo? Ni kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ bashã afɔle lɛ, no hu ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo? Kɛji omɔ nakai kooloo okɛyake amralo lɛ, ani eeena ohe tsuijurɔ, aloo eeekwɛ ohiɛ?”
9No hewɔ lɛ, osɔfoi, agbɛnɛ nyɛkpaa Naa Nyɔŋmɔ fai koni eduro wɔ. Ani nɛkɛ nikeenii ni jɛ nyɛdɛŋ nɛɛ baahã ekwɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ? 10Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mina ni kulɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ŋamɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinai lɛ koni nyɛkayashɛre la yakatswaa yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ. Minaaa nyɛhe miishɛɛ, ni mimɔŋ nikeenii ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi lɛ hu mli. 11Kɛjɛ hulu shitee mli aahu kɛyashi eshinyɔɔ mli lɛ, mɛi miikafo mi yɛ jeŋ majimaji amli. Ni aashãshãa tsofakɛŋma aahã mi, ni akɛ nibii ni ahe tsetsee miishãshãa afɔle miihã mi, ejaakɛ migbɛi ehehe yɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ anɔ. 12Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbuleɔ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛji nyɛkɛɛ akɛ abule Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ momo, ni no hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ niyenii ni nyɛnyaŋeɔ baa bashãa afɔle yɛ nɔ lɛ. 13Nɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ ji, ‘Mɛɛ tɔlɛ po ji enɛ, ni nyɛshoɔ nyɛgugɔŋ nyɛwoɔ mi.’ Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mɔ ko nii ni ayashɔ̃ akranaŋ naa, loo kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ nyɛkɛbahãa akɛ nyɛfɔle. Aso nyɛsusuɔ akɛ mamɔ nɛkɛ afɔle mli kɛ miishɛɛ lo? 14Alomɔ shishiulɔ ni yɔɔ too nuu yɛ etoo ku mli, shi kɛji ewo shi lɛ, ekɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe moŋ bashãa afɔle ehãa Yehowa lɛ, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ji mi,’ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, ‘Ni jeŋ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ sheɔ mi gbeyei.’ ”

Title: MALEAKI 2
Content:
1“Agbɛnɛ nyɛ, osɔfoi, kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛ. 2Kɛji nyɛbooo wiemɔ nɛɛ toi ni nyɛkɛaato nyɛtsui mli, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ nyɛjeŋba awo migbɛi hiɛ nyam lɛ, no lɛ mibalomɔ nyɛ; mibalomɔ nibii ni ahãa nyɛ ni nyɛkɛkwɛɔ nyɛhe lɛ fɛɛ. Anɔkwale mli lɛ, milomɔ nibii nɛɛ momo ejaakɛ nyɛbuuu mikitã lɛ. 3Naa, mibakã nyɛshwiei ahiɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛfɔleshãa kooloi lɛ awamɔ lɛ aaakpa nyɛhiɛ; ni aaaloo nyɛ kɛ wamɔ lɛ fɛɛ ayashwie tumo nɔ. 4 Enɛ ji nɔ ni nyɛkɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi mikɛ kitã nɛɛ tsu kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ; ni asaŋ koni kpãŋmɔ ni kã mi kɛ osɔfoi, ni ji Levi shwiei lɛ, ateŋ lɛ akaku mli,” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ.
5 “Mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ mli lɛ, miwo shi akɛ madro amɛ wala kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, ni mifee hu, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe mi gbeyei, ni amɛhiɛ hu asɔ migbɛi lɛ. 6Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nii ni ja, shi jeee nii ni ejaaa; ni amɛkɛ mi hi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ jalɛ mli. Amɛfee nii ni ja, ni amɛkpale mɛi babaoo kɛje nɔsha he. 7Ejaakɛ osɔfoi agbɛnaa nitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee krɔŋŋ lɛ. Amɛ amɛŋɔɔ esa akɛ mɛi aya koni amɛyakase mla lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ amɛ ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ.
8“Shi nyɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, nyɛgba afã kɛje gbɛ ni ja lɛ nɔ. Nyɛkɛ nyɛnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ehã mɛi babaoo etɔ̃ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ, Levi shwiei ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.” Yehowa kɛɛ. 9“No hewɔ lɛ, bei abɔ ni nyɛyeee mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkwɛɔ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ yɛ nyɛnifeemɔ mli lɛ, mibahã nyɛhe guɔ agbo yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ahiɛ.”
Anɔkwa ni maŋbii yeee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ
10Ani jeee tsɛ kome wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɔɔ lo? Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome ni bɔ wɔ lo? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeee enyɛmi anɔkwa, ni wɔyeee kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ? 11Yuda yeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa, ni musubɔɔ nibii sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ afeɔ yɛ Israel kɛ Yerusalɛm. Yuda ebule Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ. Yudahii lɛ eyaŋɔŋɔɔ ŋamɛi ni jaa maŋsɛɛ wɔji. 12Yehowa aaaplene nuu fɛɛ nuu ni feɔ nɛkɛ nɔ ko yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, koni ekahã ena hegbɛ efata he dɔŋŋ kɛshã afɔlei ni maŋbii lɛ shãa hãa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ.
13Asaŋ nɔ ni ji enyɔ hu ni nyɛfeɔ nɛ. Nyɛwoɔ yara ni nyɛdɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛyaafonu fɔɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfɔleshãa nibii lɛ esaaa Yehowa hiɛ dɔŋŋ aahu po ni eeemɔ mli kɛ tsuijurɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ. 14Nyɛbiɔ nɔ hewɔ ni nibii baa lɛ nakai akɛ Yehowa mɔɔɔ nikeenii lɛ amli lɛ. Ejaakɛ be ni okɛ oblahiiaŋ ŋa lɛ kpãŋɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji nyɛdasefonyo. Owo oŋa lɛ shi akɛ obaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi onyɛɛɛ lɛ anɔkwa lɛ oye; tsɛbelɛ lɛ ji onaanyo kɛ oŋa fɛɛ yɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa. 15Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ ji mɔ ni bɔ wala, asaŋ ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaa wala mumɔ lɛ yi ehã wɔ lɛ lo? Ni mɛni etaoɔ yɛ wɔdɛŋ mɔ? Eekwɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛbaafɔ bii ni baatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔkwale mli. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni shi ni nyɛwo nyɛblahiiaŋ ŋamɛi lɛ nyɛkaku mli kɛtsɔ̃ anɔkwa ni nyɛyeee nɔ. 16Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, “Miihi mligbalamɔ. Miihi kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ye eŋa nɛkɛ sane. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni shi ni nyɛwo lɛ nyɛkakwaa.”
Kojomɔ gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ
17“Nyɛhã etɔ Yehowa kɛ nyɛwiemɔi lɛ.” Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔkɛhã etɔ lɛ?’ Ejɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ lɛ, ehi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni Yehowa yɛ mɔ lɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.’ Ni nyɛbiɔ hu akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane lɛ yɔɔ?”

Title: MALEAKI 3
Content:
1 Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ koni ebasaa gbɛ lɛ eto mi. Kɛkɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ lɛ baaba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ trukaa. Kpãŋmɔ Bɔfo lɛ ni nyɛshwe lɛ aahu lɛ aaashɛ shi.”
2 Shi namɔ baanyɛ ekpee ebaa lɛ naa? Ni namɔ aaanyɛ shi adamɔ be ni eeebapue lɛ? Ejaakɛ etamɔ niiahetsuulɔ la loo niiahefɔlɔ samla. 3 Ebaata shi tamɔ jwiɛtɛi hetsuulɔ ni hãa jwiɛtɛi he tseɔ keŋkeŋ lɛ. Nakai ebaatsuu osɔfoi ni ji Levi shwiei lɛ ahe keŋkeŋ tamɔ atsuɔ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi he lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛkɛ afɔleshãa nikeenii ni kpa bɛ he aba abahã Yehowa. 4No dani Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii anikeenii ni amɛkɛbaahã Yehowa baasa ehiɛ tamɔ esa ehiɛ blema yɛ tsutsu afii lɛ amli lɛ.
5Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibatsi mabɛŋkɛ nyɛ koni makojo gbɔmɛi abii; mikɛ sane baashi mɛi ni sheee mi gbeyei lɛ oya nɔŋŋ, ŋkunyaayelɔi kɛ gbãlãfitelɔi kɛ mɛi ni kãmɔɔ amale kitã lɛ. Nakai nɔŋŋ maye odase mashi mɛi ni shishiuɔ apaafoi yɛ nyɔmɔwoo mli kɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ yoo okulafo kɛ awusa kɛ gbɔ sane hiɛ buɔ shi lɛ.”
6“Yehowa ji mi, mitsakeee; ni no hewɔ ni nyɛ, Yakob shwiei, nyɛpleneko kɛbashi benɛ nɛɛ lɛ. 7Nyɛgba afã yɛ mikpɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ, tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu fee kɛjɛ blema lɛ, ni nyɛyeee amɛnɔ. Nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ, ni mi hu mibakpale kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ. “Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ wɔɔtsɔ̃ wɔkpale?’ 8Shi nɔ ni mibiɔ nyɛ ji akɛ, aso eja gbɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa ashishiu Nyɔŋmɔ lo? Dabida! Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi. Nyɛaabi akɛ, ‘Yɛ mɛni mli?’ Yɛ nibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ afɔlei ni nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ mli. 9 Naa, nyɛmiilomɔ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛ maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi. 10 Nyɛkɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ fɛɛ abaa nitoohe lɛ koni niyenii ahi miwe lɛ! Nyɛkɛ enɛ akaa mi nyɛkwɛa akɛ migbeleŋ ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni mifɔseŋ jɔɔmɔ mishwieŋ nyɛnɔ ni ateke nɔ lo? 11Nyɛhewɔ lɛ mibatsi baalabii ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ anaa mahã nyɛ koni amɛkafite nyɛŋmɔshi nibii; ni nyɛwain tsei ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ baawo babaoo. 12Kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ mli majimaji fɛɛ baabu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni ajɔɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaatsɔ̃ maŋ ni mii eshɛ ehe.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Musuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ
13Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwie wiemɔi ni naa wa yɛ mihe. Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni mli wɔwieɔ wɔshiɔ bo yɛ?’ 14Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Sɛɛnamɔ bɛ he akɛ asɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. Kɛji wɔye egbee nɔ, aloo wɔnyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kwraa po tamɔ mɛi ni agbo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ mli? 15Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa jeŋ moŋ ji akɛ mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ. Ni jeee shweremɔ kɛkɛ mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii shwereɔ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ kaa Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkwɛɔ, ni amɛjeɔ toigbalamɔ mli sɔkee.’ ”
16Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ kɛ amɛhe wie. Yehowa bo amɛ toi, ni enu nɔ ni amɛtao. Mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, ni asaŋ amɛjwɛŋɔ egbɛi lɛ hiɛnyamwoo he lɛ aŋmala amɛgbɛii awo wolo mli koni akɛkai amɛ. 17Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ mimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ krɛdɛɛ, gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii lɛ. Mikɛ amɛhe baake amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni tsɛ Ataa kɛ ebi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ he keɔ lɛ lɛ. 18No dani nyɛbaana ekoŋŋ nɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ jalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ teŋ, kɛ srɔto ni yɔɔ mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ.”

Title: MALEAKI 4
Content:
Yehowa Gbi lɛ miishɛ
1Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, gbi ko miiba; ni emli edɔ la tamɔ flɔnɔɔ. Eshishɛɛ lɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ abele gbetselii; ebaashã amɛ bɔ ni eshwɛŋ eko eko shishifã loo tso nine. 2Shi nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ mi gbeyei lɛ, mihewalɛ lɛ baate shi tamɔ jalɛ hulu ahã nyɛ, ni eeetsa nyɛ. Nyɛaaje kpo kɛ nyamɔ kɛ tuumɔ tamɔ tsinabii ni agbele amɛ. 3Gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaanaanaa mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛnajiashi ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ lamlu.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
4“Nyɛkaia nibii ni mitsulɔ Mose etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni ji mlai kɛ akpɔi kɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔi ni mikɛhã lɛ yɛ Horeb Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛbahã Israelbii koni amɛye nɔ lɛ.
5 “Shi dani nakai Yehowa gbi wulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ baashɛ lɛ, mibatsu Gbalɔ Elia kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ. 6Ebaahã tsɛmɛi asumɔ amɛbii ekoŋŋ, ni bii hu aaasumɔ amɛtsɛmɛi ekoŋŋ, koni mikaba mibakpãtã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ hiɛ.”

Title: MATEO WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Mateo Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ, Yesu ji yiwalaherelɔ lɛ. Lɛ ji mɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ eye shi ni ewo ewebii lɛ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli lɛ nɔ. Sanekpakpa nɛɛ ejeee Yudafoi, mɛi ateŋ ni afɔ Yesu yɛ kɛ mɛi ateŋ ni ehi lɛ, kɛkɛ anɔŋ; shi moŋ eji je nɛɛŋ bii fɛɛ anɔ.
Mateo Sanekpakpa lɛ ato emli sane lɛ naa aŋma lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Akɛ Yesu fɔmɔ he sane lɛ je shishi; bɔ ni asɔle lɛ kɛ bɔ ni aka lɛ ahã. Atsa nɔ kɛ Yesu shiɛmɔ nitsumɔ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ emɛi atsamɔ yɛ Galilea lɛ. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ sane lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Yesu fã gbɛ kɛjɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm; nɔ ni ba enɔ yɛ jɛi, yɛ nakai otsi lɛ mli, egbele kɛ eshitee yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Mateo Sanekpakpa lɛ jieɔ Yesu kpo faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kpanaa ji lɛ. Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ. Etsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli he sane faŋŋ. Enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ ajara mli enumɔ.
1. Gɔŋ nɔ shiɛmɔ ni kɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he. Etsɔ̃ɔ jeŋba kpakpa, gbɔmɔ gbɛnaa, nitsumɔ kɛ nɔ ni baaba ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeliŋ bii lɛ anɔ yɛ jeŋ nɛɛ mli (Yitsei 5-7).
2. Kaselɔi 12 lɛ asane-kpakpashiɛmɔ lɛ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ (Yitso 10)
3. Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he abɛi lɛ (Yitso 13).
4. Kaselɔfeemɔ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ (Yitso 18).
5. Je nɛɛŋ naagbee kɛ wɔsɛɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli ni baaba lɛ he sane (Yitsei 24-25).
Mlijaramɔi
Nuŋtsɔ Yesu fɔmɔ kɛ eweku kpãa 1.1—2.23
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ 3.1-12
Yesu baptismɔ kɛ ekaa 3.13—4.11
Yesu shiɛmɔ nitsumɔ yɛ Galilea 4.12—18.35
Yesu jɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm 19.1—20.34
Naagbee otsi lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm 21.1—27.66
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shitee kɛ ehekpojiemɔi 28.1-20

Title: MATEO 1
Content:
Yesu Kristo Wekukpãa
(Luka 3.23-38)
1Wolo wekukpãa Yesu Kristo, bi David, bi Abraham bi. 2 Abraham fɔ Isak, Isak fɔ Yakob, ni Yakob fɔ Yuda kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ; 3 Yuda kɛ Tamar fɔ Perez kɛ Zera, Perez fɔ Hezron, ni Hezron fɔ Ram; 4Ram fɔ Aminadab, Aminadab fɔ Nahashon, ni Nahashon fɔ Salmon; 5 Salmon kɛ Rahab fɔ Boaz, Boaz kɛ Rut fɔ Obed, ni Obed fɔ Ishai; 6 Ishai fɔ Maŋtsɛ David, ni David kɛ Uria ŋa lɛ fɔ Solomon. 7 Solomon fɔ Rehoboam, Rehoboam fɔ Abia, ni Abia fɔ Asa; 8Asa fɔ Yehoshafat, Yehoshafat fɔ Yoram, ni Yoram fɔ Uzia; 9Uzia fɔ Yotam, Yotam fɔ Ahaz, ni Ahaz fɔ Hezekia; 10Hezekia fɔ Manase, Manase fɔ Amon, ni Amon fɔ Yosia; 11 Yosia fɔ Yekonia kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, be ni abaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ. 12 Ni be ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yekonia fɔ Shealtiel ni Shealtiel, fɔ Zerubabel, 13Zerubabel fɔ Abiud, Abiud fɔ Eliakim, ni Eliakim fɔ Azor; 14Azor fɔ Sadok, Sadok fɔ Akim, ni Akim fɔ Eliud; 15Eliud fɔ Eleazar, Eleazar fɔ Matan, ni Matan fɔ Yakob; 16 Yakob fɔ Yosef ni ji Maria ni fɔ Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ wu lɛ.
17Belɛ yinɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Abraham nɔ kɛbashi David nɔ lɛ feɔ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ; ni kɛjɛ David nɔ kɛbashi Babilon nomŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ, ni kɛjɛ Babilon nomŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi Kristo nɔ lɛ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Yesu fɔmɔ
(Luka 2.1-7)
18 Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni Yesu Kristo fɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛ. Enyɛ Maria lɛ, be ni Yosef etsɛ ehe baa ni amɛnako amɛhi shi lɛ, ana akɛ ehiɛ musu kɛjɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli. 19Shi Yosef, ewu lɛ, akɛni jalɔ ji lɛ ni etaooo akɛ ebɔ lɛ ahora lɛ eto eyiŋ akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe kpoo. 20 Shi be ni ejwɛŋɔ nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yosef, David bi, kaashe oŋa Maria lɛ ŋɔɔ gbeyei, shi musu ni ehiɛ nɛɛ ejɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, 21 ebaafɔ binuu, ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu, ejaakɛ lɛ ebaahere emaŋ lɛ yiwala kɛjɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ amli.”
22 Shi enɛ fɛɛ ba, koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ,
23“Naa, oblayoo foro lɛ aaana musu,
Ni eeefɔ binuu, ni amɛaawo lɛ
gbɛi akɛ Imanuel, eshishi ji
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ.”
24Ni be ni Yosef te shi kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli lɛ, efee bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni eŋɔ eŋa lɛ; 25 shi eleee lɛ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni efɔ binuu. Ni Yosef wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.

Title: MATEO 2
Content:
Nilelɔi ni jɛ bokã lɛ
1 Be ni afɔ Yesu yɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Herode yinɔ lɛ, nilelɔi jɛ bokã ba Yerusalɛm babi akɛ, 2 “Nɛgbɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ ni afɔ lɛ yɔɔ? Wɔna eŋulami lɛ yɛ bokã ni wɔba ni wɔbaja lɛ.” 3Shi be ni Maŋtsɛ Herode nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛ Yerusalɛm fɛɛ yoyoro; 4ni ebua maŋ lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ebi amɛ he ni aaafɔ Kristo lɛ yɛ. 5 Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea; shi bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ ŋma nɛ,
6 ‘Ni bo, Betlehem ni oyɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
jeee bo ji bibioo fe fɛɛ
yɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ ateŋ kwraa,
shi omli lumɔ
ni aaakwɛ mimaŋ Israel lɛ aaajɛ!’ ”
7Kɛkɛ ni Herode tsɛ nilelɔi lɛ nigii, ni ebi amɛ fitsofitso beyinɔ ni ŋulami lɛ pue. 8Ni ehã amɛtee Betlehem ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyataoa abifao lɛ fitsofitso; ni kɛ nyɛna lɛ lɛ, nyɛbakɛa mi, koni mi hu maya ni mayaja lɛ.” 9Be ni amɛnu maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee. Ni ŋulami lɛ ni amɛna yɛ bokã lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ aahu, kɛyashi ebadamɔ he ni abifao lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ. 10Ni be ni amɛna ŋulami lɛ, amɛna miishɛɛ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. 11 Ni amɛtee shĩa lɛ, ni amɛna abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ Maria lɛ; ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ. Amɛfɛne amɛkotokui anaa, ni amɛkekee lɛ nii: shika kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ mire. 12Ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli akɛ amɛkaku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee Herode ŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ kroko nɔ kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Foijee kɛ Ijipt yaa
13Ni be ni amɛtee lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi; ŋɔɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni ojo foi oya Ijipt, ni ohi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni makɛɛ bo nɔ ko; shi Herode baatao abifao lɛ ni egbe lɛ,” 14Ni ete shi eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni eyiŋ etee Ijipt. 15 Ni ehi shi yɛ jɛi kɛyashi Herode gbo; koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Ijipt mitsɛ mibi lɛ kɛjɛ.”
Betlehem abifabii lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ
16Agbɛnɛ be ni Herode na akɛ nilelɔi lɛ yeee lɛ anɔkwa lɛ, emli fu waa, ni etsu ayagbe gbekɛbii hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Betlehem kɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, mɛi ni eye afii enyɔ kɛ mɛi ni yeko nakai lɛ, kɛji abu kɛjɛ be ni ebi nilelɔi lɛ sane lɛ fitsofitso lɛ. 17No ni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ ba mli akɛ,
18 “Anu gbee ko yɛ Rama,
yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli babaoo;
Rahel miifo ebii,
ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ miishɛjemɔ,
ejaakɛ amɛbɛ.”
Sɛɛkuu kɛ Ijipt jɛɛ
19Shi be ni Herode egbo lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli yɛ Ijipt, 20 ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi ni oŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ ni oya Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni taoɔ abifao lɛ amɛgbe lɛ amɛgboi.”
21Ni Yosef te shi ni eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni eba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 22Shi be ni enu akɛ Arkelao miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yudea yɛ etsɛ Herode sɛɛ lɛ, eshe jɛiyaa gbeyei; ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli lɛ, edɔ eyi kɛtee Galilea niiaŋ. 23 Ni eba ebahi maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli, koni nɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Aaatsɛ lɛ Nazarenyo.”

Title: MATEO 3
Content:
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ
(Marko 1.1-8; Luka 3.1-9, 15-17; Yohane 1.19-28)
1 Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ba ebashiɛ yɛ Yudea ŋa lɛ nɔ, 2 ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui; shi ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.” 3 Shi mɔ nɛ ji mɔ he ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie akɛ,
“Mɔ ko gbee miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ,
‘Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ!
Ni nyɛfea etɛmpɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ!’ ”
4 Shi lɛ Yohane lɛ, yooma hetsɔi akɛlo etade, ni wolo kpãa fĩ emliteŋ, ni eniyenii ji baalabii kɛ ŋa nɔ wo. 5Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea fɛɛ kɛ Yordan niiaŋ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ; 6ni ebaptisi amɛ yɛ Yordan faa lɛ mli, be ni amɛjajeɔ emɛhe eshai lɛ.
7 Shi be ni ena Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii baa ebaptisimɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Shinɔi ashwiei, namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛjo mlifu ni baaba lɛ naa foi? 8Belɛ nyɛwoa yibii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ mɔ! 9 Ni nyɛkasusua ni nyɛkɛɛ yɛ nyɛmli akɛ, ‘Wɔ lɛ wɔtsɛ ji Abraham;’ shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ etee bii ashi kɛjɛ tɛi nɛɛ amli ehã Abraham. 10 Shi lema lɛ kã tsei lɛ ashishifã lɛ nɔ momo; hewɔ lɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ atoɔ afɔɔ shi, ni ashɛɔ afɔɔ la mli. 11 Mi lɛ, nu mikɛbaptisiɔ nyɛ hã tsuitsakemɔ; shi mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ehe wa fe mi; etokotai tete misaaa mɔ ni hiɛɔ. Lɛ eeebaptisi nyɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ la. 12 Ehiɛ eshaatsene yɛ edɛŋ, ni ebaabɛɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fitsofitso, ni ebaabua eŋmaa lɛ naa eto eboŋo mli; shi tutuu lɛ, ekɛ la ni gbooo baashã.”
Yesu baptisimɔ
(Marko 1.9-11; Luka 3.21-22)
13Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jɛ Galilea eba Yohane ŋɔɔ yɛ Yordan naa, koni ebaptisi lɛ. 14Shi Yohane tsi lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, “Mi moŋ ni ehia mi akɛ bo obaptisiɔ mi lɛ, ni bo obaa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ?” 15Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpɛlɛ̃mɔ kɛkɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ sa akɛ wɔgbeɔ jalɛ fɛɛ naa.” Kɛkɛ ni ekpɛlɛ̃. 16Ni be ni abaptisi Yesu lɛ, ejɛ nu lɛ mli amrɔ eje kpo; ni naa, agbele ŋwɛi naa ahã lɛ, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ miikpeleke shi tamɔ okpo kɛmiiba enɔ. 17 Ni naa, gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni mina ehe tsui lɛ.”

Title: MATEO 4
Content:
Yesu kaa
(Marko 1.12-13; Luka 4.1-13)
1 Kɛkɛ ni Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔ Yesu kɛtee ŋa nɔ, koni abonsam ayaka lɛ. 2 Ni be ni ehi ŋmaa shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ. 3 Ni abonsam lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, fã koni tɛi nɛɛ atsɔ̃mɔ aboloo.” 4 Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Jeee aboloo kɛkɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala; shi mɔŋ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni jɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ daaŋ lɛ.’ ”
5 Kɛkɛ ni abonsam lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yiteŋ he ni yɔɔ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ, 6 ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, kɛ ohe atswa shi; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Ohewɔ lɛ eeefã ebɔfoi lɛ ni amɛaahiɛ bo yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni okɛ onane akashi tɛ ko.’ ” 7 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma ekoŋŋ akɛ, ‘Kaaka Nuŋtsɔ, bo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ” 8Asaŋ abonsam lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ni kwɔ somromoo ko nɔ, ni ekɛ jeŋ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ kɛ amɛnunyam lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ; 9ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baahã bo, kɛji okula shi oja mi lɛ.” 10 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee mihiɛ, Satan! Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ oja, ni lɛ kɛkɛ osɔ̃mɔ!’ ” 11 Kɛkɛ ni abonsam lɛ shi lɛ, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi ba ni amɛbasɔmɔ lɛ.
Galilea nitsumɔ lɛ shishijee
(Marko 1.14-15; Luka 4.14-15)
12 Shi be ni Yesu nu akɛ amɔ Yohane lɛ, eyiŋ etee Galilea. 13 Ehiii shi yɛ Nazaret shi moŋ ebahi Kapernaum maŋ ko ni kã ŋshɔ naa, yɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali niiaŋ, 14 koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ lɛ aba mli akɛ,
15“Zebulon shikpɔŋ kɛ Naftali shikpɔŋ,
Ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ, yɛ Yordan sɛɛ lɛ,
Galilea, jeŋmaji ashikpɔŋ lɛ,
16Maŋ ni ta duŋ mli lɛ,
ena la kpeteŋkple,
ni mɛi ni tara gbele shikpɔŋ,
kɛ ehɔ̃ɔŋ mli lɛ,
la ete shi ehã amɛ!”
17 Kɛjɛ no nɔ lɛ Yesu bɔ̃i shiɛmɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui; shi ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ!”
Wolɛi ejwɛ atsɛmɔ
(Marko 1.16-20; Luka 5.1-11)
18Be ni Yesu kpaa shi yɛ Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi enyɔ, Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea, ni amɛmiihɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ wolɛi ji amɛ. 19Ni etsɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbanyiɛa misɛɛ, ni mafee nyɛ wolɛi ni baahɛ gbɔmɛi.” 20Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi amɛyai lɛ, ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ. 21Ni be ni eje jɛi eyaa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi krokomɛi enyɔ, Zebedeo bi Yakobo kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ Zebedeo yɛ lɛlɛ mli amɛmiikpɛ amɛyai lɛ; ni etsɛ amɛ. 22Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi lɛlɛ lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛ lɛ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii, eshiɛ ni etsa helai
23 Ni Yesu kpa Galilea muu lɛ fɛɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni eshiɛɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni etsaa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejaramɔ fɛɛ hejaramɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli. 24 Ni ehe sane gbɛ shwã Siria fɛɛ, ni akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɛ hewalɛ ni helai kɛ piŋmɔi srɔtoi hiɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ gbligbli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ kuumɔhela ba eŋɔɔ, ni etsa amɛ. 25 Ni asafoi pii jɛ Galilea kɛ Dekapoli kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Yordan sɛɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.

Title: MATEO 5
Content:
Gɔŋ nɔ shiɛmɔ
(Luka 6.17-19)
1Shi be ni ena mɛi pii lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eho eta shi ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ. 2Ni egbele enaa etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekɛɛ,
3 “Ajɔɔ mumɔ lɛ mli ohiafoi lɛ; shi amɛnɔ ji ŋwɛi
maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”
4 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ; shi aaashɛje amɛmii.”
5 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.”
6 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni jalɛ he hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai yeɔ amɛ lɛ; shi amɛaatɔrɔ.”
7 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni naa mɔbɔ; shi aaana amɛ mɔbɔ.”
8 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni tsuii amli tse lɛ; shi amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ.”
9 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni kpãtãa lɛ; shi aaatsɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ bii.”
10 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni jalɛ hewɔ ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ; shi amɛnɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”
11 “Ajɔɔ nyɛ, kɛji ajɛ nyɛ ni awa nyɛ yi ni amale awie nyɛhe efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ yɛ mihewɔ lɛ,
12 nyɛnyaa ni nyɛmli afilia nyɛ ejaakɛ nyɛnyɔmɔwo fa yɛ ŋwɛi; shi nakai amɛwa gbalɔi ni tsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ lɛ ayi.”
Ŋoo kɛ la
(Marko 9.50; Luka 14.34-35)
13 “Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋoo ji nyɛ. Shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni akɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ? Ehiii hãaa nɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja atsi ashwie, ni gbɔmɛi naanaa nɔ. 14 Nyɛ ji je lɛ mli la lɛ. Maŋ ni ma gɔŋ nɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ akɛtee. 15 Asaŋ asuuu kane amaaa tsese shishi; shi moŋ akɛmaa kanetso nɔ, ni etsoɔ ehãa mɛi ni yɔɔ shĩa lɛ fɛɛ. 16 Nakai nyɛhãa nyɛla atsoa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, koni amɛna nyɛnifeemɔnii kpakpai lɛ, ni amɛwo nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.”
Mla lɛ he nitsɔɔmɔ
17 “Nyɛkasusua akɛ miba Mla lɛ loo gbalɔi lɛ aguu; mibaaa guu shi moŋ miba ni mabahã eye emuu. 18 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ hoko nɛɛ, yota kome loo kuli kome ejeŋ Mla lɛ mli hoŋ, ja fɛɛ eba mli. 19No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagoi kitãi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ ekome ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nakai lɛ, aaatsɛ lɛ bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye Mla lɛ nɔ ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ agbo yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. 20Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛjalɛ lɛ faaa kɛtekeee mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛboteŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa.”
Mlifu he nitsɔɔmɔ
21 “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaagbe gbɔmɔ! Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli.’ 22 Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mli fuɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ enyɛmi akɛ, ‘Yaka gbɔmɔ’ lɛ eeeye gwabɔɔ lɛ hiɛ fɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Buulu’ lɛ eeeye abonsamiiaje la lɛ mliyaa fɔ. 23 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji okɛ onɔkeenɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni okai yɛ jɛi akɛ onyɛmi kɛ bo yɛ sane ko lɛ, 24shi onɔkeenɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni oya okɛ onyɛmi lɛ ayakpãtã dã, koni oba ni okɛ onɔkeenɔ lɛ abahã. 25 Okɛ obelɔ lɛ atsa mra, be ni okɛ lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ, koni obelɔ lɛ kɛ bo akahã kojolɔ lɛ, ni kojolɔ lɛ kɛ bo hã tsuŋwolɔ lɛ, ni akɛ bo wo tsuŋ. 26Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale mli akɛ ojeŋ jɛi ojeŋ kpo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooowo naagbee pesewa lɛ.”
Gbãlãfitemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ
27 “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaafite gbãlã!’ 28 Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ yoo ni ehe feɔ lɛ akɔnɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ efite gbãlã momo yɛ etsui mli. 29 Shi kɛji oninejurɔ hiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ fãa ni oshɛ ofɔ; ejaakɛ ehi hã bo akɛ ohenii lɛ eko fiteɔ, koni akashɛ ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje. 30Ni kɛji oninejurɔ miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo ni oshɛ ofɔ̃; ejaakɛ ehi hã bo akɛ ohenii lɛ eko fiteɔ, koni ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ akaya abonsamiiaje.”
Gbãlã mligbalamɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ
(Mateo 19.9; Marko 10.11-12; Luka 16.18)
31 “Asaŋ akɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaashwie eŋa lɛ ehã lɛ shwiemɔ wolo.’ 32 Shi mi lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ sane hewɔŋ lɛ ehãa yoo lɛ fiteɔ gbãlã; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mɔ ni ashwie lɛ lɛ, fiteɔ gbãlã.”
Kitãkãmɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ
33 “Asaŋ nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaakã amale kitã, shi ye okitãi lɛ anɔ ohã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.’ 34 Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkakãa kitã kwraa! Kaakã ŋwɛi, shi Nyɔŋmɔ sɛi ni; 35 loo shikpɔŋ, shi enajiaŋshi maaŋoo ni; loo Yerusalɛm, shi Maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ maŋ ni. 36Ni okakã oyitso tete, ejaakɛ onyɛŋ ofee yitsɔi kome eyɛŋ loo ediŋ. 37 Shi nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ afea: ‘Hɛɛ, hɛɛ!’ ‘Dabi, dabi!’ Shi nɔ ni fe enɛɛmɛi lɛ ejɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ mli.”
Oweletɔɔ
(Luka 6.29-30)
38 “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hiŋmɛi yɛ hiŋmɛi najiaŋ; nyanyɔŋ yɛ nyanyɔŋ najiaŋ.’ 39 Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkatsia mɔ fɔŋ lɛ gbɛ, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagba oninejurɔ toiŋ lɛ, tsɔ̃ ekome lɛ hu ohã lɛ. 40 Ni kɛji mɔ ko tao akɛ ekɛ bo aye sane ni eshɔ̃ oflaka lɛ, hã eŋɔ ohebo lɛ hu. 41Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaanyɛ onɔ akɛ okɛ lɛ anyiɛ shitoo kome lɛ, okɛ lɛ aya enyɔ. 42Mɔ ni baa bo nɔ ko lɛ hã lɛ, ni mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ofa lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ ohe oshi lɛ.”
Henyɛlɔi asuɔmɔ
(Luka 6.27-28, 32-36)
43 “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ, ‘Suɔmɔ onaanyo, ni onyɛ ohenyɛlɔ.’ 44 Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ, 45 koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ bii, ejaakɛ ehãa ehulu teɔ shi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai anɔ. Ni ehaa nyɔŋmɔ nɛɔ yɛ jalɔi kɛ mɛi ni ejaaa lɛ anɔ. 46Shi kɛji nyɛsumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ, mɛɛ nyɔmɔwoo nyɛyɔɔ? Ani toohelɔi lɛ tete efeee nakai nɔŋŋ? 47Ni kɛji nyɛ ŋaa nyɛnyɛmimɛi kɛkɛ lɛ, mɛni nyɛfeɔ ni teke nɔ? Ani jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ tete efeee nakai nɔŋŋ? 48 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhia kɛwulaa shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hi kɛwula shi lɛ.”

Title: MATEO 6
Content:
Ejurɔfeemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ
1 “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa ni nyɛkafea nyɛjalɛnii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ koni amɛna nyɛ; no lɛ, nyɛbɛ nyɔmɔwoo ko yɛ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ dɛŋ. 2No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ oofee ejurɔ lɛ, kaashiɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi, tamɔ osatofoi lɛ feɔ yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ blohui lɛ amli koni gbɔmɛi ajie amɛyi. Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo. 3 Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oofee ejurɔ lɛ, kaahã obɛku le nɔ ni oninejurɔ feɔ, 4koni ojurɔfeemɔ lɛ ahi teemɔ mli, ni oTsɛ lɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.”
Sɔlemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ
(Luka 11.2-4)
5 “Ni kɛ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ osatofoi lɛ; shi amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛdamɔ kpeehei lɛ kɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoi amɛsɔle, koni mɛi ana amɛ. Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo. 6 Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oosɔle lɛ, botemɔ opia mli, ni oŋa oshinaa lɛ, ni osɔle otsɛ oTsɛ yɛ teemɔ mli; ni oTsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.
7 “Shi kɛji nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkawiea trilii tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ; shi amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛwiemɔ babaoo lɛ hewɔ aaabo amɛ toi. 8 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ amɛ; shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ le nii ni hiaa nyɛ dani nyɛbiɔ lɛ.”
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ lɛ
(Luka 11.2-4)
9 “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsɔlea nɛkɛ,
‘WɔTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi,
ogbɛi lɛ he atse;
10 omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aba.
Afee nɔ ni osumɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
tamɔ afeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ.
11Hã wɔ ŋmɛnɛ wɔdaaŋmaa;
12 ni okɛ wɔnyɔji lɛ ake wɔ,
tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔkɛkeɔ mɛi ni hiɛ wɔ nyɔji lɛ.
13 Ni okɛ wɔ akaya kaa mli;
shi jiemɔ wɔ kɛjɛ efɔŋ mli.
[Shi onɔ ji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ
kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ anunyam lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ. Amen.’]
14“Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔi fa amɛ lɛ, nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛaafa nyɛ hu. 15 Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔi efaaa amɛ lɛ, nyɛTsɛ lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaŋ nyɛ.”
Ŋmaahilɛ
16 “Shi kɛji nyɛmiihi ŋmaa lɛ nyɛkafea nyɛhiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ tamɔ osatofoi lɛ; shi amɛfeɔ amɛhiɛ nyanyaanya, koni mɛi ana akɛ amɛmiihi ŋmaa. Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo. 17Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oohi ŋmaa lɛ, kpa oyi mli mu ni ofɔ ohiɛ; 18koni mɔ ko akana akɛ oohi ŋmaa, akɛ ja oTsɛ ni anaaa lɛ lɛ; ni oTsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.”
Ŋwɛi jwetri
(Luka 12.33-34)
19 “Nyɛkabɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni omlɛgɛ kɛ ŋkanale fiteɔ nii ni julɔi gbuɔ kɛboteɔ mli kɛbajuɔ yɛ lɛ. 20 Shi nyɛbɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi, he ni omlɛgɛ kɛ ŋkanale fiteee nii ni julɔi egbuuu kɛboteee mli kɛyajuuu yɛ lɛ. 21Shi he ni ojwetri yɔɔ lɛ jɛi otsui aaahi.”
Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane
(Luka 11.34-36)
22“Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane ji hiŋmɛi. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tse lɛ ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ aaayi kɛ la. 23Shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tseee lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ aaawo duŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji la ni yɔɔ omli lɛ ji duŋ lɛ, te no duŋ lɛ aaafa ahã tɛŋŋ!”
Henaagbamɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ
(Luka 12.22-31)
24 “Mɔ ko nyɛŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi enyɔ asɔ̃mɔ; ejaakɛ no lɛ eeenyɛ mɔ kome ni eeesumɔ mɔ kroko lɛ; aloo eeekpɛtɛ mɔ kome he, ni eeebu mɔ kroko lɛ akɛ ejeee mɔ ko. Nyɛnyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mamona (ninamɔ) nyɛsɔ̃mɔ.
25 “No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛkafea yeyeeye yɛ nyɛwala he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaanu hewɔ, aloo yɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawo hewɔ. Ani wala efeee ŋmaa, ni gbɔmɔtso efeee atade? 26 Nyɛkwɛa ŋwɛi loofɔji lɛ: amɛduuu nii, asaŋ amɛkpaaa nii, asaŋ amɛbuaaa naa amɛwooo aboŋoi amli; shi nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ lɛɔ amɛ kɛ̃. Ani nyɛhiii aahu fe amɛ? 27Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ aaanyɛ atsa ekwɔlɛ nɔ ninetalɔ kome? 28Ni mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛfeɔ yeyeeye yɛ atade hewɔ? Nyɛjwɛŋa ŋa nɔ fɔfɔii lɛ ahe, bɔ ni amɛdaraa; amɛgbooo deŋme, asaŋ amɛtsɛ̃ɛɛ kpãa. 29 Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Solomon kɛ enunyam lɛ fɛɛ tete ewulaaa tamɔ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ ekome. 30Shi kɛji ŋa nɔ jwɛi ni ŋmɛnɛ eyɛ ni wɔ ni ashɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wulaa nɛkɛ lɛ, ani efeŋ nɔ ni fe enɛ ehaŋ nyɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa lɛ lo? 31No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔɔye, aloo mɛni wɔɔnu, mɛni hu wɔkɛ aha wɔhe?’ 32Ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ diɔ. Shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ le akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ he miihia nyɛ. 33 Shi nyɛtaoa Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ ejalɛ lɛ tsutsu ni akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ aaafata he ahã nyɛ. 34 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛtoa wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔ aaahao yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. Gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ efɔŋ lɛ fa hã lɛ.”

Title: MATEO 7
Content:
Kojomɔ
(Luka 6.37-42)
1 “Nyɛkakojoa, koni akakojo nyɛ. 2 Shi nɔ kojomɔ ni nyɛkɛkojoɔ lɛ, akɛaakojo nyɛ; ni nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, akɛasusu ahã nyɛ. 3Shi mɛɛba onaa kuli ni yɔɔ onyɛmi hiŋmɛi mli lɛ, shi bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli mplaŋ lɛ oyooo lɛ? 4Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni oookɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, ‘Hã majie kuli lɛ yɛ ohiŋmɛi mli,’ be mli ni mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ? 5Osatofo, jiemɔ mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli tsutsu, ni no dani ooona nii faŋŋ ni ojie kuli lɛ yɛ onyɛmi lɛ hiŋmɛi mli. 6Nyɛkɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akahãa shifɔji; asaŋ nyɛkashɛrɛa nyɛdiagbai nyɛshwiea kplotoi ahiɛ, ni amɛbanaana nɔ yɛ amɛnajiashi, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe amɛbatserɛ nyɛ.”
Bimɔ, taomɔ kɛ shimɔ
(Luka 11.5-13)
7 “Nyɛbia, ni aaahã nyɛ; nyɛtaoa, ni nyɛaana; nyɛshia, ni aaagbele ahã nyɛ. 8Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ lɛ, enine shɛɔ nɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ lɛ, enaa; ni mɔ ni shiɔ lɛ aaagbele ahã lɛ. 9Aloo nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ? 10Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ ŋshɔŋloo, ni eeehã lɛ onufu? 11 Belɛ kɛji nyɛ ni nyɛ ji mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ nyɛle bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ nyɛkɛ nikpakpai hãa nyɛbii lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ eŋɔŋ nikpakpai ehaŋ mɛi ni biɔ lɛ lɛ?
Mla ni jara wa lɛ
12 “No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mɛi afee nyɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ enɛ ji Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ.”
Agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ
13 “Nyɛbotea agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ mli! Ejaakɛ agbo ni lɛɛ kɛ gbɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, ni mɛi ni boteɔ mli lɛ fa. 14 Shi agbo fintɔŋŋ kɛ gbɛ ni etsa ji nɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli lɛ, ni mɛi fioo ji mɛi ni naa no.”
Amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛaale amɛ
(Luka 6.43-44)
15 “Shi nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ amale gbalɔi lɛ ahe; amɛkɛ too wolo haa amɛhe kɛbaa nyɛŋɔɔ, shi amɛmligbɛ lɛ klãji fulɔi ji amɛ. 16 Amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛaale amɛ. Ani atseɔ wainyibii yɛ ŋmeitsei anɔ, aloo atseɔ agbãmii yɛ aŋlɛŋlɛi anɔ? 17Nakai nɔŋŋ tso fɛɛ tso ni ji ekpakpa lɛ woɔ yibii kpakpai; shi tso gbonyo woɔ yibii gbohii. 18Tso kpakpa nyɛɛɛ awo yibii gbohii, ni asaŋ tso gbonyo nyɛɛɛ awo yibii kpakpai. 19 Tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ, atoɔ lɛ ni ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ la mli. 20 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛale amɛ.”
Mileee nyɛ kwraa
21 “Jeee mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛɔ mi akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ!’ lɛ, aaabote ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; shi moŋ mɔ ni feɔ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ. 22 Mɛi pii aaakɛɛ mi nakai gbi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ! Ani jeee bo ogbɛi lɛ mli wɔfee hewalɛnii pii yɛ lo?’ 23 Ni no lɛ magba mli makɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mileee nyɛ kwraa, nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtsuɔ nibii ni ejaaa gbɛ!’ ”
Tsumalɔi enyɔ lɛ
(Luka 6.46-49)
24 “No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔi nɛɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ aaato nilelɔ ni ma etsu yɛ tɛsaa nɔ lɛ he. 25Ni nyɔŋmɔ tue, ni fai ba, ni kɔɔyɔi tswa, ni amɛshimɔ tsu lɛ, shi ewuleee; ejaakɛ ato shishi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ. 26Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔi nɛɛ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ aaato nuu kwashia ni ma etsu yɛ shia nɔ lɛ he. 27Ni nyɔŋmɔ tue, ni fai ba, ni kɔɔyɔi tswa, ni amɛshimɔ tsu lɛ, ni ewule, ni ewulemɔ lɛ da!”
28 Ni be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa lɛ, asafoi lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he; 29 ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii akɛ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ hegbɛ, shi jeee tamɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ.

Title: MATEO 8
Content:
Kpitiyelɔ ko tsamɔ
(Marko 1.40-45; Luka 5.12-16)
1Shi be ni Yesu jɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpeleke shi lɛ, asafoi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ. 2Ni naa, kpitiyelɔ ko ba ebakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse!” 3Ni Yesu kpã enine mli eta ehe ni ekɛɛ, “Miisumɔ, ohe atse!” Ni amrɔ lɛ ekpiti lɛ tã. 4 Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni okakɛɛ mɔ ko; shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni ohã keenii ni Mose to lɛ, ni no aaafee odase ahã amɛ.”
Asraafoiohaatsɛ ko wenuu tsamɔ
(Luka 7.1-10)
5Shi be ni Yesu bote Kapernaum lɛ, asraafoiohaatsɛ ko ba eŋɔɔ ebakpa lɛ fai, 6ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, miwenuu kã shi yɛ shĩa kɛ kuumɔhela, eena nɔ naakpa.” 7Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miiba ni mabatsa lɛ.” 8Ni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, esaaa mi akɛ obaa mikoi lɛ shi; shi moŋ wiemɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, ni aaatsa miwenuu lɛ. 9Ejaakɛ mi po ni mi ji gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nɔyeli shishi lɛ, miyɛ asraafoi yɛ mishishi, ni mikɛɔ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Yaa!’ Ni eyaa; kɛ mɔ kroko hu akɛ, ‘Ba!’ Ni ebaa; ni mikɛɔ mitsulɔ akɛ, ‘Feemɔ enɛ!’ Ni efeɔ.” 10 Shi be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ minako hemɔkɛyeli ni da tamɔ enɛ yɛ Israel! 11 Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɛi pii aaajɛ bokã kɛ anai aba, ni amɛkɛ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob aaabatara okplɔ̃ he yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. 12 Shi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli bii lɛ, aaashwie amɛ awo gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.” 13 Ni Yesu kɛɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, bɔ ni ohe oye lɛ, afee nakai ahã bo.” Ni atsa ewenuu lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.
Petro shaayoo tsamɔ
(Marko 1.29-34; Luka 4.38-39)
14 Ni be ni Yesu ba Petro we lɛ, ena eshaayoo lɛ kã shi kɛ atridii. 15Ni emɔ enineshi, ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ, ni ete shi ni esɔmɔ amɛ.
Helatsɛmɛi pii atsamɔ
(Marko 1.32-34; Luka 4.40-41)
16Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, akɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli ba eŋɔɔ. Ni ekɛ ewiemɔ fãmɔ mumɔi lɛ, ni etsa mɛi ni he yeɔ fɛɛ. 17 Koni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewo wɔhejaramɔi lɛ, ni etere wɔhelai lɛ.”
Mɛi ni taoɔ Yesu sɛɛ anyiɛ
(Luka 9.57-62)
18 Shi be ni Yesu na mɛi pii yɛ ehewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ afo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛya esɛɛgbɛ. 19Ni mlatsɔɔlɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛya he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.” 20 Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔi yɛ bui, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji yɛ tsui; shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ bɛ he ni ekɛ eyitso ŋmɛɔ.” 21 Ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ; ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni mayafu mitsɛ dã.” 22Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ, ni ohã gbohii afu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbohii.”
Yesu fã ahum yi ni efɔ̃ɔ tswaa
(Marko 4.35-41; Luka 8.22-25)
23Ni ebote lɛlɛ ko mli ni ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ. 24Ni naa; ŋshɔ lɛ fee hamahama aahu ni ŋshɔkei miikumɔ miiwo lɛlɛ lɛ mli; shi Yesu, ewɔ.
25Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsiɛ̃ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!” 26 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsheɔ gbeyei nɛkɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa?” Kɛkɛ ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ yi, ni eŋmɛ dɛmm. 27Shi gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ fee amɛ yaa amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɔmɔ srɔto nɛ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ ŋshɔ tete boɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?”
Yesu tsa hii enyɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli
(Marko 5.1-20; Luka 8.26-39)
28Be ni eyashɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbɛ yɛ Gadarabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɛi enyɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli ni amɛjɛ gbohii afũuhe lɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe; amɛhiɛ ewo la tsɔ̃ bɔ ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃. 29 Ni naa, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ? Ani oba biɛ ni obawo wɔ hejaramɔ dani be lɛ ashɛ?” 30Ni kplotoi akuu kpele ko miiye nii yɛ shɔŋŋ. 31Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji ofã wɔ lɛ hã wɔyabote kplotoi akuu lɛ mli.” 32Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa!” Ni amɛje kpo amɛyabote kplotoi akuu lɛ mli; ni naa, kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ wo foi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi yɛ nu lɛ mli. 33Ni mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛ lɛ jo foi, amɛtee maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛyagba saji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ anɔ lɛ hu. 34Ni naa, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ je kpo ni amɛkɛ Yesu ayakpe; ni be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ eje amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ eya.

Title: MATEO 9
Content:
Kuumɔ helatsɛ ko tsamɔ
(Marko 2.1-12; Luka 5.17-26)
1 Yesu bote lɛlɛ mli, ni efo ŋshɔ lɛ, ni eba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli. 2Ni naa, akɛ mɔ ko ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela ni kã saa nɔ ba eŋɔɔ. Ni be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ekɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela lɛ akɛ, “Bi, hã otsui anyɔ omli, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo!” 3 Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ yɛ amɛmli akɛ, “Musu mɔ nɛ bɔɔ nɛɛ.” 4 Ni be ni Yesu na amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ nii fɔ̃ji yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nɛɛ? 5Te emli nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jaraaa hu, akɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Aŋɔ ohe eshai lɛ afa bo,’ aloo ‘Tee shi ni onyiɛ’ lɛ? 6Shi be ni afee ni nyɛna akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ,” — kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni oya shĩa!” 7Ni ete shi etee shĩa. 8Shi be ni asafo lɛ na lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam akɛ ekɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ ehã gbɔmɛi.
Mateo tsɛmɔ
(Marko 2.13-17; Luka 5.27-32)
9Ni be ni Yesu je jɛi eyaa lɛ ena nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mateo ta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Ni ete shi enyiɛ esɛɛ.
10Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni eta niyenii ashi yɛ shĩa lɛ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi babaoo ba, ni amɛkɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ batara okplɔ̃ lɛ he. 11 Ni be ni Farisifoi lɛ na lɛ, amɛbi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii nɛɛ?” 12Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, tsofatsɛ he ehiaaa amɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ. 13 Shi nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakasea nɔ ni ji enɛ shishi. ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ mitaoɔ, ni jeee afɔle!’ Ejaakɛ mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi eshafeelɔi moŋ.”
Ŋmaahilɛ he sane
(Marko 2.18-22; Luka 5.33-39)
14 Kɛkɛ ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ wɔ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ fɔɔ ŋmaahilɛ, shi okaselɔi lɛ ehiii ŋmaa lɛ?” 15 Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani yookpeemɔ he bialɔi lɛ aaanyɛ aye ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ? Shi gbii aaaba momo ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaaje amɛteŋ kɛaatee, ni no dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.
16 “Shi mɔ ko kɛ mamanaa hee taaa atade momo; ejaakɛ nɔ ni akɛta lɛ yeɔ atade lɛ, ni folɔ lɛ lɛɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ. 17Asaŋ akɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli; no lɛ, wolo tɔi lɛ aaaflɛ, ni wain lɛ aaashwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ aaafite; shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli moŋ akɛwoɔ, ni enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ shweshweeshwe.”
Onukpa lɛ biyoo lɛ kɛ yoo ni ta Yesu atade he lɛ
(Marko 5.21-43; Luka 8.40-56)
18Be ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, onukpa ko ba bakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, “Mibiyoo eje mli amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ba ni okɛ onine abaŋmɛ enɔ, ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃.” 19Ni Yesu te shi ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
20Ni naa, yoo ko ni eye láfɔsemɔ hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ baje esɛɛgbɛ eta etade naamuu lɛ he. 21 Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Kɛji mina mita etade lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ, mihe aaawa mi.” 22Shi Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Biyoo, hã otsui anyɔ omli, ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehere oyiwala!” Ni yoo lɛ he wa lɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
23Ni be ni Yesu ba onukpa lɛ we lɛ ni ena blɛkpalɔi kɛ mɛi pii ni feɔ hoo lɛ, 24 ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa sɛɛ, ejaakɛ oblayoo lɛ gboko, shi wɔ kɛkɛ ewɔɔ.” Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ. 25Shi be ni ashwie mɛi lɛ, etee tsu lɛ mli, ni emɔ oblayoo lɛ nineshi, ni ete shi. 26Ni nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ jije yɛ jɛi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shwilafoi enyɔ lɛ atsamɔ
27Ni be ni Yesu je jɛi ehoɔ lɛ, shwilafoi enyɔ nyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛmiibolɔ akɛ, “Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, David Bi!” 28Ni be ni ebote shĩa lɛ, shwilafoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ akɛ manyɛ enɛ mafee lo?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ!” 29 Kɛkɛ ni etara amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, afee nakai ahã nyɛ.” 30 Ni amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ gbele. Ni Yesu bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni mɔ ko akalea!” 31Shi amɛ lɛ, be ni amɛje jɛi lɛ, amɛyagbɛ ehe sane lɛ amɛshwã yɛ jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Mumui ko tsamɔ
32Shi be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ, akɛ mumui ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli ba eŋɔɔ. 33Ni be ni efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ, mumui lɛ wie. Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe amɛkɛɛ, “Anako nɛkɛ nɔ ko pɛŋ yɛ Israel!” 34 Shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ efãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ!”
Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ
35 Ni Yesu kpa maji lɛ kɛ akrowai lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni eshiɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kpakpa lɛ, ni etsa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejaramɔ fɛɛ hejaramɔ. 36 Shi be ni ena mɛi babaoo lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ etɔ amɛ ni amɛfee yuuyaa tamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ. 37 Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nikpamɔ lɛ fa, shi nitsulɔi lɛ faaa. 38No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkpaa nikpamɔ nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai, koni ewo nitsulɔi agbɛ kɛba enikpamɔ lɛ mli!”

Title: MATEO 10
Content:
Yesu tsu kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ
(Marko 3.13-19; Luka 6.12-16)
1Ni Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba, ni ehã amɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ hewalɛ ni amɛfamɔ amɛ ni amɛtsa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejaramɔ fɛɛ hejaramɔ. 2Shi bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ ji Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea; Yakobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Yohane; 3Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo, Toma kɛ Mateo, tóohelɔ lɛ, Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Tadeo; 4Simon, maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
5Nɛkɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nɛɛ Yesu tsu, ni efã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkagbalea jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkabotea Samariabii amaŋ ko mli hu; 6 shi moŋ nyɛyaa Israel we toi ni elaaje lɛ aŋɔɔ. 7 Shi ni nyɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛshiɛa nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ shi etã.’ 8 Nyɛtsaa helatsɛmɛi, nyɛtea gbohii ashi, nyɛhãa kpitiyelɔi ahe atsea, nyɛfamɔa mumɔi fɔ̃ji; yaka nyɛna, yaka nyɛkɛhãa. 9Nyɛkataoa shika loo jwiɛtɛi loo akɔɔble nyɛwoa nyɛhɛfiinii amli; 10 asaŋ nyɛkataoa gbɛfãa kotoku, loo flakai enyɔ, loo tokotai loo tso; shi nitsulɔ lɛ eŋmaa sa lɛ.
11“Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ loo akrowa fɛɛ akrowa mli ni nyɛaabote lɛ, nyɛbia mɔ ni sa shi yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛto jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaatee. 12 Shi kɛ nyɛmiibote shĩa lɛ, nyɛŋaa shĩa lɛ. 13Ni kɛji shĩa lɛ sa lɛ, nyɛhãa nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ abaa enɔ; shi kɛji esaaa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ akpale aba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ. 14 Ni kɛji mɔ ko hereee nyɛ, ni ebooo nyɛwiemɔi lɛ atoi lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije nakai shĩa lɛ loo nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnajiashi mlu lɛ. 15 Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, ejaraŋ haŋ Sodom kɛ Gomora shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, tamɔ nakai maŋ lɛ.”
Kaselɔi lɛ ayiwaa
(Marko 13.9-13; Luka 21.12-17)
16 “Naa miitsu nyɛ tamɔ too Gwantɛŋi yɛ klãji ateŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ atɛ̃a tamɔ onufui, ni nyɛfea kpoo tamɔ okpoi.
17 “Shi nyɛhĩɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ kɛaatee kojomɔhei, ni amɛaayi nyɛ yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ. 18 Ni amɛkɛ nyɛ aaatee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi ahiɛ yɛ mihewɔ, koni no afee odase ahã amɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ. 19 Shi kɛji amɛŋɔ nyɛ kɛtee lɛ nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe yɛ bɔ ni nyɛaawie aloo nɔ ni nyɛakɛɛ hewɔ; shi akɛ nɔ ni nyɛawie aahã nyɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ. 20 Ejaakɛ jeee nyɛ ji mɛi ni wieɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛTsɛ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni wieɔ yɛ nyɛmli lɛ.
21 “Shi nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi aaahã gbele, ni tsɛ kɛ bi aaahã, ni bii aaate shi awo amɛfɔlɔi, ni amɛaahã agbe amɛ. 22 Ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛyawulaa shi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala. 23 Shi kɛ amɛmiiwa nyɛ yi yɛ maŋ ko mli lɛ, nyɛjoa foi nyɛyaa ekroko mli; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ nyɛgbeŋ Israel maji lɛ fɛɛ naa dani Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba. 24 Kaselɔ efeee etsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ni asaŋ nyɔŋ efeee enuŋtsɔ. 25 Efa hã kaselɔ akɛ eeetamɔ enuŋtsɔ. Kɛji shĩatsɛ lɛ amɛtsɛ Beelzebul lɛ, ewebii lɛ shii enyiɛ amɛtsɛŋ amɛ nakai?”
Mɔ gbeyei ni sa akɛ ashe
(Luka 12.2-7)
26 “Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ, ni agbeleŋ nɔ; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni atee nɔ ni aleŋ. 27Nɔ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ yɛ duŋ mli lɛ, nyɛwiea yɛ la hiɛ; ni nɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛtoiŋ mikɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛshiɛa yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ. 28 Ni nyɛkashea mɛi ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ susuma lɛ amɛgbe lɛ gbeyei; shi moŋ nyɛshea mɔ ni nyɛɔ susuma kɛ gbɔmɔtso fɛɛ hiɛ ekpãtãa yɛ abonsamiiaje lɛ gbeyei. 29Ani aflimatai enyɔ lɛ jeee pesewa ahɔ̃ɔ aheɔ? Shi amɛteŋ ekome flo enyɔŋ shikpɔŋ, ja ejɛ nyɛTsɛ lɛ dɛŋ. 30Shi nyɛyiteŋtsɔ̃i po lɛ akane fɛɛ. 31No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛjara wa aahu fe aflimatai babaoo.”
Kristo he odaseyeli yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ
(Luka 12.8-9)
32“Hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbaa mli tsiɔ mitã yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, mi hu magba mli matsi etã yɛ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ. 33 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaa mi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, mi hu makwa lɛ yɛ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ.”
Jeee hejɔlɛ, shi klante
(Luka 12.51-53)
34“Nyɛkasusua akɛ miba ni mabahã hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; jeee hejɔlɛ hamɔ miba shi klante moŋ. 35Ejaakɛ miba ni mabahã mɔ ate shi ashi etsɛ, biyoo ate shi ashi enyɛ, shaayoo ate shi ashi eshaayoo. 36 Ni mɔ diɛŋtsɛ shĩateŋbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi. 37 Mɔ ni dɔɔ tsɛ loo nyɛ he fe mi lɛ, esaaa mi; ni mɔ ni dɔɔ binuu loo biyoo he fe mi lɛ, esaaa mi. 38 Ni mɔ ni wooo esɛŋmɔtso kɛnyiɛɛɛ misɛɛ lɛ, esaaa mi. 39 Mɔ ni baa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, enine aaashɛ nɔ.”
Mɛi ni hereɔ Yesu kaselɔi anyɔmɔwo
(Marko 9.41)
40 “Mɔ ni hereɔ nyɛ lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ. 41Mɔ ni hereɔ gbalɔ yɛ gbalɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, gbalɔ nyɔmɔwoo eeena; ni mɔ ni hereɔ jalɔ yɛ jalɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, jalɔ nyɔmɔwoo eeena. 42 Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahã mɛi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nuhɔ̃ɔ kpulu kome pɛ enu yɛ kaselɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ enyɔmɔwoo eŋmɛŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

Title: MATEO 11
Content:
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ tsu kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ
(Luka 7.18-23)
1Be ni Yesu etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nibii nɛɛ egbe naa lɛ, eje jɛi eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii ni eshiɛ yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli.
2 Shi be ni Yohane nu Kristo nitsumɔi lɛ ahe yɛ gboklɛfoiatsu lɛ mli lɛ, etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, 3 “Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?” 4Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yohane nɔ ni nyɛnuɔ kɛ nɔ ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ: 5 shwilafoi miina nii, ni obubuafoi miinyiɛ; kpitiyelɔi ahe miitse, ni toimulɔi miinu nii, gbohii miite shi, ni ohiafoi lɛ aajaje sane kpakpa lɛ aatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 6 Ni ajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mihe sane etɔtɔŋ enane.”
Yesu ye Yohane he odase
(Luka 7.24-35)
7 Shi be ni mɛi ni atsu nɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛyaa lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i Yohane he wiemɔ kɛ mɛi babaoo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ, “Mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ? Glã ni kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ? 8Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ? Naa, mɛi ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi awei amɛyɔɔ. 9 Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbalɔ? Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni fe gbalɔ tete. 10 Ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji mɔ hewɔ ni aŋma akɛ, ‘Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ ato bo lɛ! 11 Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɛi ni yei fɔ amɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko eteko shi ni fe Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ni ji bibioo kwraa yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ fe lɛ. 12 Shi kɛjɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yinɔ kɛbaa nɛɛ, hewalɛ naa aŋɔɔ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni hewalɔi gbalaa lɛ hewalɛ naa. 13Shi gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Mla lɛ gba kɛbashi Yohane nɔ. 14 Ni kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛmɔ mli lɛ, mɔ nɛ ji Elia ni baaba lɛ. 15Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!
16“Shi namɔ he mikɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaato? Amɛtamɔ gbekɛbii ni tara jaji anɔ ni amɛtsɛtsɛɔ amɛnanemɛi akɛ,
17 ‘Wɔkpã blɛ wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛjooo;
Wɔwo yara wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛfooo.’
18 Ejaakɛ Yohane ba, ni eyeee nii, ni esaa enuuu nɔ ko lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli.’ 19 Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba, ni eyeɔ nii ni esaa enuɔ nɔ ko lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, nuu fulɔ kɛ dãanulɔ, tóohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi ashieŋtsɛ nɛ!’ Ni abu nilee bem yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.”
Maji ni tsakeee amɛtsui lɛ
(Luka 10.13-15)
20Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i maji, hei ni etsu ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ amli tsiimɔ yɛ lɛ, ahiɛ wiemɔ, yɛ amɛtsui ni amɛtsakeee lɛ hewɔ, ekɛɛ, 21 “Kpoo hã bo, Korazin! Kpoo hã bo, Betsaida! Ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, eji atsu yɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon kulɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ kpekpe kɛ lamlu mli jeeŋmɔ. 22Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ejaraŋ haŋ Tiro kɛ Sidon yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ tamɔ nyɛ. 23 Ni bo Kapernaum, ani aaawo onɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi? Gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee; ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ omli lɛ, eji atsu yɛ Sodom kulɛ ema shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. 24 Shi miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ejaraŋ haŋ Sodom shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ tamɔ bo.”
Yesu mli fili lɛ ni ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi
25 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yesu kɛɛ, “Miijie oyi, Ataa; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ okɛ nii nɛɛ etee nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, ni ojie otsɔ̃ɔ abifabii. 26Hɛɛ, Ataa, bɔ ni sa ohiɛ ji no. 27 MiTsɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo midɛŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko leee Bi lɛ, akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ, asaŋ Tsɛ lɛ hu, mɔ ko mɔ ko leee lɛ, akɛ ja Bi lɛ, kɛ mɔ ni Bi lɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ejieɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ.”
Nyɛbaa ni mahã nyɛ hejɔɔmɔ
(Luka 10.21-22)
28 “Nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni etɔ nyɛ ni nyɛjatsui fe nyɛ lɛ, ni mahã nyɛ hejɔɔmɔ. 29 Nyɛwoa mipã lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛkasea mi; shi mihe jɔ, ni mibaa mihe shi kɛjɛ mitsui mli; ni nyɛaana hejɔɔmɔ nyɛhã nyɛsusumai lɛ. 30 Ejaakɛ mipã lɛ teremɔ waaa, ni mijatsu lɛ etsiii.”

Title: MATEO 12
Content:
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ
(Marko 2.23-28; Luka 6.1-5)
1 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yesu tsɔ̃ abele ŋmɔji amli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ; ni hɔ̃mɔ miiye ekaselɔi lɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i abele lɛ kuumɔ kɛ kpemɔ. 2 Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ na lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, okaselɔi lɛ miifee nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afee yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.” 3 Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee be ni hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ: 4 bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, ni eyaye aboloi ni akɛmãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni aŋmɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ loo mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ yeɔ, akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ? 5 Aloo nyɛkaneko yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ osɔfoi buleɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni amɛyeee fɔ. 6Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ ko ni fe Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɛ biɛ. 7 Shi eji nyɛle wiemɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ mitaoɔ shi jeee afɔle’ lɛ shishi kulɛ, nyɛbuŋ mɛi ni yeee fɔ lɛ afɔ. 8Ejaakɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ.”
Nuu ni nine kome egbo lɛ
(Marko 3.1-6; Luka 6.6-11)
9Ni eje jɛi eyabote amɛkpeehe lɛ. 10 Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni enine kome egbo. Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani eja gbɛ akɛ atsaa mɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ?” Bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo enaa folɔmɔ. 11Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eyɛ too kome, ni too lɛ yagbee bu mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni emɔŋ emli ni ejie lɛ? 12 Ani gbɔmɔ jara waaa babaoo fe too? No hewɔ ni eja gbɛ akɛ afeɔ ejurɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.” 13Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpã onine lɛ mli!” Ni ekpã mli ni eye emuu tamɔ ekome lɛ. 14 Shi Farisifoi lɛ je kpo tee eyi nɔ apam, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Tsulɔ ni ehala lɛ
15 Shi be ni Yesu kpa enɛ shi lɛ, egbala ehe shi kɛje jɛi. Ni mɛi babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni etsa amɛ fɛɛ, 16 ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛkahã anu ehe; 17 bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie lɛ aba mli akɛ,
18 “Naa, mitsulɔ ni mihala lɛ,
misuɔlɔ ni misusuma naa ehe tsui lɛ;
mikɛ miMumɔ lɛ aaaŋmɛ enɔ,
ni eeejaje kojomɔ etsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ.
19Ebeŋ, ni ebolɔŋ hu, ni mɔ ko nuŋ egbee yɛ blohuiaŋ.
20Glã ni amia lɛ,
ekuŋ, ni kane mli tako ni tsoɔ sulii lɛ, egbeŋ,
Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeehã jalɛ aye kunim.
21Ni egbɛi lɛ nɔ jeŋmaji lɛ
aaaŋɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃.”
Yesu kɛ Beelzebul
(Marko 3.20-30; Luka 11.14-23)
22Kɛkɛ ni akɛ mɔ ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli ni ji shwilafo kɛ mumui fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni etsa lɛ ni shwilafo ni ji mumui hu lɛ wie ni ena nii. 23Ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee David Bi lɛ nɛ?” 24 Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ Beelzebul hewalɛ kɛkɛ mɔ nɛ kɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ.” 25Shi akɛni Yesu yoo amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, ejwaa; ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ loo shĩa fɛɛ shĩa ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ edamɔɔɔ shi. 26Ni kɛji Satan fã Satan lɛ, egba ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe; belɛ te emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaafee tɛŋŋ adamɔ shiŋ? 27Ni kɛji mi lɛ Beelzebul hewalɛ naa mifãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɛ lɛ, nyɛbihii lɛ, namɔ hewalɛ naa amɛfamɔ amɛ yɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ amɛaakojo nyɛ. 28 Shi kɛji mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ naa mifãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ yɛ lɛ, no lɛ ninamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ enina nyɛ lɛ. 29 Shi kulɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ko aaanyɛ hewalɔ we abote ni eyaha enibiiŋ, akɛ ja efi hewalɔ lɛ dani eeewo ewe lɛ haa? 30 Mɔ ni bɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ, shi ete ewo mi; ni mɔ ni kɛ mi buaaa naa lɛ, gbɛ egbɛɔ eshwãa. 31 No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, akɛ esha kɛ musubɔɔ fɛɛ aaafa gbɔmɛi; shi Mumɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ lɛ akɛfaŋ. 32 Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie wiemɔ ko ashi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie ashi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ yɛ je nɛɛŋ loo jeŋ ni baaba lɛ mli.”
Tso kɛ eyibii
(Luka 6.43-45)
33 “Nyɛhãa tso lɛ afea tso kpakpa, ni ewo yibii kpakpai; aloo nyɛhãa afea tso gbonyo, ni ewo yibii gbohii; ejaakɛ tso yibii akɛleɔ tso. 34 Nyɛ shinɔi ashwiei! Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛ ji mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ, ni nyɛaanyɛ ekpakpa nyɛwieŋ? Ejaakɛ nɔ ni eyi tsui obɔ kɛteke nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ naabu wieɔ. 35Gbɔmɔ kpakpa jieɔ nikpakpai kɛjɛɔ etsuiŋ jwetri kpakpa lɛ mli; ni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ hu jieɔ nifɔɔji kɛjɛɔ etsuiŋ jwetri fɔŋ lɛ mli. 36Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, yaka wiemɔ fɛɛ yaka wiemɔ ni gbɔmɛi wieɔ lɛ, amɛbaabu he akɔntaa yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ. 37Shi owiemɔi lɛ amli aaajɛ abu bo bem, ni owiemɔi lɛ amli aaajɛ abu bo fɔ.”
Farisifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi
(Luka 11.29-32)
38 Kɛkɛ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔmiitao onine naa okadi ko wɔkwɛ.” 39 Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yinɔbii fɔ̃ji kɛ gbãlãfitelɔi miitao okadi; shi ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko, akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ. 40 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yona ye shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ ŋshɔŋ loo kpeteŋkple lɛ musuŋ lɛ, nakai Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaye shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ mli tɔ̃ɔ. 41 Nineve hii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛaabu amɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ naa; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ. 42 Wuoyigbɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni eeebu amɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ ejɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe ebabo Solomon nilee lɛ toi; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Solomon nilee lɛ yɛ biɛ.”
Mumɔ fɔŋ sɛɛkuu kɛ gbɔmɔ mli botemɔ
(Luka 11.24-26)
43“Shi mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ, kɛ eje gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, eyanyiɛɔ hei ni nu bɛ etaoɔ hejɔɔmɔ, shi enaaa eko. 44Ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Maku misɛɛ matee miwe he ni mijɛ lɛ.’ Ni kɛ eba lɛ, enaa akɛ ekã shi efolo, ni abɛɛ mli, ni awula mli. 45 Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaa ni eyaŋɔɔ mumɔi krokomɛi kpawo ni ji mɛi fɔ̃ji fe lɛ ekɛfataa ehe, ni amɛbaa amɛbahiɔ jɛi; ni nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ naagbee shihilɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ efɔŋ fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ. Nakai nɔŋŋ ebaaba mli yɛ yinɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ hu gbɛfaŋ.”
Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi
(Marko 3.31-35; Luka 8.19-21)
46 Shi be ni ekɛ asafoi lɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ badamɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛkɛ lɛ awie. [ 47Ni mɔ ko bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛkɛ bo awie.”] 48 Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ mɔ ni bakɛɛ lɛ lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji minyɛ, ni namɛi ji minyɛmimɛi?” 49Ni ekpã enine mli etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ ekɛɛ, “Naa, minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi nɛ! 50 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, lɛ ji minyɛmi nuu kɛ minyɛmi yoo kɛ minyɛ.”

Title: MATEO 13
Content:
Nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ
(Marko 4.1-9; Luka 8.4-8)
1Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu je shĩa lɛ eyata ŋshɔ lɛ naa. 2 Ni asafo babaoo babua amɛhe naa yɛ eŋɔɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etee lɛlɛ ko mli eyata shi, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ damɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa. 3Ni ewie wiemɔi pii etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli ekɛɛ, “Nidulɔ yiŋ etee nidumɔ. 4Ni be ni eduɔ lɛ, wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie gbɛ he, ni loofɔji ba bakɔlɔ. 5Ni ekomɛi hu yashwie tesai anɔ, he ni amɛnaaa su pii yɛ; ni amrɔ lɛ, akɛni amɛbɛ sũ ni mli kwɔ hewɔ lɛ amɛkwɛ̃ oya; 6shi be ni hulu te shi lɛ, amɛshã: ni akɛni amɛbɛ fã ko hewɔ lɛ amɛŋalã. 7Ni ekomɛi hu yashwie ŋmei ateŋ ni ŋmei lɛ kwɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ. 8Shi ekomɛi hu yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni ewo yibii: eko oha, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. 9Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛ nuɔ nii lɛ, enu!”
Nɔ̃ hewɔ ni Yesu wie yɛ abɛbuai amli
(Marko 4.10-12; Luka 8.9-10)
10Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ okɛ amɛ wieɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli lɛ?” 11Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ akɛhã nyɛ akɛ nyɛle ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli teemɔ saji lɛ, shi amɛ lɛ akɛ hãko amɛ. 12 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ aaahã lɛ ni ena kɛteke nɔ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ tete lɛ, aaashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ. 13 Enɛ hewɔ mikɛ amɛ wieɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiina nɛ shi amɛnaaa, ni amɛmiinu nɛ shi amɛnuuu, ni amɛnaaa shishi hu.
14 Ni Yesaia gbalɛ lɛ eba mli yɛ amɛhe akɛ,
‘Nu lɛ nyɛbaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi;
ni na lɛ nyɛbaana nɛ, shi nyɛyoŋ sɛɛ.
15Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ tsui ekpliŋ,
ni amɛtoii ewa, ni amɛŋamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii;
koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii,
ni amɛkanu kɛ amɛtoii,
ni amɛtsui hu akana shishi,
ni amɛkpale ni mitsa amɛ.’
16“Shi nyɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii lɛ, akɛ amɛmiina nii, kɛ nyɛtoii lɛ, akɛ amɛmiinu nii. 17 Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbalɔi kɛ jalɔi pii shwe ni amɛna nii ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, shi amɛyanaaa, aloo ni amɛnu nii ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ, ni amɛyanuuu.”
Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi
(Marko 4.13-20; Luka 8.11-15)
18“Agbɛnɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛboa nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi toi. 19Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he wiemɔ lɛ ni eyooo sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ lɛ baa bashaa nɔ ni adu yɛ etsui mli lɛ. Mɔ nɛ ji gbɛ he he ni adu wu lɛ yɛ lɛ. 20Shi tɛsaa ni adu wu lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ damɔ shi hã mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni ehereɔ amrɔ kɛ miishɛɛ; 21shi akɛni ebɛ shishifã lɛ, ehiɔ shi fioo kɛkɛ; ni kɛji haomɔ loo yiwaa ba yɛ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsɛɛɛ kɛkɛ lɛ enane etɔ̃tɔ̃. 22 Ni ŋmei ateŋ he ni adu wu lɛ yɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔ kɛ nii pii ahe lakamɔ lɛ gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni ewooo yibii. 23Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni adu wu lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni eyoɔ sɛɛ, ni esaa ewoɔ yibii hu, eko oha, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.”
Jwɛi kɛ ŋmaa ni efutu lɛ
24 Ebu amɛ abɛ kroko hu ekɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ nuu ko ni duɔ wui kpakpai yɛ eŋmɔ mli. 25Shi be ni mɛi wɔ lɛ, ehenyɛlɔ ko ba ebadu jwɛi efutu ŋmaa lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee. 26Shi be ni ŋmaa lɛ kwɛ ni ewo yibii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni jwɛi lɛ hu pue. 27Ni shĩatsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, ani jeee wui kpakpai odu yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ? Nɛgbɛ ekɛ jwɛi nɛɛ jɛ mɔ?’ 28Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Henyɛlɔ ko bafee enɛ nɛɛ. Ni etsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Be lɛ ooosumɔ akɛ wɔya ni wɔyafãmɔ lo?’ 29Shi ekɛɛ, ‘Dabi, ekolɛ aleenɔ jwɛi lɛ fãamɔ mli lɛ, nyɛaafãmɔ ŋmaa lɛ hu nyɛfutuŋ. 30 Nyɛŋmɛa enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ni amɛdara kɛyashi ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ, ni ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ makɛɛ nikpalɔi lɛ akɛ, nyɛbuaa jwɛi lɛ anaa tsutsu, ni nyɛfimɔa amɛ keikei, koni ashã; shi ŋmaa lɛ nyɛbuaa naa nyɛyawoa miboŋo lɛ mli.’ ”
Sinapi wu kɛ mãsha lɛ
(Marko 4.30-34; Luka 13.18-21)
31Yesu bu amɛ abɛ kroko ekɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ sinapi wu ni mɔ ko kɔ ni eyadu yɛ eŋmɔ mli; 32eji wui ateŋ bibioo fe fɛɛ, shi kɛ ekwɛ̃ lɛ, edaa fe shwie bai fɛɛ; ni efeɔ tso, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji baa bafeɔ tsui yɛ eniji ateŋ.”
33 Ebu amɛ abɛ kroko akɛ, “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ mãsha ni yoo ko kɔ ni ekɛhɔ mã tsesei etɛ̃ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni fɛɛ sha.”
34 Abɛbuai amli Yesu kɛ asafoi lɛ wie nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ ewieee nɔ ko akɛ ja yɛ abɛbuai amli kɛkɛ; 35 koni nɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ,
“Magbele minaa yɛ abɛbuai amli;
magba nii ni akɛtee kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ.”
Jwɛi kɛ ŋmaa ni efutu abɛ lɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ
36 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jie asafoi lɛ agbɛ ni etee shĩa lɛ. Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ ŋmɔ lɛ mli jwɛi lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi.” 37Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wui kpakpai adulɔ lɛ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ; 38 ŋmɔ lɛ ji je lɛ; wui kpakpai lɛ ji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli bii lɛ; jwɛi lɛ ji mɔ fɔŋ lɛ bii lɛ; 39henyɛlɔ ni du amɛ lɛ ji abonsam; ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ ji je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ; ni ŋmaakpalɔi lɛ ji ŋwɛi bɔfoi. 40Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni abuaa jwɛi anaa ni akɛ la shãa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee yɛ je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ. 41 Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaatsu ebɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛaabua nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔnii fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii ni shiɔ mla lɛ anaa kɛaaje emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, 42 ni amɛkɛ amɛaawo la flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi. 43 No ni jalɔi lɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ hulu yɛ amɛ-Tsɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!”
Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he abɛi etɛ̃
44 “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ jwetri ni akɛtee yɛ abɔɔ mli, ni be ni mɔ ko yana lɛ, ekɛtee, ni no he miishɛɛ ni ena hewɔ lɛ etee ni eyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhe nakai abɔɔ lɛ.
45“Asaŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ guɔyelɔ ko ni taoɔ adiagbai fɛɛfɛji, 46 ni be ni eyana adiagba kome ni jara wa lɛ, etee ni eyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhe.
47 “Asaŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ yaa ni afɔ̃ yɛ ŋshɔ mli ni edu loi srɔtoi fɛɛ eko; 48ni be ni eyi lɛ, wolɛi lɛ gbala kɛba shia nɔ, ni amɛtara shi amɛbua ekpakpai lɛ anaa amɛwo kpaii amli; shi nii ni ehiii lɛ amɛshɛrɛ amɛshwie. 49 Nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee yɛ je lɛ naagbee lɛ. Ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ aaaje kpo aba ni amɛbaahala mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ yɛ jalɔi lɛ ateŋ; 50ni amɛkɛ amɛ aaawo la flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli. Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.”
51Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛna nii nɛɛ fɛɛ ashishi lo?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ!” 52Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔ fɛɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ ni afee lɛ kaselɔ, ahã ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, etamɔ shĩatsɛ ko ni jieɔ nii hei kɛ nii memeji kɛjeɔ ejwetri lɛ mli.”
Akwa Yesu yɛ Nazaret
(Mateo 6.1-6; Luka 4.16-30)
53Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe abɛbuai nɛɛ anaa lɛ, eje jɛi; 54ni be ni eba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii yɛ amɛkpeehe lɛ, ni ehã amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ. “Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ yana nilee kɛ hewalɛnii nɛɛ kɛjɛ? 55Ani jeee ŋaalɔ lɛ bi lɛ nɛ? Ani jeee enyɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Maria lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii ni ji Yakobo kɛ Yose kɛ Simon kɛ Yuda lɛ? 56 Ni enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ, ani jeee amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ wɔ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ yana nii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ mɔ?” 57 Ni etsɔ̃ pampi ehã amɛ. Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abuɔ gbalɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ja lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe kɛkɛ.” 58Ni akɛni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ lɛ etsuuu hewalɛnii pii ko yɛ jɛi.

Title: MATEO 14
Content:
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ gbele
(Marko 6.14-29; Luka 9.7-9)
1Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ lumɔ Herode nu Yesu he sane; 2ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ni; lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, no hewɔ ni hewalɛi lɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ emli nɛɛ.” 3 Ekɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ emɔ Yohane efi lɛ ni ewo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ Herodia, enyɛmi Filipo ŋa lɛ hewɔ. 4 Efee enɛ, ejaakɛ Yohane kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ejaaa gbɛ akɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ.” 5Ni kulɛ etao akɛ egbe lɛ, shi eeshe asafo lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛbuɔ Yohane gbalɔ. 6Shi be ni ayeɔ Herode fɔmɔ gbi lɛ, Herodia biyoo lɛ bajo yɛ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni efee Herode fɛo; 7no hewɔ lɛ, ekã kitã ekɛwo lɛ shi akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeebi lɛ lɛ eeehã lɛ. 8Ni enyɛ wo lɛ ŋaa, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso ofɔ̃ kã mli ohã mi yɛ biɛ!” 9Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi ekitãi ni ekãmɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii ashi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ akɛhã lɛ. 10Ni etsu ayafo Yohane yitso yɛ tsu lɛ mli. 11Ni akɛ eyitso lɛ fɔ̃ kã mli kɛba, ni akɛhã oblayoo lɛ, ni ekɛyahã enyɛ. 12Ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ ba amɛbawo egbonyo lɛ ni amɛyafu, ni amɛtee amɛyakɛɛ Yesu.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii
(Marko 6.32-44; Luka 9.10-17; Yohane 6.1-14)
13Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, etsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli kɛje jɛi kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko banee. Ni be ni asafoi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛje maji lɛ amli amɛnyiɛ amɛnane kɛtiu lɛ. 14 Ni be ni Yesu kpeleke lɛ, ebana mɛi babaoo, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ, ni etsa amɛhelatsɛmɛi lɛ. 15Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Ŋa nɔ ji biɛ, ni je miina; jiemɔ asafoi lɛ agbɛ ni amɛya akrowai lɛ amli ni amɛyahe niyenii amɛye.” 16Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ehiaaa akɛ amɛaatee; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nii amɛyea.” 17Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ pɛ ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ biɛ ji aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ.” 18Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ biɛ!” 19Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtaratara shi yɛ jwɛi lɛ anɔ. Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ, ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ nɔ; ni ekumɔ aboloi lɛ amli ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ hu kɛhã asafoi lɛ. 20 Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛye, ni amɛtɔrɔ, ni amɛkɔlɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃. 21Shi mɛi ni ye lɛ aaashɛ hii akpei enumɔ, soro yei kɛ gbekɛbii.
Yesu yasɔle
(Marko 6.45-52; Yohane 6.15-21)
22Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu tsirɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ayisɛɛ, ni amɛbote lɛlɛ lɛ mli ni amɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛya ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, kɛyashi eeewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ. 23 Ni be ni ewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko banee ni eyasɔle. Be ni je na lɛ, ekometoo eyɔɔ jɛi.
Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ
(Marko 6.45-52; Yohane 6.15-21)
24Shi lɛlɛ lɛ eshɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ momo ni ŋshɔkei lɛ miihɛlɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ eekpee kɔɔyɔɔ. 25Ni maŋkɛ hima, aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ loo nɔ mli lɛ, Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ. 26 Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, amɛtsui fã, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Sisaŋ!” Ni amɛbolɔ kɛ gbeyeishemɔ. 27Shi amrɔ lɛ Yesu fã enaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnaa tsui, miŋ; nyɛkashea gbeyei.” 28Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji bo ni lɛ, fã mi koni matsɔ̃ nu lɛ hiɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ.” 29Ni ekɛɛ, “Ba!” Ni Petro je lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni enyiɛ nu lɛ hiɛ kɛmiiya Yesu ŋɔɔ. 30Shi be ni ena akɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ miitswa waa lɛ, eshe gbeyei ni ebɔ̃i shiumɔ, ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ mi!” 31 Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu kpã enine mli esɔo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo ni ohemɔkɛyeli faaa, mɛni hewɔ oje ŋwane?” 32Ni be ni amɛbote lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa. 33Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ bakoto lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛɛlɛŋ!”
Yesu tsa helatsɛmɛi yɛ Genesaret
(Marko 6.53-56)
34Ni be ni amɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ, amɛba Genesaret shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 35Ni be ni jɛibii lɛ yoo lɛ lɛ, amɛtsu atee jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni ayaŋɔ helatsɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ; 36 ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ehã amɛna etade lɛ naamuu lɛ he amɛtara kɛkɛ; ni mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni tara he lɛ he wa amɛ kwraa.

Title: MATEO 15
Content:
Onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi
(Marko 7.1-13)
1Kɛkɛ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi ni jɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, 2 “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni okaselɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ amɛfɔɔɔ amɛdɛ̃ dani amɛyeɔ nii.” 3Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ? 4 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, ‘Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ!’ Kɛ ‘Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!’ 5Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ akɛ, nɔ ni kulɛ ooona yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, mikɛke Nyɔŋmɔ’ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekawo etsɛ loo enyɛ dɔŋŋ. 6Ni nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ nyɛgu Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ. 7 Osatofoi! Gbɛ naa pɛ Yesaia gba yɛ nyɛhe akɛ,
8 ‘Maŋ nɛɛ kɛ amɛnaabu woɔ mi;
shi amɛtsui etsi ehe kɛjɛ mihe kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
9Shi yakatswaa amɛjaa mi lɛ,
Ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni ji gbɔmɛi akitãi.’ ”
Nibii ni buleɔ mɔ
(Marko 7.14-23)
10Ni etsɛ asafo lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi ni nyɛna shishi! 11 Jeee nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ buleɔ gbɔmɔ; shi moŋ nɔ ni jeɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, no buleɔ gbɔmɔ.” 12Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ole akɛ be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, ewo amɛ mlila waa?” 13Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Tso fɛɛ tso ni jeee miŋwɛi-Tsɛ lɛ tɛoɔ lɛ, fã aaafã. 14 Nyɛkadia amɛsɛɛ! Shwilafoi ni tsɔ̃ɔ shwilafoi agbɛ ji amɛ; ni kɛ shwilafo miitsɔ̃ɔ shwilafo gbɛ lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaagbee bu mli.” 15Ni Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ abɛ nɛɛ shishi!” 16Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu nyɛnako nii ashishi lolo? 17Ani nyɛkpako shi akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, musuŋ eyaa ni ajieɔ awoɔ tiafi mli? 18Shi nii ni jɛɔ daaŋ jeɔ kpo lɛ, tsui mli ejɛɔ, ni nomɛi buleɔ mɔ lɛ. 19 Ejaakɛ tsui mli ni susumɔi fɔ̃ji, gbɔmɔgbee, gbãlãfitemɔ, ajwamãŋbɔɔ, juu, amale odaseyeli kɛ oshekuyeli jɛɔ. 20Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ; shi dɛ̃ ni afɔɔɔ dani ayeɔ nii lɛ, no buleee mɔ.”
Kanaanyoo ko hemɔkɛyeli
(Marko 7.24-30)
21Kɛkɛ ni Yesu je jɛi eyiŋ etee Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ. 22Ni naa, Kanaanyoo ko jɛ jɛi niiaŋ nɔŋŋ babolɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa mi mɔbɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, David Bi; mibiyoo miina nɔ kɛ mumɔ fɔŋ.” 23Shi efooo edaaŋ. Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba bakpa lɛ fai akɛ, “Wo lɛ gbɛ ni eya, shi eebolɔ kɛnyiɛ wɔsɛɛ!” 24 Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Israel we toi ni elaaje lɛ aŋɔɔ kɛkɛ atsu mi.” 25Shi yoo lɛ ba bakulã shi yɛ ehiɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, feemɔ he eko ohã mi!” 26Shi ekɛɛ, “Ejaaa akɛ aŋɔɔ bii aboloo lɛ ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ shifɔji abii.” 27Shi ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ mli moŋ; shi bɛ shifɔji abii lɛ hu yeɔ fufuji ni shwieɔ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi lɛ eko!” 28 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “O yoo, ohemɔkɛyeli da! Afee ahã bo tamɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ!” Ni atsa ebiyoo lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Yesu tsa mɛi pii
29 Ni Yesu je jɛi eba Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Ni ekwɔ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyata shi yɛ jɛi. 30Ni asafoi pii ba eŋɔɔ; amɛhiɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛ obubuafoi kɛ shwilafoi kɛ mumuii kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii, ni amɛkɛ amɛ bashwie enaji anaa; ni etsa amɛ. 31 Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, be ni amɛna akɛ mumuii miiwie, ni obubuafoi ahe ewa amɛ, ni akpaketsɛmɛi miinyiɛ, ni shwilafoi miina nii lɛ; ni amɛwo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei ejwɛ niyenii
(Marko 8.1-10)
32 Shi Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba ni ekɛɛ, “Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ asafoi lɛ ahe, akɛ amɛkɛ mi ehi shi gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛyeɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ miwoɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛ musuŋ hɔ̃mɔ, ni ekolɛ amɛyatɔ biti yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.” 33Ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ wɔbaana aboloi ni fa pii yɛ, yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ, bɔ ni aaashɛ asafo babaoo nɛɛ naa?” 34Ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpawo, kɛ loi bibii fioo ko.” 35Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtara shi yɛ shikpɔŋ. 36Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi kpawo lɛ kɛ loi lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛhã asafoi lɛ. 37Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ; ni amɛkɔlɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ flɔtɔi kpawo obɔ̃bɔ̃. 38Mɛi ni ye lɛ ayibɔ ji hii akpei ejwɛ, soro yei kɛ gbekɛbii. 39Ni ewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ, ni ebote lɛlɛ mli, ni eba Magadan niiaŋ.

Title: MATEO 16
Content:
Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi
(Marko 8.11-13; Luka 12.54-56)
1 Ni Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ baka Yesu, amɛbi lɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ŋwɛi okadi ko. 2 Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɛkɛ mli lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Jeŋ baatse, ejaakɛ ŋwɛi etsu.’ 3 Ni leebi lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛnɛ nyɔŋmɔ baanɛ’, ejaakɛ ŋwɛi etsu ni ehiɛ eha. Osatofoi, nyɛle ŋwɛi atatuiaŋ nibii ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, shi bei lɛ ahe okadii lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ! 4 Yinɔbii fɔ̃ji kɛ gbãlãfitelɔi miitao okadi, shi ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko, akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ.” Ni eshi amɛ eyiŋ etee.
Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi amãsha lɛ
(Marko 8.14-21)
5Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ yaa ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ kpa nɔ ni amɛŋɔ aboloo amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ. 6 Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ amasha lɛ he!” 7Shi amɛwiewie he yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Aboloo ni wɔhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ!” 8 Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa! Mɛni hewɔ nyɛwiewieɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ akɛ aboloo ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ? 9 Nyɛnako nii anaa lolo? Ni nyɛsaa nyɛkaiii mɛi akpei enumɔ lɛ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ kafui abɔ ni nyɛkɔlɔ lɛ, 10 aloo mɛi akpei ejwɛ lɛ aboloi kpawo lɛ kɛ flɔtɔi abɔ ni nyɛkɔlɔ lɛ? 11Te tɛŋŋ ni nyɛnaaa naa akɛ jeee aboloo he mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ? Nyɛhiɛ ahĩa nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ amasha lɛ he!” 12Agbɛnɛ amɛyoo akɛ jeee aboloo masha hewɔ ekɛɛ amɛhiɛ ahi amɛhe nɔ lɛ, shi moŋ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔŋ.
Petro odase ni eye yɛ Yesu he
(Marko 8.27-30; Luka 9.18-21)
13Shi be ni Yesu ba Kaisarea Filipi niiaŋ lɛ, ebi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mɛi kɛɔ akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ji?” 14 Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ni; ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia ni; ni mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ Yeremia loo gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni.” 15Ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” 16 Simon Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Bo ji Kristo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Bi lɛ!” 17 Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ bo, Simon, Yona bi; ejaakɛ jeee heloo kɛ lá jie enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bo, shi moŋ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ. 18 Ni mi hu miikɛɛ bo akɛ, bo ji Petro lɛ, ni nɛkɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ nɔ matswa misafo lɛ mama, ni gbohiiaje agboi lɛ nyɛŋ enɔ aye. 19 Ni maŋɔ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ naa samfei lɛ mahã bo; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofɛne yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛne yɛ ŋwɛi. 20 Kɛkɛ ni etswa ekaselɔi lɛ anaa mã akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko akɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ.”
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he
(Marko 8.31-33; Luka 9.22-27)
21 Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ nɔ lɛ Yesu bɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ ja etee Yerusalɛm ni eyana amanehulu pii yɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni agbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ ete shi. 22Ni Petro ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee afa, ebɔ̃i lɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ akahã enɛ ba mli, Nuŋtsɔ; enɛ akagbale bo fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃!” 23Shi etsɔ̃ ehe ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Jee mihiɛ, Satan! Ootɔ̃tɔ̃ minane; ejaakɛ ojwɛŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahe, shi gbɔmɛi anii ahe moŋ ojwɛŋɔ.”
Hekwamɔ
(Marko 8.34—9.1; Luka 9.23-27)
24 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ. 25 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, enine aaashɛ nɔ. 26Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ baana, kɛji enine shɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, shi elaaje esusuma lɛ? Aloo mɛni gbɔmɔ kɛaahã ni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma lɛ? 27 Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaba yɛ eTsɛ anunyam lɛ mli kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ; ni no mli lɛ eeewo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa. 28 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiba yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.”

Title: MATEO 17
Content:
Yesu gbɔmɔtso su tsake
(Marko 9.2-13; Luka 9.28-36)
1Gbii ekpaa sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni ekɛ amɛ tee gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ekɛ amɛ pɛ. 2 Ni egbɔmɔtso su tsake yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ehiɛ kpɛ tamɔ hulu, ni etadei lɛ yɛ tamɔ la. 3Ni naa, Mose kɛ Elia bajie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ miiwie. 4Ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ehi akɛ wɔyɛ biɛ! Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, mafee bui etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ, onɔ ekome, kɛ Mose nɔ ekome, kɛ Elia nɔ ekome.” 5 Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, atatu halaŋŋ ko bakete amɛnɔ, ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni minaa ehe tsui lɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi!” 6Ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa. 7Ni Yesu ba ni ebatara amɛhe ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtea shi, nyɛkashea gbeyei!” 8Shi be ni amɛwo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja Yesu kome pɛ.
9Ni be ni amɛkpelekeɔ gɔŋ lɛ, Yesu tswa amɛnaa mã ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkagbaa ninaa nɛɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a mɔ ko, akɛ ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ dã.” 10 Ni ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ja Elia eba dã lɛ?” 11Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Elia miiba, ni ebaato nibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ ekoŋŋ; 12 shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Elia eba momo, ni amɛyooo lɛ, shi moŋ amɛfee lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu baana amanehulu yɛ amɛdɛŋ.” 13 Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ kɔ sɛɛ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ he ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ.
Yesu tsa gbekɛ nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli
(Marko 9.14-29; Luka 9.37-43a)
14Be ni amɛshɛ asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, nuu ko ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakula shi yɛ ehiɛ, 15ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa mibi nuu lɛ mɔbɔ, shi eeye gbligbli ni eena nɔ po ni ehiii, ejaakɛ bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee la mli, ni bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee nu mli. 16Ni mikɛ lɛ ba okaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ amɛtsa.” 17 Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Ao yinɔbii ni heee yeee ni bɛ amɛŋlɛnɔ! Mɛɛ beyinɔ mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kɛyashi? Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi? Nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa biɛ nyɛbahãa mi!” 18Ni Yesu fã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yi, ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ jɛ emli je kpo, ni gbekɛ lɛ he wa lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
19 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ yɛ afã, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛba wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ lɛ wɔfã lɛ?” 20 Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni faaa lɛ hewɔŋ. Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni tamɔ sinapi wu lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Fãa yɛ biɛ kɛya jɛi!’ Ni eeefã; ni nɔ ko bɛ ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛfee. [ 21Shi nɛkɛ henɔ nɛɛ, anyɛɛɛ lɛ afã akɛ ja sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ naa kɛkɛ.]”
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he ekoŋŋ
(Marko 9.30-32; Luka 9.43b-45)
22 Shi be ni amɛkpaa Galilea lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ, 23ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi.” Ni amɛwerɛ ho amɛhe tsɔ̃.
Sɔlemɔtsu onia
24 Be ni amɛba Kapernaum lɛ, oniatsulɔi lɛ ba Petro ŋɔɔ babi akɛ, “Ani nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ wooo Sɔlemɔtsu onia lɛ?” 25Ekɛɛ, “Ewoɔ.” Ni be ni eba shĩa lɛ, Yesu tsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ, “Te osusuɔ tɛŋŋ, Simon? Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, namɛi adɛŋ amɛheɔ too loo onia yɛ?
