Yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛbii adɛŋ loo mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ?” 26Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ bii lɛ yeɔ amɛhe mɔ. 27Shi bɔ ni afee ni wɔkato amɛ pampi lɛ, yaa ŋshɔ lɛ naa oyafɔ̃ kpoŋ, ni loo klɛŋklɛŋ ni aaabakɔ kpoŋ lɛ, sha lɛ, ni kɛ ogbɛ edaaŋ lɛ, ooona shika ni naa shiɔ yii enyɔ; kɔ ni okɛhã amɛ, ohã mi kɛ bo fɛɛ.”

Title: MATEO 18
Content:
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
(Marko 9.33-37; Luka 9.46-48)
1 Nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli?” 2Ni Yesu tsɛ gbekɛ bibioo ko kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛteŋ, 3 ni ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛtsakeee ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbekɛbii bibii lɛ, nyɛboteŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa. 4No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa ehe shi tamɔ gbekɛ nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. 5 Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛ fioo kome ni tamɔ mɔ nɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi.
Nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
(Marko 9.42-48; Luka 17.1-2)
6 “Shi mɔ ni tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ nane lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni akɛ lɛ yawo ŋshɔŋ. 7Kpoo hã je lɛ yɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ saji ahewɔ! Ejaakɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ saji lɛ baaba kɛ̃ moŋ nɛ; shi kpoo hã gbɔmɔ ni nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ enɔ̃ kɛbaa lɛ! 8 Shi kɛji onine loo onane miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni oyɛ niji enyɔ loo naji enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ naanɔ la lɛ mli. 9Ni kɛji ohiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, fãa yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ hiŋmɛi kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni oyɛ hiŋmɛii enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje.”
Too ni laaje lɛ he abɛ lɛ
(Luka 15.1-7)
10 “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkabu mɛi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ejeee mɔ ko; ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, amɛbɔfoi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kwɛɔ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ daa. [ 11Shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba nɔ ni elaaje lɛ yiwalaheremɔ.]
12“Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ, kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi oha ni amɛteŋ ekome du gbɛ lɛ, ani eshiŋ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ ni eya eyatao nɔ ni edu gbɛ lɛ? 13Ni kɛji ena lɛ lɛ, anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, emii shɛɔ ehe yɛ no he fe nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu ni eduko gbɛ lɛ. 14Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome laajeɔ.”
Mɔ kɛ enyɛmi ni etɔ̃ enɔ teŋsaamɔ
15 “Shi kɛji onyɛmi ko tɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, yaa ni oyatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yi enyɔ kɛkɛ. Kɛji ebo bo toi lɛ, nyɛmi efee nyɛmi. 16 Shi kɛji ebooo bo toi lɛ, kɛ mɔ kome loo mɛi enyɔ afata ohe, koni odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ daaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi. 17 Ni kɛji amɛ hu ebooo amɛ toi lɛ, yaakɛɛ asafo lɛ, ni kɛji ebooo asafo lɛ hu toi lɛ, buu lɛ tamɔ wɔŋjalɔ kɛ toohelɔ. 18 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaafi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaafɛne yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛne yɛ ŋwɛi. 19 Asaŋ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ kpãa gbee yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni amɛbiɔ lɛ he lɛ, miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ aaafee ahã amɛ. 20 Ejaakɛ he ni mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ, yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, miyɛ amɛteŋ yɛ jɛi.”
Tsulɔ ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ
21Kɛkɛ ni Petro ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, shii enyiɛ minyɛmi atɔ̃ minɔ ni mikɛfa lɛ? Kɛyashi shii kpawo lo?” 22 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ kɛyashi shii kpawo; shi moŋ shii kpawo toi nyɔŋmai kpawo. 23No hewɔ lɛ, ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ko ni taoɔ ekɛ etsuji ababu akɔntaa. 24Ni be ni ebɔ̃i buu lɛ, akɛ mɔ ko ni hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ talentai akpei nyɔŋma ba eŋɔɔ. 25Shi akɛni ebɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛaawo lɛ lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ fã akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii kɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ, ni akɛwo nyɔmɔ lɛ. 26Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ho gbee enaji anaa ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!’ 27Ni tsulɔ nɛɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ ni eŋmɛɛ ehe, ni ekɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ ke lɛ. 28Shi be ni nakai tsulɔ lɛ je kpo lɛ, eyana enanemɛi tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ talentai oha; ni emɔ lɛ emia esɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ, ‘Wo mi nyɔmɔ ni ohiɛ mi lɛ!’ 29Kɛkɛ ni enaanyo tsulɔ lɛ ho kula shi ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, ‘Too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!’ 30Shi lɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛɛɛ; shi moŋ eyawo lɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeewo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ. 31Shi be ni enanemɛi tsuji lɛ na nɔ ni ba lɛ, edɔ amɛ tsɔ̃, ni amɛbagba amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 32Kɛkɛ ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ hã ayatsɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsulɔ fɔŋ! Akɛni okpa mi fai hewɔ lɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ nyɔmɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ ke bo. 33Ani kulɛ jeee bo hu ogbɛnaa ji akɛ ona onaanyo tsulɔ lɛ mɔbɔ, bɔ ni mi hu mina bo mɔbɔ lɛ?’ 34 Ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ mli fu, ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni apiŋ lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeebawo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 35 Nakai nɔŋŋ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hu aaafee nyɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi tɔ̃mɔ ekeee lɛ kɛjɛɛɛ etsuiŋ lɛ.”

Title: MATEO 19
Content:
Gbãlãtsemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ
(Marko 10.1-12)
1Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa lɛ, eje Galilea eba Yudea kpokpai lɛ anɔ yɛ Yordan sɛɛ; 2ni mɛi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ ni etsatsaa amɛ yɛ jɛi. 3 Ni Farisifoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsɔ̃ lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani eja akɛ nuu shwieɔ eŋa yɛ sane fɛɛ sane hewɔ?” 4 Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko akɛ, mɔ ni bɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, nuu kɛ yoo ebɔ amɛ? 5 Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome lɛ.’ 6 Belɛ agbɛnɛ amɛjeee mɛi enyɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ heloo kome; no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsa lɛ, akahã gbɔmɔ miigbala mli.” 7 Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni Mose wo kitã akɛ ahã shwiemɔ wolo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ?” 8Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsuiwalɛ hewɔ ni Mose hã nyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛshwie nyɛŋamɛi lɛ; shi shishijee lɛ mli lɛ ebɛ nakai. 9 Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ jɛ ni eeeshwie eŋa ni eyaŋɔ yoo kroko lɛ efite gbãlã; [ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ yoo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ, lɛ hu efiteɔ gbãlã.”] 10Ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nɛkɛ nuu kɛ eŋa sane yɔɔ lɛ, belɛ ehiii akɛ aŋɔɔ yoo mɔ.” 11 Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ mli amɔ, ja mɛi ni akɛhã lɛ kɛkɛ. 12Ejaakɛ osaii komɛi yɛ ni afɔ amɛ nakai kɛjɛ amɛnyɛmɛi amusu mli; ni osaii komɛi yɛ ni gbɔmɛi sa amɛ; ni osaii lɛ ekrokomɛi hu yɛ ni ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsa amɛhe. Mɔ ni aaanyɛ mli amɔ lɛ, emɔ mli!”
Yesu jɔɔ gbekɛbii
(Marko 10.13-16; Luka 18.15-17)
13Kɛkɛ ni akɛ gbekɛbii bibii ba eŋɔɔ, koni ekɛ eniji ashwie amɛnɔ ni esɔle ehã amɛ. Shi ekaselɔi lɛ fãmɔ amɛ. 14 Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.” 15Ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ; ni eje jɛi.
Oblanyo niiatsɛ lɛ
(Marko 10.17-27; Luka 18.18-27)
16Ni mɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛɛ nɔ kpakpa po mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?” 17 Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba obiɔ mi nɔ kpakpa he sane? Mɔ kome yɔɔ ni ji mɔ kpakpa [lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ]. Shi kɛji ootao akɛ obote wala mli lɛ, ye kitãi lɛ anɔ.” 18 Ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te nii ni jiŋ?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Kaagbe gbɔmɔ; kaafite gbãlã; kaaju; kaaye amale odase; 19 wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ; kɛ suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.” 20Oblanyo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ miye nɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi. Mɛni shwɛɔ mi lolo?” 21 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji ootao akɛ ohi kɛwula shi lɛ, yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ nii ni oyɔɔ lɛ, ni okɛhã ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba obanyiɛ misɛɛ.” 22 Shi be ni oblanyo lɛ nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee kɛ dɔlɛ; ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
23Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ewa hã niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. 24Shi asaŋ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ejaraaa hãaa yooma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ejaraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ.” 25Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe tsɔ̃ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?” 26Shi Yesu kwɛ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi agbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛŋ enɛ afee; shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaanyɛ nii fɛɛ afee.”
Yesu sɛɛnyiɛmɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo
(Marko 10.28-31; Luka 18.28-30)
27Kɛkɛ ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi nii fɛɛ, ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ; belɛ mɛni wɔbaana?” 28 Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛ misɛɛ nɛɛ, be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaata enunyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ jeŋ hee lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛaatara sɛ̃ii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, ni nyɛaakojo Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ. 29 Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshi shĩai loo nyɛmimɛi hii loo nyɛmimɛi yei loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo ŋa loo bii loo shikpɔji yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, aaato lɛ najiaŋ toi oha, ni eeena naanɔ wala. 30 Shi klɛŋklɛŋ bii pii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpee bii, ni sɛɛkpee bii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ bii.”

Title: MATEO 20
Content:
Waintrom mli nitsulɔi lɛ
1 “Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ nuu shĩatsɛ ko ni je kpo maŋkɛ mra ni eyabɔ nitsulɔi apaa kɛya ewaintrom mli. 2Ni be ni ekɛ nitsulɔi lɛ eye naa denario kome jenamɔ lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ kɛtee ewaintrom lɛ mli. 3Ni kɛbaa ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu mli lɛ, eje kpo ekoŋŋ ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi damɔ shi efolo yɛ jaa lɛ nɔ; 4ni ekɛɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli, ni nɔ ni sa lɛ, mahã nyɛ,’ ni amɛtee. 5Asaŋ kɛbaa ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli kɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ eje kpo, ni eyafee nakai nɔŋŋ. 6Ni kɛbaa gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ mli lɛ eje kpo ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi hu damɔ shi efolo, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba ni nyɛdamɔ shi efolo yɛ biɛ jenamɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ?’ 7Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Akɛni mɔ ko ebɔko wɔ apaa lɛ hewɔŋ.’ Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli.’
8 “Agbɛnɛ be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, waintromtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsulɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsɛ nitsulɔi lɛ ni owo amɛ nyɔmɔ, ni obɔ̃i kɛjɛ sɛɛkpee bii lɛ anɔ kɛyashi klɛŋklɛŋ bii lɛ anɔ.’ 9Ni be ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ bii lɛ ba lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛna denario komekome. 10Ni be ni klɛŋklɛŋ bii lɛ ba lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ amɛaana fe nakai; shi amɛ hu amɛna denario komekome. 11Shi be ni eshɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ, amɛshɛ tɔkemɔ kɛ shĩatsɛ lɛ woo 12akɛ, ‘Sɛɛkpee bii nɛɛ; ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome kɛkɛ amɛtsu nii, ni ohã amɛ kɛ wɔ ni wɔtsu nii jenamɔ ni etɔ wɔ ni latsaa etsa wɔ lɛ fɛɛ pɛ!’ 13Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Naanyo, mifeko bo efɔŋ ko; ani jeee denario okɛ mi ye naa? 14Ŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji onɔ lɛ ni oya. Shi miisumɔ akɛ mahã sɛɛkpee mɔ nɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mihã bo lɛ nɔŋŋ. 15 Aloo mibɛ hegbɛ akɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minii feɔ nɔ ni misumɔɔ? Ani mimlihilɛ lɛ hewɔ ohiŋmɛi etsu nɛɛ?’ 16 Nɛkɛ ni sɛɛkpeebii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii, ni klɛŋklɛŋbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpeebii; [ejaakɛ atsɛ mɛi pii, shi mɛi fioo ahala.]”
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃
(Marko 10.32-34; Luka 18.31-34)
17Ni be ni Yesu yaa Yerusalɛm lɛ, ekɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tee afã yɛ gbɛteŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ nigii akɛ, 18 “Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaawo osɔfonukpai kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛaabu lɛ gbele fɔ. 19Ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaahã jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ni amɛye ehe fɛo ni amɛkɛ kpelebii ayi lɛ ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi.”
Yakobo kɛ Yohane nibimɔ lɛ
(Marko 10.35-45)
20 Kɛkɛ ni Zebedeo bii lɛ anyɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakula shi ni eba lɛ nɔ ko. 21 Ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ?” Ehere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ ni mibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ata oninejurɔ nɔ, ni mɔ kome hu ata obɛku nɔ yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” 22 Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ bii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛleee nɔ ni nyɛbiɔ lɛ. Ani nyɛaanyɛ kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛnu?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔɔnyɛ.” 23Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mikpulu lɛ nyɛaanu moŋ shi mininejurɔ kɛ mibɛku nɔ tamɔ lɛ, ejeee minɔ ni mikɛhãa, shi moŋ mɛi ni miTsɛ esaa eto amɛ lɛ anɔŋ.”
24Ni be ni mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ nu lɛ, amɛmli wo nyɛmimɛi enyɔ lɛ la. 25 No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛle akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lumɛi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni amɛteŋ gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ hu yɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ. 26 Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ agbo atsɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ; 27 ni mɔ ni taoɔ nyɛteŋ onukpa atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛtsulɔ. 28 Tamɔ bɔ ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaa ni asɔmɔ lɛ, shi eba sɔ̃ɔmɔ moŋ ni ekɛ esusuma lɛ ahã yɛ mɛi pii akpɔ̃mɔ hewɔ lɛ.”
Yesu tsa shwilafoi enyɔ
(Marko 10.46-52; Luka 18.35-43)
29Ni be ni amɛjɛ Yeriko amɛyaa lɛ, asafo babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ. 30Ni hii shwilafoi enyɔ tara gbɛ lɛ toi, ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Yesu miiho lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” 31Shi asafo lɛ famɔ amɛyi akɛ amɛmua amɛnaa; shi amɛbolɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” 32Ni Yesu wa damɔ shi ni etsɛ amɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã nyɛ?” 33Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ agbele wɔhiŋmɛii lɛ.” 34Ni Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ, ni etara amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe, ni amrɔ lɛ amɛna nii, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.

Title: MATEO 21
Content:
Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ
(Marko 11.1-11; Luka 19.28-44; Yohane 12.12-19)
1Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛshɛ Betfage yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yesu tsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, 2ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ mli, ni amrɔ lɛ nyɛaana teji yoo ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi kɛ ebi; nyɛfɛnea amɛ nyɛbahãa mi. 3 Ni kɛ mɔ ko bi nyɛ sane ko lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Amɛhe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;’ ni amrɔ lɛ eeehã nyɛkɛ amɛ aba.”
4Shi afee enɛ fɛɛ koni nɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ,
5 “Nyɛkɛa Zion biyoo lɛ akɛ,
naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ.
Ehe jɔ, ni eta teji nɔ
kɛ teji ni ji nitsumɔ kooloo lɛ bi nɔ.”
6Ni kaselɔi lɛ tee amɛyafee bɔ ni Yesu fã amɛ lɛ. 7Ni amɛkɛ teji lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ ba, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei lɛ shwie amɛnɔ, ni eho eta nɔ. 8 Ni mɛi pii kɛ amɛtadei ha gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi krokomɛi hu folɔ tsei aniji amɛkɛshwie gbɛ lɛ nɔ; 9 ni asafoi ni nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ bolɔ amɛkɛɛ,
“Hosiana David Bi lɛ!
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ!
Hosiana yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!”
10Ni be ni ebote Yerusalɛm lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bu hoo amɛkɛɛ, “Namɔ nɛ?” 11Shi asafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji Yesu, gbalɔ lɛ ni jɛ Nazaret yɛ Galilea lɛ.”
Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he
(Marko 11.15-19; Luka 19.45-48)
12 Ni Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eyashwie mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etsirɛ shikatsakelɔi lɛ akplɔ̃i lɛ kɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ asɛii lɛ etswiatswia shi. 13 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Aaatsɛ miwe lɛ Sɔlemɔ we,’ shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu.”
14Ni shwilafoi kɛ obubuafoi ba eŋɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etsa amɛ. 15Shi be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ na naakpɛɛnii ni efee kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ ni bolɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ akɛ, “Hosiana David Bi!” lɛ, amɛmli wo la, 16 ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oonu nɔ ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɔ nɛɛ lo?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, ani nyɛkaneko dã akɛ, ‘Abifabii kɛ fufɔbii anaa osaa yijiemɔ oto yɛ?’ ” 17Ni eshi amɛ eje maŋ lɛ mli etee Betania, ni eyawɔ jɛi.
Yesu lomɔ agbãmitso lɛ
(Marko 11.12-14, 20-24)
18Shi leebi be ni eku esɛɛ eyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ. 19 Ni ena agbãmitso ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ he, ni etsi eshɛ he, shi enaaa nɔ ko yɛ nɔ akɛ ja bai kɛkɛ; ni ekɛɛ tso lɛ akɛ, “Owoŋ yibii ko dɔŋŋ gbi ko gbi ko!” Ni agbãmitso lɛ ŋlã amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ. 20Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni agbãmitso lɛ ŋlã amrɔ nɛɛŋ?” 21 Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛjeee ŋwane lɛ, jeee nɔ ni afee agbãmitso nɛɛ kɛkɛ nyɛaafee; shi kɛji nyɛkɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ tete akɛ, ‘Fãa ni oyagbee ŋshɔŋ lɛ’, eeeba mli nakai. 22Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaasɔle nyɛbi kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, nyɛnine aaashɛ nɔ.”
Hegbɛ ni Yesu yɔɔ
(Marko 11.27-33; Luka 20.1-8)
23 Ni be ni eba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ hewɔ ofeɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, ni namɔ hã bo nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ?” 24Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mibabi nyɛ sane kome, ni kɛji nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, mi hu matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni mikɛfeɔ nibii nɛɛ. 25Yohane Baptisimɔ lɛ, nɛgbɛ ejɛ? Ŋwɛi ejɛ, loo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ?” Ni amɛtao mli yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛheee Yohane nyɛyeee mɔ?’ 26Ni kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ, no hu wɔmiishe asafo lɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ buɔ Yohane gbalɔ.” 27Kɛkɛ ni amɛhere Yesu nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔleee.” Lɛ hu ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ hewɔ ni mifeɔ nibii nɛɛ mɔ.”
Bihii enyɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ
28“Shi agbɛnɛ te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ? Nuu ko yɛ bii enyɔ; ni etee mɔ kome ŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Mibi; ŋmɛnɛ yaatsu nii yɛ miwaintrom lɛ mli.’ 29Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Miyaaa.’ Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ eshwa ehe, ni etee. 30 Ni etee mɔ kroko lɛ hu ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ. Shi lɛ lɛ, ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Ataa, matee!’ Shi eyaaa. 31 Te mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni fee nɔ ni amɛtsɛ lɛ sumɔɔŋ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsutsumɔ lɛ ni.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ toohelɔi lɛ kɛ ajwamãŋi lɛ miitsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛmiiya Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. 32 Ejaakɛ Yohane ba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ jalɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee; shi tóohelɔi kɛ ajwamãŋi lɛ he lɛ amɛye. Ni fee sɛɛ, be ni nyɛyoo hu lɛ, nyɛshwaaa nyɛhe tete, koni nyɛhe lɛ nyɛye.”
Waintrom mli apaafoi fɔ̃ji lɛ
(Marko 12.1-12; Luka 20.9-19)
33 “Nyɛboa abɛ kroko hu toi,” Yesu kɛɛ, “Shĩatsɛ ko yɛ, ni efee waintrom, ni efo afabaŋ ewo he, ni etsa wainbu yɛ mli, ni emã mɔɔ yɛ mli; ni ekɛhã hulɔi apaayeli; ni edom. 34Ni be ni wainyibii kpamɔ be lɛ shɛ lɛ, etsu etsuji kɛtee hulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, akɛ amɛyaŋɔ eyibii lɛ eko amɛbahã lɛ. 35Ni hulɔi lɛ mɔmɔ etsuji lɛ, ni amɛyi mɔ kome, ni amɛgbe mɔ kome, ni amɛtswia mɔ kome hu tɛi. 36Asaŋ etsu tsuji krokomɛi ni fa fe tsutsu bii lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. 37Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ etsu ebinuu kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Mibi lɛ, lɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ aaasɔ lɛ.’ 38 Shi hulɔi lɛ, be ni amɛna binuu lɛ moŋ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ! Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ, koni wɔŋɔ egboshinii lɛ.’ 39Ni amɛmɔ lɛ amɛtsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛjɛ waintrom lɛ mli, ni amɛyagbe lɛ. 40Agbɛnɛ, kɛji waintromtsɛ lɛ ba lɛ, mɛni eeefee hulɔi nɛɛ?” 41Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eeekpãtã gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji nɛɛ ahiɛ butuu, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã hulɔi krokomɛi apaayeli, mɛi ni kɛ yibii aaabahã lɛ yɛ be ni sa mli.” 42 Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko yɛ Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli dã akɛ,
‘Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ,
no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ enɛ jɛ,
ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiŋmɛiiaŋ?’
43No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ abaashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ni akɛaahã jeŋmaŋ ko ni woɔ yibii. [ 44Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbee tɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ emli aaatsɛrɛ; shi mɔ ni tɛ lɛ aaagbee enɔ lɛ, eeegbɛlɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.”]
45Ni be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ nu ebɛi lɛ, amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛ amɛhe ewieɔ lɛ. 46Ni kulɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ, shi amɛyashe asafoi lɛ agbeyei, ejaakɛ asafoi lɛ buɔ lɛ gbalɔ.

Title: MATEO 22
Content:
Yookpeemɔ okplɔŋmɛɛ lɛ he abɛ lɛ
(Luka 14.15-24)
1Yesu wo enaa nɔ ekɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ yɛ abɛbuai amli ekɛɛ, 2 “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ko ni kpee yoo ehã ebinuu. 3Ni etsu etsuji akɛ amɛyatsɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ kɛba yookpeemɔ lɛ, shi mɛi lɛ emiii baa. 4 Esaa etsu tsuji krokomɛi ekɛɛ, ‘Nyɛyakɛa mɛi ni akpee lɛ akɛ, naa, migbe miniyenii lɛ anaa; agbe mitsinai lɛ kɛ milɛɛ kooloi lɛ, ni agbe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ naa: nyɛbaa yookpeemɔ lɛ!’ 5Shi amɛ lɛ amɛbuuu po, ni amɛtee amɛhei srɔtoi, mɔ kome tee ebɔɔ mli, ni mɔ kroko hu tee eguɔyeli. 6Ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ mɔ̃mɔ etsuji lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛ niseniianii, ni amɛgbe amɛ. 7 Shi be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ nu lɛ, emli fu, ni etsu etabilɔi, ni amɛyagbe nɛkɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi nɛɛ, ni ashã amɛmaŋ lɛ. 8Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, ‘Ato yookpeemɔ lɛ he nii agbe naa moŋ, shi mɛi ni akpee lɛ amɛsaaa. 9 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyaa ŋmaŋmashai lɛ anɔ, ni mɛi abɔ ni nyɛaana lɛ, nyɛkpea amɛ kɛbaa yookpeemɔ lɛ.’ 10Ni tsuji lɛ je kpo tee gbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛyabua mɛi fɛɛ ni amɛna lɛ anaa, mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai, ni yookpeemɔ he lɛ yi tɔ kɛ mɛi.
11“Shi be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ba mɛi lɛ akwɛmɔ lɛ, ebana mɔ ko yɛ jɛi ni wooo yookpeemɔ atade; 12ni ebi lɛ akɛ, ‘Naanyo, te fee tɛŋŋ ni oba biɛ nɛɛ ni owooo yookpeemɔ atade?’ Ni etɔ mu. 13 Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛfimɔa eniji kɛ enaji ni nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛyashɛa nyɛfɔ̃a gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli! Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.’ 14Ejaakɛ atsɛ mɛi pii moŋ; shi mɛi fioo ahala.”
Oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hãmɔ
(Marko 12.13-17; Luka 20.20-26)
15Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ tee ajina, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ. 16 Ni amɛtsu amɛkaselɔi lɛ kɛ Herodebii lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo, ni otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni osheee mɔ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ; 17no hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ bɔ ni osusuɔ, ani eja akɛ atsuɔ onia ahãa Kaisare, aloo ejaaa?” 18Shi Yesu yoo amɛyiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Osatofoi, mɛɛba nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi? 19Nyɛkɛ shika ni akɛtsuɔ onia lɛ atsɔ̃a mi!” Ni amɛkɛ shika lɛ bahã lɛ. 20Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mfoniri nɛ, ni namɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?” 21 Amɛkɛɛ, “Kaisare nɔŋ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ nyɛkɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare, ni Nyɔŋmɔ nii lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ!” 22Ni be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛshi lɛ amɛtee.
Gbohiiashitee he sanebimɔ
(Marko 12.18-27; Luka 20.27-40)
23 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Sadukifoi ni kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ hu ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, 24 “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji mɔ ko gbo ni ebɛ bii lɛ enyɛmi aŋɔ eŋa lɛ, koni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.’ 25Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi wɔteŋ, ni kromɔbi lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni ebɛ bii, ni eshi eŋa lɛ ehã enyɛmi lɛ. 26Nakai nɔŋŋ eba mli yɛ mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, kɛyashi mɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ. 27Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu gbo. 28Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ, mɛi kpawo lɛ ateŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ ehi shi?” 29Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmiitɔ̃ naa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee ŋmalɛi lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ. 30Ejaakɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ aŋɔɔɔ yei, ni asaŋ akɛ yei hãaa gbãlã; shi moŋ amɛtamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi yɛ ŋwɛi. 31Shi ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ yɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ he akɛ, 32 ‘Mi lɛ, Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi lɛ?’ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jeee gbohii aNyɔŋmɔ ni, shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi aNyɔŋmɔ ni.” 33Ni be ni asafoi lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ etsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he.
Kitã Wulu lɛ
(Marko 12.28-34; Luka 10.25-29)
34Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu akɛ eku Sadukifoi lɛ anaa lɛ, amɛbabua amɛhe naa; 35ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ji mlatsɔɔlɔ lɛ ka lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, 36“Tsɔɔlɔ te nɔ ni ji Mla lɛ mli kitã wuluŋ?” 37 Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ otsui muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ osusuma muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ. 38Kitãi lɛ amli oti kɛ ewulu nɛ. 39 Ni nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ no, akɛ, ‘Suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.’ 40 Kitãi enyɔ nɛɛ nɔ Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ.”
David Bi ni ji David Nuŋtsɔ lɛ
(Marko 12.35-37; Luka 20.41-44)
41Ni be ni Farisifoi lɛ anaa ekpe shi lɛ, Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, 42“Te nyɛsusuɔ yɛ Kristo lɛ he tɛŋŋ? Namɔ bi ji lɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “David Biŋ.” 43Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba mɔ ni David, yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, tsɛɔ lɛ ‘Nuŋtsɔ’ ni ekɛɔ akɛ,
44 ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ,
Ta mininejurɔ nɔ
Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mikɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ
aaawo onaji ashishi lɛ?’
45Agbɛnɛ kɛji David tsɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebiŋ?” 46Ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ hetoo ko ahã, ni asaŋ kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ nɔ ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.

Title: MATEO 23
Content:
Yesu wie shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ
(Marko 12.38-40; Luka 11.39-52; 20.45-47)
1Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ asafoi lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ wie ekɛɛ, 2“Mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ, Mose sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ amɛtara lɛ. 3 No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛye nɔ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ ni nyɛfea; shi nyɛkafea nibii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ moŋ shi amɛfeee. 4Shi amɛfimɔɔ jatsui kɛ tsiimɔ amɛŋmɛlɛɔ mɛi akɔ̃ji anɔ; shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ amɛkɛ amɛwao saa he. 5 Shi amɛnii fɛɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ koni mɛi ana. Ejaakɛ amɛhãa amɛsɔlemɔkaimɔ kotokui kɛ amɛtadei anaamui lɛ lɛɔ. 6 Amɛsumɔɔ yitsotamɔ kɛji atsɛ okplɔ̃, kɛ onukpai asɛii yɛ kpeehei lɛ, 7kɛ jaanɔ ŋamɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ akɛ mɛi atsɛ amɛ ‘Tsɔɔlɔ!’ 8Shi nyɛ lɛ, akatsɛ nyɛ ‘Tsɔɔlɔ’; ejaakɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ; shi nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ji nyɛ. 9Ni nyɛkatsɛa mɔ ko nyɛTsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ mɔ kome pɛ ji nyɛTsɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ. 10Asaŋ akatsɛ nyɛ ‘Nuŋtsɔ’; ejaakɛ mɔ kome pɛ ji nyɛNuŋtsɔ, lɛ ji Kristo. 11 Shi mɔ ni ji agbo yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, etsɔ̃ nyɛtsulɔ. 12 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawo ehe nɔ lɛ, aaaba lɛ shi; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaba ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ.
13“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛŋaa ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ naa nyɛwoɔ gbɔmɛi; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nyɛboteee mli, ni mɛi ni taoɔ mli abote lɛ hu, nyɛŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛbote mli.”
[ 14 “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛ ablatoo sɔleɔ sɔlemɔi kakadaji. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkojomɔ aaafe nine.”]
15“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛbɔleɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ kpula, koni nyɛfee mɔ kome Yudafonyo; ni be ni mɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ nakai lɛ, nyɛfeɔ lɛ abonsamiiaje bi toi enyɔ fe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe.
16 “Kpoo hã nyɛ, gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi! Nyɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kitã lɛ, no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ kitã lɛ, efiɔ lɛ.’ 17Shwilafoi kwashiai! Te nɔ ni feŋ, shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ, loo Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni hãa shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ? 18Ni asaŋ, ‘Mɔ ni aaakã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kitã lɛ, no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã enɔ afɔle lɛ kitã lɛ, efiɔ lɛ.’ 19 Shwilafoi kwashiai! Te nɔ ni feŋ, afɔle lɛ, loo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni hãa afɔle lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ? 20No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni aaakã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kitã lɛ, ekã no kɛ nii ni yɔɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ kitã. 21Ni mɔ ni kãa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kitã lɛ, ekã no kɛ mɔ ni hiɔ mli lɛ kitã. 22 Ni mɔ ni kãa ŋwɛi kitã lɛ, ekã Nyɔŋmɔ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ hu kitã.
23 “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ anisi kɛ kumino mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, shi Mla lɛ mli nii ni he jaraa ni ji jalɛ saneyeli kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɛshiɔ; enɛɛmɛi sa akɛ nyɛfeɔ kɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ. 24Gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi nyɛtsereɔ nɔ nɔ adɔ̃dɔ̃ŋ, shi nyɛmiɔ yooma!
25 “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ; shi amɛmligbɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ojotswaa kɛ adufudeyeli.
26 “Farisifonyo shwilafo, sha kpulu lɛ kɛ kã lɛ mli ni aje tsutsu, kɛkɛ lɛ esɛɛ hu aaaje!
27 “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛtamɔ gbohii asaŋi ni asha he ni amɛhewɔ efee fɛo moŋ, shi amɛmligbɛ lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbohii awui kɛ muji nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ. 28Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ lɛ, nyɛpueɔ akɛ jalɔi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi yɛ mligbɛ lɛ nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ osato kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ̃.
29“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛmãmɔɔ gbalɔi lɛ atoohei, ni nyɛwulaa jalɔi lɛ asaŋi lɛ, 30ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Eji wɔtsɛmɛi ayinɔ lɛ wɔyɛ jeŋ kulɛ, wɔfataŋ amɛhe kɛshwieŋ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi.’ 31 Belɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛhe odase akɛ mɛi ni gbe gbalɔi lɛ abii ji nyɛ. 32Nyɛ hu nyɛwoa nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ asusumɔ tsene lɛ obɔ̃ mɔ! 33 Onufui, shikpãi ashwiei! Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ nyɛjo abonsamiiaje fɔbuu lɛ naa foiŋ? 34 No hewɔ lɛ, naa, miitsu gbalɔi kɛ nilelɔi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, ni nyɛaagbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni nyɛaasɛŋ mɛi komɛi, ni mɛi krokomɛi lɛ nyɛaayi amɛ kpelebii yɛ nyɛkpeehei lɛ, ni nyɛaawa amɛ yi kɛaajɛ maŋ kome mli kɛaatee ekroko mli. 35 Bɔ ni afee ni jalɔi alá fɛɛ ni ashwie shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Abel, jalɔ lɛ, lá lɛ nɔ kɛbashi Zakaria, Barakia bi lɛ, ni nyɛgbe lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ lá lɛ nɔ lɛ aba nyɛnɔ. 36Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaaba yinɔbii nɛɛ anɔ.”
Yesu ye Yerusalɛm he jaramɔ
37 “Yerusalɛm, Yerusalɛm, bo ni ogbeɔ gbalɔi lɛ ni otswiaa mɛi ni atsuɔ amɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ atɛi; shii enyiɛ mitao akɛ kulɛ mabua obii anaa tamɔ bɔ ni wuɔ buaa ebii anaa ewoɔ efiji ashishi lɛ, ni nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ! 38 Naa, ashi nyɛwe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ahã nyɛ! 39 Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ.’ ”

Title: MATEO 24
Content:
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fitemɔ he gbalɛ
(Marko 13.1-2; Luka 21.5-6)
1Ni Yesu je kpo yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni be ni eyaa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tsui lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ. 2 Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Te nyɛmiina nii nɛɛ fɛɛ? Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ashiŋ tɛ kome yɛ eko nɔ yɛ biɛ ni akpãŋ aluŋ shi.”
Amanehului ashishijee
(Marko 13.3-13; Luka 21.7-19)
3Shi be ni eta shi yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ yɛ afã amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ beyinɔ ni aaafee nii nɛɛ, ni mɛni ji obaa lɛ kɛ je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ he okadi?” 4Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni mɔ ko akabalaka nyɛ. 5 Ejaakɛ mɛi pii kɛ migbɛi aaabakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji Kristo lɛ!’ Ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii. 6Shi nyɛaanu tai kɛ tai atatsĩĩ ahe; nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛtsui akafãa; ejaakɛ esa akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ aba mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ naagbee lɛ shɛko. 7Shi maŋ aaate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyeli aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli; ni hɔ̃ji kɛ shikpɔŋ hosomɔi aaaba hei srɔtoi. 8Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ kɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ashishijee ni. 9 Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ amɛwo amanehulu mli, ni amɛaagbe nyɛ; ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ. 10Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛi pii anane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃ɔ amɛnanemɛi asɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛaanyɛnyɛɛ amɛhe. 11 Ni amale gbalɔi pii aaate shi, ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii. 12 Ni akɛni mlakwamɔ baafa hewɔ lɛ, mɛi pii asuɔmɔ lɛ he aaajɔ. 13 Shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛyawulaa shi lɛ, lɛ eyiwala aaahere. 14 Ni aaashiɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kpakpa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni akɛye jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ odase; ni no dani naagbee lɛ aaaba.”
Amanehulu kpeteŋkple lɛ
(Marko 13.14-23; Luka 21.20-24)
15 “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛna ‘Amaŋfɔ̃ nihiinii lɛ’ ni gbalɔ Daniel wie he lɛ akɛ ema he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ (mɔ ni kaneɔ lɛ eyoo sɛɛ!) 16No lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi amɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ; 17 mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ lɛ, ekakpeleke shi eyakɔ nɔ ko kɛjɛ eshĩa; 18ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi lɛ, ekaaku esɛɛ eyakɔ etade. 19Shi kpoo hã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ yei ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ! 20 Shi nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛfoijee lɛ akaba yɛ fɛ̃i be lɛ mli aloo yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ. 21 Ejaakɛ nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amanehulu kpele aaaba ni anako enɔ dã kɛjɛ je lɛ shishijee mli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni asaŋ anaŋ enɔ gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ. 22Ni kɛ afooo nakai gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, ahereŋ heloo ko heloo ko yiwala; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ ahewɔ lɛ aaafo nɔ. 23No mli lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, Kristo lɛ yɛ biɛ loo biɛ lɛ’, nyɛkahea nyɛyea. 24 Ejaakɛ amale kristoi kɛ amale gbalɔi aaate shi ni amɛaafee okadii wuji kɛ ashwãi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ, bɔ ni kɛ aaaho lɛ amɛaalaka halamɔbii lɛ tete. 25Naa, mikɛɛ nyɛ mito. 26No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji amɛkɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, eyɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ’, nyɛkayaa; aloo, ‘naa, eyɛ piai lɛ amli lɛ;’ nyɛkahea nyɛyea. 27 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni srawa gbaa kɛjɛɔ bokã kɛyaa anai lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ aaatamɔ. 28 Ejaakɛ he fɛɛ he ni gbonyo kã lɛ, jɛi akpaŋai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ.”
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa
(Marko 13.24-27; Luka 21.25-28)
29 “Shi nakai gbii lɛ amli amanehului lɛ asɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, hulu aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ni ŋulamii aaatserɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi atswia shi, ni ŋwɛi hewalɛi lɛ aaahoso. 30 Kɛkɛ lɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ okadi lɛ aaapue yɛ ŋwɛi, ni no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaawo yara, ni amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ anɔ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ anunyam babaoo. 31 Ni eeetsu ebɔfoi lɛ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni gbee wa, ni amɛaabua ehalamɔbii lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛajɛ ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome kɛaaya naagbeehe kroko lɛ.”
Agbãmitso he nikasemɔ
(Marko 13.28-31; Luka 21.29-33)
32“Shi nyɛkasea agbãmitso abɛ ni ebuɔ lɛ, be ni eniji lɛ efrɔke ni eefu baa lɛ, nyɛle akɛ latsaa be lɛ eshɛ etã. 33Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛna nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛlea akɛ eshɛ agboi lɛ anaa etã. 34Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, ja nii nɛɛ fɛɛ eba mli dã. 35 Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ baaho aya, shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ.”
Mɔ ko leee gbi lɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ
(Marko 13.32-37; Luka 17.26-30, 34-36)
36 “Shi nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee nɔ ko yɛ he, bɔfoi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tete leee, ni Bi lɛ leee, ja Tsɛ lɛ kome kɛkɛ. 37 Shi bɔ ni Noa gbii lɛ fee lɛ, nakai Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ hu aaatamɔ. 38 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ gbii ni nyiɛ nu afua lɛ hiɛ lɛ amli, ni mɛi lɛ hiɛ niyeli kɛ ninumɔ kɛ yooŋɔɔ kɛ gbãlãhamɔ mli aahu kɛyashi gbi ni Noa yabote adeka lɛ mli, 39ni amɛleee kɛyashi nu afua lɛ baloo amɛ fɛɛ kɛtee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ aaatamɔ. 40 No mli lɛ mɛi enyɔ aaahi ŋmɔshi; aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome lɛ. 41Yei enyɔ aaawiɛ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ; aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome lɛ. 42 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee nɔ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ baa. 43 Shi nyɛkaia akɛ, kɛ shĩatsɛ ko le nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni julɔ baa lɛ, kulɛ eeesra ni eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni agbu ewe lɛ awoŋ. 44 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛsusuuu lɛ nɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa.”
Tsuji anɔkwafoi
(Luka 12.41-48)
45“Belɛ namɔ ji tsulɔ anɔkwafo kɛ nilelɔ mɔ ni enuŋtsɔ kɛ lɛ eto ewebii lɛ anɔ, koni ehã amɛ amɛŋmaa yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ? 46Ajɔɔ nakai tsulɔ lɛ, mɔ ni be ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ baa lɛ ni eeebana lɛ ni eefee nakai lɛ. 47 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaato enii fɛɛ kwa nɔ.
48 “Shi kɛji nakai tsulɔ fɔŋ lɛ aaakɛɛ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Minuŋtsɔ lɛ miitsi ebaabe lɛ eeto;’ 49ni eeebɔ̃i enanemɛi tsuji lɛ yii, ni ekɛ dãatɔlɔi lɛ aaaye, ni ekɛ amɛ aaanu lɛ, 50nakai tsulɔ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba yɛ gbi nɔ ni ekwɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni eleee, 51 ni eeefo emli enyɔ ni eeehã lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ osatofoi lɛ ateŋ. Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.”

Title: MATEO 25
Content:
Oblayei nyɔŋma lɛ he abɛ lɛ
1 “No mli lɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaatãmɔ oblayei nyɔŋma ni hole amɛkanei ni amɛtee amɛkɛ ayɛmforowu ayakpe. 2Shi amɛteŋ mɛi enumɔ lɛ kwashiai ji amɛ, ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ nilelɔi ni. 3Kwashiai lɛ hole amɛkanei lɛ shi amɛŋɔɔɔ mu amɛhiɛɛɛ amɛdɛ̃. 4Shi nilelɔi lɛ kɛ mu wo amɛtɔi amli amɛfata amɛkanei lɛ ahe. 5Ni akɛni ayɛmforowu lɛ tsɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ ye amɛ fɛɛ ni amɛwɔwɔi. 6Shi nyɔɔŋ teŋ lɛ anu blɔmɔ akɛ, ‘Naa, ayɛmforowu lɛ miiba ee! Nyɛjea kpo, nyɛkɛ lɛ ayakpea!’ 7Kɛkɛ ni oblayei lɛ fɛɛ te shi ni amɛsaa amɛkanei lɛ. 8Ni kwashiai lɛ kɛɛ nilelɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔ nyɛmu lɛ eko, ejaakɛ wɔkanei lɛ miigboi.’ 9Shi nilelɔi lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Ekolɛ ebashɛŋ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ; shi moŋ nyɛyaa mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ lɛ aŋɔɔ nyɛyahea eko nyɛhãa nyɛhe,’ 10Shi be ni amɛtee hemɔ lɛ, ayɛmforowu lɛ ba, ni mɛi ni esaa amɛhe eto lɛ kɛ lɛ tee yookpeemɔ lɛ, ni aŋa shinaa lɛ. 11 No sɛɛ lɛ, oblayei krokomɛi lɛ hu ba ni amɛbakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, gbelemɔ wɔ!’ 12 Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ mileee nyɛ.’ 13 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee gbi lɛ loo ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ.”
Tsuji etɛ̃ lɛ ahe abɛ lɛ
(Luka 19.11-27)
14 “Shi etamɔ nuu ko ni be ni ebaadom lɛ, etsɛ etsuji, ni etu enibii ewo amɛdɛŋ; 15ni ehã mɔ kome talentai enumɔ, mɔ kome hu enyɔ, ni mɔ kome hu ekome, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni eeenyɛ he nii etsu; ni edom. 16Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ mɔ ni na talentai enumɔ lɛ tee ni eyatsɔ̃mɔ he, ni ena talentai enumɔ ebɔ he. 17Nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni na enyɔ lɛ hu yana enyɔ ebɔ he. 18Shi mɔ ni na ekome lɛ tee eyatsa shi, ni ekɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ shika lɛ tee.
19“Shi yɛ mli aahu lɛ, tsuji nɛɛ anuŋtsɔ lɛ ba, ni ekɛ amɛ babu akɔntaa. 20Ni mɔ ni na talentai enumɔ lɛ ba, ni ekɛ talentai enumɔ kroko hu babɔ he ekɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, okɛ talentai enumɔ hã mi, naa, mina enumɔ hu mifata he.’ 21 Enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Aekoo, tsulɔ kpakpa kɛ anɔkwafo, oye anɔkwa yɛ nii fioo he, mato bo nii pii anɔkwɛlɔ; botemɔ onuŋtsɔ miishɛɛ lɛ mli.’ 22Ni mɔ ni na talentai enyɔ lɛ hu ba ni ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, okɛ talentai enyɔ hã mi, naa, mina talentai enyɔ hu mifata he.’ 23 Enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Aekoo, tsulɔ kpakpa kɛ anɔkwafo, oye anɔkwa yɛ nii fioo he, mato bo nii pii anɔkwɛlɔ; botemɔ onuŋtsɔ miishɛɛ lɛ mli.’ 24Shi mɔ ni na talenta kome lɛ hu ba bakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, mile bo akɛ yiwalɔ ji bo; okpaa nii yɛ he ni oduko nɔ ko yɛ, ni obuaa nii anaa yɛ he ni oshwãko nɔ ko yɛ; 25ni no hã mishe gbeyei, ni miyafu otalenta lɛ. Naa onii.’ 26Shi enuŋtsɔ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsulɔ fɔŋ kɛ anihaolɔ! Ni ole akɛ mikpaa nii yɛ he ni miduko nɔ ko yɛ ni mibuaa nii anaa yɛ he ni mishwãko nɔ ko yɛ lɛ, 27kulɛ ogbɛnaa ji akɛ oŋɔɔ mishika lɛ owoɔ tsakelɔi adɛŋ, ni kɛ miba lɛ ni mibahe minii kɛ ehekpa. 28No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhea talenta lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛhãa mɔ ni yɔɔ talentai nyɔŋma lɛ. 29 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ aaahã lɛ, koni ena ni ateke nɔ; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahe nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ. 30 Ni tsulɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko nɛɛ, nyɛtsia lɛ nyɛwoa gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi!’ ”
Jeŋmaji lɛ akojomɔ
31 “Shi be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba yɛ enunyam lɛ mli, ni bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ aaafata ehe lɛ, no mli lɛ eeeta enunyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ; 32 ni aaabua jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ anaa yɛ ehiɛ, ni eeegbala amɛmli tamɔ bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ gbalaa gwantɛŋi kɛ abotiai amli lɛ. 33 Ni ekɛ gwantɛŋi lɛ aaadamɔ eninejurɔ nɔ, shi abotiai lɛ ekɛ amɛ aaadamɔ ebɛku nɔ. 34Kɛkɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaakɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ eninejurɔ nɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa, nyɛ mɛi ni miTsɛ ejɔɔ nyɛ, nyɛbaŋɔa maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni asaa ato nyɛ kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ! 35 Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nii miye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nu minu; gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhã mibato nyɛŋɔɔ; 36minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwo mi atade; mihe ye, ni nyɛbasara mi; awo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛba miŋɔɔ.’ 37 Kɛkɛ lɛ jalɔi lɛ aaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ hɔ̃mɔ miiye bo, ni wɔhã bo nii oyeŋ, aloo akɛ kumai miiye bo, ni wɔhã bo nɔ ko onuŋ? 38Ni te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ gbɔ ji bo, ni wɔhã obato wɔŋɔɔŋ; aloo akɛ onyiɛ yayai ni wɔwo bo atade? 39Asaŋ te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ ohe miiye aloo awo bo tsuŋ, ni wɔba oŋɔɔŋ?’ 40 Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ aaahere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni nyɛfee nyɛhã minyɛmimɛi nɛɛ ateŋ bibioo kome lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ nyɛfee nyɛhã lɛ.’
41 “Kɛkɛ lɛ eeekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ebɛku nɔ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛjea minɔ, nyɛ mɛi ni alomɔ nyɛ, nyɛyaa naanɔ la lɛ ni asaa ato abonsam kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ mli! 42Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nii maye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nu manu; 43gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhãaa mabato nyɛŋɔɔ; minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwooo mi atade; mihe ye ni asaŋ awo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛbasaraaa mi.’ 44Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ hu amɛaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ hɔmɔ miiye bo aloo kumai miiye bo aloo akɛ gbɔ ji bo aloo onyiɛ yayai aloo ohe miiye aloo awo bo tsuŋ, ni wɔbasɔmɔɔɔ bo lɛ?’ 45Kɛkɛ lɛ eeehere amɛ nɔ eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ ni nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mɛi bibii kwraa nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mi hu!’ 46 Ni mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ, amɛaatee naanɔ hejaramɔ mli; shi jalɔi lɛ aaatee naanɔ wala mli.”

Title: MATEO 26
Content:
Atee Yesu yinɔ apam
(Marko 14.1-2; Luka 22.1-2)
1Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ anaa lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, 2 “Nyɛle akɛ eshwɛ gbii enyɔ ni ayeɔ Hehoo lɛ, ni aaajie Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ahã ni asɛŋ lɛ.” 3No mli lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ eyabua amɛhe naa yɛ osɔfonukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kaiafa lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli. 4Ni amɛtee apam, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ Yesu ŋaa mli ni agbe lɛ; 5shi amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, koni maŋ lɛ mli akabafee hirihiri.”
Afɔ Yesu mu yɛ Betania
(Marko 14.3-9; Yohane 12.1-8)
6Be ni Yesu yɔɔ Betania yɛ Simon, kpitiyelɔ lɛ, we lɛ, 7yoo ko hiɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ emli mukɛŋma ni jara wa kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni be ni eta niyenii ashi lɛ, efɔse eshwie eyiteŋ. 8Shi be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ; amɛmli wo la amɛkɛɛ, “Te yaka nifitemɔ nɛɛ shishiŋ? 9Ejaakɛ mukɛŋma nɛɛ kulɛ aaanyɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ahe shika pii ni akɛhã ohiafoi.” 10Shi be ni Yesu na enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛgbaa yoo lɛ naa? Etsu nitsumɔ fɛɛfɛo ehã mi. 11 Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa, shi mi lɛ, jeee daa mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi. 12Ejaakɛ mukɛŋma nɛɛ ni efɔse eshwie migbɔmɔtso lɛ nɔ nɛɛ, efee eto mifuu lɛ. 13Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, he fɛɛ he ni aajaje sane kpakpa nɛɛ yɛ, yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ lɛ, aaagba nɔ ni yoo nɛɛ fee nɛɛ hu akɛkai lɛ.”
Yuda kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ
(Marko 14.10-11; Luka 22.3-6)
14Kɛkɛ ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yuda Iskariot lɛ yiŋ etee osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ 15 ni eyabi akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛaahã mi ni majie lɛ mawo nyɛdɛŋ?” Ni amɛkane jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛhã lɛ. 16 Ni kɛjɛ no be lɛ nɔ lɛ etao ehe gbɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ ewo amɛdɛŋ.
Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ anaagbee niyenii
(Marko 14.12-21; Luka 22.7-14, 21-23; Yohane 13.21-30)
17 Shi akpiti gbii juji lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa wɔhã bo ni oyaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ jɛi?” 18Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli ni nyɛyakɛa ashimashi akɛ, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, mibe lɛ eshɛ etã; owe lɛ mikɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ!’ ” 19Ni ekaselɔi lɛ yafee bɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
20Be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ yatara niyenii lɛ ahe. 21Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.” 22Ni edɔ amɛ naakpa, ni amɛbɔ̃i lɛ bimɔ ekomekome yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, miŋ lo?” 23 Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mɔ nine ni kɛ minine kpeɔ yɛ kã lɛ mli lɛ, lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ. 24Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ; faŋ nɔ ni anaaa afɔ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ.” 25Ni Yuda, esɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ, here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ani miŋ, Tsɔɔlɔ?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ!”
Nuŋtsɔ niyenii lɛ shishitoo
(Marko 14.22-25; Luka 22.15-20; 1 Korintobii 11.23-25)
26 Shi be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɔ aboloo, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea, nyɛyea! Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso lɛ.” 27Ni ewo kpulu lɛ, ni eda shi ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnua eko! 28 Ejaakɛ enɛ ji mila ni ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni afɔse ashwie shi yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ hã eshaifaa lɛ. 29Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ benɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ, kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ aaanu lɛ ehee yɛ miTsɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” 30 Ni be ni amɛla yijiemɔ lala ko lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛtee Mu gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto
(Marko 14.27-31; Luka 22.31-34; Yohane 13.36-38)
31 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ mihewɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Matswa tookwɛlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni tooku lɛ aaagbɛ ashwã.’ 32 Shi mishitee sɛɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛya Galilea.” 33Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ nane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ ohewɔ lɛ, mi lɛ minane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ gbi ko gbi ko.” 34 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ nɔŋŋ, dani wuɔ aaagbɛɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃.” 35 Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji gbo mikɛ bo aaagbo tete lɛ mikpãŋ yɛ osɛɛ.” Nakai nɔŋŋ kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ hu kɛɛ.
Yesu yɛ Getsemane
(Marko 14.32-42; Luka 22.39-46)
36Agbɛnɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ba he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Getsemane; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtaraa shi yɛ biɛ, koni maya ni mayasɔle yɛ jɛi.” 37 Ni eŋɔ Petro kɛ Zebedeo bihii enyɔ lɛ efata ehe ni ewerɛ bɔ̃i ehe hoo ni ehao. 38 Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Misusuma were eho ehe kɛyaashi gbele mli tɔ̃ɔ, nyɛhia shi yɛ biɛ ni nyɛkɛ mi ashia kpe!” 39 Ni etee hiɛ fioo, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ, kɛji aaaho lɛ, hã ni kpulu nɛɛ aho mihe aya; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.” 40Ni eba kaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ena akɛ amɛwɔ, ni ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛkɛ mi ashi kpe ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome pɛ? 41 Nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛkabote kaa mli; mumɔ lɛ miikpɛ̃lɛ̃ moŋ, shi heloo lɛ egbede.” 42Eyiŋ etee ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni eyasɔle ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ, kɛji kpulu nɛɛ nyɛŋ mihe aho aya akɛ ja minu lɛ, afee bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.” 43Ni be ni eba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ena akɛ amɛwɔ; ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii etsii. 44 Ni esaa eshi amɛ etee ekoŋŋ, ni eyasɔle nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃, ni ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ. 45Kɛkɛ ni eba ekaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ ni nyɛwɔɔ nɛɛ? Naa; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ etã, ni aaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ. 46Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔyaa; naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ eshɛ shi etã.”
Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ emɔmɔ
(Marko 14.43-50; Luka 22.47-53; Yohane 18.3-12)
47Ni be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, Yuda, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ ba, ni asafo pii ni jɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ, kɛ lɛ nyiɛ, ni amɛhiɛ klantei kɛ kpotii. 48Shi esɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ eto amɛ okadi akɛ, “Mɔ naa ni mashwɔ lɛ, lɛ ni; nyɛmɔa lɛ!” 49Ni amrɔ lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, “Oshwiee, Rabi! Ni eshwɔ enaa.” 50Shi Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Naanyo, mɛni feemɔ oba yɛ biɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni mɛi lɛ batua Yesu ni amɛmɔ lɛ. 51Ni naa, mɛi ni kɛ Yesu yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kpã enine mli egbala eklante, ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ, ni efo etoi. 52 Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ oklante lɛ ato etoohe; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɔlɔɔ klante lɛ, klante naa amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ. 53Aloo osusuɔ akɛ minyɛŋ miTsɛ fai makpa ni amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ eeehã mi ŋwɛi bɔfoi fe asafoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ? 54Shi no lɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nɔ ni ŋmalɛi lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ ja eba lɛ nɛkɛ lɛ aaaba mliŋ?”
55No ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ asafoi lɛ akɛ, “Mimɔmɔ nyɛba kɛ klante kɛ kpotii, tamɔ amɔɔ ojotswalɔ ko nɛɛ? Mitaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ daa mitsɔ̃ɔ nii, ni nyɛmɔɔɔ mi. 56 Shi afee enɛ fɛɛ koni nii ni gbalɔi lɛ ŋmala lɛ aba mli.” Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi shi lɛ.
Yesu yɛ Gwabɔɔ wulu lɛ hiɛ
(Marko 14.53-65; Luka 22.54-55, 63-71; Yohane 18.13-14, 19-24)
57Agbɛnɛ mɛi ni mɔ Yesu lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee Kaiafa, osɔfonukpa lɛ; ŋɔɔ, yɛ he ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ. 58Shi Petro nyiɛ esɛɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ebote jɛi ekɛ tsuji lɛ yata shi, koni ekwɛ bɔ ni naagbee aaatamɔ ahã. 59Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ tao amale odase yɛ Yesu he, koni amɛgbe lɛ; 60shi amɛnaaa eko; tsɛbelɛ amale odasefoi pii ba. Fee sɛɛ lɛ amale odasefoi enyɔ ba 61 amɛbakɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Manyɛ makumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni mama lɛ gbii etɛ̃.’ ” 62Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi ebi lɛ akɛ, “Otooo he eko? Mɛɛ odase mɛnɛɛmɛi yeɔ shiɔ bo nɛɛ?” 63 Shi Yesu etswaaa esɛŋ. Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina Nyɔŋmɔ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, akɛ kɛji bo ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ!” 64 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ. Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eta Hewalɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ amli.” 65 Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ gbala etadei ni ekɛɛ, “Ebɔ musu! Mɛni wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ odasefoi wɔfee dɔŋŋ? Naa, agbɛnɛ nyɛnu emusubɔɔ lɛ! 66 Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ?” Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Esa gbele!” 67 Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehiɛ, ni amɛgbala lɛ mai; ni mɛi komɛi hu tswia lɛ nii 68amɛkɛɛ, “Kristo, gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ, namɔ ji mɔ ni yi bo lɛ?”
Petro kwa Yesu
(Marko 14.66-72; Luka 22.56-62; Yohane 18.15-18, 25-27)
69Shi Petro ta sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ kpo te lɛ mli; ni oblayoo ko ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ, “Bo hu te okɛ Yesu, Galileanyo lɛ, yɔɔ!” 70Shi etso yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ.” 71Shi be ni Petro te shi etee koi lɛ shi lɛ, mɔ kroko hu na lɛ, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ hu kɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, yɔɔ.” 72Ni etso ekoŋŋ kɛ kitãkãmɔ ekɛɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ.” 73Ni fee sɛɛ fioo lɛ, mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ bakɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Anɔkwale ji akɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji bo; ejaakɛ owiemɔ tete jieɔ bo shi!” 74Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i loomɔ kɛ kitãkãmɔ akɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ wuɔ gbɛɛ. 75 Ni Petro kai Yesu wiemɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dani wuɔ aaagbɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃” lɛ. Ni eje kpo eyafo blobloblo.

Title: MATEO 27
Content:
Akɛ Yesu ba Pilato hiɛ
(Marko 15.1; Luka 23.1-2; Yohane 18.28-32)
1 Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ tee Yesu yinɔ apam, koni amɛgbe lɛ. 2 Ni amɛfi lɛ ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee amɛyahã Amralo Pontio Pilato.
Yuda Iskariot gbele
(Bɔfoi 1.18-19)
3 Agbɛnɛ be ni Yuda, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, na akɛ abu lɛ fɔ lɛ, eshwa ehe, ni ekpale jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ eyahã osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ, 4ni ekɛɛ, “Mifee esha akɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lá ni efɔŋ ko bɛ ehe lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “No jeee wɔhe sane ko; bo diɛŋtsɛ kwɛmɔ nɔ!” 5 Ni eyashɛrɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ eshwie Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee eyawo esɛ̃ kpãa. 6 Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ yaloo jwiɛtɛi lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Ejaaa akɛ akɛtoɔ (Sɔlemɔ we lɛ) nitoohe lɛ mli ejaakɛ lá yinii ni.” 7Ni amɛtee ajina, ni amɛkɛhe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ abɔɔ lɛ, koni afu gbɔi yɛ jɛi. 8 No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ nakai abɔɔ lɛ ‘Lá Abɔɔ’ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ. 9 No ni gbalɔ Yeremia wiemɔ lɛ ba mli akɛ, “Ni amɛŋɔ jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ, ni ji mɔ ni aye enaa ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi wo eyi jara lɛ yinii lɛ; 10ni amɛkɛhe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ abɔɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã mi lɛ.”
Pilato bi Yesu nii
(Marko 15.2-5; Luka 23.3-5; Yohane 18.33-38)
11Shi akɛ Yesu badamɔ Amralo lɛ hiɛ, ni Amralo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ.” 12 Shi be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ folɔɔ enaa lɛ, ejieee naa. 13Kɛkɛ ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani onuuu saji sɔŋŋ ni amɛkɛshwieɔ onɔ nɛɛ?” 14 Shi Yesu efooo edaaŋ kwraa; ni Amralo lɛ naa kpɛ ehe diɛŋtsɛ.
Abu Yesu gbele fɔ
(Marko 15.6-15; Luka 23.13-25; Yohane 18.39—19.16)
15Shi daa kɛ shɛ gbijurɔ lɛ, Amralo lɛ ŋmɛɔ gboklɛfonyo kome ni asafo lɛ sumɔɔ he ehãa amɛ. 16No mli lɛ amɛyɛ gboklɛfonyo kpanaku ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Baraba. 17No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛbabua amɛhe naa lɛ, Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ he nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ mihã nyɛ, Baraba, aloo Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ?” 18 Ejaakɛ ele akɛ hetsɛ̃ naa amɛkɛ lɛ hã.
19Shi be ni eta kojomɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, eŋa tsu aba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ jalɔ nɛɛ akaye sane ko; ejaakɛ ehewɔ lɛ mihe ejara mi babaoo yɛ wɔlamɔ mli ŋmɛnɛ.”
20Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ wo asafoi lɛ ayiŋ akɛ, amɛbi Baraba moŋ, koni agbe Yesu. 21Shi Amralo lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ he nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ mihã nyɛ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Baraba.” 22Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni mifee Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ he mɔ?” Amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Hã ni asɛŋ lɛ!” 23Ni Amralo lɛ kɛɛ, “Mɛɛ efɔŋ efee?” Shi amɛbolɔ waa moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Hã ni asɛŋ lɛ!”
24 Be ni Pilato na akɛ enyɛɛɛ he nɔ ko efee; shi moŋ basabasa feemɔ miiba lɛ, ekɛ nu fɔ edɛ̃ yɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mi lɛ miyeee jalɔ nɛɛ lá yi sɔ̃; nyɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ!” 25 Ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Elá aba wɔ kɛ wɔbii anɔ!” 26Kɛkɛ ni eŋmɛɛ Baraba he ehã amɛ; shi Yesu lɛ, ekɛ kpelebii yi lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Asraafoi lɛ ye Yesu he fɛo
(Marko 15.16-20; Yohane 19.2-3)
27Kɛkɛ ni Amralo lɛ asraafoi lɛ ŋɔ Yesu kɛtee kojomɔhe lɛ, ni amɛyabua asraafoi aku lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛbabɔle lɛ; 28ni amɛ jie ehe atadei lɛ, ni amɛkɛ atade tsuru yuu ko wo lɛ; 29ni amɛfee ŋmei akekre amɛkɛfi eyitso, ni amɛkɛ tso hã lɛ ehiɛ yɛ eninejurɔ, ni amɛkula shi yɛ ehiɛ amɛye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Oshwiee, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ!” 30 Ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehe, ni amɛhe tso lɛ yɛ edɛ̃ ni amɛkɛtswia eyiteŋ. 31Ni be ni amɛye ehe fɛo lɛ, amɛ jie atade yuu lɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ wo lɛ, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee koni amɛyasɛŋ lɛ.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele
(Marko 15.21-41; Luka 23.26-49; Yohane 19.17-30)
32Be ni amɛyaa lɛ; amɛna nuu Kirenenyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon, ni amɛnyɛ enɔ ni ewo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ. 33Ni be ni amɛshɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi Golgota ni eshishi ji “Yitsoŋoŋohe” lɛ, 34 amɛkɛ wain ni akɛ drɔ efutu mli hã Yesu ni enu; shi be ni esa enaa lɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ enuɔ. 35 Be ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja etadei lɛ. 36Ni amɛho amɛtara jɛi, ni amɛbu ehe. 37Ni amɛŋma sane ni akɛfɔ̃ enɔ lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, “Yesu, Yudafoi lɛ aMaŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ!” 38 No mli lɛ asɛŋ ojotswalɔi enyɔ afata ehe; mɔ kome yɛ eninejurɔ nɔ, ni mɔ kome hu yɛ ebɛku nɔ. 39 Shi mɛi ni hoɔ lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔ amɛshi lɛ, ni amɛhoso amɛyitsei, 40 ni amɛkɛɛ, “Bo ni okumɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni osaa omãa gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala! Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, jee sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ okpeleke shi koo!” 41Nakai nɔŋŋ osɔfonukpai lɛ hu kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, 42“Mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala ehere, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ehere. Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ji lɛ! Eje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ agbɛnɛ ekpeleke shi, ni wɔɔhe lɛ wɔye. 43 Ekɛ ehe fɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ; ejie lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ koo, kɛji eyɛ ehe tsui lɛ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji mi.’ ” 44Nakai nɔŋŋ ojotswalɔi lɛ ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ hu bɔ lɛ ahora.
45Shi kɛjɛ shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛyashi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ lɛ duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. 46 Shi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Eshishi ji, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi?” 47Shi be ni mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Elia mɔ nɛ tsɛɔ nɛɛ.” 48 Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome sha foi eyakɔ ŋshɔŋ kotsa, ni ekɛtsɔ̃ ashiŋ mli, ni ekɛma tso naa ehã lɛ akɛ enu. 49Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ahi shi! Hã wɔkwɛ akɛ Elia aaaba abajie lɛ lo?” 50Shi Yesu bo ekoŋŋ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni ebu enaa.
51 Ni naa, Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba enyɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbayi shi, ni shikpɔŋ hoso, ni tɛsai gbala; 52ni gbohii abui anaa gbelegblei, ni krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni ewɔ lɛ agbɔmɔtsei pii te shi; 53 ni eshitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛje kpo kɛjɛ amɛbui lɛ amli, ni amɛtee maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli amɛyajie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi pii. 54Shi be ni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ buɔ Yesu he lɛ na shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ kɛ nii ni afee lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei tsɔ̃, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi nɛ!” 55 Shi yei pii yɛ jɛi ni damɔ shɔŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ; amɛ ji mɛi ni nyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ kɛjɛ Galilea ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ; 56amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria ni ji Yakobo kɛ Yose nyɛ lɛ, kɛ Zebedeo bii lɛ anyɛ lɛ.
Yesu fuu
(Marko 15.42-47; Luka 23.50-56; Yohane 19.36-42)
57 Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, niiatsɛ ko ni jɛ Arimatia ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef lɛ ba; lɛ hu Yesu kaselɔ ji lɛ. 58Lɛ etee Pilato ŋɔɔ eyatutɔ lɛ ni ekɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ahã lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Pilato fã akɛ akɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ahã lɛ. 59Ni Yosef ŋɔ gbonyo lɛ, ni ekɛ klala farefare bla lɛ, 60 ni ekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbonyobu hee ni ekpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli lɛ mli, ni ekoklo tɛ kpeteŋkple ekɛtsi gbonyobu lɛ naa, ni eyiŋ etee. 61Shi Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria mɔ kome lɛ yɛ jɛi, amɛtara gbonyobu lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Ahã ayabu bu lɛ he
62Shi Hesaamɔ-kɛ-too-Gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ anaa bakpe shi yɛ Pilato ŋɔɔ, 63 amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔkai akɛ, be ni shishiulɔ nɛɛ hiɛ kã lɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ mate shi ekoŋŋ.’ 64No hewɔ lɛ, fã ni ayabu bu lɛ he jogbaŋŋ kɛyashi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, koni ekaselɔi lɛ akabaju lɛ kɛtee, ni amɛyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ’; ni sɛɛkpee shishiumɔ lɛ bafee efɔŋ fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ.” 65Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, asraafoi nɛ, nyɛyaa ni nyɛyabua bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ.” 66Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee; amɛsɔo tɛ lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ gbonyobu lɛ naa kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛhã asraafoi lɛ bu he.

Title: MATEO 28
Content:
Yesu shitee
(Marko 16.1-8; Luka 24.1-12; Yohane 20.1-10)
1Shi hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ naagbee, be ni je bɔ̃i tsɛremɔ kɛbaa otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria mɔ kome lɛ ba bu lɛ saramɔ. 2Ni naa, shikpɔŋ ehoso waa, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jɛ ŋwɛi kpeleke shi, ni ebakoklo tɛ lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ, ni eho eta nɔ. 3 Ni ehiɛ kpɛɔ tamɔ srawa, ni etade lɛ hu yɛɔ futafuta. 4Shi ehe gbeyei hã bulɔi lɛ ahe kpokpo ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbohii. 5Shi bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ yei lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛmiitao Yesu mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ; 6 ebɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ ete shi, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ. Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa hegbɛ ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lɛ. 7 Ni nyɛyaa mramra nyɛyakɛa ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni eetsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛya Galilea; jɛi nyɛaana lɛ yɛ; naa, mikɛɛ nyɛ.” 8Ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ bu lɛ he mramra kɛ gbeyei kɛ nyamɔ babaoo, ni amɛhiɛ foi koni amɛyagba ekaselɔi lɛ.
9Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ bakpe ni ekɛɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” Ni amɛbamɔmɔ enaji amli; ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ. 10 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa minyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni amɛya Galilea; ni jɛi amɛaana mi yɛ.”
Onukpai lɛ hã bulɔi lɛ nyɔɔŋnii koni amɛmale
11Shi be ni amɛyaa lɛ, bulɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi eba maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛbagba nii ni afee lɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ osɔfonukpai lɛ. 12Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ bɔ gwa ni amɛtee ajina, ni amɛhã asraafoi lɛ jwiɛtɛi pii, 13 amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛkɛa akɛ, nyɔɔŋ, be ni wɔwɔ lɛ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba baju lɛ kɛtee. 14Ni kɛji enɛ bashɛ Amralo lɛ toiŋ lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔkɛ lɛ baawie ni wɔkwɛ ni akahao nyɛ.” 15Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe jwiɛtɛi lɛ, ni amɛfee bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ. Ni nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Yesu tu sane kpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ ewo kaselɔi lɛ adɛŋ
(Marko 16.14-18; Luka 24.36-49; Yohane 20.18-23; Bɔfoi 1.6-8)
16 Shi kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ yiŋ amɛtee Galilea gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Yesu etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ akpe yɛ lɛ, 17ni be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ; shi mɛi komɛi je ŋwane. 18 Ni Yesu ba ekɛ amɛ bawie ekɛɛ, “Aŋɔ hegbɛ fɛɛ ahã mi yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ. 19 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyaa ni nyɛyafea jeŋmaji fɛɛ mikaselɔi, nyɛbaptisia amɛ nyɛwoa Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ gbɛi mli, 20 ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛye nii fiaa ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ. Ni naa, mi lɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ daa kɛyaashi jeŋ naagbee lɛ.”

Title: MARKO WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Marko Sanekpakpa lɛ jeɔ shishi kɛ wiemɔi ni baa nɛɛ, “Yesu Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ bi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ nɛ.” Anaa Yesu akɛ mɔ ko ni tsuɔ nii waa ni esaa eyɔɔ hewalɛ hu. Ehewalɛ nɛɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔi kɛ hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji anɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni eŋɔɔ mɛi ahe eshai efaa amɛ lɛ amli. Yesu lɛ etsɛɔ ehe akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi ni ba ekɛ ehe bashã afɔle ni ekɛkpɔ̃ mɛi kɛjɛ esha mli.
Marko wolo lɛ gbaa Yesu he sane lɛ faŋŋ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔmimaa hu, ni nɔ nɔ mi ni emaa titri ji enitsumɔ, shi jeee ewiemɔi loo etsɔ̃ɔmɔi. Eje shishi ewie Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu sɔlemɔ kɛ ekaa lɛ he kukubɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ Yesu mɔtsamɔ nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ tsa nɔ. Fee sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kaselɔi lɛ banu lɛ shishi fe tsutsu lɛ, shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ hu bagri amɛwo lɛ fe tsutsu lɛ po.
Yitsei ni gbeɔ wolo lɛ naa lɛ gbaa nɔ ni ba Yesu nɔ yɛ eje nɛɛ mli shihilɛ naagbee otsi lɛ mli, titri lɛ esɛŋmɔ kɛ eshitee kɛjɛ gbohiiateŋ.
Asusuɔ akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ naagbee wiemɔi srɔtoi enyɔ ni afo amɛhe akrabatsa lɛ jeee Marko ji mɔ ni ŋmala shi moŋ mɔ kroko.
Mlijaramɔi
Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee 1.1-13
Yesu nitsumɔ yɛ Galilea 1.14—9.50
Kɛjɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm 10.1-52
Naagbee otsi yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ ekpokpai anɔ 11.1—15.47
Yesu shitee kɛjɛ gbohiiateŋ 16.1-8
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni ete shi lɛ he kpojiemɔ kɛ mɛi atsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ eŋwɛiyaa 16.9-20

Title: MARKO 1
Content:
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ
(Marko 3.1-12; Luka 3.1-18; Yohane 1.19-28)
1Yesu Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, he Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee, 2 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ mli akɛ,
“Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛmiitsɔ̃ ohiɛ,
mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ.
3 Mɔ ko miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ,
‘Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ,
nyɛjajea etɛmpɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ!’ ”
4No hewɔ lɛ, Yohane ba ni ebaptisi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisi amɛ, koni akɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ. 5Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yudea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ tee eŋɔɔ. Amɛjaje amɛhe eshai, ni abaptisi amɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ mli.
Kristo baa kɛ enitsumɔ he gbalɛ
(Marko 3.11-12; Luka 3.15-18; Yohane 1.29-30)
6 Yohane lɛ yooma hetsɔi atade ewoɔ, ni wolokpãa ekɛfiɔ emliteŋ; ni eyeɔ baalabii kɛ ŋa nɔ wo. 7Eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni he wa fe mi; misaaa mɔ ni kotoɔ shi fɛneɔ etokotai anaa kpãa tete. 8Mi lɛ, nu mikɛ baptisi nyɛ; shi lɛ lɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ekɛaabaptisi nyɛ.”
Yesu Baptisimɔ
(Mateo 3.13—4.11; Luka 3.21-22; 4.1-13)
9 Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ eba mli akɛ Yesu jɛ Nazaret yɛ Galilea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba ni Yohane baptisi lɛ yɛ Yordan mli. 10Yesu je kpo kɛjɛ nu lɛ mli nɔŋŋ pɛ kɛkɛ ni ena ni ŋwɛi naa miigbele ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ miikpeleke shi tamɔ okpo kɛmiiba enɔ. 11 Ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Bo ji misuɔmɔ Bi lɛ. Bo ohe tsui minaa!”
Yesu kaa
(Mateo 4.1-11; Luka 4.1-13)
12Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Mumɔ lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ. 13Eye gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ jɛi, ni Satan ka lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hi shi; ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi basɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Galilea nitsumɔ lɛ shishijee
(Mateo 4.12-18; Luka 4.14-15)
14Agbɛnɛ be ni amɔ Yohane sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu tee Galilea ni eyashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ. 15 Ekɛɛ, “Be lɛ eshɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ enina nyɛ! Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui, ni nyɛhea Sanekpakpa lɛ nyɛyea.”
Wolɛi ejwɛ atsɛmɔ
(Mateo 4.18-22; Luka 5.1-11)
16Be ni Yesu nyiɛ Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ena Simon kɛ enyɛmi Andrea ni amɛmiihɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli ejaakɛ wolɛi ji amɛ. 17Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbanyiɛa misɛɛ ni mafee nyɛ wolɛi ni baahɛ gbɔmɛi.” 18Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi amɛyai lɛ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ. 19Ni be ni etee ehiɛ fioo lɛ, ena Yakobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Yohane ni amɛ hu amɛyɛ lɛlɛ mli amɛmiikpɛ amɛyai lɛ. 20Amrɔ lɛ etsɛ amɛ, ni amɛshi amɛtsɛ Zebedeo kɛ apaafoi lɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli
(Luka 4.31-37)
21Amɛbote maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kapernaum lɛ mli, ni be ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, Yesu tee kpeehe lɛ, ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii. 22 Amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii akɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ; shi jeee tamɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ.
23Kɛkɛ lɛ, naa nuu ko yɛ kpeehe lɛ ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli. Ebo waa ekɛɛ, 24 “Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ bo yɔɔ, Yesu Nazarenyo? Oba wɔhiɛ kpãtãmɔ? Mile mɔ ni ji bo. Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!” 25Yesu fã eyi ekɛɛ, “Bu onaa ni oje emli!” 26 Ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ hã eshɔ̃, ni ebolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni eje emli! 27Mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ fɛɛ he jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni nɛ? Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hee ko nɛ! Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji po, ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi!” 28Ni amrɔ lɛ ehe sane gbɛ shwã Galilea fɛɛ.
Petro shaayoo tsamɔ
(Mateo 8.14-15; Luka 4.38-39)
29Amɛje kpeehe lɛ nɔŋŋ pɛ ni amɛkɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane tee Simon kɛ Andrea we lɛ. 30Simon shaayoo lɛ kã shi kɛ atridii, ni Yesu jɛishɛɛ pɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ. 31Etee eŋɔɔ, emɔ enineshi, ni ewo enɔ, kɛkɛ ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ, ni ebɔ̃i amɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Helatsɛmɛi pii atsamɔ
(Mateo 8.16-17; Luka 4.40-41)
32Gbɛkɛ be ni hulu enyɔ shi lɛ, akɛ helatsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli fɛɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ. 33Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ agbo lɛ naa. 34 Yesu tsa mɛi pii ni yeyeɔ helai srɔtoi, ni efãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji pii. Eŋmɛɛɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ agbɛ ni amɛwie, ejaakɛ amɛle lɛ.
Yesu shiɛ yɛ Galilea
(Luka 4.42-44)
35Maŋkɛ mra be ni hiɛ gbeleko lɛ, Yesu te shi ni eje kpo kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko, ni eyasɔle yɛ jɛi. 36Shi Simon kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ tiu lɛ.
37Ni be ni amɛyana lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo mɛi fɛɛ taoɔ nɛɛ.” 38Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa maji krokomɛi ni jwere wɔhewɔhewɔ nɛɛ amli, koni mayashiɛ yɛ jɛmɛ hu, ejaakɛ no hewɔ miba.” 39 No hewɔ lɛ, eyashiɛ yɛ amɛkpeehei ni yɔɔ Galilea lɛ fɛɛ, ni efãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji hu.
Kpitiyelɔ ko tsamɔ
(Mateo 8.1-4; Luka 5.12-16)
40Kpitiyelɔ ko ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni ebakula ehiɛ ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, “Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse.” 41Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekpã enine mli eta ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miisumɔ; ohe atse!” 42Amrɔ lɛ kpiti lɛ tã yɛ ehe ni ehe tse. 43Ni amrɔ lɛ ewo lɛ gbɛ ni etswa enaa ma ekɛɛ, 44 “Kwɛmɔ ni okakɛɛ mɔ ko nɔ ko; shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni oshã afɔle ni Mose eto lɛ yɛ ohetsuumɔ hewɔ, ni no afee odase ahã amɛ.” 45Shi lɛ lɛ, be ni eje kpo lɛ, ebɔ̃i sane lɛ shiɛmɔ. Enɛ hã sane lɛ gbɛ shwã bɔ ni Yesu nyɛɛɛ aje faŋŋ abote maŋ ko mli dɔŋŋ; shi ehi ŋa lɛ nɔ hei komɛi, ni mɛi jɛɔ he fɛɛ he baa eŋɔɔ.

Title: MARKO 2
Content:
Kuumɔhelatsɛ ko tsamɔ
(Mateo 9.1-8; Luka 5.17-26)
1Gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ba Kapernaum ekoŋŋ, ni anu ehe akɛ eyɛ shĩa. 2Mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa bɔ ni anaaa gbɛ yɛ agbo lɛ naa tete. Be ni eshiɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, 3akɛ mɔ ko ni yeɔ kuumɔhela ni mɛi ejwɛ tere lɛ ba eŋɔɔ. 4Shi akɛni mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ ashɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛyafã tsu ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ yiteŋ, ni amɛgbu folɔ ni amɛshiu helatsɛ lɛ kɛ saa ni ekã nɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbayi shi. 5Be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ekɛɛ helatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bi, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo!” 6Shi mlatsɔɔlɔi komɛi ni tara jɛi lɛ susu yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ, 7 “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ nɛ wieɔ wiemɔ ni tamɔ enɛ? Eebɔ musu! Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ eshai afa, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ?” 8Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Yesu yoo yɛ emumɔ mli akɛ amɛmiisusu nɛkɛ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsusuɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛtsuiiaŋ? 9Te emli nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jaraaa hu, akɛ aaakɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo’, aloo ‘Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ’ lɛ? 10Shi bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ” ekɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ, 11“Miikɛɛ bo akɛ, tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni oya shĩa.” 12Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi, ni ewo esaa lɛ ni eje kpo yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnako enɛ eko dã!”
Levi tsɛmɔ
(Mateo 9.9-13; Luka 5.27-32)
13Ni Yesu je kpo ekoŋŋ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Asafo lɛ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nitsɔɔmɔ. 14Ni be ni ehoɔ lɛ, ena Levi ni ji Alfeo bi lɛ ni eta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Ni ete shi enyiɛ esɛɛ. 15Ni be ni Yesu ta niyenii ahe yɛ Levi shĩa lɛ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi pii hu fata ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ahe ni ayeɔ nii lɛ ejaakɛ amɛyi fa, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
16Be ni Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ na akɛ Yesu kɛ eshafeelɔi kɛ toohelɔi nɛɛ miiye nii lɛ, amɛbi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni ekɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii ni ekɛ amɛ nuɔ nɛɛ?” 17Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ tsofatsɛ he ehiaaa amɛ, shi mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ moŋ. Mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi eshafeelɔi moŋ.”
Ŋmaahilɛ he sane
(Mateo 9.14-17; Luka 5.33-39)
18Gbi ko be ni Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ hiɔ ŋmaa lɛ, mɛi komɛi ba Yesu ŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni Yohane kɛ Farisifoi lɛ akaselɔi lɛ hiɔ ŋmaa ni bo lɛ okaselɔi lɛ ehiii ŋmaa lɛ?” 19Yesu to he ekɛɛ, “Ani ayɛmforowu lɛ bialɔi lɛ aaanyɛ ŋmaa ahi be mli ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ? Gbii abɔ ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛŋ ŋmaa amɛhi. 20Shi be aaaba ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaajɛ amɛŋɔɔ; ni nakai gbi lɛ dani amɛaahi ŋmaa. 21Mɔ ko kɛ mamanaa hee taaa atade momo; ejaakɛ mamanaa hee lɛ ni akɛta lɛ tserɛɔ emomo lɛ, ni fɔlɔ lɛ lɛɔ. 22Asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ wain hee wooo wolotɔi memeji amli; ejaakɛ wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolotɔi lɛ, ni wain lɛ aaashwie shi, ni wolotɔi lɛ aaafite; shi moŋ wain hee lɛ wolotɔi hei amli akɛwoɔ.”
Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ Nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ
(Mateo 12.1-8; Luka 6.1-5)
23Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ Yesu yatsɔ̃ abele ŋmɔji komɛi amli, ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ yaa lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i abele lɛ kuumɔ. 24No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Kwɛ, mɛɛba okaselɔi lɛ feɔ nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ nɛɛ?” 25Yesu to he akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee gbi ko be ni efi lɛ ni hɔmɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ dã. 26 Bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ yɛ Osɔfonukpa Abiatar yinɔ ni eyaye aboloo ni akɛmãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni ehã mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ hu eko amɛye, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ ni eyeɔ akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?” 27 Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ hewɔ ato hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, shi jeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ hewɔ abɔ gbɔmɔ. 28No hewɔ lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ po nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ.”

Title: MARKO 3
Content:
Nuu ni nine egbo lɛ
(Mateo 12.9-14; Luka 6.6-11)
1Ni Yesu tee kpeehe lɛ ekoŋŋ. Nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni enine kome egbo; 2ni amɛsra lɛ akɛ eeetsa lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lo, koni amɛyafolɔ enaa. 3Yesu kɛɛ mɔ ni nine egbo lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni obadamɔ wɔteŋ!” 4Ni ebi mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Ani hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ eja akɛ afeɔ ekpakpa aloo afeɔ efɔŋ, akɛ ahereɔ gbɔmɔ yiwala aloo agbeɔ lɛ?” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ. 5 Ni ekwɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛkpe kɛ mlifu, ejaakɛ edɔ lɛ akɛ amɛtsui wa nɛkɛ; ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpã onine lɛ mli!” Ekpã mli, ni atsa enine lɛ ni eye emuu. 6 Farisifoi lɛ je kpo, ni amrɔ lɛ amɛkɛ Herodebii lɛ to eyinɔ apam bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
Asafo yuu lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa
7Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ gbala amɛhe shi kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Mɛi pii ni jɛ Galilea kɛ Yudea 8 kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Idumea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yordan sɛɛ kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ fɛɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ. Nɛkɛ asafo yuu nɛɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ejaakɛ amɛnu nibii ni efeɔ lɛ ahe. 9Mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛsaa lɛlɛ bibioo ko amɛhã lɛ koni asafo lɛ akamia lɛ. 10 Etsa mɛi pii hewɔ lɛ mɛi ni helai hiɛhiɛ amɛ fɛɛ bu kɛba eŋɔɔ koni amɛbatara ehe. 11 Ni be fɛɛ be ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ aaana lɛ lɛ, amɛhoɔ amɛgbeɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ni amɛbolɔɔ akɛ, “Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.” 12Ni etswa amɛnaa ma veveeve akɛ amɛkajie lɛ shi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Yesu hala kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ
(Mateo 10.1-4; Luka 6.12-16)
13Ni Yesu tee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni etsɛ mɛi ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etaoɔ lɛ, ni amɛba eŋɔɔ. 14Ni ehala mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ koni amɛkɛ lɛ abahi shi ni etsu amɛ shiɛmɔ, 15koni amɛna hewalɛ ni amɛkɛfamɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji. 16Mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni ehala lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Simon, mɔ ni ewo lɛ Petro lɛ, 17 kɛ Yakobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ Yohane, enyɛmi lɛ, ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ Boanerges (eshishi ji nyɔŋmɔshimɔ bii); 18kɛ Andrea kɛ Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo kɛ Toma kɛ Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Tadeo kɛ Simon, maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ, 19kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Yesu kɛ Beelzebul
(Mateo 12.22-32; Luka 11.14-23; 12.10)
20Ni Yesu ba shĩa. Mɛi babaoo naa bakpe shi ekoŋŋ bɔ ni lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ wooo niyeli po. 21Be ni ewekumɛi nu he lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyamɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi miikɛɛ akɛ eyiŋ miikã lɛ.
22 Mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ni jɛ Yerusalɛm ba lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Beelzebul yɛ emli, mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa efãmɔɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ.” 23No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli akɛ, “Te Satan aaafee tɛŋŋ afã Satan hu? 24Kɛji maŋtsɛyeli ko gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nyɛŋ shi adamɔ. 25Ni kɛji shĩa ko gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, nakai shĩa lɛ nyɛŋ shi adamɔ. 26Ni kɛji Satan te shi wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ni egba emli lɛ, enyɛŋ shi edamɔ, shi moŋ enaagbee ji no.
27“Mɔ ko nyɛŋ hewalɔ ko we abote ni eyaha enii, akɛ ja efi hewalɔ lɛ dã kɛkɛ lɛ eeenyɛ ewe lɛ nii eha. 28Miikɛɛ nyɛ faŋŋ akɛ, akɛ gbɔmɛi ahe eshai fɛɛ aaafa amɛ kɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ ni amɛaawie hu; 29 shi mɔ ni bɔɔ musu eshiɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko kɛyashi naanɔ, shi moŋ eye fɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.” 30 Yesu wie enɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli.”
Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ
(Mateo 12.46-50; Luka 8.19-21)
31Kɛkɛ ni Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba, ni amɛbadamɔ agbo lɛ naa, ni amɛtsu aba eŋɔɔ ni abatsɛ lɛ. 32Asafo lɛ tara shi yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao bo.” 33Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji minyɛ ni namɛi ji minyɛmimɛi lɛ?” 34Ekwɛ mɛi ni tara ehe lɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi nɛ! 35Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, lɛ ji minyɛmi nuu kɛ minyɛmi yoo kɛ minyɛ.”

Title: MARKO 4
Content:
Nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ
(Mateo 13.1-9; Luka 8.4-8)
1 Yesu bɔ̃i nitsɔɔmɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa yɛ ehe, no hewɔ lɛ, ebote lɛlɛ ko mli ni eyata shi. Lɛlɛ lɛ ma nu lɛ hiɛ, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ bua shi yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa. 2Ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii pii yɛ abɛbuai amli; yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ ekɛɛ, 3“Nyɛboa toi! Naa, nidulɔ ko yiŋ etee nidumɔ. 4Ni eba mli akɛ be ni eshwãa wui lɛ, ekomɛi yashwie gbɛ toi, ni loofɔji ba amɛbakɔlɔ. 5Ekomɛi yashwie tɛsai anɔ he ni amɛnaaa su pii yɛ, ni amɛkwɛ̃ oya, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa su ni mli kwɔ. 6Shi be ni hulu je lɛ, eshã amɛ, ni akɛni amɛbɛ fã hewɔ lɛ amɛglã. 7Wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie ŋmei ateŋ, ni ŋmei lɛ kwɛ̃ kɛba ŋwɛi ni amɛgbe tsei lɛ, hewɔ lɛ amɛwooo yibii. 8Shi wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛdara, ni amɛwo yibii: eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko oha.” 9Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, hã ni enu.”
Nɔ hewɔ ni Yesu wie yɛ abɛbuai amli
(Mateo 13.10-17; Luka 8.9-10)
10Be ni shwɛ Yesu kome lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ ehe lɛ kɛ kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ bi lɛ abɛ lɛ shishi. 11 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he teemɔ sane lɛ ehã nyɛ, shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, abɛbuai amli akɛ amɛ wieɔ nii fɛɛ yɛ koni
12 ‘Na lɛ amɛna nɛ, shi amɛkayoo,
ni nu lɛ amɛnu nɛ, shi amɛkana shishi;
ni eba lɛ akɛ amɛkpale ni akɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ
afa amɛ.’ ”
Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi
(Mateo 13.18-23; Luka 8.11-15)
13Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛnuuu abɛ nɛɛ shishi? Belɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni nyɛaanu abɛi lɛ fɛɛ shishiŋ? 14Nidulɔ lɛ duɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ. 15Gbɛtoi bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ, shi amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Satan baa ebasharaa wiemɔ ni adu yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ. 16Tɛsaa shikpɔŋ nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛmɔɔ mli mra kɛ miishɛɛ; 17shi amɛbɛ shishifã yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmli hewɔ lɛ be fioo kɛkɛ amɛhiɔ shi, ni kɛ amanehulu loo yiwaa te shi yɛ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ. 18Shikpɔŋ ni ŋmei yɔɔ nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ; 19 shi je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔ kɛ ninamɔ he lakamɔ kɛ nii krokomɛi ahe akɔnɔ yaboteɔ amɛmli ni amɛgbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni ewooo yibii. 20Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛmɔɔ mli, ni amɛwoɔ yibii, eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko hu oha.”
Kane ni akɛhɔ tsese shishi
(Luka 8.16-18)
21 Ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Ani akɛ kane maa tsese loo saatso shishi? Ani jeee kanetso nɔ akɛmaa? 22 Nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ ni agbeleŋ nɔ, ni asaŋ nɔ ko bɛ ni akɛtee ni ajieŋ lɛ shi. 23Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi ni ekɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu.”
24 Ni esaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ he jogbaŋŋ! Nɔ susumɔ nɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, no akɛaasusu ahã nyɛ, ni aaafata he ahã nyɛ. 25 Mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahã lɛ eko afata he, shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahe fioo ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ.”
Dumɔwui ni kwɛ̃ lɛ
26Yesu tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɔɔ nɛ, etamɔ nuu ko ni shwãa dumɔwui yɛ shikpɔŋ. 27 Eyawɔɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni eteɔ shi kɛji je tsɛre, ni no mli fɛɛ lɛ dumɔwui lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ, ni edaa, ni eleee bɔ ni feɔ. 28Shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ woɔ yibii: jwɛifɔ lɛ tsutsu, kɛkɛ lɛ ŋmãatso lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ŋmãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ ŋmãatso yi. 29 Shi kɛ ŋmãa lɛ tsu lɛ, amrɔ lɛ ehãa akɛ nikpamɔ kakla lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ eshɛ.”
Sinapi wu lɛ
(Mateo 13.31-35; Luka 13.18-21)
30Yesu bi akɛ, “Mɛni he wɔkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaato? Aloo mɛɛ abɛ wɔɔbu yɛ he? 31Etamɔ sinapi wu ni ji wu bibioo fe shikpɔŋ nɔ wui fɛɛ. 32Shi kɛ adu lɛ, ekwɛ̃ɔ, ni edaa fe shwie bai fɛɛ. Egbalaa niji kpelei, bɔ ni ŋwɛi loofɔji aaanyɛ afee tsui yɛ ehɔɔŋ lɛ shishi.”
33Yesu tsɔ̃ abɛbuai pii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi anɔ eshiɛ wiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ amɛnu shishi. 34Ekɛ amɛ ewieee akɛ ja yɛ abɛbuai amli; shi kɛ shwɛ ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ sɔŋŋ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ abɛi lɛ fɛɛ shishi.
Yesu fã ahum yi ni efɔ̃ɔ tswaa
(Mateo 8.23-27; Luka 8.22-25)
35Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfoa ŋshɔ lɛ kɛyaa esɛɛgbɛ.” 36No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshi asafo lɛ ni amɛŋɔ lɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛtee; ni lɛji krokomɛi hu fata ehe. 37Shi ahum kpele ko batswa, ni ŋshɔkei kumɔ wo lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni eehe eyi. 38Ni Yesu yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; etsɔle sune ni ewɔ. Ni kaselɔi lɛ tsĩɛ lɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ni wɔhiɛ heɔ akpãtã nɛɛ, jeee ohe sane koŋ?” 39Ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ yi, ni ekɛɛ ŋshɔ lɛ akɛ, “Bu onaa ni ofee diŋŋ!” Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ dɛmm. 40Kɛkɛ ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsheɔ gbeyei nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba ni nyɛbɛ hemɔkɛyeli?” 41Amɛshe gbeyei naakpa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Namɔ po nɛ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ ŋshɔ tete boɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?”

Title: MARKO 5
Content:
Yesu tsa nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli lɛ
(Mateo 8.28-34; Luka 8.26-39)
1Ni amɛba Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Gerasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 2Be ni Yesu je lɛlɛ lɛ mli pɛ kɛkɛ ni nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli jɛ gbohii abui lɛ amli kɛ lɛ bakpe. 3Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ, gbohii abui amli ehiɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ awo dɔŋŋ; 4ejaakɛ awo lɛ gboklɛi kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi shii abɔ, shi be fɛɛ be ni aaawo lɛ lɛ, etserɛɔ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi lɛ ni ekumɔɔ gboklɛi lɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ ehe ajɔɔ. 5Nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ lɛ, gbohii abui kɛ gɔji lɛ amli eyɔɔ, ni ebolɔɔ ni ekɛ tɛi folɔɔ ehe.
6Shi be ni ena Yesu yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ejo foi kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakula shi yɛ ehiɛ; 7 ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ Bi, mɛni sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ? Mina Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ kaapiŋ mi!” 8Ekɛɛ enɛ ejaakɛ Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee gbɔmɔ nɛɛ mli, bo mumɔ fɔŋ!” 9Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Te ogbɛiŋ?” Nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Migbɛi ji Asafo, ejaakɛ wɔyi fa!” 10Ni ekpa Yesu fai waa akɛ ekashwie amɛ kɛmiije jɛi niiaŋ.
11Kplotoo ku kpele ko yɛ jɛi amɛmiiye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he. 12Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ kpa Yesu fai amɛkɛɛ, “Hã wɔya kplotoi lɛ ateŋ ni wɔyabote amɛmli.” 13Ni eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ. Mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ je nuu lɛ mli, ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli. Ni kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ — aaafee akpei enyɔ — wo foi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkpeleke shi kɛyashwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi yɛ jɛi.
14Kɛkɛ ni kplotookwɛlɔi lɛ jo foi, ni amɛyagba yɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli, ni mɛi lɛ je kpo amɛbakwɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ. 15Amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbana nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji asafo hi emli lɛ ta shi ni ewo atade ni ehiɛ etserɛ lɛ; ni efee amɛ gbeyei. 16Mɛi ni na lɛ gba amɛ nɔ ni ba nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji hi emli lɛ nɔ kɛ kplotoi lɛ ahe sane lɛ. 17Ni amɛbɔ̃i Yesu faikpamɔ akɛ eje amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ eya.
18Be ni Yesu boteɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji hi emli lɛ kpa lɛ fai ni ehã ekɛ lɛ ahi shi. 19Shi Yesu ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ; moŋ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa owe kɛ owekumɛi aŋɔɔ ni oyagba amɛ nii ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ efee ehã bo, kɛ mɔbɔ ni ena bo lɛ!” 20 Ni nuu lɛ yiŋ etee, ni eyabɔ̃i nii ni Yesu efee ehã lɛ lɛ shiɛmɔ yɛ Dekapoli; ni efee amɛ fɛɛ naakpɛɛ.
Yairo biyoo lɛ kɛ yoo ni ta Yesu atade he lɛ
(Mateo 9.18-26; Luka 8.40-56)
21Be ni Yesu kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ fo ŋshɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛba esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, mɛi pii babua ehe yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa. 22Kɛkɛ ni kpeehe lɛ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yairo lɛ ba, ni be ni ena Yesu lɛ, eho egbee enaji anaa, 23 ni ekpa lɛ fai pii ekɛɛ, “Gbo mibiyoo fioo heɔ agbo nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ ba ni okɛ oniji abashwie enɔ koni ehe awa lɛ ni eyi ana wala!” 24Ni Yesu kɛ lɛ tee. Mɛi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛmiififia lɛ.
25Ni yoo ko ni eye láhoo hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, 26ni ena nɔ babaoo yɛ tsofatsɛmɛi pii adɛŋ; efite edɛŋ nii fɛ̃ɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ enaaa he sɛɛ ko kwraa shi wu kɛkɛ moŋ hela lɛ woɔ lɛ, 27be ni enu Yesu he lɛ, ebaje esɛɛgbɛ yɛ mɛi pii lɛ ateŋ, ni eta etade lɛ he; 28ejaakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Kɛji mita etade lɛ po he kɛkɛ lɛ mihe aaawa mi.” 29Ni amrɔ lɛ elá ni hoɔ lɛ naa mɔ, ni enu he yɛ ehewojiaŋ akɛ atsa ehela lɛ. 30 Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu yoo akɛ hewalɛ ko eje emli, ni etsɔ̃ ehe yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ ni ebi akɛ, “Namɔ ta mitade lɛ he lɛ?” 31Ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oona akɛ asafo lɛ miififia bo, ni osaa obiɔ akɛ, ‘Namɔ ta mihe lɛ?’ ” 32Shi Yesu kwɛ ehe koni ena mɔ ni fee nakai lɛ. 33Shi akɛni yoo lɛ le nɔ ni afee ahã lɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ bagbee ehiɛ, ni egba lɛ anɔkwale lɛ fɛ̃ɛ. 34Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Biyoo, ohemɔkɛyeli ehã ohe ewa bo; yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni ohela lɛ ajɔ.”
35Be ni Yesu wieɔ lolo lɛ, kpeehe onukpa lɛ webii lɛ ekomɛi ba bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obiyoo lɛ egbo; mɛɛba ogbaa Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ naa lolo?” 36Shi be ni Yesu nu wiemɔ ni awie lɛ, ekɛɛ Yairo akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei; he oye kɛkɛ!” 37Ni ehãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko anyiɛ esɛɛ akɛ ja Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ, kɛkɛ. 38Amɛba kpeehe onukpa lɛ we lɛ, ni Yesu bana hoofeemɔ kɛ mɛi ni foɔ ni amɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ babaoo lɛ. 39 Ni ebote shĩa lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ hoo ni nyɛfoɔ nɛkɛ? Gbekɛ lɛ gboko; wɔ ewɔɔ!”
40Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ. Shi lɛ lɛ eshwie mɛi lɛ fɛ̃ɛ kɛje kpo, ni eŋɔ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata lɛ Yesu lɛ he lɛ kɛtee he ni gbekɛ lɛ kã lɛ. 41 Ni emɔ enine shi ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Talita, kuumi!” Eshishi ji, “Gbekɛyoo, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, tee shi!”
42Ni amrɔ lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ te shi ni ebɔ̃i shisharamɔ; eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Ni mɛi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa; 43shi Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma veveeve akɛ amɛkahã mɔ ko le enɛ; ni efã akɛ ahã gbekɛ lɛ nɔ ko ni eye.

Title: MARKO 6
Content:
Akwa Yesu yɛ Nazaret
(Mateo 13.53-58; Luka 4.16-30)
1Yesu je jɛi eyiŋ etee emaŋ lɛ mli, ni ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ. 2Ni be ni shɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ ebɔ̃i nitsɔɔmɔ yɛ kpeehe lɛ; ni mɛi pii ni nu lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ yana nii nɛɛ kɛjɛ? Mɛɛ nilee akɛhã lɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ enine nɔ atsuɔ nɛkɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi nɛɛ? 3Ani jeee ŋaalɔ lɛ nɛ, Maria bi lɛ, kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yose kɛ Yuda kɛ Simon nyɛmi nuu lɛ, ni jeee enyɛmimɛi yei hu kɛ wɔ yɔɔ biɛ lɛ?” Ni ehe sane lɛ hã amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃. 4 Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Akpaaa gbalɔ woo akɛ ja yɛ emaŋ kɛ ewekumɛi ateŋ kɛ ewe kɛkɛ.” 5Ni enyɛɛɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔ ko etsu yɛ Nazaret, fe akɛ ekɛ eniji ŋmɛlɛ helatsɛmɛi fioo ko nɔ, ni etsa amɛ. 6Ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ hewɔ. Ni eyakpa akrowai lɛ amli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Yesu tsu kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ
(Mateo 10.5-15; Luka 9.1-6)
7 Ni Yesu tsɛ kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ebɔ̃i amɛ tsumɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni ehã amɛ hewalɛ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ. 8Ni ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ amɛkahiɛ nɔ ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, akɛ ja tso kɛkɛ; amɛkahiɛ aboloo loo kotoku loo shika yɛ amɛhɛfiinii amli; 9shi amɛwo tokotai, ni amɛkawo flakai enyɔ. 10Esaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “He fɛɛ he ni nyɛaabote shĩa ko yɛ lɛ, nyɛhia jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaje jɛi. 11 He fɛɛ he ni mɛi lɛ hereee nyɛ ni amɛbooo nyɛ toi yɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije jɛi lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnane shi mlu nyɛshwiea shi nyɛkɛyea odase nyɛshia amɛ.” 12Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyashiɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui. 13 Ni amɛfãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji pii ni amɛfɔfɔɔ helatsɛmɛi pii amu ni amɛtsa amɛ.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ gbele
(Mateo 14.1-12; Luka 9.7-9; 3.19-20)
14 Ni maŋtsɛ Herode nu he, ejaakɛ Yesu gbɛi ehehee shi, Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, no hewɔ ni hewalɛ nɛɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ emli nɛɛ.” 15Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Elia ni;” shi mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ, “Gbalɔ ni, tamɔ blema gbalɔi lɛ eko.”
16Be ni Herode nu lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Yohane ni mifo eyi lɛ, lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ nɛɛ!” 17 Ekɛɛ enɛ ejaakɛ lɛ Herode lɛ etsu ayamɔ Yohane, ni efi lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ ewo tsuŋ. Efee enɛ ejaakɛ ekɛ Herodia, enyɛmi Filipo ŋa lɛ, efee eŋa; 18ni Yohane kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ejaaa gbɛ akɛ okɛ onyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ feɔ oŋa.” 19Hewɔ lɛ Herodia bɛ Yohane wo emli, ni eetao lɛ egbe; shi enyɛɛɛ, 20ejaakɛ Herode miishe Yohane gbeyei, akɛni ele akɛ jalɔ kɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ lɛ, ni eto lɛ shweshweeshwe. Kɛ ebo ewiemɔ toi lɛ, ehe jaraa lɛ pii, shi kɛ̃lɛ esumɔɔ akɛ ebo lɛ toi.
21Ni gbi ni sa lɛ bashɛ, be ni Herode yeɔ efɔmɔ gbijurɔ ni eŋmɛ ebladei kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ Galilea onukpai lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ: 22Herodia biyoo ba ebajo, ni esa Herode kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ahiɛ.
