Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ gbekɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Bi mi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ, ni mahã bo!” 23 Ni ekã lɛ kitã akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi mi lɛ mahã bo, kɛji mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ fã tete po lɛ!” 24Ni gbekɛ yoo lɛ je kpo yabi enyɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mibi?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso.” 25Ni amrɔ lɛ eba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ oya ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miitao ni okɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso ahã mi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ kã mli.” 26Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ naakpa; shi ekitã lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii lɛ ashi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ ekãmaa lɛ. 27Ni amrɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu oblafo, ni efã lɛ akɛ ekɛ Yohane yitso aba.
28Ni etee eyafo eyi yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni ekɛŋmɛ kã mli kɛba ekɛbahã gbekɛ yoo lɛ, ni lɛ hu ekɛyahã enyɛ. 29Ni be ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛba amɛbawo egbonyo lɛ amɛyafu.
Bɔfoi lɛ asɛɛkuu
30 Bɔfoi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba lɛ nii ni amɛyafee kɛ nii ni amɛyatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 31Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ sɔŋŋ nyɛbaa ni wɔtea ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee ni nyɛyajɔa nyɛhe fioo.” Ejaakɛ mɛi ni baa yaa lɛ fa tsɔ̃ ni amɛnaaa dekã kɛye nii tete.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii
(Mateo 14.13-21; Luka 9.10-17; Yohane 6.1-14)
32Ni amɛtsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee. 33Ni asafoi lɛ na amɛ ni amɛmiiya, ni mɛi pii yoo amɛ; ni amɛjɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ amli amɛjo foi kɛtsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kɛtee jɛi, ni amɛho amɛnaa. 34 Be ni Yesu kpeleke lɛ, ena asafo kpele, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ; ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nibii pii tsɔ̃ɔmɔ. 35 Ni be ni je bɔ̃i namɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋa nɔ ji biɛ, ni je hu miina; 36wo mɛi lɛ agbɛ koni amɛya akrowai kɛ maji ni jwere wɔhewɔ nɛɛ amli ni amɛyahe nii amɛye.” 37Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nɔ ko amɛyea.” Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔya wɔyahe aboloo denarioi ohai enyɔ wɔkɛhã amɛ amɛye?” 38Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ? Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakwɛa.” Be ni amɛyakwɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ.”
39Ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ atara shi kuikui yɛ jwɛifɔ lɛ nɔ. 40Ni amɛtara shi kuikui, ohahai kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔi. 41 Ni Yesu kɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ nɔ. Ekumɔ aboloi lɛ, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛmamɔ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ. Eja loi enyɔ lɛ hu ehã amɛ fɛɛ. 42Amɛ fɛɛ amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ. 43Ni amɛhala aboloo fufuji kɛ loo fufuji lɛ amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli obɔ̃bɔ̃. 44Ni mɛi ni ye aboloo lɛ ayibɔ ji hii akpei enumɔ.
Yesu yasɔle
(Mateo 14.22-33; Yohane 6.15-21)
45Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu tsirɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ayisɛɛ ni amɛbote lɛlɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛya ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛya Betsaida, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeewo asafo lɛ gbɛ. 46Ni be ni ewo amɛ gbɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyasɔle.
Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ
(Mateo 14.24-33; Yohane 6.16-21)
47Be ni je na lɛ, lɛlɛ lɛ eshɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ, ni Yesu kome yɛ shikpɔŋ. 48Ena akɛ wirimɔ lɛ miitɔ kaselɔi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛmiikpee kɔɔyɔɔ; ni maŋkɛ hima aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ loo nɔ mli lɛ, enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba amɛŋɔɔ, ni eetao eho amɛhe. 49Be ni amɛna lɛ ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ sisa ni, ni amɛbolɔ 50ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛna lɛ, ni amɛtsui fa. Ni amrɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛmli; mi ni; nyɛkashea gbeyei!” 51 Ni eba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa. Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa. 52Ejaakɛ amɛyooko nɔ ni aboloo sane lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ sɛɛ; amɛjwɛŋmɔ kpleee he.
Yesu tsa helatsɛmɛi yɛ Genesaret
(Mateo 14.34-36)
53Ni be ni amɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ, amɛba Genesaret shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakpeleke. 54Ni be ni amɛje lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mɛi lɛ yoo Yesu, 55ni amɛsha foi kɛyakpa jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ aholemɔ yɛ sai anɔ kɛ eŋɔɔbaa yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛnu akɛ eyɔɔ. 56 Ni he fɛɛ he ni ebote akrowai loo maji loo ŋmɔji amli yɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ helatsɛmɛi bashwieɔ blohuiaŋ, ni amɛkpaa lɛ fai koni ehã amɛna etade naamuu lɛ kɛkɛ he amɛtara; ni mɛi abɔ ni tara he lɛ, amɛhe wa amɛ.

Title: MARKO 7
Content:
Blematsɛmɛi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔi
(Mateo 15.1-9)
1Agbɛnɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni jɛ Yerusalɛm ba lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ. 2 Amɛna akɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi yeɔ nii kɛ dɛ̃ ni abule, ni ji dɛ̃ ni afɔko. 3Ejaakɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ja amɛkɛ nu efɔ amɛdɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ dani amɛyeɔ nii; amɛfeɔ enɛ amɛkɛyeɔ onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ. 4Ni kɛ amɛjɛ jara nɔ amɛba lɛ, ja amɛju amɛhe dani amɛyeɔ nii. Ni nibii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni ato ahã amɛ ni amɛfeɔ yɛ kpuji kɛ gbɛi kɛ ayawai amlifɔmɔ kɛ saatsei ahefɔmɔ he. 5Ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ bi Yesu akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ okaselɔi lɛ yeee onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ ni amɛfɔɔɔ amɛdɛ dani amɛyeɔ nii nɛɛ?” 6 Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ Yesaia gba yɛ nyɛ osatofoi nɛɛ ahe tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
‘Maŋ nɛɛ, amɛnaabui amɛkɛwoɔ mi;
shi amɛtsui etsi ehe kɛje mihe kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
7Shi yakatswaa amɛjaa mi lɛ,
ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni ji gbɔmɛi akitãi.’
8“Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ, nyɛshi, ni gbɔmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anɔ nyɛyeɔ.”
9Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ akɛ nyɛkwa Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ koni nyɛye nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ! 10 Ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ, ‘Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ’, kɛ ‘Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!’ 11Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni kulɛ ooona yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, “Korban” (nɔ ni akɛke Nyɔŋmɔ) ni’ lɛ, 12belɛ nyɛhãaa efee nɔ ko ehã etsɛ loo enyɛ dɔŋŋ; 13ni nyɛkɛ nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ egu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ. Ni nyɛfeɔ nibii pii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi.”
Nibii ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ
(Mateo 15.10-20)
14Ni Yesu tsɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛboa mi toi ni nyɛnua shishi! 15 Nɔ ko bɛ ni jɛɔ kpo nɔ gbɛ boteɔ gbɔmɔ mli ni aaanyɛ lɛ abule, shi nɔ ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ ji nɔ ni jɛɔ emli lɛ. [ 16Kɛ mɔ ko yɛ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu.”]
17Ni be ni eje asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ eba shĩa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ abɛ lɛ shishi. 18Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nɛkɛ nyɛ hu nyɛnaaa nii ashishi? Nyɛnaaa akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛɔ kpo nɔ gbɛ boteɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ abule, 19ejaakɛ jeee etsui mli eboteɔ shi emusuŋ eyaa, ni eyajeɔ kpo yɛ tiafi mli?” (Yesu kɛɛ enɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ŋmaa fɛɛ ŋmaa he tse.) 20Ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni jɛɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, no nɔŋŋ buleɔ lɛ. 21Ejaakɛ mligbɛ ni ji gbɔmɛi atsuii amli lɛ, jɛi jwɛŋmɔi fɔ̃ji jɛɔ: ajwamãŋbɔɔ, juu, awuyeli, 22gbãlãfitemɔ, hiɛjoomɔ, yiŋsha, shishiumɔ, nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, hiŋmɛisha, oshekuyeli, hewoo, kwashiai asaneyeli. 23Nii fɔ̃ji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, mligbɛ amɛjɛɔ ni amɛbuleɔ gbɔmɔ.”
Siro Foinikeyoo lɛ hemɔkɛyeli
(Mateo 15.21-28)
24Ni Yesu je jɛi, ni eyiŋ etee Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ. Eyabote shĩa ko, ni esumɔɔɔ akɛ aleɔ, shi enyɛɛɛ ehe etee. 25Ejaakɛ ejɛishɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni yoo ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ ebiyoo fioo mli nu ehe ni eba ebakula shi yɛ enaji anaa. 26Shi yoo lɛ jeŋmajiaŋ yoo ji lɛ, ni he ni ejɛ ji Foinike ni yɔɔ Siria lɛ. Ebakpa Yesu fai ni efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ ebiyoo lɛ mli. 27Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã bii lɛ fɛɛ atɔrɔ dã; ejaaa akɛ aŋɔɔ bii aboloo lɛ ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ gbeebii.”
28Shi yoo lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ mli moŋ, shi bɛ gbeebii ni yɔɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi lɛ hu yeɔ bii lɛ afufuji lɛ eko!” 29Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Owiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, yaa! Mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ eje obi lɛ mli.” 30Yoo lɛ yiŋ etee eshĩa ni eyana ebiyoo lɛ kã saa nɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ eje emli.
Yesu tsa mumui toimulɔ ko
31 Yesu ku esɛɛ ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ Tiro niiaŋ kɛfoŋ yɛ Sidon ni etsɔ̃ Dekapoli kpokpai lɛ anɔ kɛba Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa. 32Ni akɛ mɔ ko ni muɔ toi ni mumui hu ji lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai koni ekɛ enine aŋmɛ enɔ. 33Ni Yesu kɛ lɛ je asafo lɛ teŋ kɛtee afã, ni ekɛ ewaobii wo etoii amli, ni etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ekɛsa elilɛi he. 34 Ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ehuu yɛ emli ni ekɛɛ mumui toimulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Hefata!” Eshishi ji, “Gbelemɔ!” 35Ni amrɔ lɛ etoii lɛ gbele, ni elilɛi kpãa lɛ fɛne, ni ewie faŋŋ. 36 Ni Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko; shi babaoo ni etswaa amɛnaa ma lɛ, babaoo ni amɛjajeɔ ji no. 37Ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Efee nii fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ! Ehãa toimulɔi nuɔ nii, ni mumuii hu wieɔ.”

Title: MARKO 8
Content:
Yesu hã mɛi akpei ejwɛ niyenii
(Mateo 15.32-39)
1Nakai bei lɛ amli, be ni mɛi pii ebabua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ ni amɛnaaa nɔ ko amɛye lɛ, Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 2 “Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ asafo lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ mi ehi shi gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛbaaye. 3Ni kɛji mihã amɛkɛ amɛmusuŋ hɔmɔ yiŋ kɛmiiya amɛwe lɛ, amɛaayatɔ biti yɛ gbɛteŋ ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ajɛɛhe jɛkɛ.” 4Ni ekaselɔi lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ aaanyɛ ana aboloo yɛ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ ni aaashɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi anaa?” 5Ebi amɛ akɛ, “Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Kpawo.”
6Ni efa asafo lɛ akɛ amɛtara shikpɔŋ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɔlɔ aboloi kpawo lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli ekɛhã kaselɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛmamɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ; ni amɛkɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ. 7Amɛyɛ loi bibii fioo hu, ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni efã akɛ akɛ no hu amãmɔ amɛhiɛ. 8Ni amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ, ni amɛhala fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ flɔtɔi kpawo obɔ̃bɔ̃. 9Shi mɛi ni ye lɛ aaafee mɛi akpei ejwɛ. Ni ewo amɛ gbɛ. 10Ni amrɔ lɛ ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ bote lɛlɛ mli, ni eba Dalmanuta niiaŋ.
Farisifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi
(Mateo 12.38-42; 16.1-4)
11 Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ ba ni amɛkɛ lɛ babɔ̃i ŋwanejee. Amɛmiitao ŋwɛi okadi yɛ edɛŋ, kɛmiika lɛ. 12 Ni edɔmɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ emumɔ mli ekɛɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ taoɔ okadi? Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, kɛ aaahã yinɔbii nɛɛ okadi ko fii!” 13Ni eshi amɛ, ni eyabote lɛlɛ mli ekoŋŋ ni etee faa lɛ sɛɛ.
Farisifoi lɛ amasha kɛ Herode masha lɛ
(Mateo 16.5-12)
14Shi amɛhiɛ ekpa nɔ ni amɛŋɔ aboloo akwaabɔi amɛkɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ, amɛhiɛɛɛ eko yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, akɛ ja ekome pɛ kɛkɛ. 15 Yesu bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi lɛ amasha kɛ Herode masha lɛ he!” 16Ni amɛtao naa yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Benɛ aboloo ni wɔhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ.” 17Ni be ni Yesu na le lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsusuɔ akɛ aboloo ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ? Ani nyɛyooko sɛɛ ni asaŋ nyɛnako nii anaa lolo? Ani nɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ naa eŋa? 18 Nyɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, ni nyɛnaaa nii? Nyɛyɛ toii hu, ni nyɛnuuu nii? Ni nyɛkaiii? 19 Be ni mikumɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ amli miha mɛi akpei enumɔ lɛ, fufuji kafui enyiɛ nyɛhole?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.” 20 “Ni be ni mikumɔ kpawo lɛ mli mihã mɛi akpei ejwɛ lɛ, fufuji flɔtɔi enyiɛ nyɛhole?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Kpawo.” 21Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛnaaa nii anaa lolo nɛɛ?”
Yesu tsa shwilafo ko yɛ Betsaida
22 Amɛba Betsaida, ni mɛi komɛi kɛ shwilafo ko ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkpa lɛ fai koni eta ehe. 23 Ni emɔ shwilafo lɛ nineshi ni ekɛ lɛ je akrowa lɛ, ni etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie ehiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani oona nii lo?” 24Nuu lɛ wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Miina gbɔmɛi, shi amɛtamɔ tsei ni miinyiɛ.” 25No sɛɛ lɛ, esaa ekɛ eniji shwie shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ; agbɛnɛ shwilafo lɛ kwɛ nii hãa, ni atsa lɛ, ni ena nii fɛɛ faŋŋ. 26Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jie lɛ gbɛ ni eya eshĩa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaaya akrowa lɛ mli tete!”
Petro odase ni eye yɛ Yesu he
(Mateo 16.13-20; Luka 9.18-21)
27Ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee maji ni yɔɔ Kaisarea Filipi lɛ amli. Ebi amɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Namɔ mɛi kɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” 28 Amɛto he akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ; ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia; ni mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji bo.” 29 Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo ji Kristo lɛ!” 30 Ni Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko ehe sane.
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he
(Mateo 16.21-28; Luka 9.22-27)
31Ni ebɔ̃i amɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ, “Ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ na amanehulu pii, ni onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ekwa lɛ, ni agbe lɛ ni gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.” 32Ewie wiemɔ nɛɛ faŋŋ. Enɛ hã Petro kɛ lɛ tee afã, ni ebɔ̃i ehiɛ kãmɔ. 33Shi etsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ekwɛ ekaselɔi lɛ, ekã Petro hiɛ ekɛɛ, “Jee mihiɛ, Satan, ejaakɛ osusuuu Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahe, shi gbɔmɛi anibii ahe moŋ ojwɛŋɔ!”
Hekwamɔ
(Mateo 16.24-28; Luka 9.23-27)
34 Agbɛnɛ etsɛ asafo lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ hu kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ. 35 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala. 36Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa, kɛji enine shɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni elaaje lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma lɛ? 37 Aloo mɛni gbɔmɔ aaahã ni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma? 38 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi kɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ahe feɔ lɛ hiɛgbele yɛ yinɔbii gbãlãfitelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi nɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ hu ehe aaafee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛgbele be ni eeeba yɛ eTsɛ anunyam lɛ mli kɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.”

Title: MARKO 9
Content:
1Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ akɛ eeba yɛ hewalɛ mli.”
Yesu gbɔmɔtso su tsake
(Mateo 17.1-13; Luka 9.28-36)
2Gbii ekpaa sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, ni ekɛ amɛ kɛkɛ tee gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ yɛ afã banee. Ni egbɔmɔtso su tsake yɛ amɛhiɛ. 3Ni etade lɛ kpɛ ni eyɛ futafuta bɔ ni niiahefɔlɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni aaanyɛ ahã eyɛ nakai. 4Ni Elia kɛ Mose jie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ Yesu miiwie. 5Ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ehi akɛ wɔhi biɛ! Hã wɔfee bui etɛ̃, onɔ ekome, kɛ Mose nɔ ekome, kɛ Elia nɔ ekome.” 6Shi eleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ ejaakɛ amɛ jijaa. 7 Ni atatu ko bakete amɛnɔ, ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi lɛ, nyɛboa lɛ toi!” 8Ni amrɔ lɛ, be ni amɛkwɛkwɛɛ amɛhe kɛkpe lɛ, amɛnaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ akɛ ja Yesu pɛ kɛ amɛ kɛkɛ.
9 Ni be ni amɛkpelekeɔ gɔŋ lɛ, Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkagbaa mɔ ko nii ni nyɛna lɛ, ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ dã.” 10Amɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ to amɛyiŋ, shi amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Te shitee kɛ gbohii ateŋjɛɛ nɛɛ shishiŋ?” 11Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Te tɛŋŋ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ ja Elia eba dã lɛ?” 12 Eto he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Elia baaba dã lɛɛlɛŋ ni ebato nibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ ekoŋŋ. Shi mɛɛba mɔ ni aŋma yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ he akɛ eeena amanehulu pii, ni aaaŋɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni abuuu lɛ lɛ? 13 Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ Elia eba momo, ni amɛfee lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ.”
Yesu tsa gbekɛ nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli
(Mateo 17.14-21; Luka 9.37-43a)
14Be ni amɛbashɛ kaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛna mɛi pii ni bua amɛhe kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ni amɛmiibibii amɛhe nii. 15Amrɔ ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na Yesu lɛ, efee amɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛsha foi kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbafala lɛ. 16Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛbibiɔ amɛ lɛ?” 17Ni mɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mikɛ mibinuu ni mumɔ ni ewieee yɔɔ emli ba oŋɔɔ. 18He fɛɛ he ni eeemɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ, etsiɔ lɛ etswaa shi ni enaa kwɛ̃ɔ afui, ni ekpeɔ enyanyɔji ashishi ni eetã loo. Mikɛɛ okaselɔi lɛ ni amɛfã lɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ.” 19Yesu to he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ao, yinɔbii ni heee yeee! Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mi kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kɛyashi? Mɛɛ beyinɔ mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi? Nyɛkɛ gbekɛ nuu lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ.” 20Ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba eŋɔɔ. Ni be ni mumɔ lɛ na Yesu lɛ, amrɔ lɛ ehã gbekɛ lɛ shɔ̃ kwekweekwe, ni egbee shi, ni ekoklo shi, ni enaa kwɛ̃ afui. 21Yesu bi etsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ enɛ bɔ̃i lɛ feemɔ?” Ni eto he ekɛɛ, “Kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi. 22Kpitiokpitio eshɛɔ lɛ efɔ̃ɔ la mli kɛ nui amli koni ekpãtã ehiɛ. Shi kɛji ooonyɛ he nɔ ko ofee lɛ, omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo yɛ wɔhe ni ofee he eko ohã wɔ!” 23 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ, ‘Kɛ ooonyɛ?’ Aaanyɛ afee nii fiaa ahã mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ!” 24Ni amrɔ lɛ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ lɛ bo ekɛɛ, “Miihe miiye; ye obua mihemɔkɛyeli ni mibɛ lɛ!”
25Shi be ni Yesu na akɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ foi kɛmiiba eŋɔɔ lɛ, efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yi ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo mumɔ mumui kɛ toimulɔ, miifã bo akɛ, ‘Jee emli, ni kaabote emli dɔŋŋ.’ ” 26 Ni mumɔ lɛ bolɔ, ni ehã gbekɛ lɛ shɔ̃ kwekweekwe, ni eje emli; ni gbekɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbonyo bɔ ni mɛi pii kɛɛ akɛ egbo. 27Shi Yesu mɔ enineshi, ni ewo enɔ, ni ete shi edamɔ shi.
28Be ni Yesu ba shĩa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ yɛ afã akɛ, “Mɛɛba wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ mumɔ lɛ wɔfã lɛ?” 29Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ henɔ nɛɛ, anyɛɛɛ lɛ afã yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko naa, akɛ ja yɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ naa pɛ kɛkɛ.”
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he ekoŋŋ
(Mateo 17.22-23; Luka 9.43b-45)
30Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ je jɛi ni amɛyatsɔ̃ Galilea, ni esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mɔ ko ale; 31 ejaakɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ anii; ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni kɛ agbe lɛ lɛ, eeete shi yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.” 32 Shi amɛnaaa nakai wiemɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei hu akɛ amɛaabi lɛ.
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
(Mateo 18.1-5; Luka 9.46-48)
33 Ni amɛba Kapernaum. Ni be ni eyɔɔ shĩa lɛ, ebi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni he nyɛwieɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?” 34 Shi amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ; ejaakɛ be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtaa naa yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ. 35 Yesu ho eta shi ni etsɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miitao klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe mɛi fɛɛ sɛɛkpelɔ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ.” 36Ni eŋɔ gbekɛ bibioo ko ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛteŋ, ni eloo lɛ atuu, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 37 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛbii ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɔ kome yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, jeee mi ehereɔ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ!”
Mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo wɔ lɛ eyɛ wɔgbɛfaŋ
(Luka 9.49-50)
38 Yohane kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔna mɔ ko ni kɛ ogbɛi miifã mumɔi fɔ̃ji, ni wɔtsi lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ wɔ enyiɛɛɛ osɛɛ” 39 Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛkatsia lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni ekɛ migbɛi aaatsu hewalɛ nitsumɔ ko ni eeenyɛ mihe efɔŋ ewie oya. 40 Ejaakɛ mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo wɔ lɛ, eyɛ wɔgbɛfaŋ. 41 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahã nyɛ nu kpulu kome nyɛnu yɛ migbɛi mli akɛ Kristo webii lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ enyɔmɔwo eŋmɛŋ lɛ.”
Nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
(Mateo 18.6-9; Luka 17.1-2)
42“Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ mɛi bibii nɛɛ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nane lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni ayashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ. 43 Kɛ onine miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ nine kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni okɛ niji enyɔ aaatee gehena (Abonsamiiaje) yɛ la ni gbooo lɛ mli, [ 44 he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo, ni amɛla lɛ hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.] 45Ni kɛ onane miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ nane kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni ohiɛ naji enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje yɛ la ni gbooo lɛ mli, [ 46he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo, ni amɛla hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.] 47 Ni kɛ ohiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, fãa oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ hiŋmɛi kome bote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli fe nɔ ni ohiɛ hiŋmɛii enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje la lɛ mli, 48 he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo ni amɛla lɛ hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.
49“Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ akɛ la aaawo lɛ ŋoo. 50 Nɔ kpakpa ji ŋoo; shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni nyɛkɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ? Nyɛhãa ŋoo ahĩa nyɛmli, ni nyɛhia shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli yɛ nyɛteŋ.”

Title: MARKO 10
Content:
Gbãlãmligbalamɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ
(Mateo 19.1-12; Luka 16.8)
1 Ni Yesu je jɛi ni eyiŋ etee Yudea niiaŋ kɛ Yordan sɛɛgbɛ. Ni mɛi pii babua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ ehe, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ.
2Ni Farisifoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani nuu yɛ hegbɛ akɛ eshwieɔ eŋa?” Amɛbi enɛ kɛmiika lɛ. 3Shi ehere nɔ ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ kitã Mose wo nyɛ?” 4 Amɛkɛɛ, “Mose hã hegbɛ akɛ aŋma shwiemɔ wolo ni ashwie lɛ.” 5Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsuiwalɛ hewɔ eŋma kitã nɛɛ ehã nyɛ; 6 shi kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, nuu kɛ yoo Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ amɛ. 7 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he; 8ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome; belɛ agbɛnɛ amɛjeee mɛi enyɔ dɔŋŋ, shi heloo kome. 9No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsa lɛ, gbɔmɔ akagbala mli.”
10Ni be ni amɛshɛ shĩa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ nakai sane lɛ nɔŋŋ ekoŋŋ. 11 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni eyaŋɔɔ mɔ kroko lɛ, efite gbãlã. 12Ni kɛji yoo shwie ewu ni eyagbã mɔ kroko lɛ efite gbãlã.”
Yesu jɔɔ gbekɛbii
(Mateo 19.13-15; Luka 18.15-17)
13Ni mɛi komɛi kɛ gbekɛbii bibii ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ko ni etara amɛhe; shi ekaselɔi lɛ fãmɔ mɛi lɛ. 14Shi be ni Yesu na lɛ, emli fu, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ. 15 Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heee Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ gbekɛ bibioo lɛ, eboteŋ mli kwraa.” 16 Ni eloo amɛ atuu, ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ.
Nuu niiatsɛ lɛ
(Mateo 19.16-27; Luka 18.18-27)
17Ni be ni eje kpo ni eyi gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko hiɛ foi kɛbanina lɛ ni ebakula ehiɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?” 18Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba otsɛɔ mi mɔ kpakpa? Mɔ kpakpa ko bɛ akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ. 19 Te ole kitãi lɛ, ‘Kaagbe gbɔmɔ, kaafite gbãlã, kaaju, kaaye amale odase, kaashishiu mɔ, wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ!’ ” 20Shi nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, miye enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ nɔ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ.” 21 Ni Yesu kwɛ lɛ ni etsui mɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eshwɛ bo nɔ kome: Yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ ni okɛhã ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba ni obanyiɛ misɛɛ.” 22Shi nuu lɛ hiɛ tsake yɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ, ni eyiŋ etee kɛ dɔlɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
23Ni Yesu kwɛ ehewɔ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛna bɔ ni ewa hã niiatsɛmɛi akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!” 24 Kaselɔi lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ahe. Shi Yesu here nɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bii, te nyɛna bɔ ni ewa hã mɛi ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ nii anɔ lɛ akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli! 25Ejaraaa hãaa yooma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli tamɔ bɔ ni ejaraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ.” 26Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa, ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?” 27Yesu kwɛ amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɛi agbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛŋ afee, shi jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛɔ nii fiaa afeɔ.”
Yesu sɛɛnyiɛmɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo
28Petro bɔ̃i lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi nii fiaa ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ.” 29Yesu kɛɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni eshi shĩa loo nyɛmimɛi hii loo nyɛmimɛi yei loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo ŋa loo bii loo shikpɔji yɛ mi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ, 30ni enaŋ shĩai kɛ nyɛmimɛi hii kɛ nyɛmimɛi yei kɛ nyɛmɛi kɛ bii kɛ shikpɔji toi oha yɛ benɛbe nɛɛ mli beebe, kɛ yiwalɛ hu; ni jeŋ ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ eeena naanɔ wala. 31 Shi klɛŋklɛŋbii pii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpelɔi, ni sɛɛkpelɔi aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii.”
Yesu wie egbele he nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃
(Mateo 20.17-19; Luka 18.31-34)
32Ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni Yesu nyiɛ amɛhiɛ; kaselɔi lɛ ahe ejɔ̃ amɛhe, ni mɛi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ miishe gbeyei. Ni eŋɔ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛtee afã ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nɔ ni baaba enɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, 33“Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛaabu lɛ gbele fɔ, ni amɛaaŋɔ lɛ amɛhã jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ. 34Ni amɛaaye ehe fɛo, ni amɛaafɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛaashwie ehe, ni amɛkɛ kpelebii aaayi lɛ, ni amɛaagbe lɛ; ni gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, eeete shi ekoŋŋ.”
Yakobo kɛ Yohane nibimɔ lɛ
(Mateo 20.20-28)
35Ni Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bii lɛ, ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔmiisumɔ akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaaba bo lɛ ofee ohã wɔ.” 36Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ mifee mihã nyɛ?” 37Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã wɔ hegbɛ koni wɔteŋ mɔ kome ata oninejurɔ nɔ ni mɔ kome hu ata obɛku nɔ yɛ onumnyam lɛ mli.” 38 Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛleee nɔ ni nyɛbiɔ lɛ; ani nyɛaanyɛ kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛnu, aloo nyɛaanyɛ ni akɛ mibaptisimɔ lɛ abaptisi nyɛ?” 39 Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔɔnyɛ.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛaanu, ni baptisimɔ ni akɛaabaptisi mi lɛ akɛaabaptisi nyɛ nɛ; 40shi mininejurɔ kɛ mibɛku nɔ tamɔ lɛ jeee minɔŋ ni mikɛhãa, shi moŋ mɛi ni asaa ato lɛ anɔŋ.”
41Ni be ni mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ nu lɛ amɛmli wo Yakobo kɛ Yohane la. 42 No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛle akɛ mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔyelɔi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni amɛteŋ gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ. 43 Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ agbo atsɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ; 44ni mɔ ni taoɔ nyɛteŋ onukpa atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe mɛi fɛɛ atsulɔ. 45Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu baaa ni asɔ̃mɔ lɛ, shi sɔ̃ɔmɔ moŋ eba, koni eŋɔ esusuma ehã akɛ kpɔmɔnɔ yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ.”
Yesu tsa Bartimeo shwilafo lɛ
(Mateo 20.29-34; Luka 18.35-43)
46Ni amɛshɛ Yeriko. Ni be ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ asafo yuu jɛ jɛi amɛyaa lɛ, Timeo bi Bartimeo, shwilafo nibalɔ lɛ, ta gbɛjegbɛ lɛ toi eebala nii. 47Ni be ni enu akɛ Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ni lɛ, ebɔi blɔmɔ akɛ, “Yesu, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” 48Ni mɛi pii fãmɔ lɛ akɛ emua enaa. Shi ebolɔ babaoo moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” 49Yesu wa damɔ shi ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɛa lɛ kɛbaa!” Ni amɛtsɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Na tsui, tee shi, eetsɛ bo!” 50Ni eshɛ etade nɔhaa lɛ efɔ̃, ni ete shi pa, ni eba Yesu ŋɔɔ. 51Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã bo?” Ni shwilafo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabuni, (eshishi ji Minuŋtsɔ), akɛ mana nii.” 52Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo.” Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ena nii, ni enyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.

Title: MARKO 11
Content:
Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ
(Mateo 21.1-11; Luka 19.28-40; Yohane 12.12-19)
1Ni be ni amɛkɛɛ amɛbɛŋkɛɔ Yerusalɛm ni amɛshɛ Betfage kɛ Betania yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yesu tsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, 2ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ lɛ mli, ni jɛi ni nyɛaashɛ pɛ, nyɛaana tejibi ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tako enɔ dã ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi; nyɛfɛnea lɛ kɛbaa. 3Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi nyɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ nyɛfeɔ enɛ?’ lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi etsɛŋ ni eeetsu ni akɛ lɛ aba ekoŋŋ.’ ” 4Ni amɛtee amɛyana tejibi lɛ ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi yɛ agbo naa yɛ blohu lɛ mli, ni amɛfɛne lɛ. 5Mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ, tejibi lɛ nyɛfɛneɔ lɛ?” 6Ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ bɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ.
7Ni amɛkɛ tejibi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei shwie enɔ, ni eho eta nɔ. 8Ni mɛi pii kɛ amɛtadei hahaa gbɛ lɛ nɔ; ni mɛi komɛi hu folɔ tsei aniji kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ mli ni amɛkɛshwie gbɛ lɛ nɔ. 9Ni mɛi ni nyiɛ hiɛ kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ bolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Hosiana! Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ! 10Ajɔɔ wɔtsɛ David maŋtsɛyeli ni baa lɛ! Hosiana yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!” 11Ni ebote Yerusalɛm, ni etee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; ni be ni ekwɛ nibii fɛɛ kɛkpe lɛ, akɛni je ena momo hewɔ lɛ, eje jɛi ni etee Betania kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
Yesu lomɔ agbãmitso lɛ
(Mateo 21.18-19)
12Enɔ jetsɛremɔ, be ni amɛjɛ Betania amɛbaa lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ. 13Ni ena agbãmitso ko yɛ shɔŋŋ ni bai yɔɔ yi, ni etee eyakwɛ akɛ aleenɔ eeena nɔ ko yɛ nɔ lo. Shi be ni eshɛ he lɛ, enaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja bai kɛkɛ, ejaakɛ agbãmiwoobe shɛko. 14 Ni Yesu wo enaa nɔ ekɛɛ agbãmitso lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko yeŋ onɔ yibii dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ!” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ nu.
Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he
(Mateo 21.12-17; Luka 19.45-48; Yohane 2.13-22)
15Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni ebɔ̃i mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shwiemɔ, ni etsirɛ shikatsakelɔi lɛ akplɔ̃i kɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ asɛii lɛ etswia shi, 16ni eŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko atere nɔ ko kɛtsɔ̃ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. 17 Ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekɛɛ, “Ani aŋmako akɛ, ‘Aaatsɛ miwe lɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ aSɔlemɔ we?’ Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu!”
18Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ nu, ni amɛtao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ; shi amɛmiishe lɛ gbeyei ejaakɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ naa kpɛɔ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he.
19Shi kɛ shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ ejeɔ maŋ lɛ mli.
Agbãmi tso lɛ he nikasemɔ
(Mateo 21.20-22)
20 Ni leebi maŋkpa, be ni amɛhoɔ lɛ, amɛna akɛ agbãmitso lɛ eŋãla kɛ eshishifã fɛɛ. 21Ni Petro kai ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Rabi, naa, agbãmitso lɛ ni olomɔ lɛ eŋãla!” 22Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhea Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛyea! 23 Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, mɔ ni aaakɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Fãa ni oyagbee ŋshɔŋ!’ Ni ejeee ŋwane yɛ etsui mli, shi moŋ eheɔ eyeɔ akɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ aaaba mli lɛ, aaafee ahã lɛ. 24 No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nii abɔ fɛɛ ni nyɛkpaa he fai yɛ nyɛsɔlemɔ mli lɛ, nyɛhea nyɛyea akɛ nyɛna, ni akɛaahã nyɛ. 25 Ni be fɛɛ be ni nyɛdamɔ shi nyɛsɔleɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛyɛ mɔ ko he sane ko lɛ, nyɛkɛfaa lɛ, koni nyɛŋwɛi-Tsɛ lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ afa nyɛ. [ 26 Shi kɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛfaaa lɛ, nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaŋ nyɛ.”]
Hegbɛ ni Yesu yɔɔ
(Mateo 21.23-27; Luka 20.1-8)
27Ni amɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ. Ni be ni Yesu nyiɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, 28ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ hewɔ ofeɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, aloo namɔ hã bo nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ ni okɛfee nibii nɛɛ?” 29Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mabi nyɛ sane kome ni nyɛhã mi hetoo, koni matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni mikɛfeɔ nii nɛɛ. 30Yohane Baptisimɔ lɛ ŋwɛi ejɛ aloo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ ejɛ? Nyɛhãa mi hetoo!” 31Ni amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛkɛ amɛhe yiyii akɛ, “Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeebi wɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee mɔ?’ 32Ni kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ,” amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ buɔ Yohane gbalɔ lɛɛlɛŋ. 33Ni amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Wɔleee.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ, mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ hewɔ ni mifeɔ nibii nɛɛ mɔ.”

Title: MARKO 12
Content:
Waintrom mli apaafoi fɔ̃ji lɛ
(Mateo 21.33-46; Luka 20.9-19)
1 Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ bɔ̃i wiemɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli akɛ, “Nuu ko fee waintrom, ni efo afabaŋ ewo he; etsa wainbu, ni etswa mɔɔ yɛ mli, ni ekɛhã bulɔi apaayeli, ni edom. 2Be ni shɛ wain kpamɔbe lɛ, etsu tsulɔ ko kɛtee hulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ koni eyaŋɔ waintrom lɛ mli yibii lɛ eko yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛba. 3Shi amɛmɔ lɛ ni amɛyi lɛ, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛŋ folo. 4Esaa etsu tsulɔ kroko hu kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ; ni amɛjwarajwaraa eyitso, ni amɛshwie ehiɛ shi. 5Asaŋ etsu mɔ kroko ekoŋŋ; ni lɛ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii hu; amɛyiyii mɛi komɛi, ni amɛgbegbee mɛi komɛi. 6Agbɛnɛ eshwɛ mɔ kome pɛ ni ebaatsu, ebinuu ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ. Naagbee lɛ etsu lɛ hu amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Amɛhiɛ aaasɔ mibi lɛ.’ 7Shi nɛkɛ okwaafoi nɛɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ ni gboshinii lɛ atsɔ̃ wɔnɔ!’ 8 Ni amɛmɔ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ, ni amɛwo lɛ yɛ waintrom lɛ mli amɛshɛ amɛfɔ̃. 9No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni waintromtsɛ lɛ baafee? Eeeba ebakpãtã okwaafoi lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã mɛi krokomɛi. 10 Ani nyɛkaneko nɛkɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ,
‘Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ,
no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.
11Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ enɛ jɛ,
ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiŋmɛiiaŋ?’ ”
12Ni amɛmiitao lɛ amɛmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ amɛhewɔ ebu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ, shi amɛmiishe asafo lɛ gbeyei. Ni amɛshi lɛ amɛtee.
Oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hamɔ
(Mateo 22.15-22; Luka 20.20-26)
13 Ni atsu Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Herodebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ koni amɛbamɔ enaa enyɔŋ yɛ wiemɔ mli. 14Ni be ni amɛba lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo, ni osheee gbɔmɔ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ, shi moŋ otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli. Ani eja akɛ atsuɔ onia ahãa Kaisare aloo ejaaa? Wɔhã, aloo wɔkahã?” 15Shi ni eyoo amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi? Nyɛkɛ denario abaa ni makwɛa.” 16Ni amɛkɛba. Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mfoniri nɛ, ni namɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaisare nɔŋ.” 17 Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare, ni nyɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ.” Ni ehe fee amɛ naakpɛɛ.
Gbohiiashitee he sanebimɔ
(Mateo 22.23-33; Luka 20.27-40)
18 Ni Sadukifoi ni kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ hu ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, 19 “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ŋma hã wɔ akɛ, ‘Kɛ mɔ ko nyɛmi gbo ni eshi eŋa, shi eshiii bi lɛ, enyɛmi lɛ aŋɔ eŋa lɛ ni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.’ 20Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi shi; ni onukpa lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni eshiii bi; 21mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ hu ŋɔ yoo lɛ, ni egbo, ni lɛ hu eshiii bi ko yɛ esɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. 22Mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ yoo lɛ hi shi, ni amɛshiii bii yɛ amɛsɛɛ. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu bagbo. 23Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli, be ni amɛaate shi lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ̃, ejaakɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ hi shi?”
24Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee ŋmalɛi lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni nyɛleee lɛ hewɔ nyɛtɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ? 25Ejaakɛ be ni amɛaate shi kɛaajɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, hii lɛ eŋɔŋ yei, ni yei lɛ hu egbãŋ; shi moŋ amɛaatamɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi. 26 Shi akɛ gbohii baate shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ani nyɛkaneko yɛ Mose wolo lɛ mli bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ yɛ ŋmeitso lɛ he sane lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Mi lɛ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi,’ lɛ? 27Enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee gbohii aNyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi aNyɔŋmɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmiitɔ̃ babaoo.”
Kitã wulu lɛ
(Mateo 22.34-40; Luka 10.25-28)
28Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni nu akɛ amɛmiibibii lɛ saji lɛ hu ba, ni be ni ena akɛ ehã amɛ hetoo jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te nɔ ni ji kitãi lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ klɛŋklɛŋ nɔŋ?” 29 Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji, Bo toi, Israel! Nuŋtsɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ kome ni; 30ni suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ osusuma fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ! 31 Kitã ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɛ, ‘Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.’ Kitã ko bɛ ni fe enɛɛmɛi.” 32Mlatsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, Tsɔɔlɔ, anɔkwale okɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome pɛ yɔɔ, ni mɔ kroko bɛ, ja lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ; 33 ni lɛ suɔmɔ kɛjɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ nilee fɛɛ kɛ susuma fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ fɛɛ mli kɛ naanyo suɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ sumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, efe shãa afɔlei kɛ afɔlei fɛɛ.” 34 Ni be ni Yesu na akɛ eto he yɛ nilee naa lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ teŋ jekɛɛɛ.” Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ sane ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
David Bi ni ji David Nuŋtsɔ Lɛ
(Mateo 22.41-46; Luka 20.41-44)
35Ni be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ Kristo lɛ, David biŋ lɛ? 36 Ejaakɛ David diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa akɛ,
‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ,
ta mininejurɔ nɔ,
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi
mafee onaneshi maaŋoo.’
37David diɛŋtsɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ; belɛ te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebi hu?” Ni mɛi babaoo bo lɛ toi kɛ miishɛɛ.
Yesu wie shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ
(Mateo 23.1-36; Luka 20.45-47)
38Ni ekɛɛ amɛ yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi ni sumɔɔ atadei wuyawuyaa woo kɛ shisheramɔ kɛ jaanɔ ŋamɔi lɛ ahe; 39mlatsɔɔlɔi ni sumɔɔ onukpai ashitaramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ yitso tamɔ yɛ niyeniiashi; 40amɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛsɔleɔ sɔlemɔi kakadaji amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi; amɛfɔbuu lɛ aaafe nine!”
Yoo okulafo lɛ onia lɛ
(Luka 21.1-4)
41 Ni Yesu yata shikatoohe lɛ ŋlɛnɔ eekwɛ bɔ ni mɛi lɛ kɛ shika woɔ onia adeka lɛ mli lɛ. Ni niiatsɛmɛi pii kɛ babaoo wo mli. 42Ni yoo okulafo ko hu ba ni ekɛ kapɛji enyɔ ni shɛɛɛ pesewa bawo mli. 43Ni etsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, nɛkɛ okulafo ohiafo nɛɛ kɛ pii ewo mli fe mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni kɛ eko ebawo adeka lɛ mli lɛ. 44 Ejaakɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛna ni eteke nɔ lɛ eko amɛkɛbawo mli; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ ehia mli ni ekɛlɛɔ ehe lɛ fɛɛ ekɛbawo mli nɛɛ.”

Title: MARKO 13
Content:
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fitemɔ he gbalɛ
(Mateo 24.1-2; Luka 21.5-6)
1Be ni Yesu jeɔ kpo yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kwɛ tɛi kɛ tsui kpelekplei!” 2Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oona nɛkɛ tsui kpeteŋkplei nɛɛ? Ashiŋ tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ ni atsiŋ atswaŋ shi.”
Amanehului ashishijee
(Mateo 24.3-14; 10.17-22; Luka 21.7-19)
3Ni be ni eta shi yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ, Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea bi lɛ yɛ afã nigii akɛ, 4“Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ be mli ni aaafee nii nɛɛ, ni kɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ kwa aaaba mli lɛ, mɛni ji ehe okadi?”
5Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ebɔ̃i amɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni mɔ ko akalaka nyɛ. 6Ejaakɛ mɛi pii aaaba yɛ migbɛi mli, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji lɛ!’ Ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii. 7Shi kɛ nyɛnu tai kɛ tai asaji ahe lɛ, nyɛkahaoa, ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ba mli, shi asaŋ naagbee lɛ shɛko. 8Maŋ aaate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyeli aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli, ni shikpɔŋhosomɔi aaaba yɛ hei srɔtoi, ni hɔmɔ aaaba. Enɛɛmɛi ji kɔ̃ɔmɔi abɔ̃imɔ.
9 “Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛlea nyɛhenɔkwɛmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ kɛaatee gwabɔi amli, ni aaayi nyɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ, ni akɛ nyɛ aaadamɔ lumɛi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ yɛ mihewɔ koni nyɛye odase nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 10 Ni ja ashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji fɛɛ dã. 11Shi kɛ amɛkpala nyɛ kɛtee amɛyahã lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛto yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawie hewɔ; shi moŋ nɔ ni akɛaahã nyɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nyɛwiea; ejaakɛ jeee nyɛ nyɛwieɔ lɛ, shi moŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni. 12Shi nyɛmi aaaŋɔ nyɛmi ahã gbele, ni tsɛ hu kɛ bi aaahã; ni bii aaate shi awo amɛfɔlɔi, ni amɛkɛ amɛ aaahã ni agbe amɛ. 13 Ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛwulaa shi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.”
Amanehulu kpeteŋkple lɛ
(Mateo 24.15-28; Luka 21.20-24)
14 “Shi kɛ nyɛna amaŋfɔ̃ nihiinii lɛ akɛ ema he ni esaaa akɛ emaa lɛ, (mɔ ni kaneɔ lɛ, ayoo sɛɛ), no lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi aya gɔji lɛ anɔ; 15ni mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ lɛ akakpleke shi aloo ebote shĩa eyakɔ nɔ ko; 16ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi lɛ ekaku esɛɛ eyakɔ etade. 17Shi kpoo hã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ mɛi ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ! 18Shi nyɛsɔlea koni enɛ akaba yɛ fɛ̃ibe mli! 19 Ejaakɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ amanehulu aaaba ni anãko enɔ dã kɛjɛ jeŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ shishijee mli aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni asaŋ anaŋ enɔ dɔŋŋ. 20Ni ja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fo gbii lɛ anɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ ahereŋ heloo ko heloo ko yiwala; shi mɛi ni ehala lɛ ahewɔ lɛ eeefo gbii lɛ anɔ.
21“Ni no mli lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, Kristo lɛ yɛ biɛ!’ Aloo, ‘Naa, eyɛ biɛ!’ lɛ, nyɛkahea nyɛyea, 22ejaakɛ amale kristoi kɛ amale gbalɔi aaate shi ni amɛaafee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii koni kɛ aaaho lɛ, amɛlaka mɛi ni ahala lɛ tete. 23Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ; mikɛɛ nyɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mito.”
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa
(Mateo 24.29-31; Luka 21.25-28)
24 “Shi no bei lɛ amli yɛ amanehulu nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hulu hiɛ aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ; 25 ni ŋulamii aaatserɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi atswia shi, ni aaahoso hewalɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ. 26 Kɛkɛ lɛ, aaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eeba yɛ atatuiaŋ kɛ hewalɛ kpele kɛ anunyam babaoo. 27 No ni eeetsu ebɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛaabua mɛi ni ehala lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ naagbeehe kɛyashi ŋwɛi naagbeehe.”
Agbãmitso he nikasemɔ
(Mateo 24.32-35; Luka 21.29-33)
28“Nyɛkasea agbãmitso he abɛ ni ebuɔ lɛ. Kɛ shɛ be ni eniji efrɔke ni eefu baa lɛ, nyɛle akɛ latsaabe lɛ eshɛ etã. 29Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛna akɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ miiba mli lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ eshɛ agboi anaa etã. 30Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, ja nii nɛɛ fɛɛ eba mli dã. 31Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ baaho aya, shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ.”
Mɔ ko leee gbi lɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ
(Mateo 24.36-44)
32 “Shi no gbi lɛ loo ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mɔ ko leee; ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ leee, ni Bi lɛ hu leee, akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ. 33Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea; ejaakɛ nyɛleee beyinɔ ni be lɛ shɛɔ. 34 Etamɔ nuu ko ni edom eshi ewe, ni ehã etsuji lɛ hegbɛ kɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ, ni efã agbonaakwɛlɔ lɛ akɛ ebu. 35 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa; ejaakɛ nyɛleee beyinɔ ni shĩatsɛ lɛ baa, ekolɛ gbɛkɛ, loo nyɔɔŋteŋ, loo wuɔgbɛɛmɔ, loo leebi; 36koni ekaba trukaa ebana nyɛ akɛ nyɛmiiwɔ. 37Nɔ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ, mɛi fɛɛ mikɛɔ, Nyɛsaraa!”

Title: MARKO 14
Content:
Ato Yesu yinɔ apam
(Mateo 26.1-5; Luka 22.1-2; Yohane 11.45-53)
1 Be ni eshwɛ gbii enyɔ ni ayeɔ Hehoo kɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ tao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ Yesu yɛ ŋaa mli ni amɛgbe lɛ. 2Shi amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, koni basabasafeemɔ akaba maŋ lɛ mli.”
Afɔ Yesu mu yɛ Betania
(Mateo 26.6-13; Yohane 12.1-8)
3 Be ni Yesu yɔɔ Betania yɛ Simon, kpitiyelɔ lɛ, we lɛ ni eta niyeniiashi lɛ, yoo ko ni hiɛ alabastro tɔ ni nardo mu ŋmiiŋmi ni jara wa naakpa yɔɔ mli ba; ni ejwa alabastro tɔ lɛ, ni efɔse mu lɛ eshwie Yesu yiteŋ. 4Shi mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ amli wo la ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ ni afite mu lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ? 5Ejaakɛ kulɛ nɛkɛ mu nɛɛ, aaanyɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ana fe denarioi ohai etɛ̃ ni akɛhã ohiafoi!” Ni amɛwie yoo lɛ he huhuuhu. 6Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛfɔ̃a lɛ hiɛmɔ! Mɛni hewɔ nyɛhaoɔ lɛ? Etsu nitsumɔ fɛɛfɛo ehã mi. 7 Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa, ni be fɛɛ be ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ amɛ ejurɔ nyɛfee; shi mi lɛ jeee daa mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi. 8Efee nɔ ni ebaanyɛ; etsɔ̃ hiɛ ebafɔ migbɔmɔtso lɛ mu eto mifuu. 9Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, he fɛɛ he ni aaashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ, yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, aaagba nɔ ni yoo nɛɛ efee nɛɛ hu akɛkai lɛ.”
Yuda kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ
(Mateo 26.14-16; Luka 22.3-6)
10Kɛkɛ ni Yuda Iskariot, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, yiŋ etee osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ koni eyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ. 11Shi amɛ lɛ be ni amɛnu lɛ amɛnya, ni amɛwo lɛ shi akɛ amɛaahã lɛ shika. Hewɔ lɛ, etao bɔ ni eeefee ni ehã amɛnine ashɛ enɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.
Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ anaagbee niyenii
(Mateo 26.17-25; Luka 22.7-14, 21-23; Yohane 13.21-30)
12Akpiti Gbii Juji lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni agbeɔ Hehoo toobi lɛ, Yesu kaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa nii wɔto wɔhã bo ni oye Hehoo lɛ yɛ?” 13Ni etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli, ni nuu ko ni hiɛ nu kɛ kpulu kɛ nyɛ aaakpe; nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ; 14 ni he ni eeeyabote lɛ, nyɛkɛa shĩatsɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, nɛgbɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ ni mikɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?’ 15Ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ŋwɛi asa kpeteŋkple ko ni awula mli ni asaa jɛi; nyɛsaa nii nyɛtoa wɔ yɛ jɛi.” 16Ni ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛyana bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
17Ni be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tee jɛi. 18Be ni amɛtara shi amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ kome ni kɛ mi miiye nii baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.” 19Ni amɛbɔ̃i ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ lɛ bimɔ ekomekome akɛ, “Miŋ lo?” 20Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ komeŋ, mɔ nine ni kɛ minine kpeɔ yɛ kã lɛ mli lɛ. 21Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ! Faŋ nɔ ni anaaa afɔ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ.”
Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ shishitoo
(Mateo 26.26-30; Luka 22.15-20; 1 Korintobii 11.23-25)
22Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɔ aboloo, ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea! Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso lɛ.” 23Ni ewo kpulu lɛ ni eda shi, ni ekɛhã amɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnu eko. 24Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛ ji milá ni ji kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ ni afɔse ashwie shi yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ lɛ. 25Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni manu lɛ ehee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” 26 Ni be ni amɛla yijiemɔ lala ko lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛtee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto
(Mateo 26.31-35; Luka 22.31-34; Yohane 13.36-38)
27 Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Matswa tookwɛlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni toi lɛ aaagbɛ ashwã.’ 28 Shi mishitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛaatee Galilea.” 29Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ nane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ tete lɛ, mi lɛ minane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ.” 30 Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ; ŋmɛnɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ shii enyɔ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃.” 31Shi Petro wie kɛ ekãa fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji gbo mikɛ bo aaagbo tete lɛ, mikpãŋ yɛ osɛɛ!” Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Yesu yɛ Getsemane
(Mateo 26.36-46; Luka 22.39-46)
32 Ni amɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Getsemane lɛ, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtaraa biɛ koni mayasɔle dã.” 33Ni eŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane efata ehe, ni ehe bɔ̃i kpokpomɔ kɛ haomɔ; 34 ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Misusuma werɛ eho ehe kɛyaashi gbele mli po; nyɛhia biɛ ni nyɛshia kpe!” 35Ni etee ehiɛ fioo, ni eho ebu shi, ni esɔle koni kɛ aaaho lɛ; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ aho ehe; 36 ni ekɛɛ, “Abba, Ataa! Onyɛɔ nii fɛɛ ofeɔ; jiemɔ kpulu nɛɛ yɛ minɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ!”
37Ni eba ebana amɛ akɛ amɛmiiwɔ, ni ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Simon, wɔ owɔɔ? Onyɛ̃ɛɛ kpe oshi ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome? 38Nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea koni nyɛkabote kaa mli. Mumɔ lɛ miikpɛlɛ moŋ, shi heloo lɛ he waaa.”
39Ni eyiŋ etee ekoŋŋ ni eyasɔle, ni ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ. 40Ni be ni eku esɛɛ eba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebana akɛ amɛwɔ ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii etsii, ni amɛleee nɔ hetoo ni amɛhãa lɛ.
41Ni eba nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ ni nyɛwɔɔ lolo nɛɛ? Efa! Ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ, naa, aaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aawo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ. 42Nyɛtea shi nyɛhãa wɔyaa; naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ eshɛ shi etã.”
Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ emɔmɔ
(Mateo 26.47-56; Luka 22.47-53; Yohane 18.2-12)
43Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ; Yuda, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, ba kɛ mɛi babaoo ni jɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ ni hiɛ klantei kɛ tsei. 44Shi sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ ehã amɛ okadi ko akɛ, “Mɔ naa ni mashwɔ lɛ, lɛ ni; nyɛmɔa lɛ ni nyɛkpalaa lɛ kɛyaa shweshweeshwe.”
45Ni be ni Yuda shɛ shi nɔŋŋ pɛ ni eba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Rabi!” Ni eshwɔ enaa. 46Ni amɛbashwie enɔ ni amɛmɔ lɛ. 47Shi mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbala eklante, ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, ni efo etoi. 48Ni Yesu fã enaa ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mimɔmɔ nyɛbaa kɛ klantei kɛ tsei tamɔ amɔɔ ojotswalɔ nɛɛ? 49 Daa ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ, nyɛmɔɔɔ mi; shi bɔ ni afee ni ŋmalɛi lɛ ana aba mli hewɔŋ.” 50Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi amɛshi lɛ.
51Shi oblanyo ko ni kɛ klala ekete eyayaiaŋ nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛmɔ lɛ; 52shi eshi klala lɛ ni ejo foi kɛ ehe yayai.
Yesu yɛ Gwabɔɔ wulu lɛ hiɛ
(Mateo 26.57-68; Luka 22.54-55, 63-71; Yohane 18.13-14, 19-24)
53Ni amɛkpala Yesu kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ eŋɔɔ.
54Ni Petro nyiɛ esɛɛ flɛŋŋ kɛyabote osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔɔ kpo te lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tsuji lɛ yatara shi, ni ewere la. 55Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ akwaashɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tao Yesu he odase ko ni amɛwo lɛ gbee, shi amɛnaaa eko, 56ejaakɛ mɛi pii ye amale odase amɛshi lɛ moŋ nɛ; shi amɛdasei lɛ yeee hegbɔ.
57Ni mɛi komɛi te shi ni amɛye amale odase amɛshi lɛ amɛkɛɛ, 58 “Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi lɛ makumɔ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni akɛ niji fee lɛ, ni gbii etɛ̃ mli lɛ mamã ekroko ni jeee niji akɛfee.’ ” 59Shi no tete hu, amɛdasei lɛ yeee hegbɔ.
60Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi damɔ shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ebi Yesu akɛ, “Otooo he eko? Mɛɛ odase mɛnɛɛmɛi yeɔ shiɔ bo nɛɛ?” 61 Shi etswaaa esɛŋ ni etooo he eko. Osɔfonukpa lɛ saa bi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Kristo, mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ Bi lɛ lo?” 62 Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Miŋ; ni nyɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eta Ofe lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ amli.” 63Shi osɔfonukpa lɛ gbala etadei ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ odasefoi wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ dɔŋŋ? 64 Nyɛnu emusubɔɔ lɛ; te nyɛjwɛŋɔ tɛŋŋ?” Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛbu lɛ fɔ akɛ esa gbele. 65Ni mɛi komɛi bɔ̃i lajɔ̃fɛɛ kɛ ehe shwiemɔ, ni amɛfi ehiɛ, ni amɛyi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbaa!” Ni tsuji lɛ shwie enɔ kɛ ma.
Petro kwa Yesu
(Mateo 26.69-75; Luka 22.56-62; Yohane 18.15-18, 25-27)
66Be ni Petro yɔɔ shishi lɛ yɛ mɔɔ kpo te lɛ mli lɛ, osɔfonukpa lɛ weyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba, 67ni be ni ena Petro ni eewere la lɛ, ekwɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Te bo hu okɛ Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ yɔɔ?” 68Shi etso ekɛɛ, “Mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ, ni minaaa shishi tete.” Ni eje kpo etee koi lɛ shi, kɛkɛ ni wuɔ gbɛɛ. 69Ni oblayoo lɛ na lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni esaa ebɔ̃i mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛ!” 70Shi Petro tso ekoŋŋ. Ni fee sɛɛ fioo lɛ mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ kɛɛ Petro ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mli lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji bo, ejaakɛ Galileanyo ji bo.” 71Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i loomɔ kɛ kitãkãmɔ akɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ ni nyɛwieɔ ehe nɛɛ!” 72 Ni amrɔ lɛ wuɔ gbɛɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ; ni Petro kai wiemɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ shii enyɔ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃” lɛ. Ni be ni ekai lɛ, efo aahu.

Title: MARKO 15
Content:
Yesu yɛ Pilato hiɛ
(Mateo 27.1-2, 11-14; Luka 23.1-5; Yohane 18.28-38)
1Ni be ni je kɛɛ etsɛreɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ akwaashɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tee ajina, ni amɛfi Yesu, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛyahã Pilato. 2Ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ.” 3Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ folɔ enaa pii. 4 Ni Pilato bi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Otooo he eko? Kwɛ onaa sɔŋŋ ni amɛfolɔɔ.” 5Shi Yesu etooo he eko dɔŋŋ, ni Pilato hiɛ fee lɛ yaa.
Abu Yesu gbele fɔ
(Mateo 27.15-26; Luka 23.13-25; Yohane 18.39—19.16)
6Shi daa kɛshɛ Gbijurɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɔ gboklɛfonyo kome ni amɛbiɔ lɛ he ehãa amɛ. 7Shi mɔ ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Baraba ni awo lɛ niiaŋ kɛ atuatselɔi ni gbe gbɔmɔ yɛ atuatsemɔ lɛ mli. 8Kɛkɛ ni asafo lɛ ba babɔ̃i lɛ faikpamɔ akɛ efee tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ daa lɛ ehã amɛ. 9Shi Pilato here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mihã nyɛ lo?” 10 Ejaakɛ ele akɛ hetsɛ̃ naa ni osɔfonukpai lɛ mɔ lɛ hã lɛ. 11Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ wo asafo lɛ yiŋ akɛ amɛhã eŋmɛɛ Baraba moŋ he ehã amɛ. 12Ni Pilato saa here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mifee mɔ ni nyɛtsɛɔ lɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mɔ?” 13Shi amɛbolɔ ekoŋŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” 14Ni Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Shi mɛɛ efɔŋ po efee?” Shi amɛbolɔ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” 15Ni akɛni Pilato taoɔ akɛ efee nɔ ni asafo lɛ taoɔ hewɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ Baraba he ehã amɛ; ni Yesu lɛ, ekɛ kpelebii yi lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Asraafoi lɛ ye Yesu he fɛo
(Mateo 27.27-31; Yohane 19.2-3)
16Ni asraafoi lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee amralo mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɛ asraafoiaku muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe. 17Ni amɛwo lɛ atade tsuru ko, ni amɛfee ŋmei akekre amɛkɛfi eyitso. 18Ni amɛbɔ̃i lɛ ŋamɔ akɛ, “Oshwiee, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ.” 19Ni amɛkɛ tso tswia eyiteŋ, ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehe, ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ. 20Ni be ni amɛyeyee ehe fɛo lɛ, amɛ jie atade tsuru lɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ wo lɛ, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee ni amɛyasɛŋ lɛ.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele
(Mateo 27.35-56; Luka 23.26-49; Yohane 19.17-30)
21 Ni asraafoi lɛ nyɛ Simon Kirenenyo ko ni jɛ kosɛɛ ni ji Aleksandro kɛ Rufo tsɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ ewo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ. 22Ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Golgota lɛ, eshishi ji Yitsoŋoŋohe. 23 Ni amɛhã lɛ wain ni akɛ mire efutuŋ akɛ enu; shi enuuu. 24 Ni be ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ, amɛja etadei lɛ amli, ni amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki, nɔ ni mɔ akɔ. 25Shi ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu mli amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ. 26Ni aŋma sane ni akɛfɔ̃ enɔ lɛ yɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, “YUDAFOI LƐ AMAŊTSƐ LƐ.” 27Ni amɛsɛŋ ojotswalɔi enyɔ amɛfata ehe, mɔ kome ye eninejurɔ, ni mɔ kome ye ebɛku. [ 28 Ni ŋmalɛ ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Ni abu lɛ ashi efɔŋfeelɔi anɔ” lɛ ba mli.]
29 Ni mɛi ni hoɔ lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi lɛ, ni amɛhoso amɛyitsei ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ei, bo ni okumɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu ni osaa omaa lɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ nɛ! 30Heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala, ni oje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ okpeleke shi!” 31Nakai nɔŋŋ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ hu ye ehe fɛo yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Ehere mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ehere; 32 Kristo, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, aje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ akpeleke shi koo, koni wɔna ni wɔhe wɔye!” Ni mɛi ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ hu bɔ lɛ ahora.
33Ni be ni shɛ ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ, duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli. 34 Ni ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ, Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Eloi, Eloi, lama Sabaktani?” Eshishi ji, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi?” 35Ni be ni mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, eetsɛ Elia.” 36Ni mɔ ko sha foi ni eyaŋɔ ŋshɔŋ kotsa etsɔ ashiŋ mli, ni ekɛma tso naa ehã lɛ akɛ enu ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔmɛa ni wɔkwɛ akɛ Elia aaabajie lɛ lo.” 37Ni Yesu bo waa ni ebu enaa.
38Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba enyɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbayi shi. 39Shi be ni asraafoiohaatsɛ ni damɔ eŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ na akɛ ebo nɛkɛ ni ebu enaa lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ni!” 40 Ni yei komɛi hu yɛ jɛi ni amɛdamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria, Yakobofio kɛ Yose nyɛ lɛ, kɛ Salome, 41mɛi ni be ni eyɔɔ Galilea ni amɛnyiɛɔ esɛɛ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ, kɛ yei krokomɛi pii ni kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Yesu fuu
(Mateo 27.57-61; Luka 23.50-56; Yohane 19.38-42)
42Ni be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, akɛni eji Hesaamɔ gbi ni nyiɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ hiɛ hewɔ lɛ, 43Yosef ni jɛ Arimatia, ni ji akwaashɔŋnyo ko ni yɔɔ gbɛi ni lɛ hu ekwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛ lɛ, ba ni ekɛ ekãa yiŋ kɛtee Pilato ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi Yesu gbonyo lɛ. 44Shi Pilato hiɛ fee lɛ yaa akɛ egbo momo; ni etsɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ egbo etsɛ lo? 45Ni be ni enu kɛjɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛ gbonyo lɛ ke Yosef. 46Ni Yosef yahe klala, ni ebajie lɛ kɛkpeleke shi, ni ekɛ klala lɛ ha ehe, ni ekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ gbonyobu ni akpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli lɛ mli, ni ekoklo tɛ ekɛŋa bu lɛ naa. 47Ni Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria, Yose nyɛ lɛ, miikwɛ, ni amɛna he ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lɛ.

Title: MARKO 16
Content:
Yesu shitee
(Mateo 28.1-8; Luka 24.1-12; Yohane 20.1-10)
1Ni be ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eho lɛ, Maria Magdalena kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ Salome yahe tsofai-kɛ-ŋma koni amɛba ni amɛkɛbakpa lɛ. 2Ni otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ leebi maŋkpa, be ni hulu jeɔ lɛ, amɛba bu lɛ naa. 3Ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Namɔ aaakoklo tɛ lɛ yɛ bu lɛ naa ahã wɔ?” 4Shi be ni amɛyaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛna akɛ akoklo tɛ ni da naakpa lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ. 5Ni be ni amɛbote bu lɛ mli lɛ, amɛna oblanyo ko ta ninejurɔgbɛ ni ewo atade yɛŋ kakadaŋŋ; ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe. 6Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei! Nyɛmiitao Yesu Nazarenyo ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ; ete shi, ebɛ biɛ; naa, he ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ nɛ! 7 Shi nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ Petro akɛ eetsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛmiiya Galilea; jɛi nyɛaana lɛ yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ.” 8Ni amɛje kpo, ni amɛjo foi kɛjɛ bu lɛ he; amɛhe kpokpo, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe; ni amɛkɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ ko, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe gbeyei.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Maria Magdalena
(Mateo 28.9-10; Yohane 20.11-18)
[9 Shi be ni Yesu te shi leebi maŋkpa yɛ otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ tsutsu ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ji Maria Magdalena, mɔ mli hu ni efã mumɔi fɔ̃ji kpawo yɛ lɛ. 10Ni lɛ etee eyagba mɛi ni kɛ lɛ hi shi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ ni amɛfoɔ lɛ. 11Shi amɛ lɛ, be ni amɛnu akɛ ehiɛ kã, ni ena lɛ lɛ, amɛheee amɛyeee.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi enyɔ
(Luka 24.13-35)
12Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo yɛ su kroko mli etsɔ̃ɔ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ, be ni amɛsharaa shi kɛyaa kosɛɛgbɛ lɛ. 13Ni amɛ hu amɛyiŋ amɛtee amɛyakɛɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, shi amɛheee nomɛi hu tete amɛyeee.
Sanekpakpa lɛ tuu kɛ kaselɔi lɛ adɛŋ woo
(Mateo 28.16-20; Luka 24.36-49; Yohane 20.19-23; Bɔfoi 1.6-8)
14 Fee sɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ diɛŋtsɛ, be ni amɛtara niyenii ashi lɛ, ni ekã amɛhiɛ yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee kɛ amɛtsuiwalɛ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛheee mɛi ni na lɛ yɛ eshitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛyeee. 15 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa je lɛ mli fɛɛ kwa nyɛyashiɛa Sanekpakpa lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni abɔ lɛ. 16 Mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ ni aaabaptisi lɛ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, shi mɔ ni heee yeee lɛ, aaabu lɛ fɔ. 17 Shi okadi ni aaanyiɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ asɛɛ nɛ, migbɛi mli lɛ amɛaafãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji; amɛaawie wiemɔi hei; 18 amɛaahole onufui anɔ; ni kɛji amɛnu nɔ ko ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ, efeŋ amɛ nɔ ko; amɛkɛ amɛniji aaashwie helatsɛmɛi anɔ, ni amɛhe aaawa amɛ.”
Yesu ŋwɛiyaa
(Luka 24.50-53; Bɔfoi 1.9-11)
19 Kɛkɛ ni be ni Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ amɛ ewie sɛɛ lɛ, aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ. 20 Shi amɛ lɛ, amɛje jɛi, ni amɛyashiɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ tsu nii, ni ekɛ okadii ni fata wiemɔ lɛ he lɛ wo wiemɔ lɛ hewalɛ.]

Title: LUKA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Luka Sanekpakpa lɛ gbaa akɛ Yesu lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni awo shi ato akɛ ebaaba ebahere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala ni ebakpɔ̃ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ. Luka wolo lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ Yesu lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ tsu lɛ ni ebashiɛ Sanekpakpa etsɔɔ ohiafoi (4.18). Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Sanekpakpa nɛɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ mɛi atutɔmɔi kɛ amɛhiamɔnii ahe nitsumɔ. Nɛkɛ miishɛɛ sane nɛɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ yɛ Luka Sanekpakpa lɛ mli. Hei ni anaa enɛ yɛ titri ji yitsei ni jeɔ wolo lɛ shishi ni tswaa Yesu baa lɛ he adafi lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ hu wolo lɛ naagbee ni wieɔ Yesu ŋwɛiyaa he lɛ. Mɔ ni gba bɔ ni fee ni egbɛ eshwã yɛ Yesu ŋwɛiyaa sɛɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋma Bɔfoi lɛ asaji lɛ.
Wolo nɛɛ hiɛ mlijai enyɔ (Yitsei 1 - 2 kɛ Yitsei 9 - 19), ni nibii ahe ni amɛwieɔ lɛ Sanekpakpa nɛɛ pɛ mli anaa yɛ. Nɔkwɛmɔnii ji
1. Saji ni kɔɔ bɔfoi lɛ alalai ahe lɛ.
2. Tookwɛlɔi lɛ ni ba amɛbasra Yesu be ni afɔ lɛ lɛ.
3. Be ni Yesu yapue yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ akɛ gbekɛ nuu lɛ.
4. Abɛbuaŋ wiemɔi ni kɔɔ (a) Samarianyo Mɔbɔnalɔ lɛ kɛ (b) Bi ni laaje (aloo Bi nyenyeŋtswi) lɛ he lɛ.
Nibii pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni Sanekpakpa lɛ maa nɔ mi veveeve ji (a) Sɔlemɔ. (b) Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ (d) Yei ahe sane yɛ Yesu nitsumɔ mli (e) Fa ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɛi ahe eshai faa amɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-4
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu fɔmɔ kɛ amɛgbekɛbiiashi saji 1.5—2.52
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ nitsumɔ 3.1-20
Yesu baptisimɔ kɛ ekaa 3.21—4.13
Yesu nitsumɔ yɛ Galilea 4.14—9.50
Kɛjɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm 9.51—19.27
Naagbee otsi yɛ Yerusalɛm 19.28—23.56
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shitee kɛ ehe kpojiemɔ kɛ eŋwɛiyaa 24.1-53

Title: LUKA 1
Content:
1Akɛni mɛi pii ekɔ efɔ̃ amɛnɔ akɛ amɛaaŋma saji ni eba mli yɛ wɔteŋ 2tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi ni na kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii kɛjɛ shishijee mli ni amɛ ji wiemɔ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ jaje tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, 3 Teofilo jurɔ, esa mihiɛ akɛ mi hu ni mitao nibii fɛɛ mli fitsofitso kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, maŋma pɛpɛɛpɛ maha bo 4koni ona anɔkwale ni yɔɔ nii ni atsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ mli.
Agba Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ fɔmɔ ato
5 Yudea Maŋtsɛ Herode yinɔ lɛ osɔfo ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zakaria; ejɛ Abia osɔfoiaku lɛ mli, eŋa jɛ Aaron biyei lɛ ateŋ, ni egbɛi ji Elizabet. 6Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jalɔi ji amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni amɛyeɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitãi kɛ ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe. 7 Shi amɛbɛ bi, ejaakɛ Elizabet lɛ kene ni, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛdara. 8Shi gbi ko be ni eshɛ esɔfoiaku lɛ nɔ, ni esɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, 9 ahala lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni esɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ gbɛnaa yɔɔ lɛ, koni ebote Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ni eyashã tsofakɛŋma. 10Ni tsofakɛŋmashãa be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miisɔle yɛ agbo lɛ naa. 11Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ni edamɔ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ. 12Ni be ni Zakaria na lɛ lɛ, etsui fã ni gbeyei mɔ lɛ. 13Shi bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
“Kaashe gbeyei, Zakaria,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebo ofaikpamɔ lɛ toi,
ni oŋa Elizabet aaafɔ binuu ahã bo,
ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yohane.
14Eeehã ona miishɛɛ, ni omli aafli bo,
ni mɛi pii aaanya efɔmɔ lɛ he.
15 Ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ agbo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni enuŋ wain loo dãa ni wa ko,
Ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaayi lɛ obɔ̃ kɛaajɛ enyɛ
musuŋ beebe.
16Ni eeekpale Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kɛaaba Nuŋtsɔ,
amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ŋɔɔ.
17 Ni eeetsɔ̃ ehiɛ yɛ Elia mumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ mli,
ni eyadɔrɔ tsɛmɛi atsuii kɛba bii ahe,
kɛ toigbolɔi hu kɛba jalɔi anilee mli,
ni esaa maŋ ni efee klalo eto Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”
18Ni Zakaria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mikɛaale enɛ? Mi lɛ nuumo ji mi, ni miŋa hu egbɔ.” 19 Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Mi ji Gabriel ni damɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni atsu mi akɛ mikɛ bo abawie ni migba bo sane kpakpa nɛɛ. 20Ni naa, oootɔ mu ni onyɛŋ owie kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni nii nɛɛ aaaba mli, ejaakɛ oheee miwiemɔ lɛ ni baaba mli kɛ be shɛ lɛ oyeee.”
21Ni maŋ lɛ miimɛ Zakaria, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ etsɛ nɛkɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ. 22Shi be ni eje kpo lɛ, enyɛɛɛ ekɛ amɛ awie, ni amɛyoo sɛɛ akɛ eyana nii yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ekɛ enine fee okadi etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni etɔ mu lolo. 23Be ni egbe esɔ̃ɔmɔ gbii lɛ naa lɛ, eyiŋ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
24 Shi nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ eŋa Elizabet na musu, ni etee ehe nyɔji enumɔ ekɛɛ, 25“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ efee mi nɛ akɛ agbɛnɛ ekwɛ ni ejie mihiɛgbele lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.”
Agba Yesu fɔmɔ ato
26Shi nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo Gabriel kɛtee Galilea maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli ni ekɛ wiemɔ ayahã 27 oblayoo foro ko ni atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef ni jɛ David we lɛ; oblayoo lɛ gbɛi ji Maria. 28Ni bɔfo lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã bo, bo ni aduro bo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ bo yɛ.” 29Etsui fã yɛ bɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ he, ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ,
“Mɛɛ ŋamɔ po nɛ!”
30Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
“Kaashe gbeyei, Maria;
ejaakɛ ohiɛ eba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
31 Ni naa, obaana musu,
ni ooofɔ binuu
ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.
32 Eeetsɔ̃ agbo, ni aaatsɛ lɛ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ Bi,
ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ etsɛ David
maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ahã lɛ.
33Ni eeeye Yakob we lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ.”
34Shi Maria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni enɛ
aaaba mli, akɛni mileee nuu nɛɛ?”
35 Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
“Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaaba onɔ.
Ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ hewalɛ aaabaha onɔ,
No hewɔ lɛ, nakai bi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni ooofɔ lɛ,
aaatsɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi.
36Shi naa, owekunyo Elizabet lɛ hu,
ena binuu musu yɛ egbɔlɛ mli,
ni mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ kene lɛ ena nyɔji ekpaa.
37 Ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛŋ afee.”
38Ni Maria kɛɛ, “Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ weyoo ji mi; bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ aba mli nakai ahã mi!” Ni bɔfo lɛ shi lɛ etee.
Maria yasara Elizabet
39Ni yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ Maria kɛ oyaiyeli yiŋ kɛtee Yuda maŋ ko mli yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, 40ni eyabote Zakaria we lɛ ni eŋa Elizabet. 41 Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Elizabet nu Maria ŋamɔ lɛ, abifao lɛ tu yɛ Elizabet musuŋ; ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yi Elizabet obɔ̃; 42 ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ bo yɛ yei ateŋ, ni ajɔɔ omusuŋbi lɛ! 43Ni nɛgbɛ mina nyam nɛɛ kɛjɛ akɛ miNuŋtsɔ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ? 44Shi naa, amrɔ pɛ ni oŋamɔ lɛ gbɛɛ yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, abifao lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ tu yɛ mimusuŋ. 45 Ni ajɔɔ bo, bo ni ohe oye akɛ wiemɔi ni ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ aaaba mli lɛ.”
Maria yijiemɔ lala lɛ
46 Ni Maria kɛɛ,
“Misusuma miikafo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ,
47ni mimumɔ mli miifili lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
miyiwalaherelɔ lɛ hewɔ,
48 akɛ ebakwɛ mi eweyoo ni ji humi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ naa, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ,
yinɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaabu mi akɛ mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ;
49ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ efee nii wuji ehã mi;
ni krɔŋkrɔŋ ji egbɛi lɛ.
50 Emɔbɔnalɛ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ
gbeyei lɛ anɔ kɛyashi yinɔi ayinɔi.
51 Ekɛ enine etsu hewalɛ nitsumɔi;
mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛtsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ mli lɛ
egbɛ amɛ eshwã.
52 Ekpa ojei kɛjɛ amɛsɛ̃ii anɔ,
ni ewo mɛi ni ji humii lɛ anɔ.
53 Ehã mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ etɔrɔ kɛ nii kpakpai,
ni niiatsɛmɛi lɛ eshwie amɛ efolo.
54Eye ebua ewenuu Israel,
koni ekai emɔbɔnalɛ lɛ,
55 tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ,
ni yɔɔ hã Abraham kɛ eshwiei lɛ kɛya naanɔ.”
56Ni Maria kɛ lɛ hi shi aaafee nyɔji etɛ̃ ni eku esɛɛ etee eshĩa.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ fɔmɔ
57Agbɛnɛ Elizabet fɔmɔ be shɛ, ni efɔ binuu. 58Ni ekuu lɛ mli bii kɛ ewekumɛi lɛ nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ babaoo, ni amɛkɛ lɛ nya. 59 Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛba gbekɛ lɛ ketiafoo, ni kulɛ amɛmiitao amɛkɛ etsɛ gbɛi Zakaria lɛ awo lɛ. 60 Shi enyɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Dabida, abaatsɛ lɛ Yohane moŋ!” 61Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko bɛ owɛku lɛ mli ni atsɛɔ lɛ nakai!” 62Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛnine fee okadi kɛbi etsɛ bɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ atsɛ lɛ. 63Ni ebi tao ko, ni eŋma akɛ, “Yohane ji egbɛi.” Ni efee amɛ fɛɛ naakpɛɛ. 64Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaabu gbele ni elilɛi fɛne, ni ewie ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi. 65Ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛkuu lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni agba saji nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yudea gɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. 66Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ kɛto amɛtsuiŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni po gbekɛ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃?” Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nine kã ehe.
Zakaria jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi
67Ni etsɛ Zakaria yi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni egba ekɛɛ,
68 “Ajie Nuŋtsɔ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi,
akɛ ebasara emaŋ lɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ.
69 Ni etee walaheremɔ aklonto shi ehã wɔ
yɛ etsulɔ David we lɛ.
70Tamɔ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ egbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi
ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ anɔ ewie lɛ;
71akɛ eeehere wɔyiwala kɛaajɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi
kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni he tsɛ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
72 Ni ena wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ amɔbɔ
ni ekai ekpãŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
73 Kitã ni ekã wɔtsɛ Abraham lɛ,
74 akɛ eeehã ajie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ
ni wɔsɔmɔ lɛ ni gbeyeishemɔ ko bɛ mli
75yɛ hetsemɔ kɛ jalɛ mli yɛ ehiɛ wɔgbii abɔ fɛɛ.
76 Ni bo, gbekɛ nɛɛ, aaatsɛ bo Ŋwɛifloflonyo lɛ gbalɔ;
ejaakɛ obaatsɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ ni oyasaa egbɛi lɛ oto,
77 koni okɛ walaheremɔ he nilee ahã omaŋ lɛ
yɛ amɛhe eshaifaa
78 ni jɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɛ
ni hãa emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ ni jetsɛremɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ebasara wɔ lɛ.
79 Koni ehã jeŋ atse ahã
mɛi ni tara duŋ kɛ gbele hɔɔŋ mli lɛ,
Ni akudɔ wɔnaji kɛya hejɔlɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.”
80 Ni gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni ehe wa yɛ mumɔ mli, ni ehi ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni akɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Israel.

Title: LUKA 2
Content:
Yesu fɔmɔ
(Mateo 1.18-25)
1Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ akpɔ ko jɛ Kaisare Augusto ŋɔɔ ba, akɛ akane jeŋ fɛɛ ni aŋma. 2Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ kanemɔ ni akane be mli ni Kirenio yeɔ amralo yɛ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
3Ni mɛi fɛɛ tee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ koni aŋma amɛgbɛi. 4Ni Yosef hu jɛ Nazaret maŋ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea, ni etee David maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea lɛ mli; ejaakɛ ejɛ David we kɛ eweku lɛ mli. 5 Etee koni aŋma ekɛ Maria, yoo ni etsɛ ehe baa ni hiɛ musu lɛ, gbɛi. 6Be ni amɛyɔɔ Betlehem lɛ ebe shɛ ni ebaafɔ. 7Ni efɔ binuu ni ji ekromɔbi lɛ, ni ekɛ mama bla ehe ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa gbɛ yɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ.
Tookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ bɔfoi lɛ
8Tookwɛlɔi komɛi yɛ ŋa nɔ yɛ jɛi niiaŋ ni amɛmiishi kpe kɛmiibu amɛtoi ahe nyɔɔŋ. 9Trukaa lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko badamɔ amɛmasɛi, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anunyam kpɛ kɛbɔle amɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa. 10Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei; ejaakɛ naa, mibagba nyɛ miishɛɛ sane kpeteŋkple ni ji maŋ fɛɛ nɔ; 11akɛ ŋmɛnɛ afɔ walaherelɔ ni ji Kristo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ahã nyɛ, yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli. 12Enɛ afee okadi ahã nyɛ, nyɛaana abifao ni akɛ mama ebala ehe ni ekã kooloi aniyeniianɔ mli.” 13 Ni trukaa lɛ ŋwɛi ta kpele bafata bɔfo lɛ he, ni amɛ jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi amɛkɛɛ,
14 “Anunyam ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo,
ni hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni ana gbɔmɛi ahe tsuijurɔ!”
15Be ni bɔfoi lɛ eje amɛŋɔɔ amɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Betlehem koo, ni wɔyakwɛa nɔ ni eba ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɛɛ.” 16Ni amɛtee oya, ni amɛyana Maria kɛ Yosef kɛ abifao lɛ ni ekã kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli. 17 Be ni amɛna abifao lɛ amɛjaje sane ni agba amɛ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ he lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ fɔlɔi lɛ. 18Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ gba amɛ lɛ hewɔ. 19 Shi Maria kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ to etsuiŋ ni esusuɔ he. 20Ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛ jie eyi yɛ nibii fɛɛ kwa ni amɛnu ni amɛna lɛ hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni agba amɛ lɛ.
Yesu gbɛiwoo
21 Ni be ni gbii kpaanyɔ shɛ ni abaafo gbekɛ lɛ ketia lɛ, awo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu, ni ji gbɛi ni bɔfo lɛ wo lɛ dani ana lɛ musu lɛ.
Akɛ Yesu yatsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ
22 Ni be ni agbe amɛhetsuumɔ lɛ naa yɛ Mose Mla lɛ naa lɛ, amɛkɛ abifao lɛ tee Yerusalɛm, koni amɛkɛ lɛ ayatsɔ̃ɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, 23 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni gbeleɔ musu naa lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ mɔ ni afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;” 24 ni amɛyashã afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ” lɛ.
Simeon gbalɛ lɛ
25Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ Yerusalɛm ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Simeon; nakai nuu lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni eekwɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ gbɛ. Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ enɔ, 26ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ egboŋ ja ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ dã. 27Ni Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ Simeon ba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. Ni be ni gbekɛ Yesu lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ kɛ lɛ ba koni amɛbafee bɔ ni Mla lɛ gbɛnaa yɔɔ amɛhã lɛ lɛ 28Simeon he lɛ efɔ̃ ekpɔkɔiaŋ, ni ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi ekɛɛ,
29 “Agbɛnɛ ooohã otsulɔ aya,
Nuŋtsɔ, yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa, yɛ hejɔlɛ mli;
30ejaakɛ mihiŋmɛii ena owalaheremɔ lɛ,
31nɔ ni osaa oma maji fɛɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
32 La ni aaahã jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ agbele,
ni ewo omaŋ Israel hiɛ nyam lɛ.”
33Ni Yesu tsɛ kɛ enyɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ nii ni awie yɛ ehe lɛ ahewɔ. 34 Ni Simeon jɔɔ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ gbekɛ lɛ nyɛ, Maria, akɛ, “Naa, akɛ mɔ nɛ edamɔ shi ehã mɛi pii ashigbeemɔ kɛ shitee yɛ Israel, kɛ okadi ni awieɔ ashiɔ; 35(ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu obaaye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ nɔ ni akɛ akplɔ egbu otsuiŋ) ni aaajie tsuii pii amli susumɔi akpo.”
Hana yijiemɔ lɛ
36Ni gbalɔyoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hana yɛ, ni ji Fanuel biyoo, ni jɛ Asher akutso lɛ mli; egbɔ naakpa, ni ekɛ ewu ehi shi afii kpawo kɛjɛ eblayeiaŋ, 37 ni agbɛnɛ okulafo ji lɛ, ni eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ejwɛ ni ejeee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kwraa, ejaa Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ faikpamɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane. 38 Lɛ hu eba yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, ni ebajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; ni ewie yɛ gbekɛ Yesu lɛ he etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ Yerusalɛm kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Sɛɛkuu kɛ Nazaret yaa
39Be ni amɛgbe nibii fɛɛ naa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Nazaret, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea. 40 Ni gbekɛ Yesu lɛ bada, ni ehe wa, ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nilee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ yɛ enɔ.
Gbekɛ Yesu lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ
41Daa afi lɛ efɔlɔi lɛ yaa Yerusalɛm amɛyayeɔ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ. 42Be ni eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ, amɛtee Yerusalɛm, tamɔ bɔ ni gbijurɔ lɛ kusum yɔɔ lɛ. 43Shi be ni aye gbijurɔ lɛ agbe naa ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, gbekɛ Yesu lɛ hi shi yɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni efɔlɔi lɛ leee. 44Amɛsusu akɛ efutu gbɛfalɔi krokomɛi lɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ gbi kome gbɛ amɛtao lɛ yɛ amɛwekumɛi kɛ mɛi ni amɛle ateŋ. 45Ni be ni amɛnaaa lɛ lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ ni amɛmiitao lɛ. 46Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ amɛyana lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eta shi yɛ tsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ eebo amɛ toi ni eebibii amɛ nii; 47ni mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enilee kɛ hetoi ni ehãa lɛ ahewɔ. 48Be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni enyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mibi, mɛɛba ofee wɔ nakai? Naa, mi kɛ otsɛ etao bo kɛ tsuiyeli.” 49 Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ mi? Ani nyɛleee akɛ esa akɛ mihiɔ shi yɛ nii ni ji miTsɛ nɔ lɛ mli?” 50Shi amɛnuuu wiemɔ ni ekɛ amɛ wie lɛ shishi. 51 Ni ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee Nazaret, ni eba ehe shi ehã amɛ. Enyɛ kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ to etsui mli. 52 Ni Yesu tee hiɛ yɛ nilee kɛ dalɛ kɛ dromɔ mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.

Title: LUKA 3
Content:
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ
(Mateo 3.1-12; Marko 1.1-8; Yohane 1.19-28)
1Kaisare Tiberio maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ mli, be ni Pontio Pilato yeɔ amralo yɛ Yudea, ni Herode yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Galilea, ni enyɛmi Filipo yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Iturea kɛ Trakoniti shikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni Lisania yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Abilene, 2ni Ana kɛ Kaiafa yeɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ ba Zakaria bi Yohane ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
3Ni eba Yordan niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni eshiɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ ni amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisi amɛ, koni akɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ; 4tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ mli akɛ,
“Mɔ ko miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ,
‘Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛjajea etɛmpɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ.
5Aaatsĩ jɔɔ fɛɛ jɔɔ,
ni aaahã gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ,
kɛ ŋmeŋme fɛɛ ŋmeŋme aba shi.
Ni aaajaje gbɛi kɔɔdɔji.
Ni gbɛ ni nɔ yɔɔ sakasaka lɛ nɔ aaabo.
6 Ni heloo fɛɛ aaana Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.’ ”
7 Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ asafoi lɛ ni je kpo ba eŋɔɔ ni ebaptisi amɛ lɛ akɛ, “Shikpãi ashwiei, namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛjo mlifu ni baa lɛ naa foi? 8 Belɛ nyɛwoa yibii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ; ni nyɛkabɔia kɛɛmɔ yɛ nyɛyiŋ akɛ, ‘Wɔtsɛ ji Abraham;’ ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ atee bii ashi kɛjɛ tɛi nɛɛ amli ehã Abraham. 9 Agbɛnɛ hu lema lɛ kã tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ anɔ momo; no hewɔ lɛ, tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ aaatoo ni aaashɛ afɔ̃ la mli.”
10Ni asafoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni wɔfee mɔ?” 11Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni yɔɔ flakai enyɔ lɛ, ekɛ mɔ ni bɛ eko lɛ aja; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmaa hu, efee nakai nɔŋŋ.” 12 Ni toohelɔi hu ba ni abaptisi amɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni wɔfee?” 13Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkahea mɔ ko too fe nine.” 14Ni asraafoi hu babi lɛ akɛ, “Ni wɔ hu mɛni wɔɔfee?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkafea mɔ ko soisoi; nyɛkafolɔa mɔ ko naa yakatswaa; ni nyɛhãa nyɛnyɔmɔwoo asaa nyɛhiɛ.”
15 Shi be ni maŋ lɛ hiɛ kã nɔ, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ susuɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ yɛ Yohane he akɛ benɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ, 16Yohane here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ nu mikɛbaptisiɔ nyɛ; shi mɔ ko ni he wa fe mi miiba, ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ etokotai anaa kpãa; lɛ ekɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ la aaabaptisi nyɛ. 17Ehiɛ eshaatsene yɛ edɛŋ, ni eeebɛɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fitsofitso, ni eeebua ŋmaa lɛ naa ewo eboŋo lɛ mli; shi tutuu lɛ ekɛ la ni gbooo aaasha.” 18Ewie nibii krokomɛi pii hu ekɛwo maŋ lɛ ŋaa, ni ekɛshiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
19 Shi Lumɔ Herode lɛ, akɛni Yohane kãa lɛ yɛ enyɛmi Filipo ŋa Herodia lɛ hewɔ, kɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni lɛ Herode lɛ efee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, 20esaa efee enɛ hu eshi nɔ, akɛ emɔ Yohane ewo tsuŋ.
Yesu baptisimɔ
(Mateo 3.13-17; Marko 1.9-11)
21Agbɛnɛ be ni abaptisi mɛi lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ abaptisi Yesu hu; ni be ni esɔleɔ lɛ ŋwɛi naa gbele, 22 ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpeleke shi kɛ su ni tamɔ okpo su kɛba enɔ; ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Bo ji miSuɔmɔ Bi lɛ, bo ohe tsui minaa!”
Yesu weku kpaa
(Mateo 1.1-17)
23 Be ni Yesu bɔ̃i enitsumɔ lɛ eye aaafee afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni tamɔ bɔ ni asusuɔ lɛ, eji Yosef bi, Heli bi, 24Matat bi, Levi bi, Melki bi, Yanai bi, Yosef bi, 25Matatia bi, Amos bi, Nahum bi, Esli bi, Nagai bi, 26Maat bi, Matatia bi, Semein bi, Yosek bi, Yoda bi. 27Yohanan bi, Resa bi, Zerubabel bi, Shealtiel bi, Neri bi, 28Melki bi, Adi bi, Kosam bi, Elmadam bi, Er bi, 29Yoshua bi, Eliezer bi, Yorim bi, Matat bi, Levi bi, 30Simeon bi, Yuda bi, Yosef bi, Yonam bi, Eliakim bi, 31 Melea bi, Mena bi, Matata bi, Natan bi, David bi, 32 Ishai bi, Obed bi, Boaz bi, Salmon bi, Nahashon bi, 33 Aminadab bi, Ram bi, Admin bi, Arni bi Hezron bi, Perez bi, Yuda bi, 34 Yakob bi, Isak bi, Abraham bi, Tera bi, Nahor bi, 35Serug bi, Reu bi, Peleg bi, Eber bi, Shela bi, 36 Kainan bi, Arpakshad bi, Shem bi, Noa bi, Lamek bi. 37Metusela bi, Henok bi, Yared bi, Mahalalel bi, Kainan bi, 38 Enos bi, Set bi, Adam bi, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ bi lɛ.

Title: LUKA 4
Content:
Yesu kaa
(Mateo 4.1-11; Marko 1.12-13)
1Yesu ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Yordan he, ni Mumɔ lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ; 2ni abonsam ka lɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ eyeee nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni no sɛɛ lɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ. 3Kɛkɛ ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, fã tɛ nɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ aboloo.” 4Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Jeee aboloo kɛkɛ nɔ gbɔmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ni eyi naa wala.’ ” 5Ni abonsam ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ko nɔ, ni ekɛ je nɛɛŋ maŋtsɛyelii lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa; 6ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo mikɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛnunyam lɛ baahã; ejaakɛ mi akɛhã, ni mikɛhãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni misumɔɔ; 7no hewɔ lɛ, bo lɛ, kɛji oookula shi oja mi lɛ, fɛɛ kwa aaatsɔ̃ onɔ.” 8 Yesu here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ oja, ni lɛ kɛkɛ osɔ̃mɔ!’ ” 9Ni Abonsam kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yiteŋ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, jɛɛ biɛ okɛ ohe atswa shi; 10 ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Eeefã ebɔfoi lɛ yɛ ohewɔ ni amɛbu ohe jogbaŋŋ, 11 ni amɛaahiɛ bo yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni okɛ onane akashi tɛ ko.’ ” 12 Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Kaaka Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ” 13 Ni be ni abonsam gbe kaa lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ, eshi lɛ dã.
Galilea nitsumɔ lɛ shishijee
(Mateo 4.12-17; Marko 1.14-15)
14Ni Yesu ku esɛɛ yɛ Mumɔ lɛ hewalɛ mli kɛba Galilea; ni ehe sane jije yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ. 15Ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ wo ehiɛ nyam.
Akwa Yesu yɛ Nazaret
(Mateo 13.53-58; Marko 6.1-6)
16Ni Yesu ba Nazaret, he ni alɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, etee kpeehe lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni ete shi koni ekane Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. 17 Ni akɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ hã lɛ, ni be ni egbele mli lɛ, ena he ni aŋma yɛ akɛ,
18 “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ yɛ minɔ,
ejaakɛ efɔ mi mu,
koni mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi.
19 Etsu mi koni mishiɛ heyeli mitsɔ̃ɔ nomii lɛ,
kɛ ninamɔ hã shwilafoi,
koni mahã aŋmɛɛ mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ahe,
ni amɛye amɛhe,
ni mishiɛ afi ko ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.”
20Ni ekota wolo lɛ ekɛhã sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ, ni eho eta shi, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ tsu amɛhiŋmɛii amɛshwie enɔ. 21Ni ebɔ̃i amɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ eba mli yɛ nyɛtoiiaŋ.” 22 Ni mɛi fɛɛ ye ehe odase, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ dromɔ wiemɔi ni jɛ enaa lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee Yosef bi lɛ nɛ?” 23 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛaabu mi nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Tsofatsɛ, tsa bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe! Nii abɔ ni wɔnu akɛ ofee yɛ Kapernaum lɛ, feemɔ yɛ biɛ ni ji omaŋ lɛ mli hu.’ ” 24 Shi ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ahereee gbalɔ ko yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ. 25 Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale akɛ okulafoi pii yɛ Israel yɛ Elia yinɔ, be mli ni aŋa ŋwɛi naa afii etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔji ekpaa sɔŋŋ ni hɔ̃mɔ kpele ba shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ; 26 shi atsuuu Elia kɛyaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ŋɔɔ, akɛ ja yoo okulafo ko ni yɔɔ Zarefat yɛ Sidon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 27 Ni kpitiyelɔi pii hu yɛ Israel yɛ gbalɔ Elisha yinɔ, shi atsaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, akɛ ja Naaman, Sirianyo lɛ kɛkɛ.” 28Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ fɛɛ mli fu naakpa, be ni amɛnu nii nɛɛ lɛ. 29Ni amɛte shi ni amɛtsirɛ lɛ kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ni amɛmaŋ lɛ ma nɔ lɛ toi, koni amɛyatsi eyisɛɛ amɛwo jɔɔ lɛ mli. 30Shi etsɔ̃ amɛteŋ kɛho, ni eyiŋ etee.
Nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli
(Marko 1.21-28)
31 Ni Yesu tee Kapernaum, Galilea maŋ ko mli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ anɔ. 32 Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ewiemɔ lɛ hewalɛ yɛ mli. 33Ni nuu ko yɛ kpeehe lɛ ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɛ emli, ni ebo waa 34ekɛɛ, “Ao! Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu Nazarenyo? Oba wɔhiɛ kpãtãmɔ? Mile mɔ ni ji bo, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!” 35Ni Yesu fã eyi ni ekɛɛ, “Muamɔ onaa ni oje emli!” Ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ tsi lɛ etswa shi yɛ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ ni eje emli, ni eyeee lɛ awui ko. 36Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛɛ wiemɔ nɛ? Ejaakɛ hegbɛ kɛ hewalɛ ekɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, ni amɛjeɔ kpo!” 37Ni ehe sane jije yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Petro shaayoo tsamɔ
(Mateo 8.14-15; Marko 1.29-31)
38Ni Yesu je kpeehe lɛ ni eyabote Simon we lɛ. Shi atridii ni naa wa emɔ Simon shaayoo lɛ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai ni ebakwɛ lɛ. 39Ni eyadamɔ emasɛi, ni efã atridii lɛ yi, ni etse yɛ enɔ. Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi ni esɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Helatsɛmɛi pii atsamɔ
(Mateo 8.16-17; Marko 1.33-34)
40Ni be ni hulu nyɔ shi lɛ, mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mɛi ni helai srɔtoi hiɛ amɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ ekomekome ni etsa amɛ. 41 Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji hu je mɛi pii amli, ni amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ!” Ni Yesu famɔ amɛyi ni eŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛwie, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ.
Yesu shiɛmɔ yɛ Galilea
(Marko 1.35-39)
42Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko; ni asafoi lɛ tao lɛ ni amɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛtsi enaa, koni ekaje amɛŋɔɔ. 43 Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Esa akɛ miyajajeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ maji krokomɛi hu, ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ atsu mi.” 44 Ni eshiɛ yɛ Galilea kpeehei lɛ.

Title: LUKA 5
Content:
Kaselɔi ni atsɛ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ
(Mateo 4.18-22; Marko 1.16-20)
1Gbi ko be ni Yesu damɔ Genesaret Kpaakpo lɛ naa ni mɛi pii jwere enɔ amɛboɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ toi lɛ, 2ena lɛji enyɔ ŋmɔlɔ shi yɛ kpaakpo lɛ naa; wolɛi lɛ eje mli ni amɛmiifɔ amɛyai ahe. 3 Ni Yesu yabote lɛlɛ lɛ ekome ni ji Simon nɔ lɛ mli, ni ekpa lɛ fai akɛ etsi kɛya nu lɛ hiɛ fioo; ni Yesu ho eta shi, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ anii kɛjɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli. 4Be ni egbe ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛɛ Simon akɛ, “Nyɛwiria kɛyaa he ni kwɔ lɛ ni nyɛyafɔa nyɛyai lɛ, koni nyɛgbe loo.” 5 Ni Simon here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onukpa, wɔtsu nii waa nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ fɛɛ ni wɔnaaa nɔ ko; shi kɛ̃lɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ maŋmɛ yai lɛ.” 6 Ni be ni amɛfee nakai lɛ, amɛgbe loo babaoo bɔ ni amɛyai lɛ bɔ̃i gbalamɔ. 7Ni amɛfɔ̃ amɛnanemɛi ni yɔɔ lɛlɛ kroko lɛ mli lɛ nine akɛ amɛba ni amɛbawa amɛ. Ni amɛba ni amɛwo lɛji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ loo ni amɛmiihe amɛshiu. 8Shi be ni Simon Petro na lɛ, eho ekula Yesu naji anaa, ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, jee mimasɛi; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ eshafeelɔ ji mi!” 9Ni ekɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ fɛɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ loo pii ni amɛgbe lɛ hewɔ; 10 ni nakai nɔŋŋ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bii lɛ ni ji Simon hefatalɔi lɛ, hu ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe. Ni Yesu kɛɛ Simon akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei! Kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ obaahɛ gbɔmɛi.” 11 Ni be ni amɛbakpeleke lɛ amɛshi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Kpitiyelɔ ko tsamɔ
(Mateo 8.1-4; Marko 1.40-45)
12Gbi ko lɛ Yesu yɛ maŋ lɛ eko mli, kɛkɛ lɛ naa nuu ko ni kpiti eshwie ehe kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi. Be ni ena Yesu lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse.” 13Ni Yesu kpã enine mli eta ehe ni ekɛɛ, “Miisumɔ, ohe atse!” Ni amrɔ lɛ kpiti lɛ tã yɛ ehe. 14 Ni etswa enaa ma akɛ, “Kaakɛɛ mɔ ko, shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni oyashã afɔle yɛ ohetsemɔ lɛ hewɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mose to lɛ, koni no afee odase ahã amɛ.” 15Shi babaoo ni ehe sane lɛ gbɛ shwã moŋ ji no, ni mɛi pii babuaa amɛhe naa ni amɛbabo lɛ toi, ni etsa amɛhelai lɛ. 16 Shi egbalaa ehe shi kɛyaa ŋa nɔ ni eyasɔleɔ.
Kuumɔhelatsɛ ko tsamɔ
(Mateo 9.1-8; Marko 2.1-12)
17Agbɛnɛ gbi lɛ eko be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ, Farisifoi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi ni jɛ Galilea kɛ Yudea maji lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm ba lɛ tara jɛi; ni ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛtsáa mɔ lɛ kpo yɛ jɛi. 18Mɛi komɛi kɛ nuu ko ni kã saa nɔ ni ekumɔ ba; ni amɛmiitao akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ aba shĩa lɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ abaŋmɛ ehiɛ. 19Ni be ni amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkɛ lɛ aba ehiɛ yɛ asafo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛkwɔ kɛtee tsu lɛ yiteŋ, ni amɛshiu lɛ kɛ esaa lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ntayai lɛ amli kɛyaŋmɛ amɛteŋ yɛ Yesu hiɛ. 20Be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ekɛɛ helatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naanyo, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo.” 21 Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ bɔ̃i susumɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ nɛ ni wieɔ musubɔɔ wiemɔ nɛɛ? Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ eshai afa akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ koome pɛ.” 22Shi be ni Yesu yoo amɛsusumɔi lɛ, ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛsusuɔ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli lɛ? 23Te nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jaraaa hu, ‘Akɛ ohe eshai efa bo’ aloo ‘Tee shi ni onyiɛ’ lɛ? 24Shi be ni afee ni nyɛle akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ” — ekɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo akɛ tee shi ni owo osaa lɛ ni oya owe!” 25Ni amrɔ lɛ nuu lɛ te shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ewo nɔ ni ekã nɔ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe, ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam woo. 26Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔna naakpɛɛnii ŋmɛnɛ!”
Levi tsɛmɔ
(Mateo 9.9-13; Marko 2.13-17)
27Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yesu je kpo, ni eyana toohelɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Levi ni eta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” 28Ni Levi shi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ, ni ete shi ebanyiɛ esɛɛ.
29 Ni Levi ŋmɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple yɛ ewe lɛ, ni toohelɔi kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii kɛ amɛ baye nii. 30Ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ amɛmlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ wie ekaselɔi lɛ ahe huhuuhu ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nyɛkɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii ni nyɛkɛ amɛ nuɔ nii nɛɛ?” 31Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ lɛ ehiaaa amɛ tsofatsɛ, shi mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ moŋ ehia. 32Mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi moŋ miba eshafeelɔi atsɛmɔ koni amɛtsake amɛtsui.”
Ŋmaahilɛ he sane
(Mateo 9.14-17; Marko 2.18-22)
33Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yohane kaselɔi lɛ fɔɔ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ, ni Farisifoi lɛ akaselɔi lɛ hu feɔ nakai nɔŋŋ, ni bo lɛ okaselɔi lɛ yeɔ nii ni amɛnuɔ nii.” 34Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛaanyɛ nyɛhã yookpeemɔ he bialɔi lɛ ahi ŋmaa, be ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ? 35Shi gbii aaaba ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaajɛ amɛŋɔɔ, ni no mli dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.”
