36Ni ebu amɛ abɛ hu ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko gbaaa mama hee naa ekɛtaaa atade momo; kɛji efee nakai lɛ, eeegbala ehee lɛ, ni mamanaa hee lɛ kɛ atade momo lɛ yeŋ. 37Ni mɔ ko kɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli, kɛ efee nakai lɛ, wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolo tɔi lɛ ni eeeshwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ hu aaafite. 38Shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli akɛwoɔ. 39Asaŋ mɔ ko enuuu wain momo ni amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni etao ehee, ejaakɛ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Emomo lɛ hi.’ ”

Title: LUKA 6
Content:
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ
(Mateo 12.1-8; Marko 2.23-28)
1 Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, Yesu yatsɔ̃ abele ŋmɔji amli; ni ekaselɔi lɛ kumɔ abele lɛ, ni amɛkposa, ni amɛkpe. 2Shi Farisifoi lɛ ekomɛi bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nyɛfeɔ nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ?” 3 Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee, be ni hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ: 4 bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, ni eyakɔlɔ aboloi ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ ni eye eko ni ehã mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ eko, tsɛbelɛ aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ mɔ ko yeɔ akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?” 5Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ji hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ.”
Nuu ni nine kome egbo lɛ
(Mateo 12.9-14; Marko 3.1-6)
6Shi hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ ekroko nɔ lɛ Yesu yiŋ etee kpeehe lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii. Ni nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni eninejurɔ egbo. 7Shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ sara lɛ amɛkwɛ akɛ eeetsa hela yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lo, koni amɛna nɔ ko nɔ amɛdamɔ amɛkɛfolɔ enaa. 8Shi Yesu le amɛsusumɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ nuu ni nine egbo lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi obadamɔ teŋ!” Ni ete shi ebadamɔ shi. 9Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibabi nyɛ nɔ ko: ani eja gbɛ akɛ afeɔ ekpakpa loo efɔ̃ŋ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, akɛ ahereɔ susuma yiwala aloo akpãtãa ehiɛ?” 10Ni ekwɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpã onine lɛ mli!” Ni efee nakai ni enine lɛ ye emuu. 11Shi amɛ lɛ amɛmli fu waa, ni amɛhala mli yɛ amɛteŋ nɔ po ni amɛaafee Yesu.
Kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ahalamɔ
(Mateo 10.1-4; Marko 3.13-19)
12Agbɛnɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, eyiŋ etee sɔlemɔ yɛ gɔŋ ko nɔ, ni eshi kpe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ eesɔle eetsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ. 13 Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, etsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ehala amɛteŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, mɛi hu ni etsɛ amɛ bɔfoi lɛ. 14Simon, mɔ ni ewo lɛ Petro hu lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea; Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo; 15Mateo kɛ Toma; Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Simon, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ; 16Yuda, Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Yesu shiɛ ni etsa helatsɛmɛi
17Ni ekɛ amɛ kpeleke shi kɛbadamɔ he ko ni yɔɔ trɛnɛɛ, kɛ ekaselɔi asafo lɛ kɛ mɛi pii ni jɛ Yudea fɛɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli ni ba lɛ toiboo kɛ amɛhelai atsamɔ lɛ, 18kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji haoɔ amɛ lɛ, ni etsa amɛ. 19Ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ miitao ehe amɛta, ejaakɛ hewalɛ miije emli ni eetsa amɛ fɛɛ.
Jɔɔmɔi kɛ loomɔi
(Mateo 5.1-12)
20Ni ehole ehiŋmɛi anɔ ekwɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ni ekɛɛ,
“Ajɔɔ nyɛ ohiafoi lɛ;
ejaakɛ nyɛnɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
21 “Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃mɔ yeɔ nyɛ amrɔ nɛɛ;
ejaakɛ nyɛaatɔrɔ.
Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛfoɔ amrɔ nɛɛ;
ejaakɛ nyɛaaŋmɔ.
22 “Ajɔɔ nyɛ, kɛji mɛi nyɛ nyɛ, ni amɛkɛ nyɛ tserɛ mli, ni amɛjɛ nyɛ ni amɛgbe nyɛgbɛi akɛ gbɛi fɔ̃ŋ yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
23 Nyɛnyaa yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ ni nyɛtumɔa, ejaakɛ naa, nyɛnyɔmɔwoo fa yɛ ŋwɛi; ejaakɛ nakai nɔŋŋ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee gbalɔi lɛ.
24 “Shi nyɛ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ, kpoo hã nyɛ!
Ejaakɛ nyɛna nyɛmiishɛjemɔ momo.
25 “Kpoo hã nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtɔrɔ amrɔ nɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ aaaye nyɛ.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛŋmɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ nyɛaaye ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛaafofoi.
26 “Kpoo hã nyɛ, kɛji mɛi fɛɛ aaawie nyɛhe ekpakpa lɛ! Ejaakɛ nakai nɔŋŋ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee amale gbalɔi lɛ.
Henyɛlɔi asuɔmɔ
(Mateo 5.38-48; 7.12a)
27“Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛboɔ toi nɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi; nyɛfea mɛi ni nyɛɔ nyɛ lɛ ejurɔ; 28nyɛjɔa mɛi ni lomɔɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mɛi ni feɔ nyɛ niseniianii. 29Mɔ ni aaagba otoi kome mli lɛ, tsɔ̃ ekome lɛ hu ohã lɛ, ni mɔ ni aaashɔ̃ ohebo lɛ, kaakãmã lɛ oflaka lɛ hu. 30Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa bo nii lɛ, hã lɛ, ni mɔ ni aaashɔ̃ onii lɛ, kaabi lɛ dɔŋŋ. 31 Ni bɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mɛi afee ahã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛhãa amɛ. 32Shi kɛji nyɛsumɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ? Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu sumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ amɛ. 33Ni kɛji mɛi ni feɔ nyɛ ejurɔ nyɛfeɔ ejurɔ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ? Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu feɔ nakai nɔŋŋ. 34 Ni kɛji nyɛfa mɛi ni nyɛhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ amɛaahã nyɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ? Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu faa eshafeelɔi koni amɛna nakai bɔ nɔŋŋ. 35Moŋ nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni nyɛfea ejurɔ, ni nyɛfaa ni nyɛhiɛ kãaa nɔ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni nyɛnyɔmɔwoo aaafa, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ bii, shi lɛ lɛ emli hi hã trumui kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji. 36No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa mɔbɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛTsɛ lɛ hu naa mɔbɔ lɛ.”
Kojomɔ
(Mateo 7.1-5)
37 “Nyɛkakojoa, koni Nyɔŋmɔ akakojo nyɛ; nyɛkabua fɔ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ akabu nyɛ fɔ; nyɛkɛfaa, ni akɛaafa nyɛ. 38 Nyɛhãa ni aaahã nyɛ; nii ni asusu jogbaŋŋ ni ahoso ni anyɛmɔ nɔ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛteke nɔ mɛi kɛaashãkã nyɛtsitsi, ejaakɛ nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaaku sɛɛ akɛsusu ahã nyɛ.” 39 Ni ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ, “Ani shwilafo aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ shwilafo gbɛ? Ani jeee bu mli amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaayagbee? 40 Kaselɔ efeee etsɔ̃ɔlɔ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni atsɔse lɛ kɛwula shi lɛ, eeetamɔ etsɔ̃ɔlɔ. 41Shi mɛɛba onaa kuli ni kã onyɛmi hiŋmɛi nɔ lɛ, ni mplaŋ ni yɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ, oyooo lɛ? 42Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, ‘Anyɛmi, hã majie kuli ni kã ohiŋmɛi nɔ lɛ,’ be ni onaaa mplaŋ ni yɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ? Osatofo, jiemɔ mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ tsutsu, ni no dani ooona nii faŋŋ ni ojie kuli lɛ yɛ onyɛmi lɛ hiŋmɛiŋ!”
Amɛyibii nyɛkɛaale amɛ
(Mateo 7.16-20; 12.33-35)
43“Ejaakɛ tso kpakpa ko bɛ ni woɔ yibii gbohii, ni asaŋ tso gbonyo ko hu bɛ ni woɔ yibii kpakpai. 44 Ejaakɛ tso fɛɛ tso diɛŋtsɛ yibii akɛleɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ atseee agbãmi yɛ ŋmeitsei anɔ, ni asaŋ atseee wain yibii yɛ aklatei anɔ. 45 Gbɔmɔ kpakpa jieɔ nɔ kpakpa kɛjɛɔ etsui mli jwetri kpakpa lɛ mli, ni gbɔmɔ fɔ̃ŋ jieɔ nɔ fɔ̃ŋ kɛjɛɔ etsui mli jwetri fɔ̃ŋ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ nɔ ni eyi tsui obɔ̃ lɛ, no naabu wieɔ.”
Tsumalɔi enyɔ lɛ
(Mateo 7.24-27)
46 “Shi mɛni hewɔ nyɛtsɛɔ mi akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ!’ Ni nyɛfeee nii ni mikɛɔ lɛ? 47Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ ni enuɔ miwiemɔi lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ mɔ ni etamɔ: 48etamɔ nuu ko ni be ni emaa tsu lɛ etsa shi kwɔŋkwɔŋ ni eto shishi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ; ni nu afua ba, ni eshimɔ nakai tsu lɛ, ni enyɛɛɛ lɛ ehoso, ejaakɛ ato shishi jogbaŋŋ. 49Shi mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, etamɔ nuu ko ni ma tsu yɛ shikpɔŋ hiɛ ni etswaaa shishitoo jogbaŋŋ; ni faa ba ni eshimɔ tsu lɛ, ni amrɔ lɛ ewule, ni nakai tsu lɛ wulemɔ lɛ da.”

Title: LUKA 7
Content:
Asraafoiohaiatsɛ ko wenuu tsamɔ
(Mateo 8.5-13)
1Agbɛnɛ be ni Yesu ewie wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ toiiaŋ lɛ, ebote Kapernaum. 2Asraafoiohaiatsɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni etsulɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa he miiye ni eehe egbo. 3Ni be ni enu Yesu he lɛ, etsu Yudafoi lɛ anukpai kɛba eŋɔɔ akɛ eekpa lɛ fai ni eba ni ebatsa etsulɔ lɛ. 4Be ni amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai naakpa amɛkɛɛ, “Mɔ ni obaafee enɛ ohã lɛ, esa lɛ; 5ejaakɛ esumɔɔ wɔmaŋ lɛ, ni kpeehe lɛ, lɛ ema ehã wɔ.” 6Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ tee. Shi be ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaashɛ shĩa lɛ, asraafoiohaiatsɛ lɛ tsu eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaagba ohe naa; ejaakɛ esaaa mi akɛ oboteɔ mikoi lɛ shi; 7no hewɔ hu ni mibuuu mihe akɛ misa mɔ ni baa oŋɔɔ lɛ; shi moŋ wiemɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, ni aaatsa mitsulɔ lɛ. 8Ejaakɛ mi po ni mi ji gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nɔyeli shishi lɛ, miyɛ asraafoi yɛ mishishi, ni mikɛɔ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Yaa!’ Ni eyaa; kɛ mɔ kroko hu akɛ, ‘Ba!’ Ni ebaa; ni mikɛɔ mitsulɔ akɛ, ‘Feemɔ enɛ!’ Ni efeɔ.” 9Be ni Yesu nu nii nɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ ehewɔ, ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ asafo ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Israel tete minako hemɔkɛyeli ni da tamɔ enɛ dã.” 10Ni be ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba shĩa lɛ, amɛbana tsulɔ lɛ ni ehe ewa lɛ.
Nain oblanyo lɛ shiteemɔ
11Jetsɛre nɔ lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nain lɛ mli; ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kɛ asafo yuu kɛ lɛ nyiɛ. 12 Shi be ni eshɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa etã lɛ, naa, awo gbonyo ko kɛmiije kpo, ni enyɛ bi kome ji lɛ; ni okulafo ji yoo lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ mli bii pii kɛ lɛ nyiɛ. 13Ni be ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ na lɛ lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafo!” 14Ni eba ebata adeka lɛ he; ni mɛi ni tere lɛ lɛ wa damɔ shi. Ni ekɛɛ, “Oblanyo, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, Tee shi!” 15 Ni mɔ ni egbo lɛ te shi eta shi, ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ; ni ekɛ lɛ hã enyɛ.
16 Ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam amɛkɛɛ, “Gbalɔ kpeteŋkple ete shi yɛ wɔteŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebasara emaŋ lɛ.” 17Ni ehe sane nɛɛ jije yɛ Yudea kɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ tsu kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ
(Mateo 11.2-6)
18Ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ yagba lɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ. 19Ni etsɛ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni etsu amɛ Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛyabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?” 20Be ni hii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ tsu wɔ oŋɔɔ. Ekɛɛ, ‘Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?’ ” 21Shi nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu tsa mɛi pii ahelai kɛ amɛhejaramɔi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli, ni mɛi pii hu ni eshwila lɛ, ehã amɛna nii. 22 Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yohane nibii ni nyɛna ni nyɛnu lɛ, akɛ shwilafoi miina nii, obubuafoi miinyiɛ, kpitiyelɔi ahe miitse, toimulɔi miinu nii, gbohii miite shi, ni aajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ aatsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi. 23Ni ajɔɔ mɔ ni mihe sane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ enane.”
Yesu ye Yohane he odase
(Mateo 11.7-19)
24Shi be ni Yohane bɔfoi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i asafoi lɛ kɛɛmɔ yɛ Yohane he akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛje kpo nyɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyakwɛ? Glã ni kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ lɛ? 25Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ? Naa, mɛi ni woɔ atade fɛɛfɛo ni amɛyeɔ nii kpakpai lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi awei amɛyɔɔ. 26 Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbalɔ? Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ni fe gbalɔ tete. 27 Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ he ni aŋma yɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ ato bo lɛ.’ 28 Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɛi ni yei fɔ amɛ lɛ ateŋ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni fe Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni ji bibioo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ fe lɛ.” 29 Ni be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ toohelɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ bem akɛni akɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ baptisi amɛ lɛ. 30 Shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kpoo Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni eyɔɔ yɛ amɛhe lɛ, akɛni amɛhãaa ni Yohane abaptisi amɛ lɛ. 31Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Namɔ he mikɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaato mɔ, ni namɔ amɛtamɔ? 32Amɛtamɔ gbekɛbii ni tara jara nɔ ni tsɛtsɛɔ amɛhe amɛkɛɔ akɛ,
‘Wɔkpã blɛ wɔha nyɛ, ni nyɛjooo;
wɔwo yara wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛfooo!’
33Ejaakɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ba ni eyeee aboloo ni enuuu wain, ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɛ emli.’ 34 Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba ni eyeɔ nii ni enuɔ nɔ ko, ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Naa nuu ŋmaayelɔ kɛ dãanulɔ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi ashieŋtsɛ!’ 35Ni abu nilee bem yɛ ebii lɛ fɛɛ anaa.”
Yoo eshafeelɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu
36Ni Farisifoi lɛ eko kpee Yesu ni ekɛ lɛ abaye nii, ni eyiŋ etee Farisifonyo lɛ we lɛ, ni eyata niyenii lɛ ahe. 37Ni naa, be ni yoo ko ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli ni ji eshafeelɔ lɛ na ele akɛ Yesu miiye nii yɛ Farisifonyo lɛ we lɛ, ekɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ emli mukɛŋma ba; 38ni ebadamɔ enajiaŋshi yɛ esɛɛgbɛ, ni efo ni ekɛ eyaafonu lɛ bɔ̃i enaji ahe fɔɔ ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ, ni eshwɔ enaji ahe, ni ekɛ mukɛŋma lɛ kpa he. 39Shi be ni Farisifonyo ni kpee Yesu niyeli lɛ na lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ emli akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, gbalɔ ji lɛ jikulɛ, eeele nɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ nɔ yoo ni taa ehe nɛɛ akɛ eshafeelɔ ji lɛ.” 40Ni Yesu wo enaa nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Simon, miyɛ sane ko ni mibakɛɛ bo.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛɛmɔ!” 41“Niflilɔ ko yɛ ni yɔɔ nyɔjiatsɛmɛi enyɔ; mɔ kome hiɛ lɛ denarioi ohai enumɔ, ni mɔ kome hu hiɛ lɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. 42Shi akɛni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛaawo nyɔmɔ lɛ, ekɛke amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, te amɛteŋ mɔ ni aaasumɔ lɛ fe enaanyoŋ?” 43Ni Simon to he ekɛɛ, “Misusuɔ akɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ pii ke lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obu atɛŋ jogbaŋŋ.” 44 Ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã yoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ Simon akɛ, “Oona nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ? Ni mibabote owe lɛ nɛɛ, ohãaa mi nu ni mikɛfɔ minaji ahe, shi yoo nɛɛ kɛ yaafonu efɔ minaji ahe, ni ekɛ eyitsɔi etsumɔ. 45 Minaa hu oshwɔɔɔ; shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, kɛjɛ be mli ni miba nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, efɔ̃ko minaji ahe shwɔmɔ. 46Mu hu okɛkpaaa miyiŋ; shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, ekɛ mukɛŋma ekpa minaji ahe. 47No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ehe eshai ni fa lɛ, akɛfa lɛ, ni no hewɔ esuɔmɔ fa babaoo lɛ; shi mɔ ni akɛ fioo efa lɛ lɛ, esuɔmɔ fioo.” 48 Ni ekɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Akɛ ohe eshai efa bo!” 49Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii ashi lɛ bɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ nɛ ni kɛ eshai faa po nɛɛ?” 50 Shi ekɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehere oyiwala, yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli!”

Title: LUKA 8
Content:
Yei ni kɛ Yesu nyiɛ lɛ
1 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yakpa maji kɛ akrowai amli eshiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi. Ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fata ehe, 2 kɛ yei komɛi hu ni efamɔ amɛmumɔi fɔ̃ji ni etsa amɛhelai lɛ: Maria, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Magdalena ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji kpawo je emli lɛ, 3kɛ Yohana, Herode tsulɔnukpa Kusa ŋa lɛ, kɛ Susana, kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii ni kɛ amɛnii ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ eko sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ
(Mateo 13.1-9; Marko 4.1-9)
4Ni be ni asafo babaoo naa ebakpe shi ni mɛi jɛ majimaji anɔ kɛmiiba eŋɔɔ lɛ, ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ, 5“Nidulɔ ko yiŋ etee ewui shwãmɔ. Eshwãmɔ mli lɛ, eko yashwie gbɛ toi, ni anaanaa nɔ, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji ba bakɔlɔ. 6Eko yashwie tɛsaa nɔ ni be ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ, eŋãla, ejaakɛ enaaa ofɔ̃. 7Eko yashwie ŋmei ateŋ, ni ŋmei lɛ kɛ lɛ kwɛ̃ ni amɛgbe lɛ. 8Ni eko hu yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni ekwɛ̃, ni ewo yibii toi oha.” Be ni ewie nii nɛɛ lɛ, ebo ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!”
Nɔ hewɔ ni Yesu wie yɛ abɛbuai amli
(Mateo 13.10-17; Marko 4.10-12)
9Shi ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Te abɛ nɛɛ shishiŋ?” 10 Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli teemɔ saji lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛle; shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ akɛhãa amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli; ‘koni na lɛ amɛna nɛ, shi amɛkayoo sɛɛ, ni nu hu amɛnu, shi amɛkanu shishi.’
Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi
(Mateo 13.18-23; Marko 4.13-20)
11 “Agbɛnɛ abɛ lɛ shishi nɛ; wu lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ. 12Gbɛ toi bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ, shi abonsam baa ni ebashaa wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ, koni amɛkahe amɛye ni ahere amɛyiwala. 13Tɛsaa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ ni amɛheɔ amɛyeɔ be kuku kɛkɛ, ni kaa be mli lɛ amɛkwaa amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ. 14Ŋmei ateŋ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ ni amɛyaa, ni je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔi kɛ ninamɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔyeli gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛmli; ni amɛwooo yibii ni hiɔ shi ni saa kɛgbeɔ naa. 15 Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni kɛji amɛnu wiemɔ lɛ amɛkɛtoɔ tsui ni hi ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ mli, ni amɛkɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ woɔ yibii.”
Kane ni akɛhɔ tsese shishi
(Marko 4.21-25)
16 “Mɔ ko esuuu kane ni ekɛ nɔ ha nɔ aloo ni ekɛma saatso shishi; shi moŋ kanetso nɔ ekɛmaa, koni mɛi ni boteɔ shĩa lɛ mli ana la lɛ. 17 Ejaakɛ nɔ ko bɛ ni akɛtee ni ajieŋ lɛ kpo, ni asaŋ nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ ni aleŋ ni ejeŋ kpo faŋŋ. 18 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ bɔ ni nyɛnuɔ wiemɔ lɛ nyɛhãa he; ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahã lɛ; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaashɔ̃ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ akɛ eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ.”
Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi
(Mateo 12.46-50; Marko 3.31-35)
19Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, shi asafo lɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ eŋɔɔ amɛshɛ. 20Ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛna bo.” 21Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi ji mɛi ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ!”
Yesu fã ahum yi ni efɔ̃ɔ tswaa
(Mateo 8.23-27; Marko 4.35-41)
22Gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ eba mli akɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa kpaakpo lɛ sɛɛ gbɛ.” Ni amɛyiŋ. 23Shi be ni amɛyaa lɛ, wɔŋɔ lɛ. Ni ahum batswa yɛ kpaakpo lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛlɛlɛ lɛ yi kɛ nu, ni amɛyɛ amanehulu mli. 24Ni amɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbatsiɛ̃ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!” Ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ kɛ nu ni efee hamahama lɛ yi, ni amɛfee diŋŋ, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ. 25Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli yɔɔ?” Ni amɛshe gbeyei ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɔmɔ srɔto po nɛ ni efãa kɔɔyɔi kɛ nui tete yi ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?”
Yesu tsa nuu mumui ko ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli
(Mateo 8.28-34; Marko 5.1-20)
26Ni amɛshɛ Gerasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Galilea ŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ nɔ. 27Ni be ni ebakpeleke lɛ, nuu ko jɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ lɛ bakpe ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ ni ewooo atade ni ehiii shĩa akɛ ja gbohii abui amli kɛkɛ. 28Ni be ni ena Yesu lɛ ebo waa ni ebagbee enaji anaa, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, Bi? Miikpa bo fai, kaapiŋ mi!” (Ekɛɛ enɛ), 29ejaakɛ Yesu fã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ akɛ eje emli. Shi emɔɔ lɛ kpitiokpitioo; ni awoɔ lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi kɛ gboklɛi ni abuɔ ehe; shi etsereɔ nii ni akɛfimɔɔ lɛ lɛ amli, ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ lɛ kpalaa lɛ kɛyaa ŋa lɛ mli. 30Ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Te ogbɛiŋ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Asafo”; ejaakɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji pii ebote emli lɛ. 31Ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekafã amɛ ni ehã amɛyabote bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli. 32Shi kplotoi akuu kpele ko yɛ jɛi amɛmiiye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛkpa Yesu fai akɛ eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli. Ni eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ.
33Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ je nuu lɛ mli, ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli, ni kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ wo foi kɛkpeleke gɔŋ lɛ kɛyashwie kpaakpo lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi. 34Ni be ni mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛ lɛ na nɔ ni eba lɛ amɛjo foi ni amɛyagba yɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ akrowai lɛ amli. 35Kɛkɛ ni amɛje kpo amɛtee nɔ ni eba lɛ kwɛmɔ, ni amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛbana nuu lɛ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ eje emli lɛ. Eta Yesu najianaa ni ewo atade ni ehiɛ etserɛ lɛ. Ni amɛshe gbeyei. 36Shi mɛi ni na lɛ hu gba amɛ bɔ ni fee ni atsa mɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli lɛ. 37Kɛkɛ ni Gerasebii lɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi niiaŋ lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bakpa lɛ fai akɛ eje amɛŋɔɔ eya; ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ naakpa. Ni eyabote lɛlɛ lɛ mli kɛku esɛɛ. 38Shi nuu lɛ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ eje emli lɛ kpa lɛ fai ni ekɛ lɛ ahi shi. Shi Yesu jie lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, 39“Kuu osɛɛ oya owe, ni oyagba nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee eha bo lɛ.” Ni eyiŋ etee, ni eyajaje nii abɔ ni Yesu efee ehã lɛ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Yairo biyoo lɛ kɛ yoo ni ta Yesu atade he lɛ
(Mateo 9.18-26; Marko 5.21-43)
40Be ni Yesu ku esɛɛ eba kpaakpo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, asafo lɛ nya ehe; ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiimɛ lɛ. 41Ni naa, nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yairo ni ji kpeehe lɛ onukpa lɛ ba, ni ebagbee Yesu najianaa ni ekpa lɛ fai, koni eba ewe lɛ. 42Ejaakɛ eyɛ biyoo kome pɛ ni eye aaafee afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni eehe egbo. Shi be ni Yesu yaa lɛ, asafoi lɛ mia lɛ.
43Ni yoo ko yɛ amɛteŋ ni eye láfɔsemɔ hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; efite enii fɛɛ ekɛwo tsofatsɛmɛi anyɔmɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ atsa. 44Ebaje Yesu sɛɛ gbɛ, ni ebata etade naamuu lɛ he, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ elá ni hoɔ lɛ lɛ sɛɛ fo. 45Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ ni ta mihe lɛ?” Shi be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ tso lɛ, Petro kɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, asafoi lɛ ebɔle ohe ni amɛmiimia bo, ni okɛɔ akɛ, Namɔ ta mihe lɛ?”
46Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Mɔ ko eta mihe, ejaakɛ minu he akɛ, hewalɛ ko eje mimli.” 47Shi be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ ehiii lɛ eheteemɔ lɛ eba kɛ hekpokpomɔ ni eho egbee Yesu najianaa ni ejaje nɔ hewɔ ni eta ehe lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ehe wa lɛ amrɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. 48 Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Biyoo, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo; yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.”
49Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, mɔ ko jɛ kpeehe onukpa lɛ we lɛ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obiyoo lɛ egbo; kaagba tsɔɔlɔ lɛ naa dɔŋŋ.” 50Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ehere nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yairo akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei; hemɔ oye kɛkɛ, ni eyi aaana wala!” 51Ni be ni eba shĩa lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni ekɛ lɛ aya jɛi akɛ ja Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo kɛ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛkɛ. 52Ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miifo ni amɛmiiye gbekɛ lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ. Shi ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkafoa; egboko, shi wɔ ewɔ.” 53Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ egbo. 54Shi Yesu mɔ enine shi, ni ebo akɛ, “Gbekɛyoo, tee shi!” 55Ni emumɔ ku esɛɛ ba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ete shi amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni Yesu fã akɛ ahã lɛ nɔ ko eye. 56 Ni efɔlɔi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe; shi etswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkagba mɔ ko nɔ ni afee lɛ.

Title: LUKA 9
Content:
Yesu tsu kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ
(Mateo 10.5-15; Marko 6.7-13)
1Agbɛnɛ Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛkpe, ni ehã amɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ anɔ ni amɛtsa helai hu. 2Ni etsu amɛNyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shiɛmɔ kɛ helatsɛmɛi atsamɔ. 3Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkaŋɔa nɔ ko nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛ̃ŋ yɛ nyɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli, nyɛkahiɛa tso loo kotoku loo aboloo loo shika loo atadei enyɔ. 4 Ni shĩa fɛɛ shĩa ni nyɛaabote mli lɛ, nyɛhia jɛi kɛyashi nyɛaaje jɛi. 5 He fɛɛ he ni mɛi lɛ hereee nyɛ yɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnajiashi mlu lɛ nyɛkɛyea odase nyɛshia amɛ.” 6Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyakpa maji lɛ anɔ amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni amɛtsa mɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Herode yeyeeyefeemɔ
(Mateo 14.1-12; Marko 6.14-16)
7 Lumɔ Herode nu nii ni afee lɛ fɛɛ he, ni efee yeyeeye, ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ Yohane ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; 8mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ Elia ejie ehe kpo; mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ blema gbalɔi lɛ eko ete shi ekoŋŋ. 9 Ni Herode kɛɛ, “Yohane lɛ mifo eyi; shi namɔ ji mɔ ni minunuɔ nɛkɛ saji yɛ ehe nɛɛ?” Ni eetao Yesu ena.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii
(Mateo 14.13-21; Marko 6.30-44; Yohane 6.1-14)
10Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ, amɛbagba Yesu nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ. Ni ekɛ amɛ tee ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee yɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Betsaida lɛ masɛi. 11Be ni asafoi lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛtiu lɛ, ni ehere amɛ atuu ni ejaje Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni etsa mɛi ni tsamɔ he ehia amɛ lɛ. 12Be ni je bɔ̃i namɔ lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wo asafo lɛ gbɛ koni amɛya akrowai kɛ ŋmɔji ni kamɔ wɔhewɔ lɛ amli, ni amɛyato jɛmɛi ni amɛna niyenii; ejaakɛ ŋa nɔ wɔyɔɔ nɛɛ.” 13Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nɔ ko amɛyea.” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔbɛ nɔ ko fe aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ pɛ, ni belɛ ja wɔtee wɔyahe niyenii wɔbahã asafo nɛɛ fɛɛ. 14Ejaakɛ amɛyi aaafee hii akpei enumɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa amɛtaraa shi kuikui aaafee nyɔŋmai enumɔ enumɔ.” 15Amɛfee nakai, ni amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ tara shi. 16Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛkɛmamɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ. 17 Amɛye, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛtɔrɔ, ni akɔlɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ awo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Petro ye Yesu he odase
(Mateo 16.13-20; Marko 8.27-30)
18Gbi ko be ni Yesu kome sɔleɔ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ eŋɔɔ; ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mɛi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” 19 Ni amɛto he akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia; ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, blema gbalɔi lɛ eko ete shi ekoŋŋ.” 20 Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Ni Petro to he ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Kristo lɛ.” 21Shi etswa amɛnaa ma ni ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ amɛkatsi tã amɛkɛɛ mɔ ko.
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he
(Mateo 16.21-23; Marko 8.31-33)
22 Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ na amanehulu babaoo, ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kwa lɛ, ni agbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.”
Hekwamɔ
(Mateo 16.24-28; Marko 8.34—9.1)
23Ni ekɛɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe, ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ daa gbi ni enyiɛ misɛɛ. 24 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala. 25Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa kɛji ena jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, shi eshɛ ehe efɔ̃ aloo ekpãtã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ lɛ? 26 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi kɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ahe feɔ lɛ hiɛgbele lɛ, lɛ hu ehe aaafee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛgbele, be ni eeeba yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam lɛ kɛ eTsɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anɔ lɛ mli lɛ. 27Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”
Yesu gbɔmɔtso su tsake
(Mateo 17.1-8; Marko 9.2-9)
28Wiemɔi nɛɛ asɛɛ aaafee gbii kpaanyɔ lɛ Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo, ni ekɛ amɛ tee gɔŋ ko nɔ ni eyasɔle. 29Be ni esɔleɔ lɛ, ehiɛ su tsake ni etade lɛ yɛ futaa ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ. 30Ni naa, hii enyɔ kɛ lɛ bawie, amɛ ji Mose kɛ Elia, 31 ni amɛbajie amɛhe kpo yɛ anunyam mli ni amɛwie ejeŋ naa ni ebaaya eyagbe yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ he. 32Shi wɔ ni tsii eŋɔ Petro kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ; ni be ni wɔ lɛ tserɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ kwraa lɛ, amɛna Yesu anunyam lɛ kɛ hii enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ. 33Ni be ni hii lɛ kɛ lɛ gbalaa mli lɛ, Petro kɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ehi akɛ wɔhiɔ biɛ, ni hã ni wɔfee bui etɛ̃, onɔ ekome kɛ Mose nɔ ekome kɛ Elia nɔ ekome;” shi eleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ. 34Be ni ewieɔ enɛ lɛ atatu ba bakete amɛnɔ; ni ekaselɔi lɛ she gbeyei be ni amɛbote atatu lɛ mli lɛ. 35 Ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji mi-Bi ni mihala lɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi!” 36Ni be ni gbee lɛ gbɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kome too ana. Ni amɛfee dioo, ni nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ amɛgbaaa mɔ ko nii ni amɛna lɛ eko.
Yesu tsa gbekɛ nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɔɔ emli
(Mateo 17.14-18; Marko 9.14-27)
37Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni amɛjeɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛkpelekeɔ shi lɛ, mɛi pii kɛ lɛ bakpe. 38Ni nuu ko jɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ bo ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, miikpa bo fai, kwɛmɔ mibi lɛ, shi mibi kome ji lɛ. 39Mumɔ ko mɔɔ lɛ, ni ekpakpa ko dani ejeɔ emli. 40Mikpa okaselɔi lɛ fai koni amɛfã lɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ.” 41Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ao yinɔbii ni heee yeee ni bɛ amɛŋɛlɛnɔ! Mɛɛ beyinɔ mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi, ni mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi? Kɛ obi lɛ aba biɛ!” 42 Be ni ebaa ni eshɛko eŋɔɔ lɛ, mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ too lɛ etswa shi ni ehã eshɔ̃, shi Yesu fã mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ lɛ yi, ni etsa gbekɛ lɛ, ni eŋɔ lɛ ehã etsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. 43Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ.
Yesu wie egbele lɛ he ekoŋŋ
(Mateo 17.22-23; Marko 9.30-32)
Shi be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ efee amɛ yaa yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yesu fee lɛ he lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, 44 “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhãa nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ayaa nyɛtoiiaŋ; ejaakɛ aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ.” 45 Shi amɛ lɛ amɛnaaa wiemɔ nɛɛ shishi, ni akɛtee amɛ ni amɛkayoo sɛɛ, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei akɛ amɛaabi lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ he nɔ ko.
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
(Mateo 18.1-5; Marko 9.33-37)
46 Shi ŋwanejee ko bate shi yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ. 47Be ni Yesu na amɛtsuiiaŋ susumɔi lɛ, ekɛ gbekɛ fioo ko badamɔ emasɛi; 48 ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛ fioo nɛɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni ji bibioo yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, lɛ ji agbo fe fɛɛ.”
Mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo nyɛ lɛ eyɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ
(Marko 9.38-40)
49Ni Yohane here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔna mɔ ko kɛ ogbɛi miifa mumɔi fɔ̃ji, ni wɔtsi lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ ebɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔnyiɛ osɛɛ lɛ ateŋ.” 50 Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkatsia lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo nyɛ lɛ, eyɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ.”
Samaria maŋ ko ni hereee Yesu lɛ
51 Be ni gbii ni abaaŋɔ Yesu lɛ kɛya ŋwɛi lɛ eshɛ etã lɛ, eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ eeya Yerusalɛm. 52 Ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ; ni amɛtee amɛyabote Samariabii amaŋ ko mli, koni amɛsaa he ko amɛto lɛ. 53Shi amɛhereee lɛ, ejaakɛ eeya Yerusalɛm. 54 Ni be ni Yakobo kɛ Yohane, ekaselɔi lɛ, na enɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, oosumɔ akɛ wɔkɛɛ ni la ajɛ ŋwɛi aba abashã amɛ?” 55Shi etsɔ̃ ehe ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ [ni ekɛɛ, “Ani nyɛleee nɔ mumɔ ni nyɛhiɛ lɛ lo? 56 Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaa gbɔmɛi asusumai ahiɛkpãtãmɔ, shi moŋ amɛyiwalaheremɔ eba.”] Ni amɛtee maŋ kroko mli.
Mɛi ni taoɔ Yesu sɛɛ anyiɛ
(Mateo 8.18-22)
57Be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ mɔ ko bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛaatee he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.” 58Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔi yɛ bui, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji hu yɛ tsui; shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ bɛ he ni ekɛ eyitso ŋmɛɔ.” 59Ni ekɛɛ mɔ kroko akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Shi lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ; ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya mayafu mitsɛ dã.” 60Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni gbohii afu amɛgbohii, shi bo lɛ yaa ni oyashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ!” 61 Ni mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ, “Manyiɛ osɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ; shi ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya mayashɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ miwe lɛ dã.” 62Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni kɛ enine yamɔɔ tsina kɔi mli ni ekuɔ ekuɛ ekwɛɔ esɛɛ lɛ, esaaa Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”

Title: LUKA 10
Content:
Yesu tsu mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo
1 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ famɔ mɛi krokomɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo hu, ni etsu amɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ kɛ he fɛɛ he ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaaya lɛ. 2 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nikpamɔ lɛ fa, shi nitsulɔi lɛ faaa; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkpaa nikpamɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai, koni etsu nitsulɔi kɛba enikpamɔ lɛ mli. 3Nyɛyaa! Naa, miitsu nyɛ tamɔ toobii yɛ klãji ateŋ. 4 Nyɛkahiɛa fotro loo kotoku loo tokotai ni nyɛkaŋaa mɔ ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ. 5Ni shĩa fɛɛ shĩa ni nyɛaabote lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ aba shĩa nɛɛ!’ 6Ni kɛji hejɔlɛ bi ko yɛ jɛi lɛ, nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ aaahi enɔ; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, eeeku esɛɛ eba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ. 7 Ni nyɛhĩa nakai shĩa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ; ni nyɛye ni nyɛnu nii ni amɛaahã nyɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nitsulɔ lɛ enyɔmɔwoo sa lɛ. Nyɛkajɛa shĩa kɛyaa shĩa. 8Ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli ni nyɛaabote ni amɛahere nyɛ lɛ, nyɛyea nɔ ni akɛaama nyɛhiɛ lɛ; 9ni nyɛtsaa helatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, ni nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ.’ 10Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli ni nyɛaabote ni amɛhereee nyɛ lɛ, nyɛjea jɛi nyɛyaa eblohui lɛ amli, ni nyɛkɛa akɛ, 11‘Nyɛmaŋ nɛɛŋ mlu tete ni yɔɔ wɔnaji ahe lɛ wɔkpalaa wɔshwieɔ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ.’ 12Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaafaŋ Sodom fe nakai maŋ lɛ!’
Maji ni tsakeee amɛtsui lɛ
(Mateo 11.20-24)
13 “Kpoo hã bo, Korazin! Kpoo hã bo, Betsaida! Ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Tiro kɛ Sidon atsu yɛ jikulɛ amɛtara kpekpe kɛ lamlu mli amɛtsake amɛtsui jeeŋmɔ. 14Shi kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaafaŋ Tiro kɛ Sidon fe nyɛ! 15Ni bo Kapernaum, ani aaawo onɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi? Gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee!
16 “Mɔ ni boɔ nyɛ toi lɛ, mi toi eboɔ lɛ, ni mɔ ni kwaa nyɛ lɛ, mi ekwaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni kwaa mi lɛ, mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ekwaa lɛ.”
Mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ asɛɛkuu
17Ni mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba kɛ miishɛɛ ni amɛbakɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mumɔi fɔ̃ji tete baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.” 18 Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mina Satan jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shi tamɔ srawa. 19 Naa, mihã nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛnaanaa onufui kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi kɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ nyɛ efɔ̃ŋ ko. 20 Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkanaa enɛ he miishɛɛ, akɛ mumɔi lɛ baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa nyɛ lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛnaa miishɛɛ akɛ aŋma nyɛgbɛi yɛ ŋwɛi.”
Yesu mli fili lɛ ni ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi
(Mateo 11.25-27; 13.16-17)
21Nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ Yesu mli fili lɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ, “Miijie oyi, Ataa; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ oŋɔ nii nɛɛ otee nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, ni ojie otsɔ̃ɔ abifabii; hɛɛ, Ataa, ejaakɛ nakai sa ohiɛ.
22“MiTsɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo midɛŋ, ni mɔ ko leee mɔ ni ji Bi lɛ, ja Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ni ji Tsɛ lɛ hu, ja Bi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni Bi lɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ejie lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.” 23 Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ehã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ hiŋmɛii ni naa nibii ni nyɛnaa lɛ. 24 Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ gbalɔi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi pii tao akɛ amɛna nii ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, ni amɛyanaaa, ni asaŋ amɛnu nii ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ, ni amɛyanuuu.”
Kitã wulu lɛ
(Mateo 22.34-40; Marko 12.28-34)
25 Ni naa, mlatsɔɔlɔ ko te shi damɔ shi, ni eka lɛ ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?” Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, 26“Mɛni aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ? Te okaneɔ tɛŋŋ?” 27 Ni eto he ekɛɛ, “Suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ osusuma fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ mli, kɛ onaanyo hu tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.” 28 Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni oto he lɛ ja; feemɔ nakai, ni oyi aaana wala.” 29Shi lɛ lɛ, akɛni eetao ehe bem ebu hewɔ lɛ, ebi Yesu akɛ, “Ni namɔ ji minaanyo?”
Samarianyo mɔbɔnalɔ lɛ
30Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nuu ko yiŋ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛmiiya Yeriko ni eyagbee ojotswalɔi ateŋ, ni amɛkpɔlɔ ehe atadei ni amɛtswia lɛ nii, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛshi lɛ ni egbo fã kɛ fã. 31Shi eba mli akɛ osɔfo ko batsɔ̃ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ; shi be ni ena lɛ lɛ, egba afã kɛho. 32Ni nakai nɔŋŋ Levinyo ko hu gba afã kɛho, be ni eshɛ jɛi ni ena lɛ lɛ. 33 Shi Samarianyo ko ni nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ bashɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, 34ni etee eŋɔɔ ni eyafɔse mu kɛ wain eshwie epilamɔi lɛ anɔ ni efimɔ nɔ, ni esaa ewo lɛ eta lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekooloo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ tee gbɔiatoohe ni eyakwɛ lɛ. 35Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni eyaa lɛ, ejie denarioi enyɔ ehã gbɔiatoohetsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛmɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooosaa ofite lɛ, kɛ miku misɛɛ miba lɛ mawo bo nyɔmɔ.’ 36Agbɛnɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ateŋ namɔ osusuɔ akɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni gbee ojotswalɔi ateŋ lɛ naanyo?” 37Ni ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ni na lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo hu yaa ni oyafee nakai nɔŋŋ.”
Marta kɛ Maria
38 Be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa lɛ eyabote akrowa ko mli. Ni yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marta lɛ kpee lɛ kɛtee ewe. 39Eyɛ nyɛmi yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Maria; enyɛmi yoo nɛɛ bata Yesu najianaa ni ebo ewiemɔ toi.
40Shi Marta gba ehe naa tuutu yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ pii he ni eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ni minyɛmi lɛ eshi mi ni mi kome misɔ̃mɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee ohe sane ko ni lo? No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ lɛ ni ebafata mihe.” 41Shi Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Marta, Marta! Oogba ohe naa, ni oohao ohe yɛ nibii pii ahe; 42 nɔ kome ehia. Nɔ ni hi lɛ no Maria ekɔ lɛ, ni no lɛ ashɔŋ yɛ edɛŋ.”

Title: LUKA 11
Content:
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ lɛ
(Mateo 6.9-13)
1Gbi ko lɛ Yesu miisɔle yɛ he ko; ni be ni egbe naa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ sɔlemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yohane hu tsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ.”
2Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ,
‘Wɔtsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi,
ogbɛi lɛ he atse;
omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aba.
Afee nɔ ni osumɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu;
tamɔ bɔ ni afeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ.
3Hã wɔ wɔdaaŋŋmaa daa gbi,
4ni okɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ afa wɔ;
ejaakɛ wɔ hu wɔkɛfaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ.
Ni okɛ wɔ akaya kaa mli.’ ”
Nyɛkãa he nyɛbia kɛyashi aaahã nyɛ
(Mateo 7.7-11)
5Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni yɔɔ shieŋtsɛ ni eeetee eŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋteŋ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Shieŋtsɛ, faa mi aboloi etɛ̃, 6ejaakɛ mishieŋtsɛ ko ejɛ gbɛ ebato mi, ni mibɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛbaama ehiɛ’; 7ni mɔ ni yɔɔ tsuŋ lɛ hereŋ nɔ akɛ, ‘Kaagba minaa; aŋa shinaa lɛ momo ni mi kɛ mibii kamɔ saa nɔ, minyɛŋ shi mate ni mahã bo.’ 8 Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ ka eshieŋtsɛ ni ji lɛ hewɔŋ kulɛ eteŋ shi ni ehã lɛ, shi enaagbamɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ eeete shi kɛ̃ ni eeehã lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni etaoɔ. 9Ni mi hu miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbia, ni aaahã nyɛ; nyɛtaoa ni nyɛaana; nyɛshia, ni aaagbele nyɛ.’ 10Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ lɛ, enine shɛɔ nɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ lɛ enaa; ni mɔ ni shiɔ lɛ aaagbele lɛ. 11Shi nɛɛ tsɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ? Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ loo lɛ, ni eeeŋɔ onufu ehã lɛ yɛ loo najiaŋ. 12Aloo kɛji ebi wuɔ wɔlɔ lɛ, eeehã lɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakro? 13Belɛ kɛji nyɛ ni nyɛ ji mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ nyɛle bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ ni nyɛkɛ nikeenii kpakpai keɔ nyɛbii lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ eŋɔŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ehaŋ mɛi ni biɔ lɛ lɛ?”
Yesu kɛ Beelzebul
(Mateo 12.22-30; Marko 3.20-30)
14Be ko lɛ Yesu miifã mumɔ fɔŋ ko ni ji mumui; ni eba mli akɛ, be ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ je kpo lɛ, mumui lɛ wie, ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe. 15 Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Beelzebul, mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ lɛ, hewalɛ naa efãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ.” 16 Ni mɛi komɛi hu ka lɛ amɛmiitao ŋwɛi okadi ko yɛ edɛŋ. 17Shi akɛni ele amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ ejwaa, ni tsu kumɔɔ shwieɔ tsu nɔ. 18Ni kɛji Satan hu gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ adamɔ shiŋ, akɛni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ Beelzebul hewalɛ mikɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ? 19Shi kɛji mi lɛ, Beelzebul hewalɛ mikɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, namɔ nyɛbii lɛ kɛfãa amɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ amɛaakojo nyɛ. 20 Shi kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ wao mikɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ. 21Kɛ hewalɔ emia egbaja ni eebu emɔ̃ɔ he lɛ, enibii yɛ shweshweeshwe; 22 shi kɛji mɔ ni he wa fe lɛ batua lɛ ni eye enɔ kunim lɛ, eshɔ̃ɔ etawuunii ni eŋɔɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ ni ejaa enomŋɔɔnii lɛ. 23 Mɔ ni bɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ ekɛ mi ena, ni mɔ ni kɛ mi buaaa naa lɛ eegbɛ eeshwã.”
Mumɔ fɔŋ sɛɛkuu kɛ gbɔmɔ mli botemɔ
(Mateo 12.43-46)
24“Kɛ mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ je gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, eyanyiɛɔ hei ni nu bɛ etaoɔ hejɔɔmɔ, ni kɛ enaaa eko lɛ, ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Maku misɛɛ matee miwe he ni mijɛ lɛ.’ 25Ni kɛ eba lɛ, ebanaa akɛ abɛɛ mli ni awula mli. 26 Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaa ni eyaŋɔɔ mumɔi krokomɛi kpawo ni ji mumɔi fɔ̃ji fe lɛ efataa ehe, ni amɛyaboteɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛhiɔ jɛi, ni nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛkpee shihilɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ efɔŋ fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ.”
Anɔkwa jɔɔmɔ
27 Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu wieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, yoo ko ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ wo egbee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ musu ni hiɛ bo kɛ fufɔ ni oye lɛ!” 28 Shi ehere nɔ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ moŋ!”
Farisifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi
(Mateo 12.38-42)
29 Shi be ni asafoi lɛ ebabua amɛhe naa pii lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Yinɔbii nɛɛ yinɔbii fɔ̃ji ni; amɛmiitao okadi, ni ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ. 30 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yona tsɔ̃ okadi hã Ninevebii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ ahã nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ. 31 Wuoyigbɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni eeebu amɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ ejɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe ni ebabo Solomon nilee toi, ni naa nɔ ko ni fe Solomon nilee lɛ yɛ biɛ. 32 Ninevehii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli ni amɛaabu amɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ naa; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ.”
Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane
(Mateo 6.22-23)
33 “Mɔ ko esuuu kane emaaa kpokplobiiaŋ loo tsese shishi, shi moŋ kanetso nɔ ekɛmaa, koni mɛi ni baa shĩa lɛŋ ana ekpɛmɔ lɛ. 34Ogbɔmɔtso lɛ kane ji ohiŋmɛi lɛ. Kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tse lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ hu mli tseɔ; shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi ehiii lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso lɛ hu woɔ duŋ. 35No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni la ni yɔɔ omli lɛ akatsɔ̃ duŋ. 36Kɛji ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ mli tse ni he ko he ko woko duŋ lɛ, tse nɔŋŋ emuu lɛ fɛɛ mli aaatse tamɔ bɔ ni kane kɛ ekpɛmɔ tsoɔ hãa bo lɛ.”
Yesu wie shi Farisifoi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ
(Mateo 23.1-36; Marko 12.38-40)
37 Ni be ni Yesu wieɔ lɛ, Farisifonyo ko bakpee lɛ akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abaye nii; ni etee shĩa lɛŋ, ni eyata niyenii lɛ ahe. 38 Shi be ni Farisifonyo lɛ na akɛ efɔflɔko ehe dani ebaaye nii lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa. 39Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Farisifoi lɛ nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ, shi nyɛmli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ juu kɛ fɔ̃. 40Kwashiai! Ani mɔ ni fee sɛɛ lɛ, jeee lɛ nɔŋŋ efee mli lɛ hu? 41Moŋ nyɛŋɔa nibii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ nyɛfea ejurɔ, ni nibii fɛɛ he aaatse ahã nyɛ. 42 Shi kpoo hã nyɛ, Farisifoi, akɛ nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ shwie kɛ bai srɔtoi fɛɛ mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, ni nyɛshiɔ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ! Kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛfeɔ enɛɛmɛi hu nyɛkɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ. 43 Kpoo hã nyɛ, Farisifoi, akɛ nyɛsumɔɔ onukpai ashitaramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ ŋamɔi yɛ jaji anɔ! 44Kpoo hã nyɛ, akɛ nyɛtamɔ saŋi ni ejeee shi, ni mɛi ni nyiɛɔ nɔ lɛ leee!” 45Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛ oowie enɛɛmɛi lɛ okɛmiibɔ wɔ hu ahora.” 46Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ hu, kpoo hã nyɛ! Akɛ nyɛkɛ jatsui ni teremɔ jaraa tereɔ mɛi, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛwao kome tete etaaa he. 47Kpoo hã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfeɔ saŋi nyɛmamɔɔ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ, gbalɔi ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ gbe lɛ; 48belɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anitsumɔi lɛ ahe odase ni eŋɔɔ nyɛnaa; ejaakɛ amɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi nyɛ nyɛfeɔ saŋi nyɛmamɔɔ amɛnɔ. 49Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Mibatsu gbalɔi kɛ bɔfoi kɛya amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛaagbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni amɛaawa mɛi komɛi ayi,’ 50koni gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ alá ni afɔse ashwie shi kɛjɛ jeŋ shishitoo mli lɛ abi shi yɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ; 51kɛjɛ Habel lá lɛ nɔ kɛyashi Zakaria, mɔ ni agbe lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ te lɛ mli lɛ, lá lɛ nɔ. Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, aaabi shi yɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ! 52Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi, ejaakɛ nyɛkɔ nilee naa samfee! Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nyɛboteee mli, ni mɛi ni taoɔ mli abote lɛ hu, nyɛtsi amɛ gbɛ.” 53Ni be ni eje kpo kɛjɛ shĩa lɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka lɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i enaa saji bɛlɛmɔ babaoo, 54 kɛmiitsɔ̃ lɛ koni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ.

Title: LUKA 12
Content:
Osato he kɔkɔbɔɔ
(Mateo 10.26-27)
1 No mli nɔŋŋ, be ni mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ ebabua amɛhe naa ni mɛi naanaa mɛi anɔ lɛ, ebɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi lɛ amãsha ni ji osatofeemɔ lɛ he. 2 Shi nɔ ko bɛ ni atsimɔ nɔ ni ajieŋ lɛ kpo, aloo ni akɛtee ni aleŋ. 3No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛwie yɛ duŋ mli lɛ, aaanu yɛ la hiɛ; ni nɔ ni nyɛwie ablɛbi yɛ piai amli lɛ, aaashiɛ yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ.”
Mɔ gbeyei ni sa akɛ ashe
(Mateo 10.28-31)
4“Nyɛ, mishieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkashea mɛi ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛaanyɛ amɛfee dɔŋŋ lɛ. 5Shi matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ mɔ gbeyei ni nyɛshe: nyɛshea mɔ ni kɛ egbe sɛɛ ni eyɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ eshɛɔ efɔ̃ɔ abonsamiiaje lɛ. Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, lɛ gbeyei nyɛshea. 6Ani jeee pesewai enyɔ ahɔ̃ɔ aflimatai enumɔ aheɔ? Shi Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kpaaa amɛteŋ ekome flo nɔ. 7 Shi nyɛyiteŋ tsɔi tete akane fɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛjara wa fe aflimatai babaoo.’ ”
Kristo he odaseyeli yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ
(Mateo 10.32-33; 12.32; 10.19-20)
8“Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbaa mli tsiɔ mitã yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu aaagba mli atsi etã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ; 9 shi mɔ ni kwaa mi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, aaakwa lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ. 10 Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie wiemɔ ko ashi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ; shi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, mɔ ni aaawie musubɔɔ wiemɔ ashi lɛ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ. 11 Shi kɛ amɛkpala nyɛ kɛtee kpeehei lɛ kɛ lumɛi kɛ ogai ahiɛ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa yɛ bɔ ni nyɛaajie nyɛnaa nyɛhã aloo nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ he, 12ejaakɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛkɛɛ.”
Niiatsɛ kwashia lɛ he abɛ lɛ
13Ni mɔ ko jɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛɛmɔ minyɛmi lɛ ni ekɛ mi aja gboshinii lɛ.”
14Shi ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naanyo, namɔ womi kojolɔ loo nijalɔ yɛ nyɛnɔ?” 15 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ hiɛjoomɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ ahe; ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ nii ni ena ni eteke nɔ lɛ mli ewala yɔɔ.”
16Ni ebu amɛ abɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuu niiatsɛ ko shikpɔŋ ba nii babaoo. 17Ni esusu he ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, ‘Te mafee tɛŋŋ, akɛni mibɛ he ni mikɛ minibanii lɛ baato nɛɛ?’ 18Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nɔ ni mafee nɛ: mibakumɔ miboŋoi lɛ mashwie shi, ni mamamɔ ewuji ni mato minibaanii kɛ minii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi; 19ni makɛɛ misusuma akɛ, susuma, oyɛ nii kpakpai babaoo ni akɛto ahã bo afii pii; jɔɔmɔ ohe, ye ni onu, ni ona tsuijurɔ.’ 20 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwashia, nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ abaabi osusuma shi yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; ni nibii ni osaa oto lɛ, namɔ nɔ eeetsɔ̃?’ 21 Nakai mɔ ni bɔɔ jwetri ehãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, shi ejeee niiatsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ yɔɔ.”
Henaagbamɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ
(Mateo 6.25-34)
22Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ Nyɛkahaoa yɛ nyɛwala he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaaye hewɔ, aloo yɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawo hewɔ; 23ejaakɛ susuma lɛ fe ŋmaa, ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ hu fe atade. 24 Nyɛjwɛŋa kwãakwãalabitei lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ amɛduuu nii, asaŋ amɛkpaaa nii, ni amɛbɛ nitoohe loo aboŋo po, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛɔ amɛ; nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni nyɛjara wa aahu fe loofɔji! 25Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ aaanyɛ atsa ekɛlɛ naa ninetalɔ kome? 26Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ nɔ ni ji bibioo fe fɛɛ nyɛfee lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛgbaa nyɛhe naa yɛ nii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahe mɔ? 27 Nyɛjwɛŋa fɔfɔii lɛ ahe, amɛtsɛ̃ɛɛ kpãa; asaŋ amɛlooo mama; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Solomon kɛ enunyam lɛ fɛɛ tete ewulaaa tamɔ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ ekome. 28Agbɛnɛ kɛji jwɛi ni ŋmɛnɛ lɛ eyɛ ŋa nɔ ni wɔ ni akɛwo flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wulaa nɛkɛ lɛ, ani ewulaŋ nyɛ aahu fe amɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa? 29Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkadia nɔ ni nyɛaaye aloo nɔ ni nyɛaanu sɛɛ, ni asaŋ nyɛkafea yeyeeye; 30ejaakɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ diɔ; shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ le akɛ nii nɛɛ ahe miihia nyɛ. 31Moŋ nyɛtaoa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, ni aaaŋɔ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ afata he ahã nyɛ.
32 “Kaashe gbeyei, kuu bibioo; ejaakɛ nyɛTsɛ lɛ yɛ he tsuijurɔ akɛ eeeŋɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ehã nyɛ. 33 Nyɛhɔ̃a nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ ni nyɛkɛfea ejurɔ; nyɛfea fotroi ni tsɔ̃mɔɔɔ ememeji nyɛhãa nyɛhe, nyɛtoa jwetri ni etãaa yɛ ŋwɛi, he ni julɔ ko bɛŋkɛɛɛ ni omlɛgɛ kpeee nii yɛ lɛ. 34Ejaakɛ he ni nyɛjwetri lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi nyɛtsui hu aaahi.”
Tsuji anɔkwafoi
(Mateo 24.45-51)
35 “Nyɛfea klalo, ni nyɛhãa nyɛkanei lɛ atsoa; 36ni nyɛfea tamɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛnuŋtsɔ gbɛ, be mli ni eeejɛ yookpeemɔ lɛ eeba, koni, kɛ eba ni ebashi lɛ, ni amɛgbele lɛ oya. 37Ajɔɔ nakai tsuji lɛ ni be ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba lɛ eeebanina amɛ akɛ amɛmiishi kpe lɛ! Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ eeemĩa, ni eeehã amɛtara niyenii ahe, ni eeeba ebasɔ̃mɔ amɛ. 38Ni kɛji eba yɛ buube ni ji enyɔ aloo nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli ni ebanina amɛ nakai lɛ, ajɔɔ nakai tsuji lɛ! 39 Shi nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ akɛ, kɛji shĩatsɛ le nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni julɔ lɛ baa lɛ, kulɛ eeebu ni eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni agbu eshĩa lɛ awoŋ. 40No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛhiɛ kãaa nɔ lɛ nɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaba.”
41Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ kɛkɛ obuɔ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ, aloo mɛi lɛ fɛɛ?” 42Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Shi namɔ mɔ ji tsulɔnukpa anɔkwafo kɛ nilelɔ, ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaawo lɛ onukpa yɛ ewebii anɔ, koni ehã amɛ amɛniyenii yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ? 43Ajɔɔ nakai tsulɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ ba ni eeebanina lɛ akɛ eefee nakai lɛ. 44 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ eeewo lɛ onukpa yɛ enibii fɛɛ nɔ. 45Shi kɛji nakai tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Minuŋtsɔ lɛ miihã ebaabe lɛ miigbala shi’ ni eeebɔ̃i wehii kɛ weyei lɛ yii kɛ niyeli kɛ numɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ lɛ, 46nakai tsulɔ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba yɛ gbi nɔ ni ekwɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni eleee, ni eeefo emli enyɔ ni eeehã lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ.
47 “Shi nakai tsulɔ lɛ ni le enuŋtsɔ suɔmɔnaanii ni esaaa ehe etooo ni esaa efeee esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ aaayi lɛ kpãi pii; 48shi mɔ ni leee ni eyafee yiinii lɛ, aaayi lɛ fioo. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋɔ pii ahã lɛ, pii aaatao yɛ edɛŋ; ni mɔ ni atu pii awo edɛŋ lɛ, aaabi nɔ ni teke nɔ shi yɛ edɛŋ.”
Jeee hejɔlɛ shi mligbalamɔ
(Mateo 10.34-36)
49“Lawoo miba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mina ni kulɛ ehere momo! 50 Shi miyɛ baptisimɔ ko ni akɛbaabaptisi mi, ni kwɛ bɔ ni mihe hiaa mi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe naa!
51“Ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ hejɔlɛ hãmɔ miba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ? Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, dabida, shi mligbalamɔ moŋ. 52Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ benɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ mɛi enumɔ aaagba yɛ shĩa kome, mɛi etɛ̃ aaate shi awo mɛi enyɔ, ni mɛi enyɔ hu aaate shi awo mɛi etɛ̃. 53 Mligbalamɔ aaaba tsɛ kɛ ebinuu, kɛ binuu hu kɛ etsɛ teŋ; nyɛ kɛ biyoo kɛ biyoo hu kɛ nyɛ teŋ; shaayoo kɛ shaayoo, ebi ŋa lɛ, teŋ, kɛ lɛ hu kɛ eshaayoo, ewu nyɛ lɛ, teŋ.”
Bei lɛ ahe nilee
54 Ni ekɛɛ asafoi lɛ hu akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛna akɛ atatu miiwo yɛ anai lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ baanɛ;’ ni ebaa mli nakai; 55ni kɛ wuoyi kɔɔyɔɔ miitswa lɛ, nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Latsaa baaba;’ ni ebaa mli nakai. 56Osatofoi, nyɛle atatuiaŋ kɛ shikpɔŋ nibii ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ; shi te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛleee yinɔ nɛɛ shishitsɔɔmɔŋ?
Okɛ obelɔ lɛ atsa
(Mateo 5.25-26)
57“Ni mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkojooo nɔ ni ja gbɛ nyɛhãaa nyɛhe lɛ? 58 Shi kɛ okɛ obelɔ miiya lumɔ hiɛ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni okɛ lɛ asaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, koni ekashãtã bo eyahã kojolɔ lɛ, ni kojolɔ lɛ hu ŋɔ bo ehã apãbɔlɔ lɛ hu, ni apãbɔlɔ lɛ wo bo tsuŋ. 59Miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ojeŋ jɛi gbi ko gbi ko ja owo onaagbee pesewa lɛ dã.”

Title: LUKA 13
Content:
Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛhiɛ akakpãtã
1Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ jɛi ni gba lɛ Galileabii ni Pilato kɛ amɛlá futu amɛfɔlei lɛ amli lɛ ahe sane. 2 Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nɛkɛ Galileabii nɛɛ eshafeelɔi ji amɛ fe Galileabii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, hewɔ ni amɛna nɛkɛ amanehulu nɛɛ? 3 Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ebɛ mli nakai, shi moŋ kɛ nyɛtsakeee nyɛtsui lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã nakai nɔŋŋ. 4Aloo nyɛsusuɔ akɛ, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ ni Siloam mɔɔ lɛ ku shwie amɛnɔ ni egbe amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛ ji nɔtɔ̃lɔi fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm? 5Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ebɛ mli nakai, shi moŋ, kɛ nyɛtsakeee nyɛtsui lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã nakai nɔŋŋ.”
Agbãmitso lɛ he abɛ lɛ
6 Ni ebu amɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko tɛo agbãmitso yɛ ewaintrom mli ni eba enɔ yibii taomɔ lɛ, enaaa eko. 7Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ tromsaalɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, afii etɛ̃ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ mibaa mibataoɔ yibii yɛ agbãmitso nɛɛ nɔ, shi minaaa eko. Toomɔ ofɔ̃ shi! Mɛɛba hu ni egbeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ?’ 8 Shi tromsaalɔ lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, hã ni ehi shi afi nɛɛ hu, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni matsa ehewɔ kɛkpe ni mawo eshishi tumo, 9akɛ aleenɔ eeewo yibii afi nɛɛ lo; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, dani otoo lɛ ofɔ̃ shi.’ ”
Yoo ni edɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ tsamɔ
10Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, eetsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehei lɛ eko. 11Yoo ko yɛ jɛi ni mumɔ ni hãa mɔ gbɔjɔɔ ehi emli afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni edɔ kɔmɔɔ, ni enyɛɛɛ emli ekpã kwraa po. 12Be ni Yesu na lɛ lɛ, etsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yoo, afɛne bo kɛjɛ ohela lɛ mli!” 13 Ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ yoo lɛ jaje trɔmɔɔ, ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
14 Shi kpeehe onukpa lɛ mli wo la akɛni Yesu tsa mɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Gbii ekpaa yɔɔ ni sa akɛ atsuɔ nii yɛ mli no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa yɛ nomɛi amli, koni atsa nyɛ, shi jeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ!” 15 Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Osatofoi! Ani hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ fɛneee etsina loo eteji yɛ niyenii anɔ he ekpalaaa lɛ eyahãaa lɛ nu lo? 16Shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ ni ji Abraham biyoo ni Satan efi lɛ nɛkɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ani ejaaa akɛ afɛneɔ lɛ yɛ nɛkɛ kpãa nɛɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lo?” 17Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ehenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ gboi, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ yɛ anunyam nibii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ.
Sinapi wu kɛ masha lɛ
(Mateo 13.31-35; Marko 4.30-36)
18Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ, “Mɛni Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ, ni mɛni he mikɛaato? 19Etamɔ sinapi wu kuli ni nuu ko kɔ ni eyadu yɛ etrom mli, ni ekwɛ̃, ni efee tso kpele, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji ba bafee tsui yɛ eniji ateŋ.” 20Ni ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mɛni he mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaato? 21Etamɔ masha ni yoo ko kɔ ni ekɛhɔ ma tsesei etɛ̃ amli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni fɛɛ sha.”
Agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ
22Ni eyakpa maji kɛ akrowai amli etsɔ̃ɔ nii, ni etse mli kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm. 23Ni mɔ ko bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ani mɛi fioo kɛkɛ yiwala abaahere?” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 24 “Nyɛpelea agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ mlibotemɔ he, ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɛi pii aaatao mli abote shi amɛnyɛŋ. 25 Be mli ni shĩatsɛ lɛ ete shi eyaŋa shinaa lɛ, ni nyɛaabɔ̃i sɛɛdaamɔ kɛ shinaa lɛ shimɔ, ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, gbelemɔ wɔ!’ lɛ, eeehere nɔ ekɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Mileee he ni nyɛjɛ.’ 26 No lɛ nyɛbaabɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔye nii ni wɔnu nii yɛ ohiɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ wɔblohui amli.’ 27 Ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mileee he ni nyɛjɛ; nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtsuɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ!’ 28 Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi, be ni nyɛaana Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ashwie nyɛ kɛje kpo lɛ. 29 Ni mɛi aaajɛ bokã kɛ anai kɛ kooyi kɛ wuoyigbɛ aaaba ni amɛaabatara okplɔ̃ he yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. 30 Ni naa, sɛɛkpeebii yɛ ni baatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii, ni klɛŋklɛŋbii hu yɛ ni baatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpeebii.”
Yesu fo shwie Yerusalɛm nɔ
(Mateo 23.37-39)
31Nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Farisifoi lɛ ekomɛi ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee biɛ nɛɛ ni oya, ejaakɛ Herode miitao bo agbe.” 32Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa nakai osɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, miifãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ni miitsa mɛi ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ magbe naa.’ 33Shi kɛ̃lɛ ja minyiɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ kɛ wɔsɛɛ, ejaakɛ ebaŋ mli akɛ aaagbe gbalɔ ko yɛ he ko akɛ ja Yerusalɛm. 34Yerusalɛm, Yerusalɛm, bo mɔ ni ogbeɔ gbalɔi lɛ ni otswiaa mɛi ni atsuɔ amɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ atɛi, shii enyiɛ mitao akɛ mibuaa obii anaa, tamɔ bɔ ni wuɔ buaa ebii anaa ewoɔ efiji ashishi lɛ, ni nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ! 35 Naa, ashi nyɛwe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ahã nyɛ. Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli’ lɛ.”

Title: LUKA 14
Content:
Yesu tsa nuu ko ni yeɔ fuumɔhela
1 Be ni Yesu tee niyeli yɛ Farisifoi lɛ anukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome we yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛwɔɔ lɛ. 2Nuu ko yɛ ehiɛ ni eeye fuumɔhela. 3Ni Yesu bi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ akɛ, “Ani eja gbɛ akɛ atsaa mɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ aloo ejaaa gbɛ?” 4Shi amɛhãaa lɛ hetoo. Kɛkɛ ni emɔ helatsɛ lɛ mli ni etsa lɛ, ni ejie lɛ gbɛ. 5 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛji eteji loo etsina yagbee nubu mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eyajieŋ lɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ?” 6Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ enɛɛmɛi ahetoo amɛhã.
Ohiafoi ejurɔfeemɔ kɛ heshibaa he nitsɔɔmɔ
7Ni be ni eyoo bɔ ni amɛhalaa onukpai ataramɔhei lɛ, ebu mɛi ni akpee lɛ abɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 8 “Kɛ mɔ ko bakpee bo kɛtee yookpeemɔ okplɔ̃ he lɛ, kaayata yitso gbɛ, ekolɛ aleee nɔ ekpee mɔ ko ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam fe bo, 9ni mɔ ni bakpee bo kɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ akaba ni ebakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Hã mɔ nɛ gbɛ!’ No lɛ okɛ hiɛgbele aaayata shishi gbɛ. 10Shi moŋ, kɛji akpee bo lɛ, yaa ni oyata shishi gbɛ, koni kɛ mɔ ni bakpee bo lɛ ba lɛ, ebakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Shieŋtsɛ, ba yitso gbɛ.’ No lɛ ohiɛ aaaba nyam yɛ mɛi ni okɛtara shi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ. 11 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ, aaaba lɛ shi, ni mɔ ni baa ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ.”
12Shi ekɛɛ mɔ ni kpee lɛ lɛ hu akɛ, “Kɛ oŋmɛ shwane loo gbɛkɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kaatsɛ oshieŋtsɛmɛi loo onyɛmimɛi loo owekumɛi loo okutsoŋ niiatsɛmɛi ni aleenɔ amɛ hu amɛkpee bo eko amɛto najiaŋ. 13 Shi kɛ oŋmɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kpeemɔ ohiafoi kɛ kpajelɔi kɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛ shwilafoi moŋ, 14 ni aaajɔɔ bo, akɛni amɛ lɛ amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛaato bo najiaŋ lɛ; ejaakɛ aaato bo najiaŋ yɛ jalɔi ashitee lɛ mli.”
Okplɔŋmɛɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ
(Mateo 22.1-10)
15 Ni be ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii ashi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nu nii nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ aboloo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!” 16Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuu ko ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple, ni ekpee mɛi pii; 17ni be ni shɛ niyeli be lɛ, etsu etsulɔ akɛ eyakɛɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa, ejaakɛ agbe nibii lɛ fɛɛ naa.’ 18Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bɔ̃i enaa jiemɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ ‘Mihe shikpɔŋ ko ni ehia akɛ maya ni mayakwɛ; miikpa bo fai ni ona ohã mi.’
19“Ni mɔ kroko kɛɛ, ‘Mihe tsina ntai enumɔ, ni miiya mayaka amɛ makwɛ; miikpa bo fai ni ona ohã mi.’ 20 Ni mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ, ‘Mikpee yoo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, minyɛŋ maba.’ 21Ni tsulɔ lɛ ba ni ebagba enuŋtsɔ lɛ nii nɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni shĩatsɛ lɛ mli fu, ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jee kpo mramra kɛya maŋ lɛ mli blohui lɛ kɛ fɔji lɛ amli, ni oyakpee ohiafoi kɛ kpajelɔi kɛ shwilafoi kɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛba biɛ!’ 22Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, afee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ gbɛ yɛ lolo.’ 23Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ ‘Jee kpo oya gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kɛ afãbai lɛ ahe ni oyanyɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛba, koni miwe lɛ ayi tɔ. 24Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko sa miniyenii lɛ anaa fii!’ ”
Yesu sɛɛnyiɛmɔ biɔ hekwamɔ
25Be ko be ni mɛi pii kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 26 “Kɛji mɔ ko miiba miŋɔɔ ni enyɛɛɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii kɛ enyɛmimɛi yei kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma hu tete lɛ, enyɛŋ etsɔ̃ mikaselɔ. 27 Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tereee esɛŋmɔtso kɛnyiɛɛɛ misɛɛ lɛ, enyɛŋ mikaselɔ etsɔ̃. 28Ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eetao mɔɔ ema lɛ, etaŋ shi ni ebu naa ekwɛ dã akɛ eyɛ nii bɔ ni ekɛaagbe naa lo? 29Koni ekaba akɛ be ni eje shishi ni eyanyɛɛɛ naa egbe lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ babɔ̃i ehefɛoyeli akɛ, 30‘Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ bɔ̃i mɔɔ maa, shi enyɛɛɛ naa egbe.’ 31Aloo mɛɛ maŋtsɛ ni kɛji ekɛ maŋtsɛ kroko yaawu lɛ etaŋ shi ni esusu he dã akɛ eeenyɛ ekɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ mɔ ni kɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ baa eŋɔɔ lɛ ayakpe lo? 32Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, be ni mɔ kome lɛ nyiɛ shɔŋŋ kɛbaa lɛ, eeetsu bɔfoi kɛya eŋɔɔ eyakpa kpãtãmɔ he fai. 33Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaaa nibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ enyɛŋ mikaselɔ etsɔ̃.”
Ŋoo ni naanu egbo
34“Ŋoo hi; shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni akɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ? 35Esaaa shikpɔŋ loo tumo nɔ tete; tsi atsiɔ ashwieɔ. Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!”

Title: LUKA 15
Content:
Too ni laaje lɛ he abɛ lɛ
(Mateo 18.10-14)
1Agbɛnɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i tsimɔ kɛ lɛ bɛŋkɛmɔ ni amɛbabo lɛ toi. 2Shi Farisifoi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛkɛɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ hereɔ eshafeelɔi atuu ni ekɛ amɛ yeɔ nii.” 3 Ni ebu amɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ ekɛɛ, 4“Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eyɛ toi oha ni amɛteŋ ekome laaje lɛ, eshiŋ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni eyatao nɔ ni elaaje lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeena lɛ? 5Ni kɛ ena lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ lɛ etswaa ekɔ̃ŋ, ni enaa miishɛɛ; 6ni kɛ eba shĩa lɛ, etsɛɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ ekuŋbii kɛkpeɔ, ni ekɛɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ mi anaa miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ mina mitoo ni laaje lɛ.’ 7Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nakai nɔŋŋ miishɛɛ aaaba ŋwɛi yɛ eshafeelɔ kome ni tsakeɔ etsui lɛ hewɔ fe jalɔi nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu ni tsuitsakemɔ he ehiaaa amɛ lɛ.”
Jwiɛtɛi kuku ni laaje lɛ he abɛ lɛ
8“Aloo mɛɛ yoo ni yɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋma, ni kɛji kuku kome laaje lɛ, ni esuŋ kane ni ebɛɛ shĩa lɛ mli fitsofitso ni etao kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeena? 9Ni kɛ ena lɛ, etsɛɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ ekuŋbii kɛkpeɔ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ mi anaa miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ mina mijwiɛtɛi kuku ni laaje lɛ.’ 10 Nakai nɔŋŋ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ naa miishɛɛ yɛ eshafeelɔ kome ni tsakeɔ etsui lɛ hewɔ.”
Bi nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ
11Yesu saa ekɛɛ, “Nuu ko yɛ bihii enyɔ. 12Ni amɛteŋ gbekɛ̃ lɛ kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, ‘Ataa, hã mi onii lɛ amli nɔ ni ji migbɛfaŋnɔ.’ Ni eja nii lɛ amli ehã amɛ. 13 No sɛɛ lɛ, yeee gbi ko kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ̃ lɛ bua fɛɛ naa, ni edom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ko, ni jɛi ekɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ yakpãtã enii lɛ ahiɛ yɛ. 14Shi be ni efite fɛɛ lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ni naa wa ko bate shi yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni ebɔ̃i lɛ fimɔ. 15Ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ ehe yakpɛtɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ eko he; ni ehã etee ebɔi lɛ amli ni eyalɛ kplotoi. 16 Ni eba etsine akɛ kulɛ ena yɔɔ ni kplotoi lɛ yeɔ lɛ eko eye ni etɔ, shi mɔ ko hãaa lɛ. 17Shi be ni ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, ‘Apaafoi enyiɛ mitsɛ bɛ ni naa niyenii yeɔ ni eko shwɛɔ, ni hɔ̃mɔ gbeɔ mi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ! 18 Mate shi matee mitsɛ ŋɔɔ ni mayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, mifee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha ni mifee esha mishi bo, 19ni misaaa mɔ ni atsɛɔ mi obi dɔŋŋ; ŋɔɔ mi ofee tamɔ opaafoi lɛ eko.” ’ 20Ni ete shi ni eyiŋ eba etsɛ ŋɔɔ. Shi be ni enyiɛ shɔŋŋ kɛbaa lɛ, etsɛ na lɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ, ni esha foi ni eyafua lɛ atuu, ni eshwɔshwɔɔ enaa. 21Ni ebi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ataa, mifee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha ni mifee esha, mishi bo, ni misaaa mɔ ni atsɛɔ mi obi dɔŋŋ!’ 22Shi tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛyajiea atade ni yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛbaa mramra, ni nyɛkɛbawoa lɛ, ni nyɛwo enine kpotia kɛ enaji hu tokotai; 23ni nyɛkɛ tsinabi ni ewo fɔ lɛ abaa nyɛbagbea, ni nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnaa tsuijurɔ; 24 ejaakɛ mibi nɛɛ gbo, ni ehiɛ etsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ; elaaje, ni ana lɛ.’ Ni amɛbɔ̃i nyamɔ.
25“Shi ebi nukpa lɛ yɛ ŋmɔshi. Ni be ni ebaa ni ebabɛŋkɛ shĩa lɛ, enu saŋkui kɛ joi ahe, 26ni etsɛ tsuji lɛ eko kɛba, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni afeɔ nɛɛ?’ 27Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Onyɛmi lɛ eba, ni otsɛ egbe tsinabi ni ewo fɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eshɛ edɛŋ kpiŋtiŋŋ.’ 28 Ni bi nukpa lɛ mli fu, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ shĩa lɛ yaa. No hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ je kpo ni ebakpa lɛ fai. 29Shi ehere nɔ ni ekɛɛ etsɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ afii abɔ sɔŋŋ ni misɔ̃mɔ bo, ni mitɔ̃ko okitã ko nɔ dã, ni mi lɛ, ohãko mi too abotiabi po dã, koni mi kɛ mishieŋtsɛmɛi ana tsuijurɔ; 30shi ŋmɛnɛ ni nɛkɛ obi nɛɛ ni kɛ ajwamãŋi eyaye onii lɛ ba lɛ, ogbe tsinabi ni ewo fɔ lɛ ohã lɛ.’ 31Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mibi, bo lɛ, okɛ mi yɔɔ daa nɛɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ onɔŋ; 32shi esa akɛ wɔnya ni wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe, ejaakɛ onyɛmi nɛɛ gbo, ni ehiɛ etsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ, elaaje, ni ana lɛ.’ ”

Title: LUKA 16
Content:
Tsulɔnukpa kutumpɔfo lɛ he abɛ lɛ
1Yesu saa kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Niiatsɛ ko ni yɔɔ, ni eyɛ tsulɔnukpa, ni abafolɔ enaa ahã lɛ akɛ eekpãtã enii ahiɛ. 2Ni etsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni minuɔ yɛ ohe nɛɛ? Baabu onukpayeli lɛ he akɔntaa ejaakɛ onyɛŋ onukpa lɛ oye dɔŋŋ.’ 3Ni tsulɔnukpa lɛ kɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, ‘Akɛni minuŋtsɔ shɔ̃ɔ onukpayeli lɛ yɛ midɛŋ nɛɛ, te mafee tɛŋŋ? Minyɛŋ shi matsa, ni sisɛ̃mɔ hu miifee mi hiɛgbele. 4Mile nɔ ni mafee ni kɛ akpa mi onukpayeli lɛ ni mɛi ahere mi yɛ amɛshĩaiaŋ.’ 5Ni etsɛ enuŋtsɔ nyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba ekomekome, ni ebi klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɔmɔ enyiɛ ohiɛ minuŋtsɔ lɛ?’ 6Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Mu tɔi oha.’ Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Hemɔ owolo lɛ ni ota shi mramra ni oŋma nyɔŋmai enumɔ.’ 7No sɛɛ lɛ, ebi mɔ kroko hu akɛ, ‘Shi bo hu enyiɛ ohiɛ?’ Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Ŋmaa flɔtɔi oha.’ Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Hemɔ owolo lɛ ni oŋma nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.’ 8 Ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie tsulɔnukpa kutumpɔfo lɛ yi akɛ eye sane lɛ ŋaa mli. Ejaakɛ je nɛɛŋ bii lɛ kɛ amɛyinɔbii lɛ yeɔ yɛ ŋaa mli fe la bii lɛ.
9 “Ni mi hu miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛŋɔa kutumpɔo ninamɔ lɛ nyɛkɛfea shieŋtsɛmɛi nyɛhãa nyɛhe, koni, be ni nyɛbɛ nɔ ko dɔŋŋ lɛ, amɛhere nyɛ yɛ naanɔ bui lɛ amli. 10 Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ ko bibioo mli anɔkwa lɛ, eyeɔ babaoo hu mli anɔkwa; ni mɔ ni yeee nɔ ko bibioo mli anɔkwa lɛ, eyeee babaoo hu mli anɔkwa. 11No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛyeko kutumpɔo ninamɔ lɛ po mli anɔkwa lɛ, nɔ ni ji anɔkwa ninamɔ lɛ, namɔ aaatu no awo nyɛdɛŋ? 12Ni kɛ nyɛyeko mɔ kroko nɔ mli anɔkwa lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, namɔ kɛaahã nyɛ? 13 Wenuu ko nyɛŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi enyɔ asɔ̃mɔ; ejaakɛ no lɛ eeenyɛ mɔ kome ni eeesumɔ mɔ kome lɛ, aloo eeekpɛtɛ mɔ kome he, ni eeegbe mɔ kome lɛ he guɔ. Nyɛnyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ninamɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔ.”
Yesu kã Farisifoi lɛ ahiɛ
14 Farisifoi lɛ hu ni ji shika suɔlɔi lɛ nu nii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛye lɛ ahi. 15 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ ji mɛi ni nyɛbuɔ nyɛhe bem yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ; shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ele nyɛtsuiaŋ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni ji gojoo yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ nihiinii ni.
16 “Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yɔɔ nɔ kɛbashi Yohane nɔ; kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ nɔ nɛɛ aashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ boteɔ mli ekãa naa. 17 Shi ejaraaa akɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ aaaho aya fe nɔ ni Mla lɛ mli kuli kome aaaje mli.
18 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni eyaŋɔɔ mɔ kroko lɛ efite gbãlã, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mɔ ni ewu eshwie lɛ lɛ, lɛ hu efite gbãlã.”
Niiatsɛ lɛ kɛ Lazaro
19“Nuu niiatsɛ ko ni yɔɔ, ni ewoɔ atade tsuru kɛ atade yɛŋ fɛɛfɛo, ni ekɛ ŋɔɔmɔnii kpakpai ayeli naa tsuijurɔ daa gbi. 20Ni ohiafo ko hu yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lazaro ni akɛ lɛ ebaŋmɛ egbo lɛ naa kɛ ehe faji obɔ̃, 21ni ebaa etsine akɛ ena ŋmaa fufuji ni jɛɔ niiatsɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ shwieɔ shi lɛ eye; shi gbei tete baa balɛmɔ̃ɔ efaji lɛ anɔ. 22Ni ohiafo lɛ bagbo, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi bawo lɛ kɛtee Abraham mlishi; ni niiatsɛ lɛ hu bagbo ni afu lɛ. 23Ni be ni eyɔɔ hejaramɔi amli yɛ gbohiiaje ni eyaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena Abraham yɛ shɔŋŋ, kɛ Lazaro ni hɔ emlishi. 24Ni ebo ekɛɛ, ‘Ataa Abraham, naa mi mɔbɔ ni otsu Lazaro ni ekɛ ewao naa ayatsɔ nu mli ni ekɛbajɔɔ mililɛi he, ejaakɛ miina nɔ yɛ lalilɛii nɛɛ amli!’ 25Shi Abraham kɛɛ, ‘Mibi, kaimɔ akɛ bo lɛ oye ejurɔ yɛ owalabe mli, shi Lazaro na nɔ; shi agbɛnɛ aashɛje emii yɛ biɛ, ni bo lɛ, aapiŋ bo. 26Ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ hu lɛ, jɔɔ kpeteŋkple ko kã wɔ kɛ nyɛ teŋ, koni mɛi ni taoɔ ajɛ biɛ aya nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ akanyɛ, ni mɛi hu ni taoɔ ajɛ afoŋ kɛba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ akanyɛ.’ 27Shi niiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Belɛ miikpa bo fai mɔ, ataa, ni otsu lɛ mitsɛ we lɛ; 28ejaakɛ miyɛ nyɛmimɛi enumɔ, bɔ ni afee ni eyaye odase kɛbɔ amɛ kɔkɔ koni amɛ hu amɛkaba piŋmɔhe nɛɛ.’ 29 Ni Abraham kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Amɛyɛ Mose kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛbo amɛ toi!’ 30Shi lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Dabi, Ataa Abraham, shi kɛji mɔ ko jɛ gbohii ateŋ tee amɛŋɔɔ lɛ, no amɛaatsake amɛtsui.’ 31Shi Abraham kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛ amɛbooo Mose kɛ gbalɔi lɛ toi lɛ, no lɛ kɛji mɔ ko te shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ tete lɛ, amɛyiŋ tsɔŋ.’ ”

Title: LUKA 17
Content:
Nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ
1Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Be fɛɛ be ni fee lɛ nibii ni hãa nane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ baaba; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛbaa lɛ! 2 Aaawa ahã lɛ fe nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni ayashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃tɔ̃ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nane lɛ.”
Mɔ kɛ enyɛmi ni etɔ̃ enɔ teŋ saamɔ
3 “Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia! Kɛji onyɛmi tɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, kã ehiɛ; ni kɛji eshwa ehe lɛ kɛfa lɛ. 4 Ni kɛji etɔ̃ onɔ shii kpawo gbi kome, ni shii kpawo hu gbi kome esaa eku esɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Mishwa mihe’ lɛ, kɛfa lɛ.”
Hemɔkɛyeli
5 Ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Fatamɔ wɔhemɔkɛyeli he ohã wɔ!” 6 Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli tamɔ sinapi wu kuli lɛ, kulɛ nyɛaakɛɛ oduŋ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Fãa kɛ oshishifãi ni oyama ŋshɔŋ!’ Ni eeebo nyɛ toi.”
Tsulɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ
7“Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ yɔɔ tsulɔ ni ekɛ tsina kɔi miihu aloo eekwɛ kooloi, ni kɛji ejɛ ŋmɔshi eba pɛ lɛ, eeekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Baata shi mramra ni oye nii,’ 8shi ekɛŋ lɛ moŋ akɛ, ‘Too nii ohã mi ni omĩa koni osɔ̃mɔ mi kɛyashi maye nii ni manu nɔ ko; no sɛɛ koni bo hu oye nii ni onu nɔ ko lo?’ 9Ani eeeda nakai tsulɔ lɛ shi akɛ efee nɔ ni afã lɛ lɛ? Mikpaaa shi. 10Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni afã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Tsuji ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko ji wɔ; nɔ ni ji wɔgbɛnaa akɛ wɔtsuɔ lɛ, no pɛ wɔtsu nɛɛ.’ ”
Kpitiyelɔi nyɔŋma lɛ atsamɔ
11 Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni enyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa Yerusalɛm lɛ, eyatsɔ̃ Samaria kɛ Galilea teŋ. 12 Ni be ni eyabote maŋ ko mli lɛ, hii kpitiyelɔi nyɔŋma kɛ lɛ kpe; ni amɛdamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, 13ni amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” 14 Ni be ni ena amɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ayatsɔ̃a osɔfoi lɛ.” Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni amɛyaa lɛ, amɛhe tã. 15Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ, be ni ena akɛ atsa lɛ lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛba, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa bawo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam. 16Ni ekɛ ehiɛ babu shi yɛ Yesu najianaa ni eda lɛ shi. Shi mɔ nɛ lɛ Samarianyo ni. 17Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɛi nyɔŋma he tã lɛ? Shi mɛi nɛɛhu lɛ, nɛgbɛ amɛyɔɔ? 18Aso anaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni kuɔ esɛɛ ekɛ anunyam bahãa Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ ja maŋsɛɛnyo nɛɛ? 19 Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tee shi ni oya; ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo!’ ”
Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, eyɛ nyɛteŋ
20 Ni Farisifoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Te be ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baaba lɛ?” Eto he ehã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baaa tamɔ nɔ ko ni anaa; 21 ni asaŋ amɛkɛŋ akɛ, ‘Naa, eyɛ biɛ! Loo biɛ!’ Ejaakɛ naa, Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eyɛ nyɛteŋ.”
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbi lɛ
22Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Gbii aaaba ni nyɛaashwe ni nyɛna Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbii lɛ ekome, ni nyɛnaŋ. 23Ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, eyɛ biɛ loo eyɛ jɛi!’ Nyɛkayaa ni nyɛkanyiɛa sɛɛ. 24Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni kɛ srawa gba ni ekpɛɔ nyram kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi afã kome kɛyaa afã kroko lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baatamɔ yɛ egbi lɛ nɔ. 25Shi klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ ja ena amanehulu babaoo ni nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ kwa lɛ. 26 Ni bɔ ni eba yɛ Noa gbii lɛ amli lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ebaaba yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbii lɛ amli hu; 27 amɛmiiyeyee nii, amɛmiinunuu dãi, amɛmiiŋɔŋɔɔ yei, ni akɛ yei miihãhãa gbãlã kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni Noa bote adeka lɛ mli ni nu afua lɛ ba ni ebakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛhiɛ lɛ. 28Etamɔ bɔ ni eba yɛ Lot gbii lɛ amli hu lɛ, Amɛmiiyeyee nii, amɛmiinunuu dãi, amɛmiihehee nii amɛmiihɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ nii, amɛmiitɛo tsei ni amɛmiimamɔmamɔɔ tsui; 29 shi gbi nɔ ni Lot je Sodom lɛ, la kɛ swɔɔ nɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, ni ekpãtã amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛhiɛ. 30Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ ebaaba gbi ni aaajie Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ kpo lɛ.
31 “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ ni enii yɔɔ shĩa lɛ akakpleke shi ebakɔlɔ, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi hu akaku esɛɛ kɛmiiba. 32 Nyɛkaia Lot ŋa lɛ! 33 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ebaa ewala yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaalaaje lɛ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala. 34Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ mɛi enyɔ aaakãmɔ saa kome nɔ: aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome. 35 Yei enyɔ aaawiɛ yɛ he kome, aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome.”
[36Mɛi enyɔ aaahi ŋmɔshi, aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome.] 37 Ni amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ?” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “He ni gbonyo kã lɛ, jɛi akpaŋai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ.”

Title: LUKA 18
Content:
Yoo okulafo lɛ kɛ kojolɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ
1 Yesu bu ekaselɔi lɛ abɛ ko ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ esa akɛ amɛsɔleɔ daa ni ekaje amɛtsine.
2Ekɛɛ, “Kojolɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko nɔ, ni esheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni asaŋ ebuuu gbɔmɔ ko. 3Ni yoo okulafo ko yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli, ni eba eŋɔɔ shii abɔ ebakɛɛ, ‘Fã mihe kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔ lɛ adɛŋ!’ 4Ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ aahu. Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, ‘Yɛŋ akɛ misheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni mibuuu gbɔmɔ hu moŋ nɛ, 5 shi akɛni yoo okulafo nɛɛ miigba minaa hewɔ lɛ, mafã ehe, koni, be ni yi aaawula shi lɛ, ekaba ni ebashwie mihiɛ ma.’ ” 6Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛnu nɔ ni kojolɔ kutumpɔfo lɛ kɛɛ! 7Ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɛ aahu tete kɛ ehalamɔbii ni bolɔɔ tsɛɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ ayelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, aso ebafãŋ amɛhe? 8Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ eeefã amɛhe oya. Shi be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba lɛ, ani eeebana hemɔkɛyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ?”
Farisifonyo lɛ kɛ toohelɔ lɛ
9Asaŋ ebu mɛi komɛi ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe nɔ akɛ jalɔi ji amɛ ni amɛgbeɔ mɛi krokomɛi ahe guɔ lɛ hu abɛ nɛɛ, 10“Mɛi enyɔ yiŋ tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni amɛyasɔle; mɔ kome lɛ Farisifonyo ji lɛ, ni mɔ kome hu lɛ toohelɔŋ. 11 Farisifonyo lɛ yadamɔ shi, ni esɔle nɛkɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ, miida bo shi akɛ mitamɔ̃ɔɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, ojotswalɔi, kutumpɔfoi, gbãlãfitelɔi, loo tamɔ nɛkɛ toohelɔ nɛɛ po; 12 mihiɔ ŋmaa shii enyɔ yɛ otsi mli, miŋɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ni minaa lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mihãa.’ 13 Shi toohelɔ lɛ damɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni emiii ni ewoɔ ehiɛ nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi tete; shi moŋ eshimɔ etsitsi ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi ni ji eshafeelɔ lɛ akpãtã!’ 14 Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ yiŋ etee ewe ni abu lɛ bem fe mɔ kome lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ aaaba lɛ shi, shi mɔ ni baa ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ.”
Yesu jɔɔ gbekɛbii bibii
(Mateo 19.13-15; Marko 10.13-16)
15Ni akɛ abifabii hu ba eŋɔɔ, koni etara amɛhe; shi be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ, amɛnyafi amɛ. 16Shi Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ. 17 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ gbekɛ ko lɛ, eboteŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa.”
Maŋ onukpa niiatsɛ lɛ
(Mateo 19.16-30; Marko 10.17-30)
18Ni onukpa ko babi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni mafee, koni mana naanɔ wala?” 19Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ otsɛɔ mi mɔ kpakpa? Mɔ kpakpa ko bɛ akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ. 20 Ole kitãi lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaafite gbãlã; kaagbe gbɔmɔ; kaaju; kaaye amale odase; wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ.’ ” 21Shi ekɛɛ, “Miye enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ anɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi.” 22 Ni be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eshwɛ bo nɔ kome lolo; yaahɔ̃ɔ nibii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ lɛ ni okɛ shika lɛ aja ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba obanyiɛ misɛɛ.” 23Shi be ni enu enɛ lɛ, ewerɛ ho ehe naakpa, ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
24Agbɛnɛ be ni Yesu na akɛ ewerɛ eho ehe lɛ ekɛɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni ewa hã mɛi ni yɔɔ nii akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli! 25Ejaakɛ ejaraaa hãaa yooma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli tamɔ bɔ ni ejaraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” 26Shi mɛi ni nu lɛ kɛɛ, “Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?” 27Shi ekɛɛ, “Nibii ni gbɔmɛi nyɛɛɛ afee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ enyɛɔ efeɔ.”
28Ni Petro kɛɛ, “Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi wɔnii ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ.” 29Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ko bɛ ni eshi shĩa loo ŋa loo nyɛmimɛi loo fɔlɔi loo bii yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewɔ 30ni enaŋ najiaŋtoo shii abɔ yɛ be nɛɛ mli, ni jeŋ ni baa lɛ mli hu enaŋ naanɔ wala.”
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he nɔ ni ji shi etɛ̃
(Mateo 20.17-19; Marko 10.32-34)
31 Agbɛnɛ etsɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba emasɛi ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni aaagbe nibii fɛɛ ni gbalɔi lɛ eŋma yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ he lɛ naa. 32Ejaakɛ abaajie lɛ awo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ; ni aaaye ehe fɛo ni aaafee lɛ niseniianii ni aaafɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ashwie ehe, 33ni amɛkɛ kpelebii aaayi lɛ ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ eeete shi ekoŋŋ.” 34 Shi amɛ lɛ amɛnaaa nii nɛɛ ateŋ ekomeflo shishi, ni akɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ etee amɛ, ni amɛyooo wiemɔi ni ewie lɛ asɛɛ!
Yesu tsa shwilafo ko
(Mateo 20.29-34; Marko 10.46-52)
35Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ebɛŋkɛ Yeriko lɛ, shwilafo ko ta gbɛ lɛ toi eebala nii, 36Ni be ni shwilafo lɛ nu akɛ mɛi pii miiho lɛ, ebi nɔ ni ji. 37Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ miiho.” 38Ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Yesu, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” 39Ni mɛi ni nyiɛ hiɛ lɛ fãmɔ eyi akɛ emua enaa; shi ebolɔ babaoo moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” 40Ni Yesu wa damɔ shi, ni efã akɛ akɛ lɛ aba. Ni be ni ebɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ, Yesu bi lɛ 41akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã bo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ mana nii ekoŋŋ.” 42 Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa nii, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo!”
43Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ena nii, ni enyiɛ esɛɛ ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam; ni be ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛ jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi.

Title: LUKA 19
Content:
Yesu kɛ Zakeo
1Yesu yabote Yeriko ni eefoŋ. 2Ni nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zakeo, ni toohelɔ nukpa ji lɛ, ni ena nii hu. 3Ni eetao Yesu ena ni ele lɛ, shi mɛi pii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ kpitioo ji lɛ. 4Ni esha foi kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ, ni eyakwɔ agbãmitso koni ena lɛ, ejaakɛ jɛi gbɛ ebaatsɔ̃. 5Ni be ni Yesu shɛ jɛi lɛ, ewo ehiɛ nɔ ni ena lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Zakeo, ohe afee oya ni okpeleke shi, ejaakɛ owe lɛ sa akɛ mato ŋmɛnɛ.” 6Ni ehe fee oya ni ekpeleke shi, ni ehere lɛ atuu. 7 Ni be ni mɛi na lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛwie huhuuhu amɛkɛɛ, “Eyato nuu eshafeelɔ ŋɔɔ.” 8 Shi Zakeo ho damɔ shi ni ekɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa, miiŋɔ minii fã make ohiafoi, ni kɛji mikɛ yaka naafolɔmɔ eshɔ̃ mɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, miiku mabɔ he toi ejwɛ mahã lɛ.” 9 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ yiwalaheremɔ eba shĩa nɛɛ, akɛni lɛ hu Abraham bi ji lɛ lɛ. 10 Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba nɔ ni elaaje lɛ taomɔ kɛ eyiwalaheremɔ.”
Menai nyɔŋma lɛ he abɛ lɛ
(Mateo 25.14-30)
11 Shi be ni amɛboɔ nii nɛɛ toi lɛ, ebu abɛ ko eshi nɔ, ejaakɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛsusu akɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baapue. 12 No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ablade ko dom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ ni eyaŋɔ emaŋtsɛyeli ni eku esɛɛ eba. 13Ni etsɛ etsuji nyɔŋma, ni ejie menai nyɔŋma ehã amɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa he kɛyashi maba.’ 14 Shi emaŋbii lɛ nyɛ lɛ, ni amɛtsu bɔfoi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛyakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔsumɔɔɔ ni mɔ nɛ abaye wɔnɔ maŋtsɛ.’
15“Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni enine eyashɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, efã akɛ atsɛ tsuji lɛ ni ekɛ shika lɛ hã lɛ kɛba, koni ena nɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ena yɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli. 16Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ ba ni ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, omena lɛ efɔ menai nyɔŋma ewoŋ.’ 17 Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Aekoo tsulɔ kpakpa! Akɛni oye anɔkwa yɛ nɔ ko bibioo mli hewɔ lɛ, ye maji nyɔŋma anɔ.’ 18Ni mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ba ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, omena lɛ efɔ menai enumɔ ewoŋ.’ 19Ni lɛ hu ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Bo hu ye maji enumɔ anɔ.’ 20Ni mɔ kroko hu ba ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, naa, omena lɛ ni mifi miwo mama naa kɛto lɛ nɛ; 21miyashe bo gbeyei, ejaakɛ yiwalɔ ji bo, okɔɔ nɔ ni okɛfɔ̃ko shi, ni okpaa nɔ ni oduko.’ 22Shi ablade lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Tsulɔ fɔ̃ŋ, bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ mikɛaakojo bo! Ni ole akɛ yiwalɔ ji mi, ni mikɔɔ nɔ ni mikɛfɔ̃ko shi, ni mikpaa nɔ ni miduko lɛ, 23mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni okɛ mishika lɛ eyawooo shikatoohe lɛ, koni kɛ miba lɛ, ni mibahe minii kɛ ehekpa?’ 24Ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛshɔ̃a mena lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛhãa mɔ ni yɔɔ menai nyɔŋma lɛ.’ 25Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ menai nyɔŋma.’ 26 ‘Eyɛ mli nakai, shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ aaahã; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete aaashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ.’
27“Shi nakai mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ miye amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ abaa biɛ ni nyɛbagbea amɛ yɛ mihiɛ nɛɛ!”
Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ
(Mateo 21.1-11; Marko 11.1-11; Yohane 12.12-19)
28Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, eho eyi hiɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm. 29Be ni ebɛŋkɛ Betfage kɛ Betania yɛ gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, 30ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ lɛ mli, ni kɛ nyɛbote mli lɛ nyɛaana tejibi ni mɔ ko tako enɔ pɛŋ ŋmɔ shi yɛ jɛi; nyɛfɛnea lɛ ni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa. 31Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi nyɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba nyɛfɛneɔ lɛ?’ lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.’ ” 32Ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ. 33Shi be ni amɛfɛneɔ tejibi lɛ, mɛi anɔ ni ji lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛfɛneɔ tejibi lɛ?” 34Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.” 35Ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei shwie tejibi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛwo Yesu amɛta nɔ. 36Ni be ni eyaa lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛtadei ha gbɛ lɛ nɔ. 37Ni be ni ebɛŋkɛ he ni akpelekeɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ, ekaselɔi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i nyamɔ ni amɛkɛ gbee ni wa jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, yɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni amɛna lɛ hewɔ, 38 amɛkɛɛ,
“Ajɔɔ maŋtsɛ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ!
Hejɔlɛ yɛ ŋwɛi,
ni anunyam yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!”
39Ni Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi jɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kã okaselɔi lɛ.” 40Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛɛ akɛ, kɛji mɛnɛɛmɛi aaamua amɛnaa lɛ, no lɛ tɛi aaabolɔ.”
41 Ni be ni eshɛ etã ni ena maŋ lɛ, efo eshwie enɔ, 42 ni ekɛɛ, “Eji yɛ ogbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ona ole nii ni hi hã ohejɔlɛ lɛ kulɛ! Shi agbɛnɛ akɛtee bo. 43Shi gbii miiba, ni ohenyɛlɔi lɛ aaatsa bu awo ohe, ni amɛaabɔle bo kpula ni amɛaasa oyi yɛ he fɛɛ he, 44 ni amɛaaŋɔ bo amɛtswa shi kɛ obii ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, ni amɛshiŋ tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ yɛ omli, ejaakɛ oyooo oduromɔ saramɔbe lɛ!”
Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he
(Mateo 21.12-17; Marko 11.15-19; Yohane 2.13-22)
45Ni Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni ebɔ̃i mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ nii yɛ jɛi lɛ shwiemɔ, 46 ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Miwe lɛ Sɔlemɔ we ni’; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu.” 47 Ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii daa nɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ miitao ehiɛ amɛkpãtã; 48 shi amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee, ejaakɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpɛtɛ lɛ ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi.

Title: LUKA 20
Content:
Hegbɛ ni Yesu yɔɔ
(Mateo 21.23-27; Marko 11.27-33)
1Gbi lɛ eko be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni ejajeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ba, 2ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ nɔ hegbɛ ni oyɔɔ hewɔ ni ofeɔ nii nɛɛ, ni namɔ ji mɔ ni hã bo nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ?” 3Ni eto he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mibabi nyɛ sane ko, ni nyɛhãa mi hetoo: 4Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ, ani ŋwɛi ejɛ aloo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ?” 5Shi amɛhala mli yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeekɛɛ, ‘Mɛɛba ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee mɔ?’ 6Ni asaŋ kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ aaatswia wɔ tɛi; ejaakɛ amɛyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ; Yohane lɛ, gbalɔ ji lɛ.” 7Ni amɛto he akɛ amɛleee he ni ejɛ. 8Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ ni mifeɔ nii nɛɛ mɔ!”
Waintrom mli apaafoi fɔ̃ji lɛ
(Mateo 21.33-46; Marko 12.1-12)
9 Ni ebɔ̃i maŋ lɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ buu akɛ, “Nuu ko fee waintrom ni ekɛhã okwaafoi apaayeli, ni etee maŋsɛɛ ni eyatsɛ aahu. 10 Ni be ni shɛ be lɛ, etsu tsulɔ ko kɛtee okwaafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, koni amɛhã lɛ waintrom lɛ mli yibii lɛ eko; shi okwaafoi lɛ yi lɛ, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛ̃ŋ folo. 11Ni esaa etsu tsulɔ kroko hu, shi amɛyi lɛ hu ni amɛshwie ehiɛ shi, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛ̃ŋ folo. 12Ni esaa etsu mɔ ni ji etɛ̃; shi lɛ hu amɛpila lɛ, ni amɛtsirɛ eyi sɛɛ kɛje kpo. 13Ni waintrom lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Mɛni sa akɛ mafee? Matsu mibi ni misumɔɔ lɛ; ekolɛ lɛ lɛ, kɛ amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaasɔ lɛ.’ 14Shi be ni okwaafoi lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ, koni gboshinii lɛ atsɔ̃ wɔnɔ.’ 15Ni amɛtsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛje waintrom lɛ mli ni amɛyagbe lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni waintromtsɛ lɛ aaafee amɛ? 16Eeeba ebakpãtã nɛkɛ okwaafoi nɛɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã mɛi krokomɛi.” Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Enɛ akagbale wɔ fɔ̃ŋfɔ!” 17 Shi ekwɛ amɛ kɛkpe ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛni nɔ ni aŋma nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ akɛ,
‘Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ,
No nɔŋŋ etsɔ koŋtɛ lɛ? ’
18 “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbee tɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, emli aaatserɛ; shi mɔ nɔ ni eeegbee lɛ, eeegbɛlɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.” 19Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ miitao lɛ amɔ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ amɛyoo akɛ amɛhewɔ ebu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ; shi amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei.
Oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hamɔ
(Mateo 22.15-22; Marko 12.13-17)
20 Ni amɛsra lɛ, ni amɛtsu saralɔi, mɛi ni fee amɛhe tamɔ jalɔi, koni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛŋɔ lɛ amɛhã amralo lɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ lɛ. 21Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ owieɔ ni otsɔ̃ɔ nii jalɛ naa, ni asaŋ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ, shi moŋ anɔkwale mli otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ. [Kɛɛmɔ wɔ]: 22Ani eja gbɛ akɛ wɔyeɔ too wɔhãa Kaisare, aloo ejaaa?” 23Shi be ni ekpa amɛŋaa lɛ shi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 24“Nyɛkɛ denario atsɔ̃a mi. Namɔ mfoniri nɛ? Ni namɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni amɛto he amɛkɛɛ, “Kaisare nɔŋ.” 25Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ nyɛkɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare; shi Nyɔŋmɔ nii lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ.” 26Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ enaa enyɔŋ ko amɛmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni ehetoo lɛ fee amɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛbu amɛnaa.
Gbohiiashitee he sanebimɔ
(Mateo 22.23-33; Marko 12.18-27)
27Ni Sadukifoi lɛ hu ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ sane ko 28 amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ŋma hã wɔ akɛ, ‘Kɛji mɔ ko nyɛmi ni yɔɔ ŋa gbo ni eshiii bi lɛ, enyɛmi aŋɔ eŋa lɛ, koni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.’ 29Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi shi, ni amɛteŋ onukpa lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni eshiii bi. 30Ni esɛɛho lɛ ŋɔ lɛ, ni lɛ hu egbo ni eshiii bi. 31Ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hu ŋɔ lɛ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛyi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ amɛfee; ni amɛshiii bii ni amɛgboi. 32Ni fee sɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu bagbo.
33“Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ? Ejaakɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ lɛ.” 34Ni Yesu to he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Je nɛɛŋ bii ŋɔŋɔɔ yei ni amɛkɛ yei hãa gbãlã, 35shi mɛi ni aaasa jeŋ ni baa lɛ kɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ namɔ lɛ, amɛŋɔɔɔ yei, asaŋ amɛkɛ yei hãaa gbãlã, 36 ni asaŋ amɛnyɛŋ amɛgboi dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi; ni Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji amɛ, ejaakɛ shitee lɛ bii ji amɛ. 37 Shi akɛ gbohii baate shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, Mose diɛŋtsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ yɛ koowie lɛ sane lɛ mli, be ni etsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ ‘Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ’ lɛ; 38shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeee gbohii aNyɔŋmɔ ni shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi aNyɔŋmɔŋ; ejaakɛ ehiɛ lɛ mɛi fɛɛ hiɛkãmɔ.” 39Shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, owie jogbaŋŋ!” 40Ni amɛkaaa lɛ sane ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
David Bi ni ji David Nuŋtsɔ lɛ
(Mateo 22.41-46; Marko 12.35-37)
41Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ akɛɔ akɛ Kristo lɛ, David biŋ lɛ? 42 Ejaakɛ David diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ,
Ta mininejurɔ nɔ,
43kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ
ohenyɛlɔi lɛ
mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.’
44Kɛ David tsɛ lɛ ‘Nuŋtsɔ’ lɛ, belɛ te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebi?”
Yesu wie shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ
(Mateo 23.1-36; Marko 12.38-40)
45Shi maŋ lɛ fɛɛ toiiaŋ ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, 46 “Nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ni amɛsumɔɔ jara nɔ ŋamɔi kɛ onukpai ashitaramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ yitsotamɔ kɛ atsɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, 47amɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, belɛ amɛkwa amɛmiisɔle sɔlemɔi kakadaji. Amɛfɔbuu lɛ aaafe nine.”

Title: LUKA 21
Content:
Yoo okulafo lɛ onia lɛ
(Marko 12.41-44)
