1Yesu wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ena niiatsɛmɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛnikeenii miiwo onia adeka lɛ mli. 2Shi ena yoo okulafo ohiafo ko hu ba ni ekɛ pesewai enyɔ bawo mli. 3 Ni ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yoo okulafo nɛɛ, ekɛ pii ewo mli fe mɛi lɛ fɛɛ; 4ejaakɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛna ni eteke nɔ lɛ eko amɛkɛbawo nikeenii lɛ amli nɛɛ, shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, ehia mli nii ni ekɛkwɛɔ ehe nɔ lɛ fɛɛ ekɛbawo mli nɛɛ.”
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fitemɔ he gbalɛ
(Mateo 24.1-2; Marko 13.1-2)
5Ni be ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he, bɔ ni akɛ tɛi fɛɛfɛji kɛ keenii ewula lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, 6 “Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, gbii aaaba ni ashiŋ emli tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ ni atsiŋ atswaŋ shi.”
Amanehului ashishijee
(Mateo 24.3-14; Marko 13.3-13)
7Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛ be nii nɛɛ aaaba mli? Ni mɛɛ okadi abaana kɛ eshɛ be ni ebaaba mli lɛ?” 8Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, koni akalaka nyɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi pii aaaba yɛ migbɛi mli ni amɛaakɛɛ, ‘Mi ni’, kɛ ‘Be lɛ eshɛ etã’. Shi nyɛkanyiɛa amɛsɛɛ. 9Ni kɛ nyɛnu tai kɛ atuatsemɔi ahe lɛ, nyɛtsui akafãa; ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ba mli dã, shi kɛ̃lɛ naagbee lɛ shɛko bianɛ.” 10Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋ baate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyɛli hu aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli; 11ni shikpɔŋ hosomɔi ni naa wa aaaba hei srɔtoi fɛɛ, kɛ hɔ̃ji kɛ gbele helai, ni gbeyei nibii kɛ okadii wuji aaajɛ ŋwɛi aba.
12 “Shi dani enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaaba lɛ, amɛaamɔmɔ nyɛ ni amɛaawa nyɛ yi ni amɛkɛ nyɛ aaahã ni akojo nyɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ ni awo nyɛ tsuŋ, ni amɛaakpala nyɛ kɛatee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi ahiɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ. 13Ni no aaahã nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛye odase. 14 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ ahia nɔ ni nyɛkasusu nɔ ni nyɛkɛajie nyɛnaa he nyɛto; 15 ejaakɛ mahã nyɛ naabu kɛ nilee ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛŋ naa adamɔ ni amɛnyɛŋ naa amɛku hu. 16Shi fɔlɔi tete kɛ nyɛmimɛi kɛ wekumɛi kɛ shieŋtsɛmɛi aaaŋɔ nyɛ ahã, ni amɛaahã agbe nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi; 17 ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ. 18 Shi nyɛyiteŋ tsɔi kome nɛkɛ elaajeŋ. 19 Hiɛmiamɔ nyɛkɛaahere nyɛsusumai lɛ.”
Yesu gba Yerusalɛm fitemɔ eto
(Mateo 24.15-21; Marko 13.14-19)
20“Shi kɛ nyɛna akɛ tai ebɔle Yerusalɛm lɛ, belɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ efitemɔ lɛ eshɛ. 21No mli lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi aya gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ aje kpo, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ akrowai akaba mli. 22 Ejaakɛ oweletɔɔ gbii lɛ nɛ, koni nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli. 23Shi miihã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ yei ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ kpoo! Ejaakɛ fimɔ babaoo baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mlifu hu baaba nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ. 24 Ni amɛaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa, ni aaaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛaatee jeŋmaji fɛɛ mli, ni jeŋmaji lɛ aaanaanaa Yerusalɛm nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni jeŋmaji abe lɛ aaashɛ.”
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa
(Mateo 24.29-31; Marko 13.24-27)
25“Ni okadii aaaba hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii amli, ni jeŋmaji lɛ ahe aaajara amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaafee yeyeeye yɛ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ ŋshɔkei akuumɔ hewɔ; 26ni nɔ aaanyɔnyɔɔ gbɔmɛi anɔ yɛ gbeyei kɛ nibii ni baa je lɛ nɔ lɛ agbɛkwɛmɔ hewɔ; ejaakɛ aaahoso ŋwɛi hewalɛi lɛ. 27 Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni eeba yɛ atatuŋ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ anunyam babaoo. 28 Shi be ni nibii nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛjajea nyɛhe nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛholea nyɛyitsei anɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛkpɔ̃mɔ lɛ miibɛŋkɛ.”
Agbãmitso lɛ he nikasemɔ
(Mateo 24.32-35; Marko 13.28-31)
29Ni ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa agbãmitso kɛ tsei fɛɛ; 30be mli beebe ni amɛfuɔ baa lɛ kɛ nyɛna lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ latsaabe eshɛ etã. 31Nakai nɔŋŋ hu, be ni nyɛaana akɛ nibii nɛɛ etsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ shi etã. 32Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ aaaba mli. 33 Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ aaaho aya; shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ.”
Nyɛsaraa
34 “Shi nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ koni fufeemɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ yɛ wala nɛɛ mli nibii ahe akahe nyɛtsuii ni nakai gbi lɛ miibati nyɛ shi trukaa; 35 ejaakɛ ebaaba mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ tamɔ tsɔne. 36 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa ni nyɛsɔlea be fɛɛ be, koni nyɛnyɛ nii ni baaba nɛɛ fɛɛ mli nyɛje, ni nyɛnyɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyɛdamɔ.”
37Shi kɛ je tsɛre lɛ Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni kɛ je na lɛ, eyaa gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyawɔɔ. 38Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ teɔ shi leebi maaŋkpa kɛbaa eŋɔɔ amɛbaboɔ lɛ toi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.

Title: LUKA 22
Content:
Atee Yesu yinɔ apam ni agbe lɛ
(Mateo 26.1-5, 14-16; Marko 14.1-2, 10, 11; Yohane 11.45-53)
1 Agbɛnɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hehoo lɛ miishɛ. 2 Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ tao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛgbe lɛ; shi amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei.
3 Shi Satan yabote Yuda mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Iskariot ni ji mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ mli. 4Ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ yawie, bɔ ni eeefee ni ejie lɛ ehã amɛ. 5Ni amɛnya, ni amɛwo lɛ shi akɛ amɛaahã lɛ shika, 6ni ekpɛlɛ̃; ni etao be ni sa ni ekɛaajie lɛ ehã amɛ ni mɛi bɛ jɛi.
Yesu to gbɛjianɔ hã Hehoo lɛ yeli
(Mateo 26.17-25; Marko 14.12-21; Yohane 13.21-30)
7 Agbɛnɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ ni sa akɛ agbeɔ Hehoo toobi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ bashɛ; 8ni etsu Petro kɛ Yohane ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyasaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ nyɛtoa wɔ, koni wɔbaye.” 9Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa wɔto yɛ?” 10Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛbote maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, naa, nuu ko kɛ nyɛ aaakpe ni ehiɛ nu kɛ kpulu; nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛyaa shĩa he ni eeeyabote lɛ, 11ni nyɛyakɛa shĩatsɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ wɔbakɛɛ bo akɛ, Nɛgbɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ ni mi kɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo niyenii lɛ yɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?’ 12Ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ŋwɛiasa kpele ko ni awula mli; nyɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ nyɛtoa yɛ jɛi.” 13 Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
Nuŋtsɔ niyenii lɛ shishitoo
(Mateo 26.26-30; Marko 14.22-26; 1 Korintobii 11.23-25)
14Ni be ni ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛ lɛ, eho eta niyenii lɛ ahe, ni bɔfoi lɛ fata ehe. 15Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Taomɔ pam mitaoɔ akɛ mikɛ nyɛ aye nɛkɛ Hehoo nɛɛ dani mana amanehulu lɛ; 16 ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miyeŋ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaaba mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” 17Ni ewo kpulu lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea ni nyɛjaa; 18ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaaba.” 19 Ni ekɔ aboloo, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, [“Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso ni akɛhã yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ; nyɛfea enɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.” 20 Nakai nɔŋŋ ewo kpulu lɛ hu yɛ niyenii lɛ asɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ yɛ mila ni akɛshwie shi ahã nyɛ lɛ mli.]
21 “Shi naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ nine kɛ minine yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ; 22ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya, tamɔ bɔ ni akpɛ mli ato lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ!”
23Ni amɛbɔ̃i amɛhe bimɔ akɛ amɛteŋ namɔ po baafee enɛ!
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
24 Shi naataamɔ hu bate shi yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ amɛteŋ namɔ sa akɛ abu lɛ agbo fe fɛɛ. 25Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ amɛnɔ hewalɛ lɛ, atsɛɔ amɛ ejurɔfeelɔi. 26Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi moŋ mɔ ni ji agbo yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, etsɔ tamɔ gbekɛ, ni mɔ ni ji onukpa hu tamɔ mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ. 27 Ejaakɛ te mɔ ni fe mɔ hu, mɔ ni taa okplɔ̃ he lɛ, aloo mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ? Ani jeee mɔ ni taa okplɔ̃ he lɛ? Shi mi lɛ miyɛ nyɛteŋ akɛ mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ. 28Shi nyɛ ji mɛi ni kɛ mi ehi shi yɛ mikai lɛ amli. 29Ni mi hu miito maŋtsɛyeli mahã nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miTsɛ eto ehã mi lɛ, 30 koni nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu yɛ mikpɔlɔ̃ lɛ he yɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; ni nyɛaatara sɛii anɔ ni nyɛkojo Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.”
Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto
(Mateo 26.31-35; Marko 14.27-31; Yohane 13.36-38)
31 Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Simon, Simon, naa, Satan ena hegbɛ, koni esha nyɛ mli tamɔ ŋmaa. 32 Shi mi lɛ mikpa fai miha bo, koni ohemɔkɛyeli akatã; ni bo hu, kɛ okpale lɛ, wo onyɛmimɛi lɛ hewalɛ.” 33Shi ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, misaa mihe mito ni kɛ tsuŋ po, gbele mli po, mikɛ bo aya.” 34Ekɛɛ, “Petro, miikɛɛ bo akɛ ŋmɛnɛ wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni ootso shii etɛ̃ akɛ oleee mi.”
Fotro, kotoku kɛ klante
35 Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Be ni mitsu nyɛ ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ fotro kɛ kotoku kɛ tokotai lɛ, ani nɔ ko he hia nyɛ” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaaa wɔ.” 36Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ fotro lɛ, ekɔ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ kotoku hu akɔ; ni mɔ ni bɛ klante lɛ, ehɔ̃ɔ etade ni ekɛhe eko. 37 Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nɔ ni aŋma nɛɛ hu, ja eba mli yɛ mihe, akɛ, ‘Ni abu lɛ ashi mlatɔlɔi anɔ’; ejaakɛ nibii ni aŋmala yɛ mihe lɛ miiba mli.” 38Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa, klantei enyɔ nɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Efa.”
Yesu yasɔle yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ
(Mateo 26.36-46; Marko 14.32-42)
39 Ni eje kpo, ni tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ eyiŋ kɛtee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ hu nyiɛ esɛɛ. 40Ni be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛsɔlea koni nyɛkabote kaa mli.” 41Ni egbala ehe shi kɛjɛ amɛŋɔɔ aaafee tɛfɔ̃ɔ jɛkɛmɔ, ni eho ekula shi, ni esɔle 42ekɛɛ, “Ataa, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, jiemɔ kpulu nɛɛ kɛje minɔ! Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.” [ 43 Ni bɔfo ko jɛ ŋwɛi bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ebawo lɛ hewalɛ. 44Ni be ni ehe jaraa lɛ lɛ, ehã esɔlemɔ lɛ mli wa. Ni ehe latsaa tsɔ̃ tamɔ lákulibii ni tsereɔ shwieɔ shi.] 45Ni be ni esɔle egbe naa ni ete shi kɛba ekaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, ebana amɛ akɛ amɛmiiwɔ ejaakɛ amɛwerɛ eho amɛhe; 46ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛwɔɔ? Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛkabote kaa mli.”
Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ
(Mateo 26.47-56; Marko 14.43-50; Yohane 18.2-12)
47Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa asafoku ko ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yuda lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ! Ni etsi ebɛŋkɛ Yesu, koni eshwɔ enaa. 48Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yuda, okɛ naashwɔmɔ miitsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ?” 49Ni be ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ na nɔ ni baaba lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔbamɔ klante lo?” 50Ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome bã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ lɛ klante ni efo eninejurɔ toi. 51Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Awa biɛ!” Ni eta etoi lɛ he ni etsa lɛ. 52Shi Yesu kɛɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ni ba enɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mi minɔ nyɛje kpo kɛba kɛ klante kɛ kpotii tamɔ abaa awuyelɔ nɔ nɛɛ? 53Daa ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, nyɛtaaa mihe; shi nyɛŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ kɛ duŋ hewalɛ lɛ nɛ!”
Petro kwa Yesu
(Mateo 26.57-58, 69-75; Marko 14.53-54, 66-72; Yohane 18.12-18, 25-27)
54Ni amɛmɔ lɛ ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ we lɛ. Shi Petro nyiɛ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ. 55Ni be ni amɛshɛre la yɛ mɔɔ teŋ lɛ mli ni amɛho amɛtara he lɛ, Petro hu ho yata amɛteŋ. 56Ni tsulɔ yoo fioo ko na lɛ ni eta la lɛ he, ni ekwɛ lɛ totooto ni ekɛɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ hu kɛ lɛ yɔɔ.” 57Shi etso ekɛɛ, “Awo, mileee lɛ!” 58No sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ lɛ, mɔ kroko hu na lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Bo hu, amɛteŋ mɔ ko ji bo.” Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Ataa, jeee amɛteŋ mɔ ko ji mi!” 59No sɛɛ aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome lɛ mɔ kroko hu ma nɔ mi veveeve akɛ, “Asonɔkwa, nuu nɛɛ hu kɛ lɛ yɔɔ; ejaakɛ Galileanyo hu ni!” 60Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Ataa, mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, be ni ekã he ewieɔ lolo lɛ, wuɔ gbɛɛ. 61 Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ekwɛ Petro; ni Petro kai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃”, lɛ. 62Ni Petro je kpo ni eyafo kɛ dɔlɛ.
Aye Yesu he fɛo ni ayi lɛ
(Mateo 26.67-68; Marko 14.65)
63Shi hii ni hiɛ Yesu lɛ ye ehe fɛo ni amɛyi lɛ. 64Ni amɛha ehiɛ ni amɛbibii lɛ akɛ, “Gbaa, namɔ ji mɔ ni gba bo ma lɛ?” 65Ni amɛwie nibii krokomɛi pii amɛkɛbɔ musu amɛshi lɛ.
Yesu yɛ Akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ
(Mateo 26.59-66; Marko 14.55-64; Yohane 18.19-24)
66 Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ anaa bakpe shi, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee amɛkwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, 67ni amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji bo ji Kristo lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ; 68ni kɛ sane ko mibi hu, nyɛhaŋ mi hetoo. 69Shi kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaata Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ.” 70Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ? Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi ni.’ ” 71Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ odase wɔfee dɔŋŋ? Ejaakɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu yɛ enaa.”

Title: LUKA 23
Content:
Akɛ Yesu tee Pilato hiɛ
(Mateo 27.1-2, 11-14; Marko 15.1-5; Yohane 18.28-38)
1Ni amɛsafo muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi, ni amɛkpala Yesu kɛtee Pilato ŋɔɔ. 2 Ni amɛbɔ̃i enaa folɔmɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔna nuu nɛɛ ni eewo wɔmaŋ lɛ yiŋ ni eegu oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hamɔ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ lɛ ji Kristo, maŋtsɛ lɛ.” 3Ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” Ni eto he ehã lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ.” 4Ni Pilato kɛɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ asafoi lɛ akɛ, “Minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ nuu nɛɛ he.” 5Shi amɛka nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ “Ewoɔ maŋ lɛŋ hirihiri kɛ enii ni etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yudea fɛɛ, ni ebɔi kɛjɛ Galilea kɛbashi biɛ nɛɛ.”
Yesu yɛ Herode hiɛ
6Shi be ni Pilato nu Galilea gbɛi lɛ, ebi akɛ nuu lɛ Galileanyo lo? 7 Ni be ni ena ele akɛ ejɛ Herode nɔyelihe lɛ, ehã akɛ lɛ tee Herode, mɔ hu ni eba Yerusalɛm yɛ nakai gbii lɛ amli lɛ ŋɔɔ. 8 Shi be ni Herode na Yesu lɛ, ena miishɛɛ babaoo, ejaakɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ejɛ etaoɔ lɛ ena, ejaakɛ enu ehe saji pii, ni ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eeefee okadi ko ni ena. 9Ni ebibii lɛ saji pii; shi ehãaa lɛ ekomeflo hetoo. 10Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ badamɔ shi ni amɛfolɔ enaa naakpa. 11Ni be ni Herode kɛ esraafoi lɛ ebɔ lɛ ahora ni amɛye ehe fɛo ni amɛwo lɛ atade kaŋkaŋ lɛ, ehã akɛ lɛ tee Pilato ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ. 12Shi nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Pilato kɛ Herode bɔ naanyo, shikulɛ sa lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe yeee.
Abu Yesu gbele fɔ
(Mateo 27.15-26; Marko 15.6-15; Yohane 18.19—19.16)
13Ni Pilato tsɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ kɛkpe, 14ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ bahã mi akɛ eewo maŋ lɛ yiŋ; ni naa, mitao esane lɛ mli yɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ, minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe yɛ saji ni nyɛkɛbafolɔ enaa lɛ ekoeko mli. 15Ni Herode hu enaaa eko, ejaakɛ ekpale lɛ kɛbahã wɔ; ni naa, efeko nɔ ko ni sa gbele. 16No hewɔ lɛ, mibayi lɛ ni maŋmɛɛ ehe.” 17[Shi ehia akɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛ mɔ kome he ehã amɛ.]
18Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛbolɔ shi kome amɛkɛɛ, “Okɛ mɔ nɛ aya, ni oŋmɛɛ Baraba he ohã wɔ!” 19(Baraba nɛɛ ji nuu ko ni atua ko ni atse yɛ maŋ lɛŋ kɛ awui ko ni aye hewɔ lɛ awo lɛ tsuŋ.) 20Shi akɛni Pilato miitao akɛ eŋmɛɛ Yesu he hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ. 21Shi amɛbolɔ akɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ! Sɛŋmɔ lɛ” 22Ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɔ ni ji shi etɛ̃ akɛ, “Shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, mɛɛ efɔŋ efee? Minako nɔ ko ni sa gbele yɛ ehe, no hewɔ lɛ, mibayi lɛ ni maŋmɛɛ ehe.” 23Shi amɛka nɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ni amɛmiitao akɛ asɛŋ lɛ; ni amɛgbei kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ anɔ lɛ ye nɔ. 24Kɛkɛ ni Pilato gbe sane lɛ naa akɛ afee bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ; 25ni eŋmɛɛ mɔ ni atuatsemɔ kɛ awuyeli hewɔ ni awo lɛ tsuŋ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ lɛ he; shi Yesu lɛ, ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ amɛtaomɔ lɛ naa.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele
(Mateo 27.32-56; Marko 15.21-41; Yohane 19.17-30)
26 Ni be ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛyaa lɛ amɛmɔ Simon Kirenenyo ko ni jɛ kosɛɛ baa lɛ, ni amɛwo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ amɛtere lɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
27Ni maŋ lɛ mli bii pii kɛ yei hu ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ ni amɛfoɔ yɛ ehewɔ lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ. 28Shi Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe ehã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Yerusalɛm biyei, nyɛkafoa yɛ mihewɔ; shi moŋ nyɛfoa yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ nyɛbii ahewɔ. 29 Ejaakɛ naa, gbii miiba no mli ni amɛaakɛɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ kenei kɛ musui ni fɔko dã kɛ fufɔi ni ayeko dã!’ 30 No mli lɛ amɛaabɔ̃i gɔji lɛ akɛɛmɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbagbea wɔnɔ!’ Kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛbahaa wɔnɔ!’ 31 Ejaakɛ kɛ tso ŋmɔŋ afeɔ enɛ lɛ, tso gbiŋ lɛ, te aaafee lɛ tɛŋŋ?” 32Ni akpala mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ hu ni ji efɔŋfeelɔi afata ehe kɛtee ni ayagbe amɛ.
33Ni be ni amɛshɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Yitsoŋoŋo lɛ, amɛsɛŋ lɛ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ yɛ jɛi, mɔ kome ye ninejurɔgbɛ ni mɔ kome hu ye abɛkugbɛ. 34 Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Ataa, kɛfa amɛ; shi amɛleee nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.” Ni amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja etadei lɛ. 35 Ni maŋbii lɛ damɔ shi amɛmiikwɛ. Ni maŋ onukpai lɛ hu ye lɛ ahi amɛkɛɛ, “Ehereɔ mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala; kɛ lɛ ji Kristo mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehala lɛ, ehere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala!” 36 Ni asraafoi lɛ hu ye ehe fɛo, ni amɛba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbahã lɛ ashiŋ, 37ni amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛ bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ, heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala!” 38Shi aŋma ŋmalɛ ko hu yɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, “YUDAFOI LƐ AMAŊTSƐ LƐ NƐ!” 39Ni efɔŋfeelɔi ni asɛŋ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome wie musubɔɔ wiemɔ eshi lɛ ekɛɛ, “Jeee bo ji Kristo lɛ? Jiemɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ wɔ hu!” 40Shi mɔ kome lɛ here nɔ ni ekã ehiɛ ekɛɛ, “Ani bo hu ni oyɔɔ fɔbuu kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli nɛɛ osheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei? 41Ni wɔnɔ lɛ sa wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔnifeemɔnii ahe nyɔmɔwoo wɔna nɛɛ; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ efeko nɔ ko ni esaaa.” 42 Ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ mi be ni oooba yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ!” 43Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale mli akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛnɛ okɛ mi aaahi Paradeiso!’ ”
44Agbɛnɛ aaafee shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli lɛ, duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli; 45 ni hulu wo duŋ, ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba kɛyi shi yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu. 46 Ni Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Ataa, odɛ̃ŋ mituɔ mimumɔ miwoɔ nɛɛ!” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ ebu enaa. 47Shi be ni asraafoiohaiatsɛ lɛ na nɔ ni efee lɛ, ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam ni ekɛɛ, “Yɛŋ lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ jalɔŋ!” 48Be ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ebabua amɛhe naa ni amɛkwɛɔ nii nɛɛ na nibii ni ba lɛ, amɛshimɔ amɛtsitsi ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee shĩa. 49 Shi mɛi ni le lɛ fɛɛ kɛ yei ni nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛjɛ Galilea lɛ hu damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ nii nɛɛ.
Yesu fuu
(Mateo 27.57-61; Marko 15.42-47; Yohane 19.38-42)
50Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef, ni ji akwaashɔŋnyo; eji gbɔmɔ kpakpa kɛ jalɔ. 51 Ni ejɛ Arimatia, Yudafoi lɛ amaji lɛ eko nɔ, lɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ amɛyiŋtoo kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ nɔ, ni eekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛ; 52lɛ eyiŋ etee Pilato ŋɔɔ ni eyakpa lɛ fai ni eŋɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ehã lɛ. 53Ni ejie lɛ kɛkpeleke shi, ni eŋɔ klala ebala ehe, ni eyato lɛ yɛ gbonyobu ni akpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli ni atoko mɔ ko yɛ mli dã lɛ mli. 54Ni nakai gbi lɛ Hesaamɔkɛtoo gbi ni, ni Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ miishɛ. 55 Ni yei lɛ ni kɛ Yesu jɛ Galilea ba lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ, amɛbakwɛ toohe lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ato egbonyo lɛ ahã. 56 Ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛyasaa tsofaikɛŋmai; ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛfee kpoo yɛ kitã lɛ naa.

Title: LUKA 24
Content:
Yesu shitee
(Mateo 28.1-10; Marko 16.1-8; Yohane 20.1-10)
1Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ leebi maaŋkpa lɛ amɛba bu lɛ he, ni amɛhiɛ tsofaikɛŋmai ni amɛsaa amɛto lɛ kɛba. 2Amɛna akɛ akoklo tɛ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa; 3ni be ni amɛbote mli lɛ, amɛnaaa Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ. 4Be ni amɛfee yaa yɛ enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, hii enyɔ badamɔ amɛmasɛi, ni amɛwo atadei kaŋkaŋi. 5Shi be ni amɛsheɔ gbeyei ni amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi lɛ, hii lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɛ gbohii ateŋ? 6Ebɛ biɛ; ete shi! Nyɛkaia bɔ ni ekɛɛ nyɛ be ni eyɔɔ Galilea lolo lɛ, 7 akɛ, ‘Ja aŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ; ni asɛŋ lɛ ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.’ ” 8Ni amɛkai ewiemɔi lɛ, 9ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ bu lɛ naa, ni amɛyagba mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ. 10 Maria Magdalena kɛ Yohana kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ yei ni eshwɛ ni fata amɛhe lɛ ji mɛi ni bagba bɔfoi lɛ nii nɛɛ. 11Ni nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fee tamɔ kwashiai asane yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛheee amɛyeee. 12[Shi Petro te shi ni esha foi kɛtee bu lɛ he; ni be ni ekoto shi ekwɛ mli lɛ, enaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja klala lɛ kɛkɛ. Ni eje jɛi etee ewe, ni enaa kpɛ ehe yɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ hewɔ].
Shisharamɔ kɛ Emao yaa
(Marko 16.12-13)
13Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ yiŋ kɛmiiya akrowa ko ni kɛ Yerusalɛm jekɛmɔ aaafee shitoi kpawo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Emao lɛ. 14Ni amɛmiigbagbaa nibii ni eba nɛɛ fɛɛ ahe saji yɛ amɛteŋ. 15 Ni be ni amɛgbagbaa saji lɛ ni amɛtaoɔ mli lɛ, Yesu diɛŋtsɛ babɛŋkɛ amɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ; 16shi aŋamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛkayoo lɛ. 17Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ saji nyɛgbaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi kɛ amɛhiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ. 18Ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kleopa lɛ to he ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani okome pɛ ji gbɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm ni leee saji ni eba jɛi yɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ?” 19 Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ saji ni?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nitsumɔ kɛ wiemɔ mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ lɛ he saji lɛ; 20kɛ bɔ ni wɔsɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ wɔmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ lɛ hã ni abu lɛ gbele fɔ, ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ. 21 Shi wɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kulɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni baakpɔ̃ Israel lɛ; ni enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii etɛ̃ ni afee nii nɛɛ. 22 Shi asaŋ wɔteŋ yei komɛi hu hã wɔnaa kpɛ wɔhe, ejaakɛ amɛtee bu lɛ he mra mli, 23ni be ni amɛnaaa egbonyo lɛ, amɛba ni amɛbakɛɛ akɛ bɔfoi komɛi hu jie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ ehiɛ kã. 24 Ni mɛi ni kɛ wɔ yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi tee bu lɛ he, ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni yei lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi lɛ ni amɛnaaa.” 25Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “O kwashiai ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛtsui mli kɛ nii fɛɛ ni gbalɔi lɛ gba lɛ hemɔkɛyeli. 26Ani jeee sa esa akɛ Kristo lɛ ana nɛkɛ amanehului nɛɛ ni ebote enunyam lɛ mli?” 27 Ni ebɔ̃i kɛjɛ Mose kɛ Gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nibii ni yɔɔ Ŋmalɛi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ ehe lɛ ashishi. 28Ni amɛbɛŋkɛ akrowa ni amɛyaa mli lɛ; ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni eeya ehiɛgbɛ. 29Ni amɛnyɛ enɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Okɛ wɔ ahi shi, ejaakɛ je miina ni eshɛ hiɛbulɛ etã.” Ni etee mli ni ekɛ amɛ yahi shi. 30 Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ekɛ amɛ tara niyenii ahe lɛ, ekɔ aboloo lɛ ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli ni ekɛhã amɛ; 31kɛkɛ ni amɛhiŋmɛi gbele ni amɛyoo lɛ, ni elaaje yɛ amɛhiɛ. 32Ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani nɔ ko etaaa wɔmli be ni ekɛ wɔ wieɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli lɛ?” 33Ni amɛte shi yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbana mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ ni amɛbua amɛhe naa; 34 amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, “Eyɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ete shi, ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Simon.” 35Ni amɛ hu amɛgba nɔ ni ba yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni fee ni amɛyoo lɛ yɛ abolookuumɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ
(Mateo 28.16-20; Marko 16.14-18; Yohane 20.19-23; Bɔfoi 1.6-8)
36Ni be ni amɛwieɔ nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Yesu diɛŋtsɛ badamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” 37 Shi amɛhɛle shi ni amɛshe gbeyei, amɛsusu akɛ mumɔ ko amɛnaa lɛ. 38Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛjijaa, ni mɛɛ hewɔ hu ni ŋwanejee teɔ shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli? 39Nyɛkwɛa miniji kɛ minaji [ni nyɛaana akɛ] mi diɛŋtsɛ ni; nyɛtaa mihe nyɛkwɛa; shi mumɔ bɛ heloo kɛ wui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛnaa akɛ miyɔɔ nɛɛ.” 40[Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ eniji kɛ enaji tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.] 41Shi be ni amɛheee amɛyeee lolo yɛ miishɛɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ efee amɛ yaa lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyɛ nɔ ko ni ayeɔ yɛ biɛ lo?” 42 Ni amɛhã lɛ loo kuku ni ashi, 43ni ehe, ni eye yɛ amɛhiɛ. 44 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi ji miwiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wie be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ, akɛ ja nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mose mla lɛ kɛ Gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Lalai lɛ amli yɛ mihe lɛ na ba mli.” 45Kɛkɛ lɛ egbele amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa, koni amɛna Ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa. 46Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ aŋma, ni nɛkɛ esa akɛ Kristo lɛ ana amanehulu ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ; 47ni ashiɛ tsuitsakemɔ kɛ eshaifaa yɛ egbɛi lɛ mli atsɔ̃ɔ maji fɛɛ, ni abɔ̃i kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm. 48 Ni nyɛ ji nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ahe odasefoi. 49 Ni naa, miiha miTsɛ shiwoo lɛ aba nyɛnɔ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛhia shi yɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaajɛ ŋwɛi awo nyɛ hewalɛ.”
Yesu ŋwɛiyaa
(Marko 16.19-20; Bɔfoi 1.9-11)
50Ni eŋɔ amɛ kɛje kpo kɛtee Betania masɛi, ni ehole eniji anɔ ni ejɔɔ amɛ. 51Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ gbala mli, ni awo lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi. 52Ni amɛja lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm kɛ miishɛɛ pii; 53ni amɛyɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ daa nɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ kɛ lɛ jɔɔmɔ.

Title: YOHANE WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanɔ Wiemɔ ji lɛ, “ni ebatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ ni ebahi wɔteŋ” (1.14). Tamɔ bɔ ni wolo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yeɔ he odase lɛ, Sanekpakpa nɛɛ aŋma bɔ ni afee ni ekanelɔi lɛ ahe aye akɛ Yesu ji yiwalaherelɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi, ni awo ehe shi ato lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ aaana wala (20.31).
Mlibotemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanɔ Wiemɔ lɛ ji Yesu. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ anaa naakpɛɛ nibii srɔtoi ni Yesu fee yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu lɛ, lɛ ji Yiwalaherelɔ lɛ ni awo ehe shi ato lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ atee nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ nibii ni naakpɛɛ nibii lɛ jie lɛ kpo lɛ naa faŋŋ. Biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wolo lɛ gbaa wɔ mɛi komɛi ni he Yesu nɔ ye ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ ekaselɔi, shi mɛi komɛi ni te shi shí lɛ lɛ, amɛheee enɔ amɛyeee. Yitsei 13-17 wieɔ naanyobɔɔ ni wa ni yɔɔ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ gbi gbɛkɛ ni ayamɔ lɛ lɛ he jogbaŋŋ. Esaa etsɔ̃ɔ wiemɔ ni Yesu wie kɛsaa ekaselɔi lɛ ajwɛŋmɔ ni ekɛwo amɛ ekãa gbɛkɛ ni nyiɛ gbi ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ. Yitsei ni gbeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ naa lɛ wieɔ Yesu mɔmɔ kɛ ekojomɔ he, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ hu ni asɛŋ Yesu ni ete shi ni ejie ehe kpo faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ ehã yɛ eshitee lɛ sɛɛ.
Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ maa naanɔ wala ni anaa akɛ nɔkeenɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ lɛ nɔ, mi. Ni etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eji keenii ni anaa kɛjɛɔ amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ, ni mɛi ni naa ji mɛi ni eŋɔ Yesu akɛ lɛ ji gbɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ kɛ wala lɛ.
Nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni akɛkadiɔ Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ jogbaŋŋ ji bɔ ni etsɔɔ ewieɔ nibii ni wɔle yɛ wɔdaadaa shihilɛ mli ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ mumɔŋ nii anaa lɛ he, taakɛ nu kɛ aboloo kɛ lá kɛ tookwɛlɔ kɛ etoi kɛ waintso kɛ eyibii nɛkɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Shishijee 1.1-18
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu klɛŋklɛŋ kaselɔi lɛ 1.19-51
Yesu nitsumɔ 2.1—12.50
Yesu naagbee gbi yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ ekpokpai anɔ 13.1—19.42
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shitee kɛ ehekpojiemɔ 20.1-31
Naagbee, ehekpojiemɔ kroko yɛ Galilea 21.1-25

Title: YOHANE 1
Content:
Wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ heloo
1 Shishijee mli lɛ Wiemɔ lɛ yɛ momo, ni Wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ ni Wiemɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni. 2 Lɛ nɔŋŋ shishijee mli lɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ. 3 Lɛ enɔ atsɔ̃ afee nibii fɛɛ, ni ashiii lɛ afeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni afee. 4 Emli wala yɔɔ, ni wala lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ala lɛ; 5 ni la lɛ tsoɔ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli, ni duŋ lɛ nyɛɛɛ enɔ eye.
6 Nuu ko yɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ kɛba, atsɛɔ lɛ Yohane. 7Eba odaseyeli, ni ebaye la lɛ he odase koni mɛi fɛɛ atsɔ̃ enɔ ahe aye. 8 Jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji la lɛ; shi moŋ eba la lɛ he odaseyeli. 9Anɔkwa la lɛ ni tsoɔ hãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ baa je lɛ mli nɛɛ. 10 Je lɛ mli la lɛ yɔɔ, ni enɔ atsɔ̃ afee je lɛ, shi je lɛ leee lɛ. 11Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi aŋɔɔ eba, ni mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋbii lɛ hereee lɛ. 12 Shi mɛi abɔ ni here lɛ, ni amɛhe egbɛi lɛ nɔ amɛye lɛ, ehã amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii, 13 mɛi ni jeee lá loo heloo loo nuu ko suɔmɔ naa afɔ amɛ yɛ, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ amɛ. 14 Ni Wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ adesa, ni ebahi shi yɛ wɔteŋ, ni wɔna enunyam lɛ akɛ Tsɛ lɛ Bi koome lɛ anunyam, ni dromɔ kɛ anɔkwale eyi lɛ obɔ̃.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ye Yesu he odase
(Mateo 3.1-12; Marko 1.6-8; Luka 3.15-17)
15 Yohane ye ehe odase ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ efe mi, etsɔ̃ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ dani miyɔɔ lɛ.’ ” 16 Ejaakɛ ebɔ̃yimɔ lɛ mli jɛ ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔna dromɔ wɔshi dromɔ nɔ. 17 Ejaakɛ Mla lɛ, Mose nɔ atsɔ̃ akɛhã; shi dromɔ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ, Yesu Kristo nɔ etsɔ̃ kɛba. 18 Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ko enako lɛ pɛŋ; Bi koome ni yɔɔ Tsɛ lɛ mlishi lɛ, lɛ ebajie lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ.
19 Ni enɛ ji Yohane odase ni eye be ni Yudafoi lɛ tsu osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” lɛ. 20Ni egba mli faŋŋ ni eshiuuu nɔ, ni egba mli akɛ, “Jeee mi ji Kristo lɛ.” 21 Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo mɔ? Elia ji bo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Jeee lɛ ji mi.” Gbalɔ lɛ ji bo? Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Dabi.” 22No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo? (Kɛɛmɔ wɔ) koni wɔna hetoo ko wɔyahã mɛi ni tsu wɔ lɛ; Te okɛɔ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe tɛŋŋ?” 23 Ekɛɛ,
“Mi ji mɔ gbee ni boɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ,
‘Nyɛjajea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ,’ ”
tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia kɛɛ lɛ.
24Ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ jɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ; 25ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛjeee Kristo lɛ loo Elia loo gbalɔ lɛ ji bo lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ obaptisiɔ mɔ?” 26 Yohane here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mi lɛ mibaptisiɔ yɛ nu mli, shi mɔ ko damɔ nyɛteŋ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛleee lɛ, 27 lɛ ji mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ, mɔ tokota naakpãa ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ lɛ.” 28Afee nii nɛɛ yɛ Betania, yɛ Yordan sɛɛ, he ni Yohane baptisiɔ yɛ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ
29 Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yohane na Yesu miiba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ ni woɔ je lɛ esha lɛ kɛyaa lɛ! 30 Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Nuu ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ dani miyɔɔ lɛ.’ 31Ni mi lɛ́ mileee lɛ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Israel hewɔ, ni miba mibaptisiɔ yɛ nu mli nɛɛ.” 32 Ni Yohane ye odase ekɛɛ, “Mina Mumɔ lɛ yi shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ okpo, ni ebahi enɔ. 33 Ni mi lɛ mileee lɛ, shi mɔ ni tsu mi akɛ mibaptisi yɛ nu mli lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Mɔ nɔ ni ooona akɛ Mumɔ lɛ yiɔ ni ehiɔ enɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni baptisiɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli lɛ.’ 34Ni mina, ni miye he odase akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɛ.”
Kaselɔi ni atsɛ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ
35Asaŋ enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yohane kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ damɔ shi; 36 ni be ni Yesu hoɔ lɛ, ekwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ!” 37Ni kaselɔi enyɔ lɛ nu ewiemɔ lɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ. 38Ni Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena akɛ amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi” (eshishi ji: Tsɔɔlɔ), “Nɛgbɛ ohiɔ?” 39Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbakwɛa.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyana he ni ehiɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ hi shi nakai gbi lɛ. Ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji ejwɛ mli ni. 40Mɛi enyɔ lɛ ni nu ni Yohane wie ni amɛyanyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi lɛ. 41 Lɛ eyana lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi Simon tsutsu, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna Mesia (ni eshishi ji Kristo,) loo (mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu) lɛ.” 42 Ni ekɛ lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ. Ni Yesu kwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Bo ji Simon, Yona bi lɛ, aaatsɛ bo Kefa (eshishi ji Petro loo tɛsaa).”
43Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yesu miitao akɛ eyaa Galilea, ni ena Filipo; ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” 44Shi Filipo jɛ Betsaida, Andrea kɛ Petro maŋ lɛ mli. 45 Filipo hu na Natanael, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna mɔ ni Mose ŋma ehe sane yɛ Mla lɛ mli, kɛ mɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ hu ŋma ehe sane lɛ, Yesu, Yosef bi ni jɛ Nazaret lɛ.” 46 Ni Natanael kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani nɔ ko kpakpa ko aaanyɛ ajɛ Nazaret?” Filipo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ba ni obakwɛ.” 47Yesu na Natanael miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Naa anɔkwa Israelnyo, mɔ mli ni apasa bɛ lɛ.” 48Natanael bi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ole mi yɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina bo fɛɛ dã ni Filipo tsɛ bo, be mli ni oyɔɔ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ.” 49 Natanael here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, bo ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ.” 50Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ni mikɛɛ bo akɛ mina bo yɛ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ hewɔ oheɔ oyeɔ nɛɛ? Ooona nii wuji ni fe enɛ.” 51 Ni etee nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaana akɛ ŋwɛi naa kã ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ miikwɔ miikpeleke yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ.”

Title: YOHANE 2
Content:
Yookpeemɔ yɛ Kana
1Enɔ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ akpee yoo yɛ Kana yɛ Galilea; ni Yesu nyɛ yɛ jɛi. 2Ni akpee Yesu hu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛtee yookpeemɔ lɛ. 3Ni be ni wain lɛ tã lɛ, Yesu nyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Amɛbɛ wain.” 4 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ohe sane mɛ ji no, Awo? Miŋmlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.” 5Enyɛ kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea.” 6 Ni tɛ botokui ekpaa mamɔ shi yɛ jɛi, yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ahetsuumɔ hewɔ, ekome yeɔ susumɔ gbɛi enyɔ loo etɛ̃. 7Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa botokui lɛ amli nu obɔ̃bɔ̃.” Ni amɛwo amɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃. 8Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyɛa eko nyɛyahãa piafonyo lɛ.” Ni amɛyɛ kɛtee. 9Shi be ni piafonyo lɛ sa enaa nu ni etsɔ̃ wain, ni eleee he ni jɛ, shi tsuji lɛ ni yɛ nu lɛ kɛkɛ le lɛ, etsɛ ayɛmforowu lɛ, 10ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, wain kpakpa ekɛbamaa shi klɛŋklɛŋ, ni kɛ mɛi lɛ etɔrɔ lɛ, no dani ekɛ nɔ ni eŋɔɔɔ lɛ baa; shi bo lɛ okɛ wain kpakpa lɛ moŋ eto kɛbashi benɛ.” 11 Enɛ Yesu fee yɛ Kana yɛ Galilea ekɛje ekadii ashishi ni ekɛ enunyam lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ he enɔ amɛye. 12 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ eyiŋ etee Kapernaum, lɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ, shi amɛyeee gbii pii ko yɛ jɛi.
Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he
13 Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ aHehoo lɛ eshɛ etã, ni Yesu tee Yerusalɛm. 14Ni eyana mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ tsinai kɛ toi kɛ okpoi kɛ mɛi ni tsakeɔ shika hu tara shi yɛ amɛkpɔlɔ̃i ahe yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. 15Ni ekɛ taŋkpei bibii fee kpelebii ni ekɛshwie amɛ fɛɛ kɛ toi kɛ tsinai lɛ kɛje Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ shikatsakelɔi lɛ ashika lɛ eshwie shi; ni etsirɛ okpɔlɔi lɛ etswia shi; 16ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjiea nii nɛɛ kɛjea biɛ, nyɛkɛ miTsɛ we lɛ akafea jara nɔ.” 17 Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ aŋma akɛ, “Owe lɛ he hiɛdɔɔ lɛ eye mi.” 18 Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ okadi okɛtsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ oyɛ hegbɛ akɛ ofeɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?” 19 Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkumɔa sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ, ni gbii etɛ̃ mli lɛ mama ekoŋŋ.” 20Kɛkɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa akɛma Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ, ni bo lɛ gbii etɛ̃ okɛaama lo?” 21 Shi lɛ lɛ, egbɔmɔtso akɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he ewieɔ lɛ. 22No hewɔ lɛ, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ ekɛɛ enɛ, ni amɛhe ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yesu wie lɛ amɛye.
23Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu yɔɔ Yerusalɛm yɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mɛi pii na okadii ni efee lɛ, ni amɛhe egbɛi lɛ nɔ amɛye. 24Shi Yesu diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ ele amɛ fɛɛ amɛsu. 25 Ni ehe ehĩaaa akɛ mɔ ko aye gbɔmɔ he odase ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ele nɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ tsui mli.

Title: YOHANE 3
Content:
Yesu kɛ Nikodemo
1 Nuu ko yɛ ni jɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nikodemo ni ji Yudafoi lɛ anukpa; 2lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, wɔle akɛ tsɔɔlɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba ji bo; ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ afee okadii ni ofeɔ nɛɛ, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ.” 3 Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ ŋwɛi afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ena.” 4Nikodemo bi lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni be ni gbɔmɔ egbɔ lɛ ni aaafɔ lɛŋ? Ani eeenyɛ ebote enyɛ musu mli ekoŋŋ ni afɔ lɛ?” 5 Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ nu kɛ Mumɔ mli afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli ebote. 6 Nɔ ni ajɛ heloo mli afɔ lɛ, heloo ni; ni nɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ, mumɔ ni. 7Ohiɛ akafee bo yaa akɛ mikɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘ja ajɛ ŋwɛi afɔ nyɛ’ lɛ. 8Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, he ni esumɔɔ etswaa kɛyaa, ni egbɛɛmɔ onuɔ, shi oleee he ni ejɛɔ kɛ he ni eyaa; nakai ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ lɛ.”
9Nikodemo here nɔ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nii nɛɛ aaanyɛ aba mli hu?”
10Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te Israel tsɔɔlɔ ji bo? Ni oleee enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ? 11 Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale akɛ, nɔ ni wɔle lɛ, no wɔwieɔ; ni nɔ ni wɔna lɛ, no he odase wɔyeɔ; shi nyɛŋɔɔɔ wɔdase lɛ. 12Kɛ mikɛ nyɛ wie shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe ni nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ wie ŋwɛinii ahe ni nyɛaahe nyɛyeŋ? 13 Ni mɔ ko ekwɔko kɛyako ŋwɛi, akɛ ja mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi kpeleke shi lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ. 14 Ni bɔ ni Mose wo onufu lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ sa akɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ, 15koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala.”
16 “Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ je lɛ, akɛ eŋɔ eBi koome lɛ ehã, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ hiɛ akakpãtã, shi moŋ ena naanɔ wala. 17 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuuu eBi lɛ kɛbaaa je lɛ mli koni ebakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ koni atsɔ̃ enɔ ahere je lɛ yiwala. 18 Mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, akojooo lɛ; shi mɔ ni heee yeee lɛ, akojo lɛ momo, ejaakɛ eheko Nyɔŋmɔ Bi koome lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ eyeko. 19 Shi kojomɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ la lɛ eba je lɛ mli, ni gbɔmɛi sumɔɔ duŋ lɛ moŋ fe la lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni; 20 ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ nyɛɔ la lɛ, ni ebaaa la lɛ he, koni akajie enitsumɔi lɛ ashi. 21Shi mɔ ni feɔ anɔkwalenii lɛ baa la lɛ he, koni enitsumɔi lɛ aje kpo, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli atsu yɛ.”
Yohane odase kroko ni eye yɛ Yesu he
22 Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ba Yudea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ bahi jɛi, ni ebaptisiɔ. 23Ni Yohane hu miibaptisi yɛ Ainon yɛ Salim masɛi, ejaakɛ nu pii yɛ jɛi, ni mɛi baa ni abaptisiɔ amɛ; 24 ejaakɛ no mli lɛ anako awo Yohane tsuŋ.
25Agbɛnɛ naataamɔ bate shi yɛ Yohane kaselɔi lɛ kɛ Yudafonyo ko teŋ yɛ hetsuumɔ he. 26 Ni amɛba Yohane ŋɔɔ ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, mɔ ni kɛ bo hi Yordan sɛɛ ni oye ehe odase lɛ, naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eebaptisi, ni mɛi fɛɛ miiya eŋɔɔ.” 27 Yohane here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ nyɛŋ ana nɔ ko, akɛ ja ajɛ ŋwɛi akɛhã lɛ. 28 Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye mi odase akɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, jeee mi ji Kristo lɛ, shi moŋ atsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ. 29 Mɔ ni hiɛ ayɛmforo lɛ, lɛ ji ayɛmforowu; shi ayɛmforowu lɛ shieŋtsɛ ni damɔ shi boɔ lɛ toi lɛ, nya enyaa yɛ ayɛmforowu lɛ gbee hewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ minyamɔ nɛɛ eba mli. 30Lɛ lɛ, ja eshwere, ni mi lɛ, minɔ gbɔ.” 31 Mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ. Mɔ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ he ewieɔ. Mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ, 32ni nɔ ni ena ni enu lɛ, no he odase eyeɔ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ edase lɛ. 33Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ edase lɛ, esɔo naa akɛ anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ. 34 Ejaakɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi ewieɔ; ejaakɛ jeee susumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ susuɔ Mumɔ lɛ ehãa lɛ. 35 Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ Bi lɛ, ni etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ. 36Mɔ ni heɔ Bi lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala; shi mɔ ni booo Bi lɛ toi lɛ, enaŋ wala; shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu hiɔ enɔ.

Title: YOHANE 4
Content:
Yesu kɛ Samariayoo lɛ
1 Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu na le akɛ Farisifoi lɛ enu akɛ eena kaselɔi, ni eebaptisi mɛi babaoo fe Yohane, 2tsɛbelɛ lɛ Yesu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaptisiii; shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ ni baptisiɔ lɛ, 3eje Yudea ni eyiŋ etee Galilea ekoŋŋ. 4Shi ja etsɔ̃ Samaria. 5 Agbɛnɛ ebashɛ Samaria maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sikar ni bɛŋkɛ shikpɔŋ kukuoo ko ni Yakob kɛhã ebi Yosef lɛ masɛi. 6Shi Yakob nubu lɛ yɛ jɛi. Ni akɛni gbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ etɔ Yesu hewɔ lɛ, eho eshwata shi yɛ nubu lɛ he. [Ebashɛ jɛi] aaafee ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli. 7Ni Samariayoo ko ba nuyɛɛ. Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã mi nu lɛ eko manu.” 8No mli lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ etee maŋ lɛ mli amɛyaahe niyenii. 9 Kɛkɛ lɛ Samariayoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te tɛŋŋ ni bo Yudanyo lɛ obaa mi Samariayoo lɛ nu ni onuŋ?” (Ejaakɛ Yudafoi kɛ Samariabii enuuu tsene kome naa nu.) 10 Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eji ole Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kɛɔ bo akɛ, ‘Hã mi eko manu lɛ’ kulɛ, bo moŋ oooba lɛ ni eeehã bo wala nu.” 11Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, obɛ nɔ ni okɛaayɛ, ni bu lɛ mli kwɔ hu; nɛgbɛ ona wala nu lɛ yɛ mɔ? 12Ani ofe wɔtsɛ Yakob ni hã wɔ nubu lɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enu mli nu, kɛ ebii kɛ ekooloi lɛ?” 13 Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ nu nɛɛ lɛ, kumai baaye lɛ ekoŋŋ; 14 shi mɔ ni nuɔ nu ni mi mahã lɛ lɛ, kumai yeŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ; shi moŋ nu ni mahã lɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nu hiŋmɛi ni baa kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli yɛ emli.” 15Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, hã mi nu nɛɛ eko, koni kumai akaye mi, ni miba biɛ mibayɛ nu dɔŋŋ.” 16Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyatsɛ owu, ni okɛ lɛ aba biɛ.” 17Yoo lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mibɛ wu” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ okɛɛ akɛ, ‘mibɛ wu’ lɛ; 18ejaakɛ ogbã hii enumɔ, ni mɔ ni ogbãa amrɔ nɛɛ tete, jeee owu ji lɛ; no lɛ owie anɔkwa.” 19Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mina akɛ gbalɔ ji bo. 20 Gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ sɔle yɛ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ akɛ Yerusalɛm ji he ni sa akɛ asɔle yɛ.” 21Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Awo, he mi oye akɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni jeee gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ jeee Yerusalɛm ni nyɛaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ. 22 Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleee mɔ ni nyɛjaa; wɔ lɛ, wɔle mɔ ni wɔjaa, ejaakɛ walaheremɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ ejɛ. 23Shi kɛ̃lɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ momo, be ni anɔkwa jalɔi lɛ aaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli, ejaakɛ jalɔi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi Tsɛ lɛ taoɔ. 24 Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔŋ, ni mɛi ni jaa lɛ lɛ, ja amɛja lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli.” 25 Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mile akɛ Mesia ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ miiba; kɛ eba lɛ, eeegba wɔ nii fɛɛ.” 26 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ni mikɛ bo wieɔ nɛɛ, mi ni.”
27Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ ekɛ yoo miiwie, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko biii lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni obiɔ lɛ?” Aloo “Mɛni wiemɔ okɛ lɛ wieɔ?” 28Agbɛnɛ yoo lɛ shi enugbɛ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee maŋ lɛ mli, ni eyakɛɛ mɛi lɛ akɛ, 29“Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa nuu ko ni ejaje nii fɛɛ ni mifee etsɔ̃ɔ mi, akɛ jeee Kristo lɛ ni lo?” 30No hewɔ lɛ, amɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli amɛba eŋɔɔ.
31Shi no mli lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, “Rabi, ye nɔ ko.” 32 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miyɛ ŋmaa ni miyeɔ, ni nyɛleee.” 33No hewɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani mɔ ko ebahã lɛ nɔ ko eye?” 34Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miŋmaa ji akɛ mafee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii, ni magbe enitsumɔ lɛ naa. 35 Ani nyɛkɛɛɛ akɛ, ‘Eshwɛ nyɔji ejwɛ ni abelekuumɔbe lɛ shɛɔ?’ Naa, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ ni nyɛkwɛa ŋmɔji lɛ bɔ ni amɛgba futaa momo ni sa kpamɔ. 36Ni mɔ ni kpaa lɛ naa enyɔmɔwoo, ni ebuaa yibii anaa etoɔ naanɔ wala, koni mɔ ni duɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kpaa lɛ fɛɛ anya shi kome. 37Ejaakɛ enɛ mli ni wiemɔ ni awie akɛ, ‘Mɔ ko duɔ ni mɔ ko kpaa’ lɛ baa mli yɛ. 38Mi lɛ mitsu nyɛ koni nyɛyakpa nɔ ni jeee nyɛ nyɛgbo he deŋme; mɛi krokomɛi egbo he deŋme, ni nyɛba amɛdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli.”
39Ni Samariabii lɛ ni jɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye yɛ yoo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛye odase akɛ, “Ekɛɛ mi nii fɛɛ ni mifee pɛŋ lɛ” hewɔ. 40No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Samariabii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekɛ amɛ ahi shi; ni ehi jɛi gbii enyɔ. 41Ni mɛi pii ni fe tsutsubii lɛ saa he ye yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewiemɔ lɛ hewɔ; 42ni amɛkɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ wɔmiihe wɔmiiye, jeee bo owiemɔ lɛ hewɔŋ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu, ni wɔna wɔle akɛ, anɔkwale, mɔ nɛ ji je lɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ.”
Maŋtsɛ wenuu lɛ binuu lɛ tsamɔ
43 Gbii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ eyiŋ kɛjɛ jɛi etee Galilea, 44 tsɛbelɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eye odase akɛ gbalɔ ko hiɛ bɛ nyam yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ. 45 Be ni eba Galilea lɛ, Galileabii lɛ ni na nii fɛɛ ni efee yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ here lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛtee gbijurɔ lɛ.
46 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu ba Kana yɛ Galilea, he ni ehã nu tsɔ̃ wain yɛ lɛ, ekoŋŋ. Ni maŋtsɛ wenuu ko yɛ Kapernaum ni ebi he miiye. 47Ni be ni enu akɛ Yesu ejɛ Yudea eba Galilea lɛ, etee eŋɔɔ ni eyatutɔ lɛ akɛ eba ni ebatsa ebi lɛ, ejaakɛ eeehe egbo. 48 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛnaaa okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii lɛ, nyɛheee nyɛyeee.” 49Maŋtsɛ wenuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ba dani mibi lɛ agbo.” 50Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, obi lɛ yi ena wala.” Ni nuu lɛ he nɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ lɛ eye, ni eyiŋ etee. 51Shi be ni eyaa lɛ, etsuji kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obinuu lɛ he ewa lɛ.” 52No hewɔ lɛ, ebi amɛ nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni ehe bɔ̃i lɛ waa, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ shwane ŋmɛlɛ kome mli ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ.” 53Kɛkɛ ni tsɛ lɛ kɛna akɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obi lɛ he ewa lɛ” lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni; ni ekɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ he ye. 54 Enɛ ji okadi ni ji enyɔ ni Yesu fee, be ni ejɛ Yudea eba Galilea lɛ.

Title: YOHANE 5
Content:
Betesda Kpaakpo lɛ naa helatsɛ lɛ tsamɔ
1Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ agbijurɔ ko bashɛ, ni Yesu tee Yerusalɛm. 2Kpaakpo ko yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Toi Agboi lɛ masɛi, ni Hebri wiemɔ mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Betesda, ni koii enumɔ yɛ he. 3Enɛɛmɛi amli helatsɛmɛi pii — shwilafoi, akpakei kɛ obubuafoi — kãmɔ [ni amɛmɛɔ nu lɛ mlitaa. 4Ejaakɛ bei komɛi lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kpelekeɔ shi kɛbaa kpaakpo lɛ mli ni ebataa nu lɛ mli; kɛkɛ lɛ emlitaa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yagbeɔ nu lɛ mli tsutsu lɛ, hela fɛɛ hela ni eyeɔ lɛ ehe tãa.] 5Nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni ehe eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ. 6Yesu na lɛ ni ekã shi, ni akɛni ele akɛ etsɛ aahu lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Oosumɔ akɛ ohe awa bo lo?” 7Helatsɛ lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mibɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ abata nu lɛ mli ni eeewo mi eyawo kpaakpo lɛ mli; shi kɛ miiya lɛ, mɔ kroko tsɔ̃ɔ mihiɛ eyagbeɔ mli.” 8 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, kɔ osaa lɛ, ni onyiɛ!” 9 Ni amrɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ he wa lɛ, ni ewo esaa lɛ ni enyiɛ.
Shi nakai gbi lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni. 10 No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ mɔ ni atsa lɛ akɛ, “hejɔɔmɔ gbi nɛ, obɛ hegbɛ akɛ otereɔ osaa.” 11Ehere amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni tsa mi lɛ, lɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kɔ osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ.’ ” 12Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ ni kɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Kɔ osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ’ lɛ?” 13Shi mɔ ni atsa lɛ leee mɔ ni ji; ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ jɛi, ni Yesu egbala ehe shi. 14 Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yana lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, ohe ewa bo; kaafee esha dɔŋŋ, koni efɔŋ ni fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ akaba onɔ.” 15Nuu lɛ yiŋ etee ni eyagba Yudafoi lɛ akɛ Yesu ji mɔ ni tsa lɛ lɛ.
16 No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka Yesu, ejaakɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ efee nii nɛɛ. 17 Shi Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ miitsu nii kɛbashi be nɛ, ni mi hu miitsu.” 18 No hewɔ titri Yudafoi lɛ taoɔ lɛ agbe lɛ, ejaakɛ jeee akɛ ebule hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ kɛkɛ, shi asaŋ etsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eTsɛ, ni efee ehe akɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ye hegbɔ.
Hegbɛ ni Bi lɛ yɔɔ
19 No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Bi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋ eto eyiŋ efee nɔ ko, ja nɔ ni ena akɛ Tsɛ lɛ miifee; ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ feɔ lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ Bi lɛ hu feɔ. 20 Ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ Bi lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nibii fiaa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efeɔ lɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nitsumɔi wuji ni fe enɛɛmɛi tete, ni nyɛnaa aaakpɛ nyɛhe. 21Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ teɔ gbohii ashi ni ehãa amɛ wala lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Bi lɛ hu hãa mɛi ni esumɔɔ lɛ wala. 22 Ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ ekojooo mɔ ko, shi moŋ etu kojomɔ lɛ fɛɛ ewo Bi lɛ dɛŋ; 23 koni mɛi fɛɛ abu Bi lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛbuɔ Tsɛ lɛ. Mɔ ni ebuuu Bi lɛ, ebuuu Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu lɛ lɛ hu.
24 “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ ni eheɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni ebaŋ kojomɔ mli, shi moŋ efo mli yɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli. 25 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ: ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba, ni eshɛ etã, ni gbohii lɛ aaanu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbee, ni mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ aaana wala. 26 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Bi lɛ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli. 27 Ni ehã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekojo hu, ejaakɛ lɛ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ. 28Enɛ akafee nyɛ naakpɛɛ; ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba, nɔ mli ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ gbohii abui amli lɛ aaanu egbee, 29 ni amɛaaje kpo, mɛi ni efee ekpakpa lɛ aaate shi kɛaatee wala mli, ni mɛi ni etsu nishaianii lɛ aaate shi kɛaatee kojomɔ lɛ mli.”
Nii ni yeɔ Yesu he odase
30 “Mi diɛŋtsɛ minyɛŋ miyiŋ mato mafee nɔ ko; bɔ ni minuɔ lɛ nakai mikojoɔ, ni mikojomɔ lɛ jalɛ kojomɔ ni, ejaakɛ mitaooo nɔ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ misumɔɔ, shi moŋ nɔ ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ sumɔɔ. 31Kɛji mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase miyeɔ lɛ, midase lɛ jeee anɔkwale. 32 Mɔ kroko yɛ ni yeɔ mihe odase, ni mile akɛ odase ni eyeɔ yɛ mihe lɛ anɔkwaleŋ. 33 Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsu atee Yohane ŋɔɔ, ni eye anɔkwale lɛ he odase. 34Shi mi lɛ, mikɛ mihe efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔ ko odase nɔ; shi bɔ ni afee ni ahere nyɛyiwala hewɔ miwieɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ. 35Yohane ji kane ni tsoɔ ni ekpɛɔ lɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛmli afili nyɛ be kukuoo kɛkɛ yɛ elá lɛ mli. 36 Shi mi lɛ, miyɛ odase ni fe Yohane nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ ehã mi akɛ migbe naa lɛ, nakai nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yeɔ mihe odase akɛ Tsɛ lɛ tsu mi. 37 Ni Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eye mihe odase. Nyɛnuko egbee dã lɛ, asaŋ nyɛnako esubaŋ dã; 38ni ewiemɔ lɛ mɔɔɔ shi yɛ nyɛmli, ejaakɛ nyɛheee mɔ ni etsu lɛ nyɛyeee. 39 Nyɛtaoɔ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli, ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nomɛi amli nyɛnaa naanɔ wala yɛ; ni nomɛi nɔŋŋ ji nii ni yeɔ mihe odase lɛ. 40Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛsumɔɔɔ akɛ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ ni nyɛna wala.
41“Mitaooo gbɔmɛi ahiɛnyam. 42Shi moŋ mikpa nyɛ shi akɛ nyɛbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ yɛ nyɛmli. 43Mi lɛ miba yɛ miTsɛ gbɛi mli, ni nyɛhereee mi; kɛji mɔ kroko ba yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛi mli lɛ, lɛ lɛ nyɛaahere lɛ. 44 Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛaanyɛ nyɛhe nyɛyeŋ, nyɛ ni nyɛtaoɔ anunyam yɛ nyɛteaŋ, shi anunyam ni jɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ koome lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ nyɛdii sɛɛ lɛ? 45 Nyɛkasusua akɛ mi mibafolɔ nyɛnaa mahã Tsɛ lɛ; mɔ ko yɛ ni miifolɔ nyɛnaa, lɛ ji Mose, mɔ nɔ ni nyɛŋɔ nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔ̃ lɛ. 46 Shi eji nyɛhe Mose nyɛye kulɛ, mi hu nyɛaahe mi nyɛye; ejaakɛ mihe sane eŋma lɛ. 47 Shi kɛji nyɛheee eŋmalɛi lɛ nyɛyeee lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛaahe miwiemɔi lɛ nyɛyeŋ?”

Title: YOHANE 6
Content:
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii
(Mateo 14.13-21; Marko 6.30-44; Luka 9.10-17)
1Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yiŋ etee Galilea Ŋshɔ ni ji Tiberia Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ. 2Ni mɛi babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna naakpɛɛ nii ni efee yɛ helatsɛmɛi lɛ ahe lɛ. 3Ni Yesu tee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yatara jɛi. 4 Shi Hehoo lɛ, ni ji Yudafoi lɛ agbijurɔ lɛ, eshɛ etã. 5Yesu yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ ena akɛ mɛi babaoo miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ebi Filipo akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ wɔɔyahe aboloo yɛ wɔhã mɛnɛɛmɛi amɛye?” 6Shi enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekɛka lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ele nɔ ni ebaafee. 7Filipo here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Denarioi ohai enyɔ naa aboloo shɛŋ amɛ, bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana fioo ko.” 8Ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Andrea lɛ, ni ji Simon Petro nyɛmi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 9“Gbekɛ nuu ko yɛ biɛ ni yɔɔ aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi bibii enyɔ; shi mɛi pii nɛɛ, amɛnɛgbɛ enɛ shɛɔ?” 10Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa mɛi lɛ ataraa shi.” Shi jwɛi pii yɛ jɛi, ni hii ni amɛyibɔ aaashɛ akpei enumɔ lɛ ho tara shi. 11Ni Yesu kɔlɔ aboloi lɛ, ni be ni eda shi lɛ, eja ehã mɛi ni tara shi lɛ, kɛ loi lɛ hu eko, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ. 12Be ni amɛtɔrɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbuaa fufuji ni eshwɛ lɛ anaa, koni nɔ ko akalaaje.” 13Kɛkɛ ni amɛbua aboloi enumɔ lɛ afufuji ni mɛi ni ye lɛ shwɛ lɛ anaa amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
14 No hewɔ lɛ, be ni gbɔmɛi lɛ na naakpɛɛnii ni Yesu fee lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Anɔkwa, mɔ nɛ ji gbalɔ ni baa je lɛ mli lɛ!” 15 Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ amɛbaaba ni amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛyawo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ekome too egbala ehe shi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Yesu nyiɛ nu hiɛ
(Mateo 14.22-33; Marko 6.45-52)
16Be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa, 17ni amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni amɛmiifo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛya Kapernaum. Shi duŋ ewo fɛɛ lɛ, Yesu bako amɛŋɔɔ lolo; 18ni ahum ko ni batswa hewɔ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ fite. 19Be ni amɛwiri aaafee shitoi etɛ̃ loo ejwɛ lɛ, amɛna Yesu ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ ni eebɛŋkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei. 20Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miŋ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.” 21No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ miishɛɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛba lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni amrɔ lɛ lɛlɛ lɛ yakpeleke he ni amɛyaa lɛ.
Yesu, wala aboloo lɛ
22Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, asafo ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ na akɛ lɛlɛ kroko bɛ jɛi dɔŋŋ akɛ ja ekome kɛkɛ, ni amɛna hu akɛ Yesu kɛ kaselɔi lɛ eyaaa lɛlɛ lɛ mli, shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛkɛ (kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ) yiŋ kɛtee; 23tsɛbelɛ lɛji krokomɛi jɛ Tiberia ba he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ da shi ni amɛye aboloo lɛ yɛ lɛ masɛi; 24no hewɔ lɛ, be ni asafo lɛ na akɛ Yesu loo ekaselɔi lɛ bɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛbote lɛji amli, ni amɛba Kapernaum amɛmiitao Yesu. 25Ni be ni amɛbana lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, te be ni oba biɛŋ?” 26Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee okadii lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nɛɛ, shi moŋ akɛni nyɛye aboloo lɛ eko ni nyɛtɔrɔ lɛ hewɔŋ. 27 Nyɛkatsua ŋmaa ni fiteɔ lɛ he nii, shi moŋ nyɛtsua ŋmaa ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaahã nyɛ lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ lɛ enaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ esɔo.” 28Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Te wɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔtsu Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ?” 29 Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ nyɛhe mɔ ni etsu lɛ nɔ nyɛye.” 30 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛɛ okadi ofeɔ ni wɔna koni wɔhe bo wɔye? Mɛni otsuɔ? 31 Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ye mana lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, ‘Ehã amɛ aboloo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi amɛye’ lɛ.” 32 Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee Mose ji mɔ ni hã nyɛ aboloo lɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, shi miTsɛ moŋ hãa nyɛ anɔkwa aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ. 33Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aboloo lɛ ji mɔ ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekpelekeɔ shi ni eŋɔɔ wala ehãa je lɛ.” 34Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, hã wɔ aboloo nɛɛ daa.”
35 Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi ji wala aboloo lɛ; mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko, ni mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, kumai hu yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko. 36 Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛna mi, ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee. 37 Mɛi fɛɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛhãa mi lɛ aaaba miŋɔɔ, ni mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, mishwieŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ. 38 Ejaakɛ jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ misuɔmɔnaa nifeemɔ hewɔ mijɛ ŋwɛi miba, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaa nifeemɔ hewɔŋ. 39 Shi enɛ ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ekɛhã mi lɛ, mikahã amɛteŋ mɔ ko miilaaje, shi moŋ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ. 40 Ejaakɛ enɛ ji mí-Tsɛ suɔmɔnaanii, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ Bi lɛ ni eheɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.”
41Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ wie ehe huhuuhu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi ji aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ;” 42 ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee Yosef bi Yesu lɛ ni wɔle etsɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nɛ? Mɛɛba mɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mijɛ ŋwɛi’ lɛ?” 43No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkawiewiea huhuuhu yɛ nyɛteŋ. 44 Mɔ ko nyɛŋ aba miŋɔɔ, akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi lɛ gbala lɛ dã, ni mi lɛ matee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ. 45 Aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli akɛ, ‘Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaafee mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii.’ Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni enu enɛ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ naa ni ekase hu lɛ, ebaa miŋɔɔ. 46 Jeee akɛ mɔ ko ena Tsɛ lɛ pɛŋ, ja mɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ; lɛ ena Tsɛ lɛ. 47 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ eyɛ naanɔ wala. 48 Mi ji wala aboloo lɛ. 49 Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye mana yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni amɛgboi. 50Enɛ ji aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi baa lɛ, koni gbɔmɔ aye ni ekagbo. 51 Mi ji aboloo ni hiɛ kã ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ; kɛji mɔ ko ye aboloo nɛɛ eko lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ. Shi aboloo ni mikɛbaahã lɛ ji miheloo ni mikɛbaahã yɛ je lɛ wala hewɔ lɛ.”
52No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ taataa naa yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Te mɔ nɛ baafee tɛŋŋ ni enyɛ ekɛ eheloo ahã wɔ ni wɔyeŋ?” 53Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyeee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ heloo ni nyɛnuuu elá lɛ, nyɛbɛ wala yɛ nyɛmli. 54Mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ matee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ. 55Ejaakɛ miheloo lɛ anɔkwa ŋmaa ni, ni milá lɛ anɔkwa numɔnɔ ni. 56 Mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ, ehiɔ mimli, ni mi hu mihiɔ emli. 57Bɔ ni Tsɛ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, tsu mi, ni Tsɛ lɛ hewɔ mihiɛ kã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni yeɔ mi lɛ hu hiɛ aaakã yɛ mihewɔ. 58Aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba nɛ; etamɔɔɔ nɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye ni amɛgboi lɛ; mɔ ni yeɔ aboloo nɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ.”
59Ewie nii nɛɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehe ko yɛ Kapernaum lɛ.
Naanɔ wala wiemɔi lɛ
60No hewɔ lɛ, be ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii nu enɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Wiemɔ ni wa nɛ; namɔ aaanyɛ toi abo?” 61Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ ekaselɔi lɛ miihuhuu yɛ enɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani enɛ tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ nyɛnane nɛɛ? 62 Shi kɛji nyɛna Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya ŋwɛi he ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ, no hu? 63 Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni hãa wala lɛ; heloo lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko. Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ, mumɔ ni, ni wala ni. 64 Shi nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ ni heee yeee.” Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ Yesu le mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ kɛ mɔ hu ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ. 65 Ni ekɛɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ miŋɔɔ aba, ja Tsɛ lɛ ehã lɛ hegbɛ lɛ.”
66Jɛ no nɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii ku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ enyiɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ. 67No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu bi mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee?” 68 Simon Petro here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ŋɔɔ wɔɔtee? Bo oyɔɔ naanɔ wala wiemɔi lɛ; 69 ni wɔ lɛ wɔhe wɔye ni asaŋ wɔna wɔle akɛ bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!” 70Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani jeee nyɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mihala? Shi nyɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ abonsam ni!” 71Shi Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, he ewieɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.

Title: YOHANE 7
Content:
Yesu tee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ
1 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kpa shi yɛ Galilea. Esumɔɔɔ akɛ eyakpaa shi yɛ Yudea, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ miitao lɛ agbe. 2 Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ Asesei agbijurɔ lɛ eshɛ etã. 3 No hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee biɛ ni oya Yudea, koni okaselɔi lɛ hu ana onitsumɔi ni otsuɔ lɛ. 4Ejaakɛ mɔ ko ni etao akɛ ale lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ efeee nɔ ko yɛ teemɔ mli. Akɛni oofee nibii nɛɛ lɛ, jiemɔ ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ.” 5Shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ tete po heee enɔ yeee. 6 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibe lɛ nako ashɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbe lɛ daa nɛɛ eshɛ. 7 Je lɛ nyɛɛɛ nyɛ anyɛ; shi mi lɛ enyɛɔ mi, ejaakɛ miyeɔ ehe odase akɛ enitsumɔi lɛ nitsumɔi fɔ̃ji ni. 8Nyɛ lɛ nyɛyaa gbijurɔ nɛɛ yeli; shi mi lɛ minako maya, ejaakɛ mibe lɛ nako ashɛ.” 9Be ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, ehi shi yɛ Galilea. 10Shi be ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ etee gbijurɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, lɛ hu etee, shi ejieee ehe shi, shi moŋ efee tamɔ mɔ ko ni miitee ehe.
11Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ bɔ̃i lɛ taomɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?” 12Ni huhuhuhu wiemɔi pii ete shi yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ yɛ ehe. Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji lɛ;” ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ, “Dabi, hã moŋ ehãa asafo lɛ duduɔ.” 13Tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko ejeee faŋŋ ewieee ehe yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ.
14Shi be ni shɛ gbijurɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii. 15 Ni Yudafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, “Te mɔ nɛ ni ekaseko nii lɛ fee tɛŋŋ ni ele woji amli nii nɛkɛ?” 16Yesu here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Minitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ. 17Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, ebaayoo yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɛ aloo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ. 18 Mɔ ni toɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam etaoɔ, shi mɔ ni taoɔ mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ anunyam lɛ, lɛ lɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ, ni nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ emli. 19 Ani jeee Mose hã nyɛ Mla lɛ? Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee Mla lɛ nɔ. Mɛni hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nyɛgbe lɛ?” 20 Asafo lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ omli; namɔ taoɔ bo agbe?” 21 Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nitsumɔ kome mitsu, ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnaa ekpɛ nyɛhe yɛ he. 22 Mose kɛ ketiafoo lɛ hã nyɛ — jeee akɛ lɛ Mose lɛ eŋɔɔ ejɛ, shi moŋ ejɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ — ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛfoɔ mɔ ketia. 23Kɛji hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ afoɔ mɔ kɛtia bɔ ni afee ni akatɔ̃ Mose Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛmli fuɔ mi akɛ mitsa gbɔmɔ muu lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ? 24Nyɛkakwɛa hiɛiaŋ nyɛkojoa, shi moŋ nyɛkojoa jalɛ kojomɔ.”
Ani Kristo lɛ nɛ?
25 Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ ni amɛtaoɔ amɛgbe lɛ nɛ? 26Ni naa, faŋŋ ewieɔ yɛ nɛɛ, ni amɛkɛɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko. Ekolɛ benɛ onukpai lɛ ena ele lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mɔ nɛ ji Kristo lɛ? 27 Shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, wɔle he ni ejɛ; shi Kristo lɛ, be ni eeeba lɛ, mɔ ko leŋ he ni ejɛ.”
28No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ebo ekɛɛ, “Nyɛle mi, ni asaŋ nyɛle he ni mijɛ; ni mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaa, shi moŋ anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ, ni nyɛleee lɛ. 29 Shi mi lɛ mile lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni lɛ etsu mi.” 30 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao amɛmɔ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko. 31 Shi asafo lɛ mli mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Be ni Kristo lɛ aaaba lɛ, ani eeefee okadii pii fe nii ni mɔ nɛ feɔ nɛɛ?”
Yesu gba eŋwɛiyaa eto
32Farisifoi lɛ nu akɛ asafo lɛ miiwie nii nɛɛ ahe huhuhuhu yɛ ehe; ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ tsu tsuji koni amɛyamɔ lɛ. 33 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi, ni mibaya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ. 34 Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba.” 35No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ baaya ni wɔnaŋ lɛ? Ani mɛi ni egbɛ eshwã Helabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ ebaaya, ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ Helabii lɛ anii? 36Mɛɛ wiemɔ ewie nɛɛ, ‘Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba lɛ?’ ”
Wala nu lɛ he shiwoo
37 Shi naagbee gbi ni ji gbii juji lɛ ateŋ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yesu yadamɔ shi ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Kɛji kumai miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eba miŋɔɔ ni ebanu nu. 38 Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, fai ni wala nu yɔɔ mli aaajɛ emli aho.” 39 Shi Mumɔ lɛ ni mɛi ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ baana lɛ he ewie nɛɛ; shi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nako aba, ejaakɛ anako awo Yesu hiɛ nyam.
Mligbalamɔ ba mɛi lɛ ateŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ
40 Be ni asafo lɛ mli mɛi komɛi nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Gbalɔ lɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛŋ!” 41 Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Kristo lɛ nɛ!” Shi mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ, “Ani Kristo lɛ, Galilea ebaajɛ? 42 Ani Ŋmalɛ lɛ ekɛɛɛ akɛ David shwiei lɛ mli kɛ Betlehem maŋ he ni David hi lɛ, jɛi Kristo lɛ baajɛ?” 43 Kɛkɛ ni mligbalamɔ ba asafo lɛ mli yɛ ehewɔ. 44 Shi kulɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi miitao akɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe.
Yudafoi anukpai lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ mɔ ko heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ
45Kɛkɛ ni tsuji lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ. Amɛbi tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ lɛ baaa?” 46 Tsuji lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Bɔ ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ wieɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ewieko nakai dã.” 47Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu alaka nyɛ? 48Ani onukpai lɛ loo Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ehe enɔ eye? 49Shi asafo ni leee Mla nɛɛ, alomɔ amɛ.” 50 Nikodemo, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ba Yesu ŋɔɔ be ko lɛ, kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 51 “Kɛ anuko mɔ ko daaŋ gbee ni aaale nɔ ni efee lɛ, wɔmla lɛ buɔ le fɔ lo?” 52 Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo hu Galilea ojɛ? Taomɔ mli okwɛ, shi gbalɔ ko eteko shi kɛjɛko Galilea pɛŋ.”
[ 53Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.

Title: YOHANE 8
Content:
Yoo gbãlãfitelɔ lɛ
1Shi Yesu yiŋ etee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 2Ni leebi maaŋkpa lɛ eba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni eho eta shi etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii. 3Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ŋɔ yoo ko ni amɔ lɛ yɛ gbãlãfitemɔ mli kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛhã edamɔ teŋ, 4ni amɛkɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, gbãlãfitemɔ mli diɛŋtsɛ amɔ lɛ yɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ. 5 Mla lɛ mli lɛ Mose wo wɔ kitã akɛ atswia nɛkɛ yei atɛi. Shi bo lɛ, te okɛɔ tɛŋŋ?” 6Shi enɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ amɛkɛtsɔ̃ lɛ, koni amɛna nɔ ko amɛkɛyafolɔ enaa. Ni Yesu koto shi, ni ekɛ ewao ŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ. 7Shi be ni amɛhiɛ lɛ bimɔ lɛ, ewo ehe nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni esha bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ tsutsu etswa lɛ tɛ lɛ.” 8Ni esaa ekoto shi ekoŋŋ, ni eŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ. 9 Be ni amɛnu nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i kpojee ekomekome, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ nɔ kɛyashi sɛɛkpee mɔ nɔ, ni bashwɛ Yesu kome kɛkɛ kɛ yoo lɛ ni edãmɔ te lɛ mli. 10Shi be ni Yesu wo ehe nɔ ni enaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja yoo lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Awo, nɛgbɛ onaafolɔlɔi lɛ yɔɔ, Ani mɔ ko ebuko bo fɔ?” 11 Ni ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko ebuko mi fɔ, Nuŋtsɔ.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mibuuu bo fɔ; yaa, shi kaafee esha dɔŋŋ.”]
Yesu ye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe odase
12 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Mi ji je lɛ mli la lɛ. Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ misɛɛ lɛ, enyiɛŋ duŋ mli gbi ko gbi ko, shi moŋ eeena wala la lɛ.” 13No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe odase oyeɔ; odase lɛ bɛ mli.” 14 Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Kɛ miiye mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase hu jiŋŋ, midase lɛ anɔkwale ni, ejaakɛ mile he ni mijɛ kɛ he ni miyaa, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleee he ni mijɛ aloo he ni miyaa. 15Nyɛ lɛ nyɛkojoɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi kojoɔ; mi lɛ mikojooo mɔ ko. 16 Ni kɛ mikojoɔ tete po, mikojomɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni; ejaakɛ jeee mi kome ni, shi moŋ mi kɛ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ ni. 17 Ni asaŋ nyɛmla lɛ mli hu aŋma akɛ, ‘Mɛi enyɔ odase lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.’ 18Mi lɛ miyeɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase, ni Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ hu yeɔ mihe odase.” 19 Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oTsɛ lɛ yɔɔ?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Nyɛleee mi ni nyɛsaa nyɛleee miTsɛ; nyɛle mi jikulɛ, nyɛaale miTsɛ hu.”
20 Yesu wie wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nitoohe lɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; ni mɔ ko mɔɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.
21 Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mi lɛ miiya, ni nyɛaatao mi, ni nyɛhe esha lɛ mli nyɛaagboi yɛ; he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba.” 22 No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Ani eyaagbe ehe hewɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba’ lɛ?” 23 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ shishi nɛɛ, mi lɛ mijɛ ŋwɛi; nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ je nɛɛ mli, mi lɛ mijɛɛɛ je nɛɛ mli. 24No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee akɛ mi nɛɛ ji lɛ lɛ, nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli.” 25Agbɛnɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. 26Miyɛ nyɛhe saji pii ni mawie ni mikɛaakojo nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ anɔkwafoŋ, ni mi lɛ, nii ni minu yɛ enaa lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ miwieɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ.” 27Amɛleee akɛ Tsɛ lɛ he ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ. 28 No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be ni nyɛaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli nyɛaale akɛ mi ni, ni akɛ mitooo miyiŋ mifeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ bɔ ni miTsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ. 29Ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ kɛ mi yɛ; Tsɛ lɛ shiko mi kome, ejaakɛ mi lɛ nɔ ni sa ehiɛ mifeɔ daa.” 30Be ni ewieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, mɛi pii he enɔ ye.
Anɔkwale lɛ aaahã nyɛye nyɛhe
31 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ Yudafoi ni ehe lɛ eye lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛhi shi yɛ miwiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, minɔkwa kaselɔi ji nyɛ, 32ni nyɛaale anɔkwale lɛ, ni anɔkwale lɛ aaahã nyɛye nyɛhe.” 33 Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Abraham shwiei ji wɔ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ̃ko mɔ ko nyɔji pɛŋ; te tɛŋŋ ni bo okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛaaye nyɛheŋ?’ ” 34 Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, esha lɛ nyɔŋ ji lɛ. 35Nyɔŋ ehiii shĩa kɛyaaa naanɔ; shi bi hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ. 36 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Bi lɛ hã nyɛye nyɛhe lɛ, no nyɛaaye nyɛhe lɛɛlɛŋ. 37Mile akɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, ejaakɛ miwiemɔ hooo nyɛmli. 38Mi lɛ, nɔ ni mina yɛ miTsɛ he lɛ, no miwieɔ; ni nyɛ hu, nɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ nyɛtsɛ naa lɛ, no nyɛfeɔ.”
39Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔtsɛ ji Abraham.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abrahambii ji nyɛ jikulɛ, nyɛaatsu Abraham nitsumɔi. 40Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, mi gbɔmɔ ko ni mikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale ni minu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa lɛ; Abraham efeee enɛ. 41Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɛ nitsumɔi nyɛtsuɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ afɔɔɔ wɔ yɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mli; Tsɛ kome wɔyɔɔ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.” 42Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ji nyɛTsɛ kulɛ, nyɛaasumɔ mi; ejaakɛ mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba; ni asaŋ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaa, shi moŋ lɛ etsu mi. 43Shi mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛnaaa miwiemɔ naa lɛ? Ejɛ miwiemɔ toi ni nyɛbooo lɛ. 44 Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛ ni nyɛjɛ emli ji abonsam, ni nyɛtsɛ lɛ suɔmɔnaanii nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ nyɛfee. Lɛ lɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ji lɛ kɛjɛ teteete, ni ekɛ anɔkwale lɛ bɛ sane ko, ejaakɛ anɔkwale bɛ emli. Kɛ eemale lɛ, esu ni, ejaakɛ amalelɔ kɛ ablatsɛ ji lɛ. 45Shi mi lɛ, akɛni miwieɔ anɔkwale hewɔ lɛ, nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee. 46 Nyɛteŋ namɔ kãa mi yɛ esha ko he? Shi kɛji anɔkwale miwieɔ lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ? 47 Mɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, enuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi; no hewɔ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛnuuu lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛjɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.”
Miyɛ dani Abraham ba
48 Yudafoi lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee gbɛnaa wɔkɛɔ akɛ Samarianyo ji bo, ni mumɔ fɔŋ hu yɛ omli lɛ?” 49Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ bɛ mimli, shi miiwo miTsɛ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛmiishwie mihiɛ shi moŋ. 50 Mitaooo mi diɛŋtsɛ minunyam; shi mɔ ko yɛ ni taoɔ ni ekojoɔ ehãa mi. 51 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji mɔ ko ye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, enaŋ gbele kɛaatee naanɔ.” 52Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpaako wɔna wɔle akɛ mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ omli. Abraham gbo, ni gbalɔi lɛ hu gboi, ni bo lɛ okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Kɛji mɔ ko ye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, esaŋ enaa gbele gbi ko gbi ko kɛaatee naanɔ.’ 53Ani ofe wɔtsɛ Abraham ni gbo lɛ? Ni gbalɔi lɛ hu gboi. Te otsɛɔ ohe tɛŋŋ nɛɛ?” 54Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji miwo mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiɛ nyam lɛ, minunyam lɛ jeee nɔ ko; miTsɛ ji mɔ ni woɔ mihiɛ nyam, mɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ lɛ, 55 ni nyɛleko lɛ, shi mi lɛ mile lɛ; ni kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ mileee lɛ lɛ, matsɔ̃ amalelɔ tamɔ nyɛ; shi mile lɛ, ni miyeɔ ewiemɔ nɔ. 56Nyɛtsɛ Abraham mli fili lɛ akɛ eeena migbi lɛ, ni ena ni emii shɛ ehe.” 57Kɛkɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onako oye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni ona Abraham lo?” 58 Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, miyɛ momo dani afɔ Abraham.” 59 Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɔlɔ tɛi ni amɛbaatswia lɛ; shi Yesu tee ehe, ni eje Sɔlemɔ we lɛ etee.

Title: YOHANE 9
Content:
Yesu tsa nuu ko ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo
1Ni be ni Yesu hoɔ lɛ, ena nuu ko ni eshwila kɛjɛ efɔmɔ mli. 2 Ni ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, namɔ fee esha, mɔ nɛ loo efɔlɔi, hewɔ ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo lɛ?” 3 Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Jeee esha ni mɔ nɛ loo efɔlɔi fee hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ ana aje kpo yɛ emli. 4 Mi lɛ, ni je etsɛre nɛɛ, ja mitsu mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, je baana, be ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ nii atsu. 5 Gbii abɔ ni miyɔɔ je lɛ mli nɛɛ, je lɛ la ji mi.” 6 Be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni ekɛ lajɔ̃ lɛ kpɔtɔ su, ni ekɛ su lɛ kpa shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii anɔ, 7ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaaju ohe yɛ Siloam (eshishi ji, Mɔ ni atsu lɛ) Kpaakpo lɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni etee eyaju ehe, ni eba ni eena nii.
8Kɛkɛ lɛ ekuŋbii kɛ mɛi ni na lɛ tsutsu ko akɛ sisɛ̃lɔ ji lɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ ni kulɛ etaa shi ni esisɛ̃ɔ lɛ nɛ?” 9Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Lɛ ni.” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Jeee lɛ ni; etamɔ lɛ.” Ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ, “Mi ni.” 10No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni ohiŋmɛii lɛ gbeleŋ?” 11Ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yesu lɛ kpɔtɔ su, ni ekɛkpa mihiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa Siloam Kpaakpo lɛ mli ni oyaju ohe.’ Ni be ni mitee miyaju mihe lɛ, mina nii.” 12Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?” Eto he akɛ, “Mileee.”
Farisifoi lɛ bibii saji yɛ etsamɔ lɛ he
13Ni amɛŋɔ mɔ ni tsutsu ni eshwila lɛ kɛtee Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ. 14 Shi gbi ni Yesu kpɔtɔ su ni ekɛgbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni. 15Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ hu saa bi lɛ bɔ ni fee ni ena nii lɛ. Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Su ni akpɔtɔ ekɛkpa mihiŋmɛii anɔ, ni miyaju mihe, ni minaa nii nɛɛ.” 16 No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ eyeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ mla lɛ nɔ.” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Te gbɔmɔ ko ni ji eshafeelɔ aaafee tɛŋŋ ni enyɛ efee naakpɛɛnii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi hu?” Ni mligbalamɔ ba amɛteŋ. 17Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi shwilafo lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo hu, te okɛɔ yɛ ehe tɛŋŋ akɛni egbele ohiŋmɛii lɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Gbalɔ ji lɛ.” 18Shi Yudafoi lɛ heee yeee akɛ shwilafo ji lɛ sa ni agbɛnɛ enaa nii nɛɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛyatsɛ efɔlɔi 19ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛbi ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ afɔ lɛ shwilafo lɛ nɛ? Te fee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni agbɛnɛ enaa niiŋ?” 20Efɔlɔi lɛ here amɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔle akɛ wɔbi lɛ nɛ, ni wɔle akɛ afɔ lɛ shwilafo; 21shi bɔ ni fee ni enaa nii agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, wɔleee, asaŋ mɔ ni gbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ hu wɔleee; eda, nyɛbia lɛ; lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaawie ehã ehe.” 22 Efɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe Yudafoi lɛ agbeyei; shi Yudafoi lɛ ekpãŋ eto akɛ, kɛji mɔ ko gba mli kpoo kɛɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ, abaashwie mɔ lɛ kɛjɛ kpeehe lɛ. 23No hewɔ ni efɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Eda, nyɛbia lɛ diɛŋtsɛ” lɛ.
24 Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɛ nuu ni sa ni eji shwilafo lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ anunyam ohã Nyɔŋmɔ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔle akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ eshafeelɔ ji lɛ.” 25Kɛkɛ ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Eshafeelɔ ji lɛ jiŋŋ, mileee; nɔ kome mile, akɛ kulɛ shwilafo ji mi, shi agbɛnɛ miina nii.” 26Ni amɛbi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mɛni efee bo? Te efee tɛŋŋ ni egbele ohiŋmɛii lɛ?” 27Ehere amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mikɛɛ nyɛ momo, ni nyɛnuuu: mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ toi nyɛbo ekoŋŋ? Ani nyɛ hu nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ ekaselɔi?” 28Amɛjɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Bo ji ekaselɔ, shi wɔ lɛ Mose kaselɔi ji wɔ. 29Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose wie; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, wɔleee he ni ejɛ.” 30Nuu lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ, akɛ nyɛleee he ni ejɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ egbele mihiŋmɛii lɛ! 31 Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ booo eshafeelɔi atoi; shi kɛji mɔ ko sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni efeɔ esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, eboɔ lɛ toi. 32Kɛjɛ ni abɔ ade nɛɛ anuko akɛ mɔ ko egbele mɔ ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo hiŋmɛii dã. 33 Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ kulɛ enyɛŋ nɔ ko efee.” 34 Amɛhere nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ, esha mli kwraa afɔ bo yɛ, ni bo moŋ otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii nɛɛ?” Ni amɛshwie lɛ.
Nuu ni atsa lɛ lɛ he Yesu nɔ eye
35Yesu nu akɛ amɛshwie lɛ; ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Oohe Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ ooye lo?” 36Ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Namɔ ji lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ koni mahe enɔ maye?” 37 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ona lɛ momo, ni asaŋ mɔ ni kɛ bo wieɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ni.” 38Ni ekɛɛ, “Miihe miiye, Nuŋtsɔ.” Ni ekula shi eja lɛ.
Mumɔŋ shwilamɔ
39 Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Kojomɔ hewɔ miba je nɛɛŋ, koni mɛi ni enaaa nii lɛ ana nii, ni mɛi ni naa nii lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ shwilafoi.” 40Ni Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nu enɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔ hu shwilafoi ji wɔ?” 41 Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Eji nyɛshwila moŋ kulɛ, nyɛhe bɛ esha; shi agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔmiina nii.’ No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhe esha lɛ yɛ nyɛhe lolo.”

Title: YOHANE 10
Content:
Toi atsu lɛ he abɛ lɛ
1“Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔɔ shinaa lɛ ni ekɛbote toi atsu lɛ mli, shi moŋ etsɔ̃ɔ he kroko ekɛkwɔɔ lɛ, julɔ kɛ ojotswalɔ ji lɛ. 2Shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ shinaa lɛ mli kɛboteɔ mli lɛ, toi lɛ akwɛlɔ ji lɛ. 3Lɛ shinaa naabulɔ lɛ gbeleɔ, ni toi lɛ nuɔ egbee, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etoi lɛ agbɛi tsɛɔ amɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ jeɔ kpo. 4Ni kɛ ejie toi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ, ni toi lɛ nyiɛɔ esɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛle egbee. 5Amɛnyiɛŋ mɔkpɔŋ sɛɛ, shi moŋ amɛaajo enaa foi, ejaakɛ amɛleee mɛi kpɔji agbee.” 6Yesu bu amɛ abɛ nɛɛ; shi amɛ lɛ amɛnuuu nɔ ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ shishi.
Yesu, Tookwɛlɔ Kpakpa lɛ
7No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Mi ji toi lɛ ashinaa lɛ. 8 Mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ mihiɛ ba lɛ, julɔi kɛ ojotswalɔi ji amɛ; shi toi lɛ booo amɛ toi hu. 9Mi ji shinaa lɛ. Mi lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko tsɔ̃ minaa etee mli lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, ni eeetee mli ni eeeje kpo, ni eeena lɛɛnii. 10 Julɔ baaa yaka, shi juu kɛ gbee kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hewɔ ebaa; mi lɛ miba bɔ ni afee ni amɛna wala ni amɛna ni ateke nɔ.
11 “Mi ji tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ. Tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ kɛ ewala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ etoi lɛ anajiaŋ. 12Shi mɔ ni ji apaafonyo ni ejeee toi lɛ akwɛlɔ, mɔ ni toi lɛ jeee enɔ lɛ naa akɛ klaŋ miiba, ni eshiɔ toi lɛ, ni ejoɔ foi, ni klaŋ lɛ bamɔmɔɔ toi lɛ ni egbɛɔ amɛ eshwãa. 13Apaafonyo lɛ joɔ foi ejaakɛ apaafonyo ji lɛ, ni toi lɛ ahe edɔɔɔ lɛ. 14 Mi ji tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ; mile mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoi lɛ, ni mitoi lɛ hu le mi, 15 tamɔ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ le mi, ni mi hu mile Tsɛ lɛ. Ni mikɛ miwala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ toi lɛ anajiaŋ.
16 “Miyɛ toi krokomɛi ni jɛɛɛ toi atsu nɛɛ mli; ni nomɛi hu, ja miŋɔ amɛ kɛba, ni amɛbanu migbee, ni toi lɛ fee kuu kome kɛ kwɛlɔ kome. 17No hewɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ mi lɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ miwala ŋmɛɔ shi, koni maŋɔ ekoŋŋ. 18 Mɔ ko shɔ̃ɔɔ yɛ midɛŋ, shi moŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛŋmɛɔ shi; miyɛ hewalɛ akɛ mikɛŋmɛɔ shi, ni miyɛ hewalɛ akɛ miŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ; bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ mi nɛ.”
19 Wiemɔi nɛɛ ahewɔ lɛ mligbalamɔ saa ba Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ ekoŋŋ. 20 Ni amɛteŋ mɛi pii kɛɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli ni eye sɛkɛ; mɛɛhewɔ nyɛboɔ lɛ toi?” 21Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Jeee mɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli wiemɔi nɛ. Ani mumɔ fɔŋ aaanyɛ shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii agbele?”
Yudafoi lɛ ŋwã Yesu
22Agbɛnɛ aaye Sɔlemɔtsu Nɔjɔɔmɔ Gbijurɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni fɛ̃ibe mli ni. 23 Ni Yesu miishara shi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɛ Solomon koi lɛ shi. 24Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ babɔle ehe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ooohã wɔyiŋ afee wɔ kɔshikɔshi kɛyashi? Kɛ bo ji Kristo lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ faŋŋ.” 25 Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mikɛɛ nyɛ momo shi nyɛheee nyɛyeee. Nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ yɛ miTsɛ gbɛi mli lɛ, nomɛi miiye mihe odase; 26 shi nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛheee nyɛyeee, ejaakɛ nyɛjeee mitoi lɛ eko. 27 Mitoi lɛ nuɔ migbee, ni mile amɛ, ni amɛnyiɛɔ misɛɛ, 28ni mihãa amɛ naanɔ wala, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãŋ kɛaatee naanɔ, ni asaŋ mɔ ko shɔŋ amɛ yɛ midɛŋ. 29MiTsɛ ni ŋɔ amɛ ehã mi lɛ fe mɛi fɛɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ashɔ̃ amɛ yɛ miTsɛ dɛŋ. 30Mi kɛ Tsɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ekomeŋ.”
31 Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɔlɔ tɛi ekoŋŋ akɛ amɛbaatswia lɛ. 32Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai pii ni jɛ miTsɛ ŋɔɔ; te nakai nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ hewɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ mi tɛi nyɛtswia nɛɛ?” 33 Yudafoi lɛ here lɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee nitsumɔ kpakpa ko hewɔ wɔbaatswia bo tɛi lɛ, shi moŋ musubɔɔ hewɔŋ, ejaakɛ bo ni gbɔmɔ ji bo lɛ, ootsɛ ohe Nyɔŋmɔ.” 34Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani aŋmako yɛ nyɛMla lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Mikɛɛ, nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ?’ 35Kɛji mɛi aŋɔɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ba lɛ tete lɛ etsɛ amɛ nyɔŋmɔi, ni anyɛŋ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli aku lɛ, 36 nyɛmiikɛɛ mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni etsu lɛ kɛba je lɛ mli lɛ akɛ, ‘Obɔ musu’, akɛni mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji mi’ lɛ? 37Kɛjeee miTsɛ nitsumɔi mitsuɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkahea mi nyɛyea; 38shi kɛji no mitsuɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ, nyɛhea nitsumɔi lɛ kɛkɛ nyɛyea mɔ, koni nyɛle ni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Tsɛ lɛ yɛ mimli, ni mi hu miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli.”
39 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao ekoŋŋ akɛ amɛmɔ lɛ, shi eje amɛdɛŋ. 40 Ni eyiŋ etee Yordan sɛɛ ekoŋŋ, he ni Yohane baptisi yɛ tsutsu lɛ, ni eyahi jɛi. 41Ni mɛi pii ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Yohane efeee naakpɛɛnii ko moŋ; shi nii fiaa ni ewie yɛ nuu nɛɛ he lɛ, anɔkwaŋ.” 42Ni mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye yɛ jɛi.

Title: YOHANE 11
Content:
Lazaro gbele
1 Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lazaro ni jɛ Betania, Maria kɛ enyɛmi Martamɛi akrowa lɛ, he miiye. [ 2 Maria ni kɛ mukɛŋma kpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ lɛ nyɛmi Lazaro he yeɔ nɛɛ.] 3No hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmimɛi yei lɛ tsu aba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa, mɔ ni osumɔɔ lɛ he miiye.” 4 Shi be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ hela nɛɛ jeee gbele hela ni, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ hewɔ eba, bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ nɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam.”
5Yesu sumɔɔ Maria kɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ kɛ Lazaro fɛɛ. 6Shi be ni enu akɛ ehe miiye lɛ, emɛ yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ gbii enyɔ. 7Ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Yudea ekoŋŋ.” 8 Kaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, eyeko gbi ko ni Yudafoi lɛ tao bo tɛi atswia lɛ, ni ooya jɛi ekoŋŋ lo?” 9 Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Ani jeee ŋmɛlɛtswai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɔɔ gbi kome mli? Kɛji mɔ nyiɛ shwane lɛ, etɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ enaa je nɛɛ mli la lɛ. 10 Shi kɛji mɔ nyiɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, etɛɔ, ejaakɛ la bɛ.” 11 Ewie nii nɛɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔshieŋtsɛ Lazaro ewɔ; shi miiya ni mayatsĩɛ lɛ.” 12Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ wɔ ewɔ lɛ, no lɛ ehe baawa lɛ.” 13Shi egbele he Yesu wie lɛ; shi amɛ lɛ amɛsusu akɛ wɔ kpakpa he ewieɔ lɛ. 14Agbɛnɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ, “Lazaro egbo; 15ni nyɛ hewɔ lɛ eŋɔɔ minaa akɛ mibɛ jɛi, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhe nyɛye; shi nyɛhãa wɔyaa eŋɔɔ.” 16 Kɛkɛ lɛ Toma, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo lɛ, kɛɛ enanemɛi kaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔ hu wɔyaa, ni wɔ kɛ lɛ ayagboa.”
Yesu, mɔ ni ji Shitee lɛ kɛ Wala lɛ
17Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu shɛ jɛi lɛ, ebana akɛ eye gbii ejwɛ momo yɛ bu lɛ mli. 18Shi Betania kɛ Yerusalɛm teŋ jekɛmɔ aaafee shitoi enyɔ. 19Ni Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii eba Marta kɛ Mariamɛi aŋɔɔ, koni amɛbaye amɛ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ amɛnyɛmi nuu lɛ hewɔ. 20Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni Marta nu akɛ Yesu miiba lɛ, etee eyakpee lɛ; shi Maria lɛ, lɛ lɛ eta shĩa lɛ. 21Kɛkɛ ni Marta bakɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eji oyɛ biɛ kulɛ, minyɛmi lɛ gboŋ. 22Shi agbɛnɛ hu mile akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã bo.” 23Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onyɛmi lɛ baate shi.” 24 Marta kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mile akɛ ebaate shi yɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.” 25Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ mi ji shitee lɛ kɛ wala lɛ; mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, kɛji egbo tete lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã; 26 ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni eheɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, egboŋ gbi ko gbi ko kɛaatee naanɔ. Oheɔ enɛ oyeɔ lo?” 27 Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, miheɔ miyeɔ akɛ bo ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni baa je lɛ mli lɛ.”
Yesu fo
28Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee ni eyatsɛ enyɛmi Maria lɛ nigii, ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eba; eetsɛ bo.” 29Be ni enu lɛ, ete shi oya ni eba eŋɔɔ. 30 Shi Yesu nako ashɛ akrowa lɛ, shi eyɛ hegbɛ ni Marta kɛ lɛ yakpe yɛ lɛ lolo. 31Be ni Yudafoi lɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ shĩa lɛ ni amɛyeɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ na akɛ Maria ete shi oya kɛje kpo lɛ, amɛtiu lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ eeya fuuhe lɛ eyafo yɛ jɛi. 32Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni Maria ba he ni Yesu yɔɔ lɛ ni ena lɛ lɛ, eho egbee enaji anaa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eji oyɛ biɛ kulɛ, minyɛmi lɛ gboŋ!” 33 Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu na lɛ akɛ eefo, kɛ Yudafoi lɛ hu ni kɛ lɛ ba lɛ, akɛ amɛ hu amɛmiifo lɛ, ehũu yɛ emumɔ mli, ni ehao; 34ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛto lɛ yɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ba ni obakwɛ.”
35 Yesu fo.
36Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ!” 37Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Ani nuu nɛɛ ni gbele shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ nyɛŋ efee ni kulɛ nuu nɛɛ akagbo?”
Yesu tee Lazaro shi
38 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu saa hũu yɛ emli ekoŋŋ, ni etee fuuhe lɛ; shi tɛkplo ni, ni tɛ bu naa. 39Yesu kɛɛ, “nyɛjiea tɛ lɛ.” Marta, mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛmi yoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, be nɛ mli lɛ efite, ejaakɛ eye gbii ejwɛ sɔŋŋ.” 40 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ kɛji ohe oye lɛ, ooona Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ?” 41No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ jie tɛ lɛ. Ni Yesu hole ehiŋmɛii anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ekɛɛ, “Ataa, miida bo shi akɛ obo mi toi lɛ. 42 Mile akɛ daa oboɔ mi toi, shi asafo lɛ ni damɔ biɛ lɛ hewɔ mikɛɔ enɛ, koni amɛhe amɛye akɛ bo otsu mi.” 43Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ebo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Lazaro ee, jee kpo!” 44Ni gbonyo lɛ je kpo, fuu mamai lɛ fimɔ enaji kɛ eniji, ni duku fi ehiɛ. Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɛnea lɛ, ni nyɛhãa eyaa.”
Atee Yesu yi nɔ apam ni agbe lɛ
45No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ ni ba Maria ŋɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he Yesu nɔ amɛye, be ni amɛna nii ni efee lɛ. 46Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yiŋ tee Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛyagba amɛ nii ni Yesu fee lɛ. 47No hewɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ tsɛ kpee, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Te wɔfeɔ tɛŋŋ, ejaakɛ nuu nɛɛ miifee naakpɛɛnii pii? 48Kɛji wɔŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ aaahe enɔ aye; ni Romabii lɛ aaaba ni amɛaabashɔ̃ wɔsɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ.” 49Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome, Kaiafa ni yeɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛleee nɔ ko kwraa, 50 ni nyɛsaa nyɛjwɛŋŋ hu akɛ ehi hã wɔ akɛ mɔ kome agbo yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ, fe nɔ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã lɛ.” 51 Shi enɛ lɛ, jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eto eyiŋ ewie, shi moŋ, akɛ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, gba egba akɛ Yesu baagbo yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ; 52 ni jeee yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ hewɔ kɛkɛ, shi bɔ ni afee ni ebua Nyɔŋmɔ bii ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ hu naa efee kuu kome. 53Ni kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkpɛ mli akɛ amɛbaagbe lɛ. 54No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu ejieee ehe kpo faŋŋ kɛnyiɛɛɛ yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ dɔŋŋ, shi eje jɛi etee shikpɔŋ ko ni kã ŋa lɛ naa lɛ nɔ, yɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Efraim lɛ mli, ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yahi jɛi.
55 Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ aHehoo lɛ eshɛ etã. Ni mɛi babaoo jɛ koi asɛɛ amɛtee Yerusalɛm, dani Hehoo lɛ ashɛ, koni amɛyatsuu amɛhe. 56Kɛkɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i Yesu taomɔ, ni be ni amɛdamɔdamɔɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ, ani ebaŋ gbijurɔ lɛ?” 57Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ewo kitã akɛ, kɛ mɔ ko le he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, etswa adafi, koni ayamɔ lɛ.

Title: YOHANE 12
Content:
Afɔ Yesu mu yɛ Betania
(Mateo 26.6-13; Marko 14.3-9)
1 Be ni eshwɛ gbii ekpaa ni ayeɔ Hehoo lɛ, Yesu ba Betania, he ni Lazaro, mɔ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, yɔɔ lɛ. 2Amɛŋmɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ni Marta sɔmɔ; ni Lazaro fata mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ahe. 3 Kɛkɛ ni Maria ŋɔ “nardo” mu ŋmiiŋmi ni jara wa naakpa ni etsiimɔ ji nsɛnitɛ kome, ni ekɛkpa Yesu naji ahe ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ enaji lɛ ahe; ni mu lɛ ŋma yi shĩa lɛ mli tɔ. 4Shi Yuda Iskariot, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, 5“Mɛɛ hewɔ ahɔ̃ɔɔ mu nɛɛ denarioi ohai etɛ̃ ni akɛ shika lɛ ahã ohiafoi?” 6 Shi enɛ ni ekɛɛ nɛɛ, jeee ohiafoi lɛ ahe ni dɔɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ julɔ ji lɛ, ni lɛ etoɔ fotro lɛ, ni ejuɔ nɔ ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ. 7No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, “Kaagba enaa; efee enɛ eto mifuu gbi lɛ. 8 Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa; shi mi lɛ, jeee daa nyɛkɛ mi aaahi shi.”
Atee Lazaro yinɔ apam
9Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii na le akɛ Yesu yɛ jɛi, ni amɛba, jeee Yesu kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ koni amɛna Lazaro, mɔ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ hu. 10Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kpɛ mli akɛ amɛaagbe Lazaro hu, 11ejaakɛ ehewɔ jɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii tee ni amɛyahe Yesu nɔ amɛye lɛ.
Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ
(Mateo 21.1-11; Marko 11.1-11; Luka 19.28-40)
