12Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni mɛi babaoo ni eba gbijurɔ lɛ nu akɛ Yesu miiba Yerusalɛm lɛ, 13 amɛkɔlɔ blɛoi, ni amɛje kpo amɛyakpee lɛ, ni amɛbolɔ akɛ “Hosiana! Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ!” 14 Shi Yesu ena teji bi ko ni eho eta nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
15“Kaashe gbeyei, Zion biyoo!
Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba.
Eta tejibi nɔ.”
16Shi ekaselɔi lɛ enaaa nii nɛɛ ashishi mra mli, shi be ni awo Yesu hiɛ nyam lɛ, no dani amɛkai akɛ aŋma nii nɛɛ yɛ ehe, ni no afee ahã lɛ lɛ.
17No hewɔ lɛ, asafo ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ be mli ni etsɛ Lazaro kɛjɛ gbonyobu lɛ mli ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohiiateŋ lɛ ye he odase. 18Enɛ hewɔ hu ni asafo lɛ yakpee lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ efee naakpɛɛnii nɛɛ. 19 No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Te nyɛna akɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ fɛi nyɛfee! Naa, je lɛ efã kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ!”
Helabii komɛi batao Yesu
20Shi Helabii komɛi yɛ mɛi ni ba koni amɛbaja Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ. 21 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ba Filipo ni jɛ Betsaida yɛ Galilea lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔmiitao akɛ wɔna Yesu.” 22Filipo ba ni ebakɛɛ Andrea, ni Andrea kɛ Filipo bakɛɛ Yesu. 23Ni Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni akɛbaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam lɛ eshɛ. 24 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ ŋmaa kuli enyɔɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbo lɛ, no lɛ eyɛ akɛ ŋmaa kuli kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛji egbo lɛ, ewoɔ yibii pii. 25 Mɔ ni dɔɔ ewala he lɛ, elaajeɔ lɛ, shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ ewala yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, eeeto lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ wala mli. 26 Kɛji mɔ ko miisɔmɔ mi lɛ, enyiɛ misɛɛ, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, jɛi misɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ hu aaahi; kɛji mɔ ko miisɔmɔ mi lɛ, miTsɛ aaawo lɛ.”
Sa akɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ
27 “Agbɛnɛ misusuma miihao, ni mɛni makɛɛ? Ataa, heremɔ mi kɛjɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli! Shi asaŋ enɛ hewɔ miba ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli lɛ. 28Ataa, wo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam!” Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Mina miwo ehiɛ nyam, ni masaa mawo ehiɛ nyam ekoŋŋ.” 29Kɛkɛ ni asafo ni damɔ jɛi ni nu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ eshi!” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ ewie!” 30 Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Jeee mi hewɔ gbee nɛɛ ba, shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛhewɔ. 31 Agbɛnɛ je nɛɛŋ kojomɔ lɛ eshɛ; agbɛnɛ abaafã je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ ashɛ afɔ̃. 32 Ni mi lɛ, kɛji awo minɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, magbala mɛi fɛɛ kɛaaba miŋɔɔ.” 33Shi enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni ebaagbo. 34 Asafo lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔnu yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ Kristo lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni bo lɛ okɛɔ akɛ ja awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ? Namɔ ji nɛkɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi nɛɛ?” 35 Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be kukuoo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ehã la lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛnyiɛa koni duŋ akabanina nyɛ; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli lɛ, eleee he ni eyaa. 36 Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhea la lɛ nɔ nyɛyea, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la bii.”
Yesu wie nii nɛɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ ehe tee amɛ.
Yudafoi lɛ heee Yesu nɔ amɛyeee
37 Efee naakpɛɛnii babaoo yɛ amɛhiɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛheee enɔ amɛyeee, 38 koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ ni ewie lɛ ana aba mli akɛ,
“Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye,
Ni namɔ ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ?”
39 Enɛ hewɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛye lɛ, ejaakɛ Yesaia saa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ,
40 “Eshwila amɛhiŋmɛii, ni ekpliŋ amɛtsui;
koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii,
ni amɛna naa kɛ amɛtsui,
ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni mitsa amɛ.”
41 Nii nɛɛ Yesaia kɛɛ, ejaakɛ ena enunyam lɛ, ni ewie ehe.
42 Kɛ̃lɛ onukpai lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii he enɔ ye; shi Farisifoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ amɛjajeee faŋŋ, koni akashwie amɛ kɛjɛ kpeehe lɛ; 43 ejaakɛ amɛmiisumɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛnyam fe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.
Yesu wiemɔ kojoɔ
44Shi Yesu bo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, jeee mi minɔ eheɔ eyeɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ; 45 ni mɔ ni naa mi lɛ naa mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ. 46Mi lɛ miba je lɛ mli akɛ la, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ akahi duŋ lɛ mli. 47 Ni kɛji mɔ ko nu miwiemɔi lɛ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, mikojooo lɛ; ejaakɛ mibaaa koni mibakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ miba koni mibahere je lɛ yiwala. 48Mɔ ni kwaa mi ni emɔɔɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, eyɛ mɔ ko ni kojoɔ lɛ. Wiemɔ ni miwie lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ. 49Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ miwieee; shi Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ moŋ ewo mi kitã, nɔ ni mikɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni miwie. 50Ni mile akɛ ekitã lɛ naanɔ wala ni; no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ.”

Title: YOHANE 13
Content:
Yesu fɔ ekaselɔi lɛ anaji ahe
1Dani Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ aaashɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le akɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa ni ekɛbaaje je nɛɛ mli kɛya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ eshɛ hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai esumɔ amɛ kɛyashi naagbee. 2 Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, belɛ abonsam kɛwo Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, tsui mli momo, akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ — 3 akɛni Yesu le akɛ Tsɛ lɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ, ni esaa eeya Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, 4ete shi yɛ niyenii lɛ ashi, ni ejie etadei lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɔ papaŋ ni ekɛŋmɔ ehɛ. 5No sɛɛ lɛ, efɔse nu ewo okpolu mli, ni ebɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ anaji ahe fɔmɔ, ni ekɛ papaŋ ni ŋmɔ ehɛ lɛ tsumɔ. 6Kɛkɛ ni ebashɛ Simon Petro nɔ, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, bo ofɔɔ minaji ahe nɛɛ?” 7Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nɔ ni mifeɔ nɛɛ, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ oleee, shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ, obaale.” 8Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafɔ minaji ahe kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji mifɔɔɔ onaji ahe lɛ, obɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ miŋɔɔ.” 9Simon Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, jeee minaji ahe kɛkɛ mɔ, shi moŋ miniji kɛ miyitso hu.” 10 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni aju ehe lɛ, ehiaaa lɛ hefɔflɔmɔ, akɛ ja enaji ahe fɔmɔ kɛkɛ, shi ehe eje kɛmɔ shi; ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe eje moŋ shi jeee nyɛ fɛɛ ni.” 11 Ejaakɛ ele mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ; no hewɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe eje lɛ.”
12Agbɛnɛ, be ni efɔ amɛnaji ahe ni ekɔlɔ etadei lɛ ni ewo ni eho eta shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛnu nɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ shishi lo? 13 Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛɔ mi Tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ; ni eja, ejaakɛ nakai ji mi. 14 Agbɛnɛ, kɛji mi, Tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mifɔ nyɛnaji ahe lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛ hu nyɛfɔfɔɔ nyɛnanemɛi anaji ahe. 15 Shi okadi mito mihã nyɛ, koni bɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfee nakai. 16 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋ efeee enuŋtsɔ, ni asaŋ bɔfo efeee mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ. 17 Kɛji nyɛle nii nɛɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ kɛji nyɛye nɔ.
18 “Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe miwieɔ; mi lɛ mile mɛi ni mihala; shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni yeɔ midɛŋ aboloo lɛ, ewo enanetsitsi eshi mi.’ 19Agbɛnɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ mato dani aba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ mi ni. 20 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni hereɔ mɔ ni mitsuɔ lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ ehereɔ lɛ; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.”
Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ
(Mateo 26.20-25; Marko 14.17-21; Luka 22.21-23)
21 Be ni Yesu kɛɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, ehao yɛ mumɔ mli, ni egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.” 22 Kɛkɛ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ kwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ, ni amɛnaaa mɔ koome he ni ewieɔ lɛ. 23Shi kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ ta emasɛi kpaakpa yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ he. 24Kɛkɛ ni Simon Petro bɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi akɛ ebi lɛ mɔ he ni ewieɔ lɛ. 25No hewɔ lɛ, nakai kaselɔ lɛ ho kpasa Yesu tsitsi ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ni?” 26Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “lɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛ atrɔma lɛ baatsɔ mli mahã lɛ lɛ.” Ni ekɛ atrɔma lɛ tsɔ mli ni ekɛhã Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ. 27 Ni atrɔma lɛ sɛɛ pɛ ni Satan bote Yuda mli. Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ, feemɔ mramra!” 28Shi mɛi ni tara okpɔlɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee nɔ hewɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ nakai lɛ. 29 Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi susu akɛ ni Yuda toɔ fotro lɛ, no hewɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ eyahe nii ni he hiaa amɛ eto gbijurɔ lɛ, aloo akɛ ekɛ nɔ ko ahã ohiafoi lɛ. 30Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni ehe atrɔma lɛ, amrɔ lɛ eje kpo. Shi je ena.
Kitã hee lɛ
31Be ni Yuda je kpo lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam, ni atsɔ̃ enɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam. 32 Kɛji atsɔ̃ enɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu aaawo ehiɛ nyam yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli, ni eeewo ehiɛ nyam oya. 33 Bii bibii, be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi; nyɛaatao mi, ni bɔ ni mikɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, ‘He ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba’ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ nyɛ hu agbɛnɛ nɛɛ. 34 Kitã hee mikɛhãa nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe. 35Kɛji nyɛsumɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ, no mɛi fɛɛ kɛaale akɛ mikaselɔi ji nyɛ.”
Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto
(Mateo 26.31-35; Marko 14.27-31; Luka 22.31-34)
36 Simon Petro bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ oyaa?” Yesu here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “He ni miyaa lɛ, onyɛŋ misɛɛ onyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ooonyiɛ misɛɛ wɔsɛɛ ko.” 37Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛɛ hewɔ minyɛŋ osɛɛ manyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ? Miwala tete mikɛaaŋmɛ shi yɛ ohewɔ.” 38Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Okɛ owala aaaŋmɛ shi yɛ mihewɔ? Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni oookwa mi shii etɛ̃.”

Title: YOHANE 14
Content:
Yesu ji gbɛ lɛ
1“Nyɛkayea nyɛtsui; nyɛhea Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyea, ni mi hu nyɛhea minɔ nyɛyea. 2Shihilɛhei pii yɛ miTsɛ we lɛ; jeee nakai ni kulɛ makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miiya ni mayasaa gbɛhe mato nyɛ lo? 3 Ni kɛji mitee ni miyasaa gbɛhe mito nyɛ lɛ, mibaba ekoŋŋ ni mibaŋɔ nyɛ kɛya he ni mi diɛŋtsɛ miyɔɔ lɛ, koni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛhi jɛi. 4Ni he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛle, ni gbɛ lɛ hu, nyɛle.” 5Toma kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔleee he ni oyaa, ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ gbɛ lɛ wɔle hu?” 6 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji gbɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ kɛ wala lɛ; mɔ ko baaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, akɛ ja etsɔ̃ minɔ. 7Eji nyɛle mi kulɛ, nyɛaale miTsɛ hu; ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛle lɛ, ni nyɛna lɛ.” 8Filipo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni no fa hã wɔ.” 9 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, oleko mi lolo, Filipo? Mɔ ni ena mi lɛ, ena Tsɛ lɛ, ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ ‘Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ?’ 10 Ani oheee oyeee akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli? Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ lɛ, jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ; shi Tsɛ lɛ ni hiɔ mimli lɛ, lɛ etsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ. 11 Nyɛhea mi nyɛyea akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli; shi kɛji nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ, nyɛhea mi nyɛyea yɛ minitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ. 12 Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eeetsu, ni eeetsu nii ni fe nomɛi tete, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 13 Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛɛakpa he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee, koni Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ aba nyam kɛtsɔ̃ Bi lɛ nɔ. 14 Kɛji nyɛkpa nɔ ko he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee.”
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo
15 “Kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ mi lɛ nyɛaaye mikitãi lɛ anɔ. 16 Ni mi lɛ mabi Tsɛ lɛ ni eeehã nyɛ Hefatalɔ kroko, koni ekɛ nyɛ ahi shi kɛya naanɔ; 17 Hefatalɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni je lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ aŋɔ, ejaakɛ enaaa lɛ ni asaŋ eleee lɛ lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛle lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ nyɛ yɔɔ, ni eyɛ nyɛmli. 18Mishiŋ nyɛ awusai; miiba nyɛŋɔɔ. 19 Eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni je lɛ enaŋ mi dɔŋŋ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛaana mi; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã, ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aaakã. 20 Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛaale akɛ miyɛ miTsɛ mli, ni nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ mimli, ni mi hu miyɛ nyɛmli. 21 Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mikitãi lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, miTsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni mi hu masumɔ lɛ, ni majie mihe shi matsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.”
22Yuda, jeee Iskariot, bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni eba hewɔ ni wɔ pɛ obaajie ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ, ni jeee je lɛ?” 23 Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ mi lɛ, eeeye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni miTsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni wɔɔba eŋɔɔ, ni wɔkɛ lɛ aaahi shi. 24Mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ mi lɛ, eyeee miwiemɔi lɛ anɔ; ni wiemɔ ni nyɛnuɔ lɛ jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ.
25“Miikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ be mli ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ. 26 Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ baatsu yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii fɛɛ, ni eeekai nyɛ nii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ.
27 “Hejɔlɛ mishiɔ mahã nyɛ, hejɔlɛ ni ji minɔ lɛ mikɛhãa nyɛ, jeee bɔ ni je lɛ hãa lɛ mihãa nyɛ nɛɛ. Nyɛtsui akayea, ni asaŋ nyɛkashea gbeyei. 28 Nyɛnu akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Miiya, ni mibaba nyɛŋɔɔ. Nyɛmiisumɔ mi kulɛ, nyɛaana miishɛɛ akɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ miTsɛ da fe mi. 29Ni agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ dani eba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, ni nyɛhe nyɛye. 30 Mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ nibii pii dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ je lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ miiba, ni ebɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ minɔ; 31 shi bɔ ni afee ni je lɛ ana ale akɛ miisumɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ wo mi kitã lɛ nakai mifeɔ lɛ. Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔjea biɛ wɔyaa.”

Title: YOHANE 15
Content:
Yesu, anɔkwa waintso lɛ
1“Mi ji anɔkwa waintso lɛ, ni miTsɛ ji okwaafonyo lɛ. 2Mihe nine fɛɛ nine ni wooo yibii lɛ, efolɔɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko ni woɔ yibii lɛ, ekpɔlɔɔ he, bɔ ni afee ni ewo yibii pii fe tsutsu lɛ. 3Nyɛhe etse momo yɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ ewie lɛ hewɔ. 4Nyɛhia mimli, ni mi hu mahi nyɛmli. Tamɔ bɔ ni tso nine nyɛŋ awo yibii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ akɛ ja ema waintso lɛ he lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛnyɛŋ akɛ ja nyɛhi mimli.
5 “Mi ji waintso lɛ, nyɛ ji niji lɛ. Mɔ ni hiɔ mimli ni mi hu mihiɔ emli lɛ, lɛ ewoɔ yibii pii; ejaakɛ kɛjeee miŋ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ nɔ ko nyɛfee. 6Kɛji mɔ ko ehiii mimli lɛ, ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ tamɔ tso nine, ni egbiɔ, ni abuaa naa awoɔ la mli, ni ashãa. 7 Kɛji nyɛhi mimli ni miwiemɔi lɛ hi nyɛmli lɛ, nyɛaakpa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ he fai, ni aaafee ahã nyɛ. 8Nɔ ni akɛwoɔ miTsɛ hiɛ nyam ji akɛ nyɛwo yibii pii, ni nyɛfee mikaselɔi.
9“Bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ sumɔ mi lɛ, nakai mi hu misumɔ nyɛ; nyɛhia misuɔmɔ lɛ mli. 10 Kɛji nyɛye mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛaahi misuɔmɔ lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni miye miTsɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni mihiɔ esuɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
11 “Mikɛ nyɛ ewie enɛɛmɛi, koni mimiishɛɛ lɛ ahi nyɛmli, ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu. 12 Mikitã ji akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni misumɔ nyɛ lɛ. 13 Mɔ ko bɛ suɔmɔ ni da fe enɛ, akɛ mɔ kɛ ewala aaaŋmɛ shi ahã eshieŋtsɛmɛi. 14 Kɛji nyɛfee nii ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, no lɛ mishieŋtsɛmɛi ji nyɛ. 15Mitsɛɛɛ nyɛ tsuji dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsulɔ leee nɔ ni enuŋtsɔ feɔ, shi moŋ shieŋtsɛmɛi matsɛ nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii fɛɛ ni minu yɛ miTsɛ naa lɛ, mitsi tã mikɛɛ nyɛ. 16Jeee nyɛ nyɛhala mi, shi mi moŋ mihala nyɛ, ni mito nyɛ koni nyɛ hu nyɛya ni nyɛyawo yibii, ni nyɛyibii lɛ ahi shi, koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ. 17Enɛ ji kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ, akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe.”
Je lɛ baanyɛ Yesu sɛɛnyiɛlɔi
18 “Kɛji je lɛ miinyɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mi tsutsu enyɛ. 19 Eji je lɛ mli nyɛjɛ kulɛ, je lɛ aaasumɔ nyɛ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, shi akɛni nyɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ mihala nyɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ lɛ. 20 Nyɛhiɛ ahia wiemɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ, akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋ efeee eNuŋtsɔ.’ Kɛ amɛwa mi yi lɛ, amɛaawa nyɛ hu yi; kɛ amɛye miwiemɔ nɔ lɛ, amɛaaye nyɛ hu nyɛnɔ nɔ. 21 Shi amɛkɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaafee nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛleee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ. 22Mibaaa mikɛ amɛ ebawieee jikulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛbɛ amɛhe esha lɛ he naajiemɔ ko. 23 Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ eenyɛ miTsɛ hu. 24 Eji mitsuuu nitsumɔi ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsuko eko dã yɛ amɛteŋ kulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛna, ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi kɛ miTsɛ fɛɛ. 25 Shi afee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni wiemɔ ni aŋma yɛ amɛMla lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Amɛnyɛ mi yakatswaa’ lɛ ana aba mli.
26 “Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni mibatsu nyɛŋɔɔ kɛaajɛ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni jɛɔ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ baa lɛ, kɛ eba lɛ, eeeye mihe odase; 27 ni nyɛ hu nyɛaaye odase, ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ mi yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee.”

Title: YOHANE 16
Content:
1 “Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnane akatɔ̃tɔ̃. 2 Amɛaashwie nyɛ kɛaajɛ kpeehei lɛ. Ni be baaba tete, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbeɔ nyɛ lɛ aaasusu akɛ ekɛmiija Nyɔŋmɔ. 3 Ni amɛaafee enɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ amɛleee Tsɛ lɛ ni amɛleee mi hu. 4Shi mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni kɛ be lɛ shɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkai akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ. Shi kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ mikɛɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ.”
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nitsumɔ
5 “Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, miiya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko biii mi akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ oyaa?’ 6Shi ni mitsi nii nɛɛ atã mikɛɛ nyɛ hewɔ lɛ; ŋkɔmɔyeli eyi nyɛtsuiiaŋ obɔ̃. 7 Kɛ̃lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale, ehi hã nyɛ akɛ matee; ejaakɛ kɛji miyaaa lɛ, Hefatalɔ lɛ baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ; shi kɛji mitee lɛ, matsu lɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ. 8 Ni lɛ lɛ, kɛji eba lɛ, eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha kɛ jalɛ kɛ kojomɔ he. 9 Eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha he, ejaakɛ amɛheee minɔ amɛyeee; 10 eeekã je lɛ yɛ jalɛ he, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ; 11 eeekã je lɛ yɛ kojomɔ he, ejaakɛ akojo je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ momo.
12 “Miyɛ nibii pii lolo ni makɛɛ nyɛ, shi nyɛnyɛŋ mli nyɛmɔ amrɔ nɛɛ. 13 Shi kɛji lɛ, anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ, ena eba lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ anɔkwale lɛ fɛɛ mli gbɛ; ejaakɛ etoŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieŋ; shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeenu lɛ, no eeewie, ni nii ni baa lɛ, eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ. 14Lɛ ebaawo mihiɛ nyam, ejaakɛ eeeŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko ni eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ. 15 Nii fiaa ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, minɔŋ; no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ebaaŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko, ni etsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.”
Haomɔ sɛɛ lɛ, miishɛɛ
16“Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” 17Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi bibii amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni ji nɔ ni ekɛɔ wɔ nɛɛ, ‘Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi kɛ ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ?’ ” 18No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni ji ‘eshwɛ fioo’ lɛ ni ekɛɔ lɛ? Wɔleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ nɛɛ.” 19Yesu na akɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛbiɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ni mikɛɛ akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi lɛ, no he nii nyɛbibiɔ nyɛhe nɛɛ? 20Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaafo ni nyɛbaawo yara, shi je lɛ baanya; nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ, shi nyɛkɔmɔyeli lɛ aaatsɔ̃ miishɛɛ. 21 Kɛji yoo miikɔmɔ lɛ, ehaoɔ, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; shi kɛ efɔ bi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekaiii hejaramɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ miishɛɛ ni enaa akɛ efɔ gbɔmɔ kɛba je lɛ mli lɛ hewɔ. 22Nakai ji nyɛ hu; amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ; shi mibana nyɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛtsui aaanyɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko shɔŋ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
23 “Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbiŋ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko. Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, eeehã nyɛ. 24 Kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ nyɛbiko nɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli; nyɛbia, ni nyɛaana, koni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu.”
Miye je lɛ nɔ kunim
25“Nii nɛɛ, abɛbuai amli mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ yɛ nɛɛ. Be miiba, ni mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ yɛ abɛbuai amli dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ faŋŋ majaje Tsɛ lɛ he sane matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ. 26Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaabi nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ yɛ migbɛi mli, shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mi mabi Tsɛ lɛ mahã nyɛ; 27 ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ miisumɔ nyɛ, akɛni nyɛsumɔ mi, ni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ lɛ. 28Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba je lɛ mli, ni miije je lɛ mli maya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.”
29Ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ oowie faŋŋ ni owieee yɛ abɛbua mli. 30Agbɛnɛ wɔna akɛ ole nii fɛɛ ni ehiaaa bo akɛ mɔ ko biɔ bo sane ko; enɛ wɔkɛheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ojɛ.” 31Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nyɛmiihe nyɛmiiye? 32Naa; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ po, ni nyɛbaagbɛ nyɛshwã ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaya emaŋ, ni nyɛaashi mi kome; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mi kome ni, ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ. 33 Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛna hejɔlɛ yɛ mimli. Je lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛbaana amanehulu, shi nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛmli, miye je lɛ nɔ kunim.”

Title: YOHANE 17
Content:
Osɔfonukpa sɔlemɔ ni Yesu sɔle. Yesu sɔle hã ehe
1Be ni Yesu wie nii nɛɛ lɛ, ewo ehiɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni ekɛɛ, “Ataa, ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; wo oBi lɛ hiɛ nyam, koni oBi lɛ hu awo ohiɛ nyam; 2 tamɔ bɔ ni ohã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ, koni mɛi fɛɛ ni okɛhã lɛ lɛ, ehã amɛ naanɔ wala lɛ. 3 Shi enɛ ji naanɔ wala lɛ, akɛ amɛle bo, anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, mɔ ni otsu lɛ. 4Miwo ohiɛ nyam yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, akɛni nitsumɔ lɛ ni okɛhã mi tsumɔ lɛ, migbe naa lɛ. 5 Ni agbɛnɛ, Ataa, kɛ anunyam ni miyɔɔ yɛ oŋɔɔ dani abɔ je lɛ awo mihiɛ nyam yɛ omasɛi.”
Yesu sɔle hã ekaselɔi lɛ
6 “Mijie ogbɛi lɛ shi mitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi ni okɛhã mi kɛjɛ je lɛŋ lɛ. Onii ji amɛ, ni okɛ amɛ hã mi, ni amɛye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ. 7Agbɛnɛ amɛle akɛ nii fiaa ni okɛhã mi lɛ, oŋɔɔ ejɛ; 8 ejaakɛ wiemɔi lɛ ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ; ni amɛmɔ mli, ni amɛna amɛle anɔkwale mli akɛ oŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni amɛhe amɛye akɛ bo otsu mi. 9 Amɛ mibiɔ mahã; jeee je lɛ mibiɔ mahã, shi moŋ mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ onii ji amɛ. 10 Minii fɛɛ lɛ onɔŋ, ni onii fɛɛ lɛ minɔŋ, ni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ amɛmli. 11 Mibɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ, shi mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ je lɛ mli, ni mi lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ. Ataa Krɔŋkrɔŋ, mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, too amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni amɛfee ekome tamɔ wɔ. 12 Be ni mikɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mito amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli. Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mibu amɛhe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko elaajeko, ja laajemɔ bi lɛ, koni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli. 13 Ni agbɛnɛ miiba oŋɔɔ, ni miiwie nii nɛɛ yɛ je lɛ mli, koni amɛna mimiishɛɛ lɛ ni eye emuu yɛ amɛmli. 14 Mikɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehã amɛ, ni je lɛ miinyɛ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mijɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ. 15 Mibiii akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ ni oto amɛ shweshweeshwe. 16Amɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mijɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ. 17 Feemɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli; owiemɔ lɛ anɔkwaleŋ. 18 Tamɔ bɔ ni otsu mi je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu mitsu amɛ je lɛ mli. 19Ni amɛhewɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mifeɔ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni amɛ hu afee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale mli.”
Yesu sɔle hã esɛɛnyiɛlɔi ni baaba
20“Shi jeee mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛkɛ mibiɔ mahã, shi miibi mahã mɛi ni baahe minɔ aye yɛ amɛwiemɔ naa lɛ hu; 21 bɔ ni afee ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee ekome, tamɔ bɔ ni bo, Ataa, oyɔɔ mimli ni mi hu miyɔɔ omli lɛ, koni amɛ hu amɛfee ekome yɛ wɔmli, ni je lɛ ahe aye akɛ bo otsu mi. 22 Ni anunyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ, koni amɛfee ekome tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔyɔɔ ekome lɛ. 23 Miyɛ amɛmli, ni bo hu oyɛ mimli, koni amɛfee ekome kɛwula shi, ni je lɛ ale akɛ bo otsu mi, ni osumɔɔ amɛ tamɔ osumɔɔ mi lɛ. 24 Ataa, mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ he ni miyɔɔ lɛ amɛkɛ mi abahi jɛi, koni amɛna minunyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ osumɔ mi dani ato je lɛ shishi. 25Ataa Jalɔ, je lɛ leee bo, shi mi lɛ mile bo, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi le akɛ bo otsu mi; 26ni mijie ogbɛi lɛ kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni masaa majie lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ, koni suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi lɛ ahi amɛmli, ni mi hu mahi amɛmli.”

Title: YOHANE 18
Content:
Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ
(Mateo 26.47-56; Marko 14.43-50; Luka 22.47-53)
1 Be ni Yesu wie nɛkɛ sɔlemɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ je kpo amɛyafo Kedron faa lɛ kɛtee he ni trom ko yɔɔ lɛ ni ekɛ amɛ tee mli. 2 Shi Yuda, mɔ ni yatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu le jɛi, ejaakɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ fɔɔ kpee yɛ jɛi. 3No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda yaŋɔ asraafoi kɛ tsuji kɛjɛ osɔfonukpai kɛ Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛhiɛhiɛ kanei kɛ hai kɛ awuiyeli dadei kɛba jɛi. 4 Kɛkɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le nii fiaa ni baa enɔ lɛ, eje kpo ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ nyɛtaoɔ?” 5Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi nɛ.” Shi Yuda, mɔ ni yatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu kɛ amɛ damɔ shi. 6Agbɛnɛ be ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi nɛ” lɛ, amɛnaa sɛɛsɛɛ ni amɛyagbeegbee shi. 7Kɛkɛ lɛ esaa ebi amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Namɔ nyɛtaoɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ.” 8Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miŋ no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji mi nyɛtaoɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa mɛnɛɛmɛi ayaa.” 9 (Ekɛɛ enɛ) koni wiemɔ ni ewie akɛ, “Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mihako amɛteŋ mɔ ko alaaje” lɛ aba mli. 10Kɛkɛ lɛ Simon Petro gbala klante ni ehiɛ lɛ ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ nyɔŋ lɛ ni efo eninejurɔ toi; nyɔŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Malko. 11 No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Kɛ oklante lɛ awo ehebo lɛ mli! Ani kpulu ni miTsɛ kɛhã mi lɛ, mikanu?”
Amɔ Yesu kɛtee Ana ŋɔɔ
(Mateo 26.57-58; Marko 14.53-54; Luka 22.54)
12Kɛkɛ ni asraafoi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ atsuji lɛ mɔ Yesu ni amɛfi lɛ, 13ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee Ana ŋɔɔ tsutsu, ejaakɛ Kaiafa ni yeɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ shaanuu ji lɛ. 14 Shi Kaiafa ji mɔ ni wo Yudafoi lɛ aŋaa akɛ ehi akɛ mɔ kome gboɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ.
Petro kwa Yesu
(Mateo 26.69-70; Marko 14.66-68; Luka 22.54-57)
15Ni Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kroko nyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ. Osɔfonukpa lɛ le nakai kaselɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ Yesu bote osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔɔ te lɛ mli; 16shi Petro damɔ agbo lɛ sɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, nakai kaselɔ kroko lɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ le lɛ lɛ je kpo ni eyakɛɛ yoo ni buɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, ni eŋɔ Petro kɛba shĩa lɛ. 17Kɛkɛ lɛ oblayoo lɛ ni buɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ kɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Te bo hu nuu nɛɛ kaselɔi lɛ eko ji bo?” Ekɛɛ, “Dabi.” 18Shi nyɔji lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ damɔ jɛi, amɛkɛ ŋãi eshɛre la, ejaakɛ fɛ̃i miiye ni amɛmiiwere; ni Petro hu kɛ amɛ damɔ shi eewere eko.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Yesu nii
(Mateo 26.59-66; Marko 14.55-64; Luka 22.66-71)
19Agbɛnɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Yesu ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ etsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he saji. 20Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Faŋŋ miwie mitsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ. Daa nɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, he ni Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ kpeɔ yɛ lɛ, ni miwieee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ dujiaŋ. 21Mɛɛba obiɔ mi moŋ? Bi mɛi ni baboɔ mi toi lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ; naa, mɛnɛɛmɛi le nii ni mikɛɛ.” 22Be ni Yesu wie nɛkɛ lɛ, tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni damɔ jɛi lɛ gba lɛ ma ni ekɛɛ, “Hetoo ni ohã osɔfonukpa lɛ nɛ?” 23Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, ye efɔŋ lɛ he odase, shi kɛji ekpakpaŋ lɛ, mɛɛhewɔ oyiɔ mi?”
24Ni Ana hã akɛ lɛ tee osɔfonukpa Kaiafa ŋɔɔ yɛ kpãa mli.
Petro kwa Yesu ekoŋŋ
(Mateo 26.71-75; Marko 14.69-72; Luka 22.58-62)
25Shi Simon Petro damɔ shi eewere la lolo. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te bo hu ekaselɔi lɛ eko ji bo?” Petro tso ni ekɛɛ, “Dabida.” 26Osɔfonukpa lɛ nyɔji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ji mɔ ni Petro fo etoi lɛ wekunyo, kɛɛ, “Ani minaaa bo kɛ lɛ yɛ trom lɛ mli?” 27Ni Petro tso ekoŋŋ, kɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Yesu yɛ Pilato hiɛ
(Mateo 27.1-2, 11-14; Marko 15.1-5; Luka 23.1-5)
28Kɛkɛ ni amɛkpala Yesu kɛjɛ Kaiafa ŋɔɔ kɛtee kojomɔhe lɛ. Ni eshɛ maŋkɛ. Ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛboteee kojomɔhe lɛ, koni amɛkabule amɛhe, bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo Hehoo lɛ yeli. 29No hewɔ lɛ Pilato je kpo ba amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ naafolɔmɔ nyɛkɛba yɛ nuu nɛɛ he?”
30Amɛhere nɔ akɛ, “Jeee efɔŋfeelɔ ji lɛ kulɛ, wɔkɛ lɛ ebahaŋ bo.” 31 Kɛkɛ lɛ Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔa lɛ, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyakojoa lɛ yɛ nyɛmla lɛ naa.” Ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔgbeɔ mɔ ko;” 32 koni Yesu wiemɔ ni ewie ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni ebaagbo lɛ aba mli.
33Kɛkɛ ni Pilato saa bote kojomɔhe lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni etsɛ Yesu, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” 34Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiŋ oto owieɔ enɛ nɛɛ, aloo mɛi komɛi gba bo nakai yɛ mihe?” 35Pilato here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani Yudafonyo ji mi? Bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋbii kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ bo hã mi. Mɛni ofee?” 36Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛɛɛ je nɛɛŋ; mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛ je nɛɛ mli kulɛ misɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ aaapele he, koni akaŋɔ mi ahã Yudafoi lɛ; shi enɛ lɛ, mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛɛɛ biɛ.” 37No hewɔ lɛ, Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ maŋtsɛ ji bo kɛ̃?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Okɛɛ; ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ ji mi. Mi lɛ, enɛ hewɔ afɔ mi, ni enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ miba je lɛ mli, koni mibaye anɔkwale lɛ he odase. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ nuɔ migbee.” 38 Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji anɔkwale?”
Abu Yesu gbele fɔ
(Mateo 27.15-31; Marko 15.6-20; Luka 23.13-25)
Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, eje kpo kɛtee Yudafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko kwraa yɛ ehe. 39Shi nyɛyɛ gbɛnaa ko akɛ miŋmɛɔ mɔ kome he mihãa nyɛ yɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mihã nyɛ lo?” 40Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee mɔnɛŋ, shi Baraba moŋ!” Shi Baraba lɛ, ojotswalɔŋ.

Title: YOHANE 19
Content:
1Kɛkɛ ni Pilato ŋɔ Yesu ni eyi lɛ kpelebii, 2ni asraafoi lɛ kɛ ŋmei fee akekre ni amɛkɛfi eyitso, ni amɛwo lɛ atade tsuru ko, 3ni amɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Hã manye, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ!” Ni amɛgbala lɛ mai.
4Kɛkɛ ni Pilato je kpo ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ lɛ eje kpo kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe.” 5Kɛkɛ ni Yesu je kpo ni ŋmei akekre lɛ fĩ eyitso ni ewo atade tsuru lɛ. Ni Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa gbɔmɔ lɛ!” 6Be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ, sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋɔa lɛ ni nyɛyasɛŋa lɛ mɔ, ejaakɛ mi lɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe.” 7 Yudafoi lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ mla, ni wɔmla lɛ naa lɛ esa gbele, ejaakɛ efee ehe Nyɔŋmɔ Bi.”
8Be ni Pilato nu nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ, eshe gbeyei fe tsutsu lɛ; 9ni ebote kojomɔhe lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni ebi Yesu akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ojɛ?” Shi Yesu hãaa lɛ hetoo. 10Ni Pilato kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ mi ewieee? Ani oleee akɛ miyɛ hegbɛ akɛ miŋmɛɔ ohe, ni miyɛ hegbɛ hu akɛ misɛŋɔ bo?” 11Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Kɛjeee ŋwɛi ajɛ akɛhã bo lɛ, kulɛ onaŋ hewalɛ ko yɛ minɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie mi wo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ he esha lɛ da fe onɔ lɛ.” 12Kɛjɛ no nɔ lɛ Pilato tao ehe eŋmɛɛ; shi Yudafoi lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Kɛji oŋmɛɛ mɔ nɛ he lɛ, ojeee Kaisare shieŋtsɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ ehe maŋtsɛ lɛ ete shi ewo Kaisare.” 13Be ni Pilato nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, ekɛ Yesu je kpo, ni eyata kojomɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ, yɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ “Tɛkamɔ” ni Hebri wiemɔ mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ “Gabata” lɛ. 14Shi Hehoo lɛ Hesaamɔkɛtoo Gbi ni, aaafee shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli ni. Ni ekɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, “Naa nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ!” 15 Shi amɛ lɛ amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Okɛ lɛ aya, okɛ lɛ aya! Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ, misɛŋ lɛ lo?” Osɔfonukpai lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔbɛ maŋtsɛ ko akɛ ja Kaisare.” 16Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ lɛ hã amɛ ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele
(Mateo 27.32-44; Marko 15.21-32; Luka 23.26-43)
Ni amɛkɛ Yesu tee. 17Ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etere esɛŋmɔtso lɛ kɛtee he ni atsɛɔ jɛi Yitsoŋoŋohe ni Hebri mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ “Golgota” lɛ. 18Jɛi amɛyasɛŋ lɛ yɛ; ni amɛkɛ mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ fata ehe, mɔ kome yɛ biɛ ni mɔ kome hu yɛ biɛ, ni Yesu yɛ teŋ. 19Ni Pilato ŋma nɔ ko ekpɛtɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ yiteŋ; nɔ ni eŋma nɛ, “YESU NAZARENYO, YUDAFOI LƐ AMAŊTSƐ LƐ”. 20Nɛkɛ nii ni aŋma nɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kane, ejaakɛ he ni asɛŋ Yesu yɛ lɛ bɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ; ni aŋma yɛ Hebri kɛ Roma kɛ Hela wiemɔi amli. 21Ni Yudafoi lɛ asɔfonukpai lɛ kɛɛ Pilato akɛ, “Kaaŋma akɛ, ‘Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ’, shi moŋ akɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ.’ ”
22Pilato here nɔ akɛ, “Nɔ ni miŋma lɛ, miŋma.”
23Be ni asraafoi lɛ sɛŋ Yesu lɛ, amɛkɔlɔ etadei lɛ, ni amɛja mli ejwɛ, asraafonyo kome nɔ ekome; ni amɛkɔ eflaka lɛ hu. Shi flaka lɛ bɛ tsamɔhe; alo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi. 24 No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa wɔgbalaa no, shi nyɛhãa wɔfɔ̃a nɔ oshiki ni wɔna mɔ nɔ ni aaatsɔ̃.” Koni ŋmalɛ ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛja mitadei lɛ amli amɛhã amɛhe, ni mihebo lɛ amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki lɛ aba mli. Enɛ ji nɔ ni asraafoi lɛ fee lɛ.”
25Shi Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛ nyɛmi yoo, Maria, Klopa ŋa lɛ, kɛ Maria Magdalena damɔ esɛŋmɔtso lɛ masɛi. 26 No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu na enyɛ kɛ kaselɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ damɔ shi lɛ, ekɛɛ enyɛ akɛ, “Awo, obi nɛ!” 27Fee sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ kaselɔ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, onyɛ nɛ!” Ni kɛjɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ kaselɔ lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
28 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le akɛ agbe nii fɛɛ naa momo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ŋmalɛ lɛ aba mli lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Kumai miiye mi.” 29 Nɔ ma jɛi kɛ emli ashiŋ obɔ̃; ni amɛkɛ ŋshɔŋkotsa tsɔ ashiŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛkɛma hisopotso naa, ni amɛkɛto enaa. 30Ni be ni Yesu he ashiŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Agbe naa!” Ni ema eyi shi, ni ebu enaa.
Atsu Yesu ŋmawuiaŋ akplɔ
31 Shi Hesaamɔkɛtoo Gbi ni, ni bɔ ni afee ni amɛgbohii lɛ akahi sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ (ejaakɛ nakai hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ gbi wulu ni) hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ yakpa Pilato fai akɛ akumɔ amɛnaji ni ajie amɛ. 32No hewɔ lɛ, asraafoi lɛ tee, ni amɛyakumɔ mɛi ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ anaji, klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ. 33Shi be ni amɛshɛ Yesu nɔ ni amɛna akɛ egbo momo lɛ, lɛ lɛ amɛkumɔ̃ɔɔ enaji; 34shi moŋ asraafoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ akplɔ tsu eŋmawuiaŋ, ni amrɔ lɛ lá kɛ nu jɛ mli ho.
35Ni mɔ ni na lɛ, lɛ eye he odase nɛɛ, ni edase lɛ anɔkwaŋ, ni ele akɛ anɔkwale ewieɔ, koni nyɛhe nyɛye. 36 Ejaakɛ afee nii nɛɛ, koni nɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Akuŋ ewu ko” lɛ aba mli. 37 Ni asaŋ ŋmalɛ kroko kɛɛ, “Amɛaakwɛ mɔ ni amɛtsu lɛ nɔ lɛ.”
Yesu fuu
(Mateo 27.57-61; Marko 15.42-47; Luka 23.50-56)
38Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yosef ni jɛ Arimatia ni ji Yesu kaselɔ shi Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ lɛ ejieee ehe shi lɛ, yabi Pilato koni ehã eyajie Yesu gbonyo lɛ; ni Pilato ŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, etee ni eyajie Yesu gbonyo lɛ kɛtee. 39 Ni Nikodemo, mɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ be ni ebaaba Yesu ŋɔɔ lɛ eba nyɔɔŋ lɛ, hu kɛ “mire” kɛ “aloe” ni afutu aaafee kiloi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ba. 40Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klalai lɛ kɛ tsofai lɛ fimɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yudafoi feɔ fuɔ mɔ lɛ. 41He ni asɛŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ, trom ko yɛ jɛi, ni gbonyobu hee ko yɛ trom lɛ mli ni atoko mɔ ko yɛ mli pɛŋ; 42no hewɔ lɛ, amɛyato Yesu yɛ jɛi yɛ Yudafoi lɛ aHesaamɔkɛtoo gbi lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ gbonyobu lɛ bɛŋkɛ.

Title: YOHANE 20
Content:
Yesu shitee
(Mateo 28.1-8; Marko 16.1-8; Luka 24.1-12)
1Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ maŋkɛ mra be ni hiɛ nako agbele lɛ, Maria Magdalena ba bu lɛ he, ni ena akɛ ajie tɛ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa. 2 Kɛkɛ ni esha foi, ni eba Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kome lɛ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Amɛwo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ mli, ni wɔleee he ni amɛkɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ.” 3No hewɔ lɛ, Petro kɛ nakai kaselɔ kome lɛ je kpo, ni amɛyiŋ kɛmiiya bu lɛ he. 4Ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo foi; shi kaselɔ kome lɛ ho Petro he, ni lɛ tsutsu eshɛ bu lɛ he; 5ni be ni ema eyi shi lɛ, ena klalai lɛ jwere shi, shi eyaaa bu lɛ mli. 6Kɛkɛ ni Simon nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛba, ni ebote bu lɛ mli, ni ena klalai lɛ jwere shi; 7 shi duku ni akɛfi eyitso lɛ kãaa klalai lɛ amasɛi, shi moŋ akumɔ mli ni ekã he kroko banee. 8Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ kaselɔ lɛ ni ba bu lɛ he tsutsu lɛ hu bote mli, ni ena, ni ehe eye; 9 ejaakɛ kulɛ amɛnuko ŋmalɛ lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ ja ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ shishi lolo. 10Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee shĩa.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Maria Magdalena
(Marko 16.9-10)
11Shi Maria damɔ bu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ eefo. Ni be ni efoɔ lɛ, ema eyi shi ekwɛ bu lɛ mli, 12ni ena ŋwɛi bɔfoi enyɔ ni wo atadei yɛji tara shi yɛ he ni kulɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ kã lɛ, mɔ kome yɛ yitsogbɛ ni mɔ kome hu yɛ najiashigbɛ. 13Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Awo, mɛɛba ofoɔ?” Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ amɛwo miNuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛtee, ni mileee he ni amɛkɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ.” 14Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe ekwɛ esɛɛ, ni ena Yesu damɔ shi, shi eleee akɛ Yesu ni. 15Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Awo, mɛɛba ofoɔ? Namɔ otaoɔ?” Lɛ lɛ esusu akɛ benɛ tromsaalɔ lɛ ni, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ bo owo lɛ kɛje biɛ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi he ni okɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ, koni mayawo lɛ.” 16Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maria!” Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ lɛ yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ, “Rabuni!” (Eshishi ji, “Tsɔɔlɔ”). 17 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaata mihe; miyako ŋwɛi yɛ miTsɛ ŋɔɔ; shi yaa minyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, miiya ŋwɛi yɛ miTsɛ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛTsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” 18Maria Magdalena ba ni ebagba kaselɔi lɛ akɛ ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ni bɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wie nɛ.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ
(Mateo 28.16-20; Marko 16.14-18; Luka 24.36-49)
19Kɛkɛ lɛ nakai gbi lɛ ni ji otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ gbɛkɛ, be ni Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ lɛ aŋamɔ shinai he ni kaselɔi lɛ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ Yesu ba ni ebadamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” 20 Ni be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, ekɛ edɛ̃i lɛ kɛ eŋmawuiaŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ na miishɛɛ akɛ amɛna Nuŋtsɔ lɛ. 21 Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ! Bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ tsu mi lɛ, nakai mi hu mitsuɔ nyɛ nɛɛ.” 22Ni be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, emu eshwie amɛnɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhea Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ! 23 Mɛi ahe eshai ni nyɛkɛaafa amɛ lɛ, akɛfa amɛ; ni mɛi ahe eshai ni nyɛkɛaato lɛ, akɛto.”
Toma ŋwanejee
24 Shi Toma, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo (eshishi ji, “hãaji”) lɛ, bɛ amɛteŋ ni Yesu ba lɛ. 25 No hewɔ lɛ, kaselɔi krokomɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ja mina edɛ̃ŋ plɛkoobii lɛ anajiaŋ, ni mikɛ miwao ewo plɛkoobii lɛ anajiaŋ, ni mikɛ minine ehɔ eŋmawuiaŋ lɛ, dani mahe maye.”
26 Ni gbii kpaanyɔ sɛɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yɛ tsu mli, ni Toma hu yɛ mli. Ni aŋamɔ shinai lɛ ni Yesu ba, ni ebadamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” 27No sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Toma akɛ, “Okɛ owao aba biɛ ni obakwɛ midɛ̃ lɛ mli, ni okɛ onine abahɔ miŋmawuiaŋ lɛ, ni okaje ŋwane, shi moŋ ohe oye.” 28 Toma here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ.” 29 Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Toma, ni ona mi hewɔ lɛ, ohe oye; ajɔɔ mɛi ni enaaa ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛhe amɛye lɛ.”
Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ oti
30Agbɛnɛ naakpɛɛ okadii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni Yesu fee yɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ahiɛ ni aŋmaaa yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli; 31 shi enɛɛmɛi lɛ aŋma koni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Yesu ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ni kɛ nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ, nyɛaana wala kɛtsɔ̃ egbɛi lɛ nɔ.

Title: YOHANE 21
Content:
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi kpawo
1Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yesu saa jie ehe kpo ekoŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ yɛ Tiberia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Ni bɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɛ.
2 Simon Petro kɛ Toma ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo lɛ, kɛ Natanael ni jɛ Kana yɛ Galilea lɛ, kɛ Zebedeo bii lɛ, kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ hu yɛ he kome kutuu. 3 Simon Petro kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miiya wuo.” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ hu wɔkɛ bo miiya.” Amɛyiŋ ni amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ amɛgbeee nɔ ko. 4 Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, Yesu badamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, shi kaselɔi lɛ leee akɛ lɛ ni. 5 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Bii, nyɛyɛ niyenii ko lo?” Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Dabi.” 6 Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔ̃a yaa lɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ ninejurɔ gbɛ, ni nyɛaana nɔ ko.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ̃, ni loi lɛ afalɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛanyɛɛɛ yaa lɛ amɛgbala. 7 No hewɔ lɛ, kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni.” Be ni Simon Petro nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni lɛ, ekɛ etade lɛ ŋmɔ ehɛ, ejaakɛ eta shi yayai, ni etu egbee ŋshɔ lɛ mli. 8Shi kaselɔi krokomɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ lɛlɛ bibioo lɛ mli kɛba, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ jekɛɛɛ, shi aaafee ninetalɔi oha loo nɔ kɛkɛ, ni amɛmiigbala yaa lɛ kɛ loo lɛ. 9Shi be ni amɛkpeleke lɛ, amɛbana ŋãi kɛ la yɛ jɛi, ni loo jwere nɔ, kɛ aboloo. 10Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ loo ni nyɛgbe bianɛ lɛ eko abaa.” 11Simon Petro tee lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni eyagbala yaa lɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ kɛ emli loo wuji obɔ̃, oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ ni loo lɛ fa nɛkɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ yaa lɛ gbalaaa. 12Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa nyɛbakpaa nyɛnaa nɔ ko.” Ni kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ bimɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” Ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni. 13 Kɛkɛ ni Yesu ba ni ebakɔ aboloo lɛ, ni ekɛhã amɛ, kɛ loo lɛ hu. 14Enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ.
Yesu kɛ Petro
15 Be ni amɛye nii lɛ tã lɛ, Yesu bi Simon Petro akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi fe mɛnɛɛmɛi lo?” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛ mitoobii lɛ!” 16 Esaa ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi lo?” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ mitoi lɛ!” 17 Ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi lo?” Edɔ Petro akɛ ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ akɛ, “Oosumɔ mi lo?” lɛ; ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ole nii fiaa, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛ mitoi lɛ! 18Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, be ni oji oblanyo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ omĩaa ni onyiɛɔ he ni osumɔɔ; shi kɛ ogbɔ lɛ, oookpã oniji amli, ni mɔ kroko aaamĩa bo, ni ekɛ bo aaatee he ni osumɔɔɔ.” 19 Shi ekɛɛ enɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni Petro baagbo kɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam. Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!”
Kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ
20 Shi be ni Petro tsɔ̃ ehe lɛ, ena kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ; lɛ ji mɔ ni kpasa Yesu tsitsi yɛ niyenii lɛ ashi ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ namɔ baatsɔ̃ɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ?” 21No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Petro na lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ “Nuŋtsɔ, shi mɔ nɛ hu?” 22Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” 23Kɛkɛ ni wiemɔ nɛɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ akɛ nakai kaselɔ lɛ gboŋ; tsɛ Yesu ekɛɛɛ lɛ akɛ egboŋ, shi moŋ ekɛɛ, “Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe?”
24 Mɔ nɛ ji kaselɔ ni yeɔ nii nɛɛ ahe odase lɛ, ni lɛ eŋma nii nɛɛ, ni wɔle akɛ edase lɛ anɔkwaleŋ. 25 Shi nii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni Yesu fee, ni kɛji akɛɛ aaaŋma fɛɛ ekomekome lɛ, misusuɔ akɛ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋ woji ni kulɛ aaaŋma lɛ eto.

Title: BƆFOI WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi lɛ Luka Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔtsamɔ ni. Oti krɛdɛɛ ni akɛŋmã wolo nɛɛ ji bɔ ni afee ni anyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpla mɛi ni banyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ni amɛkɛyagbɛ ehe Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛshwã yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria niiaŋ fɛɛ aahu kɛyashi jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ (1.8). Wolo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni ato Kristo asafo lɛ shishi yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛ bɔ hu ni etee nɔ ni etsɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛkple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ. Nɔ pɔtɛɛ hu ni woloŋmalɔ lɛ taoɔ ni ekanelɔi lɛ anu shishi faŋŋ ji akɛ Kristofoi lɛ amɛbaaa ni amɛkɛ amralofoi kɛ lumɛi ni yɔɔ Roma maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ abakede, shi moŋ Kristofoi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ ba ni ebawo Yudafoi lɛ ajamɔ lɛ obɔ.
Aaanyɛ adamɔ bɔ ni Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ fee ni eshwere ni egbɛ eshwa kɛ bɔ ni afee ato Kristo Asafo lɛ nɔ ni akɛja Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi lɛ amli etɛ̃.
1. Kristo Asafo lɛ shishitoo yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Yesu ŋwɛiyaa lɛ sɛɛ.
2. Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛɛkɛshwamɔ yɛ maji krokomɛi amli yɛ Palestina shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
3. Bɔ ni wiemɔ lɛ gbɛ shwã shikpɔji ni bɔle Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ he aahu kɛyashɛ Roma.
Nɔ kome jeɔ kpo faŋŋ yɛ Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi ahe wolo nɛɛ mli, no ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nitsumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ ni ekɛbayi mɛi ni ehe Yesu nɔ amɛye yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Pentekoste gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amli lɛ. Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tee nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Kristo Asafo lɛ kɛ asafonukpai lɛ agbɛ ni ewo amɛ hewalɛ hu yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wolo lɛ yeɔ he odase akɛ amɛtsu lɛ mli. Shiɛmɔwiemɔ ni akɛbahã klɛŋklɛŋ Kristofoi lɛ afolɔ lɛ kuku kuku yɛ shiɛmɔi srɔtoi amli. Agbɛnɛ hu, nii ni tee nɔ fɛɛ ni aŋmala amɛhe saji yɛ Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi lɛ ahe wolo lɛ mli lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ hewalɛ kɛ ekãa ni shiɛmɔi srɔtoi nɛɛ wo mɛi ni he Kristo nɔ amɛye yɛ amɛwala mli lɛ, asaŋ kɛ amɛnaanyobɔɔ yɛ Kristo asafo lɛ mli.
Mlijaramɔi
Hesaamɔ kɛhã odaseyeli 1.1-26
a. Yesu naagbee famɔ kɛ eshiwoo 1.1-14
b. Yuda sɛɛyelɔ 1.15-26
Odaseyeli yɛ Yerusalɛm 2.1—8.3
Odaseyeli yɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria 8.4—12.25
Paulo nitsumɔ 13.1—28.31
a. Shiɛmɔ lɛ he klɛŋklɛŋ gbɛfãa 13.1—14.28
b. Kpee yɛ Yerusalɛm 15.1-35
d. Gbɛfaa ni ji enyɔ 15.36—18.22
e. Gbɛfaa ni ji etɛ̃ 18.23—21.16
ɛ. Paulo mɔŋwoo yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Kaisarea kɛ Roma 21.17—28.31

Title: BƆFOI 1
Content:
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo
1 Teofilo, miklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ mli lɛ, migba nii fɛɛ ni Yesu babɔ̃i feemɔ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ 2kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi, be ni etsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ewo ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ akitãi sɛɛ lɛ. 3Emanehulu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ odaseyeli nibii pii anɔ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ bɔfoi nɛɛ akɛ ehiɛ kã, ni ehã amɛna lɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ, ni ekɛ amɛ wie Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he. 4 Ni be ni ekɛ amɛnaa kpe shi lɛ, ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkajea Yerusalɛm, shi moŋ nyɛmɛa Tsɛ lɛ shiwoo lɛ ni nyɛnu yɛ minaa lɛ; 5 ejaakɛ Yohane lɛ, nu ekɛbaptisi, shi nyɛ lɛ eyeŋ gbii pii ko ni akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaabaptisi nyɛ.”
Yesu ŋwɛiyaa
6 No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛnaa bakpe shi lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ani nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli obaatee maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shi oma shi ohã Israel lɛ?” 7Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee nyɛnɔ ji akɛ nyɛaale bei loo gbii lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ eto yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ mli lɛ. 8 Shi moŋ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ na ba nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛaana hewalɛ ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ midasefoi yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria fɛɛ, kɛyashi jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ.”
9 Be ni ewie nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛmiikwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni awo lɛ, ni atatu ko ŋɔ lɛ kɛje amɛhiɛ kɛtee. 10 Ni be ni eyaa ni amɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi gãa lɛ, naa, hii enyɔ ni wo atadei yɛji damɔ amɛmasɛi, 11 ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Galileabii, mɛɛba nyɛdamɔ shi nyɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi nɛkɛ? Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛje nyɛŋɔɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi nɛɛ, ebaaba nakai nɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna akɛ eyaa ŋwɛi nɛɛ.”
Ahala Matia ni eye Yuda najiaŋ
12 Kɛkɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ ni kɛ Yerusalɛm jɛkɛmɔ aaafee hejɔɔmɔ gbi gbɛfãa lɛ, nɔ amɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ. 13 Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛtee ŋwɛitsu ko mli, he ni Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea kɛ Filipo kɛ Toma kɛ Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo kɛ Alfeo bi Yakobo kɛ Simon, maŋ he hiɛdɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yakobo bi Yuda hiɔ lɛ. 14 Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ yei lɛ kɛ Yesu nyɛ Maria kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hiɛ sɔlemɔ mli waa.
15Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Petro te shi edamɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ (mɛi fɛɛ ni ebabua amɛhe naa lɛ aaafee oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ) ni ekɛɛ, 16 “Anyɛmimɛi, esa akɛ nɔ ni aŋma ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekɛɛ eto yɛ David naa yɛ Yuda, mɔ ni nyiɛ mɛi ni bamɔ Yesu lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, he lɛ aba mli, 17ejaakɛ abu lɛ ashi wɔnɔ, ni eyɛ egbɛnaa yɛ nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli.” 18 Shi nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ ŋɔ enɔsha ni efee lɛ mli nyɔmɔwoo lɛ ehe abɔɔ, ni eyama eyi shi, ni emli gba enyɔ ni emlinii fɛɛ tue shwie shi. 19Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ na le enɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ nakai abɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwiemɔ mli akɛ Akeldama, eshishi ji “Lá-Abɔɔ”. 20 Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ mli akɛ,
‘Eshihilɛhe lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃
ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akahi mli,’ kɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ,
‘Enɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ hu mɔ kroko aŋɔ.’
21 “No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ hii ni kɛ wɔ nyiɛ be mli fɛɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yesu yaa baa yɛ wɔteŋ, 22 kɛjɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛje wɔŋɔɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome atsɔ eshitee lɛ he odasefonyo afata wɔhe.” 23Ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, Yosef ni atsɛɔ lɛ Barsaba ni awo lɛ Yusto hu lɛ, kɛ Matia, amɛdamɔ shi. 24Ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ, “Bo, Nuŋtsɔ, ni ole gbɔmɛi fɛɛ atsuiiaŋ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ohala 25ni eŋɔ nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ bɔfo nitsumɔ ni Yuda eje mli koni ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ lɛ.” 26 Ni amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki, ni oshiki lɛ yagbee Matia nɔ, ni abu lɛ ashi bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ anɔ.

Title: BƆFOI 2
Content:
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ fɔsemɔ
1 Be ni Pentekoste gbi (loo gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ) lɛ shɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ he kome. 2Ni trukaa lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko ni tamɔ ahum ni tswaa waa jɛ ŋwɛi ba, ni ebayi shĩa he ni amɛtara lɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃. 3 Ni lilɛii ni agbalagbalaa mli ni tamɔ la lilɛii pue; ni ebatara amɛyiteaŋ ekomekome; 4 ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ bayimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni amɛbɔ̃i wiemɔi krokomɛi awiemɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwo amɛnaa lɛ. 5 Shi Yudafoi Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi komɛi yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛjɛ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi lɛ anɔ. 6Ni be ni anu nɛkɛ gbɛɛmɔ nɛɛ, mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nu akɛ amɛmiiwie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋwiemɔ. 7Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani mɛi ni wieɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee Galileabii ni? 8Shi te fee tɛŋŋ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ he ni afɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ? 9Partiabii kɛ Mediabii kɛ Elambii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mesopotamia kɛ Yudea kɛ Kapadokia, Ponto kɛ Asia, 10Frigia kɛ Pamfilia, Ijipt kɛ Libia niiaŋ yɛ Kirene masɛi kɛ gbɔi ni jɛ Roma, Yudafoi kɛ mɛi ni etsɔ̃mɔ Yudafoi, 11Kretabii kɛ Arabiabii: wɔmiinu akɛ amɛmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ nibii wuji lɛ yɛ wɔwiemɔi lɛ amli.” 12Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛfee yaa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Te enɛ shishiŋ?” 13Shi mɛi komɛi hu ye fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Dãa dɔkɔdɔkɔ etɔrɔ amɛ.”
Petro shiɛmɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ fɔsemɔ gbi lɛ nɔ
14Shi Petro kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ te shi amɛdamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ ekɛ asafo lɛ wie ekɛɛ, “Yudahii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm, nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ, ni nyɛboa miwiemɔi lɛ atoi. 15Jeee dãa mɛnɛɛmɛi etɔrɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsusuɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ leebi ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu kɛkɛ nɛ; 16 shi moŋ enɛ ji nɔ ni gbalɔ Yoel wie lɛ akɛ,
17“Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ,
‘Ni aaaba mli yɛ naagbee gbii lɛ anɔ akɛ,
mafɔse miMumɔ lɛ eko mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ,
ni nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba,
ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninai,
ni nyɛnukpai lɛ aaala lamɔi.
18Ni asaŋ mitsuji hii kɛ mitsuji yei lɛ anɔ hu
mafɔse miMumɔ lɛ eko mashwie yɛ nakai gbii
lɛ anɔ,
ni amɛaagba.
19Ni mahã naakpɛɛnii aba ŋwɛi,
ni okadii hu aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
lá kɛ la kɛ lasu lamɔ.
20Hulu aaatsɔ̃ duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaatsɔ̃ lá,
dani Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbi wulu ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ aaaba.
21 Ni aaaba mli akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.’
22“Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ atoi! Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ji nuu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii ni etsɔ̃ enine nɔ efee yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ ye ehe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle lɛ. 23 Yesu nɛɛ ni ajie lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo kɛ enii ni ele eto lɛ naa ahã lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ mɛi ni bɛ mla lɛ anine nɔ nyɛsɛŋ lɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ. 24 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi ni efɛne lɛ kɛjɛ gbele piŋmɔi lɛ amli, akɛni gbele nyɛŋ enaa etsi lɛ. 25 Ejaakɛ David wie yɛ ehe ekɛɛ,
‘Minaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ daa,
ejaakɛ eyɛ mininejurɔ nɔ, koni mikadidãa.
26No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui nyɔ̃ mimli ni mililɛi nya,
ni asaŋ migbɔmɔtso hu aaajɔɔ ehe yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli;
27ejaakɛ oshiŋ misusuma yɛ gbohiiaje,
ni ohaŋ omɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ana fitemɔ.
28Ohã mile wala gbɛ̃i lɛ,
Ni ooowo mi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ.’
29 “Anyɛmimɛi, makɛɛ nyɛ faŋŋ yɛ blematsɛ David lɛ he akɛ egbo ni afu lɛ, ni asaŋ eyɛ wɔteŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. 30 Akɛni gbalɔ ji lɛ ni ele akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekã lɛ kitã akɛ emusuŋbii lɛ eko baata esɛi lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, 31ena eto ni ewie Kristo shitee lɛ he akɛ ashiii esusuma yɛ gbohiiaje ni egbɔmɔtso hu fiteee. 32Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi; no he odasefoi ji wɔ fɛɛ. 33Agbɛnɛ akɛni awo enɔ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ ni ena Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo lɛ kɛjɛ Tsɛ lɛ dɛ̃ŋ hewɔ lɛ, efɔse nɔ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ eshwie shi. 34 Ejaakɛ David eyaaa ŋwɛi, shi lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ,
‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ,
ta mininejurɔ nɔ,
35kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee
onajiashi maaŋoo.’
36 “No hewɔ lɛ, Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ale krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ nɛkɛ Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ nɛɛ efee Nuŋtsɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ.”
37 Shi be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ Petro kɛ bɔfoi ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ?” 38 Ni Petro kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã abaptisi lɛ awo Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, koni akɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ afa nyɛ, ni nyɛaana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔkeenɔ lɛ. 39 Ejaakɛ shiwoo lɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, mɛi abɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatsɛ kɛaaba lɛ anɔ ni.”
40 Ni ewie wiemɔi krokomɛi pii ekɛye odase ni ekɛwo amɛ ŋaa akɛ, “Nyɛhãa aherea nyɛyiwala kɛjea yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ nɛɛ mli.”
41Kɛkɛ ni abaptisi mɛi ni he ewiemɔ lɛ, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ akɛ susumai aaafee akpei etɛ̃ fata amɛhe.
Bɔ ni heyelɔi lɛ hi shi hã
42 Ni amɛhiɛ bɔfoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ abolookuumɔ lɛ kɛ sɔlemɔi lɛ amli. 43Ni gbeyei mɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anɔ afee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii pii. 44 Ni mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ he kome, ni amɛfee amɛnii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ekome; 45amɛhɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛshikpɔji kɛ amɛhenii, ni amɛja shika lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni he hiaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ. 46 Ni daa gbi lɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome yaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛkumɔkumɔɔ aboloo yɛ shĩai, ni amɛkɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yeɔ nii, 47 ni amɛ jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛhiɛ ba nyam yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ mɛi ni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ efataa asafo lɛ he gbi fɛɛ gbi.

Title: BƆFOI 3
Content:
Nuu obubuafo lɛ tsamɔ
1Gbi ko gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ ni ji sɔlemɔ be lɛ, Petro kɛ Yohane tsa mlu kɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ. 2 Ni nuu ko yɛ ni ji obubuafo kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ, ni awoɔ lɛ daa abataa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo” lɛ naa, koni ebala nii yɛ mɛi ni yaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ adɛ̃. 3Ni be ni ena Petro kɛ Yohane boteɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, eba amɛ nɔ ko. 4Shi Petro kɛ Yohane fɛɛ kwɛ lɛ gãa, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ wɔhiɛ!” 5Ni edɔ ehiŋmɛii eto amɛnɔ, ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaana nɔ ko yɛ amɛdɛ̃. 6 Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ mibɛ eko; shi nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ, no mikɛhãa bo nɛɛ, Yɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, gbɛi mli lɛ, tee shi ni onyiɛ.” 7Ni emɔ̃ eninejurɔ mli ni ewo enɔ edamɔ shi; ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaji kɛ enanetalɔi lɛ amli wa lɛ; 8ni ehuru edamɔ shi ni ebɔ̃i nyiɛmɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ kɛbote Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ tuumɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ. 9Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ni eejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; 10ni be ni amɛyoo lɛ akɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni ta Sɔlemɔ We “Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo” lɛ naa ebalaa nii lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe babaoo yɛ nɔ ni afee ahã lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Petro shiɛmɔ yɛ Solomon Ablanaa lɛ nɔ
11 Shi akɛni obubuafo ni atsa lɛ lɛ kpɛtɛ Petro kɛ Yohane hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kutuu kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ ablanaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Solomon Ablanaa” lɛ nɔ ni amɛhe ejɔ̃ amɛhe. 12Be ni Petro na enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Israelhii, mɛɛba nyɛhiɛ feɔ nyɛ yaa yɛ enɛ hewɔ, aloo mɛɛba nyɛkwɛɔ wɔ gãa nɛkɛ, tamɔ nɔ ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ loo wɔNyɔŋmɔjamɔ wɔkɛhã nuu nɛɛ nyiɛɔ nɛɛ? 13 Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ewo etsulɔ Yesu hiɛ nyam, Yesu mɔ ni nyɛjie lɛ nyɛhã ni nyɛkwa lɛ yɛ Pontio Pilato hiɛ, be ni lɛ lɛ ekpɛ mli akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe lɛ. 14 Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Jalɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkpa fai akɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ awuyelɔ moŋ ake nyɛ, 15ni Wala Lumɔ lɛ, nyɛgbe lɛ; shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni no he odasefoi ji wɔ. 16Ni egbɛi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa, ni egbɛi lɛ tsa nuu nɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛle lɛ; ni enɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã efee kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
17 “Ni agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mile akɛ leee ni nyɛleee hewɔ ni nyɛfee, tamɔ nyɛnukpai lɛ nɔŋŋ; 18 shi nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ eto momo yɛ egbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa akɛ eKristo lɛ aaana amanehulu lɛ, ehã eba mli nakai. 19 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ, koni agbe nyɛhe eshai lɛ, 20bɔ ni afee ni mumɔŋ hewalɛwoo ko ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ aba, ni eeetsu Yesu Kristo mɔ ni ejie eto ehã nyɛ momo lɛ; 21mɔ ni sa akɛ ŋwɛi aŋɔ lɛ kɛyashi be ni aaato nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewie he yɛ egbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ teteete lɛ gbɛjianɔ. 22 Ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni eeewie etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ mli. 23Ni aaaba mli akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boŋ nakai gbalɔ lɛ toi lɛ, aaakpãtã ehiɛ kwraa kɛaaje mɛi lɛ ateŋ!’ 24Ni asaŋ gbalɔi fɛɛ hu ni wie kɛjɛ Samuel kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtsi nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ atã amɛto. 25 Nyɛ ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ bii, kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, be ni ekɛɛ Abraham akɛ, ‘Ni oshwei mli aaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wekui fɛɛ yɛ’ lɛ. 26Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee etsulɔ Yesu lɛ shi lɛ, nyɛ tsutsu nyɛŋɔɔ etsu lɛ ni ebajɔɔ nyɛ ni ekpale nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛjɛ enifɔɔji anii lɛ ahe.”

Title: BƆFOI 4
Content:
Petro kɛ Yohane yɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ
1 Shi be ni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ wieɔ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ bashwie amɛnɔ, 2 ejaakɛ efee amɛ mlifu akɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii, ni amɛmiijaje amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ. 3Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ, ejaakɛ je ena etã. 4 Shi mɛi ni nu lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he ye, ni hii lɛ ayibɔ bashɛ aaafee akpei enumɔ.
5Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalɛm, 6kɛ Osɔfonukpa Ana, kɛ Kaiafa kɛ Yohane kɛ Aleksandro kɛ mɛi abɔ ni jɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ weku lɛ mli lɛ; 7 ni amɛyaŋɔ Petro kɛ Yohane amɛbadamɔ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewalɛ nyɛkɛfee enɛ, aloo mɛɛ gbɛi mli nyɛfee yɛ?” 8 Kɛkɛ ni Petro ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋ mli lumɛi kɛ onukpai, 9kɛji akɛ wɔ miiye sane ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ yɛ ejurɔ ni afee nɛkɛ helatsɛ nɛɛ hewɔ akɛ namɔ nɔ atsɔ̃ atsa lɛ lɛ, 10 no lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ana ale akɛ, Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, ni nyɛsɛŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, lɛ egbɛi mli nuu nɛɛ damɔ nyɛhiɛ ni ehe ewa lɛ nɛɛ. 11 Lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋmalɛi lɛ wie yɛ ehe akɛ,
‘Tɛ lɛ ni nyɛ ni nyɛ ji tsutswalɔi lɛ gbe ehe guɔ lɛ,
no ebatsɔ̃ koŋtɛ nɛɛ.’
12 Ejaakɛ yiwalaheremɔ bɛ mɔ kroko mli; ni asaŋ gbɛi kroko hu bɛ ŋwɛi shishi ni akɛhã gbɔmɛi ni sa akɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ ahere wɔyiwala.”
13Agbɛnɛ be ni amɛna Petro kɛ Yohane ekãa lɛ, ni amɛyoo akɛ jeee woloŋlelɔi kɛ nilelɔi komɛi ji amɛ lɛ, efee amɛhiɛ yaa, ni amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ Yesu ehi shi. 14 Ni asaŋ akɛni amɛna gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ damɔ shi hewɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa nɔ ko amɛkɛɛ. 15Shi amɛfã amɛ akɛ amɛje gwabɔɔ lɛ mli amɛje kpo fioo, ni amɛtee ajina 16 amɛkɛɛ, “Te wɔɔfee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ okadi ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ afee lɛ yɛ faŋŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahiɛ, ni wɔnyɛŋ wɔtso. 17 Shi kɛ̃lɛ bɔ ni afee ni ekahehee tuutu ko dɔŋŋ yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔwoa amɛhe gbeyei, koni amɛkawie yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ.” 18Ni amɛtsɛ amɛ kɛba, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkatsi tã ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Yesu gbɛi mli kwraa dɔŋŋ.
19 Shi Petro kɛ Yohane here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ eja gbɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ abo nyɛ moŋ toi fe Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛkojoa. 20Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛŋ akɛ ja wɔwie nii ni wɔna kɛ nii ni wɔnu lɛ.” 21Shi be ni gwabɔɔ lɛ saa wo amɛhe gbeyei lɛ, amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛpiŋ amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ miiwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ nɔ ni afee lɛ hewɔ; 22ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ naakpɛɛ tsamɔ nɛɛ eye fe afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Heyelɔi lɛ sɔle ni awo amɛ ekãa
23Shi be ni aŋmɛɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛba amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ. 24Be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hole amɛgbei anɔ amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, bo ni oji Nyɔŋmɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii fiaa ni yɔɔ amɛmli, 25 bo mɔ ni otsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ owie yɛ wɔtsɛ David, otsulɔ lɛ, naa okɛɛ akɛ,
‘Mɛɛba jeŋmaji lɛ feɔ hoo,
ni maji lɛ hu jwɛŋɔ yakanii?
26Shikpɔŋ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ
ete shi edamɔ shi,
ni lumɛi lɛ hu anaa ebakpe shi
ewo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ!’
27 “Lɛɛlɛŋ, Herode kɛ Pontio Pilato kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ Israel maji lɛ hu ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ maŋ nɛɛŋ amɛwo otsulɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu, mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ, 28 koni amɛfee nii abɔ ni onine kɛ oyiŋtoo lɛ eto efɔ shi akɛ afee lɛ. 29 Ni agbɛnɛ hu, Nuŋtsɔ, kwɛmɔ amɛmɔhegbeyei ni amɛwoɔ lɛ, ni ohã otsuji lɛ kɛ ekãa pii ajaje owiemɔ lɛ, 30ni okpã onine mli ni ohã atsatsaa mɛi, ni atsɔ̃ otsulɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu lɛ gbɛi nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii.”
31Ni be ni amɛsɔle nɛkɛ lɛ, he ni amɛnaa ebakpe shi yɛ lɛ hoso, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃; ni amɛkɛ ekãa jaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Heyelɔi lɛ fee amɛnii fɛɛ kwasafonii
32 Shi mɛi babaoo lɛ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ tsui koome kɛ susuma koome, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɛɛɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ amli eko akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, shi eyɛ hã amɛ fɛɛ. 33 Ni hewalɛ kpeteŋkple bɔfoi lɛ kɛye Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shitee lɛ he odase, ni dromɔ kpeteŋkple yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ. 34Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ ni efiɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔji loo shĩai lɛ hɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ nii ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ ayinii lɛ ba, 35amɛkɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa, ni ajaa ahãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bɔ ni hiaa lɛ. 36 Ni Yose, mɔ ni bɔfoi lɛ wo lɛ Barnaba (eshishi ji: Miishɛjemɔ bi) lɛ, ni ji Levinyo ni esɛɛ jɛ Kipro lɛ, 37yɛ shikpɔŋ, ni ehɔ̃ɔ, ni ekɛ shika lɛ ba ni ekɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa.

Title: BƆFOI 5
Content:
Anania kɛ Safira
1Shi nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania kɛ eŋa Safira lɛ yahɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ ko, 2 ni nuu lɛ kɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ, ni eŋa hu le he eko, ni ekɛ fã lɛ ba ni ekɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa. 3 Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Anania, mɛɛba Satan yi otsuiŋ obɔ̃, ni omale otsɔ̃ɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni okɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ? 4Ani be ni eyɔɔ lɛ, jeee bo onɔ ni? Ni be ni ohɔ̃ɔ hu lɛ, shika lɛ jee bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ ni? Mɛɛba oto nɛkɛ yiŋ? Jeee gbɔmɛi omale otsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ.” 5Ni be ni Anania nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, egbee shi, ni egbo. Ni gbeyei kpele mɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ. 6Ni oblahii lɛ te shi, ni amɛbasaa lɛ kɛhã fuu, ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo ni amɛyafu lɛ.
7Ni aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ eŋa ni leee nɔ sane ni eba lɛ hu ba jɛi. 8Ni Petro bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bɔ ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhe nɛ? Kɛɛmɔ mi.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Hɛɛ, nɛkɛŋ.” 9Kɛkɛ ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛfee naabu kome koni nyɛkɛka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ nɛɛ? Naa, mɛi ni yafu owu lɛ anaji yɔɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, ni amɛaawo bo hu kɛaatee.” 10Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ egbee shi yɛ Petro najianaa, ni egbo. Ni be ni oblahii lɛ ba lɛ amɛbana akɛ egbo ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyafu lɛ yɛ ewu lɛ masɛi. 11Ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu nii nɛɛ.
Okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii
12 Shi atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anine nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii pii yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hi Solomon Ablanaa lɛ nɔ. 13Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ekaaa akɛ ekɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ aaayakpɛtɛ amɛhe, shi maŋ lɛ buɔ amɛ naakpa. 14 Ni asaŋ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ yeɔ, hii kɛ yei babaoo, bafata amɛhe, 15 aahu po ni aholeɔ helatsɛmɛi kɛbaa blohui amli abashwieɔ sai kɛ saatsei anɔ, koni kɛ Petro miiho lɛ, ehɔɔŋ kɛkɛ atsɔ̃ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi anɔ. 16Ni mɛi pii jɛ maji ni jwere Yerusalɛm hewɔ lɛ amli babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhiɛ helatsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji haoɔ amɛ kɛba, ni atsa amɛ fɛɛ.
Awa bɔfoi lɛ ayi
17 Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ ni ji Sadukifoi lɛ akuu lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ edɔ diɛŋtsɛ, 18ni amɛbamɔmɔ bɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ maŋ kpabuŋ. 19 Shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo bagbele tsu lɛ shinai lɛ, ni ejie amɛ ekɛɛ, 20“Nyɛyaa nyɛyadamɔa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nyɛjajea nɛkɛ wala nɛɛ wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a maŋ lɛ!” 21Ni be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛyiŋ leebi maŋkpa amɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ amɛyatsɔ̃ɔ nii. Agbɛnɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ba ni amɛbatsɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛtsu kɛtee tsu lɛ mli koni ayajie bɔfoi lɛ kɛba. 22Shi be ni tsuji lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, amɛnaaa amɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbagba 23akɛ, “Tsu lɛ wɔna akɛ aŋa naa kpɛŋŋ, ni bulɔi lɛ hu damɔ shinai lɛ anaa; shi be ni wɔgbele lɛ, wɔnaaa mɔ ko yɛ mli.” 24Shi be ni osɔfo lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, amɛfee yaa yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ahe [ni amɛbi] akɛ, “Te enɛ naa yaakpa tɛŋŋ?” 25Ni mɔ ko ba bagba amɛ akɛ, “Naa, hii lɛ ni nyɛwo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ damɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii.” 26Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ yiŋ ni amɛyaŋɔ amɛ kɛba, jeee nɔnyɛɛ naa, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei, ni akabatswia amɛ tɛi.
27Ni be ni amɛkɛ amɛ ba lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛ badamɔ akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi amɛ 28 akɛ, “Ani wɔwooo nyɛ kitã kadikadi akɛ nyɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli? Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni nyɛhã Yerusalɛm eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛmiitao akɛ nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ lá lɛ baa wɔnɔ.” 29 Shi Petro kɛ bɔfoi lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Esa akɛ aboɔ Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ toi fe gbɔmɛi. 30 Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ ni nyɛgbe lɛ lɛ, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tee lɛ shi; 31 lɛ enɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wo kɛtee eninejurɔ nɔ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ, koni ehã Israel ana tsuitsakemɔ kɛ eshaifaa. 32 Ni wɔji saji nɛɛ ahe odasefoi, nakai nɔŋŋ ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã mɛi ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ.”
33 Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ ewo amɛmli la ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛaagbe amɛ. 34 Shi Farisifonyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gamaliel, mlatsɔɔlɔ ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ buɔ lɛ lɛ, te shi damɔ shi yɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ teŋ, ni efã akɛ akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aje kpo fioo, 35ni ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ aaaye ahã. 36Ejaakɛ nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ Teuda te shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ji lɛ, ni hii aaafee ohai ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe yakpɛtɛ ehe; shi agbe lɛ, ni mɛi abɔ ni bo lɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ shwã ni amɛyi hɛ shi. 37Mɔ nɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yuda, Galileanyo lɛ, te shi yɛ mɛi akanemɔ be lɛ mli, ni egbala asafo babaoo eshwie esɛɛ; lɛ hu ehiɛ kpãtã ni mɛi ni bo lɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ hu gbɛ shwã. 38No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛŋmɛa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe ni nyɛkadia amɛsɛɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ nɛkɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ loo nɛkɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ jɛ lɛ, ebaafite; 39 shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ lɛ nyɛfite, koni nyɛkabafee nyɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wuɔ.” 40 Ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛba, ni amɛyi amɛ, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkawie yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli; ni amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe. 41Kɛkɛ ni amɛje akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ amɛtee kɛ miishɛɛ, akɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ abu amɛ mɛi ni sa akɛ abɔ amɛ ahora. 42 Ni gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ nitsɔɔmɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ shĩai.

Title: BƆFOI 6
Content:
Ohiafoi akwɛlɔi kpawo lɛ ahalamɔ
1 Nakai bei lɛ amli, be ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi faa lɛ, Helenibii lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Hebribii lɛ, ejaakɛ Hebribii lɛ ahiɛ jeɔ Helenibii lɛ okulafoi lɛ anɔ yɛ daa kwɛmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ. 2Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tsɛ asafo lɛ kɛba, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Esaaa akɛ wɔshiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔyasɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ okpɔlɔi ahe. 3 No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtaoa nyɛteŋ hii kpawo ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nilee eyi amɛ obɔ̃, koni wɔkɛ amɛ ato nɛkɛ nitsumɔ ni he hiaa nɛɛ nɔ; 4shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔhiɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ wiemɔ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.” 5 Ni wiemɔ lɛ sa asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ni amɛfamɔ Stefano, nuu ko ni hemɔkɛyeli kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃, kɛ Filipo kɛ Prokoro kɛ Nikanora kɛ Timon kɛ Parmena kɛ Nikolao ni emɔ Yudafoi ajamɔ mli ni ejɛ Antiokia lɛ, 6 ni amɛkɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi badamɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ; ni amɛsɔle ni amɛkɛ amɛniji shwie amɛnɔ.
7 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ shwere, ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi bafa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni osɔfoi lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii mɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli.
Stefano mɔ̃mɔ
8Ni Stefano, mɔ ni dromɔ kɛ hewalɛ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ, fee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii wuji yɛ maŋ lɛ mli. 9Shi mɛi komɛi ni jɛ kpeehe ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Mɛi ni eye amɛhe” akpeehe lɛ, kɛ Kirenemɛi kɛ Aleksandriamɛi kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kilikia kɛ Asia lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi te shi ni amɛkɛ Stefano taa naa; 10 shi amɛnyɛɛɛ Stefano nilee kɛ mumɔ ni ekɛwieɔ lɛ naa amɛdamɔ. 11 Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ mɛi komɛi yafi ni amɛbakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnu akɛ ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Mose kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.” 12Ni amɛwo maŋbii lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛte shi kɛba enɔ amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ. 13 Ni amɛkɛ amale odasefoi badamɔ shi, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Be fɛɛ be lɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ miiwie miishi he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Mose Mla lɛ, 14ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, aaafite biɛ, ni eeetsake kusumi ni Mose kɛhã wɔ lɛ.” 15Ni mɛi ni tara akwaashɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ tsu amɛhiŋmɛii amɛshwie enɔ, ni amɛna ehiɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hiɛ.

Title: BƆFOI 7
Content:
Stefano shiɛmɔ
1Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Stefano akɛ, “Ani saji nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai lo?” 2 Ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi kɛ Ataamɛi, nyɛboa toi! Anunyam Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔtsɛ Abraham be ni eyɔɔ Mesopotamia, ni enako ebahi Haran lɛ, 3 ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jee oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ owekumɛi ateŋ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ.’ 4 Kɛkɛ ni eje Kaldeabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyahi Haran. Ni be ni etsɛ gbo sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ kɛjɛ jɛi kɛba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔ; 5 ni ehãaa lɛ nɔyelinɔ ni ji shikpɔŋ ni shɛɔ nane tokota lɛɛmɔ tete, shi ewo lɛ shi akɛ ekɛaahã lɛ kɛ eshwiei ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ, tsɛ no mli lɛ ebɛ bi kwraa po. 6 Shi bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie ji akɛ, eshwiei lɛ aaayato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, ni aaafee amɛ nyɔji ni aaawa amɛ yi afii ohai ejwɛ. 7Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, ‘Makojo nakai maŋ ni amɛaayasɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛaaje jɛi ni amɛaabaja mi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ.’ 8 Ni ekɛ ketiafoo he kpãŋmɔ lɛ hã lɛ; ni no hewɔ efɔ Isak ni efo lɛ ketia gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni Isak fɔ Yakob, ni Yakob hu fɔ blematsɛmɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ. 9 Ni blematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ hɔ̃ɔ Yosef kɛtee Ijipt, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ yɛ, 10 ni ejie lɛ yɛ emanehului fiaa mli, ni ehã ehiɛ ba nyam, ni efee nilelɔ yɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ Farao hiɛ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ yɛ Ijipt kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
11“Shi hɔmɔ kɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple ba Ijipt kɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ naaa nii amɛye. 12 Ni be ni Yakob nu akɛ abele yɛ Ijipt lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ etsu wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtee. 13 Ni nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef hã enyɛmimɛi lɛ yoo lɛ, ni Farao hu bale Yosef weku lɛ. 14 Ni Yosef tsu ayakpee etsɛ Yakob kɛ eweku lɛ fɛɛ kɛba; amɛyi nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ. 15 Ni Yakob yiŋ etee Ijipt, ni lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ yagboi yɛ jɛi. 16 Akɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ba Shekem, ni abato amɛ yɛ fuuhe ni Abraham tse shika he yɛ Hamorbii lɛ adɛŋ yɛ Shekem lɛ mli.
17 “Shi be ni bè ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye eshi ni ewo Abraham lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ lɛ, maŋ lɛ shwere, ni amɛyi fa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, 18 kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋtsɛ kroko ni leee Yosef lɛ bate shi yɛ Ijipt. 19Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ, ekɛ wɔjakubii lɛ ye ŋaa mli ni efee wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ efɔŋ, akɛ ehã amɛshɛrɛ amɛbii abifabii amɛshwie, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkahi jeŋ. 20 Nakai be lɛ mli afɔ Mose, ni ehe yɛ fɛo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni alɛ lɛ yɛ etsɛ we lɛ nyɔji etɛ̃. 21 Ni be ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ, Farao biyoo lɛ yawo lɛ, ni elɛ lɛ ekɛ lɛ fee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi. 22Ni atsɔ̃ɔ Mose Ijipt nilee fɛɛ, ni efee mɔ ko ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ ewiemɔi kɛ enitsumɔi amli.
23 “Be ni eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, eba eyiŋ akɛ eeeyasara enyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ. 24Be ni ena akɛ aafee amɛteŋ mɔ ko efɔŋ lɛ, efã ehe, ni etɔ mɔ ni afeɔ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ he owele ni egbe Ijiptnyo lɛ. 25Ni esusu akɛ kulɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aaayoo sɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitsɔ enine nɔ ehere amɛ; shi amɛyooo sɛɛ. 26 Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ ebanina amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ ni amɛmiinɔ, ni ekpãtã amɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Ataamɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji nyɛ; mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ nyɛhe efɔŋ nɛɛ?’ 27Shi mɔ ni feɔ enaanyo efɔŋ lɛ tsirɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ? 28Ani ootao akɛ ogbe mi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ lɛ ogbe Ijiptnyo lɛ? 29 Ni wiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ Mose jo foi, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Midian shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni efɔ bihii enyɔ yɛ jɛi.
30 “Shi be ni shɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmeitso ko lalilɛi mli. 31Be ni Mose na lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ ninaa lɛ hewɔ; ni be ni etsiɔ ebɛŋkɛ ni ekwɛ lɛ enu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbee ni eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 32 ‘Mi ji otsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ Ni Mose he kpokpo ni ekaaa akɛ eeeyakwɛ. 33Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jiemɔ otokotai lɛ yɛ onane, ejaakɛ he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni. 34Mina mimaŋ ni yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ amanehulu lɛ, amɛŋtsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ hu minu; ni mikpeleke shi miba amɛ jiemɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, ba ni matsu bo Ijipt.’
35 “Nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛkwa lɛ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ’ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ koo lɛ mli lɛ nine nɔ etsu lɛ akɛ lumɔ kɛ kpɔlɔ. 36 Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpala amɛ kɛje kpo, ni efee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ. 37 Lɛ ji nakai Mose lɛ ni kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ’ lɛ. 38 Mose ji mɔ ni kɛ asafo lɛ hi ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni edamɔ bɔfo ni kɛ lɛ wie yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ehe wala wiemɔi lɛ ni ekɛbahã wɔ lɛ.
39“Shi wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsi lɛ amɛto afã, ni amɛtsui kpale kɛtee Ijipt ekoŋŋ; 40 ni amɛkɛɛ Aaron akɛ, ‘Feemɔ nyɔŋmɔi ohã wɔ ni amɛnyiɛ wɔhiɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ ni kpala wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ ni efee lɛ.’ 41Nakai be lɛ mli amɛfee tsinabi amãgã, ni amɛshã afɔle amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛna amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ. 42 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsi ehe kɛjɛ amɛhe ni eŋmɛɛ amɛhe akɛ amɛja ŋwɛinii, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ awolo lɛ mli akɛ,
‘Nyɛ Israel we, ani nyɛshã kooloi afɔle
kɛ niyenii afɔle nyɛhã mi
yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?
43Dabida, Molok buu lɛ moŋ nyɛwo nyɛtere
kɛ nyɛnyɔŋmɔ Refan lɛ ŋulami lɛ
ni ji amãgãi ni nyɛshɔ ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ.
Shi Babilon sɛɛ maloo nyɛ kɛaatee.’
44 “Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hiɛ Odase Buu lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. Afee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni kɛ Mose wie lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efee lɛ lɛ, no ji efee lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni ena lɛ. 45 Buu nɛɛ, be ni wɔtsɛmɛi ni ba yɛ sɛɛ lɛ hu anine shɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ Yoshua hiɛ kɛba jeŋmaji ni Nyɔŋmɔ shwie amɛ yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni ehi shi kɛbashi David yinɔ. 46 David nɛɛ hiɛ ba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ekpa fai ni ahã emã shihilɛhe ko eha Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 47 Shi Solomon ji mɔ ni mã tsu ehã lɛ.
48 “Tsɛbelɛ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ ehiii tsui ni akɛ niji fee amli, tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ hu kɛɛ lɛ,
49‘Ŋwɛi lɛ, misɛ̃i ni,’ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ,
‘ni shikpɔŋ lɛ, minaneshi maaŋoo ni.
Mɛɛ tsu nyɛaama nyɛhã mi mɔ,
Asaŋ nɛgbɛ ji mihejɔɔmɔhe lɛ?
50Aso jeee minine fee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ?’
51 “Nyɛ kuɛŋtilɔi kɛ tsuiiaŋ kɛ toiiaŋ foolɔi! Nyɛ lɛ, daa nɛɛ nyɛkuɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa; bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfeɔ. 52 Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ waaa lɛ yi? Amɛgbe mɛi ni gba yɛ jalɔ lɛ baa lɛ he amɛto lɛ. Ni agbɛnɛ nyɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ, 53 nyɛ ni nyɛna Mla lɛ kɛtsɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ, ni nyɛyeee nɔ lɛ.”
Stefano gbele
54 Shi be ni amɛnu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkpe amɛnyanyɔji ashishi kɛ mlifu. 55Shi Stefano ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kwɛ ŋwɛi gãa, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kɛ Yesu ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, 56 ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, miina ŋwɛi naa ni egbele, kɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ. 57Shi amɛbolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni amɛtsimɔ amɛtoii, ni amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ke kɛbashwie enɔ, 58 ni amɛtsirɛ eyi sɛɛ kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛi. Ni odasefoi lɛ kɛ amɛmamai lɛ shwie oblanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saul lɛ najianaa. 59 Ni be ni amɛtswiaa Stefano tɛi lɛ, ebo etsɛ Yesu ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, heremɔ mimumɔ lɛ!” 60 Ni ekula shi, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaawo amɛ nɛkɛ esha nɛɛ he nyɔmɔ!” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ mli ewɔ.

Title: BƆFOI 8
Content:
Saul wa Asafo lɛ yi
1 Shi gbe ni agbe Stefano lɛ ŋɔɔ Saul hu naa.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ yiwaa kpele te shi wo asafo ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛgbɛ amɛshwã Yudea kɛ Samaria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ shwɛ. 2 Hii Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi komɛi yato Stefano, ni amɛfo lɛ pam.
3 Shi Saul bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã asafo lɛ hiɛ, ni ejɛɔ shĩa kɛyaa shĩa ni eyagbalaa hii kɛ yei ni eyawoɔ amɛ tsuŋ.
Ashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ Samaria
4Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ yakpa shi, ni amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ. 5 Ni Filipo tee Samaria maŋ ko nɔ, ni eyashiɛ Kristo he sane etsɔ̃ɔ jɛi bii lɛ. 6Ni mɛi babaoo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome bo wiemɔi ni Filipo wieɔ lɛ toi be ni amɛnu ni amɛna okadii ni efee lɛ. 7 Ejaakɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ amumɔi lɛ bolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ni amɛje amɛmli, ni atsa mɛi ni ekumɔ kɛ obubuafoi pii hu. 8 Ni miishɛɛ babaoo ba nakai maŋ lɛ mli.
Simon ŋkunyaayelɔ lɛ
9Shi nuu ko yɛ maŋ lɛ mli momosa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon ni eyeɔ ŋkunyaa ni ehãa Samariabii lɛ anaa kpɛɔ amɛhe, etsɔ̃ɔ ehe akɛ gbɔmɔ agbo ji lɛ; 10ni mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ boɔ lɛ toi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hewalɛ Kpeteŋkple lɛ.” 11Ni akɛni ejɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ekɛ ekunyaayeli lɛ ehã amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛboɔ lɛ toi. 12 Shi be ni amɛhe Filipo ni jaje Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ amɛye lɛ, abaptisi hii kɛ yei fɛɛ. 13Kɛkɛ ni Simon diɛŋtsɛ hu he ye, ni abaptisi lɛ, ni ekɛ ehe kpɛtɛ Filipo, ni be ni ena okadii ni afee kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi wuji ni atsu lɛ, enaa kpɛ ehe.
14Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ nu akɛ Samariabii emɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛtsu Petro kɛ Yohane kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ. 15Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ amɛkpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai amɛhã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, 16ejaakɛ ebako amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ, shi baptisimɔ kɛkɛ abaptisi amɛ awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli. 17Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛniji ŋmɛ̃lɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
18Shi be ni Simon na akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aniji kɛ mɛi anɔ ŋmɛ̃lɛmɔ lɛ hãa anaa Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ shika ba ebahã amɛ 19ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa mi hu nɛkɛ hewalɛ nɛɛ koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mikɛ miniji aaaŋmɛ̃ enɔ lɛ ana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” 20Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ oshika lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ shika akɛheɔ! 21Obɛ gbɛnaa loo gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli; ejaakɛ otsui ejaaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 22No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ shwa ohe yɛ onɔsha nɛɛ hewɔ, ni okpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, akɛ aleenɔ akɛ otsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ aaafa bo lo. 23Ejaakɛ mina akɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ eyi bo obɔ̃ tamɔ kɔlikɔ joomɔ ni nɔ̃ sha kpãa lɛ mli oyɔɔ nɛɛ.” 24Ni Simon here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkpaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai nyɛhãa mi koni nibii ni nyɛwie nɛɛ eko akaba minɔ.”
25Agbɛnɛ, be ni amɛye odase ni amɛshiɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba Yerusalɛm lɛ, amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Samariabii akrowai pii amli.
Filipo kɛ Etiopia piafonyo lɛ
26Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko kɛ Filipo bawie akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya wuoyigbɛ yɛ tɛmpɔŋ ni kã shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛyaa Gaza lɛ nɔ.” 27Ni ete shi ni eyiŋ etee. Ni naa, Etiopiabii amaŋnyɛ Kandake lɛ piafonyo ni ji esɔ̃ɔlɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ ejwetri fɛɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ; ebaho Yerusalɛm eyaja Nyɔŋmɔ, 28ni agbɛnɛ eku esɛɛ eta eshwiili mli kɛmiiya ni eekane gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ. 29Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ Filipo akɛ, “Yaa ni okɛ ohe ayakpɛtɛ shwiili lɛ he.” 30Shi be ni Filipo wo foi kɛtee lɛ, enu akɛ eekane Yesaia wolo lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani oonu nɔ ni okaneɔ lɛ shishi lo? 31Ni ekɛɛ, “Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni manyɛ manu shishiŋ, akɛ ja mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ mi dã?” Kɛkɛ ni ekpa Filipo fai akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abata shi. 32 Shi ŋmalɛ lɛ he ni ekaneɔ lɛ nɛ,
“Akpala lɛ kɛtee tamɔ too gwantɛŋ ni ayaagbe lɛ,
ni bɔ ni too gwantɛŋbi feɔ dioo yɛ ehetsɔikulɔ
hiɛ lɛ,
nakai nɔŋŋ etswaaa esɛŋ.
33Be ni aba lɛ shi lɛ akojooo lɛ jalɛ naa;
shi eshwiei lɛ, namɔ aaagba amɛhe sane?
Ejaakɛ afo ewala sɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
34Ni piafonyo lɛ bi Filipo akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, namɔ he gbalɔ lɛ wieɔ nɛɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ loo mɔ kroko?” 35Ni Filipo gbele enaa ni eje shishi kɛjɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni ejaje Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ. 36Ni be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛbashɛ nu ko he, ni piafonyo lɛ kɛɛ, “Naa nu; mɛni tsiɔ mibaptisimɔ gbɛ?” [ 37 Shi Filipo kɛɛ, “Kɛji ohe oye kɛ otsuiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, oyɛ hegbɛ.” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Miihe miiye akɛ Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.”] 38Ni efã akɛ shwiili lɛ awa, ni Filipo kɛ piafonyo lɛ fɛɛ yimɔ shi kɛtee nu lɛ mli, ni ebaptisi lɛ. 39 Ni be ni amɛje nu lɛ mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ sha Filipo kɛtee; ni piafonyo lɛ enaaa lɛ dɔŋŋ, shi eyi gbɛ kɛ nyamɔ. 40 Shi Filipo lɛ, ana lɛ yɛ Azotu; ni be ni efoɔ mli lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛyashi ebashɛ Kaisarea.

Title: BƆFOI 9
Content:
Saul tsuitsakemɔ
(Bɔfoi 22.3-16; 26.12-18)
1 Shi Saul kã he ekɛ gbele miiwo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ahe gbeyei lolo, ni eyiŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, 2ni eyabi lɛ woji ni ekɛya Damasko kpeehei lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji ena mɛi komɛi ni hiɛ nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, hii jio, yei jio, ni efimɔ amɛ ni ekpala amɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm. 3 Shi be ni enyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni eebɛŋkɛ Damasko lɛ, trukaa lɛ la kpɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbabɔle lɛ, 4ni eflɛo egbee shi, ni enu gbee ko ni miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Saul, Saul, mɛɛba owaa mi yi?” 5 Ni ekɛɛ, “Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?” Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Mi Yesu, mɔ ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ. Ewa hã bo akɛ ooofã ntia oshi kooloi akpalamɔtso lɛ naa dade lɛ.” 6Ni ekɛ hekpokpomɔ kɛ ŋmiŋmi kɛɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee?” Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya maŋ lɛ mli, ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni sa akɛ ofee.” 7Shi hii ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ etɔ mu kɛdamɔ shi, amɛmiinu gbee lɛ moŋ, shi amɛnaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko. 8Ni Saul te shi; shi be ni egbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ, enaaa nii; ni amɛmɔ enine mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ tee Damasko. 9Ni enaaa nii, ni asaŋ eyeee nii ni enuuu nɔ ko hu gbii etɛ̃.
10Shi kaselɔ ko yɛ Damasko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Anania!” Ni ekɛɛ, “Naa mi, Nuŋtsɔ.” 11 Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya blohu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Trɔmɔɔ lɛ mli, ni oyabi mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saul ni jɛ Tarso lɛ shi yɛ Yuda we lɛ; ejaakɛ naa, eesɔle, 12ni Saul na yɛ ninaa mli akɛ nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania lɛ miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ enine miiŋmɛ enɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ena nii ekoŋŋ.” 13Shi Anania here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, minu nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ he sane yɛ mɛi pii anaa, akɛ efee omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ efɔŋ babaoo; 14 ni biɛ hu tete ena hegbɛ kɛjɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ adɛŋ akɛ ebafimɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ ogbɛi lɛ.” 15 Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji midɛŋ dade ni mihala mihã mihe koni ehiɛ migbɛi lɛ kɛya jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Israelbii lɛ hu ahiɛ. 16 Mibatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ amanehului abɔ ni sa akɛ ena yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ.”
17Kɛkɛ ni Anania yiŋ etee ni eyabote shĩa lɛ, ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmi Saul! Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ bo be ni obaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, etsu mi oŋɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ona nii ekoŋŋ ni oyi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” 18Ni amrɔ lɛ nibii komɛi jɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ shwie shi tamɔ loototoi, ni ena nii, ni ete shi ni abaptisi lɛ; 19ni eye nii, ni ehe wa lɛ.
Saul shiɛmɔ yɛ Damasko
20Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ eshiɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ. 21 Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ nɛ kpãtã mɛi ni tsɛɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, ni jeee no hewɔ nɔŋŋ eba biɛ hu tete koni ebafimɔ amɛ ni ekpala amɛ kɛya osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ?” 22 Shi Saul lɛ, ena hewalɛ babaoo, ni ehã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ anaa tã, ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ mɔ nɛ ji Kristo lɛ.
Saul je Yudafoi lɛ adɛŋ
23Shi gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ to eyi nɔ apam akɛ amɛaagbe lɛ. 24Ni Saul banu amɛkpãŋmɔ lɛ he. Shi amɛbuɔ maŋ agboi lɛ anaa daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛgbe lɛ. 25 Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ lɛ wo kafu mli nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛshiu lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛyayi shi.
Saul yɛ Yerusalɛm
26 Ni be ni Saul ba Yerusalɛm lɛ, eka kaselɔi lɛ ahe kpɛtɛmɔ, shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiishe lɛ gbeyei, amɛheee amɛyeee akɛ kaselɔ ji lɛ. 27 Shi Barnaba ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee bɔfoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni eyagba amɛ bɔ ni ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wie, kɛ bɔ ni efee ekãa yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli yɛ Damasko. 28Ni ekɛ amɛ yaa baa yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni eshiɛ kɛ ekãa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ mli. 29Ni ekɛ Helenibii lɛ wie ni ekɛ amɛ taa naa; shi amɛka lɛ gbee. 30 Be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ nu he lɛ amɛkɛ lɛ tee Kaisarea, ni amɛwo lɛ gbɛ kɛtee Tarso.
31Agbɛnɛ asafo lɛ na hejɔlɛ yɛ Yudea kɛ Galilea kɛ Samaria fɛɛ, ni enane mɔ shi, ni enyiɛɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ mli, ni ekɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ miishɛjemɔ lɛ shwereɔ.
Petro tsa Ainea yɛ Lida
32Shi eba mli akɛ, be ni Petro eyakpa hei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, eba mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Lida lɛ hu aŋɔɔ. 33Ni ebana nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ainea ni ekɛ kuumɔhela ekã saa nɔ afii kpaanyɔ sɔŋŋ. 34Ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo miitsa bo; tee shi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oŋmɛ osaa lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi. 35Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Lida kɛ Sharon lɛ na lɛ, ni amɛtsake ni amɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Petro tee Dorka shi yɛ Yopa
36Shi yoo kaselɔ ko yɛ Yopa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tabita, eshishi ji Dorka. Nitsumɔi kpakpai kɛ ejurɔfeemɔ eyi yoo nɛɛ obɔ̃. 37Shi eba mli akɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, ehe baye ni egbo. Ni amɛju ehe ni amɛkɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ ŋwɛitsu ko mli. 38Lida kɛ Yopa jɛkɛɛɛ kwraa, ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu akɛ Petro yɛ Lida lɛ, amɛtsu hii enyɔ kɛtee eŋɔɔ amɛyakpa lɛ fai akɛ ekashashao shi, shi eba amɛŋɔɔ oya. 39Ni Petro te shi ni ekɛ amɛ tee.
