Bɔ ni fee ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ shweshweeshwe ji no.

Title: BƆFOI 28
Content:
Paulo yɛ Malita ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ
1Ni be ni wɔje mli sɔŋŋ lɛ, no dani wɔbale akɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Malita. 2 Jɛibii lɛ fee wɔ ejurɔ pii, ejaakɛ amɛshɛre la, ni amɛhere wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm hiɛmɛɛ yɛ nunɛmɔ babaoo kɛ fɛ̃i lɛ hewɔ. 3Shi be ni Paulo bua lai ŋmɛŋmlɛbii anaa ni ekɛyawo la lɛ mli lɛ, shinɔ ko jɛ la grigri lɛ mli kpɛtɛ enine he. 4Be ni jɛibii lɛ na kooloo lɛ kpɛtɛ enine he lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ awuyelɔ ni, ni ahere eyiwala kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli moŋ nɛ, shi oweletɔɔ eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ gbɛ ni eyi ana wala.” 5 Ni ehwanya kooloo lɛ ewo la lɛ mli, ni eyeee lɛ awui ko. 6 Amɛhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eeefuufuu loo eeetswa shi egbo trukaa. Shi be ni amɛkwɛ aahu ni amɛna akɛ nɔ ko srɔto ko efeee lɛ lɛ, amɛtsake amɛjwɛŋmɔ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko ji lɛ.
7Ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ onukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Publio lɛ yɛ shikpɔji yɛ jɛi niiaŋ; gbɔmɔ nɛɛ here wɔ hiɛmɛɛ ni ekɛ tsuijurɔ fee wɔ gbɔ gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ. 8Eba mli akɛ Publio tsɛ kã shi kɛ atridii kɛ fɔ kɛ la wamɔ; ni Paulo tee eŋɔɔ, ni esɔle ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni etsa lɛ. 9Be ni afee enɛ lɛ, mɛi krokomɛi hu ni he yeɔ yɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ba, ni atsa amɛ. 10Ni amɛ hu amɛwo wɔhiɛ nyam babaoo, ni be ni wɔfã yɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛhã wɔ nibii ni he hiaa wɔ.
Paulo jɛ Malita kɛtee Roma
11Ni nyɔji etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ wɔyabote Aleksandria lɛlɛ ko ni ekadimɔ ji Dioskurioi (loo nyɔŋmɔi hãaji) ni ebaye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli, ni wɔfã kɛtee. 12Wɔyadamɔ Sirakusa ni wɔhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃. 13Ni wɔjɛ jɛi lɛ, wɔlɔgɔ shi kɛba Regio; ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, be ni wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ bɔ̃i tswaa lɛ, wɔyi mli, ni gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ wɔshɛ Puteoli. 14Jɛi wɔbana nyɛmimɛi komɛi yɛ; ni amɛkpa wɔ fai akɛ wɔkɛ amɛ ahi shi gbii kpawo. Kɛkɛ ni wɔyashɛ Roma. 15Nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nu wɔhe, ni amɛbakpee wɔ yɛ Apio jara nɔ kɛ Gbɔiatoohei Etɛ̃ lɛ; ni be ni Paulo na amɛ lɛ, eda Nyɔŋmɔ shi ni etsui nyɔ emli. 16 Ni be ni wɔbashɛ Roma lɛ, aŋmɛ Paulo gbɛ akɛ ekome ehi shi kɛ asraafonyo kome ni miibu ehe.
Paulo shiɛ yɛ Roma
17 Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ Paulo hã atsɛ Yudafoi lɛ anukpai ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛbakpe; ni be ni amɛnaa ebakpe shi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi, mitɔ̃ko maŋ lɛ loo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ akusumi lɛ anɔ; kɛ̃lɛ akɛ mi wo Romabii lɛ adɛŋ yɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ gboklɛfonyo. 18Be ni amɛtao misane lɛ mli lɛ, amɛsumɔ akɛ amɛŋmɛɛ mihe, ejaakɛ sane ko bɛ mihe kwraa ni sa gbele. 19 Shi akɛni Yudafoi lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, efi akɛ maŋɔ misane lɛ mahã Kaisare yeli, shi jeee akɛ miyɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛbaafolɔ mimaŋ lɛ naa. 20 Nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ mitsɛ nyɛ kɛba koni mana nyɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ awie ejaakɛ Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ hewɔ ni awo mi nɛkɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ nɛɛ.” 21Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔnako woji komɛi kɛjɛko Yudea yɛ ohe, ni asaŋ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko bako biɛ ebagbako ohe sane ko, ni mɔ ko ebawieko ohe wiemɔ fɔŋ ko. 22 Shi wɔmiisumɔ akɛ wɔle ojwɛŋmɔ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ kuu nɛɛ wɔle akɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ awieɔ ashiɔ.” 23Ni be ni amɛto lɛ gbi lɛ, amɛteŋ mɛi pii ba eŋɔɔ yɛ etoohe lɛ, ni kɛjɛ leebi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ lɛ, ejaje Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni eye he odase faŋŋ, ni ejɛ Mose Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli etao ni amɛyiŋ atsɔ̃ kɛba Yesu gbɛfaŋ. 24Ni mɛi komɛi he wiemɔi ni ewie lɛ amɛye, shi mɛi komɛi hu heee yeee. 25Ni akɛni amɛyakpãaa gbee hewɔ lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee be ni Paulo wie wiemɔ nɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia naa 26 akɛ,
‘Yaa maŋ nɛɛ ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ,
nu lɛ nyɛbaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi.
Ni na lɛ nyɛbaana nɛ, shi nyɛyoŋ sɛɛ.
27Ejaakɛ maŋ nɛɛ tsui ekpliŋ,
ni amɛtoi wa kɛ ninumɔ,
ni amɛmiamia amɛhiŋmɛii,
koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii
ni amɛkanu kɛ amɛtoii.
Ni amɛtsui hu akana shishi,
ni amɛkpale ni mitsa amɛ.’
28 “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ, atsu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ eyahã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni amɛ lɛ amɛaabo toi hu.” [ 29Ni be ni ewie wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛjejee ŋwane babaoo yɛ amɛteŋ.]
30Ni Paulo hi shĩa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyaŋɔ mli afii enyɔ ni ehereɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baa eŋɔɔ lɛ, 31 ni eshiɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane lɛ, ni ekɛ ekãa fɛɛ jajeɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo he saji lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiii lɛ gbɛ.

Title: ROMABII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Paulo wolo ni eŋmã emaje Romabii lɛ, eŋmã koni ekɛyasaa gbɛ eto sramɔ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaaya eyasara asafo lɛ yɛ Roma lɛ. Eyiŋtoo ji akɛ ebaaya eyatsu nii fioo yɛ Kristofoi lɛ ateŋ bɔ ni afee ni kɛji ena amɛpĩamɔ lɛ, edãmɔ nɔ ni ekɛya Spain. Wolo nɛɛ eŋmã ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni enuɔ Kristofoi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ shishi ehãa, kɛ bɔ hu ni hemɔkɛyeli nɛɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ Kristofoi awala shihilɛ mli. Ni wolo nɛɛ mli ji he ni Paulo shɛɛwiemɔi lɛ yeɔ emuu fe fɛɛ yɛ.
Be ni Paulo ŋa Roma asafo lɛ ni ehã amɛle bɔ ni esɔleɔ ehãa amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ oti krɛdɛɛ ni yɔɔ emajemɔ wolo lɛ mli; no ji akɛ, Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ gbɔmɛi abem ehãa, akɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔŋŋ akɛjeɔ shishi ni hemɔkɛyeli gbeɔ naa (1, 17).
Agbɛnɛ Paulo gbala eshɛɛwiemɔ nɛɛ mli fitsofitso. Etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ, ajieɔ lɛ kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi adesai fiaa kwa: Yudafoi jio, Jeŋmajiaŋbii jio, ejaakɛ esha eŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nom. Ni Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ nɛɛ kpo faŋŋ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Paulo tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Wala Hee ni wɔnaa kɛjɛɔ wɔ kɛ Kristo naanyobɔɔ mli lɛ hãa wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanyobɔɔ hee lɛ yeɔ emuu. Mɔ ni heɔ eyeɔ lɛ, ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ yɛ hejɔlɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hereɔ eyi wala kɛjɛɔ esha kɛ gbele hewalɛ dɛŋ. Yɛ Yitsei 5-8 mli lɛ, Paulo saa etsɔ̃ɔ oti ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ mli kɛ hewalɛ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ yɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ wala mli. Agbɛnɛ Bɔfo Paulo bɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ehã anu shishi faŋŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni ehiɛ hã gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ kɔɔ Yudafoi kɛ Jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ tswɛm hu ahe pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɔ ni ekɛgbe naa ji akɛ Yudafoi lɛ akwa ni amɛkwa Yesu lɛ, no hu shi Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo lɛ nɔ, akɛni kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ aaana Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ eko, ni eheɔ eyeɔ akɛ Yudafoi lɛ kaŋ he amɛkwaŋ Yesu kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
Naagbee lɛ, Paulo tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ pɛ ni sa akɛ Kristofoi aba amɛjeŋ amɛhã, titri lɛ akɛ amɛsumɔsumɔɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛ kɛ amɛhe naanyobɔɔ mli. Nibii pɔtɛ̃ɛ komɛi ahe ni ewie ji Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, Kristofoi agbɛnaa yɛ amɛmaŋ kɛ amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛteaŋ, kɛ henilee. Nɔ ni ekɛgbe wolo lɛ naa ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋamɔi kɛ kɔkɔbɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ kɛ oti 1.1-17
Yiwalaheremɔ ni he ehia 1.18—3.20
Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ gbɛ 3.21—4.25
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli 5.1—8.39
Israelbii lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo mli 9.1—11.36
Kristofoi ajeŋba 12.1—15.13
Naamuu kɛ ŋamɔi 15.14—16.27

Title: ROMABII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Wolo nɛɛ jɛ mi Paulo, Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ bɔfo ni atsɛ lɛ ni ajie lɛ ato ahã Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ, dɛŋ. 2 Sanekpakpa nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ewo he shi eto momo yɛ egbalɔi lɛ anaa yɛ Ŋmalɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli, 3 Sanekpakpa nɛɛ kɔɔ eBi lɛ, mɔ ni yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ ajɛ David shwiei lɛ mli afɔ lɛ lɛ, he. 4 EBi nɛɛ, hetsemɔ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, atsɔ̃ gbohiiashitee lɛ nɔ ajie lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ hewalɛ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ni ji Yesu Kristo wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ. 5 Enɔ mitsɔ̃ mina dromɔ kɛ bɔfo nitsumɔ koni mihã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ abo hemɔkɛyeli lɛ toi, yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ. 6Jeŋmaji nɛɛ ateŋ nyɛ Romabii hu nyɛyɔɔ. Nyɛ mɛi ni atsɛ akɛ nyɛbafee Yesu Kristo mɛi lɛ.
7 Miiŋma nyɛ mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ ni etsɛ nyɛ ni nyɛ ji mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Roma lɛ fɛɛ, dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Faikpamɔ kɛ shidaa
8 Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, miitsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ miida miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhewɔ, akɛ agbaa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ he sane yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ. 9 Ejaakɛ midasefonyo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ yɛ mimumɔ mli yɛ eBi lɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ mli lɛ, akɛ mifɔ̃ko nyɛ kaimɔ dã, 10 ni mikpaa fai daa yɛ misɔlemɔi amli, akɛ aleenɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ gbɛ aaaja ahã mi ni maba nyɛŋɔɔ lo. 11 Ejaakɛ miishwe akɛ mana nyɛ, koni mikɛ mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii lɛ eko abahã nyɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akɛwaje nyɛ, 12 no ji akɛ, atsɔ̃ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nɔ ashɛje mimii, ni atsɔ̃ mi hu minɔ lɛ nɔ ashɛje nyɛmii.
13 Shi anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ mifɔɔ miyiŋtoo akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, koni mibana yibii komɛi yɛ nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ, tamɔ mina yɛ jeŋmaji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ. 14Mihiɛ Helabii kɛ jekɔ̃ji, nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni leee nii fɛɛ anyɔmɔ. 15No hewɔ lɛ, miishwe akɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Roma lɛ hu, mabajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Sanekpakpa lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ
16 Ejaakɛ mihiɛ gbooo Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ he, ejaakɛ eji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni akɛhereɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ yiwala, Yudanyo lɛ tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu. 17 Ejaakɛ no mli ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kpo yɛ, kɛjɛɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli kɛyaa hemɔkɛyeli mli, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Shi jalɔ ni tsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala.”
Fɔ ni gbɔmɛi eye
18Ejaakɛ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kpo kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi kɛbaa gbɔmɛi ni kɛ nishaianii tsĩɔ anɔkwale lɛ gbɛ lɛ amusubɔɔ kɛ nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, 19 akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ he nii ni aaanyɛ ale lɛ yɛ faŋŋ hã amɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejie etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ. 20 Ejaakɛ ehenii ni anaaa ni ji enaanɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔ ni eji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ mli beebe lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ enii ni efee lɛ anɔ ayɔseɔ ni anaa faŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛbɛ naajiemɔ ko; 21 ejaakɛ amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ, shi amɛwooo ehiɛ nyam akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛdaaa lɛ shi hu, shi amɛfee shwɛm yɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi amli, ni amɛtsui ni kɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ ewo duŋ. 22 Amɛtsɛ amɛhe nilelɔi, shi amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kwashiai, 23 ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni gbooo lɛ anunyam lɛ amɛtsake amɛhã gbɔmɔ ni gboɔ lɛ subaŋ henɔ ko kɛ loofɔji kɛ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛtsɛmɛi kɛ waamɔnii anɔ.
24 No hewɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã muji nitsumɔi yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɔnɔi lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshwie amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ ahiɛ shi yɛ amɛteaŋ. 25Amɛŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ amɛtsakeɔ amale, ni amɛjaa ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ bɔɔnɔ lɛ yɛ bɔlɔ lɛ najiaŋ, bɔlɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ! Amen.
26Enɛ hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã hiɛgbejianii ahe hiɛdɔɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ adebɔɔ naanyobɔɔ ni ato lɛ, amɛyei lɛ etsake hiɛ ehã nɔ ni kɛ adebɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo eyaaa; 27 ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛhii lɛ hu eshi amɛyei lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ akɔnɔ ni naa wa nyiɛɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe sɛɛ, ni hii kɛ hii tsuɔ hiɛgbejianii, ni amɛna amɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo ni sa yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmli.
28Ni akɛni amɛbuuu akɛ esa akɛ amɛleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã jwɛŋmɔ ni esaaa koni amɛfee nibii ni esaaa; 29mɛi ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ fɛɛ, efɔŋfeemɔ, hiɛjoomɔ, nifɔɔjianii; amɛyimɔ tɔ kɛ hetsɛ̃, awuyeli, bei, shishiumɔ, nyɛɛ; 30amɛyeɔ amɛhe osheku, Nyɔŋmɔnyɛlɔi, mɛi ni hiɛ esɔɔɔ mɔ, hetsɔ̃ɔlɔi, shwãlɔi, nɔfɔŋ he ŋaatsɔlɔi, fɔlɔi anɔtoigbolɔi, 31mɛi ni bɛ henilee, kpãŋmɔ mli kulɔi, mɛi ni edɔɔɔ mɔ he, mɛi ni enaaa mɔbɔ. 32Amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ krɛdɛɛ nɛ, akɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ sa gbele, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ amɛfeɔ, shi moŋ amɛnaa mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ ahe miishɛɛ hu.

Title: ROMABII 2
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kojomɔ lɛ
1 No hewɔ lɛ, bo, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kojoɔ lɛ, obɛ naajiemɔ ko; ejaakɛ be mli ni okojoɔ mɔ kroko lɛ, oobu bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe fɔ; ejaakɛ bo ni okojoɔ lɛ otsuɔ nakai nii lɛ nɔŋŋ. 2Shi wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ ni baa mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ anɔ lɛ ja. 3Bo gbɔmɔ ni okojoɔ mɛi ni tsuɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ni ofeɔ nakai nɔŋŋ lɛ, ani osusuɔ akɛ bo lɛ ohe aaaje Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ lɛ mli? 4 Aloo obuuu emlihilɛ kɛ eyishiŋmɛɛ kɛ etsuishitoo babaoo lɛ, ni oleee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ lɛ gbɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo kɛya tsuitsakemɔ mli? 5Shi okɛ otsuiwalɛ kɛ ohe ni oshwaaa lɛ miitĩa mlifu naa ohã ohe oto Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbi lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni ebaatsɔ̃ ejie ejalɛ kojomɔ lɛ kpo lɛ; 6 lɛ ebaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔ̃mɔ bɔ ni sa enitsumɔi lɛ: 7mɛi ni kɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ hiɛɔ ekpakpafeemɔ mli ni amɛtaoɔ anunyam kɛ woo kɛ shihilɛ ni fiteŋ lɛ, eeehã amɛ naanɔ wala; 8 shi mɛi ni sumɔɔ bei ni amɛbooo anɔkwale lɛ toi, shi amɛboɔ nii ni ejaaa moŋ toi lɛ, amɛnɔ ji mlifu kɛ mlila. 9 Amanehulu kɛ hejaramɔ aaaba gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ susuma nɔ, Yudanyo tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu; 10shi anunyam kɛ woo kɛ hejɔlɛ aaaba mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nikpakpai anii lɛ nɔ, Yudanyo tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu. 11 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ.
12Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni bɛ Mla lɛ ni amɛfee esha lɛ amɛaalaaje akɛ mɛi ni bɛ Mla; ni mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ Mla lɛ shishi ni amɛfee esha lɛ, Mla lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛaakojo amɛ. 13 Ejaakɛ jeee Mla lɛ nulɔi ji jalɔi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, shi moŋ Mla lɛ nɔyelɔi ji mɛi ni aaabu amɛ akɛ jalɔi. 14 Ejaakɛ kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni bɛ Mla lɛ kɛ amɛfɔmɔŋ su lɛ tsuɔ Mla lɛ naanii lɛ, amɛ ni amɛbɛ Mla lɛ amɛ ji mla hã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe. 15 Amɛnifeemɔnii tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ aŋma Mla lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ amɛtsuii amli, ni amɛhenilee hu yeɔ odase, ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ folɔɔ amɛnaa kɛ amɛfee nɔ ni ehiii aloo ejieɔ amɛnaa kɛ amɛfee nɔ ni hi. 16Enɛ baaba mli gbi nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ akojo gbɔmɛi ateemɔŋnii lɛ yɛ misanekpakpa lɛ naa lɛ.
Yudafoi kɛ Mla lɛ
17Shi kɛji bo lɛ atsɛɔ bo Yudanyo, ni okɛ ohe fɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ nɔ, ni oshwãa ofɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, 18ni ole esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, ni ole nii ni hi, ejaakɛ ajɛ Mla lɛ mli atsɔ̃ɔ bo, 19 ni obuɔ ohe akɛ oji shwilafoi agbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ mli lɛ ala, 20kɛ mɛi ni leee nii atsɔselɔ kɛ abifabii atsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ejaakɛ oyɛ nilee kɛ anɔkwale he mfoniri kɛjɛ Mla lɛ mli, 21 bo ni otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi anii lɛ, otsɔ̃ɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe nii? Oshiɛɔ akɛ akaju, shi ojuɔ; 22okɛɔ akɛ akafite gbãlã, shi ofiteɔ gbãlã; ohiɔ amãgãi, shi ojuɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nii. 23Bo ni okɛ Mla lɛ shwãa lɛ okɛ Mla lɛ nɔtɔmɔ lɛ gbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he guɔ. 24 Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Nyɛhewɔ lɛ awieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔi yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ.”
25 Shi kɛ oyeɔ Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, kulɛ ketiafoo he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ; shi kɛ ofee ohe Mla lɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔ lɛ, oketiafoo lɛ etsɔ̃ foo. 26 Shi kɛji foolɔ lɛ yeɔ Mla lɛ gbɛnai lɛ anɔ lɛ, ani abuŋ efoo lɛ akɛ ketiafoo? 27Ni heloo gbɛfaŋ foolɔ lɛ ni yeɔ Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaakojo bo ni ohiɛ Mla ni aŋma lɛ ni afo bo ketia hu ni ofee ohe mlatɔ̃lɔ lɛ. 28 Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni anaa lɛ yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ akɛ Yudanyo doo ji Yudanyo, ni asaŋ jeee nɔ ni anaa yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso he ji ketiafoo; 29 shi moŋ mɔ ni ji Yudanyo yɛ mligbɛ lɛ ji Yudanyo, ni tsui mli ketiafoo ji nɔ ni atsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ afo, shi jeee Mla lɛ nɔ, ni eyijiemɔ lɛ jɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛɔ.

Title: ROMABII 3
Content:
1Belɛ agbɛnɛ, mɛni Yudanyo kɛfe mɛi krokomɛi mɔ? Aloo mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ ketiafoo mli? 2 Efa yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji akɛ atu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ awo amɛdɛŋ. 3 Shi kɛ mɛi komɛi heee yeee lɛ, mɛni? Ani he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ aaahã Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwayeli lɛ afee yaka? 4 Dabida! Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ fee amalelɔ po, lɛ lɛ ja efee anɔkwafo tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni afee ni ana akɛ osane ja yɛ owiemɔi lɛ amli, ni oye kunim yɛ okojomɔ lɛ mli.” 5Shi kɛji wɔja ni wɔjaaa lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ, te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Aso Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ejaaa kɛji emlifu ba wɔnɔ lɛ? (Miiwie akɛ gbɔmɔ). 6Dabida! Ejaakɛ kɛji nakai ni lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaakojo je lɛ?
7Shi kɛ mimalemɔ lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ faa kɛtekeɔ nɔ hã enunyam lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni akã he akojoɔ mi akɛ eshafeelɔ? 8 Ani jeee tamɔ bɔ ni afoɔ sane afɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ yɛ wɔhe akɛ wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfea efɔŋ koni ekpakpa aba” lɛ? Nakai mɛi lɛ afɔbuu lɛ ja pɛ.
Jalɔ ko bɛ
9 Belɛ mɛni? Ani wɔ Yudafoi wɔhi fe mɛi krokomɛi? Jeee nakai kwraa; ejaakɛ wɔfolɔ Yudafoi kɛ Helabii fɛɛ anaa momo akɛ amɛfɛɛ amɛyɛ esha shishi, 10 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Jalɔ ko bɛ, mɔ kome folo bɛ;
11nilelɔ ko bɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni taoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ
sɛɛgbɛ.
12Amɛ fɛɛ amɛgba afã,
amɛ blublu amɛhiii amɛhãaa nɔ ko;
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ ekpakpa, mɔ kome folo bɛ.
13 Gbonyobu ni agbele naa ji amɛsɛ̃ lɛ;
amɛkɛ amɛlilɛii shishiuɔ mɔ,
shikpãi anaa ebɔɔ yɛ amɛnaabu.
14 Loomɔ kɛ joomɔ eyi amɛdaaŋ obɔ̃.
15 Amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ láshishwiemɔ;
16hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ awerɛhoo yɛ amɛgbɛi anɔ.
17Ni hejɔlɛ gbɛ lɛ amɛleee.
18 Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ ko bɛ amɛhiɛ.”
19 Shi agbɛnɛ wɔle akɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Mla lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla lɛ shishi lɛ ekɛwieɔ, koni mɔ ko mɔ ko akana naabu, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aye fɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 20 Ejaakɛ adamɔŋ Mla lɛ nitsumɔ nɔ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem yɛ ehiɛ; ejaakɛ Mla nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ aleɔ nɔ ni ji esha.
Jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ
21 Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ashi Mla lɛ sɛɛ ajie Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ kpo faŋŋ, ni no he odase Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yeɔ; 22 no ji Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ srɔto ko bɛ; 23 ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ efee esha, ni Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ ebɔ amɛ, 24 ni akɛ edromɔ lɛ buɔ amɛ bem yaka kɛtsɔ̃ɔ kpɔ̃mɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ nɔ. 25 Lɛ ji mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jie to akɛ kpãtãmɔ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ elá lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ koni ekɛjie ejalɛ lɛ kpo, yɛ ehiɛ ni eku efɔ̃ eshai ni afee sa lɛ anɔ yɛ etsuishiŋmɛɛ mli lɛ hewɔ; 26koni ejie ejalɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ benɛ be nɛɛ mli, ni eye bem ni ebu mɔ ni heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ lɛ hu bem.
27 Agbɛnɛ mɛni nɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ? Nɔ ko bɛ. Mɛɛ Mla nɔ atsɔ̃? Nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ nɔ lo? Dabi, shi hemɔkɛyeli mla lɛ nɔ moŋ atsɔ̃. 28 No hewɔ lɛ, wɔbuɔ akɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ abuɔ gbɔmɔ bem, shi jeee Mla nitsumɔi anɔ. 29 Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Yudafoi kɛkɛ aNyɔŋmɔ ni? Ani jeee jeŋmaji lɛ hu aNyɔŋmɔ ni? Hɛɛ, jeŋmaji lɛ hu aNyɔŋmɔ 30akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome ni, ni hemɔkɛyeli naa ebuɔ ketiafoo bem, ni esaa edamɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ebuɔ foo bem lɛ. 31 Belɛ wɔmiitsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ wɔhã Mla lɛ afee yaka lo? Dabida, shi wɔkɛmiima Mla lɛ nɔ mi moŋ.

Title: ROMABII 4
Content:
Abraham hemɔkɛyeli akɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ
1Belɛ mɛni wɔɔkɛɛ akɛ Abraham ni ji wɔtsɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ na mɔ? 2Kɛ nitsumɔi anɔ adamɔ abu lɛ bem lɛ, kulɛ eyɛ shwãa nɔ, shi belɛ jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 3 Ejaakɛ te ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ tɛŋŋ? “Ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ.” 4 Mɔ ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, abuuu enyɔmɔwoo lɛ akɛ dromɔ nɔ ko, shi moŋ akɛ egbɛnaa nɔ ko. 5Shi mɔ ni jeee nii etsuɔ, shi eheɔ mɔ ni buɔ eshafeelɔ bem lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ akɛ jalɛ ehãa lɛ. 6Tamɔ bɔ ni David hu kɛɔ akɛ ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ shiɔ nitsumɔi asɛɛ ebuɔ lɛ jalɔ lɛ,
7 “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni akɛ amɛmlatɔ̃mɔi lɛ efa amɛ,
ni atsimɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ anɔ lɛ.
8Ajɔɔ nuu ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ebuuu ehe esha lɛ ehãaa lɛ lɛ.”
9Agbɛnɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ, mɛi ni afo amɛ ketia kɛkɛ anɔ ni, aloo foolɔi lɛ hu anɔ̃ŋ? Ejaakɛ wɔkɛɔ akɛ abu hemɔkɛyeli lɛ akɛ jalɛ ahã Abraham. 10Agbɛnɛ te abu lɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ tɛŋŋ? Be ni afo lɛ ketia lɛ aloo be mli ni afoko lɛ ketia lɛ? Jeee be mli ni afo lɛ ketia, shi moŋ be ni eji foolɔ lɛ. 11 Ni enine shɛ ketiafoo okadi lɛ nɔ akɛ jalɛ naasɔomɔnɔ ni akɛsɔo ehemɔkɛyeli ni ena be mli ni eji foolɔ beebe lɛ naa, ni efee mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ be ni amɛ ji foolɔi lɛ atsɛ, ni abu hemɔkɛyeli ahã amɛ hu akɛ jalɛ; 12 ni asaŋ efee ketiafolɔi atsɛ hu ehã mɛi ni amɛjeee ketiafolɔi kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɔ wɔtsɛ Abraham, mɔ ni he ye be mli ni eji foolɔ beebe lɛ, nane.
Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo ni anaa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ
13 Ejaakɛ jeee Mla nɔ ni Abraham ye hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ loo eshwiei ashi akɛ je lɛ aaatsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, shi moŋ akɛni ehe eye ni Nyɔŋmɔ bu lɛ akɛ jalɔ lɛ hewɔŋ. 14Ejaakɛ kɛ Mla shishibii lɛ ji niyelɔi lɛ, belɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ efee yaka, ni shiwoo lɛ hu he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ dɔŋŋ. 15 Mla lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa, shi he ni mla bɛ lɛ, mlatɔ̃mɔ hu bɛ.
16Enɛ hewɔ ejɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni shiwoo lɛ afee dromɔ sane, ni ama shi shiŋŋ ahã eshwiei lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeee Mla shishibii lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni jɛ Abraham, ni ji wɔ fɛɛ wɔtsɛ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ hu; 17 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ bo efee jeŋmaji pii atsɛ” yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ehe eye lɛ hiɛ, mɔ hu ni tsiɛ̃ɔ gbohii ahiɛ, ni etsɛɔ nibii ni bɛ lɛ kɛbaa tamɔ nɔ ni amɛyɛ momo lɛ. 18 Ni he ni kulɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko bɛ lɛ, ena hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ he ni ehe eye, mɔ ni etsɔ̃ jeŋmaji pii atsɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nakai oshwiei lɛ aaatamɔ.” 19 Ni ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɔjɔɔɔ, ni ejwɛŋŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso gbo ni egbo momo, akɛni eye aaafee afii oha lɛ, kɛ Sara fɔ ni efɔɔɔ lɛ he; 20 ni eyiŋ efeee lɛ kɔshikɔshi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo lɛ he tamɔ akɛ eheee eyeee, shi moŋ ena hewalɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, 21ni eyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ jogbaŋŋ akɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo he shi lɛ, eeenyɛ efee hu. 22No hewɔ hu ni abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ. 23 Shi jeee lɛ kɛkɛ ehewɔ aŋma akɛ “abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ” lɛ, 24shi moŋ wɔ mɛi ni abaabu ahã wɔ lɛ hu hewɔ, wɔ mɛi ni wɔheɔ mɔ ni tee wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ; 25 shi akɛ lɛ hã yɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ yɛ wɔbembuu hewɔ.

Title: ROMABII 5
Content:
Nɔ ni jɛɔ bembuu mli kɛbaa
1 Agbɛnɛ akɛni adamɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem hewɔ lɛ, wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ yɛ hejɔlɛ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ. 2 Lɛ enɔ wɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ena gbɛ hu kɛba dromɔ ni wɔyɔɔ mli nɛɛ mli, ni wɔnyaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ hewɔ. 3 Shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ wɔnyaa yɛ amanehului amli hu, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ amanehulu lɛ tsɛɔ hiɛmiamɔ kɛbaa, 4ni hiɛmiamɔ tsɛɔ su ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛbaa; ni su nɛɛ tsɛɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛbaa; 5 ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeee efolo; ejaakɛ atsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ nɔ afɔse Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ awo wɔtsuii amli.
6Ejaakɛ be mli ni wɔhe waaa lɛ beebe Kristo bagbo yɛ be ni sa mli ehã mɛi ni efeee Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ. 7Ejaakɛ ekpakpa ko dani mɔ ko aaagbo ahã jalɔ ko; ni mɔ kpakpa ko hewɔ lɛ, ekolɛ mɔ ko aaashi etsitsi akɛ eeegbo. 8 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ, akɛ be mli ni wɔji eshafeelɔi lɛ beebe ni Kristo bagbo yɛ wɔnajiaŋ. 9 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni abu wɔ bem yɛ elá lɛ hewɔ lɛ, aaatsɔ̃ enɔ ahere wɔyiwala kɛjɛ mlifu lɛ mli aahu. 10 Ejaakɛ kɛ be mli ni wɔji henyɛlɔi lɛ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbele lɛ bakpãtã wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni akpãtã wɔteŋ nɛɛ, aaahere wɔyiwala yɛ ewala lɛ mli aahu. 11Shi jeee no kɛkɛ, shi asaŋ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hu yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, mɔ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni agbɛnɛ wɔna kpãtãmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Adam kɛ Kristo
12 Agbɛnɛ, gbɔmɔ kome nɔ esha tsɔ̃ kɛba je lɛ mli, ni gbele tsɔ̃ esha nɔ kɛba. Bɔ ni fee nɛ ni gbele lɛ tsɛŋe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee esha lɛ. 13 Esha yɛ jeŋ dani ahã Mla lɛ; shi akɛni mla bɛ hewɔ lɛ, abuuu esha lɛ he akɔntaa. 14 Kɛ̃lɛ gbele lɛ ye maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Adam yinɔ kɛbashi Mose yinɔ yɛ mɛi po ni efeko esha ni tamɔ Adam nɔtɔmɔ lɛ anɔ, Adam ni ji mɔ ni baaba lɛ mfoniri lɛ.
15Shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ shigbeemɔnɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ, kɛ mɔ kome lɛ shigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ ni mɛi pii lɛ gboi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ kɛ nɔkeenɔ ni tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ dromɔ nɔ ba lɛ fa kɛteke nɔ hã mɛi pii lɛ aahu. 16Ni srɔto yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ kɛ esha ni tsɔ̃ mɔ kome nɔ kɛba lɛ mli; ejaakɛ mɔ kome he esha ni akojo lɛ, ehebuamɔ lɛ fee fɔbuu; shi dromɔ ni jɛ mɛi pii anɔtɔ̃mɔ mli lɛ tsɔ̃ bembuu. 17Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ kome shigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ jɛ ni gbele tsɔ̃ nakai mɔ kome lɛ nɔ ye maŋtsɛ lɛ, belɛ mɛi ni ena dromɔ kɛ jalɛ nɔkeenɔ ni fa kɛteke nɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ mɔ kome ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ aye maŋtsɛ yɛ wala mli aahu.
18 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ mɔ kome shigbeemɔ nɔ abu gbɔmɛi fɛɛ fɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ atsɔ̃ mɔ kome jalɛ nɔ abu gbɔmɛi fɛɛ awala bem. 19 Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome lɛ toigbele lɛ nɔ ahã mɛi pii tsɔ̃mɔ eshafeelɔi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaatsɔ̃ mɔ kome lɛ toiboo lɛ nɔ ahã mɛi pii hu atsɔ̃mɔ jalɔi.
20 Shi Mla lɛ babote mli koni nɔtɔmɔ lɛ afa kɛteke nɔ. Shi he ni esha fa yɛ lɛ, dromɔ lɛ fa kɛteke nɔ yɛ jɛi, 21 koni bɔ nɔŋŋ ni esha lɛ ye maŋtsɛ yɛ gbele mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ dromɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ jalɛ nɔ aye maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ wala mli yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, hewɔ.

Title: ROMABII 6
Content:
Esha bɛ wɔnɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ
1 Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Aso wɔkã he wɔhi esha lɛ mli, koni dromɔ lɛ afa? 2Dabida! Wɔ ni esha gbɛfaŋ lɛ wɔtamɔ mɛi ni egboi lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔhiɛ aaakãmɔ yɛ emli loloŋ? 3 Aloo nyɛleee akɛ wɔteŋ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi wɔ awo Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, egbele lɛ mli abaptisi wɔ awo? 4 No hewɔ lɛ, akɛ baptisimɔ ni abaptisi wɔ awo egbele lɛ mli lɛ efu wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ, koni tamɔ bɔ ni atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ anunyam naa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔɔnyiɛ yɛ wala hee mli.
5 Ejaakɛ kɛji wɔ kɛ lɛ efee ekome yɛ egbele lɛ henɔ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ aaafee ekome yɛ eshitee lɛ nɔ lɛ mli hu; 6 ejaakɛ wɔle enɛ akɛ asɛŋ wɔgbɔmɔ momo lɛ kɛ lɛ, koni esha gbɔmɔtso lɛ hiɛ akpãtã ni wɔkasɔ̃mɔ esha lɛ dɔŋŋ. 7Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni egbo lɛ, eye ehe yɛ esha dɛŋ. 8 Shi kɛ wɔ kɛ Kristo gbo lɛ, wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ aaana wala hu, 9ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ ni atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ nɛɛ, egboŋ dɔŋŋ; gbele naŋ enɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ. 10 Ejaakɛ ni egbo lɛ, esha hewɔ egbo, shi kome pɛ; shi ni ehiɛ kã nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ehiɛ kã ehã. 11 Nakai nyɛ hu nyɛbua nyɛhe akɛ mɛi ni egboi yɛ esha gbɛfaŋ ni amɛhiɛ kãmɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli.
12 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa esha miiyea nyɛgbɔmɔtso ni baagbo lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni nyɛbo lɛ toi yɛ ekɔnɔi lɛ amli; 13 ni asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ akahãa esha akɛ esha lɛ tawuunii; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ mɛi ni hiɛ etsɛ̃ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ afea jalɛ tawuunii nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ. 14 Ejaakɛ esha naŋ nyɛnɔ hewalɛ, ejaakɛ jeee Mla shishi nyɛyɔɔ, shi moŋ dromɔ shishi nyɛyɔɔ.
Jalɛ tsuji ji wɔ
15 Belɛ mɛni? Aso wɔfee esha akɛni wɔbɛ mla shishi shi dromɔ moŋ shishi wɔyɔɔ lɛ? Dabida! 16 Ani nyɛleee akɛ, mɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe feɔ tsuji nyɛhãa ni nyɛboɔ lɛ toi lɛ, nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ni nyɛboɔ lɛ toi lɛ tsuji ji nyɛ; esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ tsuji jio, aloo toiboo ni kɛ mɔ yaa jalɛ mli lɛ tsuji jio? 17Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ kulɛ sa lɛ esha tsuji ji nyɛ, shi agbɛnɛ nyɛjɛ nyɛtsui fiaa mli nyɛbo nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛ nyɛ ewo mli nɛɛ toi. 18 Ni akɛni akpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ esha dɛŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ jalɛ tsuji. 19Miiwie akɛ gbɔmɔ yɛ nyɛgbedemɔ ni jɛ gbɔmɔfɔmɔ su mli lɛ hewɔ. Tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ fee tsuji nyɛhã nyaŋemɔ nii kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ koni nyɛkɛtɔ̃ Mla lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ afea jalɛ tsuji ahãa krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ.
20Be ni nyɛ ji esha tsuji lɛ, nyɛye nyɛhe kɛjɛ jalɛ dɛŋ. 21 Ni mɛni nyɛna kɛjɛ mli yɛ nakai be lɛ mli? Yibii ni nyɛhiɛ egboi yɛ he agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi anaagbee ji gbele. 22 Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, ni akpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ esha dɛŋ ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji nɛɛ, nɔ ni nyɛnaa kɛjɛɔ mli ji krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ, ni enaagbee ji naanɔ wala. 23 Ejaakɛ esha dɛŋ nyɔmɔwoo lɛ gbele ni; shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenɔ lɛ naanɔ walaŋ yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli.

Title: ROMABII 7
Content:
Kristofonyo eye ehe yɛ Mla lɛ dɛŋ
1Aloo nyɛleee, anyɛmimɛi, mɛi ni le Mla mikɛwieɔ nɛɛ, akɛ Mla lɛ yeɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ be mli ni eyɔɔ wala mli lɛ kɛkɛ? 2Tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ yoo ni yɔɔ wu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ewu lɛ hiɛ kã lɛ, mla efi lɛ ekpɛtɛ ewu lɛ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, ekɛ ewu mla lɛ bɛ sane ko dɔŋŋ. 3No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ewu lɛ yɛ jeŋ lolo ni eyagbã mɔ kroko lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ gbãlãfitelɔ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, eye ehe kɛjɛ mla lɛ dɛŋ, ni kɛ eyagbã nuu kroko lɛ, ejeee gbãlãfitelɔ dɔŋŋ. 4Minyɛmimɛi, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu atsɔ̃ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ nɔ ahã nyɛgboi yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɔ kroko ni ji mɔ ni atee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nii, koni wɔwo yibii wɔhã Nyɔŋmɔ. 5 Ejaakɛ be ni wɔhi shi yɛ wɔgbɔmɔfɔmɔ su lɛ naa lɛ, eshai ahe akɔnɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ nɔ tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔhenii lɛ amli ni wɔkɛwo yibii wɔhã gbele. 6 Shi agbɛnɛ wɔkɛ Mla lɛ bɛ sane ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbohii yɛ nɔ ni fi wɔ kpɛŋŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, bɔ ni afee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔ yɛ mumɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee mli, shi jeee yɛ gbɛ momo lɛ ni ji Mla ni aŋma lɛ nɔ.
Mla lɛ kɛ esha
7 Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Aso Mla lɛ esha ni? Dabida! Shi moŋ jeee Mla lɛ hewɔŋ kulɛ mileee esha; ejaakɛ kulɛ mileee nɔ ni ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, kɛjeee Mla lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nii anɔ.” 8 Shi esha lɛ tsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ ena hegbɛ ni eteɔ akɔnɔi fɛɛ ashi yɛ mimli; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla bɛ lɛ esha hu egbo. 9Shi mihi shi pɛŋ ni mibɛ mla; shi be ni kitã lɛ ba lɛ, esha lɛ hiɛ tsɛ ekoŋŋ; 10 shi mi lɛ migbo; ni mina akɛ kitã lɛ ni akɛhã mi yɛ wala hewɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɛ gbele ehã mi. 11 Ejaakɛ esha lɛ na hegbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ eshishiu mi, ni ekɛ no nɔŋŋ gbe mi.
12 Hewɔ lɛ Mla lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni kitã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni eja ni ehi hu.
13 Aso belɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele ehã mi lo? Dabida! Shi moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni esha lɛ aje shi akɛ esha; ni ekɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ nɔŋŋ tsɛ gbele ehã mi, koni esha lɛ atsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ esha kɛteke nɔ.
Gbɔmɔfɔmɔ sui enyɔ
14 Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ mumɔŋ nɔ ni; shi mi lɛ heloo gbɔmɔ ji mi, ni ahɔ̃ɔ mi awo esha shishi. 15Shi nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ mileee, ejaakɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔ lɛ, jeee no mifeɔ, shi nɔ ni mihiɔ moŋ lɛ, no mifeɔ. 16 Shi kɛ nɔ ni misumɔɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ mikpɛ̃lɛ̃ɔ akɛ Mla lɛ hi. 17Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni hiɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ. 18 Ejaakɛ mile akɛ mimli, no ji migbɔmɔ su lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ko kpakpa ko bɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ lɛ miyɛ eko moŋ, shi ekpakpafeemɔ ni ebɔ mi. 19Ejaakɛ ekpakpa ni misumɔɔ lɛ mifeee; shi efɔŋ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, no moŋ mifeɔ. 20Shi kɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ kɛ̃ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ.
21Belɛ minaa mla ko akɛ mi ni misumɔɔ akɛ mafee nɔ ni hi lɛ, efɔŋ moŋ kpɛtɛ mihe. 22Mimligbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ miishɛɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ he; 23 shi minaa mla kroko yɛ mihe nii lɛ amli ni kɛ mla ni kɛ mijwɛŋmɔ yaa lɛ wuɔ ta, ni eŋɔɔ mi nom ehãa esha mla lɛ ni yɔɔ mihenii lɛ amli lɛ. 24Gbɔmɔ ni nii yɔɔ mɔbɔ ji mi! Namɔ aaajie mi kɛaajɛ gbele gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ dɛŋ? 25 Shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, nɔ.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ mi nɔŋŋ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ moŋ, shi mikɛ migbɔmɔ su sɔ̃mɔɔ esha Mla.

Title: ROMABII 8
Content:
Shihilɛ yɛ mumɔ naa
1 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ fɔ ko fɔ ko bɛ ni abaabu mɛi ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ. 2 Ejaakɛ mumɔ mla ni hãa wala yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ekpɔ̃ mi yɛ esha kɛ gbele mla lɛ dɛŋ. 3 Ejaakɛ nɔ ni Mla lɛ nyɛɛɛ afee yɛ gbedemɔ ni heloo lɛ ehã egbede hewɔ lɛ, no Nyɔŋmɔ fee: etsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ yɛ su ni tamɔ esha heloo su mli, yɛ esha hewɔ; ni ebu esha lɛ fɔ yɛ heloo lɛ mli, 4 koni afee Mla lɛ taomɔnii ni ja lɛ yɛ wɔmli, wɔ mɛi ni wɔnyiɛɛɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa wɔnyiɛɔ lɛ. 5Mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ heloo naa lɛ, heloonii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ; shi mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ, mumɔnii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ. 6 Ejaakɛ heloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, gbele ni, shi mumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, wala kɛ hejɔlɛ ni. 7 Heloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛɛ ni, akɛni ebaaa ehe shi ehãaa Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni esaa enyɛŋ tete lɛ; 8ejaakɛ mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ heloo mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ amɛsa.
9 Nyɛhiii shi yɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ, kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ. Shi kɛ mɔ ko bɛ Kristo Mumɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee Kristo nɔ ji lɛ. 10Shi kɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ egbo yɛ esha hewɔ nɛ, shi Mumɔ lɛ hiɛ kã, yɛ jalɔi ni abu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ. 11Shi kɛ mɔ ni tee Yesu shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ, mɔ ni tee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ aaahã nyɛgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ hu yi ana wala yɛ eMumɔ ni hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ hewɔ.
12 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɔjiatsɛmɛi ji wɔ, shi jeee heloo lɛ nyɔmɔ wɔhiɛ ni wɔɔhi shi yɛ heloo naa. 13 Ejaakɛ kɛ heloo naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ lɛ, nyɛbaagboi shi kɛ nyɛkɛ Mumɔ lɛ gbeɔ heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, nyɛhiɛ aaakãmɔ. 14Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ kpalaa amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ bii. 15 Ejaakɛ jeee nyɔŋ mumɔ nyɛna ni aaahã nyɛshe gbeyei ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni hãa mɛi tsɔ̃mɔɔ bii ni hãa wɔboɔ wɔtsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Aba! Ataa!” lɛ. 16 Lɛ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔmumɔ lɛ yeɔ odase akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji wɔ. 17 Ni kɛ bii ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ niyelɔi hu ji wɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ niyelɔi kɛ Kristo nanemɛi niyelɔi; kɛji wɔ kɛ lɛ na amanehulu lɛ, koni awo wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ nyam hu.
Wɔsɛɛ anunyam
18 Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ amanehului lɛ kɛ anunyam ni wɔsɛɛ abaajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ yeee egbɔ. 19 Ejaakɛ bɔɔnii lɛ kɛ gbɛkwɛmɔ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ miimɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ akpojiemɔ lɛ. 20 Ejaakɛ akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ ewo yakayakanii ashishi, jeee yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa, shi moŋ yɛ mɔ ni ba amɛ shi lɛ suɔmɔ naa; kɛ̃lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ 21 akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu abaahã amɛye amɛhe kɛjɛ fitemɔ ni yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ anunyam heyeli lɛ mli. 22Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ ni amɛkɔ̃mɔ̃ɔ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ. 23 Shi jeee amɛ kɛkɛŋ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ tete, wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ Mumɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu wɔkɛ̃mɔ̃ɔ yɛ wɔmli, ni wɔkwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔbaatsɔ̃mɔ bii, no ji abaakpɔ̃ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ. 24 Ejaakɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ naa ahere wɔyiwala yɛ. Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni anaa lɛ, ejeee hiɛnɔkãmɔ, ejaakɛ namɔ hiɛ kãa nɔ ni enaa nɔ? 25Shi kɛ nɔ ni wɔnaaa lɛ nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, belɛ wɔkɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ.
26Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Mumɔ lɛ hu yeɔ buaa wɔ yɛ wɔgbedemɔi lɛ amli; ejaakɛ bɔ ni sa akɛ wɔsɔle lɛ wɔleee; shi moŋ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔi ni anyɛŋ akɛɛ lɛ dãmɔɔ mli hãa wɔ. 27Ni mɔ ni taoɔ tsuii amli lɛ le nɔ ni ji mumɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ edãmɔɔ mli ehãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa.
28 Shi wɔle akɛ mɛi ni sumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nibii fiaa yeɔ buaa amɛ ni ahi ahã amɛ, amɛ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ yɛ yiŋtoo naa lɛ. 29 Ejaakɛ mɛi ni ele amɛ eto momo lɛ, amɛ ejie eto ni amɛsubaŋ atamɔ eBi lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni efee nyɛmimɛi pii ateŋ kromɔbi. 30Shi mɛi ni ejie eto lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ etsɛ; ni mɛi ni etsɛ lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ bem ebu; ni mɛi ni ebu amɛ bem lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ nyam ewo.
Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo mli
31Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ yɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔŋ? Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ, namɔ aaate shi awo wɔ? 32Lɛ mɔ ni kãmãaa wɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ, shi moŋ ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnajiaŋ lɛ, ani eŋɔŋ nibii fiaa efataŋ ehe ekeŋ wɔ? 33Namɔ aaafolɔ Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii lɛ anaa? Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ bem. 34 Namɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ fɔ lɛ? Kristo, mɔ ni gbo, shi nɔ ni fe no lɛ, mɔ ni atee lɛ shi ni eyɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni esaa edamɔɔ mli ehãa wɔ lɛ? 35Namɔ aaagbala wɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni Kristo kɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ mli? Amanehulu loo fimɔ loo yiwaa loo hɔ̃mɔ loo yayainyiɛmɔ loo osharã loo klante? 36 Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ,
“Ohewɔ lɛ agbeɔ wɔ aahu jenamɔ tuu;
abu wɔ akɛ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ.”
37Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi fiaa mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni sumɔ wɔ lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ kunim tsɔ̃. 38Ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ gbele jio, wala jio; ŋwɛi bɔfoi jio, nɔyelɔi jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio, hewalɛi jio, 39ŋwɛi jio, shishi jio, aloo nibii ni abɔ lɛ amli nɔ kroko jio, amɛnyɛŋ amɛgbala wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli lɛ mli.

Title: ROMABII 9
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ emaŋ ni ehala lɛ
1Miiwie anɔkwale yɛ Kristo mli, mimaleee, ni mihenilee hu miiye mi odase yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, 2akɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ babaoo, ni mitsui yeɔ daa. 3 Ejaakɛ mina ni kulɛ ajie mi yɛ Kristo he akɛ musumɔ yɛ minyɛmimɛi ni ji miwekumɛi yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ ahewɔ. 4 Amɛ ji Israelbii lɛ; ni amɛnɔ ji bitsɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ anunyam lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔi lɛ kɛ mlahãmɔ lɛ kɛ jamɔ lɛ kɛ shiwoi lɛ, 5 amɛnɔ ji tsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛmli hu Kristo tete jɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, lɛ ji nii fiaa nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ. Amen!
6 Shi jeee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ efee yaka. Ejaakɛ jeee mɛi ni jɛ Israel mli lɛ fɛɛ ji “Israel musuŋ bii”, 7 ni asaŋ jeee akɛ ni Abraham shwiei ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ, bii ji amɛ fɛɛ, shi moŋ, “Mɛi ni jɛ Isak mli lɛ aaatsɛ amɛ oshwiei.” 8 No ji akɛ, jeee heloo naa bii lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ bii, shi shiwoo naa bii lɛ moŋ abuɔ akɛ oshwiei. 9 Ejaakɛ shiwoo wiemɔ lɛ nɛ, “Wɔsɛɛ agbɔ be nɛ lɛ maba, ni Sara aaana binuu.” 10 Shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ wɔtsɛ Isak kome lɛ nɔŋŋ Rebeka kɛna musu, 11shi be ni anako afɔ bii lɛ, ni amɛsaa amɛfeko nɔ kpakpa ko loo nɔ fɔŋ ko lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni akɛhalaa mɔ lɛ amã shi, ni ekajɛ nitsumɔi amli, shi moŋ ejɛ mɔ ni tsɛɔ mɔ lɛ, 12 akɛɛ Rebeka akɛ, “Onukpa lɛ baasɔ̃mɔ gbekɛ lɛ.” 13 Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Yakob lɛ, misumɔ lɛ, shi Esau lɛ minyɛ lɛ lɛ.”
14 Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ani Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ sane ko ni ejaaa? Dabida! 15 Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ ni minaa lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mɔbɔ mibana, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ mi hãa lɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi ahã.” 16 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ ko suɔmɔ loo emɔdɛŋbɔɔ naa ni, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa ni. 17 Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitee bo shi, koni majie mihewalɛ kpo kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ, koni atsi migbɛi tã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.” 18 Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, enaa lɛ mɔbɔ, ni kɛ eesumɔ akɛ ewaje mɔ ko tsui lɛ, ewajeɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kɛ emɔbɔnalɛ
19Shi agbɛnɛ ooobi mi akɛ, “Belɛ mɛɛba Nyɔŋmɔ shwaa mɔ̃ mɔ? Ejaakɛ namɔ aaanyɛ eyiŋtoo naa aku?” 20 Shi, bo gbɔmɔ, namɔ ji bo, ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kaneɔ? Ani nɔ ni ashɔ̃ lɛ aaabi mɔ ni shɔ̃ lɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba oshɔ̃ mi nɛkɛ?” 21Aloo gbɛshɔ̃lɔ bɛ hegbɛ yɛ su lɛ nɔ, akɛ ekɛ su ni akpɔtɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ eko aaashɔ̃ nɔ ko ni yɔɔ nyam ni ekɛ eko hu aaashɔ̃ nɔ ko ni bɛ nyam? 22 Shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ akɛ ejie emlifu kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ni ehã ale ehe ni wa lɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ eŋmɛɔ etsui shi babaoo ehiɛɔ mlifu nii ni sa fitemɔ lɛ, 23 bɔ ni afee ni ehã ale enunyam falɛ lɛ hu yɛ emɔbɔnalɛ nii ni esaa eto ehã anunyam lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɛni obaakɛɛ? 24Shi nakai etsɛ wɔ hu, jeee mɛi ni jɛ Yudafoi ateŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi mɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ lɛ hu. 25 Tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ Hoshea wolo lɛ mli akɛ,
“Matsɛ mɛi ni jeee mimaŋ lɛ akɛ mimaŋ,
kɛ mɔ ni asumɔɔɔ lɛ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni asumɔɔ lɛ.”
26 “Ni aaaba mli akɛ, he ni akɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ,
‘Jeee mimaŋ ji nyɛ’ lɛ,
jɛi nɔŋŋ aaatsɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bii yɛ.”
27 Shi Yesaia bo yɛ Israel he akɛ, “Kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayibɔ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia lɛ, mɛi fioo ni baashwɛ lɛ yiwala aaahere. 28Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsu ewiemɔ lɛ he nii kuku egbe naa pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” 29 Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yesaia ekɛɛ eto momo lɛ akɛ,
“Eji Tai aNuŋtsɔ lɛ eshwɛɛɛ shwiei ko ehãaa
wɔ kulɛ,
wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ Sodom, ni wɔfee tamɔ Gomora pɛ.”
Israel nine shɛɛɛ jalɛ nɔ
30 Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni ediii jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ ena jalɛ ni ji jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ; 31 shi Israel moŋ ni diɔ jalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, enine shɛɛɛ nɔ. 32Mɛɛ hewɔ ni? Ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ amɛtaooo, shi moŋ tamɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔi anɔ taoɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛtɛrɛ tɛmɔ tɛ lɛ; 33 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Naa, mikɛ tɛmɔ tɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ko
miima shi yɛ Zion,
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ,
ehiɛ gboŋ.”

Title: ROMABII 10
Content:
1Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mitsui shweɔ kɛ fai ni mikpaa Nyɔŋmɔ mihãa Israel ji akɛ ahere amɛyiwala. 2Ejaakɛ miiye amɛhe odase akɛ amɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he moŋ, shi jeee nilee naa. 3 Ejaakɛ amɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ, shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjalɛ moŋ amɛtaoɔ amɛkɛma shi, hewɔ lɛ amɛbaaa amɛhe shi amɛhãaa Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ. 4 Ejaakɛ Kristo ji Mla lɛ naagbee, ni lɛ ji jalɛ hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Yiwalaheremɔ yɛ hã mɛi fɛɛ
5 Ejaakɛ Mose ŋma yɛ jalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli lɛ he akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ enɛɛmɛi anɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli.” 6 Shi bɔ ni jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Kaakɛɛ yɛ otsui mli akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaakwɔ kɛaatee ŋwɛi?’ ” No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛkpeleke shi. 7Aloo, “Namɔ aaakpeleke shi kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli?” No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ kɛba. 8 Shi moŋ te ekɛɔ tɛŋŋ? “Bɛŋkɛmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ bo yɛ odaa mli kɛ otsui mli fɛɛ,” no ji hemɔkɛyeli wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔshiɛɔ lɛ. 9 Shi kɛji okɛ onaabu jaje akɛ, “Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ” lɛ, ni ohe oye yɛ otsui mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, aaahere oyi wala. 10Ejaakɛ tsui akɛheɔ ayeɔ kɛshɛɔ jalɛ he, ni naabu akɛjajeɔ kɛshɛɔ yiwalaheremɔ he. 11 Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, ehiɛ gboŋ.” 12 Ejaakɛ srɔto ko bɛ Yudanyo kɛ Helanyo teŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɔɔ, ni niiatsɛ hu ji lɛ ha mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ. 13 “Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyi wala.”
14Shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaabo amɛtsɛ mɔ ni amɛheko lɛ amɛyeko lɛ hu? Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaahe mɔ ni amɛnuko ehe sane lɛ amɛye hu? Ni asaŋ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaanu kɛ shiɛlɔ ko bɛ lɛ? 15 Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaashiɛ, kɛ atsuko amɛ lɛ? Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni Sanekpakpashiɛlɔi ni shiɛɔ nikpakpai lɛ anaji yɔɔ fɛo ha!”
16 Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi, ejaakɛ Yesaia kɛɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye?” 17 Belɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, sane toiboo mli jɛɔ, ni sane toiboo hu tsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa.
18 Shi miibi akɛ, “Aso nu amɛnuuu?” Anɔkwale mli lɛ amɛnu, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ,
“Amɛgbee ejije kɛtee shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛwiemɔi lɛ eshɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ.”
19 Shi miibi hu akɛ, “Aso le Israel leee?” Mose etsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ,
“Mahã nyɛye maŋ ni jeee maŋ ko he awuŋã,
ni mikɛ maŋ ko ni leee nɔ ko aaawo nyɛ mlila.”
20 Yesaia kɛ ekãa kɛɛ,
“Mihã mɛi ni taooo mi lɛ na mi,
Ni mijie mihe kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni biko mishi lɛ.” 21 Shi Israel lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Daa jenamɔ migbɛɔ minijiaŋ mihãa maŋ toigbolɔi kɛ sanenaajielɔi lɛ.”

Title: ROMABII 11
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ yɛ ha Israel lolo
1 Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, “Belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ emaŋ lɛ efɔ̃?” Dabida! Ejaakɛ mi hu Israelnyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Abraham shwiei kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli. 2 Nyɔŋmɔ shɛko emaŋ ni ele eto momo lɛ efɔ̃ko. Aloo nyɛleee nɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ Elia yi nɔ lɛ, be ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni efolɔɔ Israel naa akɛ, 3“Nuŋtsɔ, ogbalɔi lɛ, amɛgbe amɛ, ni ofɔleshãalatɛi lɛ, amɛwule amɛshwie shi, ni eshwɛ mi kome too, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe.” 4 Shi mɛɛ hetoo Nyɔŋmɔ hã lɛ? “Mishwɛ hii akpei kpawo ni kɛ amɛnakutsei kulako shi hãko Baal mihã mihe.” 5 Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amrɔ nɛɛ hu eshwɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ dromɔ halamɔ naa. 6Shi kɛji dromɔ lɛ naa ni lɛ, belɛ jeee nitsumɔi anaa ni dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ no lɛ dromɔ lɛ jeee dromɔ dɔŋŋ.
7Belɛ te tɛŋŋ? Nɔ ni Israel taoɔ lɛ enine shɛɛɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ anine shɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, awaje amɛtsui, 8 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ shɔ̃ɔfeemɔ ko, hiŋmɛii ni amɛkɛnaaa nii, kɛ toii ni amɛkɛnuuu nii kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ.” 9 Ni David kɛɛ akɛ,
“Hã amɛkpɔlɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ akpa kɛ loofɔlɔduu tsɔne kɛ
tɛmɔnɔ kɛ toigbalamɔ ahã amɛ.
10Hã amɛhiɛ awo duŋ, ni amɛkana nii,
ni ohã amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ daa.”
11 Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, “Belɛ amɛtɛrɛ koni amɛgbee shi?” Dabida! Shi moŋ atsɔ̃ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ nɔ ahere jeŋmaji lɛ ayi wala, koni Israel aye awuŋã. 12Shi kɛ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ je lɛ ninamɔ, ni amɛnɔgbɔmɔ lɛ hu tsɔ̃ jeŋmaji aninamɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛyifalɛ lɛ te eeehã ninamɔ lɛ afee tɛŋŋ?
Jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ayiwalaheremɔ
13Agbɛnɛ nyɛ ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiabii lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi mi ji jeŋmaji abɔfo lɛ, mawo misɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam, 14 akɛ aleenɔ mikɛaahã mijakubii lɛ aye awuŋã, ni mahere amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ayiwala lo. 15Ejaakɛ kɛ amɛshɛmɔkɛfɔ̃ɔ lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ je lɛ ekpãtã lɛ, belɛ amɛheremɔ lɛ, ani jeee wala ni jɛ gbohii ateŋ ni?
16“Shi kɛji fioo ni ajie ahã Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belɛ nakai masui lɛ fɛɛ hu yɔɔ; ni kɛ tso shishifã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belɛ nakai niji lɛ hu yɔɔ. 17 Shi kɛji akumɔ tso niji lɛ ekomɛi, ni abatɛo bo ni oji ŋaŋmutso lɛ yɛ amɛnajiaŋ, ni ona mutso lɛ shishifã lɛ kɛ emlinu lɛ eko lɛ, 18 kaashwã yɛ niji lɛ anɔ; shi kɛji oshwã yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, naa, jeee bo ohiɛ shishifã lɛ, shi shishifã lɛ moŋ hiɛ bo.”
19Agbɛnɛ ekolɛ oookɛɛ akɛ, “Kuumɔ akumɔ niji lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni atɛo mi awo tso lɛ mli.” 20Ojogbaŋŋ! He ni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ akumɔ amɛ; ni bo lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli okɛdamɔ shi lɛ. Kaawo ohe nɔ, shi moŋ she ohe gbeyei; 21ejaakɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebaaa tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niji lɛ ayi lɛ, bo hu ebaaŋ oyi. 22 No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ kɛ bɔ ni ekɛ mɔ yeɔ waa hu, ekɛ mɛi ni egbee shi lɛ yeɔ waa, shi bo lɛ, emli hi yɛ onɔ kɛji ohi emlihilɛ lɛ mli lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo hu aaafo bo ashɛ afɔ̃. 23 Ni amɛ hu, kɛji amɛhiɛɛɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ mli lɛ, aaatɛo amɛ awo mli; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ atɛo amɛ awo mli ekoŋŋ. 24Ejaakɛ, kɛji bo lɛ, fo afo bo yɛ tso ni yɛ bɔɔsu naa lɛ ŋaŋmutso ni lɛ he, ni atɛo bo awo mutso kpakpa lɛ mli, ni jeee adebɔɔ gbɛ ni lɛ, mɛnɛɛmɛi ni ji tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niji lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni atɛoŋ amɛ awoŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmutso lɛ mli!
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Israel baawo egbɛhe ekoŋŋ
25 Ejaakɛ misumɔɔɔ akɛ mishiuɔ nyɛ nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ nɔ, anyɛmimɛi, koni nyɛkabu nyɛhe oleetei, akɛ, wajemɔ awaje Israel tsui fã kɛ fã kɛyashi beyinɔ ni jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba mli. 26 Ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ahere Israel fɛɛ yiwala, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Jielɔ lɛ aaajɛ Zion aba
ni eeebajie nɔshafeemɔ yɛ Yakob he eshɛ efɔ̃;
27 ni enɛ ji mi kɛ amɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ,
akɛ majie amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛaatee.”
28Yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ henyɛlɔi ji amɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ; shi yɛ halamɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asumɔɔ amɛ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ ahewɔ. 29Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwaaa ehe yɛ edromɔ nii lɛ kɛ etsɛmɔ lɛ he. 30Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛbooo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, shi agbɛnɛ ana nyɛ mɔbɔ yɛ amɛtoigbele lɛ hewɔ lɛ, 31nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛ hu agbɛnɛ amɛtoi egbo, koni bɔ ni ana nyɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, amɛ hu ana amɛ mɔbɔ. 32 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋamɔ mɛi fɛɛ ayi ewo toigbele mli, bɔ ni afee ni ena amɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ
33 Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ nifalɛ kɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee mlikwɔlɛ! Ekojomɔi lɛ anyɛɛɛ shishi ana, ni egbɛi lɛ hu anyɛɛɛ sɛɛ mo aja!
34 Ejaakɛ “Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ,
Aloo namɔ ewo lɛ ŋaa pɛŋ?
35 Aloo namɔ etsɔ̃ hiɛ ehã lɛ nɔ ko,
ni kulɛ aaato lɛ najiaŋ?”
36Ejaakɛ edɛŋ nii fɛɛ jɛ, ni enɔ amɛtsɔ̃ kɛba, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyɔɔ amɛhã. Lɛ aaaŋɔ anunyam ahã kɛya naanɔ. Amen!

Title: ROMABII 12
Content:
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli
1 No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlitsɔlɛ miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛŋɔ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ afɔle ni hiɛ kã ni he tse ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; enɛ ji jamɔ ni sa. 2 Ni nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ jeŋbii, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee lɛ afea nyɛhe gbɔmɛi hei, koni nyɛyoo nii ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii kpakpai ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ.
3 Shi miitsɔ̃ dromɔ ni akɛduro mi lɛ nɔ miikɛɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akɛ, ekabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe tuutu fe bɔ ni sa; shi moŋ ejwɛŋ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ lɛ naa. 4 Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbɔmɔtso kome he lɛ wɔyɛ henii pii, shi henii lɛ fɛɛ tsuuu nitsumɔ kome lɛ, 5 nakai nɔŋŋ wɔyi pii nɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ yɛ Kristo mli, ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ enaanyohenɔ ji lɛ, 6 ni dromɔ ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔyɛ dromɔ keenii srɔtoi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ; kɛji mɔ ko nɔ ji akɛ egba lɛ, egba yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ naa; 7 kɛji sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni lɛ, ehiɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; kɛ tsɔɔlɔ ji mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ mli; 8 mɔ ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, ehiɛ wiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; mɔ ni kɛ enii feɔ ejurɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ; mɔ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, ebɔ mɔdɛŋ; mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsuijurɔ.
Jeŋba ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ
9 Suɔmɔ lɛ osato akahi mli. Nyɛhia efɔŋ kwraa; nyɛ kpɛtɛa ekpakpa he; 10 nyɛkɛ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ni mli wa asumɔsumɔa nyɛhe; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛ woo ahã enaanyo. 11 Nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ naa akabaa shi; nyɛmumɔ lɛ he adɔa la; nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ. 12 Nyɛnyãa yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli; nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ yɛ amanehulu mli; nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli daa. 13 Nyɛhãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiamɔ lɛ afea nyɛ hu nyɛhiamɔ; nyɛbɔa gbɔfeemɔ he mɔdɛŋ.
14 Nyɛjɔa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ, nyɛjɔa ni nyɛkalomɔa. 15 Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni nyãa lɛ anyãa, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni foɔ lɛ afoa. 16 Nyɛjwɛŋjwɛŋa nyɛhe jwɛŋmɔ kome; nyɛkajwɛŋa henɔwomɔ jwɛŋmɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibalɔi lɛ abɔa. Nyɛkabua nyɛhe nilelɔi.
17 Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ najiaŋ; nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo yɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ nyɛtoa. 18 Kɛ aaaho lɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahia shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli. 19 Suɔlɔi, nyɛkatɔa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe owele, shi moŋ nyɛŋmɛa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Minɔ ji oweletɔɔ, mi mato najiaŋ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.” 20 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji hɔ̃mɔ miiye ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, hã lɛ nii eye; kɛji kumai miiye lɛ lɛ, hã lɛ nu enu; ejaakɛ kɛ ofee nakai lɛ, obaabua ŋai kɛ la naa oshwie eyiteŋ. 21Kaahã efɔŋ miiye onɔ kunim, shi moŋ okɛ ekpakpafeemɔ aye efɔŋ nɔ kunim.

Title: ROMABII 13
Content:
Heshibaa hã maŋnɔyelɔi
1 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba ehe shi ahã hegbɛi ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ hegbɛ ko bɛ ni jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ; hegbɛi ni yɔɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ to. 2No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kuɔ hegbɛ lɛ naa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ eteɔ shi eshiɔ lɛ; ni mɛi ni teɔ shi nakai lɛ aaana amɛkojomɔ. 3 Ejaakɛ lumɛi lɛ, amɛhe bɛ gbeyei hã mɔ ni feɔ ekpakpa, shi hã mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ moŋ; shi kɛji otaooo akɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ he ahi gbeyei ahã bo lɛ, feemɔ ekpakpa, ni ooona yijiemɔ yɛ edɛŋ; 4 ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji lɛ yɛ ohewɔ, koni ahi ahã bo. Shi kɛji ofee efɔŋ lɛ, she gbeyei; ejaakɛ jeee yaka ehiɛ tsi lɛ; shi eji Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ oweletɔlɔ ni hãa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ nɔ. 5No hewɔ lɛ, sa akɛ abaa he shi, jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ henilee hewɔ hu. 6Enɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtsuɔ onia hu lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji ji amɛ, ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ he amɛyɔɔ. 7 Bɔ ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛnaa lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhãa lɛ. Mɔ nɔ ni ji onia lɛ, nyɛtsua onia; mɔ nɔ ni ji tóo lɛ, tóo; mɔ nɔ ni ji gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ; mɔ nɔ ni ji woo lɛ, woo.
Suɔmɔ ji Mla lɛ nɔyeli
8 Nyɛkahiɛa mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔmɔ, akɛ ja suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛaasumɔsumɔ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ enaanyo lɛ eye Mla lɛ nɔ kɛwula shi. 9 Ejaakɛ kɛji akɛɛ akɛ, “Kaafite gbãlã! Kaaju! Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ!” Ni kɛ kitã kroko hu yɛ lɛ, fɛɛ hɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ni ji “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe” lɛ mli. 10 Suɔmɔ efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko, hewɔ lɛ suɔmɔ pɛ ji Mla lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli.
Ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ ebɛŋkɛ
11 Ni nyɛle enɛ hu, no ji be lɛ, akɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛkɛaate shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli lɛ eshɛ; ejaakɛ wɔyiwalaheremɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ agbɛnɛ fe tsutsu be ni wɔhe wɔye lɛ. 12 Nyɔɔŋ lɛ eho etã, ni jetsɛremɔ ebɛŋkɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔjiea duŋ mli nitsumɔi lɛ wɔshwiea, ni wɔwo la tawuunii lɛ. 13 Nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa fɛɛfɛo bɔ ni sa shwane, jeee yɛ dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ mli; jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ mli, jeee bei kɛ awuŋayeli mli; 14 shi moŋ nyɛwoa Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo tamɔ dama, ni nyɛkahãa heloo lɛ nɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ heloo lɛ sɛɛdii.

Title: ROMABII 14
Content:
Kaakojo onyɛmi
1 Mɔ ni ji gbedelɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ nyɛherea lɛ atuu; shi nyɛkɛ lɛ akakojoa yɛ esusumɔi ahe. 2 Mɔ ko yɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni ekɛyeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ; shi mɔ ni egbede lɛ, shwie kɛkɛ eyeɔ. 3 Mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ akagbe mɔ ni yeee lɛ he guɔ, ni mɔ ni yeee lɛ akakojo mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehere lɛ atuu. 4 Namɔ ji bo ni okojoɔ mɔ kroko wenuu? Edamɔ shi jio, egbee shi jio, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enuŋtsɔ sane ni; shi eeedamɔ shi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ ni eeehã edamɔ shi.
5 Mɔ ko buɔ gbi ko fe gbi kroko, ni mɔ ko hu buɔ gbi fɛɛ gbi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ enɛ he. 6Mɔ ni buɔ gbi titri ko lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ efeɔ. Mɔ ni yeɔ nii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyeɔ, ejaakɛ edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi; ni mɔ ni yeee nii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyeee, ni lɛ hu edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi. 7Ejaakɛ wɔteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ kãaa hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, ni mɔ ko gbooo hu hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. 8 Shi kɛji wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ kã wɔhã; ni kɛji wɔgboi hu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔgboi wɔhã. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔhiɛ kã jio, wɔgboi jio, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nii ji wɔ. 9Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ Kristo gbo ni ete shi ni ehiɛ kã bɔ ni afee ni etsɔ̃ gbohii kɛ hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ aNuŋtsɔ. 10 Shi bo, mɛɛba okojoɔ onyɛmi? Aloo bo hu, mɛɛba ogbeɔ onyɛmi he guɔ? Ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ sɛi lɛ hiɛ. 11 Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ,
“Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Akɛni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ
nakutso fɛɛ nakutso aaakula shi ahã mi,
ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi aaajaje Nyɔŋmɔ atsɔ̃ɔ.’ ”
12 No hewɔ lɛ, wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɔntaa ehã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Kaato onyɛmi pampi
13No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa wɔkojokojoa wɔhe dɔŋŋ; shi enɛ moŋ nyɛkojoa, akɛ mɔ ko kɛ tɛmɔnɔ ko akama enyɛmi gbɛ nɔ aloo eto lɛ pampi. 14 Mile ni misaa miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni eji bulemɔnɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Mɔ ni buɔ nɔ ko akɛ bulemɔnɔ ni lɛ, lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bulemɔnɔ ehãa. 15 Shi kɛji nɔ ko ni oyeɔ lɛ gbaa onyɛmi naa lɛ, belɛ jeee suɔmɔ naa obaa ojeŋ yɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ. Okɛ oniyenii lɛ akakpãtã mɔ ni Kristo gbo hã lɛ lɛ hiɛ. 16 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa awiea nyɛnɔ kpakpa lɛ he efɔŋ. 17 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ jeee niyeli kɛ ninumɔ ni, shi moŋ jalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ ni; 18ni mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Kristo yɛ enɛɛmɛi amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ naa ehe tsuijurɔ ni esa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.
19 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔtiua hejɔlɛ nibii kɛ nibii ni wɔkɛhã wɔnanemɛi anane amɔ shi moŋ sɛɛ. 20Kaafite Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ niyenii ko hewɔ. Nibii fɛɛ he tse nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ eji efɔŋ hã gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ ekɛtoɔ pampi lɛ. 21 Ehi akɛ okaye loo ni asaŋ okanu wain loo nɔ ko ni aaato onyɛmi pampi. 22Bo lɛ oyɛ hemɔkɛyeli? Okɛto oha bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni ekojooo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yɛ nɔ ni ebuɔ akɛ ehi lɛ mli lɛ. 23 Shi mɔ ni yiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ lɛ, kɛji eye lɛ, eyeɔ fɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ ejɛɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli eyeee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ esha ni.

Title: ROMABII 15
Content:
Nyɛfea nɔ ni aaasa nyɛnanemɛi ahiɛ
1 Wɔ mɛi ni wɔyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔkɛ mɛi ni bɛ hewalɛ lɛ agbɔjɔmɔi lɛ kpeɔ amɛ, ni wɔhe akasa wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhiɛ. 2 Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asa enaanyo hiɛ, koni ahi ahã lɛ ni enane amɔ shi. 3 Ejaakɛ Kristo hu hãaa ehe asa ehiɛ; shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Mɛi ni bɔɔ bo ahora lɛ ahorabɔi lɛ ebakã minɔ.” 4 Ejaakɛ nibii abɔ ni aŋma ato momo lɛ, aŋma ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii, koni wɔkɛ hiɛmiamɔ kɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli miishɛjemɔ lɛ ana hiɛnɔkãmɔ. 5 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa wɔnyɛɔ wɔhiɛ wɔmĩaa ni eshɛjeɔ wɔmii lɛ ahã nyɛna jwɛŋmɔ kome yɛ nyɛteŋ tamɔ Kristo Yesu, 6koni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ naabu kome awo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, hiɛ nyam.
Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ hã Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ
7No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhereherea nyɛhe, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo ehere nyɛ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ mli lɛ. 8 Shi miikɛɛ akɛ Yesu Kristo tsɔ̃ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ehã Yudafoi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ hewɔ, koni ekɛmã shiwoi ni awo tsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ mi; 9 ni jeŋmaji lɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, majie oyi yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ,
ni matsi ogbɛi tã mala.”
10 Ni Ŋmalɛ lɛ saa kɛɛ,
“Nyɛ jeŋmaji, nyɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ mli afilia nyɛ!”
11 Ni asaŋ,
“Nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi, nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ,
ni nyɛkafoa lɛ, nyɛ maji fɛɛ!”
12 Ni asaŋ Yesaia kɛɛ akɛ,
“Ishai shishifã lɛ aaaba,
mɔ hu ni aaate shi koni ebaye jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lɛ;
lɛ enɔ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ̃.”
13Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ fɛɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, koni nyɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni ateke nɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ mli.
Nɔ hewɔ ni Paulo kɛ ekãa ŋma wolo nɛɛ
14Shi anyɛmimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miheɔ miyeɔ krɛdɛɛ yɛ nyɛhe akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ kɛ mlihilɛ; ni nilee fɛɛ eyimɔ nyɛ tɔ, ni nyɛnyɛɔ nyɛwieɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛhe hu. 15 Shi, mikɛ ekãa pii ŋmala saji nɛɛ ekomɛi mihã nyɛ, koni mikɛkai nyɛ, yɛ dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro mi lɛ hewɔ; 16 koni mitsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔ mihã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni mitsu Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ he nii akɛ osɔfo, ni jeŋmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ afɔle ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni atsuu he yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli. 17No hewɔ lɛ, miyɛ shwãanɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ nii ni mitsuɔ mihãa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ; 18 ejaakɛ mikaŋ akɛ mawie nɔ ko akɛ ja nɔ ni Kristo tsɔ̃ minɔ etsu ehã jeŋmaji lɛ atoiboo yɛ wiemɔ kɛ nifeemɔnii amli, 19 yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii ahewalɛ mli, yɛ Mumɔ hewalɛ mli; bɔ ni fee nɛ ni mijɛ Yerusalɛm mibɔle shi aahu kɛyashi Ilirikum ni mishiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ migbe naa. 20 Nɔ ni mikɛmã mihiɛ titri ji akɛ, he ni atsiko Kristo gbɛi tã yɛ lɛ, jɛi majaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mikayatswa mɔ kroko shishitoo nɔ; 21 shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Mɛi ni ajajeko ehe sane ko atsɔ̃ko amɛ lɛ,
amɛaana,
ni mɛi ni nuko lɛ, amɛaanu shishi.”
Paulo to eyiŋ akɛ eeeya Roma
22 Enɛ nɔŋŋ etsi mi gbɛ aahu ni mibako nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ. 23 Shi agbɛnɛ akɛni mibɛ nɔ ko tsumɔ yɛ biɛ niiaŋ dɔŋŋ, ni misaa mije afii pii miitao akɛ mibaa nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, 24 be fɛɛ be ni mafã gbɛ kɛaatee Tarshish lɛ, maba nyɛŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ miiho lɛ, mabakwɛ nyɛhiɛ, koni, kɛji mina miishɛɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tswɛm lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya jɛi. 25 Shi amrɔ nɛɛ mifã gbɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm ni miyasɔ̃mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ. 26 Ejaakɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia fɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ etsu onia ko kɛhã krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ateŋ ohiafoi lɛ. 27 Tsuijurɔ naa amɛfee yɛ lɛɛlɛŋ moŋ, shi asaŋ amɛhiɛ amɛ nyɔmɔ. Ejaakɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ena amɛmumɔŋ nikpakpai lɛ eko lɛ, belɛ esa akɛ amɛ hu amɛkɛ heloo nikpakpai lɛ eko asɔ̃mɔ amɛ. 28No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mina migbe enɛ naa ni misɔo nɛkɛ yibii nɛɛ anaa mihã amɛ lɛ, mabatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Tarshish. 29 Ni mile akɛ, kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli jɔɔmɔ falɛ mli maba yɛ.
30 Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hewɔ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ suɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, akɛ nyɛfata mihe kɛpele yɛ nyɛsɔlemɔi ni nyɛsɔleɔ nyɛhãa mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ amli, 31koni ajie mi yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ adɛŋ, ni misɔ̃ɔmɔ ni miyaa miyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ asa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ jogbaŋŋ; 32koni, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, mikɛ miishɛɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ, ni mabawo mitsui yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ. 33 Hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen!

Title: ROMABII 16
Content:
Ŋamɔi kɛ kɔkɔbɔi
1Miijie wɔnyɛmi yoo Foibe ni ji Kenkrea asafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ yi mahã nyɛ, 2koni nyɛhere lɛ hiɛmɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛfata ehe yɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni nyɛhe hiaa lɛ yɛ mli lɛ mli; ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu eji mɛi pii kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miyelikɛbualɔ.
3 Nyɛŋaa Priskila kɛ Akwila, ni ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛhãa mi; 4amɛkɛ amɛhe wo gbele mli yɛ miyiwala hewɔ, ni jeee mi kɛkɛ midaa amɛ shi, shi moŋ jeŋmaji lɛ amli asafoi lɛ fɛɛ hu daa amɛ shi.
5 Nyɛŋaa asafo ni yɔɔ amɛwe lɛ hu. Nyɛŋaa misuɔlɔ Epaineto ni ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni jɛ Asia ni kɛ ehe hã Kristo lɛ. 6Nyɛŋaa Maria ni gba ehe naa pii yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ. 7 Nyɛŋaa Androniko kɛ Yunia, miwekumɛi ni awo mi kɛ amɛ tsuŋ ni amɛyɔɔ gbɛi yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ. 8Nyɛŋaa Amplia mɔ ni misumɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ. 9Nyɛŋaa Urbano ni ji wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, kɛ misuɔlɔ Staki. 10Nyɛŋaa Apele mɔ ni he emɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli lɛ. Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Aristobulo shĩabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ. 11Nyɛŋaa miwekunyo Herodion lɛ. Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Narkiso shĩabii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛyɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
12Nyɛŋaa Trifaina kɛ Trifosa ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Nyɛŋaa Persi mɔ ni asumɔɔ ni etsu nii pii yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ. 13 Nyɛŋaa Rufo mɔ ni ahala lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ enyɛ ni ji nyɛ hã mi hu lɛ. 14Nyɛŋaa Asinkrito, Flegon, Herme, Patroba, Herma kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ. 15Nyɛŋaa Filologo kɛ Yulia, Nerea kɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ, kɛ Olimpa kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
16 Nyɛkɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ aŋaŋaa nyɛhe. Kristo asafoi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
17 Shi anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛhiɛ akã mɛi ni jeɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni nyɛkase lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛkɛ mligbalamɔi kɛ pampitoo baa lɛ ahe, ni nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛje amɛhe. 18 Ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, jeee wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmusu; ni amɛkɛ naaŋɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔi lakaa mɛi ni leee efɔŋ lɛ. 19 Shi nyɛtoiboo lɛ mɛi fɛɛ enu he; no hewɔ lɛ, mina nyɛhe miishɛɛ; shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe nilelɔi yɛ ekpakpa gbɛfãŋ; shi efɔŋ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɛi ni leee nɔ ko. 20 Shi etsɛŋ ni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaanaanaa Satan nɔ kwraa yɛ nyɛnajiashi. WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi.
21 Minaanyo nitsulɔ Timoteo kɛ miwekumɛi Lukio kɛ Yason kɛ Sosipatre miibi nyɛ.
22Mi Tertio ni miŋma nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ, miibi nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
23 Gaio ni ji mi kɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ shĩatsɛ lɛ miibi nyɛ. Erasto ni ji maŋ shikatolɔ lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Kwarto miibi nyɛ. [ 24WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.]
Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ
25 Shi mɔ ni aaanyɛ ahã nyɛfi shi shiŋŋ yɛ misanekpakpa lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ lɛ naa, yɛ teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ kpojiemɔ naa, 26 teemɔ sane ni agbɛnɛ ajie atsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ yɛ naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ famɔ naa, ni atsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ aŋmalɛi lɛ anɔ atsi tã atsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛbo hemɔkɛyeli lɛ toi lɛ naa lɛ, 27 lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji nilelɔ kometoo lɛ, aŋɔ anunyam ahã lɛ, yɛ Yesu Kristo mli kɛyashi naanɔ. Amen!

Title: 1 KORINTOBII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Bɔfo Paulo ŋma eklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ eyahã Korintobii lɛ bɔ ni afee ni ekɛku naagbai komɛi ni ete shi yɛ Kristofoi awala kɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ naa yɛ asafo hee ni eyato shishi yɛ Korinto lɛ mli. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Korinto lɛ eji Helabii amaŋ wulu ni maji srɔtoisrɔtoi anɔbii ebahi jɛi, ni esaa eji Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni atsɛɔ lɛ Akaia lɛ hu maŋ wulu. Ehe gbɛi akɛ he ko ni ayeɔ jra waa yɛ, ni emlibii lɛ shwãa fɔ̃ɔ amɛkusum nɔ; eji he ko hu ni jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ ehe shi waa yɛ, ni asaŋ jamɔi srɔtoi babaoo hu yɛ jɛmɛ.
Nɔ hewɔ titri ni bɔfo lɛ ŋma ewolo lɛ ji naagbai srɔtoi ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, tamɔ akɛ mligblamɔi kɛ jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ nɛkɛ. Asaŋ, nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ kɛ gblãshihilɛ, henilee, asafo lɛ gbɛjianɔtoo, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dromɔ keenii kɛ Kristo shitee kã etsui nɔ po ni ehiii. Bɔfo lɛ kɛ niiasɛɛyoomɔ kɛ nilee ni mli kwɔ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Sanekpakpa lɛ wieɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe ni egblaa eko fɛɛ eko mli fitsofitso. Yitso 13 lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ suɔmɔ fe dromɔ keenii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛdro emɛi lɛ, ni tamɔ nɔ ni no ji yitso ni ale fe fɛɛ yɛ majemɔ wolo nɛɛ mli.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-9
Mligblamɔi yɛ asafo lɛ mli 1.10—4.21
Nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ kɛ weku shihilɛ 5.1—7.40
Kristofoi kɛ wɔŋjalɔi 8.1—11.1
Kristo asafo lɛ wala kɛ jamɔ 11.2—14.40
Kristo kɛ mɛi ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ ashitee 15.1-58
Yelikɛbuamɔ onia kɛhã Yudea Kristofoi lɛ 16.1-4
Bɔfo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ he sane kɛ wolo lɛ naamuu 16.5-24

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ kɛ shidaa
1Paulo, Yesu Kristo bɔfo ni atsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Sostene, 2 ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ Korinto lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni atsuu amɛhe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ. Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he ni tsɛɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo ni ji wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ.
3 Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
4Miida miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa nɛɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni akɛhã nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hewɔ. 5Akɛ nibii fɛɛ mli lɛ ahã nyɛshwere yɛ emli, yɛ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee fɛɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ. 6Tamɔ bɔ ni ama Kristo he odase lɛ nɔ mi yɛ nyɛmli, 7 ni dromɔ nikeenii ko eshwɛɛɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkwɛɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ. 8 Lɛ nɔŋŋ eeewaje nyɛ kɛaatee naagbee ni nyɛhe akaba kpa ko yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbi lɛ nɔ. 9 Anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛba eBi Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, naanyobɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Mligbalamɔi yɛ asafo lɛ mli
10 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, akɛ nyɛnaabu afee ekome ni mligbalamɔi akaba nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛa jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ susumɔ kome. 11Ejaakɛ Kloe webii lɛ batswa mi adafi yɛ nyɛhe, minyɛmimɛi, akɛ bei yɛ nyɛteŋ. 12 Nɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ ji akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi;” “Mi lɛ, Apolo nɔ ji mi;” “Mi lɛ, Kefa nɔ ji mi;” “mi lɛ, Kristo nɔ ji mi.” 13Ani agbala Kristo mli? Ani Paulo asɛŋ ahã nyɛ lɛ? Aloo Paulo gbɛi mli abaptisi nyɛ awo lɛ? 14 Miida Nyɔŋmɔ shi akɛ mibaptisiii nyɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ ja Krispo kɛ Gaio, 15koni mɔ ko akakɛɛ akɛ mibaptisi lɛ yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi mli. 16 Lɛɛlɛŋ, mibaptisi Stefana we lɛ, shi mikaiii akɛ mibaptisi mɔ ko mifata he dɔŋŋ. 17 Ejaakɛ Kristo tsuuu mi baptisimɔ, shi moŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ, ni jeee yɛ nilee wiemɔi amli tete, koni Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ akafee yaka.
Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kɛ enilee
18 Ejaakɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he sane lɛ ji kwashiai asane hã mɛi ni hiɛ kpãtãa lɛ; shi wɔ mɛi ni ahereɔ wɔyiwala lɛ, eji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ hã wɔ. 19 Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ,
“Mafite nilelɔi anilee,
Ni ŋaalɔi aŋaa lɛ hu mahã afee yaka.”
20 Nɛgbɛ nilelɔ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ je nɛɛŋ naataalɔ yɔɔ? Ani Nyɔŋmɔ hãko je lɛ mli nilee lɛ atsɔ̃ kwashiai asane? 21 Shi akɛni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee naa lɛ je lɛ nyɛɛɛ etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enilee nɔ kɛle Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ ekɛ kwashiai asane lɛ ni ashiɛɔ lɛ ahere mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ayiwala. 22 Ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ, naakpɛɛ okadii ashi amɛbiɔ, ni Helabii hu taoɔ nilee; 23 shi wɔ lɛ, Kristo ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ wɔshiɛɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ pampi ehã Yudafoi, kɛ kwashiai asane ehã jɛŋmaji lɛ. 24 Shi mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ lɛ, Yudafoi jio, Helabii jio, Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee hã amɛ. 25Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwashiai asane lɛ, nilee yɛ mli fe gbɔmɛi anilee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔjɔmɔ lɛ he wa fe gbɔmɛi ahewalɛ.
26 Shi anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkwɛa nyɛtsɛmɔ lɛ, jeee heloo gbɛfaŋ nilelɔi pii, jeee hewalɔi pii, jeee abladei pii atsɛ; 27shi moŋ je nɛɛ mli kwashiaianii lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛwo nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble; ni je nɛɛ mli gbɔjɔmɔnii lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛwo nii ni he wa lɛ ahiɛgble; 28ni je nɛɛ mli nii ni abuuu kɛ nii ni agbe he guɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hala, kɛ nibii ni bɛ lɛ tete, koni ehã nibii ni yɔɔ lɛ afee yaka; 29 bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko akashwã yɛ ehiɛ. 30 Shi lɛ ejɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ Kristo Yesu, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ nilee ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ hetsuumɔ kɛ kpɔ̃mɔ ehã wɔ lɛ mli; 31 koni, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, eshwã efɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ.”

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 2
Content:
Paulo eshiɛɛɛ nilee shi Kristo ni asɛŋ lɛ
1 Ni mi hu, anyɛmimɛi, be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, jeee wiemɔ flɛmii loo nilee tuutu mikɛba, ni mibajaje Nyɔŋmɔ sane lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; 2 ejaakɛ mitooo miyiŋ akɛ male nɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ, akɛ ja Yesu Kristo, mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ. 3 Ni mikɛ nyɛ hi shi yɛ gbɔjɔmɔ kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ pii mli; 4 ni miwiemɔ kɛ mishiɛmɔ lɛ hu jeee gbɔmɛi anilee wiemɔi ni hãa mɔ yiŋ tsɔ̃ɔ mikɛshiɛ, shi moŋ wiemɔi ni jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hewalɛ kpo, 5 bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ akadamɔ gbɔmɛi anilee nɔ, shi moŋ edãmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ nilee
6Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔwieɔ nilee wiemɔ yɛ mɛi ni edara yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ ateŋ, shi jeee je nɛɛ mli nilee loo je nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi ni jeee fɛifɛi lɛ anilee. 7 Shi moŋ wɔwieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni akɛtee yɛ teemɔ sane mli lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ saa eto hã wɔnunyam dani aje jeŋ shishi, 8 nilee ni je nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛle kulɛ amɛsɛŋ anunyam Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, 9 shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ,
“Nii ni hiŋmɛi enako ni toi hu nuko
ni ebako gbɔmɔ ko tsuiŋ dã
ji nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.”
10 Shi wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ eMumɔ lɛ nɔ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ; ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ taoɔ nibii fɛɛ mli, Nyɔŋmɔ nibii ni mli kwɔlɔ tete. 11Shi gbɔmɛi ateŋ namɔ le nii ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ mli, akɛ ja gbɔmɔ lɛ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ? Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ hu mɔ ko mɔ ko leee, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ. 12Shi wɔ lɛ, jeee je nɛɛ mli mumɔ lɛ wɔna, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, koni wɔle nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro wɔ lɛ.
13 Nomɛi hu wɔwieɔ, jeee wiemɔi ni gbɔmɛi anilee tsɔ̃ɔ wɔwieɔ, shi moŋ wiemɔi ni Mumɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ, ni wɔkɛ mumɔŋnii toɔ mumɔŋnii ahe. 14 Shi gbɔmɔ su ni akɛfɔ lɛ lɛ heee Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ nii lɛ; ejaakɛ ebuɔ lɛ kwashiai asane, ni enyɛɛɛ naa ena, ejaakɛ mumɔ akɛtaoɔ naa. 15 Shi mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ kojoɔ nii fiaa, shi lɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko ekojooo lɛ. 16 Ejaakɛ “Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii?” Shi wɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ Kristo jwɛŋmɔ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 3
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi nitsulɔi ji wɔ
1 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, minyɛɛɛ mikɛ nyɛ awie tamɔ mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi, shi moŋ tamɔ helooŋ gbɔmɛi, tamɔ abifabii yɛ Kristo mli. 2 Fufɔ mihã nyɛ, shi jeee ŋmaa ni tsii, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye; ni asaŋ amrɔ nɛɛ tete nyɛnyɛɛɛ lolo, 3 ejaakɛ helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ lolo. Shi gbii abɔ ni awuŋayeli kɛ bei yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lolo lɛ, ani jeee helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ ni gbɔmɛi ajeŋba nyɛbaa lɛ? 4 Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ Paulo nɔ ji mi,” ni mɔ ko hu kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi,” lɛ, ani jeee helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ?
5 Agbɛnɛ, Namɔ ji Apolo? Namɔ ji Paulo? Amɛ ji sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni nyɛtsɔ̃ amɛnɔ nyɛhe nyɛye, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛhã lɛ. 6 Mi lɛ, mitɛo; Apolo shwie nɔ nu; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hã eda. 7Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ ni tɛo lɛ ji nɔ ko, ni jeee mɔ ni shwie nɔ nu lɛ hu, shi moŋ mɔ ni hã eda, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 8 Shi mɔ ni tɛoɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ nɔ nu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekomeŋ; shi amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɔmɔwoo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edeŋmegbomɔ naa. 9 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi nitsulɔi ji wɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu ji nyɛ.
10 Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni ekɛduro mi lɛ naa lɛ, mito shishi tamɔ tsutswalɔ ko ni hiɛ yɔɔ ŋaa, shi mɔ kroko tswaa nɔ. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akwɛ ni ahi bɔ ni etswaa nɔ ehãa lɛ. 11 Ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ shishi kroko ato fe nɔ ni ato momo ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ. 12Shi kɛ mɔ ko kɛ shika loo jwiɛtɛi loo tɛi ni jara wa loo tsei loo jwɛi loo gbetselii tswa shishitoo nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, 13 mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ baaje kpo faŋŋ; ejaakɛ Gbi lɛ aaajie lɛ kpo, ejaakɛ la mli eeeje kpo yɛ, ni bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ yɔɔ lɛ, la lɛ baajie lɛ kpo. 14Kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ ni ji nɔ ni etswa ema nɔ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, eeena nyɔmɔwoo; 15shi kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ aaashã lɛ, enine baanyɛ shi; shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, shi kɛ̃lɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni tsɔ̃ la mli.
16 Ani nyɛleee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli? 17Kɛ mɔ ko fite Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ, fitemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaafite lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni no ji nyɛ.
Kɔkɔbɔɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli nilee he
18 Mɔ ko akalaka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. Kɛji mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ nilelɔ ji lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, efee ehe kwashia, koni etsɔ̃ nilelɔ. 19 Ejaakɛ je nɛɛ mli nilee lɛ ji kwashiai asane yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Emɔɔ nilelɔi lɛ yɛ amɛŋaa fɔŋ lɛ mli.” 20 Ni asaŋ aŋma akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le nilelɔi ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ akɛ yakanii ni.” 21No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ gbɔmɛi anɔ. Shi nii fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnɔ ni: 22Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Kefa jio, je lɛ jio, wala jio, gbele jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio; fɛɛ lɛ nyɛnɔ ni, 23 Shi nyɛ lɛ Kristo nii ji nyɛ; shi Kristo lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔŋ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 4
Content:
Kristo bɔfoi lɛ
1 Bɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɛi abu wɔ nɛ, akɛ Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ saji lɛ anɔ tsuji nukpai. 2 Shi nɔ ni eshwɛ ni ataoɔ yɛ tsuji nukpai adɛŋ ji akɛ ana amɛ akɛ anɔkwafoi. 3Shi mi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko titri ko hã mi akɛ nyɛkojoɔ mi aloo akɛ akɛ gbɔmɛi akojomɔ aaakojo mi; mi diɛŋtsɛ tete mikojooo mihe. 4 Ejaakɛ mileee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee no hewɔ aaabu mi bem; shi mɔ ni kojoɔ mi ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ. 5 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkakojoa nɔ ko dani shɛ be lɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba, mɔ ni kɛ dujiaŋ nibii ni akɛtee lɛ tete aaaba la hiɛ, ni eeejie tsuiiaŋ ajinai lɛ ashi lɛ. Ni no mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana eyijiemɔ kɛaajɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
6 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛhewɔ mikɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ toɔ mi kɛ Apolo he lɛ, koni nyɛkwɛ wɔ ni nyɛkase nɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ “mɔ ko akajwɛŋ fe nɔ ni aŋma lɛ” koni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ henɔwomɔ akabu mɔ ko fe mɔ kroko. 7 Shi namɔ buɔ bo akɛ esoro bo? Ni asaŋ, mɛni oyɔɔ ni jeee hã ahã bo? Shi kɛji hã ahã bo lɛ, mɛɛba oshwãa tamɔ nɔ ni jeee hã ahã bo lɛ?
8 Nyɛtɔrɔ momo! Nyɛna nii momo! Nyɛshi wɔsɛɛ ni nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ! Ni mina ni kulɛ nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, koni wɔ hu wɔkɛ nyɛ aye!
Bɔ ni wɔsane tamɔ yɛ mɛi ahiɛ
9 Ejaakɛ efeɔ mi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ wɔ ni ji bɔfoi lɛ moŋ efee sɛɛkpelɔi, tamɔ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã gbele; ejaakɛ akɛ wɔ efee kwɛmɔnii ahã je lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ gbɔmɛi. 10 Wɔ lɛ, kwashiai ji wɔ yɛ Kristo hewɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ, nilelɔi ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli; wɔ lɛ, gbɔjɔlɔi ji wɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ hewalɔi ji nyɛ; nyɛ nyɛhiɛ yɔɔ nyam, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔhiɛ bɛ nyam. 11 Kɛbashi be nɛ fɛɛ lɛ, hɔmɔ kɛ kumai yeɔ wɔ, ni wɔnyiɛɔ yayai, ni agbalagbalaa wɔ mãi, ni wɔbɛ hilɛhe krɛdɛɛ ko. 12 Ni wɔgboɔ deŋme wɔkɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔniji tsuɔ nii; be ni ajɛɔ wɔ lɛ, wɔmiijɔɔ; be ni awaa wɔ yi lɛ, wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ; 13be ni afiteɔ wɔgbɛi lɛ, wɔɔwie naajɔlɛ wiemɔ; afee wɔ tamɔ je lɛ tumonɔnii, mɛi fɛɛ ajwɛi kɛbashi be nɛ.
Paulo wie tsɔ̃ɔ Korintobii lɛ akɛ tsɛ
14Miŋmaaa enɛɛmɛi ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele, shi moŋ miiwie miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ tamɔ mibii ni misumɔɔ. 15 Ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛyɛ kwɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma tete yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, jeee tsɛmɛi pii nyɛyɔɔ; ejaakɛ mi mitsɔ̃ Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ mifɔ nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli. 16 No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkase mi. 17 No hewɔ hu ni mitsu Timoteo, ni ji misuɔmɔ bi kɛ anɔkwafo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ni ebakai nyɛ bɔ ni mibaa mijeŋ mihãa yɛ Kristo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo fɛɛ asafo mli yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.
18Shi akɛni mɛi komɛi susuɔ akɛ mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo amɛhe nɔ. 19 Shi kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miisumɔ lɛ, etsɛŋ ni maba ni mabana mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ ahewalɛ, shi jeee amɛwiemɔ. 20 Ejaakɛ jeee wiemɔ mli Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɔɔ, shi moŋ hewalɛ mli. 21Te nyɛtaoɔ lɛ tɛŋŋ? Mihiɛ kpãa kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, aloo miba yɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ mli?

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 5
Content:
Ajwamãŋbɔɔ yɛ asafo lɛ mli
1 Aakɛɛ kwraa po akɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ajwamãŋbɔɔ ni bɛ jemajiaŋbii ateŋ tete akɛ mɔ ko kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ. 2Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛwoɔ, ni nyɛyeee ŋkɔmɔ moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni ajie mɔ ni tsu nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ? 3 Mi ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli, shi mumɔ mli miyɔɔ yɛ lɛ, mikojo mɔ ni tsu nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ momo, tamɔ nɔ ni miyɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɔŋŋ. 4 Kɛji nyɛnaa kpe shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli ni miyɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ mumɔ mli, ní Nuŋtsɔ Yesu hewalɛ fata he lɛ, 5 wɔkɛ gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ awo Satan dɛŋ, koni epiŋ egbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ahere mumɔ lɛ yiwala yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Gbi lɛ nɔ.
6 Nyɛshwãa lɛ bɛ fɛo. Nyɛleee akɛ masha bibioo shaa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ? 7 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea masha momo lɛ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ ma hee, tamɔ bɔ ni akpiti ji nyɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ agbe wɔHehoo Toobi ni ji Kristo lɛ. 8 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔyea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ, jeee kɛ masha momo, ni asaŋ jeee kɛ efɔŋ loo nɔshafeemɔ masha, shi moŋ kɛ anɔkwale akpiti ŋmiiŋmi.
9 Miŋma nyɛ yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ nyɛkɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi akabɔ; 10jeee jeŋbii ateŋ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo amimyelɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi ahe kwraa miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nakai ni kulɛ ja nyɛje je lɛ mli. 11 Shi agbɛnɛ miŋma nyɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ ji ajwamãŋbɔlɔ loo hiɛjoolɔ loo wɔŋjalɔ loo mɔjɛlɔ loo dãatɔlɔ loo amimyelɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, nyɛkɛ lɛ akayea nii tete.
12 Shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, mɛɛ amɛkojomɔ hu mina? Ani jeee mɛi ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ nyɛkojoɔ, 13 shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni kojoɔ amɛ? Nyɛjiea mɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 6
Content:
Heyelɔi kɛ amɛsaji akahã mɛi ni heee yeee
1Te kɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ enaanyo na sane ko lɛ, eshiɔ etsitsi ekɛ lɛ yayeɔ sane lɛ yɛ jeŋbii akojomɔhe, shi ekɛ lɛ eyaaa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aŋɔɔ? 2 Ani nyɛleee akɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ baakojo je lɛ? 3Ani nyɛleee akɛ wɔbaakojo ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete, ni mbasroo walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji? 4No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛyɛ walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji komɛi ayeli lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛhãa mɛi ni asafo lɛ ebuuu amɛ lɛ kojoɔ mɔ? 5Miikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele. Aso nilelɔ kome flo bɛ nyɛteŋ, mɔ ni aaanyɛ enyɛmimɛi ateŋ ekojo? 6Shi moŋ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi yayeɔ sane yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ aŋɔɔ po?
7 Enɛ lɛ aye nyɛnɔ kunim momo, akɛni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe yeyeɔ saji lɛ. Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi afee nyɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ moŋ? Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi aye nyɛ amim moŋ? 8Shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛfeɔ nyɛmimɛi tete nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ, ni nyɛyeɔ amɛ amim.
9Ani nyɛleee akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ? Nyɛkahãa alakaa nyɛ! Ajwamãŋbɔlɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi loo gbãlãŋkulɔi loo hii ni tsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛhe yei hãa hii krokomɛi loo hii ni kɛ hii feɔ yakayakanii, 10 loo julɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo dãatɔlɔi loo mɛi ajɛlɔi loo ojotswalɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ. 11Ni nɛkɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɔɔ sa; shi agbɛnɛ aju nyɛhe, ni asaŋ atsuu nyɛhe, ni abu nyɛ bem hu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ awoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam
12 Miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee nibii fɛɛ hi; miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi mihãŋ nɔ ko aye minɔ. 13 Ŋmaa yɛ hã musu, ni musu hu yɛ hã ŋmaa; shi Nyɔŋmɔ baahã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ afo. Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ, jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ eyɔɔ, shi moŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyɔɔ; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hu yɛ hã gbɔmɔtso lɛ. 14 Nyɔŋmɔ tee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni ebaatee wɔ hu shi yɛ ehewalɛ naa.
15 Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ Kristo henii ni? Belɛ miŋɔ Kristo henii lɛ mifee ajwamãŋ henii lo? Dabida! 16 Aloo nyɛleee akɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehe yabɔɔ ajwamãŋ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ gbɔmɔtso kome? Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome.” 17 Shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe bɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ mumɔ kome. 18Nyɛjoa ajwamãŋbɔɔ naa foi! Esha fɛɛ esha ni gbɔmɔ feɔ lɛ, jeee egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli eyɔɔ; shi mɔ ni bɔɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ, efeɔ esha eshiɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ. 19 Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛna kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni, ni nyɛjeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ lo? 20 Ejaakɛ ahe nyɛ kɛ jara ni wa. No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ awoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 7
Content:
Nɔ ni Paulo susuɔ yɛ gbãlãshihilɛ he
1Agbɛnɛ, yɛ nii ni nyɛŋma nyɛbahã mi lɛ ahe lɛ, ehi hã nuu akɛ ekata yoo he; 2shi ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ lɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewu. 3Wu lɛ atsu eŋa lɛ gbɛnaanii ehã lɛ, ni ŋa lɛ hu afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã ewu. 4Ŋa lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi moŋ ewu lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ wu lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi eŋa lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ. 5Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akakãmaa nyɛhe, akɛ ja nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛkpãa gbee akɛ nyɛaafee nakai kɛyashi be ko koni nyɛna dekã nyɛsɔle; ni nyɛfee ekome ekoŋŋ, koni Satan akatsɔ̃ nyɛnaa yɛ nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye hewɔ.
6Enɛ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, jeee kitã miwoɔ nyɛ, shi miiwie kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ gbɛŋmɛɛ yɛ he. 7 Ka mihewɔŋ kulɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ nɛɛ. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ keenɔ kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ, mɔ ko nɔ nɛkɛ, ni mɔ ko hu nɔ ekroko.
8 Shi oshijafoi kɛ okulafoi lɛ, miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ehi hã amɛ kɛji amɛhi shi tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu miyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ. 9Shi kɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe nɔ amɛye lɛ, amɛbote gbãlãshihilɛ mli; ejaakɛ gbãlãshihilɛ hi fe nɔ ni akɔnɔ aaahao bo.
10 Shi mɛi ni ebote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, mi, ni jeee mi tete, shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ moŋ woɔ amɛ kitã akɛ; ŋa akatse ewu gbãlã; 11ni kɛji etse gbãlã lɛ tete lɛ, ehi shi akɛ mɔ ni bɛ wu, aloo ekɛ ewu lɛ ayakpãtã; ni wu hu akaŋmɛɛ eŋa he.
12Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, jeee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi mi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛmi ko yɛ ŋa ni jeee heyelɔ, ni yoo lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ ehe. 13Ni kɛ yoo ko hu yɛ wu ni jeee heyelɔ, ni nuu lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekatse lɛ gbãlã. 14 Ejaakɛ atsuɔ nuu ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ he yɛ eŋa lɛ mli, ni atsuɔ yoo ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ hu he yɛ ewu lɛ mli; ejaakɛ jeee nakai jikulɛ, nyɛbii lɛ hu ahe yɛ muji; shi amrɔ nɛɛ amɛhe tse. 15 Shi kɛ mɔ ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ miigbala ehe shi lɛ, egbala ehe shi; anyɛɛɛ nyɛmi nuu loo nyɛmi yoo nɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ yɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ hejɔlɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ wɔ kɛba. 16 Shi, bo yoo, bo obaahere owu lɛ yiwala jio, ole? Aloo bo nuu, bo hu obaahere oŋa lɛ yiwala jio, ole?
Bɔ ni atsɛ mɔ ko lɛ nakai ehi shi
17 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eja nikeenii ehã lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehi shi nakai. Ni nakai mito hu yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli. 18Kɛ afo mɔ ko ketia ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, ekatsɔ̃ ehe foolɔ; foo mli atsɛ mɔ ko yɛ hu, ekafo ketia. 19 Ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni foo hu jeee nɔ ko, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔyeli moŋ ji nɔ ko. 20 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nɔ shihilɛ mli ni eyɔɔ ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ ehi. 21Ani nyɔŋ ji bo be ni atsɛ bo lɛ? Kaahã miidɔ bo; shi kɛ ooonyɛ ohe okpɔ̃ lɛ, bɔɔ he mɔdɛŋ. 22 Shi mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni eji nyɔŋ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ odehe ni; nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ ni eji odehe lɛ, Kristo nyɔŋ ni. 23 Jara ni wa akɛhe nyɛ; nyɛkatsɔmɔa gbɔmɛi anyɔji. 24 Anyɛmimɛi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nɔ mli ni eyɔɔ ni atsɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ ehi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ.
Oblayei kɛ oblahii kɛ okulafoi
25 Shi oblayei foroi lɛ, mibɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã ko yɛ amɛhe, shi nɔ ni misusuɔ mikɛɔ nɛɛ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ koni eye anɔkwa. 26 No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni misusuɔ akɛ ehi ji, hejaramɔ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehi hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ. 27Mla efi bo ekpɛtɛ yoo he? Kaatao fɛnemɔ. Afɛne bo yɛ yoo he? Kaatao ŋa. 28Shi kɛji oŋɔ yoo hu, ofeko esha; ni kɛji oblayoo foro hu bote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efeko esha; shi gbɔmɔtso gbɛfaŋ amanehulu mɛnɛɛmɛi baana; shi mi lɛ, nyɛhe mifoɔ.
29 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, be lɛ faaa dɔŋŋ; nɔ ni eshwɛ ji akɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋamɛi tete afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ eko; ni mɛi ni foɔ lɛ hu afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni fooo; 30ni mɛi ni nyaa afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni nyaaa; ni mɛi ni heɔ nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni jeee nɔtsɛmɛi; 31 ni mɛi ni tsuɔ je nɛɛ he nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni tsuuu he nii; ejaakɛ je lɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa lɛ nɛɛ hoɔ eyaa.
32Shi misumɔɔɔ akɛ nyɛfee yeyeeye. Mɔ ni bɛ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ; 33 shi mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esa eŋa lɛ hiɛ, 34ni efeɔ jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛ. Yoo ni bɛ wu loo oblayoo foro lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ, koni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kɛ mumɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esane asa ewu hiɛ. 35Shi enɛ lɛ, nyɛ ekpakpa hewɔ mikɛɔ, jeee nyɛkuɛ kpãa miwoɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni afee fɛo, koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko wooo nyɛ najiaŋ.
36Shi kɛji nuu ko susuɔ akɛ ebaaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ eblayoo foro gbɛfaŋ, ni enyɛɛɛ ehe nɔ eye dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ enyɛɛɛ he nɔ ko efee lɛ, efee bɔ ni esumɔɔ, efeee esha; amɛkpee amɛhe. 37Shi mɔ ni ekpɛ mli yɛ etsui mli, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efiii lɛ, shi enyɛɔ efeɔ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ ni ekpɛ mli nɛkɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui mli akɛ eeeya nɔ ehiɛ lɛ akɛ eblayoo foro lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ. 38No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ eblayoo foro lɛ boteɔ gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ moŋ, shi mɔ ni boteee gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ fe no.
39 Yoo lɛ, gbii abɔ ni ewu hiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛ mla efi lɛ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ akɛ egbã mɔ ni esumɔɔ; shi belɛ afee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli. 40 Shi kɛji ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, eyɛ hejɔlɛ aahu. Mijwɛŋmɔ nɛ, ni efeɔ mi akɛ mi hu miyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 8
Content:
Niyenii ni akɛhã wɔji
1 Agbɛnɛ yɛ wɔji afɔle gbɛfaŋ lɛ, wɔle akɛ “wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ nilee.” Nilee hãa mɔ woɔ ehe nɔ, shi suɔmɔ hãa mɔ nane mɔɔ shi. 2 Kɛ mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ ele nɔ ko lɛ, eleko bɔ ni sa akɛ ele lolo. 3 Shi kɛ mɔ ko miisumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ le lɛ.
4 Agbɛnɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ wɔji afɔle nii ayeli he lɛ, wɔle akɛ wɔŋ ko wɔŋ ko jeee fɛifɛi yɛ je nɛɛ mli, ni asaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ, akɛ ja Mɔ kome kɛkɛ. 5Ejaakɛ kɛji nibii komɛi yɛ ni atsɛɔ amɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ; ŋwɛi amɛyɔɔ jio, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyɔɔ jio, tamɔ bɔ ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi ahe ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi ahe lɛ, 6 wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kome pɛ wɔyɔɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ mli ni nibii fɛɛ jɛ ni wɔyɔɔ wɔhã lɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome hu ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ, mɔ nɔ ni nibii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba ni wɔ hu wɔtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ.
