7 Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ le nii nɛɛ; shi mɛi komɛi yɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔŋjamɔ efee amɛhenɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛmiiye wɔji afɔle nii lɛ, amɛyeɔ lɛ akɛ wɔji afɔlenii, ni enɛ buleɔ amɛ ejaakɛ egbede amɛhenilee. 8 Shi jeee ŋmaa hãa wɔsaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; kɛ wɔyeee lɛ ehãaa wɔtɛ nɔ atse, ni asaŋ kɛ wɔye hu ehãaa wɔhi fe nine.
9 Shi nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni nyɛhegbɛ nɛɛ akabatsɔ̃ pampi miihã gbedelɔi lɛ. 10Ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko na bo ni “ole nii” lɛ akɛ ota wɔŋtsu mli ooye nii lɛ, ani enɛ woŋ mɔ ni egbede lɛ henilee hewalɛ koni eyaye wɔji afɔlenii lɛ? 11 Ni no lɛ “onilee” lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmi gbedelɔ ni Kristo bagbo yɛ lɛ hu ehewɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã. 12Shi kɛji nyɛfee nyɛmimɛi lɛ esha nɛkɛ ni nyɛkɛpila amɛhenilee ni waaa lɛ, no lɛ Kristo nyɛfeɔ esha nyɛshiɔ lɛ. 13 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ŋmaa aaahã minyɛmi nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ, miyeŋ loo gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ, koni mikahã minyɛmi lɛ nane miitɔ̃tɔ̃.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 9
Content:
Paulo fa ebɔfo ni eji lɛ he
1 Ani mihiɛɛɛ mihe? Ani jeee bɔfo ji mi? Ani minako Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ? Jeee minine naa nitsumɔ ji nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lo? 2 Kɛji mijeee bɔfo mihãaa mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, nyɛ lɛ mi ji bɔfo mihã nyɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ ji mibɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ naasɔomɔnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
3Enɛ ji nɔ ni mikɛfãa mihe yɛ mɛi ni kojoɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ. 4 Ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔyeɔ nii ni wɔnuɔ? 5 Ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔhiɛɔ nyɛmi yoo Kristofonyo ni ji wɔŋa lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ, tamɔ bɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ hu kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ Kefa? 6Aloo mi kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔhiɔ shi ni wɔtsuuu nii? 7Namɔ yaa ta ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewoɔ ehe nyɔmɔ? Namɔ feɔ waintrom ni eyeee emli yibii lɛ eko? Aloo namɔ lɛɔ kooloi ni enuuu amɛfufɔ lɛ eko?
8Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, ani gbɔmɛi kɛkɛ wieɔ nakai? Ani Mla lɛ hu ekɛɛɛ nakai nɔŋŋ? 9 Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Mose Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Kaawo tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele lɛ naabu kotoku.” Ani tsinai ahe ni dɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, 10aloo wɔhewɔ kwraa moŋ ewieɔ nɛɛ? Wɔhewɔ nɔŋŋ aŋma, ejaakɛ esa akɛ mɔ ni huɔ lɛ, ekɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ahu, ni mɔ ni kpalaa abele hu hiɛ akã nɔ akɛ ebaaye eko. 11 Kɛ wɔdu mumɔŋnii wɔhã nyɛ lɛ, ani eji nɔ ko wulu akɛ wɔɔkpa nyɛheloŋnii lo? 12Kɛ maji krokomɛi yɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ fe amɛ? Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔfeee nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ he nɔ ko, shi moŋ wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli, koni wɔkatsi Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛ.
13 Ani nyɛleee akɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, Sɔlemɔ wenii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ amɛyeɔ? Ni mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ amɛnaa? 14 Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to akɛ mɛi ni jajeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ aye Sanekpakpa lɛ mli nii.
15 Shi mi lɛ, mifeko nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ekome flo he nɔ ko. Ni miŋmaaa enɛ koni afee nakai ahã mi; ejaakɛ kɛ ka nɔ ni mɔ ko aaahã mishwãa lɛ afee yaka lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ. 16 Ejaakɛ kɛji miijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ po jiŋŋ, ejeee shwãanɔ hã mi; ejaakɛ akɛfi minɔ akɛ mijaje; kɛ mijajeee Sanekpakpa lɛ, kpoo hã mi! 17 Ejaakɛ kɛ mitsu yɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, miyɛ nyɔmɔwoo; shi kɛjeee suɔmɔ naa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ atu tsulɔnukpayeli awo midɛŋ. 18 Agbɛnɛ mɛni ji minyɔmɔwoo mɔ? No ji akɛ, kɛ miijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ, majaje lɛ yaka ni miheee nɔ ko, bɔ ni afee ni mikafee nɔ ko tuutu yɛ mihegbɛ ni miyɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ he.
Bɔ ni Paulo fee etao mɛi ehã Kristo
19 Mihiɛ mihe ni mijeee mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔŋ, kɛ̃lɛ mifee mihe mɛi fɛɛ anyɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi babaoo anɔ. 20 Yudafoi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ Yudanyo mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ Yudafoi anɔ; mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ Mla shishi mihã amɛ, tsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mibɛ Mla shishi, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ anɔ. 21 Mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni bɛ Mla mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ anɔ, tsɛ mijeee mɔ ko ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla, shi moŋ miyɛ Kristo mla shishi. 22 Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ gbedelɔ mihã gbedelɔi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ gbedelɔi lɛ anɔ; mitsɔ̃ mihe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mihã mɛi fɛɛ, koni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mikɛhere mɛi komɛi ayiwala. 23Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ mifeɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mi hu mana emli jɔɔmɔi lɛ eko.
Kristofoi akaŋshii
24 Ani nyɛleee akɛ foidamɔ mli lɛ, foidalɔi lɛ fɛɛ daa moŋ, shi mɔ kome kɛkɛ naa emli juromɔ nɔ lɛ? Nyɛdaa foi lɛ nakai, koni nyɛnine ashɛ nɔ. 25 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shiɔ akaŋ lɛ, eyeɔ ehe nɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli. Agbɛnɛ amɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ nakai, koni amɛna akekre ni fiteɔ, shi wɔ lɛ, koni wɔna nɔ ni fiteee. 26No hewɔ lɛ, foi ni midaa nɛɛ, midaaa lɛ kɛkɛ ni oti emaaa mihiɛ; nɔmɔ ni minɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee kɔɔyɔɔ mikɛnɔɔ; 27 shi moŋ mitswiaa migbɔmɔtso lɛ nii, ni miyeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ, koni mi ni mishiɛɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ akashɛ mi afɔ̃.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 10
Content:
Wɔji ahe kɔkɔbɔɔ
1 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛhiɛ aje nɔ akɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ hi atatu lɛ shishi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ, 2ni abaptisi amɛ fɛɛ awo Mose mli yɛ atatu lɛ kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli. 3 Ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mumɔŋ niyenii kome lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛye, 4 ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ nu kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ tɛsaa ni kɛ amɛ nyiɛ lɛ mli nu, ni tɛsaa lɛ ji Kristo. 5 Shi kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naaa amɛteŋ mɛi pii ahe tsui, ejaakɛ aplene amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
6 Shi akɛ enɛɛmɛi eto wɔ okadi, koni wɔkahã nibii fɔ̃ji miifee wɔ akɔnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni efee amɛ lɛ. 7 Asaŋ nyɛkatsɔmɔa amãgãjalɔi tamɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi fee lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Maŋ lɛ ho tara shi ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, ni amɛte shi ni amɛshwɛ.” 8 Ni wɔsaa wɔkabɔ ajwamãŋ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi bɔ ajwamãŋ ni gbi kome nɔ lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔ lɛ. 9 Ni asaŋ wɔkaka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ka lɛ ni onufui bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ. 10 Ni nyɛsaa nyɛkawiea huhuuhu tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hu wie huhuuhu ni hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ. 11Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba amɛnɔ ni akɛto okadi ahã wɔ, ni aŋma ni akɛbɔ wɔ kɔkɔ, wɔ mɛi ni je lɛ naagbee bei lɛ enina wɔ lɛ.
12No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni susuɔ akɛ edamɔ shi lɛ akwɛ ehe ni ahi koni ekagbee shi. 13Kaa ko bako nyɛnɔ ni jeee gbɔmɔ he nɔ; shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ehãŋ aka nyɛ fe bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ; moŋ, yɛ kaa lɛ mli lɛ, ebaaje gbɛ ni nyɛkɛaaje mli koni nyɛnyɛ mli nyɛmɔ.
14 No hewɔ lɛ, misuɔmɔ mɛi, nyɛjoa wɔŋjamɔ naa foi! 15Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ akɛ nilelɔi wieɔ; nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli. 16 Jɔɔmɔ kpulu lɛ ni wɔjɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo lá lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni? Aboloo ni wɔkumɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni? 17 Ejaakɛ aboloo kome ni, ni wɔyi pii moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyeɔ aboloo kome lɛ eko.
18 Nyɛkwɛa Israel! Ani mɛi ni yeɔ afɔleshãanii lɛ, jeee naanyo amɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ bɔɔ lɛ? 19 Belɛ mɛni mikɛɛ mɔ? Akɛ amãgã afɔle ji nɔ ko, aloo akɛ amãgã ji nɔ ko? 20 Dabi, shi moŋ miikɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni wɔŋjalɔi lɛ shãa lɛ, mumɔi fɔ̃ji amɛshãa amɛhãa, shi jeee Nyɔŋmɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji bɔɔ naanyo. 21 Nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji akpulu fɛɛ nyɛnu shi kome; nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ nii kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji anɔ lɛ nɔ nii fɛɛ nyɛye shi kome. 22Aloo wɔmiifee ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aye awuŋã? Ani wɔhe wa fe lɛ?
Wɔŋ loo he ŋaawoo
23 Wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeee nibii fɛɛ hi; wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeee nibii fɛɛ hãa mɔ nane mɔɔ shi. 24 Mɔ ko mɔ ko akapele miihã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ apele ahã enaanyo.
25 Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ loo jara nɔ lɛ nyɛyea; shi henilee hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkabia mli; 26 ejaakɛ “shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ emlinii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ ni.” 27Shi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kpee nyɛ okplɔ̃ he ni nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛaama nyɛhiɛ lɛ, nyɛyea ni nyɛkabia mli, yɛ henilee hewɔ. 28 Shi kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ akɛshã afɔle ahã amãgã” lɛ, nyɛkayea yɛ mɔ ni tswa adafi lɛ kɛ henilee hewɔ. 29Shi henilee ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ, jeee bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ kroko lɛ nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛɛ hewɔ sa akɛ mɔ kroko henilee akojo mihe ni mihiɛ lɛ? 30 Kɛ shidaa mikɛye lɛ, mɛɛba awieɔ mihe efɔŋ yɛ nii ni mida shi yɛ he lɛ hewɔ?
31 No hewɔ lɛ, nii nyɛyeɔ jio, nii nyɛnuɔ jio, aloo nɔ kroko nyɛfeɔ jio, nyɛfea fɛɛ nyɛkɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam. 32 Nyɛkatsɔmɔa pampii nyɛhãa Yudafoi kɛ Helabii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ fɛɛ; 33 tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mi hu misumɔɔ akɛ nibii fɛɛ mli lɛ masa mɛi fɛɛ hiɛ, ni mitaooo nɔ ni hi hã mi diɛŋtsɛ, shi moŋ nɔ ni hi hã mɛi pii koni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 11
Content:
Yiteŋhaa he ŋaawoo
1 Nyɛkasea mi, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mikaseɔ Kristo lɛ. 2Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miijie nyɛyi akɛ nyɛkaiɔ mi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, ni nyɛhiɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mli bɔ pɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ. 3 Shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu yitso ji Kristo, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo hu yitso ji nuu, ni Kristo yitso ji Nyɔŋmɔ. 4 Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ekɛ nɔ ko eha eyiteŋ lɛ, eegbe eyitso lɛ he guɔ. 5Shi yoo fɛɛ yoo ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ehiɛ eyitso folo lɛ, lɛ hu eegbe eyitso lɛ he guɔ; ejaakɛ etamɔ nɔ ni eshɛ eyi nɔŋŋ pɛ. 6Kɛ yoo lɛ ehaaa eyi nɔ lɛ, eku eyi mɔ; shi akɛni eji hiɛgbele sane hã yoo akɛ eeeku eyi loo eeeshɛ eyi lɛ, eha eyi nɔ. 7 Shi nuu lɛ, esaaa akɛ ehaa eyiteŋ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ kɛ anunyam ji lɛ. 8 Ejaakɛ nuu jɛɛɛ yoo mli, shi yoo moŋ jɛ nuu mli. 9 Ni asaŋ abɔɔɔ nuu yɛ yoo hewɔ; shi yoo moŋ abɔ yɛ nuu hewɔ. 10No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ ana hewalɛ he okadi ko yɛ yoo lɛ yiteŋ. 11Kɛ̃lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, nuu nyɛŋ ashi yoo sɛɛ, ni yoo hu nyɛŋ ashi nuu sɛɛ. 12Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni yoo jɛ nuu mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nuu hu tsɔ̃ yoo nɔ kɛba; shi nii fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
13Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli yɛ nyɛteŋ. Ani eyɛ fɛo akɛ yoo aaasɔle yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ehaaa eyi nɔ lo? 14Ani adebɔɔ diɛŋtsɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nuu ŋmɛ eyi kusuu lɛ, eyɛ hiɛgbele hã lɛ, 15shi yoo lɛ, kɛji eŋmɛ eyi kusuu lɛ, eji anunyam hã lɛ? Ejaakɛ akɛ yitsɔi lɛ hã lɛ akɛ hehaanɔ. 16Shi kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee ehe naataalɔ yɛ enɛ he lɛ, wɔ lɛ jeee wɔkusum ji no, ni Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ
17 Shi agbɛnɛ nibii ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛfee nɛɛ, jeee nyɛyi mikɛjieɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛkpe lɛ, jeee ekpakpa jɛɔ mli, shi moŋ efɔŋ. 18 Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, minu akɛ, kɛ nyɛyabua nyɛhe naa yɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, mligbalamɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni miheɔ miyeɔ fã kɛ fã. 19 Ejaakɛ sa akɛ mligbalamɔi aba nyɛteŋ koni mɛi kpakpai lɛ ajie amɛhe shi faŋŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
20Agbɛnɛ, kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ he kome lɛ, jeee Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ yeli nyɛba lɛ, 21ejaakɛ nyɛniyeli nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛ yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniyenii, ni be ni hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, belɛ mɔ ko etɔ dãa. 22 Aso nyɛbɛ shĩai ni nyɛaaye nii ni nyɛaanu yɛ jɛi? Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ nyɛbuuu, ni nyɛwoɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ ahiɛgble? Te makɛɛ nyɛ tɛŋŋ? Ani mijie nyɛyi? Enɛ lɛ, mijieee nyɛyi yɛ he.
23 Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mina kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ, akɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu lɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni atsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, ekɔ aboloo, 24ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea nyɛyea, enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso ni akɛhã yɛ nyɛhewɔ; nyɛfea enɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.” 25 Nakai nɔŋŋ ewo kpulu lɛ hu yɛ niyenii lɛ asɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ yɛ milá lɛ mli; nyɛfea enɛ, shii abɔ ni nyɛaanu lɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.” 26 Ejaakɛ shii abɔ ni nyɛyeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni nyɛnuɔ nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛmiijaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbele lɛ nyɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeba.
27 No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni enuɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ bɔ ni esaaa lɛ, eetɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ elá lɛ nɔ. 28 Shi gbɔmɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ekwɛ dani eye aboloo nɛɛ eko ni enu kpulu nɛɛ eko. 29Ejaakɛ mɔ ni yeɔ ni enuɔ bɔ ni esaaa lɛ, kojomɔ moŋ eyeɔ ni enuɔ ehãa ehe lɛ, ejaakɛ ebuuu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ. 30 No hewɔ hu ni nyɛteŋ mɛi pii egbɔjɔ ni amɛhe yeɔ, ni mɛi babaoo hu egboi nɛɛ. 31Shi kɛji wɔka wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔkwɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ekojoŋ wɔ. 32 Shi kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miikojo wɔ lɛ, ekɛmiitsɔse wɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akabu wɔ kɛ je lɛ fɛɛ fɔ.
33No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛbaaye nii lɛ, nyɛmɛmɛa nyɛhe. 34Shi kɛ hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eye nii yɛ shĩa dã, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkpee lɛ akatsɛ kojomɔ miihã nyɛ. Shi nii ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ miba lɛ, mato amɛ gbɛjianɔ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 12
Content:
Mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii
1Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ mahã nyɛle mumɔŋnii ahe nɔ ko. 2 Nyɛle akɛ be ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ, amãgãi mumuii lɛ aŋɔɔ akpala nyɛ kɛtee, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni akpala nyɛ ahã lɛ. 3 No hewɔ lɛ, miihã nyɛle akɛ mɔ ko ewieee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ naa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yesu ji musumɔ”; ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ” hu, akɛ ja yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naa.
4 Dromɔ keenii srɔtoi yɛ, shi Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ hãa; 5 ni sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛ, shi Nuŋtsɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ; 6ni nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ amli. 7 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ahãa Mumɔ lɛ jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ emli koni ahi ahã mɛi fɛɛ. 8Mɔ ko lɛ, atsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ ahã lɛ nilee wiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu ahã lɛ niiashishinamɔ wiemɔ yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa. 9Mɔ ko lɛ, ahã lɛ hemɔkɛyeli yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa; ni mɔ kroko hu ahã lɛ tsamɔ dromɔ keenii yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli. 10 Mɔ ko lɛ hewalɛnii atsumɔ; mɔ ko lɛ gbalɛ; mɔ ko hu mumɔi ashikpamɔ ni akɛnaa mumɔi amligbalamɔi; mɔ ko lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu wiemɔi ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ. 11 Shi nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ tsuɔ, ni ejaa ehãa bɔ ni esumɔɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ.
Wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Gbɔmɔtso Kome henii ji wɔ
12 Shi tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ ekome ni, shi ehiɛ henii pii, ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii pii lɛ fɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ni lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu ji Kristo. 13 Ejaakɛ Yudafoi ji wɔ jio, Helabii ji wɔ jio, nyɔji ji wɔ jio, wɔhiɛ wɔhe jio, wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome nɔ atsɔ abaptisi wɔ awo gbɔmɔtso kome mli; ni wɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Mumɔ kome akɛhã wɔ ni wɔnu.
14 Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ hu jeee he nɔ kome ni, shi moŋ henii pii ni. 15Kɛji nane aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni jeee nine ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ he nii lɛ eko ji mi” lɛ, ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ? 16Ni kɛji toi hu aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni jeee hiŋmɛi ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji mi” lɛ, ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ? 17Kɛ gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ ninumɔ yɔɔ? Kɛ ninumɔ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ nifuu yɔɔ? 18Shi agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henii lɛ eko fɛɛ eko ema gbɔmɔtso lɛ he, bɔ ni esumɔɔ. 19Shi kɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ henɔ kome ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɔɔ? 20 Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ henii pii ni moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ni.
21Hiŋmɛi nyɛŋ ekɛɛ nine akɛ, “Ohe ehĩaaa mi;” ni asaŋ yitso nyɛŋ ekɛɛ naji akɛ, “Nyɛhe ehĩaaa mi.” 22Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛhe waaa kwraa lɛ, amɛ moŋ amɛhe hiaa wɔ titri; 23ni nii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛ ji gbɔmɔtso henii ni hiɛ bɛ nyam kwraa lɛ, nomɛi titri ahiɛ nyam wɔwoɔ, ni wɔhenii ni bɛ fɛo lɛ moŋ naa hefɛo titri ko; 24shi wɔhenii ni yɔɔ fɛo momo lɛ, enɛ he ehĩaaa amɛ. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsara gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ, ni nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, no titri ekɛ woo hãa 25koni mligbalamɔ akaba gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli, shi moŋ henii lɛ abaabaa amɛhe yi pɛpɛɛpɛ. 26Ni kɛji henɔ kome miina nɔ lɛ, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ naa nɔ, ni kɛji henɔ kome hiɛ ba nyam hu, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ.
27 Shi nyɛ lɛ, Kristo gbɔmɔtso ji nyɛ; ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ehenii lɛ eko ji lɛ. 28 Ni klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wo mɛi komɛi bɔfoi yɛ asafo lɛ mli, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, gbalɔi, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, tsɔɔlɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, hewalɛ nitsulɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ he dromɔ keenii, yelikɛbualɔi, hiɛnyiɛlɔi, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi. 29Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji bɔfoi? Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji gbalɔi? 30Ani mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ dromɔ keenii? Ani mɛi fɛɛ wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi? Ani mɛi fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wiemɔi ashishi? 31 Shi nyɛhiɛ adɔa dromɔ keenii ni fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe.
Ni masaa matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ ni hi fe fɛɛ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 13
Content:
Suɔmɔ fe dromɔ keenii fɛɛ
1Kɛji mikɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi alilɛi wieɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mitsɔ̃ ayawa ni jijeɔ loo ŋmɛlɛ ni gbɛɔ. 2 Ni kɛji miyɛ gbalɛ dromɔ keenii, ni minaa teemɔŋnii fɛɛ naa, ni mile nii fɛɛ, ni kɛji miyɛ hemɔkɛyeli fɛɛ hu, bɔ ni manyɛ gɔji mafãmɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mijeee nɔ ko. 3 Ni kɛji mikɛ minii fɛɛ kuma mɛi, ni kɛji mikɛ migbɔmɔtso hã ni ashã mi, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ minaaa sɛɛ ko.
4Suɔmɔ toɔ etsui shi; emli hi; suɔmɔ hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ mɔ nɔ; suɔmɔ eshwãaa; efeee pupuupu; 5 efeee nii ni esaaa; epeleee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, emli wooo la; eniŋŋ efɔŋ he; 6 enyãaa nɔ sha he; shi anɔkwale moŋ he enyãa; 7 emiɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli; eheɔ nii fɛɛ eyeɔ; ehiɛ kãa nii fɛɛ nɔ; emĩaa ehiɛ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
8Suɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo gbi ko gbi ko. Shi kɛji gbalɛi ni lɛ, amɛsɛɛ baafo; kɛji wiemɔi ni lɛ, abaafɔ̃ɔ; kɛji nilee ni lɛ, esɛɛ baafo. 9Ejaakɛ wɔnii ni wɔle lɛ, fã kɛ fã ni, ni wɔgbalɛ hu fã kɛ fã ni. 10Shi kɛ nɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ba lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ji fã kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.
11Be ni mi ji abifao lɛ, miwieɔ tamɔ abifao, mijwɛŋɔ tamɔ abifao, misusuɔ tamɔ abifao; shi be ni mitsɔ̃ nuu nukpa lɛ, mishɛrɛ abifabiianii lɛ mishwie. 12 Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ ashwishwɛ mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa nii tuutuu, shi no mli lɛ eeefee hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; amrɔ nɛɛ mile nii fã kɛ fã, shi no mli lɛ, male nii kɛyi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ale mi kɛyi shi lɛ.
13 Shi agbɛnɛ hemɔkɛyeli, hiɛnɔkãmɔ, suɔmɔ, nɛkɛ nibii etɛ̃ nɛɛ, hiɔ shi; shi suɔmɔ ji amɛteŋ nɔ ni fe fɛɛ.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 14
Content:
Wiemɔi srɔtoi kɛ gbalɛ
1 Nyɛdia suɔmɔ sɛɛ. Ni nyɛhiɛ adɔa yɛ mumɔŋnii lɛ ahe, shi titri lɛ, gbalɛ. 2Ejaakɛ mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, jeee gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ; ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nuuu, akɛni mumɔ mli ewieɔ teemɔ saji yɛ lɛ. 3Shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ ni ekɛhã amɛnane amɔ shi, ni ekɛwo amɛ hewalɛ, ni ekɛshɛje amɛmii. 4Mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enane ehãa mɔɔ shi; shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, asafo lɛ nane ehãa mɔɔ shi.
5 Miisumɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛwie wiemɔi srɔtoi; shi nɔ ni misumɔɔ titri ji akɛ nyɛgba; ejaakɛ mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, efe mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi, belɛ ja mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shishi bɔ ni afee ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ̃ shi. 6 Shi agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji miba nyɛŋɔɔ mibawie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni jeee kpojiemɔ loo nilee loo gbalɛ loo nitsɔɔmɔ ko ni lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛ mibahã nyɛna?
7Tamɔ bɔ ni nii ni bɛ wala lɛ agbɛɛmɔ yɔɔ lɛ, blɛ jio, saŋku jio, kɛji egbɛɛɛ kɛ gbei srɔtoisrɔtoi lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akpãa loo nɔ ni atswaa lɛ? 8Ejaakɛ kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ egbɛɛɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ, namɔ aaasaa ehe ato ta? 9Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ nyɛ hu, yɛ wiemɔ srɔto wiemɔ mli lɛ, kɛji nyɛwieee nɔ ni shishi yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ no lɛ nyɛbaafee tamɔ mɛi ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ kɔɔyɔɔ. 10Wiemɔi srɔtoi pii yɛ je lɛ mli moŋ, shi ekome flo bɛ ni bɛ shishi. 11Shi kɛji minaaa wiemɔ lɛ shishi lɛ, belɛ mibatsɔ̃ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hu baatsɔ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ. 12 Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, akɛni nyɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ mumɔŋ nii ahe lɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtekea nɔ ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ shi.
13 No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, esɔle koni enyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shishi hu. 14Ejaakɛ kɛji misɔle kɛ wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, mimumɔ miisɔle nɛ, shi mijwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ewooo yibii. 15 Belɛ mɛni sa akɛ mafee? Mikɛ mumɔ aaasɔle, shi mikɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu aaasɔle; mala lala kɛ mumɔ, shi mala kɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu. 16Ejaakɛ kɛ okɛ mumɔ miijɔɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ni leee mli eko lɛ aahere oshidaa lɛ nɔ akɛ “Amen”, akɛni eleee nɔ ni okɛɔ lɛ? 17Bo lɛ, ooda shi jogbaŋŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ kroko lɛ nane mɔɔɔ shi. 18Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi akɛ mife nyɛ fɛɛ yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ mli; 19shi kɛ̃lɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ awie wiemɔi komekomei enumɔ, koni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi anii moŋ, fe nɔ ni mawie wiemɔi komekomei akpei nyɔŋma yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi amli.
20 Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkafea nyɛhe gbekɛbii yɛ jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ. Efɔŋ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe abifabii; shi jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni edara.
21 Aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ,
“Wiemɔi krokomɛi kɛ naabui krokomɛi anɔ matsɔ̃
mikɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ aaawie,
Shi no hu tete amɛboŋ mi toi, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.”
22No hewɔ lɛ, wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ ejeee okadi hã heyelɔi, shi moŋ eji okadi hã mɛi ni heee yeee; ni gbalɛ lɛ, ejeee mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ heyelɔi anɔ. 23No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ he kome, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miiwie wiemɔi srɔtoi, ni mɛi ni leee mli eko aloo mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ba jɛi lɛ, ani amɛkɛŋ akɛ nyɛmiiye sɛkɛ? 24Shi kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miigba, ni mɔ ko ni heee yeee aloo eleee mli eko lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, mɛi lɛ fɛɛ agbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ, ni aaakã lɛ, ni nomɛi nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ, 25 aaajie etsuiŋ teemɔnii akpo faŋŋ, ni no aaahã ekɛ ehiɛ abu shi eja Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeejaje akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛɛlɛŋ.”
Mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii ahe gbɛjianɔtoo
26 Belɛ te tɛŋŋ, anyɛmimɛi? Kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yɛ lala ko, mɔ ko hu yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ kpojiemɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ srɔto ko, mɔ ko yɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ ko lɛ, afee fɛɛ bɔ ni mɛi anane aaamɔ shi. 27Kɛji aawie wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, daa nɛɛ mɛi enyɔ loo, kɛ efa aahu lɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ pɛ awie, mɔ kome mɔ kome, ni mɔ kome hu atsɔ̃ɔ shishi; 28shi kɛji shishitsɔ̃ɔlɔ ko bɛ lɛ, mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ afee dioo yɛ asafo lɛ mli, shi ewie ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ. 29 Shi gbalɔi lɛ, mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ awie, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ahala mli. 30Shi kɛji ajie nɔ ko kpo atsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko ni ta shi lɛ, mɔ ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ momo lɛ afee dioo. 31Ejaakɛ kɛ afee lɛ mɔ kome mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛgba, koni mɛi fɛɛ akase nii, ni awo mɛi fɛɛ hewalɛ. 32Gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa gbalɔi lɛ; 33ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejeee sakasakafeemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ hetselɔi asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, 34 yei lɛ afee dioo yɛ asafoi lɛ amli, ejaakɛ aŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛwie, shi moŋ amɛba amɛhe shi, tamɔ bɔ ni Mla lɛ kɛɔ lɛ. 35Shi kɛ amɛmiisumɔ akɛ amɛkase nɔ ko lɛ, amɛbi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi yɛ shĩa. Ejaakɛ eyɛ hiɛgbele hã yei akɛ amɛaawie yɛ asafo mli.
36Aloo nyɛŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ? Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛŋɔɔ eba? 37 Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ gbalɔ loo mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ ji lɛ lɛ, sa akɛ ele akɛ nɔ ni miŋma nyɛ nɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã ni. 38Shi kɛ mɔ ko enaaa enɛ lɛ, ashi lɛ.
39No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛhiɛ adɔa yɛ gbalɛ he, ni wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ lɛ hu nyɛkatsĩa naa. 40 Afee nii fɛɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛ gbɛnaagbɛnaa.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 15
Content:
Kristo shitee lɛ
1Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miihã nyɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛmɔ mli, ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ mli hu lɛ, 2no akɛhereɔ nyɛyiwala hu, kɛ nyɛmɔ mli bɔ ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ nyɛhe nyɛye yakatswaa. 3 Ejaakɛ saji ni he hiaa fe fɛɛ ni akɛhã mi ni mi hu mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ ji akɛ Kristo gbo yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa; 4 ni afu lɛ, ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa; 5 ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Kefa, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ. 6No sɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi fe ohai enumɔ shi kome, mɛi ni amɛteŋ mɛi pii yɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, shi mɛi komɛi hu ewɔ lɛ. 7 No sɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yakobo, no sɛɛ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ.
8 Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi hu ni mitamɔ mɔ ko ni akpatu afɔ lɛ lɛ. 9 Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mi ji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ, ni misaaa tete akɛ atsɛɔ mi bɔfo, ejaakɛ miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi. 10 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa mi ji mɔ ni mi ji nɛɛ, ni edromɔ ni eduro mi lɛ efeee yaka; shi moŋ mitsu nii waa fe amɛ fɛɛ; shi jeee mi mitsu, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ. 11No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miŋ o, amɛŋ o, nakai wɔshiɛɔ ni nakai hu nyɛhe nyɛye.
Gbohiiashitee
12Shi kɛ aashiɛ yɛ Kristo he akɛ atee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, mɛni hewɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ? 13Kɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ, belɛ Kristo hu ateee lɛ shi. 14Shi kɛ ateee Kristo shi lɛ, belɛ wɔshiɛmɔ lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ hu efee yaka; 15 ni asaŋ akpa wɔ shi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he amale odaseyelɔi ji wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔye Nyɔŋmɔ he odase akɛ etee Kristo shi, mɔ ni kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ, belɛ eteee lɛ shi lɛ. 16 Ejaakɛ kɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ, belɛ Kristo hu ateee lɛ shi. 17 Ni asaŋ kɛ ateee Kristo shi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛkãmɔ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lolo; 18no lɛ mɛi ni ewɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ hu elaaje. 19Kɛ wala nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ wɔhiɛ kã Kristo nɔ yɛ lɛ, wɔnii yɛ mɔbɔ fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
20 Shi agbɛnɛ atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ateŋ. 21 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni gbele tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ shitee hu tsɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba. 22Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam mli ni mɛi fɛɛ gboiɔ yɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo mli lɛ aaahã mɛi fɛɛ yi ana wala yɛ. 23 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛhe. Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ ji Kristo, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi ni ji Kristonii lɛ, yɛ ebaa lɛ mli; 24 no sɛɛ dani naagbee lɛ baaba, be ni ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaahã Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, ni eeefo nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ. 25Shi ja eye maŋtsɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaawo enajiaŋshi. 26 Naagbee henyɛlɔ ni abaakpãtã ehiɛ ji gbele. 27 Ejaakɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kwa ewo enajiaŋshi”. Shi kɛ ekɛɛ akɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ ewo eshishi” lɛ, belɛ ekãshi faŋŋ akɛ mɔ ni kɛ nibii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ bɛ mli. 28Shi be ni akɛ nii fɛɛ ewo eshishi lɛ, no lɛ Bi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ ehe aaawo mɔ ni kɛ nii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ shishi, koni Nyɔŋmɔ afee nibii fɛɛ ayitso.
29Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ, te amɛbaafee tɛŋŋ? Kɛ gbohii eteŋ shi kwraa lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ: 30 Mɛɛba wɔ hu osharã sharãa wɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa fɛɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ? 31 Mina nyɛheshwãa ni miyɔɔ yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu mli, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ migboɔ daa gbi. 32 Kɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ, mikɛ “kooloi awuyelɔi” wu yɛ Efeso lɛ, no lɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ minaa? Kɛ gbohii eteee shi lɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnua nii, ejaakɛ wɔ́ lɛ wɔbaagboi!”
33Nyɛkahãa ashishiua nyɛ. “Naanyobɔɔ fɔŋ fiteɔ jeŋba kpakpa.” 34 Nyɛhãa nyɛhiɛ akãa shi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛkafea esha; ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi leee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he. Miikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele.
Shitee gbɔmɔtso lɛ
35Shi mɔ ko aaabi akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ atee gbohii ashi? Ni asaŋ mɛɛ gbɔmɔtso amɛkɛaaba?” 36 Kwashia! Nɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oduɔ lɛ, ja egbo fɛɛ da ni eyi naa wala. 37Ni asaŋ nɔ ni oduɔ lɛ, jeee tso ni baaba lɛ oduɔ lɛ, shi moŋ dumɔwu kuli ko kɛkɛ, kɛ ŋmaa ni jio, dumɔwu kroko ni jio; 38 shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãa lɛ tso bɔ ni esumɔɔ, ni wu fɛɛ wu lɛ, ehãa lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etso. 39Jeee heloo fɛɛ ji heloo kome: esoro gbɔmɛi aheloo, ni esoro kooloi aheloo; esoro loofɔji aheloo, ni esoro nuŋloi anɔ.
40Ni ŋwɛi gbɔmɔtsei yɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɔ gbɔmɔtsei hu yɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ esoro ŋwɛi nii anunyam, ni esoro shikpɔŋ nɔ nii hu anɔ. 41Esoro hulu anunyam, ni esoro nyɔɔŋtsere hu anunyam, ni esoro ŋulamii anunyam, ejaakɛ esoro ŋulami kome anunyam yɛ ekroko nɔ he.
42Nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbohiiashitee lɛ hu. Aduɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ fitemɔ mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ nɔ ni fiteee mli. 43 Aduɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ni bɛ nyam mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ anunyam mli. Aduɔ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ hewalɛ mli. 44Aduɔ susuma gbɔmɔtso, ateɔ mumɔ gbɔmɔtso shi. Kɛ susuma gbɔmɔtso yɛ lɛ, mumɔ gbɔmɔtso hu yɛ. 45 Nakai aŋma hu akɛ, “Adam ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ susuma ni hiɛ kã;” naagbee Adam lɛ tsɔ̃ mumɔ ni hãa mɔ yi naa wala. 46Shi jeee mumɔ nɔ lɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ, shi moŋ susuma nɔ lɛ, no sɛɛ lɛ mumɔ nɔ lɛ. 47Klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ mli lɛ, su ni; gbɔmɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi. 48Bɔ ni mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ; ni bɔ ni ŋwɛinyo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai ŋwɛibii lɛ hu yɔɔ. 49 Ni tamɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ subaŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔbaahiɛ ŋwɛinyo lɛ hu subaŋ.
50 Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, heloo kɛ lá nine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ fitemɔ hu nine shɛŋ nɔ ni fiteee lɛ nɔ. 51 Naa, teemɔ sane mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ: Jeee wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaawɔ lɛ, shi abaatsake wɔ fɛɛ, 52 trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli, be ni aaakpã naagbee tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ abaakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni aaatee gbohii ashi ni amɛfiteŋ dɔŋŋ, ni wɔ lɛ, abaatsake wɔ. 53 Ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ. 54 Shi be ni nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔ ni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ, no lɛ wiemɔ ni aŋma lɛ aaaba mli akɛ,
“Ami gbele yɛ kunim mli.”
55 “Ao gbele, nɛgbɛ okunim lɛ yɔɔ?
Ao gbele, nɛgbɛ ogãi lɛ yɔɔ?”
56 Shi gbele gãi lɛ ji esha; ni esha hewalɛ ji Mla lɛ. 57Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ ehãa wɔyeɔ kunim lɛ.
58 No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ, nyɛfĩa shi ni nyɛkagbugbãa ni nyɛtekea nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ mli daa nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ efeŋ yaka yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.

Title: 1 KORINTOBII 16
Content:
Yelikɛbuamɔ onia hã hetselɔi lɛ
1 Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ onia ni atsuɔ ayahã hetselɔi lɛ he lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mito mihã Galatia asafoi lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai. 2 Daa otsi mli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ nɔ ko ato yɛ bɔ ni enaa lɛ naa, koni mikaba dani atsu onia. 3Ni kɛji miba lɛ, matsu mɛi ni nyɛbuɔ akɛ amɛsa kɛ woji ni amɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii lɛ aya Yerusalɛm. 4Kɛji esa akɛ mi hu matee lɛ, mikɛ amɛ aaatee.
Paulo gbɛfai ahe gbɛjianɔtoo
5 Shi miyatsɔ̃ Makedonia dani maba nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ Makedonia miyatsɔ̃. 6 Shi ekolɛ mahi nyɛŋɔɔ fioo, ni ekolɛ maye fɛ̃ibe lɛ hu yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni he fɛɛ he ni maya lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ. 7 Ejaakɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ minaa nyɛ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ minyiɛ gbɛfãa nɔ kɛkɛ, shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ, matsɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
8 Shi mibahi Efeso kɛyashi Pentekoste gbi lɛ. 9 Agbele shinaa kpeteŋkple ahã mi kɛhã nitsumɔ ni baawo yibii, shi mɛi ni kuɔ naa lɛ ayi fa.
10 Shi kɛji Timoteo ba lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ekɛ gbeyeishemɔ akahi shi yɛ nyɛteŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ etsuɔ tamɔ mi nɔŋŋ. 11 Hewɔ lɛ mɔ ko akabu lɛ akɛ ejeee mɔ ko shi nyɛjiea lɛ gbɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli koni eba miŋɔɔ; shi miikwɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ.
12 Shi wɔnyɛmi Apolo lɛ, mikpa lɛ fai aahu ni ekɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ; shi ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kwraa akɛ eeeba amrɔ nɛɛ, shi kɛ ena hegbɛ jiŋŋ, eeeba.
Naagbee wiemɔi kɛ ŋamɔi
13 Nyɛbua, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, nyɛfea hii, ni nyɛhe awaa! 14Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
15 Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛle Stefana shĩa bii lɛ, akɛ amɛ ji Akaia klɛŋklɛŋ yibii, ni amɛkɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ, 16 koni nyɛ hu nyɛba nyɛhe shi nyɛhã mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nii lɛ eko ni egboɔ deŋme yɛ mli lɛ.
17Shi mina miishɛɛ akɛ Stefana kɛ Fortunato kɛ Akaiko eba, ejaakɛ ni nyɛbɛ miŋɔɔ nɛɛ, amɛ amɛbaye nyɛnajiaŋ. 18 Ejaakɛ amɛbahã mimumɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛmumɔ ena ekãa. No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ nyɛlea amɛ jogbaŋŋ.
19 Asia asafoi lɛ miibi nyɛ. Akwila kɛ Priskila kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ amɛwe lɛ miibi nyɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli. 20 Nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ. Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
21 Mi, Paulo diɛŋtsɛ, minine naa bimɔ nɛ.
22 Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sane lɛ, mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ musumɔ! Maran-ata: Nuŋtsɔ, ba.
23Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!
24Misuɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli! Amen.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Bɔfo Paulo wolo ni ji enyɔ ni eŋma emaje Korintobii lɛ, eŋma be mli ni nibii amli ewa waa ehã lɛ yɛ ekɛ Korinto asafo lɛ naanyobɔɔ hewɔ. Asafo lɛ mlibii lɛ ekomɛi ejie amɛhiɛ faŋŋ amɛka lɛ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ baatswa. Shi lɛ lɛ, ejie shwee kple ni eshweɔ akɛ asaa amɛteŋ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, ni be ni ana asaa amɛteŋ lɛ, ena miishɛɛ ho he ni enya kɛ tsuijurɔ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Paulo wie naanyobɔɔ ni yɔɔ ekɛ Korinto asafo lɛ teŋ lɛ he yɛ emajemɔ wolo lɛ mli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nɔ hewɔ ni etutu ehiɛ ewo amɛ ni ewieɔ jɛmɔi kɛ hiŋtihiŋti ni gbaa asafo lɛ naa lɛ he nyanyaanya lɛ. Ehã amɛle akɛ emii eshɛ ehe waa ejaakɛ ekɔkɔbɔɔ lɛ efeee yaka, shi moŋ ekɛ tsuitsakemɔ kɛ kpãtãmɔ eba. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eba asafoŋbii lɛ ni amɛje amɛtsuiaŋ faa amɛye too koni akɛyaye abua Kristofoi ohiafoi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ. Naagbee lɛ, Paulo fã ebɔfo ni eji lɛ he, ni ejie ehe yi ejaakɛ mɛi enyɔ oo ko yɛ Korinto ni amɛ kɛ shwãa miishi amɛtsitsi akɛ amɛ ji bɔfoi kpakpai lɛ, ni amɛmiigbe lɛ Paulo lɛ he guɔ akɛ lɛ lɛ jeee bɔfo kpakpa ji lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-11
Paulo kɛ Korinto Asafo lɛ 1.12—7.16
Onia ni akɛyawa Yudea Kristofoi lɛ 8.1—9.15
Paulo fã hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ akɛ bɔfo lɛ he 10.1—13.10
Naamuu 13.11-13

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Paulo, ni ji Kristo Yesu bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo lɛ ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ Korinto lɛ kɛ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Akaia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
2 Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Paulo daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ yelikɛbuamɔ hewɔ
3 Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ji musuŋtsɔlɛtsɛ kɛ miishɛjemɔ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 4Eshɛjeɔ wɔmii yɛ wɔmanehului lɛ fɛɛ mli, koni wɔ hu wɔnyɛ wɔkɛ miishɛjemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛshɛjeɔ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmii lɛ ashɛje mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ amii. 5 Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Kristo amanehului lɛ baa wɔnɔ kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo hewɔ lɛ wɔmiishɛjemɔ hu faa kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ. 6 Shi kɛji amanehulu wɔna jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ kɛ yiwalaheremɔ hewɔ ni; ni kɛji wɔmii ashɛjeɔ hu jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ ni hãa nyɛkɛ tsuishitoo mĩaa nyɛhiɛ kɛnaa nakai amanehului ni wɔnaa lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ ni. 7Ni wɔhiɛ ni kã nyɛnɔ lɛ gbugbãaa, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔ ni nyɛnaa amanehului lɛ eko lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛnaa miishɛjemɔ lɛ hu eko.
8 Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔmanehului ni wɔna yɛ Asia lɛ atee nyɛ, akɛ wɔna nɔ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ po, ni wɔhiɛ kãaa wala nɔ tete, 9shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔna faŋŋ akɛ gbele fɔbuu kã wɔnɔ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ akafɔ̃ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe nɔ, shi moŋ wɔkɛfɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ ni teɔ gbohii ashi lɛ nɔ; 10Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ gbele ni yɔɔ gbeyei tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ mli, ni ebaajie wɔ, ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaaya nɔ ejie wɔ, 11kɛji nyɛfata he kɛkpa fai nyɛhã wɔ, koni mɛi pii ada shi ahã wɔ yɛ dromɔ keenii ni akɛhã wɔ yɛ mɛi pii afaikpamɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Paulo tsake egbɛfãa lɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo
12 Shi wɔshwãa lɛ nɛ: wɔhenilee odase ni eyeɔ wɔ akɛ hetsemɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli, titri lɛ yɛ wɔkɛ nyɛteŋ shihilɛ mli, ni jeee heloo gbɛfãŋ nilee naa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa. 13Ejaakɛ wɔŋmaaa nyɛ nibii krokomɛi fe nii ni nyɛkaneɔ ni asaŋ nyɛle, ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale kɛwula shi hu, 14 tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna nyɛle wɔ hu fã kɛ fã akɛ nyɛshwãanɔ ji wɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛ ji wɔshwãanɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
15Enɛ nɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ hewɔ mito miyiŋ akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ tsutsu lɛ koni nyɛna dromɔ shii enyɔ, 16 no ji, ni mibatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Makedonia, ni asaŋ maku misɛɛ kɛjɛ Makedonia maba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, koni nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya Yudea. 17Belɛ ni mito miyiŋ nakai lɛ, yiŋ flɛflɛ mikɛfee? Aloo miyiŋ ni mito lɛ, gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ mikɛto, ni makɛɛ “hɛɛ”, “hɛɛ”, kɛ “dabi” “dabi”, fɛɛ shi kome? 18Shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ wɔwiemɔ ni wɔkɛ nyɛ wie lɛ ejeee nɔ ni kɛɔ “hɛɛ” kɛ “dabi” fɛɛ shi kome. 19Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi Yesu Kristo mɔ ni mikɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo shiɛ ehe sane yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, ejeee “hɛɛ” kɛ “dabi” fɛɛ shi kome, shi moŋ eji “hɛɛ”. 20 Ejaakɛ lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi abɔ ni yɔɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ “hɛɛ”; ni no hewɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ enɔ wɔkɛɔ “Amen” kɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ. 21 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni hãa wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ fiɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli, ni efɔ wɔ mu; 22 lɛ nɔŋŋ esɔo wɔnaa, ni ekɛ Mumɔ lɛ ehã wɔ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu. 23 Shi mi lɛ, miitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ebaye odase eshi mi kɛji ejeee anɔkwale akɛ nyɛyibaamɔ hewɔ minako maba Korinto lɛ. 24 Jeee akɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɔŋ wɔyeɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, shi moŋ wɔfata nyɛhe kɛmiitsu nii kɛhã nyɛmiishɛɛnamɔ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 2
Content:
1 Shi mikpɛ mli yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ. 2Ejaakɛ kɛ mihã nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, namɔ baashɛje mimii akɛ mɔ nɔŋŋ ni mihã eye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ? 3Ni miŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ, koni kɛ miba lɛ, mɛi ni kulɛ sa akɛ amɛhã mimii ashɛ mihe lɛ akahã miye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnɔ akɛ nyɛaana akɛ mimiishɛɛ ji nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ. 4Shi mijɛ hejaramɔ pii kɛ tsuiyeli babaoo mli mikɛ yaafonui babaoo ŋma nyɛ, jeee ni nyɛwerɛ aho nyɛhe, shi moŋ ni nyɛna suɔmɔ babaoo ni misumɔɔ nyɛ.
Mɔ ni etɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ akɛfa lɛ
5 Shi kɛ mɔ ko ehã aye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, jeee mi ni ehã miye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, shi, bɔ ni afee ni minaa akaya shɔŋŋ lɛ, ehã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ko kɛ̃. 6Nakai mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ ni mɛi pii ekã lɛ fa hã lɛ; 7hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛfaa lɛ moŋ ni nyɛshɛjea emii koni ŋkɔmɔyeli tuutu lɛ akahã enijiaŋ je wui. 8No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛma nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ mi nyɛhã lɛ; 9 ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ hu ni miŋma nyɛ wolo lɛ, koni mikɛna nɔ gbɔmɛi ni ji nyɛ, akɛ nyɛboɔ toi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ gbɛfaŋ lo. 10 Shi mɔ ni nyɛkɛ nɔ ko faa lɛ lɛ, mi hu mikɛfaa lɛ; ejaakɛ mi hu, nɔ ni mikɛfa lɛ, kɛ mikɛ nɔ ko efa lɛ, mikɛfa yɛ nyɛhewɔ yɛ Kristo hiɛ; 11 koni Satan nine akashɛ wɔnɔ, ejaakɛ wɔle eŋaatsɔ̃i lɛ.
12 Shi be ni miba Troia ni mibashiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ ni agbele gbɛ ahã mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, 13 minaaa hejɔlɛ yɛ mimumɔ mli, ejaakɛ minaaa minyɛmi Tito hewɔ lɛ mishɛ amɛ, ni miyiŋ kɛtee Makedonia.
Kunimyeli yɛ Kristo mli
14Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ nyiɛɔ wɔhiɛ be fɛɛ be yɛ ekunimyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ ehãa enilee ŋmajee lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ. 15 Ejaakɛ Kristo ŋmajee ni ekɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔ yɛ mɛi ni ahereɔ amɛyiwala lɛ kɛ mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, 16 mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ, eji gbele ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli hã amɛ; shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, eji wala ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli hã amɛ. Ni namɔ sa hã nɛkɛ nitsumɔ? 17 Ejaakɛ wɔtamɔɔɔ mɛi pii ni kɛ nibii krokomɛi futuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, shi moŋ wɔwieɔ lɛ ŋmiiŋmi bɔ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, yɛ Kristo mli.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 3
Content:
Kpãŋmɔ Hee lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi
1 Aso wɔbɔ̃i wɔhe yijiemɔ ekoŋŋ? Aloo ehĩa wɔ akɛ wɔhiɛɔ yijiemɔ woji kɛbahãa nyɛ loo kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ehĩaa mɛi komɛi lɛ lo? 2 Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji wɔwolo ni aŋma yɛ wɔtsuii amli ni mɛi fɛɛ le ni amɛkaneɔ lɛ, 3 ni ajie nyɛ faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛ ji Kristo wolo ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he, ni jeee blɛgi akɛŋma, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ, jeee yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛi anɔ, shi moŋ yɛ tsuii ni ji heloo taoi anɔ.
4Shi Kristo hewɔ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nɛɛ. 5 Jeee akɛ wɔsa yɛ wɔnyɛmɔ naa, ní wɔɔjwɛŋ akɛ nɔ ko jɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmli, shi wɔsalɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ; 6 lɛ ehã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni sa akɛ akɛfee kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi, jeee nɔ ni aŋma shi moŋ Mumɔ nɔ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni aŋma lɛ gbeɔ mɔ; shi Mumɔ lɛ hãa mɔ yi naa wala.
7 Shi kɛ gbele sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akpɛ yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛi anɔ lɛ yɛ nyam bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ Mose hiɛ akwɛ yɛ ehiɛ nyam ni sɛɛ foɔ lɛ hewɔ po lɛ, 8 ani Mumɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam fe no? 9 Ejaakɛ kɛ fɔbuu sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ yɛ nyam lɛ, ani jalɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam kɛtekeŋ nɔ aahu? 10Ejaakɛ anunyam lɛ ni fa babaoo tsɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ bɛ nyam yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ. 11Ejaakɛ kɛ nɔ ni hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ yɛ nyam lɛ, belɛ nɔ ni hiɔ shi lɛ yɛ nyam aahu fe no.
12Agbɛnɛ akɛni wɔyɔɔ nɛkɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔfeɔ ekãa babaoo, 13 ni wɔfeee tamɔ Mose ni kɛ hiɛhaanɔ ha ehiɛ, koni Israelbii lɛ akwɛ nɔ ni hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ naagbee lɛ. 14 Shi moŋ aŋa amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa. Ejaakɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nakai hiɛhaanɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ha kpãŋmɔ momo lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ; ajieko shi akɛ Kristo mli esɛɛ foɔ yɛ. 15Shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni akaneɔ Mose wolo lɛ, hiɛhaanɔ ha amɛtsui nɔ; 16 shi kɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, aaajie hiɛhaanɔ lɛ. 17Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji Mumɔ lɛ, ni he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi heyeli yɔɔ. 18Shi wɔ fɛɛ ni wɔkɛ hiɛ kpetekplee kwɛɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ tamɔ akwɛɔ ashwishwɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiitsake wɔmiitsɔ̃mɔ nakai subaŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛmiijɛ anunyam mli kɛmiiya anunyam mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ejeɔ Nuŋtsɔ ni ji Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 4
Content:
Mumɔŋ jwetri yɛ su kpuji amli
1 No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni akɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ ehã wɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa lɛ, wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui, 2 shi wɔkwa hiɛgbejianii ni akɛtee lɛ, ni wɔbaaa wɔjeŋ yɛ kutumpɔo mli; ni asaŋ wɔkɛ nibii futuuu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ anɔkwale lɛ wiemɔ faŋŋ jieɔ wɔhe yi wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ henilee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 3 Shi kɛ ha aha wɔsanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ tete lɛ, mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ amli kɛkɛ aha hiɛ yɛ, 4 amɛ ji mɛi amli ni je nɛɛ mli nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eshwila mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ yɛ, koni Kristo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ lɛ anunyam Sanekpakpa la lɛ akakpɛ miihã amɛ. 5 Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔshiɛɔ, shi moŋ Kristo Yesu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ wɔ hu akɛ nyɛtsuji yɛ Yesu hewɔ; 6 ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ la ajɛ duŋ mli akpɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpɛ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam he nilee la lɛ akpɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo hiɛ.
7 Shi wɔhiɛ nɛkɛ jwetri nɛɛ yɛ su kpuji amli, koni hewalɛ ni fa kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ afee Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ni jeee wɔnɔ. 8 Afĩfĩaa wɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔtsui esuuu; wɔfeɔ yaa, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeko wui, 9awaa wɔ yi, shi kɛ̃lɛ akwako wɔ; atswiaa wɔ shi, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔpleneko. 10 Daa nɛɛ wɔhiɛ Yesu gbele lɛ yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli. 11 Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ nɛɛ, daa nɛɛ atu wɔ awo gbele dɛŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ amli. 12No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ gbele tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli, shi nyɛ lɛ, wala tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛmli.
13 Shi akɛni wɔyɔɔ nakai hemɔkɛyeli mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Mihe miye hewɔ ni miwie” lɛ, wɔ hu wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔwieɔ; 14 ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ mɔ ni tee Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shi lɛ, eeetee wɔ kɛ Yesu shi, ni ekɛ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaadamɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ. 15Ejaakɛ nyɛhewɔ afeɔ fɛɛ, koni dromɔ ni fa babaoo lɛ atsɔ̃ mɛi pii ashidaa nɔ atɛke nɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnyamwoo.
Wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa
16No hewɔ ni wɔtsui efãaa lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ wɔkponɔgbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ fiteɔ kwraa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔmli gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee gbi fɛɛ gbi. 17Ejaakɛ wɔmanehulu ni jaraaa ni asaŋ esɛɛ etsɛɛɛ nɛɛ, baahã wɔna naanɔ anunyam kpele ni jara wa aahu; 18ejaakɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni kwɛɔ nii ni anaa lɛ, shi moŋ nii ni anaaa lɛ wɔkwɛɔ; ejaakɛ nii ni anaa lɛ hiɔ shi be fioo kɛkɛ, shi nii ni anaaa lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyashiɔ naanɔ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 5
Content:
Wɔshweɔ wɔŋwɛi gbɔmɔtso hee kɛ ŋwɛi shĩa hee lɛ
1 Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ, kɛ akumɔ wɔbuu ni wɔyɔɔ mli ni ji wɔshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ shĩa jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ tsu ko ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, shĩa ko ni jeee niji akɛfee, ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ yɛ ŋwɛi. 2 Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi tete yɛ wɔbuu nɛɛ mli, ni wɔshweɔ akɛ akɛ wɔtsu ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ awo wɔ, 3ni kɛ akɛwo wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ anaŋ wɔ akɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ yayai. 4 Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ buu lɛ mli lɛ hu, akɛni wɔhe jaraa wɔ hewɔ lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔŋtsɔi, ejaakɛ wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ ajie wɔhenii, shi moŋ wɔsumɔɔ akɛ awo wɔ nii ashwie nɔ, koni wala lɛ ami nɔ ni gboɔ lɛ. 5 Shi mɔ ni saa wɔ hã enɛ nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni hã wɔ Mumɔ lɛ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ lɛ.
6 No hewɔ lɛ, wɔyɛ tsui daa, ni wɔle akɛ gbii abɔ ni wɔyɔɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli nɛɛ wɔdom kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ; 7 ejaakɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ, shi jeee ninamɔ naa, 8 shi wɔyɛ tsui, ni esa wɔhiɛ moŋ akɛ wɔɔdom kɛjɛ gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ mli, ni wɔyahi shĩa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. 9 No hewɔ lɛ, oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ, shĩa wɔyɔɔ jio, dommɔ wɔdom jio, esa ni wɔsa ehiɛ. 10 Ejaakɛ ja wɔ fɛɛ wɔpue faŋŋ yɛ Kristo kojomɔ sɛi lɛ hiɛ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana nii ni efee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwobɔɔ ni efee lɛ, ekpakpa jio, efɔŋ jio.
Kristo ekpãtã wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ
11No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔle Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ nyɛhenilee mli hu. 12 Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe yi wɔjieɔ wɔhãa nyɛ ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ wɔkɛmiihã nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛkɛshwã nyɛfɔ̃ wɔnɔ, koni nyɛna eko nyɛkɛɛ mɛi ni shwãa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ shi jeee yɛ tsui mli lɛ. 13Ejaakɛ kɛ sɛkɛ wɔyeɔ jiŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ wɔyeɔ, ni kɛ wɔyɛ shishiishi hu jiŋŋ, nyɛ hewɔ ni. 14Ejaakɛ Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ nyɛɔ wɔnɔ, ni wɔkojoɔ nɛkɛ akɛ, kɛ mɔ kome gbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele lɛ, belɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ egboi. 15 Ni egbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele, koni mɛi ni hiɛ kãmɔ lɛ ahiɛ akakãmɔ miihã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛhiɛ akãmɔ ahã mɔ ni gbo ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ ahã amɛ lɛ.
16Belɛ, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, wɔleee mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa; ni kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa wɔle Kristo yɛ tete lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ wɔleee lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ. 17 Hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, bɔɔnɔ hee ji lɛ; blema nii lɛ eho; naa, nibii fɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ ehee. 18Shi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ekɛ wɔ kpãtã, ni ekɛ kpãtãmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ hã wɔ lɛ dɛŋ; 19no ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ ekɛ je lɛ kpãtã, ni ebuuu amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ ehãaa amɛ, ni etu kpãtãmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ.
20No hewɔ lɛ, wɔji bɔfoi yɛ Kristo najiaŋ, tamɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ wɔnɔ eewie eetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi: wɔdamɔ Kristo najiaŋ wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ, nyɛhãa akpãtã nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ! 21Ejaakɛ mɔ ni leee esha lɛ, wɔhewɔ lɛ ehã etsɔ̃ esha, koni wɔ lɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ yɛ emli.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 6
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi anitsumɔ walɛ kɛ enyam
1 Shi akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi ji wɔ yɛ enitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkahã Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ fee yaka. 2 Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Be ni sa mli mibo bo toi yɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua bo yɛ.” Naa, be ni sa jogbaŋŋ nɛ; naa, yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɛ.
3Ni wɔtooo mɔ ko mɔ ko pampi yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, koni akagbe wɔsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he guɔ. 4Shi moŋ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji wɔ. Wɔmĩaa wɔhiɛ babaoo. Wɔtoɔ wɔtsui shi yɛ amanehului kɛ fimɔi kɛ jaramɔi amli. 5 Ayiɔ wɔ ni awoɔ wɔ tsuŋ kpitiokpitio. Afeɔ wɔ soisoi. Wɔtsuɔ nii kɛ kpeshii kɛ deŋmegbomɔ pii. Wɔhiɔ ŋmãa, 6 ni wɔbɔɔ hetsemɔ he mɔdɛŋ kɛ nilee. Wɔŋmɛɔ wɔtsui shi; wɔmli hi. Yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ naa lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ osato bɛ mli. 7 Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ wɔwieɔ anɔkwale. Ni wɔwoɔ jalɛ tawuunii yɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku fɛɛ. 8Mɛi komɛi woɔ wɔhiɛ nyam; ni mɛi komɛi gbeɔ wɔhe guɔ. Mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe efɔŋ, ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe ekpakpa. Anaa wɔ akɛ shishiulɔi, kɛ̃lɛ, anɔkwafoi ji wɔ. 9 Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni aleee kɛ mɛi ni ale krɛdɛɛ; tamɔ mɛi ni gboiɔ, ni naa, wɔhiɛ kãmɔ. Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni agbalaa amɛtoi, ni kɛ̃lɛ agbeko wɔ. 10 Wɔ tamɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi, shi wɔmii shɛɔ daa. Wɔ tamɔ ohiafoi, shi wɔfeɔ mɛi pii niiatsɛmɛi, ni wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko, ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔyɛ nii fiaa.
Nyɛgbelea nyɛtsui naa nyɛhãa wɔ
11Korintobii, wɔkɛ nyɛ ewie faŋŋ; wɔtsui mli egbele. 12Gbɛ yɛ wɔmli hã nyɛ, shi nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛtsuii amli joɔ. 13 Nyɛ hu nyɛgbelea nyɛtsuii amli nakai nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛto wɔ najiaŋ. Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ mibii.
Kristojamɔ kɛ wɔŋjamɔ bɛ nɔ ko feemɔ
14 Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ akagbalaa kɔŋtso kome, akɛni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeee hegbɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɛɛ bɔɔ jalɛ kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ yeli la kɛ duŋ yɔɔ? 15Ni mɛɛ gbeekpãmɔ Kristo kɛ Belial yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ nijaa mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ kɛ mɔ ni heee yeee yɔɔ? 16 Ni asaŋ mɛɛ ekomefeemɔ yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu kɛ amãgãi ateŋ? Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ,
“Mahi amɛmli, ni manyiɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.”
17 No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ,
“Nyɛjea amɛteŋ, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe,
ni nyɛkataa muji nɔ ko he,
ni mahere nyɛ atuu.
18 Ni matsɔ̃ nyɛtsɛ,
ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ mibihii kɛ mibiyei,” Yehowa, Ofe lɛ, kɛɛ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 7
Content:
1Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni asumɔɔ, akɛni wɔna nɛkɛ shiwoi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsua wɔhe kɛjɛa heloo kɛ mumɔ muji fɛɛ mli, ni wɔhã wɔhetsemɔ aye emuu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli.
Paulo mii shɛ ehe akɛ asafo lɛ eshwa ehe
2 Nyɛhãa wɔ gbɛ yɛ nyɛmli! Wɔfeko mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ ko; wɔyeko mɔ ko awui, wɔyeko mɔ ko amim. 3 Mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛbu nyɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ mikɛɛ momo akɛ wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ yɛ wɔtsui mli bɔ ni gbele mli oo, wala mli oo, wɔkɛ nyɛ ekome. 4Mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ waa, ni asaŋ mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ babaoo; miyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛjemɔ, miyi kɛtɛke nɔ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ wɔmanehulu lɛ fɛɛ mli.
5 Ejaakɛ shi be ni wɔba Makedonia lɛ hu, wɔnaaa wɔgbɔmɔtso hejɔlɛ kwraa; shi moŋ he fɛɛ he lɛ amanehulu sɔŋŋ wɔnaa: wɔkponɔgbɛ lɛ nɔmɔi, wɔmligbɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔi. 6 Shi Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni shɛjeɔ mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ amii lɛ, kɛ Tito baa lɛ shɛje wɔmii; 7shi jeee ebaa lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ miishɛjemɔ ni nyɛkɛshɛje emii lɛ hu, ejaakɛ egba wɔ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ mi lɛ kɛ nyɛheshwamɔ lɛ kɛ mihe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ; enɛ hã mina miishɛɛ babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ.
8 Ejaakɛ kɛ wolo ni miŋma nyɛ lɛ edɔ nyɛ lɛ, mishwaaa mihe; kɛji mishwa mihe po lɛ, ejaakɛ mina akɛ nakai wolo lɛ edɔ nyɛ, kɛ be kuku po, 9agbɛnɛ mimii eshɛ; jeee dɔ ni edɔ nyɛ lɛ hewɔ ni, shi moŋ akɛni dɔlɛ lɛ hã nyɛshwa nyɛhe lɛ hewɔ ni; ejaakɛ edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akajɛ wɔ ni nɔ ko bɔ nyɛ. 10 Ejaakɛ dɔlɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɛɔ tsuitsakemɔ kɛbaa, tsuitsakemɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa yiwalaheremɔ ni ashwaaa he yɛ he lɛ mli; shi je nɛɛ mli dɔlɛ lɛ tsɛɔ gbele. 11Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ dɔlɛ ni edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ, nɔ naajiemɔ, nɔ mlifu, nɔ gbeyeishemɔ, nɔ shwee, nɔ hiɛdɔɔ, nɔ jalɛ kojomɔ ni etsɛ ewo nyɛmli! Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ nyɛhe tse yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.
12No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miŋma nyɛ tete lɛ, jeee mɔ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, asaŋ hu jeee mɔ ni atɔ̃ enɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ apue faŋŋ ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 13Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔmii eshɛ. Shi miishɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ Tito miishɛɛ lɛ he lɛ hã wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ babaoo, ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhã etsui enyɔ emli, 14ejaakɛ kɛ mishwã nyɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ko mli lɛ, nyɛwooo mi hiɛgbele; shi tamɔ bɔ ni wɔwie nibii fɛɛ anɔkwale mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔshwãa hu ni wɔshwã wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Tito lɛ efee anɔkwale, 15 ni eyɛ nyɛhe tsui babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ, ejaakɛ ekaiɔ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ here lɛ lɛ. 16Mina miishɛɛ akɛ mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 8
Content:
Kristofoi atooyeli
1 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiihã nyɛle dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro Makedonia asafoi lɛ, 2akɛ aka amɛ yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ, ni amɛhĩa katekate lɛ mli po, amɛ jie mlihilɛ falɛ kpo; 3ejaakɛ miiye odase akɛ amɛhã bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ, ni amɛhã fe bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ tete yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa, 4 ni amɛkɛ tutɔmɔ babaoo kpa wɔ fai ni ahã amɛ hu amɛna naanyobɔɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ mli gbɛ, 5ni jeee bɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛŋɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe amɛhã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu kɛ wɔ hu, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa. 6No hã wɔkpa Tito fai, koni bɔ ni ebɔ̃i momo sa lɛ, nakai etsu dromɔ nitsumɔ nɛɛ kɛgbe naa hu yɛ nyɛteŋ. 7 Shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtɛkeɔ nɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ fɛɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni jɛ wɔmli ni eyɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkwɛa koni nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ mli hu lɛ nyɛtɛke nɔ.
8Miwieee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ mɛi krokomɛi amɔdɛŋbɔɔ mikɛkaa nyɛ hu nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ makwɛ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋŋ lo. 9 Ejaakɛ nyɛle wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ ni ji niiatsɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ohiafo yɛ nyɛhewɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ ehia lɛ nɔ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi.
10Nɔ ni mijwɛŋ yɛ sane nɛɛ he nɛ, enɛ hi hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni akɛbaafee lɛ hu nyɛ tsutsu nyɛje shishi afi beebe nɛ. 11No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛgbea feemɔ lɛ naa, koni bɔ ni oya nɔŋŋ ni nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛjɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbea naa. 12 Ejaakɛ kɛ tsui yɛ he lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko hãa kɛjɛɔ nɔ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ saa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; jeee kɛjɛ nɔ ni ebɛ mli. 13Ejaakɛ mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mɛi komɛi ahe ajɔ amɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhao, shi moŋ koni fɛɛ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ; 14 nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ ayaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ mɛi komɛi nyɛɛɛ ahã lɛ najiaŋ, koni be kroko lɛ nɔ ni amɛ hu amɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ abaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛhã lɛ najiaŋ, koni aye hegbɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; 15 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Mɔ ni bua pii naa lɛ, enaa eko yɛ sɛɛ,
ni mɔ ni bua fioo naa hu lɛ, eshwɛɛɛ lɛ eko.”
16Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛhedɔɔ nɛɛ wo Tito tsui mli lɛ; 17ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ wɔkɛŋmɛ ehiɛ ni eba ni ekpɛlɛ̃, shi akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ he tsui waa hewɔ lɛ, eba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa. 18Shi nyɛmi ni wɔtsu wɔfata ehe nɛɛ yɛ yijiemɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ; 19 shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi asafoi lɛ hala lɛ hu, ni ekɛ wɔ anyiɛ ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nitsumɔ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ anunyam, ni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ he tsui ni wɔyɔɔ; 20ejaakɛ wɔmiikwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni mɔ ko akawie wɔhe efɔŋ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa nikee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ hewɔ; 21 ejaakɛ oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ efee fɛo, jeee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.
22Shi wɔtsu wɔnyɛmi lɛ hu wɔfata amɛhe, mɔ ni wɔka lɛ kpitiokpitio yɛ nibii pii amli, ni wɔna akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, shi agbɛnɛ eebɔ mɔdɛŋ po fe tsutsu lɛ, yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ pii lɛ hewɔ. 23 Shi Tito lɛ, mihefatalɔ ni mikɛtsuɔ nyɛhe nii ji lɛ, ni wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu, asafoi lɛ abɔfoi kɛ Kristo hiɛnyam ji amɛ. 24 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛsuɔmɔ kɛ shwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ kpo nyɛtsɔa amɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 9
Content:
Nihãmɔ mli jɔɔmɔ
1 Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛyaasɔ̃mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ he lɛ, ehĩaaa akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɔ ko. 2 Ejaakɛ mile bɔ ni nyɛna he tsui ni mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ Makedoniabii lɛ akɛ Akaiabii esaa amɛhe amɛto kɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛ afi lɛ beebe; ni nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ ewo mɛi pii ahiɛdɔɔ. 3 Shi mitsu nyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni wɔshwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ akafee yaka yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛhe bɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ; 4ni kɛ Makedoniabii lɛ kɛ mi ba lɛ, amɛkabanina nyɛ akɛ nyɛsako nyɛhe, ni wɔhiɛ, misumɔɔɔ akɛ makɛɛ akɛ nyɛ nyɛhiɛ bagboi yɛ wɔhiɛ ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ mli. 5No hewɔ lɛ, mijwɛŋ akɛ ehĩa akɛ makpa nyɛmimɛi lɛ afai ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ ni amɛbasaa nɛkɛ nyɛjɔɔmɔ ni awo shi momo nɛɛ amɛto koni efee klalo akɛ jɔɔmɔ nɔ ko shi jeee nɔ ko ni akɛ hiɛjoomɔ miishɔ̃ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
6 Shi enɛ mikɛɔ akɛ, mɔ ni lɛteɔ nii ahe duɔ lɛ, ekɛ helɛtemɔ hu aaakpa; ni mɔ ni duɔ yɛ jɔɔmɔ mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mli nɔŋŋ eeekpa yɛ. 7 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni ekpɛ mli momo yɛ etsui mli, ni ekajɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli loo nɔnyɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ tsuijurɔnaa halɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ. 8Shi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ akɛ eeehã dromɔ fɛɛ atɛke nɔ ahã nyɛ, koni nyɛhe atua nyɛ kwraa yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli daa nɛɛ ni nyɛna nii kɛtɛke nɔ hã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa; 9 tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
“Egbɛɔ eshwãa ehãa ohiafoi lɛ;
ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.”
10 Shi mɔ ni kɛ dumɔwui keɔ dulɔ ni ekɛ aboloo hu hãa yeli lɛ, eeehã nyɛ dumɔwui ni afa, ni eeehã nyɛjalɛ yibii lɛ hu ashwere; 11 ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni nyɛfee mlihilɔi kwraa, ni nyɛmlihilɛ lɛ ahã atsɔ wɔnɔ akɛ shidaa aha Nyɔŋmɔ; 12 ejaakɛ nɛkɛ yelikɛbuamɔ nɛɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee fɛnemɔ kɛkɛ efɛneɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ yɛ fimɔ mli, shi moŋ ehãa adaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi babaoo kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ hu. 13Ejaakɛ odase kpakpa ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ yeɔ lɛ hãa amɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ ye ni nyɛyeɔ Kristo Sanekpakpa ni nyɛjajeɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ mlihilɛ ni nyɛkɛyeɔ nyɛbuaa amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ, 14ni amɛbaasɔle amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛbaashwe nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛnɔ kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ. 15Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ enikeenii ni anyɛŋ agba lɛ hewɔ!

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 10
Content:
Paulo miifã ebɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ he
1 Shi mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ Kristo hejɔlɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ lɛ hewɔ, mi ni akɛɛ kɛ miyɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ mifeɔ mihe humi yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi kɛ mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mijeɔ ekãa miwoɔ nyɛ lɛ. 2 Shi miikpa nyɛ fai ni kɛ miba lɛ, nyɛkahã mikɛ hewalɛ ni mito akɛ mikɛbaawie lɛ miijie ekãa kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni susuɔ akɛ wɔtamɔ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo naa lɛ. 3Eyɛ mli akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ moŋ, shi wɔwuuu ta yɛ heloo naa. 4 Ejaakɛ wɔtawuunii lɛ jeee heloo mli nii ni, shi moŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, hewalɛnii ni akɛkumɔɔ mɔji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni, 5ni wɔkumɔɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ he nɔ ni awoɔ ashiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ, ni wɔŋɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwɛŋmɔ nom ni ebo Kristo toi, 6ni wɔsaa wɔhe wɔto koni, kɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ ye emuu lɛ, wɔgbala toigbele fɛɛ he toi.
7Nyɛkwɛa nibii bɔ ni nyɛnaa amɛ lɛ. Kɛ mɔ ko heɔ yeɔ akɛ Kristo nɔ ji lɛ lɛ, esusu he ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eji Kristo nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔji Kristo nii. 8 Ejaakɛ kɛ shwãa po mashwã kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ wɔhegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã wɔ ni wɔkɛhã nyɛnane amɔ shi ni jeee akɛ wɔkɛbutu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ gboŋ, 9koni mikafee akɛ mɔ ko ni woɔ nyɛhe gbeyei kɛ woji. 10 Ejaakɛ akɛɔ akɛ, woji lɛ amli saji tsii ni amɛmli wa moŋ, shi kɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɛ biɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe waaa ni ewiemɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ. 11 Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ana ale enɛ akɛ, bɔ ni wɔwiemɔ yɔɔ yɛ woji amli kɛ wɔbɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ kɛ wɔyɛ jɛi lɛ wɔnifeemɔnii hu yɔɔ.
12 Ejaakɛ wɔkaaa akɛ wɔɔbu wɔhe wɔshi mɛi komɛi ni jieɔ amɛhe yi lɛ anɔ, aloo akɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe aaato amɛhe. Amɛ lɛ, akɛni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe susuɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe toɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛyooo sɛɛ. 13 Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔshwãŋ fe nine, shi moŋ wɔshwãa yɛ susumɔ kpãa ni Nyɔŋmɔ esusu ehã wɔ ni kɛlɛ shɛɔ nyɛ hu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ naa. 14Ejaakɛ wɔkpãaa wɔmli tsɔ tamɔ mɛi ni shɛɛɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ klɛŋklɛŋ wɔkɛ Kristo he Sanekpakpa lɛ shɛ nyɛŋɔɔ; 15 wɔshwãaa fe nine yɛ mɛi krokomɛi anitsumɔi ahewɔ; shi wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ shwere lɛ, wɔnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli baagbele kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ wɔsusumɔ kpãa lɛ naa, 16koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ niiaŋ, ni wɔkashwã wɔfɔ̃ nii ni atsu momo yɛ mɔ kroko nɔ mli lɛ anɔ.
17 Shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ eshwã efɔ̃! 18 Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni jieɔ ehe yi lɛ ji mɔ ni sa, shi moŋ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jieɔ eyi lɛ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 11
Content:
Eba lɛ akɛ Paulo ajie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yi
1Mina ni kulɛ nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mikwashiafeemɔ fioo! Shi anɔkwale nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mi. 2 Ejaakɛ nyɛhe awuŋã ni miyeɔ lɛ, miiye lɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye; ejaakɛ mitsɛ nyɛhe baa mihã nuu kome ni mikɛ oblayoo foro ni he tse ayahã Kristo. 3 Shi miishe gbeyei akɛ aleenɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni onufu lɛ kɛ ekutumpɔo lɛ laka Hawa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafite nyɛ hu nyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni nyɛŋmɛɛ suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ Kristo lɛ he. 4 Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko ba ni ebashiɛ Yesu kroko ni wɔshiɛko, loo mumɔ kroko ni nyɛnako, loo Sanekpakpa kroko ni nyɛmɔko mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhere lɛ jogbaŋŋ. 5 Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ. 6 Shi kɛ mi ji gbɔmɔ ko ni leee nɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ gbɛfaŋ tete lɛ, mijeee nakai yɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ; shi moŋ wɔfee enɛ faŋŋ wɔhã nyɛ, yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ, yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
7 Aloo belɛ akɛ miba mihe shi koni awo nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ mijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yaka lɛ mifee esha? 8 Mitswa asafoi krokomɛi ojo mihe nyɔmɔwoo yɛ amɛdɛŋ mikɛsɔ̃mɔ nyɛ. 9 Ni be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ ni efi mi tete lɛ, mifeee jatsu mihãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko, ejaakɛ nii ni hia mi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ Makedonia ba lɛ hã shɛ midɛŋ, ni mile mihenɔkwɛmɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni masaa male mihenɔkwɛmɔ, koni mikatsɔ̃ jatsu mihã nyɛ. 10 Gbii abɔ ni Kristo anɔkwale lɛ yɔɔ mimli nɛɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ mishwãa nɛɛ gbɛ yɛ Akaia niiaŋ. 11Mɛɛ hewɔŋ? Akɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ hewɔŋ? Nyɔŋmɔ le.
12Nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ, mafee, koni mikɛtsi mɛi ni taoɔ mihe sane lɛ agbɛ, ni ana amɛ yɛ amɛshwãanii lɛ amli, tamɔ bɔ ni anaa wɔ hu lɛ. 13 Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ ji amale bɔfoi, nitsulɔi shishiulɔi ni tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ Kristo bɔfoi. 14Ni enɛ bɛ naakpɛɛ tete ejaakɛ Satan diɛŋtsɛ tsakeɔ ehe etsɔ̃ɔ la bɔfo; 15no hewɔ lɛ, kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ tamɔ jalɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko wulu ko; amɛnaagbee baafee tamɔ bɔ ni amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
16 Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ mɔ ko akabu mi kwashia, shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, belɛ nyɛŋɔa mi akɛ kwashia kɛkɛ mɔ, koni mi hu mawo shwãa fioo ko. 17Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, miwieee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baawie, shi moŋ tamɔ kwashia wieɔ, yɛ nɔmimaa ni miyɔɔ akɛ miyɛ shwãa nɔ lɛ hewɔ. 18Akɛni mɛi pii shwãa yɛ heloo naa hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mashwã eko. 19Akɛni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nilelɔi ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ toɔ nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ; 20ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko miiye nyɛ nyɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ko miitswa nyɛ ojo, kɛ mɔ ko miimɔ nyɛ, kɛ mɔ ko miiwó ehe nɔ yɛ nyɛnɔ, kɛ mɔ ko miigbala nyɛhiɛ ma lɛ, nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɔ lɛ. 21Miiwie kɛ hiɛgbele akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni wɔfee gbedee tsɔ̃. Shi nɔ mli ni mɔ ko feɔ ekãa yɛ lɛ, miiwie tamɔ kwashia, mi hu mifeɔ ekãa yɛ mli. 22 Hebribii ji amɛ? Mi hu eko ji mi. Israelbii ni? Mi hu eko ji mi. Abraham shwiei ni? Mi hu eko ji mi. 23 Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ? Miiwie tamɔ mɔ ni yitsoŋ kãa lɛ. Mife amɛ yɛ tɔlɛ nitsumɔi ni tɛke nɔ amli, yɛ tsuŋwoi babaoi amli, yɛ yii ni fa tsɔ̃ amli, yɛ gbelei amli kpitiokpitio. 24 Yudafoi yi mi shii enumɔ, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ, shwɛ ekome ni afee kpãi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. 25 Atswia mi kpãi shii etɛ̃, atswia mi tɛi shi kome, mikɛ lɛlɛ sha shi shii etɛ̃. Miye jenamɔ kɛ jetsɛremɔ yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli. 26Mifã gbɛ kpitiokpitio kɛ emli osharãi yɛ fai ahiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ ojotswalɔi adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ mijakubii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ maŋ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋa nɔ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ nyɛmimɛi shiwodudui lɛ ateŋ. 27 Mitsu nii kɛ tɔlɛ, yɛ kpeshii amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai mli, yɛ ŋmaahilɛi amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ fɛ̃i kɛ yayainyiɛmɔ mli. 28 Nibii ni yɔɔ sɛɛ ayakã; shi nɔ ni haoɔ mi daa gbi ji asafoi lɛ fɛɛ ahe susumɔ. 29 Namɔ gbedeɔ, ni mi lɛ migbedeee? Namɔ nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ, ni mimli eshãaa mi?
30 Kɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ mashwã kɛ̃lɛ, mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedemɔnii anɔ. 31 Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ, mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ, le akɛ mimaleee. 32Yɛ Damasko lɛ, lumɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ Areta shishi lɛ hã bulɔi bu Damaskobii amaŋ lɛ he ni amɔ mi, 33 ni ashiu mi yɛ kafu mli kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ ni yɔɔ gbogbo lɛ mli kɛyi shi, ni mijo foi yɛ edɛŋ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 12
Content:
Nii ni ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Paulo
1Shwãa he ehĩa moŋ, shi ehĩii hãaa mi, kɛ̃lɛ mibawie ninai kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpojiemɔi ahe. 2Mile gbɔmɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli. Afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ nɛ lɛ, ashá nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ; ashá lɛ ni eyɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; ebɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le. 3Ni mile nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ akɛ ashá lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, jeee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le. 4Shi akɛ asha lɛ kɛtee Paradeiso ni eyanu wiemɔi ni anyɛŋ awie, ni gbɔmɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etsĩɔ tã lɛ, no lɛ mile. 5 Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ hewɔ mashwã, shi mishwãŋ mihãŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, akɛ ja yɛ migbedemɔi lɛ ahe. 6 Ejaakɛ kɛji miitao mashwã lɛ, mifeŋ kwashia, ejaakɛ anɔkwale mawie; shi mikuɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ɔ nɔ, koni mɔ ko akabu mi fe bɔ ni enaa mi aloo enuɔ yɛ minaa lɛ.
7 Shi bɔ ni afee ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu ko yɛ kpojiemɔi lɛ adaramɔ ni amɛdara kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahã mi ŋmei ko yɛ miheloo mli, ni ji Satan bɔfo, koni egbala mi mai, ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu. 8Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ koni eje minɔ; 9ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Miduromɔ lɛ fa hã bo, ejaakɛ mihewalɛ lɛ, gbedeefeemɔ mli eyeɔ emuu yɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ titri akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedeefeemɔi lɛ anɔ moŋ, koni Kristo hewalɛ lɛ abu mihe. 10 No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ, mimii shɛɔ yɛ gbedeefeemɔi amli, yɛ hiɛnaanɔniinamɔi amli, yɛ fimɔ̃i amli, yɛ yiwaa mli, yɛ jaramɔ mli; ejaakɛ kɛ mifee gbedee lɛ, no minaa hewalɛ.
Paulo wie asafo lɛ hiɛ
11 Mifee kwashia; nyɛ nyɛnyɛ minɔ ni mifee nakai. Ejaakɛ kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛ moŋ nyɛjieɔ miyi; ejaakɛ kɛji mijeee nɔ ko tete po, eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ. 12 Okadii ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ afee yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ mli, yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi amli. 13 Ejaakɛ mɛni mli nyɛkpeɔ sɛɛ yɛ fe asafoi krokomɛi lɛ, fe akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ? Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ tɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ afaa mi!
Paulo fã ehe
14 Naa, enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni misaa mihe akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, shi mikɛ mihe ebafɔŋ nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ jeee nyɛnii lɛ mitaoɔ, shi moŋ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Ejaakɛ esaaa akɛ bii tiaa nii toɔ amɛfɔlɔi, shi moŋ fɔlɔi ni tiaa nii toɔ amɛbii. 15 Shi masumɔ babaoo akɛ mafite nii ni miyɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni asaŋ mikɛ mihe ashã afɔle yɛ nyɛsusumai ahewɔ. Ani esa akɛ bɔ ni suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ faa lɛ, nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ lo?
16Nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, eyɛ mli akɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ nɛ; shi akɛni ŋaalɔ ji mi hewɔ lɛ, mimɔ nyɛ yɛ ŋaa mli. 17Ani mitsɔ̃ mɛi ni mitsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ eko nɔ miye nyɛ amim lo? 18 Mikpa Tito fai ni mitsu lɛ kɛ wɔnyɛmi ko; ani Tito baye nyɛ amim ko? Ani jeee nakai mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔkɛnyiɛ? Jeee nakai najiamaamɔhei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ wɔnyiɛ?
Kɔkɔbɔɔ
19Asaŋ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnaa sɔŋŋ wɔjieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ lo? Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔwieɔ yɛ, yɛ Kristo mli; shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnaneshimɔmɔ hewɔ wɔwieɔ. 20 Ejaakɛ miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ kɛ miba lɛ, mibanaŋ nyɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛnaŋ mi bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, pɛsɛŋkuminya, oshekuyeli, mɔhewiemɔ, hefaa, sakasakafeemɔ; 21 ni misaa miishe gbeyei akɛ kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaba mi shi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ mahã mɛi ni efee esha sa ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii, yɛ amɛmujinii kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ.

Title: 2 KORINTOBII 13
Content:
Naagbee kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ ŋaawoo
1 Nyɛŋɔɔ ni mibaa nɛɛ ji nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃. Odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ adaaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi. 2Mɛi ni efee esha sa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ mito momo, ni asaŋ miikɛɛ amɛ mato be mli ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ akɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ lɛ, kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ, 3ejaakɛ nyɛmiitao naakpɛɛ okadi ko ni nyɛkɛaana akɛ Kristo wieɔ yɛ mimli, Kristo mɔ ni gbedeee yɛ nyɛmli, shi moŋ ehe waa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ. 4 Ejaakɛ asɛŋ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, ehiɛ kã; ni wɔ hu wɔgbedeɔ yɛ emli; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakãmɔ ahã nyɛ.
5 Nyɛkaa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lo? Nyɛtaoa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmli nyɛkwɛa. Aloo nyɛleee yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe akɛ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛmli? Kɛ nyɛleee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni esaaa kwraa ji nyɛ. 6Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale akɛ wɔ lɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni esaaa. 7Shi miikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, koni nyɛkafee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko kwraa, jeee koni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni sa hewɔŋ, shi moŋ koni nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa, ni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni esaaa. 8Ejaakɛ wɔnyɛŋ nɔ ko wɔfee wɔshi anɔkwale lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ nɔ ko wɔɔfee lɛ, wɔɔfee wɔhã anɔkwale lɛ. 9Ejaakɛ wɔnaa miishɛɛ kɛ wɔfee gbedee ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛyɛ hewalɛ lɛ; shi nɔ he fai ni wɔkpaa ji nyɛ emuuyeli. 10 No hewɔ hu ni miŋmaa enɛ be ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ, koni kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mikɛ nyɛ akaye waa, yɛ hegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã mi ni mikɛsaa shi jeee ni mikɛfite lɛ naa.
11 Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛyea emuu, nyɛshɛjea nyɛhe mii, nyɛjwɛŋmɔ afea ekome, nyɛhĩa shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
12 Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
13Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ Kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen.

Title: GALATIABII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Be ni abɔ̃i Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ yɛ mɛi ni jeee Yudafoi ji amɛ lɛ ateŋ ni amɛhere lɛ atuu lɛ, sanebimɔ kome ni bate shi ji akɛ, aso esa akɛ mɔ ko aye Mose Mla lɛ nɔ dani etsɔ̃ anɔkwa Kristofonyo lo? Paulo etsɔ̃ɔ naa momo akɛ enɛ he ehĩaaa kwraa. Anɔkwale moŋ ni yɔɔ mli ji akɛ nɔ kometoo pɛ nɔ mɔ ko baanyɛ edamɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ eyɛ wala yɛ Kristo mli, no ji hemɔkɛyeli; no nɔ pɛ atsɔ̃ɔ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ. Emli tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ji akɛ, mɛi komɛi ejɛ asafoi ni yɔɔ Galatia ni ji Romabii ashikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Asia Fio lɛ mli, amɛba amɛbate shi amɛshi Paulo ni amɛmiifi nɔ veveeve akɛ ja mɔ oye Mose Mla lɛ hu nɔ dani Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ ahere oyiwala.
Nɔ krɛdɛɛ hewɔ ni Paulo ŋma wolo nɛɛ eyahã Galatiabii lɛ ji akɛ eetao ehã mɛi ni alakaa amɛ ni atɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ amɛnane kɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ aku amɛsɛɛ amɛba anɔkwa hemɔkɛyeli kɛ jamɔ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Paulo kɛ ehefãmɔ je shishi etsɔ̃ɔ nɔ hewalɛ tuuŋtu ni eyɔɔ akɛ atsɛ lɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo lɛ. Egba mli kpoo kɛ nɔmimaa akɛ tsɛ́ ni atsɛ́ lɛ ni ebashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ, ejɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko hewalɛ mli, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ, ni ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ mɛi ahewɔ krɛdɛɛ ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ. Agbɛnɛ etee nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ pɛ atsɔ̃ɔ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kpo faŋŋ. Naagbee lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Kristofoi ajeŋba kɛ suɔmɔ ni jɛɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ ejɛɔ ebaa tswaa.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-10
Hewalɛ ni Paulo yɔɔ akɛ Kristo bɔfo lɛ 1.11—2.21
Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ he Sanekpakpa 3.1—4.31
Kristofonyo heyeli kɛ egbɛnaa 5.1—6.10
Naamuu 6.11-18

Title: GALATIABII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Mi Paulo ni mi ji bɔfo ni mibɔfonitsumɔ lɛ jɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ, ni jeee gbɔmɔ ko nɔ hu etsɔ̃, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ lɛ, 2kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni mi yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Galatia asafoi lɛ.
3 Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ ahã nyɛ; 4 Yesu Kristo ni kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ, koni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ jeŋ fɔ̃ŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ. 5Enɔ ji anunyam lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Sanekpakpa kroko bɛ
6Efee mihiɛ yaa akɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛmiitsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ yɛ Kristo dromɔ mli lɛ he kɛya Sanekpakpa kroko he; 7shi jeee Sanekpakpa kroko ni, fe akɛ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ ni hãa nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futuɔ, ni amɛtaoɔ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi. 8Shi kɛji wɔ po aloo bɔfo ni jɛ ŋwɛi tete bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, yɛ nɔ ni wɔjaje wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu! 9Tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ momo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛmɔ mli nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!” 10 Ejaakɛ be nɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahiɛ gbɛ mitaoɔ loo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ gbɛ? Aloo miitao gbɔmɛi ahiɛ masa? Ejaakɛ kɛ mikã he miitao masa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, jeee Kristo tsulɔ ji mi.
Bɔ ni fee ni Paulo tsɔ̃ bɔfo
11Shi miihã nyɛle, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ Sanekpakpa ni mijaje lɛ, ejɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ; 12ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ ko dɛŋ mina kɛjɛ, ni jeee tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hu atsɔ̃ɔ mi, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ naa mina yɛ. 13 Ejaakɛ nyɛnu misa jeŋba lɛ he yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli. Bɔ ni miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi fe nine ni mibɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ makpãtã ehiɛ; 14ni mitee hiɛ yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli fe mitipɛŋfoi pii yɛ mijakubii ateŋ, ni mihiɛ dɔ naakpa yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ he.
15 Shi be ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie mi eto kɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ beebe ni ekɛ edromɔ lɛ tsɛ mi kɛba lɛ hiɛ, 16 akɛ eeejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, koni mijaje ehe Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mibiii gbɔmɔ ko ŋaawoo yɛ he, 17ni misaa miyaaa Yerusalɛm hu yɛ mɛi ni ji bɔfoi dani mi hu mitsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ miyiŋ kɛtee Arabia ni misaa miku misɛɛ kɛba Damasko ekoŋŋ. 18 Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii etɛ̃ lɛ, mitee Yerusalɛm ni mayale Kefa, ni mihi eŋɔɔ gbii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ; 19 shi minaaa bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko akɛ ja Yakobo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ. 20Shi nii ni miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, naa, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ mikɛɔ yɛ akɛ mimaleee.
21 No sɛɛ lɛ, miba Siria kɛ Kilikia niiaŋ. 22Shi aleee mihiɛ yɛ Yudea asafoi ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ amli; 23shi amɛnuɔ kɛkɛ akɛ akɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni be ko mli ni ewa wɔ yi lɛ, agbɛnɛ eejaje hemɔkɛyeli ni tsutsu lɛ ebɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã hiɛ lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ.” 24Ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mihewɔ.

Title: GALATIABII 2
Content:
Bɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ ŋɔ Paulo akɛ bɔfo
1 Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ misaa mikɛ Barnaba tee Yerusalɛm, ni miŋɔ Tito hu mifata mihe. 2Shi mitee yɛ kpojiemɔ ko naa, ni mikɛ Sanekpakpa ni mishiɛɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ yaŋmɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ sɔŋŋ ahiɛ bɔ ni afee ni foi ni midaa aloo ni mida lɛ akafee yaka. 3 Shi Tito tete ni kɛ mi yɔɔ ni eji Helanyo lɛ, anyɛɛɛ enɔ akɛ efo ketia. 4 Mɛi ni wo ketiafoo sane nɔ ji amale nyɛmimɛi komɛi ni ju shi kɛbafutu wɔ, ni amɛba nigii koni amɛbasara wɔhe ni wɔye yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, koni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ; 5 shi wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni wɔbo amɛ toi ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome po tete, koni Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ ahi shi daa ahã nyɛ.
6Shi mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ amɛyɔɔ gbɛi lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa lɛ, jeee mihe sane ko ni, Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ehalaaa lɛ, mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mi nɔ ko amɛfataaa he; 7 shi moŋ be ni amɛna akɛ atu foolɔi ateŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ jajemɔ lɛ awo midɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni atu ketiafolɔi anɔ lɛ awo Petro dɛŋ, 8ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsu nii yɛ Petro mli ni ehã eye bɔfo yɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ etsu nii yɛ mi hu mimli yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, 9 be ni amɛyoo dromɔ ni akɛhã mi lɛ, Yakobo kɛ Kefa kɛ Yohane ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, amɛkɛ naanyobɔɔ ninejurɔ lɛ ta mi kɛ Barnaba dɛ̃, koni wɔ lɛ wɔya jeŋmaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛ lɛ amɛya ketiafolɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ; 10 shi ohiafoi kɛkɛ amɛkɛɛ wɔkai, ni no nɔŋŋ he mɔdɛŋ mibɔ akɛ mafee.
11Shi be ni Kefa ba Antiokia lɛ midamɔ ehiɛ miku enaa, ejaakɛ eye sane ni ejaaa. 12 Ejaakɛ dani mɛi komɛi aaajɛ Yakobo ŋɔɔ aba lɛ, ekɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ yeɔ nii; shi be ni amɛba lɛ, egbala ehe shi ni etse ehe, ejaakɛ eeshe mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ gbeyei. 13Ni Yudafoi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛ lɛ fee nakai osato lɛ, ni amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ gbala Barnaba kɛtee amɛgbɛfaŋ. 14Shi be ni mina akɛ amɛnyiɛɛɛ trɔmɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ naa lɛ, mikɛɛ Kefa yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ, “Kɛ bo ni oji Yudanyo lɛ ohiɔ shi tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋnyo ni jeee tamɔ Yudafonyo lɛ, mɛɛba onyɛɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhi shi tamɔ Yudafoi?”
Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ lɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ahereɔ amɛyiwala
15Afɔ wɔ Yudafoi akɛ ni wɔjeee eshafeelɔi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli, 16 shi akɛni wɔle akɛ abuuu gbɔmɔ bem kɛjɛɛɛ Mla nitsumɔi amli, akɛ ja atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔhe Kristo Yesu nɔ wɔye, koni abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni jeee Mla nitsumɔi amli, ejaakɛ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem kɛjɛŋ Mla nitsumɔi amli. 17Shi agbɛnɛ kɛji wɔ ni wɔtaoɔ akɛ abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo mli lɛ ana wɔ akɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu eshafeelɔi ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ Kristo ji esha sɔ̃ɔlɔ lo? Dabida! 18Ejaakɛ kɛ nii ni mikumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mimaa ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔ. 19 Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ migbo yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, koni mihiɛ akã ahã Nyɔŋmɔ. 20 Asɛŋ mi kɛ Kristo; hewɔ lɛ jeee mi mihiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, shi Kristo ni hiɛ kã yɛ mimli; shi mihiɛ ni kã yɛ heloo mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni sumɔ mi ni ekɛ ehe hã yɛ mihewɔ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli mihiɛ kã yɛ. 21Mikwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla nɔ jalɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, belɛ Kristo lɛ yakatswaa egbo lɛ.

Title: GALATIABII 3
Content:
Mla loo hemɔkɛyeli
1O Galatiabii ni bɛ yitsoŋ! Namɔ kpɛ nyɛ ayɛ, nyɛ ni atɛŋ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛhiɛ akɛ mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ? 2Enɛ kɛkɛ mitaoɔ male yɛ nyɛnaa: Mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi amli nyɛna kɛjɛ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi mli? 3Aso nɛkɛ nyɛbɛ yitsoŋ? Ni nyɛkɛ mumɔ bɔ̃i lɛ, agbɛnɛ heloo nyɛkɛbaagbe naa lo? 4Nɔ babaoo ni nyɛna nɛɛ, yakatswaa nyɛna lo (kɛ eyɛ mli akɛ yakatswaa nyɛna lɛ)? 5Belɛ mɔ ni kɛ Mumɔ lɛ hãa nyɛ ni etsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi ahewɔ efeɔ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛboɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ hewɔ ni? 6 Tamɔ bɔ ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ.
7No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, amɛ ji Abrahambii. 8 Shi akɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ ena momo akɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu jeŋmaji lɛ abem yɛ hewɔ lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Abraham eto akɛ, “Omli aaajɔɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ.” 9 Belɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ Abraham heyelɔ lɛ.
10 Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ Mla nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ, loomɔ kã amɛnɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eyaaa nɔ efeee nii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ.” 11 Shi eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla mli lɛ abuŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko bem yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ “jalɔ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli mli eyi aaana wala yɛ;” 12 shi Mla lɛ, jeee hemɔkɛyeli sane ni, shi moŋ “Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli.”
13 Kristo kpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ Mla lɛ loomɔ lɛ mli, akɛni etsɔ̃ loomɔ ehã wɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsotsoro tso nɔ lɛ;” 14koni Abraham jɔɔmɔ lɛ aba jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli, ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli ana Mumɔ ni awo he shi lɛ.
Mla lɛ kɛ shiwoo lɛ
15Anyɛmimɛi, miiwie lɛ gbɔmɛiaŋ: gbɔmɔ kpãŋmɔ tete, kɛji akpɛlɛ̃ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko kwaaa, ni asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fataaa he. 16 Shi Abraham lɛ, akɛ lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ wie shiwoo wiemɔi lɛ. Ekɛɛɛ akɛ, “kɛ oshwiei lɛ” tamɔ nɔ ni ekɛ mɛi pii miiwie, shi moŋ tamɔ mɔ kome akɛ, “kɛ oshwie lɛ”, mɔ ni ji Kristo lɛ. 17 Shi nɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ji akɛ Mla ni awo yɛ afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eguuu kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ema nɔ aduatsɔ eto lɛ ni ehã shiwoo lɛ afee yaka. 18Shi kɛ gboshinii lɛ jɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ jeee shiwoo lɛ mli ejɛ dɔŋŋ; shi Abraham lɛ, shiwoo nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛke lɛ.
19 Agbɛnɛ mɛɛ ji Mla lɛ mɔ? Akɛhã ni akɛna nɔtɔmɔi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni shwie ni awo lɛ shi lɛ aaaba; ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ atsɔ̃ awo Mla lɛ, ni akɛwo mlidaamɔlɔ dɛŋ. 20Shi mlidaamɔlɔ sane lɛ, ejeee mɔ kome nɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ kome ji lɛ.
21 Agbɛnɛ Mla lɛ shiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi lɛ lo? Dabida! Ejaakɛ eji awo mla ko ni aaanyɛ wala ahã kulɛ, anɔkwale mli lɛ wɔbembuu baajɛ mla nɔyeli mli. 22 Shi moŋ; ŋmalɛ lɛ eŋa nibii fɛɛ yi ewo esha shishi, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛ shiwoo lɛ ahã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli ehã wɔye wɔhe
23Shi dani hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ba lɛ, aŋa wɔyi tamɔ gboklɛfoi awo Mla shishi kɛyashi hemɔkɛyeli ni abaajie kpo lɛ aaaba. 24No hewɔ lɛ, Mla lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔtsɔselɔ kɛmiiya Kristo ŋɔɔ koni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem. 25 Shi ni hemɔkɛyeli ba nɛɛ, wɔbɛ tsɔselɔ lɛ shishi dɔŋŋ. 26 Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli kɛtsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ; 27 ejaakɛ nyɛ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi nyɛ awo Kristo mli lɛ, nyɛwo Kristo. 28 Yudanyo bɛ lɛ, Helanyo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nyɔŋ bɛ lɛ, odehe hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nuu bɛ lɛ, yoo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ: ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli. 29 Shi kɛji Kristo nii ji nyɛ lɛ, belɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ, kɛ gboshiniiyelɔi hu yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa.

Title: GALATIABII 4
Content:
1Shi miikɛɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni gboshiniiyelɔ lɛ ji abifao lɛ, srɔto ko bɛ ekɛ nyɔŋ teŋ, tsɛbelɛ lɛ ji nii lɛ fɛɛ tsɛ; 2shi moŋ eyɛ nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsuji nukpai ashishi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni tsɛ lɛ eto lɛ. 3 Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu, be ni wɔji abifabii lɛ, akɛ wɔ wo je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anyɔŋyeli lɛ shishi. 4 Shi be ni be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kɛba, yoo fɔ lɛ, eba Mla shishi; 5 koni ebakpɔ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ bii. 6 Shi akɛni bii ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu eBi lɛ Mumɔ lɛ kɛba nyɛtsuii amli, ni eboɔ akɛ, “Aba, Ataa!” 7 No hewɔ lɛ, ojeee nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ bi ji bo, ni kɛji bi ji bo lɛ, belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ efee bo niyelɔ hu.
Galatiabii asɛɛsɛɛyaa
8Shi be mli ni nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛfee nyɛhe nyɔji nyɛhã nibii ni yɛ amɛbɔɔsu naa lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ni lɛ; 9shi agbɛnɛ moŋ ni nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ele nyɛ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkuɔ nyɛsɛɛ kɛya shishijee nibii ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ko afee ni bɛ hewalɛ ko lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛje shishi nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ? 10 Nyɛyeɔ gbii kɛ nyɔji kɛ bei kɛ afii ahe gbɛjianɔ ni ato lɛ nɔ. 11 Miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ yakatswaa migba mihe naa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ.
12 Miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtamɔa mi, ejaakɛ mi hu mitamɔ nyɛ. Nyɛfeko mi efɔŋ ko; 13 shi nyɛle akɛ heloo gbedemɔ mli mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mijaje lɛ, 14ni nɔ ni ji naatsɔ̃ɔmɔ hã nyɛ yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛgbeee he guɔ ni asaŋ nyɛnyaŋeee; shi moŋ nyɛhere mi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, tamɔ Kristo Yesu diɛŋtsɛ. 15Agbɛnɛ nɛgbɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ miiye nyɛhe odase akɛ ehiɔ feemɔ jikulɛ nyɛfamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii tete nyɛhã mi. 16 Ani mitsɔ̃ nyɛhenyɛlɔ akɛ mikɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale lɛ? 17 Jeee nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ kpakpa ko mɛi komɛi bɔɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao akɛ amɛtsi nyɛ wɔŋɔɔbaa gbɛ moŋ, koni nyɛbɔ amɛ moŋ amɛhe mɔdɛŋ. 18Shi ehi akɛ abɔ nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ daa kɛji akɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa fee, ni jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ. 19 Mibii bibii ni mikɔ̃mɔɔ kɛ nyɛfɔmɔ ekoŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaashɔ̃ Kristo subaŋ yɛ nyɛmli. 20Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ nyɛmasɛi amrɔ nɛɛ ni mitsake gbɛ nɔ ni matsɔ̃ ni mikɛ nyɛ awie, ejaakɛ miyiŋ feɔ mi kɔshikɔshi yɛ nyɛhewɔ!
Mla lɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ
21 Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhi Mla shishi lɛ, nyɛkɛa mi, ani nyɛnuuu Mla lɛ lo? 22 Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ Abraham yɛ bii enyɔ, mɔ kome lɛ, ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, ni mɔ kome hu ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ. 23 Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa; shi mɔ ni ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ shiwoo naa. 24 Nibii nɛɛ abɛ ni. Enɛɛmɛi ji kpãŋmɔi enyɔ lɛ. Ekome lɛ jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋyeli mli efɔɔ ewoɔ: no ji Hagar; 25ejaakɛ Hagar ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ yɛ Arabia; shi ekɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ekɛ ebii lɛ ji nyɔji; 26 shi ŋwɛi Yerusalɛm lɛ ji odehe lɛ, ni ji wɔnyɛ lɛ. 27 Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ,
“La nyamɔ lala, bo kene ni ofɔɔɔ;
wo nyamɔ nɔ ni obolɔ kɛ miishɛɛ,
bo ni okɔ̃mɔɔɔ;
ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ moŋ bii fa
fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ po!”
28 Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔ lɛ, shiwoo lɛ bii ji wɔ tamɔ Isak. 29 Shi tamɔ bɔ ni no be lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa lɛ waa mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ yi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ hu. 30 Shi mɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ? “Shwiemɔ nyɔŋyoo lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɔŋyoo bi lɛ ekɛ odehe lɛ bi lɛ yeŋ gboshinii lɛ.” 31 No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔjeee nyɔŋyoo lɛ bii, shi moŋ odehe lɛ bii.

Title: GALATIABII 5
Content:
Nyɛhiɛa nyɛheyeli lɛ mli
1 Kristo ehã wɔye wɔhe, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ, ni nyɛkahãa abɔa nyɛ nyɔŋyeli apã lɛ dɔŋŋ. 2 Naa, mi Paulo, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛhã afolɔ nyɛ ketia lɛ, Kristo he baŋ sɛɛnamɔ haŋ nyɛ. 3Shi misaa miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ni foɔ ketia lɛ akɛ ehiɛ nyɔmɔ, no ji akɛ eye Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. 4Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ abu nyɛ bem yɛ Mla mli lɛ, nyɛtse nyɛhe kɛjɛ Kristo he; nyɛjɛ dromɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi. 5Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɛɔ jalɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ. 6 Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, jeee ketiafoo, ni asaŋ jeee foo hu ni nyɛɔ nɔ ko efeɔ, shi moŋ hemɔkɛyeli ni tsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ nɔ etsuɔ nii lɛ.
7Kulɛ nyɛmiiya nɔ jogbaŋŋ; namɔ po tsi nyɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛkabo anɔkwale lɛ toi? 8 Jwɛŋmɔ tsake mɔ nɛɛ, jeee mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ mli ejɛ. 9 Masha bibioo hãa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ shaa. 10 Mi lɛ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ ebaŋ lɛ akɛ nyɛaajwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ kroko; shi mɔ ni haoɔ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji lɛ, esɔ̃ abua eyiteŋ. 11 Shi mi lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji ketiafoo lɛ mishiɛɔ lolo lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni awaa mi yi lolo? Nakai ni kulɛ, sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he pampi lɛ sɛɛ efo. 12 Ao mina ni kulɛ mɛi ni hãa nyɛgbugbãa lɛ folɔ amɛhenii tete po amɛshwie.
Heyeli mli shihilɛ kɛ Mumɔ naa nyiɛmɔ
