13 Ejaakɛ heyeli mli atsɛ nyɛ kɛba, anyɛmimɛi; shi nyɛheyeli lɛ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkahãa etsɔ̃a hegbɛ ehã heloo lɛ taomɔnii, shi moŋ nyɛtsɔa suɔmɔ nɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe. 14 Ejaakɛ Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli yɛ wiemɔ kome nɛɛ mli akɛ, “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.” 15Shi kɛ nyɛkɔ̃mɔkɔ̃mɔɔ nyɛhe ni nyɛyeyeɔ nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakpãtãa nyɛhe hiɛ.
16 Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji, “Nyɛnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ naa, ni nyɛfeŋ heloo akɔnɔi lɛ anaa nii.” 17 Ejaakɛ nii ni heloo lɛ taoɔ lɛ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ eyaaa, ni nii ni Mumɔ lɛ hu taoɔ lɛ kɛ heloo lɛ eyaaa; enɛɛmɛi kɛ amɛhe yeee, enɛ hewɔ lɛ nii ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ nyɛfee. 18Shi kɛ Mumɔ lɛ kpalaa nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbɛ Mla lɛ shishi.
19 Shi heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ: nomɛi ji ajwamãŋbɔɔ, mujinitsumɔ, nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, 20wɔŋjamɔ, suu, nyɛɛ, bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, bei mumɔ, atuatsemɔ, mligbalamɔ, 21 hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, dãatɔɔ, dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ nii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi, nii ni miikɛɛ nyɛ mato, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ momo lɛ, akɛ mɛi ni feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛnine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.
22Shi Mumɔ lɛ yibii ji suɔmɔ, miishɛɛ, hejɔlɛ, tsuishitoo, mlihilɛ, ejurɔfeemɔ, hemɔkɛyeli, 23 kpoofeemɔ, henɔyeli. Enɛɛmɛi lɛ mla ko eguuu. 24 Shi mɛi ni ji Kristo nii lɛ, amɛsɛŋ heloo lɛ kɛ ehiɛdɔɔnii kɛ ekɔnɔi lɛ fɛɛ. 25 Kɛji wɔhiɛ kã yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa hu. 26 Wɔkatao yaka anunyam ni wɔwowoo wɔhe mlila ni wɔhiɛ kɔ̃ wɔnanemɛi anɔ.

Title: GALATIABII 6
Content:
Nyɛkpeekpea nyɛhe kɛterea nyɛjatsui lɛ
1 Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji mɔ ko miitɔ̃ ni amɔ lɛ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛ ji mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ nyɛsaa nakai mɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ; ni ole ohe nɔ kwɛmɔ koni bo hu akaka bo. 2Nyɛjatsui lɛ nyɛkpeekpea nyɛhe kɛterea, ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ nyɛaatsɔ nyɛye Kristo mla lɛ nɔ. 3Ejaakɛ kɛji efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ mɔ ko ji lɛ be mli ni ejeee mɔ ko lɛ eeshishiu ehe. 4 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enitsumɔ ekwɛ, ni no dani eeena nɔ ko yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli kɛkɛ ni eshwã efɔ̃ nɔ, ni jeee mɔ kroko nɔ́ nɔ. 5 Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejatsu.
6 Shi mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ etsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ aja nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ.
7Nyɛkalakaa nyɛhe, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aliii lɛ. Ejaakɛ nɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɔ duɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ ebaakpa. 8 Ejaakɛ mɔ ni duɔ nii yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo mli lɛ, eheloo lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa fitemɔ kɛjɛ; shi mɔ ni duɔ nii yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa naanɔ wala kɛjɛ. 9 Shi nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa wɔ, ejaakɛ kɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui lɛ, wɔbaakpa hu yɛ be ni sa mli. 10 Belɛ be mli ni hegbɛ yɔɔ hã wɔ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔfea mɛi fɛɛ ejurɔ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni ji hemɔkɛyeli lɛ webii lɛ.
Naagbee kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ ŋamɔ
11Nyɛkwɛa ni ŋmaa okadii adaramɔ ni mikɛŋma nyɛ wolo kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minine! 12 Mɛi ni taoɔ akɛ amɛ hiɛ aba nyam yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, amɛ, amɛnyɛɔ nyɛnɔ ni afolɔ nyɛ ketia, be ni afee kɛkɛ ni akawa amɛyi yɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ hewɔ. 13Ejaakɛ mɛi ni afolɔ amɛ ketia lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tete yeee Mla lɛ nɔ; shi moŋ amɛmiitao akɛ afolɔ nyɛ ketia, koni amɛshwã amɛfɔ̃ nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nii nɛɛ nɔ. 14 Shi mi lɛ, akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ akɛ ja wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ asɛŋ je lɛ ahã mi, ni mi hu asɛŋ mi ahã je lɛ. 15 Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni asaŋ foo hu jeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ nɔ ni ji nɔ ko ji bɔɔnɔ hee tsɔ̃mɔ. 16 Ni mɛi abɔ ni aaanyiɛ yɛ nɛkɛ jeŋba he mla nɛɛ naa lɛ, hejɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ aba amɛ kɛ “Nyɔŋmɔ Israel” lɛ nɔ.
17 Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko akagba minaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu pilamɔ okadii lɛ yɛ migbɔmɔtso lɛ he.
18WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi, anyɛmimɛi. Amen.

Title: EFESOBII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Oti kome ni ma Bɔfo Paulo hiɛ ni ekɛŋma Wolo eyahã Efesobii lɛ ji akɛ eetao etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaaŋɔ adebɔɔ fɛɛ, no ji, nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, eto yitso kome shishi yɛ Kristo mli (1, 10). Oti kroko hu ji akɛ Paulo miiba Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi fiaa kwa ni amɛhi shi yɛ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo kple nɛɛ naa bɔ ni afee ni kɛtsɔ̃ amɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo ekomefeemɔ nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi adesai ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli fɛɛ afee ekome.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Paulo gbala ekomefeemɔ ni ewoɔ he ŋaa nɛɛ mli fitsofitso. Etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hala ehalamɔbii lɛ, bɔ ni kɛtsɔ̃ ebi Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ ni ehã amɛye amɛhe, kɛ bɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ fo shi kple ni ewo wɔ lɛ yinɔbaa. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ eba emajemɔ wolo nɛɛ kanelɔi fɛɛ koni amɛba amɛjeŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛ kɛ Yesu ekomefeemɔ lɛ aje kpo faŋŋ yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛwala shihilɛ mli. Paulo kɛ wiemɔi srɔtoisrɔtoi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ, kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi nyɛ fee ekome kɛhi shi lɛ, belɛ amɛ kɛ Kristo hu efee ekome. Asafo lɛ tamɔ gbɔmɔtso ni Kristo ji eyitso, aloo etamɔ tsu ni Kristo ji ekoŋtɛ, aloo etamɔ ŋa ni Kristo ji ewu. Nɛkɛ Wolo nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Bɔfo Paulo ji niŋmalɔ kpanaa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo mli ehã ena Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo faŋŋ. Enɛ hãa Kristo suɔmɔ, ehe afɔleshãa, eshaifãa kɛ dromɔ kɛ hetsemɔ feɔ faŋŋ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-2
Kristo kɛ Asafo lɛ 1.3—3.21
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli 4.1—6.20
Naamuu 6.21-24

Title: EFESOBII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ ŋma yahã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ji heyelɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ:
2Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ yɛ mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii ahewɔ
3 Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ mumɔŋ jɔɔmɔ ejɔɔ wɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ. 4 Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, lɛ ehala wɔ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ emli dani ato jeŋ shishi, koni wɔfee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni wɔhe akahi kpa ko yɛ ehiɛ. 5 Ni ejɛ suɔmɔ mli ejie wɔ eto ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ ebii yɛ Yesu Kristo hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ naa lɛ; 6 koni akɛjie edromɔ ni ekɛduro wɔ yɛ mɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ mli lɛ anunyam lɛ yi. 7 Lɛ emli wɔna kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ yɛ, ni ji nɔtɔmɔi afaa lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ elá lɛ nɔ, yɛ edromɔ falɛ lɛ naa. 8Ehã dromɔ fa kɛteke nɔ ehã wɔ yɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ fɛɛ mli lɛ. 9 Ehã wɔle eyiŋtoo ni ji teemɔ sane lɛ ni ekpɛ mli eto bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ Kristo mli. 10 Ebaahã egbɛjianɔtoo lɛ aba mli yɛ be ni sa lɛ mli, koni eŋɔ nibii fɛɛ eto yitso kome shishi yɛ Kristo mli, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. 11 Lɛ emli wɔna gboshinii lɛ hu yɛ, wɔ mɛi ni ajie wɔ ato yɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nibii fiaa lɛ gbɛjianɔtoo naa, yɛ eyiŋ ni eto bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ lɛ naa, 12bɔ ni afee ni wɔ mɛi ni wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Kristo nɔ lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ enunyam lɛ yijiemɔ. 13 Lɛ emli akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni awo he shi lɛ sɔo nyɛ hu nyɛnaa yɛ be ni nyɛnu anɔkwale lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ji yiwalaheremɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ. 14 Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ji wɔgboshinii lɛ ayibaafoonɔ kɛyashi Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enii lɛ hã enunyam lɛ yijiemɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni jeɔ kpo yɛ Kristo mli lɛ
15 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu, be ni minu nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ, 16mifɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shidaa, shi mikaiɔ nyɛ yɛ misɔlemɔi amli, 17koni wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji anunyam Tsɛ lɛ ahã nyɛ nilee kɛ kpojiemɔ mumɔ yɛ le ni nyɛaale lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli. 18Nyɛmligbɛ hiŋmɛii anɔ atse, koni nyɛna nyɛle nɔ ni ji hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni yɔɔ etsɛmɔ lɛ mli, kɛ egboshinii lɛ anunyam lɛ falɛ yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi amli, 19kɛ nɔ ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ dalɛ ni tekeɔ nɔ babaoo hãa wɔ mɛi ni wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ yɛ enyɛmɔ hewalɛ nitsumɔ lɛ naa lɛ. 20 Hewalɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ etsu yɛ Kristo mli, be ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni ekɛ lɛ ta eninejurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ, 21 yɛ onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi ni awo, jeee be nɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ, shi be ni baaba lɛ mli hu lɛ anɔ. 22 Ni ekɛ nibii fiaa ewo enajiaŋshi, ni ekɛ lɛ efee nibii fɛɛ yitso ehã asafo lɛ 23 ni ji egbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ lɛ mɔ ni ewoɔ mɛi fɛɛ obɔ̃ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli lɛ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ.

Title: EFESOBII 2
Content:
Kɛjɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli
1 Nyɛ hu kulɛ gbohii ji nyɛ yɛ nyɛ nɔtɔmɔi kɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli. 2 Ni nyɛnyiɛ yɛ mli sa yɛ no je nɛɛŋ su lɛ naa, yɛ lumɔ ni yɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli hewalɛ lɛ ni ji mumɔ ni tsuɔ nii amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ toigbele bii amli lɛ naa. 3 Amɛteŋ wɔ fɛɛ hu wɔhi wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ sa yɛ wɔheloo akɔnɔi lɛ amli, ni wɔtsu nii ni heloo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, ni wɔji bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu yɔɔ wɔnɔ yɛ wɔfɔmɔsu lɛ naa, tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
4Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa babaoo lɛ, etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ babaoo ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ nɔ, 5 ni wɔ ni kulɛ gbohii ji wɔ yɛ nɔtɔmɔi amli lɛ, etsiɛ wɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ hiɛ, dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala! 6Ni etee wɔ kɛ lɛ shi, ni eŋɔ wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ eta ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ lɛ Kristo Yesu lɛ mli. 7 Efee enɛ koni bei ni baaba lɛ amli lɛ ejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ falɛ ni teke nɔ lɛ kpo yɛ emli ni hi hã wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli. 8 Ejaakɛ dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala kɛtsɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ, ni enɛ lɛ, jeee nyɛmli ejɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ ni, 9 jeee nitsumɔi amli ejɛ koni mɔ ko akashwã. 10 Ejaakɛ enine naa nitsumɔnii ji wɔ, abɔ wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ahã nitsumɔi kpakpai ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto koni wɔnyiɛ yɛ mli lɛ.
Kristo mli lɛ Yudafonyo kɛ jeŋmajiaŋnyo efee ekome
11 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ ketiafolɔi ni akɛ niji folɔ amɛ ketia yɛ heloo mli lɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ foolɔi lɛ, 12 nyɛbɛ Kristo nakai be lɛ mli. Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ yɛ Israel maŋ biyeli gbɛfaŋ kɛ gbɔi yɛ kpãŋmɔi ni damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo nɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ hu, nyɛbɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko, ni nyɛbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tete yɛ je nɛɛŋ. 13Shi agbɛnɛ, Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ Kristo lá lɛ nɔ nyɛbɛŋkɛ. 14 Ejaakɛ lɛ ji wɔhejɔlɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ kui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ efee ekome, ni ekumɔ gbogbo afabaŋ ni yɔɔ teŋ ni ji nyɛɛ lɛ. 15 Ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo gu Mla lɛ kitãi kɛ akpɔi lɛ, koni ekɛ mɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ abɔ gbɔmɔ hee kome yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli ni ehã hejɔlɛ aba, 16 ni ekpãtã amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ, nɔ nɔ ni egbe nyɛɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ. 17 Ni eba ebajaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ hu. 18Ejaakɛ enɔ wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa gbɛ, yɛ Mumɔ kome mli, kɛyaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
19 No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ jeee gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ananemɛi maŋbii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii, 20 ni atswa nyɛ ama bɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ shishitoo lɛ ni ekoŋtɛ ji Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ. 21Emli atswa tsu muu lɛ fɛɛ afee ekome yɛ, ni eeda eefee Sɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; 22 ni emli atswaa nyɛ awoɔ afee Nyɔŋmɔ shihilɛhe yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ.

Title: EFESOBII 3
Content:
Paulo teemɔ sane lɛ bɔfo
1 Enɛ hewɔ ni mi, Paulo, ni mi ji Kristo Yesu gboklɛfonyo hã nyɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ, 2kɛji nyɛnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ edromɔ ehã mi hã nyɛsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, 3 kpojiemɔ nɔ etsɔ̃ ehã mile teemɔ sane lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni miŋma nyɛ fioo momo lɛ. 4Kɛji nyɛkane lɛ, nyɛaanyɛ nyɛyoo akɛ mina Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ shishi. 5 Teemɔ sane nɛɛ, yinɔi ni eho lɛ mli lɛ ahãaa gbɔmɛiabii ale, tamɔ bɔ ni agbɛnɛ ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ ebɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 6 No ji akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ hu niyelɔi lɛ ekomɛi kɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ ekomɛi kɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hu ekomɛi ji amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ. 7No he sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nikee nii ni atsɔ̃ ehewalɛ nitsumɔ nɔ akɛhã mi lɛ naa, 8 mi ni mi ji bibioo fe hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akɛ nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ ehã mi, akɛ mijaje Kristo nifalɛ ni anyɛɛɛ shishi ana lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ. 9 Ni mihã mɛi fɛɛ ana teemɔ sane lɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ faŋŋ, teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ yinɔi ni eho lɛ amli kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ mli lɛ, 10 koni agbɛnɛ atsɔ̃ asafo lɛ nɔ ahã onukpai kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ hegbɛ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ ale Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi pii anɔ lɛ. 11 Nyɔŋmɔ fee nii nɛɛ yɛ enaanɔ yiŋ ni eto yɛ Kristo Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli lɛ naa. 12 Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔna ekãa ni wɔkɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ hewalɛ. 13 No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, ni nyɛnijiaŋ akaje wui yɛ mimanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛnunyam ni.
Kristo Suɔmɔ
14Enɛ hewɔ ni miyaa minakutsei anaa yɛ Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ, 15mɔ mli ni nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ “tsɛ” yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ jɛ lɛ. 16 Ni yɛ enunyam falɛ naa lɛ ehã nyɛtsɔ̃ eMumɔ lɛ nɔ nyɛhe awa kpiŋtiŋŋ yɛ nyɛmli gbɔmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, 17 ni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni Kristo ahi shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli, ni nyɛshishifã amɔ shi ni nyɛma shi shiŋŋ yɛ suɔmɔ mli. 18Miisɔle ni nyɛna hewalɛ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ ayoo Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ lɛɛmɔ kɛ ekɛlɛ kɛ enɔkwɔlɛ kɛ emlikwɔlɛ lɛ. 19Ni nyɛle esuɔmɔ ni teke nilee fɛɛ lɛ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ ayimɔ nyɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
20Shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ efeɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ babaoo fe nii fɛɛ ni wɔkpaa he fai loo wɔjwɛŋɔ, yɛ ehewalɛ ni tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli lɛ naa lɛ, 21lɛ aŋɔ anunyam ahã yɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!

Title: EFESOBII 4
Content:
Ekomefeemɔ yɛ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli
1 No hewɔ lɛ, mi ni mi ji gboklɛfonyo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa tsɛmɔ ni akɛtsɛ nyɛ lɛ. 2 Nyɛnyiɛa kɛ heshibaa fɛɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ fɛɛ kɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ ni nyɛnanaa nyɛhã nyɛhe kɛ suɔmɔ. 3Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ kpãa ni fiɔ nyɛ lɛ ato ekomefeemɔ ni jɛɔ Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ. 4 Gbɔmɔtso kome kɛ Mumɔ kome yɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ kome ji nɔ ni yɔɔ tsɛmɔ ni atsɛ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ. 5 Nuŋtsɔ kome, hemɔkɛyeli kome, baptisimɔ kome, 6 Nyɔŋmɔ kome, mɛi fɛɛ aTsɛ kome mɔ ni yɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli ni eyɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli lɛ.
7 Shi wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, akɛ dromɔ lɛ ehã lɛ yɛ Kristo nikeenii asusumɔ lɛ naa. 8 No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ,
“Ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi,
ni eŋɔ nomi anom,
ni ekɛ nikeenii hã gbɔmɛi.”
9 Shi ni akɛɛ ekwɔ lɛ, te eshishiŋ, kɛjeee shi hu ekpeleke kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ shishiniiaŋ tsutsu lɛ? 10Mɔ ni kpeleke shi lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ hu ji mɔ ni kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛii fɛɛ ayiteŋ, koni eyi nii fiaa obɔ̃ lɛ. 11 Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehã mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃mɔ bɔfoi, mɛi komɛi lɛ gbalɔi, mɛi komɛi hu Sanekpakpashiɛlɔi, ni mɛi komɛi hu nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsɔɔlɔi. 12 Efee enɛ koni akɛsaa hetselɔi lɛ ahã sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ tswaa, 13kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔɔshɛ ekomefeemɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ ehe nilee mli lɛ he. Ni wɔfee nuu ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo emuuyeli lɛ susumɔ naa; 14 koni wɔkakã he wɔfee abifabii ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hosoɔ amɛ tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ nii, ni ekpalaa amɛ kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ gbɔmɛi aŋaafɔŋtoo kɛ kutumpɔo ni akɛshishiuɔ mɛi lɛ naa. 15 Shi moŋ wɔfee anɔkwafoi yɛ suɔmɔ mli, ni wɔdara yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ tamɔ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ. 16 Lɛ emli gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔ fɛɛ talɔ ni ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ emɔmɔɔ ehe eshimɔshimɔɔ ehe nɔ yɛ. Ni ehe mɔɔ ehe, ni kɛ henɔ fɛɛ henɔ miitsu enii jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehãa gbɔmɔtso lɛ daa, ni emaa ehe yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli
17 No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ ni miima nɔ mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, akɛ nyɛkanyiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋbii lɛ nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛyaka jwɛŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ dɔŋŋ, 18 ejaakɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli ewo duŋ. Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wala gbɛfaŋ, akɛni nilee ekaaa amɛ ni amɛtsui hu ekpliŋ lɛ. 19Amɛbɛ henumɔnii dɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛŋɔ amɛhe amɛhã nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ hiɛjoomɔ tsuɔ nyaŋemɔ nii fɛɛ kwa.
20Shi nyɛ lɛ, jeee nakai nyɛkase Kristo lɛ, 21kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛnu ehe, ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii yɛ emli hu, tamɔ bɔ ni ji anɔkwale yɛ Yesu mli lɛ, 22 akɛ nyɛshɛ nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ momo yɛ nyɛsa jeŋba lɛ naa gbɔmɔ ni efite yɛ shishiumɔ sɛɛdii lɛ anaa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃. 23 Ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi hei yɛ mumɔ ni nyɛkɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, 24 ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni abɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ nɔ yɛ anɔkwa jalɛ kɛ hetsemɔ mli, tamɔ atade.
25 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshɛa amale nyɛfɔa ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awie anɔkwale, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso kome henii ji wɔ. 26 Nyɛmli afũa, shi nyɛkafea esha; hulu akanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛmlifu lɛ nɔ. 27Asaŋ nyɛkaŋmɛa abonsam lɛ gbɛ. 28 Mɔ ni juɔ lɛ ekaju dɔŋŋ, shi ebɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniji atsu nitsumɔ kpakpa, koni ena nɔ ko ni ekɛhã mɔ ni ehia lɛ lɛ. 29 Wiemɔ sha ko wiemɔ sha ko akaje nyɛnaa kwraa; shi moŋ wiemɔ ni hi ni ehia koni ehã mɔ nane amɔ shi ni akɛduro mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ. 30 Ni nyɛkafea Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nidɔɔnii; lɛ emli asɔo nyɛnaa yɛ ato kpɔ̃mɔ gbi lɛ. 31 Nyɛhãa mlijoomɔ kɛ mlila kɛ mlifu kɛ blɔmɔ kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ sɛɛ afoa yɛ nyɛteŋ. 32 Shi nyɛmli ahia ahãhãa nyɛhe, nyɛmusuŋ atsɔ̃tsɔ̃a nyɛ yɛ nyɛhe, nyɛkɛfafaa nyɛhe, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛfa nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.

Title: EFESOBII 5
Content:
Nyɛnyiɛa tamɔ la bii
1 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ bii ni asumɔɔ. 2 Ni nyɛnyiɛa yɛ suɔmɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhewɔ akɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔle ni akɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni jeɔ ŋma krɔŋŋ lɛ.
3 Shi ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ fɛɛ loo hiɛjoomɔ lɛ akatsĩ tã tete yɛ nyɛteŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi. 4 Nakai nɔŋŋ akatsĩ hiɛgbejianitsumɔ kɛ kwashiai awiemɔ kɛ fɛoyeli ni ji nibii ni esaaa lɛ tã yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi. 5 Ejaakɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ akɛ, ajwamãŋbɔlɔ ko ajwamãŋbɔlɔ ko loo hiɛjoolɔ ko ni ji wɔŋjalɔ bɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ yɛ Kristo kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
6Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ wiemɔi foji miishishiua nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa toigbelebii lɛ anɔ lɛ. 7Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akabɔa amɛhe. 8 Ejaakɛ sa lɛ duŋ ji nyɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; nyɛnyiɛa tamɔ la bii. 9Ejaakɛ la lɛ yibii jeɔ kpo yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ anɔkwale fɛɛ mli. 10 Nyɛkaa nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛna nɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ; 11ni nyɛkatsua duŋ nitsumɔi ni wooo yibii lɛ eko, shi nyɛjiea amɛ shi. 12 Ejaakɛ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛteɔ lɛ, eyɛ hiɛgbele akɛ aaatsi tã tete. 13 Shi nii fɛɛ ni akɛ la jieɔ amɛ shi lɛ, anaa lɛ faŋŋ; ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni anaa lɛ faŋŋ lɛ, la ni. 14 No hewɔ ni ekɛɛ,
“Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, bo mɔ ni owɔɔ lɛ,
ni ote shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ
ni Kristo aaatso ahã bo!”
15 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ bɔ ni nyɛaanyiɛ nyɛhã, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni leee nii, shi moŋ tamɔ nilelɔi, 16 mɛi ni tsuɔ amɛbe he nii, ejaakɛ gbii nɛɛ gbii fɔ̃ji ni. 17 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛhe mɛi ni bɛ yitsoŋ, shi moŋ nyɛyoa nii ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ.
18 Ni nyɛkatɔrɔa dãa, nɔ mli ni yakayaka jeŋba yɔɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛyimɔa obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ, 19 Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe awiewiea yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, nyɛlaa ni nyɛtswaa saŋku yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ. 20Nyɛdaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa yɛ nii fiaa hewɔ yɛ wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, 21ni nyɛbabaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ Kristo gbeyeishemɔ mli.
Ŋamɛi kɛ wumɛi
22 Nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwumɛi lɛ, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛfeɔ nyɛhãa. 23 Ejaakɛ wu lɛ ji ŋa lɛ yitso, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu ji asafo lɛ yitso, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji gbɔmɔtso ni ji asafo lɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ. 24Shi tamɔ bɔ ni asafo lɛ baa ehe shi ehãa Kristo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ yei lɛ hu afee ahã amɛwumɛi lɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
25 Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ asafo lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ ehewɔ, 26koni ekɛ hejuu yɛ nu mli kɛ wiemɔ atsuu ehe ni ehã efee krɔŋkrɔŋ, 27 koni eŋɔ lɛ edamɔ shi ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɛ anunyam asafo ni kpa ko loo nɔ kũaikũai ko loo nakai nɔ ko bɛ ehe, shi moŋ efee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ. 28Nakai sa akɛ wumɛi hu asumɔ amɛŋamɛi, tamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei. Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eŋa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esumɔɔ. 29Ejaakɛ mɔ ko enyɛko lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo dã, shi moŋ elɛɔ lɛ ni ehiɛɔ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ asafo lɛ; 30 ejaakɛ egbɔmɔtso henii ji wɔ. 31 “Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ heloo kome.” 32Teemɔ sane ni tsii nɛ; mi lɛ mikɛtoɔ Kristo kɛ asafo lɛ he. 33Shi ekɔɔ nyɛ hu nyɛhe ekomekome; esa akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asumɔ eŋa, tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe; koni ŋa lɛ ashe ewu.

Title: EFESOBII 6
Content:
Bii kɛ fɔlɔi
1 Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi lɛ atoi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; ejaakɛ enɛ ja. 2 “Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ,” no ji klɛŋklɛŋ kitã ni hiɛ shiwoo akɛ, 3 “Koni ahi ahã bo, ni otsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” 4 Ni nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, shi moŋ nyɛlɛa amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ ewiemɔkɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Tsuji kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi
5 Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ, tamɔ akɛ nyɛmiifee nyɛhã Kristo; 6jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛsalɛ, shi tamɔ Kristo tsuji ni jieɔ amɛmusuŋ amɛfeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii, 7ni amɛkɛ tsuijurɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɛi. 8 Ni nyɛle akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nyɔŋ ji lɛ jio, odehe jio, nɔ ekpakpa ni efeɔ lɛ, no he nyɔmɔwoo ebaana kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ. 9 Ni nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ, nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ni nyɛfɔ̃a amɛhe gbeyeiwoo ni nyɛle akɛ nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛ egbɛfaŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ
10 Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛhe awaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ nyɛmɔ lɛ mli. 11 Nyɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ abonsam ŋaatsɔ̃i lɛ ana nyɛdamɔ. 12 Ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɛi wɔkɛna lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ onukpayelii kɛ hegbɛi kɛ je nɛɛŋ duŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ni yɔɔ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ. 13No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɔlɔa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ amɛnaa nyɛkpee yɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni be ni nyɛgbe fɛɛ naa lɛ nyɛnyɛ shi nyɛdamɔ.
14 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛkɛ anɔkwale afia nyɛhɛ ni nyɛwo jalɛ dama lɛ 15ni nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ awo nyɛnaji; 16 nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛhiɛa hemɔkɛyeli tsɛŋ lɛ mli; no nyɛkɛaanyɛ mɔfɔŋ lɛ gãimlibii ni tsoɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛgbe lɛ; 17 ni nyɛŋɔa yiwalaheremɔ akɛ dadefai, kɛ mumɔŋ klante ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ.
18 Ni nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ fɛɛ asɔlea be fɛɛ be yɛ mumɔ mli, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛsaraa, ni nyɛkãa he daa nyɛkpaa fai nyɛhãa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ fɛɛ 19 kɛ mi hu, koni kɛ migbele minaa lɛ, akɛ wiemɔ awo minaa ni mikɛ ekãa ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ mli teemɔ sane lɛ 20 ni mitsuɔ he nii akɛ bɔfo yɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ mli nɛɛ. Nyɛkpaa fai koni yɛ ejajemɔ lɛ mli lɛ mawie kɛ ekãa bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ.
Naagbee ŋamɔ
21 Shi bɔ ni afee ni nyɛ hu nyɛle bɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛ nii ni mitsuɔ lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ nyɛmi Tihiko ni ji sɔ̃ɔlɔ anɔkwafo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ aaagba nyɛ fɛɛ. 22 Ejaakɛ enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛle bɔ ni wɔyɔɔ, ni ehã nyɛtsui anyɔ nyɛmli.
23Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛmimɛi lɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ.
24Dromɔ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ ahi shi. Amen!

Title: FILIPIBII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Filipibii awolo lɛ Bɔfo Paulo ji mɔ ni ŋma emaje eklɛŋklɛŋ asafo ni eyato shishi yɛ Ablotsiri yɛ Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni atsɛɔ lɛ Makedonia nɔ lɛ. Be ni eŋma wolo nɛɛ, eyɛ mɔɔŋ, ni nɔ ni gbaa enaa ni ehãaa etsui anyɔ emli kwraa ji akɛ mɛi komɛi ni kɛɛ Kristo shiɛlɔi ji amɛ lɛ ete shi eshi lɛ Paulo, in asaŋ, amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi hu miitsɔ̃ɔ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ yɛ Filipi asafo lɛ mli. Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, akɛni Paulo heɔ Kristo nɔ eyeɔ jogbaŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, ewolo lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ.
Nɔ titri hewɔ ni eŋma wolo lɛ ji akɛ ekɛyada Filipi Kristofoi lɛ ashi akɛ be ni nibii amli yawa hã lɛ yɛ ehiamɔ beiaŋ lɛ, amɛmaje lɛ keenii babaoo. Bɔfo Paulo tsɔ̃ wolo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ ekɛyawo amɛ ekãa, tsɛ nibii srɔtoi miigba lɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa moŋ. Ebi amɛ hu ni amɛba amɛhe shi tamɔ Yesu, fe nɔ ni amɛaaŋmɛ gbɛ ni ahi ahã ŋkome shihilɛ kɛ hewoo tridii afee amɛhe nɔ.
Ekai amɛ akɛ amɛ kɛ Yesu efee ekome yɛ amɛwala shihilɛ mli, ni enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenii ni amɛna kɛtsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ, shi moŋ jeee yɛ Yudafoi lɛ aMla kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi anɔ ni amɛyeɔ hewɔ ni. Ema miishɛɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ Yesu feɔ ekome kɛhiɔ shi lɛ naa lɛ nɔ aduatsɔ.
Nibii pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni Paulo ma nɔ mi yɛ ewolo lɛ mli lɛ nomɛi baa nɛɛ: miishɛɛ kɛ he ni aheɔ he ayeɔ, ekomefeemɔ kɛ hiɛmiamɔ yɛ Kristofoi ahemɔkɛyeli kɛ jeŋba mli. Asaŋ wolo lɛ jie suɔmɔ kple ni Bɔfo Paulo yɔɔ hã asafo ni yɔɔ Filipi lɛ kpo faŋŋ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-11
Nibii ni kɔɔ Paulo he krɛdɛɛ 1.12-26
Wala yɛ Kristo mli 1.27—2.18
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito he gbɛjianɔtoo 2.19-30
Kɔkɔbɔɔ yɛ henyɛlɔi kɛ oshrãi ahe 3.1—4.9
Paulo kɛ enanemɛi ni yɔɔ Filipi lɛ 4.10-20
Naamuu 4.21-23

Title: FILIPIBII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Yesu Kristo tsuji lɛ; ŋma yahã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Yesu Kristo mli yɛ Filipi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi kɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
2 Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Paulo sɔle hã Filipibii lɛ
3 Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi be fɛɛ be ni mikaiɔ nyɛ 4yɛ midaa faikpamɔi fɛɛ ni mikpaa mihãa nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni mikɛ miishɛɛ kpaa fai, 5yɛ wa ni nyɛwa yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛfaŋ kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ kɛbashi be nɛ lɛ hewɔ; 6 ni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ, akɛ mɔ ni bɔ̃i nitsumɔ kpakpa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeekã he kɛyashi eeegbe naa yɛ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ. 7Eja akɛ mijwɛŋɔ enɛ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛkã mitsui nɔ, nyɛ ni yɛ migboklɛi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ kɛ enɔmimaa fɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛ kɛ mi fɛɛ lɛ dromɔ lɛ niyelɔi ji wɔ lɛ. 8Bɔ ni mikɛ Yesu Kristo mlitsɔlɛ lɛ shweɔ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji midasefonyo.
9Ni enɛ he fai mikpaa, akɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ afa kɛya nɔ, ni eteke nɔ yɛ nilee kɛ sɛɛyoomɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ 10 ni nyɛyoo nii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, koni nyɛfee krɔŋŋ ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe kɛyashi Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ; 11 ni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ jalɛ yibii ni awoɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, hã Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam kɛ yijiemɔ.
Kristo ji wala, ni gbele lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni
12 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ saji ni ba minɔ lɛ ehã Sanekpakpa lɛ eshwere moŋ. 13 Ni Asaŋ ehã migboklɛi lɛ eje shi faŋŋ yɛ Kaisare asraafoi amɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, akɛ Kristo hewɔ awo mi tsuŋ lɛ. 14Ni nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo etsɔ̃ migboklɛi lɛ anɔ ena hewalɛ ni amɛkɛ ekãa babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ miijaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛsheee gbeyei.
15Mɛi komɛi lɛ, hetsɛ̃ kɛ bei hewɔ amɛshiɛɔ Kristo lɛ; shi mɛi komɛi hu kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa shiɛɔ. 16 Mɛnɛɛmɛi jɛɔ suɔmɔ mli shiɛɔ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ lɛ hewɔ ni mikã biɛ nɛɛ. 17Shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, amɛkɛ mligbalamɔ mumɔ shiɛɔ Kristo, ni jeee krɔŋŋ ni, shi moŋ amɛjwɛŋmɔ ji akɛ amɛtee amanehulu shi amɛwo mi yɛ migboklɛi lɛ amli.
18 No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni? Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, kwa akwaa jio, anɔkwale naa jio, Kristo kɛ̃ ashiɛɔ lɛ, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ miyɛ miishɛɛ. Ni asaŋ mana miishɛɛ, 19 ejaakɛ mile akɛ enɛ baatsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ yɛ nyɛfaikpamɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo Mumɔ lɛ yelikɛbuamɔ naa. 20 Migbɛkwɛmɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛkɛ ji akɛ mihiɛ akagbo yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, shi moŋ, bɔ ni afeɔ daa lɛ, nakai agbɛnɛ hu akɛ ekãa fɛɛ aaawo Kristo hiɛ nyam yɛ migbɔmɔtso mli, yɛ wala mli jio, gbele mli jio. 21 Ejaakɛ yɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ, Kristo ji wala, ni gbele lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni. 22 Shi kɛji wala yɛ heloo nɛɛ mli hãa mitsuɔ nii ni woɔ yibii lɛ, mileee emli nɔ ni makɔ; 23 shi miihao yɛ nibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ; miishwe ni maje mli ni mikɛ Kristo ayahi shi, ejaakɛ no hi aahu; 24shi nyɛhewɔ lɛ heloo mli shihilɛ lɛ he ehĩa fe no. 25Ni akɛni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mile akɛ mahi shi, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaahi shi, koni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ashwere, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ yɛ mli; 26koni nyɛmli ni baafli nyɛ yɛ mihewɔ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ bakpe ekoŋŋ lɛ ateke nɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
27 Nɔ kome kɛkɛ ji akɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ, koni kɛ miba mibana nyɛ jio, mikɛ nyɛ bɛ jio, manu nyɛhe akɛ nyɛdamɔ shi yɛ mumɔ kome mli, ni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome miipele Sanekpakpa lɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he, 28ni nyɛkahãa henyɛlɔi lɛ miiwoa nyɛhe gbeyei yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli; nyɛgbeyei ni nyɛsheŋ lɛ ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ okadi hã amɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, eji yiwalaheremɔ okadi hã nyɛ, ni enɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ. 29Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ aduro nyɛ yɛ Kristo hewɔ, jeee ni nyɛhe enɔ nyɛye kɛkɛ, shi moŋ akɛ nyɛna nɔ hu yɛ ehewɔ. 30 Ni nakai ta kome lɛ ni nyɛna ni miiwu, ni agbɛnɛ nyɛnuɔ akɛ miiwu lolo lɛ, no nɔŋŋ mli nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.

Title: FILIPIBII 2
Content:
Kristo heshibaa kɛ egbojee
1No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ Kristo mli hewalɛwoo ko yɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ miishɛjemɔ ko yɛ, kɛ mumɔŋ naanyobɔɔ ko yɛ, kɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ko yɛ lɛ, 2nyɛhãa mimiishɛɛ lɛ ayia obɔ̃, akɛ nyɛmiijwɛŋ nɔ kome, nyɛhiɛ suɔmɔ kome, susuma kome, mumɔ kome. 3 Ni nyɛkafea nɔ ko kɛ mligbalamɔ mumɔ loo yaka anunyam taomɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ abua nyɛnanemɛi akɛ amɛfe nyɛ. 4 Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akafo enɔ mli, shi moŋ efo enaanyo nɔ mli. 5Nɔ ni Kristo Yesu hu jwɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ nyɛjwɛŋa.
6 Lɛ mɔ ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su moŋ,
shi ebuuu hegbɔ ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ye lɛ akɛ nɔ
ko ni sa akɛ ehiɛ mli kpɛŋŋ,
7 Moŋ ejie efɔ̃ shi.
Eŋɔ tsulɔ su efɔ̃ enɔ,
Etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ, ni enifeemɔ gbɛfaŋ hu ana lɛ akɛ
gbɔmɔ.
8 Eba ehe shi ni ebo toi kɛtee gbele mli,
kɛtee sɛŋmɔtso nɔ gbele mli tete.
9 Enɛ hewɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo enɔ gojoo,
ni eduro lɛ gbɛi ni ta gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi nɔ,
10 koni mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ
nɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ
ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nakutso akula shi
yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli;
11ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi agba mli kpoo akɛ
Yesu Kristo ji Nuŋtsɔ,
kɛwo Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Nyɛtamɔ kanei yɛ je lɛ mli
12 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛboɔ toi daa nɛɛ, jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ titri lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ atsua nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he nii; 13 ejaakɛ suɔmɔ ni aaasumɔ jio, feemɔ ni aaafee jio, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛ mli bɔ ni lɛ etaoɔ.
14 Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ ni huhuuhu wiemɔi kɛ naataamɔ akahi mli; 15 koni nyɛhe akahi shwamɔ, ni nyɛfee mɛi krɔŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ bii ni he bɛ kpa ko yɛ yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ ni bɛ eŋɛlɛnɔ nɛɛ mli, mɛi ateŋ ni nyɛtsoɔ tamɔ kanei yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ. 16 Ni nyɛhiɛ wala wiemɔ lɛ mli, koni etsɔ̃ shwãanɔ ehã mi yɛ Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ, akɛ mifoijee lɛ efeee yaka ni mideŋmegbomɔ lɛ hu efeee efolo.
17 Shi kɛji afɔse milá ashwie nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni akɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ afɔle lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, miyɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaana tsuijurɔ; 18 nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛ hu nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mi anaa tsuijurɔ.
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito
19Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ etsɛŋ ni matsu Timoteo nyɛŋɔɔ, koni kɛji minu bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni mi hu mitsui anyɔ mimli. 20 Ejaakɛ mibɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ mi hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni nyɛhe sane dɔɔ lɛ krɔŋŋ tamɔ lɛ. 21 Ejaakɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnii amɛpleɔ, shi jeee Kristo Yesu nii. 22Shi nyɛle etɛ naa, akɛ ekɛ mi sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ he tamɔ bi kɛ etsɛ. 23No hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ kã enɔ, akɛ amrɔ ni mana misane lɛ naa lɛ, matsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ. 24 Shi miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu, etsɛŋ ni maba.
25 Kɛ̃lɛ mijwɛŋ akɛ ehĩa akɛ matsu wɔnyɛmi Epafrodito, ni ji minaanyo nitsulɔ kɛ minaanyo tabilɔ kɛ nyɛbɔfo kɛ mihiamɔnii ahe sɔ̃ɔlɔ hu lɛ, nyɛŋɔɔ; 26ejaakɛ eeshwe nyɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛni nyɛnu akɛ ehe miiye hewɔ lɛ eehao. 27Ehe ye lɛɛlɛŋ, ni ebɛŋkɛ gbele tã, shi Nyɔŋmɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ, ni jeee lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mi hu, koni mikaye ŋkɔmɔ mito ŋkɔmɔ nɔ. 28No hewɔ titri mikɛ oyaiyeli tsu lɛ lɛ, koni kɛ nyɛna lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ ni mi hu mikaye ŋkɔmɔ tuutu. 29 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ aherea lɛ atuu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛbua gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo; 30ejaakɛ Kristo nitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ gbele kwraa, ni ekɛ ehe wo osharã mli, koni ebaye nyɛnajiaŋ kɛsɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni ehiii nyɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ.

Title: FILIPIBII 3
Content:
Anɔkwa jalɛ
1 Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli! Akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, efeee mi ahuntoo, ni ehãa nyɛfeɔ shweshweeshwe. 2 Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbei lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nitsulɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso henii folɔmɔ lɛ he! 3 Ejaakɛ wɔ moŋ wɔji ketiafolɔi lɛ, wɔ mɛi ni wɔjaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ mumɔ naa, ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔtso nifeemɔ nɔ lɛ, 4 tsɛbelɛ miyɛ nɔ ko yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ tete ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ̃ nɔ. Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ eyɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, miyɛ nɔ ni fe no. 5 Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ afo mi ketia, Israel fɔmɔbi kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli nyo ji mi, Hebrinyo krɛdɛɛ mli Hebrinyo, ni yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, Farisifonyo, 6 ni jamɔ he hiɛdɔɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asafo lɛ yiwalɔ ji mi, ni yɛ jalɛ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mihe bɛ shwamɔ ko. 7 Shi kɛ̃lɛ nii ni ji sɛɛnamɔ hã mi sa lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ mibu amɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ. 8Anɔkwale mli lɛ mibuɔ fɛɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu, miNuŋtsɔ lɛ, he nilee ni fe nii fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ; lɛ ehewɔ ni nii fɛɛ ebɔ mi, ni mibuɔ amɛ akɛ tumo nɔ nii, koni mana Kristo, 9 ni ana mi yɛ emli, akɛ mibɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mijalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli, shi moŋ jalɛ ni tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa miyɔɔ, 10 ni male lɛ Kristo eshitee lɛ hewalɛ lɛ; ni mana emanehului lɛ eko, ni matamɔ lɛ yɛ egbele lɛ gbɛfaŋ; 11akɛ aleenɔ mana mashɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ he lo.
Foijee kɛ oti lɛ heshɛɛ
12 Jeee akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ momo aloo mihi kɛwula shi momo, shi miipele mihiɛ gbɛ ni minine ashɛ nɔ, gbii abɔ ni Kristo Yesu nine eshɛ mi hu minɔ lɛ. 13Anyɛmimɛi, mibuuu mihe akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ, shi nɔ kome kɛkɛ mifeɔ: Nii ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ mijieɔ mihiɛ yɛ nɔ, shi nii ni yɔɔ hiɛgbɛ lɛ moŋ mikpãa mimli ni mashɛ he, 14 ni miitiu oti lɛ kɛyashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛmɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ he juromɔ nɔ lɛ he.
15 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔ mɛi abɔ ni wɔdara yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ wɔjwɛŋa nakai. Ni kɛ nɔ ko yɛ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ ekroko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie no hu kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ. 16 Shi nɔ ni wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ kɛbashi he ni wɔshɛ nɛɛ, wɔya nɔ wɔkɛ no nɔŋŋ aba wɔjeŋ.
17 Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkasea mi. Nyɛkwɛa mɛi ni nyiɛɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔtoɔ nyɛ okadi lɛ. 18 Mikɛɛ nyɛ shii abɔ, ni miikɛɛ nyɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ yaafonui, akɛ mɛi pii yɛ ni baa amɛjeŋ akɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ henyɛlɔi. 19 Amɛnaagbee ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni amɛmusu taomɔnii ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛhiɛgbele mli amɛnunyam yɔɔ, shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ.
20 Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔmaŋ lɛ ŋwɛi eyɔɔ, he ni wɔkwɛɔ yiwalaherelɔ ni ji Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛɔ lɛ. 21 Lɛ ebaatsake wɔgbɔmɔtso ni hiɛ bɛ nyam lɛ koni etamɔ enunyam gbɔmɔtso lɛ su, yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔ ni ekɛnyɛɔ eŋɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ewoɔ eshishi hu lɛ naa lɛ.

Title: FILIPIBII 4
Content:
Ŋaawoi
1 No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ ni mishweɔ, mimishɛɛ kɛ mikekre, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ nakai yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ!
2Miikpa Euodia fai, ni miikpa Sintike fai, akɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ afee ekome yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli. 3 Hɛɛ, bo hu miibao, minaanyo sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ anɔkwaleŋ, ni oye obua yei nɛɛ; ejaakɛ amɛfata mihe kɛpele Sanekpakpa lɛ he, kɛ Klɛmente hu kɛ minanemɛi nitsulɔi krokomɛi ni amɛgbɛi yɔɔ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ.
4 Nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli daa! Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ! Nyɛmii ashɛa! 5Nyɛmlijɔlɛ lɛ nyɛhãa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ alea! Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. 6 Nyɛkahaoa yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he, shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ shidaa atsĩa nyɛtaomɔnii lɛ atã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 7 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ hejɔlɛ ni fe jwɛŋmɔi fɛɛ lɛ aaabu nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli!
8 Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nii abɔ ni ji anɔkwa, nii ni sa woo, nii ni ja, nii ni he tse, nii ni yɔɔ fɛo, nii ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa lɛ fɛɛ, kɛji jeŋba kpakpa ko yɛ, kɛji yijiemɔ ko hu yɛ lɛ, enɛɛmɛi ahe nyɛjwɛŋa! 9 Nii hu ni nyɛkase ni nyɛmɔ mli ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna yɛ mihe lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ nyɛfea, ni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Shidaa yɛ Filipibii anikeenii lɛ ahe
10Shi mina miishɛɛ babaoo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛhã mi nɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ efrɔke ekoŋŋ; nyɛjwɛŋɔ he, shi hegbɛ ni nyɛyanaaa. 11 Jeee akɛ fimɔ ni efi mi hewɔ miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi lɛ mikase akɛ shihilɛ fɛɛ shihilɛ ni miyɔɔ mli lɛ mimii ashɛ he. 12 Mile ohia mli shihilɛ, ni mile kpɔtɔɔyeli hu; mihe ehomɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ mli: tɔɔ kɛ hɔ̃mɔ, ninamɔ kɛ ohiayeli. 13 Minyɛɔ nii fɛɛ mifeɔ yɛ mɔ ni wajeɔ mi lɛ mli.
14Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ, akɛ nyɛbaye nyɛbua mi yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ. 15 Shi nyɛ Filipibii diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛle akɛ, Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee lɛ mli, be ni miyiŋ kɛjɛ Makedonia lɛ, asafo ko bɛ ni kɛ mi bɔɔ naanyo yɛ hãmɔ kɛ hemɔ gbɛfaŋ, akɛ ja nyɛ kɛkɛ; 16 ejaakɛ be ni miyɔɔ Tesalonika lɛ hu nyɛtsu shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ abahã mi nii ni hiaa mi lɛ. 17 Jeee akɛ nikeenii mitaoɔ; shi moŋ miitao yibii ni baahã nyɛkɔntaa lɛ afa. 18 Shi mina nii fɛɛ ni eteke nɔ; ni akɛni minine eshɛ nii ni nyɛkɛmaje Epafrodito kɛbahã mi lɛ nɔ nɛɛ, mina nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ; eji ŋmajee kpakpa kɛ afɔle kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 19MiNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛ nii ni hiaa nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ enifalɛ lɛ naa yɛ anunyam mli, yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
20Shi anunyam ahã wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Naagbee ŋamɔi
21Nyɛŋaa hetselɔ fɛɛ hetselɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli nyɛhãa mi. Nyɛmimɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ miibi nyɛ. 22Hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kaisare we lɛ, miibi nyɛ.
23WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi!

Title: KOLOSEBII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Bɔfo Paulo ŋma ewolo nɛɛ eyahã asafo ni yɔɔ Kolose lɛ. Kolose lɛ eji Asia Fio maŋ ko ni ye Efeso bokãgbɛ. Asafo nɛɛ, jeee Paulo ji mɔ ni yato shishi, shi moŋ eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ ebaakwɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, lɛ Paulo lɛ, etsuɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛlɔi ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ kɛyaa jɛi. Efeso lɛ, Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ maŋ wulu ni, ni Paulo ena ele akɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi komɛi ete shi yɛ Kolose ni amɛkɛ hiɛdɔɔ miijaje akɛ dani mɔ obaana ole Nyɔŋmɔ ni ona yiwalaheremɔ kɛ mɔ shi lɛ, sa ni doo oja “mumɔŋ nɔyelɔi kɛ onukpai komɛi.” Kɛshi enɛ nɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔlɔi nɛɛ miifi nɔ veveeve akɛ sa ni ofee kusumi komɛi tamɔ akɛ ketiafoo nɛkɛ, ni asaŋ oye mlai fɛɛ ni kɔɔ niyenii srɔtoi kɛ nibii krokomɛi ahe lɛ hu nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yɛ ewolo lɛ mli lɛ, Paulo wie eshi tsɔ̃ɔmɔi gbohii nɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ji anɔkwa Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ. Eshɛɛwiemɔ lɛ mli agugu ji akɛ Yesu Kristo pɛ ji mɔ ni nyɛɔ hãa yiwalaheremɔ yeɔ obɔ̃. Ehã anu shishi faŋŋ akɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔi nɛɛ amɛhãa hemɔkɛyeli gbugbãa ejaakɛ amɛshwieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ Kristo he kɛyaa shɔŋŋ. Asaŋ, Kristo nɔ tsɔ̃ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ je lɛ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ enɔ ebaatsɔ̃ ni ehã je lɛ aku esɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ. Akɛ aaahere je lɛ yiwala lɛ, fɛɛ damɔ wɔ kɛ Kristo ekomefeemɔ nɔ. Agbɛnɛ hu, Paulo gbla bɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni he jraa nɛɛ kɔɔ mɛi abɔ ni heɔ Kristo nɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ awala he lɛ mli fitsofitso.
Nɔ kome ni esaaa ni hiɛ kpaa nɔ ji akɛ Tihiko ni Paulo tsu kɛ ewolo lɛ akɛ ekɛahã Kolosebii lɛ, Onesimo kɛ lɛ tee, ni lɛ Onesimo nɛɛ nyɔŋ ji lɛ, ni lɛ ehewɔ tutuuŋtu Paulo ŋma wolo eyahã Filemon lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-8
Kristo su kɛ enitsumɔ 1.9—2.19
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli 2.20—4.6
Naamuu 4.7-18

Title: KOLOSEBII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo 2 ŋma yahã nyɛmimɛi hetselɔi kɛ heyelɔi yɛ Kristo mli ni yɔɔ Kolose lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Shidaa sɔlemɔ
3Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ shi yɛ nyɛhewɔ daa nɛɛ yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli. 4 Ejaakɛ wɔnu nyɛKristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛ sumɔɔ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ he 5yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni akɛto ahã nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ. Nyɛnu enɛ momo yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ mli. 6Sanekpakpa lɛ eshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni eyɔɔ yɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni eewo yibii ni eeshwere, tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ yɛ nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ. 7 Nyɛkase enɛ yɛ Epafra, wɔnaanyo tsulɔ ni wɔsumɔɔ, ni ji Kristo anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ hã nyɛ lɛ naa. 8Lɛ ebagba wɔ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwoɔ nyɛmli lɛ he sane.
9 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ hu, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni wɔnu lɛ, wɔfɔ̃ko sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ nyɛ hãmɔ, koni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ esuɔmɔnaanii alee yɛ mumɔŋ nilee kɛ shishinumɔ fɛɛ mli. 10 Koni nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni asa ehiɛ kwraa ni nyɛwo yibii yɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa mli. Enɛ ahã nyɛshwere yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee mli 11ni awaje nyɛ kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ enunyam nyɛmɔ lɛ naa. No ahã nyɛnyɛ nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ ni nyɛto nyɛtsui shi kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli. 12 Ni nyɛdaa Tsɛ lɛ shi, mɔ ni hã wɔfee mɛi ni sa krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ la lɛ mli lɛ agboshinii lɛ eko yeli. 13 Ni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ duŋ hewalɛ lɛ mli kɛtee esuɔmɔ Bi lɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ; 14 lɛ emli wɔna kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ ni ji wɔhe eshai faa lɛ yɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ su ni Kristo hiɛ kɛ enitsumɔ
15 Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni anaaa lɛ subaŋ, lɛ enɔ atsɔ abɔ nii fɛɛ. 16 Ejaakɛ emli abɔ nii fiaa yɛ, nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nii ni anaa kɛ nii ni anaaa, maŋtsɛ sɛii jio, nɔyelii jio, onukpayelii jio, hegbɛi jio, nii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enɔ atsɔ̃ abɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ abɔ ahã. 17 Eyɛ dani nii fiaa yɔɔ, ni emli nii fiaa yɔɔ. 18 Ni lɛ ji gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ji asafo lɛ yitso, lɛ ji shishijee lɛ, gbohii ateŋ kromɔbi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ nii fiaa mli. 19 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esu muu lɛ fɛɛ ahi emli. 20 Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ esɛŋmɔtso nɔ lá lɛ nɔ ekɛ hejɔlɛ ba, ni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kpãtã, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ. 21 Nyɛ ni sa ni yɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ kɛ nyɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ji ahewɔ lɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji kɛ henyɛlɔi ji nyɛ. 22 Agbɛnɛ ekɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele nɔ ekpãtã nyɛ ni ekɛ nyɛ edamɔ shi akɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni he bɛ kpa ko ni sane ko bɛ amɛhe yɛ ehiɛ. 23Shi esa ni nyɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ shishitoo lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkatsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ he, Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛnu ni ashiɛɔ atsɔ̃ɔ bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi, ni mi Paulo misɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he lɛ.
Sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ ni Paulo tsu hã Kristo Asafo lɛ
24 Agbɛnɛ mimii shɛɔ yɛ mimanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ amli, ni mikɛ miheloo naa Kristo amanehului ni shwɛ lɛ mikɛwoɔ amɛ obɔ̃ hã egbɔmɔtso ni ji esafo lɛ. 25Ni mitsɔ̃ esafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ nitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etu ewo midɛŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ naa, akɛ mashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛwula shi lɛ. 26 Enɛ ji teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ teteete kɛ yinɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. 27 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ ahã amɛle nɔ ni ji nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ anunyam falɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ. Teemɔ sane nɛɛ ji akɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛmli koni nyɛna anunyam lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ. 28 Lɛ ehe sane wɔjajeɔ, ni wɔwoɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ŋaa, ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ nilee nɛɛ fɛɛ, koni wɔkɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ adamɔ shi akɛ mɔ ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo mli. 29No he deŋme migboɔ ni mipeleɔ yɛ ehewalɛ ni tsuɔ nii kɛ hewalɛ yɛ mimli lɛ naa.

Title: KOLOSEBII 2
Content:
Nyɛkaŋmɛa gbɛ ni mɔ ko hã nyɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbugbãa
1Ejaakɛ miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle nɔ pelemɔ ni mli wa ni mipeleɔ yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi abɔ ni enako mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ahewɔ. 2Miifee enɛ koni amɛtsɛ amɛtsui amɛŋmɛ amɛmli ni amɛfee ekome yɛ suɔmɔ mli ni amɛna hewalɛ falɛ fɛɛ ni anaa kɛjɛɔ niiashishinumɔ mli lɛ ni amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ ni ji Kristo. 3 Mɔ mli ni akɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee jwetrii lɛ fɛɛ etee yɛ lɛ. 4 Shi miikɛɛ enɛ, koni mɔ ko kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko akashishiu nyɛ. 5 Ejaakɛ kɛ mikɛ nyɛ bɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli po, mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni mimii shɛɔ kɛ mikwɛ bɔ ni nyɛdamɔ shi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ nyɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ shifimɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyia obɔ̃ kɛ Kristo wala
6No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛhere Kristo Yesu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ atuu lɛ, nyɛnyiɛa yɛ emli. 7 Ni nyɛshishifã amɔ̃ shi ni atswa nyɛ ama enɔ ni nyɛfi shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ ni nyɛteke nɔ kɛ shidaa.
8 Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahĩa, koni mɔ ko kɛ jeŋ nilee kɛ yaka shishiumɔ ni damɔ gbɔmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anɔ, shi jeee Kristo nɔ lɛ, akaŋɔ nyɛ nom. 9 Ejaakɛ Kristo mli Nyɔŋmɔ su muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso su mli; 10 ni nyɛye emuu yɛ emli, lɛ mɔ ni ji onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ yitso lɛ. 11 Lɛ emli afolɔ nyɛ ketia hu yɛ, jeee ketia ni akɛ nine fo, shi moŋ ketiafoo ni ji heloo gbɔmɔtso lɛ jiemɔ yɛ Kristo ketiafoo lɛ mli. 12 Ejaakɛ afu nyɛ kɛ lɛ yɛ baptisimɔ lɛ mli; ni emli hu atee nyɛ shi yɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa. 13 Ni nyɛ ni nyɛ ji gbohii yɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛheloofoo lɛ mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ wala, ni ekɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa nyɛ. 14 Ni egbe wɔnyɔmɔ ni wɔhiɛ ni aŋma kɛ ekpɔi lɛ, ni ejie kɛtee, ni ekala ekpɛtɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he. 15Ni ekpɔlɔ onukpayelii kɛ hewalɛi lɛ ahe nii, ni ebɔ amɛ ahora faŋŋ, ni enyã yɛ amɛnɔ.
16 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miikojoa nyɛ yɛ niyeli loo ninumɔ loo gbii juji loo nyɔji hei loo hejɔɔmɔ gbii agbɛfaŋ, 17 ejaakɛ nii ni baaba lɛ asusuma kɛkɛ ni, shi nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji Kristo. 18 Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ taomɔ ni etaoɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ aja ŋwɛi bɔfoi miishɔ̃ nyɛjuromɔnii lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ. Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni edamɔ ji ninai, ni eheloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hãa ewoɔ ehe nɔ efolo, 19 ni ehiɛɛɛ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ mli, mɔ mli ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔi kɛ fai lɛ anɔ enaa nii ni hiaa lɛ kɛjeɔ ni emɔmɔ̃ɔ ehe kɛshimɔ̃ɔ ehe nɔ kɛdaa bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ lɛ.
20 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛkɛ Kristo egbo ni je nɛɛŋ shishijeenii bɛ nyɛnɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛhiɔ shi tamɔ nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kamɔ̃ lolo yɛ je nɛɛŋ, ni nyɛhãa awoɔ nyɛ akpɔi akɛ, 21“Kaamɔ mli, ni kaasa onaa, ni kaata he tete” lɛ? 22 Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ji nibii ni hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ amɛhe nitsumɔ mli; amɛ ji akpɔi ni awo yɛ gbɔmɛi akitãi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anaa. 23 Suɔmɔnaa jamɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɔtso yiwaa hãa nibii nɛɛ feɔ tamɔ nɔ ni nilee yɛ mli nɛ, shi yɛ heloo akɔnɔ naatsii gbɛfaŋ lɛ, ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.

Title: KOLOSEBII 3
Content:
Nyɛhia shi yɛ Kristo ni ete shi lɛ hewalɛ mli
1 No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ atee nyɛ kɛ Kristo shi lɛ, nyɛtaoa nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, he ni Kristo yɔɔ ni eta Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ yɛ lɛ. 2 Nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe nyɛjwɛŋa, jeee nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. 3 Ejaakɛ nyɛgboi, ni akɛ nyɛwala lɛ kɛ Kristo etee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli. 4 Be ni Kristo, mɔ ni ji wɔwala lɛ, aaapue lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ lɛ aaapue yɛ anunyam mli.
Shihilɛ momo lɛ kɛ ehee lɛ
5 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea nyɛhenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ: ajwamãŋbɔɔ, nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ, mlila, akɔnɔ fɔŋ, kɛ hiɛjoomɔ ni ji wɔŋjamɔ lɛ. 6 Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa toigbelebii lɛ anɔ lɛ. 7Enɛɛmɛi amli nyɛ hu nyɛnyiɛ sa, be ni nyɛhi shi yɛ mli lɛ.
8 Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛshɛrɛa nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea: mlifu, mlila kɛ shwee ni ashweɔ mɔ efɔŋ, kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ hiɛgbejiawiemɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛdaaŋ. 9 Nyɛkamalemalea nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛjie gbɔmɔ momo lɛ kɛ enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, 10 ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni aafee lɛ ehee yɛ ebɔlɔ lɛ subaŋ nɔ, koni ele lɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ. 11 Enɛ mli lɛ Helanyo kɛ Yudanyo, ketiafolɔ kɛ foolɔ, gbɔ, Sikitianyo, nyɔŋ kɛ odehe ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ Kristo ji nii fiaa yɛ mɛi fɛɛ mli.
12 No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii, mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛ suɔmɔ mɛi ji nyɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛwoa musuŋtsɔlɛ, mlihilɛ, heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ, kpoofeemɔ, tsuishitoo. 13 Ni kɛji mɔ ko kɛ mɔ ko na sane ko lɛ, nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛfafaa nyɛhe; tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu kɛfa nyɛ lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfea. 14 Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛwoa suɔmɔ ni ji kpãa ni fiɔ nibii fɛɛ feɔ lɛ ekome ni ehãa eyeɔ emuu lɛ. 15 Ni nyɛhãa Kristo hejɔlɛ lɛ ayea lumɔ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli; nɔ he ni atsɛ nyɛ kɛba yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli lɛ. Ni nyɛlea shidaa.
16 Nyɛhãa Kristo wiemɔ lɛ ahia nyɛmli babaoo; ni nyɛkɛ nilee fɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛhe nii ni nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, ni nyɛkɛ shidaa alaa yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ. 17 Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ yɛ wiemɔ loo nitsumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛfea fɛɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, ni nyɛtsɔ̃a enɔ nyɛdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Tsɛ lɛ shi.
Kristofoi ashĩa mli shihilɛ
(Efesobii 5.22—6.9)
18Nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛwumɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ. 19 Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, ni nyɛmli akajoa yɛ amɛnɔ. 20Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; ejaakɛ no sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ. 21 Nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, koni amɛnijiaŋ akaje wui.
22Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ amɛsa, shi moŋ yɛ tsui krɔŋŋ mli akɛ mɛi ni sheɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyei. 23Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛmusuŋ nyɛtsua, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛtsuɔ nyɛhã ni jeee gbɔmɛi, 24ni nyɛle akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ nyɛnine baashɛ gboshinii lɛ anɔ yɛ akɛ nyɛnyɔmɔwoo. Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Kristo nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ. 25 Shi mɔ ni feɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ, nii ni ejaaa gbɛ nɔŋŋ he nyɔmɔwoo eeena, ni hiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛŋ.

Title: KOLOSEBII 4
Content:
1 Nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛkɛ nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni sa pɛ ahãa nyɛtsuji lɛ, ni nyɛlea akɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ŋaawoi
2 Nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli, ni nyɛshia kpe yɛ mli kɛ shidaa. 3 Ni nyɛsaa nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ agbele gbɛ ahã wɔ hã wiemɔ lɛ, ni wɔwie Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ, nɔ hewɔ hu ni mikã kpãa mli nɛɛ. 4Nyɛsɔlea koni majie no shi faŋŋ bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ.
5 Nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nilee mli yɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛtsu nyɛbe he nii. 6 Nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ he abaa nyam daa ni ŋoo ahi mli, ni nyɛle bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛhãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hetoo.
Naagbee ŋamɔi
7 Tihiko, ni ji suɔmɔ nyɛmi kɛ anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ naanyo tsulɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, aaagba nyɛ mihe saji fɛɛ. 8 Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni nyɛle bɔ ni wɔyɔɔ, ni eshɛje nyɛmii. 9 Mitsu lɛ kɛ Onesimo ni ji anɔkwa kɛ suɔmɔ nyɛmi ni jɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ; amɛaagba nyɛ biɛ saji fɛɛ.
10 Aristarko, minaanyo gboklɛfonyo lɛ, miibi nyɛ; kɛ Marko ni ji Barnaba nyɛmi bi (mɔ ni miwo nyɛ shi yɛ ehe akɛ nyɛhere lɛ atuu kɛ eba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ) 11Yoshua ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yusto lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, miibi nyɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi pɛ ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ ni etsɔ̃mɔ tsuiwoo ehã mi.
12Epafra ni jɛ nyɛteŋ ni ji Kristo tsulɔ ni daa nɛɛ ekɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ hiɛ sɔlemɔi amli waa kɛhã nyɛ, koni nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ mɛi ni eye emuu ni amɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii fɛɛ feemɔ lɛ, miibi nyɛ. 13Ejaakɛ miiye ehe odase akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ naakpa yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Hierapoli lɛ ahe. 14 Luka, tsofatsɛ ni asumɔɔ lɛ kɛ Dema miibi nyɛ.
15Wɔmiibi nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea lɛ, kɛ Nimfa kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ. 16Kɛ akane nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa akanea yɛ Laodikea asafo lɛ mli hu, ni nyɛ hu nyɛkane nɔ ni jɛ Laodikea lɛ. 17 Ni nyɛkɛa Arkipo akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ogbe sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atu awo odɛ̃ŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ naa kwraa!”
18 Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni miŋma nɛ.
Nyɛkaia mikɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ!
Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!

Title: 1 TESALONIKABII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Tesalonika ji Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni atsɛɔ lɛ Makedonia lɛ maŋ wulu. Paulo yato asafo shishi yɛ jɛmɛ be ni eshi Filipi lɛ sɛɛ. Shi eyeee be ko kwraa ni Yudafoi lɛ te shi shi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛmiiklɔ enɔ akɛni Paulo lɛ, Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ lɛ ehã ena hiɛ yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni kulɛ amɛnya Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ he lɛ. Enɛ hã Paulo kpatu eshi Tesalonika kɛtee Beroia. Nosɛɛ be ni eyashɛ Korinto lɛ, enine shɛ shɛɛ nɔ kɛjɛ enaanyo Timoteo ni ekɛtsuɔ nii lɛ dɛŋ yɛ Tesalonika asafo lɛ hewɔ; ehã ele nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ jɛmɛ. Enɛ hã Paulo ŋma eklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ eyahã Tesalonika Kristofoi lɛ koni ekɛwo amɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛshɛje amɛmii. Eda Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ adafi ni atswa lɛ yɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ. Ekai amɛ bɔ ni ehi shi ehã be ni ekɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ni saji ni gbaa asafo lɛ naa yɛ Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehã amɛ hetoo: Ani mɔ ko ni ehe Kristo nɔ eye, shi egbo dani Kristo aaaba ekoŋŋ lɛ, eeena naanɔ wala ni Kristo kɛbaaba lɛ eko? Ni mɛɛbe Kristo baaba ekoŋŋ? Paulo tsɔ̃ enɛ nɔ ewo amɛ ekãa koni amɛya nɔ amɛkɛ dioofeemɔ atsu amɛnii, belɛ amɛkɛmiimɛ Kristo baa ekoŋŋ ni hiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1
Shidaa kɛ yijiemɔ 1.2—3.13
Kristofoi ajeŋba he ŋaawoo 4.1-12
Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ 4.13—5.11
Naagbee ŋaawoo 5.12-22
Naamuu 5.23-28

Title: 1 TESALONIKABII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ:
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!
Tesalonikabii ashihilɛ kɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli
2Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhewɔ, ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛtãtsii yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli. 3 Ni wɔkaiɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛhiɛ ni kã wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ mli hiɛmiamɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ hiɛ. 4Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ, wɔle halamɔ ni ahala nyɛ lɛ, 5 akɛ wɔSanekpakpa lɛ baaa nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ wiemɔ mli kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔmimaa babaoo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, no ji bɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ. 6 Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ wɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, akɛni nyɛkɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ mɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli lɛ. 7 Ni no ehã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ nyɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia lɛ. 8 Ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ ni egbɛ eshwã, jeee yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛkɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhe ni nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ejije kɛtee he fɛɛ he, ni ehĩaaa wɔ nɔ ko kɛɛmɔ tete. 9 Ejaakɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbaa wɔhe sane bɔ ni wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ bɔ ni nyɛkpale kɛjɛ amãgãi ahe kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni nyɛbasɔ̃mɔ anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ 10 ni nyɛkwɛ eBi lɛ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, Yesu ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ mlifu ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ.

Title: 1 TESALONIKABII 2
Content:
Paulo nitsumɔ yɛ Tesalonika
1 Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ni wɔba lɛ efeee yaka. 2 Wɔna nɔ momo, ni afee wɔ niseniianii hu yɛ Filipi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔna ekãa yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli ni wɔkɛjaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, tsɛbelɛ ate shi ashi wɔ babaoo. 3Ejaakɛ wɔwiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee shishiumɔ loo nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ loo kutumpɔo mli ejɛ; 4 shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebu wɔ akɛ wɔsa akɛ atu Sanekpakpa lɛ awo wɔdɛŋ lɛ, nakai wɔwieɔ, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi moŋ tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa Nyɔŋmɔ ni kaa wɔtsuii kwɛɔ lɛ hiɛ. 5 Ejaakɛ wɔwieko naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko pɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, ni wɔtoko hiɛjoomɔ he abla ko hu, Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefonyo, 6 asaŋ wɔtaooo gbɔmɛi ahiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ loo mɛi krokomɛi aŋɔɔ. 7Tsɛ wɔyɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔfeɔ wɔhe agboi yɛ nyɛnɔ, akɛni Kristo bɔfoi ji wɔ lɛ; shi moŋ wɔhe jɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni bii anyɛ hiɛɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebii dɔdɔɔdɔ lɛ. 8Ni akɛni wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ jogbaŋŋ nɛkɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔna he tsui akɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ kɛkɛ wɔkɛaahã nyɛ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔwala tete, ejaakɛ wɔmiisumɔ nyɛ naakpa. 9 Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkaiɔ wɔtɔlɛ kɛ wɔdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ, akɛ bɔ ni afee ni wɔkatsɔ̃ jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hewɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔmiitsu nii, ni wɔsaa wɔmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
10Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefoi akɛ wɔjeŋ ni wɔba yɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, eja, ni shwamɔ ko bɛ he. 11Tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛle akɛ wɔhiɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tamɔ tsɛ hiɛɔ ebii. 12 Ni wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni wɔshɛjeɔ nyɛmii hu, ni wɔkpaa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ kɛbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli kɛ enunyam lɛ mli lɛ.
13 Enɛ hewɔ ni wɔ hu wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ be ni nyɛnine shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ wɔnaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛmɔ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eji hu lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, shi jeee akɛ gbɔmɛi awiemɔ ko. Wiemɔ nɛɛ tsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nyɛmli. 14Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi ni yɔɔ Yudea yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, ejaakɛ amanehului ni nyɛna yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ amɛ hu amɛna yɛ Yudafoi lɛ adɛŋ; 15 amɛgbe Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ gbalɔi lɛ hu, ni amɛwa wɔ yi. Amɛsaaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni amɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeee. 16 Amɛtsĩɔ wɔ gbɛ hu akɛ wɔkawie wɔtsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ ni ahere amɛyiwala. Ni amɛkɛwoɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ obɔ̃ daa, shi mlifu lɛ enina amɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Paulo shwe akɛ eyasara asafo lɛ ekoŋŋ
17 Shi wɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, akɛni wɔkɛ nyɛ mli egbala be kukuoo ko yɛ na ni wɔnaaa wɔhe yɛ heloo mli gbɛfaŋ, shi jeee yɛ wɔmumɔ mli hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ shwee pii tao akɛ wɔna nyɛhiɛ ekoŋŋ. 18Hewɔ lɛ wɔtao akɛ wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ, mi Paulo, mitao akɛ maba shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ shi Satan tsĩ wɔ gbɛ. 19 Ejaakɛ namɔ ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ loo wɔmiishɛɛ loo wɔshwãa akekre yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hiɛ, yɛ ebaa be lɛ mli lɛ? Ani jeee nyɛ ni? 20Ejaakɛ nyɛ nyɛ ji wɔnunyam kɛ wɔmiishɛɛ.

Title: 1 TESALONIKABII 3
Content:
Atsu Timoteo kɛtee Tesalonika
1 No hewɔ lɛ, be ni wɔnyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, wɔkpɛ mli akɛ ashi wɔ kome yɛ Atene, 2 ni wɔtsu Timoteo ni ji wɔnyɛmi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ. Wɔtsu lɛ ni ebawo nyɛ hewalɛ ni eshɛje nyɛmii yɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ, 3 koni nɛkɛ amanehului nɛɛ akahã mɔ ko mɔ ko miigbugbãa. Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nɔ ni kã shi hã wɔ nɔŋŋ ji no. 4Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto akɛ wɔbaana amanehulu, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ni nyɛle lɛ. 5 Enɛ hewɔ ni mi hu, be ni minyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, mitsu Timoteo ni mikɛle nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, akɛ aleenɔ kalɔ lɛ ebaka nyɛ, ni ehã wɔdeŋme ni wɔgbo lɛ efee yaka lo.
6 Shi agbɛnɛ ni Timoteo jɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ba wɔŋɔɔ ni ebagba wɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ he sane kɛ kaimɔ kpakpa ni nyɛkɛkaiɔ wɔ daa lɛ kɛ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ akɛ nyɛaana wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔshweɔ ni wɔna nyɛ lɛ 7hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmanehulu kɛ wɔhejaramɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã wɔmii eshɛ yɛ nyɛhe; 8ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛfi shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔna wala hee.
Paulo da Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ Tesalonikabii lɛ ahewɔ
9Ejaakɛ mɛɛ shidaa po wɔɔnyɛ wɔkɛda Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛ hewɔ yɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ nyɛhe yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ hewɔ? 10Nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔkpaa fai babaoo, koni wɔna nyɛhiɛ ni wɔhã nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ aye emuu.
11Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ aaahã wɔgbɛ aja kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ. 12Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni ehã nyɛteke nɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ. 13 Bɔ ni afee ni ehã nyɛtsui afi shi ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ abaa be lɛ mli.

Title: 1 TESALONIKABII 4
Content:
Nyɛhĩa shi yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ kɛ suɔmɔ mli
1Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkase yɛ wɔŋɔɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛba nyɛjeŋ ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Nyɛmiifee nakai, shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni wɔmiiwo nyɛ ŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nyɛfee ni ateke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ. 2Ejaakɛ nyɛle kitãi ni wɔwo nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ. 3Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii, no ji, nyɛhetsemɔ akɛ nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ he; 4 ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa lɛ hiɛmɔ yɛ hetsemɔ kɛ woo mli, 5jeee yɛ akɔnɔ hiɛdɔɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋmajiaŋbii ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ. 6Ni mɔ ko akatɔ̃ enyɛmi nɔ ni eye lɛ amim yɛ sane nɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ahe oweletɔlɔ ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto ni wɔye he odase lɛ. 7Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛɛɛ wɔ ehãaa nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ, shi moŋ hã hetsemɔ. 8 Hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, mɔ ni kwaa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔ ko ekwaa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ eMumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hãa nyɛ lɛ.
9 Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ he lɛ, ehĩaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe; 10ejaakɛ nyɛfeɔ nakai hu nyɛhãa nyɛmimɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Makedonia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ. Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ nyɛfee kɛteke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ. 11 Ni nyɛkɛfea nyɛ oti akɛ nyɛaahi shi dioo ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akawo mɛi asaji amli ni nyɛkɛ nyɛniji atsu nii, bɔ ni wɔwo nyɛ kitã lɛ, 12 koni nyɛjeŋba afee mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ fɛo, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko akahĩa nyɛ.
Gbohii kɛ hiɛkãalɔi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ mli
13 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahe sane, koni nyɛkaye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni bɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko lɛ. 14 Ejaakɛ kɛ wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Yesu gbo ni ete shi lɛ, belɛ nakai nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ baatsɔ̃ Yesu nɔ aŋɔ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ hu afata ehe kɛba.
15 Ejaakɛ wɔmiikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ naa akɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni wɔbaashwɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ŋ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahiɛ. 16 Ejaakɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baakpleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi yɛ oshebɔɔ mli ni ŋwɛi bɔfonukpa gbee kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ baagbɛɛ, ni gbohii ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ tsutsu baate shi, 17 no sɛɛ lɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, aaasha wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ atatui amli kɛaatee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpeemɔ yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni nakai wɔkɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaayahi shi daa. 18No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ashɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii.

Title: 1 TESALONIKABII 5
Content:
Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa lɛ
1 Shi anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni kɔɔ gbii lɛ kɛ bei lɛ ahe lɛ, ehe ehĩaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ. 2 Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ baaba tamɔ julɔ baa nyɔɔŋ lɛ. 3 Ejaakɛ be mli ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ hejɔlɛ ni wɔyɛ shweshweeshwe!” lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ aaabatua amɛ trukaa, tamɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ tuaa yoo ni hiɛ musu lɛ, ni amɛjeŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ. 4Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbɛ duŋ mli ni Gbi lɛ aaabati nyɛ shi tamɔ julɔ. 5 Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, labii ji nyɛ kɛ shwanebii hu, wɔjeee nyɔɔŋ loo duŋ bii. 6Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa wɔwɔa tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhãa wɔshia kpe ni wɔhiɛ akãa shi. 7Ejaakɛ mɛi ni wɔɔ lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛwɔɔ, ni mɛi ni tɔrɔɔ dãa lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛtɔrɔɔ. 8 Shi wɔ lɛ, akɛni shwanebii ji wɔ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔhiɛ akãa shi ni wɔwo hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ dama lɛ ni wɔbumɔ dade fai ni ji yiwalaheremɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ. 9Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etooo wɔ ehãaa mlifu, shi moŋ hã yiwalaheremɔnamɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ, 10 mɔ ni gbo wɔyi gbele, koni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ jio, wɔwɔ jio, wɔkɛ lɛ ahi shi lɛ. 11 Hewɔ lɛ nyɛshɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã enaanyo nane amɔ shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ.
Naagbee ŋaawoi kɛ ŋamɔi
12 Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛteŋ ni amɛyeɔ nyɛnɔ onukpa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni amɛwieɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ. 13Nyɛbua amɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli, yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ. Nyɛhãa hejɔlɛ ahĩa nyɛteŋ.
14 Ni wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a hejɔ̃lɔi lɛ, nyɛwoa gbeyelɔi lɛ ekãa; nyɛwaa mɛi ni yɔɔ gbedee lɛ; nyɛtoa nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ. 15 Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni mɔ ko kɛ efɔŋ akato efɔŋ najiaŋ, shi moŋ daa nɛɛ nyɛnyiɛa ekpakpafeemɔ sɛɛ nyɛhãhãa nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ.
16 Nyɛnaa miishɛɛ daa, 17 nyɛsɔlea ni nyɛkafɔa; 18 nyɛdaa shi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli. Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii yɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ.
19 Nyɛkagbea Mumɔ lɛ; 20 nyɛkagbea gbalɛi lɛ ahe guɔ. 21 Nyɛkaa nii fiaa nyɛkwɛa, ni nɔ ni hi lɛ nyɛmɔa no mli. 22Nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ efɔŋ su lɛ he.
23Shi hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ atsuu nyɛhe kwraa kɛmɔ shi, ni eto nyɛmumɔ kɛ nyɛsusuma kɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ ni shwamɔ ko akahi he yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa be lɛ mli. 24 Anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni eeefee hu.
25Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu. 26 Nyɛŋaa nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
27Miikã nyɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã akɛ nyɛhãa akanea nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ!
28WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!

Title: 2 TESALONIKABII WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Mɛi ayiŋ ni etɛ̃ɛɛ amɛ yɛ Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ kã he eegba mɛi anaa lolo yɛ Tesalonika asafo lɛ mli. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Bɔfo Paulo ŋma ewolo ni ji enyɔ lɛ eyahã Tesalonikabii lɛ ni ekɛwie he ni mɛi heɔ yeɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa gbi lɛ eshɛ momo lɛ he. Paulo yasaa nɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔfutumɔ nɛɛ ni ehã anu shishi akɛ fɛɛdã ni Kristo baaba ekoŋŋ lɛ, eshafeemɔ kɛ yitsoŋwalɛ baakwɔ tso yɛ naakpɛɛ gbɔmɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ (2.3) ni baate shi eshi Kristo lɛ gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ naa.
Bɔfo lɛ ma nɔ mi akɛ sa akɛ ewolo nɛɛ kanelɔi lɛ afi shi shiŋŋ ni amɛhemɔkɛyeli akagbugbãa, tsɛ amɛyɛ haomɔ kɛ nɔnaa mli moŋ nɛ, shi moŋ amɛtsu nii yɛ amɛdaaŋ ŋmaa hewɔ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ Paulo kɛ enanemɛi ni ekɛtsu nii lɛ fee lɛ, ni amɛmia amɛhiɛ amɛfee ekpakpa hu.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-2
Yijiemɔ kɛ juromɔ 1.3-12
Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ 2.1-17
Kristofoi ajeŋba he ŋaawoo 3.1-15
Naamuu 3.16-18

Title: 2 TESALONIKABII 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ.
2 Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ dɛŋ ahã nyɛ!
Kojomɔ yɛ Kristo baa be lɛ mli
3 Eji wɔgbɛnaa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ miida naakpa, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ enanemɛi lɛ miifa kɛmiiya nɔ hu. 4 No hewɔ lɛ, wɔdiɛŋtsɛ tete wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ amli, yɛ nyɛhiɛmiamɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛyiwalɛi kɛ nyɛmanehului ni nyɛnaa lɛ amli lɛ hewɔ.
5 Eji Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ he okadi, koni abu nyɛ akɛ nyɛsa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni nyɛnaa he nɔ lɛ, 6 akɛni eja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ mɛi ni haoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehao amɛ eto najiaŋ, 7 ni nyɛ mɛi ni ahaoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ kɛ wɔ fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ, be ni aaajie Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kpo kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi kɛ ebɔfoi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ. 8 Ekɛ lalilɛi aaatɔ owele yɛ mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɛi ni booo wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ anɔ. 9 Amɛaana nyɔmɔwoo ni ji naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni aaajie amɛ kɛaajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ anunyam lɛ he, 10 be ni eeeba koni awo ehiɛ nyam yɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli ni ana enaakpɛɛnii yɛ eheyelɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ahe wɔdase ni wɔye wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aye.
11Enɛ hewɔ hu ni wɔsɔleɔ daa wɔhãa nyɛ, koni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa tsɛmɔ lɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ lɛ ahã ekpakpafeemɔ he miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ ayi obɔ̃, 12bɔ ni afee ni awo wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛmli ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aba nyam yɛ emli, yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ naa.

Title: 2 TESALONIKABII 2
Content:
Mlakwalɔ lɛ
1 Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa lɛ kɛ wɔnaa ni abaabua yɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ hewɔ 2akɛ nyɛkahãa ahã nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futu oya, ni asaŋ nyɛkahãa akɛ mumɔ ko loo wiemɔ ko loo wolo ko ni aaakɛɛ akɛ ejɛ wɔŋɔɔ lɛ miihã nyɛhao akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ eshɛ etã. 3 Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miishishiua nyɛ yɛ gbɛ ko gbɛ ko nɔ; ejaakɛ ja jamɔkwamɔ lɛ eba fɛɛ dã ni aaajie mlakwamɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ bi lɛ kpo. 4 Eteɔ shi ewoɔ ehe nɔ eshiɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni atsɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ loo jamɔ lɛ aahu bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyataa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni ekɛ ehe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
5Nyɛkaiii akɛ be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lo? 6Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, nɔ ni tsiɔ ekpojiemɔ lɛ gbɛ kɛyashi ebe aaashɛ lɛ, nyɛle. 7 Ejaakɛ mlakwamɔ teemɔsane lɛ miitsu nii momo, shi kɛyashi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ aaaje jɛi kɛkɛ. 8 Ni no dani aaajie mlakwalɔ lɛ kpo; Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ edaaŋ mumɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ ni ekɛ ebaa lɛ puemɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ. 9 Mlakwalɔ nɛɛ, Satan nitsumɔ nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ kɛba kɛ amale hewalɛ kɛ amale okadii kɛ amale naakpɛɛnii, 10 kɛ efɔŋ mli shishiumɔ fɛɛ ni akɛ shishiuɔ mɛi ni hiɛ baakpãtã ejaakɛ amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ anɔkwale suɔmɔ lɛ mli ni akɛhere amɛyiwala lɛ. 11 Ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuɔ shishiumɔ hewalɛ kɛbaa amɛŋɔɔ ni amɛhe amale amɛye, 12koni akojo mɛi fɛɛ ni heee anɔkwale lɛ amɛyeee, shi amɛnaa efɔŋ moŋ he tsui lɛ.
Ahala nyɛ kɛhã yiwalaheremɔ
13 Shi wɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehala nyɛ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ehã yiwalaheremɔ kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhe ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsuɔ kɛ he ni nyɛheɔ anɔkwale lɛ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nɔ. 14Enɛ mli etsɔ̃ wɔSanekpakpa lɛ nɔ etsɛ nyɛ kɛba, koni nyɛna wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo anunyam lɛ. 15 Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛfĩa shi, ni nyɛhiɛa nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ mli loo wolo mli lɛ mli.
16Shi lɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ naanɔ miishɛjemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kpakpa hã wɔ yɛ dromɔ naa lɛ, 17lɛ nɔŋŋ eshɛje nyɛmii ni ewaje nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ kpakpa kɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ mli.

Title: 2 TESALONIKABII 3
Content:
Nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ
1 Nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ koni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ agbɛ ashwã oyayaayai ni awo ehiɛ nyam, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ. 2Ni ajie wɔ kɛjɛ yiwalɔi gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ adɛŋ, ejaakɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli.
3 Shi anɔkwafo ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mɔ ni aaawaje nyɛ ni eeebu nyɛhe ni ejie nyɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ. 4 Wɔhiɛ kã nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ nii ni wɔwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, nyɛmiifee ni nyɛaafee hu.
5Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akudɔ nyɛtsuii kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ kɛ Kristo tsuishiŋmɛɛ lɛ mli.
Esa akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsu nii
6 Shi anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiiwo nyɛ kitã yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, akɛ nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nyɛmi fɛɛ nyɛmi ni feɔ hejɔ̃ ni ehiii shi yɛ nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ naa lɛ he. 7 Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ esa akɛ nyɛkaseɔ wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔfeee wɔhe hejɔ̃lɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ. 8 Ni asaŋ wɔyeee mɔ ko ŋmaa yaka, shi moŋ wɔkɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ kɛ tɔlɛ tsuɔ nii nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane bɔ ni afee ni wɔkafee jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko. 9 Jeee akɛ wɔbɛ nakai hegbɛ, shi moŋ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhe afee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ wɔhã nyɛ ni nyɛkase. 10 Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu, wɔwo nyɛ kitã akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ nii lɛ, belɛ ekaye nii hu.”
11Ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni feɔ hejɔ̃, ni amɛtsuuu nii, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli. 12 Nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ wɔmiiwo amɛ kitã ni wɔmiiwo amɛŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli akɛ amɛtsu nii waa ni amɛye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛdɛŋ ŋmaa.
13 Shi nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa nyɛ. 14 Shi kɛ mɔ ko booo wɔwiemɔ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ toi lɛ, nyɛkadia lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, koni ehiɛ agbo; 15ni nyɛkabua lɛ akɛ henyɛlɔ, shi moŋ nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a lɛ akɛ nyɛmi.
Naagbee wiemɔ
16Shi lɛ hejɔlɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ahã nyɛ hejɔlɛ daa yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi.
17 Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni ji okadi yɛ miwolo fɛɛ wolo mli nɛ; bɔ ni miŋmaa nɛ.
18WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Timoteo ji Kristofonyo oblanyo ni jɛ Asia Fio. Enyɛ lɛ Yudayoo ni kɛ etsɛ hu Helanyo ni. Etsɔ̃ Paulo naanyo kɛ yelikɛbualɔ yɛ eshiɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli. Paulo Klɛŋklɛŋ Wolo ni eŋma Timoteo lɛ kɔɔ nibii etɛ̃ krɛdɛɛ ahe.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, wolo lɛ bɔɔ kɔkɔ yɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ he. Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ajwɛŋmɔ ni efutu ni, ni edãmɔ he ni aheɔ ayeɔ akɛ jeŋ ni wɔyɔɔ mli nɛɛ efɔŋ ni, ni nɔ pɛ ni baahã mɔ ko ana yiwalaheremɔ ji teemɔŋ nilee pɔtɛ̃ɛ ko, kɛ agbɛnɛ hu, shihilɛ yɛ gbɛ titri ko nɔ, tamɔ akɛ niyenii komɛi ahii kɛ oshijafeemɔ nɛkɛ.
Nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ wolo lɛ saa ewoɔ asafonɔkwɛmɔ kɛ jamɔ he ŋaa, ni etsɔ̃ɔ jeŋba ni sa asafonukpai kɛ yelikɛbualɔi.
Naagbee lɛ, awo Timoteo ŋaa bɔ ni ebaafee ni etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ egbɛnaa hu yɛ kui srɔtoisrɔtoi ni heɔ Kristo nɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ amli.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-2
Ŋaawoo ni kɔɔ asafo lɛ kɛ enɔkwɛlɔi lɛ ahe 1.3—3.16
Ŋaa ni awo Timoteo yɛ enitsumɔ lɛ he 4.1—6.21

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ, famɔ naa lɛ, 2 ŋma yahã Timoteo ni ji ebi krɔŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ. Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔTsɛ lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, dɛŋ ahã bo!
Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
3 Tamɔ bɔ ni be ni miyaa Makedonia ni mikpa bo fai akɛ ohi shi yɛ Efeso, koni obɔ mɛi komɛi akɔkɔ akɛ amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi krokomɛi. 4 Ni asaŋ obɔ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛkadi adesãi kɛ wekukpãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ tsralaa lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi kɛ yaka hiɛklamɔ baa fe akɛ eeewa wɔ ni wɔle Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ he yiŋtoo, ni hemɔkɛyeli sane ni lɛ, nakai fai mikpaa bo ekoŋŋ. 5 Shi ŋaawoo lɛ oti ji suɔmɔ ni jɛ tsui ni mli tse kɛ henilee kpakpa kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni osato ko bɛ mli lɛ mli. 6 Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni mɛi komɛi eje sɛɛ, ni amɛkpale kɛtee yaka wiemɔ he. 7Amɛmiitao amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi, tsɛ amɛnaaa nii ni amɛkɛɔ lɛ loo nii ni amɛwieɔ kɛ nɔmimaa lɛ shishi.
8 Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ hi kɛji mɔ ko kɛtsu nii bɔ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ lɛ. 9Ejaakɛ ale enɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla lɛ, jeee jalɔ hewɔ awo, shi mɛi ahewɔ ni awo moŋ ji mlatɔ̃lɔi kɛ toigbolɔi, mɛi ni he tseee kɛ hebulelɔi, tsɛgbelɔi kɛ nyɛgbelɔi, gbɔmɔgbelɔi, 10 ajwamãŋbɔlɔi, hii ni kɛ hii wɔɔ, gbɔmɔ julɔi, amalelɔi, kitãmlikulɔi, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ yeee lɛ, 11 yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ lɛ anunyam Sanekpakpa ni atu awo midɛŋ lɛ naa.
Paulo daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ etsɛmɔ hewɔ
12 Miida wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu ni wo mi hewalɛ lɛ shi, akɛ ebu mi anɔkwafo, ni eŋɔ mi ewo sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli, 13mi ni tsutsu lɛ mi ji musubɔlɔ kɛ mɛi ayiwalɔ kɛ mɛi aniseniianifeelɔ lɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ana mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ mileee ni mifee, yɛ he ni miheee miyeee hewɔ. 14Shi wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ dromɔ lɛ fa hã mi aahu kɛteke nɔ, ni nɔ ni fata he kɛba ji hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ. 15 Eji anɔkwa wiemɔ ni sa akɛ amɔ mli kwraa, akɛ Kristo Yesu ba je nɛɛŋ eba eshafeelɔi ayiwalaheremɔ, mɛi ateŋ ni mi mi ji oti lɛ; 16shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛ hewɔ ni ana mi mɔbɔ lɛ, koni mi tsutsu mimli Yesu Kristo ajie etsuishitoo lɛ fɛɛ kpo yɛ, ni akɛto mɛi ni baahe enɔ aye ni amɛna naanɔ wala lɛ okadi. 17 Shi naanɔi aMaŋtsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni gbooo, mɔ ni anaaa, mɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, aŋɔ woo kɛ anunyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!
Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ
18 Kitã ni miwoɔ bo nɛ, mibi Timoteo, yɛ gbalɛi ni agba kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ yɛ ohe lɛ anaa, koni okɛwu ta kpakpa lɛ, 19 ni ohiɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ henilee kpakpa. Nɔ ni mɛi komɛi shɛrɛ shwie ni amɛyasha shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ. 20 Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Himeneo kɛ Aleksandro, mɛi ni mitu miwo Satan dɛŋ, koni atsɔse amɛ ni amɛkawie musubɔɔ wiemɔi dɔŋŋ lɛ.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 2
Content:
Asafo mli jamɔ
1 Agbɛnɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni miwoɔ he ŋaa ji akɛ ahiɛ faikpamɔi, sɔlemɔi, mlidaamɔi, shidai amli, ahã gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, 2ahã maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, koni wɔhi shi kpoo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ kɛ jeŋba ni hiɛ sɔɔ fɛɛ mli. 3 Ejaakɛ enɛ hi ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ hiɛ. 4 Esumɔɔ akɛ ehere gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwala, koni amɛshɛ anɔkwale lɛ lee mli. 5 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome yɔɔ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋdamɔlɔ kome hu ni ji gbɔmɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ, 6 mɔ ni ŋɔ ehe ehã akɛ kpɔmɔ nɔ ehã mɛi fɛɛ. Enɛ ji odase ni aye yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ; 7 ni no hewɔ awo mi shiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo (anɔkwale miwieɔ yɛ Kristo mli, mimaleee), jeŋmaji atsɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
8No hewɔ lɛ, miitao akɛ hii asɔle yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛhole niji ni he tse nɔ ni mlifu loo naataamɔ akaba mli.
9 Nakai nɔŋŋ yei hu, amɛkɛ atade ni sa kɛ hiɛ ni gboɔ nɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ awula amɛhe, jeee kɛ yigbɔɔ loo shika loo adiagbai loo atade ni jara wa, 10 shi moŋ kɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ni sa yei ni tsɛɔ amɛhe akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔi lɛ. 11 Yoo afee dioo ni ekɛ heshibaa fɛɛ akase nii. 12 Shi mihãaa yoo hegbɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nii aloo eye nuu nɔ, shi moŋ efee dioo. 13 Ejaakɛ Adam tsutsu abɔ, no sɛɛ lɛ Hawa. 14 Ni jeee Adam alaka lɛ, shi yoo lɛ alaka lɛ, ni ebote nɔtɔmɔ mli. 15Shi aaahere eyiwala kɛaatsɔ̃ bifɔmɔ nɔ, kɛji ehi shi kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hetsemɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 3
Content:
Asafonɔkwɛlɔi
1 Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ: kɛ mɔ ko miitao nɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ, eetao nitsumɔ kpakpa. 2 Shi esa akɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ afee mɔ ni anaŋ ehe sane ko atã, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa kome, hiɛshikãlɔ, mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli tse, mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, gbɔfeelɔ, mɔ ni le nitsɔɔmɔ, 3jeee dãanulɔ, jeee ninekpokpookpotsɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni he jɔ, mɔ ni beee, mɔ ni hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ shika nɔ, 4 mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ jogbaŋŋ, ni ebii boɔ lɛ toi kɛ woo fɛɛ. 5Shi kɛ mɔ ko leee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ yeli lɛ, te eeefee tɛŋŋ ekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ hu? 6Asaŋ jeee mɔ ni bote Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli etsɛko, koni ekawo ehe nɔ ni egbee kojomɔ ni abonsam gbee mli lɛ mli. 7 Shi sa akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ hu aye ehe odase kpakpa, koni ehe guɔ akagbo ni ekagbee abonsam tsɔne mli.
Asafoŋ sɔ̃ɔlɔi
8 Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu esa akɛ amɛfee gbɔmɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee lilɛintatsɛmɛi, jeee mɛi ni sumɔɔ dãa, jeee hiɛjoolɔi, 9shi mɛi ni hiɛɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ teemɔ sane lɛ yɛ henilee ni he tse mli. 10Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi hu aka amɛ akwɛ fɛɛ dã; no sɛɛ lɛ, kɛ sane ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛsɔ̃mɔ. 11 Yei lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ; amɛfee mɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee oshekuyelɔi shi mɛi ni hiɛ kã shi, ni amɛyeɔ anɔkwa yɛ nii fɛɛ mli. 12 Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ amɛfee ŋa komekome tsɛmɛi, mɛi ni yeɔ amɛbii kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩai anɔ jogbaŋŋ. 13Ejaakɛ mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ amɛnaa gbɛnaa kpakpa amɛhãa amɛhe, ni amɛnaa ekãa babaoo yɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli.
Teemɔ sane wulu lɛ
14Mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ etsɛŋ ni maba oŋɔɔ; shi miiŋma bo enɛɛmɛi 15 koni kɛ mitsɛ lɛ, ni ole bɔ ni sa akɛ oba ojeŋ ohã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ asafo lɛ, anɔkwale lɛ akulashiŋ kɛ nɔdaamɔnɔ lɛ mli. 16 Ni nɔ ko ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ eda kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ teemɔ sane lɛ:
Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe shi faŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli,
abu lɛ bem yɛ mumɔ mli,
bɔfoi na lɛ,
ashiɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ,
ahe enɔ aye yɛ jeŋ,
aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ anunyam mli.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 4
Content:
Amale tsɔɔlɔi
1 Shi Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ faŋŋ akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli lɛ mɛi komɛi aaakwa hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ni amɛaabo lakamɔ mumɔi kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji atsɔ̃ɔmɔi atoi 2kɛtsɔ̃ amalelɔi asatofeemɔ nɔ; amalelɔi ni ashã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhenilee, tamɔ akɛ dade kɛ la shãa nɔ lɛ; 3 amɛtsiɔ yooŋɔɔ gbɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ahi ŋmaa ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ ni amɛle anɔkwale lɛ kɛ shidaa aye lɛ. 4 Ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ ehi, ni ahiii nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛ shidaa yeɔ lɛ, 5ejaakɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ kɛ sɔlemɔ tsuɔ he.
Kristo Yesu sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa
6Kɛji otsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ enɛɛmɛi lɛ, obaafee ohe Kristo Yesu sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, mɔ ni kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa ni onyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ wiemɔi lɛ lɛɔ ehe. 7 Shi yeimeji ayakayaka adesãi lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he. Ni otsɔse ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli moŋ. 8 Ejaakɛ hetsɔsemɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso gbɛfaŋ he sɛɛnamɔ faaa, shi hetsɔsemɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɛ nii fiaa mli, ni eyɛ wala ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni baaba lɛ he shiwoo. 9 Eji anɔkwa wiemɔ ni sa akɛ amɔ mli kwraa. 10 Enɛ hewɔ wɔgboɔ deŋme ni wɔpeleɔ wɔhiɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɔ, mɔ ni ji gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwalaherelɔ lɛ, titri lɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
11Wo nibii nɛɛ ahe kitã ni otsɔ̃ɔ. 12 Kaahã mɔ ko miibu akɛ ojeee mɔ ko yɛ oblanyo ni oji lɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ okɛ ohe ato okadi ohã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, yɛ wiemɔ mli, yɛ hetsemɔ mli. 13Okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ̃ ŋmalɛi lɛ akanemɔ kɛ asafo lɛ hamɔ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ nitsɔɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba. 14 Kaaŋmɛɛ dromɔkeenɔ ni yɔɔ omli ni atsɔ̃ gbalɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ aniji ni akɛshwie onɔ lɛ nɔ akɛhã bo lɛ he. 15Tsu nii nɛɛ ahe nii, okɛ ohe awo mli kwraa, koni mɛi fɛɛ ana onɔyaa faŋŋ. 16 Ohiɛ ahi ohe nɔ, ohiɛ ahi tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, hii shi yɛ nii nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ kɛji ofee enɛ lɛ, ooohere bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ mɛi ni boɔ bo toi lɛ fɛɛ ayiwala.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 5
Content:
Bɔ ni akɛ onukpai kɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei wieɔ
1 Kaafãmɔ onukpa ko, shi moŋ owie otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ tsɛ; oblahii hu akɛ nyɛmimɛi; 2yei onukpai lɛ akɛ nyɛmɛi; oblayei lɛ hu akɛ nyɛmimɛiyei yɛ hetsemɔ fɛɛ mli.
Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ hã okulafoi
3 Yei okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ wo amɛ. 4Shi kɛ yoo okulafo ko yɛ bii loo nabii lɛ, amɛkase Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩa tsutsu, ni amɛto amɛfɔlɔi lɛ anajiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ejaakɛ enɛ sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 5 Shi mɔ ni ji yoo okulafo lɛɛlɛŋ ni eshwɛ ekome too lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni ehiɛɔ faikpamɔi kɛ sɔlemɔi amli nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane. 6Shi yoo okulafo ni bɔɔ ahoshwi lɛ, ehiɛ kã nɛ, shi egbo. 7Wo amɛ kitãi nɛɛ, koni akana amɛhe sane ko atã. 8Shi kɛ mɔ ko kwɛɛɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, titri lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩabii lɛ, ekpa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ, ni efaŋ mɔ ni heee yeee fe lɛ.
9Akaŋɔ yoo okulafo ko awo sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli akɛ ja mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni egbã nuu kome 10 ni ayeɔ enitsumɔi kpakpai ahe odase, no ji: kɛ elɛ bii, kɛ efee mɛi agbɔ, kɛ efɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi anaji ahe, kɛ eye ebua mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ, kɛ edi nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa sɛɛ lɛ.
11Shi yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ, kaaŋɔ amɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ akɔnɔ te shi yɛ amɛmli ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ Kristo he lɛ, amɛtaoɔ gbãlã, 12ni amɛnaa kojomɔ ejaakɛ amɛku amɛklɛŋklɛŋ shiwoo lɛ mli. 13Ni amɛsaa amɛkaseɔ hejɔ̃feemɔ, amɛkpaa shi yɛ shĩai, ni jeee hejɔ̃lɔi kɛkɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi amɛwiewieɔ mɛi ahe hu, amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli, amɛwieɔ nii ni esaaa. 14 No hewɔ lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ agbã, ni amɛfɔ bii, ni amɛye amɛwe nɔ, ni amɛkahã henyɛlɔ lɛ miina hegbɛ ko kɛmiijɛ wɔ. 15Ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi ekpale eyanyiɛ Satan sɛɛ momo. 16Shi kɛ nuu loo yoo heyelɔ ko yɛ wekumɛi yei okulafoi lɛ, ekwɛ amɛ, ni jatsu akakã asafo lɛ nɔ, koni asafo lɛ akwɛ okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ.
Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ hã asafonukpai
17 Onukpai ni tsuɔ amɛnii jogbaŋŋ akɛ nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, abu amɛ akɛ amɛsa woo toi enyɔ, titri lɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ shiɛmɔ kɛ nitsɔɔmɔ he nii waa lɛ. 18 Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Kaawo tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele naabu kotoku;” kɛ, “Nitsulɔ lɛ, enyɔmɔwoo sa lɛ.” 19 Kɛ afolɔ onukpa ko naa lɛ, kaahe okpɛ̃lɛ akɛ ja yɛ odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ naa dã. 20 Mɛi ni feɔ esha lɛ, okã amɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu ashe gbeyei.
21Miiwo bo kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo Yesu kɛ ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ oye nii nɛɛ anɔ ni okasha ohe okojo, ni asaŋ okafee nɔ ko kɛ niiaŋkpamɔ. 22 Kɛ oniji akashwie mɔ ko nɔ oya, ni asaŋ kaafata mɛi krokomɛi ahe kɛfee esha. Too ohe krɔŋŋ.
23Kaanu nu kɛkɛ dɔŋŋ, shi nuu wain fioo yɛ omusu kɛ ohelai ni yeɔ bo kpitiokpitio lɛ ahewɔ.
24Mɛi komɛi ahe eshai jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ ekɛ amɛ yaa kojomɔ mli, shi mɛi komɛi anɔ hu nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ. 25Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nitsumɔi kpakpai hu jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni nii ni ejeee kpo lɛ hu anyɛŋ akɛtee.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 6
Content:
Tsuji kɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi
1 Tsuji abɔ ni yɔɔ apã shishi lɛ abu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo fɛɛ, koni akawie Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔ. 2 Shi tsuji ni yɔɔ nuŋtsɔmɛi heyelɔi lɛ akaŋɔ lɛ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ esaaa akɛ hiɛ sɔɔ amɛ, shi moŋ amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ mɛi ni naa sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ he sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi heyelɔi kɛ suɔmɔmɛi ji amɛ. Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nii nɛɛ ni owo he ŋaa.
Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwa ninamɔ
3 Kɛ mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kroko ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo wiemɔi ni hi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ naa lɛ nɔ lɛ, 4no lɛ ewo ehe nɔ, eleee nɔ ko, shi moŋ eeye ŋwanejee kɛ naataamɔ hela, ni nibii ni jɛɔ mli ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, bei, oshekuyeli, mɛi ahe susumɔi fɔ̃ji, 5yakayaka blɔmɔi — enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ mɛi ateŋ ni anaa yɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ efite ni ashɔ̃ anɔkwale lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ ji ninamɔ lɛ.
6 Shi lɛɛlɛŋ, ninamɔ kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ, kɛji mɔ ko miishɛ enii ahe lɛ. 7 Ejaakɛ wɔkɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko baaa je nɛɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ nɔ ko aya hu. 8 Shi kɛ wɔyɛ ŋmaa kɛ hehaanii kɛkɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔmii ashɛ he. 9 Shi mɛi ni taoɔ afee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ gbeɔ kaa kɛ tsɔne kɛ kwashiai akɔnɔi pii ni fiteɔ mɔ, ni tsiɔ mɛi ewoɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ laajemɔ mli lɛ amli. 10 Ejaakɛ nibii fɔ̃ji fɛɛ ashĩshifã ji shikasuɔmɔ ni mɛi komɛi di sɛɛ ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ piŋmɔi babaoo egbulɔ amɛtsui lɛ.
Ŋaawoi
