“Naa, mikɛ koŋtɛ miiŋmɛ shi yɛ Zion,
tɛ ni ahala ni ejara wa.
Ni mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ hiɛ gboŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
7 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ejara wa hã nyɛ; shi mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ,
“Tɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ ekwa lɛ,
No nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ”
8 kɛ
“Tɛmɔtɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ
tɛsaa ehã amɛ.”
Ejaakɛ akɛni amɛbooo wiemɔ lɛ toi hewɔ lɛ amɛtɛrɛ, ni no nɔŋŋ ato amɛ ahã; 9 shi nyɛ lɛ, weku ni ahala ji nyɛ, osɔfoi, maŋtsɛmɛi, jeŋmaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, maŋ ni ekɛfee enɔ, koni nyɛjaje mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛjɛ duŋ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enaakpɛɛ la lɛ he lɛ agbojee lɛ; 10 nyɛ ni sa lɛ nyɛjeee maŋ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ ji nyɛ, nyɛ ni anaaa nyɛ mɔbɔ, shi agbɛnɛ ana nyɛ mɔbɔ lɛ.
Kristofoi kɛ maŋbii ateŋ shihilɛ
11 Misuɔmɔmɛi, miiwie miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ gbɔi kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋsɛɛ, akɛ nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa heloosɛɛdiinii ni kɛ susuma wuɔ ta lɛ ahe, 12 ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ateŋ, koni be mli ni amɛwieɔ nyɛhe akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, amɛkɛ nyɛnitsumɔi kpakpai lɛ ni amɛbaana lɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ saramɔ Gbi lɛ nɔ.
13 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa gbɔmɛi agbɛjianɔtoo fɛɛ gbɛjianɔtoo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ, maŋtsɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ jio, 14lumɛi ni etsu yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anɔ oweletɔɔ hewɔ kɛ ekpakpafeelɔi ayijiemɔ hewɔ lɛ jio. 15 Ejaakɛ nakai ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, akɛ ekpakpafeemɔ nyɛkɛaatsĩ gbɔmɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ lɛ akwashiafeemɔ fɛɛ naa, 16 akɛ mɛi ni eye amɛhe, shi jeee mɛi ni nyɛkɛ nyɛheyeli lɛ aaafee efɔŋ nɔhaanɔ, shi moŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji. 17 Nyɛwoa mɛi fɛɛ; nyɛsumɔa nyɛmimɛi lɛ; nyɛshea Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, nyɛwoa maŋtsɛ.
Tsuji aŋɔ Kristo amanehulu akɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ
18 Webii, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ fɛɛ abaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛnuŋtsɔmɛi, jeee mɛi kpakpai kɛ mɛi ni nuɔ nii ahe hãa mɔ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ hu. 19Ejaakɛ enɛ ji dromɔ, kɛ lee ni mɔ ko le Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ ni ena amanehulu ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ. 20 Ejaakɛ kɛ tɔ̃ nyɛtɔ̃ ni ayi nyɛ ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ yɛ mli lɛ, mɛɛ anunyam yɔɔ mli? Shi kɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa ni nyɛna he amanehulu ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no ji nɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 21 Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ atsɛ nyɛ, ejaakɛ Kristo hu na amanehulu ehã nyɛ ni ekɛfee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ehã nyɛ, koni nyɛnyiɛ enanemaahei lɛ asɛɛ. 22 Lɛ mɔ ni efeee esha ni asaŋ anaaa shishiumɔ yɛ edaaŋ lɛ. 23Mɔ ni be ni ajɛɔ lɛ lɛ, ejɛɛɛ mɔ ko etooo najiaŋ, be ni enaa amanehulu lɛ, elomɔɔɔ mɔ ko, shi moŋ etu esane ewo mɔ ni kojoɔ jalɛ naa lɛ dɛŋ lɛ. 24 Kristo diɛŋtsɛ etere wɔhe eshai lɛ yɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli kɛtee sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ, koni wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni egboi yɛ esha gbɛfaŋ ni wɔhiɛ akamɔ yɛ jalɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ; lɛ ehe faji akɛtsa nyɛ lɛ. 25 Ejaakɛ kulɛ nyɛtamɔ toi ni elaaje, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba nyɛsusumai alɛlɔ kɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

Title: 1 PETRO 3
Content:
Yeigbãyei kɛ wumɛi
1 Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ hu, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwumɛi lɛ, koni, kɛ mɛi komɛi booo wiemɔ lɛ toi tete lɛ, ashi wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ yei lɛ ajeŋba nɔ ni nine ashɛ amɛnɔ, 2ejaakɛ amɛnaa nyɛjeŋba ni he tse ni gbeyeishemɔ yɔɔ mli lɛ. 3 Ni nyɛhewulamɔ akafee yigbɔɔ kɛ shikawoo kɛ atadewoo yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ. 4Shi moŋ efee tsui mli gbɔmɔ ni akɛtee yɛ mumɔ ni he jɔ ni yɔɔ kpoo lɛ hewulamɔ ni fiteee lɛ mli lɛ; no ji nɔ ni jara wa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 5Ejaakɛ sa lɛ, nakai ji bɔ ni yei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu ni hiɛ kã Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ wula amɛhe, ni amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi. 6 Tamɔ bɔ ni Sara bo Abraham toi, ni etsɛɔ lɛ “nuŋtsɔ” lɛ; ebiyei ji nyɛ, kɛ nyɛfeɔ ekpakpa ni nyɛsheee nɔ ko gbeyei lɛ.
7 Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ wumɛi, nyɛkɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ ahia shi yɛ nilee naa, ni nyɛkɛ woo awoa yoo akɛ mɔ ni he waaa tuutu ko, akɛni amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ji wala dromɔ lɛ niyelɔi lɛ, koni akatsĩ nyɛsɔlemɔi lɛ agbɛ.
Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa efɔŋ najiaŋ
8Shi naagbee lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛa jwɛŋmɔ kome, nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe, nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe akɛ nyɛmimɛi, nyɛmli ashãa nyɛ ahãa nyɛhe, nyɛjwɛŋa heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ. 9 Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa efɔŋ najiaŋ aloo jɛmɔ yɛ jɛmɔ najiaŋ, shi moŋ nyɛjɔa, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ enɛ hewɔ atsɛ nyɛ, koni nyɛnine ashɛ jɔɔmɔ lɛ nɔ. 10 Shi,
“Mɔ ni taoɔ wala asumɔ
ni ena gbii kpakpai lɛ,
emɔ elilɛi mli kɛje efɔŋ he,
kɛ enaabu hu koni ekawie
shishiumɔ wiemɔ.
11Ewi efɔŋ ni efee ekpakpa.
Etao hejɔlɛ ni enyiɛ no sɛɛ.
12Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiŋmɛi
kã jalɔi ahe,
ni eboɔ amɛfaikpamɔ toi;
shi mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ,
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ejie ehiɛ eka amɛ.”
Nyɛfea ekpakpa kɛ nyɛna amanehulu yɛ mli tete
13Ni kɛ nyɛbɔɔ ekpakpa he mɔdɛŋ lɛ, namɔ aaafee nyɛ efɔŋ? 14 Shi kɛ jalɛ hewɔ nyɛnaa amanehulu tete lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ. Shi nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛkahaoa hu. 15 Shi Nuŋtsɔ, Kristo lɛ, nyɛbua lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli; ni daa nɛɛ nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, koni nyɛna hetoo nyɛhã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ nyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ shi lɛ; 16shi nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ bulɛ ahãa hetoo, ni nyɛhiɛ henilee kpakpa, koni be ni aawie nyɛhe efɔŋ lɛ, mɛi ni gbeɔ nyɛjeŋba kpakpa ni nyɛyɔɔ akɛ Kristofoi lɛ he guɔ lɛ ahiɛ agboi. 17 Ejaakɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ akɛ nyɛna amanehulu lɛ, ehi moŋ akɛ nyɛaana amanehulu akɛ ekpakpafeelɔi fe nɔ ni nyɛaana amanehulu akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi.
18 Ejaakɛ Kristo hu na amanehulu yɛ eshai ahewɔ shi kome, lɛ jalɔ lɛ yɛ mɛi ni ejaaa lɛ anajiaŋ, koni ekɛ wɔ aya Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ. Ni agbe lɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ moŋ, shi ahã lɛ wala yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ. 19 Ni mumɔ lɛ mli etsɔ̃ kɛtee mumɔi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ, eyashiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. 20 Amɛ mɛi ni blema lɛ amɛbooo toi, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛ etsui shi ni emɛ amɛ aahu yɛ Noa bei lɛ amli, be ni afeɔ adeka kpeteŋkple lɛ, nɔ mli ni ahere mɛi fioo ni ji mɛi kpaanyɔ lɛ asusumai ayiwala yɛ kɛtsɔ̃ nu mli lɛ, 21 Ni agbɛnɛ baptisimɔ ni nakai nu lɛ ji ehe okadi lɛ hereɔ nyɛ hu nyɛyiwala. Ejeee hewolo nɔ mujijiemɔ, shi moŋ eji kpãŋmɔ ni ajɛɔ henilee kpakpa mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋɔ, kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo shitee lɛ nɔ, 22 mɔ ni etee ŋwɛi ni eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni akɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ hegbɛi kɛ hewalɛi fɛɛ ewo eshishi lɛ.

Title: 1 PETRO 4
Content:
Nyɛhĩa shi akɛ mɛi ni wala etsake
1Agbɛnɛ akɛni Kristo na amanehulu ehã wɔ yɛ heloo mli hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ nakai jwɛŋmɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ amiaa akɛ tawuunii, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ena amanehulu yɛ heloo mli lɛ, ekpa eshafeemɔ. 2Koni be ni eshwɛ ehã lɛ yɛ heloo mli shihilɛ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ekahi shi yɛ gbɔmɛi akɔnɔi anaa dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii anaa. 3 Ejaakɛ be ni eho momo lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛna be bɔ ni sa nyɛkɛtsu jeŋmajiaŋbii atsui naanii lɛ, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, akɔnɔi, dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ, ninumɔ kɛ wɔŋjamɔ ni ahiɔ lɛ amli. 4Ni agbɛnɛ ni nyɛhe etswaaa shi nyɛkɛ amɛ eyaaa nɛkɛ shihilɛ gbonyo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ mli hewɔ lɛ, efeɔ amɛ naakpɛɛ ni amɛwieɔ nyɛhe musubɔɔ wiemɔi. 5 Shi amɛbaabu akɔntaa amɛhã mɔ ni esaa ehe eto ni ebaakojo hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ lɛ. 6 Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ ni ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ gbohii tete hu, koni amɛhi shi yɛ mumɔŋ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ, tsɛ akojo amɛ bɔ ni akojoɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛduromɔ keenii lɛ asɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe
7 Shi nibii fɛɛ anaagbee lɛ eshɛ etã. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ mli atsea ni nyɛhiɛ akãa shi ahãa sɔlemɔi. 8 Shi titri lɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ mli awa, ejaakɛ suɔmɔ haa eshai babaoo nɔ. 9 Nyɛfeefea nyɛhe gbɔ ni huhũumɔ akahi mli. 10Nyɛduromɔ keenii lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ena lɛ, nyɛkɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni jeɔ kpo yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi anɔ lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi kpakpai. 11 Kɛ wiemɔ mɔ ko wieɔ lɛ, ewie lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi; kɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɔ ko sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, esɔ̃mɔ akɛ hewalɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hãa lɛ lɛ mli ejeɔ esɔ̃mɔɔ, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ nii fɛɛ mli; lɛ enɔ ji anunyam lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Nyɛbaana amanehulu akɛ Kristofoi
12 Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛkahãa amanehulu la ni akɛkãa nyɛ lɛ miifee nyɛ sane srɔto ko, tamɔ akɛ nɔ ko srɔto ko feɔ nyɛ lɛ; 13 shi moŋ bɔbɔ ni nyɛnaa Kristo amanehului lɛ eko lɛ, nakai nyɛmii ashɛa, koni enunyam kpojiemɔ lɛ mli hu nyɛmii ashɛ ni nyɛmli afili nyɛ. 14 Kɛ Kristo gbɛi hewɔ ajɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ, ejaakɛ anunyam Mumɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ. 15Shi nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akana amanehulu akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ loo julɔ loo efɔŋfeelɔ aloo mɔ ko ni kɛ ehe woɔ mɛi krokomɛi asaji amli. 16 Shi kɛ mɔ ko na amanehulu akɛ Kristofonyo lɛ, ehiɛ akagbo, shi moŋ ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam ejaakɛ ehiɛ Kristo gbɛi.
17 Ejaakɛ be ni abaaje kojomɔ shishi kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ eshɛ etã; shi kɛ wɔnɔ tsutsu ejɛ lɛ, belɛ mɛi ni booo Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ, te amɛnaagbee aaafee tɛŋŋ?
18 Ni kɛ ekpakpa ko dani aaahere jalɔ yiwala lɛ,
“Mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei
kɛ eshafeelɔ lɛ,
nɛgbɛ amɛbaadamɔ?”
19 No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni naa amanehulu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaa lɛ hu atu amɛsusumai amɛwo bɔlɔ anɔkwafo lɛ dɛŋ yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ mli.

Title: 1 PETRO 5
Content:
Wiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hã asafo lɛ mli onukpai
1 No hewɔ lɛ, onukpai ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mi ni mi ji onukpa lɛ eko kɛ Kristo amanehului lɛ ahe odasefonyo ni baana anunyam ni abaajie kpo lɛ hu eko lɛ; ŋaa ni miwoɔ amɛ nɛ. 2 Nyɛlɛa Nyɔŋmɔ tooku ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ, jeee nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ yɛ suɔmɔ naa; tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ, asaŋ jeee sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛgbele hewɔ, shi moŋ tsuijurɔ naa; 3 asaŋ jeee akɛ mɛi ni yeɔ mɛi ni akɛhã nyɛ nɔkwɛmɔ lɛ anɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, shi moŋ mɛi ni feɔ amɛhe nɔkwɛmɔnɔ amɛhãa toiku lɛ. 4 Ni be ni Tookwɛlɔnukpa lɛ aaajie ehe kpo lɛ, nyɛnine aaashɛ anunyam akekre ni ŋalaaa lɛ nɔ.
Heshibaa kɛ hiɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔfɔɔ
5 Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa onukpai lɛ. Ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbabaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛ heshibaa afee mama nyɛŋmɔa nyɛhɛ, ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ kuɔ hewolɔi anaa, shi eduroɔ heshibalɔi.” 6 Hewɔ lɛ nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nine ni wa lɛ shishi, koni ewo nyɛnɔ yɛ be ni sa mli. 7 Nyɛkɛ nyɛhaomɔ fɛɛ afɔ̃a enɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛsane kã etsui nɔ.
Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ nyɛtsia abonsam gbɛ
8 Nyɛhiɛ akãa shi, nyɛsaraa ejaakɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔ, abonsam lɛ, nyiɛ tamɔ jata ni huɔ eetao mɔ ko emi. 9 Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli nyɛtsĩa lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nakai amanehului lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ hu naa.
10 Shi dromɔ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛba enaanɔ anunyam lɛ mli yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, kɛ nyɛna amanehulu fioo nɛɛ etã lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eeesaa nyɛ pɛ, ni eeewaje nyɛ, ni eeewo nyɛ hewalɛ ni eeehã nyɛfi shi shiŋŋ.
11Lɛ nɔŋŋ aaaŋɔ hewalɛ ahã kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Shɛɛ kɛ bimɔ
12 Mitsɔ̃ wɔnyɛmi Silvano ni ji anɔkwafo tamɔ bɔ ni mibuɔ lɛ lɛ nɔ miŋma nyɛ wolo fioo nɛɛ mikɛmiiwo nyɛ ekãa, ni mikɛmiiye odase miishi sɛɛ akɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa dromɔ lɛ. Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ mli.
13 Asafo ni yɔɔ Babilon ni ahala amɛ tamɔ ahala wɔ lɛ kɛ mibi Marko hu miibi nyɛ. 14 Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ suɔmɔ naashwɔmɔ.

Title: 2 PETRO WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Petro Wolo ni ji enyɔ lɛ eŋma eyahã klɛŋklɛŋ Kristofoi asafo kpeteŋkple ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ. Nɔ pɔtɛ̃ɛ hewɔ ni eŋma wolo lɛ ji, bɔ ni afee ni anyɛ aku amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ anitsumɔ lɛ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ yibii ni nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ woɔ lɛ naa. Bɔ pɛ ni aaanyɛ afee adãmɔ naagbai nɛɛ anaa ji akɛ amɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo he anɔkwa nilee lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, akɛni nilee nɛɛ ejɛ mɛi ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛna Yesu kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi ni eetsɔ̃ɔ nii ni amɛnu enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hu lɛ adɛŋ lɛ.
Nɔ ni gbaa woloŋmalɔ lɛ naa titri ji tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni mɛi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu ekuŋ esɛɛ ebaŋ dɔŋŋ lɛ. Etsɔ̃ɔ naa akɛ kɛji efee mɛi komɛi akɛ Yesu baa ekoŋŋ lɛ etsɛ tsɔ̃ lɛ, amɛsusumɔ lɛ jeee nakai ni, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miito etsui shi akɛni esumɔɔɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi alaaje, shi moŋ eshwee ji akɛ mɛi fɛɛ atsake amɛtsui ni amɛkpa eshafeemɔ (3.9).
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-2
Kristofoi atsɛmɔ 1.3-21
Amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi 2.1-22
Kristo naagbee baa lɛ 3.1-18

Title: 2 PETRO 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1Simon Petro ni ji Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ bɔfo lɛ ŋma yahã mɛi ni nine eshɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni jara wa tamɔ wɔnɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo jalɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 2Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ afa ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu he nilee lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛɔ ni ehalaa
3 ENyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ nii fiaa ni hi hã wala kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ eke wɔ yɛ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam kɛ ehewalɛ nɔ etsɛ wɔ lɛ he nilee mli. 4Ni etsɔ̃ nii nɛɛ anɔ hu ekɛ shiwoi kpeleikpelei ni jara wa lɛ eke wɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ nɔ nyɛjo je nɛɛŋ fitemɔ ni yɔɔ akɔnɔ mli lɛ naa foi ni nyɛna Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ eko. 5 Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ nuufeemɔ afataa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ he; nyɛkɛ nilee afataa nuufeemɔ lɛ he; 6nyɛkɛ henɔyeli afataa nilee lɛ he; nyɛkɛ hiɛmiamɔ afataa henɔyeli lɛ he; nyɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ afataa hiɛmiamɔ lɛ he; 7 nyɛkɛ nyɛmimɛi ahedɔɔ afataa Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ he; ni nyɛkɛ suɔmɔ afataa nyɛmimɛi ahedɔɔ lɛ he. 8Ejaakɛ kɛji nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛmli ni efa lɛ, ehãŋ nyɛfee mɛi ni ebɔɔɔ mɔdɛŋ aloo mɛi ni wooo yibii yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo he nilee lɛ gbɛfaŋ. 9 Ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ lɛ shwilafo ji lɛ, ni enaaa shɔŋŋ nii, ni ehiɛ ekpa ehe ni atsuu kɛjɛ eshai ni efee sa lɛ amli lɛ anɔ.
10Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtsɛmɔ kɛ nyɛhalamɔ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ; ejaakɛ, kɛ nyɛfee enɛ lɛ, nyɛtɛrɛŋ gbi ko gbi ko. 11Ejaakɛ nakai ni aaaŋmɛ nyɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlibotemɔ gbɛ aahu tsɔ̃.
12No hewɔ lɛ, daa nɛɛ majwɛŋ nɔ makai nyɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, tsɛ nyɛle momo, ni nyɛnane emɔ shi yɛ anɔkwale ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ mli. 13 Shi gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, mibuɔ akɛ eja akɛ mikɛ kaimɔ ahɛle nyɛ shi. 14 Ejaakɛ mile akɛ migbele lɛ baaba nɔŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hu ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ. 15Shi mabɔ he mɔdɛŋ koni mijeŋjee sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ ahi nii nɛɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be.
Kristo anunyam lɛ he odasefoi
16Ejaakɛ jeee adesai ni afolɔ anɔ wɔdamɔ wɔjaje wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hewalɛ kɛ ebaa lɛ he sane wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, shi moŋ wɔji odasefoi ni na enunyam kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ wɔhiŋmɛii. 17 Ejaakɛ ena woo kɛ anunyam kɛjɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, be ni nakai gbee lɛ kɛ lɛ wie kɛjɛ anunyam kpeteŋkple lɛ mli akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni mina ehe tsui lɛ.” 18Ni nɛkɛ gbee nɛɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu akɛ ŋwɛi ejɛ, be ni wɔ kɛ lɛ yɔɔ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
19Ni ama gbalɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ mi ahã wɔ fe tsutsu lɛ, ni kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ no nɔ akɛ là ni tsoɔ yɛ he ko ni woɔ duŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni je aaatsɛre ni tooloo lɛ aaate shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmiifee jogbaŋŋ. 20Ni nyɛlea enɛ tsutsu akɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli gbalɛ fɛɛ gbalɛ lɛ jeee mɔ ko niiashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni. 21 Ejaakɛ gbalɛ ko bako yɛ gbɔmɔ suɔmɔ̃naa pɛŋ, shi moŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsirɛ gbɔmɛi ni amɛwie wiemɔi ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã amɛ lɛ.

Title: 2 PETRO 2
Content:
Amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwereɔ be kukuoo kɛkɛ
1 Shi amalegbalɔi hu te shi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi baaba nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ lɛ. Amɛkɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi aaaba nigii, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni kpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ po, amɛaakwa lɛ, ni amɛkɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni he yɔɔ oya aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ. 2Ni mɛi pii aaanyiɛ amɛnyɛnyɛntswibɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛhewɔ lɛ aaawie anɔkwale gbɛ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔi. 3Ni amɛkɛ hiɛjoomɔ kɛ shishiumɔ wiemɔi aaatao ni amɛna nyɛhe sɛɛ. Shi kojomɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ aaaba amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ wɔɔɔ!
4Ejaakɛ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bɔfoi ni fee esha lɛ ahe ekeee amɛ, shi moŋ etsi amɛ ewo gbohiiaje bu kɛ emli duŋ lɛ mli, ni eŋɔ amɛ ehã akɛ akɛ amɛ ato ahã kojomɔ, 5 ni asaŋ kɛ ekɛ blema je lɛ he ekeee lɛ, shi moŋ Noa ni ji jalɛ shiɛlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni gbe yi fee kpaanyɔ lɛ kɛkɛ yi ebaa, ni ekɛ nu afua lɛ ba mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ aje lɛ nɔ, 6 ni kɛji Sodom kɛ Gomora maji lɛ hu eshã ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃ lamlu, ni ekɛ butumɔ kojo amɛ ekɛto mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ okadi, 7ni kɛji ejie Lot, jalɔ, mɔ ni hao yɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔi lɛ anyɛnyɛntswibɔɔ jeŋba lɛ he lɛ, yɛ mli 8 (ejaakɛ amɛmlatɔ̃mɔ nitsumɔi lɛ ni jalɔ lɛ na ni enu be ni eyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ piŋ esusuma ni ja lɛ daa gbi) lɛ, 9 belɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le bɔ ni efeɔ ejieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi yɛ kaa mli, kɛ bɔ ni efeɔ etoɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji yɛ piŋmɔ mli kɛyashi kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ; 10shi titri lɛ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo akɔnɔ ni yɔɔ muji sɛɛ, ni amɛbuuu nɔyeli hewalɛ lɛ, tsuisalɔi kɛ yibulɔi ni kɛji amɛmiiye gbɔmɛi agboi ahe osheku ni amɛhe kpokpooo; 11tsɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete ni yɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ babaoo fe amɛ lɛ, amɛ po amɛwieee amɛhe efɔŋ kɛkojooo amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi ajeŋba tuuŋtu
12Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tamɔ kooloi ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni afɔ amɛ ahã mɔmɔ kɛ gbee lɛ, amɛwieɔ nii ni amɛleee he nɔ ko lɛ he efɔŋ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ, 13ni aaafee amɛ efɔŋ akɛ efɔŋ ni amɛfee mɛi krokomɛi lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo. Amɛbuɔ shwane fintiŋŋ ahoshwibɔɔ akɛ nii ni ŋɔɔ; mujiatsɛmɛi ni he yɔɔ taŋ ni; amɛmii shɛɔ yɛ amɛshishiumɔi lɛ ahe be ni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeɔ nii lɛ. 14Amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbãlãfitemɔ ni kpaaa eshafeemɔ. Amɛlakaa susumai ni nane mɔko shi lɛ. Amɛyɛ tsui ni he esa kɛ hiɛjoomɔ; loomɔbii ni. 15 Amɛje gbɛ ni ja lɛ nɔ, ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛyanyiɛ Beor bi Bileam, mɔ ni sumɔ nɔshafeemɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo lɛ, gbɛ lɛ nɔ; 16 shi akã ehiɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emlatɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ, teji ni leee wiemɔ lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔ gbee wie, ni etsĩ gbalɔ lɛ kwashiafeemɔ lɛ naa.
17Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji nubui ni nu bɛ mli, atatui ni ahum loɔ kɛyaa, mɛi ni akɛ duŋ kpii lɛ eto ehã amɛ. 18Ejaakɛ akɛni naafuu wiemɔi wuji jeɔ amɛnaa hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ heloo akɔnɔi anɔ amɛkɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lakaa mɛi ni je mɛi ni baa amɛjeŋ yɛ shishiumɔ mli lɛ adɛŋ etsɛko lɛ; 19 amɛwoɔ amɛ shi akɛ amɛaaye amɛhe, tsɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ fitemɔ nyɔ̃ji ji amɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni aye enɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyɔŋ ehã mɔ ni ye enɔ lɛ. 20 Ejaakɛ kɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo he nilee lɛ nɔ amɛjo je nɛɛ mli mujinii lɛ anaa foi ni asaa adu amɛ yɛ nomɛi amli ni aye amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛnaagbee shihilɛ etsɔ̃ efɔŋ fe amɛtsutsu shihilɛ lɛ. 21 Ejaakɛ faŋ nɔ ni amɛnaaa amɛle jalɛ gbɛ lɛ, fe nɔ ni amɛle ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpale kɛjɛ kitã krɔŋkrɔŋ ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ lɛ he. 22 Shi anɔkwa abɛ lɛ eba mli yɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Gbee kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshwee he, ni kplotoo ni aju ehe lɛ yakokloɔ ŋmɔtɔ mli.”

Title: 2 PETRO 3
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ hãaa Naagbee Gbi lɛ aba mra
1 Agbɛnɛ, suɔmɔmɛi, enɛ ji wolo ni ji enyɔ ni miŋmaa nyɛ, ni fɛɛ mli lɛ makai nyɛ ni mikɛhɛle nyɛjwɛŋmɔ krɔŋŋ lɛ shi 2ni nyɛkai gbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ awiemɔi ni amɛwie sa kɛ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ kitã ni bɔfoi ni atsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ.
3 Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛle enɛ, akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, hefɛoyelɔi aaaba kɛ hefɛoyeli, ni amɛaanyiɛ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi lɛ anaa, 4 ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ebaa lɛ he shiwoo lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni tsɛmɛi lɛ tee yawɔwɔi nɛɛ, bɔ ni nibii fɛɛ yɔɔ kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ shishijee mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛyɔɔ nɛɛ.” 5 Kwa amɛkwaa amɛ jieɔ amɛhiɛ yɛ enɛ nɔ akɛ ŋwɛi yɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe, ni shikpɔŋ hu jɛ nu mli, ni etsɔ̃ nu mli ebama shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ naa; 6 no nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ni nu ŋɔ je ni yɔɔ no be lɛ mli lɛ ni ehiɛ kpãtã lɛ. 7 Shi ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ, nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ekɛ amɛ to hã là kɛyashi kojomɔ gbi lɛ ni aaakpãtã mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
8 Shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa sane kome nɛɛ nɔ, akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, gbi kome tamɔ afii akpe, ni afii akpe hu tamɔ gbi kome. 9 Jeee tsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hãa eshiwoo lɛ sɛɛ tsɛɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi komɛi susuɔ akɛ esɛɛ etsɛ lɛ, shi moŋ etsui shi etoɔ ehãa wɔ, ejaakɛ esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi alaaje, shi moŋ akɛ mɛi fɛɛ atsake amɛtsui. 10 Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ baaba tamɔ julɔ, ni no mli lɛ ŋwɛi lɛ aaaho aya kɛ gbɛɛmɔ, ni je nɛɛ mli shishijeenii lɛ aaashã ni amɛaatserɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kɛ emli nii lɛ aaashã.
Nyɛhiɛ akajea jeŋ ni yɔɔ daa lɛ nɔ
11Agbɛnɛ, akɛni nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ baafite hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛ gbɔmɛi sa akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ yɛ jeŋba krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli? 12Be mli ni nyɛkwɛɔ gbɛ ni nyɛshweɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Gbi lɛ baa lɛ, nɔ mli ni ŋwɛi aaahere kɛ là ni eeetsere, ni jeŋ shishijeenii hu aaasere yɛ là mli lɛ! 13 Shi yɛ eshiwoo lɛ naa lɛ, wɔmiikwɛ ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee ni jalɛ hiɔ mli lɛ gbɛ.
14 No hewɔ lɛ, suɔmɔmɛi, akɛni nyɛkwɛɔ nii nɛɛ agbɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ koni ana nyɛ ni muji loo kpa ko bɛ nyɛhe yɛ ehiɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; 15ni nyɛbua wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ tsuishitoo lɛ akɛ yiwalaheremɔ, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔsuɔmɔ nyɛmi Paulo lɛ hu ŋma nyɛ, yɛ nilee ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ naa lɛ, 16tamɔ bɔ ni ewieɔ enɛɛmɛi ahe yɛ ewoji lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ. Woji nɛɛ amli nibii komɛi yɛ ni amɛshishinumɔ wa, ni mɛi ni ekaseko nɔ ko lɛ kɛ mɛi ni nane mɔko shi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ shishi ekroko, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfeɔ ŋmalɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛkpãtãa amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ.
17Agbɛnɛ suɔmɔmɛi, akɛni nyɛ lɛ nyɛle momosa hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, koni akɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji alakamɔ sane lɛ akashãtã nyɛ hu, ni nyɛjɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshifimɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi 18Shi nyɛshwerea yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ kɛ nilee lɛ mli. Lɛ nɔŋŋ aŋɔ anunyam ahã agbɛnɛ kɛ daa. Amen!

Title: 1 YOHANE WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Yohane Klɛŋklɛŋ Wolo lɛ hiɛ otii titrii enyɔ; akɛ ebaawo ekanelɔi lɛ hewalɛ ni amɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ eBi, Yesu Kristo ahi shi yɛ naanyobɔɔ mli; agbɛnɛ hu koni ebɔ ekanelɔi lɛ akɔkɔ ni amɛkanyiɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi asɛɛ ni amɛbafite naanyobɔɔ nɛɛ. Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ edamɔ he ni aheɔ ayeɔ akɛ esha jɛ shrãmɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesai kɛ je lɛ naa lɛ nɔ, enɛ hewɔ lɛ Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, nyɛŋ efee gbɔmɔ adesa krɔŋŋ. Tsɔ̃ɔlɔi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ dani mɔ ko aaakɛɛ akɛ ahere eyiwala lɛ, belɛ ja ewi ehe kɛjɛ je nɛŋ nibii ahe. Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ hu akɛ yiwalaheremɔ kɛ subaŋ kpakpa loo suɔmɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ ahe ehĩaaa.
Woloŋmalɔ lɛ wie eshi nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ ni egba mli kpoo akɛ Yesu Kristo lɛ gbɔmɔ adesa krɔŋŋ ji lɛ. Esaa ema nɔ mi akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ Yesu nɔ amɛyeɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sa akɛ amɛsumɔsumɔɔ amɛhe hu.

Title: 1 YOHANE 1
Content:
Wala Wiemɔ lɛ
1 Wala wiemɔ lɛ yɛ kɛjɛ shishijee. Wɔnu ni wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛii, wɔkwɛ ni wɔniji etara he yɛ wala wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ. 2 Ni wala lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, ni wɔna, ni wɔyeɔ he odase ni wɔjajeɔ naanɔ wala lɛ, nɔ ni kɛ Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ he sane wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ. 3Nɔ ni wɔna ni wɔnu lɛ, no wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ hu, koni nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ wɔ abɔ naanyo. Shi wɔnaanyobɔɔ lɛ, Tsɛ lɛ kɛ eBi Yesu Kristo lɛ wɔkɛbɔɔ. 4 Wɔmiiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ ayi obɔ̃.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ là ji lɛ
5 Ni enɛ ji sane lɛ ni wɔnu kɛjɛ ebi lɛ ŋɔɔ ni wɔsaa wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ. No ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, là ji lɛ, ni duŋ ko kwraa bɛ emli, 6 Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ wɔkɛ lɛ miibɔ naanyo ni wɔnyiɛɔ duŋ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiimale ni wɔyeee anɔkwa. 7 Shi kɛji wɔnyiɛɔ là lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɔɔ là lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe miibɔ naanyo, ni eBi Yesu Kristo la lɛ tsumɔɔ wɔhe kɛjeɔ esha fɛɛ mli.
8Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ esha ko bɛ wɔhe lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔshishiuɔ, ni anɔkwale lɛ bɛ wɔmli. 9 Kɛji wɔjaje wɔhe eshai lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, anɔkwafo kɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni ekɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ aaafa wɔ ni eeetsumɔ wɔhe kɛjɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ fɛɛ mli. 10Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ wɔfeko esha lɛ, belɛ wɔhã Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ amalelɔ, ni ewiemɔ lɛ bɛ wɔmli.

Title: 1 YOHANE 2
Content:
Kristo, wɔyelikɛbualɔ
1 Mibii bibii, miiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ koni nyɛkafee esha. Ni kɛ mɔ ko fee esha jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ mlidaamɔlɔ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, Yesu Kristo jalɔ lɛ. 2 Lɛ ji wɔhe eshai lɛ ahe kpãtãmɔnɔ; shi jeee wɔnɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ hu.
3Ni kɛ wɔyeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, no wɔkɛnaa akɛ wɔle lɛ. 4Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Mile lɛ,” ni eyeee ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, amalelɔ ji lɛ, ni anɔkwale lɛ bɛ emli. 5 Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, lɛ emli Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ eye emuu yɛ. Enɛ wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔyɛ emli. 6 Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ eyɛ emli lɛ, sa akɛ enyiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu enyiɛɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Kitã hee lɛ
7 Suɔmɔmɛi, jeee kitã hee ko miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, shi moŋ kitã momo ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Kitã momo lɛ ji wiemɔ ni nyɛnu lɛ. 8 Shi asaŋ kitã hee miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, nɔ ni ji anɔkwa yɛ Kristo mli kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛmli lɛ, ejaakɛ duŋ lɛ eho, ni anɔkwa là lɛ miitso momo.
9 Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ eyɛ la lɛ mli ni enyɛ̃ɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eyɛ duŋ lɛ mli lolo. 10Mɔ ni sumɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eyɛ la lɛ mli, ni nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔnɔ ko bɛ emli. 11Shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, duŋ lɛ mli eyɔɔ, ni duŋ lɛ mli enyiɛɔ, ni eleee he ni eyaa, ejaakɛ duŋ lɛ eshwila ehiŋmɛii.
Nyɛkasumɔa je lɛ
12Miiŋma nyɛ, mibii bibii, ejaakɛ akɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ efa nyɛ yɛ Kristo gbɛi lɛ hewɔ. 13Miiŋma nyɛ, ataamɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Miiŋma nyɛ, oblahii, ejaakɛ nyɛye mɔ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.
14 Miiŋma nyɛ, gbekɛbii, ejaakɛ nyɛle Tsɛ lɛ.
Miiŋma nyɛ, ataamɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Miŋma nyɛ, oblahii, ejaakɛ nyɛhe wa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmli, ni nyɛye mɔ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.
15 Nyɛkasumɔa je lɛ loo nibii ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli. Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ je lɛ, belɛ Tsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ lɛ bɛ emli, 16ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ — heloo lɛ sɛɛdiinii lɛ kɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ asɛɛdiinii lɛ kɛ shihilɛ mli hewoo lɛ — ejɛɛɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli, shi moŋ je lɛ mli ejɛ. 17Je lɛ hoɔ eyaa kɛ emli sɛɛdiinii lɛ, shi mɔ ni feɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe yɛ Kristo henyɛlɔi ahe
18 Gbekɛbii, naagbee ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɛ; ni bɔ ni nyɛnu akɛ Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ miiba lɛ, Kristo henyɛlɔi lɛ pii eba amrɔ nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ wɔle akɛ naagbee ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɛ. 19 Wɔteŋ amɛjɛ amɛtee, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛjeee wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi, ejaakɛ wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi ji amɛ kulɛ amɛ kɛ wɔ hi shi. Shi amɛtee bɔ ni afee ni amɛ jie amɛhe shi akɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ jeee wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi ji amɛ.
20 Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛna mufɔɔ kɛjɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ, ni nyɛle nii fɛɛ. 21Jeee akɛ nyɛleee anɔkwale lɛ hewɔ miŋma nyɛ nɛɛ, shi moŋ akɛ nyɛle, ni nyɛle akɛ amale komeflo jɛɛɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli.
22Namɔ ji amalelɔ, kɛjeee mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ Yesu jeee Kristo lɛ? Mɔ ni kwaa Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ, lɛ ji Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ, 23 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaa Bi lɛ, ebɛ Tsɛ lɛ hu; shi mɔ ni gbaa mli kpoo akɛ eheɔ Bi lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ Tsɛ lɛ hu.
24 No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, nyɛhãa no ahia nyɛmli. Kɛji nɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ hi nyɛmli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛaahi Bi lɛ kɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli. 25Ni enɛ ji shi ni ewo wɔ lɛ — naanɔ wala lɛ.
26Mɛi ni hãa nyɛduɔ gbɛ lɛ ahewɔ miŋmaa nyɛ nii nɛɛ. 27 Ni nyɛ lɛ, mufɔɔ ni nyɛna kɛjɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmli, ni ehe ehĩaaa nyɛ akɛ mɔ ko atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii, shi moŋ bɔ ni emufɔɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii fɛɛ, ni eji anɔkwale ni jeee amale ni lɛ, bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ nyɛhia emli.
28 Ni agbɛnɛ, mibii bibii, nyɛhia emli koni be ni eeebapue lɛ, wɔna ekãa ni wɔhiɛ akagboi ni wɔnyɛɛɛ ehiɛ wɔdamɔ yɛ ebaa lɛ mli. 29 Kɛji nyɛle akɛ jalɔ ji lɛ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ afɔ lɛ kɛjɛ emli.

Title: 1 YOHANE 3
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ bii
1 Nyɛkwɛa suɔmɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛsumɔ wɔ, akɛ atsɛ wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii, ni nakai wɔji! Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ leee wɔ, ejaakɛ eleee Nyɔŋmɔ. 2 Suɔmɔmɛi, agbɛnɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji wɔ, ni anako ajie nɔ ni wɔbaatsɔ̃mɔ lɛ shi; shi wɔle akɛ, be ni aaajie no shi lɛ, wɔɔtamɔ Kristo, ejaakɛ wɔɔna lɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ. 3Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ yɛ emli lɛ, etsuuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ ehe tse lɛ.
4Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ eefee mlatɔ̃mɔnii hu; ni esha lɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ ni. 5 Ni nyɛle akɛ Kristo jie ehe kpo, koni ewo wɔhe eshai kɛya; ni esha ko bɛ emli. 6 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hiɔ emli lɛ, efeee esha; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, enako lɛ ni asaŋ eleko lɛ.
7 Bii bibii, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miihã nyɛdu gbɛ. Mɔ ni tsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ, jalɔ ji lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu eji jalɔ lɛ. 8 Mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, ejɛ abonsam mli; ejaakɛ kɛjɛ shishijee beebe lɛ, abonsam feɔ esha. Enɛ hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ jie ehe kpo koni efite abonsam nitsumɔi lɛ.
9 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, efeee esha, ejaakɛ esu yɛ emli, ni enyɛŋ esha efee, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ. 10Enɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ kɛ abonsam bii lɛ jieɔ amɛhe shi faŋŋ yɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuuu jalɛnii lɛ, ejɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, nakai nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ enyɛmi hu.
Nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe
11 Ejaakɛ enɛ ji sane ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, akɛ wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe. 12 Jeee tamɔ Kain ni jɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ mli ni egbe enyɛmi lɛ. Ni mɛɛ hewɔ egbe lɛ? Ejaakɛ enitsumɔi lɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni, shi enyɛmi lɛ nɔ lɛ ja.
13 Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji je lɛ miinyɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akafea nyɛ yaa. 14 Wɔle akɛ wɔfo mli kɛjɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli, ejaakɛ wɔsumɔɔ wɔnyɛmimɛi. 15 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ ji lɛ; ni nyɛle akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ko gbɔmɔgbelɔ ko bɛ naanɔ wala yɛ emli. 16 Enɛ mli wɔyoɔ suɔmɔ lɛ yɛ, akɛ ekɛ ewala ŋmɛ shi yɛ wɔhewɔ, ni sa akɛ wɔ hu wɔ kɛ wɔwala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi ahewɔ. 17 Shi mɔ ni yɔɔ je nɛɛ mli nii, ni enaa akɛ efi enyɛmi, ni emli joɔ yɛ enɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ aaahi emliŋ? 18 Mibii bibii, nyɛkahãa wɔsumɔa mɛi yɛ wiemɔ mli loo lilɛi nɔ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ nitsumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli hu.
Wɔnaa ekãa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ
19Ni no wɔkɛaale akɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli wɔjɛ, ni wɔɔtsɛ wɔtsui wɔŋmɛ wɔmli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 20Kɛji wɔtsui buɔ wɔ fɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ da fe wɔtsui, ni ele nii fiaa. 21 Kɛji wɔtsui ebuuu wɔ fɔ lɛ, wɔnaa ekaã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. 22 Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaa lɛ lɛ, wɔnaa yɛ edɛŋ, ejaakɛ wɔyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ni wɔfeɔ nii ni sa ehiɛ. 23 Ni enɛ ji ekitã lɛ, akɛ wɔhe eBi Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ nɔ wɔye, ni wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo wɔ kitã lɛ. 24 Ni mɔ ni yeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ hiɔ emli, ni lɛ hu ehiɔ emli; ni nɔ ni wɔkɛleɔ akɛ ehiɔ wɔmli ji Mumɔ ni ekɛhã wɔ lɛ.

Title: 1 YOHANE 4
Content:
Anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ kɛ shishiumɔ mumɔ lɛ
1 Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛkahea mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ nyɛyea; shi moŋ nyɛkaa mumɔi lɛ nyɛkwɛa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli amɛjɛ lo, ejaakɛ amalegbalɔi pii eba je lɛ mli. 2Enɛ nyɛkɛaayoo Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ. Mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ ni jajeɔ faŋŋ akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ. 3 Ni mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ ni ejajeee akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli lɛ, jeee Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ, shi moŋ no ji Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛnu ehe akɛ eeba, ni agbɛnɛ tete eyɛ je lɛ mli momo lɛ.
4Mibii bibii, nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ni nyɛye amalegbalɔi lɛ anɔ kunim; ejaakɛ Mumɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ da fe mumɔ ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ. 5 Amɛ lɛ, je lɛ mli amɛjɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛwieɔ akɛ mɛi ni jɛ je lɛ mli, ni je lɛ boɔ amɛ toi. 6 Wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mli wɔjɛ; mɔ ni le Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi mɔ ni jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, ebooo wɔ toi. No wɔkɛyoɔ anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ kɛ shishiumɔ mumɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ
7Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛhãa wɔsumɔsumɔa wɔhe; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ. Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ mɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ ni ele Nyɔŋmɔ. 8Mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ mɔ lɛ, eleee Nyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ. 9 Enɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ wɔ lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi koome lɛ kɛba je lɛ mli, koni wɔtsɔ̃ enɔ wɔna wala. 10 Enɛ mli suɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ, jeee akɛ wɔ ni wɔsumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ lɛ ni esumɔ wɔ, ni etsu eBi lɛ akɛ ebafee wɔhe eshai lɛ ahe kpãtãmɔnɔ.
11 Suɔmɔmɛi, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔ hu wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe. 12 Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔ ko enako lɛ pɛŋ. Kɛji wɔsumɔɔ wɔhe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɔ wɔmli, ni esuɔmɔ lɛ yeɔ emuu yɛ wɔmli.
13 Nɔ ni wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔhiɔ emli ni lɛ hu ehiɔ wɔmli ji akɛ ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eMumɔ lɛ eko ehã wɔ. 14 Ni wɔ lɛ wɔna ni wɔmiiye odase akɛ Tsɛ lɛ etsu eBi lɛ akɛ je lɛ yiwalaherelɔ. 15 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jajeɔ faŋŋ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɔ emli, ni lɛ hu ehiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli. 16 Ni wɔ lɛ wɔ́le, ni wɔ́he suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛsumɔɔ wɔ lɛ wɔye. Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ, ni mɔ ni hiɔ suɔmɔ mli lɛ, ehiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hu hiɔ emli. 17 Enɛ mli suɔmɔ lɛ eye emuu yɛ, yɛ wɔmli akɛ wɔɔna ekãa yɛ Kojomɔ Gbi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, nakai wɔ hu wɔyɔɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli. 18Gbeyeishemɔ bɛ suɔmɔ mli, shi moŋ suɔmɔ ni eye emuu lɛ shwieɔ gbeyeishemɔ, ejaakɛ gbyeishemɔ mli yɛ piŋmɔ; ni mɔ ni sheɔ gbeyei lɛ, enako eye emuu yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
19Wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ tsutsu esumɔ wɔ. 20Kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ akɛ, “Miisumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,” ni enyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, amalelɔ ji lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ enyɛmi ni enaa lɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni enaaa lɛ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni eeenyɛ lɛ esumɔ hu? 21 Ni nɛkɛ kitã nɛɛ wɔna kɛjɛ eŋɔɔ, koni mɔ ni sumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ asumɔ enyɛmi hu.

Title: 1 YOHANE 5
Content:
1 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ akɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ. Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ mɔ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ, esumɔɔ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ hu.
Yesu Kristo he odaseyeli
2Kɛji wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni wɔyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, no wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ. 3 Ejaakɛ enɛ ji suɔmɔ ni wɔkɛsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akɛ wɔye ekitãi lɛ anɔ; ni ekitãi lɛ waaa, 4 ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ, eyeɔ je lɛ nɔ kunim; ni kunim ni wɔye je lɛ nɔ ji wɔhemɔkɛyeli. 5 Ni namɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ, akɛ ja mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ?
6 Yesu Kristo ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ nu kɛ lá mli kɛba, jeee nu kɛkɛ mli, shi moŋ nu kɛ lá mli. Ni Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni yeɔ odase lɛ, ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji anɔkwale lɛ. 7Shi mɛi etɛ̃ ji mɛi ni yeɔ odase lɛ, ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji anɔkwale lɛ. 8Mumɔ lɛ kɛ nu lɛ kɛ lá lɛ, ni mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ feɔ ekome. 9Kɛji wɔhe gbɔmɛi odase lɛ wɔye lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ odase lɛ da fe no; ni Nyɔŋmɔ odase lɛ ji akɛ eye odase yɛ eBi lɛ he. 10 Mɔ ni heɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ odase yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli, mɔ ni heee Nyɔŋmɔ eyeee lɛ, ehã Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ amalelɔ, ejaakɛ eheko odase ni Nyɔŋmɔ ye yɛ eBi lɛ he lɛ eyeko. 11Ni enɛ ji odase lɛ, akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ naanɔ wala ehã wɔ, ni nɛkɛ wala nɛɛ yɛ eBi lɛ mli. 12Mɔ ni yɔɔ Bi lɛ, eyɛ wala; mɔ ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ebɛ wala hu.
Naanɔ wala
13Miiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, nyɛna nyɛle akɛ nyɛyɛ naanɔ wala. 14 Ni ekãa ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ ehiɛ lɛ ji akɛ, kɛji wɔba nɔ ko yɛ esuɔmɔ naa lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi. 15Ni kɛji wɔle akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaa lɛ lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi lɛ, belɛ wɔle akɛ nii ni wɔba lɛ lɛ, wɔnine eshɛ nɔ.
16 Kɛji mɔ ko na enyɛmi miifee esha ni jeee esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ, eba Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeehã lɛ wala, no ji mɛi ni feɔ esha ni jeee esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ. Esha ko yɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli; jeee enɛ hewɔ mikɛɔ akɛ eba Nyɔŋmɔ. 17Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ esha ni, shi esha ko yɛ ni kɛ mɔ eyaaa gbele mli.
18 Wɔle akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, efeee esha; shi moŋ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, ekwɛɔ ehe nɔ, ni mɔ fɔŋ lɛ etaaa ehe.
19 Wɔle akɛ wɔjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ efɔŋ nɔyeli shishi.
20 Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ eba, ni ehã wɔ jwɛŋmɔ koni wɔle anɔkwafo lɛ. Ni wɔyɛ anɔkwafo lɛ mli, yɛ eBi Yesu Kristo lɛ mli, mɔ ni ji anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ naanɔ wala lɛ.
21 Mibii bibii, nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahĩa yɛ wɔji ahe.

Title: 2 YOHANE WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Yohane Wolo ni ji enyɔ lɛ “Onukpa lɛ” ŋma eyahã “esuɔmɔ Awula jurɔ ko kɛ ebii lɛ”; eeenyɛ eba lɛ akɛ jɛmɛ asafo lɛ kɛ emli bii lɛ ni. Wiemɔ kuku kɛkɛ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli ji akɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ miiba ekanelɔi lɛ ni amɛsumɔsumɔɔ amɛhe; nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, eebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ yɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔi gbohii lɛ ahe.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1-3
Suɔmɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ 4-6
Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ahe kɔkɔbɔɔ 7-11
Naamuu 12-13

Title: 2 YOHANE 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Onukpa lɛ ŋma yahã Awula ni ahala lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ, mɛi ni misumɔɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, ni jeee mi kome kɛkɛ, shi mɛi fɛɛ hu ni le anɔkwale lɛ 2yɛ anɔkwale ni hiɔ wɔmli ni ekɛ wɔ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ lɛ hewɔ.
3Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, Tsɛ lɛ Bi lɛ, dɛŋ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi yɛ anɔkwale suɔmɔ mli!
Anɔkwale kɛ suɔmɔ
4Mina miishɛɛ babaoo akɛ mina obii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nyiɛ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ wo wɔ kitã lɛ. 5 Ni agbɛnɛ miikpa bo fai, Awula, jeee akɛ belɛ miiŋma bo kitã hee ko, shi moŋ nɔ ni wɔyɔɔ kɛje shishijee lɛ, akɛ wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe. 6Ni suɔmɔ lɛ ji akɛ wɔnyiɛ yɛ ekitãi lɛ anaa; kitã lɛ ji akɛ, bɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, nyɛba nyɛjeŋ nakai.
7 Ejaakɛ shishiulɔi pii eba je lɛ mli, mɛi ni ejajeee akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli. Mɔ nɛ ji shishiulɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ. 8 Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkalaaje nii ni nyɛkɛ nitsumɔ ena lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛna nyɔmɔwoo muu.
9 Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tekeɔ Kristo tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ ni ehiii mli lɛ, ebɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; mɔ ni hiɔ Kristo tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, eyɛ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ. 10 Kɛ mɔ ko ba nyɛŋɔɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkaherea lɛ kɛbaa nyɛwe, ni nyɛkafalaa lɛ tete; 11ejaakɛ mɔ ni fala lɛ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ ekome yɛ enitsumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ amli.
Naagbee wiemɔi
12 Kulɛ miyɛ nibii pii ni maŋma nyɛ, shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mikɛ wolo kɛ “blɛgi” ŋmaa, shi moŋ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ abawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, koni wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ ayi obɔ̃.
13Onyɛmi yoo ni ahala lɛ bii lɛ miibi bo.

Title: 3 YOHANE WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Yohane Wolo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ “Onukpa lɛ” ŋma eyahã asafonukpa ko ni gbɛi ji Gaio lɛ. Woloŋmalɔ lɛ jie Gaio yi yɛ yelikɛbuamɔ ni ekɛhã Kristofoi krokomɛi lɛ hewɔ, ni ebɔ lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Diotrefe lɛ he.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1-4
Ajie Gaio yi 5-8
Agbe Diotrefe he guɔ 9-10
Ajuro Demetrio 11-12
Naamuu 13-15

Title: 3 YOHANE 1
Content:
Ŋamɔ
1 Onukpa lɛ ŋma yahã suɔlɔ Gaio, mɔ ni misumɔɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
2Suɔlɔ, miikpa fai akɛ oshwere yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli ni ohi hewalɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni osusuma shwereɔ lɛ. 3 Ejaakɛ mina miishɛɛ babaoo be ni nyɛmimɛi komɛi ba ni amɛbaye onɔkwale lɛ he odase, bɔ ni onyiɛɔ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ. 4Mibɛ miishɛɛ ko ni da fe enɛ akɛ manu akɛ mibii lɛ nyiɛɔ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ.
Gaio
5Suɔlɔ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otsuɔ ohãa nyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔkwale mli ofeɔ yɛ, tsɛbelɛ gbɔi ji amɛ. 6 Amɛ amɛbaye osuɔmɔ lɛ he odase yɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ; ni kɛ ooowo amɛ gbɛ bɔ ni sa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ooofee jogbaŋŋ. 7 Ejaakɛ Kristo gbɛi lɛ hewɔ amɛtee, ni amɛheee nɔ ko yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ. 8 No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔhereɔ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ atuu, koni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ anɔkwale lɛ he nanemɛi nitsulɔi.
Diotrefe kɛ Demetrio
9Miŋma wolo ko mimaje asafo lɛ, shi Diotrefe mɔ ni taoɔ amɛnɔ onukpa aye lɛ hereee wɔ. 10No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miba lɛ mahã nyɛle enifɔɔji anii ni efeɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ewieɔ wɔhe wiemɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, ni enɛɛmɛi tete hu faaa hãaa lɛ, shi moŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehereee nyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni asaŋ mɛi ni sumɔɔ akɛ amɛaafee nakai lɛ etsĩɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni eshwieɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ asafo lɛ mli.
11 Suɔlɔ, kaakase nɔ ni ji efɔŋ, shi kasemɔ nɔ ni ji ekpakpa moŋ. Mɔ ni feɔ ekpakpa lɛ, ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli; mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ lɛ, enako Nyɔŋmɔ.
12 Demetrio lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ miiye ehe odase, ni anɔkwale diɛŋtsɛ miiye ehe odase, ni wɔ hu wɔmiiye ehe odase, ni ole akɛ wɔdase lɛ anɔkwa ni.
Naagbee ŋamɔi
13 Kulɛ miyɛ nibii pii ni maŋma bo, shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mikɛ “blɛgi” kɛ niŋmaatso ŋmaa bo; 14shi moŋ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni mana bo, ni wɔɔwie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
15Hejɔlɛ ahã bo!
Wɔshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ miibi bo. Tsɛ wɔshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛii ekomekome ni oŋa amɛ.

Title: YUDA WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Yuda Wolo lɛ eŋma koni ekɛyabɔ amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi ni tsɛɔ amɛhe akɛ mɛi ni ehe Kristo nɔ amɛye lɛ kɔkɔ. Yɛ wolo kuku nɛɛ ni tamɔ Petro Wolo ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli lɛ, niŋmalɔ lɛ wo ekanelɔi lɛ ekãa ni amɛkã he amɛwu ta amɛkɛple hemɔkɛyeli ni Nyɔŋmɔ etu ewo krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ adɛŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ he.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1-2
Amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ asubaŋ, amɛnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ amɛfɔbuu 3-16
Ŋaawoo kɛhã hemɔkɛyeli mlihiɛmɔ 17-23
Jɔɔmɔ 24-25

Title: YUDA 1
Content:
1 Yuda, ni ji Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ; ŋma yahã mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ ni afee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli ni akɛ amɛ eto ahã Yesu Kristo lɛ.
2Mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ suɔmɔ afa kɛya nɔ ahã nyɛ!
Amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi
3 Suɔmɔmɛi, be ni misaa mihe kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ diɛŋtsɛ akɛ maŋma nyɛ yɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he sane he lɛ, mina akɛ ehe ehia akɛ maŋma ni mikɛwo nyɛ ekãa, koni nyɛpele hemɔkɛyeli ni atu awo krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ adɛŋ shi kome lɛ he. 4Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi komɛi eju shi ebabote wɔteŋ, mɛi ni blema beebe ajɛ aŋma amɛhe sane afɔ̃ shi ahã nɛkɛ kojomɔ nɛɛ, mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni ŋɔɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ amɛbɔɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi, ni amɛkwaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji nɔyelɔ koome lɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ. 5 Shi miitao akɛ makai nyɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛle enɛ fɛɛ momo lɛ, akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here maŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt, shi no sɛɛ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ahiɛ. 6 Ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi hu ni ehiɛɛɛ amɛnukpayeli lɛ mli, shi moŋ amɛshi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshihilɛhe lɛ, ekɛ naanɔ kpãi efimɔ amɛ eto duŋ kpii mli ehã Gbi Wulu lɛ nɔ kojomɔ lɛ. 7 Kaimɔ bɔ ni Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ maji ni jwere amɛhe lɛ, bɔ ni amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ aahu tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛtao ni amɛkɛ bɔfoi lɛ afee efɔŋ lɛ. Enɛ fɛɛ kã shi akɛ okadii hã mɛi fɛɛ ni naa naanɔ la mli nyɔmɔwoo lɛ.
8Nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi ni ju shi bote mli lɛ hu buleɔ heloo lɛ yɛ amɛlamɔi amli, ni amɛbuuu nɔyeli, ni amɛwieɔ anunyamtsɛmɛi ahe wiemɔi fɔ̃ji. 9 Shi bɔfonukpa Mikael lɛ, be ni ekɛ abonsam yiyiɔ ni ekɛ lɛ taa naa yɛ Mose gbonyo lɛ he lɛ, ekaaa akɛ eeebu lɛ fɔ ko, shi moŋ ekɛɛ, “Kã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaakã ohiɛ!” 10Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ, amɛ lɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛleee lɛ amɛyeɔ he osheku, shi nii ni amɛle yɛ amɛfɔmɔ su lɛ naa tamɔ kooloi ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ amɛkɛfiteɔ amɛhe. 11 Kpoo hã amɛ! Ejaakɛ amɛkɔ Kain gbɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɔ shishiumɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ tamɔ Bileam yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hewɔ, ni amɛhiɛ ekpãtã yɛ atuatsemɔ mli tamɔ Kora. 12Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni woɔ nyɛsuɔmɔ niyenii lɛ ahe muji, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ nyɛ yeɔ nii ni amɛsheee gbeyei. Ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe amɛlɛlɛɔ. Atatui ni nu bɛ amɛmli ni kɔɔyɔɔ kpalaa amɛ kɛbɔleɔ shi ji amɛ. Tsei ni yibiiwoo be mli lɛ amɛwooo yibii, shi amɛgboi shii enyɔ ni afãmɔ amɛ kɛ amɛshishifãi. 13 Ŋshɔkei hu ni yɔɔ hamahama ni fɛ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛgbejianii kɛbaa ŋwɛi tamɔ afũi ji amɛ. Amɛtamɔ ŋulamii dudulɔi, ni asaa duŋ kpii lɛ ato amɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.
14 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ahe ni Henok ni ba yɛ yinɔ ni ji kpawo mli kɛjɛ Adam nɔ lɛ gba yɛ akɛ, “Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miiba kɛ ekrɔŋkrɔŋbii akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai abɔ 15 ni ebakojo mɛi fɛɛ, ni ekã mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ bɛ mli fɛɛ kɛ wiemɔi ni wawai fɛɛ ni eshafeelɔi Nyɔŋmɔkwalɔi ewie yɛ ehe lɛ he.” 16Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji huhuuhu wielɔi kɛ krɔlɔi ni nɔ esaaa amɛhiɛ, ni nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi anaa, ni amɛnaabu wieɔ naafuu wiemɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ mɛi ahiɛsaa yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hewɔ.
Kɔkɔbɔi kɛ nitsɔɔmɔi
17Shi suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛkaia wiemɔi ni wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo bɔfoi lɛ ewie eto momo lɛ. 18 Amɛkɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Naagbee be lɛ mli lɛ, hefɛoyelɔi ni nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ anaa lɛ aaaba.” 19 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni kɛ mligbalamɔi baa lɛ, mɛi ni nyiɛɔ yɛ heloo naa ni bɛ mumɔ lɛ.
20 Shi suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛtswaa nyɛhe nyɛmaa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni he tse jogbaŋŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛsɔlea yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, 21ni nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛkwɛa wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mɔbɔnalɛ lɛ gbɛ koni nyɛna naanɔ wala.
22Mɛi ni ji jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛnaa amɛ mɔbɔ; 23 mɛi komɛi hu nyɛshaa amɛ kɛjɛa la lɛ mli kɛherea amɛyiwala; mɛi komɛi hu nyɛkɛ hegbeyeishemɔ anaa amɛ mɔbɔ, ni nyɛhĩa amɛtaade ni amɛkɛ heloo jeŋba ewo he muji lɛ tete.
Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ
24 Shi lɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛaabu nyɛhe ni nyɛkatɛrɛ ni eŋɔ nyɛ eyadamɔ enunyam lɛ hiɛ ni kpa ko bɛ nyɛhe yɛ mliflimɔ mli lɛ, 25 Nyɔŋmɔ koome ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, lɛ aŋɔ anunyam kɛ agbojee kɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ ahã kɛjɛ naanɔ agbɛnɛ kɛ naanɔ fɛɛ. Amen!

Title: KPOJIEMƆ WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Content:
WOLO LƐ HE SANE
Ninaa ni ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Yohane lɛ aŋma be mli ni awaa Kristofoi ayi yɛ he ni amɛheɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ amɛyeɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ. Oti pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni ma woloŋmalɔ lɛ hiɛ ji akɛ eeehã ekanelɔi lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni ewo amɛ ekãa kɛ shifimɔ koni amɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli gbãgbãlii be mli ni amɛnaa amanehulu ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ.
Wolo lɛ mli fa kpotoo lɛ, ewieɔ kpojiemɔ kɛ ninaa srɔtoisrɔtoi babaoo ahe. Tsɛ wiemɔ ni akɛŋma wolo lɛ shishinumɔ wa moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ Kristofoi ni aŋma ahã yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛnuɔ shishi faŋŋ; shi mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ naa lɛ akɛ teemɔŋ nɔ ko.
Otii pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni wolo lɛ wieɔ he lɛ, atiɔ amɛ mli shii abɔ yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi pii anɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ninai srɔtoi pii anɔ.
Shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔi kɛ shishinumɔi srɔtoi yɔɔ yɛ wolo nɛɛ he, shi kɛ̃lɛ wiemɔ krɛdɛɛ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ, no tuuŋtu lɛ ejeɔ shi faŋŋ. No ji akɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, naagbeenaagbee mli aahu lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baaye ehenyɛlɔi, ni Satan shi nɔ lɛ, anɔ kɛ̃. Nyɔŋmɔ baajuro emɛi ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi hee kɛ jeŋ hee be ni nɛkɛ kunimyeli nɛɛ baaye emuu lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi
Mlibotemɔ 1.1-8
Shishijee ninaa kɛ woji ni aŋmala ayahã asafoi kpawo lɛ 1.9—3.22
Wolo kɛ enaasɔomɔnii kpawo lɛ 4.1—8.1
Tɛtrɛmantrɛi kpawo lɛ 8.2—11.19
Drako lɛ kɛ kooloi enyɔ lɛ 12.1—13.18
Ninaa srɔtoi 14.1—15.8
Tɔi kpawo lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu 16.1-21
Babilon fitemɔ kɛ kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ kɛ Abonsam nɔyeli 17.1—20.10
Naagbee kojomɔ 20.11-15
Ŋwɛi hee kɛ jeŋ hee kɛ Yerusalɛm hee 21.1—22.5
Naamuu 22.6-21

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 1
Content:
Mlibotemɔ
1 Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ ní Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã lɛ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ etsuji nii ní sa akɛ aba mli nɔŋŋ ní ekɛtsu ebɔfo lɛ ni ehã etsulɔ, Yohane le lɛ. 2 Yohane ye Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo odase lɛ he odase, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ena lɛ he. 3 Ajɔɔ mɔ ni kaneɔ gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nibii ni aŋma yɛ mli lɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ be lɛ eshɛ etã.
Yohane miiŋa asafoi kpawo lɛ
4 Yohane ŋma yahã asafoi kpawo ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ. Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɛ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ dɛŋ; kɛ mumɔi kpawo ni yɔɔ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ; 5 kɛ Yesu Kristo ni ji odasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ, gbohii ateŋ kromɔbi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔyelɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Esumɔɔ wɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá etsuu wɔhe kɛjɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ amli, 6 ni ekɛ wɔ efee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ osɔfoi ehã eTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ aŋɔ anunyam kɛ hewalɛ ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!
7 Naa, eeba kɛ atatui lɛ, ni hiŋmɛi fɛɛ hiŋmɛi
aaana lɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsulɔ lɛ nii lɛ hu.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaawo yara yɛ
ehewɔ. Aba mli nakai. Amen!
8 “Mi ji Alfa kɛ Omega lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɛ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ,” Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ kɛɛ.
Yohane na Yesu yɛ ninaa mli
9Mi Yohane ni ji nyɛnyɛmi kɛ nyɛnaanyo yɛ Yesu Kristo amanehulu lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ ehiɛmiamɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Miyɛ ŋshɔkpɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Patmo lɛ nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo he odaseyeli lɛ hewɔ. 10 Miyɛ mumɔ mli yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko gbɛɛmɔ yɛ misɛɛ tamɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ 11ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni onaa lɛ; ŋmaa owo wolo mli, ni okɛmaje asafoi kpawo lɛ: Efeso kɛ Smirna kɛ Pergamo kɛ Tiatira kɛ Sarde kɛ Filadelfia kɛ Laodikea.”
12 Ni mitsɔ̃ mihe koni makwɛ mɔ gbee ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ. Ni be ni mitsɔ̃ mihe lɛ, mina shika kanetsei kpawo, 13 kɛ mɔ ko yɛ kanetsei lɛ ateŋ ni tamɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi, ni ewo atade yuu ni ekɛ shika kpãa efi etsitsi. 14 Eyitso kɛ eyitsɔi yɛɔ tamɔ toohetsɔi yɛŋ, tamɔ snoo, ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi, 15 ni enaji tamɔ ayawa kaŋkaŋ ni atsuu he yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli, ni egbee tamɔ nui babaoo gbɛɛmɔ. 16 Ehiɛ ŋulamii kpawo yɛ eninejurɔ, ni tsi kɛ enaa nta ni naa ba jɛ edaaŋ, ni ehiɛ tamɔ hulu ni miitso kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ. 17 Ni be ni mina lɛ lɛ, migbee shi yɛ enaji anaa tamɔ gbonyo; ni ekɛ eninejurɔ ŋmɛ minɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei; mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ 18kɛ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ. Migbo, ni naa, mihiɛ kã kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ, ni mihiɛ gbele kɛ gbohiiaje naa samfei lɛ. 19No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmaa nii ni ona lɛ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ kɛ nii ni baaba yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ. 20 Ŋulamii kpawo ni ona yɛ mininejurɔ lɛ kɛ shika kanetsei kpawo lɛ ahe teemɔ sane lɛ nɛ: ‘Ŋulamii kpawo lɛ ji asafoi kpawo lɛ abɔfoi, ni kanetsei kpawo lɛ ji asafoi kpawo lɛ.’ ”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 2
Content:
Efeso asafo lɛ
1 “Efeso asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyaha lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii ni mɔ ni hiɛ ŋulamii kpawo lɛ yɛ eninejurɔ ni enyiɛɔ shika kanetsei kpawo lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ. 2 Mile onitsumɔi lɛ kɛ odeŋmegbomɔ lɛ kɛ ohiɛmiamɔ lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni okpɛ̃lɛɛɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ; mile akɛ oka mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ bɔfoi ji amɛ shi amɛjeee bɔfoi lɛ ni ona akɛ amalelɔi ji amɛ. 3Ni ohiɛ mli, ni oŋmɛɔ otsui shi yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ni etɔko bo. 4Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ bo yɛ sane, no ji akɛ, oŋmɛɛ otsutsu suɔmɔ lɛ he. 5 No hewɔ lɛ, kaimɔ he ni ojɛ ogbee shi lɛ, ni otsake otsui, ni otsu tsutsu nitsumɔi lɛ. Shi kɛ jeee nakai lɛ, maba onɔ oya ni matsi okanetso lɛ kɛaajɛ egbɛhe lɛ, belɛ ja oshwa ohe. 6 Shi kɛ̃lɛ oyɛ nɔ ko, ni no ji akɛ onyɛɔ Nikolaimɛi lɛ anitsumɔi lɛ ni mi hu minyɛɔ lɛ. 7 Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛ nuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ. Mɔ ni yeɔ kunim lɛ, mahã lɛ hegbɛ ni eye walatso lɛ ni yɔɔ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Paradeiso lɛ mli lɛ nɔ yibii lɛ eko.’ ”
Smirna asafo lɛ
8 “Ni Smirna asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii ni klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ, mɔ ni gbo ni ehiɛ kã ekoŋŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ: 9 Mile omanehulu lɛ kɛ ohia lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ niiatsɛ ji bo, ni mile mɛi ni kɛ oshekuyeli kɛɔ akɛ Yudafoi ji amɛ, yɛ be mli ni jeee nakai ni, shi moŋ amɛ ji Satan kpeehe lɛ mli bii. 10 Kaashe amanehulu ni obaana lɛ ekoeko gbeyei. Naa, abonsam baaŋɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi awo tsuŋ, koni akɛka nyɛ, ni nyɛaana amanehulu gbii nyɔŋma. Feemɔ anɔkwafo kɛyashi gbele mli, ni mahã bo wala akekre lɛ. 11 Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ. Kunimyelɔ lɛ, gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ efeŋ lɛ efɔŋ ko.’ ”
Pergamo asafo lɛ
12 “Ni Pergamo asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, Nii ni mɔ ni hiɛ tsi kɛ enaa nta ni naa ba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ: 13 Mile he ni oyɔɔ lɛ, he ni Satan maŋtsɛ sɛi yɔɔ lɛ; ni ohiɛ migbɛi lɛ mli, ni okwaaa minɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ be mli ni agbe Antipa, midasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ Satan shihilɛhe lɛ. 14 Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ bo yɛ sane fioo yɛ ohe, no ji akɛ oyɛ mɛi yɛ jɛi ni hiɛ Bileam tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; Bileam ni tsɔ̃ɔ Balak akɛ etsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ atsɔ̃ne ni amɛye wɔji afɔleshãanii ni amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ. 15 Nakai nɔŋŋ hu oyɔɔ mɛi ni hiɛ Nikolaimɛi atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli. 16 No hewɔ lɛ, tsakemɔ otsui! Shi kɛji jeee nakai lɛ, maba onɔ oya ni mikɛ amɛ aaabawu kɛ midaaŋ tsi lɛ. 17 Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ. Mɔ ni yeɔ kunim lɛ, mahã lɛ mana ni akɛtee lɛ eko, ni mahã lɛ tɛ yɛŋ, ni tɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋma gbɛi hee ni mɔ ko leee akɛ ja mɔ ni náa lɛ.”
Tiatira asafo lɛ
18 “Ni Tiatira asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ,
“Nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi ni enaji tamɔ ayawa kaŋkaŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ. 19Mile onitsumɔi lɛ kɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ kɛ osɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ohiɛmiamɔ lɛ, ni mile onitsumɔi lɛ akɛ sɛɛkpee nii lɛ fe tsutsunii lɛ tete. 20 Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ bo yɛ sane ko, akɛ oŋmɛ yoo Isabel ni tsɛɔ ehe gbalɔ yoo lɛ gbɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ mitsuji lɛ anii, ni elakaa amɛ ni amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ ni amɛye wɔji afɔleshãanii. 21Ni mihã lɛ be koni ekɛtsake etsui, shi esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ etsake ni efɔ̃ɔ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ. 22Naa, mikɛ lɛ miifɔ̃ hela saa nɔ, ni mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ fite gbãlã lɛ hu miiwo amanehulu kpeteŋkple mli, belɛ ja amɛtsake amɛtsui ni amɛshi enitsumɔi lɛ. 23 Ni ebii lɛ, gbe magbe amɛ; ni asafoi lɛ fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ mi ji mɔ ni taoɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ tsuii amli, ni mahã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enyɔmɔwo bɔ ni nyɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
24“Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Tiatira lɛ, mɛi abɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli ni amɛleee ‘Satan teemɔŋ nibii ni mli kwɔlɔ’, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ lɛ, akɛ, Mikɛ jatsu kroko eŋmɛŋ nyɛnɔ; 25 shi nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛa mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba. 26Ni kunimyelɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni hiɛɔ minitsumɔi lɛ amli kɛyashiɔ naagbee lɛ, mahã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ, 27 tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mina kɛjɛ miTsɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ dadetso aaakpala amɛ ni eeejwara amɛ tamɔ ajwaraa su gbɛi; 28ni maŋɔ tooloo lɛ mahã lɛ. 29 Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 3
Content:
Sarde asafo lɛ
1 “Ni Sarde asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii ni mɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ kɛ ŋulamii kpawo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ: Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; mile akɛ ohiɛ gbɛi akɛ ohiɛ kã, shi ogbo. 2 Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, ni owaje nii ni eshwɛ ni heɔ agboi lɛ. Ejaakɛ minako onitsumɔi lɛ akɛ amɛye emuu yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ. 3 No hewɔ lɛ, kaimɔ nɔ ni ona ni onu lɛ, ni oye nɔ, ni otsake otsui. Shi kɛ ohiɛ etsɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ, maba tamɔ julɔ, ni oleŋ nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni maba onɔ kwraa. 4 Shi kɛ̃lɛ oyɛ mɛi fioo ko yɛ Sarde, mɛi ni woko amɛtadei lɛ amuji; ni amɛkɛ mi baanyiɛ yɛ atadei yɛji amli, ejaakɛ amɛsa nakai. 5 Kunimyelɔ lɛ aaawo lɛ atadei yɛji, ni migbeŋ egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko, ni magba mli matsi egbɛi tã yɛ miTsɛ hiɛ kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ. 6“Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.”
Filadelfia asafo lɛ
7 “Ni Filadelfia asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ,
“Nii ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, anɔkwafo lɛ, mɔ ni hiɛ David samfee lɛ, mɔ ni gbeleɔ ni mɔ ko ŋaaa, ni eŋaa hu ni mɔ ko gbeleee lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 8 Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; naa, mikɛ shinaa ni agbele ema ohiɛ ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ aŋa; ejaakɛ hewalɛ fioo oyɔɔ shi oye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okwako migbɛi lɛ. 9 Naa, mikɛ mɛi ni jɛ Satan kpeehe lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ Yudafoi ji amɛ shi ebɛ mli, shi malemɔ moŋ amɛmaleɔ lɛ aaaba ni amɛbakoto onaji anaa, ni amɛle akɛ mi lɛ miisumɔ bo. 10 Ejaakɛ oye miwiemɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Miamɔ ohiɛ’ lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mato bo shweshweeshwe yɛ kaa ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni baaba jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛbaaka mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli. 11 Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ; hiɛmɔ nɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ mli ni awa, koni mɔ ko akashɔ̃ okekre lɛ! 12 Kunimyelɔ lɛ, mafee lɛ akulashiŋ yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni ejeŋ kpo dɔŋŋ. Ni maŋma miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi, kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ maŋ ni ji Yerusalɛm hee ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi kpelekeɔ shi kɛjɛɔ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ gbɛi kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi hee lɛ yɛ enɔ. 13Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.”
Laodikea asafo lɛ
14 “Ni Laodikea asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ,
“Nii ni Amen lɛ ni ji odasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ kɛ anɔkwayelɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nibɔɔ lɛ shishijee lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 15 Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; mile akɛ obɛ ŋanii ni obɛ klakla hu. Mina ni kulɛ ofee ŋanii loo ofee klakla! 16Shi nɛkɛ nɛɛ, akɛni kulɔkulɔ oyɔɔ ni obɛ ŋanii ni obɛ klakla hu hewɔ lɛ, mibafɛ̃ bo yɛ midaaŋ mashwie. 17 Ejaakɛ okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Niiatsɛ ji mi ni miyɛ nii, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehĩaaa mi.’ Ni oleee akɛ ohao ni onii hu yɛ mɔbɔ ni ohiafo kɛ shwilafo kɛ heyayaitsɛ ji bo. 18 Miiwo oŋaa akɛ ohe shika ni atsuu he yɛ la mli yɛ miŋɔɔ koni ona nii, kɛ atadei yɛji, koni owo ni oyayaiaŋ hiɛgbele lɛ akakã jaanɔ; ni ohe hiŋmɛi tsofa ni okɛfɔ ohiŋmɛii anɔ koni ona nii. 19 Mi lɛ, mɛi abɔ ni midɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, mikãa amɛ ni mitsɔseɔ amɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ohiɛ adɔ ni otsake otsui. 20 Naa, Midamɔ shinaa lɛ naa ni miishi; kɛji mɔ ko nu migbee ni egbele shinaa lɛ, maba eŋɔɔ ni mikɛ lɛ aaabaye nii, ni lɛ hu ekɛ mi aaaye. 21 Kunimyelɔ lɛ mahã ekɛ mi ata mimaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mi hu miye kunim ni mikɛ miTsɛ ta emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
22“Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 4
Content:
Jamɔ yɛ ŋwɛi
1 Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa, shinaa ko ni agbele yɛ ŋwɛi; ni klɛŋklɛŋ gbee ni minu ni tamɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni kɛ mi wie lɛ kɛɛ, “Kwɔɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nii ni sa akɛ aba mli yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ.” 2 Kɛkɛ lɛ amrɔ lɛ mumɔ lɛ yi minɔ; ni naa, maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ko ma shi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni mɔ ko ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ. 3 Ni mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ, kɛ aakwɛ lɛ lɛ, etamɔ yaspi kɛ sardio, ni kwaabuɛtɛ ebɔle maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ, ni kɛ aakwɛ lɛ, etamɔ smaragdo. 4 Ni maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ mamɔ shi kɛkpe, ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ tara sɛ̃ii lɛ anɔ; amɛwo atadei yɛji, ni shika akekrei fimɔ amɛyitsei. 5 Ni srawai kɛ gbɛɛmɔi kɛ nyɔŋmɔshimɔi jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli, ni la hai kpawo ni tsoɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ. 6 Ni nɔ ko tamɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ ni tamɔ kristalo yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ.
Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ ni hiŋmɛii eyimɔ amɛhiɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ ehewɔ. 7 Klɛŋklɛŋ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tamɔ jata, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ tsina, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hiɛ tamɔ gbɔmɔ, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ tamɔ okropɔŋ ni miifiliki. 8 Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji ekpaa, ni amɛhewɔ kɛ amɛmli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ hiŋmɛii, ni amɛjɔɔɔ amɛhe nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ,
“Krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Nuŋtsɔ
Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ,
mɔ ni yɛ momo lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ
kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ.”
9Ni be ni hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ŋɔɔ anunyam kɛ agbojee kɛ shidaa amɛhãa mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ni ehiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ, 10 onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ hoɔ gbeɔ shi yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛjaa mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ, ni amɛshɛrɛɔ amɛkekrei lɛ amɛshwieɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ,
11“WɔNuŋtsɔ kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ,
osa akɛ oŋɔ anunyam kɛ woo kɛ hewalɛ lɛ,
ejaakɛ bo obɔ nii fɛɛ,
ni osuɔmɔ naa abɔ amɛ ni amɛyɔɔ wala.”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 5
Content:
Wolo ni asɔo naa lɛ
1 Ni mina wolo ko yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ ninejurɔ, ni aŋma nii yɛ emli kɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ, ni asɔo naa kɛ naasɔomɔi kpawo. 2Ni mina bɔfo hewalɔ ko miishiɛ kɛ gbee wulu akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ ni sa akɛ egbele wolo lɛ naa ni etserɛ enaasɔomɔi lɛ?” 3Ni anãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ ŋwɛi loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi ni aaanyɛ wolo lɛ naa agbele loo mli akwɛ. 4Ni mifo aahu, ejaakɛ anãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko ni sa akɛ egbele wolo lɛ naa loo ekwɛ mli. 5 Ni onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaafo! Naa, jata lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ ni ji David shishifã lɛ, eye kunim ni ebaanyɛ egbele wolo lɛ naa ní etserɛ enaasɔomɔi kpawo lɛ.”
6 Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ teŋ kɛ onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Toobi ko damɔ shi tamɔ nɔ ni agbe lɛ, ni eyɛ akloŋtoi kpawo kɛ hiŋmɛii kpawo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ ni atsu kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ. 7Ni eba ni ebahe wolo lɛ yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ ninejurɔ.
Mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ alala hee
8 Ni be ni ehe wolo lɛ, hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛ onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ho gbee shi yɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ saŋku kɛ shika tɔi kɛ amɛmli tsofaikɛŋma obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ. 9 Ni amɛla lala hee ko amɛkɛɛ,
“Osa akɛ oheɔ wolo lɛ ni otserɛɔ enaasɔomɔi lɛ,
ejaakɛ agbe bo, ni okɛ olá lɛ ekpɔ̃ mɛi ehã Nyɔŋmɔ
kɛjɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ kɛ
jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ mli.
10 Ni okɛ amɛ efee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ osɔfoi ohã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
ni amɛaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
Ŋwɛi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ lala
11 Ni mikwɛ, ni minu bɔfoi pii ni ebɔle maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛkpe lɛ agbee, ni amɛyibɔ huuhai abɔ kɛ akpe toi abɔ
12 ni amɛkɛ gbee wulu kɛɛ akɛ,
“Toobi ni agbe lɛ
sa hewalɛ kɛ nifalɛ kɛ nilee kɛ nyɛmɔ
kɛ woo kɛ anunyam kɛ jɔɔmɔ.”
13Ni minu ni bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ kɛɛ akɛ,
“Jɔɔmɔ kɛ woo kɛ anunyam kɛ nɔyeli
ahã mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ
kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ!”
14 Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛɛ “Amen!” Ni onukpai lɛ ho gbee shi, ni amɛja.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 6
Content:
Naasɔomɔi lɛ
1 Ni mina akɛ Toobi lɛ tse naasɔomɔi kpawo lɛ ekome; ni minu ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ gbee ni tamɔ nyɔŋmɔshimɔ gbee kɛɛ, “Ba!” 2 Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ, ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ hiɛ gãi, ni ahã lɛ akekre, ni eje kpo tamɔ kunimyelɔ ni miiya eyaye kunim.
3 Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, minu ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ba!” 4Ni okpɔŋɔ kroko ni tsuɔ je kpo, ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ, ahã lɛ hegbɛ ni ejie hejɔlɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni mɛi agbegbee amɛhe, ni ahã lɛ klante kpeteŋkple ko.
5 Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, minu ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ba!” Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ diŋ ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ hiɛ nsɛni yɛ edɛŋ. 6Ni minu gbee ko yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ miikɛɛ, “Ŋmaa susumɔnɔ kome denario, ni abele susumɔnii etɛ̃ denario; ni mu kɛ wain lɛ kaata he!”
7 Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, minu hiɛkãalɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ gbee miikɛɛ, “Ba!” 8 Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ lamlulamlu ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Gbele, ni Gbohiiaje nyiɛ esɛɛ kpaakpa. Ni ahã amɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mlijai ejwɛ mli ekome nɔ, akɛ amɛkɛ klante kɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ gbele hela kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi awuyelɔi agbegbee amɛ.
9 Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ, mina mɛi ni agbe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ odase ni amɛye lɛ hewɔ lɛ asusumai yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. 10 Ni amɛbolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ anɔkwafo, mɛɛ beyinɔ po oookojo ni oootɔ wɔla lɛ he owele yɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ?” 11 Ni akɛ atade yɛŋ hã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛjɔɔ amɛhe be fioo ko lolo, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛnanemɛi tsuji lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu ni abaagbe amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni agbe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ aaashɛ.
12 Ni mina be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ, ni naa, shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni hulu tsɔ ediŋ tamɔ kpekpe ni akɛ yitsɔi fee, ni nyɔɔŋtsere muu lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ lá; 13 ni ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ tserɛ shwie shikpɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni agbãmitso yi agbãmii ŋmilikitii tserɛɔ shwieɔ shi kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kpeteŋkple hoso agbãmitso lɛ. 14 Ni ŋwɛi tsi ehe kɛtee sɛɛ tamɔ wolo ni aakota; ni atsirɛ gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔkpɔ fɛɛ ŋshɔkpɔ kɛje egbɛhe.
15 Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ji lumɛi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ hewalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɔji fɛɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi fɛɛ yateetee amɛhe yɛ bui amli kɛ gɔji atɛsai amli, 16 ni amɛkɛɛ gɔji lɛ kɛ tɛsai lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbagbea wɔnɔ ni nyɛtea wɔnɔ ni wɔkana mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ mlifu lɛ! 17 Ejaakɛ emlifu gbi wulu lɛ eshɛ, ni namɔ aaanyɛ shi adamɔ?”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 7
Content:
Israelbii akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ
1 Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mina ŋwɛi bɔfoi ejwɛ damɔ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, ni amɛhiɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ amli, koni kɔɔyɔɔ ko akatswa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo ŋshɔ nɔ loo tso ko nɔ. 2Ni mina bɔfo kroko miikwɔ kɛmiijɛ hulu shiteehe kɛmiiba, ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ naasɔomɔnɔ, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni ahã amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛfee shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ 3 akɛ, “Nyɛkafea shikpɔŋ lɛ loo ŋshɔ lɛ loo tsei lɛ efɔŋ ko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔkɛ naasɔomɔnɔ aaakadi wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji lɛ ahiɛŋtsei anɔ dã.” 4 Ni minu mɛi ni akɛ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ ekadi amɛ lɛ ayibɔ: Mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ ni akɛ naasɔomɔnɔ ekadi amɛ kɛjɛ Israelbii lɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso mli: 5Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ akɛ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ kadi mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Ruben akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Gad akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; 6Asher akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Naftali akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Manase akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; 7Simeon akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Levi akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Isakar akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; 8Zebulon akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Yosef akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Benyamin akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Asafo kpele lɛ
9 Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa, asafo kpele ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ akane ni jɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ kɛ akutsei kɛ maji kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi amli damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛwo atadei yɛji, ni amɛhiɛ blɛoi yɛ amɛdɛŋ, 10 ni amɛbolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa amɛkɛɛ, “Yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Toobi lɛ nɔ!” 11 Ni bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ahe kɛkpe, ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ 12 amɛkɛɛ, “Amen! Jɔɔmɔ kɛ anunyam kɛ nilee kɛ shidaa kɛ woo kɛ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ahã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!”
13Ni onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome bi mi akɛ, “Mɛi ni wo atadei yɛji nɛɛ, namɛi ni, ni nɛgbɛ amɛjɛ?” 14 Ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, bo ole” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni jɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple lɛ mli lɛ, ni amɛfɔ amɛtadei lɛ ahe, ni amɛhã eyɛ futaa yɛ Toobi lɛ lá lɛ mli. 15 No hewɔ ni amɛyɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛjaa lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane yɛ eSɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ; ni mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛsɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaashi ebuu lɛ eto amɛnɔ. 16 Hɔ̃mɔ yeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ, ni kumai hu yeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ hulu eshaŋ amɛ ni latsaa ko etsaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ; 17 ejaakɛ Toobi lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ teŋ lɛ aaalɛ amɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛaatee wala nubui ahe. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yaafonui fɛɛ.”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 8
Content:
Naasɔomɔnɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ
1 Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔnɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ, afee diŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswaa fã. 2 Ni mina bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni akɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi kpawo hã amɛ. 3 Ni bɔfo kroko ba ni ebadamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ehiɛ shika tsofakɛŋma shãanɔ, ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma babaoo hã lɛ, koni ekɛfata krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ fɛɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ ahe yɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ lɛ nɔ. 4 Ni tsofakɛŋma lɛ lasu lɛ te shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛjɛ bɔfo lɛ dɛŋ, ni krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ fata he. 5 Ni bɔfo lɛ kɔ tsofakɛŋma shãanɔ lɛ, ni eje efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ la lɛ eko ewo lɛ obɔ̃, ni etsi eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kɛ gbɛɛmɔi kɛ srawagbalamɔi kɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ ba.
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi ejwɛ lɛ
6Ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi kpawo lɛ saa amɛhe koni amɛkpã.
7 Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ kɛ la ni lá futu mli ba ni ebashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni tsei amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni jwɛi fɔ fɛɛ shã.
8 Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ashɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ gɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni shãa kɛ la afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ, ni ŋshɔ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ lá.
9Ni ŋshɔ lɛ mli bɔɔnii ni yɔɔ wala lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome gboi, ni lɛji lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome fite. 10 Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ŋulami kpeteŋkple ni tsoɔ tamɔ haa jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shi, ni egbee fai lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nubui lɛ anɔ. 11 Ni ŋulami lɛ gbɛi ji taatso, ni nui lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ taatso ni gbɔmɛi pii gboi yɛ nui lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛmiijoo.
12 Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ kpã etrɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni atswa hulu mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome nɔ, amɛmlijai etɛ̃ mli ekomekome lɛ wo duŋ, ni shwane mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ jeŋ tseee ni nyɔɔŋ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
13 Ni mikwɛ, ni minu okropɔŋ ko miifiliki yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Kpoo! Kpoo! Kpoo hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ bɔfoi etɛ̃ ni eshwɛ lɛ atɛtrɛmantrɛi ni amɛbaakpã lɛ agbɛɛmɔi lɛ ahewɔ!”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 9
Content:
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji enumɔ lɛ
1 Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni mina ŋulami ko jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa samfee lɛ hã lɛ. 2 Ni egbele bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa, ni lasu te shi kɛjɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kpeteŋkple mli lasu, ni hulu kɛ atatuiaŋ wo duŋ yɛ bu lɛ mli lasu lɛ hewɔ. 3 Ni baalabii jɛ lasu lɛ mli kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ahã amɛ hewalɛ tamɔ hewalɛ ni shikpɔŋ nɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi yɔɔ lɛ; 4 ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkafee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛi loo baaŋmɔŋ loo tso ko efɔŋ ko, akɛ ja gbɔmɛi ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ okadi yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ lɛ kɛkɛ. 5Ni ahãaa amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi moŋ akɛ amɛpiŋ amɛ nyɔji enumɔ. Ni amɛnaajaramɔ tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakro naajaramɔ, kɛ etsɛ̃ mɔ lɛ. 6 Ni nakai gbii lɛ amli lɛ gbɔmɛi aaatao gbele, shi amɛnaŋ, ni amɛaashwe ni amɛgboi, shi gbele aaajo amɛnaa foi.
7 Ni baalabii lɛ asubaŋ tamɔ okpɔŋɔi ni asaa ahã ta, ni nibii komɛi fimɔ amɛyitsei tamɔ shika akekrei, ni amɛhiɛiaŋ tamɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ; 8 ni amɛyitsɔi tamɔ yei ayitsɔi, ni amɛnyanyɔji tamɔ jatai anɔ; 9ni amɛwo damai tamɔ dade damai, ni amɛfijiaŋ gbɛɛmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ shwiilii babaoo ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiya ta agbɛɛmɔ. 10 Ni amɛyɛ leii tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi aleii kɛ amɛnaa gãii, ni amɛyɛ hewalɛ yɛ amɛleii lɛ amli ni amɛkɛaafee gbɔmɛi efɔŋ nyɔji enumɔ. 11 Ni amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ ji bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ bɔfo lɛ, ni atsɛɔ egbɛi yɛ Hebri wiemɔ lɛ mli akɛ Abadon, ni Hela wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛ Apolion.
12 Kpoo kome eho; naa, kpoi enyɔ miiba lolo yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ.
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji ekpaa lɛ
13 Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ akloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ mli 14 ni miikɛɛ bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ akɛ, “Fɛnemɔ bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni afimɔ amɛ yɛ Eufrate Faa kpeteŋkple lɛ naa lɛ!” 15 Ni afɛne bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni asaa ato ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ kɛ gbi lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ lɛ kɛ afi lɛ, koni amɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome. 16Ni tabilɔi ni tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ lɛ ayibɔ ji akpe toi akpei ohai enyɔ; minu amɛyibɔ lɛ. 17Ni bɔ ni mina okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔtaralɔi lɛ yɛ ninaa lɛ mli nɛ: amɛwo damai ni hiɛ là kɛ safiro kɛ swɔɔ su; ni okpɔŋɔi lɛ ayitsei tamɔ jatai ayitsei, ni là kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ. 18Nɛkɛ haomɔi etɛ̃ ni ji là kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ ni fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ nɛɛ, akɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome. 19Ejaakɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahewalɛ yɛ amɛdaaŋ kɛ amɛleii amli, ejaakɛ amɛleii lɛ tamɔ onufui aleii, ni yitsei yɛ he, ni nomɛi amɛkɛfeɔ efɔŋ.
20 Ni gbɔmɛi ni shwɛ ni nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ egbeee amɛ lɛ, amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛdiɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe. Amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ ayawa kɛ tɛ kɛ tso amãgãi ni nyɛɛɛ amɛna nii loo amɛnu nii loo amɛnyiɛ lɛ ajamɔ. 21Ni asaŋ amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛgbɔmɔgbee kɛ amɛsuu kɛ amɛjwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ amɛjuu lɛ ahe.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 10
Content:
Bɔfo lɛ kɛ wolo bibioo lɛ
1 Ni mina bɔfo hewalɔ kroko jɛ ŋwɛi miikpeleke shi, ni eha atatu, ni kwaabuɛtɛ yɛ eyiteŋ, ni ehiɛ tamɔ hulu, ni enaji tamɔ la akulashiŋi. 2 Ni ehiɛ wolo bibioo ko ni agbele naa yɛ edɛŋ; ni ekɛ enanejurɔ ma ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ekɛ enane abɛku hu ma shikpɔŋ nɔ. 3 Ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa, tamɔ jata huuɔ; ni be ni eboɔ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbei. 4 Ni be ni nyɔŋmɔ shiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbei lɛ, kulɛ miiŋma; ni minu gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, “Sɔomɔ nii ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wie lɛ anaa oto, ni oka ŋma.”
5 Ni bɔfo lɛ ni mina akɛ edamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ wó eninejurɔ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, 6 ni etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ gbɛi ekɛkã kitã akɛ, “Be ko be ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, 7 shi moŋ be mli ni aaanu bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee be ni eehé ekpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, no lɛ agbe Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ hu naa, bɔ ni ejaje etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ.”
8 Ni gbee ni minu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Yaa ni oyahe wolo lɛ ni agbele naa lɛ yɛ bɔfo ni damɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.” 9 Ni mitee bɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni miyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ wolo bibioo lɛ ahã mi.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hemɔ ni oye, ni eeejoo yɛ omusuŋ, shi odaaŋ moŋ lɛ eeeŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ tamɔ wo.” 10Ni mihe wolo bibioo lɛ yɛ bɔfo lɛ dɛŋ ni miye ni eŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo, shi be ni miye lɛ, ejoo yɛ mimusu mli.
11Ni akɛɛ mi akɛ, “Esa akɛ ogba gbalɛ ni kɔɔ maji kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ majianɔ wiemɔi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi pii ahe ekoŋŋ.”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 11
Content:
Odasefoi enyɔ lɛ
1 Ni ahã mi glã ko ni tamɔ nisusumɔ tso, ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi ni oyasusu Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni okane mɛi ni jaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ mli lɛ. 2 Ni kpo ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, shi no sɛɛ ni okasusu no, ejaakɛ akɛhã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni amɛaanaanaa maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ. 3 Ni mahã midasefoi enyɔ lɛ hegbɛ ni amɛgba gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni amɛwo kpekpe.”
4 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ kanetsei enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ. 5 Ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao afee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, la jeɔ amɛdaaŋ ni ekpãtãa amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ; ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao akɛ efee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ agbeɔ lɛ. 6 Mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛŋaa ŋwɛi naa, koni nu akanɛ yɛ amɛgbalɛ bei lɛ amli; ni amɛyɛ hegbɛ hu yɛ nui lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhãa etsɔ̃ɔ lá, ni amɛkɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ haoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shii abɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ.
7 Ni kɛ amɛgbe amɛdaseyeli lɛ naa lɛ, kooloo lɛ ni jɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛ amɛ baawu ta, ni eeeye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eeegbe amɛ; 8 ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaajwere maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ blohu lɛ mli, maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ mli akɛ Sodom kɛ Ijipt lɛ, he ni asɛŋ amɛNuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ. 9Ni mɛi komɛi ni jɛ maji lɛ kɛ akutsei lɛ kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ aaakwɛ amɛgbohii lɛ gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ŋ ni afu amɛ. 10Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaanya yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ, ni amɛ aaamajemajee amɛhe keenii, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbalɔi enyɔ nɛɛ piŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. 11 Ni gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ wala mumɔ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba amɛmli, ni amɛte shi amɛdamɔ amɛnaji anɔ, ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔmɔ mɛi ni na amɛ lɛ. 12 Ni amɛnu gbee waa ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɔa kɛbaa biɛ nɛɛ!” Ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ atatu mli, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ na amɛ. 13 Ni nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni maŋ lɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome wule, ni shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe gbɔmɛi akpei kpawo, ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛkɛ anunyam hã ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
14 Kpoo ni ji enyɔ lɛ eho; naa, kpoo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ miiba oya.
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji kpawo lɛ
15 Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni anu gbei wuji yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, “Je nɛɛ mli maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ eKristo lɛ nɔ, ni eeeye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ!” 16 Ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ ni tara amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ 17 amɛkɛɛ,
“Wɔmiida bo shi, bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ,
bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ ni oyɛ ni obaaba lɛ,
akɛ oŋɔ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni oye maŋtsɛ!
18 Ni jeŋmaji lɛ amli efu.
Ni omlifu be lɛ eshɛ kɛ be
ni abaakojo gbohii lɛ.
Ni abaawo otsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ
kɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ ogbɛi lɛ gbeyei,
mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ anyɔmɔ.
Ni abaafite mɛi ni fiteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ!”
19 Ni agbele Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ana ekpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ yɛ eSɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni srawai gbala kɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni nyɔŋmɔ shimɔ ni shikpɔŋ hoso ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi babaoo nɛ.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 12
Content:
Yoo lɛ kɛ Drako lɛ
1Ni ana naakpɛɛ okadi kpeteŋkple ko yɛ ŋwɛi: yoo ko ni hulu ha ehe, ni nyɔɔŋtsere yɛ enajiaŋshi, ni ŋulamii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ akekre fi eyitso. 2 Ehiɛ musu ni fɔmɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ nɔnaa ehã eebolɔ.
3 Ni ana naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, ni naa, drako tsuru kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma, ni maŋtsɛ faii kpawo bumɔ eyitsei lɛ. 4 Ni elei miigbala ŋwɛi ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome; ni etsirɛ amɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni drako lɛ badamɔ yoo ni baafɔ lɛ hiɛ, koni kɛ efɔ lɛ, ni emi ebi lɛ. 5 Ni yoo lɛ fɔ binuu ni kɛ dadetso baakpala jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ; ni asha ebi lɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ masɛi. 6 Ni yoo lɛ jo foi kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko, he ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto ehã lɛ lɛ, koni ayalɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
7 Ni ta te shi yɛ ŋwɛi, Mikael kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ fã drako lɛ nɔ ta. Ni drako lɛ bɔfoi fata ehe kɛwu, 8ni aye drako kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ anɔ, ni asaŋ amɛnaaa gbɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi. 9 Ni ashɛ drako kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ji blema onufu lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abonsam loo Satan lɛ ni shishiuɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ashɛrɛ ebɔfoi lɛ hu ashwie afata ehe.
10 Ni minu gbee wulu ko yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni hegbɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ eKristo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ ashɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ anaaflɔlɔ lɛ ni folɔɔ amɛnaa yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ afɔ̃. 11 Ni amɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ lá lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛdaseyeli wiemɔ lɛ eye enɔ kunim, ni amɛdɔɔɔ amɛwala he kɛyashi gbele mli tete. 12No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ ŋwɛii kɛ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ jɛi, nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ! Shi kpoo hã shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ! Ejaakɛ abonsam lɛ ekpeleke shi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, egri naakpa, ejaakɛ ele akɛ be fioo kɛkɛ eyɔɔ.”
13Ni be ni drako lɛ na akɛ ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, etiu yoo lɛ ni fɔ binuu lɛ. 14 Ni akɛ okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ hã yoo lɛ, koni efiliki ni eshi onufu lɛ kɛya ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ egbɛhe lɛ, he ni alɛɔ lɛ yɛ afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ. 15Ni onufu lɛ fɛ̃ nu ni tamɔ faa ko kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie yoo lɛ sɛɛ, koni nu lɛ asha lɛ kɛya. 16Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ ye bua yoo lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ gbele edaaŋ ni emii faa lɛ ni drako lɛ fɛ̃ kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie lɛ. 17 Kɛkɛ ni drako lɛ mli fu yoo lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ yoo lɛ shwiei ni eshwɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni amɛhiɛ Yesu Kristo odase lɛ mli lɛ ayawu. 18Ni eyadamɔ ŋshɔ naa shia lɛ nɔ.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 13
Content:
Kooloi enyɔ lɛ
1 Ni mina kooloo ko miije kpo kɛmiijɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli kɛmiiba kɛ eklontoi nyɔŋma kɛ eyitsei kpawo, ni maŋtsɛ faii nyɔŋma bumɔ eklontoi lɛ, ni musubɔɔ gbɛi yɛ eyitsei lɛ ahe. 2 Ni kooloo lɛ ni mina lɛ tamɔ mlaŋtswi, ni enaji tamɔ oshishibrishi naji, ni enaabu tamɔ jata naabu. Ni drako lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple hã lɛ. 3 Ni mina eyitsei lɛ ateŋ ekome tamɔ nɔ ni epila gbele pilamɔ, ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ kooloo lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe, 4ni amɛja drako lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ hegbɛ lɛ ehã kooloo lɛ, ni amɛja kooloo lɛ hu amɛkɛɛ, “Namɔ tamɔ kooloo lɛ, ni namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ lɛ awu?”
5 Ni ahã lɛ naabu ni wieɔ wiemɔi wuji kɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi, ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee enɛ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ. 6Ni egbele enaa ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ewie egbɛi lɛ kɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe musubɔɔ wiemɔi. 7 Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ awu ni eye amɛnɔ kunim; ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ nɔ. 8 Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaja lɛ. Ja mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋma egbɛi kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee yɛ Toobi ni agbe lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɛkɛ.
9Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nii. 10 Kɛji ato akɛ aŋɔ mɔ ko nom lɛ, aaaŋɔ lɛ nom; ni kɛ ato akɛ akɛ klante agbe mɔ ko lɛ, klante akɛaagbe lɛ. Biɛ wɔnaa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ yɛ.
11 Ni mina kooloo kroko miije kpo kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ eklontoi enyɔ tamɔ toobi akloŋtoi, ni wieɔ tamɔ drako. 12 Ni etsuɔ klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ hegbɛ lɛ fɛɛ he nii yɛ ehiɛ, ni ehãa shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ jaa klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ. 13 Ni efeɔ okadii wuji, ni ehãa la po jɛɔ ŋwɛi baa shikpɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ. 14 Ni ekɛ okadii ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee yɛ kooloo lɛ hiɛ lɛ shishiuɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ amɛfee amãgã amɛhã kooloo lɛ ni klante naa pilamɔ yɔɔ ehe ni ehiɛ kã lɛ. 15Ni ahã lɛ gbɛ ni ekɛ mumɔ ahã kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ, koni kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ awie tete, ni ehã agbe mɛi fɛɛ ni jaaa kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ. 16 Ni ehã akadiɔ mɛi fɛɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi, odehei kɛ nyɔji yɛ amɛninejurɔ loo amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ. 17Koni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ehe nii aloo ehɔ̃ɔ nii, akɛ ja mɔ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ji kooloo lɛ gbɛi loo yibɔ ni damɔ shi hã egbɛi lɛ.
18 Biɛ nilee he ehia yɛ. Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ abu kooloo lɛ yibɔ lɛ he akɔntaa; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yibɔ ni; ni eyibɔ lɛ ji ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 14
Content:
Toobi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ
1 Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, Toobi lɛ damɔ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ ni aŋma egbɛi kɛ eTsɛ gbɛi yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ fata ehe. 2 Ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ nui pii agbɛɛmɔ, ni asaŋ etamɔ nyɔŋmɔshimɔ kpeteŋkple gbɛɛmɔ; ni gbee ni minu lɛ tamɔ saŋkutswalɔi ni miitswa amɛsaŋkui agbee. 3 Ni amɛlaa lala hee ko yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ; ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lala lɛ akase, akɛ ja mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ. 4 Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni kɛ yei buleko amɛhe, ejaakɛ oblahii ni he tse ji amɛ, ni amɛnyiɛɔ Toobi lɛ sɛɛ kɛyaa he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ. 5 Ni anaaa amale ko yɛ amɛdaaŋ ejaakɛ kpa ko bɛ amɛhe.
6 Ni mina bɔfo kroko miifiliki yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ, ni ehiɛ naanɔ Sanekpakpa ni eyaajaje etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ kɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli. 7Ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Nyɛshea Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni nyɛkɛ anunyam ahãa lɛ ejaakɛ ekojomɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; ni nyɛjaa mɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ!”
8 Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji enyɔ nyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Egbee shi, Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ dãa lɛ eko.”
9 Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji etɛ̃ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni ekɛ gbee wulu kɛɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko ja kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ, ni ehe ekadi lɛ yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ loo enine nɔ lɛ, 10 lɛ hu eeenu Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu dãa ŋmiiŋmi ni akɛwo emlifu kpulu lɛ mli lɛ eko, ni aaapiŋ lɛ yɛ la kɛ swɔɔ mli yɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ. 11 Ni amɛpiŋmɔ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ. Ni mɛi ni jaa kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eŋɔ egbɛi okadi lɛ, nãaa hejɔɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.”
12 Biɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ni hiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ kɛ Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ he ehia yɛ.
13 Ni minu gbee jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa: Ajɔɔ gbohii lɛ ni gboiɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ. Hɛɛ, Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ, koni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe kɛjɛ amɛdeŋmegbomɔi lɛ amli ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ.”
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nikpamɔ lɛ
14 Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, atatu yɛŋ, ni mɔ ko ta nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ bi, ni shika akekre fi eyitso, ni ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba yɛ edɛŋ. 15 Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ni ebolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ onikpamɔ kakla lɛ awo mli ni okpa nii, ejaakɛ nikpamɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nikpamɔnii lɛ etsu.” 16Ni mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ enikpamɔ kakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii lɛ.
17Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ mli, ni lɛ hu ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba.
18Ni bɔfo kroko ni yɔɔ la nɔ hewalɛ je kpo kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli, ni ebo etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba lɛ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Okɛ okakla ni naa ba lɛ awo mli ni okpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ ejaakɛ ewaintso yibii lɛ etsu!” 19 Ni bɔfo lɛ shɛ ekakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ, ni ekɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ wainŋaanɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli. 20 Ni anaanaa wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ, ni lá ho kɛjɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ mli ni ekɛlɛ ji shitoi ohai enyɔ.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 15
Content:
Bɔfoi ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo lɛ
1 Ni mina naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, eda ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ: bɔfoi kpawo ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo ni ji naagbeenii lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi akɛgbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ naa.
2 Ni mina nɔ ko tamɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ ni akɛ lá efutu mli, ni mɛi ni eye kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ kɛ ekadi lɛ kɛ egbɛi lɛ yibɔ lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ damɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ saŋkui lɛ. 3 Ni amɛla Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose lala lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ lala lɛ amɛkɛɛ,
“Onitsumɔi lɛ dara ni amɛyɛ naakpɛɛ,
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe!
Ogbɛi lɛ ja ni anɔkwale ni,
bo jeŋmaji lɛ aMaŋtsɛ!
4 Namɔ po sheŋ bo gbeyei, Nuŋtsɔ,
ni ewoŋ ogbɛ́i lɛ hiɛ nyam?
Ejaakɛ bo okometoo ji Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ;
ejaakɛ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba ni amɛbaja yɛ ohiɛ,
ejaakɛ ajie ojalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ashi faŋŋ.”
