5 Ni nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni agbele Odase Buu lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi, 6 ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni amɛwo klala ni he tse ni kpɛlɛɔ kaŋkaŋ, ni amɛfimɔ amɛtsitsii kɛ shika mlifiinii. 7 Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ shika tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ mlila lɛ hã bɔfoi kpawo lɛ. 8 Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ lasu ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ mli lɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛ̃ɛɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli abote kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ahaomɔi kpawo lɛ anaa.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 16
Content:
Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu tɔi kpawo lɛ
1 Ni minu gbee ni wa ni jɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli miikɛɛ bɔfoi kpawo lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyafɔsea Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu tɔi kpawo lɛ nyɛshwiea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
2 Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ yi mli etee, ni eyafɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɛi ni kooloo lɛ okadi yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ famɔ faji fɔ̃ji ni waa mɔ he.
3 Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo ŋshɔ mli; ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gbonyo lá, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ gbo.
4 Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo fai kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ amli, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ lá. 5Ni minu nui lɛ anɔ bɔfo lɛ miikɛɛ,
“Jalɔ ji bo, bo ni oyɔɔ, ni oyɛ, ni oji
Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,
akɛni okojo nɛkɛ nɛɛ.
6Ejaakɛ amɛshwie krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ
kɛ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi.
Ni lá nɔŋŋ ohã amɛ ni amɛnu;
esa amɛ nakai!”
7 Ni minu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ miikɛɛ,
“Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe,
anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji okojomɔi lɛ!”
8Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie hulu nɔ; ni ahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛ la ashã gbɔmɛi. 9 Ni la dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ shã gbɔmɛi, ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui ni amɛwo ehiɛ nyam.
10 Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie kooloo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ wo duŋ, ni gbɔmɛi kɔ̃mɔ amɛlilɛii yɛ nɔnaa lɛ hewɔ. 11 Ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ nɔnai lɛ kɛ amɛfaji lɛ ahewɔ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe.
12 Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo Eufrate Faa agbo lɛ mli. Ni emli nu lɛ gbi, koni akɛsaa gbɛ ahã maŋtsɛmɛi ni jɛ hulu shiteehe lɛ. 13 Ni mina mumɔi etɛ̃ ni he tseee ni tamɔ kɔkɔdenei miije kpo kɛmiijɛ drako lɛ daaŋ kɛ kooloo lɛ daaŋ kɛ amalegbalɔ lɛ daaŋ. 14 Ejaakɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji amumɔi ni, ni amɛfeɔ okadii, ni amɛyaa maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ, koni amɛyabua amɛnaa amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ ta lɛ.
15 “Naa, miiba tamɔ julɔ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni saraa ni ekwɛɔ etadei lɛ anɔ lɛ, koni ekanyiɛ yayai ni ana ehiɛgbele lɛ.”
16 Ni mumɔi lɛ bua maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anaa kɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ Harmagedon lɛ.
17Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni gbee ni wa ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbe naa!” 18 Ni srawai gbala kɛ gbɛɛmɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔ shimɔ, ni shikpɔŋ hoso waa diɛŋtsɛ; nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ gbeyeigbeyei nɛɛ, asonɔkwa, anako eko dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni abɔ gbɔmɔ adesa kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ. 19 Ni maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli gbala etɛ̃, ni jeŋmaji lɛ amaji lɛ fɛɛ wule, ni akai Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ dãa kpulu lɛ ahã lɛ. 20 Ni ŋshɔkpɔ fɛɛ ŋshɔkpɔ laaje, ni gɔji lɛ anãaa dɔŋŋ. 21 Ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi agboi ni amɛtsiimɔ tamɔ talenta jɛ ŋwɛi bashwie gbɔmɛi anɔ, ni gbɔmɛi lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ ahaomɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ haomɔ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛɛ kɛba lɛ yɛ gbeyei po ni ehiii.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 17
Content:
Ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ
1 Bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba, ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, “Ba ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ta nui babaoo lɛ anɔ lɛ kojomɔ lɛ. 2 Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa lɛ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tɔrɔ dãa.”
3 Ni bɔfo lɛ kpala mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee ŋa nɔ. Ni mina yoo ko ta kooloo tsuru fɔɔ ko nɔ ni kooloo nɛɛ he fɛɛ lɛ musubɔɔ gbɛii sɔŋŋ, ni eyɛ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma. 4 Yoo lɛ wo atade afaseo diŋ kɛ etsuru fɔɔ, ni akɛ shika kɛ tɛi ni jara wa kɛ adiagbai ewula lɛ, ni ehiɛ shika kpulu yɛ edɛŋ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ mli nihiinii kɛ mujinii. 5 Ni aŋma gbɛi ko ni ji teemɔ sane yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ, “Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ajwamãŋi lɛ kɛ nihiinii lɛ anyɛ lɛ.” 6 Ni mina yoo lɛ akɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ alá lɛ kɛ Yesu he odasefoi lɛ alá lɛ etɔ lɛ dãa.
Be ni mina lɛ lɛ, minaa kpɛ mihe naakpa. 7Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ onaa ekpɛ ohe? Mibagba bo yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo ni eta nɔ ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ahe teemɔ sane lɛ. 8 Kooloo lɛ ni ona lɛ be ko mli lɛ eyɛ, shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaajɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli eje kpo kɛya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli. Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aŋmako amɛgbɛii yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ anaa aaakpɛ amɛhe kɛ amɛna kooloo lɛ akɛ be ko mli lɛ, eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaaba lɛ.
9 “Biɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni nilee yɔɔ mli he ehĩa yɛ. Yitsei kpawo lɛ ji gɔji kpawo ni yoo lɛ ta nɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ maŋtsɛmɛi kpawo hu ni. 10Amɛteŋ mɛi enumɔ egbee shi, mɔ kome yɛ, ni mɔ kome lɛ nako aba, ni kɛ eba lɛ, ja ehi shi fioo. 11 Ni kooloo lɛ ni be ko mli lɛ eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ, ni ejɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ amli, ni eeya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.”
12 “Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ni ona lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋma ni, mɛi ni maŋtsɛyeli shɛko amɛdɛŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbaana hegbɛ amɛye maŋtsɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome kɛ kooloo lɛ. 13Amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome, ni amɛkɛ amɛhewalɛ kɛ amɛhegbɛ lɛ hãa kooloo lɛ. 14 Amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ baawu, shi Toobi lɛ baaye amɛnɔ kunim, ejaakɛ lɛ ji Nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ lɛ, ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni atsɛ kɛ mɛi ni ahala kɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.”
15 Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nui lɛ ni ona ni yoo ajwamãŋ lɛ ta nɔ lɛ ji maji kɛ asafoi kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi. 16 Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma ni ona lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ amɛaanyɛ ajwamãŋ lɛ, ni amɛafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ni amɛkɛ la aaashã lɛ kɛmɔ shi. 17 Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛwo amɛtsuii amli koni amɛfee eyiŋtoonii lɛ ni amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni amɛkɛ amɛmaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã kooloo lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ aaaba mli.”
18 “Ni yoo lɛ ni ona lɛ ji maŋ kpeteŋkple ni yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ.”

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 18
Content:
Babilon shigbeemɔ
1 Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mina bɔfo kroko miikpeleke shi kɛmiijɛ ŋwɛi, ni eyɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple, ni enunyam lɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tse; 2 ni ekɛ̃ ehe shi ebo ekɛɛ, “Egbee shi, Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ni etsɔ̃ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ashihilɛhe, kɛ mumɔi ni he tseee fɛɛ atsu kɛ loofɔlɔ fɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni he tseee ni anyaŋeɔ hu tsu. 3 Ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa ni naa wa lɛ eko, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jarayelɔi lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ enyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa.”
4 Ni minu gbee kroko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, “Nyɛjea emli, mimaŋ, koni nyɛkɛ lɛ akafea eshai ni efeɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkana ehaomɔi lɛ eko. 5 Ejaakɛ ehe eshai lɛ anɔ ekwɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekai enifɔɔji anii lɛ. 6 Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu ewo lɛ, ni nyɛkua nyɛbɔa he toi enyɔ nyɛhãa lɛ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa. Kpulu lɛ ni efutu dãa yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛfutua lɛ toi enyɔ nyɛwoa mli nyɛhãa lɛ. 7 Bɔ ni ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ nyam ni ebɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ, nakai bɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛhãa epiŋmɔ kɛ ewerɛhoo lɛ afaa; ejaakɛ ekɛɔ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Mita shi akɛ maŋnyɛ, ni mijeee okulafo, ni minaŋ awerɛhoo.’ 8 No hewɔ lɛ, gbi kome nɔ ehaomɔi lɛ aaaba, gbele kɛ awerɛhoo kɛ hɔ̃mɔ, ni akɛ la aaashã lɛ butuu, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni kojoɔ lɛ he wa.”
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ayarawoo yɛ Babilon hewɔ
9 Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ ni amɛkɛ lɛ bɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ aaafo lɛ, ni amɛaawo yara yɛ hewɔ, be ni amɛaana eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ. 10 Ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ, Babilon, maŋ ni he wa lɛ! Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli ni okojomɔ eba nɛɛ!”
11 Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jarayelɔi lɛ aaafo lɛ ni amɛaaye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko heee amɛguɔ nii lɛ dɔŋŋ: 12 shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi, ojarawatɛi kɛ adiagbai, kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaseo diŋ, kɛ seda kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni jeɔ ŋma kɛ shwuɔwu nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛ tso ni wa kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ marmaratɛ fee, 13kɛ sinamon kɛ mrɔŋo kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ mire kɛ ohɛ kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ shikishaŋ kɛ ŋmaa, kɛ tsinai kɛ toi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii kɛ nyɔji kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumai. 14Jarayelɔi lɛ kɛɛ, “Ni yibii ni baa otsine lɛ eje odaaŋ, ni ŋɔɔmɔ nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni kpɛlɛɔ nyɛramnyɛram lɛ ebɔ bo, ni onaŋ amɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ.” 15Ni nibii nɛɛ aguɔyelɔi ni etsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ etsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ epiŋmɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛaafo ni amɛaaye ŋkɔmɔ 16ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple ni buɔ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaseo diŋ kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ, ni ewulaa kɛ shika kɛ ojarawatɛi kɛ adiagbai lɛ! 17Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli lɛ nɛkɛ nifalɛ babaoo nɛɛ fɛɛ ebɔ lɛ.”
Ni lɛlɛ kudɔɔtsɛ fɛɛ kudɔɔtsɛ kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nyiɛɔ lɛlɛ mli kɛyaa he ko, kɛ amlãkui kɛ mɛi abɔ ni tsuɔ ŋshɔ hiɛ nii lɛ damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, 18 ni be ni amɛna eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Aso maŋ ko ehi shi pɛŋ ni da tamɔ maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ?”
19 Ni amɛkɛ mlu wo amɛyiteaŋ, ni amɛkɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli bo amɛkɛɛ, “Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni emli mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ lɛji yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ eninamɔ lɛ nɔ amɛfee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ! Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli ni fɛɛ ebɔ lɛ nɛɛ!”
20 Bo ŋwɛi, kɛ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii kɛ bɔfoi kɛ gbalɔi, nyɛnyaa yɛ ehewɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekojo lɛ ehã nyɛ!
21 Ni bɔfo ko ni he wa wo tɛ ko ni tamɔ wiɛ wulu, ni eshɛ efɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ aaatsi Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ atswa shi waa, ni anaŋ lɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ. 22Ni anuŋ saŋkutswalɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ blɛkpãlɔi kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛkpãlɔi lɛ agbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anaŋ ŋaalɔ ko ŋaalɔ ko ni le ŋaa ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anuŋ wiɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko hu kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli. 23Ni anaŋ kane la ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anuŋ ayɛmforo wu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli; ejaakɛ ojarayelɔi lɛ ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi wuji, ni okunyaayeli lɛ akɛshishiu jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ.”
24Ni emli ana gbalɔi kɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni agbe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ala lɛ yɛ.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 19
Content:
Nyamɔ yɛ ŋwɛi
1 Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, minu gbee ni wa ni tamɔ asafo babaoo gbee yɛ ŋwɛi ni miikɛɛ, “Haleluya! Yiwalaheremɔ kɛ anunyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ! 2 Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji ekojomɔi lɛ, akɛni ekojo ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ efite shikpɔŋ lɛ ni etɔ etsuji lɛ ala lɛ he owele yɛ enɔ lɛ.” 3 Ni amɛkɛɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, “Haleluya! Ni la ni shãa maŋ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ!” 4 Ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ho gbee shi ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Amen! Haleluya!” 5 Ni gbee ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, nyɛ mɛi ni ji etsuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ fɛɛ!”
6 Ni minu gbee ko tamɔ asafo kpeteŋkple gbee kɛ nui babaoo kɛ nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi ni naa wa agbɛɛmɔ miikɛɛ, “Haleluya! Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ miiye maŋtsɛ!”
Toobi lɛ Yookpeemɔ lɛ
7 “Nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa ni wɔmli afilia wɔ ni wɔwo ehiɛ nyam! Ejaakɛ Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ lɛ eshɛ, ni eŋa lɛ esaa ehe eto. 8 Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ewo klala ni hetse ni kpɛlɛɔ nyɛramnyɛram.” Ejaakɛ klala lɛ ji krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ajalɛnii lɛ.
9 Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa, Ajɔɔ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛba Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa wiemɔi nɛ.” 10Ni miho migbee enaji anaa koni maja lɛ. Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, kaafee nakai! Bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ni hiɛ Yesu odase lɛ mli lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi. Já Nyɔŋmɔ!” Ejaakɛ Yesu he odase lɛ ji gbalɛ mumɔ lɛ.
Tatsɛ ni ta okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ nɔ lɛ
11 Ni mina ni agbele ŋwɛi naa, ni mina okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ, ni mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Anɔkwafo kɛ Anɔkwayelɔ; ni jalɛ naa ekojoɔ ni ewuɔ ta yɛ. 12Ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi, ni maŋtsɛ faii pii bumɔ eyitso, ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ he ni mɔ ko mɔ ko leee akɛ ja lɛ diɛŋtsɛ; 13ni ewo atade ni akɛtsɔ lá mli; ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ.” 14Ni tai ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tara okpɔŋɔi yɛji anɔ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛwo klala yɛŋ futaa ni he tse. 15Ni tsi ni naa ba jɛɔ edaaŋ, koni ekɛ no atswia jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anii; ni ekɛ dadetso aaakpala amɛ. Ni eeenaanaa Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ. 16Ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ etade kɛ egboŋ nɔ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ.”
Harmagedon Ta lɛ
17 Ni mina bɔfo ko damɔ hulu mli, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ loofɔji ni filikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple lɛ he, 18koni nyɛbaye maŋtsɛmɛi aloo kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi aloo kɛ hewalɔi aloo kɛ okpɔŋɔi aloo kɛ mɛi ni tara amɛnɔ lɛ aloo kɛ odehei kɛ nyɔji kɛ mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ aloo.”
19 Ni mina kooloo lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtai lɛ ni abua amɛnaa ni amɛkɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ eta lɛ ayawu. 20Ni amɔ kooloo lɛ, ni amɔ amalegbalɔ lɛ afata ehe, amalegbalɔ lɛ ni fee okadii yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛshishiu mɛi ni ŋɔ kooloo lɛ okadi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ. Ni aŋɔ kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ ni akɛ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ wo la kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli ni amɛhiɛ kãmɔ. 21Ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ, akɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ tsi ni jɛɔ edaaŋ lɛ gbe amɛ, ni loofɔji fɛɛ ye amɛloo lɛ amɛtɔrɔ.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 20
Content:
Afii Akpe Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ
1 Ni mina bɔfo ko miikpeleke shi kɛmiijɛ ŋwɛi, ni ehiɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa samfee lɛ kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ kpeteŋkple ko yɛ edɛŋ. 2 Ni emɔ drako lɛ, blema onufu lɛ ni ji abonsam kɛ Satan hu lɛ, ni efi lɛ afii akpe, 3 ni eshɛ́ lɛ efɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eŋa naa ni esɔo naa, koni ekashishiu jeŋmaji lɛ dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe afii akpe lɛ naa. Ni no sɛɛ lɛ ja afɛne lɛ be fioo ko.
4 Ni mina maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii ni mɛi ni akɛ kojomɔ ehã amɛ lɛ tara nɔ. Ni mina mɛi ni afolɔ amɛyii yɛ Yesu he odaseyeli lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ asusumai lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni jako kooloo lɛ loo emãgã lɛ ni amɛheko ekadi lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ loo amɛdɛ̃ lɛ. Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ hiɛkãalɔi ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛ Kristo ye maŋtsɛ afii akpe. 5Shi gbohii ni shwɛ lɛ ahiɛ etsɛ̃ɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe afii akpe lɛ naa. Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ shitee lɛ. 6Mɔ ni naa gbɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ shitee lɛ mli lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ. Gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ nakai mɛi lɛ anɔ; moŋ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo osɔfoi, ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ afii akpe.
Satan nɔ kunimyeli
7Ni kɛji agbe afii akpe lɛ naa lɛ, aaafɛne Satan kɛaajɛ tsu lɛ mli, 8ni ebaaje kpo ni eyashishiu jeŋmaji lɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ, Gog kɛ Magog, koni ebua amɛnaa kɛkpe ni amɛya ta. Amɛyifalɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ naa shia. 9Ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee kɛyaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛyabɔle mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ansra lɛ kɛ maŋ ni asumɔɔ lɛ kɛkpe. Ni la jɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebashã amɛ butuu. 10Ni abonsam lɛ ni shishiuɔ amɛ lɛ, ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ la kɛ swɔɔ kpaakpo lɛ mli, he ni kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ hu yɔɔ lɛ, ni aaapiŋ amɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Naagbee kojomɔ lɛ
11 Ni mina maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i yɛŋ ko ni da, kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi jo foi yɛ ehiɛ, ni amɛbɛ gbɛhe dɔŋŋ. 12 Ni mina gbohii lɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji, damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, ni agbele woji anaa; ni agbele wolo kroko ni ji wala wolo lɛ hu naa. Ni adamɔ nibii ni aŋmala yɛ woji lɛ amli lɛ anɔ akojo gbohii lɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ anaa. 13Ni ŋshɔ jie gbohii ni yɔɔ emli lɛ ehã, ni gbele kɛ gbohiiaje hu jie gbohii ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ amɛhã; ni akojo amɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa. 14 Ni gbele kɛ gbohiiaje lɛ, ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie la kpaakpo lɛ mli. Enɛ ji gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ. 15 Ni kɛji mɔ ko yɛ ni anãaa akɛ aŋma egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ, ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ la kpaakpo lɛ mli.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 21
Content:
Ŋwɛi Hee kɛ Shikpɔŋ Hee lɛ
1 Ni mina ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee; ejaakɛ tsutsu ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ tsutsu shikpɔŋ lɛ eho etee, ni ŋshɔ bɛ dɔŋŋ. 2 Ni mina Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm hee lɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi miikpeleke shi, ni asaa lɛ ato tamɔ ayɛmforo ni awula lɛ ahã ewu. 3 Ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ shihilɛhe lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni eeehi shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ emaŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛ aaahi shi. 4 Ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yafonui fɛɛ. Gbele bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni ŋkɔmɔyeli loo bolɔmɔ loo nɔnaa ko hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ tsutsunii lɛ eho etee.”
5 Ni mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Naa, miifee nii fɛɛ ehee.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa, ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli.” 6 Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Agbe naa. Mi ji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ. Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, mahã lɛ wala nubu lɛ mli nu lɛ eko yaka. 7 Kunimyelɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yelɔ, ni matsɔ eNyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ hu eeetsɔ̃ mibi. 8 Shi gbeyelɔi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi kɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi kɛ sulɔi kɛ wɔŋjalɔi kɛ amalelɔi fɛɛ lɛ, amɛna amɛgbɛhe yɛ kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ la kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli. Enɛ ji gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ.”
Yerusalɛm Hee lɛ
9 Ni bɔfoi kpawo ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ naagbee haomɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba miŋɔɔ ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, “Ba, ni matsɔ̃ bo ayɛmforo lɛ ni ji Toobi lɛ ŋa lɛ.” 10 Ni eŋɔ mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee gɔŋ kpele ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi maŋ kpeteŋkple ni ji Yerusalɛm krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi eekpleke shi, 11 ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ ni ekpɛɔ tamɔ tɛ ni jara wa waa, tamɔ yaspi ni mli tse akɛ kristalo. 12 Eyɛ gbogbo kpeteŋkple ni kwɔ kɛ agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ damɔ agboi lɛ anaa, ni aŋmala gbɛii ni ji Israelbii lɛ akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ nɔ. 13Agboi etɛ̃ yɛ bokãgbɛ ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ kooyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ anaigbɛ. 14Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ yɛ shishitoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni Toobi lɛ bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛnɔ.
15 Ni bɔfo ni kɛ mi wie lɛ hiɛ shika susumɔtso koni ekɛsusu maŋ lɛ kɛ egboi lɛ kɛ egbogbo lɛ. 16 Ni maŋ lɛ kã shi koji ejwɛ, ni ekɛlɛ tamɔ elɛɛmɔ nɔŋŋ. Ni ekɛ susumɔtso lɛ susu maŋ lɛ, ni efee shitoi akpe kome kɛ ohai enumɔ. Ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ kɛ ekwɔlɛ ye egbɔ. 17Ni esusu egbogbo lɛ efee ninetalɔi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ nisusumɔtso naa, ni ji bɔfo lɛ tso lɛ. 18Ni nɔ ni akɛtswa gbogbo lɛ ji yaspi, ni maŋ lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tamɔ ashwishwɛ krɔŋŋ ni. 19 Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ shishitoo lɛ awula amɛ kɛ tɛi ni jara wa srɔtoi fɛɛ. Klɛŋklɛŋ shishitoo lɛ yaspi, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ safiro, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kalkedɔn, nɔ ni ji ejwɛ smaragdo, 20nɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ sardonike, nɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ sardio, nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ krisolito, nɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ berilo, nɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ topasiɔn, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ krisopraso, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ hiakinto, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ amɛtisto. 21 Ni agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ adiagbai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni, agbo kome lɛ adiagba kome akɛfee. Ni maŋ lɛ blohu lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni, ni emli tse tamɔ ashwishwɛ.
22Ni minaaa Sɔlemɔtsu yɛ mli, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ ji eSɔlemɔtsu. 23 Ni hulu loo nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛmɔ he ehĩaaa maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ mli, ni Toobi lɛ ji ela. 24 Ni jeŋmaji lɛ aaanyiɛ yɛ ela lɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aaaŋɔ amɛnunyam lɛ kɛaaba mli. 25 Ni egboi lɛ aŋamɔŋ kwraa shwane, ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi. 26Ni akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anunyam lɛ kɛ amɛwoo lɛ aaaba mli. 27 Ni nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ mɔ ni maleɔ boteŋ mli kwraa akɛ ja mɛi ni aŋma amɛgbɛi yɛ Toobi lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɛkɛ.

Title: KPOJIEMƆ 22
Content:
Walanu Faa lɛ kɛ Walatso lɛ
1 Ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi walanu faa ni hiɛ kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ kristalo ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli. 2 Ni eblohu lɛ teŋ kɛ faa lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ walatso ma shi, ni ewoɔ yibii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ekome nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ, ni tso lɛ yibai lɛ akɛtsaa jeŋmaji lɛ. 3 Ni musu ko musu ko bɛ dɔŋŋ. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ aaama maŋ lɛ mli; ni etsuji lɛ aaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ; 4 ni amɛaana ehiɛ, ni egbɛi lɛ aaahi amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ. 5 Ni nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi, ni kane la loo hulu la he ehiaŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatso ahã amɛ, ni amɛaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Yesu baa ni ji enyɔ lɛ
6 Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli. Ni Nuŋtsɔ ni ji gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsu ebɔfo lɛ ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ etsuji nii ni sa akɛ aba nɔŋŋ.”
7 “Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.”
8 Ni mi, Yohane, ji mɔ ni nu ni na nii nɛɛ. Ni be ni minu ni mina lɛ miho mibu shi ni maja yɛ bɔfo lɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii nɛɛ lɛ naji anaa. 9Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, kaafee nakai! Ejaakɛ bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi. Já Nyɔŋmɔ!” 10 Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaasɔo nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. 11Mɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, eya nɔ efee nii ni ejaaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji mujiatsɛ lɛ, eya nɔ ewo ehe muji lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji jalɔ lɛ, eya nɔ efee jalɛnii, ni mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eya nɔ ehi krɔŋkrɔŋ.”
12 “Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ, ni mihiɛ minyɔmɔwo lɛ kɛmiiba, ni mawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa enitsumɔ lɛ. 13 Mi ji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ.”
14Ajɔɔ mɛi ni fɔɔ amɛtadei lɛ ahe, koni amɛna hegbɛ yɛ walatso lɛ he ní amɛtsɔ̃ agboi lɛ amli kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. 15 Shi maŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbei lɛ kɛ sulɔi lɛ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi lɛ kɛ amãgãjalɔi lɛ kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ amale ni emaleɔ yɔɔ jɛi.
16 “Mi Yesu, mitsu mibɔfo lɛ koni ebaye nii nɛɛ ahe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ amli. Mi ji David shishifã lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ, tooloo ni kpɛɔ lɛ.”
17 Ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛ Ayɛmforo lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Ba!” Ni mɔ ni nuɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ba!” Ni mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, eba, ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ lɛ, ebahe wala nu lɛ yaka.
Naagbee
18 Mi miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fata nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ haomɔi ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ afata he ahã lɛ. 19 Ni kɛji mɔ ko jie nɔ ko kɛjɛ nɛkɛ gbalɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie egbɛnaa kɛaajɛ wala wolo lɛ kɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nii ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ amli.
20Mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ he odase lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hɛɛ, miiba nɔŋŋ!’ ” Amen! Ba, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu!
21WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen!
